PHARMACY - aegle-f. Aegle folia. N. O. Rutaceae. Tincture of the leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Ascites. Asthma. Beriberi. Bites. Bronchitis. Colic. Constipation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Edema. Fever. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Impotency. Indigestion. Influenza. Jaundice. Kidney stones. Leprosy. Liver, disorders. Phlegm. Pneumonia. Rabies. Ringworm. Water brash.

HERBAL - In Bengal, the leaves of this plant are kept in the drinking pot of patients suffering from dropsy with the belief that drinking this water will accelerate the cure. The leaves of the Aegle-f. are used by the Sannyasi (monks and ascetics) of India to suppress sexual desires and excitement (Agn.) as they have found it produces sexual impotency. For seminal weakness and impotency.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Pramada Prasanna Biswas of Padna, Bengal, made a short proving of this drug using a preparation from the leaves. This remedy destroys phlegm, and is useful for fevers associated with catarrhal symptoms. Generally useful for bowel complaints. Diarrhea and dysentery. Alternating diarrhea and constipation, it acts as a mild stimulant to the intestinal mucus membrane. It can act as a laxative for existing constipation. Intestinal colic. Dropsy, particularly when due to heart disease. Continued fever associated with dropsy, especially of children. Dropsy in certain parts or throughout entire body. Bruised pains. Diminished appetite. Sensation of heat worse movement, better rest. Weakness. Leprosy. Bites from venomous animals such as snake, rabid dog and scorpion. Coughs, asthma, gonorrhea. Jaundice, ascites associated with liver disorders. Bleeding piles. Hemorrhages. Anemia. Kidney stones. Diseases of heart and hemicrania. MIND - Mistakes in spelling. Anxiety with heat and bruised feeling. Lack of concentration while studying.

Head - Heaviness of head. Heaviness, better aftertea. Heaviness of head with sneezing, malaise, chilliness. Heaviness with soreness in right eye. Heaviness, with throat pain. Heaviness with thirst. Pain in frontal region better open air, better pressure. Bursting pain, in forehead. Pressing pain in the right frontal region, with profuse sweat all over the body.

Eyes - Pain, soreness in the right eye, worse deep inspiration, sunlight, pressure. Sensation, as if sand in the eye. Watery discharge, left eye, better closing eyes. Agglutination of eyelids, worse morning.

Nose - Watery discharge bland, white, worse bathing, change in temperature, better hot inhalation. Coryza, bland white or watery discharge. Sneezing with heaviness of head, malaise, chilliness. Sneezing worse pungent odor. Tickling sensation with thin watery, bland discharge. Thick, bland and yellowish discharge with profuse salivation, disturbed sleep.

Face - Jaw, aching with soreness in throat worse chewing. Jaw, right soreness and tenderness with enlarged cervical lymph nodes on the right side worse chewing, swallowing, better warmth. Food - Appetite diminished with bad taste in mouth. Appetite diminished during fever. Appetite, increased with increased thirst and sleepiness. Thirst for large quantity of water at short intervals. Desires rice, meat, milk.

Mouth - Bitter taste in mouth. Salivation, profuse. Taste, bad with diminished appetite. Taste, bitter. Thick yellow coating on the tongue during fever. Tongue flabby with imprints of teeth on edges. Tongue thick, moist and yellow coating.

Throat - Pain, bruised, amel. hot drinks. Pain, stitching with dry cough worse during deglutition, amel. hot drinks. Soreness, worse swallowing. Soreness with aching in jaw worse chewing. Vertigo - Vertigo worse lying down. Vertigo worse physical exertion, better lying down. Vertigo worse on walking and standing. Vertigo with darkness before eyes. COMMENTS - An anti-psoric remedy, historically used for skin diseases such as itches and ringworm. An anti- bilious and febrifuge remedy. Headache due to congestion. Headache between 4 a.m. and 8 p.m. (Lyc.). Heat in the vertex appears in the evening, relieved by eating something. In the afternoon and evening, flushes of heat come out from the eyes and face, and in the ear. All these symptoms disappear after eating. Irregularity or disorder of the stomach, abdomen is distended and flatus passes with a loud sound, worse in the afternoon. Water brash. Accumulation of wind in the lower abdomen. Constipation with flatus (Lyc.). Indigestion, abdominal colic, piles and constipation (Nux-v.). Chronic gastrointestinal catarrh with flatulent colicky pains. Decreased quantity of urine. Slight pain in the back and lumbar region that is worse in the afternoon. All pains in the limbs are aggravated after four p.m. Beriberi, with a full, strong and regular pulse (Dig., with irregular or intermittent pulse). Swollen upper eyelids. Anasarca, ascites and edema of all sorts. Full, strong and regular pulse (Bell.). Chronic fevers associated with hepatic and splenic disorders, with swollen feet, burning in the eye, face, hands, and feet, no appetite, diminished urine, and cough. Continual fever. Fever with swelling in the hands, legs and face. Catarrhal fevers in children. Fever with dropsy and diarrhea. Influenza, with fever and swollen face and eyelids. Bronchitis and pneumonia. Lt. Col. R. N. Chopra asserted that none of the preparations appear to possess any specific therapeutic properties to cure either amoebic or bacillary dysentery, but its efficacy is certain in chronic cases with the keynote symptoms. Ghose noted the case of Babu Sarat Chandra Jana, aged 28, who had sudden swellings of his legs and feet on March 2, 1932. His urine was examined, but there was no albumen present. The urine became scanty and high-colored. Pain over the hepatic region. Giddiness of head and heart palpitations. Ghose prescribed Boerhaavia Diffusa in drop doses to be taken thrice daily. The medicine was continued for six days and the patient got rid of the swelling and other complaints within ten days. Ghose had a second case, Babu Santiram Roy, aged 28, who had an epidemic dropsy on May 30,1932. He was treated by several well-known allopaths of Calcutta, but nothing could lessen the swelling. Ghose was called in on June 14. The patient complained of a terrible headache, principally on the right side. Preexisting liver derangement, at the time it was congested and painful to touch or pressure. Swollen hands, feet and abdomen. Scanty, high- colored urine. Cough with thick, white mucus expectoration. Throbbing pain in the cardiac region felt off and on. Ghose prescribed Boerhaavia in 2-drop doses thrice daily. He was cured within a month. Ghose cured more than 30 cases of epidemic dropsy with the help of this new drug. Aegle marmelos contains almost all the identical therapeutic properties ascribed to Aegle folia. REFERENCES - Ghose.

HERBAL - The aegle marmelos tree is indigenous to India and is found wild all over the Sub-Himalayan forests, in Bengali, in Central and South India, and in Burma. It is also cultivated to a great extent. Different parts of the bel tree are used in Ayurvedic medicine. The root bark is used in the form of a decoction as a remedy in hypochondriasis, melancholia, intermittent fever and palpitation of the heart. It constitutes an ingredient in the “Dasam- ul” or ten roots used by the Ayurvedic physicians. The leaves are made into a poultice and applied to inflamed parts. The fresh juice is bitter and pungent, and when mixed with water is praised as a remedy in catarrh and feverishness. The fruit, both green and ripe, is used against diarrhea and intestinal conditions. For diarrhea and dysentery the roasted or sun-dried unripe fruit cut in slices is general used. The astringent rind of the ripe fruit is employed in dying and tanning and it is also used medicinally. Ayurvedic physicians note that the ripe fruit is nutritious, delicious, aromatic, alternative and a laxative. It is given with sugar candy to prevent the growth of piles and to remove habitual constipation. When taken in excess it often causes flatulence. Syrup of ripe fruits is used in dyspepsia. The root bark is a refrigerant, and is given in fevers and asthma, with palpitations of the heart. In native practice, a poultice of the leaves is applied to the chest in acute bronchitis. The decoction of the Aegle leaves is given in asthma, a marmalade of bel fruit is a household remedy for diarrhea and dysentery.

HOMEOPATHIC - A proving of Aegle marmelos was done by the Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy of the Ministry of health and family welfare. Government of India, giving a good array of symptoms. It showed a marked affinity for the gastrointestinal tract, skin and upper respiratory tract though it has also evoked symptoms from head, eyes, genitalia, back and extremities. A study to clinically confirm the symptoms elicited during provings is in progress and the data obtained so far show its positive application in vertigo, styes, rhinitis, stomatitisanddermatitis. Nocturnal seminal emission with amorous dreams. Backache and cramps in calf muscles. Lachrymation and burning in eyes, better closing eyes. Allergic conjunctivitis. Styes, especially when accompanied with stitching pain and sensation of dust particles in eyes with lachrymation (Sulph., Staph.). Aphthae with difficulty in eating. MIND - Disinclination to talk. Disinclination to work, with sadness. Irritability. Hypochondriasis. Melancholy.

Stitching pain, worse swallowing, drinking and eating. Vertigo - Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Vertigo with constipation. Vertigo better lying down. Vertigo worse walking, sitting and standing. COMMENTS - R. N. Khory, in the Materia Medica of India, noted many traditional uses for Aegle. Aegle marmelos is held sacred by the Hindus, and its leaves are presented to Shiva as an offering by the devotees. It is often planted near the temples. The Hindus consider it an emblem of fertility and a very auspicious plant. No herbal remedy has been longer and better known or appreciated by the inhabitants of India than the bel fruit. Two kinds of fruit are available in the market: a small, wild variety and a cultivated variety. The full-grown fruit of either variety, when it just begins to ripen, is best for medicinal purposes. The unripe or half-ripe fruit is regarded as an astringent, digestive, stomachic and is said to be an excellent remedy for diarrhea owing to the presence of tannins or mucilaginous substances. It is said to be particularly useful in chronic diarrhea. It is sometimes used in combination with opium by ayurvedic practitioners. The fruit is also sliced and a configure made from it. which is commonly used by Hindu physicians in the treatment of diarrheas and dysentery. The ripe fruit is sweet, aromatic and cooling. When taken fresh, it possesses laxative properties. The dried pulp is pale orange or flesh colored, and when mixed with water, yields a pleasant orange-colored food which has mild astringent properties. REFERENCES - Ghose.

HOMEOPATHIC - The action of this remedy is most marked on the lower bowels, producing engorged hemorrhoidal veins with the characteristic backache and absence of constipation. Hemorrhoids, with much pain but little bleeding. Venous stasis in general. Varicose veins of a purple color. Many of the symptoms which Aesc. produces are due to a deranged liver or reflex from hemorrhoids. Everything is slowed down, digestion, heart, bowels, etc. Torpor and congestion of the liver and portal system with constipation. Fullness in various parts, dry, swollen mucus membranes. This remedy has great affinity for the pelvis, hips, the sacro-iliac joint and sacrum problems. Sacro-iliac problems since an injury or a fall. Degenerative hip disease. Arthritis of the hip. Aching pains in hips and pelvis. Sore muscles, mornings on waking and on motion. Glandular swellings. Aesculus produces sensation of heat, dryness, stiffness and roughness in throat, nose, anus, etc. Throat symptoms with hemorrhoid conditions. Mucus membranes dry, swollen, burn and feel raw. Joints weak. The back aches and gives out. Backache, lumbo-sacral region aches. Walking greatly aggravates all symptoms. When walking feet turn under. Soles feels sore, tired and swell. Hands and feet swell and become red after washing, feel full. MIND - Aesc. patients are despondent, gloomy and irritable. Irritable, unable to fix his attention. Depressed and irritable. Extremely irritable. Loses tempereasily. Feels miserably cross. Gloomy and despondent. Malaise. Dullness of head and mind, fullness at root of nose. Dullness, sluggishness on waking in morning, on waking at night. Mistakes in localities. Wakes up with confusion of mind, bewildered, especially the children. Doesn't know where she is nor whence came the objects around her.

Head - Headache dull, confused, aching as from a cold. Pressure in forehead with nausea, followed by stitches in right hypochondrium. Pain from occiput to frontal region with bruised sensation of the scalp, worse in the morning. Neuralgic stitches from right to left through forehead, followed by flying pains in epigastrium. Bruised pain in occiput to the frontal region with flushes of heat over occiput, neck and shoulders.

Eyes - Eyeballs feel heavy, dull, hot and sore with lachrymation with enlarged blood vessels.

Mouth - Thickly coated tongue, tongue and mouth feel as if scalded. Cannot control the tongue so as to form words rightly. Toothache, lower molar, worse warm drinks, better holding cold water in mouth. Salivation. Taste sweet, bitter, metallic. Teeth as if covered with oil.

Throat - Hot, dry, raw, stitching pain into ears when swallowing. Swollen glands. Follicular pharyngitis connected with hepatic congestion. Veins in pharynx distended and tortuous. Throat sensitive to inspired air, feels excoriated and constricted, burns like fire on swallowing in afternoon. Feeling of roughness, dryness, stitching or burning like fire on swallowing. Neuralgic pains in the fauces. Hawking of ropy mucus of sweetish taste. Vertigo - Vertigo when sitting and walking. Slight vertigo while sitting, worse rising from seat. Vertigo with sensation as if he had to balance the head. COMMENTS - Disordered liver. Soreness and fullness in the liver region, the abdomen is sore to the touch. Jaundice with bileless stools. Throbbing in abdomen, especially hypogastrium. The most intense action is on the lower bowel and pelvic organs. Malaise, dullness of head and mind, fullness at root of nose. Follicular pharyngitis with dryness, burning, roughness, contraction in throat. Keynote use for hemorrhoids, blind or bleeding, relieved by bleeding. Large, swollen hemorrhoids, like a bunch of grapes. Feeling of dryness in rectum as if little sticks or splinters were pricking the folds of the mucus membrane with weak feeling in sacroiliac joints, as if legs would gave way. Constipation, large, hard stools, followed by feeling of prolapse of rectum. Boericke noted fullness in the rectum, pain in the anus as if sticks stuck up the rectum. General aching in lumbar and sacral regions with stiffness in the back, almost impossible to walk. Tearing pain in the small of the back and hips. Great affinity for the hips, the sacroiliac joint, for sacrum problems. “Hip joint disease,” “dislocates easily.” May palliate for hip dysplasia. Degenerative hip disease, arthritis of the hip, bursitis. Deep, sore, aching pains. Characteristic worse from rising from a seat. Paralytic feeling in the hip and sacrum, feels weak, lame, and stiff. Ankylosing spondylitis, rigid back that aches and is sore. For the back giving out during pregnancy, with a white leucorrhea. Ruptured disks, herniated disks, prolapsed disks, with radiating pains. Sacroiliac and lumbosacral problems with aching down both thighs, the backs of the thighs, and strong aching in the back. Varicose veins (Ham.). “Venous stasis,” the veins in the body are weak, producing hemorrhoids and varicose veins. Veins have lost tone and swell up with blood. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aesc-g., Aloe, Coll., Merc., Nux-v., Podo., Sulph. (2) Phyt. - throat dry, more often in acute cases. (3) Aloe, Collinsonia. Nux-v. Sulph., Puls. (4) Arg-n. has also pain in sacroiliac joints and sensation as if the bones were loose. (5) Ne- gundium americanum. (6) Kali-bi. - throat, but Aesc. h. has not the stringy mucus. Phatak.

Veins of portal system are also engorged producing soreness and fullness of the liver and abdomen.

Hemorrhoids external, worse standing and walking, worse during menopause. Irritation caused by ascarides and aids their expulsion.

Has to make repeated efforts at rising, worse walking and stooping. Aching in lumbar and sacral regions with stiffness in the back, almost impossible to walk.

PHARMACY - aether. Aether. Ether. Etherum. Ethyl oxide. Ethylic ether. Sulfuric ether. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Catalepsy. Convulsions. Cough. Delirium tremens. Hiccough. Mania. Meningitis. Nausea. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ether is the well-known anesthetic and the effects are those observed in patients under the action of its vapor, administered for the purpose of operation in habitual ether drinkers and on some who have voluntarily experimented with the drug upon themselves. Ether is closely allied to alcohol, it possesses very similar intoxicating properties, produces visions, frequently pleasurable, hallucination and in some instances a persistent maniacal condition. Convulsions, spasms and a cataleptic state. Chilliness. Bronchitis is a common after result of ether anesthesia and Belladonna has been observed to be the best antidote for this. Macerator reported the cure of a woman of 60, who had been confined to bed for weeks with severe neuralgia of the head, raised welts on the scalp like ridges accompanying the pain. Ether 200c cured quickly. MIND - Exhilaration, furious excitement, flushed face. Pleasant dreams of rapid flight through the air, gorgeous visions and unearthly music. Frightful dreams, fancied he heard the ringing of his own funeral bell. Low-spirited, fearful of some disease, desponding. Loss of consciousness.

Head - Meningitis. Temporal arteries enlarged, beat violently. Head drops to one side or is thrown back. Severe neuralgia of head with raised welts on scalp.

Eyes - Eyes suffused, lids closed, conjunctive injected. Pupils dilated. Dim vision as if mist or thin cloud before eyes.

Ears - Sounds indistinct, seem far off, yet resound violently in the ears.

Face - Face flushed.

Mouth - Mouth often open. Salivation, slight frothing at mouth. Pronunciation difficult and indistinct.

Stomach - Hiccough persistent. Nausea. Vomiting. Vertigo - Dizziness, headache with partial blindness follow ether anesthesia. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Chest - Extreme coldness of the chest, wants it covered. Tightness, irritation and pain.

Heart - Excitement and invigoration of heart's action. Pulse full and bounding.

Limbs - Paralysis of lower limbs. Lungs - Violent cough from stinging or heat in bronchia. Expectoration of blood. Breathing is quickened, stertorous. Congestion of lungs and brain.

Painful, irritating, scabby eruptions of face. Scrofulous disorders. Scrofulous ophthalmia and otorrhea offensive. Hereditary syphilis. It seems to combine the powers of its various components. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc., Sil., Psor. (2) Aethiops Antimonalis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

CLINICAL - Attention deficit. Anasarca. Brain, weakness. Cholera infantum. Colic. Coma. Convulsions. Cough. Delirium. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, discharge. Ecchymosis. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders. Gland disorders. Headaches. Herpes. Hiccoughs. Idiocy. Infantile, paralysis. Insomnia. Malnutrition. Marasmus. Mental, retardation. Mental, retardation. Milk, allergy. Pyloric, stenosis. Stomach disorders. Trismus. Vomiting, projectile.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aethusacynapium affects the brain and nervous system, connected with gastrointestinal disturbances. Keynote violent action. Violent vomiting, violent convulsions, violent pains, violent delirium. In epileptiform spasms, the thumbs are clenched, face becomes red, eyes turned downwards, pupils dilate and staring, foams at mouth. There is great weakness of mind or body. Inability to digest milk (Nat-c.). Diarrhea, with marked aggravation from drinking milk and poor circulation. Improperly fed babies (Calc-p.). Patient cannot stand, sit up or hold the head up. Children who lack the power to hold their heads up with no particular ailment, sometimes they can't even stand or bear any weight on their limbs. Want of power to stand up. Sharp pains. Parts feel screwed together. Weak, nervous and prostrated from overwork. Prostration with somnolence. Profound prostration and stupor and lack of reaction, even speechless. Anguish, crying and expression of uneasiness and discontent. Useful forchildren's summer complaints and diseases during dentition. MIND - Mind and body become weak. Brain fatigue from over study. Inability to think, to fix the attention. Awkwardness. Mental, retardation. Attention deficit. Idiotic children. Idiocy may alternate with furor and irritabil- ity. Weepy, worse as disease progresses. Stupefaction during vertigo. Fear before sleep to close eyes lest he should never wake. Examination failure from sense of incapacity. Unable to read after overexertion of mental faculties. Restlessness, anxious and crying. Irritability, especially in open air. Irritability during headache. Feels different from other people. Reserved people with inwardly strong emotions. Feels unconnected to other people. Loners. Great sadness when alone. Lives in his own sentimental world. Loves animals, talks to animals, looks after them with unnatural passion. Delirium, better perspiration. Unconscious, delirious. Fancies herself lost on waking. Hallucinations. Delusions of animals. Delirium, sees cats, dogs and rats. Wants to jump out of bed or out of the window.

Head - Head feels confused. Head or brain feels as if bound up or in avise. Occipital pain extending down spine, better lying down and by pressure. Head symptoms relieved by expelling flatus (Sang.), and by stool. Cannot raise head. Hair feels pulled. Squeezing headache with vertigo worse walking and looking upward. Dizzy and drowsy.

Eyes - Eyes drawn downward, squinting, pupils dilated. Brilliant and protruding. Cornea sunken. Objects seem larger or double. Photophobia, chronic. Swelling of meibomian glands. Rolling of eyes on falling asleep.

Ears - Feel blocked, better by inserting the fingers and drawing the parts apart. Sense of something hot from ears, as if something hot steaming out. Hissing sound.

Nose - Nose stopped up with much thick mucus. Herpetic eruption on tip of nose. Frequent ineffectual desire to sneeze. Alae nasi drawn in.

Face - Sunken, pale, puffed, red-spotted, collapsed. Expression anxious, full of pain. Linea nasalis marked blue white pallor about the lips, puffed, spotted, red.

Mouth - Dryness. Aphthae in the mouth. Tongue seems too long. Burning and pustules in the throat with difficult swallowing. Speech slow, embarrassed. Speechless. Bitter taste, of onions, cheese, sweetish in morning.

Throat - Sensation of constriction, preventing swallowing. Stinging in the throat. Soft palate red, swollen. Pungent heat in mouth and throat. Vertigo - Vertigo, with sleepiness, can't raise the head. Vertigo with drowsiness with palpitation, head hot after vertigo ceases. COMMENTS - Ingesting Aethusa plant matter causes severe projectile vomiting. There is also gripping with diarrhea, vomiting, crying. Guernsey said Aeth. is invaluable for adults who complain of regurgitation of food an hour after it has been taken. Copious vomiting in adults with a great feeling of distress, can't tell what the distress is about, but it still exists. A peculiar expression of great anxiety and pain. Linea nasalis, a surface of pearly whiteness on upper lip bounded by distinct lines from wings of nose to angles of mouth. Inability to hold down any food. Severe spasmodic vomiting. Malassimilation. Also for vomiting during pregnancy that's very spasmodic andprojectile. Goodforprojectile vomiting, pyloric stenosis, failure to thrive in children. Keynote intolerance to milk in any form. Milk allergies in children with vomiting and spasm (Nat-c., has gas, bloating and diarrhea). Vomiting of everything taken, especially milk, which is ejected in yellowish or greenish curds. Great weakness and exhaustion after vomiting, the child is so exhausted they fall asleep at once. Wakes hungry, eats and vomits again. “Hungry after vomiting.” Epilepsy in children with emaciation, mal- assimilation and failure to thrive. Epileptic spasms (Cup.), the thumbs are clenched, the head is drawn back and the eyes go down. Epilepsy with foaming, pupils fixed and dilated. Prostration and sleepiness after attacks. Convulsions with cold limbs. Sensation of swelling in the head and face on entering a room, sunken cornea, and eyeballs convulsed and directed downwards. Sensation of swelling in hands after walking. Lancinating pains. Swelling of breast or axillary glands with sharp pains. Prostration, stupid. Tetanus. Alcoholism, with tremors, shaking, malassimilation and emaciation. Late learning to walk. Backward children with muscle weakness, stumbling, falling, late speech. Poor mental and brain development and coordination. Characteristic inability to think or fix the attention. Stupor, in some cases alternating with a furor. Hallucinations. Delirium, sees cats and dogs. Wants to jump out of bed or out of the window. Irritability, especially in open air. Somnolence. Clarke sent single doses of Aeth., at rare intervals with great rehef, to a little child in an orphan home who suffered from severe headaches and inability to fix his attention on his lessons. The little boy asked for the remedy himself subsequently on a return of the old symptoms. Clarke gave it to an undergraduate preparing for an examination with complete success. He had been compelled to give up his studies, but was able to resume them and passed a brilliant examination. Guernsey said “The mental symptoms peculiar to children and frequently of adults, are, great anguish and crying. As the disease progresses the patient becomes more and more retired in his disposition and more inclined to weep.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ant-c., Calc., Ars., Cic. (2) Athamantha - confused head, vertigo better lying down, bitter taste and saliva. Hands and feet icy cold. (3) Cic., Con., Oena., Ant-c. and Calc. - vomiting of milk. (4) Are., Asar., Cupr., Ip., Op. Complementary: Calc., Sil. It antidotes: Opium, and is antidoted by vegetable acids. Teste places Aeth. in the Sulphur group with Cic., Con., Aster., Bov., Lob., Merc., Kreos. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Intolerance of milk, vomiting as soon as swallowed or in large curds. Hungry after vomiting. Regurgitation, about an half hour after eating. Nausea at sight of food. Painful contraction of stomach. Violent vomiting of a white frothy matter. Projectile vomiting. Vomiting of frothy matter white as milk or yellow fluid. Pyloric stenosis. Retching. Vomiting vnthsweatandgreatweakness, accompanied by anguish and distress, followed by sleepiness. Stomach feels turned upside down with burning feeling up to the chest. Tearing pains in the stomach extending to esophagus.

Abdomen - Cold internal and external with aching pain in bowels. Colic, exhaustion and drowsiness. Colic, followed by vomiting, vertigo and weakness. Black bluish swelling, coldness of abdomen, subjective and objective with coldness of legs with aching in bowels better warm application. Bubbling sensation around navel.

Rectum - Cholera infantum, child cold, clammy, stupid with staring eyes and dilated pupils. Cholera disorders in old age. Undigested, thin, greenish stools. preceded by colic with tenesmus followed by exhaustion and drowsiness. Yellow, green, slimy diarrhea. Obstinate constipation, feels as if all bowel action is lost.

Male - Right testicle drawn up with pain in kidney.

Female - Sharp pains in sexual organs. Pimples on external parts, itching on getting warm. Menses watery. Swelling of breasts with sharp pains. Food - Burning thirst with total loss of appetite. Desires wine, but aggravated from it. Intolerance of milk. Nibbling appetite. Regurgitation of food long after eating. Digestion affected from brain exhaustion. Glands - Lymphatic glands swollen like strings of beads.

Chest - Crampy constriction in chest. Stitches in left side of chest. Constitutions - Suited to infants, teething children and cholera disorders of children and the elderly.

Heart - Violent palpitations with vertigo, headache and restlessness. Pulse rapid, hard and small, not rhythmical.

Back - Small of back as if in vice, aching. Want of power to stand to hold up head. Swelling of glands around neck like string of beads. A feeling as if pain in back could be better by straightening out and bending stiffly backwards.

Limbs - Want of power to stand up or hold head up. Weakness of lower limbs. Fingers and thumbs bent inwards or clenched. Numbness of hands and feet. Violent spasms. Sensation as if arms had become much shorter. Heaviness, weakness, contraction of fingers. Excoriation of thighs on walking. Lungs - Difficult, oppressed, anxious respiration, crampy constriction. Short breath interrupted by hiccough. Suffering renders the patient speechless. Cough causes pain in head.

Sleep - Disturbed by violent startings or cold perspiration. Dozing after vomiting or stool. Child is so exhausted, it falls asleep at once. Rolling of the eyes or slight convulsion on falling asleep. Limpness and deep sleep after vomiting, with a deathly nausea.

Skin - Excoriation of thighs when walking. Easy perspiration, surface of body covered with clammy sweat. Lymphatic glands swollen. Itching eruption around joints better from heat. Skin of hands dry and shrunken. Ecchymosis. Anasarca. Whole body may be blue, black.

Modalities - Better in open air. Better from walking in open air. Better by conversation and company. Worse from milk. Worse coffee. Worse wine, drunkenness. Worse frequent over eating. Worse from 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evenings. Worse warmth. Worse summer. Worse warmth of bed. Worse cold water. Worse over exertion. Heat causes all eruptions to itch intolerably.

Kidneys - Cutting pain in bladder with frequent urging. Pain in kidneys.

Temperature - Great heat, no thirst. Profuse, cold sweat. Must be covered during sweat. Sweating, on slightest physical effort.

PHARMACY - Agarin. Agaricinum. Agaric acid. It is obtained from the fungus Boletus laricis (White Agaric) and is a white crystalline powder. Triturations and dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataracts.Chorea. Emphysema. Erythema. Heart, weakness. Neuralgias. Neuritis. Tic douloureux.

HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy is employed in severe cases of chorea. Useful for the sweats of tuberculosis, it should be given before retiring. The dose may be repeated once or twice during the night. Heart dilation, when complicated with emphysema. Fatty degeneration. Weakened heart action from acute diseases and old age, when attended with profuse perspiration and erythema. Agaricin should be studied when the symptoms are crossed over the body. Chorea. There is marked twitching of the eyelids, spasmodic movements from simple involuntary motions and jerks of single muscles to a dancing of the whole body. Trembling of the limbs, soreness of the spine and redness of the eyes. Involuntary movements cease during sleep, symptoms are worse during a thunderstorm. Neuritis. The parts are red, hot and swollen. There are burning, itching and cramps of the hands and feet. There is twitching of the muscles of the hands and feet. The sleep is restless and disturbed. COMMENTS - Royal reported that the 3x of Agarin. given three times daily cured a most violent case of Tic douloureux of the left side of face after Ars., Mag-p. and Bell, had failed. A slight touch would cause the paroxysms to recur. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Agar. REFERENCES - Blackwood.

HERBAL - An agaricus mushroom found in the highlands of Piedade, Brazil. The inhabitants in Piedade enjoy long and good health with very few degenerative disease. The people there rarely suffer from cancer, heart disease, stroke, diabetes, arthritis, allergies, asthma, eczema, ulcers, etc. In the 1960s, a Japanese descendant living in Brazil visited Piedade and made the observation that the people there eat a special kind of mushroom which is not found anywhere else. He sent samples of the mushroom to Japan for study and cultivation. About the same time, two scientists from America also visited Piedade and made a similar observation. They proceeded to analyze the nutritional content of the Brazilian mushroom and published the results in scientific journals in 1965. Experiments showed that not only the Agaricus mushroom is an effective cancer fighter, but also that it is the best cancer fighter among all the medicinal mushrooms known. The mushrooms fight cancer by enhancing the body's own immune system rather than directly trying to kill off the cancer cells. It is therefore as safe as any food substance can be. Subsequent studies showed that the Agaricus mushroom has a powerful normalizing effect of all body physiological functions. That is why that clinically it has been effective against many health problems afflicting mankind.

Rectum - Constipation and hemorrhoids.

Heart - Angina pectoris. Heart tonic. High blood pressure, and low blood pressure. Hardening of the arteries.

Sleep - Insomnia. COMMENTS - Dr. Alexander Yuan of Hong Kong reported on this agaricus mushroom noting its usefulness for blood purification, cold hands and feet, frozen shoulder, hangovers. Neck and shoulder pain and low back pain. Chronic debility. Collagen disease. German measles. Frequent colds and influenza, lack of energy. Insomnia, weak concentration. Pale, sallow complexion. Hyperactivity and improved athletic performance, among other benefits. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Care. REFERENCES - Murphy. Yuan.

Skin - Athlete foot. Eczema. Atopic dermatitis. Psoriasis. Skin cancer.

Kidneys - Kidney infection. Kidney failure. Lungs - Chronic bronchitis. Hay fever, allergic rhinitis, and asthma.

Blood - Raynaud's disease. Septicemia. Cancer - Breast cancer. Hodgkin's lymphoma. Leukemia. Lymphatic cancer. Ovarian cancer. Skin cancer.

full:
PHARMACY - agar-epn. - Agaricus campanu- latus. Agaricus ovalis. A rare species, found in England on dung. N. O. Fungi. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthenopia. Backaches. Belching. Constipation. Delirium. Diarrhea. Flatulence. Hemorrhoids. Jaundice. Neuralgias. Palpitations. Spasms. Toothache. Trembling. Twitching. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Poisonous doses produce violent vomiting and diarrhea with numerous nervous phenomena, tonic contractions of smooth muscle fiber, increased glandular and mucus secretions, and persistent anemia of nerve centers from spasm of arterioles. Chorea-like spasms. Vertigo and general intolerance of the sun. Heavy weight in occiput. A very irritable and sensitive spine. Asthenopia with flickerings. Twitching of eyes and lids. Gastro-enteric inflammation, with excessive, inodorous flatulence. Irritable bladder. A host of neuralgic pains everywhere, mostly splinter-like, burning and shooting. Particularly valuable in burning of the skin as from a frostbite, especially on the ears and feet. Chorea-like twitchings of various fibrillae and even groups of muscles. Tremblings, external and internal. Flesh feels bruised, or as if frostbitten, sensitive to touch and to cold air. General aggravation from walking in the open air. ameliorated when warm in bed. Pains in the limbs may disappear on motion, and return during rest. Symptoms often appear crosswise, as in right arm and left leg, etc. Shooting, splinter-like pains everywhere. MIND - Delirium, attempts to escape. Incoherent talking. Aversion to mental work. Confusion and vertigo, aggravated by heat of sun.

Head - Drawing in bones of forehead, to the root of the nose. Shooting pains, mostly in the sides of the head or in small spots. Feeling of icy coldness on the head.

Eyes - Twitching of lids and eyeballs. Margins of lids red, agglutinating. Vision dim on attempting to use the eyes. Flickering, type wavers, with itching and burning.

Ears - External ear burns and itches, as if it had been frozen. Twitchings of the auricular muscles. Numerous ringing and other noises within the ear.

Nose - Clear water runs from the nose, without inflammatory symptoms.

Face - Pale. Twitching of the muscles. Pains lancinating, tearing in the cheek.

Mouth - Dryness on salivation. Sweet taste. Toothache, neuralgic, aggravated by open air. Splinter-like pains in the tongue. Splinter-like pains through the jaws. Upper lip chapped, smarting, dry, with burning vesicles. Lips twitch.

Throat - Constriction of larynx. Sharp pain extends through right eustachian tube to ear. General dryness. Contractions. Feels swollen externally, hands feel tight. Vertigo - Vertigo, aggravated by heat of sun. RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. REFERENCES - Allen.

Stomach - Unnatural hunger, in evenings. Belching, empty. Numerous sensations with spasmodic contractions, irritable spine. Pains, gnawings, boring, cramps, and fullness.

Abdomen - Flatulent distention, rumblings, cutting, griping, stitches, and tension.

Rectum - Burning. Hemorrhoids.

Stool - Emission of much inodorous gas. Watery diarrhea. Constipation.

Male - Sexual desire without erections. Modalites - Better by motion. Better by coffee. Worse by walking in open air. Worse from heat of the sun.

Female - Violent pressing, tearing pains in back and abdomen with the menses. Pruritus pudendi.

Respiratory - Convulsive paroxysms of cough, sudden, ends with repeated sneezing. Expectoration of balls of mucus. Difficult respiration as if chest were full. Deep breathing and sighing. Noisy respiration at night.

Chest - Numerous pains, tearing, pinching, tensive, stinging, burning. Constriction, oppression, heaviness. Rawness.

Heart - Palpitations. Tumultuous action. Irregular, intermittent pulse, ameliorated by coffee.

Back - Stiffness and soreness of nape. Backaches. Bruised and strained feelings. Deep stitches, burning, itching along spine and limbs. Spine sore to the touch and on stooping. Extreme pain and soreness in lower dorsal regions, becoming a pulsating on motion. Severe pains in the spine, boring, stitching, drawing, and soreness, mostly in lower dorsal region. Back pains, aggravated by walking in open air.

Limbs - Limbs weary and heavy. Trembling. Twitching. Shooting pains, shifting. Pains often ameliorated by motion.

Sleep - General sleepiness, especially after eating.

Skin - Jaundice. Redness, stinging, burning as if frostbitten. Itching. White nodular elevations, with intense itching and burning.

Bladder - Irritable bladder. Sharp pains. Burning on urinating. Not profuse urine. Lemon-colored urine, discharge of sticky mucus.

Perspiration - Profuse inodorous sweat, often localized to the chest. Oily sweat.

Temperature - Chilliness on motion, in the air, or on lifting the clothes. Burning heat on different spots, mostly local.

PHARMACY - agar-cps. Agaricus campestris. Common mushroom. Psalloita campestris. N. O. Fungi. Historical dose: All potehcies.

CLINICAL - Abdominal pain. Abscesses. Boils. Cold. Colic. Cramps. Delirium. Dyspnea. Fever. Gangrene. Inflammatory, swellings. Nausea. Pulse, weak. Quinsies. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus campestris is the common mushroom. This mushroom, common in the North America and in Europe, is esculent, stem only two to three inches high. COMMENTS - Poisoning symptoms. Slight delirium. Eyes sunken, with livid circles. Face humid, hippocratic. Tongue red and parched. Skin cold, covered with cold sweat. Greenness of the skin. Formation of abscesses, which discharge a thin, ill-conditioned pus, and pass rapidly into suppuration and gangrene. Abdomen retracted. Great abdominal pain at intervals. Severe colic. Nausea. Purging and vomiting of liquid matter. Pulse hard, weak, rapid, irregular. Pulse feeble. Respiration irregular. Severe cramps. Kind of tertian fever. Somnolency. RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-em., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. REFERENCES - Allen.

PHARMACY - agar-em. Agaricus emeticus. Russula emetica. N. O. Fungi. A small acrid species, foundin woods in Europe. Tincture of fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anxiety. Belchings. Cold sweat. Diarrhea. Gastritis. Heartbum. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Agar-em. resemble those of the other Agarics, but while cold water aggravates the symptoms of Agaricus muscarius it speedily and permanently relieves those of Agar-em. Violent burning pains in the stomach. There is a sudden and violent craving for ice-cold water during the worst attacks of anxiety, which gives gradual relief. All symptoms better from cold water. Violent vomiting with anxious sensation, as if the stomach hung on threads which would be momentarily tom in two with ice-cold sweat of face. Gastritis with cold sweat and a vomiting sensation. Sudden great weakness. Severe vertigo, one must be carried to bed, is not able to sit or stand. Faintness worse by moving head. Faintness worse by smelling vinegar, which is unbearable. MIND - Attacks of anxiety. Anxiety in stomach.

Eyes - Lachrymation from odors. Lasting weakness of eyes. Food - Sudden, violent desire for ice-cold water, during the worst attacks of anxiety, which gives gradual relief. Dislike for wine and meat, relieve by cold water.

Nose - Sneezing from smells.

Mouth - Nauseous taste in mouth. Sharp burning in mouth.

Stomach - Violent vomiting with anxious sensation, with ice-cold sweat of face. Violent burning pain in stomach. Painful pressure in stomach, followed by frequent belchings, repeated attempts to vomit. Constantly increasing anxiety in stomach. Stomach so sensitive that one could not touch it, nor cough. Vertigo - Vertigo, so severe that one must be carried to bed is not able to sit or stand. RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Distended abdomen. Constantly increasing pain in abdomen.

Modalities - Better from cold water. Worse from odors. Worse by smelling vinegar.

Pulse - Pulse rapid, exceedingly weak.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - agar. Agaricus muscarius. Fly agaric. Amanita muscaria. Bug agaric. Champignon fou. N. O. Fungi. Grows in Europe, Asia and America in dry places, especially in dry pine woods. Trituration of the carefully dried-up cap. Tincture of the fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Alcoholism. Blepharospasm. Brain, softening. Bunion. Chilblains. Chorea. Coldness. Cough. Cramps. Delirium tremens. Epilepsy. Fever, enteric. Frostbite. Gangrene. Headaches. Hyperpyrexia. Hypothermia. Itching. Jaundice. Lachrymal, fistula. Lichen. Lumbago. Menses, painful. Meningitis. Myopia. Neuralgias. Nosebleeds. Numbness. Nystagmus. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Sacrum, pains. Sebaceous tumors. Sexual excess, effects. Spinal, Irritation. Spleen, disorders. Tics. Toothaches. Tremors. Tuberculosis. Twitching. Typhoid fever. Typhus.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus contains several toxic compounds, the best known of which is muscarin. The symptoms of poisoning do not develop at once, usually twelve to fourteen hours elapse before the initial attack. Agaricus acts as an intoxicant to the brain, producing more vertigo and delirium than alcohol, followed by profound sleep with lowered reflexes. Agaricus is used in many parts of the world for making an intoxicating drink. We find in alcoholism a sphere for its action and also in all states of delirium, mania and even idiocy. Cerebral excitement, as found in delirium of fevers, alcoholism, etc. The delirium is to make verses and prophesy, also silly merriness and incoherent talk with mania, kisses companions. Frostbite and chilblains, itching, redness and burning. Bunions. Sensations if pierced by needles of ice. Sensitive to pressure and cold air. Violent bearing down pains. Symptoms appear diagonally as right arm and left leg. Pains are accompanied by sensation of cold, numbness and tingling. General paralysis. Jerking, twitching, trembling and itching are strong indications. Epilepsy with great exertion of strength. Chorea, twitching ceases during sleep. Various forms of neuralgia and spasmodic disorders and neurotic skin troubles are pictured in the symptomatology of this remedy. Agar, is a spleen medicine, causing stitch in the side and it has cured stitch in runners, enabling them to run further. Anemia. Incipient tuberculosis is related to the tubercular diathesis. Offensive breath, belchings and stools. Sweat may be oily, but is not offensive. MIND - Mental depression, languor, indifference. Disinclination to work, confusion. Indisposed to perform any kind of work especially mental. Cannot do anything new, cannot do routine work, or does the opposite. Slow in learning to walk and talk. Awkward and clumsy. Morose, self-willed, stubborn. Selfish behavior. Alcoholism. Dull and dizzy as if drunk. Delirium tremens. Reveals secrets. Pressure on spine causes involuntary laughter. Aversion to being touched. Hyperactive, clumsy children without any fear or idea about danger. Fearlessness, recklessness and thoughtlessness. Convulsions after being scolded (Ign.). Makes many revengeful plans. Confusion of mind on waking in morning, better after eating. Knows no one, throws things. Hysteria after sexual excesses. Memory active, in evening. Fears to be left alone lest he injure himself inafrenzy. Fear of cancer. Preoccupied with death, dying, graveyards. Fear of ghosts. Fear after going to bed. Pities herself. Delirium of fevers. Delirium characterized by makes verses, singing, shouting and muttering, rhymes and prophesies. Increased cheerfulness, courage, loquacity, exalted fancy. Hilarious. Embraces and kisses hands. Delirium with much twitching. Fearlessness. Sings, talks incoherently, but does not answer. Loquacity, changes rapidly from subject to subject, but does not answer. Great mental excitement and incoherent talking, immoderate gaiety alternates with melancholy. Perception of relative size of objects is lost. Physical strength is increased, can lift heavy loads. Delirium begins with paroxysm of yawning. Sings, talks incoherently, changes rapidly from subject to subject, but doesn't answer. Full of ecstasy. Furious or raging delirium. Screaming, raving, wants to injure himself.

Head - Head in constant motion. Headache must move head to and fro. Falling backward, as if a weight in occiput. Lateral headache, as if from a nail (Coff., Ign'). Dull headache from prolonged deskwork. Headache, must move the head to and fro. Headache with nosebleed. Headache with thick mucus discharge. Headache better after stool or urination. Headaches of alcoholics. Aching in vertex. Head drawn towards shoulders. Pain in small spots. Cold spots on head. Icy coldness like icy needles or splinters. Sharp, tearing, aching and boring pain in occiput. Neuralgia with icy cold head. Desire to cover head warmly (Sil.). Twitching and stitches, more on left side. Scalp tender, sensitive. Itching nettle-rash on scalp.

Eyes - Eyes as if weak, without having exerted them. Asthenopia from prolonged strain. Spasms of accommodation. Twitching of eyelids and eyeballs (Cod.). Oscillating eyeballs. Heat in eyes. Lids heavy, as if stuck together. Eyelids thick, dry, burning red, itch and agglutinate. Inner angles very red. Gum in canthi. Narrowing of space between eyelids. Nystagmus, squint. Swellingofteargland. Vesicles or ulcers on cornea. Lachrymation from smells or coughing. Sensitive to light, even candlelight. Pupils dilated.

Ears - Itching in the ears with redness and burning pain, as if they had been frozen. Twitching of the muscles about the ears with noises. Rattling, fluttering in tympanic cavity. Sharp pains in left mastoid process. Excessive secretion of wax. Very acute hearing. Feels worse from hearing people talk. Dull hearing.

Nose - Redness of nose. Nervous nasal disturbances. Hay fever, itching of nasopharynx and ears. Itching internally and externally. Spasmodic sneezing after coughing, sensitiveness, watery discharge. Inner angles very red. Fetid, dark, bloody discharge. Nosebleeds in elderly people. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Flow of clear water without coryza. Redness. Obstruction on stooping. Sensation of soreness in nose and mouth.

Face - Face, blue and puffed. Grimaces. Idiotic expression. Facial twitching. Muscles feel stiff. Face itches and burns. Lancinating, tearing pain in cheeks, as of splinters. Neuralgia, as if cold needles ran through nerves or sharp ice touched them. Pricking in chin, as from needles. Herpetic eruptions. Pimples changing to vesicles filled with yellow serum. Burning and smarting on lips. Faceache with toothache. Jaws clenched. Eruption about mouth in growing children given to licking of lips.

Mouth - Aphthae on roof of mouth. Herpes on lips. Burning and smarting on lips. Offensive breath. Froth at mouth. Swelling and bleeding gums with pain. Angles of mouth droop from paralysis, saliva runs out. Twitching. Sweet, bitter taste. Taste sweet, sharp and bitter. Increased flow of acrid saliva. Salivation during menses. Thirsty all the time. Indistinct, jerky speech.

Throat - Stitches along eustachian tube to ear. Feels contracted. Small solid balls of phlegm thrown up. Dryness of pharynx, swallowing difficult. Scratching in throat, cannot sing a note. Burning, cooling feeling. Pressure as from a foreign body sticking in throat, not better swallowing. Dryness and constriction of pharynx. Induration of tonsils and other glands.

Stomach - Empty belchings, tasting of apples. Flatulent distention of stomach. Profuse inodorous belchings. Eructation, empty, tasting of apples or of rotten eggs. Belchings and hiccoughs. Eructations alternating with hiccough. Burning in stomach about three hours after a meal, changing into a dull pressure. Gastric disturbance with sharp pains in liver region. Nervous disturbances with spasmodic contractions, hiccough. As if a lump in epigastrium. Vomiting, bitter with prostration with stitches in rectum and groin. Stools - Fetid stools. Pappy stools with cutting in abdomen and passing of wind. Very hard stools, at first hard and knotty, then soft, finally diarrheic. Diarrhea with much fetid, garlicky odor flatus. Diarrhea of children with grass green, bilious stools. Diarrhea, morning after rising.

Abdomen - Burning in abdomen. Flatulent distention of abdomen. Sharp pains in spleen (Cean.), and abdomen. Sharp pain in the splenic region in runners. Colic. Cutting, griping pains in bowels. Rumbling and fermenting in bowels. Profuse, inodorous, hot flatus. Sensation of writhing. Abdomen as if empty, hollow or cold.

Rectum - Crampy colic, with passing wind. Sharp itching in rectum. Itching,prickling in rectum and anus, as from worms. Biting in rectum after emission of flatus. Flatus hot. Emission of much inodorous gas. Constipation with rumbling in bowels duringpregnancy. Hemorrhoids. Writhing in rectum. Burning in anus. Warm feeling in anus. Anus as if completely closed. Dysentery.

Male - Burning in urethra during sex, worse ejaculation. Sexual desire increased. After sex, great debility, profuse sweat, burning and itching of the skin, tension and pressure under ribs. Hot seminal discharge. Premature ejaculation. Testes painfully retracted. Old gleet. Complaints after sexual debauches.

Female - Spasmodic dysmenorrhea. Laborlike cramps, must lie down. Menses too profuse, earlier. Menses with titillation in genital organs and desire for sex. Tearing, pressive pain in genitals and back, with itching. Severe bearing-down pains, especially after menopause. Bearing down pains on lifting. Leucorrhea, dark, bloody, excoriating, patient is unable to walk. Leucorrhea, with much itching, with sexual desire. Complaints following childbirth and sex. Itching, with sexual desire. Sexual excitement. Food - Loss of appetite after sex. Thirsty all the time. Much hunger, but no relish for food. Better from coffee. Better for an hour after eating while he is so exhausted, but great sleepiness remains. Alcoholism. Craving for alcohol. Worse after tobacco. Worse tea and coffee. Wine causes indisposition to work. Coffee accelerates pulse. Meat causes heartburn. Prunes causes pressure in stomach. Smelling vinegar causes faintness. Smell of vinegar unbearable. Drinking cold water aggravates.

Chest - Anxiety in chest. Stitches under short ribs, left side. Sharp pain behind sternum most at end of expiration. Sharp pain in right lung while walking. Severe burning in chest. Chest as if too narrow. Chest as if too full of blood. Chest as if sprained, worse deep breathing. Burning, biting pimples on chest. Constitutions - Light hair, skin and muscles lax. Old people with indolent circulation. Venous weakness. Diarrhea. Alcoholics, especially with headaches. Mushrooms are forbidden by Grauvogl to persons with the hydrogenoid constitution. The patients are exceedingly sensitive to cold and damp.

Heart - Anxious sensation of pressure in heart. Irritable heart of tea and coffee drinkers, and tobacco smokers. Irregular, tumultuous palpations after tobacco. Heart region oppressed, as if thorax were narrowed. Oppression on bending body down. Palpitations with redness of face. Palpitations during sex and depressed afterwards in both the sexes. Pulse intermittent and irregular.

Back - Painful weakness and soreness. Shooting, burning pains along spine. Pain with sensitiveness of spine to touch, worse in dorsal region. Aching in back after dinner. Burning pains along the spinal cord. Pain as if hot and cold needles stabbed into spine. Painfulness along spinal cord when stooping. Painful pulsation in spinal canal. Lumbago, worse in open air. Crick in back and neck. Twitching of cervical muscles. Spine seems short. Muscles of back feel tight, as if they would break on bending. As if cold air were spreading along back. As if cold water were running down back. Spinal irritation, due to Agaricus muscarius sexual excesses. Sacrum as if beaten or dislocated. Swelling of cervical glands. Breasts - Metastases from suppressed milk to the brain, abdominal troubles etc. Nipples, itch and burn, look red during pregnancy. Causations - Blood poisoning. Frostbite. Mental exertion or excitement, over-exertion. Fright. Alcoholism, sexual excess, subjective symptoms arising after sex.

Limbs - Stiff all over. Pain over hips. Rheumatism better motion. Weakness in loins. Uncertain gait. Frostbite. Hands and feet very sensitive to cold. Itching of toes and feet as if frozen. Cramps in hands and feet. Cramp in soles of feet. Joints feel as if dislocated. Pain in shin. Neuralgia in locomotor ataxia. Muscular soreness. Paralysis of lower limbs with spasmodic condition of arms. Trembling and twitching. Numbness of legs on crossing them. Paralytic pain in left arm followed by palpitations. Tearing painful contractions in the calves. Rheumatism better motion.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from rush of ideas. Restless from violent itching and burning. On falling asleep, starts, twitches and awakens often. Drowsy in daytime. Unpleasant dreams awaking from sleep. Paroxysms of yawning. Frequent yawning before pains or spasms as a concomitant. Yawning followed by involuntary laugh- ter. Vivid dreams. Anxiety as if suffocating in dreams. Nightmares of dead people and graveyards.

Skin - Miliary eruptions with severe itching and burning. Burning, itching, redness and swelling, as if frozen. Pimples, hard like small fleabites. Chilblains. Angioneurotic edema, rosacea. Swollen veins with cold skin. Circumscribed erythematous, papular and pustular and edematous lesions. Itching changing place on scratching. Itching over affected part. Skin pains, when cold. Miliary eruptions with intolerable itching and burning. Slight blow causes ecchymosis.

Modalities - Better from moving about slowly. Worse from open air. Worse cold orfreezing air. Worse cold weather. Worse before a thunderstorm. Worse sun. Worse morning. Worse after eating. Worse after sex. Worse from touch. Worse debauchery, alcohol. Worse mental exhaustion. Worse fright. Worse during menses. Worse pressure on dorsal spine.

Teeth - Teeth sensitive to touch, pressure, or while chewing. Teeth as if too long. Tearing pain, pulsating, worse cold air. Shooting pain from right upper teeth up to right side of head. Teeth worse, when abdomen gets better. Toothache at beginning of menses and during. Swelling and bleeding gums, with pain.

Tongue - Tremulous tongue (Lach.). Tongue coated white. Tongue dry, one side numb with vertigo. Tongue as if dry and contracted, as after an astringent. Splinter like pains in tongue with salivation. Sharp pain, soreness or burning at tip of tongue. Bad taste at root of tongue. Tip of tongue studded with small dirty yellow aphthae. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning. Vertigo from sunlight. Vertigo from heat of sun. Vertigo with palpitations. Vertigo on walking. Vertigo reeling as if drunk. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Vertigo with stupefaction and burning in vertex. Vertigo after menses. Vertigo from yawning. Vision - Double vision (Gels.). Dim and flickering vision. Flickering vision while writing. Shortsighted. Reading difficult, as type seems to move to swim. Focal distance changes while reading. Dim vision as from a mist. Vibrating specters. Muscae volitantes, brown. Yellow, brown or black spots before left eye. COMMENTS - Mushrooms are among the articles of diet forbidden to persons of the hydrogenoid constitution, in which the patients are exceedingly sensitive to cold and damp. Agreeing with this, in the provings of Agaricus is a great sensitiveness to cold air. In skin disorders and brain exhaustions, give the lower potencies. A left- sided remedy. Talcott considered Agar, the most similar to general paralysis of all the remedies, with exalted notions of grandeur and power, hilarity and excitement followed by depression, confusion, imbecility. Ludicrous behavior, poor perception. Causes delirium, mania and idiocy. Very talkative and loquacious, and tend to be alcoholics (Lach.). Creative, tendency to poetry, prophesy. Incoherent speech. Silly, may have a confused mind, can't think. States of ecstasy and trance. Wants to kiss and embrace everyone (Hyos.). Mania with great displays of strength. Confusion in the brain as if semi-intoxicated. Tendency to use alcohol or drugs, spaced out, low energy. Disintegrated personality. Severe mood changes, irritability. May alternate between two states, one of being silly, foolish and manic and the other being depressed, sad and indifferent and the states may alternate. Worse in the morning and during the daytime. Spacey, awkward. Dull, stupid, poor memory. Can’t function during the day, relieved at night. Energy in the evening, they become more fluent, increased intellect. Worse mental exertion in general. Marked and persistent vertigo with constant impulse to fall backward. Very sleepy after meals. Twitching about eyes and face, redness without heat, puffy and distorted. Visual defects along with twitches, may have blurring vision or twitching in the left eye. Facial twitches, trigeminal neuralgias, tic douloureux. Spasmodic twitchings throughout body, followed by tremulousness, finally relaxation and exhaustion. Don't twitch during sleep. Drops things. Hands fly open uncontrollably. Arm may snap or twitch without their knowing it (Nux-v.). Muscular jerking and twitching, good for chorea. Spinal problems associated with twitching or brain problems associated with a retarded mind. Spasms and twitches due to spinal disease, arthritis or injury to the spine. Twitchings are especially marked in the eyes, eyelids and facial muscles. Blepharospasm and tic convulsif. Awkward people. Ankylosing spondylitis. Spine is as stiff as a board, as if spine would break (Tub., Rhus-t., Nat-m.). Severe arthritis of the spine. Shooting, burning pains in the spinal cord, as if the whole spine is on fire. Tingling deep in the spine. As if hot or cold needles are being stuck in the spine. For cold spots along the spine or very tender places that cannot be touched. Numbness of the extremities from some spinal problems. Pain in the sacrum followed by general paralysis symptoms, numbness in the limbs. Burning up and down the spine (Phos.). Back and neck feel dislocated, or for slipped discs with severe pain (Bry., Rhus-t.). Formication of the skin as if bugs are crawling under the skin (Cocain.). Symptoms in extremities are as if the blood was cut off to the feet or hands, severe numbness, tingling, biting, burning of the extremities, as if they are on fire. Spasms and then burning pain and numbness in their legs, intermittent claudication. Better moving, worse rest. Burning cold, numb, twitching. Awkward walk. Feet feel so cold as if they are frozen, like blocks of ice. Frostbite. Ailments since frostbite or sensation as if frozen. Poor circulation where the hands and feet turn blue, then burn as if on fire. Chilblains, loss of blood to the extremities. Spasms in the arteries and cuts off the blood. Chilblains, worse heat. Creeping, crawling sensations, formication, itching. Peripheral vascular disease when the blood vessels in the extremities have deteriorated to the threat of gangrene. Compromised blood flow. Typhoid states. Epilepsy. Brain disorders and fever with rolling of the head. Pain as if touched or pierced by needles of ice is very characteristic. Diagonal symptoms, right side and left forearm (Lac-c.). Electric-like shocks with jerking, spasms and twitching, painful. For bone aches as if they would break. Peculiar headaches, “throbbing headache with sensation of stiffness of muscles of face. Dull, drawing headache in the morning, extending into root of nose with nosebleed or thick mucus discharge. Pain as from a nail in right side of head.” Face feels stiff with the headache. Chilly remedy, worse cold weather, cold air, drinking cold water. They can also have sun headaches (Nat-m.). Worse from storms. Better in the evening, better warmth and better motion. Ravenous appetite with bolting of food. Desire for eggs, sweets and salt. Used for sudden, morning diarrhea that smells like sulphur (Aloe, Sulph., Rumx.). For diarrhea in children that is grass green (Cham.). Worse after sex (Ph-ac., Sil.), may have more pains and twitches. Sexual desire enormous and enthusiastic with relaxed penis and impotence. Bearing down pains in the pelvis as if everything will come with acrid, vaginal discharge with itching of the vagina. Also for spasmodic chronic hiccups (Nux-v.) and herpes on the lips that burn and smart. The nervous patients requiring Agar, pass little urine (opp. Ign.), though the bladder may be irritable. Clinical for alcoholism, intoxication, hangovers, DTs, the shakes. Worse alcoholic or for “old drunks”, spasms, twitches or convulsions, frothing at the mouth with arching of the back (Nux-v.). Muscle quivers and delirium tremors. Disordered speech in alcoholics. Lost continuity of speech. Children with retarded development. Late learning to walk and talk. For children who have slow minds or mental retardation. Fainting and twitching of children. Or twitches and spasms ever since puberty or a shock. Excitement brings on twitches and spasms. Uncoordinated children, they stumble, fall, and drop things. It's hard for them to learn. Very anxious about their health. Fear of cancer (Ars. Nit-ac., Phos. Kali-ar.). Preoccupation with spookiness, fear of ghosts. Talk and dream about the dead, are obsessed with coffins. RELATIONS - Agar, stands between Stram. and Lach. Antidote: Absin., Coff., Camph. Compare: (1) Agar- cpn., Agar-cps., Agar- em., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. (2) Muscarine, Atropiaexactly opposes Muscarine, resembles Pilocarpine in action. (3) Tamus - chillblains and freckles. (4) Cimic., Cann-i., Hyos.,Tarant-h. (5) Bov., Stict, Act-r., Cann-i., Op., Stram. - alcoholism, chorea. (6) Coff. - ecstasy. (7) Cic. - spasm of eyes. (8) Cod. - spasm of the eyelids. Mygal., Tarent., Verat. - icy-cold feeling in head. (9) Ars. - hot needles, Agar, ice-cold needles. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Liver - Sharp pains in liver. Cirrhosis. Liver weakness from alcohol. Lungs - Dyspnea while walking, has to stand still to get breath. Suffocative fits with anxiety and fainting. Labored, oppressed breathing. Difficult, noisy breathing. Frequent deep sighing. Dyspnea with rapid beating of heart. Impeded breathing at night, from closure of nose by thick mucus. Rapid breathing, with heat all over and sweat, most in face. Easy expectoration offloculi or balls of mucus. Large brown lumps. Mucus, worse mornings.

Kidneys - Lameness in left kidney, sore to touch. Stitches in urethra. Stitches and burning while urinating. Sudden and violent urging to urinate. Frequent urination. Viscid, glutinous, mucus from urethra. Urine, flows slowly or in drops, has to press for passing urine. Urine, cold, profuse, colorless, clear, lemon colored. As if a cold drop of urine were passing. Urine scanty and dark.

Cough - Cough with rattling of mucus, without expectoration. Dry cough after dinner. Cough ends in a sneeze. Spasmodic coughing at night after falling asleep. Cough with expectoration of little balls of mucus. Has to sit up in bed, or cough takes his breath. Has to sit down when cough comes. Violent attacks of coughing that can be suppressed by effort of will, worse eating, pain in head while cough lasts. Convulsive, hacking cough, with anxious sweat.

Perspiration - Cold sweat on face, neck, chest. Sweats easily. Sweats on alternate sides. Night sweats. Copious sweat when walking, or from least exertion. Greasy sweat, but not offensive. Sweats from anxious palpitations of heart. Sweats during stool.

Temperature - Chills or sweats easily. Chills with warm face, hands and feet. Very sensitive to cool air. Chilliness in open air, strikes through whole body. Shiverings over body, running from above downward. Goosebumps. Violent attacks of fever in evening. Burning spots.

name: Agaricus Pantherinus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from pressure..
constitution: Chills. Cholera. Chorea. Cold. Collapse. Coma. Cramps. Convulsions. Delirium. Diarrhea. Gastritis. Malaise. Trismus. Urine, suppression. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - agar-ph. Agaricus phalloides. Amanita bulbosa. Agaricus bulbosa. Amanita phalloides. N. O. Fungi. Europe and North America. Tincture of fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chills. Cholera. Chorea. Cold. Collapse. Coma. Cramps. Convulsions.…
full:
PHARMACY - agar-ph. Agaricus phalloides. Amanita bulbosa. Agaricus bulbosa. Amanita phalloides. N. O. Fungi. Europe and North America. Tincture of fresh fungus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chills. Cholera. Chorea. Cold. Collapse. Coma. Cramps. Convulsions. Delirium. Diarrhea. Gastritis. Malaise. Trismus. Urine, suppression. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agaricus phalloides is a small stinking fungus common in Europe and North America. The poison is a toxalbumin, resembling the poison in the rattlesnake and the poison excreted by the cholera and diphtheria germs. It acts on the red blood corpuscles, dissolving them so that blood escapes into the alimentary canal and the whole system is drained. The amount of this toxic principle is small, even handling specimens and breathing the spores affects some people unpleasantly. The poison is slow in development, even twelve to twenty hours after taking it the patient feels all right. Symptoms generally begin with vertigo, followed by violent choleraic symptoms with rapid loss of strength, with death preceded by stupor and spasms on the second or third day. Symptoms observed in poisoning cases give a complete picture. Extreme prostration and chilliness, the sweat is cold, marked hippocratic face, the tongue is cold and there is violent thirst. Debility, prostration. Malaise. Staggers as if intoxicated and with odd gestures, labors to express his sufferings but cannot articulate a syllable. Violent convulsions. Slight convulsive motions in the legs and arms, which generally extend to the muscles of the trunk and cause irregular distortions of the whole body. Constant restlessness. Very frequent bilious vomiting. Incessant cramps in stomach. Hard, tense abdomen. Frequent whitish watery stools or bilious, bloody stools. The urine is suppressed, the voice is hoarse. Pulse small intermittent, hardly perceptible. The limbs are cold and there are violent cramps in legs, feet and calves. Fatty degeneration of liver, heart and kidneys, hemorrhages in lungs, pleura and skin. Lethargic but mentally clear. Sudden changes from rapid to slow and from slow to rapid breathing. Intense thirst for cold water, dry skin. Extreme collapse. Cholera, cramps in stomach, cold limbs, urine suppressed. Vomiting and purging. Continuous urging to stool, but no gastric, abdominal or rectal pain. MIND - Mental excitement for three days after taking them. Delirium with faint indistinct dreams. Very averse to lying down. Restlessness and impatience lead him to make frequent attempts to walk about, but without any fixed object or design. Complete consciousness until death. Stupor. Coma and rattling respiration before death.

Mental excitement, which has in some cases lasted for three days. Sometimes there is stupor, at . other times consciousness remains until death. The effects do not come on until ten or twelve hours after taking the drug (Colch.). RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-pa., Agar-st., Amanita vemus. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Incessant cramps of stomach. Very frequent mucus and bilious vomiting. Vomiting of an offensive greenish-colored fluid of blood.

CLINICAL - Coma. Convulsions. Delirium. Headache. Twitching. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Thomas Stevenson M. D., writes in Guy's Hosp. Reports, vol. xix, p. 418: R. M., age thirty- nine years, ate food with Agar-st. in it. In half an hour he complained of nausea, some oppression in his breathing, and of severe pain across the forehead, with giddiness. His wife then noticed a strangeness in his appearance, and that in attempting to walk he kept his eyes fixed on the ground and guided himself with difficulty. He was, however, quite conscious of everything, and opened a book to see if he could read, but found that he was unable to make out any of the letters. When outdoors he continued to suffer severely from the pain across the forehead, with giddiness, and in addition experienced a feeling as if something was continually over his head, or as if passing “through an arcade.” He staggered much. About 11 p.m. after more than three hours, Mr. Hicks was called to see him. Hicks found him sitting down in a semi-state of stupor, with pupils dilated and inactive, and the pulse slow and feeble, from 55 to 60. On being roused and made to get up he looked completely bewildered, staggered as if tipsy, and said he could not recognize the things in the room, nor the room itself as that which he usually occupied. He now become more restless, threw his arms about, and seemed anxious to be continually moving from place to place. He also appeared to be somewhat convulsed, with twitching of the muscles of the face, and complained of pickings in his hands, and of a feeling as if they were swelling. He suddenly became more excited, and rushed wildly out of the house into the street. He was found in a neighbor's house, considerably prostrated after his exertions, and in a very lethargic state. Twenty grains of Zinc sulphate were now administered, and in a short time vomiting ensued, much dark fluid with numerous pieces of fungi being brought up. For a short time afterwards he expressed himself as feeling better, and was allowed to be taken to the door of the cottage. Almost immediately afterwards, as if moved by a sudden impulse, he again rushed wildly out, but after going a short distance stopped suddenly, as if bewildered. Emetics were again administered and the stomach pump used, and in the course of a few hours he gradually recovered, though feeling much prostrated. He said that during the whole time he was quite conscious of what was being done, but that at times he felt drowsy and inclined to sleep. When the convulsive paroxysms came on he felt wild and excited, with ah irresistible desire to move about and to run. He had no pain in the stomach or bowels at any time, nor did the feeling of oppression of his breathing continue after the first symptoms. RELATIONS - Compare: Agar. Agar-cpn., Agar-cps., Agar-em., Agar-pa., Agar-ph., Amanita vemus. REFERENCES - Stevenson.

HERBAL - The fermentedjuice of Agave americana is the Mexican intoxicating beverage “Pulque. ’’ The plant has a local reputation as a remedy for hydrophobia. Indicated in stomach ache and painful erections in gonorrhea.

HOMEOPATHIC - Agav-a. is an unproved remedy. According to Hansen, Agav-a. is indicated in scurvy, stomachache and gonorrhea. Hydrophobia. Scurvy, pale countenance, swollen and bleeding gums. Strangury. The legs covered with dark purple blotches, swollen, painful and hard. Appetite poor, bowels constipated. MIND - Quarrelsomeness, excitement, fright inability to swallow, great anxiety. COMMENTS - A striking case is quoted by the Homeopathic Recorderfrom El Siglo Medico. A boy developed the classical symptoms of hydrophobia four and a half months after being bitten. He showed quarrelsomeness, excitement, fright, inability to swallow, small frequent pulse, and great anxiety. Finally swallowing was impossible, restraint had to be used to prevent him from biting his nurses in the hospital. As a last resource, a piece of Agave was offered to the boy by the doctor in attendance, cut from a hedge of the plant with which the hospital grounds were fenced. To the astonishment of all, the boy reached for it and ate it greedily, almost without chewing. By evening a decrease in the violence of the nervous attacks was manifest, though they remained as frequent as before. The improvement was slow but steady. On the fourth day he took some nourishment. but also continued chewing Agave and swallowing the juice. On the fifth day he recovered consciousness but still demanded Agave. On the eighth day he said he did not want any more as “it tasted too bitter and caused a burning in the mouth.” He had no further symptoms of the disease. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anhalonium, Lyss., Lach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

MIND - Sadness and pessimism. Desire for the unattainable. Unsatisfied, unrealistic desires. Alcoholism with mental troubles. Voluble state, excitable. Jokes, asks questions is humorous. State of nervous irritation, stammers, shouts, becomes violent, even aggressive. Hypomania, a state of exaltation, exaggerated over-activity, followed often by a period of depression. Temporary amnesia following the excited state. Dazed state.

Difficulty in wiping the nose, the scabs come off, causing great pain. Nose blocked at night, alternating from one side to the other. Ozaena. Sinusitis.

COMMENTS - The Homeopathic proving was directed by De Legarreta using 3x, 15 drops three times a day. In his first proving, he used the mother tincture, prepared from the plant itself. In the second proving, the remedy was prepared from Tequila liqueur. The symptomatological table was the same in both cases. De Legarreta recommends 15 drops of 3x in the morning, fasting as a preventive treatment foralcoholism, causing aversion to alcoholic drinks. Sleep - Insomnia becomes worse after drinking alcohol. Disturbed dreams, having a bearing on the day's events and of an obsessive nature.
