CLINICAL - Allergies. Anus, fissure. Ascites. Catarrh. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Diarrhea. Earache. Facial paralysis. Feet, easily galled. Hay fever. Hernia. Influenza. Itching. Laryngitis. Neuritis. Neuroma. Otitis. Panaritium. Pneumonia. Sinusitis. Sneezing. Traumatic, neuritis. Whitlow. Whooping cough. Worms. Yellow fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allium cepa covers more symptoms of common colds and hay fever than any other remedy. Anyone who has cut up raw onions for cooking knows the irritation upon the eyes and nose. Onions cause active sneezing andlachrymation. If the homeopathic principle of cure is true, it ought to be a good remedy for coryza, and it is. All-c. affects the mucus membranes of nose, eyes, larynx and bowels, causing increased secretions. Hay fever and coryza with acrid nasal discharges and laryngeal symptoms. Burning of the eyelids, nose, mouth, throat, bladder, skin. Acute colds from damp cold weather. Coughs, colds or headache, worse in warm room, better in open air, worse again on returning to warm room. Eye discharges may be bland. Cough caused by tickling in larynx, constant inclination to hack in order to relieve it. It has cured violent catarrhal laryngitis, hoarse cough with feeling as if it would split and tear the larynx, causing watering of eyes. Cough from inhaling cold air. Nasal secretion is acrid, secretion from eye is bland. Traumatic neuritis. Neuralgic pains like a fine thread, following amputations or injuries to nerves. Thread- like pains in the face. Left-side facial paralysis. Wounds do not heal. Singer's coryza. Neuroma. Senile gangrene. Sensation of glowing heat in different parts of the body. Symptoms go from left to right. The feet are aggravated by walking. The toothache is better by cold air or cold washing. Picking or sucking teeth improves the toothache. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Desires raw onions. Strangulated hernia has been known to follow the eating abundantly of cooked onions. A raw onion eaten just before going to bed is a popular remedy for sleeplessness. MIND - Anxious about their health. Despair of recovery. Fear that pain will become unbearable. Melancholy. Indefinable anxiety. Indolence in morning. Confusion of mind, after coffee, wine.

Head - Dull headache, with coryza. Catarrhal headache, in forehead, worse in warm room, towards evening. Headache ceases during menses, returns when flow disappears. Aching in forehead, extending to eyes and face, better free running coryza. Electric shock passes through head. Skull bones numb. Pain in occiput and down the neck.

Eyes - Itching, biting, burning in the eyes. Eyes red, sensitive to touch. Flow of tears. Much burning and smarting lachrymation. Sensitive to light. Eyes suffused and watery, profuse, bland lachrymation, better in open air. Burning in eyelids, worse coughing, wants to rub them. Sensation as if eye were hanging by a string or torn. Nearobjects seem distant, while yawning. Letters appear smaller. Swelling around the eyes.

Ears - Earache, shooting pain in Eustachian tube. Aching extending to throat. Itching in ears from allergies. Otitis media. Discharge of pus from the ear. Hardness of hearing.

Nose - Fluent coryza with headache, cough and hoarseness. Way/ever (Euphr., Sabad., Psor.). Allergies every August. Spring coryza. Nose drips. Acrid discharge, when singing. Sneezing, especially when entering a warm room. Constant sneezing with profuse acrid coryza. Burning and smarting in the nose. Burning pain in edges of nose and lips. Profuse watery discharge with sneezing. Acrid burning discharge. Nasal discharge excoriating the nose and upper lip. Feeling of a lump at root of nose. Coryza, headache, cough and hoarseness. Copious acrid watery discharge from nose, with bland watering of eyes. Polyps. Nosebleed. Sinusitis. Sensitive to odors of flowers and the skin of peaches. Nose stopped, nasal voice. Common colds becomes laryngitis.

Face - Thread-like pains in face. Paralysis of left half of face, also in limbs of same side. Facial neuritis. Food - Thirst. Canine hunger. Appetite, increased or diminished. Strong craving for raw onions, cannot take any other nourishment.

Mouth - Bad odor from the mouth and throat.

Throat - Hoarseness. Sensation as of a lump in the throat. Tickling in larynx. Expectoration of a lumpy mucus through the posterior sinuses. Sensation as if larynx is split and torn. Pain in throat extending to the ear. COMMENTS - Coryza with frequent sneezing and profuse acrid discharge, corroding upper lip and nose. Lachrymation, also profuse, but bland (Euphr. is the reverse). The action of All-c. seems to be primarily in the nose (Euphr., in the eyes). Allium Cepa is irritating discharge with burning and itching, from a cold, flu, allergies and hay fever. The nose, the back of the throat, the palate and the throat are itching and burning. A keynote is that the upper lip is red and irritated. Frequent sneezing (Ars.), with discharge. Strong symptoms from the nose, profuse sneezing (Nat-m.). Another keynote is itching in the back of the throat that drips into the larynx and causes hoarseness and change of voice. Burning in the larynx and voice box. Allergic asthma. A hay fever that was suppressed with antihistamines that went into the lungs (Ars., lod.). Nash found it particularly useful in children when the profuse coryza or cold extended to the bronchial s with much mucus coughing and rattling of mucus. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Am. - toothache. Cham. - abdominal pains. Roasted coffee will remove onion breath. Compare: (1) Euphr., Wye., Sabad., Arundo, All-s. (2) Aeon., Puls., Gels. (3) Nux-v. - coryza recurring in August. (4) Verat. - colic with despondency. (5) Thuj. - offensive breath and diarrhea after eating on. ions. (6) Lach. - left to right. (7) Calen.. Hyper.neuritis, amputation pain. Complementary: Phos., Puls., Sars., Ther., Thuj. Incompatible: All-s., Aloe, Scilla. Followed by: Calc, and Sil. in polyps. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Nash. Murphy.

Stomach - Sour belching. Nausea, coming from stomach up the throat into the fauces. Weak, empty feeling in stomach. Pressure in stomach. Pain in region of pylorus.

Abdomen - Rumbling offensive flatus. Pains in left hypogastrium. Colic sitting, moving about. Very offensive flatus. Belching with rumbling and puffing up of the abdomen. Violent cutting pain in the left lower abdomen, with frequent desire to urinate. Pains in liver region. Abdomen distended, rumbling, urging, and finally diarrhea.

Rectum - Diarrhea after midnight and in the morning. Flatus very offensive. Hemor rhoids, tearing, jerking pains in anus. Stitches in the rectum. Cracks at the anus. Itching at the anus. Worms.

Back - Intense pain in ñapé of neck. Pain under right shoulder blade. Chills run down the back with frequent urination, followed by heat and thirst. Causations - Damp cold wind, weather causes colds and toothache. Colds of spring, hay fever of August, epidemics of spasmodic cough in autumn. Wet feet. Eating spoiled fish, cucumbers, salads. Injuries. Shooting pains after surgical operations. Constitutions - Especially adapted to phlegmatic patients. Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Limbs - Joints feel lame. Panaritium. Painful disorders of the fingers about the nails, red streaks running up the arm. Limbs, especially arms feel sore and tired. Neuralgia of stump. Bad effects from getting feet wet. Ulcers when skin is rubbed off by the shoes especially on the heels. Sore feet from long walking. Lungs - Hacking cough on inhaling cold air. Acute bronchitis. Oppressed breathing from pressure in middle of chest. Constricted feeling in region of epiglottis. Violent catarrhal laryngitis, the hoarse cough seemed to split and tear the larynx. Much sneezing and coughing.

Sleep - Yawning in deep sleep or with headache and drowsiness and cramp in stomach. Wakes at 2 a.m. Gaping in deep sleep. Dreams of being near water, of battles, precipices, deep wells, of storms, high waves, Annoying dreams in convalescents.

Skin - Redness, nettle rash, measles, scarlatina, when the complaints are characterized by the coryza symptoms. Prickling as from pins. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body. Red streaks running up arm. Felon after childbirth.

Modalities - Better in open air. Better cold room. Better bathing. Better motion. Worse in a warm room. Worse damp weather. Worse spring. Worse wet feet. Worse afternoon and evening. Worse lying down. Worse singing. Rest aggravates, feels better from motion.

Kidneys - Sensation of weakness in bladder and urethra. Frequent and copious urination. Increased secretion of urine with coryza. Strangury after wet feet. Dribbling of urine in elderly people. Urine red, with much urging and burning in urethra.

Temperature - Fever with rumbling in the abdomen, coryza, and thirst. Flitting heat over whole body, and thirst. Coldness alternates with heat during catarrh. Sweats easily and copiously.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from sitting bent. Worse from change of temperature. Worse pressure. Worse drinking bad water. Worse gluttony. Walking aggravates pains in limbs. Every step causes excruciating pain in intestines. Worse in evening and night. Worse in morning on waking..

PHARMACY - all-s. Allium sativum. Garlic. N. O. Liliaceae. Alliaceae. Tincture of fresh bulb. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alopecia. Asthma, periodical. Bronchiectasis. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Chest, complaints. Colic. Colitis. Constipation. Coughs. Coxalgia. Dandruff. Deafness. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Fevers. Hams. Headaches. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. High blood pressure. Hoarseness. Mensfrual. Menorrhagia. Ophthalmia. Prolapsed anus. Retained, placenta. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Salivation. Scurvy. Skin, disorders. Sprains. Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Whitlow. Worms.

HERBAL - Garlic has been used as a condiment from ancient times and also as a remedy against worms and fevers. It has a reputation of lowering the blood pressure.

HOMEOPATHIC - All-s., though closely related to All-c., is incompatible with it and not very like it in action. It produces headache in connection with digestive troubles and menstruation. Heavy headache, can hardly open eyes, better onset of menses, worse after. Teste cured with it chronic dyspepsia in old, fleshy persons, whose bowels were deranged by the least irregularity of diet. He also greatly relieved cases of diabetes mellitus with it. Periodical asthma, a case of permanent dyspnea, rheumatism of hip, swelling of breasts after weaning. Characteristic respiratory symptoms include a cough, giving rise to fetid breath (Caps.). Bronchial catarrh with profuse, gelatinous, difficult mucus expectoration. Cough when smoking. All-s. has vaso-dilatory properties. It acts directly on intestinal mucus membrane increasing peristalsis. Colitis with pathological flora. Adapted to fleshy subjects with dyspepsia and catarrhal disorders. High livers. Patients who eat a great deal more, especially meat, than they drink. The digestion in disordered by slightest irregularities in diet. Pressure in epigastrium and transverse colon, better by pressure and sitting bent. Pain in hip, psoas and illiac muscles. Stings and bites. Dropsy after protracted intermittent in marshy districts. The child is drowsy, lifeless, extremely pale, bowels torpid, will not walk and the legs do not grow as rapidly as rest of the body. Breasts swollen and painful to touch. Profuse menses. During menses there is soreness of vulva and thighs. Pulmonary tuberculosis. Hemoptysis. Cough and expectoration diminishes, temperature becomes normal, weight is gained and sleep becomes regular. MIND - Anxiety and impatience. Sensitive. Fears he won't recover, that he won't able to bear any medicine. Fear of being poisoned. Fear he will never get well. Impulse to run away. Wants many things, pleased with nothing. Weak memory. Sadness when alone. Weeping during sleep.

Head - Heavy, pulsation in temples. Headaches before menses, ceases during, worse after menses. Heaviness in forehead. Dull pain in occiput in morning, while lying on the back. Headache with mucus in the throat in dyspeptic subjects. Dandruff.

Eyes - Catarrhal ophthalmia at night, smarting, burning and lachrymation, agglutination, returns every night when he tries to read. Tarsi sore with irritation.

Ears - Catarrhal deafness. Hardened earwax and crusts (Thuj.).

Nose - Coryza rather dry than fluent, with pressive pain from above the root of the nose. Smarting at junction of ale nasi and face. Blowing blood from the nose in the night.

Face - Spots on face. Lips are dry. Sharp pain on one side of the face.

Mouth - Much sweetish saliva after meals and at night. Tickling sensation in the lower teeth. Swelling of lower gums. Dryness of palate. Hot taste in mouth, from throat, strongly reminding him of garlic.

Throat - Sticky feeling in throat with dryness, tickling, heat, and raw feeling in larynx. Sensation as of something cold rising in throat. Sensation as of a hot and smarting vapor rising in the throat. Mucus accumulations in the throat in the morning.

Stomach - Burning belchings. Slightest error in diet disturbs the stomach. Sensations of cold and or hot ascending esophagus. Burning in stomach, very sensitive to the least pressure. Weight in stomach which prevents sleep. Pressure inward as from a stone in epigastrium.

Abdomen - Pressure in upper abdomen, better by sitting bent and pressing with both hands. Colic from flatus, twisting and pinchings around navel. Emission of fetid flatus. Everything seemed to drag downward. Weight in hypogastrium, immediately after a meal.

Rectum - Constipation with constant dull pains in bowels. Expels flatus. Stool first fecal, then watery and hot. Involuntary stools. Diarrhea with cuttings in abdomen and loins. Hemorrhoids. Prolapsed anus. Worms.

Female - Eruption in vagina, on breasts and vulva during menses. Menses profuse, too early. Headache and dizziness lessen as the flow becomes established. Soreness of vulva and thighs during menses. Suppurating pimples on vulva. During menses extensive excoriations of skin of internal portions of thighs. Retained placenta. Food - Voracious appetite. Thirst. Hunger and emptiness in stomach without appetite. Desire for butter. Digestion is disordered by slightest error in diet. Complaints from bad water, gluttony.

Chest - Darting pain in the chest which prevents sleep. Pain in left chest with dark urine. Chest complaints worse after eating. Constitutions - Rather a gourmand than a glutton. Suited to persons who are disposed to excesses at the table, have strong constitutions, dark complexions, firm flesh, though occasionally disposed to obesity. Persons who eat a great deal more than they drink. Suited to fleshy people and those used to high living.

Heart - Leaping beats of the heart. High blood pressure.

Back - Red spots like ringworm on the back. Itching between shoulders. Tearing, cutting pain in sacrum, in morning. Simple pain in coccyx. Breasts - Breasts swollen and tender during menses. Swelling of breast after weaning. Dull stitches in right breast. Breasts sensitive to touch. Eruption of red blotches between the breasts and around the nipples. Causations - Drinking bad water, gluttony, meat eating.

Limbs - Rheumatism of hip. Tearing pain in hip. Pain in psoas and iliacus muscles, worse crossing legs. Painful contraction in arm. Pain in forearm, seems as if paralyzed. Burning, then moisture in palms. Skin peels off the hands. Tearing pains in fingers extending below the nails. Weakness in lower limbs, painful weariness in the thighs. Pain as from a sprain in ankle joint, in toe joints. Tingling in feet, burning in soles, stiffness in feet. Lungs - Difficult breathing as if sternum compressed. Periodic asthma. Constant rattling of mucus in bronchials. Cough in the morning after leaving bedroom with mucus expectoration. Coughing when smoking. Sensitive to the cold air. Painful irritation of windpipe when coughing. Cough seeming to come from stomach. Dry cough after eating. Bronchiectasis with fetid expectoration. Great difficulty in expectorating a glutinous mucus. Expectoration of thin, yellowish, purulent-looking blood-streaked mucus of putrid odor.

Sleep - Drowsiness after a meal. Muscles twitch on falling asleep. Sleep prevented by stitches on chest, weight on stomach, or thirst. Coldness felt in sleep and awakening him frequently. Dreams of water and storms. Anxious dreams, continuing after waking.

Skin - Loose, dry, wilted skin. Skin sensitive. Swelling with itching and burning. Red spots, on hands, on chest, on back. Herpetic itching burning, red or whitish spots on a swollen surface.

Modalities - Better from sitting bent. Worse from change of temperature. Worse pressure. Worse drinking bad water. Worse gluttony. Walking aggravates pains in limbs. Every step causes excruciating pain in intestines. Worse in evening and night. Worse in morning on waking.

Tongue - Tongue pale red papillae. Sensation of a hair on tongue or throat. Vertigo - Vertigo while reading. Vertigo on looking steadily at anything for a long time. Short-lasting vertigo, and only on rising from a chair. COMMENTS - Pain, pressi ve from within outward (Bry.), stinging or stinging and burning or stinging with paralytic weakness ortearing and crampy. Sometimes they increase gradually to a high point and then decrease gradually (Sulph., Stann.). “Hair” sensation on tongue, worse reading. Copious sweetish saliva. The hip is the seat of many rheumatic pains. Tearing in hip. Pain in psoas and iliac muscles worse least movement, though he can lift the limb with the hands. Aggravation from reading (Cina.). Vertigo, brought on by looking long and steadily at anything. This is probably, in essence, the same modality as worse by reading. Catarrhal ophthalmia returning every night on trying to read. Coryza, moist, dry, thin, fluent with pressive pains above root of nose. Scurvy gums, sore mouth. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: All-c., Lyc. Compare: (1) Ars., Senega, Kali-n. All-c. (2) Ornithogalum umbellatum - stomach disorders. (3) Bry., Caps., (fetid breath with cough). (4) Coloc. - colic, hip-pain, Ign., Kali-bi. (ropy expectoration, hairon tongue). (5) Rhus-t. and Hyos. (fear of being poisoned), Lyc., Nux-v., Seneg. Complementary: Ars. Incompatible: Aloe., All-c., Scilla. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Urine increased. Whitish very abundant urine, becoming cloudy from nitric acid. A kind of diabetes. Dark brown with copious sediment.

Temperature - Chilliness on one side only. Shivering before midday and in evening. During coldness, redness of face. Vomiting during the fever. Sweat in afternoon. Sweat acrid, causing itching, fetid.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from climbing stairs. Better closing eyes. Better eating, but if hungry, there is no improvement. Worse by dust, smells. Worse heat. Worse coughing. Worse laughter. Worse physical or mental exertion. Worse noise. Worse left side. Worse between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m..

Pharyngitis. Pimples.

CLINICAL -…
full:
PHARMACY - allox. Alloxanum. Meoxalylurea. Allopathic drug. It takes the form of rhomboid crystals soluble in alcohol and insoluble in water. The anhydrous crystals are dark yellow in color, the hydrogenized crystals are colorless. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aerophagy. Alcoholism. Aphthae. Arthritis. Bedwetting. Blood, disorders. Cardiac neurosis. Catarrh. Conjunctivitis. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Ecchymosis. Eczema. Glossitis. Glycosuria. Headaches. Hypogycemia. Insomnia. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Myopia. Narcolepsy. Nausea. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Nightmares. Numbness. Osteoporosis. Pancreas, disorders. Pharyngitis. Pimples. Poly-neuritis. Purpura. Rheumatism. Toothache. Toxemia. Toxic diabetes. Vaginitis. Varicose veins.

HOMEOPATHIC - Alloxan was discovered accidentally by Dum and his collaborators in 1943. The toxicological action can be seen at the level of the pancreas, the kidneys, the liver, the lungs and in the blood. In animals, diabetes mellitus is provoked or, in other words, alloxanic diabetes. There would be a rapid degeneration if the islet Beta cells responsible for the production of insulin. The homeopathic proving of Alloxan was undertaken by Templeton on two occasions, in 1949 on six provers, when the potencies 6c and 30c were tried out, and in 1951 on nine provers and seven controls. Lack of heat and vital reaction. Disturbed sleep with nightmares. General indifference. Need for solitude. Dryness of digestive mucus membranes. Diabetes mellitus. Excessive thirst and frequent urination. Joint pains in the lumbar, sacral and ileocecal regions. Neuralgia of the tongue. Toothache. Acrid dyspepsia. Spontaneous ecchymosis and eruption of itching pimples. Sensation of body being dispersed into different parts. Osteoporosis and muscular weakness. Decrease of phosphoremia and increase of phosphates in the blood. Glycosuria without hyperglycemia. MIND - Great forgetfulness. Forgets places, names, things just done, just heard. Loss of short-term memory. Spelling mistakes. Words don't register. Mistakes in spelling. Dyslexia. Silly mistakes in writing simple words. Silly sort of attitude to serious things. Alcoholic poly-neuritis with mental troubles. Paranoia. Sadness and tearfulness improved by solitude. Need for solitude and uneasiness about the future. Weeping better when alone. Indifference towards the surrounding environment. Indifference to conversation. Indifference to loved ones. Indifference to work. Irritable with people, talking, loud voices. Irritability from noise. Fits of anger. Hurried. Dogmatic. Dictatorial. Impatient, taps foot with impatience. Quarrelsome. Hurried, others move too slow. Wants to dash about, wants to do everything quickly. Confusion as to his identity, as if head was being lifted off. Delusion, as if head were separated from body (Psor.). People talking seemed miles away. Voices seemed far away. Keeps washing hands.

Head - Feeling of constriction and heat in the head, which is cold to the touch. Heaviness of head on waking with sensation of the hair being pulled. Headache better ascending steps, better closing eyes, worse couching, worse hot room. Headache from hunger, but eating does not relieve. Headache worse laughing, better talking, better travelling.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Eyelids red, burning and itching. Eyes painful, especially as a result of light and after reading, ameliorated by closing the lids. Sight dim with patches and bright spots. Myopia. Dim vision and twitching of eyelids, on waking (Cycl.). Sparks like fragments of fire.

Ears - Deep, drumming pain inside. Itching of the auditory canal. Eczema of the outer ear.

Nose - Acute catarrh of the nasal mucus membrane with streaming, sometimes from the right side, sometimes from the left. Aggravated by dust, smells and heat. Catarrh from dust. Sensation of heat in nose on inspiration. Smell in nose as of musty books.

Mouth - Breath smells like apples. Salty taste on lips. Sweetish taste on lips. Corners of lips cracked. Dry, chapped lips. Lowerjaw painful. Toothache, aggravated by sweet things. Tip of tongue painful. Small, superficial ulcers on the mouth and palate. Bitter, acrid taste, sweet taste on the lips. Mouth dry.

Throat - Acute and chronic laryngitis and pharyngitis. Dry, painful on the left side with burning, grating pain. Swallowing painful, improved with a hot drink. Throat pain better drinking, better expectoration, worse singing, when talking. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Uranium nit. - Excessive thirst, morbid hunger, emaciation. Polyuria. (2) Ph-ac. - Apathy, indifference towards everything, weakness, headaches, diarrhea, abundant urine, seminal discharge, weakness of vertebral column. (3) Arg-n. - Apprehension. Sadness. Weakness of legs. Feeling of a splinter of wood sticking in the pharynx. Urinary incontinence by day and by night, desire for sweet things to eat. REFERENCES - Julian.

Stomach - Nausea before meals and heavy, aching feeling after. Nausea when travelling.

Abdomen - Abdominal distention with profuse rumbling. Toxic diabetes. Ileocecal pain, aggravated by bending forwards and by movement. Sensation of a band around abdomen.

Rectum - Diarrhea, worse between 6 a.m. and 9 a.m., leaving a burning excoriation in the anus. Feeling of insufficient evacuation. Stools clammy and sticky, blood-streaked. Fullness after stool.

Female - Inflammation of the vulva and vagina. Feeling of swelling in the vagina, especially after standing for a long time. White leucorrhea, non-irritating, but increasing with the approach of menses. Sensation as if vagina were swollen, worse standing. Food - Feeling of hunger, quickly sated. Hypogycemia. Aversion to salt. Desire for cold dritiks, refreshing things. Excessive thirst and feeling of dryness. Worse cold drinks, warm drinks. Better warm drinks.

Chest - Feeling of a heavy weight on the chest. Heaviness better menses. Stitching pain better menses. Constitutions - The subjects are often phosphoric and very weak. Subjects nervous, uneasy, anxious.

Heart - Pain as of a punch in the precordial region. Shooting pain in the heart, worse when walking. Retro- sternal cramping pain. Cardiac neurosis.

Back - Stiffness better stretching. Pain and cervical stiffness, aggravated in bed, ameliorated by stretching. Cramping pain in the shoulder blade, cutting pain, aggravated by drinking. Lumbar rheumatism. Arthritis of the spine, preventing movement. Pain in the lower lumbar region, worse in bed, in kneeling position and by standing, better by hot weather. Pain in lumbar region worse cold weather. Pain in lumbo-sacral region extending down legs.

Limbs - Cramp in the calves and toes in bed. Aching with shivering in the arms, legs, ameliorated by stretching out, aggravated by the cold and by standing. Chronic joint problems. Chronic rheumatism of the hip. Heaviness and prominent veins in the legs. Varicose veins. Varicose hemorrhage. Itching of leg followed by ecchymoses. Numbness of arms when raising them. Numbness of legs when crossing them.

Sleep - Troubled sleep with dreams, nightmares. Sleepwalking, somnambulism. Insomnia until 2 a.m. Sleep disturbed by dreams. Dreams of accidents. Dreams being chased by a horse. Dreams of resurrection. Dreams of death of a friend. Dreams of bandits, robbers. Dreams of rats, toads, frogs in the bed. Dreams of being followed or falling. Dreams killing with a knife. Dreams being imprisoned. Dreams of sermons.

Skin - Dry, cracking eczema. Ecchymosis. Rheumatoid purpura. Purpura without fever, beginning suddenly with large, benign ecchymoses. Hands dry, chapped. Spontaneous bruising of the fingers and legs. Skin dirty, with eruption of itching pimples.

Modalities - Better from climbing stairs. Better closing eyes. Better eating, but if hungry, there is no improvement. Worse by dust, smells. Worse heat. Worse coughing. Worse laughter. Worse physical or mental exertion. Worse noise. Worse left side. Worse between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m.

Liver - Pain in liver on breathing, after eating, better eating, better pressure. Pulsating in liver. Bubbling in region of liver. Lungs - Breathing difficult after meals.

Kidneys - Kidney pain on the left side on urination. Dysuria. Glycosuria. Frothy urine, burning as it passes down the urethra. Frequent urination by day. Waking from urging to urinate, morbid desire. Sudden urging, can't hold urine for long.

Bladder - Feeling of fullness in the bladder. Coldness in bladder, worse draft of air. Sensation as if bladder is swollen. Incontinence on hurrying to get up, on sneezing. Bedwetting.

Blood - Reduction in the number of phosphates in the blood plasma, normal presence of glucose in the blood, azotemia. Reduction of sedimentation rate.

full:
PHARMACY - aln. Alnus rubra. Red alder. Alnus serrulata. Alnus glutinosa. Black alder. Tag alder. Common alder of Europe. N. O. Cupuliferae. Betulaceae. Tincture of the bark. Tincture of the young shoots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Glands, enlarged. Gleet, hemorrhage. Herpes. Impetigo. Leucorrhea. Psoriasis. Rheumatism. Scrofula. Syphilis.

HERBAL - The bark-tincture of Aln. is used by herbalists as an ‘ ‘alterative’ ’in scrofulous conditions in chronic skin affections, rheumatism, syphilis, gravel and gleet. Aln. has some reputation as a remedy for skin affections, glandular enlargements and indigestion from imperfect secretion of gastric juice. It stimulates nutrition and thus acts favorably upon strumous disorders, enlarged glands, etc.

HOMEOPATHIC - Among its indications are leucorrhea with erosions which bleed easily, amenorrhea with burning pains from back to pubis and hematuria. Ulcerated mucus membranes of mouth and throat. Fingers covered by crust caused by pustules, disagreeable odor. Indigestion from imperfect secretion of gastric juice.

Female - Leucorrhea with erosions of cervix, bleeding easily. Amenorrhea with burning pains from back to pubis.

Skin - Chronic herpes. Enlarged submaxillary glands. Eczema, prurigo. Purpura hemorrhagica. Poison oak, used topically. COMMENTS - The plant grows in swamps and marshes. Not to be confused with certain of the Rhamnacae, which are also popularly called Alders. Cooper, who used a fresh plant tincture of Alnus glutinosa, noted the “Pain in rectum after stool.” and “heaviness in head as after being drunk the night before.” Hale gave, as particularly indicating it, “Eruptions on the skin alternating with diseased conditions of mucus membrane.” REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Cooper.

name: Aloe Socotrina
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cool open air. Better cold applications. Better passing flatus. Better closing eyes. Better taking tea or stimulants. Worse in early morning. Worse evenings. Worse summer. Worse heat. Worse hot damp weather or hot dry weather. Worse after eating or drinking. Worse after dysentery. Worse yawning or chewing. Worse stepping hard. Worse evening. Worse standing or walking..

Tuberculosis. Uterus, prolapsed. Varicose veins. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Aloe socotrina is one of the oldest and most famous remedies. It is in worldwide use as a purgative and forms a leading ingredient in a large number of patent medicines for regulating the bowels and menstrual functions.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aloe has the anti-psoric property of throwing out internal complaints to the skin. It causes congestion of various parts, especially abdomen, pelvic organs and head. Especially suitable to lymphatic and hypochondriacal patients. Bad effects from sedentary life or habits. Dissatisfied and angry about himself, alternating with lumbago. Aloe affects abdominal veins, causing congestion, relaxation in rectum, liver, colon and pelvis. The rectal symptoms are usually very strong. Prolapse rectum. Burning in rectum. Heat internally and externally. Pulsation in rectum after eating. Portal congestion. Hemorrhoids like a bunch of grapes, better cold bathing. Burning and stitching in anus and rectum from hemorrhoids, preventing sleep. Hot rtool and flatus. The child goes around the house, dropping little hard, round, marble-like stools. Diarrhea, after eating oysters in the hot season, or of beer drinkers. A lot of mucus is passed with pain in rectum, after lumpy, watery stools. Rumbling, gurgling in bowels, sudden urging, sense of insecurity then hurriedly passes a gushing watery stool. Uncertain whether gas or stool will come. Diarrhea with pain in the rectum after stool. Lienteric stools. Ana/ weakness, oozes mucus. Stools escape with flatus or when urinating. Stools, mushy, lumpy, watery, gelatinous, bloody, solid stools passed involuntarily, urging to stools with passing flatus only. Aloe has a diarrhea that is worse in the early morning (Sulph). Diarrhea worse immediately after eating, worse from walking (Aesc., Thuj.), or standing (Sulph.). Feeling of insecurity of bowels on passing gas or before stool (Phos.). Periodic headaches which alternate with lumbago. Sensation of fullness in the parts. Heavy, dragging, as of a load. Drawing, downward sensation. Discharges, gelatinous, post nasal, stools, etc. General weakness and weariness. Heat external and internal. Aloe has been used successfully in the treatment of tuberculosis by giving the pure juice. Carroll Dunham cured a heavy frontal incapacitating headache in an old man occurring in winter and alternating with a diarrhea which occurred in summer when he was free from headache. Dunham also cured incontinence of urine in an old man with enlarged prostate with the diarrhea. MIND - Ill humor, especially in cloudy weather or with constipation. Taciturn after eating. Sense of insecurity. Discontented, better evening. Dissatisfied and angry about himself. Sadness in morning, betterevening. Hates people, repels everyone. Thinks that she would die in a week. Fright at slight noises. Restlessness and fear. Fear of men. Exhaustion alternating with activity. Disinclination to mental labor. Life is a burden. Aversion to labor. Lassitude alternating with great mental activity. Children, with much emotions, chat and laugh. Hysteria. Extremely excited during pain. Easily excited, angry, revengeful. Wants to destroy object of wrath, better tea or mild stimulants. Trembling from musical sounds and other noises. Imagines that persons are stepping hard or quickly. Time passes too slowly.

Head - Dull, pressive pain, worse heat. Headache alternates with lumbago. Headache alternates with intestinal and uterine disorders. Headaches are above forehead with heaviness in eyes, must partially close them. Headache better closing eyes. Headache after stool. Headache with heaviness of eyes and nausea. Headaches worse heat, better cold applications. Heavy pressure on vertex. Clinking in head as from some thin-slivered glass, extending to ears. Headaches with gastrointestinal irritation and coldness of lower limbs. Congestion to head, compelling one to sit up. Congestion to head and face during stool. Sensitiveness of scalp in spots. Alopecia with chronic headaches. Dryness of hair.

Eyes - Lachrymation. Congestion of eyes. Pressure in orbits. Compelled to make small during pain in forehead. Pain deep in orbits. Flickering before eyes. Redness of eyes with yellow vision. Closes eyes partially from pain in forehead. Pain as if in muscles, worse right side.

Ears - Cracking when chewing when mov-._ r ingjaw. Sudden explosion and clashing in left ear. Tinkling as of some thin, shivered, metallic globe in head. Sticking in left ear, later in right. Earache during menses. Internal and external heat.

Nose - Coldness of tip. Nosebleed in morning on awakening. Full of crusts. Nosebleed from nose after waking. Cory za with burning and pain in nose. Sneezing causes stitches in umbilical region. Redness of nose in open cold air. Dryness of nose in morning, in bed.

Face - Lips dry, cracked, swollen, pustular, sore at corners. Lips markedly red, bleed- ■ ing. Pain while yawning or chewing. Heat of the face when excited, or during headache. Face pale during cloudy weather. Lips moist, white, scaly.

Mouth - Dry mouth, with increased thirst and greater redness of the lips. Lips dry, peeling off, cracked, bleeding. Metallic, bitter or sour taste. Bitter, nauseous taste. Taste like ink or iron. Yellow spots in mouth. Accumulation of saliva in mouth. Sickening smell from mouth. Increased salivation. Inflamed sore spots in mouth and inside of cheeks. Palate swollen. Concave edges of teeth seem sharp and hurt tongue.

Throat - Thick lumps of tough mucus. Varicose condition of veins in pharynx. Dry, scrapy feeling. Hawking of thick lumps of jelly-like mucus. Raw and swollen feeling in throat. Fauces raw, hot, as if burned. Scraping in larynx. Voice husky, hawking.

Stomach - Bitter, acrid or sour eructations. Tasteless belchings with oppressions in stomach. After eating, flatulence and nausea with a headache. Pain in pit when making false step. Sensations as if vomiting were coming on, from rising of flatulence toward throat. Fullness in stomach, followed by distension. Nausea with headache. Nausea with empty feeling in stomach. Nausea with pain at umbilicus. Vomiting of blood. Stools - Feces and urine escape together, can't pass one without the other. Child goes around house, dropping little hard round marble-like stools. Stool passes without effort, almost unnoticed. Lumpy, watery stool. Jelly- like stools with soreness in rectum after stool. A lot of mucus with pain in rectum after stool. Stool escapes with flatus or when urinating. Stools mushy, lumpy, watery, gelatinous. Stools bloody. Stools small, brownish, slimy, half fluid. Stools bright yellow.

Abdomen - Heaviness in hypogastrium. Colic before and during stool. Abdominal pains better from passing burning, offensive flatus. Colitis. Dragging down in abdomen. Abdomen feels full, heavy, hot, bloated. Weak feeling, as if diarrhea would come on. Great accumulation of flatus, pressing downwards, causing dis- tress in lower bowels. Sensation as if plug between symphysis pubis and coccyx with urging to stool. Twisting, griping pains, must sit bent forward. Soreness in sides. Rumbling, gurgling in bowels, sudden urging. Pain around navel, worse pressure. Pain from navel to rectum. Bloated abdomen, more on left side, or along colon and worse after eating. Pulsating pain around navel. Pelvis as if filled with hot water.

Rectum - Every morning, on rising, has a hasty desire for stool. Must run from bed to toilet. Diarrhea, drives him out of bed. Diarrhea from cold, damp room. Diarrhea in hot, damp weather. Diarrhea when walking or standing. Diarrhea after Aloe socotrina chagrin. Hospital diarrhea. Colic and diarrhea. Cholera. Rumbling, gurgling in rectum, sudden urging. Sensation of weakness and loss of power of anal sphincter. Sense of insecurity in rectum, when passing flatus. Uncertain whether gas or stool will come. Urging to stool as soon as he eats, or immediately after eating and drinking. Constant bearing down in rectum, bleeding, sore and hot, relieved by cold water. Hemorrhoids protrude like grapes. Hemorrhoids bleed often and profusely. Hemorrhoids very sore and tender, better cold-water application. Hemorrhoids with soreness and constant bearing down in rectum. Burning and sharp pains in anus and rectum, from hemorrhoids, preventing sleep. Burning in anus and rectum. Burning, copious flatus. Constipation with heavy pressure in lower part of abdomen. Pulsation in rectum and sexual irritation. Dysentery, after childbirth. Fistula in anus.

Male - Offensive sweat on genitals. Epididymis sensitive, to touch or while walking. Penis shrunk and testicles cold. Scrotum relaxed. Prostate enlarged. Involuntary emissions during siesta. Itching of prepuce. Erections after urinating. Premature ejaculation. Sexual irritability after eating, after waking (in children). Increased sexual desire with erections.

Female - Menses too early, last too long and too profuse. Menstrual flow increased, dark and clotted. Prolapse uterus. Bearing down in rectum, worse standing and during menses. Uterus feels heavy, cannot walk much on that account. Labor-like pains in loins, extend down legs. Menopausal hemorrhage. Heavy congested uterus with labor-like pains, felt in groins and hips worse standing and during menses. Leucorrhea of bloody mucus, preceded by colic. Dysentery after childbirth. Food - No appetite. Hungry during diarrhea. Hungry after stools. Thirst with dryness of mouth, awakens at night. Aversion to meat. Desires juicy things, fruits. Desires apples. Desires salty food. Beer causes diarrhea. Beer relieves pains in anus. Diarrhea after eating oysters. Diarrhea from vinegar. Vinegar relieves colic. Sour food doesn't agree.

Chest - Congestion to the chest. Breathing impeded by stitches in the left side of the chest. Front of chest feels sore on deep inspiration. Weakness of chest. Constitutions - Adapted to weary people, the aged and phlegmatic, old beerdrinkers. Suited to old people, to women of relaxed phlegmatic habit, to persons of lymphatic or hypochondriac temperament. Allen said it's adapted to weary people with very broken down constitutions and elderly people. Menopausal years. Coughs - Cough in winter, with itching. Coughs when she would sit down. Cough when standing, or stand up. Cough after sitting, with lachrymation. Dry, irritative, hacking cough with metallic taste in mouth. Cough with scratching in throat. Cough with sharp pain right side of larynx.

Heart - Strong beat of heart occasionally. Pulse accelerated. Pulse weak, suppressed after vomiting. Pulse slow in afternoon.

Back - Backache. Pain in lumbar region, worse moving. Sharp pain through sacrum, extending to loins. Lumbago alternating with a headache and hemorrhoids. Pain in sacrum, worse while sitting, better moving about. Creeping sensation beginning in sacrum, until it was a creeping in bones over whole body. Heaviness and pressure in sacrum worse sitting, better moving about. Causations - Sedentary habits, poor diet.

Limbs - Lameness in all limbs. Drawing pains in joints. Sensation of weakness in the joints of the hands and feet. Sensation as if joints, bruised or dislocated. Pricking, dull twitching in joints. Paralytic drawing in muscles. Soles are painful when walking on the pavement. Cold hands with warm feet. Heaviness of right arm. Weakness of wrist-joints. Weakness of ankle-joint. Varicose veins.

Sleep - Drowsy, dozing in morning. Spasmodic jerks when falling asleep. Sleeplessness from itching and burning in anus. Insomnia, cannot get to sleep for a long time, thoughts crowd upon him and keep him awake. Awakened by thirst. Awakened by urgency to urinate. Dreams of soiling himself. Oppressive dreams. Dreams of danger, could not cry out.

Skin - Itching, especially of legs. Spots which, when scratched, pain and become sensitive. Itch appears each year, as winter approaches. Golden colored skin. Furuncles with disordered liver. Ointments aggravates burning (Sulph.). Pimples on abdomen. Spots which, when scratched, become sensitive.

Modalities - Better from cool open air. Better cold applications. Better passing flatus. Better closing eyes. Better taking tea or stimulants. Worse in early morning. Worse evenings. Worse summer. Worse heat. Worse hot damp weather or hot dry weather. Worse after eating or drinking. Worse after dysentery. Worse yawning or chewing. Worse stepping hard. Worse evening. Worse standing or walking.

Tongue - Dry tongue. Yellow ulcers on the tongue. Severe fine stitches in under part of tongue when moving it. Tongue coated yellowish-white. Tongue stiff, dry, red. Inflamed sore spots on tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo with sense of insecurity. Vertigo on moving. Vertigo as if everything whirled with her, worse going up stairs or turning quickly. Vertigo with anxiety when moving. Vision - Flickering vision with heat of face. Flickering vision during headache. Yellow vision. Sees yellow rings moving before eyes, with redness of eyes. Dim vision while writing. COMMENTS - This is Aloe socotrina, not Aloe vera. Keynote incontinent stool, and an early morning sudden urge to diarrhea or stool. Colitis, irritable bowel, and dysentery. Uneasiness and pains in the liver region. Fullness, heaviness, heat and inflammation. The whole abdomen is painfully sensitive to touch. Rumbling. Feeling as of a plug wedged in between pelvis and coccyx. Abdominal colic. Burning gas, heaviness in the rectum. Strong relationship to Sulphur. Sudden and continued desire to go to stool. Tenesmus, weak rectum with forceful stool. Desire for stool after each meal (Ars., Chin., Lyc., Podo., Trom., and Ferr. when it's while still eating). Rumbling and cramping in abdomen before and during stool. The hard stool falls out without being noticed, urging to stool while passing water, every time on passing water feeling as if stool would pass. A hard stool may be passed involuntarily. “Stool passes unnoticed.” Nash noted the case of a child, constipated from birth, who screamed all the time he as being held to stool, could not pass it even after an enema. Yet when not trying, he passed solid pieces in bed without knowing. Cured with Aloe 200c. Involuntary soft stool while passing wind. With the diarrhea, flatulency, pinching in abdomen, pain in back and rectum and chilliness. Flatus offensive, burning, copious, much flatus with small stool. Burning in anus with passing of flatus. Lack of confidence of the sphincter ani (Cimic.). Stools like mush, bright yellow, gray, hot, undigested. Mucus and blood in feces. Profuse withjelly-like lumps. Watery stools, worse standing or walking. Watery stool containing lumps “like frog spawn.” Bilious, yellow fecal, bright yellow diarrhea, great rumblings in bowels and escape of much wind. Worse morning and evening in damp weather, from overheating after cold taken in damp room, after chagrin. Diarrhea driving one out of bed very early in morning (Sulph). Diarrhea with sense of insecurity (Phos.). Faintness after stool with cold sweat. Griping may (Nux-v.), or may not (Merc.), cease after stool. Heaviness, heat, pressing, burning in rectum. Itching, burning, pulsating as from fissures at anus. After stool there is a cutting, feeling as if more would come, protruding hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids that protrude like a bunch of grapes, constant bearing-down in rectum, bleeding, sore, tender, hot, better by cold water. Periodic headache which alternates with lumbago. Darting pains in left temple worse every step. A peculiar dull, heavy, pressing pain in forehead. Worse all exertion, especially mental. Pressure in vertex and forehead as from a weight. Heaviness in the eyes (All-s.). Compelled to make the eyes small during pain in forehead. In females, pain in hypogastrium as if menses coming on. Labor-like pains drawing into legs. Menses too early and too profuse. During menstruation there is a headache, better by application of cold water, earache, pain in small of back, and pressing down in rectum. Fullness in pelvis. Leucorrhea of bloody mucus preceded by colic. Pain in small of back, worse sitting or awaking at night, better moving about. Lumbago alternating with headache. RELATIONS - Aloe is related to All-c., All-s., Agave., Scilla, Colch. Antidoted by: Sulph., Mustard, Camph. relieves for a while, Lyc., and Nux-v. relieve the earache. Compare: (1) Sulph. similiar in many symptoms, and is of equal importance with Sulph. in chronic diseases with abdominal plethora. (2) Kali-bi., Lyc., All-s. (3) Ail. - dull, frontal headache. (4) Gamb. - diarrhea. (5) Am-m. - abdominal and diarrheic symptoms. (6) Nux-v. - gastric abdominal and uterine troubles: bad effects of sedentary habits. (7) Aesc. - hemorrhoids. (8) Merc., - dysentery. (9) Podo. - alterations between head symptoms and abdominal symptoms. Complementary: Sulphur. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Fullness in region of liver, pain under right ribs. Tension in the region of the liver. Uneasiness, heat, pressure, and tension in the region of the liver. Pain in the liver, worse on standing, so that he bends forward. Sharp pains in the liver, when drawing a long breath. Chronic types of jaundice with bilious states, the tongue is coated, breath foul, and a sensation of fullness and heaviness in hepatic region. Lungs - Difficult respiration with sharp pains from liver to chest. Whistling in throat, as if something had fallen into trachea. Yellow, tenacious mucus. Spits up blood.

Kidneys - Incontinence in aged, bearing- down sensation and enlarged prostate. Every time on passing urine, feeling as if thin stool would escape with it. Burning pain when urinating. Frequent urging, worse at night or in afternoon. Urging so quick he can scarcely retain urine. Scanty, hot and high colored urine. Urine with much mealy sediment or slimy. Urine copious, pale, after stool. Urine saffronyellow, becoming cloudy.

Perspiration - Cold sweat after stool. Sweat smells strong. Offensive sweat on genitals. Sweats at night. Sweats after drinking.

Temperature - Chill with coryza, in the cold open air. Chill at stool. Shivering. Cold hands, warm feet. Internal heat. Heat in spots, on scalp or face. Heat flushes with anxiety and restlessness.

The gel can also be taken internally for diabetes, stomach ulcers, colitis or as a general tonic. Aloe has been used successfully in the treatment of tuberculosis by giving the pure juice. author: Murphy
constitution: Anemia. Breast-feeding, disorders. Breast-milk, excessive. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Fevers. Indigestion. Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Lienteria. Malaria. Nausea. Palpitations. Pregnancy, vomiting. Rheumatic pains. Ulcers. Uterus, debility. Weakness.

full:
PHARMACY - alst-c. Alstoniaconstricta. Bitter bark. Native quinine bark. N. O. Apocynaceae. Australia. Tincture of the bark.Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Breast-feeding, disorders. Breast-milk, excessive. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Fevers. Indigestion. Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Lienteria. Malaria. Nausea. Palpitations. Pregnancy, vomiting. Rheumatic pains. Ulcers. Uterus, debility. Weakness.

HERBAL - Alstonia constricta is an exceedingly bitter herb. It grows in India and the one from Malabar are probably similar in effects to Alstonia scholaris. It has been used as a tonic after exhausting fevers. Locally, it has been for ulcers and rheumatic pains.

HOMEOPATHIC - Alstonia was proved by Dr. Cathcart of Australia, who found it produce great debility and prostration or low fever often with diarrhea. Characteristic gone sensation in stomach and sinking in abdomen with debility. Malarial disease with diarrhea, dysentery, anemia, and feeble digestion. Dr. Dietz gave the following as leading indications: debility from lack of digestive power in the stomach or general assimilative power. Tongue generally has a dirty white coat, especially at base, though it may be clean. Nausea, worse morning, before breakfast or at irregular times, when depending on reflex irritation from pelvic organs. Food seems to remain in stomach a long time undigested. Diarrhea of undigested food immediately after eating, has to leave table before finishing a meal. This symptom was cured by Alst. c. lx in a patient who had taken a great deal of iron. Violent purging and cramps in bowels. Heat and irritation in lower bowels. Camp diarrhea, bloody stool.Dysentery. Diarrhea from bad water and malaria. Painless watery stools (Phos-ac.). Diarrhea immediately after eating. Leucorrhea and bearing-down worse by walking. Swollen feeling in right ovarian region. Sharp shooting pain from left side of stomach through to back (spleen). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Similar in action to Alstonia scholaris, the Dita bark of India aand Malabar. (2) Ars., Chin. - similar in diarrhea, chronic dyspepsia and debility. (3) Hydr., Ferr-cit., Chin. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Characteristics are the gone sensation in stomach and sinking in abdomen, with debility. Diarrhea immediately after eating. Diarrhea from bad water. Cramps in bowels with violent purging. Irritation and heat in lower bowels. Camp diarrhea. Bloody stool. Dysentery. Diarrhea from malaria. Painless watery stools (Ph-ac.). Ferr-cit., Chin. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - alumn. Alumen crudum. Potash alum. Potassic-Aluminic Sulphate. Trituration of the crystallized double sulphate of Aluminium and Kalium. Trituration of the pure crystals. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcohol, effects. Alopecia. Anus disorders. Asthma. Backaches. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Cancer. Chilblains. Colic. Constipation. Coughs. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eczema. Emaciation. Epithelioma. Esophagus, stricture. Eye, disorders. Eyes, surgery. Fungus. Glands, indurated. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhages. Hoarseness. Indurations. Itching, skin. Lead, colic. Leucorrhea. Locomotor ataxia. Nausea. Noma. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Paralysis.Paralytic, weakness. Polyps. Scurvy. Skin, rough. Strabismus. Teeth, operations. Throat, disorders. Typhoid. Ulcers. Uterus, disorders. Uvula. Vaginismus. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known astringent action of Alum, gives a leading indication for its use in practice. On the other hand, it is equally available for the states of relaxation, which corresponds with its secondary action. Stools as hard as stones. No desire for stool for days. Aggravated constipation and hemorrhage from bowels during the course of typhoid. Cancer of uterus and rectum with the most obstinate constipation. Constrictions and contractions of sphincters and various parts. Tendency to induration of glands and other tissues. Tongue, rectum, uterus etc., are hardened, ulcers with Indurated base. Indurations following inflammation. Lupus or cancer of nose. Scirrhus of the tongue. Paralytic weakness of all the muscles of the body with typhoid. Relaxation of muscles. Prolapsed uterus and rectum, excruciating pains. Sensation of dryness and constriction. Mental paresis, dysphagia especially to liquids. Sluggish action of muscles, hemorrhages of various kinds, large clots in typhoid, relaxed mucus membranes, relaxed uvula, hoarseness and bronchial affections, diarrhea. Sensitive to cold, exposure to air causes roughness and chaps in the skin. Yellow bland discharges. Useful after operations on the eyes and teeth. Hemorrhages from leech bites, extracting teeth, etc. Parenchymatous bleeding from mouth, gums, nose, uterus. Hemorrhages of dark blood. Mucus membrane dry in nose, on tongue in mouth, larynx. Emaciation. Joints of arms, hands and feet feel bruised. MIND - Nervous tremors from bad news. Doubting people. Lectophobia. Desires to remain in bed. Fear of falling. Spells of rage, attacks people. Thinking about disease causes palpitations. Anxiety at night. Anxiety at night with nausea and headache. Sadness in morning. Weeping in morning.

Head - Alopecia. Rush of blood to head. Headache, better drinking cold water. Burning pain and weight on vertex, better ice-cold cloths pressed on the part. Headache shooting through temples with nausea, better drinking cold water. Jerking pain in left forehead, evening. Pains coming and going, from place to place. Headache in morning on awaking.

Eyes - Wild look with spells of rage. Bruised feeling on pressure or by moving eyelids. Spots on cornea. Prolapse of iris after cataract operation. Right eye squints towards the nose. Varicosities of conjunctiva. Purulent ophthalmia of infants. Itching burning on border of lower lids. Dilated pupils. Diplopia by candlelight. Sees double by candlelight.

Ears - Heat in both ears and left side of face at night. Purulent otorrhea. Hears every noise in sleep.

Nose - Nasal polyps, left side with rough skin all over the face and body. Lupus or cancer on nose. Dryness of nostrils and choanae. Nosebleed.

Mouth - Mouth dry, without thirst. Dryness of mouth, tongue and throat. Taste bitter, sourish, astringent. Taste sweetish. Disgusting after-taste. Spreading ulcers in mouth. Noma. Profuse salivation, mercurial in origin or not.

Throat - Tendency to throat colds. Burning and severe pains. Hoarseness worse from talking. Aphonia. Enlarged and indurated tonsils from frequent colds. Every cold settles in throat. Mucus membrane red and swollen. Throat relaxed. Throat sore and dry when swallowing fluids. Uvula inflamed and enlarged. Uvula elongated, relaxed. Scraping in throat with cough. Tickling in throat. Burning pain down the esophagus. Constriction, spasms of esophagus, liquids can scarcely be swallowed.

Stomach - Burning heat, better by drinking cold water. Sinking sensation, better by eating. The pain is better by pressing on stomach. Nausea with faintness and weakness. Attacks of nausea in morning before breakfast. Vomits large quantities of glairy mucus or tough, colorless slime. Vomiting of everything he eats. Vomits blood. Habitual vomiting in alcoholics.

Abdomen - Colic worse by walking, with fullness and heaviness. Potter's colic, lead colic. Abdomen retracted, better from pressure. Contractive sensation deep in pelvis with complaints of rectum and bladder.

Rectum - Constipation of the most aggravated kind, as in cancer of uterus and rectum. No desire to stool for days. Violent ineffectual urging to stool. No ability to expel stool. Marble-like masses pass, but rectum still feels full. Itching after stool. Itching in anus. Long lasting pain and smarting in rectum after stool, also hemorrhoids. Yellow like an infant's, ft'emorrfiage from howe/s. Wematemesis of hard drinkers. Passes large clots. Sensations - Sensation of dryness. Sensation of constriction, as if a cord or band around limbs in paralytic states. ;

Male - Eczema on the back of penis and scrotum. Erections while at dinner. Frequent emissions. Gonorrhea, gleet. Shooting pain from middle line of belly, as along a thread, down into penis. Cutting pain in left side of penis.

Female - Induration of cervix. Left ovary affected. Menses scanty, watery. Hands weak, drops things during menses. Chronic gonorrhea, yellow with little lumps along urethra. Weight and prolapse of uterus. Affections of left ovary with troublesome constipation. Chronic yellow vaginal discharge. Leucorrhea and emaciation with yellow complexion. Vagina very sensitive, and narrowed by swellings of various size. Vaginismus. Itching. Aphthous patches in vagina (Caul.). Bleeding after childbirth. Food - Appetite increased, even with fullness in stomach. Loathes food. Emaciation. Thirst, throat dry and increased appetite with heat in stomach, better by drinking cold water, intense with fever. Mouth dry, but no increase of thirst.

Heart - Palpitations worse from thinking of her disease. Palpitationsfrom lying down on right side. Palpitation from mental excitement. Pain from heart to lower part of right leg. Dilatation of heart. Strong pulsation through whole body.

Back - Sensation as if cold water were poured down back, with headache. Backache in evening on both sides of spine, with every deep inhalation. Weakness of spine in evening.

Limbs - Bruised pain in joints of arms, hands and feet. Weakness of all muscles, especially arms and legs. Constricted feeling around limbs. Cold hands and feet during pain in stomach. Chilblains. Lungs - Asthma. Croup and bronchitis. Catarrh of chest. Hemoptysis. Great weakness of chest. Difficult to expel mucus. Copious ropy, expectoration in morning in elderly persons. Ropy sputa. Atonic hemoptysis.

Sleep - Many complaints come on during sleep, like nightmares. Light sleep, hears every little noise. Can't get to sleep on account of orgasm of blood. Sleeplessness from fever. Disturbed by nightmare, at 4 a.m.

Skin - Skin roughens and chaps after exposure to cold air. Skin dry. Eczema. Proud flesh, chilblains, indolent ulcers. Ulcers with indurated base. Indolent ulcers. Scorbutic ulcers. Indurations resulting from chronic inflammations. Glands inflame and harden. Furuncles on body, on thighs. Fungus granulations. Alopecia. Epithelioma. Veins become varicose and bleed.

Modalities - Worse from cold, except headache, which is relieved by cold. Worse during sleep. Worse lying on right side. Worse bad news.

Teeth - Teeth loose. Teeth and gums scorbutic. Gums swollen, inflamed, spongy. Profuse bleeding after extraction of tooth.

Tongue - Dryness of tongue. Tongue dry, black. Tongue burning in evening. Tongue sour feeling, stitches worse at tip. Tongue clean, except a slight coating of slime on back part. Scirrhus of tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness in the pit of stomach, better opening eyes, turning on right side. Vertigo when lying on his back. COMMENTS - The Alumn. patient is very sensitive to cold, exposure to air roughens and chaps the skin. Slight scratches bleed. Bleeding after tooth extraction. Catarrhal conditions prevail throughout. Sensations of dryness and contraction. Contractive sensation in abdomen and pelvis and retraction of abdomen as in lead colic. Paralytic states with the sensation as if bound with a tight band. Tendency to indurations whenever inflammations occur. Scirrhus indurations, indurated glands. Pains are insupportable. Attacks come and go suddenly, periodically. Many complaints come on during sleep, like nightmares. Turning on right side improves the vertigo. Lying on right side brings on palpitations. There is sensitiveness to all sorts of weather changes and especially to cold. W. P. Wesselheft cured bronchitis characterized by scraping from upper sternum to throat with free expectoration of thick, yellow mucus, paroxysmal cough, morning cough with gagging. Aching in chest and in the lower part of the back in region of lower ribs. Profuse expectoration with a scraping pain, for scraping coughs are usually dry. All-c. had helped the preliminary sneezing and coryza. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Cham. - cramps in abdomen. Nux-v., Ip. - nausea and vomiting. Sulph. Antidote to: Lead poisoning, calomel and other mercurials, Aloe - vomiting blood. Compare: ( 1 ) Alumina, Alum, Aloe. - rectum. (2) Caps. - long uvula. (3) Ferr. - relaxed abdominal walls, prolapsed uterus. (4) Kali-bi. - stringy discharges. (5) Merc. - prolapsed uterus, vagina, rectum, tenesmus. (6) Merc-c., Mur-ac., Nit-ac„ Nux-v., Op., Plat. - lead poisoning. (7) Plb., Rat., Stann., Sulph., Sul- ac., Zinc - eyes. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

Kidneys - Frequent and painful urging with painful passing of small quantities of urine. Must urinate every hour or two, night and day. Diabetes mellitus. Urine passed with difficulty. Oily iridescent film on urine. Urine falls down perpendicularly (Hep.). Urine scanty, clear flow, containing lumps of blood. Urine sediment slimy, tough or membraneous. Scanty, reddish urine in colic.

Bladder - Irritable bladder alternating with pain in vertex. Catarrh of bladder, mostly with the aged. Discharge of mucus from urethra. Itching of orifice of urethra. Breasts - Sore, inflamed nipples. Induration of cervix and breasts (Carb-an., Con.). Breast cancer. Causations - Bad news. Operations on eyes, on teeth. Constitutions - Adapted to elderly people, especially bronchial catarrhs. Disease of bladder. Children with profuse bronchial catarrh. Coughs - Cough in morning before breakfast, better after. Dry cough, in evening after lying down. Chronic morning cough of elderly people. Cough from tickling in larynx caused by talking.

Temperature - Chill during nausea. Coldness followed by headache. Coldness of skin followed by heat and tingling. Coldness during pain in stomach, followed by heat with rush of blood to head, can hardly hold it up. Furious delirium. Fever with intense thirst, nausea, etc. Internal heat throughout body. Heat in forehead. Warmth creeps over abdomen.
