PHARMACY - ant-c. Antimonium crudum. Native Sulphide of Antimony. Antimonium sulphuratum nigrum. Stibium sulfuratum nigrum crudum. Historical doye: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Anus, irritation. Arthritis. Backache. Belching. Blepharitis. Boils. Bunions. Callosities. Catarrh. Chills. Chotea. Constipation. Corns. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emaciation. Feet, sore. Fever. Food, allergies. Freckles. Gastrointestinal, disorders. Gout. Grief. Gum rash. Headaches. Heartburn. Heatstroke. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Horny, growths. Hysteria. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Marasmus. Nails,fungus. Nails, split nausea. Nettle rash. Nosebleed. Nym- phomania. Obesity. Otorrhea. Premenstrual, syndrome. Proctitis. Prolapsed,rectum. Red gum. Remittent, fever. Rheumatism. Skin, disorders. Stomach, disorders. Suicidal. Sunstroke. Tendons, inflamed. Tongue, coated. Toothache. Urticaria. Vertigo. Voice, low. Vomiting. Warts. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ant-c. is pre-eminently a stomach and skin remedy. It corresponding to constitutions with tendency to growths and rough scaling skin with horny patches. These homy patches are very tender, the patient can hardly bear to walk on therfi. Fungus under nails. Nails tend to grow in splits. Warts. Boericke said, “thickly coated white tongue are. true guiding symptoms.” Fis-' sures on comer of the mouth that split and crack (Petr.). Lips are dry and cracked, usually at comers. Thickly coated tongue, white, milky-white or like whitewash evenly laid. The edges may be red and sore. Sore, cracked and erusty nostrils and comers of mouth. Chronic indigestidh. Patient can have a big appetite, eats beyond the capacity of his digestion or without discrimination, the mental and skin symptoms can be due to this disturbance. Exceedingly weak condition of the body. Abnormal hunger, not relieved by eating, emptiness of epigastrium and want of animal heat. Gastric derangements, with z tongue coated thickly white, with different complaints. Disgust for all foods. Nursing iv children throw up a little sour milk as soon to as they take the breast or bottle, then refuses to nurse again (Aeth. after vomiting the child tr sleeps and wakes hungry). rri Heartburn, gas. Food allergies, especially tjto sour wines and vinegar. Intolerance to il s wine. In one case it produced *a feeling of h. intoxication like that of alcohol, so that the patient refused to take any more of it. Chronic complaints that are traceable to suppression of eruptions or ulcers. Effects of suppressed eruptions. Worse by heat (Apis, b Puls,, Cham., Sec., Camph.). Worse from s cold washing, cold water and cold food. Cannot bear heat of sbn. bh- 'An absence of pain, where it Would be expected. Rheumatism and gout if parts are inflamed o» swollen. Gout with stomach symptoms. Acute gout having left deposits with gastric symptoms. Inveterate chronic gout without fever. Dark hemorrhages. Dropsical swelling of whole body. Mucus membranes generally affected. Swelling pain and redness of glands. Exter- 1® nal parts turn black, dry gangrene. Obesity n of young people. Tendency to grow fat. MArasmus of children. Emaciation. Glandular obstructions. Scrofula. Fungus articularis. Metastasis of gout and rheumatism causing gastric catarrh. Anasarca. MIND - Excessive irritability and fretfulness, with a thickly-coated white tongue. Fretful cross and peevish. Adults are sulky, do not wish to speak with anyone. Angry at every little attention. Homesickness. Weeping and impressionable. Nervous hysterical girls and women, who are overcome by mellow light from stained- glass windows. Sentimentalmoodby moonlight. Dreamy, sentimental. Amativeness. Ill effects of disappointed love, grief. Ecstasy and exalted love. Love sick, with sulkiness. Sulky, doesn't want te speak with anyone. Either sentimental or cross and touchy during; diarrhea and before menses. The child is cross, but will scream at every little attention (Cham, wants to be carried). Child cannot bear to be touched or looked at (Nat-m.). Can’t bear to be washed or touched. Anger when touched. Peevishness, worse touch orconsolation. Very sentimental, easily moved, more so in the adult. Nymphomania during suppressed menses. Disposition to start, even at slight noises. v. Excitability. Anxious reflections in relation to one’s present and future. Can be anxious about their fate, health and future. Cross and contradictive, whatever is done fails to give satisfaction. Sleepy and weary. Talks in rhymes or verses, taciturn. So - busy with oneself one forgets to urinate or defecate, eats only when asked. Loathing of food, bathing etc. Great sadness and woeful mood. Sorrowful, irritable humor. Distrustful. Suicidal depression. Inclination to shoot himself, at night he is obliged to get out of bed because he can’t free himself of the idea. Loathing, disgust for life. Abject despair, wants to commit suicide by drowning. Mental symptoms are worse from suppressed eruptions (Mez.). Suicidal thoughts drive him out of bed.

Head - Headaches, worse in vertex, on ni ascending. Headaches from disordered stomach. Headache worse candy or acid wines, fruits, fats, ascending stairs. Headache from alcoholic drinks. Suppressed eruptions. Heaviness in forehead with vertigo, nausea and nosebleed. Headaches from bathing in cold water. Headache after stopped coryza. Headache with great loss of hair. Itching of the head with falling of hair. Tendency to take cold about sfrii n head. Heaviness in forehead with vertigo, nausea and nosebleed. Lentil-sized, flat tubercles here and there on scalp, painful to pressure, crawling sensation around them. Rush of blood to head, followed by nosebleed.

Eyes - Dull, sunken, red, itch inflamed, agglutinated. Canthi are raw, fissured and cracked, red and moist, Itching in canthi, Chronic blepharitis. Pustules on cornea and on the margins of the lids. Looking into the fire causés cough. Inflammation of lachrymal glands and ducts. Chronic sore eyes of children. Photophobia. Dried mucus in corners. Eyes worse glare of snow.

Ears - Redness and swelling, pain in eusta- h chian tube. Ringing and deafness. Moist eruption around ear. Otorrhea. Deafness, J i. as if bandaged or a leaf lying on ear.

Nose - Fluent or dry coryza. Nostrils •2u‘t chapped and covered with crusts. Stuffed nose in a heated room. Eczema of nostrils, sore, cracked and scurfy. Nosebleed and headache. Nosebleed, evenings with rush of blood to head. Feeling of coldness on in- tow halation. Nose painful when breathing. Perpiration - Hot sweat. Perspires at same mi hour every other day. Sweats in morning but when awaking, causes shrivelling of to - fingertips. Sweat soon disappears and followed by dry heat. Cold, clammy sweat from motion. Sweats during rheumatic to pains. Sweats during headache.

Face - Acne worse near fire. Dry lips. Eczema about mouth. Pimples, pustules and boils on face. Eruption like nettlerash. Freckles. Yellow crusted eruption on cheeks and chin. Sallow, haggard or sad. Cracks in the comers of the mouth. Comers of lips and nostrils cracked and sore. Burning, stinging on chin, as from a hot spark. Small, sore, honey colored granules on chin. Sharp pain in left cheek when exhaling. Twitching of facial muscles. Heat and itching on cheeks. Submaxillary glands swollen.

Mouth - Aphthae. Dryness of mouth. Gums bleed easily. Taste bitter. Pappy taste. Salivation, taste sklty. Tongue coated thick white, as if whitewashed. Canker sores. Sore feeling and redness on border of tongue. Much slimy mucus. Pimples around the mouth. Rawness of palate, with expectoration of much mucus.

Throat - Much thick yellowish mucus from posterior sinuses. Hawking in open air. Great heat in the throat while moving in the open air. Sensation as if a foreign body had lodged with constant desire to 1B' swallow. Vertigo - Confusion of head, as after long labor in the cold. A feeling of intoxication. Vertigo with nausea and nosebleed. Ver- ' ,l; tigo with nausea and confused feeling, as if drunk. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo from deranged stomach. COMMENTS - Restlessness and jerking of muscles. Slight noises startle. Nosebleed with vertigo after headache after rush of blood to head. Gastric and remittent fevers and fevers of children with great thirst and the characteristic white tongue. The fever runs higher at night. Tendency to take cold about head. ., Scrofulous ophthalmia, canthi especially affected (Graph, the whole margin). Otorrhea. Moist eruption behind ears (Graph.). Itching of the scalp and hair falling out. Fungus infections or deformity of the nails, calluses from pressure, corns, painful bunions, painful warts and horny warts (excrescences). Good for warts that grow next to the nail and bleed and irritate. Thickened skin, spots on the nails, nails that split, “crippled nails.” Arthritis and deformative arthritis of the fingers and toes. Constipation and other intestinal disorders. Severe gastric flu with a white tongue. Chronic indigestion. Diarrhea which alternates with constipation, often found in old people, “stomach weak, digestion easily disturbed in old people.” Anal fissures (Graph., Sil.). Continuously oozing hemorrhoids, staining linen. General symptoms are worse heat of sun, sun gives headache, worse bathing or change of weather. Intoxicated easily from wine (Zinc., Chin., Caps.), face flushes after a couple sips. May cough if they look at a fire or will be aggravated by radiant heat. Worse from heat, but great sensitiveness to cold. Suitable to the hydrogenoid constitutions. Tendency toward obesity. A student, 17, had twenty-three warts on right hand and thirty-four warts on the left hand. Mainly on backs and fingers, but a few on interior surface of fingers. In addition, inflammation of eyelids. Ant-c. 200x cured her of warts in 7 weeks. Dr. M. Jousset has recorded a severe case of chorea which resisted all the usual remedies and was cured with Ant-c. prescribed on the digestive symptoms, particularly the characteristic white tongue. Ant-c. corresponds in a sense to the swine, as Ars. does to horses and Puls, to sheep. RELATIONS - Antidote to: Stings of insects. Antidoted by: Calc., Hep., Merc. Bry. Compare: (1) Nat-m„ Ant-t., Antimonium Chlo- ridum. (2) Kermes mineral - Stibiat sulph. rub. - Bronchitis. (3) Also Puls, Ip., Sulph. (4) Aethi-a., Am-m., Apis, Bry., Graph., Ran-b., Rhus-t., Vario., Cham., Chin, and Hep., Rhus-t, Sep. and Spig. (5) Sulph. - Averse to be washed, digestive condition, loaded tongue and worse from warmth in summer complaints. (6)Stram. - averse to be looked at. Complementary: Squil., Sulph. Follows well: Puls., Ip. Followed by: Puls., Merc., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Digestion disordered easily. Heartburn, nausea, vomiting. Burning, spasmodic pains, driving to despair. Gastric derangements, with tongue coated thickly white, with different complaints. After nursing, the child vomits its milk in curds and refuses to nurse afterwards and is very cross. Great desire to eat, but no strength to do it. Eructation tasting of the ingesta. Gastrointestinal complaints from bread and pastry, acids, sour wine, pork, cold bathing, overheating, hot weather. Constant belching. Gouty moves to stomach and intestines. Indigestion, c chronic. Sweetish water brash. Bloating after eating. Sensation of emptiness in stomach. Stomach seems to be always overloaded. Stomach is painful to pressure. Nausea with diarrhea. Loathing nausea, and desire to vomit. Vomiting, worse eating or drinking, without nausea or relief. Nausea ceases, vomiting continues. Vomiting, fearful with convulsions, which nothing can stop. Vomiting of slimy mucus and bile.

Abdomen - Inflation of the abdomen with a sensation of fullness, chiefly after a meal. Abdomen very much distended, with much rumbling. Colic with loss of appetite, hard stool, red urine. Sensation of emptiness in the abdomen, as after violent diarrhea. Sensation of swelling and of hardness in the inguinal region, on its being pressed. Incarcerated flatus. Flatus in the abdomen with rumbling and bor- borygmi. Cutting in bowels with watery diarrhea. Violent cutting pains, sometimes with want of appetite, red urine and hard ' I stools. Pinching pain and sensation as if diarrhea would come on.

Rectum - Anal itching. Burning, itching and fissures in the anus. Diarrhea alternating with constipation. Acrid diarrhea. Diar- Ito^d rhea in summer. Diarrhea, worse during headache. Diarrhea with much belching. Hemorrhoids, bliijd and running with burning and tingling. Mucus hemorrhoids, prickling and burning with continuous tuo< mucus discharge from anus, staining yellow. Catarfhal proctitis. Flow of black blood from the anus. Abuse of laxatives. Constipation in heat of summer, in bed Soreness in rectum as if an ulcer has been torn open, during stool. Expansive pressure in the rectum during stool as if an ulcer had been torn open. Burning furunculus in the perineum. Rectal hemorrhage with solid stools, hemorrhoids. Boils on perineum, burning around them.

Stool - Stools composed entirely of mucus. Hard and loose stools, with nausea. Stools watery, containing undigested food. Diarrhea after acids, sour wine, baths, overeating. Diarrhea alternates with constipation, especially in elderly ' people. Diarrhea, watery with cutting pains. Urgent inclination to go to stool. Stools composed entirely of mucus, pappy. Constant secretion of yellowish-white ' ' mucus by the anus. Difficult evacuation of hard stools, the feces are too large in size. Stools of hard lumps mixed with « watery discharge. Diarrhea during summer after nursing.

Male - Eruption on scrotum and about . genitals. Impotence.. Atrophy of penis and testicles. Biting, itching of scrotum with eruptions. Excited sexual desire with uneasiness of the whole body. Nightly pollutions with or without voluptuous dreams. Itching of penis, of tip of glans. Erections when getting warm in bed, with sleeplessness.

Female - Menses too early and profuse. Premenstrual syndrome. Toothache before menses. Amenorrhea. Menses suppressed from cold bathing. Menses suppressed with feeling of tenderness of the ovaries, pressure in womb as if something would come out during menses. Painful ovaries in love sick girls. Leucorrhea watery, acrid, lumpy. Nymphomania from checked menses. Excited, genitals itch. Nausea, vomiting with diarrhea, all during pregnancy. Hemorrhoidal affections during pregnancy. Tenderness of ovarian region, with nausea, vomiting and white tongue. Irritable, painful ovaries of hysterical girls who are dreamers, who suffer from unrequited affections. Watery vaginal discharge causes smarting down thighs. Food -Loss of appetite with disgust for food. Great desire to eat, but gets no strength. Appetite does not return after severe illness. Food leaves an aftertaste or causes constant belching. Good appetite with burning at pit of stomach. Diminished appetite in summer owing to heat. Loathing of food with a bitter taste. Long- lasting loss of appetite with disgust for all food. Hunger early on waking without appetite, eating does not better it. Desire for acids, sour pickles. Desit^ for cucumbers, sour, wine, vinegar. Desire for beer with chill. Intense thirst with dryness of lips, more at night. Patient is a gross feeder, a glutton, he eats beyond the capacity of his digestion or without discrimination.

Chest - Stifling oppression and paralytic orthopnea. Shootings in the chest, when -c1' drawing breath and at other times. Itch- 5o ing of chest with oppression. Pain, as if contusion in the pectoralis major, on raissing the arm and on pressure. Sharp pain under left breast. Burning pain in the chest oP with heat. Pains during fever. Oppression and pressive pains, more right side. Sharp pains in chest when exhaling. Burning and sticking pains. Severe itching upon chest continuing all day. Constitutions - Suited to infants and chilis dren with coated, moist, white tongues and in the elderly. Hydrogenoid constitutions. Tendency to grow fát. Constitutions with tendency to rough scaling skin with horny zu patches. A scrofulous medicine.

Heart - Violent palpitations. Pulse extremely irregular, now accelerated and again slow. Pulse changing every few biu. beats. Slow pulsation during fine prick- on ii.- ing headache. •

Back - Itching and pain of neck and back. Violent pain in small of back when rising, better when walling. Coccyx heavy. Swelling of cervical glands. Spasmodic drawing, in muscles of nape, reaching to scapulae. Backache evening after lying down and in morning. Backache worse stooping, exerting arms and turning head to left. Spasmodic stitches in right scapula when sitting. Causations - Ill effects of disappointed love, grief and suppressed eruptions. Hot weather or sun. Getting over- heated, Overeating.

Limbs - Lassitude, tremulous fatigue and heaviness of all limbs. Twitching of muscles. Jerks in arms. Limbs weak during headache. Arthritic pain in joints of fingers. Horny or split nails. Nails brittle, grow out of shape. Horny growth under the nails. Skin beneath nails painfully nom. sensitive. Discolored nails. Horny warts on hands and soles. Weakness and shakinof hands in writing followed by offensive flatulence. Painful stiffness of knee. Pustules on thighs. Inflamed corns. Pain in heels. Painful inflammation of the tendon of elbows with great redness and curvature of the arms. Shiny elbows. Callosities on soles. Skinon solesis withered on account of foot sweat. Feet very tender, covered with large horny places. Rheumatic pain, in legs. Numbness of legs during rest and while sitting. Weakness and shaking of hands in writing, followed by offensive flatus. Crippled feet. Lungs - Deep, sighing, as from fullness of chest, afternoon and after eating. Unequal breathing, during sleep. Oppression coming from stomach. Constriction almost to suffocation. Spells of sighing. Difficult breathing, with raised shoulders. Respiration deep with sighing. Expectoration of large quantities of mucus, exhausts the patient.

Sleep - Great sleepiness during day. Deep unrefreshing sleep, can hardly rise in morning, so tired. Sleepy and weary. Drowsiness in elderly people. Strong inclination to sleep during the day, chiefly in the evening or morning. Waking with fright during the night. Frequent waking from itching here and there. Sleeplessness with shivering over left side. Dreams, anxious, horrible, voluptuous or painful. Dreams full of quarreling. Anxious dreams, as if he were to be hurt. Horrible dreams, about mutilation of men. Coma with, delirium.

Skin - Freckles become numerous. Eczema with gastric derangements. Pimples, vesicles and pustules, pimples and vesicles as from stings of insects. Pustules here and there with brown scurf. Eruptions worse heat of stove, etc. Sensitive to cold bathing. Thick, hard, honey-colored scabs. Urticaria. Urticaria, white with red areola, itching fearfully. Itching when warm in bed. Itching of skin, feels sore when scratched. Skin diseases during pregnancy. Measles-like eruptions. Dry gangrene. Scaly, pustular eruption with burning and itching, worse at night. Callosities from slight pressure, ulcers become fistulous. Deep, spongy ulcers. Smooth warts. Warts (Thuj., Sabin., Caust.).

Modalities - Better in open air. Better moist warmth. Better during rest. Better lying down. Worse in evening. Worse at night. Worse moonlight. Worse water, wet poultices. Worse cold bathing, cold water (on head). Worse dampness. Worse radiated heat. Worse heat from sun. Worse from acids, vinegar. Worse sweets, wine, pork. Worse overeating, debauches. Worse after getting drunk. Worse rising up. Worse ascending stairs. Worse touch.

Larynx - Heat in larynx in open air. Voice harsh and badly pitched. Voice, lacks control, harsh, badly pitched better using it. Aphonia from overheating. Laryngitis, Rough voice from over use. Hoarseness after cold water bath. Great weaknes or entire loss of the voice, chiefly on becoming warm. Sensation of a foreign substance in the larynx with inability to expectorate. Violent spasm in the larynx with sensation of excoriation.

Teeth - Gums detach from teeth, bleed easily. Grinding of teeth, when sleeping in sitting position. Pains in hollow teeth. Toothache worse touching tooth with rrtongue, better walking in open air. Teeth noi! so sore it seems one can hardly bear the dental operation. Toothache in hollow teeth, worse night, touching tooth with tongue causes pain as if nerve were torn.Sharp pains in tooth when’inspiring air. Toothache before menses.

Kidneys - Urine is turbqi and has a foul odor, ah Cutting iiTurethra while urinating. Tenesmus of bladder rouses him from sleep at night Urination is frequent, profuse with burning and backache. Involuntary urination, on coughing. Gritty sediment. Suit Frequent urination with much mucus, intense burning in urethra and backache during emission.

Cough - Cough in paroxysms, as if-arising from abdomen, first paroxysm always most severe, subsequent ones weaker and weaker, until the last one only resembles a hacking cough. Burning with dry cough and dyspnea. Burning at every cough. Cough in hot sun. Cough with hot breath. Cough shaking whole body, with involun- Lt tary escape of copious urine. Cough on coming into warm room. Cough from cold air. Cough with burning sensation inchest, -w itching of chest, oppression. Looking into os: fire aggravates cough. Cough after rising in morning.

Temperature - Chill predominating during day. Violent chill, shaking, toward noon, with thirst. Chill over back, feet cold as ice, with sweat on rest of body. Chill at every motion, with cough. Chill after vomiting. Chill before menses. Chilly even in warm room. Disturbances of stomach during apyrexia in intermittent fevers. Intermittent fever with disgust, nausea, vomiting, ¿ belchings, ¿oated tongue, diarrhea. Hot sweat. Great heat from little exercise, especially in the sun. Heat and thirst after sweat. Fever at night. Body hot, limbs cold, during cough. Fever with desire to sleep and want of thirst.

HOMEOPATHIC - Recommended by Hale in cases of uterine hyperplasia, also in cases of humid asthma, bronchitis and other pulmonary disorders. Inability'to raise the sputum, especially in the aged and weak patients. Pneumonia. Stage of resolution of pneumonia slow and delayed. In sub-acute and chronic colds in chest which have extended downwards from head and into the bronchial tubes in the form of hard, croupy cough with a decided wheeze. Indicated by frequent spells of coughing with expectoration of frothy, white or thick ;i yellowish mucus. Loss of appetite and strength. Moderate febrile action. Coated tongue. Yellowish discoloration of skin and conjunctive, sweaty. Dull and drowsy. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - ant-o. Antimonium oxydatum. Antimonious oxide. Antimony sesquiôxide. Fumes from antimony works. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bloody urine. Cough. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Headache. Impotence. Intermittent, fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Great relaxation of the whole organism.

Head - Lightning-like stitches through the . head backward, which suddenly disappear, while the headache in the forehead - > remains. Slight headache increases to an r.p intolerable degree. Lungs - Cough violent, shattering, dry, with stitches in chest. Cough dry, painful, lt. finally ends in a difficult expectoration of tenacious mucus. Respiration difficult, with mucus and sibilant rales over the chest.

Mouth - Tongue coated white.

Abdomen - Distended by incarcerated gases.

Rectum - Diarrhea, with griping pains in abdomen. Stools troublesome, frequent, consisting of food evacuated soon after eating.

Male - Penis flaccid. Complete impotence, no ejaculation of semen, âhd even no erections. Atrophy of testicles and penis. Pains in the testicles.

Chest - Very great constriction of the chest, with stitches. Sharp stitches through the chest, towards the shoulders and back. Violent stitches in chest, with dry cough.

Back - Sharp pains in the sacro-lumbar region.

Skin - Pustular eruption on lower abdomen, neck, body. Eruption thickest on genitals, in the bends of the limbs, on nates, and especially OQ thighs ancfscrotum. Pustular elevations, like pocks, on the scrotum.

Bladder - Pains and urging at neck of bladder, and burning in the urethra during urination. Discharge of a few drops of mucus from the urethra. Gonorrhealike discharge from the urethra. Urine of a deep orange-yellow color, almost red. Deep-red and bloody urine, causing burning in the urethra, from which exuded a whitish mucus after cessation of the bloody urine. |

Temperature - Very profuse and debilitating sweats during sleep. Very tormenting, pouring sweat, every time after sleeping, followed by great exhaustion. Complaints assume the form of intermittent fever. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - In its provings, the most notable effects were produced in the eye and chest As with the other Antinomies, there is disordered digestion, g^sty mouth and taste in morning. Chronic nasal and bronchial catarrh. Increase of tough mucus in larynx and bronchi, respiration difficult. Dry, hard cough with passive congestion of upper lobe of left lung. Nosebleed on washing. Itching on hands and feet. Burning in head with eye complaints. Amaurosis (commencing). Spots on cornea and hypopion. Acne.

Head - Pfessive pains. Burning pain in head, with eye complaints. Reddish swelling behind right ear, leaving a redness and scurfiness.

Eyes - Amaurosis, commencing. Spots on cornea. Iris protruding through cornea.

Nose - Nosebleed on washing the face. Increased secretion in nose and throat. Loss of smell. I

Face - Pustular acne. Food - Loss of appetite, almost a loathing of food.

Mouth - Metallic taste. Pasty mouth and taste in morning.

Throat - Increased secretion in nose and throat. Rough and scrapy feeling. Metallic styptic taste. Burning or heat in fauces. Mucus from throat becomes offensive to smell. Pressure in throat as if a plug stuck in it. Scratching, rough feeling in throat in jporning. Tickling in larynx. Accumulation of tough mucus in larynx and bronchi. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Other Ahtimo- nies. (2) Aur. - chest, Ars., Ferr., Merc-sulph., Sulph. (3) Am-c. - nosebleed after washing. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Pressure and fullness in stomach and abdomen, umbilical region sensitive.

Abdomen - Pressure, tension and fullness in abdomen. Umbilical region sensitive. Violent colic and rumbling around navel.

Rectum - Passage of much flatus with sud- ¿I, den urging, followed by a solid stool at 3^ first, then bright yellow and pasty stool. Constipation. Feces hard and passed with difficulty. . . , > t

Stool - Passage of much flatus with sudden urging, followed by a stool, solid at first then bright yellow and pasty, afterwards violent colic and rumbling around navel. Constipation, feces hard and passed with difficulty.

Male - Pustular eruption on scrotum with much itching. .

Limbs - Itching on hands and feet. Arms heavy in morning. Boring and tearing pain in arms and hand-joints. Swelling of fingers.. Lungs - Accumulation of tough mucus in bronchi andlarynx. Tiçklingin larynx./n- creasedmucus with fullness in bronchials. Respiration difficult, pressure in bronchi with constriction. Dry, hard cough, no expectoration. Congestion of upper lobe of left lung. Winter coughs, patient is sore all over. Pneumonia, when hepatization occurred and resolution failed to take place. Increased mucus sputum, mixed with blood of a sweetish taste. Passive congestion of upper lobe left lung with hard, dry cough.

Sleep - Deep sleep. Wakes after midnight with dull headache. Wakes with restless- e ness and sexual desire. Awoke suddenly with heavy, confused head, pressure in stomach, difficult breathing. Sleep dreamy.

Skin - Acne, pustular variety. Itching on hands and feet.

Kidneys - Urine increased, dark red.

full:
PHARMACY - antip. Antipyrinum. Phenazone. Antipyrine. Phenyl-dimethyl-pyrazolon. A product of coal tar through Toulon. Solution and trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bedwetting. Cheyne-stokes, breathing. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Edema. Epilepsy. Erythema. German measles. Hallucinations.Headache. Heart paralysis. Lachrymation. Menses, suppressed. Mind, deranged. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pemphigus. Scarlatina. Throat, sore-. Tinnitus. Toothache. Urticaria. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Antipyrine is known from the poisonous effects it produced in old-school practice. Many fatal cases were recorded and there can be little doubt that its injudicious use determined a fatal issue in many cases that have remained unrecorded. Antipyrines action is very like that of Acetan, in producing collapse, but it has more effect on the skin, causing scarlpt rash and edema. It is one of the drugs that induce leucocytosis, similar to ergotine, salicylates and tuberculin. Antipyrine acts especially on the vasomotor centers, causing dilation of the capillaries of the skin and circumscribed patches of hyperemia and swelling. In large doses, it causes profuse perspiration, dizziness, cyanosis, somnolence, albumen and blood in urine. Acute erythema multiform. MIND - Fear of going insane. Hallucinations of sight and hearing. Nervous anxiety, Ears - Pains and buzzing. Tinnitus.

Head - Throbbing headache. Headache under ears with earache. Sensation of constriction. Flashes of heat.

Eyes - Puffiness of lids. Conjunctiva red and edematous with lachrymation. Red spots (Apis).

Ears - Roaring. Fluttering before left ear, as from a large bird. Warmth of left ear. Tearing pain. Twitching in right ear.

Nose - Fluent coryza. Nasal mucus membrane swollen. Dull pains in frontal sinus.

Face - Edema and puffiness. Red and swollen.

Mouth - Swelling of lips, tongue Burning of mouth and gums. Ulceration of lips and tongue, vesicles and bullae. Small lump in cheek. Bloody saliva. Toothache along lower jaw. bierves-Generalprostration. Epileptiform seizures. Contractures. Trembling and cramps. Crawling and numbness. _

Throat - Painful when swallowing. Expectoration of fetid pus. Abscess, white false membrane. Sensation of burning. COMMENTS - A young female patient who took Antipyrine on her own account whenever she thought she might be going to have a headache, developed intense dysmenorrhea (to which she was not subject) with depression. This was only removed after she had discontinued the drug. Later, she took Phenacetin with result that an eruption of erythema appeared on both cheeks, which peeled after a few days and recurred persistently. It would seem that the drug is homeopathic to some forms of neuralgia. One patient had Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Erythema appears first on face and arms, last on legs. Hansen mentioned its use in bedwetting and nosebleed. Better from hot drinks. RELATIONS - Antidotad by: Bell. The symptoms are much intensified in persons addicted to coffee in excess.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting, burning and pain.

Abdomen - Burning pain in abdomen. Feels •“ as if full of stones. Painless rumbling. Flat- -'(H ulence, with rumbling in bowels. Violent -^ colic with drowsiness. Colic, as if bowels would be cut to pieces. Spasmodic cough, much flatus. Sharp, cutting colic before n« stool. Colic around umbilicus, better after stool. Pressure in abdomen, especially on i stooping forward. Pain in the groins and ht' cold creeps before menses.

Rectum - Sharp pain in rectum. Burning at anus after loose stool. Constipation, alternating with diarrhea. Desire for stool ineffectual though bowpls- seem full and pressing. Diarrhea and vomiting. Diarrhea in pneumonia, smallpox, and other erup- >' tive diseases, especially if the eruption has been suppressed. Involuntary evacuations. Palpitations during stools. Cholera morbus. Cholera when vomiting is copious and there is coldness, and threadlike or trembling pulse. Sensations - Sensation of weight or heaviness in many parts, head, occiput, coccyx, limbs. Sensation of coldness in blood vessels.

Stool - Mucus stools, grass green. Bloody feces. Diarrhea in eruptive diseases. Watery, slimy, bloody diarrhea. Diarrhea with vomiting. Diarrhea with flatulence. Diarrhea of alcoholics. Very offensive diarrheic stools. Stools yellowish-brown. Stools thin, bilious. Stools with heat at anus. Stools slimy, like yeast. Stools of cadaverous smell.

Male - Pain in testicles after checked gonorrhea. Orchitis. Warts on glans penis. Excitation of sexual system. Pustules on genitals-and thighs. Syphilis.

Female - Itching and burning in vagina. Dysmenorrhea. Menses suppressed. Watery leucorrhea.

Chest - Rattling of mucus in the chest when breathing. Velvety feeling in chest. Burning sensation in chest, which ascends to throat. Paralysis of the lungs. Anxious oppression of the chest, with a sensation of heat, which ascends to the heart. Rheumatic pain in the left side of the chest. Miliary eruption. Constitutions - Suited to old people and children. Gouty subjects and alcoholics with gastric disorders. Hydrogenoid type constitutions. Torpid and phlegmatic constitutions. Worn-out constitutions. Coughs - Gasping for air, before every attack of cough. Coarse, loose, rattling cough. Cough followed by vomiting or sleep worse anger. Lungs seems full of mucus yet less and less is raised. Must sit up to breathe or cough. Coughs and yawns alternately. Coughing and gasping. Cough excited by eating with pain in chest and larynx. Cough and dyspnea better lying on right side (opposite Bad.). Child bends backwards with cough.

Heart - Faintness with sensation of stoppage of heart. Throbbing throughout the body. Rapid, weak, irregular pulse.

Back - Lumbago. Violent pain in sacrolumbar region. Slightest effort to move may cause retching and cold, clammy sweat. Worse lifting. Sensation as if a heavy load was hanging on end of coccyx, dragging downwards all time. Twitching of muscles, limbs tremulous. Vertebrae seem to rub against each other. Cramp in gi muscles of neck. Burning in back. Causations - Effects df anger (cough) or vexation. Ill effects of vaccination when Thuj. fails and Sil. is not indicated.

Limbs - Acute 'articular rheumatism. Rheumatic and bruised pains. Twitching of muscles. Trembling of the hands. Fin gertips icy cold or dead, numb, dry and hard. Restless arms. Feet go to sleep on sitting. Dropsy of synovial membranes. ' * Dropsy of the legs and knee joint (left). Calves as if sore. Tension in hamstring when walking. Synovitis. Joints swollen. Jerking up of limbs during sleep with loose stools. Weakness of all limbs. Constant inclination to stretch.

Sleep - Sleepiness during sweat. Irresistible inclination to sleep with nearly all complaints. Great drowsiness with all complaints. Drowsiness from warmth. Yawning with many complaints. Electriclike shocks on falling asleep. Cries during sleep with fixed eyes and trembling. Lies on back with left hand passed under head. Trembling during sleep. Heavy, anxious dreams. Dreams, clearly remembered in morning on waking.

Skin - Erythema, eczema, pemphigus. Intense itching, urticaria, appearing and disappearing suddenly with internal coldness. Angioneurotic edema. Dark blotches on skin of penis, sometimes with edema.

Modalities - Better cold open air. Better from sitting erect. Better lying on right side. Better vomiting. Better belching and expectoration. Better motion. Worse from warmth. Worse warmroom. Worse wraps. Worse warm weather. Worse overheating. Worse cold dampness. Worse from anger. Worse lying, sitting down. Worse rising from a seat. Worse motion. Worse morning. Worse sour things and milk.

Compare - ( 1 ) Anilinum - skin symptoms. (2) Aeon. - numbness, rapidity of attack. (3) Acetan., Ars., Chloral. REFERENCES: Boericke. Clarke.

Teeth - Violent toothache in morning. Rheumatic pain of intermittent type. Gums bleed. Gums spongy, with nosebleed. Teeth covered with mucus. Dentition with catarrhal hyperemia.

Tongue - Difficult, even painful, to move tongue. Tongue flaccid, dry. Imprints of teeth on border of the tongue. Tongue red, dry in middle, red in streaks. Çoated, pasty, thick white with red edges. Tongue moist, t clean, or loaded with a brown coating. Tongue moist and yellow in middle. Vertigo - Dizziness with cough. Vertigo with dullness and confusion. Vertigo L alternates with drowsiness. Vertigo from lifting head from pillow. Fits of vertigo ^with sparking before the eyes. Vertigo must lie down. Vertigo with dimness of vision and pressing headache. Vertigo with violenbchills. , • COMMENTS -Tiering said that Antimonium Tartaricum was the invention of the Alchemists. Tartar emetic. It has been used.as a poison, similarto Arsenic, usually someone would be dead in 12 to 24 hours. It has a very strong affinity for the lungs and stimulating the secretions of the mucus membranes. Chest disorders with a great accumulation of mucus with coarse rattling and inability to raise it. “Lies with head back.” “A child coughs when angry.” Heath cured a case of whooping cough in a child who was very fretful before the cough. The mother said that if the child got angry she immediately had a fit of coughing. “Cough at 4 a.m.” is another indication. Last stages of pneumonia, severe rattling in the lungs, and white, thick mucus. Asthma with white, thick mucus, wet asthma (Puls.). Chronic bronchitis in the elderly with a rattling cough and white, thick mucus that’s hard to expectorate. Drowning victims, pulmonary edema, Infantile pneumonia. For children who get colds often and it goes to the chest with a great accumulation of mucus. Sometimes'indicated after gas poisonings, if the gas caused irritation to the mucus membranes and mucus comes up (Carb-v., Bry., Ant-t.). For emphysema when caused by an irritant causing loss of lung space (Sil.). Respiratory distress due to constriction and mucus in the lungs. There is a great accumulation of mucus in the lungs. The sputum is thick and ropy but it is white and more sticky like glue. No expulsive power. Noisy breathing with severe wet cough. Weakness of the bronchioles where they can't expectorate, can be used chronically. The nostrils flare because they can't breathe. Suffocating, choking because-of the mucus. Gastric and bilious complaints. Constant nausea..Nausea felt in chest (Puls.). Nash found Ant-t. the nearest thing to a specific in cholera morbus, the indications being “nausea, vomiting, loose stools, prostration, cold sweat, stupor or drowsiness.” Deathly nausea (Ip., Puls.). Difficulty vomiting, just like expectoration. They strain, a lack of explosive power. Vomits whatever is eaten. Vomits thick, white, ropy mucus, may have blood or slime in it. Also produces ulcers, ulceration of the mucus membranes. Ulcers that bleed and then they vomit blood. The tongue has a thick, white, pasty coat with red papillae showing through. Intense nausea and vomiting with great effort with perspiration on forehead. -FullneSs and sensation of stones in abdomen, especially when sitting bent forward. Anxiety felt in the stomach, apprehension in the stomach. Sensations of a weight or heaviness in the abdomen or various parts of the body. The abdomen is distended, severe cramps or cutting pains. There is heat about heart and warmth rising up from it. Coldness in the blood vessels. Generally cold hands and feet. The face is pale or cyanotic .and the breathing stertorous. Severe weakness from lack of oxygen, tired from coughing. Oppression of the chest. Great drowsiness or sleepiness with cough and congestion in the lungs (Op., more of a stupor). Can palliate or bring them back if it's possible. Drowning victims and newborns who are not breathing, or for any severe respiratory problems going into respiratory failure (Carb-v.). Coma. - Arthritis in the smaller joints. Sensation of weight or heaviness in many parts, head, occiput, coccyx, limbs. Pulsations in all the blood vessels. Chronic trembling of head of head and hands (as in Parkinson's disease). “Sycotic” skin. Clarke verified a symptom given in Hering, “warts at.the back of the glans penis.” Leprosy, chickenpox, smallpox and impetigo, worse after smallpox vaccination. It has been used instead of vaccines for preventive purposes and a prophylactic power has been claimed for it (Vario.). The terrible backache of smallpox is paralleled by the back-pains of Ant-t., which Clarke found to correspond to more cases of lumbago than any other remedy. Worse by warmth, but not the excessive sensitiveness to heat and sun of Ant-c. and some of tlfe rheumatic symptoms are better by warmth. Cough worse from warm drink, lying in bed, especially bçcoming warm there. Suffocates in a warm room, want fresh air (Puls.). Greatly aggravated by the sun. Cough is worse anger and worse after eating. Thirstlessness, lost any desire for fluids (Puls., Ip.). May vomit water if they try to drink it. As if they have enough fluid already (Apis.). Crave apples- and acid fruits, but may be aggravated by sour food or wine, causing severe diarrhea. Great aversion to milk or are aggravated by milk. Loathing of food. Peevishness, whining and crying (Cham.). Restless, apprehension and agitation. Dullness and bewilderment of head as if benumbed. Irritable, don’t want to be looked at or talked to or touched. The whole body feels tender. Children may want to be carried and cling to their mother or may scream on being touched, keynote that they do not want to be bothered. Coughing fits at 4 a.m. The child looks pale, sunken eyes and have dark rings arOund the eyes and they have periodic cold sweats. The child cries and may jerk during sleep. Difficulty nursing and breathing at the same time. Better when held upright and hit on back to break up the mucus. Children are very anxious and timid, especially in the evening, as if they are anticipating the night because it is so bad for them. They lay down and get congestion and coughingfits. They have apprehension about the future, but it's more the upcoming night. Elderly may feel despair of recovery. Etiology can be cold, damp weather that seems to bring out the mucus. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Asaf., Chin., Cocc., Con. (pustules on genitals), Ip., Laur., Opium in large doses is the best antidote in poisoning, Puls., Sep. Antidotes: Bar-c., Bry. HOMEOPATHIC - The msect partakes of the properties of the plant it lives on. Chenopodium glaucum being a popular colic remedy and allied to the Polygonacae, Rheum and Rumex. Aphis is peculiar in being the only remedy which has toothache better by sweat, though Cham, has general better by sweat. Coryza with burning and biting on margins of nostrils, especially of septum. Increase of violent toothaches in bed, only relieved from a general warth sweat breaking out. Cutting in atxiomen and rumbling of flatus. Ineffectual urging in bladder and rectum. In the morning urging after rising, several mush-like stools with pinching, burning in anus with urging. Flatus accompanies stool. Thin stools with slime and spots of dark blood.

Head - Head confused in the evening with transient heat in the face. Pressure and tightening in the forehead or occiput, increased by motion. Tearing shooting in the head.

Eyes - Burning heat in the eyelids during several evenings.

Ears - Tearing pains, sometimes in one ear, and sometimes in the other.

Nose - Pain of excoriation in the nostrils. Violent sneezing. Coryza, with burning and smarting at the edges of the nostrils and at the septum. Fluent coryza.

Face - Color pale, yellowish, heat in the face, with head confused as by coryza, at night. Dry lips, sometimes especially in the morning. Food - No appetite for meat and wheat bread, with chilliness. Increased thirst from sensation of dryness in throat. Much thirst in evening, second week.

Mouth - Painful vesicles at the end of the tongue. Dryness of the mouth and of the throat. Increase in the secretion of saliva. Scraping sensation in the palate.

Throat - Secretion of frothy- mucus in the mouth and throat. Scraping and burning, as from acrid substances. Sensation of dryness and increase of mucus secretion. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aeth. - stool after rising, pinching, cutting before, urging after. (2) Nat-s. - stool after rising with discharge of wind. (3) Nux-v. - frequent urging in rectum and bladder. (4) Gels. - chills up and down the back. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Rectum - Loose evacuations of the consis- ' tency of liquid pap. Flatulency before and after a stool. Liquid, mucus-like stools in the morning, with spots of blood. Tearing shooting in-the rectum.

Male - Voluptuous excitation of the glans penis.

Back - Pain in the left shoulder blade.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains. Bruise-like pain of the limbs. Tearing shootings in the shoulders and the upper part of the arms. Pulling and tearing above the knee in the morning. Weariness in the legs. Coldness of the feet, extending to the knees. Burning lancinations in corns. Lungs - Expectoration of mucus. Voice frequently rough and smothered, removed by hawking. Frequent irritation in the larynx, which compels coughing. Dry cough, provoked by irritation in the throat.

Sleep - Sleeplessness at night, without much pain. Lascivious dreams with pol- 1 lutions. , - -

Teeth - Toothache with tearing shootings, i Nocturnal tearing pains in the teeth, with tearing shootings above the face towards morning. > „ ., A -

HOMEOPATHIC - Apis acts on cellular tissue of eyes, face, throat, ovaries, causing edema of skin and mtfcus membranes. In the serous membranes of heart, brain, pleura etc. it produces inflammation with effusion. - Allergic reactions to bee or wasp stings. The effects of a bee sting, burning, stinging, smarting, prickling, sharp pain with excessive swelling, are the leading symptoms for the selection of this remedy. The well-known effects of a bee’s sting: burning, stinging, sharp pains with excessive swelling, give leading keynotes for its employment in a great variety of conditions. Allergic edema of face, eyelids, lips, mouth and throat. Burning, stinging itching. Redness and swelling with stinging and burning pain in eyes, eyelids, ears, face, lips tongue, throat, anus, testicles. - The stinging pains appears in many diseases and conditions, causing the “cry cerebral” in acute hydrocephalus and meningitis. Sudden shrill cries in hydrocephalus and meningitis. Extreme sensitivity to touch. General bruised, sore pains is marked of brain, abdomen, ovaries, bladder. Stinging pains in hemorrhoids. Edema of the throat may be accompanied with stinging pains. Burning symptoms (Ars.), worse by heat. Apis produces serous inflammation with effusion, membranes of brain, heart and pleuritic effusion. Swelling or puffing up of various parts, edema, red rosy hue, stinging pains, soreness intolerance of heat and from the slightest touch. Afternoon aggravation are some of the general guiding symptoms. The pains are sudden that extort cries. Acute inflammation of kidneys and other parenchymatous tissues are characteristic pathological states corresponding to Apis. Constricted sensations. Sensation of stiffness and as-of something torn off in the interior of the body. Prostration even to faintness. . Trembling jerking and twitching. Symptoms go from right to left. Numbness. Thrombosis. Lymphangitis. Inflammation of kidneys, bladder. Paralysis after diphtheria and other severe diseases. MIND - Great anxiot^ restlessness and fidgety. Fussy and fidgety, hard to please. Fear of being poisoned. Dread of apoplexy. Constant whining in children. Cannot bear to be left alone . Restlessness and constantly busy. Ailments from hearing bad news. Weeping, cannot help crying, all day and night without any cause. Absent-minded with impaired memory. Cannot concentrate mind on attempting to f read and write. Stupor with sudden sharp cries and startings. Awkward, drops things readily. Listless, cannot think clearly. Couldn't bring his thoughts to bear on t anything. Apathy and indifference. Indifference, says nothing ails him. Indifference with dull- ? ness of head. Nothing seems to satisfy, all wrong and out of place. Fruitless activity. Irritable, excitable and sehsitive. Fickle and inconsistent behavior. Childish, silly behavior in women after delivery. Hysterical girls at puberty. Borrows troublé about everything. Jealous,fidgety, hard to please. Jealous, fright, rage, vexation, grief. Foolishly suspicious. Whining. Muttering delirium alternating with stupor. Declares she is well, during delirium. Sudden shrill, piercing screams. Mania from sexual irritation. Sexual mania alternating with stupor in women. Premonition of death. Sensation of dying. Lost of consciousness.

Head - Chronic sick headache. Sudden stabbing in head. Sharp shrieks. Bores head into pillow and screams out. Hydrocephalus enlargement of head. Rolling of the head from side to side in hydrocephalus. V Boring of the head backward in pillow in meningitis. Inability to hold the head a up in meningitis. Stinging pains. Numb, tired headache, better pressure. Flow of tears with headache. Fontanelles sunken. Fontanels reopen. Brain feels very tired. Heat, throbbing, pains, better on pressure and worse on motion. Aching in forehead and temples. Dull, heavy sensation in occiput, as from a blow. Erysipelas of scalp. Painful hair. Musty head sweat. Head feels swollen. Hair- falls out, bald spots. Apoplexy.

Eyes - Myopia. Styes. Asthenopia during éruptive fevers. Ophthalmia. * Face - Red, hot, swollen with piercing pains. Waxy pale and edematous. Lips bluish, edematous, upper. Bee stings. Erysipelas with stinging burning edema. Extends from right to left. Expression happy, terror stricken or apathetic. Jaws stiff, with stiffness of tongue. Paralysis of right side with right eye closed. Desire for washing face with cold water. Formication and prickling in face.

Ears - Redness and swelling of both ears. External ear red inflamed, sore. Stinging pains. Raises the hand to the back of ear with each scream. Scarlatinal otitis. Ten- ^ sion about ears. Violent j>ain in left ear, when chewing. Shooting, burning pain. Pain in ears, when swallowing. Impaired hearing. Deafness.

Nose - Red, swollen inflamed nose with sharp pains. Coldness of tip of nose. Boils in nostril, better cold. Nostrils red and ^ burning. Bridge of nose puffy. Coryza, * worse warmth. Coryza with feeling of swelling in nose. Thick, white, fetid, mucus discharge, mixed with blood. Copious nosebleed towards morning.

Throat - Tonsillitis with skin eruptions. Tonsils are swollen, fiery red, stinging .J'. pain, while swallowing, better cold drinks. Ulcers on tonsils. Swollen throat from allergic reaction. Constricted, stinging pains. Uvula swollen, sac- like. Sandy, ,t glossy or translucent better cold, swollen inside and outside. Throat purple. Angina. Diphtheria with early prostration, dirty membrane, edema of uvula. Throat sore, v. swallowing painful worse solids, sour or hot substances. Sensation as if fishbone in throat. Vasculargoitre.

Abdomen - - Dropsy of abdomen. Burning, pain and tenderness in epigastrium. Sore, bruisedpain, on pressure, when sneezing. Extremely tender. Rumbling in abdomen. Violent cutting pains. Peritonitis. Swelling in right groin. Ulceration of navel in newborn. Inguinal hernia. Sensitivity of ileocecal region.

Rectum - Anus seems open. Anus is sore, swollen with profuse hemorrhage. Anus feels raw, remains open. Prolapsed anus. Hemorrhoids with stinging pain after confinement. Cholera infantum. Cannot urinate without a stool Constipation, feels as if something would break on straining. Feels tight as if to break, on straining at stool. Electric shocks in rectum before urging to stool. Sensations - The burning is like hot needles. Sensation of constriction. Sensation of stiffness and as of something torn off the interior part of the body.

Stool - Stools, odorless or offensive involuntary worse motion. Diarrhea, watery yellow orange-yellow or tomato-sauce like stools. Stools, olive-green, slimy.

Female - Amenorrhea of puberty. Premenstrual syndrome with water retention. Menses suppressed with mental and head symptoms, especially in young girls. Hysterical girls at puberty. Menses last a . day or appear at intervals of one day. Dys- ' menorrhea with scanty discharge of slimy blood or with ovarian pains. Dysmenorrhea, with severe ovarian pains. Bearing-down, as if menses were to appear. Great tenderness over abdomen and uterine region. Metritis. Metrorrhagia profuse with heavy abdomen, faintness, stinging pain. Menorrhagia with the miscarriage.Leucorrhea, profuse, acrid, green. Edema of labia, relieved by cold water. Ovarian cysts. Soreness and stinging pains. Ovaritis, worse in right ovary. Ovarian tumors, with stinging pains. Ovaries numb or congested with suppressed menses. Pains in ovaries, worse sex. Toxemia. Miscarriage during early months. Uterine hemorrhage during pregnancy. Dropsy in later parts of pregnancy with puerperal convulsions. Mania in women from sexual excesses or suppressed menses. Food - Thirstless with edema, dropsy. Craving for milk (Rhus-t.). Better from milk. Craving for sour things. Child nurses by day, refuses at night.

Chest - Pains from below ribs going upwards. Burning or soreness below ribs. Hydrothorax. Burning stinging pains throughout entire front of the chest. Hydrothorax after pleurisy. Chest feels as if beaten or bruised. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Heart - Heart troubles with great feeling of suffocation. Heart stitches backward from apex. Violent palpitations, shake the whole body. Palpitations of heart from scanty secretion of urine. Insufficiency of'mitral valves. Organic heart disease. Blowing sound with the diastole. Pericarditis. Pulse is hard small intermittent and quick, weak.

Back - Back of the neck stiff. Back as if tired and bruised. Rheumatic pain in back. Burning pressing in coccyx worse when Sii sitting down. Back tired and bruised. Scapulae as if lame. Cervical glands t n swollen. Violent pain in sacrum, could not sit. Dragging-pain in lumbar region 11 with ovarian and uterine diseases.

Limbs - Edematous. Synovitis. Felon in the beginning with burning, stinging throbbing pains. Knee swollert. shiny, sensitive, sore with stinging pain. Feet swollen and stiff. Feel too large. Rheumatic pain in back and limbs. Tired, bruised feeling. Numbness of hands and fingertips. Hives with intolerable itching. Palms hot. Edema of hands. Limbs-, immovable, heavy, numb.. Feet numb and stiff. Legs and feet waxy, pale swollen and edematous. Trembling-of hands and feet. Nails feel loose. Hemiplegia from severe mental shock. Staggers when eyes are shut. Lungs - Asthma witn hives. Dyspnea from allergic reactions. Breathing hurried and difficult. Panting breathing, feels every breath would be his last. Air hunger. Edema of larynx. Feels as if he could not draw another breath. Suffocation, short, dry cough, supra-sternal. Painful shock in head and chest from every cough. v, Larynx drawn in. Hoarseness. Expectora- >t J. tion sweetish. !Male - Affections of prostate gland. Dropsy Zll of the scrotum. Hydrocele and cysts. n, Testiclespainful when touched. Frequent and long-lasting erections. Swelling of testicles, worse right. Violent itching and j redness of scrotum, sore to touch. Sexual desire increased or diminished. Discharge of prostatic fluid. Gonorrhea, copious secretion of thin, ichorous discharge. Gonorrhea with burning, stinging pain. Large boils on pubes. Swelling of foreskin.-

Sleep - Very drowsy. Great inclination to sleep but cannot from nervous restlessness. Drowsiness during feyer. Screams and sudden starting during sleep. Kicks off covers during sleep. Yawning after coughing. Dreams full of care and toil. Dreams of being busy going from place to place. Travelling dreams. Flying dreams. Unpleasant dreams. . Stomach - Belchings that tasting of ingesta worse drinking water or flow of water. Bitter or acrid belching. Soreness in the pit of stomach when touched. Gastroenteritis. Nausea and vomiting. Neither eats nor drinks for weeks. Vomiting of frothy mucus. Vomiting with diarrhea. Vomiting of food, bile.

Skin - Bee stings, insect bites. Swellings after bites Or stings. Nettle rash. Edematous swellings. Allergic dermatitis. Sudden puffing up of whole body. Hives, burning, stinging and itching. Rosy red, sensitive, sore skin. Stinging pains. Scarlatina. Erysipelas with sensitiveness and swelling, rosy hue. Urticaria like bee stings, or stings from other insects, with intolerable itching at night. Boils. Carbuncles with burning, stinging pain (Ars., Anthr). Rough eruptions or stinging-like spots on skin. Large urticaria. Skin dry, hot, alternating with gushes of sweat. Nettle-rash in warm weather, when one can't sweat.

Modalities - Better from cool air. Better cold applications. Better cool bathing. Better uncovering. Better slight expectoration. Better motion. Better sitting erect. Worse from heat in any form. Worse hot weather. Worse heat of room. Worse heat of fire. Worse hot drinks. Worse hot bath. Worse warm bed. Worse pressure. Worse touch,even of hair. Worse in late afternoon. Worse after sleeping in closed ' ' and heated rooms. Worse right side. Worse pressure. Worse after sleep. Worse lying 1 down. Worsefrom suppressed eruptions. Worse at 4 p.m. 'Mouth - Scalding in mouth and throat. •^ Bitter taste. Fetid breath. Viscid, tough, ’ 5I frothy saliva. Gums swollen. Lips swollen, b‘ especially upper. Membrane of mouth and ” throat glossy, as if varnished. Red, shining ‘J and puffy like erysipelas. Vesicles. Raw, burning and painful stinging blisters. Dryness of mouth.

Teeth - Sudden involuntary biting teeth together. Grinding of the teeth. Gums as if numb. Gums swollen. Gums bleed easily. Swelling and redness of gums and si cheek. Sore and stinging pain in teeth. Dentition. Teeth covered with yellow mucus or brown sordes. iTemperature - Chill, anticipating with dyspnea, urticaria, desire to uncover, alternate with heat. Heat of one part coldness of another. Thirstless during fever. Thirst -t during chill. Burning heat, but chilly -bi ' when moved. Afternoon chill with thirst, .■>, worse on motion and heat. Worse from heat with smothering feeling. Sleeps after the fever paroxysm.

Tongue - Tongue as. if scalded, red hot, trembling. Cancer of the tongue. Tongue fiery red, swollen, sore and raw with vesicles. Tongue feels raw. Tongue hangs out or cannot be protruded. Tongue as if wooden. Stinging blisters along edge of tongue. Dryness of tongue. Tongue red at tip. Tongue coated white. Tongue trembles, catches in teeth. Tongue first covered thickly white, later covered with a brown crust. Vertigo - Vertigo with sneezing worse lying or closing eyes. Vertigo with nausea and headache. Vertigo-as if she would fall. Vertigo with obscuration of sight, nausea and disgust for fpod. Vision - Obscured vision, in meningitis cerebrospinalis. Could only observe light coming in at window when turning herself towards it. Whitish grey mist. Weak vision, with feeling of fullness in eyes. Blindness better stool. Myopia. Objects appear too large. Could see better at night than in daytime. Diplopia after meningitis. Whirling. Indistinct vision, as if a skin were drawn over eye. COMMENTS - Acute remedy for anaphylactic shock from bee stings, jellyfish, nettles, scorpions, from drugs, from allergic reactions especially to strawberries and to certain foods. In a severe case, their face swells, first the eyes swell, then the face swells, and then the throat swells. It's also for hives, itching, burning, stinging hives from insect bites, from certain foods, severe allergies. Chronic treatment can lesson sensitivity (Vesp., Carb-ac.). Burns or sunburns with stinging pain, worse heat, or burns with water-filled blisters. Has been used for eczema, skin cracked and painful, burning, swollen, suppurating, worse wafer. PMS with acute, severe edema, water retention, irritability, emotional sensitivity. Right sided ovarian cysts, especially if so painful it's about to burst. Appendicitis. Acute nephritis with stinging pains. Good for urinary retention, cystitis, bladder infections (Canth.). Bladder feels full and urethra is swollen so urine comes out in painful drops. Pelvis feels full. For puncture wounds when the arm swells, vaccinations. Joint pain from arthritis or injury, the joint swells up. Toxemia in pregnancy, women have protein in the urine and high blood, pressure. Inflammation of the body cavity like peritonitis or fluid collecting around the heart, for meningitis, for hydrocephalic children, for painful inflammation of the scrotum. Brain cry, high pitch shrill, due to inflammation and on the brain. Never well since meningitis (Bell.). Originally used for edema. Often edema from the immune system or the kidneys, the histamine is released, the tissues swell. Better heat, look for the stinging pains and worse heat in some type of allergic reaction or bite or sting or some kidney failure type of problem. Apis has great sensitiveness of the surface to touch. General soreness, every hair is painful to contact. Great debility as if he h had worked hard is compelled to lie down. Tired and bruised feeling. Great restlessness di and fidgetiness (the Ars. restlessness is more from mental anxiety). Trembling, jerking and twitching. One half of the body twitching, the other lame or paralyzed. Hemiplegia. Apis is more a right-sided medicine, symptoms proceed from right to left (Rhus-t. left to right) and from above downwards. . Stiffness of lower jaw, soon amounting to <- a sense of complete fixation. This stiffness extended to tongue and throat, rendering speech difficult and unintelligible and causing a condition of extreme discomfort. The stiffness being accompanied by a feeling of in ■ constriction, wffich excited a single, spasmodic, hacking cough at short intervals. Some difficulty in breathing, especially S' in inspiration. These symptoms were accompanied by a terrible restlessness. On a later occasion there was dyspnea, face purple, head thrown back. The same symptoms as above recurred, but the throat 0,1 ' was more swollen and the distress extended below the larynx to the upper part of the lung, 'which soon became very sore and sensitive. '" An hour after the sting on this occasion a violent cough came on. It seemed to be excited by the constrictive feeling in the throat, but it reached down to the sore place in the lungs, causing great “" distress. It was a deep, hard, ringing cough, lasting without intermission for three hours. ''Traces of the cough and soreness lasted for months. Hni ' Apis has slow action and must not be changed too soon. Increased flow of urine shows it is having a favorable effect. The dropsies of Apis are characterized by a waxy hue of skin, whitish or yellowish, transparent swelling of eyelids, bag-like swelling under eyes, surface of body sore, bruised or burning. In cardiac dropsy the feet swell after walking and are intolerably sore and burning. In chest disorders there is sensation of contraction (Lach.) and inability to lie down. Tension, swelling and stiffness of limbs. This tight sensation is manifested in another symptom: sensation in abdomen as if something tight would break if too much effort was made to void a constipated stool. Aversion to tight things like Lach. Prostration even to faintness. Paralytic weakness. Paralysis after diphtheria and other severe diseases. Nervous, restless, over-sensitive or hot and drowsy with or without thirst. Worse from touch or pressure (though the head is better by pressure). Apis has a sensitiveness to heat, especially to heated rooms (Puls., lod., Kali- i.. Sec., Sulph.), worse by warmth of bed. Cold water better. Thirstlessness, there's no desire to drink. Can have fever with thirstlessness. A keynote is the eyes swell from allergic reactions. The person feels hot, the area is swollen. Sensation as though it would burst, skin becomes very sensitive. Dry skin. Wandering pains. Described as a red-hot needle stuck in and moved around. Shrieking out with pain, keynote. The eyes are glassy, the face is hot and puffy. Bobs head back and forth Worse bathing, better cold applications. Fears suffocation. Aggravated by heat, congestion and stuffy room (Puls.). Often has *0 choking feeling because the throat swells n up. Dreams of flying from place to place. Induced jealousy. Arching back of neck. RELATIONS - Antidotes: to medium doses and poisonings, Nat-m. in all forms, sweet oil, onions. Ammonia, Lach., Ledum. Ip., also powdered Ip. applied locally. It antidotes: Canth., lod., Chin., Dig. Everything smells or tastes like honey. It has been proved in large doses, its most prominent symptoms included “Heaviness with great desire to sleep. Trembling of 'the body. Prostration and trembling. Swollen sensations of face and body. Swelling of hands and feet, showing its relation to dropsical states like Apoc. can. and Stroph.” Face - Twitching in face. Heart, disorders. Heart, dropsy. Hemoptysis. Hydrocephalus. Hydrothorax. Hypotension. Kidney, dropsy. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Mitral, regurgitation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Scarlatina. Snuffles. Tobacco heart. Tricuspid, regurgitation. Typhus. Urinary, difficulties. Vomiting. Watery, stools.

HOMEOPATHIC - Provings were made with fresh plant tinctures or fresh or powdered root tinctufès or infusions. Watery infusions with just enough spirit to keep them from fermenting are said to be more efficacious than tinctures. The clinical effects of Strophanthus and n ; , the symptoms produced on patients to whom (fn it has been given in large doses, clearly show the relationship between it and Apocynum. Both produce intense gastric disturbance, j extreme depression of the heart's action and both control dropsical effusions and produce diuresis. Apocynum depresses the heart, kidneys and intestines, relaxing sphincters. Hypotensive, low bloodpressure. Arrhythmia. Congested heart failure with ascites. Relaxation of sphincters. Mitral and tricuspid regurgitation. A diminished frequency of the pulse is a prime indication. Apocynum is a useful remedy for general dropsies with or without organic disease. Increases secretions of mucus and serous membranes and acts on cellular tissue, producing edema and dropsy and on skin causing diaphoresis. Swelling of every part of the body with scanty urine and sweat, feels if he could only StVeat he would get well. Urinary troubles, especially suppression and strangury. An effective remedy for dropsies, edema, ascites, anasarca and hydrothorax. Dropsy with great thirst, but water causes pain or is vomited after typhus, scarlatina, cirrhosis. Dropsy after hemorrhage, quinine. Dropsy of serous membranes. Acute inflammatory dropsy. Acute alcoholism. Useful for the digestive complaints of Bright's disease with nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, and difficult breathing. In acute hydrocephalus, the child lies in stupor with automatic motion of one arm and leg. Paralysis of left side, one eye motionless other rolling. Weakness is marked. Excretions diminished, especially urine and sweat. Rheumatic stiffness. MIND - Acute or chronic alcoholism. Confusion of mind during fit of pain. Can't think. Bewildered, nervous, low-spirited. Faints when raised from pillow. Restlessness, nervousness at night.

Head - Dull ache^ Hydrocephalus with stupor, vision lost, forehead projecting, sutures open, stage of exudation.

Eyes - Hot and red, as if sand in them. One eye motionless and other rolling.

Nose - Long continued sneezing. Snuffles of children (Samb.). Chronic nasal catarrh with tendency to acute stuffiness with dull, sluggish memory. Dull headache. Takes cold easily, nostrils become congested and blocked up easily. Filled with thick yellow . mucus in morning, snuffles of infants.

Face - Bloated worse lying down, passes off after sitting up. Face pale, covered with cold sweat in diarrhea. Dry, lips, mouth.

Mouth - Dry tongue, immoderate thirst. Tongue coated. Constant spitting, increase of mucus and saliva. .

Stomach - Nausea with drowsiness. Excessive vomiting. Dull, heavy, sick feeling. Oppression in epigastrium and chest, impeding breathing (Lob.). Sensation of sinking in the pit of stomach after profuse urination, diabetes insipidus. Uremic vomiting. Vertigo - Dizzy. Piercing pain in right temple followed by vertigo. Vertigo suddenly, appearing and disappearing. COMMENTS - The dropsies of Apocynum are general dropsies with or without organic disease, swelling of every part of the body, cardiac dropsies. It's specific for edema related to a weak heart, congestive heart failure. Edema of the heart, pericardium and the limbs. The ankles are swollen because of heart problems. History of heart attack and weak heart ever since ( Am-c., Crat.). Hypotensive, low blood pressure. Ascites, mitral and tricuspid valve regurgitations (Naja). Alcoholism, delirium tremens. Bright's disease, chronic nephritis. Kidney effect is considered secondary to the heart. Apoc. causes an intense sinking sensation, drowsiness and a bewildered state of mind. Dizziness, hemorrhages. The excretions are diminished, especially urine and sweat. Hydrocephalus has been cured with it, “Child lying in stupor with constant involuntary motion of one arm and leg.” “Paralysis of left side, one eye motionless, one rolling.” Three cases of neuralgia of the right side, groin, hip and, in one case,.region of right kidney, have been cured with this remedy. All were violent, extorting cries. In one case the pain set in very suddenly and the slightest jar aggravated. | Hale said the kidneys are the peculiar seat of the operation of the drug and that it is in kidney dropsies that it is especially curative. It has cured diabetes insipidus with “a sense of sinking in the pit of the stomach with great debility.” Hemorrhages, especially menorrhagia and hemorrhages at the change of life have been cured with it. Hale has found it restore the menses when given in cases of dropsy. Boericke said to use “tincture (ten drops three times daily).” Less effective in potency (like Echi., Equis., and Crat,). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Apoc-a., Alst, Stroph., Acet-ac. (2) Apis, - thirstless in dropsies. (3) Ars., Bell., Bry., Chin., Colch. (4) Dig. - dropsy, slow pulse. (5) Elat., Hell. - hydrocephalus, ascites. (6) Aloe, Ambr. and Trom. - diarrhea. (7) Kali-caust., Lyc., Merc., Merc-sulph. (8) Sulph., Nux-v., Squil., Ign., Curare, Spig., Verat. (9) Strophanthus - extreme cardiac depression with intense gastric disturbance, dropsy. (10) Aralia Hispida. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Abdomen - Bloated. Ascites, often with chronic diarrhea. Distention after a moderate meal. Dropsy after scarlet fever. Dropsy after abuse of quinine.

Rectum - Diarrhea with dropsy, yellow, painless, noisy, gushing stools. Feeling as if anus is open and stools run through out. Watery stools, flatulent with soreness in anus, worse after eating.

Male - Prostate^land enlarged. Penis and scrotum swollen, dropsical.

Female - Amenorrhea with bloating of abdomen and legs. Metrorrhagia with nausea, fainting, vital depression. Uterine hemorrhage, blood expelled in large clots or sometimes in fluid state. Hemorrhage at menopause. Ovarian tumor. Cough during pregnancy. , . - Food - Great thirst with hydrothorax. Great thirst, but water disagrees, causing pain or is immediately thrown off. Thirst on walking.

Chest - Oppression about epigastrium and chest. Constitutions - Sanguine constitutions.

Heart - Heart's action is depressed. Mitral and tricuspid regurgitation. Rapid and feeble, irregular cardiac action, low arterial tension, pulsating jugulars, general cyanosis and general dropsy. Pulse, slow, fluttering, irregular or intermittent.

Limbs - Rheumatic condition. Joints stiff, especially on moving in the morning. Constant involuntary motion of one leg and one arm. Fingernails of bluish red m color. Aching in both knees. Edema of feet, ankles, and legs. Lungs - Sighing. Short, dry cough. Breathing is short and unsatisfactory, difficult. Hydrothorax. Hemoptysis. Violenthoarse cough, worse at night. Cough short, dry, loose and rattling.

Sleep - Great restlessness and little sleep. Drowsy in afternoon, restless at night. Stupor. Desire to sleep, but inability to do so. Drowsy before and after nausea and vomiting.

Skin - Rough, dry. Cannot sweat.

Modalities - Better from warmth. Worse from cold weather. Worse cold drinks. Worse from uncovering. Worse lying. Worse after sleep. Worse on waking in the morning. Diarrhea is worse immediately after eating. Food or water is immediately ejected, though hungry.

Kidneys - This remedy acts upon urinary organs, producing diufesis and removing the dropsical effusions. Kidney dropsy. Urine is copious, scanty. Bedwetting in old men. Bladder much distended. Turbid, hot urine with thick mucus and burning in urethra after urinating. Little expulsive power. Dribbling. Strangury. Retention of urine with paralysis of lower limbs.

Perspiration - Sweats when the skin moistens. Clammy sweats. Body covered with large drops of cold sweat.

HOMEOPATHIC - Apomorphine contains the emetic properties of Opium. The chief power of this drug lies in the speedy and effective vomiting that it produces, which becomes a strong guiding symptom to its ho- meopathic use. It causes very rapid vomiting, most rapid when injected subcutaneously. Vomiting without previous nausea. Alcoholism with constant nausea, constipation and insomnia. Drowsiness. Faintness. Specific for severe morning sickness. Keynote is obstinate, severe morning sickness with a lot of saliva and water brash. The vomiting is preceded by nausea, lassitude and increased secretion of sweat, saliva, mucus and tears. The peculiar vomiting witfi its suddenness, completeness and the absence of pain or continued nausea. Pneumonia with vomiting.

Head - Hot feeling all over body, especially head.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting. Violent inclination to vomit. Empty retching and headache, heartburn. Reflex vomiting of pregnancy. ;j , , Vertigo - Dizziness. Seasickness. COMMENTS - Apom. has been used with success in cases of sympathetic vomiting and from pressure of a tumor on the brain. Halbert has given Apom. 3x with success in a desperate case of combined alcoholism and opium addiction. The symptoms were constant nausea, constipation insomnia, delirious headache, extreme emaciation, pronounced hysteria. Boericke mentions alcoholism, seasickness, and vomiting, nausea, increased salivation and sweat, nausea and vomiting. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Opium, Hyos., Ip., Ant-t., Cer-ox. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.
