CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Anxiety. Biliousness. Constipation. Coryza. Eczema. Emaciation. Flatulence. Gastroenteritis. Goiter. Headache. Hypoglycemia. Hyperthyroid. Loeffler's syndrome. Lupus. Lymphadenitis. Nausea. Phlegm. Polyneuritis. Seasickness. Seaside, effects. Thyroid problems. Tuberculosis. Varicose, ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aqua marina is a great blood purifier and vitalizer. Potentized seawaterin weakness, lack of reaction, symptoms are worse by the seaside. For the treatment of diseases of skin, kidneys and intestines. Lymphadenitis. Goiter. Lupus, eczema, varicose ulcers. Scrofulous disorders of children. Gastroenteritis and tuberculosis. Aq-mar. acts primarily on the blood, as in toxic, scrofulous conditions, enteritis. It helps detoxifies in cancer cases. Aq-mar. has been principally used in high potencies for the effects of residence near the sea, which causes biliousness, constipation, headache, etc. It has been used in wine glassful doses and also in potencies as a remedy for seasickness. Worse at seaside or on the sea. Subject anxious and in a feverish state with fetid sweating and head pains. Thoracic pains and back pains, cough with watery or mucus sputum tasting of rust. Neuralgic pains down right temple and forehead. Face ache left side, cold'water intolerable. Sensation of a hair or fishbone in throat, tickling and urging to swallow, causing cough, which does not relieve. Pain on swallowing, extending to ear and temples. Nausea Sid nauseous sensation in stomach and abdomen. “Constant hawking and raising of phlegm tough and white like cotton.” General and genital weakness, despite arousal of desires. Vesicular rashes. Alcoholic polyneuritis with mental troubles. Addison's disease. Emaciation. Hypoglycemia. Overactive thyroid. Hyper-secretion from the thyroid. Perspiration. Trembling. Fatigue in the morning, feeling feverish at 10 a.m. MIND - Absent-minded. Slowness of mind. Intellectual concentration difficult. Feels tormented. Agitated. Tormented by lewd thoughts. Fearofmadness. Impressionofbeing spied upon. Finds salvation in religion. Anxiety aggravated by talking. Anxiety in company. Anxiety by iced drinks. Anxiety worse perspiration. Anxiety improved between 2 p.m. and 4 p.m. Delusion of being watched (Ars.). Aversion to bathing.

Head - Headaches with vertigo, aggravated by pressure, eating, heat, movement, improved after sleep. Localized head pains in the forehead and occipital region and felt when thinking about them. Occipital headaches, vertigo, buzzing in ears, with visual and psychosomatic complaints. Acute, pressure, neuralgic pain above right frontal portion of head (from inhalation by an atomizer). Severe neuralgic pains . down right temple and above right frontal protuberance, very acute and vanishing without a trace, appearing after ten or thirty minutes in left side of neck (near edge of trapezius muscle# (immediately from inhalation by an atomizer), j, >H

Ears - Stinging pain in right ear in the evening. Transient stitches. : iw.iZ

Nose - Coryza with watery flow, blocking the left nostril. Coryza better tea. Feeling of having a cold at the root of the nose only. Thick, fetid mucus, falling into the back of the throat. Aggravated after eating, by respiration and sleep. Burning and heaviness in the eyelids. Spasmodic rhinitis. Purulentrhinitis. Frontal sinusitis. Obstruction first of right nostril, then of left. Sneezing in morning on waking.

Face - Face ache on left side of upper and lower jaw, extending under lower jaw to right side. The pain was acute like toothache. Cold water was intolerable. Food - Appetite and thirst increased, especially at 11.30 a.m. after eating. Aversion to fish. Desires salt, farinaceous food. Worse salt, cold drinks. Better salt, ice cold drinks.

Mouth - White, yellowish mucous. Lips dry, especially at night, split in the middle of the lower lip. Breath fetid, spitting of blood and burning in the mouth. Pain on swallowing, ameliorated by gulping, aggravated by cold dnnks. Red rash, painful around the chin. Mucus like cotton (Puls.). Pain as from a splinter.

Throat - Sore throat after eating. Pain in the right tonsil, improved by pressure and sleep. Throat congested, especially on the left and trickling of mucus. Mucus fetid when swallowing. Sensation as if a small substance were in the throat causing a desire to cough, but not benefited by coughing. Pain on swallowing, extending into ear and temples. Vertigo - Vertigo with buzzing in ears. Vertigo with visual disturbances and occipital headaches. COMMENTS - Aqua marina been used for thyroid problems because of the iodine content of seawater. For people aggravated by seawater, headaches, constipation and seasickness. Mentals are slow and apathetic. Great fatigue in the morning (Mag-m., Nat-m). Neuralgic pains in the face. Great weakness after sex. They have offensive perspiration (Sil.), offensive sweat on hands, feet, and under the arms. Seeping of fetid muçus, worse when getting up in the morning. Sore throat with sensation of foreign substance in throat. Pain in the right tonsil, aggravated after eating, ameliorated by pressure and during the night. Acute, paroxysmal, neuralgic pain in right anterior portion of head all the afternoon and evening (from inhalation by atomizer). RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Nat-m. (2) Chlo- rum - but in addition to its chief ingredient, seawater contains in solution every inorganic substance in the worgi, also Silica marina. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian

Stomach - Epigastric pain, aggravated by pressure and hot applications. Seasickness. Nausea and nauseous sensation in stomach and abdomen with eructation of wind.

Abdomen - Flatulence, sensitivity, pain at the sides of the ribs. Spasmodic colitis. Intestinal parasites. Epigastric pain, aggravated at the tip of the xyphoid cartilage. Pains at 11 p.m., worse*by pressure and agitation. Pain better exercise (Coloc.).

Rectum - Heaviness, pain before and during defecation, even when stools soft. Anal burning, heavy bleeding when first going to stool. Stools, hard at first, then soft in great quantities. Evacuation of small worms.

Male - Libido maintained, but- sexual impotence. Seminal discharge followed by weakness, sleepiness and the need to stretch out as a result of muscular pains. Impotence. Increased sexual desire without erections.

Chest - Thoracic pain situated at the level of the third intercostal space, right against the sternum. Pain the lowest three intercostal spaces in the morning when rising, worse with pressure. Pain at the tip of the shoulder blade in the evening. Constitutions - Hypersensitive subjects, tubercular with a congestion of the veins and mucus membranes in the phosphoric or carbo-phosphoric type with an unstable nervous system.

Back - Vertebral column affected. Pains in the neck, back and thorax, stiff, heavy or prickling pains. Aggravated by hot drinks, heat, pressure contact. Pain at the nape of the neck with stiffness and difficulty in turning the head. Arthritis of the spine. Arthrosis of the spine. Arthritis of the scapula and shoulder.

Limbs - Pain in the right arm from the elbow to the fingertips. Pain in the lower limbs, tenderness.at the limbs. Offensive smelling perspiration of the hands, feet and axilla. Pain on exerting pressure on muscles. Trembling of the limbs. Involuntary movement of the legs when they are touching the ground.

Skin - Itching of the toes, the inner side of the thighs and the bends of the arms and legs. Vesicular rash on the face, cheeks and chin. Fetid sweating of the feet and hands. Acrocyanosis. Eczema of the palms.

Modalities - Better from eating. Better rest. Worse from movement. Worse pressure and heat»Worse afternoon and evening. Worse neuralgic pain in anterior portion of head. Pain in right ear, worse evening. Face pain, worse cold water. Aversion to bathing.

Liver - Slight hepatic deficiency. Lungs - Early tuberculosis. Loeffler's syndrome. Morning cough with cold, watery sputum. Rusty, djty taste at the back of throat. Difficulty expectorating. Expectoration mucus like cotton.

full:
PHARMACY - and. Aralia racemosa. American Spikenard. N. O. Araliaceae. Grows in rich woodlands throughout North America. Tincture of fresh root. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Coryza. Cough. Diarrhea. Hay fever. Hemorrhoids. Leucorrhea. Nausea. Prolapse, anus. Sneezing.

HERBAL - Aralia was used by the old herbalists as a remedy in tuberculosis and coughs, and for leucorrhea and other female complaints when the secretions are acrid or suppressed.

HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic uses have been chiefly based on a proving by Dr. S. A. Jones, in whom it developed an attack of asthma. Jones also experienced diarrhea and prolapsed rectum, soft, yellow stools, and an aching pain in the rectum after stool, extending upwards on the left side. Pain in rectum worse lying on side lain on. Patient is weak, relaxed and exhausted. Biliousness. Asthmatic conditions with cough aggravated on lying down. Acrid mucus secretions. Drenching sweat during sleep. Extreme sensitiveness to drafts. The characteristic cough, according to Burnett is: “a fit of coughing occurring before midnight, either immediately on lying down or more commonly after a short sleep.” Cough occurring at 11 p.m. after a short sleep. MIND - Fear of lung disease cannot be shaken off.

Nose - Hay fever. Frequent sneezing, worse least drafts with copious, watery excoriating nasal discharge. COMMENTS - Loud wheezing respiration coming on immediately on lying down at midnight. Loud inspiration, more difficult than expiration. Right lung more affected than the left. On turning to left sided, left side seemed affected and right side became quite free. As the attack passed off phlegm came more freely, had a salty taste and felt warm in the mouth. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Gins., Hed. (2) Calc. - turning on one side, symptoms go to that side, relieving opposite side. (3) Rumex - cough at 11 p.m. (4) Chlorum - opposite of Aral, inspiration easy, expiration difficult. (5) Pecten jacobaeus - humid asthma. Quick, labored breathing. Constriction of chest, especially right side. Asthma preceded by coryza and burning in throat and chest. Attack ends with copious expectoration of tough, frothy mucus. Worse at night. (6) Ars-i., Naph., All-c., Rosa, Sabad., Sinapis. Complementary: Lob. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Female - Menses suppressed. Foul smelling leucorrhea, acrid with pressing-down pain. Lochia suppressed with tympanites.

Modalities - Better from lying with head high. Better sitting up. Worse from drafts. Worse 11 p.m.. Worse after a short nap.

Liver - Pain from liver to right scapula. Lungs - Asthmatic condition with coughing, worse lying down. Dry cough coming on after first sleep, about middle of night. Raw, burning feeling behind the sternum. Asthma on lying down at night with spasmodic cough, worse after first sleep with tickling in throat. Constriction of chest, feels as if a foreign body were in throat. Obstruction worse in spring. Whistling breathing. Salty expectoration feels warm in mouth. The least current of air causes sneezing with copious watery, excoriating nasal discharge of salty acrid taste. .Mouth - Aphthae. As if foreign body in throat. Nausea in throat.

PHARMACY - aran. Aranea diadema. Papal cross spider. Diadema aranea. Araneus diade- matus. N. O. Arachnida. Araneae. Europe. Tincture of the whole animal. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acroparesthesia. Allergies. Bones disorders. Cancer. Catalepsy. Chills. Colic. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Hemorrhages. Headache. Hemoptysis. Intermittent fever. Leucocytosis. Lung, cancer. Malarial cachexia. Menstruation, irregularities. Neuralgia. Obesity. Polycythemia. Polyuria. Punctured, wounds. Rickets. Scorbutic, disorders. Scurvy. Spleen, disorders. Toothache. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Grauvogl is our chief authority for the use of Aranea. The spider poisons powerfully affect the nervous system (Tarent., Mygal.). It is one of the leading remedies for the hydrogenoid constitution as described by him and for intermittent fevers and other intermittent disorders. By hydrogenoid constitution, Grauvogl meant an abnormal sensitiveness to damp and cold and inability to live near fresh water, either rivers or lakes, or in damp, chilly places. This gives the worse from bathing, from the damp weather, localities or habitations, worse drawing in cold air. Aran, is the remedy for the constitution favorable to malarial poisoning, where every damp day or place favors chilliness. There i s abnormal susceptibility to dampness and cold. Patient feels cold to the very bones, cannot get warm enough. Coldness not relieved by anything. Inability to live near fresh water, rivers, lakes or in damp chilly places (Dulc., Nat-s.). Characteristic periodicity, coldness, and great susceptibility to dampness. Feeling of faintness with nausea, vertigo, trembling and cold sweating. Chilliness followed by little or no fever. Chill not better by external warmth, no sweat with fevers. Shivering, cold sweats. Palpitations. Head and feet cold. Face congested and burning. Rush of blood to the head. Chill and neuralgic attacks at the same hour every day, every other day, week, month or regular period. Attacks are violent and sudden. Loquacious with painful attacks beginning and ending abruptly. Aggravation from mental exertion, amelioration from pressure on head. Periostitis. Punctured wounds. Feelingas if parts were enlarged and heavier. Wake up at night with hands feeling twice their natural size. Exhaustion, must lie down. Swelling of the spleen after malaria suppressed by quinine, malarial attacks worse in wet rainy weather, severe attacks of neuralgia after malaria suppressed by quinine. Neurosis. Periodic neuralgia. Parkinson's syndrome. Acroparesthesia at night. Radicular neuritis. Toxic or viral polyneuritis. Facial neuralgia. Obesity with fat and water retention. Hemorrhage. Violent hemoptysis of bright red blood in debilitated subjects, bathing and damp places aggravate, coldness as if the bones were made of ice. Pains are like electric shocks. Headache relieved by smoking tobacco. Toothache after lying down at night. Creeping as of ants all over the body. Many symptoms occur on the right side. MIND - Nervous. Great inner unrest, irritability, fear of death. Stays awake late, uneasiness and the need to move about. Confusion of mind, better by smoking in open air. People and objects seem unreal. Speech is perceived as if far away. Alternately, happy and depressed. Despondent, longs for death. Claustrophobia.

Head - Head numbed, head pains, improved by smoking. Daily headaches, improved by fresh air. Feeling of ants on the nape of the neck. Pain in the trigeminal nerve and occipital nerve.

Eyes - Double vision. Heat and glittering before eyes, before headache. White is perceived as yellow.

Ears - Pricking pain in the right ear and Eustachian tube, spreading towards the left ear. Buzzing in the ears.

Nose - Nose red, copper color.

Face - Face pale, yellowish color. Pain in right trifacial nerve from periphery inwards. Cheeks feel as if swollen during toothache.

Mouth - Sudden violent pain in teeth at night immediately after lying down. Feeling of cold toothache (incisors) in the cold air, pains recur at the same time each day. Bitter taste, better smoking.

Throat - Throat painful, red and swollen. Prickling, burning pains in the throat. Vertigo - Vertigo, even when in bed. Vertigo with flickering before the eyes. COMMENTS - Grimmer said cancer of lungs with hemorrhage, cases based on the tubercular miasm. Hydrogenoid constitution. Abnormal sensitiveness to damp and cold, inability to live near fresh water, lakes, rivers, etc. or in damp, chilly places (Nat-s.. Thuj.). Very sensitive to dampness and rainy weather. Marked periodicity of symptoms, clock-like regularity, annual recurrence of symptoms and conditions. Vascular and cerebral tension with insomnia, feverish agitation, clouding of consciousness. Neuralgia at regular intervals, especially of the trigeminal region, occipital nerve and of the limbs. Gastric and intestinal complaints, as well as genital and urinary complaints, mostly cramping pains. The patient thinks his illness is improved by smoking, but the symptoms always recur at the same hour. Hemorrhages from many parts, from wounds. Punctured wounds. Exhaustion. Pains like electric currents. Great desire to lie down, many symptoms better lying down. Sensation of swelling in many parts, head, face, hands of numbness of coldness as if bones were made of ice. RELATIONS - It antidotes: Chin., Quinine, Merc. Antidoted by: Smoking tobacco. Compare: (1) Cedrón. Mygale, Tela, Theridion, Tarent., Ip., Nux-v. (2) Ars. - intermittents and bone disorders. (3) Lachesis - has greater loquacity and hypersensitivity to light touch, cannot bear the any constriction, better after menses. (4) Cedrón - intermittents of hot climates, Aran, of cold climates chiefly. (5) Apis - Very sharp pains, which are worse by heat and partial or generalized edema, occurring suddenly. (6) Form-ac. - Its action is directed towards cutaneous and mucus allergies, for exudative tendencies. Action on neuritis, arthritis or arthrosis. (7) Paris Quad. - Neuralgias and Barre-Liéou's syndrome. (8) Hypericum. REFERENCES - Clarke. Grimmer. Julian.

Stomach - Cramps after eating a little, epigastrium painful to pressure. Nausea. Stomach pains, as though it would burst. Noisy eructation, either tasteless or tasting rotten and repulsive.

Abdomen - Heaviness and sensation of repletion in the intestines with rumbling, repeated at the same hour each day. Shooting pains going from the gallbladder towards the appendix.

Rectum - Violent attacks of diarrhea, vertigo and faintness. Stools liquid, accompanied by abdominal pains, improved by rubbing the abdomen. Stools glairy or yellow with repulsive odor. Diarrhea, alternating with constipation. Sensations - As if enormous enlargement or numbness of parts, worse on waking or he wakes with such a feeling.

Female - Menstrual blood has a smell of ammonia. Menses, too early, too copious, accompanied by pain in the lumbar and sacral regions, which is aggravated at the end of the period. Lumbar, abdominal neuralgia with vomiting and yawning during menstrual cycle. Food - Desire for milk and feeling of being soothed greatly. Thirsty.

Chest - Pain in intercostal nerve from nerve endings to spine. Bright red hemorrhage from lungs (Mill.. Ferr- p.). Constitutions - Hydrogenoid constitution, subject to neuralgia as a result of humid cold. Hemorrhagic diathesis.

Heart - Palpitations.

Back - Back icy.

Limbs - Stinging pains in all the joints. Arms and legs feel as if asleep. Bone pains in limbs. Pain in os calcis, better continued motion. Sensation of swelling and of parts going to sleep. Numbness of parts supplied by ulnar nerve. Arms and legs feel numb. Bones cold, as if made of ice. Ulcer on heel. Limbs feel heavy. Dull, gnawing aching in the bones of the limbs, on the right side. Pain in the right hip and right knee. Arthritis. Arthrosis. Lungs - Hemoptysis, bright red. Irritated cough with huskiness.

Sleep - Sleep disturbed, waking often and feeling that the hands and forearms are fat and swollen, as if enlarged. Anxious dreams, painful awakening. Restless and waking, as if hands and forearms were swollen and heavy.

Skin - Yellow color of the face. Small fissures and cracks. Small vesicles which burst easily and dry immediately. Formation of abscesses. Slow healing of small wounds.

Modalities - Better smoking tobacco. Better in open air. Better movement. Better in the fresh air. Better summer and pressure. Worse from cold, damp weather. Worse cold bathing. Worse late in afternoon. Worse at midnight. Exact periodicity. Periodic recurrence at the same time of neuralgic pains and cold shivers. Worse from mental strain, especially of head pains.

Kidneys - Acute glomerulonephritis. Nephrotic syndrome. Urine strongly yellow in color. Polyuria. Strong smell of ammonia in the urine. Proteinuria. Oxalate, urate and phosphate crystals. Urochrome and guanidine present.

Blood - Polycythemia. Leucocytosis.

Temperature - Coldness with pain in long bones and feeling of stone in abdomen at the same hour daily. Chilly day and night, always worse during rain. No sweat.

HOMEOPATHIC -…
full:
PHARMACY - aran-ix. Aranea ixobola. Cross-spider. America. Tincture of the whole animal. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholic polyneuritis. Facial neuralgia. Goiter. Hashimoto'sdisease. Muscle pain. Neurasthenia. Neuritis. Psychosis. Thyroiditis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aranea Ixobola is a Cross-spider which lives in Europe, but was imported from America. Pooch examined the venom, which comes fromtheChelicerae. The dried venom represents 30% of the original poison. J. Mezger undertook a homeopathic proving in 1952 at the Robert Bosch Hospital in Stuttgart, at the time when Dr. Otto Leeser was director there. Thirty-two provers, of whom seven were women and all were doctors, participated. Action was directed to the digestive system, principally the liver and gallbladder. Neurotropic and vascular action, both central and peripheral. Extreme inner disquiet. Euphoria, depression. Overwhelming need to smoke. Hypersensitive senses of smell and hearing. General and localized feeling of coldness. Shaking, sensation of inner trembling, need to move about. Spasmodic contracture of the unstriped muscles. Arterial congestion, spasms of the digestive passages. Spasms of the striped muscles. Cramps, tremors, and clonic spasms. Rheumatic pains. Neuritis with abnormality of cerebrospinal fluid. Painful pulsations of the heart and large vessels. Pain in the liver and gallbladder. Thyroid complaints. Spasmodic instability of the nerves, vessels and muscles. Parathyroid deficiency and tetany. Toxic adenoma of the thyroid. Hashimoto's disease, sub-acute thyroiditis with goiter. Spasmodic cardiovascular complaints. Psychotic, digestive and hepatic disorders. MIND - Absent-minded. Mental exertion aggravates. Answer, answers snappishly. Snappish. Impolite. Hurried. Restlessness, better open air (Arg-n.). Witty talk. Delusions, everything seems unreal. Delusions of being smaller. Time passes too slowly, appears longer. Euphoric state, as if he had drunk wine. Teasing disposition and the need to speak. Melancholy, weariness of life. Irritable. Must make a great effort not be impolite or rude. Incapable of mental concentration inattentive, wants to do nothing. Must make an effort to set to work. Need to move about, feels better in the fresh air. Inner disquiet and hastiness, nothing is finished quickly enough for him. Neurosis from anguish. Mania and depression.

Head - Hot feeling in the head and vertigo. Deafening or stinging headache, especially right-sided, worse when bending down or after alcohol, better in fresh air or smoking a cigarette. Headache after mental effort. After copious urination, headache disappears.

Ears - Hypersensitive to noise.

Nose - Sharpened, perverted sense of smell. Irritation of the mucus membranes in the nose. Watery discharge. Hypertrophic Aranea ixobola rhinitis.

Mouth - Dry feeling in the mouth and pharynx, sometimes localized on one side only. Bleeding gingivitis, cracking of the lips, aphthae.

Throat - Itching of the throat and difficulty swallowing, as if he had an inflammation, ameliorated by hot drinks. Constant need to scratch the throat and occasional grayish-white sputum. Pulsating in throat with palpitations. Vertigo - Vertigo with ahot feeling. Vertigo with nausea. COMMENTS - Hypertrophic cirrhosis without jaundice. Viral hepatitis. Atony of the gallbladder. Acute inflammation of the gallbladder. Gallstones. Chronic cholecystitis without the formation of stones. Cirrhosis of the bladder and enlargement of the spleen. Fibrocystic disease of the pancreas. Chronic pancreatitis. Cystic fibrosis of the pancreas. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Viscum Album. (2) Tarent. - Nervous complaints with restlessness, anxiety, need to run. palpitations and suffocation, sexual excitement. (3) Theridion - Nervous hypersensitive and intolerance of the slightest sound. Left-sided thoracic pain, nausea and vertigo from closing eyes. REFERENCES-Julian.

Stomach - Vomiting after drinking alcohol. Vomiting, worse wine (Ant-c.).

Abdomen - Distension of right hypochondrium. Pain better bending backward. Immediately after meals, nausea with feeling of repletion and heaviness in the hepatic region. Pain in gall bladder. Biliary colic. Sharp, shooting pains in the gallbladder.

Rectum - Sometimes constipation, but more often pale yellow diarrhea with a repulsive odor. Explosive evacuation and immediately the feeling of not quite having emptied the intestines.

Male - Low libido with cold genital organs. Increased libido with insufficient erection.

Female - Menses too early by a week, preceded by blood-streaked leucorrhea. Disorders of libido. Food - Aversion to fats and rich food. Desires cheese, meat. Strong desire for sugary foods, which are easily digested. Desires sweet food, tobacco. Worse alcohol, fats and rich food. Worse wine. Better coffee, tobacco. Worse by fatty foods, especially pork fat, and alcohol.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Constitutions - Tubercular condition in phosphoric, nervous subjects.

Heart - Palpitations of heart immediately after lying. Palpitations extending to epigastrium. Strong palpitations and squeezing feeling. Pressure and tingling in the precordial region. Tachycardia and neurosis with strain in those who worry. Aortic deficiency of arterial origin. Pulse is felt in the carotid artery and abdominal aorta, worse when lying down and resting, better, when moving and after drinking coffee. Acceleration of the pulse.

Back - Stiffness at the nape of the neck, occurring suddenly and spreading towards the trapezius muscles and the shoulders. Acute pain in the lumbar region, requiring him to stop work for several days.

Limbs - Numbness of single parts. Coldness of painful parts. Pain in left leg, sciatica, better motion. Trembling of hands increased. Rheumatic pains in all the joints, especially in the arms, legs and shoulders. Left-sided sciatic pain after standing for a long time, better by moving the legs. Heavy feeling in the arms, especially the right arm and swollen feeling with clumsiness of the right hand. Numb feeling in the forearm and left hand. Lungs - Persistent, irritating cough and feeling of soreness in the respiratory passages, every breath is painful. Dry feeling in the trachea and intense thirst after cold drinks. Chronic tracheitis. Chronic asthma. Miller's asthma (false croup).

Sleep - Sleep long in coming, followed by a rush of thoughts and inner unrest. Remains awake for several hours during the night. Sleep disturbed by worrying or frightening dreams. Dreams of quarrel with a friend. Dreams of the death of a close relation or husband. Dreams of violence.

Skin - Cracked lips. Chapped fingers. Acne of the scalp, at the hairline. Desquamation of the hands and nose like that following scarlet fever. Seborrhea of the nose. General itching worse when scratched or from pressure. Erythema like fleabites. Varieties of lupus erythematous, simple or exanthematic. Eczema treated by inoculation of impetigo. Psoriasis of the scalp and hair. Rosy pityriasis. Pityriasis characterized by pimples with a hair in the center.

Modalities - Better from drinking coffee and smoking cigarettes. Better motion. Better in fresh air. Better walking. Better getting up. Better leaning backwards. Better lying down and stretching out fully. Better after expelling gas and going to stool. Worse from rest. Worse cold. Worse alcohol. Worse in the morning. Worse warm and wet weather.

Kidneys - Overpowering need to urinate and increased or reduced volume of urine. Polyuria.

Temperature - Constant chilliness, despite staying in a warm room, but no sign of catarrh. Feet cold, not gaining heat when moving. Sweating over the whole body, especially after eating soup. Sudden flushes of heat with headaches and sweating on the forehead. Sweating at night, which wakes him.

CLINICAL - Arthritis. Eczema. Gout. Lumbago. Rheumatism. Urine, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - The strawberry tree sheds its bark annually, which gives the signature of its use in skin cases. Arbu. is one of Dr. Cooper's remedies. He cured several cases of eczema with it and observed that it produced pains in the joints of a gouty or rheumatic character. Noting these symptoms, he was led to give it in certain inveterate cases of arthritis. For eczema associated with gouty and rheumatic symptoms. Arthritis, especially larger joints. Lumbago. Symptoms shift from skin to joints. One patient who was benefited by the remedy had worse in North- East winds. The larger joints are principally affected and the slightest movement sets up inflammation. Bladder symptoms. In one case, the patient noticed that it “cleared his urine.” Arbutin has a reputation among the allopaths as a urinary remedy. Arbutus is allied to Uvaursi, which belongs to the Ericaceae. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arbutin, Led., Bry., Kalm. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HERBAL - The betel-nut is in very common use in the East as a masticatory for sweetening the breath and hardening the gums. The chief medical use of the Areca nut has been in helminthiasis in dogs, but it is not altogether without danger. According to F. Hobday. Tenaline is a much safer and more certain anthelmintic than Arecoline. He advises a dose of one minim of the solution to the pound-weight of the animal, either given pure or with a little water. It is not to be given by injection. The Hydrobromate of Arecoline has been used to cause contraction of the pupil. It acts more promptly and more energetically than Eserine, but its duration of action is shorter. Increases the amplitude of pulsations of the heart. It arrests the heart's action in diastole in poisonous doses and in non-toxic doses increases the amplitude of the pulsations without increasing their frequency. Acts also as a salivatory, according to Ricapet, it surpasses Pilocarpine as such. Serviceable in glaucoma. Useful for worms and parasites. It promotes the contractibility of the intestines and as a tineafuge it requires no additional laxative. It should be given in pills coated with gelatin or keratin. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Sense of constriction and burning. Violent pain in supra-sternal fossa and under the sternum every time she turned to one side. Suffocative attack. Respiration difficult and short. Constant dry, spasmodic cough, allowing her to articulate but one word at a time. Painful cramps in feet. The face and tongue were very red. Weakness. Painful cramps in feet. Arg-cy. has been helpful in cases of cancer of the tongue and larynx. Angina pectoris. Asthma, severe spasmodic cough. Cramps. Spasms of the esophagus. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - arg. Argentum metallicum. Silver metal. Silver leaf. Precipitated silver. Silver, (Ag., At. Wt. 107.66). Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anklosing spondylitis. Bedwetting. Blepharitis. Brain-fag. Cartilage, disorders. Chlorosis. Conjunctivitis. Cough. Diabetes. Emaciation. Encephalomyelitis. Epilepsy. Epithelial, disorders. Exostosis. Keratitis. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hip joint, disease. Hysterical, joints. Influenza. Joints disorders. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Menopausal, hemorrhage. Osteomyelitis. Osteoporosis. Ovarian, cysts. Ovaries, disorders. Rheumatism. Uterus, cancer, prolapsed. Tuberculosis. Voice, loss.

HOMEOPATHIC - Luna of the Alchemists. Argentum metallicum corresponds to deep-seated insidious disease. In the mental sphere it affects the intellect more than the disorders. Headache of businessmen. Left-sided headache as if in brain substance. Headache and dyspepsia induced by mental agitation, nursing the sick, mental exertion. The more deeply seated the troubles are the more likely are they to be painless. Argentum metallicum affects all the cartilages and hence all joints and bones with tearing and bruised pains, tenderness and weakness, painful, so-called “hysterical” joint, joint rheumatism without swelling, pain in rib cartilages and especially the left. Exostosis on skull. Affects nerves causing convulsive and spasmodic effects. Epileptic attacks followed by delirious rage jumping about, striking those near. Argentum metallicum acts upon joints and their components, bones, condyles, cartilages and ligaments. Arg- m. thickens the tissue especially cartilages. Emaciation, a gradual drying up, desire for fresh air, dyspnea, sensation of expansion and left-sided pains are characteristic. The larynx is also a special center for this drug. Emaciation. Symptoms appearslowly, but progressing, deeply penetrating. Decay. Malfunctioning of the pituitary gland, the optic thalamus, the ovaries and testicles. Infectious encephalomyelitis, caused by influenza. Parkinson's disease. Sensation of electric shocks and nervous trembling over the whole body. Sleeping sickness. Twitching, contraction and trembling of limbs, needs to get up and walk about. Secretions of mucus membranes are thick, gray or tenacious or like boiled starch. Lies down on account of tiredness and weakness. Pains gradually increase, become violent then suddenly cease, worse by touch. Painless twitching or electric-like shocks. Pains are accompanied by polyuria. Cramps in muscles, limbs feel powerless. Bones are painful, tender. Sore rawness. MIND - Forgetful. Loss of control over mind andbody. Loss of mentalpower. Total diminution of memory and difficulty in concentrating. Mental exertion aggravates. Mental agitation causes headache and indigestion. Neurosis from worry. Worried, feverish, more or less hasty. Hypochondria. Anxiety about health. Fear of apoplexy during palpitations. Nightly fears in children. Restless anxiety which drives him from place to place. Hurried feeling. Cries for a long time about trifles, weary, sad, pitiful state. Cries from nervous irritation with talkativeness, agitation and mental strain. Talkative or disinclined to talk in society, changes subjects. Hasty, deceitful. Bars out all sympathy for friends. Loquacity in daytime. Takes on all sorts of whims often does strange and unaccountable things. Constant feeling of being drunk. Increased cheerfulness and disposition to talk the whole time. Melancholy. Depressive psychosis. Maniacal and depressive state. Pre-senile and senile dementia. Delirium after epilepsy. Cerebral inhibition, following psychological stress. Delirious rage with jumping about and striking those near, after epileptic attack. Starting as if electric shocks through body during sleep, wakening her. Time passes slowly.

Head - Dull paroxysmal neuralgia over left side, gradually increasing and ceasing suddenly. Headfeels empty, hollow. Pain between left eye and frontal eminence. Exostosis on skull. Crawling and emptiness in head. Scalp very tender to touch. Drilling, boring headache.

Eyes - Itching in eyelids and canthi. Abundant purulent discharge. Lachrymal stricture. Eyelids and tarsi become thick. Eyelids red and thick. Obscurity of vision. Violent itching of the corners of the eyes. Blepharitis with eyes closed. Catarrhal, purulent conjunctivitis. Follicular conjunctivitis. Ulcerated keratitis. Iritis.

Ears - Itching of ear lobes, has to scratch until it bleeds. Shooting pain in the left ear, spreading to the brain. Blocked feeling in the right ear. Sub-acute ear infection. Diminution in auditive acuity. Buzzing in the ears.

Nose - Copious flow of nasal mucus. Exhausting coryza with sneezing. Violent fluent coryza with frequent sneezing, causing exhaustion. Nosebleed with tickling, worse blowing nose. Nostrils blocked with or without sneezing. Boils on the nose. Adenoids. Chronic rhinitis. Nasal polyps. Lupus of the nose.

Face - Pale, sallow with weakness. Red. Sudden heat with palpitations. Pain in facial bones.

Mouth - Dry feeling in the mouth, although the tongue is moist. Stomatitis and gingivitis. Bringing up of thick, sticky, grayish, gelatinous mucus in the morning.

Throat - Hoarseness and aphonia, worse using voice. Larynx feels sore and raw. Total loss of voice in professional singers. Worse from use of voice. Hawking, viscid, gray, jelly-like mucus and throat sore, on coughing. Chronic pharyngitis. Profuse and easy morning expectoration. Tension in throat worse yawning. Fauces numb. Abscess on the tonsils. Vertigo - Attacks of vertigo on looking at running water. Whirling, as if drunk. Vertigo on entering a room after a walk. Worse entering warm room. Vertigo with intoxicated feeling. COMMENTS - The muscular system is affected with cramps in limbs, calves feel too short going downstairs, stiffness, numbness, electric-like shocks in joints and limbs, painless twitchings. The heart is especially \ affected, frequent, spasmodic, though painless twitchings in whole heart muscle, worse lying on back, fears having a stroke. Sensation as if heart stood still, followed by trembling, then irregular violent throbbing. Palpitation, at night during pregnancy. In social interaction, disinclined to talk, discouraged (Reaction from this is a great inclination to talk, mind very clear.) Frontal headache of businessmen. Headache increasing gradually and ceasing suddenly, at acme as if a nerve being torn, usually left side. Sticky saliva and mucus expectoration, which is easy. Secretion like boiled starch from the mucus membranes, or there may be a thin and at the same time thick yellow or greenish discharge. Great hunger even after a full meal. Extreme dryness of mouth, tongue sticks to palate. This symptom with the polyuria Argentum metallicum points to diabetes in which Arg. is particularly indicated if there is swelling of the ankles. Spasmodic bedwetting at night. Effects of onanism: impotence, atrophy of penis, bruised pains in testicles. Pains in left ovary, feels enormously swollen, prolapse of uterus (scirrhus). Metrorrhagia, large lumps with violent pains, worse by every motion. Arg-m. acts more on the left side than the right, left ovary is affected. “Prolapse uterus with pains in left ovary.” Juvenile disorders of growth in bones. Fracture of the tip of the second metatarsal bone. Fracture of the scaphoid and tarsal bone. Fracture of the anteriortibia. Deforming arthritis of the hip. Vertebral arthritis. Prominent tenderness. Tearing pressure and pains in the bones. Joint rheumatism without swelling. Parts feel bruised when pressed on. Hoarseness of singers and speakers, worse speaking or singing. Laughing causes cough. Restless sleep, electric shock through body wakens her. Very specific for the ligaments and cartilage infections, fibrositis, condylitis (Arg-n.). Severe laryngitis is a keynote, clergyman's sore throat. RELATIONS - Teste classes Arg-m. with Mere, and with Ars. Antidotes: Merc., Puls., Zinc,, Pall, (ovaries, Pall., right, Arg., left). Stann. - cough excited by laughing. Antidoted by: Merc., Puls. - an occasional dose of Puls, favors action of Arg-n. in ophthalmia. Compare: ( 1 ) Arg-n. - Anxious unrest with great hastiness. Ir- ritation of the mucus membranes with nervous and muscular weakness. Phobias. (2) Alum., Calc, Plat., Puls, Sei., Sep., Stann., Zinc. (3) Med. - Amnesia for recent facts. Hasty and fidgety, burning of the heels. Itching secretions from the skin and mucus membranes, smell of brine. Joint pains improved at the seaside. Ameliorated by resting in ‘knee-chest'position. (4) Psor. - Demineralized weak, chilly. Anxious with periodic migraines and offensive eruptions. (5) Ampélopsis - Chronic hoarseness in scrofulous patients. Follows well: Alum., Plat. Followed well by: Calc., Puls., Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian. Murphy.

Stomach - Feeling of hunger and empty stomach in the morning. Burning in stomach, ascending to the chest. Anxiety and pressure in the pit of stomach. Appetite increased or repugnance to all food. Hiccough on smoking. Nausea in dreams.

Abdomen - Loud croaking with hunger in abdomen. Painful soreness of abdomen, worse riding in a carriage. Abdominal distention. Noisy rumblings in the bowels like frogs croaking with drawing, cutting pains. Feeling as though a live worm were coming out of the anus.

Rectum - Vomiting during stool. Stools soft, passed several times during the day.

Male - Crushed pain in (right) testicles. Clothing increases pain when walking. Seminal emissions without sexual ex citement and erection. Frequent urination with burning. Yellowish green discharge. Frequent emission of sperm at night. Testicular pain, on the left side, as if bruised. Impotence and nightly seminal discharge. Sterility. Loss of libido. Inflammation of the glands and prepuce. Orchitis. Tumors of the testicle. Acute and chronic inflammation of the prostate gland.

Female - Ovaries feel too large. Pain in left ovary. Ovarian cysts, tumors. Bearingdown pain. Prolapse uterus with pain in left ovary and small of the back, extending in front and downwards. Eroded spongy cervix. Palliative in scirrhus of uterus. Menopausal hemorrhage. Sore feeling throughout abdomen. Scirrhus of uterus. Leucorrhea, foul, excoriating, bloody water. Palpitations during pregnancy. Food - Want of thirst, even during hot stage of fever. Desire for wine. Aversion to even the thought of food. Appetite very much increased, hungry after eating a full meal. Great hunger. Hungry in morning, giving her nausea. Appetite good, at times loss of appetite with aversion to smoking.

Chest - Raw, sore feeling when coughing. Great weakness in the chest (left), stitches in chest impeding breathing, while reading aloud or talking. Feeling of raw spot near supra sterna fossa. Boil near the last rib, Pain in left lower ribs. Neuralgic pains along the entire border of left lower rib. Aching and shooting pains in the right side of the chest and sternum. Prickling pains in different areas of the chest. Constitutions - Suited to thin patients with hollow eyes, pale skin, tendency to tubercle, decay, cancer, deep ulcers, imbecility. It is adapted to tall thin irritable people.

Heart - Stops, then trembles, then throbs, better inspiration. Palpitations with cardiac unrest, better by lying on left side. Palpitations during pregnancy, better deep inhalations. Pulse intermittent and very irregular during palpitation.

Back - Severe backache, must walk bent with oppression of chest. Icy cold feeling near sacrum. Causations - Onanism. Sunstroke.

Limbs - Rheumatic disorders of joints, especially elbow and knee. Involuntary contractions of fingers, partial paralysis of forearm, writer's cramp. Swelling of ankles. Arms feel powerless. Legs weak and trembling worse descending stairs. Calves feel as if too short on going down stairs. Swelling of ankles (Diabetes). Writer's cramps. Limbs feel numb or stiff. Burning in corns. Lungs - Easy expectoration of gray, gelatinous or starchy mucus. Cough from laughing. Hectic fever at noon. On reading aloud, must hem and hawk. Alteration in timbre of voice. Fits of coughing with violent expectoration of mucus resembling cooked starch.

Sleep - Electric shocks on dropping to sleep. Nausea in dreams. Sleep disturbed by terrifying dreams, which leave him worried on waking. Sleeping sickness.

Skin - Nervous itching, crawling, tickling on various parts. Itching, burning sensation spread unevenly over the surface of the skin without the need to scratch. Tingling sensation, as if an insect were crawling over the skin. Rosy pityriasis. Prurigo. Itching. Senile pruritus.

Modalities - Better in open air, cough. Better at night when lying down (opposite Hyos.). Better from motion. Better coffee. Better wrapping up. Worse from touch, pressure. Worse toward noon. Worse 3 p.m. to 6 p.m. Worse from using voice, speaking, singing. Worse from mental strain. Worse cold damp. Worse riding in carriage. Worse from lying on back. Worse sitting, stooping. Worse from entering warm room. Worse in the sun.

Kidneys - Frequent urination, polyuria. Diuresis. Urine profuse, turbid, sweet odor. Diabetes, if there is swelling of the ankles. Urine like whey of sweet odor. Chronic urethritis. Frequent need to urinate and profuse emission of urine. Yellowish- green urinary secretions. Chronic cystitis. Hydronephrosis. Pyelonephrosis. Pyelitis. Proteinuria and glycosuria.

Perspiration - Sweats only on abdomen and chest. Sweats during and after meals. Sweats after midnight.

Temperature - Hectic fever at noon. Feeling of cold and shivers by day and night. Very high temperature between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m.

Boring in outside of right ankle and side of right foot. Tearing in left thumb and hand. Pressing pain in forehead, worse stooping, better coughing. Head - After 4 p.m., frontal headache again, especially on stooping. Awoke with pressing in the forehead, which lasted till 4 p.m.; increased on stooping, relieved by coughing; once, in the open air., even nausea appeared with a more violent attack of the headache, which, in general, was not always equally severe in a given time, but sometimes decreased remarkably, then again without cause, became suddenly very violent. Heaviness and pressure in the frontal bone, with heat in the forehead; increased on stooping; more violent at times, and lasting till he went to sleep. 9:30 a.m. tearing in the frontal bone; again at 4 p.m. Drawing in the skin of the left temple, as if it were contracted. Tearing in the left temple. Tearing in the vertex and in the occiput. Tearing on both sides of the occiput.

Eyes - Pain on the right lower orbital border. Tearing below the right eye. Violent stitching in the right lids. Violent stitches in the skin of the right lid.

Face - Tearing in the upper jaw. Tearing in the right upper jaw.

Mouth - Taste slightly metallic, inclining to bitter.

Throat - Convulsive contraction in the pharynx. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Limbs - On walking, drawing in the skin on the external side of the left thigh; drawing in the skin above the inner condyle of the left elbow-joint. Tearing in the left shoulder. Drawing in the skin above the inner condyle of the right elbow. On the evening, boring on the sides of the right foot. Boring outside of the right ankle. Pressing deep in the right leg, on sitting, lasting several minutes, and often returning.

Kidneys - Very frequent and violent urging to urinate; much urine. Violent urging to urinate, with dark yellow, and very acrid urine. Remarkably violent urging to urine, which had to obeyed speedily; much clear urine passed; again in an hour, and several times afterwards, until 4 p.m. In the night, very frequent urination; urine as usual in quality and quantity. Frequent and copious urination, but with less urging.

PHARMACY - arg-n. Argentum nitricum. Silver nitrate. Lunar caustic. Trituration and solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Addison's disease. Anemia. Anticipation. Anxiety, attacks. Chancre. Chemosis. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Belchings. Erysipelas. Eyes disorders. Flatulence. Fears. Fright. Gastric ulcer. Gonorrhea. Hands, swelling. Headache. Heartburn. Herpes zoster. Impetigo. Incoordination. Locomotor ataxia. Melancholy. Neuralgia. Ophthalmia, neonatorum. Panic, attacks. Paralysis. Prostate, enlargement. Scarlatina. Smallpox. Spinal irritation. Syphilis. Taste, altered. Throat disorders. Tongue ulcerated. 'Trembling. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - It was the use of Argentum nitricum in ancient times in the treatment of epilepsy which led to the production of the lamentable cases of lead-colored pigmentation of the skin called Argyria. Arg-n. has irresistible desir e for sugar, which at the same time aggravates. Kent related a case illustrating this. A nursing infant had a grass-green diarrhea which failed to yield to Merc., Ars., and Cham. At last Kent discovered that the mother ate a pound of candy a day. Arg-n. was given and the candy stopped and the child soon got well. Grimmer used it for Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are important indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears and restlessness with trembling hands, skin cancers. In Arg-n. the neurotic effects are very marked, many brain and spinal symptoms presenting themselves which give certain indications forits homeopathic employment. Symptoms of incoordination, loss ofcontrol and want of balance everywhere, mentally and physically, trembling in affected parts. Emaciation is progressive. Paraplegia. Ascending paralysis. Parts seem enlarged or bound up. Pains increase and decrease gradually. The cases of epilepsy calling for this drug are those caused by fright or occurring at the menstrual period. For days or hours before the attack the pupils are dilated and after the attack the patient is very restless and has trembling of the hands. Impulse to walk very fast (Lil-t.). Suitable to businessmen, students. Very characteristic is the great desire for sweets, the splinter-like pains and free muco-purulent discharge in inflamed and ulcerated mucus membranes. Sensation as if a part were expanding and other errors of perception are characteristic. Pains increase and decrease gradually. Muco-purulent discharges and splinter like pains. Faint and tremulous. Flatulent state and prematurely aged look. Explosive belching, especially in neurotics. Upper abdominal disorders brought on by undue mental exertion. Paraplegia, myelitis .and disseminated sclerosis of brain and cord. Intolerance of heat. Sensation of a sudden pinch (Dudgeon). Destroys red blood corpuscles, producing anemia. MIND - Nervous impulsive and hurried, yet timid and anxious. Panic and anxiety attacks. Dreads ordeals. Anticipation, apprehension and fear, when ready to go to doctor, dentist, church, etc. Diarrhea from anticipating upcoming events. Performance, anxiety. Examinations, fear of taking tests. Thinks that all his undertakings will and must fail. Fears, phobias and anxieties. Fears projecting corners of buildings and high buildings. Fear of heights. Fearsome. Fear °f flying in airplanes. Fear of impending evil. Fear of crowds. Fear of dark. Claustrophobia. Fear of fainting. Fear of being too late. Fear of failing. Fear of having a panic attack. Fear of losing self- control. Peculiar mental impulses. Impulse to jump when crossing a bridge or from a window. Impulsive, wants to do things in a hurry (Lil-t.). Walks rapidly from anxiety. Fear of passing a certain point of high buildings. Imagines he cannot pass a certain point (Kali-br.). The sight of high buildings makes him giddy and causes him to stagger, it seems as if houses on both sides of street would approach and crush him. Tormented by strange ideas and emotions. Irrational, does strange things and comes to strange conclusions, does foolish things. Hidden irrational motives for actions. Delusion he is despised. Thinks about killing himself. Obstinate, against whatever was proposed, he had the queerest objection. Errors ofperception. Time passes slowly (Cann-i.). Time seems short, wants to do things in a hurry, must walk fast, etc. Brain fag. Memory weak. Perversion of senses. Indifference while in company. Loss of ambition. Melancholic, apprehensive of serious disease. Fear of some incurable disease. Forsaken feeling. Sensation of isolation. Desire to talk. Hesitates, falters in speech in gait, etc. Childish talk. Talks about his sufferings. Talks of one subject. Believes that all his undertakings will fail. Weeps, says he is lost beyond hope.

Head - Nervous headache with coldness and trembling. Headaches, worse mental exertion, dancing, better tight bandaging. Head as if in a vise. Sensation of expansion. Brain fatigue with general debility and trembling. Aching in frontal eminence with enlarged feeling in corresponding eye. Boring pain, better on tight bandaging and pressure. Itching of scalp. Hemicrania, bones of head feel as if separated. As if skull bones were separated. Headache ends in vomiting. Headaches of hysterical young women, delicate literary persons. Itching, crawling sensation on the scalp.

Eyes - Acute conjunctivitis. Great swelling of conjunctiva, discharge abundant and purulent. Eyestrain from sewing, worse in warm room. Aching, tired feeling in eyes, better closing or pressing upon them. Useful in restoring power to the weakened ciliary muscles. Inner canthi swollen and red. Photophobia in warm room. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Painful purulent ophthalmia. Chronic ulceration of margin of lids, sore, thick, swollen. Unable to keep eyes fixed steadily. Opacity of cornea. Ulcer in cornea. Pterygium of pink color. Blepharitis, thick crusts on eyelids. Pupils dilated. Chemosis. Eye symptoms worse with abdominal symptoms.

Ears - Tearing pain in ears. Sharp pain from right to left ear, with congestion to head. Buzzing in ears with vertigo. Ringing with deafness. Whizzing in left ear, with feeling of obstruction and hard hearing. Fullness and ringing.

Nose - Nasal bones painful as if bruised. Nasal discharge like boiled starch. Discharge of whitish pus, with clots of blood. Nosebleed during menopause. Loss of smell. Violent itching. Coryza with chilliness, lachrymation andheadache. Violent itching, rubs it. Ulcers in septum.

Face - Sunken, old, pale and bluish. Face yellow, dirty looking. Old man's look, tight drawing of skin over bones. Sickly, sunken, grayish of muddy color. Infraorbital neuralgia, left side. Prosopalgia, almost taking away eyesight. Drops of sweat on face.

Mouth - Fetor from mouth. Taste coppery like ink. Canker sores. Stringent, sour or bitter-sour taste. Food escapes from mouth during chewing. Cannot talk, spasms of muscles of tongue and throat. Stammers. Tough mucus in mouth. Ptyalism. Lips dry and viscid, without thirst. Lips tremble while speaking. Lips blue.

Throat - Burning and dryness in fauces and pharynx. Much thick mucus in throat and mouth causes hawking. Raw, rough and sore. Uvula and fauces dark red. Sensation as if a splinter in throat, when swallowing, breathing or moving the neck better cool drinks. Dark redness of throat catarrh of smokers with tickling as of hair in throat. Strangulated feeling. Swallowing difficult. Chronic induration of tonsils. Food lodges in pharynx. Smoker's catarrh with sensation as of a hair in throat. Loss of voice. Chronic laryngitis of singers. Raising the voice causes cough, high notes cause cough. Chronic hoarseness.

Stomach - Alcoholic gastritis. Belching with most gastric ailments. Ineffectual effort at eructation. Gastroenteritis. Flatulence, painful swelling of stomach. Enormous distension. Painful spot over stomach that radiates to all parts of the abdomen. Gnawing ulcerating pain. burning and constriction. Trembling and throbbing in stomach. Enormous distention. Ulcerative pain in left side under ribs. Ulceration with radiating pain. Deathly nausea during headache, not better after vomiting. Nausea, retching, vomiting of glairy mucus. Astringent sour or bitter vomiting. Vomiting with diarrhea and violent colicky pains.

Abdomen - Rumbling, gurgling. Flatulence causing distention and bursting of abdomen. Loud, explosive belchings discharged upwards and downwards. Shivering through bowels, extending up the back. Colic with much gas and distention. Constriction in bowels, as if tightly tied with a band. Sharp ulcerative pain on left side, below short ribs. Cutting pain with loud rumbling. Spasms of diaphragm.

Rectum - Diarrhea from emotions, worse immediately after eating and drinking. Diarrhea from anticipation. Diarrhea after any emotion with flatulence. Nervous diarrhea after sugar candy. Diarrhea of children after weaning. Fluids go right through him after sweets. Constipation, alternates with diarrhea. Hemorrhoidal pain in morning. Itching of anus. Tenia or threadworms.

Stool - Stools, shreddy, mucus, turning green like chopped spinach. Watery, noisy, flatulent stools. Stools, green like chopped spinach with shreddy mucus and enormous distention of abdomen, very offensive.

Male - Chancre like ulcers, on the prepuce. Testes drawn up high. Genitals shrivel. Desire waning. Cutting in urethra with painful erection. Sex painful, urethra as if put on stretch or sensitive at orifice. Impotency. Erection fails when sex is attempted. Cancer-like ulcers. Ulcers on prepuce.

Female - Pain in stomach and spasmodic contraction in chest before menses. Menses scanty with dyspnea. Menses, irregular too soon too late or last one day only. Menses with headache. Metrorrhagia with nervous weakness at menopause, also of young widows and childless women. Leucorrhea profuse with erosion of cervix, bleeding easily. Leucorrhea mucus, bloody, corroding, yellow and profuse. Prolapsed uterus. Uterine hemorrhage, two weeks after menses, painful disorders of left ovary. Ovaries painful with pains radiating to sacrum and thighs. Itching of skin and flushes of heat during menopause. Disposition to miscarriage. Infertility. Puerperal convulsions. Orgasms at night. Sex painful, followed by bleeding. Food - Desire for cheese and salt. Loss of appetite. Appetite good, but every kind of food disagrees. Hypoglycemia. Eating relives nausea but aggravates stomach pain. Better after warm drinks. Better sourthings, smoking. Better after alcohol. Great craving for sweets. Craves sugar, which disagrees. Desires for cheese and salt. Desires ice cream, fat and sweets. Craves plum sauce. Worse from coffee. Worse cold drinks

Chest - Angina pectoris with nightly aggravation. Intense spasm of chest muscles. Feels as if a bar were around chest. Painful spots in chest. Pain in the chest on putting boots. As if weight of stone in middle of the sternum. Constitutions - Withered up and dried constitutions, especially when associated with unusual or long continued mental exertion. It corresponds to Grauvogl's carbo-nitrogenoid constitution (Sulph., Cupr.) in higher to the hydrogenoid or sycotic constitution. Hysteric nervous persons, headaches from mental causes characterized by dullness of head. Women with menstrual disturbances. Cachetic state. Scrawny, feeble, dried-up-looking women. Guernsey put it, “withered and dried up by disease. A child looks like a withered old man.”

Heart - Angina pectoris. Organic heart troubles of business men, students and brain workers. Burning feeling in region of heart. Anxiety with palpitations and throbbing throughout the whole body. Palpitations with nausea. Palpitations, worse lying on right side (Alumn.). Palpitations, worse riding in car, better pressing by hand. Unpleasant sensation of fullness about the heart better fresh open air. Sensation as if heart would stop beating, when sitting quietly. Pulse is irregular intermittent.

Back - Much pain. Spine sensitive with nocturnal pains (Ox-ac.). Paraplegia. Posterior spinal sclerosis. Pain in the small of the back worse rising from sitting better standing or walking. Throbbing in spine or weak spine. Glands of the neck indurated. Weakness in sacro-iliac symphysis as if bones were loose. Heaviness in sacrum, as before menses. Glands of neck indurated. Breasts - Sore nipples from nursing. Causations - Anticipation. Apprehension, fear or fright. Eating ices. Mental strain and worry. Masturbation and sexual excesses. Intemperate habits. Sugar. Tobacco.

Limbs - Lassitude and weariness of forearm and legs with trembling. Cannot walk with eyes closed. Trembling with general debility. Trembling of hands, cannot write. Numbness of arms. Numbness of fingertips, ring and little fingers. Fingers half Argentum nitricum clenched, cannot be separated. Paralysis with mental and abdominal symptoms. Weakness, rigidity or twisting in calves. Walks and stands unsteadily, especially when unobserved. Post- diphtheria paralysis (Gels.). Chorea-like convulsions, with the legs drawn up, arms jerked outwards and upwards. Peripheral neuralgias. Edema of legs. Legs feel as if made of wood or padded. Paraplegia after debilitating causes. As if a weight hanging to coccyx. Lungs - Asthma, worse summer, cold weather or taking cold. Asthmatic attacks from going up stairs or bodily exertion. Suffocative cough, as if from a hair in throat. Dyspnea. Craves fresh air. Many people in a room seem to take away his breath. Panting, quick, sibilant breathing. Rawness, soreness, high up in trachea worse coughing. Crowded rooms takes away his breath. Desire to take deep breath which aggravates the dyspnea. Craves fresh air. Asthma, worse in summer in cold weather or taking cold.

Sleep - Drowsy stupor. Sleepless from fancies before his imagination. Ailments from long, wearisome, fatiguing night watching. Restless sleep, awakes almost every hour, disturbed with many dreams. Horrible dreams of snakes, wakes in fright. Dreams he is hungry. Dreams of sexual gratification.

Skin - Brown, tense and hard. Drawing in skin, as from a spider-web or dried albuminous substance withered and dried up. Irregular blotches. Ulcers, angry, deep with hard edges. Warty granulations. Adherent crusts. Bedsores. Bluish-black eruption. Scarlet fever.

Modalities - Better from open air, fresh air. Better cool air, cold, cold bath. Better from hard pressure. Better motion. Better belching. Better from bending double, pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse anxiety, apprehension. Worse fear or fright. Worse from suspense. Worse from mental strain and worry. Worse warmth in any form. Worse at night. Worse from cold food, cold drinks. Worse ice cream. Worse sugar, sweets. Worse after eating. Worse leftside. Worse in aroom in closed, small places. Worse lying on right side. Worse looking down. Worse from drinking, crowds. Worse from warmth in any form. Worse before and during menses. Worse from riding. Worse thinking intently.

Teeth - Gums tender and bleed easily. Pain in healthy teeth. Teeth pain worse chewing, cold things, sour things.

Tongue - Red streak down middle of tongue. Tongue has prominent papilla. Tongue tip is red and painful. Tongue furred with clean edges. Aphthae on edges of the tongue. Tongue coated white. ,Vertigo - Vertigo with buzzing in ears and with nervous disorders. Vertigo before epilepsy. Vertigo looking down from heights. Vertigo with transient blindness. Vertigo worse closing eyes. Vertigo with cerebral congestion. Vertigo - Vertigo at sight of high buildings. Vision - Spots before the vision. Blurred vision. Distorted vision. Misty vision. Diplopia, from rush of blood to head. Sight worse by candlelight, than by daylight. Black motes, before right eye. Dim vision on thinking intently, with headache. Grey spots and serpent-like bodies moving before eyes. Vanishing vision must constantly wipe away mucus. Farsighted. Paralysis of accommodation from errors of refraction. COMMENTS - Among the key symptoms of Arg-n. are great tremor, nervous feeling, and sensation as if being squeezed in a vice. Feeling of constriction in various parts as if a band of iron around chest or waist. A feeling as if the body or some part of the body was expanding. Migraine with feeling as if head were enormously enlarged, better tightly bound. Defective coordination. Paralysis of motion and sensation, a peculiar numbness accompanied with hyperesthesia. Sensation of a splinter sticking in various parts. Burning sensations. In allopathic practice the dyspepsia for which it is given is worse before food, when the stomach is empty. The opposite condition is the leading indication in homeopathic practice. Gowers recorded a case in which the use of Arg-n. for stomach trouble caused (like lead), drop-wrist, gout and albuminuria. E. P. Brewer recorded a proving in which the prover, a young man, took on three consecutive days one grain a day of Arg-n. triturated with sugar of milk. A number of motor and sensory symptoms were elicited, reminding Brewer of locomotor ataxia for which it has been used with success by old- school practitioners. This use also has led to many cases of ar- gyria. Among the symptoms of this proving were “Mental operations sluggish, continued thought required special effort, but exertion of mind did not aggravate the heaviness and fullness of head. Lower limbs fatigued, as if they would suddenly fail him. Loss of ambition. Building air castles by day: monstrous dreams by night.” Other symptoms were sore throat with white patches, rheumatic pains in (left) wrist and finger joints with external tenderness of bony prominences, pain on rising in right sacroiliac notch. Sore muscles of neck and back. Urticaria spots in various parts. In poisoning cases complete loss of consciousness insensibility and convulsions have occurred. Some of the notable digestive symptoms are: “Irresistible desire for sugar. Fluids go right through him.” Belching ac- companies most gastric disorders. Green stools are remarkable. Green mucus like chopped spinach in flakes. Stool turning green after remaining on diaper. Stool expelled with much spluttering. Stool shreddy, red, green muco-lymph orepithelial substance. There is a pain in the small of the back, better on standing or walking, but severe when rising from a seat (Sulph., Caust.). Mucus membranes affected, purulent and bloody discharges, membranous diarrhea with agonizing pains. Epithelium affected (cancers). Intestinal catarrh with shreddy membranous discharges is often cured by Arg-n. Most symptoms are worse night, very nervous at night. Worse at night or in morning on rising (epileptic attacks). Day half more cough, night half more diarrhea. Worse on awaking. At 11 a.m. nervous attacks better by stimulants. Chill down back every day at noon. A large number of symptoms appear on the left side. Grimmer notes that it's used along with Natrum Mur to antidote the effects of silver nitrate cauterization. For example, of the nose, and sometimes they do the uterus, the cervix, to stop bleeding, any place. Parkinson's paralysis, or disorders after stroke, loss of motor control, especially on left. Good for multiple sclerosis. Addison's disease, lead-colored pigmentation of the skin. Mental symptoms are important indications for the use of the remedy, nervous fears anirestlessness with trembling hands, skin cancers. Severe blood sugar problems, acute or chronic sugar poisoning, hypoglycemia, diabetes. Consider Arg-n., a left-sided Lycopodium. Voracious, canine desire for sweets. Bingeing on sweets. Can become angry or irritable after sugar. Also craves salt. Another keynote is gas and bloating, then low blood sugar. They can have a splinter-like sensation in the throat. It's specific for laryngitis. Hoarseness, sore throat. Epilepsy from frights. Diarrhea from anxiety. Headache from over studying, eye strain. Conjunctivitis, looks like raw meat, pus green and yellow in color. Majorphobiaremedy. Panic attacks when low blood sugar. They have a lot of fears of fainting, fears of having a fit in public, fears of epilepsy, the general idea is fears of losing control. Fear of something bad happening, “impending doom.” Superstitions, rituals, conspiracy paranoia. “Fear of being poisoned,” anxiety over health. Fear of death, may predict their own death (Agn.). In late stages, fear of their own thoughts. Tormenting thoughts and impulses, repeating thoughts. Over-active mental plane, anticipation leading to worry. For anticipation, stage fright to the point here they get diarrhea (Gels., Aeon.). Gastrointestinal symptoms with anxiety. Vertigo due to anxiety. Concentration problems, brain degeneration, early senility with strong imaginations. Symptoms worse at night. Hasty walk, keynote, they walk so fast that the upper body is leaned forward. Neurological deficiencies and incoordination of walking, staggering gaits. Keynote craving of sugar, which aggravates. The aggravation of the sugar is as strong as their craving. Sugar causes headaches, anxiety, irritability, and low blood sugar. Severe gas and bloating. Craves salt and strong cheese (Puls, Ign, Rhus-t.). Worse heat, skin may be cool, but they think they are hot (Sec.). Desires company, open, forward with a lot of vitality. Strong emotional nature. Impulsive, instinctive expression of emotions. Happy, easy-going high sexual power. High sex drive, loss of erection or premature ejaculation due to overexcitement and anticipation. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Am-caust., effects of tobacco. Nat-m., Ars.. Milk. Antidotes to: Puls., Calc., Sep., next in importance, Lyc., Sil., Rhus-t., Phos., Sulph. Compare: (1) Ars., Merc., Phos., Puls. (2) Arg-cy. - angina pectoris, asthma, spasm of esophagus. (3) Argent, iodat. - throat disorders, hoarseness, gland affected. (4) Argent, phos. - an excellent diuretic in dropsy. (5) Arg-oxyd. - chlorosis with menorrhagia and diarrhea. (6) Arg-m. - acts on cartilages, Arg-n. more on mucus membranes, skin, bone and periosteum and is suited to herpetic patients. (7) to Aur., Cupr., Kali-bi„ Lach., Merc., Merc-c., Merc-i., Nairn., Nit-ac..Thuj. (8) In complaints from pressure of clothes like Calc.. Bry., Caust., Lyc., Sars., Stann. (9) In congestive headaches like Glon. and other Nit-ac„ Hep., worse by cold, Arg-n. worse in warm room. (10) Puls, is its nearest analog. Inimical: Coff. ( it increases the nervous headache). Follows well: Bry., Spig. (dyspepsia). Spongia (goiter), Caust. (urethral affections), Verat-a. (flatus). Is followed well by: Lyc. (flatus). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Violent pain from kidney to bladder, worse touch, motion and deep inspiration. Touching region of kidneys increases pain. Urethra inflamed with pain, burning, itching, pain as from a splinter. Emission of a few drops after having finished. Urethritis with pain, increased gonorrhea, priapism, dysuria, bloody urine andfever. Early stage of gonorrhea, profuse discharge and terrible cutting pains, bloody urine. Urging to urinate, urine passes less easily and freely. Retention of urine. Sugar in urine. Divided stream. Urine passes unconsciously, day and night. Yellow bloody urine. Urine is highly colored, dark red with albumin. Urine scanty and dark.

Cough - Cough is worse laughing, stooping, smoking, ascending stairs before menses. High notes causes cough. Suffocative cough, at noon. Cough when angered.

Perspiration - Sweats in morning or at night. Profuse sweat on the face in beads. Sweat and chilliness as soon as he gets warm in bed.

Temperature - Chills with nausea. Chilly- when uncovered, yet feels smothered if wrapped up. Chilly with many complaints. Chills with cold hands and feet. Constant chilliness up back and over shoulders. Intermittent fever, with hemorrhage from lungs. Fever with no thirst.

full:
PHARMACY - arist-cl. Aristolochiaclematitis. Common biithwort. Aristolochia infesta. N. O. Aristolochiaceae. Europe, South America, Asia. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Anorexia. Arthritis. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chills. Colic. Cystic mastitis. Cystitis. Depression. Dysmenorrhea. Eczema. Enteritis. Hormonal, imbalances. Insomnia. Laryngitis. Mastitis. Menopause. Metritis. Nephritis. Premenstrual syndrome. Rheumatism. Spasmodic colitis. Sinusitis. Vaginitis. Varicose veins. Vertigo.

HERBAL - Aristolochia Clematitis, of the Aristolochiaceae family, grows in Southern Europe and South America. Its active principle is clematine, which is identical to the Aristolochia or the Serpentarin as well as to non-purified Aristolochic acid. Aristolochic acid causes menorrhagia, tends towards miscarriage, and has a toxic action on the kidneys and liver parenchyma as well as intestinal mucus membranes. “Aristos” means better, “locheia” means giving birth. Used in popular medicine to induce birth or stimulant the menses. Also as a diuretic, and against rheumatism. In high doses it is an emetic and cathartic. In South America, some Aristolochia are used for blindness.

HOMEOPATHIC - The proving by Mezger made use of the spring rhizome. The experiment was carried out by eighteen provers, of whom thirteen were women. The potencies 5x, 2x, 12x and the mother tincture were used in the proving. The experiment lasted for twelve weeks. It produced excess of estrogen hormones. Marked affect on the urinary passages, kidneys, venous system, skin. Irregular menses. Premenstrual insomnia with agitation and congestion of the pelvis. Joint pains improved by movement. State of fatigue, or the opposite. Worn out with vertigo, chilliness, slightly improved by heat. Hunger pangs and need to eat despite feeling nausea. Tendency to plumpness. MIND - Sensation of solitude. Fearforthe future. Rejects company. Psychosomatic complaints tending towards depression, especially in women who are going through the menopause (Sep.). Depression, ameliorated by fresh air and menses. Mental condition aggravated before and after periods, clearly ameliorated during menstrual flow.

Head - Diffuse headaches, improved in the fresh air and by cold, damp compresses. Congestive headache (Bell.).

Eyes - Watering aggravated by light, reading. Burning and itching.

Nose - Sinusitis. Coryza in the morning, improved by getting up, by fresh air. Watery flow, improved between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m.

Mouth - Mouth painful, with cracked corners of the lips. Teeth painful, aggravated by cold food, ameliorated by hot food.

Throat - Throat discolored, yellow, dry. Tonsils inflamed, swallowing painful. Laryngitis. Vertigo - Vertigo with headache in the morning, worse when learning forwards. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Puls. - close therapeutic relationship, acting on the same type of patient. (2) Calen. - which is also an excellent healing plant. (3) Rhus-t. - also shows amelioration from movement. REFERENCES - Julian.

Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia.

Abdomen - Colic. Spasmodic colitis. Enteritis. Abdomen distended, painful, before and during menses. Breasts - Pain and feeling of hardening of the left breast. Pain in the breast. Cystic mastitis.

Rectum - Rectum prolapsed after eating. Rectal weakness. Mucus diarrhea, hemorrhoid bleeding between stools, which contain mucus.

Female - Brown discharge, watery flow. Eczema of the vulva. Sensual itching, aggravated before menses, ameliorated during menses, aggravated after menses. Menses absent, late or short, Blood black, withclotting. Varicocele. Dysmenorrhea. Infrequent menses. Amenorrhea. Metritis. After-pains with laryngitis. Vaginitis. Food - Anorexia, nausea with vertigo and cold sensations.

Chest - Chest feels hard, like a breastplate. Constitutions - Hormonal imbalances. Subjects of a nervous constitution, with extreme sensitivity, and who cry easily. Tubercular conditions of the “worn-out” type.

Limbs - Arthritis in women, with menopause. Rheumatism of the knee. Limbs cold, with chilblains, skin discolored or red. Legs heavy before menses. Joint pains improved by movement, aggravated in the sitting position. Fingers and toes swollen before menses. Swollen, distended varicosities before menses. Varicose veins. Lungs - Bronchitis. Angina, laryngitis with hoarseness. Morning cough, thorax painful on left side.

Skin - Varicose eczema. Acrocyanosis in young girls. Burns, also for external use in compresses of liquid extract at 15%, diluted 1:50 in water.

Modalities - Better during menses. Better from elimination of secretion. Worse from suppression. Worse before and after menses.

Kidneys - Pain in the kidneys and bladder with a frequent urination. Bedwetting, especially in older women. Incontinence and compelling need to urinate. Pyelitis. Cystitis. Albuminuria with white discharge.

Temperature - Chilliness.

full:
PHARMACY - arist-m. Aristolochia mil- homens. Brazilian snake-root. Aristolochia cymbifera. Aristolochia glandifera. N. O. Aris- tolochiacae. Tincture of the ttowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Achilles tendon. Diabetes. Extravasations. Heart, pain.

HOMEOPATHIC - In a proving by Mure, prominent among the key symptoms were sharp and pricking pains in various parts. Pain at apex of heart stopping breath. Excoriations of lips and gums. Cramp-like pains in left Achilles tendon. Stitching pains in various parts. Pain in heels, burning in anus and frequent irritation. The whole leg is covered with large irregular patches formed by extravasated blood. Pain in back and limbs. Stiffness of legs. Itching and swelling around the malleoli. The mouth is pasty in the morning. Anorexia. Flatulence in stomach and abdomen. Colic followed by diarrhea. Burning at anus. Disturbed rest. Disgusting dreams. Head burning hot. Great thirst and bitter mouth, makes water more frequently than usual. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aristolochia Serpentaria. REFERENCES Clarke.

PHARMACY - arist-s. Aristolochia serpentaria. Virginia snake-root. Serpentary. N. O. Aris- tolochiacae.Triturationofdried roots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Poison oak.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aristolochia serpentaria was proved by Jorg's provers and others. Chief effects were noticed in the gastro-enteric organs, nausea, vomiting, abdominal distention, flatulence and urging to stool. Increased, and afterwards lost, appetite. Symptoms of intestinal tract, diarrhea, meteorism. Flatulent dyspepsia. Distention and cutting pains in abdomen. Irritation of the urinary and genital organs with frequent desire to urinate. Disturbed rest, also heat of the head (Arist-m.). Brain congestion. Symptoms like those of poison oak. MIND - Peevish mood. Disinclination for work.

Head - Sticking in forehead extending to base of brain. Increased warmth of head.

Mouth - Copious salivation with frequent spitting.

Stomach - Increased appetite, yet able to eat little, since the first morsels satisfy. Loss of appetite. Nausea and vomiting, vomiting did not cease until the stomach was entirely emptied. Distended feeling as if too full. Heaviness better by emission of much flatus.

Abdomen - Colic in umbilical region. Distention, rumbling, uneasiness, cutting pains, with emission of flatus, belchings which relieve. •

Stool - Distressing itching about anus. Frequent desire with evacuation of more gas than feces. Frequent desire for stool with evacuation of scanty, hard, tenacious feces with much flatulence. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Back - Pressive pain in nape of neck.

Kidneys - General irritation of urinary and genital organs. Violent desire to urinate with great increase in quantity of urine. Frequent desire but only a little brownish urine passed.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from lying down. Better lying outstretched. Better with head low. Better motion. Better clear, cold, stimulating weather. Worse evening and night. Worse from injuries.
