PHARMACY - am. Arnica montana. Leopard's bane. Brusiewort. Fallkraut. Fall herb. N. O. Composite. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tmctureofroot.Historicaldose: All potencies. Arnica should not be used externally where there is broken skin. For tom and lacerated wounds, Calendula can be used locally.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Aching, pains. Back, pains. Baldness. Bedsores. Black eye. Blows. Boils. Brain disorders. Breath, fetid. Bronchitis. Bruises. Carbuncle. Chest, disorders. Chorea. Concussions. Contusions. Coms. Cramp. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Ec- chymosis. Exhaustion. Eyes, disorders. Falls. Fatigue. Gout. Head, injury. Hematemesis, Hematoma. Hematuria. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Impotence. Influenza. Injuries. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Mastitis. Meningitis. Mental shock. Miscarriage. Over- lifting. Over-working. Paralysis. Pleurodynia. Purpura. Pyemia. Rheumatism. Shock. Spleen, pain. Sore, pains. Sprains. Stings. Strains. Strokes. Suppuration. Swellings. Taste, disorders. Thirst. Trauma. Traumatic, fever. Tumors. Typhoid. Voicedisorders. Whooping cough. Wounds. Yawning.

HERBAL - Growing on the mountains, Arnica may be said to possess a native affinity to the effects of falls. As its German name. Fallkraut, attests, its value as a vulnerary has been known from remote times. It may be said to be the traumatic par excellence. Ussher noted that the local use of Arnica produced an extraordinary growth of hair on a limb. This suggested the use of an oil mixed with Am. lx in a case of baldness, which was followed with marked success. Clarke once ran a piece of wire into the tip of one of his fingers, causing paralyzing pain. He applied Am., 1 x at once and the pain was better instantly seeming to be wiped out from the point of injury up the arm.

HOMEOPATHIC - Trauma and its effects, recent or remote is met by Arnica as by no other single dmg and the provings bring out the appropriateness of the remedy in the symptoms it causes. Tumors in many parts, following injury, have been cured by Arnica including scirrhus tumors of the breast. Nervous disorders as chorea after falls. Trauma in all its forms, and the recent or remote effects injuries are covered by this remedy. It produces conditions upon the system quite similar to those resulting from injuries, falls, blows, contusions. Compound fractures. Mental or physical shocks. After traumatic injuries, overuse of any organ, strains. Tinnitus aurium. It affects blood, causing putrid and septic conditions. Putrid phenomena. Septic conditions, prophylactic of pus infection. Strokes with a red, full face. It is especially suited to cases when any injury, however remote, seems to have caused the present trouble. Trauma of grief, remorse or sudden realization of financial loss. Arnica is disposed to cerebral congestion. Marked effect on the blood. Acts best in plethoric, feebly in debilitated with impoverished blood, cardiac dropsy with dyspnea. A muscular tonic. Thrombosis. Hematocele. Influenza with sore bruised muscles. Limbs and body ache as if beaten, joints as if sprained. Bed feels too hard or full of lumps. Great prostration, with a tired feeling. Discharges are foul, breath, taste, flatus, stools etc. Tendency to tissue degeneration, low septic conditions. Abscesses that do not mature. Typhoid, septic fevers. Recurring boils. Thrombosis. Sore, lame, bruisedfeeling. Rheumatism of muscles and tendons, especially of back and shoulders. Aversion to tobacco. Vaginitis in females and impotence in males from excessive sexual indulgence. MIND - Arnica is used after severe mental stress orshock.Mentaloremotionalshocks.Never well since a trauma, fright or grief. History of severe physical trauma with chronic men- tal or emotional effects. Accident, trauma victims. Nervous, can't bear pain, whole body oversensitive. Fear of being touched or injured. Feels like a wounded animal. Fear of the approach of anyone. Fear of sickness. Fear of instant death with heart distress. Fear at night. Fear on awakening. Agoraphobia. Fear of open spaces. Fear of crowds, public places. Violent attacks of anguish, anxiety with angina pectoris (Aeon.). Easily frightened, unexpected trifles cause him to start. Hypochondriacal anxiety. Fear remains at night after fright (Op.). A sudden fear that rouses one from sleep at night especially after an accident (Op.). Head injury or strokes that effect mental functions. Morose, repentant mood. Overworked and exhausted. Indifference to work. Depression from injuries to the head (Nat-s.). Forgetful, what he reads quickly escapes his mind. Absent-minded. Forgets the word he is about to say. Unconscious. When spoken to answers correctly, but relapses. Coma. Muttering delirium. Delirium tremens. Morose, delirious. Nervous and mental shock. Sits as if in thought. Says there is nothing the matter with him. Feels well in serious cases, because of shock. Sends the doctor home. Wants to be left alone. Prays quietly for her soul. Stupor, with involuntary discharge of feces, typhoid. Stupefaction, loss of sight and hearing, from concussion of brain.

Head - Hematoma. Head injury. Headaches from injury to head. Meningitis from injury to head. Periodical attacks of migraine. Hot head with a cold body. Brain feels tired. Burning in brain. Confused, sensitivity of brain with sharp, pinching pains. Stroke victims, with loss of consciousness, involuntary evacuations from bowels and bladder, paralysis. Head as if too large. Headache as from a nail. Headaches from strong emotions. Cold spot on the forehead. Burning or hot spots on vertex. Head throws backwards while walking. Baldness. Recurring boils on scalp. Scalp feels contracted.

Eyes - Bloodshot. Eyes sunken. Black eye from injury. Traumatic ulceration with much hemorrhage into anterior chamber. Expedites absorption of clots, in retinal hemorrhage. Bruised iris after cataract operations. Bruised, sore feeling in eyes after close work. Eyesfeel tired and weary after sightseeing, moving pictures. Lachrymationburning. Photophobia. Righteye protrudes, looks larger than left. Must keep eyes open, dizzy on closing them. Photophobia. Pupils contracted, dilated.

Ears - Shooting in and around ears. Blood from ears. Suppurating otitis with stupor. Cartilages of ears as if bruised. Bruised pain in external ears. Sensitive to shrill noise. Sensitivity to loud sounds. Hearing impaired from injury to the head. Dull hearing, after concussion. Hardness of hearing. Deafness after typhus. Noises in ear caused by rush of blood to the head. Humming.

Nose - Bruised, from above downward. Swelling of nose. Nosebleeds after injury. Nosebleeds after every fit of coughing after washing face, dark fluid blood. Nose feels sore, cold. Violent sneezing from overlifting. Nose feels sore, cold. Post-nasal drip. Catarrh of antrum. Burning pain in typhoid fever. Nosebleeds during typhoid fever. Ulcerated nostrils. Empyema of maxillary sinus.

Face - Face hot and red, with cold legs. Sunken, very red, pale. Acne sore and painful. Bruised pains. Chilliness during headache. Herpes in face. Ruddy, congested, bluish red in strokes, fevers. Lower jaw hangs down, paralysis. Redness and burning of one cheek. Cheeks puffed, red. Swelling of parotid gland during measles. Throbbing and stinging pain, in swollen cheeks.

Mouth - Soreness of gums after teeth extraction (Sep.). Dry and thirsty. Bitter taste (Coloc.). Taste as from bad eggs. Fetid breath. Taste disgusting, putrid, slimy. Bad taste after operation. Empyema of maxillary sinus. Bright red, puffy fauces. Saliva diminished. Swallowing is prevented by sort of nausea as if food would not go down. Heat in lips. Lips burn, swollen and cracked. Lower lip trembles, while eating.

Throat - Acute tonsillitis, swelling of soft palate and uvula. Bright red, puffy fauces. Burning, when swallowing. Stinging in back of throat. Raw, sore feeling. Crackling in trachea, when lying down. Hoarseness from overuse of voice. Hoarseness, worse exertion, colds or getting wet. Hoarseness early in morning. Voice deep or low, muttering.

Stomach - Belchings, tasting of bad eggs after coughing. Eructations of bitter mucus. Oppressive gases pass upward and downward. Stomach distended with wind. Pain in stomach during eating. Pinching, spasmodic griping pain in stomach. Pressure as from a stone. Feeling as if stomach were pressing against spine. As if a lump in stomach. Hiccough. Motion sickness. Nausea with burning and scratching in throat. Retching at night. Fetid vomiting. Vomiting of dark, red coagulated blood. Vomiting of blood after injuries. V omiting of food, mixed with blood. Stools - Dysenteric stools with muscular pains. Brown or white diarrhea. Offensive, brown, bloody,putrid involuntary stools. Stools look like brown yeast. Must lie down after every stool. Stools are bloody, foamy, purulent, acrid involuntary during sleep. Ribbon-like stools, from enlarged prostrate or retroverted uterus. Stools consisting of bloody, slimy mucus, with urging and violent bellyache. Undigested stools.

Abdomen - Colic, with retention of urine. Colic, resembling dysentery. Cramps from epigastrium down over the bowels, then foul stools. Tympanitic distension. Distended with offensive flatus. Flatus smelling of rotten eggs. Bruised pain, in sides of abdomen. Sharp pains from side to side. Sharp thrusts through abdomen. Sharp pain in region of spleen, taking away breath. Swashing in abdomen as from water.

Rectum - Flatus smelling of rotten eggs. Sensation of rumbling in rectum, without stools. Obstinate constipation after a blow on epigastrium. Straining of tenesmus in diarrhea. Dysentery with dysuria, in summer and autumn. Diarrhea at night, with cutting in intestines. Diarrhea of tuberculosis, worse lying on left side. Prolapsed anus, worse after walking for few minutes only better washing the whole body. Cramps in rectum, while standing. Anus as if bruised. Burning along perineum during urination.

Male - Genitals bruised and much swollen. Swelling of penis and scrotum, bluish-red. Hot swelling of scrotum after injury. Spermatic cords painfully swollen. Relaxed testicles. Hematocele. Phimosis from friction. Hydrocele caused by a bruise. Violent continued erections often waking. Seminal emission during caress. Impotence from sexual excess or abuse. Erysipelas of scrotum.

Female - Menses, early, hot, profuse. Uterine hemorrhage from mechanical injury after sex. Hemorrhages bright red or mixed with clots. Bloody discharge between menses. Ulcers of uterus with a tendency to bleed. Labia painfully swollen. Prolapsus caused by concussion. Ovarian region feels as if sprained, obliging her to walk bent. Threatened miscarriage from falls etc. Soreness of the whole body during pregnancy. Feeling as if fetus were lying crosswise. Cannot bear fetal movements, cause nausea and vomiting. Labor pains, weak orceasing. Bruised parts after labor. Soreness and lameness of parts after delivery. Puerperal fever. Violent after-pains, worse breast-feeding. Food - Loss of appetite. Loathing very sight of food. Canine hunger. Loss of appetite and sourness of stomach of brandy drinkers, creates a disgust for brandy. Aversion to milk and meat. Aversion to broth, smoking tobacco. Longing for vinegar. Desires sour, alcoholic drinks. Constant desire to drink, but knows not what for, as all drinks are offensive. Thirst with dry mouth.

Chest - Burning or rawness in chest. Sharp pains under false ribs. Bruised, aching sensation in chest on walking. Sensation as if all ribs were bruised, when coughing. Bones and cartilages of chest are painful, worse motion, breathing or coughing. Heavy sensation lower chest. Sharp pains in chest, taking the breath away, better pressure. Pain in intercostal muscles. Pleurodynia (Ran-b.. Bry., Cimic.). Constitutions - Adapted to sanguine, plethoric persons, disposed to cerebral congestion. Persons easily made train-sick or seasick. It is suited to persons who are sensitive to mechanical injuries and who feel the effects of them long after. Teste noted it for plethoric red-faced persons.

Heart - Sudden pain as if heart is squeezed or had got a shock. Strain of heart from violent running. Weakened heart muscles. Palpitations after any exertion. Palpitations after any shock or injury. Palpitations shake the whole body. Angina pectoris, with severe pain in elbow of left arm. Sharp pain in heart. Heart pains, left to right. Horror of constant death with cardiac distress at night. Cardiac dropsy with distressing dyspnea. Fatty heart and hypertrophy. Pulse feeble and irregular. Weak fluttering of pulse. Pulse hurried. Pulse quicker than beat of heart.

Back - Backache from muscle strain, overuse. Great soreness and pain in back, as if bruised or beaten. Back sore and aches, worse overlifting. Agonizing pain in back and hips before urination. Bruises on back from injuries, blows. Violent pain, in spine, as after sudden rising up after long stooping. Cervical vertebrae tender. Muscles of neck weak, head falls backwards or any side. Sacrum as if beaten.

Limbs - Sore and bruised limbs. Soreness after overexertion. Sprained and dislo- cated feeling. Lame feeling. Great fear of being touched or approached. Pain in back and limbs, as if bruised or beaten. Limbs ache as if beaten. Everything on which he lies seems too hard. Bed feels too hard. Heaviness in all limbs. Deathly coldness of forearm. Joint, muscle pain from injury. Cannot walk erect, on account of bruised pain in pelvic region. Sore, aching muscles with influenza. Gout. Rheumatism begins low down and works up (Led.). Rheumatism, from exposure to dampness, cold. Rheumatism from excessive muscular strain. Cramps in the fingers, writer's cramp. Pain in arms better hanging down. Want of strength in the hands on grasping. Veins of hands distended. Knee joints suddenly bend when standing. Feet numb.

Sleep - Unrefreshing sleep. Involuntary stools during sleep. Sleepless and restless when overtired. Can't fall asleep, fantastical illusions while lying awake. Frequent yawning in evening, without sleepiness. Yawning before chill. Comatose drowsiness, awakens with hot head, drops to sleep as he answers. Nightmares. Horrors in the night. When dreaming sees black forms of spectres, ghosts, spirits. Dreams of death. Dreams of being buried alive, suffocation. Dreams of mutilated bodies. Anxious and terrible dreams, awakes in terror, then sleepless. Awful dreams, of robbers and murderers.

Skin - Ecchymosis. Bruises from injury. Every little injury makes bruises. Black and blue spots. Eruptions after trauma. Red, hot, edematous. Hot, hard, shining swelling, from insect stings. Dusky, mottled. Acne indurata, characterized by symmetry in distribution. Very sore acne. Itching, burning, eruption of small pimples. After scratching, itching begins somewhere else. Tingling and itching which moves from pk"e to place. Crops of small boils (Ichthy., Sil.). Carbuncles. Bedsores. Petechiae. Erysipelas. Scarlet fever when the eruption doesn't come out. Erythema nodosum. Corns. Varicose ulcers.

Modalities - Better from lying down. Better lying outstretched. Better with head low. Better motion. Better clear, cold, stimulating weather. Worse evening and night. Worse from injuries. Worse from falls, blows, bruises, shock. Worse jarring, noise. Worse after labor, over-exertion, sprains. Worse least touch. Worse motion. Worse rest. Worse alcohol, wine. Worse damp cold. Worse after sleep. Worse coal gas. Worse lying on left side.

Teeth - Swollenjaw after dental work. Pains after dental work, injuries. Soreness of gums after teeth extraction (Sep.). Gums sore, swollen during dentition. Sore and aching after trauma. Beating and tingling in gums, during toothache. Throbbing, toothache. Excruciating, cutting, tearing, in teeth.

Tongue - Tongue dry, almost black. Biting, burning and scraping at root of tongue. Tongue, dry, almost black. Red stripe down centre of tongue. Tongue coated white. Tongue coated yellow. Tongue dry with brown streak down middle. Vertigo - Chronic vertigo, objects whirl about especially when walking. Vertigo of the elderly. Vertigo with nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. Vertigo worse walking, sitting erect, closing eyes. Vertigo worse, head injury. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo on rising and on moving. Vision - Diplopia from trauma, muscular paralysis, retinal hemorrhage. Diplopia, with vertigo, on looking downward. High objects appear to lean forward and about to fall. Flickering, worse reading or writing, with headache. Lost vision, after a violent blow. On reading, print seems to dance in a fog and vanish, must rub eyes. Muscae volitantes. Obscured, lost vision, during headache. COMMENTS - Arnica is allied to wounds and cures hemorrhages of many kinds including strokes, dilatation and rupture of small bloodvessels. Vomiting, coughing, purging, accompanied by streaks of blood in vomit. Extravasation of blood into the conjunctiva as in whooping cough. Hemorrhages into the tissues of internal organs or the skin. An odd symptom of Arnica is “coldness of the nose.” A case of facial (left) neuralgia, face swollen, dark red, very painful to touch, was cured with Arnica (radix), the guiding symptom being “cold nose.” Patient had bitter taste, was very excitable and worse at night. Effects of violent cough or sneezing, the child cries before cough comes on (or with the cough) in whooping cough. Chronic bronchitis when patients have bruised, weak aching in the chest or great sensitiveness of the chest on exertion or walking. Arn. affects the left upper extremity and the right chest. Putrid excretions (Bapt.), putrid breath, fetid sweat. Incessant passing of stool and urine in putrid states. Nash gave “Stupor with involuntary discharge of feces and urine.” “Fears being touched or struck by those coming near him.” “Putrid smell from mouth.” “Bruised, sore feeling in uterine region, cannot walk erect.” “While answering falls into a deep stupor before finishing.” “Head alone or face alone, hot, rest of body cool.” “Many small boils, painful, one after another, extremely sore.” “Suddenness” is a feature of Arn. pains and action. P. P. Wells related a cure of double pleuro-pneumonia in a child with sudden stabbing pains on both sides of the chest almost preventing breathing. Arnica instantly caused a violent aggravation, the next instant relief was perfect and the child fell asleep breathing naturally. Keynote sore, bruised feeling. Bluish discoloration, bruising, better cold applications. The bed feels too hard. Fatigue, “fear of being approached,” an animal-like fear of guarding a wounded area. Can believe nothing is wrong when severely injured, sign of shock (Op.). Patient may be irritable and want to be left alone. Can have amnesia, or nightmares after injury or loss of confidence since injury. Intermittent fear of death. A major goutremedy, afraid of joints being touched. Good for flus and mono when there is a sore, achy feeling all over. Also acute muscle fatigue in athletes. Superficial tissue trauma. Boils that feel sore and bruised. Comas from trauma and injury. Any fever with a sore, bruised feeling. For chronic weak joints after repeated injuries. Shock due to trauma or shock from the injury itself. For grief and financial shock. Good for overexertion. It's also used for trauma from blows from blunt instruments, sprains. For post-stroke victims, for injuries and hematomas. For heart attacks from overexertion. For internal bleeding. Achi- ness and weakness from the weight of the baby in pregnant women. For people who have a tendency to bruise easily. Vertigo, worse head injuries and strokes. Also for severe illness when the patient goes into the stupor stage. Good after dental work. For vomiting of blood after injury to the abdominal region or injury to the uterus. Sensitive to cold damp weather, and hot sun. Worse from touch. Alcohol will aggravate the condition, but may crave alcohol to relieve pain. Also worse tobacco. Sensation worse after an adjustment to spine (Ruta., Rhus- t.). RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph. Vitex trifolia. Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon., Bapt., Bell-p., Ham., Led., Rhus-t.. Hyper., Symph.. (2) Abrot., Absin., Calen., Cham., Cina, Gnaph. (3 ) other Composites. (4) Am-c., Crot-t. - swashing in abdomen. (5) Ars., Bapt. - typhoid states, Bapt. “feels ill,” Arn. “feels well.”Bry.,Rhod.,Ruta., Sul- ac. Complementary: Aeon., Ip. Follows well: Aeon., Ip., Verat., Apis. Followed well by: Aeon., Ars., Bry., Ip., Rhus-t. Antidote to: Am-c., Chin., Cie., Ferr., Ign., Ip., Seneg. Antidoted by: Camph., Ip. (to massive doses), Coffee (headache), Aeon., Ars., Chin., Ign., Ip. (to potencies). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Liver - Sharp pain in region of liver; painful when turning in bed. Pressure in region of liver. Pain from liver through left chest and down left arm. Lungs - Asthma with inclination to move about. Asthma with sleeplessness before midnight. Asphyxia neonatorum. Dyspnea with hemoptysis. Short, panting breathing. Children lose their breath when angry. Raw, sore feeling in morning. Pneumonia, approaching paralysis. Can't expectorate, but must swallow whatever is loosened by coughing. Bloody expectoration. Hemorrhage after mechanical injuries. Offensive, green, purulent, blood-streaked expectoration. Spitting up of black, thick, viscid blood, or bright red, frothy blood, mixed with mucus and coagula. Pneumothorax from external injuries. Pleurisy after mechanical injuries. Pleurodynia (Bry., Ran-b., Cimic.).

Kidneys - Cutting pain in kidneys. Piercing pain, as from knives plunged into kidneys, with chilliness and inclination to vomit. Involuntary dribbling with constant urging. Has to wait a long time for urine to pass. Urine has dark brick-red sediment. Bloody urine from mechanical causes. Urine in small quantity, staining napkin yellow-brown. Red urine in liver complaint. Scanty, red urine, very offensive. Brown clear urine which immediately becomes whitish and turbid.

Bladder - Retention of urine in bladder from over exertion after labor. Urine retained, with aching and pressing in bladder. Bladderaffections after mechanical injuries. Bladder tenesmus with very painful urination. Tenesmus of bladder with diarrhea. Bladder feels full and sore, the pressure of urine hurts him. Cutting pain in orifice of urethra at end of urination. Infants scream from pain in bladder. Constant dribbling of urine after labor. Breasts - Sore nipples. Mastitis from injury. Tumors of breast from injury (Bell-p., Con.). Violent after-pains, worse nursing. Causations - Mechanical injuries. Fright, financial loss, anger. Overuse of any organ. Surgical operations. Insect stings. Splinters.

Cough - Cough produced by weeping and lamenting. Dry cough from tickling low down in trachea. Cough causes bloodshot eyes or nosebleed. Violent, spasmodic cough with facial herpes. Cardiac cough, paroxysmal, at night during sleep, worse exercise. Whooping cough, child cries before coughing. Cough after measles. Cough in sleep without waking.

Perspiration - Sour sweat at night. Sour or offensive sweat, sometimes cold. Several transitory sweats all over at night, with anguish. Worse when sweating. Sweat partial on front of body. Sweat followed by faintness.

Temperature - Chilly with heat and redness of one cheek. Coldness of part lain on. Thirst during chill. Must uncover but it chills him. Shivering over whole body. Shivering, as if dashed with cold water. Internal chills with external heat. Heat and redness of head with coolness of rest of body. Internal heat, feet and hands cold. Head or face alone hot, body cold. Heat flushes, with thirst. Influenza fever. Intermittent fever. Typhoid fever. Septic and traumatic fevers.

name: Arsenicum Album
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from company. Better heat, warm drinks and food, warm wraps. Better hot dry applications. Better from motion, walking about. Better lying with head elevated. Better sitting erect. Better sweating. Better open air. Worse periodically. Worse by the seashore. Worse wet weather, cold damp. Worse from cold air. Worse ices, cold drinks or food. Worse right side. Worse lying on affected part. Worse exertion. Worse around midnight. Worse after midnight. Worse 11 p.m. to 2 a.m. Worse every 14 days, yearly. Worse quinine, alcohol, tobacco. Worse eruptions undeveloped or suppressed..

Fears. Fevers. Food, poisoning. Gangrene. Gastric, ulcers. Gastritis. Gastroenteritis. Glandular, swellings. Gout. Hay asthma. Hay fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hepatitis. Herpes zoster. The arsenic-eaters of the Tyrol can take as much as a few grains of white arsenic or the sulphide, every two days. HOMEOPATHIC - Ars-br. has proven a great anti-psoric andanti-syphilitic remedy. Hansen said it is useful for “Acne rosacea with violet papules on the nose. Diabetes mellitus.” Herpetic eruptions, syphilitic growths, glandular tumors and indurations. Carcinoma, locomotor ataxia and obstinate intermittent fevers. Acne rosacea with violet papules on nose, worse in the spring. Acne in. young people. Great restlessness, wants to be carried continually. Larynx and trachea invaded; the effort to breathe causes profuse sweating. Irregular brownish stripe on center of tongue, more toward base. Great thirst for large quantities. COMMENTS - Anshutz's best successes were in obstinate cases of syphilis, in the first stages of tabes dorsalis, in the reconvalescence from exhausting acute diseases, in gastric suppurations inactivity of bowels, tardy digestion, constipation. In those cases where Chin-s. failed in intermittent fevers, he prescribed Ars-br. twice daily, four drops, each time in a full glass of water. Gradually diminishing it to one daily dose and in four weeks. Even the most obstinate cases yielded to this treatment. The patient felt encouraged by his increasing vigor, the fever-cakes disappear, the bowels moved regularly and appetite left nothing to be desired. Those mean obstinate cases of intermittent fevers often appearing in the form of unbearable neuralgias, yielded more rapidly to it than to the Quinine. Anshutz noted the case of “S. T., age 46 years old, contracted syphilis some years ago and was relieved of it by mercurial treatment and by Zittman's decoction. About six years ago he felt out of sorts and a papular eruption appeared on forehead, temples and especially at the root of the nose. Though treatment was immediately instituted, still in a few weeks the face of the patient was covered by ugly, foul-smelling crust. “Cod liver oil was now taken internally and applied externally until the scurfs fell off and the eruption concentrated on three points. For six months that treatment was kept up, but after being omitted for a few weeks, the eruption spread again to its former extent. Every treatment was tried in rotation without the least benefit. “In the spring 1856 he entered my clinic. In the center of the forehead, at the root of the nose, on both eyebrows on the temples and right cheek there are moist herpetic eruptions covered with crusts, exuding on least pressure an acrid, burning discharge, with easily bleeding. “Around these eruptions the skin is injected, reddened interspersed with a large network of veins. Cough and expectoration hint to a beginning of tuberculosis, an heirloom in the family. Little appetite, disturbed digestion, tardy defecation and evening fever. “He is ordered Solutio Ars-br. twice a day, four drops in a glass of water and already after two weeks the eruption begins to dry up, appetite returns and bowels are regular. “After two months two crusts fall off and the skin under them is soft, shining, somewhat red. About July all eruption had gone and the cough greatly improved.” He continued by noting that “Ars-br. is also a powerful remedy in diabetes mellitus and insipidus, cured cases where the patient had already been reduced from 138 pounds to 98 and where the urine could be condensed, by boiling into syrupy consistency. “A diabetic patient needs fresh pure air if he wishes to get well, confinement in a room or in the office prevents the action of any treatment, for it needs ozone to reduce the sugar of the blood into carbonic acid and water. “Let the patient take three drops thrice daily in a glass of water and after a week the insatiable burning thirst will be quenched and these doses must be continued until the quantity of sugar in the urine is reduced, when the remedy might be taken twice a day and continued for a long time.” REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Produces most characteristically excoriations of mucus membranes, like all arsenical preparations. The discharge irritates the membrane from which it flows and over which it flows. The discharge may be fetid, watery and the mucus membrane is red, angry, swollen, itches and burns. Ars-i., produces marked emaciation, fatty degeneration, debility, night sweats. Tuberculous and anemic conditions are benefited by it. Also hypertrophy and weakening of heart muscle (degeneration). It will be indicated by a profound prostration, rapid, irritable pulse, recurring fever and sweats, emaciation. Tendency to diarrhea. Hectic fever and debility. Enlargement of the spleen. Bad effects of malaria or quinine. Threatened pyemia (Pyrog., Meth-b). In Ars-i., we have a remedy most closely allied to manifestations of tuberculosis. In the early stages of tuberculosis, even though there is an afternoon rise in temperature, Ars-i. is very effective. This remedy is for tuberculosis with hoarse, racking cough and profuse expectoration of a purulent nature and attended with cardiac weakness, emaciation and general debility. Scrofulous glands. Drenching night sweats. Ars-i. should be thought of when the discharges of mucus membranes are persistently acrid, profuse, thick, gluey, yellow like honey in chronic disorders and thin in acute conditions. Discharges cause burning on the parts on which they flow. Influenza, hay fever, old nasal catarrhs and catarrh of middle ear. Swelling of tissues within the nose. Hypertrophied condition of eustachian tube and deafness. Acrid coryza, influenza, hay fever. There is marked burning in the eyes, nasal passages, mouth and pharynx. Thin, acrid, watery discharges from anterior and posterior nares. Watery discharge drops from tip of the nose. Aphonia. Slight hacking cough, dry stopped nostrils. Has been use in cancerous affections and in all stages of syphilis. Cancer of breast after ulceration has set in. Epithelioma and lung cancers based on tubercular disease. Epithelioma of the lip. Axillary tumors. Great emaciation. Weakness and debility. Heart weakened by chronic lung disorders. Arteriosclerosis. Fatty degeneration of the heart. Myocarditis. Myocardial degeneration. In chronic pneumonia, when abscess is about to form. Pneumonia following influenza. Chronic pneumonia with abscess in lung. MIND - Excitable. Hurried. Impatience. Anxiety about health. Drips water, which is hot. green, acrid, reddens upper lip. Irritation and tingling of nose constant desire to sneeze (Pollanin.). Aggravation by sneezing. Frequent sneezing, but unsatisfactory. Mouth - Breath fetid.

Female - Foul, bloody, yellow irritating leucorrhea with swelling of labia. Food - Intense thirst with desire for cold water which is ejected at once.

Back - Burning heat in lumbar region, as if clothes were on fire. Soreness of back and neck. Breasts - Lump in breasts, worse touch. Cancer of breast after ulceration has set in. Nipple retracted. Emaciation of breasts.

Limbs - Cold limbs. Heaviness of limbs with weariness. Pain in humerus, worse from writing. Clothes feel cold better walking. Tired, weary feeling in calves of both legs while kneeling. Lungs - Asthma. General wheezing on first lying down. Breathing too rapid, even when at rest, increasing in rapidity on exertion, soon becoming an audible wheezing. Chronic bronchitis. Catarrhal pneumonia with muco-purulent expectoration, dyspnea, night sweats. Pneumonia that fails to clear up. Lungs - Broncho-pneumonia after influenza. Rales and crepitation. Pleuritis. Short of breath, air hunger. Feeble respiration. Expectoration, yellow-green, foul. Muco-purulent and occasionally stringy mucus. Pulmonary tuberculosis. Tubercular pleurisy.

Sleep - Restless sleep. Constant yawning. Sleeplessness from headache.

Skin - Dry, scaly, itching. Psoriasis.Marked exfoliation of skin in large scales, leaving a raw exuding surface beneath. Enlarged scrofulous glands. Eczema of the beard, watery, oozing, itching, worse washing. Ichthyosis. Acne is hard, indurated base with pustule at apex. Venereal bubo. Eczema of beard worse washing.

COMMENTS - This is a synthetic remedy, its iodine element makes the person hot and adds an affinity for the glands, so it's a warm-blooded glandular remedy. Good for fever with swollen glands. Acute sore throat with burning and swollen glands, worse heat. In chronic, watery diarrhea in tubercular subjects in cases of emaciation with good appetite. This remedy can be continued for some time. Clinically, it has been found advisable in tuberculosis to begin with about the 4x and gradually go lower to the 2x trituration, 3 times a day. Also for hay fever and allergies, usually will look like an infection with swollen glands and fever, not an allergy. Psoriasis (Kali-ar). Affinity for the thyroid, hypothyroid conditions. Good for AIDS patients with emaciation, fever, swollen glands. Eczema of the beard, psoriasis, diarrhea of phthisis. Emaciation with good appetite. Always chilly, feeble respiration. Many symptoms appear on right side. Swollen feeling of parts. Enlarged or swollen feeling of brain, head, eyelids, hands and fingers. Syphilis wakes up after being many years dormant. Itching in many parts, skin peels off in small scales. Cutting, burning, stinging pains. MIND - Memory weak for what he has read, has to read everything two or three times before he comprehends it. Thinking of symptoms aggravates. Moody, doesn't wish to see anybody. Desire to be alone. Depression with exhaustion. Low spirited. Sad with tearful eyes, but can't weep, even during most painful events. Fear of being poisoned. Annoyed by visions, causing her to cry. Fearful visions of spectres in bright daylight. Sees threatening people after her and screams horribly. Feels as if she has to run away. Abdomen - Bloated abdomen. Pain in spleen down to groin. Red rash on abdomen. Painful swelling in right groin. Pulsation in navel.

Head - Writing and thinking aggravates headaches. Headache over eyes, with chilliness. Head feels too large. Left-sided headache up to eyes and into ears. Headaches, worse stooping and lying down. Edematous swelling of forehead. Laughing aggravates. Falling off of hair.

Eyes - Eyes, red, swollen and watery, burn with coryza. Hot and corroding lachrymation during coryza. Pterygium, with enlarged bloodvessel. Eyes weak. Can't look into bright light. Eyes painful after reading, sewing. Eye pain from walking in wind.

Ears - Numbness below ears.

Nose - Coryza with hot face, itching and hoarseness. Coryza, burning hot water runs from nose, excoriating edges of nostrils. Sore nose. Thick, yellow discharge. Violent itching in tip of nose.

Face - Face bloated, red and hot, during coryza. Red, itching, burning and swollen. Stiffness in lower jaws when biting. Twitching in left lower jaw.

Mouth - Dry mouth. Hot breath. Mouth sore and ulcerated. Lips dry and hot. Gums swollen and sore. Gums feel as if scalded, with salivation. Gums painful when touched.

Throat - Hoarseness during coryza. Sore throat during coryza. Violently inflamed throat, with pain when swallowing, worse right side. Angina with much heat in throat and several little ulcers. Itching of external throat.

Stomach - Hot eructations as of bile, with throbbing through whole body. Pressure in region of stomach. Empty retching and ■cutting in belly. Nausea towards morning. Nausea with headache, in morning.

Rectum - Diarrhea, burning watery stools with relief of pain. Sore feeling in rectum, better very hot water, not by cold washing. Intense itching at anus, followed by crawling.

Male - Itching on scrotum. Itching on glans. Prepuce swollen. Chancres with burning pain. Offensive sweat on genitals.

Female - Menses too early and too long- lasting. Menses too scanty. Heat in uterus and vagina. Burning when touched. Pains in uterus and vagina during menses. Food - No appetite. Aversion to wine and alcoholic drinks. Great desire for brandy or alcoholic drinks. Worse after brandy.

Chest - Chilliness extending into chest. Pulsation under sternum. Small blisters filled with blood on left side of chest. Sensation as if a heavy load were lying on chest.

Heart - Pains in region of heart after mental disturbances. Sharp pain in heart. Can lie only on left side in heart disease. Pulse accelerated in morning (Sulph.).

Back - Chilliness in neck, during headache. Numbness and lameness sensation of right lumbar region. Pain in spine between scapulae. Sharp pain behind scapulae. Crawling sensation on back. Feeling as if a furuncle would form. Weakness of neck. Itching in neck during coryza. Breasts - Itching of breasts. Pain in breast extends to hip and spleen.

Limbs - Limbs feel heavy.

Sleep - Great drowsiness in morning. Falling asleep on sitting down. Very sleepy, but can't fall asleep. Dreams of danger on the water.

Skin - Itching, has to pinch spot. Skin peels off in small scales. Bluish-red eruptions. Rash and red smooth spots. Red spots over whole body. Small furuncles in face.

Modalities - Better darkness. Better pinching, sitting erect. Washing helps the itching - of anus. Cold bathing helps the itching of face. Worse stooping. Worse light. Worse on waking in morning. Worse lying on left side (heart). Worse thinking of symptoms. Worse right side. Hot bathing aggravates the pain in hip.

Tongue - The tongue coated white and shows imprint of the teeth. Tongue white. slimy, furred. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bell., Nat-c. Compare: (1) lod., Merc., Nat-c. in syphilis, Nux-.v. - drowsy after sound sleep. (2) Rhus-t. - pain in back, hips, etc., Sulph. (pulse), Ars. (3) Useful in pterygium after failure of Nux- v. and Spig. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clafké.

Liver - Sore pain in liver goes through to shoulders and spine. Lungs - Great difficulty in breathing, with sneezing, coryza, lachrymation.

Kidneys - Hot urine in evening. Red, sandy sediment.

Temperature - Chilliness on occiput, neck and chest.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - ars-s-f. Arsenicum sulphuratum flavum. Arsenious sulphide. Orpiment. Arsenic trisulph. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Decay. Children, emaciated. Diarrhea. Gonorrhea. Indigestion. Jaundice. Laryngeal, tuberculosis. Strokes. Walking, late.

HOMEOPATHIC - Orpiment of the Alchemists. The two sulfides of Arsenic orpiment and Realgar have been used in a somewhat general way in cases combining the strong symptoms of both elements. Independent observations and provings have been made with the two salts. Grimmer called Ars-s-f. an arsenicum that effects the skin and mucus membrane strongly, malignant and regular ulceration, especially of the stomach, which is the seat of severe burning pains with vomiting and diarrhea. There are symptoms of the two components, there is intense torturing anxiety and apprehension with restlessness. Ars-s-f. has the burning pains and sensations of both Ars. and Sulph., stitching, tearing and rheumatic pains moving from place to place. Lameness, staggering, trembling. Spasms, colic, vomiting and diarrhea. Annoying twitching. General debility. Chafing of skin about genitals and behind ears of children. Needle pricks from within outwards in chest, also on forehead, right side. Sticking behind the ear. Difficult respiration. Leuco- derma and squamous syphilides. Sciatica and pain around the knee. MIND - Apprehensi ve. Intense torturing anxiety and apprehension. Obstinate. Touchy, hasty and restless. Discontented. Aversion to being spoken to. Vanishing of thoughts.

Head - Great weakness in head. Stroke. Needle-like stitches in right frontal region. Forehead cold.

Nose - Dry nose. Sneezing.

Mouth - Taste bitter. Tongue furred, yellow-white, stiff, swollen. Dry mouth with disgust for all nourishment. Mouth and throat dry. Herpetic ulcers. Teeth pain as if loose, when chewing food.

Stomach - Indigestion. Burning and gnawing in stomach with vomiting and diarrhea. Cramp in stomach with fainting, colic, vomiting, diarrhea. Violent, persistent vomiting. Vomiting of offensive bile relieves.

Abdomen - Violent griping pain with convulsions. Violent colic. Swelling of abdomen.

Rectum - Diarrhea with colic, backache and tenesmus. Diarrhea daily 8 a-m. and several times during day, but not at night. Stool like water, green and slimy and terribly offensive.

Male - Gonorrhea with terrible pains, discharge copious, yellow, constant, burning day and night along entire urethra with restlessness.

Back - Pain inlumbar vertebrae when moving. Back constantly cold. Food - Loss of appetite. Aversion to fat, rich food and meat. Desires coffee, sweets, warm food and drinks. Extremely thirsty.

Limbs - Sciatica with pain around knee. Knees pain and totter. Feet burn. Feet cold, offensive sweat. Lungs - Difficult breathing.

Sleep - Starting in sleep, also in falling asleep, as if he would fall out of bed. Restless at night, excited, dreams with seminal emissions.

Skin - Skin itching, dry, cracked, cracks. Skin scaly and blackish. Leucoderma. Eruption on outer side of left wrist, also on inner side.

Modalities - Better by steam or hot water. Better lying down. Marked periodicity (Ars., Sulph.). Worse every afternoon and evening.

Temperature - Hectic fever without thirst. Chronic intermittent fever, worse every afternoon and evening. Terrible heat at night. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Sulph. (2) Calc. - children slow in learning to walk. (3) Ars-s-r. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Arsenicum Sulfuratum Rubrum
author: Murphy
constitution: Acne. Diarrhea. Eczema. Furuncles. Gastritis. Influenza. Neuralgia. Psoriasis. Sciatica.

PHARMACY - ars-s-r. Arsenicum sulphuratum rubrum. Arsenic sulphide. Realgar. Arsenic disulfide. Trituration. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Diarrhea. Eczema. Furuncles. Gastritis. Influenza. Neuralgia. Psoriasis. Sciatica.

HOMEOPATHIC - The…
full:
PHARMACY - ars-s-r. Arsenicum sulphuratum rubrum. Arsenic sulphide. Realgar. Arsenic disulfide. Trituration. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Diarrhea. Eczema. Furuncles. Gastritis. Influenza. Neuralgia. Psoriasis. Sciatica.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Realgar of the ancient Alchemists. The Red Sulphide of Arsenic was introduced and proved by Neidhard, but it has been used somewhat empirically on indications borrowed from its two components. Clarke found Ars-s-r. useful in many cases of influenza and its sequelae, especially sciatica. Influenza with intense catarrhal symptoms, great prostration and high temperature, purulent discharges. Burning pains, as if coals of fire in stomach, worse drinking cold water. External heat. Bone pains. Chilly even before a hot stove. Restless sleep with very vivid dreams. Psoriasis, acne and sciatica. Itching in various parts. Pellagra. Convulsions. Itching in various parts. Numbness. All symptoms worse at night. Worse on waking (headache). MIND - Crossness, irritable and acts with more energy. Indisposed for mental or physical exertion after meals.

Head - Severe continued pain extending deep into brain in right frontal region, also in right ear, worse by stooping and exercise, better cold application, 5 p-m. Waking often with dull pain in forehead over eyes, extending over top of head to crown. Pain commencing at back of head, extending around sides. Neuralgia right side of face, nose, jaw and through temple.

Ears - Sensations of fulness and pressing outward in right ear. Snapping sound in ear corresponding to pulsation of temporal artery. Ear feels hot. Redness and burning of ear. Tingling similar to frost-bite.

Mouth - Bitter taste on waking.

Throat - Hoarseness with accumulation of thick, tenacious mucus in throat. Mucus membranes of mouth and throat inflamed. Right tonsil enlarged. Intolerable itching in throat inducing short, dry, expulsive cough. COMMENTS - J. Meredith cured with Ars- s-r. mainly, a young girl who suffered from in occipital headache, profuse, repulsive, Arsenicum sulf, rubrum nauseating nasal catarrh, leucorrhea, pelvic pains, menstrual troubles and general anemic appearance. T. N. McLaughlin reported much success in skin cases, especially in cases of psoriasis and also of eczema, acne and furuncles. He gave Ars-s-r. in tablets of 2x trituration. He found patients who could not tolerate Ars. could take Ars-s-r. without any unpleasant symptoms and with marked curative effect. There was no gastric or intestinal irritation in any of his cases. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars-s-f., Caps. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

Stomach - Burning in stomach like coals of fire, worse drinking cold water, could not bear least pressure on region of stomach. Sharp cutting pain in left abdominal region after each meal. Weight and gnawing in stomach.

Abdomen - Dull pain in bowels. Feeling of fullness. Violent colic with terrible vomiting. Large bluish spots.

Rectum - Pain in anus worse by efforts to stool or urination, bearing-down would cause heavy sickening sensation.

Stool - Diarrhea, yellow, mushy stools in morning early after getting up and in the evening before going to bed, constant tenesmus in anus.

Chest - Chest pains. Wakes at 5 a.m. with sharp cutting pain. Commencing between cartilages of 5th and 6th ribs. Extending inwards and upwards deep into chest. Slightest motion aggravates, had to limit respiration as much as possible.

Heart - Occasional sharp pains through base of heart impeding respiration.

Back - After rising in morning a heavy pressing pain, extending from tip of coccyx to anus, soreness of coccyx.

Limbs - Rheumatism from right shoulder down arm as if in bone. Pain in right hip with lameness of leg. Severe pain in left tibia. All joints immovable after recovery from the poison.

HERBAL - This herb has been used in China to treat…
full:
PHARMACY - art-a. Artemisia annua. Sweet wormwood. Sweet Annie. Qing hao. N. O. Compositae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Fever. Intermittent fever. Malaria. Parasites. Stomach, problems. Worms.

HERBAL - This herb has been used in China to treat malaria and fevers. Artemisinin is an alkaloid extracted from the plant that is being used as an anti-malarial drug. It reduces fevers and destroys the malaria organism. Artemisia annua has been used in tinctures, powders and teas. It is of special use in those areas where anti- malarial drugs like quinine are no longer effective.

HOMEOPATHIC - Art-a. has not been proved homeopathically. Clinically it has been used to treat fevers, stomach problems, and parasites. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Chin., Art-v. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

name: Artemisia Vulgaris
author: Murphy
constitution: Anorexia. Catalepsy. Chorea. Convulsions. Cramps. Dysmenorrhea. Eclampsia. Epilepsy. Hydrocephalus. Hysteria. Masturbation. Miscarriage. Sleepwalking. Twitching. Worms. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - art-v. Artemisia vulgaris. Mu- wort. Wormwood. Beifuss. N. O. Compositae. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally and internally is injurious to eyes.

CLINICAL - Anorexia. Catalepsy. Chorea. Convulsions. Cramps. Dysmenorrhea.…
full:
PHARMACY - art-v. Artemisia vulgaris. Mu- wort. Wormwood. Beifuss. N. O. Compositae. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally and internally is injurious to eyes.

CLINICAL - Anorexia. Catalepsy. Chorea. Convulsions. Cramps. Dysmenorrhea. Eclampsia. Epilepsy. Hydrocephalus. Hysteria. Masturbation. Miscarriage. Sleepwalking. Twitching. Worms. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Like the other Artemisias, this remedy has a prominent place in convulsive diseases. Some reputation as a remedy for epileptic conditions and convulsive diseases of childhood and girls at puberty. Acts better when given with wine than with water. Excitable and irritable before attack of epilepsy. Epilepsy after fright or grief after a blow on the head with menstrual disturbances with teething. Attack accompanied or followed by profuse offensive sweat, by seminal ejaculations. Profuse sweat, having a peculiar fetid, cadaverous or garlic-like odor is a characteristic of the remedy. Attacks frequently repeated, then followed by a long interval of rest. Petit mal. Epilepsy without aura after fright and other violent emotions. Epilepsy after masturbation. Several convulsions close together. Irregular or deficient menstruation with epileptic convulsions. Violent cramps in abdomen with irregular insufficient menstruation. Nervous chlorosis with very dry skin. Chorea with inability to swallow. Colored light produces dizziness. Worms. Right side convulsed, left paralyzed. MIND - Complaints from fright. Catalepsy after fright. Epilepsy after fright or grief. Weak-minded with epileptic fits. Excitable before the attack of epilepsy. Sudden whining. Stupor after convulsions. Peevish and inclined to weep. Very much vexed, irritable, depressed. Walks in the street, suddenly stops, stares into space often mumbles a few words, becomes normal and Artemisia vulgaris remembers nothing. Kleptomania. Inclination to steal.

Head - Drawn back by spasmodic twitch- ings. Head bent backwards and sideways. Congestion of brain. Sharp shooting pains through the head.

Eyes - Colored light produces dizziness. Pain and burning of vision, better rubbing, worse using eyes. Eyes turned up before attack.

Face - Twitching in the face, mouth drawn to left Face looks older.

Mouth - Mouth drawn to left. Chewing motion of gums, grinding teeth. Lower jaw pressed forward. Bites tongue in spasms. Speech unintelligible, can utter but single words, and these only with great exertion.

Throat - S wallowing difficult, food escapes from the mouth. Vertigo - Vertigo caused by colored lights, but not by white light. Epileptic vertigo. COMMENTS - Convulsions of nursing or teething children. Epileptic spasms, after cooling off, while over- heated from dancing. Epilepsy from menstrual disturbances. Nightly epilepsy with violent trismus injuring teeth. During epileptic attacks violent sweat of offensive odor. Long and deep sleep after a fit. Sleepwalking. Congestion of the brain and spine. Hydrocephalus. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Absin. - nearest relative. (2) Abrot., Cina, Cham., Am., Mill. (3) Cic. - staring, jerking head, etc. (4) Cina - eyes. (5) Apis, Hell. (6) Bufo - irritable before fit, Caust., Ruta, Sec. (7) Bry. - chewing motion of jaw. Compatible: Stram., Puls., Aur. Follows well after: Aeon., Bell., Bry., Hell., Cina, lod. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting. Cramps in stomach.

Abdomen - Violent cramps in abdomen. Causations - Blow on head. Fright, grief or bad news. Masturbation. Constitutions - It has a prominent place in convulsive diseases of childhood and girls at puberty.

Rectum - Greenish diarrhea. Passes feces and urine with the spasms. Worms.

Male - Nightly pollutions. Seminal ejaculations with the spasm.

Female - Irregular or deficient menstruation with epileptic convulsions. Profuse menses. Violent uterine contractions. Spasms during menses. Prolapsed uterus. Nervous chlorosis, with very dry skin. Violent contractions of pregnant uterus, threatened miscarriage. Checked lochia. Eclampsia. Food - Hunger, but cannot get the food down.

Limbs - Over-fatigue or weakness of the feet after long walks or long illness. Lungs - Rattling breathing with the spasms. Breathing checked, suddenly a deep inspiration ends the attack, catalepsy.

Sleep - Sleepwalking. Gets up at night and works, but remembers nothing in the morning (Luna.. Kali-p.).

Teeth - Grinding of teeth, forth at mouth, thumbs drawn into fist, eyes half open, drawn upwards.

Kidneys - Urine increased, yellowish. Obstinate strangury in a child.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat, smelling like garlic. Sweats during epileptic attacks. Sweating is a sign of relief. Warm sweat all over, most on occiput.

Temperature - Chilly, feels unwell with drawing in limbs Coldness of body.

full:
PHARMACY - arum-d. Arum dracontium. Green dragon. Arisaema dracontium. N. O. Araceae. North America. Tincture of root before flowering or after the ripening of the seeds. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Coughs. Croup. Headaches. Hoarseness. Impotency. Influenza. Itching. Laryngismus stridulus. Pharyngitis. Sore, throat. Urticaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - Arum-d. has the irritating properties of Arums generally. It has been well proved by Dr. C. P. Hart and tested clinically as well. Asthmatic attacks from cold. Croupy, hoarse cough with sore throat. Laryngismus between 12 a.m. and 2 a.m., attacks every week or ten days. Pharyngitis with sore, raw and tender throat. Swallowing develops and worsens the throat symptoms. Dryness and smarting. Throat raw and tender. Hawking. Continual disposition to clear throat by hawking and coughing. Hoarseness on awaking in morning, expectorates thick mucus. Expectoration of thick, heavy, yellowish-white pus. Rattling of mucus on full expiration. Chronic itching. Eruption of pimples or species of lichen, on nose, a patch of urticaria on right arm near elbow. The symptoms move about and from side to side, especially right to left. MIND - Great languor and depression of spirits, with asthma at night.

Head - Heavy, shooting pain in ears, aching pain behind right ear.

Throat - Contant disposition to clear throat. Hoarseness, excess of mucus in larynx. Dry, sore, worse swallowing. Raw and tender throat. Laryngismus. RELATIONS - Arum Italicum. Arum macula- turn. Compare: (1) Calad, in skin affections, Arum-t. (2) Useful after: Colch. and Ant-t. in laryngismus. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Rumbling and much flatus. Pain in bowels from incarcerated flatus.

Rectum - Flatus with eructations. Copious, semi-liquid stool with much flatus. Bilious stools with aching in abdomen and burning in rectum.

Male - Frequent and copious emissions of urine. Great diminution, mostly an entire absence of sexual desire. Penis flaccid and relaxed. Fine shooting pains in course of left spermatic cord. Lungs - Asthmatic at night. Asthma from cold. Oppression of breathing. Rattling of mucus. Paroxysms of dyspnea with considerable secretion of mucus in larynx and trachea. Expectoration thick, heavy.

Heart - Heart beats so violently as to shake walls of chest.

Skin - Urticaria and other eruptions. Neurotic eruptions.

Kidneys - Irresistible desire to pass urine, burns and smarts.

Cough - Loose cough with dry soreness of throat, worse at night lying down. Cough from laryngeal irritation, worse at night and when lying down. Croupy, hoarse cough with sore throat. Rattling cough in larynx and swelling of air passages, threatening suffocation.

CLINICAL - Nettle rash. Pricking pains.

HERBAL - Arum-dru. is commonly cultivated in gardens. It has a fetid smell which is apt to cause headache. A styptic metallic taste at back of mouth was observed after pounding the root and tearing up leaves and stems.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pricking, mingled with intolerable itching in fingers, as if hand plunged among nettles. On rubbing the fingers together, a sensation follows, as if a vast number of stings were driven perpendicularly into them. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - arum-i. Arum italicum. N. O. Araceae. Southern Europe. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Brain-fag. Colic. Fever. Headache. Hoarseness. Itching.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Paul Pitet is the authority forthis medicine. He used it forbrain-fatigue with headache in occipital region. The chief symptoms observed were headache, chiefly in occiput, worse in damp weather. Dull pain in brain/rom least intellectual effort. Colic in umbilical region with diarrhea. Smarting and tearing pains in rectum during stool. Burning behind sternum. Burning in fingers, worse by pressure. Skin covered with miliary vesicles. Prickling and formication as from hundreds of needles on fingertips. The colic is worse by wine, brandy, coffee. Itching is worse 6 p.m. Hoarseness at 9 p.m. Damp weather worse. Unconquerable drowsiness in morning. Copious night sweat, especially on chest, smelling of ivy. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aeth., Pic-ac. (2) Anae. - brain-fag. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Arum Maculatum
author: Murphy
constitution: Ascarides. Asthma. Catarrh. Coryza. Hoarseness. Nasal, polyps. Prolapsed anus. Scorbutus. Swallowing, constant.
keynote:
PHARMACY - arum-m. Arum maculatum. Cuckoo-pint. Arum vulgare. N. O. Araceae. Tinctureoffresh tuber or com. ffistoric«Z<fose.’ Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascarides. Asthma. Catarrh. Coryza. Hoarseness. Nasal, polyps. Prolapsed anus. Scorbutus. Swallowing,…
full:
PHARMACY - arum-m. Arum maculatum. Cuckoo-pint. Arum vulgare. N. O. Araceae. Tinctureoffresh tuber or com. ffistoric«Z<fose.’ Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascarides. Asthma. Catarrh. Coryza. Hoarseness. Nasal, polyps. Prolapsed anus. Scorbutus. Swallowing, constant.

HOMEOPATHIC - Leading symptoms include inflammation and ulceration of mucus membranes. Violent irritation of nose and eyes. Pain left side of nose. Nasal irritation with polyps. Bleeding from mucus membranes and cavities. Violent convulsions. Great physical depression and lassitude. Irrepressible inclination to sleep after meals, the face becoming redder than usual during sleep. Tongue swollen, pricking, stinging, burning, excoriated. Burning, stinging pains in mouth and lips “as with a hundred needles.” Tickling and burning in throat. Sensation of a swelling in left side above larynx. Hoarseness. From abdomen ascending to chest an oppression over whole chest with hot breath, it then rose into throat. Burning, constricting pain in stomach. Ascaride. Prolapsed anus. MIND - Anxiety and fear. Hypochondriacal. Melancholy and depressed. Taciturn.

Head - Migraine. Headache in left temple and forehead. Headache with dyspepsia.

Eyes - Aching in left eye.

Nose - Violent irritation of nose and eyes.

Mouth - Gums bleed readily. Tongue so swollen he could not swallow.

Throat - Pain in the throat with difficult deglutition, as if from constriction in the esophagus with constant inclination to swallow after drinking, sensation as if something were attached to the epiglottis. Obstinate hoarseness. Pressure in the larynx. Tickling with inclination to cough. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Sweet oil, milk, butter. Gum relieves pungent effect on mouth. Compare: (1) Arum-t. Arums. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Stomach - Pains in stomach on pressing it. Burning, constricting pains. Vomiting of blood.

Abdomen - Sensation of emptiness after breakfast in the abdomen, as after vomiting with contraction in the abdomen, as from anxiety and fear. Severe aching between the navel and the hip, especially when standing upright, lying on the side, or drawing a deep inspiration, with great sensitiveness of the part affected to external pressure.

Rectum - Diarrhea. Ascarides. Prolapsed anus.

Female - Menses profuse.

Sleep - Redness of face during sleep. Almost uncontrollable sleepiness, an hour after dinner.

Skin - Redness and erosions of skin. Blisters. Eczema.

Kidneys - Clear, watery urine, exhaling a smell of burned horn and depositing a cloudy sediment. Lungs - Phlegm in the respiratory organs. Violent tight cough with a scanty expectoration. Bloody expectoration. After much coughing, expectoration of mucus streaked with yellow.

name: Arum Triphyllum
author: Murphy

PHARMACY - arum-t. Arum triphyllum. Jack-in-the-Pulpit. Arisaema atrorubens. Indian turnip. N. O. Araceae. North and South America. Tincture of fresh tuber or corm. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.
