full:
PHARMACY - arum-t. Arum triphyllum. Jack-in-the-Pulpit. Arisaema atrorubens. Indian turnip. N. O. Araceae. North and South America. Tincture of fresh tuber or corm. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Acrid, discharges. Brain, inflammation. Clergyman's sore throat. Delirium. Diphtheria. Glandular, swellings. Hay fever. Headache. Hoarseness. Jaw-joint painful. Laryngitis. Mouth, sore. Scarlatina. Tongue, cracked. Typhoid fever. Voice, hoarse.

HERBAL - Arum-t. is the most important of the Arums. Arum maculatum, Italicum, Dracon- tium, have the same action as the Triphyllum. They all contain an irritant poison, causing inflammation of mucus surfaces and destruction of tissue.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Lippe, who is one of the greatest authorities on this remedy, said it should not be given low or repeated often. “Bores head in pillow” is an indication when the brain is involved. Kent pointed out that almost all the discharges are acrid and cause irritation of orifices. The hoarseness is that of public speakers who, after long exertion, get cold (as from a draft) and suddenly are unable to finish (Rhus-t. the hoarseness is at the beginning and passes off by using the voice.). Well marked irritating properties, excitable and irritable in mind and body. Raw, bloody surfaces appear on lips, on mouth, on nose, etc. Rawness with itching. Discharges are acrid, causing painful sore, rawness and burning of parts. Acrid, mucus membranes of mouth, throat and larynx. Irritating to the nose and throat. Prominently affects the left side. Headache, worse from hot coffee, from too hot clothing. Children lose their appetite, do not want to play, lose flesh, have headaches. Picks the nose and lips until they bleed. Corners of mouth sore, cracked and bleeding also, “pickingends offingers”and “boringnose” Especially side of nose. Tongue cracked and bleeding. Urine scanty or suppressed. Bores head into the pillow. Jerking shooting pain. Patient passes into unconsciousness and slides down in bed. This with its scarlet rash suggested its appropriateness in cases of scarlatina of malignant type in which it has met with great success. An indication of its curative action in scarlatina is the urine becoming more abundant and watery. MIND - Restlessness, tossing about in bed. Nervous, bites nails until fingers bleed. Restlessness orirritability. Excessively cross and stubborn. Great delirium. Delirium, bores in nose, picks at one spot or at dry lips. Forgetful. Absence of mind, giddy.

Head - Bores head into pillow. Child puts hand on back of head and cries during headache. Headache from too warm clothing, from becoming hot and hot coffee. Violent headache, pressing on right or both sides, worse from hot coffee, better after dinner, and after breakfast. Head burning hot. Tinea capitis.

Eyes - Quivering of upper left eyelid. Heavy, sleepy. Aversion tolight. Quivering of left upper lid. Catarrh of lachrymal sac, bores into side of nose.

Nose - Soreness of nostrils. Constant picking at nose until it bleeds or picking at lips, fingers, until it is sore, especially children. Nasal obstruction with fetid discharge, sneezing worse at night. Large scabs high up on right side of nose. Hay fever with pain over root of nose. Coryza, discharge blood-streaked, watery. Acrid, excoriating discharge, producing raw sores. Nose completely stopped with fluent, acrid discharge, must breathe through mouth.

Face - Face feels chapped, as if from cold wind, feels hot. Lips dry, swollen, cracked, corners of mouth sore, bleeding, cracked, picks them. Face swollen. Swelling of submaxillary glands.

Mouth - Raw feeling at roof and palate. Lips chapped and burning. Lips dry, swollen, cracked corners of the mouth sore. Corners of mouth sore and cracked. Picking lips until they bleed. Mouth painfully raw, sore inflamed. Aphthae. Saliva profuse, acrid, corroding.

Throat - Clergyman's sore throat. Hoarseness. Laryngitis. Expectoration of much mucus. Voice uncertain, uncontrollable. Worse talking, singing. Constricted and swollen, burns, raw. Constant hawking. Raw, sore, painful on clearing or coughing, yet grasps and wants to scratch it. Swelling of glands on throat and neck.

Stomach - Sensation of emptiness, as after vomiting, with contraction.

Abdomen - Sensation of emptiness after breakfast. Severe aching between the navel and the hip, with great sensitiveness of the part affected to external pressure. Contraction in the abdomen, as from anxiety and fear.

Rectum - Diarrhea, typhoid-like. Stools like corn meal. Stool dark brown, watery, thin, acrid. Thin feces escape from anus, and keep the parts raw and burning.

Male - Tearing pain in right testicle, sometimes extending to abdomen, comes and goes suddenly. Smarting at end of penis. Modalities - Worse from over use of voice. Worse talking, singing. Worse from cold winds. Worse northwest wind. Worse cold wet. Worse heat. Worse lying down.

Female - Cutting pain in either ovary. Menstrual blood darker. Menses checked for two months, returned. Food - Loss of appetite.

Chest - Raw feeling in chest. Lungs sore.

Back - Stiff-neck, with intolerable pressing headache. Pain in region of atlas vertebra, extending to right side. Sore, moist places on coccyx.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from soreness of mouth or itching of skin. Starting during sleep.

Skin - Dry heat of skin. Scarlet rash, raw, bloody surfaces anywhere. Itching of fingers and toes. Eruptions leave a brilliant red stain. Pemphigus. Impetigo contagiosa. Erythema of scarlet rash, skin peels afterwards. Itching of scarlet eruption.

Tongue - Tongue sore, red papillae elevated. Tongue red, sore, whole mouth raw. Tongue cracked and bleeding. Strawberry tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo andfullness. Vertigo with absence of mind. Light-headed, sleepy. COMMENTS - One of the first indications for this remedy is the appearance of raw, bloody surfaces, which may be on the lips, buccal cavity, nose, back of ear, etc. Burning in many parts, ear, lips, tongue, palate, throat, anus, lungs, upper arms. Child has headache, puts hand on back of head and cries. A raw spot appears on the lip, corners of mouth, or on the nose. Emitting one drop of blood, urine scanty, this raw spot may occur on the hand when the child bores and digs at it. Dull headache, upper part feels cold, as if open and without covering. Keynote irresistible desire to pick the nose (Cina), from inflammation of the nerve endings in the nose. Hay fever or coryza that leaves ulcers and sores on the upper lip. For hoarseness and laryngitis, “speaker's sore throat.” Raw feeling in the palate and throat, burning. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Buttermilk, Lac-ac., Acet-ac., Puls. Compare: (1) Am- c., All-c. (2) The other Arums and Calad. (3) Ail.’- scarlatina, depressing, stupid, drowsy sleep. (4) Cina - boring nose. (5) Am-c. - acrid discharge from nose in scarlatina, but right parotid more decidedly affected in Am-c., drowsiness is very marked. (6) Am-m. (scarlatina), Arg-n. (scarlatina, painful red blotches left side of tongue). (7) Ars., Canth., Caps. (8) Castor. - nasal discharge watery and acrid but with violent tearing pain at root of nose. (9) Caust., All-c., Crocus - elevated papillae, but tongue white. (10) Hep., Hydr-ac., lod., Kali- i., Lach., Lyc., Merc., Mez., Mur-ac., Nit-ac., Phyt., Sang., Sil., Sulph. (11) Useful after: Hep., Nit-ac., Caust., Seneg. Complementary: Nit-ac. Incompatible: Calad. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Very scanty secretion of urine. Uremia. Frequent discharge of abundant pale urine. Clear, watery urine and smelling like burnt horn, and depositing a cloudy sediment. Lungs - Accumulation of mucus in trachea. Cough hurts the throat and annoys the patient. Voice, hoarse, squeaky or breaks. Hay asthma.

name: Arundo Mauritanica
author: Murphy
constitution: Allergies. Catarrh. Coryza. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Ear, discharge. Edema. Hayfever. Hair, loss. Itching. Nasal, discharges. Ophthalmia. Pustules. Scrofulous, ophthalmia. Sneezing. Stomach, pain. Urine, deposits. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - arund. Arundo mauritanica. Reed. Italian grass. Arundo donax. N. O. Gramineae. Mediterranean. Tincture of the root sprouts. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Catarrh. Coryza. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Ear, discharge.…
full:
PHARMACY - arund. Arundo mauritanica. Reed. Italian grass. Arundo donax. N. O. Gramineae. Mediterranean. Tincture of the root sprouts. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Catarrh. Coryza. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Ear, discharge. Edema. Hayfever. Hair, loss. Itching. Nasal, discharges. Ophthalmia. Pustules. Scrofulous, ophthalmia. Sneezing. Stomach, pain. Urine, deposits. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Arundo is a reedy grass and the tincture is made from the root-shoots. It has not been tested much clinically, but its chief sphere has been proved to be in catarrhal conditions. Chagon is the authority for the pathogenesis. Hay fever, beginning with burning and itching of palate and conjunctiva. Catarrhal states. Constant watery diarrhea of nursing or teething children. Urine deposits much red sand. Mouth excoriated. Thirst. Coryza and snuffing. Pain in liver. Purulent discharge from the ear. MIND - Dullness of mind. Indifference to painful sensations. Absence of ideas. Anxiety better open air. Anxiety from coughing. Anxiety from accumulation of mucus in bronchi. Lascivious fancies. Laughs easily, a stupid hilarity.

Head - Itching, falling off of hair. Hair falls off entirely in children. Roots of hairs painful. Pustules. Pain in occiput, extends to right ciliary region. Deep seated pain in sides of head. Painful undulation in frontal region. Scurf.

Eyes - Ophthalmia in children. Blepharitis. Pricking, itching, burning in conjunctiva. Undulating luminous openings appear wherever he looks. Fluttering luminous objects. Cannot look up.

Ears - Burning and itching in auditory canals. Eczema behind ears. Purulent discharge from ears. Sound of little bells in ears.

Nose - Hay fever begins with burning and itching of palate and conjunctiva. Annoying itching in the nostrils and roof of the mouth (Wye.). Coryza, loss of smell (Nairn.). Sneezing, itching of nostrils.

Face - Erysipelas on right cheek. Pricking in point of chin.

Mouth - Bleeding of gums. Ulcers and exfoliations in the commissures. Fissures in tongue. Pain in sublingual glands. Salivation. Burning and itching of palate.

Throat - Globus hystericus. Pit of throat as if bruised afterexpectoration. Burning and pain on swallowing. Obstruction prevents swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo on getting out of bed. COMMENTS - Hay fever remedy, keynote itching in the nostrils. Loss of smell (Puls., Sabad.). Itching of the upper palate, raw and sore, try to scratch palate with their tongue (Wye.). Burning itching in auditory canals, coincides with pain in sublingual glands. The inflammation of ears begins with shooting pains in concha, extends to external meatus, finally with itching and discharge of blood. Hay fever. Pain at root of nose. Coryza with snuffling. In the beginning, water runs from nose, later, green mucus and thick, white, slimy masses, with sneezing, pieces of indurated greenish mucus. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anthroxantum. (2) Anan., Lolium. (3) All-c., Sil., Sulph., Calc., Lyc., Sabad., Psor. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Coldness in stomach. Longing for acids. Wants to belch but cannot. Burning in esophagus.

Abdomen - Movement as from something alive in abdomen. Flatulence, pain at pubic region. Pain in liver. Pricking in spleen. Acute pain at umbilicus.

Rectum - Burning at anus. Constant diarrhea of nursing or teething children (Cham., Calc-p.). Greenish stools. Stools at first hard, soon become loose. Stools followed by burning at anus. Pricking at anus. Hemorrhoids and prolapsed rectum.

Male - Pain in spermatic cord after sex. Sexual desire, lascivious ideas, frequent erections. Difficult breathing after sex.

Female - Early, profuse, long-lasting menses, dark, clotted blood. Sexual desire with vaginal itching. Violent desire for sex or aversion to it. Pains start from left side of jaw, extending to shoulders and loins and finally settling on pubis, burning like fire. Food - Want of appetite. Constant thirst, after waking in morning. Thirst during fever. Food tastes insipid. Water has a bad taste. Craving for acids.

Chest - Pricking in chest.

Heart - Pricking in arteries. Abnormal movements of heart. Oppression of heart.

Back - Acute pain under left scapula. Jerking in neck, crawling on left side of it. Breasts - Excessive secretion of milk causes pain in left breast. Burning and pain in nipples.

Limbs - Itching, burning. Edema of hands and feet. Pain in limbs as if tightly bandaged. Burning and swelling of soles. Copious and offensive sweat of feet. Lungs - Accumulation of mucus in bronchi causes anxiety. Catarrhal cough. Dyspnea, cough, bluish expectoration. Sputa at first bluish, then white, and alternates. After expectorating, bruised feeling in pit of throat. After cough, burning in the epigastrium, with the larynx obstructed.

Skin - Eczema, itching and crawling, especially of chest, upper limbs. Fissures in fingers and heels.

Kidneys - Burning on urinating. After urinating, weight, burning, and itching in urethra. Red sediment (Lyc.), red sand in urine.

Perspiration - Tendency to sweat. Motion causes profuse sweat.

name: Asafoetida
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Many symptoms appear while sitting and are better in open air. Touch relieves pain in head, on touch pains cease or change place. Scratching relieves itching. Worse atnight. Worse leftside. Worse during rest. Worse warm applications, warm wraps. Worse after suppressions. Worse mercury. Worse noise. Worse sitting. Worse after eating or drinking..
constitution: Asthma. Belching. Bone, diseases. Breast-feeding. Chorea. Decay, bones. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia Fainting, easily. Flatulence. Globus, hystericus. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hypersensitiveness. Hysteria. Iritis. Mercury, poisoning. Neuralgias. Obesity. Orbital, neuralgia. Ozaena. Syphilis. Tympanitis. Ulcers. Whitlow.
keynote:
PHARMACY - asaf. Asafoetida. Gum-of the Stinkasand. Ferula asafoetida. Narthex Asafoetida. Scorodosma foetida. N. O. Umbel- liferae. Tincture of the gum resin, obtained by incision from the living root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Belching.…
full:
PHARMACY - asaf. Asafoetida. Gum-of the Stinkasand. Ferula asafoetida. Narthex Asafoetida. Scorodosma foetida. N. O. Umbel- liferae. Tincture of the gum resin, obtained by incision from the living root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Belching. Bone, diseases. Breast-feeding. Chorea. Decay, bones. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia Fainting, easily. Flatulence. Globus, hystericus. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hypersensitiveness. Hysteria. Iritis. Mercury, poisoning. Neuralgias. Obesity. Orbital, neuralgia. Ozaena. Syphilis. Tympanitis. Ulcers. Whitlow.

HERBAL - The fetid smell of Asafoetida may be regarded as one of its "herbal signatures. ”

HOMEOPATHIC - Fetid discharge from the nose, bones affected. Offensive discharges. Watery stoolsof most disgusting odor, profuse and greenish, fetid flatus. Belchings smelling like garlic. Flatulent hysteria. Characteristic sensitiveness to touch. Flatulence and spasmodic contractions of stomach and esophagus with reverse peristalsis, everything comes up, nothing goes down. Excessive abdominal distention and sensation as if everything in the abdomen would burst through the mouth. After belching of wind, strong rancid taste in mouth. Sinking sensation at epigastrium, worse 11 a.m. Hysteria from suddenly suppressed discharges. Deficient milk with over sensitiveness after confinement. Decay of bones, especially in the syphilitic organism, with extreme sensitiveness and terrible throbbing, nightly pains. Glands all over the body are hot and throb. Pain, as if a nail or plug driven in. MIND - Dissatisfied with oneself. Irritable, complains of her troubles. Irritability during menses, alternating with indifference. Changing moods, fits of joy with burst of laughter. Fickle, cannot persevere in anything. Wants now one thing, then another. Great excitability and sensitiveness, yet with complete indifference to everything. Ill-humor. Apprehensive. Fear arising from abdomen. Fear from stomach. Apprehension of dying. Fears paralysis or softening of brain. Hysterical and hypochondriacal. Magnifies her symptoms. Craves sympathy. Hysteriafrom suddenly suppressed discharges. Hysteria with much trouble about throat or esophagus, clutches throat. Walks hither and thither. Oversensitiveness, mental and physical. Faints from emotional excitement or disturbance. Faintness from noise or from being in crowded streets. Fainting during pain. Faints when he thinks that he has taken medicine. Faints almost without cause in a closed room.

Head - Headaches in occipital region, better stool. Irritable, complains of her troubles, sensitive. Pressive pain from within outward. Boring pain above eyebrows.

Eyes - Orbital neuralgia, better pressure and from rest. Iritis and intra-ocular inflammations with boring, throbbing pains at night. Stitches under left frontal eminences. Boring pains in and around eyes. Syphilitic iritis. Superficial corneal ulcer with digging pains, worse at night. Eyelids stick to balls. Numbness about eyes, ulceration of cornea. Syphilitic iritis.

Ears - Offensive otorrhea with boring pains in mastoid bone. Mastoid disease with pain in temporal region with pushing out sensation. Offensive, purulent discharge. Hardness of hearing.

Nose - Offensive discharge from the nose. Syphilitic ozaena with very offensive purulent discharge. Decay of nasal bones (Aur.). Tension over nasal bones with numbness.

Face - Puffy, purple as if heated. Small tubercles in the cheek. Swelling of the lower lip. Numbness of bones.

Mouth - Greasy, rancid taste. Constant chewing with frothy saliva from mouth, chorea.

Throat - Sensation as if peristaltic motion were reversed and esophagus were driven from stomach to throat. Sensation as if a ball rises in throat. Globus hystericus. Everything presses towards throat. Spasms of gullet and stomach. Vertigo - Vertigo with violent pressing in head. Vertigo with vanishing of sight. Vertigo with sweat on forehead and limbs. COMMENTS - Asafoetida has hiccough-like contractions of diaphragm. Griping pain below navel while standing. Heat in spleen and abdomen. Stitches in right hypochondrium towards the diaphragm. Affects the left side generally, left side of abdomen, left hypochondrium, left side of neck and nape, left arm, left leg. Hysterical restlessness and anxiety. Eyes inflamed, dry sensation, better in open air. Characteristic bruised, sore and sensitive bones of the orbits. Iritis after abuse of mercury (Merc, has less sensitiveness). Decay of bones, bone diseases. Multiple nodes on the roof of mouth, discolored, bone deeply involved. Periosteal disorders ending in ulcers which are so sensitive that no dressing is tolerated. Pressing pains in various parts, especially pressure from within outwards, worse in room, better in open air. Used for foul flatulence where it is a social, cultural problem. Lingering odor. Regurgitation and bad-smelling and bad- tasting burps. Belchings, the taste stays in their mouth for hours or even days. Used in tincture for giardia and parasites with the symptom of foul smelling flatus. RELATIONS -Antidotes: China, Merc.Antidoted by: Puls., Caust., Camph., Chin., Merc., Valer. Compare: (1) Aur, Chin, Lach, Merc, Sumb, Valer. (2) Compare family relations: Am-c., Cic., Con. (3) Similar to: Arg-n. - better open air, Aur. - bone diseases, iritis, Castor., Chin., Caust., Crot-t. (whooping cough), Hep. - sensitiveness round ulcers, faints from pains, (4) Mosch., Mang, and Kali-i. (5) nodes: Mang., bluish, Kali-i., pink, pain unbearable. Asaf, the nodes are multiple and discolored. (6) Ign., Merc., Phos., Puls., Thuj., Valer. Complementary: Caust. Puls. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Explosive belchings smelling like garlic and rancid in taste. Violent gastralgia, cutting and burning in stomach and region of diaphragm. Great difficulty in bringing up flatus. Flatulence and regurgitation of liquids. Sensation of emptiness and weakness with distention and beating in the stomach and abdomen. Forcible eructation of gas. Gurgling and rolling of flatus, which escapes afterwards with loud and difficult eructation. Pulsation in the pit of stomach, perceptible to the hand or even visible.

Abdomen - Great distention. Flatulence, sudden, pushing upwards. Flatuent colic with abdominal pulsations. Hysterical flatulence. Bowels seem knotted. Flatus passing upwards, none downwards. Heat in spleen and abdomen. Bones - Periosteum painful, swollen, enlarged. Decay of bones and deep ulcerations. Ulcers affecting bones, thin, ichorous pus. Fits of hard, violent throbbing. Pains are pressive, sharp, stitching, extending outwards, associated with numbness. Pains change place and are better by touch. Aching, boring in bones. Darting pain and decay in bones. Breasts - Breasts turgid with milk, when not pregnant. Deficient milk with oversensitiveness. Galactagogue, in sensitive, hysterical women. Causations - Ill effects of checked skin eruptions or suppressed discharges. Neuralgia of stump after operations. Nervous disorders from suppressed skin eruptions. Most pains are accompanied by numbness in the affected parts.

Rectum - Distended, griping with hunger. Obstinate constipation. Pain in perineum, as if something dull pressed out. Diarrhea, extremely offensive with meteorism and regurgitation of food. Diarrhea, stools dark, watery with disgusting odor. Only mucus is passed.

Male - Needle like stitches in penis. Fainting after seminal emissions.

Female - Menses too early too scanty, last for a short time. Irritability during menses, alternating with indifference. Bearing down in the genital especially while riding in a carriage. Labor-like pains in uterine region, with cutting and bearing down. Leucorrhea, profuse, greenish, thin offensive. Swelling and inflammation of genitals. Excited sexual desire. Uterine ulcer, sensitive and painful. Miscarriages. Food - Ravenous hunger. Disgust for all food. Aversion to beer. Beer tastes slimy. Desire for strong, cooling food. Desire for wine. Fat food causes indigestion. Heat in face after eating. Diarrhea after eating. Want of thirst. Fever without thirst.

Chest - Spasmodic tightness, as if lungs could not be fully expanded. Palpitation more like a tremor. Constitutions - Suited to nervous and hysterical people, phlegmatic, scrofulous and syphilitic who have taken much Mercury. Though the patient is of full habit and stout aspect yet he is intolerably nervous and oversensitive. Clumsy children. Obesity.

Heart - Palpitations more like a tremor. Heart seems full, distended. Reflex heart symptoms of nervous origin.

Limbs - Pain and tenderness in tibia intolerable, worse night. Cannot work on account of backache. Cold swelling around ankles. Convulsive tremors better by holding. Lungs - Asthmatic attacks at least once in a day, worse bodily exertion, sex, satisfying meals. Spasms of the glottis, alternating with contraction of finger and toes.

Skin - Suppressed skin symptoms produce nervous disorders. Itching, better scratching, ulcers painful on edges. Eruptions of vesicles. Bluish ulcers with highly sensitive edges. Itching better scratching. Old scars turn purple and ulcerate. Foul burrowing pus.

Modalities - Many symptoms appear while sitting and are better in open air. Touch relieves pain in head, on touch pains cease or change place. Scratching relieves itching. Worse atnight. Worse leftside. Worse during rest. Worse warm applications, warm wraps. Worse after suppressions. Worse mercury. Worse noise. Worse sitting. Worse after eating or drinking.

Kidneys - Urine brown and of pungent odor. Spasms in bladder during and after urination.

Perspiration - Cold, moist skin. Cold sweat on limbs. Sweats during vertigo. Sweats with drowsiness.

Temperature - Chills runs over body. Chills with coldness and dryness of skin. Chills every day between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m. Coldness and trembling. Chill alternating with heat. Chills during faintness. Heat of face after dinner. Fever with anxiety and sleepiness. Fever without thirst. Heat in toes. Heat of face, with cold hands and feet, and chills of back.

full:
PHARMACY - asar. Asarum europaeum. European Snake-root. Asarum officinale. Asarabacca. Hazelwort. Wild Nard. Wild Nath. N. O. Aristolochiacae. Mountainous woods in Europe. Tinctures of root and whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Anus, prolapsed. Asthenopia. Catarrhs. Cough. Deafness. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Eyes, affections, operations. Faintness. Fidgets. Headache. Hypersensitive. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Levitation, sensation. Prolapsed rectum. Typhus. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Before Hahnemann's time, Asarum was little known except as an emetic. Hahnemann's proving brought to light some unique characteristics, including that cold air and cold washing ameliorates many of the symptoms. With a single dose of Asar. 200c, Clarke cured a case of sub-acute inflammation of eyes and lids which had lasted some months after an attack of influenza, the symptoms were better in open air and by washing in cold water. Deschere reported a case of dysmenorrhea in a nervous, fidgety woman of twentyseven, who had intense backache during first two days, so severe that the she could not move. It often rose to the dorsal region, when it would take away her breath. Cured with Asar. 50c, one dose every evening. Hypersensitiveness of nerves. Scratching on silk or linen, rattle of paper is unbearable, even the idea that someone might scratch with fingertip or nail produces a disagreeable thrill, through him. Nervous affections, loss of vital energy with excessive nerve sensitivity. Always feels cold. Cold shivers from any emotion. Sensation of lightness of the limbs. Pains and spasmodic muscular actions. Useful for the darting pains remaining after operations on the eyes. Nervous deafness and asthenopia. Tension and contractive sensations. Pressure, tension and contractive sensation are also leading features, patient thinks that his whole body or single parts were being pressed together. Mucus discharges are glairy. For alcoholics. MIND - Inability to think. Deficiency of ideas better vomiting. Thoughts vanish with drawing pressure in forehead. Thoughts vanish as when falling asleep. Vacant feeling on attempting to concentrate mind. No desire to do anything, from stupid feeling in head. Nervous irritability and exaltation. Sensibility increased, even from mere imagination. Feeling of lightness as if floating, when walking in the L, en air. Delusion he is hovering in air like : spirit. Thinks she is gliding through the air when she walks. Oversensitive to slightest noise. Cold shivers from any emotion is also a marked symptom. Ill-humor. Sadness, with weeping. Nerves on edge. Great merriness alternating with occasional momentary quiet or gloominess. Aversion to sex, kissing and embracing. Wrings hands. Very sensitive to violence.

Head - Compressive headache. Tension of whole scalp, cannot bear combing, hair painful (Chin.). Coryza with sneezing.

Eyes - Watering and burning of the eyes. Feel stiff, burn, feel cold. Better in cold air or water, worse sunlight and wind. Asthenopia. Darting pains in the eye after operations.

Ears - Painfully sensitive hearing. Sensation as if plugged up with coryza. Sensation as if skin were stretched over external ear (right). Catarrh with deafness. Heat of external ear. Noises.

Nose - Coryza with sneezing. Sharp aching pain above root of nose. Bloody mucus from nose. Dry coryza, left nostril stopped up. Tickling in nose, causing a sneeze, and discharge of clear fluid. Violent sneezing.

Face - Warm feeling in face better cold washing. Burning, stinging, on cheeks. Cutting pain with cramp at joint of lower jaw. Dryness of inner side of lower lip.

Mouth - Accumulation of cold watery saliva in the mouth with nausea. Tobacco tastes bitter when smoking. Clean tongue. Disgusting taste.

Stomach - Flatulence, belching and vomiting. Horrible feeling at epigastrium on waking in the morning, alcoholics. Nausea, worse after eating. Accumulation of cold, watery saliva. Violent empty retching. Violent vomiting with diarrhea and violent colic.

Abdomen - Oppression around navel, three or four times after each meal, lasting one hour. Pain in region of descending colon, with discharge of stringy mucus.

Rectum - Strings of odorless, yellow mucus pass from bowels. Diarrhea of tough mucus. Undigestedfood in stools. Stools worse after eating or drinking. Gelatinous or shreddy mucus in stool. Mucus colitis. Prolapsed rectum.

Female - Menses too early, long lasting, black. Violent pain in small of back. Tenacious, yellow leucorrhea. Violent pain in small of back at the appearance of menses, scarcely permitting her to breathe, worse motion. Threatened miscarriage from excessive sensibility of nerves. Food - Want of appetite, even nauseated by food. Craving for alcohol. Smoking tobacco tastes bitter.

Chest - Sharp pressure in region of last ribs as with the back of a knife. Pain around both lungs as if they were constricted by a wire. Frequent stitches in both lungs during inspiration. Constitutions - Nervous constitutions. It is suitable to people of sedentary habits who shrink from cold or always feel cold. Literary, sedentary people who are sick and chilly.

Back - Paralytic pain in muscles of nape of neck. Weakness with staggering.

Limbs - Lightness of all the limbs. Gurgling sensation in patella. Weakness with staggering. Lungs - Nervous, hacking cough. Short respiration. Asthmatic breathing, worse odors and cold. Both lungs as if constricted by wire. Stitches in larynx better cough.

Sleep - Great drowsiness by day. Short breath by night. Frequent yawning, great drowsiness. Nightly vexatious dreams, about humiliations. Restless sleep.

Modalities - Better from cold bathing of face. Better washing. Better in damp and wet weather. Better on wetting affected parts. Worse in cold dry weather. Worse from penetrating noise. Worse emotions. Worse retching.

Perspiration - Sweat is sour, easily excited. Sweats easily, especially on upper body. Sour sweat in axillae. Sweats after lying down in evening.

Temperature - Chilliness, single parts get icy cold. Cold feeling not better by covering or heat of room. Vertigo - Great faintness. Elderly people with weak constitutions, who get dizzy easily. Lightness as if floating. Sensation that she is gliding through the air, when she walks. COMMENTS - Sensation as though whole body or single parts were being pressed together. Pain as from contraction in forehead, temples and behind ear with watering and burning of the eyes, worse afternoon, better when sitting and by washing. Pressure, tension and contractive sensations. Plugged sensation. Sensation of skin stretched over right external ear. Deafness. Eyes inflamed, bleary, staring. Weak sight, worse bright light. When reading, sensation as if eyes would be pressed asunder. Accumulation of cold watery saliva in mouth. Hunger in early morning. Constant nausea. Vomiting with diarrhea and violent colic. Stool of jelly-like mucus. Menstrual colic. Headache before and after menses. Violent pain in small of back which scarcely permits her to breathe, at beginning of menses. Heat, especially of face and in palms of hands. When retching, all symptoms worse except dullness of the head, which is better. Vertigo as if floating, or can't feel the ground, particularly in the elderly (Calc.). Can get faint or lose sensations in their legs. Sensitive to odors and noises. Can crave alcohol. Also a geriatric remedy for weak constitutions, easily dizzy (Ambr., Con.). RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., vinegar and vegetables acids. Compare: (1) Aeon., Arg-n, Castor, Ther. (2) Aloe. - stringy stools, Camph. - cholerine, Cupr., Hep., Ip. - cholerine, Merc. - stringy stools. (3) Nux-v., Phos., Podo., Puls, and Sul-ac. - stringy stools, Sep., Stram., Tab. and Verat. - cholerine. Asaf. - over- sensitiveness. (4) Sticta, Calc., Cann-i., Gels., Thuj., Ol-j. - levitation. Mosch., Tarent., Meph., Zinc. - fidgety feet. (5) Ip., especially in diarrhea, Sil., Nux-v., China. Complementary: Caust, Puls, Sil. Followed well by: Bism. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

keynote: PHARMACY - asbes. Asbestos. Silicate mineral fiber. Asbestos is a term applied to some mineral silicates present in a fiber form. There are many members of the family: common among these are blue asbestos (crocidolite), white (chrysotile) and brown or grey asbestos (amosite).…
full:
PHARMACY - asbes. Asbestos. Silicate mineral fiber. Asbestos is a term applied to some mineral silicates present in a fiber form. There are many members of the family: common among these are blue asbestos (crocidolite), white (chrysotile) and brown or grey asbestos (amosite). Other forms of asbestos include an- thophyllite, and tremolite, which are present in some commercial talcs.Trituration.f/iviorica/ dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asbestosis. Anemia. Ascites. Bronchitis. Cancer. Dyspnea. Emphy- sema.^Fibrosis. Hoarseness. Lung, cancer. Mesothelioma. Nausea. Pleural, effusion. Pneumonia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Asbestos is a mineral fiber that was commonly used in a variety ofbuilding construction materials for insulation and as a fire retardant. The most dangerous asbestos fibers are too small to be visible. Once they are inhaled, the asbestos fibers can remain and accumulate in the lungs. Breathing high levels of the fibers can lead to an increased risk of lung cancer, mesothelioma (a cancer of the chest and abdominal linings), and asbestosis (irreversible lung scarring that can be fatal). Symptoms of these diseases do not show up until many years after exposure. The most common symptoms of asbestos exposure are shortness of breath, coughing, and chest pain. A dry crackling sound in the lungs while inhaling. Pains in the lower back or sides of the chest. Persistent coughs, loss of appetite, weight loss, and recurrent bronchitis or pneumonia. Less common symptoms may include fever or night sweats. Ascites or fluid buildup in the abdomen, weight loss, nausea, difficulty with bowel movements, anemia, and foot swelling.

Throat - Hoarseness. COMMENTS - Asbestos has been known and used for as long as 4,500 years. Many centuries ago, Finnish peasants mixed it in pottery and sealed cracks in their log huts with it. The ancient Romans wove asbestos fibers into fabrics to make towels, nets and even head coverings for women. Intheearly 1900's, doctors in Europe knew that asbestos workers were dying from respiratory ailments. In 1924, Dr. W. E. Cooke reported in the British Medical Journal cases of pulmonary fibrosis (asbestosis) in workers employed in the asbestos industry. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil. (2) Cob., Rado. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Abdomen - Ascites. Peritoneal cancer. Back - Pains in lower back.

Chest - Pains in sides of chest. Lungs - Breathing difficulties. Cancer. Shortness of breath, which increases overtime. Increased sputum. Chronic and persistent coughs. Coughing up blood. Scarring of lungs and pleura. Pleural effusion. Food - Loss of appetite. Weight loss and fatigue. Nausea.

PHARMACY - asc-c. Asclepias cornuti. Milkweed. Silkweed. Asclepias syriaca. N. O. Asclepiadacae. North America. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Bronchitis. Catarrhal fever. Diaphoresis. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Hay fever. Headaches. Indigestion. Influenza. Menses, scanty. Miscarriage. Neuralgia. Pleurisy. Rheumatism. Uremia. Uterine pains.

HOMEOPATHIC - Asclepias cornuti is a remedy for dropsy, hepatic, kidney or after scarlet fever. It causes diaphoresis and augments the urinary secretion. Dropsy after heart disease. Uremia. Intermittent, pressing- down uterine pains. Acts especially on the nervous system and urinary organs. Nervous headache, as if a sharp instrument were thrust through from one temple to the other with vomiting, followed by sweating or profuse urination. Belching of food with its proper taste. Influenza, catarrhal fever, bronchitis, hay fever. Headache from checked sweat or retention of effete matters. Uterine pains are intermittent, pressing with threatened miscarriage. Coldness of surface after vomiting. Diaphoresis, profuse sweat. Acute rheumatism confined to large joints with much pain and swelling.

Head - Nervous headache after suppressed perspiration, followed by increased urine with increase of specific gravity. Headache from retention of effete matters in system.

Throat - Burning and tickling in the fauces with nausea and headache.

Stomach - Excessive nausea with violent headache, violent vomiting and retching. Severe and long-continued vomiting. Sensation of rawness in the stomach and pain.

Abdomen - Flatuent colic. Rumbling in abdomen, as if diarrhea would set in. Pain and soreness in abdomen, with or without distension. Stitching and aching pains, in left side of abdomen.

Rectum - Diarrhea with nausea and vomiting with excoriation of the anus. Copious stools of soft, fluid consistence, yellowish in color and attended with some griping pain. Constipation, pain in right side, lower limbs, loss of appetite.

Male - Tickling sensation at the end of the penis.

Female - Intermittent, bearing-down, labor-like pains, pressing from sacrum to hypogastrium. Scanty flow. Suppression of menses. Food - Increased appetite, vomiting and headache with constipation. Great appetite even a few hours after a meal.

Heart - Action of heart lessened, pulse slow. Feeble pulse after vomiting.

Back - Cutting and aching about lowest dorsal vertebra.

Sleep - Drowsy, sleepiness, hard sleep during the night.

Tongue - Tongue covered with a white fur. Vertigo - Vertigo, dullness and stupidity. Vertigo with headache. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cimic., Bry., Colch., Asc-t. (2) Asclepias Vincetoxicum. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Ardor urinae. Increased flow of urine. Pale-colored urine with light specific gravity. Increase of solid matters in urine. Lungs - Increase of the bronchial secretions. Burning and tickling in fauces. Pain in left side of chest on deep inspiration (pleurisy).

Perspiration - Diaphoresis, profuse sweat.

Temperature - Coldness of the surface of the skin and feeble pulse.

full:
PHARMACY - asc-i. Asclepias incarnata. Swamp milkweed. N. O. Asclepiadaceae. North America. Tincture of the rhizome. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Asthma. Catarrh. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dyspnea. Leucorrhea. Rheumatism. Syphilis. Worms.

HERBAL - Asclepias Incarnata is diuretic, stomachic, anthelmintic, and in very large doses, emetic. When it is used anthelmintic, the powder of the root has been employed, in doses of ten to twenty grains per day. As a diuretic in dropsy this herb is of considerable value. It strengthens the heart. Often relieves the heart distress caused by infiltration of the tissues, especially the difficult breathing.

HOMEOPATHIC - Catarrhal discharges. Dropsy withdyspnea.Catarrhal inflammation of the respiratory organs. Dysentery and diarrhea. Leucorrhea. Rheumatism from cold. Dropsies. COMMENTS- Dr. Tully, of New Haven, has found it useful in catarrh, asthma, syphilis, rheumatism, and worms. Dr. Fowler, of New York, speaks in the most unequivocal terms of its virtues in amenorrhea. Dr. A. C. Jones, of Philadelphia, has given it in several cases of suppressed menstruation, without benefit. Dr. Hale, of Michigan, thinks it is the Asclepias syriaca which is so useful in amenorrhea, and not the Asclepias incarnata. REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Asclepias Tuberosa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse in morning. Worse on rising. Worse by motion. Worse by coughing. Worse from tobacco. Worse from motion. Worse deep breathing. Worse lying down. Worse rising up. Worse coughing..

full:
PHARMACY - asc-t. Asclepias tuberosa. Pleurisy root. Butterfly-weed. N. O. Asclepiadacae. North America. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alopecia. Asthma. Bilious fever. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chancre. Colic. Coughs. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Dysentery. Flatulence. Headaches. Heart disorders.Influenza. Marsh, fever. Ophthalmia. Pericarditis. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Pleuro-pneumonia. Pneumonia. Rheumatism. Scrofula. Syphilis.

HERBAL - Asc-t. is said to be diaphoretic and expectorant, without being stimulant. In large doses, it is often a cathartic. It is thought, by the herbal doctors, to act prominently on the cutaneous system, stimulating the capillary circulation, promoting diaphoresis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Asclepias tuberosa has been used for bronchitis andpleurisy. Marked action on the chest muscles, which has been verified. Also effective in autumn dysentery with painful diarrhea, griping and tenesmus. Increases the secretions of skin, serous and mucus membranes. Catarrhal states from cold and damp weather. Bronchitis and pleurisy. Pains in lungs better bending forward. Stitches in left side shooting over to right and up to left shoulder. Profuse perspiration in pneumonia and pleuropneumonia. A general eliminative remedy, acting specially on the sweat glands. Influenza with pleuritic pains. Cutting pain behind sternum intercostal spaces near sternum tender to pressure. Catarrhal complaints from cold and damp weather. Bilious marsh fever on rice plantations. High fever with hot sweat. Sick headache with flatulence in stomach and bowels. Dyspepsia. Sensitive to tobacco. Unfit for business because of pain in bowels and frequent stools. Irritation of larynx with huskiness, grip with pleuritic pain. Diarrhea or rheumatic conditions. Muscular and joint rheumatism with stitching pains, dark red urine and hot, perspiring skin. MIND - Dullness of mind with difficult thinking. Languid and dull all day both in body and mind. Memory weak. Mood changes, without any cause.Cheerful mood. Excessive dejection. Fretful and peevish.

Head - Headache better after footbath. Headache in the morning on rising. Headache pressing deeply on the base of the skull. Pain in the forehead from coughing. Alopecia.

Eyes - Eyes look dull, fatigued, and heavy, as after a long illness. Ophthalmia, with itching and pain in eyes. Feeling of sand in the eyes. Vision disturbed, large spots before the eyes.

Nose - Sticky yellow nasal discharge, Snuffles of children. Fluent coryza with much sneezing. Blowing of blood from left nostril. Itching of the nose. Snuffles of children.

Face - Hippocratic face after violent diarrhea. Yellow complexion. Vesicles on lips. Itching of lips.

Mouth - Breath smells like pepper. Tough yellow coating on tongue. Taste, putrid of blood. Teeth yellow- coated. Bleeding of the gums. Tongue covered with a tough yellow coating.

Throat - Slight constriction of throat, and pricking in larynx. Vertigo - Feeling of drunkenness with weakness of sight after smoking a very little. Swimming of the head with dullness behind forehead. COMMENTS - Sharp, stitching, pricking pains, worse by motion. Sensitive to tobacco. Pain in forehead and abdomen from coughing. Griping and sharp peritoneal pains, worse by pressure. Excessive weakness, walking seems impossible. Dyspnea. Hard cough, dry or hoarse, croupy with tight breathing and constriction of larynx and acute pleuritic pains. Warm feeling in chest. Pain like pricking of a needle in region of heart. Contracting pain in heart. Sharp pains, starting from left nipple downward with stiffness of left side of neck. Increased secretions of skin, serous and mucus membranes. Catarrhal states from cold and damp weather. Bronchitis and pleurisy (often will follow Bry. in pleurisy cases), coughing and pain in the chest and pain on breathing. Pains in lungs, better bending forward. Stitches in left side shooting over to right and up to left shoulder. Profuse perspiration in pleuro-pneumonia. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ant-t. (2) Asclepias Incamata. Periplocagreca - Cardiac tonic, acts on circulation and respiratory center, accelerating the respiration in a ratio disproportionate to pulse. (3) Agar., diagonal pains. (4) Bry., Verat. Relieved pains with stool at night. (5) Dulc. - worse cold and damp. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Fullness, pressure, weight. Belchings. Nausea, and efforts to vomit, in the morning when rising. Stomach pains, burning, disagreeable weight. In evening, violent stomach pain after supper. Cramps.

Abdomen - Flatulence after meals. Colic pains from flatulence. Colic on going upstairs. Rumbling in the bowels with uneasiness, or sharp, cutting pains and soreness. Burning borborygmi. Dull pain in bowels on pressure. Emission of fetid flatulence.

Rectum - Autumnal dysentery. Tenesmus. Catarrhal dysentery with rheumatic pains. Diarrhea is a worse in winter. Stools with a feeling as stream of fire passing through abdomen. Soft and fetid stool. Early morning diarrhea. Winter diarrhea. Stools like white of eggs, yellow, green, clammy, enveloped in froth, like moss. Stools smell like rotten eggs or burn like fire. Constipation after diarrhea.

Male - Flabbiness, perspiration, and insipid smell of genitals. Excoriation of glans penis in several places with a bloody discharge, better by bathing with urine. Chancre. Weakness, erection without desire.

Female - Profuse menses. Menorrhagia with violent bearing down pain. Food - Loss of appetite, especially in morning. Insatiable hunger. Sensitive to tobacco.

Chest - Warm feeling in chest. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Acute pleuritic pain in right side, with dry, hacking cough, and scanty mucus expectoration. Chest pains better bending forward, worse lying, breathing. Pains worse 4 a.m. and 4 p.m. Spaces between ribs close to sternum tender. Pain in lower chest, diaphragm. Constitutions - Hydrogenoid type, which corresponds to catarrhal complaints, worse from cold and damp weather.

Heart - Pericardial effusion. Constrictive pain in the heart. Tenderness to pressure over heart. Sharp pains, like pricking of a needle in region of heart. Pulse slightly accelerated.

Back - Stiff-neck on waking. Sharp pains in back and between the shoulders. Pains shooting from left chest into left shoulder. Sharp pain in loins near sacrum, lumbago. Breasts - Sharp pains shooting from left nipple downward, with stiffness of left side of neck. Pain beneath left nipple with palpitations.

Limbs - Rheumatic pain in all the joints. Rheumatic pains that affect the body diagonally, or left upper and right lower or the opposite. Pains near wrists. Joints give sensations as if adhesions being broken up on bending. Itching of thighs and buttocks but no eruption. Pain in right hip. Corns painful. Lungs - Short of breath and weak on walking. Bronchitis and pleurisy. Dry cough, throat constricted, causes pain in head and abdomen. Lungs - Breathing painful, at base of left lung. Humid asthma, worse after eating, worse after smoking a little. Oppression and difficulty of breathing, in paroxysms, like asthma. Catarrh with frontal headache and sticky yellow discharge.

Sleep - Drowsy. Uneasy, restless sleep. Troublesome dreams.

Skin - Vesicles, pimples, and pustules all over the body, especially on arms, legs, and face, itching.

Modalities - Worse in morning. Worse on rising. Worse by motion. Worse by coughing. Worse from tobacco. Worse from motion. Worse deep breathing. Worse lying down. Worse rising up. Worse coughing.

Kidneys - Sharp pain in urethra, excoriation of glans penis in several places with bloody and purulent secretion. Urine very red, looks as if blood were in it.

Temperature - Chill towards noon, with cold feet though room is warm. Feverish afternoon. High fever with hot sweat. Rheumatic, catarrhal, bilious marsh fevers of rice plantations.

PHARMACY - asim. Asimina triloba. American papaw. Anona triloba. Paw Paw. Custard Apple. N. O. Anonaceae. Tincture of ripe and unripe fruit, green leaves, bark and root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Anonaceae, to which Asimina belongs, are allied to the Magnolia family. From eating the unripe fruit, five children developed high fever, sore throat and a scarlet eruption with diarrhea, one of them eventually having a carbuncle. Asimina produces a series of symptoms much like scarlet fever, sore throat, fever, vomiting, scarlet eruption. Tonsils and submaxillary glands enlarged with diarrhea. Fauces are red and swollen. Face swollen. In provings, the mouth, throat and stomach are irritated. Drinks much, desire for ice cold things and worse after eating. Hoarseness talks with difficulty. Languid, drowsy irritable. Acne. Itching in evening on undressing. Thick, yellow nasal discharge in morning. Hard, flaky, dark grey and often offensive nasal discharge. Cramps in chest. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Caps., Bell., Ill. (Colic). REFERENCES - Clarke.

author: Murphy
constitution: Coryza. Coughs. Cystitis. Diabetes. Dropsy. Gravel. Heart disorders. Hydrothorax. Kidney, disorders. Kidney, stones. Migraine. Nasal catarrh. Palpitations. Polyuria. Pulse, weak. Rheumatic, pains. Urinary disorders.

full:
PHARMACY - aspar. Asparagus officinalis. Garden asparagus. N. O. Liliaceae. Tincture of young sprouts. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Coryza. Coughs. Cystitis. Diabetes. Dropsy. Gravel. Heart disorders. Hydrothorax. Kidney, disorders. Kidney, stones. Migraine. Nasal catarrh. Palpitations. Polyuria. Pulse, weak. Rheumatic, pains. Urinary disorders.

HERBAL - Asparagus has a marked and immediate action on the urinary secretion. Like other liliaceous plants it acts on the kidneys, heart and dropsical effusions.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cystitis. Frequent urination with fine stinging in the meatus, followed by stitches out of the urethra. After urinating, burning in urethra with sensation as if some were still passing. Increased urine, beer- brown without sediment. Urine is strong smelling, odor peculiar, deposits greasy sediment on sides of vessel, gravel. Severe coryza and nasal catarrh with profuse secretion of thin, whitish fluid from left nostril, afterwards right. Frequent violent sneezing. Copious discharge of tenacious mucus from the throat, not easily loosened, but brought up by hawking or paroxysms of cough. Weakness and cardiac depression with dropsy. Rheumatic pains, especially about left shoulder and heart. Fullness in chest, hydrothorax. Visible violent palpitations, while sitting, with anxious restlessness increased by motion or ascending with oppression of chest. Pulse weak, slow, irregular. Pain at left acromion process, under clavicle and down left arm. Constant desire to be carried about in the arms. MIND - Constant anxiety and apprehension. Anxiety with palpitations of the heart and ill humor. Calmness of the mind. Fretful and peevish. Disturbed by trifles.

Head - Aching in forehead and root of nose. Morning migraine headaches with scotoma. Aching pain in the temples, aggravated by pressure, weight in the forehead.

Eyes - Darting and tingling in the eyes, sight more piercing.

Nose - Coryza with profuse, thin fluid.

Face - Paleness of the face. Increase of heat in the face, cheeks burning.

Mouth - Taste insipid, sweetish (as of copper), softness of the saliva, as if it were mixed with blood.

Throat - Throat feels rough with hawking copious, tenacious mucus from throat. Abundant secretion of mucus in the throat, a constant rattling of mucus in the chest with roughness in the throat.

Stomach - Belchings, flatulency in the stomach, nausea in the morning, on waking. Vomiting of food, mixed with bile and slimy matter afterwards diarrhea of bile and of fecal matter.

Abdomen - Sensation of fullness in the abdomen, pinching in the umbilical region, at night with painful sensibility to the touch. Inflation of the abdomen, frequent emission of wind.

Rectum - Bilious diarrhea with pain as of excoriation in the anus, colic and dragging in the groins.

Urine - Urine loaded with phosphates and the urate of ammonia in kidney dropsy. Gravel passes in small quantities with the urine. It is one of the best antidotes to mercurial over-dosing and especially in cases of syphilis. Scrofula and bone decay. Produces rushes of blood and hemorrhages. “Worse from sunset to sunrise.” Ulcers which attack the bones. Warts, scrofulous, syphilitic, mercurial. Exostosis, decay, nightly bone pains, especially cranial, nasal and palatine. Glands swollen in scrofulous subjects. Palpitations and congestions. Head - Hair falls out. Every morning pressure over eyes, pains in forehead, dullness in head, lasting until afternoon, better in evening, nasal discharge bloody, fetid. ¡chorus. Continual humming in head with beating of carotids. Violent headache, in left side of head, mostly over eye.

Eyes - Amaurosis. Ophthalmia, scrofulous, cancerous, at the same time, nose scurfy.

Nose - Ulcers, caries. Ozaena. Nose swollen, hard, shining (scrofulous), if he takes cold, erysipelas sets in. Destruction of nasal bones. Scurfy, oozing tetter on nose.

Face - Ulcers in cavities of upper jaw. Pallor of face. Ulcer in right corner of mouth.

Mouth - Redness and swelling of palate behind upper incisors. Salivation. Bitter taste. Fetid odor from mouth.

Rectum - Clay-like feces. Hemorrhoid which protrudes and is painful. Stools hard. Feces like whitish clay.

Back - Cracking in cervical vertebrae on bending head. Burning and drawing, tension and pressure in muscles to left of nape extending to shoulder, worse bending head to right, at times unbearable during rest. Pustular eruption on back. Causations - Vexation (jaundice). Constitutions - Suited to Carbo-nitrogenoid and mercurio-syphilitic constitutions.

Neck - Burning pain in skin of nape. Heat in nape rising into head and cheeks.

Limbs - Rheumatism or gouty pains. Burning in skin of right axilla. Pressure in right deltoid. Boring and pressing pains in arms and elbow-joints. Boring pain in bones. Painful stitching in fingertips. Boring pains in thighs, knees, tibia (first right then left). Boring in both sides right Achilles tendon when sitting. Stitches in tips of toes in bunion.

Skin - Intolerable itching all over body, sores followed by an eruption of little lumps, several covered with dark- looking scabs. Jaundice. Deep-spreading syphilitic ulcers on skin.

Fever - Remarkable coldness of back. Remarkable heat in skin. Sweats only on right side, left (affected) side of head remains dry. Excessive perspiration. Food - No appetite in jaundice.

Modalities - Worse in cold, wet weather. Worse from October to spring (headache). Worse by rest.

Teeth - Teeth get loose, look dirty, gums recede.

Tongue - Burning, stitches and induration. Burning on tip of tongue. Tongue coated white in jaundice. Warts on tongue. COMMENTS - Hale considered this the most active of all the preparations of gold. In toxic doses itcauses “violent gastroenteritis” accompanied by cramps, convulsive trembling insomnia, priapism and insensibility. In pathogenetic doses it causes epigastric pain, nausea, loss of appetite and constipation. The constipation is like that of Hydr., being accompanied with catarrh. Hale used it with success in nervous dyspepsia with a tendency to diarrhea after eating in gastric and duodenal catarrh with or without jaundice. He stated that the primary effect of the salt is to cause congestion, irritation of the uterus and ovaries, sub- acute metritis, ovaritis, profuse and premature menses, habitual abortion, nymphomania, ulceration of uterus, cervicitis. For these, the potencies are suitable. The secondary effects are “Atonic amenorrhea, scanty and delaying menses, deficient sexual desire, infertility from ovarian torpor, ovarian dropsy,” for these, Hale recommended the lowest triturations. He suggested its use in puerperal mania with sexual excitement, ovaritis, gastrointestinal irritation and suicidal impulses. Also in corresponding states in men. Aur-m-n. is a specific for asymptomatic ovarian tumors and asymptomatic fibroids. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Arg-n., Ars., Bad., Bry., Crot., Con. (2) Graph., Hep., lod., Kali-bi., Kali-i. (3) Lyc., Merc., Nit-ac., Phos., Sulph., Thuj. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy.

Liver - Hepatic cirrhosis. Pressure in liver region. Jaundice after vexation.

Kidneys - Dark urine in jaundice. Turbid urine.

Perspiration - Sweats only on right side. Excessive sweats. Suppressed sweats.

HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colombia. Ayahuasca in Ecuador and Peru. Inca “vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.

HOMEOPATHIC - Selective action on brain and nervous system, favorably influencing their nutritive function. Leading indications are nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, and general weakness. Sleeplessness with nervous exhaustion and weakness. Chronic insomnia. Delirium tremens. Drug addictions. Bad effects of morphine or heroin addiction. Addicted to cocaine, marijuana, nervines, tranquilizers or sedatives. Alcoholism. Insomnia due to drugs or alcohol. Post-diphtheria paralysis. Rheumatism of heart. Colds and coryza. Nervous palpitations. It is useful in nervous exhaustion, sexual debility, debility after exhausting diseases. Weakness of the mind when due to masturbation or sexual irregularities. Nervous states of the female and male sexual systems. Nervous tremors of the aged. Parkinson's disease, chorea and epilepsy. MIND - Prostration of mind, mental exhaustion, brain fag, with sleeplessness. Symptoms from mental or physical overwork. Mental exertion aggravates. Dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty of thinking and comprehending. Inability to keep mind on any one subject. Nervous exhaustion in brain workers, or from worry and anxiety. Difficult concentration from masturbation. Brain fatigue with sleeplessness. Morphine or heroin addiction. Alcoholism, dipsomania to help withdrawal. Hypochondriasis. Constitutions - Nervous constitution.

Head - Nervous headache at menstrual period with burning at top of head. Occipital headache with phosphatic urine. Aching deep in brain. Vertex headache during menses.

Nose - Coryza. Acute colds. Watery discharge. Rhinitis.

Rectum - Cholera. Diarrhea.

Urine - Sediment, phosphates increased. COMMENTS - Aven, is pre-eminently an anti-neurotic, quieting the nervous system to a remarkable degree. Its special sphere of action seems to be upon the male sexual organs, regulating the functional irregularities of these parts perhaps as much as any remedy can. Aven, is indicated in the sleeplessness of the weak and elderly. Also for children who are nervous and weak. It is a most useful remedy in all cases of nervous exhaustion, general debility, nervous palpitation of the heart insomnia inability to keep the mind fixed upon any one subject. More especially when any or all of these troubles is apparently due to nocturnal emissions, masturbation, or sexual over activity. This is a specific remedy for drug addiction, mainly heroin and morphine, but also tobacco, cocaine, marijuana and valium. Boericke noted it for alcohol addiction. It is one of the most valuable means for overcoming morphine addiction. In most cases in which the habit has not used more than four grains daily the opiate may be abruptly discontinued and even substituted without any serious results. If a larger quantity than this amount has been taken for some time, it is better to gradually reduce the daily dose of morphine in the usual manner, simply prescribing the Avena in addition. The latter should be given in the same dose, as a rule, regardless of the amount of morphine taken. In other words, it is not necessary to increase the Avena as the opiate is withdrawn. When the quantity of morphine has not exceeded four grains daily it should be stopped at once, as stated above and Avena given in its stead in fifteen-drop doses, four times a day in wine glassful of hot water. By this method the disagreeable aftereffects will be much less than though the dose of morphine is gradually reduced and the patient will find life quite bearable, as a rule, at the end of a week. Avena sativa should always be given in appreciable doses of the tincture. Fifteen drops three or four times a day, well diluted, will usually meet the case. It may be given in doses of from five to sixty drops in rare instances. It should, however, never be given in larger quantities than twenty minims unless the patient is thoroughly accustomed to the remedy and has found the usual dose insufficient. Otherwise, there is danger of getting the physiological effect of the drug, which is pain at the base of the brain. When this symptom makes its appearance the medicine should be discontinued for a day or two and then given in reduced doses. There seems to be no danger whatever of forming the habit of taking this remedy, as it can be suddenly abandoned at any time without evil consequences, even when given in large quantities. In one case it was prescribed in sixty drop doses, night and morning, for one year and then abruptly stopped. Nothing was substituted, without bad effects. Whenever a quick action is desired and in all cases where Avena is given to overcome the morphine habit, it should be prepared in hot water. It is also a good plan to prescribe it in this fashion wherever indigestion complicates the case. Anshutz employed this drug in his private practice for a number of years with the most gratifying results. He has very rarely found it to fail when indicated and on account of his high opinioii of the remedy he has taken great pleasure in thus bringing it prominently to the attention of the medical profession. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Alfalfa - general tonic similar to Avena sativa. Alfalfa, also for scanty and suppressed urine. (2) Passiflora, Valerian. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Male - Disposition to masturbation. Troublesome erections, wanting. Seminal emissions aggravates. Seminal emissions without erection. Spermatorrhea. Impo- tency after sexual excesses. Diminished sexual desire.

Female - Amenorrhea. Dysmenorrhea with weak circulation.

Heart - Inflammation of heart, carditis. Endocarditis. Rheumatic heart. Palpitations.

Limbs - Numbness, as if paralyzed. Weakness, twitching, trembling of hands. Strength of hand diminished. Numbness, insensibility. Paralytic weakness. Rheumatic pains.

Sleep - Chronic insomnia, worse during convalescence. Sleeplessness after worry, mental exertion, after influenza, from weakness. Insomnia, aggravated by exhaustion, alcohol. Sleeplessness in alcoholics, with delirium tremens.

HERBAL - Azadirachta Indica is a large tree. The leaves, bark, wood, roots, fruits and every part of this tree, are intensely bitter. The vast range of its action is chiefly due to azaserine, margocine and catechin, the three active principles found in this tree. This is an Indian remedy from very ancient times. The bark, known as Margosa bark, is the best-known medicinal portion. The tincture for the provings were made from the bark by Dr. P. C. Majumdar of Calcutta, India. Majumdar contributed a synopsis of Aza. According to Ayurveda, the different parts of this tree possess different medicinal properties. Sanskrit authors agree that Azadirachta Indica bark, though very disagreeable in taste, is generally used with success. The Neem tree is used for treatment of bacterial, viral, fungal infections and for the treatment and prevention of malaria. Its action on fevers is well-known in India, the native physicians use Neem as the principal substance in their febrifuge medicines. It is especially useful in cases previously maltreated with quinine. In Kenya the tincture of Neem in the 2x dilution has been used as a treatment for three weeks to neutralize the malaria organism from the body. A decoction of fresh leaves is used as a favorite wash to cure old ulcers of long standing. It remo ves within a short time the sloughs and promotes the healing. The fruit is purgative, demulcent and is used in some forms of skin disorders. A kind of oil is produced from the seed of ripe fruits and this oil is said to cure leprosy, eczema and some other obstinate skin diseases. Neem is also praised by some of the allopathic physicians for its tonic, anti-septic, astringent and anti-periodic properties.

HOMEOPATHIC - Aza. has been used in cases of lassitude, thirst, cough, fever. Loss of appetite, helminthiasis, boils, bilious derangements. Catarrh, vomiting, skin diseases, hiccough, gonorrhea. Its leaves are used in some forms of ophthalmic diseases, parasites, worms and disorders brought on by deranged bile or from the use of poisonous things. Aza. is used in a variety of complaints, especially of the eyes, digestive derangements and skin disorders. An afternoon fever and rheumatic pains in various parts are caused by this remedy. Pain in sternum and ribs in back and shoulders and limbs. Giddy on rising, headaches, scalp sensitive, eyes burn, pain in right eyeball. Heat, pricking and aching in hands. Loss of memory. Thirsty for large quanti ties of water at long intervals. Tendency to miscarriage. Copious leucorrhea. MIND - Mind, weak and dull, full of anxiety inactive. No desire to go out of walk out. Depressed. Mistakes in writing and spelling words. Senile dementia. Hypochondriasis. Amnesia. Loss of memory. Forgetful. Abdomen - Great uneasiness in the abdomen, with flatulent rumbling in the bowels, twisting pain in the epigastric region, no tenderness in the abdomen, clutching pain in the umbilical region, obliging to bend forwards, which affords some relief. Abdomen a little distended, passing of offensive flatus. Painful tension in the hypochondria region.

Head - Right-sided headache with throbbing of the temporal artery and pain in the right eyeball, worse in the open air. Scalp and hair painful and sensitive to the touch.

Eyes - Burning, dull and heavy. Pain in the eye, from slightest pressure. Red, sunken, congested, with slight coryza. Sense of pressure in the right eye.

Ears - Buzzing in the ears. A peculiar cracking sound is heard in the ear like tickling with a feather, which is increased on opening the mouth.

Nose - Running of watery fluid from the nose.

Face - Flushing and heat in the face. Pale. Alternating heat and pallor of the face.

Mouth - No thirst, but mouth is clammy, water has relish, good taste. Mouth is bitter. A painful burning sensation, as if scalded, is felt on the sides and surface of the tongue, papillae seem to be enlarged and prominent. Putrid taste in the mouth. Saliva coming out which tastes salty. Slight difficulty in deglutition, especially water and meat.

Throat - Bitter taste in the throat. Slight hoarseness. Left-sided sore throat. Vertigo - Sensation of drunkenness, especially on lifting the head and around 10 a.m. COMMENTS - The most peculiarfeature of the proving is the fever, which commences with a very slight chill or none at all, at about 3 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. and abates around 7:30 p.m. Glowing heat and burning, especially in face, eyes, palms of hands and soles of feet in open air. Sweat copious, commencing on forehead, gradually extending towards trunk, no sweat on lower part of body. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cedrón, Chin., Ars., Nat-m. (2) Guarea. (3) Ars. - Prostration, anxiety, restlessness. Cadaverous odor of secretions. Aggravation from 1 a.m. to 3 a.m. (4) Chin. - General weakness from loss of liquid. Thirst for large quantities of water. Hemorrhaging from the mucus membranes. Sensitive scalp. (5) Sulph. - Quarrelsome with grandiose ideas. Burning pains, weakness in the morning. Need for fresh air and fear of water. Morbid alternations. (6) Med.- Forgets names and recent events. Restlessness, precipitation, desire fordrinks. Irritating leucorrhea. Breasts cold. Heels sensitive. Sleeps in knee-chest position. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - No thirst, appetite very acute and keen. Very great thirst for large quantity of cold water, at long intervals. Heartburn and water brash. Uneasy sensation in the thorax.

Rectum - Diarrhea, no satisfaction after stool. Feeling after stool, that the rectum is not empty. Constipation with ball-like stools which are hard and small, alternating with diarrhea. Insufficient, constipated, stools hard, small and knotty, stools hard. Copious, soft, semi-solid stools.

Male - Great excitement of sexual organs. Sexual desire a little diminished.

Female - Copious leucorrhea. Metritis of the cervix. Metrorrhagia. Recuning miscarriages.

Chest - Pain in sternum and ribs. Aching in the lower part of the right chest below the nipple. Stitches in the chest. Crampy pains in the lower part of chest. Transitory stitches in the chest, especially in the right side. Cramping pains at the base of the lungs. Constitutions - Nervous or rheumatic constitutions.

Heart - Pulse rapid and strong, or rapid and weak. Pulse is quick and hard, feeble.

Back - Itching of the body, especially the back, worse in the open air and in the afternoon. Pain and aching at the nape of the neck.

Neck - Pain and debility in the nape of the neck.

Limbs - Numbness of the limbs, as if the limbs are paralyzed. Rheumatic pains in the lower limbs. Gnawing in the legs. Strength of the hand diminished. Burning of the hands and soles of the feet. Numbness of the hands only, especially the right hand. Lungs - Sighing, breathing at intervals. Hot breath, rapid respiration. Short dry cough in the afternoon. Violent cough with thick, white, jelly-like sputum, which is difficult to expel. Cough after bathing. Cough with grayish expectoration, thick sputa. Cough with tasteless white sputa.

Sleep - Insomnia and agitation in bed. Wakes frequently. Dreams of fights and quarrels in the second half of the night. Sleeplessness and tossing in the bed, dreamy and interrupted sleep at night.

Skin - Itching of various parts of the body without the appearance of any eruption. Sudamina on the back.

Fever - Fever commences with very slight chill or without chill at 4:30 p.m. and abates at 7:30 p.m. Afternoon fever. Glowing heat and burning, especially in the face, eyes, palms of the hands and soles of the feet, in open air. Food - Thirsty for large quantities of water at long intervals. Keen appetite. Desires cold drinks and sweets.

Modalities - Worse in the open air. Worse in the afternoon.

Kidneys - Urine purple in color. Urine scanty and high colored and scalding, urine white, clear and copious, urine of strong odor.

Perspiration - Copious sweat, especially on the forehead, neck and upper part of the body. Sweating commences on the forehead, gradually extending towards the trunk, no sweat in lower part of the body.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bacillinum is a nosode of tuberculosis named and first described by Dr. Burnett, for whom it was prepared from tuberculosis sputum by Dr. Heath. As this preparation has been experimented with separately, its symptoms are given apart from the other nosodes of tuberculosis. Useful as an intercurrent remedy. Bacillinum has been used for the treatment of tuberculosis, generally causing the sputum to decrease and less become less purulent. Tubercular meningitis. It has a disposition to catch colds and sore throats. Respiratory and lung weakness. Chronic reoccurring sore throats and coughs. Glands of the neck are enlarged and tender. Night-sweats. Bacillinum is indicated for the weak lungs of elderly people and for children with chronic catarrhal conditions and attacks of suffocation at night with difficult cough. Suffocative catarrh. The patient expectorates very little. Chronic catarrhal conditions of the lungs when bronchial mucus and dyspnea are present. Tubercular meningitis. Ringworm. Dr. Burnett has shown that ringworm of the scalp and pityriasis versicolor on the body are indications of tubercular diathesis and they respond to this remedy. He cured a case of insanity and ringworm. Tuberculosis patients are better in dry sunny climates in mountains areas and in the pine forests. Sunlight helps to prevent tuberculosis, also there has been many cures of tuberculosis via sunbathing and the milk diet, which these patients crave. Dr. Cartier has found it particularly useful in cases where there was excessive mucopurulent bronchial secretion threatening to occlude the lungs. It should be compared with Bacillinum testium, Tuber. Bovinum, Tuber. Aviaire and Tuber. Koch. MIND - Taciturn, sulky, snappish, and irritable. Does not want to be disturbed. Fretful ailing, whines and complains. Great weakness. Morose. Depressed and melancholic, even to insanity. Tendency to be frightened, fear of dogs.

Head - Severe headache, deep in, recurring from time to time, worse shaking head. Terrible pain in the head as if he had a tight hoop of iron around it. Meningitis. Ringworm. Alopecia areata.

Eyes - Eczema of the eyelids.

Ears - Otitis after sore throats.

Nose - Nasal congestion. Coryza.

Face - Indolent, pimple on left cheek, breaking out from time to time and persisting for many weeks. Food - Poor appetite.

Throat - Tickling in fauces, compelling cough. Pricking in larynx with sudden cough. COMMENTS - In the provings, a constant symptom was a severe headache, deep in, worse by motion. Also a slight cough with easy expectoration of phlegm. Tends to do better in chronic cases of tuberculosis, as compared to acute cases. There are leading indications for it when present in combination with other disorders. An inter-current course of Bacillinum will often make a wonderful change in patients who have a personal or family history of chest disorders. Bacillinum is an acute miasm remedy for Phosphorus and Calcarea constitutions in particular. Grimmer used it for cases stemming from a tubercular inheritance with extreme soreness of affected parts, patients of rheumatic tendencies with syphilitic taints in the bloodstream, general muscular soreness. Dr. Young recorded the cure of several cases of cretinism. A case of insanity with pityriasis yielded rapidly to the remedy. Pityriasis has been cured by it when all attempts to kill the body lice by chemicals were useless. Clarke has found an eczematous condition of the margins of the eyelids a strong indication for it. Bacillinum is made from tuberculosis bacilli, and Tuberculinum is from bovine tuberculosis. Tuberculinum is a deeper and more chronic remedy. Bacillinum tends to be more for acutes, but there's a lot of overlap. If a Bacillinum case keeps relapsing, follow with Tuberculinum. Miasmatic remedy, history of tuberculosis in family. Good for children or adults with a tendency to get colds and sore throats frequently, particularly if they react well to acute remedies, but keep coming back. For children who get a cold at every change in the weather. Often swollen glands in the throat. Weight on the chest (Phos.). Mucus in the lungs, bronchitis. Good for the elderly with a tendency to colds and bronchitis. Lingering colds. The majority of the symptoms are gone, but a lingering cough or sore throat. Nondescript coughs. Ringworm (Sep., Thuj., Tell.), and the tendency to ringworm. Diarrhea, especially with a cold, sore throat (Ars.). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Phos., Dros., Mercury. Its effects seem to be identical to that of Koch's Tuberculinum. Both are useful in the tubercular diathesis before tuberculosis has developed. In the early stages of tubercular disease of glands, joints, skin and bones. (2) Psor. (3) Bac-t. (4) Ant-t., lod., Lach., Ars-i., Myosotis. Complementary: Kali-c., Calc-p., Lach., goes with this remedy very well. Follows well: Levico, 5-10 drops, follows as an intercurrent where much debility is present (Burnett). REFERENCES - Boericke. Kidneys - Increased quantity of urine, pale with white sediment. Rises several times in the night to urinate.

Perspiration - Night-sweats.

Temperature - Flush of heat, some perspiration, severe headache. Fever, with emaciation, abdominal pains and discomfort. Restless at night, glands of both groins enlarged and indurated, cries out in sleep, strawberry tongue.

HERBAL - Bacopa monnieri is a perennial, creeping herb whose habitat includes wetlands and muddy shores. It commonly grows in marshy areas throughout India. Bacopa monnieri is an herb used in India for memory, epilepsy, and as a mild sedative. It has been used for centuries to treat epilepsy, improve memory capacity, increase concentration, and reduce stress- induced anxiety. Traditionally, it was used as a brain tonic to enhance memory development, learning, and concentration, and to provide relief to patients with anxiety or epileptic disorders. Patients taking Bacopa say that they can better handle difficult mental tasks and stress. It improves the memory. Increased learning abilites. Protects the brain from the effects of aging. Alleviate anxiety. Mental and brain fatigue. Attention-deficit disorders. The plant has also been used in India and Pakistan as a cardiac tonic. Digestive aid. Improves respiratory function in cases of broncho-constriction. According to Unani medicine, it is bitter, aphrodisiac, good in scabies, leucoderma, syphilis etc. It is a blood purifier and useful in diarrhea and fevers. Bacopa is bitter, pungent, heating, emetic, laxative and useful in bad ulcers. Also used to treat anemia, ascites, enlargement of spleen, biliousness, indigestion, inflammations, leprosy, tumors, etc. COMMENTS - In India, this herb has also been used traditionally to consecrate new born babies in the belief that it will stimulate the intelligence. Studies suggest bacopamay improve intellectual activity in children. Recent research has focused primarily on Bacopa's cognitive-enhancing effects, specifically memory, learning, and concentration, and results support the traditional Ayurvedic herbal claims. Also, research on anxiety, epilepsy, bronchitis and asthma, irritable bowel syndrome, and gastric ulcers also supports the traditional uses of Bacopa. RELATIONS - Compare: Ginko, Kali-p. Gotu kola. REFERENCES - Murphy.
