HOMEOPATHIC - Peruvian Balsam has been proved by Lembke. It has been chiefly used empirically in catarrhal tuberculosis or bronchial catarrh with copious purulent expectoration. Sputa thick, creamy, yellowish white, loud rales, night sweats, hectic. Bals-p. is useful in bronchial catarrh with copious, purulent expectoration. Debility and hectic fever. Cracks of nipples and fingers.

Nose - Profuse, thick discharge. Chronic, fetid, nasal catarrh. Bleeding from right nostril. Ozaena with ulceration. Eczema with ulceration.

Throat - Scraping in larynx in forenoon, dry cough. Continued scraping of fauces. COMMENTS - Hale used it with success in “chronic, purulent, fetid anterior or posterior nasal catarrh with or without ulceration.” He said that a cerate of the Balsam is the best application next to Glycerol of Aloes for indolent ulcers, cracked nipples, cracks in fingers and palmar surfaces of hands or fissured and chapped lips. Bals-p. is used locally as a stimulant to raw surfaces in indolent ulcers, scabies, cracked nipples. Promotes granulation, removes the fetid odor. A one percent solution in alcohol or ether may be used with the atomizer in respiratory disorders. Internally, it is used as an expectorant in chronic bronchitis. Used externally for killing scabies. All parts affected are gently rubbed with it at night and a bath taken in the morning. A single application is sufficient. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Balsamum Tolutanum. (2) Oleum Caryophyllum - oil of cloves in profuse expectoration, 3 to 5 minims in milk or capsules. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stool - Mucus diarrhea. Copious liquid stool, painless. Passage of blood with normal stool.

Chest - Cough, mucus and purulent expectoration. Tuberculosis of mucus type, vomit in lungs. Loud rales in chest (Kali-s., Ant-t.).

Limbs - Oppressive pain in right wrist. Severe pain in left tibia. Boring in right tibia. Lungs - Bronchitis and tuberculosis with muco-purulent, thick, creamy expectoration. Tuberculosis of mucus type, vomit in lungs. Very loose cough, mucus and purulent expectoration.

Kidneys - Scanty urine, with much mucus sediment. Urination more frequent and copious. Catarrh of bladder (Chim.). Sticking and cutting in urethra.

Perspiration - Night-sweats.

Temperature - Hectic fever and nightsweats with irritating, short cough and scanty expectoration.

HERBAL - In folk medicine, the leaves have been used to treat blood diseases and inflammation. The hardened material inside bamboo has been used for tuberculosis, asthma and leprosy. The shoots are said to be an appetite stimulant and digestion aid. The root has been used for ringworm. The juice from the flowers has been used for earache and deafness. Some modem studies confirm its anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor effects and its action on the utems.

HOMEOPATHIC - Arthritis and rheumatism. Back pain and sciatica. Spinal injuries. Tension and stiffness ofjoints, worse from damp, cold weather. Clumsiness and awkwardness. Radiating pains. Wandering and wave-like pains. Numbness and tingling. Post-partum depression (Sep.). Generally chilly, better from warmth and worse cold and damp. MIND - Everything seems uncertain. Emotionally sensitive, vulnerable. Yielding disposition. Sadness with weeping. Crying over trivial things. Conscientious about trifles. Capricious. Restless, tosses about in bed. Startled as from a fright. Cannot handle things anymore, overwhelmed by stress. Mental exhaustion, brain fag. Anxiety, felt in chest. Anxiety during vertigo. Anxiety of conscious. Bites nails. Anxiety about the future, finances. Worries about money. Depression with a strong fear of poverty. Overpowering panic attacks. Fear of losing self-control, of misfortune, of failure. Fear during pregnancy. Fear of impending disease. Fear of something wrong in her head. Fear of brain tumor, epileptic convulsions. Fear of lumps in breast. Fear of something wrong in head, Fear of being observed. Fear of saying something wrong. Fear of vertigo. Hypochondriasis. Moods changeable, variable. Jealous. Brooding. Domineering. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill-humor, peevish. Anger from noises. Cursing, swearing. Quarrelsome, scolding. Averse to being disturbed. Irritable towards husband, children, better in the evening. Irritable, when spoken to. Easily offended. Sensitive to reprimands, criticism. Post-partum depression. Depression with a feeling that they would never get well again. General feeling of betrayal and desertion. Forsaken feeling. New mother feels stressed, drained, overwhelmed, and trapped. Feelings of helplessness. Pities herself. Feels inferior, poor self confidence. Timidity about appearing in public. Discontented, dissatisfied with himself, everything. Desire for change. Ennui, boredom. Feels cut off from life. Indifference, apathy to everything. Sadness alternating with indifference. Depression before menses, in morning on waking, afternoon, worse 4 pm. Desire for solitude. Mental dullness, sluggishness. Difficulty thinking and comprehending. Concentration difficult while driving, studying, reading, writing. Confusion of mind in morning, as if in a dream. Mistakes about time. Confounds the days of the week. Mistakes in writing, omitting letters. Absent-mindedness. Memory weakness, from mental exertion. Forgetful. Delusions, imagines that she is alone in the world. Blames her partner for her bad mood. Imagines he is deceived, deserted, forsaken. Delusions everything will fail. Imagines he has ruined his health. Delusions, that left and right side are not the same. Delusions that body parts are distorted. Foolish behavior. Attempts to escape.

Head - Headaches are worse from physical exertion, cold wind, and bending the head forward. Pressing pain.

Eyes - Blinking. Itching, swelling of eyelids.

Nose - Colds. Nasal congestion. Dryness and numb. Sensitive to odors.

Face - Acne. Painful pimples. Numbness. Pain in facial bones.

Mouth - Profuse salivation. Gingivitis.

Throat - Sore throat. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, suppuration. Coldness sensation. Redness. Lump, plug sensation. Mucus, tenacious, difficult to hawk up. Difficult swallowing. Hoarseness. Roughness sensation. Ulcerative pain.

Stomach - Belching. Heartburn, worse from excitement, beer. Indigestion. Dyspepsia. Empty, weak, hungry feeling. Nausea from odors. Nausea with headaches. Motion sickness. Lump sensation. Vomiting after nuts. Vomiting, evening.

Abdomen - Gas and bloating. Obstructed flatulence. Rumbling noises. Bilious complaints. Tenderness in the gallbladder region.

Rectum - Anal, itching. Constipation, with soft stool. Diarrhea, like gushing water. Greasy and fatty stools. Involuntary stool.

Urine - Dark color, frothy, foamy urine. Profuse, increases amounts urine. Scanty urine. Strong, putrid odor, like rotten eggs, sulphur. Vertigo - Vertigo with staggering. As if intoxicated. Worse from looking downward. Motion sickness. Vision - Double vision. Foggy, dim vision. Blurred vision with lachrymation. COMMENTS - Bernd Schuster related several cases of his experiences with Bamb-a. The first concerned Karen, a 29-year-old mother, who could not look after her 12-week-old baby because of severe headaches. The baby was delivered by caesarian and her headaches started shortly afterwards. Initially, the pain was felt only when she shook her head or cleaned her teeth, but by the time the baby was three weeks old she could only lie down. She could not bear the sound of her child crying. Pain was better if she lay down or supported her head. There was a feeling of heaviness or enlargement of her head. Menstruated immediately after childbirth. Irritable. She said she wished her little boy would get lost. Then she laughed and said she didn't mean it and then cried and said, I feel guilty enough about not looking after him properly. After being given Bamb-a., her head and neck pain did not return and her mood improved markedly The second case concerned Lisa, a 35- year-old new mother, who reported “The stress of the birth completely changed me. It was difficult. I am nervous and a wreck. Breastfeeding makes me feel weaker while nursing I have a terrible feeling. My mood is the same as when my mother died. I always weep when I am nursing. I feel empty, miserable, depressed, drained of all my energy.” She was completely stressed and almost felt persecuted by her crying baby. She lay in bed all day. She was afraid to be solely responsible for the child. “I imagined the relationship with the child to be closer, but I need someone to help me I need more support.” After being given Bamb-a., Lisa was more at ease with her baby; the weakness, emptiness and depression have gone and she had more energy. She found it easier to tell friends how she really felt and to accept help. The third case concerned Judy, a 38- year-old mother of two, who suffered from headaches, backaches, sciatica and a feeling of stiffness in the morning, all of which were worse for three days before her period. She had been diagnosed with postnatal depression in the past. She described it as “feeling down.” “My children are not babies any more, but still everything to do with them depends very much on me. My husband is never there. My parents have now moved here and they are always wanting something. And I have to do a lot of jobs physically which women don't usually do. They all come to me when they want something but no one ever asks if they can help me. It bothers me for the future if I get ill, no one will be there for me.” She has had other homeopathic remedies and chiropractic, which both worked well, but it was not until she was given Bamb-a. that her mood improved profoundly, she changed the dynamics in her relationships and her pain and stiffness disappeared. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sep., Puls., Placenta. (2) Rhus-t., Dulc., Cimic., Eup-per. REFERENCES - Schuster.

Male - Atrophy, shriveled genitals. Troublesome erections. Priapism.

Female - Dysmenorrhea. Profuse menses. Suppressed menses. Offensive leucorrhea. Post-partum depression, accompanied by a stiff neck, back pain or sciatica (Cimic.). Prolonged lochia. Menstrual problems after childbirth. Excoriation of cervix. Tearing pain in ovaries.

Chest - Sensation of a lump near sternum. Ears - Hissing noises in ear. Stopped sensation. Pulsation during headache.

Heart - Stitching, burning pain and stiffness. Dragging sensation in heart region.

Back - Backaches. Spinal injuries. Ankylosing spondylitis. Burning along the spine. Stiffness and tension. Cramping, aching and dragging pains. A knotted feeling in the back. Heat waves, flushes. Numbness and tingling. Sacroiliac pains. Coccyx pain, after injuries, stiffness. Stiffness, shoulders. Neuralgic and rheumatic pains, shoulders.

Neck - Stiffness, worse from damp, cold weather. Tension in neck. Very difficult to turn the neck. Torticollis.

Limbs - Weak ankles. Burning in the soles of the feet. Icy cold feet. Weakness of the hand, difficulty in writing. Contractions and spasms.

Sleep - Insomnia. Sleeplessness, from an overactive mind. Constantly turning ideas over in the mind. Wakes 3:30 a.m. to 4:30 a.m. Confused dreams. Nightmares. Dreams of accidents, misfortune, disease, deaths. Dreams of animals, water. Dreams children, old friends. Dreams of teeth falling out. Amorous dreams.

Skin - Excoriation. Itching during sleep. Painful scars. Sensitive to hot water. Stings, from insects.

Fever - Influenza (Rhus-t.). Food - Strong aversion to fat and to beer. Desires wine, cheese spicy foods. Desires stimulants, like coffee. Worse from fats, beer and wine.

Modalities - Pains are better from rest, heat, hot drinks. Worse in the morning on waking, Worse from cold and damp.

Teeth - Toothaches, pain worse from sweets.

Tongue - Burning, raw pains. As if tongue was burnt. Formication. Tingling and prickling sensations. Metallic, offensive, sour, putrid taste.

Liver - Pressing pain.

Bladder - Cystitis, from taking cold. Dragging pains. Pain comes in waves. Causations - Ailments from anger, vexation, suppressed anger, anticipation, foreboding, excitement, wounded pride, honor.

Perspiration - Profuse night-sweats. Odor of sweat, like fresh coffee. Offensive, sweetish sweats. Sticky, viscid sweats.

Temperature - Alternating fever and chills. Chilliness, worse at night. Shaking, shivering with chills.

full:
PHARMACY - bani-c. Banisteriopsis caapi. Ayahuasca. Spirit Vine. Yagé. Psycho- tria viridis. N. O. Malpighiaceae. South America. Amazon. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - AIDS. Allergies. Asthma. Autism. Cancer. Chronic, fatigue. Clairvoyance. Delusions. Digestive, problems. Drug, abuse. Emphysema. Hallucinations. Insomnia. Kyphosis. Malnutrition. Nausea. Numbness. Parkinson's, disease. Scoliosis. Sexual, abuse. Vomiting. Worms.

HERBAL - Ayahuasca, commonly called yagé, or yajé in Colombia. Ayahuasca in Ecuador and Peru. Inca “vine of the dead, vine of the souls,” aya means in Quechua “spirit,” “ancestor,” “dead person,” while huasca means “vine,” “rope,” and caapi in Brazil. Ayahuasca brew is prepared from segments of a species of the vine Banisteriopsis, a genus belonging to the Malpighiaceae.

HOMEOPATHIC - Tiredness, exhaustion, debility. Unable to move from tiredness. Shakiness and disorientation. Unable to recover one's energy with rest. Feelings of detachment, poor memory and vagueness with the exhaustion. Rushes of energy which are associated with raised heartbeat and that cause some anxiety. Heightened sensitivity of all senses, mostly vision and hearing. Muscular soreness and weakness from tiredness. Limbs go to sleep, pins and needles sensations. Tightness, tingling, aching, and drawing in the spine. Numbness and general malaise. Anesthesia. Muscle wastage. Tissue necrosis. Easy dislocation of joints. Crumbling of bone tissue. Digestive tract malfunction. Poor assimilation and metabolism. Imbalance of bowel flora causing psychological symptoms such as depression. Pains can be sharp, sudden on appearance and quick to go, tend to be worse night. Autism. Ailments from injuries, worse spine or the head. AIDS. Cancer. Chronic fatigue. Parkinson's disease. Strong history of drug abuse. Multiple allergy syndrome. MIND - Confusion of mind. Cannot think straight. Difficult concentration, compre hension. Dullness, sluggishness. Mistakes about time. Memory weakness. Forgetfulness. Thoughts intrude and crowd around each other. Tormenting, persisting thoughts. Amorous thoughts. Clear-sighted, increased precision of mind. Sensitive to all external impressions. Senses are acute. Oversensitive to light, noise, shrill sounds, sad stories. Charmedby colors, especially red. Easily startled. Moods are changeable, variable, swings between extremes of rage and well being. Impulsive. Restless, nervous. Impatient, hurried, everybody moves too slow. Stressed mentally and emotionally. Full of worries, forebodings. Insecure. Anxious, desperate. Anxiety from palpitations, on waking. Anxiety about salvation. Overpowering panic attacks. Prolonged anguish and fear which has heightened every sense. Irritability from any disturbance, when questioned. Fastidious. Obstinate, headstrong. Rage, fury. Impulse to kill. Anger during meetings. Jealousy associated with sexual excitement. Suspicious, mistrustful. Weeping, causeless. Pessimistic. Dwells on past disagreeable events. Homesick, nostalgic. Sadness, depression, crying difficult. Ailments from grief, sorrow. Grief of the deepest kind. Forsaken feeling. Worse from consolation, company. Aversion to company. Indifference, apathy towards friends. Despair of life. Unmitigated misery. Suicidal thoughts. Loquacity alternating with sadness. Loss of self-control. Feelings of being disconnected, worse fatigue, stress, anxiety or fear. Inability to feel connected to the mother. Desire for sympathy. Inability to remember childhood. Loss of purpose. Sense of uselessness and frustration at not being able to find one's path. Sense of having been derailed. Work fatigues easily. Sympathetic, compassionate. Fear that something bad will happen. Fear of insanity, of losing self-control. Fear of crossing a bridge, of falling. Fear of ghosts, evil. Fear of impending death, feels as if soul were escaping from body. Fear of terrible dreams. Disoriented. Sense of unreality. Feels as if intoxicated, drugged. Blissful. Cheerfulness. Euphoria. Tranquility, serenity, calmness. Thoughtless. Out-of-body states. Feeling of lightness. Fearlessness. No conception of time. Incorrect judge of sizes. Trance. Clairvoyant and clairaudient. Telepathic phenomena. Psychic abilities that may be illusory. Hears voices or receives psychic messages. False messages. Pride about psychic abilities, may be deluding themselves. Delusions, visions and hallucinations on closing eyes. Floating in air, that he is a bird, of flying, that he has no weight. Delusions that body parts are immaterial, that the head is separated from body, that the mind and body are separated. Religious delusions, that he lost his salvation, of gods, goddesses, angels, devils, ghosts, spirits. Frightful images, phantoms. Delusions of dangerous animals, crocodiles, tigers. Delusions of leopards, reptiles, snakes. Delusions of seeing monsters. Visions of suffering, cruelty, torture, of being at war. Delusions of danger, of being surrounded by the enemy, of being watched, that another person is in the room. Delusions -of events long past. Delusions that death is approaching, about the death of others.

Head - Sensation of being stuffed up with cotton wool. Heat in the vertex or cold as ice.

Eyes - Acute vision or blurred. Sees images superimposed on whatever is being looked at. Doubts what is seen, has to look again.

Ears - Hears acutely. Hears as if from a distance.

Stomach - Sensitive stomach, reacts to many foods. Nausea and vomiting after stimulant food and drink. Feels relieved from vomiting. Nausea and vomiting with anxiety and dread. COMMENTS - Ayahuasca has been noted to produce lethargy, immobility, a desire to close the eyes and a sense of withdrawal from the environment. Visions or dreams, most commonly of snakes which portend either good or evil: they appear either with an open mouth that threatens to swallow, or in motion. Results are different among non-native users. Extreme spiritual fear, often followed by giddiness, nervousness, nausea and sometimes vomiting accompanied by profuse sweating. Flashes of light, which can be followed by a bluish haze on closing the eyes. General lassitude and a heightened aware- . ness and appreciation of colors. Deep and dream filled sleep. On waking there is a common urgency to pass diarrhea. The net result of the whole experience is one of peace of mind and a physical purging.

Abdomen - Flatuence. Malabsorption and malnutrition from defective gut.

Rectum - Constipation, ineffectual urging and straining.

Male - Prostate trouble relating to impo- tency. Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened libido, which can lead to excessive masturbation. Excessive libido as if it were a spiritual experience. Sexual abuse followed by a crippled sex-life.

Female - Total loss of libido after use of hallucinatory drugs. Heightened libido, which can lead to excessive masturbation. Excessive libido in those who enjoy it as if it were only a spiritual experience. Sex with detached feelings. Sexual abuse followed by a crippled sex-life. Difficult, prolonged or late periods. Food - Craves alcohol, stimulants such as coffee and tea. No appetite, would prefer to do without food.

Heart - Congenital heart disease. Real or phantom pains. Raised heart rate. Palpitations.

Back - Injuries to the spine and coccyx. Tension in the neck. Scoliosis and kyphosis. Dreams - Exhausting, frightful or joyful dreams. Unremembered dreams. Dreams of animals, reptiles. Dreams of crossing bridges, flying, musical instruments, music, food. Amorous, lewd, lascivious, sexual dreams. Dreams of previous events, old friends, people not seen for years. Dreams of anger of cruelty, enemies, death, dying, war, being taken prisoner, strife, being wounded.

Limbs - Muscle wasting. Poor extension and abduction of limbs due to inelasticity of tendons and ligaments. Poor circulation, coldness and numbness of extremities. Possible remedy for gangrenous states. Lungs - Restricted breathing from emotional disturbances. Emphysema. Asthma, chronic constricted airways.

Sleep - like trance, in which the person would want to keep the eyes closed, but in which there would be a sense of alertness with greatly increased intensity of awareness and insight into metaphysics or into personal problems of the moment. Users described various themes, including the separation of sour and body separate, often with a sense of flight, sometimes at high speed. Visions of jungle animals. Mystical visions of angels, Christ or the Devil. Clairvoyance, vision of a future event. Visual experience of an event from the past that in some way illuminates the present. RELATIONS - Compare: Anae., Ahal. Op. REFERENCES - Murphy. Wansbrough.

Kidneys - Weak kidneys. Frequent urinary infections or pains in the kidneys.

Perspiration - Offensive, strong, sweetish odor.

CLINICAL - Dyspnea. Headaches. Oppression. Spleen pain. Typhoid. Vision, weak.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pain in the right jaw and oppression in left hypochondrium, producing dyspnea and a necessity to assume an erect position. COMMENTS - J. Meredith notedhisexperience with this shrub. He showed symptoms including congestion of the forepart of head. Weak vision. Hectic flush after tea. Right molar felt too long, worse by pressure intermittent, right jaw (later both jaws) stiff and painful at joint. Sciatica left side. Appetite increased, more energy for mental work. Improved sleep. He was also relieved of a distressing symptom, that has troubled him for many months, and for which the ordinary Bapt. tincture in any preparation had failed to relieve. He described it as “areally distressing left hypochondrium oppression, fullness and actual dyspnea, impelling me to assume an erect position." This oppression would continue half the night. The distress was located either in the spleen or splenic curve of the colon. It was uninfluenced by eating. Bapt-c. seemed to relieve the symptom very rapidly, causing something to move to the left and downwards, after which he went to sleep. A case simulating typhoid was rapidly relieved by the remedy, showing its relation to Bapt. tinct. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Biliousness. Blood, poisoning. Brain, softening. Cancer. Delirium. Delusions. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Epidemic, influenza. Enteric fever. Esophagus, stricture. Eye disorders. Fevers. Gallbladder, disorders. Gastric, fever. Headaches, bilious. Hectic, fever.High, fever. Hysteria. Infections. Influenza. Intestinal toxemia. Mumps. Miscarriage, threatened. Toxemia. Tuberculosis. Typhoidfever. Typhus. Vaccinations. Variola. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Baptisia, the wild indigo of America, has its reputation as a remedy for typhoid fever. In low potency it increases the resistant power of the body against typhoid. In one case, that of an old man, food could be swallowed and retained some days, but not on others. He had always liked very hot food. The esophagus was red and granular. Bapt. 12c cured. Hale considered it specific in threatened miscarriage from mental depression, shock of bad news, watching, fasting or low septic fevers. Patients in these conditions often complain of “dreadful sinking at the stomach,” fetid breath and other symptoms of Baptisia. Many cases of tuberculosis are relieved by this remedy when the symptoms and type of fever correspond. It has cured hysteria with prostration, numbness and fear of paralysis, wanting to die, rubbing hands continually, restlessness. Baptisia tinctoria has the ill effects of anti-typhoid serum vaccinations. It affects the blood, causing septic conditions, like low fevers and malaria poisoning. The symptoms of this remedy are of an asthenic type, simulating low fevers, septicemia conditions of the blood, malarial poisoning and extreme prostration. Restlessness, does not sleep quietly, wants to be on the move. Indescribable sickfeeling all over. Tired, bruised, sick feeling in all parts of the body. Great languor, wants to lie down. Weak and tremulous, as if recovering from a severe illness. Prostration with disposition of fluids to decompose. Great muscular soreness and putrid states are present. All the secretions are offensive, breath, stool, urine, sweat, etc. It has proved specific in a large number of cases is epidemic influenza. Besotted look, bleary eyes, aching head, sore throat, pains and soreness all over the body and profound prostration. Chronic intestinal toxemia of children with fetid stools and belchings. Foul odor of the body, breath of excretions, stools, sweat, urine etc. Brown, sordes, stools, menses. Discharges, stools, hemorrhages etc. are dark in color, fetid. Dark spots appear upon the body. Mucus membranes that become dark. Ulceration of the mucus membranes, especially of the mouth, with tendency to putrescence. Feeling of soreness, heaviness and aching of muscles. Prostration is rapid, bed feels too hard on account of soreness of muscles, yet he feels too weak to move. Lifeless body but restless mind. Restless, always rubs the hands, hysterical. Insensitive to pain. Parts feel numb or too large. Bed sores. Intermittent pulse, especially in the elderly. Numbness, prickling and paralytic feeling over the whole body, especially left side. MIND - Dull and confused mind. Inability to think. Mind wanders as soon as eyes are closed. Confusion, as if intoxicated. Ideas confused. Aversion- to mental and bodily exertion. Hopeless of recovery and certain of death. Melancholia with stupor. Indifference, doesn't care to do anything. Aversion to hear conversation about sickness or injuries. Falls asleep while answering or does not complete his sentence. Delirium, wandering, muttering. Wild, wandering feeling. Bewildered. Sense of duality. Illusion of divided personality. Thinks he is broken or double and tosses about the bed trying to get pieces together. Imagines his limbs are talking to each other. Sensation as if some person touched him gently while dozing. Parts feel separated. Worse when thinking of pains in various parts of body.

Head - Congestive headache. Headache, as if intoxicated. Dull, bruised feeling in occiput. Headache, fever and delirium. Frontal headache, with pressure at root of nose. Headache, with stupor and confusion. Excitement of brain, with delirium at night. Feels too large. Heavy, numb feeling in head. Brain feels sore. As if a blow or heavy pain on occiput. Vertex feels as if would fly off. Brain feels sore. Skin of forehead feels tight, seems drawn to back of head.

Eyes - Blood vessels congested, eyes look red, inflamed. Eyes feel swollen. Eyelids heavy. Half closed. Cannot bear light. Feeling as if eyes would be pressed into head. Eyeballs feel sore with great confusion of sight. Visually, everything appears to move. Severe pains in eyes on reading, compelling to stop. Partial paralysis of lids. Photophobia, eyes burn, but don't water. Chronic ophthalmia.

Ears - Ears feel hot and burn, yet cold to touch. Soreness in right ear, running down neck. Roaring in ear, with mental confusion. Dull hearing. Early deafness in typhoid conditions. Delirium with almost complete deafness.

Nose - Dull pain at root of nose. Nosebleed of dark blood. Sensation of fullness, edema. Sneezing and feeling as after a severe cold. Thick mucus from nose. Right nostril stopped up. Illusion of smell of burnt feathers.

Face - Anxious, frightened look. Dusky, stupid. Besotted look. Dark red. Heat and redness of face. Sweats on face and forehead. Face and whole head feel numb. Pain at root of nose. Burning, prickling of left side of face and head. Cheeks burn. Muscles of jaw rigid. Cracked, bleeding lips. Pain in left parotid gland. Lower jaw drops.

Mouth - Mouth and tongue very dry in fevers. Filthy taste with flow of saliva. Flat, bitter taste. Foul or bitter nauseous taste. Putrid, offensive breath. Breath fetid. Can swallow liquids only, least solid food gags. Lower jaw drops. Sore mouth of nursing child. Thick speech. Soft palate swollen. Putrid ulcers with salivation. Saliva viscid. Ulcers in the mouth. Sordes on lips. Dark red, tumid mouth and throat.

Throat - Aphonia. Larynx sore to touch, painful swallowing or speaking. Septic sore throat. Fauces red, dark, putrid ulcers. Painless sore throat and offensive discharge. Numb inside but sensitive outside. Mucus rattles in throat. Can swallow liquids only, least solid food gags. Spasms of gullet. Constriction at cardiac orifice of esophagus. Constrictive feeling in throat causing frequent efforts at swallowing. Dark redness of tonsils and soft palate. Tonsils and soft palate dark red and swollen. Sharp pain in right tonsil. Ragged ulcers in the throat.

Stomach - Gastric fever. Can swallow only liquids. Cramp in stomach, evening. Constriction at cardiac orifice. Cardiac orifice contracted convulsively. Ulcerative inflammation of stomach and bowels. Dreadful sinkingfeeling in the stomach. Pain in epigastric region. Feeling of hard substance (Abies-n.). Nausea with eructations, followed by painful vomiting. Easy vomiting. Sudden attacks of vomiting and diarrhea, with fever. Vomiting due to spasm of esophagus.

Abdomen - Distended and rumbling. Fullness and distention of the abdomen. Severe colic in umbilical and hypogastric region. Intestinal toxemia. Soreness of abdomen in region of liver. Right side markedly affected. Right, iliac region sensitive. Pain in region of spleen. Abdominal muscles sore on pressure. Sharp, rheumatic pains in groins, worse from walking. Glands of left groin swollen, painful on walking.

Rectum - Intestinal toxemia of children with fetid stools and belchings. Constipation with fullness of abdomen. Offensive diarrhea day and night. Diarrhea sudden, horribly foul, mushy, painless, dark or bloody stools. Aphthous diarrhea. Very fetid exhausting diarrhea. Dysentery of the elderly people with pain in limbs, small of back and rigors. Painless dysentery with fever. Stricture from hemorrhoids. Stools very offensive, thin, dark, bloody. Stool like sheep dung, dry and crumbling. Stool papescent, with large quantities of mucus. Sensations - As if bruised or beaten all over the body. Bed feels too hard, makes him feel sore and bruised. Feels as if lying on a board, changes position.

Male - Dull pain in right groin and testicle. Orchitis. Pressing pain in testes as if squeezed.

Female - Menses too early and too profuse. Threatened miscarriage from mental depression, shock, night- watching, low fevers. Lochia acrid, fetid. Puerperal fever. Stomatitis of nursing mothers. Food - No appetite. Constant desire for water. Great thirst. Loss of appetite. Averse to nourishment and stimulants. Child can drink nothing but milk. All symptoms worse from beer (Kali-bi.).

Chest - Constriction and oppression of the chest. Weakness of chest. Sharp pains in center of sternum. Weight and oppression in precordial region, with a feeling of unsatisfied breathing, afternoon.

Heart - Heartbeats seem to fill the chest. Feeling of greatly increased frequency of heart's pulsations, seem to fill chest. Audible palpitations. Pulse first accelerated, then slow and faint.

Back - Back and hips very stiff, ache severely, worse walking. Symptoms radiate from small of back. Back sore and bruised. Feels as if lying on board. Neck tired, cannot hold it easy in any position. Dull pain in sacrum. Pain in sacrum around hips and legs. Bedsores. Stiffness and lameness of neck muscles, worse on moving head. Rheumatic pains in muscles of back, followed by burning. Breasts - Dull stitches in left nipple.

Limbs - Muscles ache, sore and bruised pains. Feels as if lying on a board, changes position often. Bed feels too hard, worse in region of sacrum. Great weakness, especially in lower limbs. Stiffness and pain, aching and drawing in arms and legs. Wandering pains in all the limbs with dizziness. Bedsores.

Sleep - Fears going to sleep on account of nightmare and sense of suffocation. Drowsy, stupid and languid, slides down in bed. Drowsiness, can only keep awake by great effort. Falls asleep when answering a question. Lies curled up like a dog on one side. Sleepless and restlessness. Sleeplessness with wandering of mind. Weary, as if he had not slept enough. Cannot get herself together, feel s scattered about bed. Troubled with dreams, but inability to remember them. Nightmares and frightful dreams.

Skin - Livid spots all over body and limbs. Burning and heat in skin (Ars.), worse in face. Eruption like measles or urticaria. Confluent smallpox, tardy eruption. Foul, Baptisia tinctoria gangrenous, eating syphilitic sores. Putrid ulcers with stupor, low delirium and prostration.

Modalities - Better drinking liquids. Better open air. Better motion. Worse from open air, cold wind. Worse autumn. Worse hot weather, humid heat. Worse fog. Worse indoors. Worse from pressure. Worse on waking, walking. Worse mental exertion. Worse swallowing solids. Worse during sleep.

Teeth - Sordes on the teeth and lips. Teeth and gums sore, ulcerated. Gums oozing of large quantities of blood on pressure with finger.

Tongue - Burning at root of tongue. Tongue feels burned. Tongue feels thick. Brown down the center, cracked, sore, ulcerated. Tongue is dry, glistening edges. Yellow- brown coating in center, edges dark-red and shining. Tongue cracked, bleeds, heavily coated. Numb, pricking sensation in tongue. Root of tongue feels numb. Vertigo - Confused, swimming feeling in head. Vertigo, with paralysis of eyelids. Vertigo, with severe nausea. Vertigo with a weak feeling, especially of lower limbs and knees. Vertigo as if intoxicated, worse walking. Vertigo, pressure at root of nose. COMMENTS - Stupor, falls asleep while being spoken to, confused as if drunk. Cannot keep his mind together, a wild wandering feeling. This scattered feeling is further exemplified by the illusion that the body is double, limbs separated and conversing with each other. Can't sleep because body seems scattered about and cannot collect pieces. Indifferent and apathetic. There is a dull, heavy sensation in the head with drowsiness and heavy eyelids. The head feels large with a numb feeling of head and face. Bruised headache, as if soreness in brain, bruised feeling in occiput, heavy feeling at base of brain with drawing in of cervical muscles. Frontal headache with pressure at root of nose. The neck is tired, cannot hold head easy in any position. The jaw drops, prostration. The eyes cannot bear light, burn, are weak, painful on reading. Weight on eyes, eyeballs sore, feels lame on moving eyes. Blear-eyed. Lids partially paralyzed. An illusion of smell “as of burnt feathers” has been caused and cured by it. Pain in left parotid gland. Flat, bitter taste. Tongue swollen, feels numb, speech difficult. Whitish yellow coating and feels burnt or scalded. Dry, parched, brown center, cracked and ulcerated. Canker sores in mouth. Ropy saliva. Sore mouth in nursing children. Thirsty. Sore throat with abscessed tonsils and pus (Merc.). Painlessness is a feature in the sore throat, putrid, painless, dark ulcers. Esophagus feels constricted down to stomach, can only swallow liquids, cases of convulsive contraction of esophagus and cardiac orifice with regurgitation of food have been cured by it. Nausea, retching and vomiting. For food poisoning from bad water. Gastric flus with nausea, loss of appetite and diarrhea (Nux-v., Ars.). Sinking, gone feeling. Pain in liver and gallbladder. Pain in spleen, in right iliac region, in groin, swollen glands. Soreness of abdominal muscles in right iliac region. Fetid, exhausting diarrhea, dysentery in autumn or hot weather. Bleeding from the colon, dark, offensive blood. Worms. The urine is high-colored, scanty, alkaline, and fetid. Orchitis, squeezed pain in testes. Lumbar backache. Feels as if lying on a board, bed feels hard. Pain in sacrum. Weakness of lower limbs. Much prickling and numbness in left foot. Numbness and soreness. Excessive drowsiness. Bedsores with offensive discharge (Hyper., Led.). Offensive, putrid discharges, like something is decomposing. The sweat is putrid, cadaver-like odor. Threatened miscarriage (Pyrog., Caul.), from overexertion, excitement, emotional stress, morning sickness, or lifting. Sudden onset septic fevers. Overall feeling of toxicity. Drugged look, “besotted appearance,” “dusky appearance.” Septic infection from blood poisoning from an infected wound, or after childbirth or surgery. Good for toxic flu. On a spectrum, Gelsemium is the mild toxic flu. then Baptisia, then Pyrogen for the most toxic. The first keynote is a bad taste in the mouth, foul mucus in the back of the throat. Used in the past as the primary remedy for typhoid, contemporary interest for AIDS, as they share many symptoms. Possible remedy for toxic fever with an AIDS case, with diarrhea, emaciation, and chronic recurring fever. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Echinacea angus- tifolia is perhaps its nearest analog. (2) Gels., Am., Ars., Pyrog., Bry. or Ars. may be needed to complete the favorable reaction. (3) Ailan- thus differs, being more painful. Bapt. more painless. (4) Rhus-t., Mur-ac., Hyos., Kali-m., Lach., Mur-ac. and Nit-ac.. Follows well: Ars. Followedwellby: Ter., Nit-ac. Ham., in typhoid Nux-v., Op., Rhus-t. Sil. has like Bapt., ability to swallow only liquids like milk, but unlike Bapt., Sil. has aversion to milk. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mutphy. Phatak.

Liver - Soreness over region of gallbladder with diarrhea. Pain in liver, from right lateral ligament to gallbladder, can scarcely walk. Constant pain in stomach and liver, worse walking, hot sensation, heavy aching in liver. Pain in liver region on going upstairs. Lungs - Asthmatic oppression of chest, with frequent yawning. Bronchial asthma. Craves air. Afraid to go to sleep on account of sense of suffocation and nightmares. Snoring. Awakes with great difficulty of breathing. Lungs feel tight and compressed. Breathing difficult from weakness of chest, worse on waking, better standing. Cough from tickling in throat.

Kidneys - Sharp pain in region of right kidney. Shooting pain in left kidney. Burning when urinating. Increased secretion of urine at night. Urine is scanty, dark red, alkaline and fetid. Light-green urine. Uremia.

Perspiration - Fetid sweat. Beginning of typhus when the nervous symptoms predominate, causes sweat to break out and relieve. Typhus with sweat on forehead and face.

Temperature - Chill with rheumatic pains and soreness all over body. Chilly with soreness of body. High fever, sudden onset. Sweat relieves. Gastric influenza. Typhoid and cerebral forms of fever. Shipboard fever. Heat all over with occasional chills. Septic fevers. The whole surface hot and dry with occasional chills, mostly up and down the back. Typhoid fever. Hashes of heat, feeling as if sweat would break out. Uncomfortable burning all over surface, especially face.

full:
PHARMACY - baros. Barosma crenulatum. Buchu. Barosma betulina. Barosma sanatifolia. N. O. Rutacae, genus, Diosmee. South Africa. Tincture of dried leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bladder disorders. Calculus. Catarrh. Gravel. Leucorrhea. Prostate, disorders.

HERBAL - The leaves of several species of Barosma contain in vitae a volatile oil, having a warm camphor- like taste and an odor something like mint.

HOMEOPATHIC - Buchu has a markedly specific effect on mucus membranes and especially on the genito- urinary system, closely resembling that of Sabal, Populus, Copaiva and Thuja. There are no provings of the remedy and the only uses made of it have been with the tincture. Muco-purulentdischarges. Hale gave as indications chronic disorders of genito-urinary organs with muco- purulent discharges, abundance of epithelium mixed with pus and mucus corpuscles. Irritable bladder with catarrh or gravel with spasmodic stricture. Prostatic disorders. Vaginal leucorrhea. Undue secretions from mucus follicles of urethra, seminal vesicles or prostate produced by excessive sex or masturbation. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Cop., Thuj., Pop., Chim. (2) Diosm. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering and Hahnemann combined the two, Baryta acética and Baryta…
full:
PHARMACY - bar-acet. Baryta acética. Barium acetate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies, second and third trituration.

CLINICAL - Forgetful. Paralysis. Rheumatic pain.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering and Hahnemann combined the two, Baryta acética and Baryta carbonate. Hering said there is hardly any difference between the two and certainly none in the symptoms cured. Bar-a. produces paralysis beginning at the limbs and spreading upward (Con.). Pruritus of aged. MIND - Absent-minded. Forgetful. Foggy mind. Childish and stupid. Lack of self confidence. Wavering long between opposite decisions. Weak mind.

Head - Tinea capitis. Very disagreeable formication and pricking under skin of head and face.

Eyes - Immovable pupils.

Face - Feeling of cobweb in face. Cadaverous pallor. Pale face. Drawn features, eyebrows rather drooping. Dark redness of cheeks. Mouth arawn to one side.

Stomach - Retching. Nausea followed by sudden and very copious vomiting of bile. Severe attacks of very copious vomiting. Vomiting almost regularly every hour for twenty-four hours.

Rectum - Involuntary stools. Rumbling in bowels. Diarrhea. Semi-liquid stool followed by constipation. Lungs - Breathing gradually more and more embarrassed. Imperfect and very frequent respiration. Respiratory sound almost inaudible. Inability tocough, to expectorate. Inability to articulate words.

Heart - Dull, deep sounds of heart. Pulse very small and frequent.

Back - Lumbago. Fine stitches in neck. Suppurating pimples. Spinal disease with tinea capitis.

Limbs - Crawiing pain with burning stitches. Paralysis of limbs. Rheumatic pain in muscles and joints. Drawing pain down whole left leg.

Sleep - Wants to sleep all the time. Restless sleep. Moaning and muttering during sleep.

Skin - Skin cool and rather moist. Skin covered with profuse sweat.

Tongue - Cold tongue, somewhat black. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bar-c., Bar-m. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Liver - Sensation as of a ball in liver. Region of liver as if swollen and cold.

Kidneys - Frequent urination. When appetite improved and thirst lessened, urinary secretions became very considerable. Clear and abundant urine. Incontinence of urine and feces.

name: Baryta Carbonica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better walking in open air. Better cold food. Better warm wraps, warm atmosphere. Better when alone, standing. Worse while thinking of symptoms. Worse company. Worse mental exertion, emotions. Worse raising arms. Worse sitting. Worse lying on painful side. Worse left side. Worse from cold air, cold damp. Worse cold exposure to feet and head. Worse washing. Worse odors. Worse warm food and after eating. Worse supressed foot sweat. Headache is worse from heat of sun or being near a warm stove..

full:
PHARMACY - bar-c. Barytacarbonica. Barium carbonate. Bar-c. with which are included symptoms of Baryta acética. Trituration of carbonate. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Aneurysm. Arteriosclerosis. Asthma. Atheroma. Atrophy. Baldness. Brain disorders. Bronchitis. Down's, syndrome. Dwarfish, children. Colds. Cysts. Dyspepsia. Emaciation. Esophagus, spasms. Fatty tumors. Foot sweats. Glandular, swellings. Hemorrhoids. Heart, disorders. High blood pressure. Impotency. Leucorrhea. Lipomas. Marasmus. Memory, defective. Mental, retardation. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Parotiditis. Photophobia. Prostate, enlarged. Quinsy. Sarcoma. Senile, dementia. Strokes. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Tonsils, enlarged. Tumors. Warts. Vertigo. Waterbrash. Wens.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bar-c. is especially indicated in infancy and old age. Dwarfish children and childish old people. Elderly people who are overweight. It has cured a case of fetid foot sweat with spells of despondency, seeking solitude, sobbing and crying. Bar-c. has cured tumors of several kinds. Induration in the breasts. Sarcoma in neck with burning. Fatty tumors, especially about the neck. Swelling and induration of glands. Has cured baldness in young people, tinea, wens. The scalp is very sensitive to touch. Enlarged glands in occiput and neck. It has proved curative in the habitual colic of children who do not thrive, enlarged mesenteric glands. Hungry, but refuses food, painful swallowing. It's a cardio-vascular poison acting on the muscular coats of heart and vessels. Arterial fibrosis. Blood vessels soften and degenerate, become distended and aneurysms, ruptures and apoplexies result. Affects glandular structures and useful in general degenerative changes, especially in coats of arteries and senility. Many cases of aneurysm have been cured with Bar-c. It corresponds to the atheromatous condition. For those liable to take cold easily, sore throat from cold, glandular disorders. There is a tendency to enlargement of the glands with indurations especially tonsils, cervical and prostate. Takes cold easily and then always have swollen tonsils. Catarrh of posterior sinuses with frequent nosebleeds. This remedy brings aid to scrofulous children, if they are backward mentally and physically. Dull, and apathetic. Down's,syndrome, delayed development. Marasmus. Dwarfish, they do not grow and develop. Scrofulous ophthalmia with a swollen abdomen. Persons subject to quinsy, which is prone to suppurate, gums bleed easily. Diseases of old men when degenerative changes begin in cardiac and cerebral vascular. Old men who have enlarged prostate or indurated testes. Offensive foot sweats. Very sensitive to cold. Very weak and weary, must sit or lie down or lean on something. Averse to meeting strangers. Often useful in the dyspepsia of the young who have masturbated and who suffer from semina’ emissions together with cardiac irritability and palpitations. Cysts. Sarcoma with burning. Vascular softening and dila- tion, aneurysm, ruptures, strokes. Lipomas, fatty tumors. Emaciation of persons who were well nourished. Prostration, weariness, constant inclination to lie down, sit or lean on something. Upper half of the body feels stiff and numb. Too tired even to eat. Paralytic effects. MIND - Increasing mental weakness. Beclouded mind. Difficult concentration. Irresolution. Confusion. Idiocy. Senile dementia. Slow mental grasp. Loss of memory tries to recollect past events. Forgets her errand or word in her mouth. Slow, inept and backward. Thinking of ailments worse. Mental dullness. Irresolute. Lost confidence in himself. Mental functions loss after a stroke. Bashful. Timid. Cowardly. Shy of strangers. Aversion to strangers, shuns, avoids strangers and unfamiliar faces. Dread of strangers. Mistrustful. Hides behind the furniture and keeps the hands over the face, peeping through the fingers. Easily frightened and afraid of strangers. Childish and thoughtless behavior, worse since a stroke. Idiocy. Whining mood. Silly, absurd. Mental retardation. Children cannot remember to learn. Slow in learning to talk. Difficult concentration in children. Talking mania during menses in young girls. Child does not want to play but sits in the corner doing nothing. Excessively busy, without any aim. Anxiety about future. Anxiety about domestic affairs. Censorious, critical. Conscientious about trifles. Grief over trifles. Suspicious that people are talking about her. Imagines being criticised and laughed at. Thinks one is being laughed at and made fun of. Homesickness. Oversensitiveness of all senses. Heedless. Loquacity during menses. Sadness about trifles. Exaltation of fancies at night.

Head - Head sensitive to cold, disposed to catch cold when washing head. Brain feels loose, better cold air. Heavy pressure over eyes. Stitching pain when standing in sun. Pulsation in temples. Crawling over scalp, as from ants, in spots. Wens on scalp. Dry eruptions or moist crusts on the scalp. Tension as if skin were too tight. Hair falls out. Baldness of vertex. Premature baldness, even in very young men.

Eyes - Burning and pressure in eyes after exerting vision. Feeling of sand in eyes. Redness of conjunctiva, with swollen lids. Itching in eyes. Photophobia. Pressure deep in eyes, better looking downward. Light dazzles and hurts eyes. Opaque cornea. Agglutination of lids. Eyelids are granular, thickened. Pupils dilate and contract quickly. Cataracts (Calc-p., Phos., Sil.).

Ears - Hardness of hearing. Crackling noise, worse swallowing, walking. Glands around ears painful and swollen. Itching in ears. Eruptions on lobes of ears. Eruption on and behind ears. Suppuration of middle ear. Reverberation on blowing nose. Roaring in right ear. Buzzing and jingling.

Nose - Dry, sneezing, worse blowing it. Coryza with swelling of upper lip and nose. Coryza worse mornings. Tip and edges of nose are painful. Sensation of smoke in nose. Discharge of thick, yellow mucus. Frequent nosebleeds. Nosebleeds before menses. Scabs around wings of nose. Smell sensitive.

Face - Expression stupid and vacant, always whining. Tension as from a cobweb (Alum.). Sensation as if white of egg had dried on face. Parotitis after scarlatina. Face deep red with purple lips and great congestion of the blood. Prosopalgia. Eruption on the face. Lips dry and cracked. Swelling of upper lip, with burning pain. Lips pendulous. Acute pain in the joint on closing the jaws. Swelling of the submaxillary glands, with induration.

Mouth - Mouth feels numb. Sour, bitter taste. Whole mouth filled with vesicles, especially inside the cheek. Saliva runs put, while asleep. Dribbling of saliva at dawn. Fetor oris, unnoticed by himself. Awakes with dry mouth. Sudden accumulation of water in mouth.Much tough mucus in mouth.

Throat - Submaxillary glands and tonsils swollen. Takes cold easily with stitches and smarting pain. Tonsils inflamed with swollen veins. Suppurating tonsils from every cold. Enlarged tonsils. Quinsy. Smarting pain when swallowing, worse empty swallowing. Feeling of a plug in pharynx. Tendency to tonsillitis. Can swallow liquids only. Sudden waterbrash. Sore throat with salivation. Throat troubles from over use of voice. Stinging pain in tonsils, pharynx or larynx. Submaxillary gland swollen. Much burning in throat. Chronic torticollis.

Stomach - Sensitivity of stomach. Spasms of esophagus as soon as food enters esophagus, causes gagging and choking (Merc-c., Graph.). Pain and weight immediately after a meal with epigastric Baryta carbónica tenderness (Kali-c.). Pain while fasting and after eating. Sore spot in stomach. Weak digestion of old people with possible malignancy, better cold food. Dyspepsia of young masturbators or with seminal emissions. Long-lasting nausea. Morning sickness and vomiting. Vomiting fluid, water and chalk, followed by prostration. Waterbrash, hiccough and eructation, which relieves pressure as of a stone.

Abdomen - Habitual colic of children who do not thrive and though apparently hungry refuse food. Children with large abdomen. Hard and tense, tender, distended with emaciation of body. Colicky pains. Pain in abdomen swallowing food. Colic with hunger, but food is refused. As if intestines fell from one side to other on turning in bed. Mesenteric glands hard and swollen.

Rectum - Burning in anus and rectum during stool. Crawling in rectum. Ascarides. Hemorrhoids protrude while urinating. Shooting pain in hemorrhoids. Constipation with hard, knotty stools. Diarrhea with lumbar ache. Diarrhea, with bloody mucus. Anus sore and moist. Oozing at anus. Anus as if excoriated.

Male - Enlarged prostate gland. Flabby genitals. Genitals feel numb. Indurated testicles. Small retracted testicles. Impo- tency. Premature emissions. Diminished desire. Erections when riding. Erections only in morning before rising. Falling asleep during sex. Painful nodes in breast in old fat men. Moisture and soreness between scrotum and thighs. Sweats about scrotum.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses scanty, last only one day. Before menses, pain in stomach and lumbar back. Menses of long duration. Tearing pain in vulva. Leucorrhea, immediately before menses. Genitals feel numb. Atrophy of ovaries and breasts. Food - Loss of appetite, though food has natural taste. Food has a sour taste. Hungry, but refuses food. Sudden disgust while eating. Aversion to sweet things, fruits especially plums. Desire for sweets. Worse after warm food. Better from cold diet. Weakness of digestion. Thirst during chill.

Chest - Sharp pain in chest, worse inspiration. Pains in the chest, mitigated partly by belching and by external heat. Sensation of soreness in the chest. Fullness and pressive heaviness, especially when ascending. Chest as if sore when coughing. Pain in axillary glands, which are swollen. Chest sensitive to pressure. Itching and burning stinging in moist, pustular eruption on chest. Constitutions - Marked influence on the growth especially of children and old people, who become childish. In children the growth is retarded, they become dwarfish mentally and physically. Children are late coming into maturity to take on their responsibilities and do their work. It is a remedy for early senility and when degenerative changes in old men begin in heart, brain and vascular system.

Heart - Arteriosclerosis. High blood pressure. Aneurysm. Cardiac symptoms after suppressed foot sweat or after masturbation. Heart feels bruised, sore. Palpitations and distress in region of heart. Palpitations Baryta carbónica when lying on left side, when thinking of it. Palpitation felt in head. Violent, long- lasting palpitations. Pulse full and hard. Pulse, slow, small.

Back - Burning in back. Glands swollen in nape and occiput. Weakness of spine. Pulsation in back after emotions. Bruised pain between scapulae. Indurated cervical glands, like knotted cords. Stiffness in sacrum. Throbbing in back after emotions. Fatty tumors upon the neck. Chronic torticollis. Itching on lumbar region. Cramp in neck. Causations - Ill effects of checked foot sweat. Vaccinations.

Limbs - Pain in axillary glands. Pain in deltoid on raising arms. Limbs feel numb. Numbness from knees to scrotum, better when sitting. Fingers numb. Pain in joints, burning pains in lower limbs. Trembling of feet and hands while writing. Cold, foul foot sweat. Pain in the knees, while kneeling. Cold, clammy feet (Calc.). Fetidfoot sweats. Toes and soles sore, soles painful when walking. Soles feel hot or bruised at night during sleep. Lungs - Asthma of old people, worse wet, warm air. Chronic bronchitis. Oppressed, breathing with anguish. Paralytic aphonia. Larynx feels as if smoke were inhaled. Lungs feel full of smoke. Paralysis of lungs in elderly people.

Sleep - Sleepy and can't sleep. Sleepiness in the daytime. Sleepiness and weariness on slightest exertion. Talking in sleep, awakens frequently, feels too hot. Twitching during sleep. Sleep, agitated. Frequent waking and anxious dreams. Almost constant dreaming, causes anxiety at night.

Skin - Acne. Lipomas. Cysts. Whitlows. Intolerable itching and tingling over the whole body at night. Sensation like the pricks of burning needles, itching and crawling sensations. Burning sarcoma. Excoriation and oozing in several parts of the skin. Injuries in the skin heal with difficulty. Swelling and induration of the glands. Warts.

Modalities - Better walking in open air. Better cold food. Better warm wraps, warm atmosphere. Better when alone, standing. Worse while thinking of symptoms. Worse company. Worse mental exertion, emotions. Worse raising arms. Worse sitting. Worse lying on painful side. Worse left side. Worse from cold air, cold damp. Worse cold exposure to feet and head. Worse washing. Worse odors. Worse warm food and after eating. Worse supressed foot sweat. Headache is worse from heat of sun or being near a warm stove.

Teeth - Rapid decay of teeth. Gums bleed and retract. Gums hurt when touched. Toothache with swelling of gums. Toothache, worse before menses. Involuntary chattering of teeth. Fistula dentalis. Abscesses at roots.

Tongue - Tongue, weak, hard, cannot speak. Paralysis of tongue. Smarting, burning, in tip of tongue. Burning soreness or vesicles on tip or under the tongue. Tongue as if swollen, with dryness, early in morning. Tip of tongue cracked and sore. As if blisters were on side of tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo with confusion, in morning. Vertigo when standing in the sun, sharp pain extending through head. Vertigo of elderly people. Vertigo with nausea, worse stooping. Vertigo when lifting arms up. Vision - Amblyopia. Gauze before eyes. Fiery sparks before eyes in dark. Sparks before eyes in dark. Diplopia. Weakness of sight caused by old age. Flying webs and black spots. Optical illusions, gener- ally in bright colors. Sees everything as in a fog when closing eyes and pressing balls. Sees a cloud before left eye. Weak vision, worse during day, evening. Weak vision in candlelight COMMENTS - A paralytic condition runs throughout the pathogenesis. There is paralysis of mind and body. Mistrust, lack of self-confidence, aversion to strangers. The child does not want to play. Deficient memory. Children cannot remember and learn. Sensation as if the brain is loose. Vertigo with nausea from stooping, or when lifting arms up in old people. Pressure and sticking in brain at vertex, on waking. Rough, dry and herpetic eruptions on the face. Dark redness. Tension of whole face as if egg white had dried on it, as if a cobweb (Bar-acet.), over face, temples and scalp. Painful swelling of parotid and of submaxillary glands. The sense of smell is very acute, may have an illusion of the smell of pine smoke. Nosebleed before menses. The tongue is paralyzed. Salivation, saliva runs out during sleep. The digestion is weak after eating. Pressing in the stomach, pain in hard, swollen abdomen. Stomach feels sore while eating, it feels as if the food had to force its way through some raw place. The anus is sore and humid. Hemorrhoids protrude with urination as well as stool. Constipation with hard, knotty stools, hemorrhoids, burning and soreness. The paralytic condition appears in the sexual organs. Soreness and moistening between scrotum and thighs. Impotence. Enlarged prostate. Paralytic condition of the respiratory organs. Feeling in the larynx as if inspiring smoke or pitch. Hoarseness and loss of voice from cough, mucus in larynx and trachea. Suffocating catarrh and paralysis of lungs in old people. Sensation as if lungs are full of smoke. There is a spasmodic cough, like whooping cough, from roughness and tickling in the throat and the pit of stomach. Cough is worse evening until midnight. Worse after getting feet cold, exercise, lying left side, cold air, thinking of it. Palpitations with soreness of heart, worse lying on left side, worse thinking of it. Violent, long-lasting palpitation felt in head. Palpitations worse on exertion. Slightest exertion makes him feel tired and sleepy. Aneurysm and atheroma. Marked pulsation in the back. Stiffness and tension in small of back in the evening, especially while sitting, allowing one to neither rise nor bend backwards. Painfulness of arms and swelling of axillary glands. Cold feet. Fetid perspiration of feet. Corns with burning and stinging. Burning and drawing pains are frequent in lowerlimbs. Tearing in limbs with chilliness. Tension and shortening of muscles Intolerable irritation all over like prickings and tingling, waking him at night. Itching, sore and humid skins. Warts. General soreness and sensitiveness. Small wounds ulcerate and get very sore. Offensive sweat of one side (mostly the left). Cold, clammy feet (Calc.). Chilliness predominates. Left side much affected. After eating, so weak cannot raise his hands. Too weak to masticate. Down's syndrome, delayed development. Slow learning, slow speech, slow walking and coordination, delayed dentition. Difficulty making connections between words and objects, communication problems. Weak long-term memory, forgetfulness, poor attention span. Simian fold, a straight line across the palms. Retarded development of growth, or of a specific organ. Stimulates the growth hormone (Pituin. 6x) if child is still growing. Also for pituitary tumors. Growth could be stopped by trauma, vaccination, or shock. Delayed development of the genitalia, especially the ovaries and the testicles. Undescended testicles (Aur., Clem.). Very shy, gentle, and docile. They have very poor self-confidence. Inability to make decisions. The Bar-c constitution has floppy hands and feet, and giggling, spacey eyes. Simple mindedness. Symptoms of autism, dreamy. Never leave childish state, dependent. Dumbfounded look on their face, clumsy, dull. Can have night terrors (Calc.). Post-apoplectic in the elderly, when they revert to a childhood-like states. They become very shy and sensitive and can't make decisions. Also from epilepsy or head injury. Elderly have poor memory and indecision, some of the symptoms of Alzheimer's. Premature senility. Can have high blood pressure, swollen glands. Hormonal problems which age them quickly. Both the elderly and children need a specific routine, structure, to be happy. Children can have recurring tonsillitis (Bar-m.). Tendencies to colds, with swollen glands. A lot of adenoid problems. Can have skin problems. Chilly. Can get emaciation easily, especially after infections. Lymphatic problems with a history of glandular problems. They have an enlarged abdomen (Sil., Calc., Sanie.). Offensive foot sweats (Sil., Nit-ac., Graph., Calc.). Clarke cured an advanced case of thoracic aneurysm with the 3x. A case has been recorded in which Bar-c. removed from an old man a pain that came suddenly in the hollow of the knee and ran down the back of the leg like a thin stream of hot fluid or molten metal running down under the skin. RELATIONS - Antidote for poisonous doses: Epsom salts. Antidoted by: Ant-t„ Bell., Camph., Dulc., Merc., Zinc. Compare: (1) Dig., Rad-br.. Arag., Oxyt., Astrag. Alum. (2) Ant-t. - paralysis of lungs. (3) Bell., Calc. - scrofulosis, coryza, etc. Calc-i. - large tonsils, Caust. - paralysis, Cham., Chin. (4) Con. - old people, Dulc. - catching cold, Fl-ac. - old people, lod. - glands, Lach., Lyc. (tonsils). (5) Mag-c., Merc, -colds, glands, diarrhea, Nat-c., Phos., Puls., Sep. (tinea), (6) Sil. - glands, fetid foot sweat, but Bar-c. lacks the head-sweat of Sil. and Sil. has self-will instead of the weak-mindedness of Bar-c. (7) Sulph., Tell. Compatible: after Scilla. Ars. Before and after Sulph. Complementary: Dulc., Silica, Psor. Incompatible: Calc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Mur- phy-

Kidneys - Burning in urethra on urinating. Every time patient urinates, his hemorrhoids come down. Urging to urinate, cannotretain the urine. Renewed straining after urination, with dribbling of urine. Frequent urination. Passes much urine at night. Urine is dark brown, scanty.

Cough - Dry suffocative cough in old people, full of mucus but lacking strength to expectorate. Cough after getting feet wet, or least exposure to cold air. Cough is worse every change of weather (Seneg.). Cough worse in the presence of strangers, eating warm food. Chronic cough, in scrofulous children, with swollen glands and enlarged tonsils.

Perspiration - Sweats on single parts, one hand, one foot, Sweats on one side of body, face. Fetid foot sweats. Stinking sweat of feet. Worse supressedfoot sweat. Debilitating at night.

Temperature - Strong disposition to chilliness. Chilliness relieved by external heat. Flushes of heat, more at night.

name: Baryta Iodata
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cold open air. Worse from walking. COMMENTS - Grimmer noted that Bar-i. has been used for breast cancer, breast tumors and eniargedglands.Breastcancersaftertrauma. HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Bar-m. are like those of the other Barium salts, but it hasadistinctcharacterofitsown. Convulsions are more marked in the muriate. Many cases of aneurysm have been benefited by Bar-m. Both elements have a strong action on the heart and arteries. It has cured whizzing and buzzing in ears, noises on chewing and swallowing. In one poisoning case, that of a girl, the instant she swallowed the solution she exclaimed that she was on fire; vomitings, convulsions, pain in the head and complete deafness supervened and death in an hour. Bar-m. causes vascular degeneration, causing hypertension when high systolic pressure with a comparatively low diastolic is present with cerebral and cardiac symptoms. Arteriosclerosis (Aur., Sec.), and cerebral disorders due to this condition. Increased tension of pulse. Vertigo, due to cerebral anemia and noises in ears. Acts on the lower digestive tract, especially rectum, on muscles and joints, giving stiffness and weakness as from walking too much. Indurated and narrowing of the cardiac orifice with pain, immediately after eating, and epigastric tenderness. Multiple sclerosis of brain and cord. Voluntary muscular power gone but perfectly sensible. Paresis after influenza and diphtheria. Icy coldness of body with paralysis. Convulsions. Convulsive attacks occur periodically with starting and excessive tossing about. Electric shocks with convulsions. General feeling of lassitude in the morning, especially weakness of the legs with muscular stiffness. Great weakness, wants to lie down. Enlargement of the glands and induration tonsils, pancreas. Chronic hypertrophy of the tonsils. Nymphomania and satyriasis. In every form of mania when the sexual desire is increased. Children who go around with their mouth open and who talk through the nose. Child lies on the abdomen all the time to shun the light. Stupid appearing, hard of hearing. Headaches, but without acute crisis, occurring in old people, heaviness rather than pain. MIND - Answers confusedly as if thinking of something else. Anxiety in evening. Irresolution. Sense of oppressive anxiety. Sadness in morning. Dejection and dread of men. Suspicious. Talking in sleep. Sexual mania in every form when sexual desire is increased. Dullness of mind. Stupid appearance. Idiocy. Startles easily. Children are inattentive when studying, sit in corners and give confused answers. Indisposition to play in children.

Head - Headache with vomiting. Heaviness of head in elderly people. Very purulent eruptions on the scalp. Scabby eruptions on the head and neck.

Eyes - Eyes fixed and immovable. Pupils dilated and insensible, with fixed look. Blennorrheal of the eyes, of the ears, and of the nose. Shuns light, child lies all the time on its face.

Ears - Earache, better sipping cold water. Offensive otorrhea. Inflates middle ear on blowing nose. Hard of hearing. Noises on chewing and swallowing or sneezing. Whizzing and buzzing.

Nose - Coryza. Sneezing in sleep without waking.

Face - Pulling pains in the muscles of the face. Painful nodosity at the point of the nose with slight pricking. Parotids swollen.

Mouth - Swelling of the salivary glands and palate. Tongue loaded. Tongue and mouth dry. Fetor of the mouth, as if from mercury. Putrid taste in the mouth, also of food.

Throat - Suppuration of tonsils after every cold. Swallowing difficult. Tonsillitis. Tonsils enlarged and infected. Uvula elongated. Paresis of pharynx and Eustachian tubes with sneezing and noises. Throat feels too wide open. Varicose veins of throat. Vertigo - Vertigo due to cerebral anemia and noises in the ears. Vertigo, swimming before the eyes, things turnaround. Head confused and heavy. COMMENTS - Periodical attacks of convulsions with excessive excitement of the limbs. Idiocy. Mania with increase of sexual desire, “in every form of mania as soon as the sexual desire is increased.” Offensive otorrhea. Parotid glands hard and swollen, especially right. Earache is better by sipping cold water. Deafness. Great salivation and odor from mouth as from mercurialization. Swelling of salivary glands. Disposition to tonsillitis. Great indigestion. A hardness below the stomach to left, from which paroxysms of dyspnea come. Induration of pancreas. Distressing throbbing in abdomen with abdominal aneurysm. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In sclerotic degenerations, especially of spinal cord, liver and heart. Plb. met. and Plb-i. (2) Aur-m. (3) Con. - indurations of abdominal glands. (4) lod., Kali-i. and Iris (pancreas). Sei. (pulsa- tions in abdomen). (5) Useful after Ars. in extravasations of blood. (6) The vomiting is antidoted by Absinthe. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Distressing throbbing in abdomen (Sei.). Induration of pancreas. Abdominal aneurysm. Inguinal glands swollen.

Rectum - Spasmodic pain in rectum. Feces slimy, jelly-like with blood. Stools white, hard as stones. Easy evacuation. Chronic, painless diarrhea or diarrhea with violent colic.

Female - Induration of ovaries. Tumor or atrophy of ovaries. Infertility. Menses too early. Pains as from a bruise, in the pelvis. Leucorrhea. Nymphomania. Food - Loss of appetite. Thirst.

Chest - Catarrh with heat. Heat in the upper part of the chest. Oppression. Constitutions - Useful in old age and childhood, when mental and physical dwarfishness is present (Bar-c.). Acts on parotid glands and pancreas. Suited to scrofulous children. Attacks of tonsillitis occurring in spring and autumn.

Great accumulation and rattling of mucus with difficult expectoration. Facilitates expectoration. Senile asthma. Bronchial disorders of elderly people with cardiac dilation. Chronic cough of scrofulous children.

Skin - Burning and pricking in excoriated places. Small, itchy eruptions on the head, nape of the neck, abdomen, and thighs. Glands are inflamed and ulcerated. Hemorrhage.

Kidneys - Great increase in uric acid, diminution of chlorides. Frequent, involuntary, and painful urine. Very offensive urine, yellowish, with whitish sediment.

Temperature - General dry heat, night and day. Redness and heat of the face. Pulse frequent and full. Tertian fever.

keynote: PHARMACY - beech-b. Beech. Fagus syl- vatica. The remedy is prepared by the boiling method. Small twigs and male and female flowers, they are found on the same tree, are boiled for half an hour. The boiled water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops…
full:
PHARMACY - beech-b. Beech. Fagus syl- vatica. The remedy is prepared by the boiling method. Small twigs and male and female flowers, they are found on the same tree, are boiled for half an hour. The boiled water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.

HOMEOPATHIC - Together with the remedies Rock Water, Vine, Vervain and Chicory, this remedy belongs to Bach's group of Over-care for Others' Welfare. These five remedies deal with attitudes of control and over- care towards others. People in need of Beech may appear haughty and rigid in body posture, in some cases, frequently raised eyebrows can be observed. Faultfinding, criticism and intolerance are predominant traits. The attitude may also be less condescending, more nagging and dissatisfied. In the treatment of persecutory delusions or paranoid personality disorders, Beech lessens the tendency to overly criticize others and fit them into a specific image with threatening features (Holly-b., Will-b.). MIND - Bach described the indications for the remedy, “The mind is narrowed in perception, tolerance andj udgment, although one believes oneself to have the right attitude and capacity for assessment. This results in self-deception. The ego raises itself above others with the selfappointed right to assume critical judgment on another's expression of life. It is a state of arrogance, an attempt to impress upon others one's own standards of assessment considered special or perfect. “Judging others creates superiority and those criticized are held low, condescended against. Oftentimes, one actually does not want them.to measure up to one's own perfect style, so that one may continue to consider oneself special. The mind does not want others to move up in standard and it gives more personal satisfaction to keep them in their place. “There is often an underlying sadness, a personal loss of a more perfect reality that is mourned. To have personal perfect standards and finding reality wanting implies a loss, a sense of being let down. In many cases, if grief was not allowed to be fully worked through there may develop a Beech state. The event or person is criticized or rejected, instead of mourned.” REFERENCES Bach.

Glands swollen, tender, red. Marked action on the vascular system, skin and glands. Hot, red face, semi-stupor, every little while starting or jumping in sleep as if it might go into convulsions. Excited mental state, hyperesthesia of all senses, delirium, restless sleep. Spasms, shocks, jerks and twitching. Constrictions occur in parts of the body like throat, vagina etc. or in ^ whole body. Fullness, congestion especially to head, and swelling. Pains are throbbing, sharp, cutting, shooting or clawing of maddening severity, coming and going in repeated attacks. Severe neuralgic pain, that come and go suddenly (Oxyt.). Violent attacks and sudden of onset. Complaints come suddenly. Hot, red skin, flushed face, dilated pupils, throbbing carotids. Marked burning heat, bright redness and dryness. Red streaks. Hot body, part, etc. Discharges are hot and scanty. Hot hemorrhages. Convulsive movements. Epileptic attacks are followed by nausea and vomiting. Spasms are followed by prolonged unconsciousness. Throws the body forwards and backwards, chorea. Convulsions commence in the arm. Scarlet fever, also as a prophylactic. Exophthalmic goiter with extreme thyroid toxemia. Sensitive to light, noise, jarring. Dry mouth and throat with aversion to water. No thirst. Hydrophobia.
