CLINICAL - Absent minded. Acne. Asphyxia. Boils. Chills. Coccyx, itching. Colic. Constipation. Corns. Cough. Cysts. Diabetes mellitus. Diarrhea. Ear, eczema. Eczema. Fever. Flatulence. Ganglion. Gleet. Headache. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Hiccough. Jaundice. Joints, disorders. Leucorrhea. Menstruation, disordered. Metrorrhagia. Morning sickness. Nausea. Neuritis. Nosebleed. Ovarian,cysts. Ovaries, disorders. Palpitations. Pellagra. Rheumatic, disorders. Scurvy. Stammering. Tetters. Tongue, ulcers. Tumors. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Whitlow. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Clarke stated “This globular fungus, which, according to report is eaten in Italy before it is ripe, becomes filled, while ripening with a black dust that breaks the husk which contains it with a slight noise.” Corresponding to this signature, “bloated, puffy condition of body surface,” and a sense of “enlargement,” leading features of the Bov. pathogenesis include flatulent distention and noisy passage of flatus. Guernsey added “We may always think of Bov. when we see a very ‘tettery' person, one who has tetters here and there, all over the body. These tetters may be either moist or dry.” The puffball exerts its influence on the circulation, causing relaxation of the capillary system, thereby ptoducinghemorrhagic diathesis. There is a general puffiness, bloated condition of body surface, which produces easy indentations with a blunt instrument (scissors etc.). Eczema-like eruption. Herpes. Marked languor and lassitude. Laxity, especially felt in joints, which seem loose. Great weakness of the joints (has cured where Rhus-t. seemed indicated and failed). Nervous joints. Enlarged or swollen feeling in head, heart, etc. Stage of numbness and tingling in multiple neuritis. Asphyxia due to charcoal fumes. Effects of over-exertion and application of tar locally. MIND - Awkward in speech and action, drops things. Everything falls from hands. Absentminded. Weak memory. Inattentive. Slowness of understanding and comprehension. Dullness, with restlessness. Alternating moods. Laughs and cries alternately. Sensitive, takes offense at everything. Ill-humor, aversion to all things. Quarrelsome. Wants to fight. Fear of insanity on waking from a dream. Irritable, takes everything amiss. Confusion on waking. Confusion while standing. Confusion when stooping. Enlarged sensation (Arg-n.). Stares vacantly into space. Sad when alone. Cheerful in company. Mental symptoms from sexual excesses.

Head - Dull, bruised pain in brain. Confusion on waking. Staggering, confusion and numbness in head after sex. Tension headaches, worse early morning, open air, lying. Stupefying headache in forehead and vertex. Sensation as if head were enlarging, especially of occiput. As if wedge is pressed in occiput. Scalp itches, worse warmth, sensitive, must scratch until sore. Falling out of hair. Scalp tender to touch.

Eyes - Eyes look weak and dim. Inflammation of eyelids, with nightly agglutination. Pressure in orbits. Vertical half-sight. Objects seem to be nearer than they really are. Stares at one point. Loss of vision from paralysis of optic nerve.

Ears - Boil in right ear with pain, worse swallowing. Discharge of fetid pus. Indistinct hearing, misunderstands much Bovista lycoperdon that is spoken.

Nose - Nose stopped up, cannot breathe, worse lying down. Scurf and crusts about nostrils and corners of mouth. Discharge from nose, stringy, tough. Watery coryza with dizziness. Bleeding of nose and gums. Nosebleed with menstrual irregularity, or from trauma. Bleeding early in the morning (during sleep), a few drops escape on sneezing.

Face - Frequent violent alternations of color. Acne, worse in summer, due to use of cosmetics. Cheeks and lips swollen. Crusts about corners of mouth. Twitching of muscles, before asthma. Pale swelling of cheek after toothache.

Mouth - Putrid taste. Stammering when reading with inability to pronounce several words rapidly. Stammering (Stram., Merc.). Mouth dry, as if sand were in it. Numbness. Increased saliva. Offensive odor from mouth. Gums bleed easily on sucking them. Bleeding after tooth extraction. Lips chapped, cracked, crusty. Pale swelling of upper lip. Scurf and crusts about nostrils and corners of mouth. Corners of mouth sore.

Throat - Burning pain in throat. Sharp pain in throat before asthma. Sore throat with scratching and burning in esophagus. Scratching sensation in larynx with viscid mucus. Rawness in larynx, mornings, with catarrhal speech. Hoarseness in morning, with scraping in throat.

Stomach - Empty eructations. Intolerant of tight clothing around waist. Hiccough before and after dinner. Sensation as if a lump of ice in stomach. Pressure and fulness in pit. Nausea better breakfast. Nausea with chilliness, whole forenbon. Morning sickness, vomits only water. Vomits watery fluid.

Abdomen - Bloatedness of abdomen. Cannot bear tight clothing around the waist. Flatulence or rumbling with constipation. Pain around umbilicus. Abdominal colic, with bright red urine. Flatulent colic. Colic relieved by eating and bending double. Offensive flatus. Sharp pain through perineum towards rectum and genitals. Coldness sensation moving about in abdomen. Ulceration in bowels.

Rectum - Offensive flatus. Flatulence or rumbling with constipation. Constipation. Fruitless urging to stool. Sharp pains through perineum towards rectum and genitals. First portion of stool is hard, latter part thin and watery. Diarrhea worse before and during menses. Chronic diarrhea of elderly people, worse at night and early morning. Diarrhea, better after breakfast. Itching in rectum, as from worms.

Male - Increased sexual desire. Reeling and confusion in head after sex.

Female - Burning pain in genitals. Menses too early. Menses too profuse, worse at night. Menses every two weeks, much dark and clotted blood. Soreness of pubes during menses. Traces of menses between menstruation. Leucorrhea a few days before or a few days after menses. Leucorrhea like white of egg, when walking. Leucorrhoea acrid, thick, tough, greenish, leaving green spots on linen worse while walking after menses. Metrorrhagia. Cannot bear tight clothing around waist (Lach.). Ovarian cysts. Voluptuous sensation. Food - Excessive hunger, even after meals. No appetite for cooked food, desire for bread only. Desire for brandy, wine, milk. Hot food relieves. Worse spirituous liquors, wine, cold food. Confusion from spirituous liquors, after wine. Thirst for cold drinks. Thirst during chill and heat.

Chest - Oppression of chest, as from constriction, with desire to loosen clothes. Sharp pains in various parts of chest. Sweat in axilla, onion smell. Burning in outer chest. Constitutions - Hemorrhagic diathesis. Adapted to old maids with palpitations and stammering children.

Heart - Heart feels enormously large. Palpitations as if heart working in water. Palpitations with tremor of hands, worse bathing, excitement. Palpitations worse after eating. Palpitations with restlessness, nausea and headache. Palpitations Bovista lycoperdon during menses. Visible palpitations of the heart.

Back - Pain in the back with heaviness after stooping. Tip of coccyx itches intolerably. Pain and stiffness of back after stooping. Stiffness of neck in morning. Shooting pains between the shoulders are better from bending, straightening up. Sharp pains in neck. Causations - Antidotes effects of charcoal fumes.

Limbs - Great weakness of all joints, clumsiness with her hands, drops things from hands. Weariness of hands and feet. Moist eczema on back of hand. Weak hands. Heavy, painful legs. Itching of feet and legs. Tip of coccyx itches intolerably. Edematous swelling of (right) foot even years after a sprain. Edema of joints after fracture. Lungs - Asthma preceded by twitching of facial muscles. Shortness of breath on moving the arms. Viscid expectoration. Spasmodic laughing and crying with asthma. Dry cough, caused by tickling in throat and chest. Cough after coming into room from cold air. Loose cough in evening, dry in morning.

Sleep - Spasmodic yawning before asthma, morning sweat in bed. Night Great drowsiness in afternoon and early evening and after eating, rest disturbed by burning and itching of nettle-rash. Restless sleep with many anxious, frightful dreams.

Skin - Eczema, red, burns, itches, disturbs sleep. Eczema, moist formation of thick crusts. Jaundice of newborns. Pellagra. Itching on getting warm. Itching eruptions, oozing, forming thick crusts or scabs with pus beneath. Urticaria on excitement with rheumatic lameness, palpitations and diarrhea (Dulc.). Urticaria covering whole body with diarrhea or metrorrha; gia. Urticaria on waking in the morning, worse from bathing. Pimples cover the entire body. Scurvy. Herpetic eruptions. Shooting pain in corns and warts. Blunt instruments leave deep impression on the skin. Tetter, moist or dry, red, scabby eruptions.

Modalities - Better from bending double. Better eating, hot food. Worse before and during menses. Worse hot weather, getting warm. Worse full moon. Worse from cold food, coffee, and wine. Worse at night. Worse after eating. Worse when blowing nose. Easily intoxicated, worse wine.

Tongue - Soreness or ulcers on edges of tongue. Burning in tip of tongue early in morning on waking. Cutting pain in tongue, before asthma. Numbness of posterior portion of tongue early in morning on waking. Tongue feels almost like wood. Vertigo - V ertigo with feeling of stupidity in head on rising. Vertigo and confusion of head after sex. Vertigo, falls over, momentarily unconscious in morning. Sudden attacks of vertigo while standing. COMMENTS - Relaxation of entire capillary system. The heart feels enormously large. Hemorrhagic diathesis. Hemorrhage from menstrual irregularities, from trauma. Hemorrhage between the periods. Menstrual flow occurring only or chiefly at night. Ovarian cysts. Puffy condition of the body, surface instruments (e.g., scissors) indent the fingers in an unusual degree. Sweat of axilla, smells like onions. Early morning sweat, worse on chest. Many symptoms are worse in early morning, including the diarrhea. Sensitive to touch, cannot bear clothing. Sensitive to drafts, chilliness predominates. Warts and corns with shooting pains. Ebullitions with great thirst. “Itching at top of coccyx.” The corners of the mouth are broken out. Numb, pithy feeling in mouth. There is stuttering and stammering speech. Awkwardness, misapplies words in speaking and writing. Colic, causing the patient to bend double (Coloc.), better by eating, sometimes accompanied by voiding of red urine. M. L. Sircar recorded a striking cure of such a case with Bov. 3x, the pain being griping-twisting intermittent, starting be- low umbilicus and diffusing itself towards epigastrium, some constipation, urine scanty and reddish. Nothing gave relief except eating. Teste observed psoric eruptions appear on the hands and feet of a patient to whom he gave Bov. for a headache. He cured with it “red, crusty eruptions on thighs and bends of knees of eighteen years' duration.” It disappeared for weeks, reappearing in hot weather and at the full moon. W. S. Gee recorded a case concerning a widow, 55. She had an eruption, which she thought to be erysipelas, on her right foot. . Some years before, she had an eruption on her left foot, which discharged much water and was “cured" by the use of a salve. A few months later, the left knee became affected and the limb was amputated above the joint. The current eruption was fiery red, covered with yellowish-brown scales, thick as an old-fashioned wafer. There were also rheumatic pains in the leg. After Rhus-t. had been given without benefit, she was cured with Bov. 4c. Dr. Gee elicited additional symptoms including “Occasional spells of short breathing, especially from working with the hands. Frequent desire to urinate, even immediately after urinating. Sleep disturbed by burning and itching and also by anxious, frightful dreams, headache when waking from sleep.” Lilienthal noted “moist vesicular eruptions with formation of thick crusts”; Bov. was given with steady improvement and eventual cure. A case of cyst in the broad ligament was cured. It was accompanied by metrorrhagia, flow at night or early morning, easily provoked from slight over-exertion during menses. Could bear nothing tight around body. Menses were preceded and followed by diarrhea. Acrid, corrosive leucorrhea, flowing at night only, follows menses. RELATIONS - It antidotes: Effects of Tar ap- plied locally. Compare: ( 1 ) Calc., Cic., Rhus-t., Sep., Phos., Puls., Staph., Sulph., Verat., Bell., Bry., Carb-v., Caust., Kali-c., Lyc., Merc., Nat- m., Sil., Spig., Stront., Valer. Aur., Puls., Lyc. (2) Stram. - laughter alternately with weeping. (3) Ars., Lyc., Sulph. - sinking immediately after eating. (4) Bufo - sensation as if heart in water. (5) Zinc. - worse from wine. (6) Coloc. - colic better bending double. (7) Am-c. - poisoning by charcoal fumes. (8) Stram. - stammering. (9) Ambra - hemorrhage between periods. (10) Sec., Ust. Followed well by: Alum., Calc., Rhus-t., Sep. Teste puts Bov. in his Sulphur group. Antidoted by: Camph. Bov. antidotes coal tar applications. Suffocation from gas. After Rhus-t. in chronic urticaria. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate, even immediately after urination. Diabetes mellitus. Stinging, itching, burning in urethra. Bright red urine. Urine bright yellow. Urine with slowly forming cloud, turbid. Urine like loam water. Urine with violet sediment.

Perspiration - Sweat in axilla, onion smell. Sweats in morning, most profuse on chest.

Temperature - Chills with pain. Chills after going to bed at night. Chill predominating, even near a warm stove. Chills all night: Shivering in evening, spreading from back. Shuddering alternating with flying heat. Fever with thirst, anxiety and restlessness. Fever heat during sleep.

PHARMACY - brach. Brachyglottis repens. Puka puka. N. O. Eupatoriacae. New Zealand. Compositae. Tincture of green leaves and flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Back, pain. Bright's disease. Cystitis. Dysmenorrhea. Nephritis. Writer's cramp.

HERBAL - The Maoris use the leaves to apply to old sores and ulcers. Horses eating young shrubs lose all power over their hind legs and spine.

HOMEOPATHIC - Brachyglottis was proved byC. L. Fischer. A large number of symptoms were produced in all regions of the body, but few have been tested clinically. Kidney and bladder symptoms predominate. Bright's disease. Produces symptoms of albuminuria. Urgency in passing urine, pain in neck of bladder. Pain in bladder after urinating. Pain in urethra and stinging in penis. A large quantity of pale-colored urine voided of low specific gravity and containing albumen. Causes lassitude, weakness, and flesh loss. Fluttering sensation (Calad.). Throbbing pains. Pains in back and limbs. Oppression of chest. Writer's cramp. Chilliness predominates. Itching in ears and nostrils. Dysmenorrhea with fluttering in abdomen, right ovary has been cured with it.

Head - Cold sensation and tightness about scalp. Throbbing in left temple. Headache over left or right eye. Headache and faceache become very severe and prevent sleep during night.

Eyes - Soreness around eyes, as if bruised. Dim sight during pressure in forehead.

Ears - Tingling, itching, pricking in ears. Throbbing about right ear, from ear to eyes, and throat to neck.

Nose - Nostrils, sore, itching. Irritation in nose.

Face - Twitching in left side of face (evening). Soreness right zygomatic process. Flushed face. Face ache left side, submaxillary glands affected.

Mouth - Pain, numbness, pricking, soreness of tongue. Heat in mouth. Toothache right side.

Throat - Soreness, rawness, scraping in throat, worse by swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo with flushed face. Vertigo with pain in forehead. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Helon., Merc-c., Plb. (2) Apis - soreness, stinging in urethra, Am. - bruised, sore feeling. (3) Bov. albuminuria, Helonias, Merc-c. - albuminuria, urging to urinate and defecate. (4) Nux-v. - urging to urinate and defecate. (5) Op. - constipation, Plb. - feces like balls, painful urination, albuminuria. (6) Eupatoriacae. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea in stomach. Fluttering. Soreness in evening. Throbbing in stomach. right side. Temerature - Chilliness and shivering. Coldness of hands and feet. Nervous chills.

Abdomen - Isolated throbbing in left groin. Fluttering sensation in abdomen. Feeling as if something rolling about.

Rectum - Ineffectual urging for stool. Diarrheic stools in evening. Tendency to diarrhea. Constipation. Evacuation of dry feces with sore, constrictive pain in anus. Feces like balls and knotty. Dry stool, like balls, evacuated with sore, constrictive pain in anus, evening.

Male - Throbbing in penis and desire to pass urine, pressure in bladder.

Female - Fluttering in region of ovary. Dysmenorrhea with fluttering in abdomen and right ovary.

Chest - Pains flying about chest and precordial region. Throbbing in sternum.

Back - First dorsal vertebra sore to touch. Cutting under left shoulder. Aching in lumbar region. Isolated throbbing in right side of back. Feeling as if whole back would contract backward and muscles of neck were affected.

Limbs - Great weakness in limbs, weariness and prostration. Cramp in fingers, thumb and wrist when writing, soreness extending along flexor carpi ulnaris. Lungs - Oppression of breathing, better by sighing.

Sleep - Great sleepiness during day with constant yawning. Restless and sleepless nights. Talking in sleep. Sleeplessness after waking. Confused dreams. Full of dreams.

Kidneys - Bright’s disease. Nephritis. Urine contains mucous, cells, albumen and casts. Passing urine preceded by pains in bowels. Urine abundant, contains mucus and albumen.

Bladder - Cystitis. Sense of swashing in bladder. Pressure in neck of bladder, urging to urinate. Soreness in urethra, feeling as if urine could not be retained.

full:
PHARMACY - bran. Brandy. Spirit of wine. Aqua vitae. Tincture. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bums. Colds. Indigestion. Insomnia. Shock. Toothaches. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Brandy is distilled wine - wine with most of the water removed - which changes the taste and makes the alcohol content higher. “Brandy” is derived from brandywijn, a word of Dutch origin for “burnt”. Created in a still to leave the water and remove the alcoholic vapor which condenses back into liquid form as it cools. In other languages too, it is the burning that is the essential feature. Concentrated spirits of wine were used in ancient Greece and Rome, both as an antiseptic and as a primitive anesthetic. From the 12th to the 14th centuries alchemists in Europe began experimenting with the distillation of many items, but medicines were still mostly given as infusions or decoctions of single herbs. Arabic writings and universities in Spain began to influence Christian schools of medicine in Italy and France. Two contemporary 13th century Spanish alchemists, Arnold de Villanova and Raymond Lully, introduced wine spirits, which they called aqua vitae (water of life), as a solvent into European medicine. This later became known as brandy, shortened from the Dutch term for “burnt wine.” In the 14th century during the Black Death brandy began to be used as a medicine by itself. It was thought of as a polycrest, a remedy of many virtues. Brandy is a stimulant, tonic and has restorative powers. Teaspoon doses of brandy were given to patients with low fevers, typhus. Sleep aid, helps prevent and treat colds. Warms the body and improves the circulation. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aleo., Vitis. REFERENCES - Murphy.

author: Murphy

PHARMACY - brass. Brassica napus. Rape seed. Cole seed. Wild com. Wild kale. N. O. Cruciferae. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Arthritis. Bulimia. Carpal tunnel. Contractures, joints. Cough. Cramps. Dropsy. Dysphagia. Edema. Gangrene. Insomnia. Jaundice. Liver, enlargement. Myalgia. Nails, shedding. Numbness. Pes, equinnus. Raynauds disease. Scleroderma. Scurvy. Ulcers. Wasting, muscles. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Our knowledge of the toxic effects of Brassica napus is derived from the experience of the Irish famine during which people ate it freely. Brass, has all the symptoms of impoverished blood, such as growth of downy, colorless hair. Dropsical swellings, scorbutic mouth, voracious appetite. Tympanitic abdomen. Skin blotches like bums. Dropping off of nails and gangrene. Weariness, strength loss. Wasting, extremé weight loss. Jaundice. MIND - Irritability. Anxiety. Depression. Distress. Memory disorders

Head - Alopecia. Very distressing frontal headache and tension.

Eyes - Sicca syndrome, reduced or no lachrymation with consequent dryness and inflammation of conjunctiva.

Face - Edema. Scleroderma. Swollen to an enormous extent, the distended state of eyelids and upper lip producing great deformity. Bum-1 ike blotches on nose and forehead (also hands and feet), varying from discoloration to ulceration.

Mouth - Mucus membrane of mouth and throat inflamed, ulcerated in parts, gums spongy.

Throat - Dysphagia. Mucus membrane of mouth and throat inflamed, ulcerated in parts, gums spongy. Vision - Xeropthalmia. COMMENTS - Allen gives this account of Brass, poisoning: They all exhibited indications of deteriorated health, the hue of the skin being uniformly sallow and muddy-looking, totally different from the brown discoloration caused by exposure to the sun, the surface was always covered with that colorless downy hair, so characteristic of what the country people here call “impoverished blood." An edematous state prevailed generally of the whole body, but a always of the face and lower extremities, the former sometimes being swollen to an enormous extent, the distended state of the eyelids and upper lip especially producing remarkable deformity The abdomen was tympanitic. The bowels torpid. The mucous membrane of the mouth and pharynx was inflamed, and in some parts ulcerated, and the gums spongy. The appetite was usually greater than natural in some cases voracious. The urinary secretion was deficient and irritating, and that of the skin suspended. Very distressing frontal headache and tension was also complained of, but the most curious symptom, next to the edematous appearance of the patient, was the state of the hands and feet, which were dry and shrunken, with blotches of a deep red, re sembling burns, on the backs of the hands and dorsum of the feet, the fingers and toes being frequently cold and livid. Similar blotches existed on the nose and forehead, and these varied in their consequence from simple discoloration to ulceration of a most troublesome description, terminating in loss of the cuticle, and dropping off of the nails, with a marked disposition in the aggravated cases to gangrene. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Raph., Armora- cea, Sinapis, Sec. REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke. Murphy. Sherr.

Abdomen - Enlargement of liver. Tympanitic abdomen. Enlargement of spleen. Liver disease.

Rectum - Bowels torpid.

Female - Transient amenorrhea. Food - Appetite increased, sometimes voracious.

Chest - Pulmonary edema. Chest wall restricted from motion. Pain. Pulmonary hypertension.

Back - Pitting edema.

Limbs - Chronic pain. Hands and feet dry and shrunken, with blotches of a deep red, like bums, on backs of hands and dorsa of feet, the fingers and toes being frequently cold and livid, ulceration, loss of nails. Myalgia. Contractures, joints. Claw-hand. Hands, feet. Genu-flexum. Pes Equinnus. Raynauds disease. Cramps, muscles. Wasting, muscles. Arthritis. Arthralgia. Loss of reflex. Weakness. Numbness. Carpal Tunnel Syndrome. Tenderness. Lungs - Pneumonia. Dyspnea, worse exertion. Respiratory failure.

Sleep - Sleep disturbances. Insomnia.

Skin - Sallow and muddy-looking, covered with downy hair. Edema. Pitting edema. Tenderness. Itching. Blotches, deep red, like bums, on backs of hands, feet, nose and forehead, varying from simple discoloration to most troublesome ulceration. Destruction of cuticle and dropping off of nails. Gangrene. Skin rash. Maculo- papular rash. Jaundice. Scleroderma. Hyperaesthesia. Hypoaesthesia. Atrophy. Hyperpigmentation.

Kidneys - Urine deficient and irritating.

Cough - Non-productive cough.

full:
PHARMACY - brom. Bromium. Bromine. (Br, At. Wt. 799). Halogens. Must be prepared fresh, as it is predi sposed to rapid deterioration. Solution in distilled water. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Asthma. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis. Cancer. Coughs. Croup. Diphtheria. Dysmenorrhea. Emaciation. Emphysema. Encysted, tumors. Fainting. Feet. pain. Fistula lachrymalis. Glands, enlargement. Goiter. Heart, diseases. Headache. Laryngismus. Migraine. Mwmps. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Parotid gland. Parotid, induration. Respiration, disorders. Scrofula. Seaside, effects. Strokes. Testicles, induration. Throat, sore. Tonsils, enlarged. Tonsils, inflamed. Trachea irritation. Tuberculosis. Tumors, breast. Ulcers. Uterus, air in. Vagina, air in. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bromine forms a leading constituent in the mineral waters of Kreutzach and Wood hall. Bromine is useful in scrofulous children with enlarged glands, which are swollen and indurated, but seldom suppurate. Like the other Halogens, Bromine is a strong antiscorbutic. Marked effects on the respiratory tract, especially larynx and trachea. Constriction and membranous formation occur in larynx, spreading upwards. A sense of suffocation. Cough, worse entering warm room Nosebleed, accompanies many problems especially those pertaining to chest and respiratory tract. s' Excoriating discharges. Profuse sweats and great weakness. Weak and easily overheated, then sweaty and sensitive to drafts. Fainting. Tremulous all over. Tendency to spasmodic attacks. Emaciation. Headache worse from drinking milk or from stooping. Boring pains in bones. Cancer. Breast cancer. Enlarged and indurated glands. Glands which become hard, but seldom suppurate. Left-sided mumps. Complaints from being over-heated. Complaints are worse at seaside, sailors coming ashore suffer from asthma, which is relieved when they go to sea again. MIND - Much anxiety of the mind. Fears a stroke. Fear of ghosts. Quarrelsome. Very bad humor. Takes no interest in the household duties. Loss of ideas. Forgetfulness. Aversion to any kind of work, even reading. Sad. Indifferent. Low spirited, inconsolable. Does not feel normal, but cannot tell why. Sits alone in her room without doing anything. Looks constantly in one direction without saying anything. Desires to be carried. Crying and lamentations, with hoarse voice. Cheerful mood, desire for mental labor. Visions when in the dark. Expects to see something jump around the floor. Delusion that strange persons are looking over patient's shoulder and that she would see someone on turning.

Head - Head congested, fears a stroke. Headache worse drinking milk, stooping. Headache in sun, passes off in shade. Headaches, deep in the vertex with palpitations. Megrim of left side, worse stooping, especially after drinking milk. Headache, worse heat of sun and from rapid motion. Sharp pain through eyes.

Eyes - Lachrymation with swelling of tear glands. Pupils dilated. Protruding eyes. Flashes before eyes. Darting through the left eye.

Ears - Hard swelling of the parotid gland, warm to touch after eruptive fevers. Noise in ears.

Nose - Tickling, smarting, asfrom cobwebs. Fan-like motion of ale (Lyc.). Nosebleed, relieving the chest. Stoppage of right nostril. Long continued, obstinate coryza. Acrid, burning coryza, with violent sneezing and soreness of the nose. Pressure at root of nose.

Face - Ashy gray. Pale, red, alternating. Swelling and hardness of parotid gland, feeling warm to the touch. Suppuration of left parotid, swelling remaining hard and unyielding. Sensation of cobweb. Seems drawn to a point at nose.

Mouth - Dry, parched. Aphthae with affection of eyes. Water tastes salty.

Throat - Tonsils, swollen, deep red, with network of dilated blood vessels. Pain, worse swallowing fluids than solids. Feels raw, evening with hoarseness. Tickling in trachea during inspiration. Hoarseness coming on from being overheated. Even a small goiter oppresses. Stony hard, swollen glands. Diphtheria. Vertigo - Dizzy when crossing a stream of water. Vertigo worse on bridge. Vertigo at the sight of running water. Vertigo with nosebleed. Vertigo with a tendency to fall backward. COMMENTS - Migraine, chiefly on left side, worse from stooping, especially after drinking milk. Sensation deep in the brain as if vertigo would come on. Vertigo with a tendency to fall backward, worse at the sight of running water or if he put his foot on a bridge, worse in damp weather. Vertigo with nosebleed. The glands (thyroid, testes, maxillary, parotid) are swollen and indurated. Tubercu- losis, especially of right lung. Hypertrophy of the heart and palpitations. Pain in heart going up to axilla. Exertion causes oppression at heart. Soreness and crusts inside nose. Nosebleed accompanies many affections, especially of chest. There is a peculiar headache with coryza. Loud emissions of air from the vagina. Particularly affects the internal head, left side. Predominantly a left-side medicine. Better at the seaside (opposite Nat-m.), but worse in sailors when coming ashore. Guernsey noted that cases of diphtheria begin in the larynx and run up. In croup with all the croupy sound, there is a loose rattling in the larynx with the breathing and coughing, but no choking in the cough, as there is in Hepar sulph. RELATIONS -Antidotes: Am-c., Camph. Salt inhibits the action of Brom. Antidoted by: Camph.. Am. c., Mag- c., Op. Useful after: lod., Phos.. Spong. Compare: (1) lod. - but lod. has worse morning, dark hair and eyes. (2)Chlorum, Lach., Spong., Fl-ac., Hep., Apis, Arg-n., Chin., Con., Coff., Cina., Cupr., Lyc., Merc., Phos. (3) Rhus-t. - cardiac hypertrophy, also Spong., Am. from over-exertion. (4) Sep., Sulph., Ant-t. (5) Puls. - blondes. Fear of ghosts or visions, also, Aeon., Ars., Carb-v., Phos., Sulph. (6) Con., Aster., Hydrobromic acid. Compatible: Arg-n. - generally after Brom. Kali-c. - emphysema. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sharp burning from tongue to stomach. Pressure like from a stone. Stomach pain, better eating. Sour things disagree. Vomiting like coffee grounds, bloody mucus. Aversion to customary tobacco smoking.

Abdomen - Tympanitic abdomen, bloated. Enlargement and induration of spleen. Passage of much wind.

Rectum - Painful hemorrhoids with black stool. Hemorrhoids, bleed, intensely painful, worse application of cold or warm water. Diarrhea after eating oysters and sour things.

Male - Swelling and induration of testes, worse slight jar. Sharp pain in glans and sides of penis. Swelling of left testicle, with sore pain, or sensation of coldness. Increased sexual desire. Nightly emissions.

Female - Menses, bright red blood. Menses flow passive with much exhaustion. Dysmenorrhea. Depressed before menses. Queer ill feeling a few days before menses. Menses too early, too profuse, with membranous shreds. Violent contractive spasms before or during menses. Chronic ovaritis. Dull, constant pain, in left ovary. Swelling of ovaries. Itching in vagina. Flatus from vagina, noisy. Vagina as if sore. Suppression of menses in scirrhus breasts. Prolapsed uterus, with mental derangement. Food - Desire for acids, which aggravate and cause diarrhea. Water tastes salty.

Chest - Violent cramping of chest. Chest pains run upward. Cold sensation when inspiring. Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous children with enlarged glands. Blue-eyed, fair people, especially children with thin, pale, delicate skins and very light hair and eyebrows to scrofulous constitutions. Blondes.

Heart - Hypertrophy from gymnastics with palpitations. Cutting pain running upwards, with heart disease. Violent palpitation worse lying on left side. Nervous palpitations with nausea with headache.

Back - Neck stiff. Goiter. Glands of neck much swollen. Encysted tumors on sides of the neck. Aching at inner border left scapula. Boring in spinous processes of different vertebrae. Glands of neck enlarged. Cystic tumors on both sides of neck. Breasts - Tumors in breasts with sharp pains, worse left. Sharp pains from breast to axilla. Sharp, shooting pains in left breast, worse pressure. Suppression of menses in scirrhus breasts. Hard, uneven tumor in right breast.

Limbs - Icy cold forearms or hands. Boring pain in one or both tibiae. Left arm, lame in cardiac affections. Lungs - Whooping cough. Dry cough with hoarseness and burning pain behind sternum. Suffocative fits, choked, croupy or wheezing cough, with palpitations. Spasmodic cough with rattling of mucus in the larynx, suffocative. Thick white expectoration. Spasms of glottis. Croup after febrile symptoms have subsided. Fibrinous bronchitis. Bronchial tubes feel filled with smoke. Wants to take a deep breath, but it excites cough. Lungs feel coated with down. Every inspiration provokes cough. Colds start in larynx, go upward and downward. Deep hoarseness if heated. Difficult and painful breathing. Larynx is cold. Laryngeal diphtheria, membrane begins in larynx and spreads upward. Dyspnea with great swelling. Asthma, difficulty in getting air into lung (Chlor, in expelling air). Asthma of sailors going ashore. Better at sea.

Sleep - Great drowsiness when reading. Continued yawning in respiratory troubles, with drowsiness. Full of dreams and anguish, jerking and starting during sleep, full of fantasy and illusions, difficult to go to sleep at night, cannot sleep enough in morning, trembling and weak on awaking.

Skin - Acne, pimples and pustules. Boils on arms and face. Glands stony, hard, especially on lower jaw and throat. Hard goiter (Spong.). Gangrene.

Modalities - Better from any motion. Better exercise. Better riding on horseback. Better at sea. Better from nosebleed, shaving. Worse from warmth. Worse damp warm. Worse Worse overheating. Worse from evening, until midnight. Worse when sitting. Worse in warm room. Worse heat of sun. Worse chilled when hot. Worse cold and damp weather and cold air. Worse water or diet. Worse from sea bathing. Worse dust. Worse draft. Worse lying on left side.

Kidneys - Constant desire to urinate with tickling sensation in tip of urethra. Dribbling of urine with burning, after urinating. Urine scanty and dark. Urine turbid, deposits a whitish sediment adhering to vessel. Urine leaves a red coating on vessel. Urine contains large flakes of white mucus. High colored urine with eczema.

Perspiration - Sweats from least exertion or exercise. Sweats on palms. Viscous sweat, with cool skin.

Temperature - Chills with yawning and stretching, repeated every other day, as a chilliness, and cold feet. Chills on alternate days, with cold feet. Internal burning heat, as if between skin and flesh.

name: Brucea Antidysenterica
author: Murphy
constitution: Abdomen, throbbing. Belches. Borborygmi. Headaches. Hypochondriasis. Pain. Tetanus.
keynote:
PHARMACY - bruc. Brucea antidysenterica. Angustura spuria. Angustura falsa. Nux vomica cortex. N. O. Loganiacae. Bark of Nux vomica or angustura falsa. Tincture or trituration. Historieal dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, throbbing. Belches. Borborygmi.…
full:
PHARMACY - bruc. Brucea antidysenterica. Angustura spuria. Angustura falsa. Nux vomica cortex. N. O. Loganiacae. Bark of Nux vomica or angustura falsa. Tincture or trituration. Historieal dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, throbbing. Belches. Borborygmi. Headaches. Hypochondriasis. Pain. Tetanus.

HOMEOPATHIC - Although the Brucea symptoms are similar to the pathogenesis of Nux-v., the bark has been experimented with independently. The homeopathic preparation of Nux-v. is prepared from the seed. Bmcea contains strychnine, and the symptoms are included in the pathogenesis of Stry. and Nux-v.. Paralyzed lower limbs, worse least touch, cries for fear of being touched. Tetanic spasms with undisturbed consciousness, worse from noise or liquids. Painful jerking of legs, cramp-like pain in knees, rigid and lame limbs of paralytics. Disposition to stretch the limbs and to yawn. Great weariness when walking. In the evening, nervous excitement, trembling and tottering when walking. Painful sensation of fatigue in the limbs. Pinching in several parts of the limbs. In the evening, stiffness in the joints and acute drawing pains in the limbs with shootings in the head in the ears and in the chest. “Headache with extreme drowsiness, disappearing in evening.” “Sensation of throbbing in pit of stomach and in entire abdomen.” For the pain in the passing of kidney stones or gallstones. MIND - Irritability, augmented in the evening. Dejection, with want of sleep. Taciturnity and hypochondriasis. Gloomy, melancholy humor with indolence and lassitude. Sad and gloomy on waking in the morning.

Head - Headache, aggravated by sitting, as well as after eating. Shootings in the head, aggravated by walking, especially in the sun. Heaviness and confusion in the head with sleepiness, disappearing in the evening. Digging, crawling in the top of the head. Headache in the evening after having walked a while in the sunshine. Headaches behind the eyebrows, which seem to be swollen.

Eyes - Dull and swollen eyes. Eyes red in the corners, in the evening. Eyes red and burning in the morning. Itching in the eyelids. Painful sensation in the eyes, as from sand, rendering it necessary to rub them.

Face - Mealy, itching tetters on the face, followed by peeling off of the skin. Paleness in the face. Slight convulsive, rapid movements in the lips.

Mouth - Acute pains in the teeth and gums, especially on drinking cold water. Accumulation of saliva in the mouth, forcing one to spit continually. Dryness and burning pain in the gullet, as if from rancid fat.

Stomach - Clammy taste. Empty belches. Sensation in the stomach, as if nothing had been eaten for a long time. Sensation of burning, heat in the pit of the stomach. Sensation of throbbing in the pit of the stomach and in the entire abdomen. Pressure in the stomach, immediately after eating or drinking. In the evening, attack of nausea with cramp-like pains in the abdomen, vomiting of food and loose evacuations with great prostration. Vertigo - Vertigo, which occasions falling in the evening. COMMENTS - Underthe name of Brucea antidysenterica, a quantity of Nux-v. bark got upon the drug market and was at first supposed to be Angusturabark. Many poisonings ensued before the mistake was discovered and the bark received the name Angustura falsa in contradistinction to the true Angustura. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The following also have drowsiness with headache: Gins., Hera., Nux-m., Nat- s., Sulph. (2) Gels. - difficult to keep the eyes open. REFERENCES Clarke.

Abdomen - Throbbing felt in the abdomen. Painful pinching in the abdomen. Squeezing, as from claws in the abdomen J followed by frequent, small, slimy evacuations. Borborygmi in the abdomen. The pains in the abdomen cease after the first evacuation. Shootings in the umbilicus after the evacuations. Loose evacuations, followed by fainting, which enforces lying down.

Rectum - Evacuations too soft, in too small quantity, and of too light a color. Strong disposition to loose evacuations with colic and flatulency. Loose evacuations in the morning and in the evening. Itching in the anus in the evening.

Chest - On breathing, sensation of great weight on the whole chest. Oppression of the chest with chilly disposition and great sensibility in the open air. In the morning, pain as from a bruise on the outside of the chest, with tight pains on breathing deeply. Pains like excoriation in the interior of the chest, especially in bed at night, which are most violent when lying on the side.

Back - Sensation of squeezing in the back.

Limbs - Pains, as of fatigue, in the thighs and loins. Cramp-like pain in the back of the hand. Miliary eruption, red, raised and itching on the back of the hand and on the body. In the evening, sensation of paralysis in tl{e thigh. Weariness in the knees. Curvature of the joint of the foot, so that one walks almost on the anklebone. Sensation of burning in corns.

Sleep - Sleepiness during the entire day, especially when seated, in the morning, early in the evening, and particularly in the afternoon. Sleepiness alternately with want of appetite. Sleep full of dreams, with ebullition of the blood. Sleep troubled with confused or frightful dreams.

Fever - Sweats on walking, with shiverings, which appear chiefly during rest. Chilly disposition and aversion to the open air. Shivering and excessive coldness. Food - Weak appetite, food at dinner and breakfast appears insipid. After a meal, violent beating of the heart, aggravation of headache, fermentation in the intestines and inclination to evacuate.

name: Brucella Melitensis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better by occupation. Better in company. Better motion. Better heat, particularly of the sun. Worse from prolonged exercise. Worse when rising from sitting. Worse when motionless. Worse after alcohol, eating. Worse from changes of temperature or weather. Worse warm room. Worse hot summer. Worse damp, wet. Worse storms. Worse in morning. * Worse from sea, wind..

Intermittent, fever. Joint, pains. Muscle, pain. Perspiration, excessive. Undulant, fever. Vertigo. Weakness. Weight, loss.

HOMEOPATHIC - Brucellosis, also known as undulant fever or Mediterranean fever, is caused by the bacterium Brucella. Undulant fever derives its name from the undulating, or up-and-down, temperature. Brucella bacteria infect cattle, goats, camels, dogs, and pigs. Transmission of the disease to humans occurs by contact with infected meat, the placenta of infected animals, or ingestion of unpasteurized milk or cheese. The illness may be chronic and persist for years. Acute brucellosis may begin with mild flu-like symptoms with fever, chills, sweating, muscle aches, joint aches and malaise. Fever spikes occur every afternoon to levels around 104° Fahrenheit. Common symptoms include fever and chills, excessive sweating, weakness, weight loss and fatigue. Loss of appetite. Anorexia, emaciation. Febrile state with profuse sweat, at night, from the least effort. Headache. Insomnia. Vertigo. Faintness. Muscular and joint pains, especially of the lower limbs. Back pain. Joint and muscle pain. Swollen glands and lymph nodes. Vesicular eruptions. Abdominal pain. Enlarged liver. Constipation, dry and hard stools. Weariness in the morning with strong desire to sleep. Pricking pains everywhere. Wandering diffuse pains particularly in lumbar region, in thighs, hips, better by mo-' tion. Alternation of symptoms, for example the joint pains disappear and cough appears. Periodical complaints, worse in winter, spring, summer, every 2 to 4 weeks. MIND - Changes mood and behavior. Emotional instability. Irritability and nervousness. Apathy and indifference. Depression. Coma.

Abdomen - Abdominal pain.

Rectum - Constipation, dry and hard stools.

Back - Feeling of coldness with shivers in the back. Back pain. Pains in lumbar region, better by motion. Glands - Swollen glands and lymph nodes.

Limbs - Muscular and joint pains, especially of the lower limbs.

Skin - Blotches and rashes. Vesicular eruptions.

Modalities - Better by occupation. Better in company. Better motion. Better heat, particularly of the sun. Worse from prolonged exercise. Worse when rising from sitting. Worse when motionless. Worse after alcohol, eating. Worse from changes of temperature or weather. Worse warm room. Worse hot summer. Worse damp, wet. Worse storms. Worse in morning. * Worse from sea, wind.

Liver - Cirrhosis. Enlarged liver.

Perspiration - Excessive sweating.

Temperature - Fever and chills. Chills with shivers. Fever, with profuse sweat, depression. Vertigo - Vertigo with loss of sight and feeling of coldness. COMMENTS - Roger Schmidt recorded two cases, published in Annales Hom. Fr., No. 2. 1959. The first case concerned M. W. R., a butcher who was 43 years old. He called on Schmidt on the 18th October, 1948, for a fever of 103.4 F in the evening which he's had for three days. Profuse sweat on the upper part of the body, preceded by shivering, which jerks him from head to foot. Restless during the fever, hungry, and has the desire to drink cold water. While telling Schmidt his history, he noted having been treated for acute brucellosis in 1935, and that half of the workers of the same firm were affected. At that time, M. W. R. stopped his work for a year. The fever, he said caused his hair to fall out, but it, fortunately, grew back. In 1940 and 1941, he had two new attacks that were treated by serum. In 1949, he relapsed again, complicated with anemia, and was treated by penicillin and vaccines. He told Schmidt that since that time he has always felt weak. Gels. 6c ameliorated the fever in 24 hours. The temperature did not rise above 99.5° F. One week later, the patient had diarrhea with profuse sweats, rapidly ameliorated by Chin. 6c. During the next month, he gained 8 pounds and was feeling better. Schmidt's intention was to complete the cure by the nosode, but he did not get the chance because, in order to resume his work, M. W. R. was forced to see the doctors who treated him before. Schmidt's second case concerned Mrs. H. B. of San Diego, married, age 69. She came to see Schmidt in September 1950, complaining of some gastric troubles, which she had for several months. She was also suffering from gas, vomiting, regurgitations, and a stubborn constipation. She was constantly depressed and weak, nervous, restless and had shiverings. She felt sudden weakness, had vertigo by the least movement. While she was young she suffered from a perforated appendix. Physical examination was negative, except for a distended abdomen. After her return to San Diego she asked Schmidt to prescribe by mail. Ars., Sulph., Nux-v., Carb-v., Kali-p., andCarbo-s. all did her some good, but the variety of remedies showed that the case was jumbled when it was difficult to get a simillium. Finally in July, 1951, Schmidt had the idea that this may be a case of Brucel. The sudden attack of fever and sweats, weight loss (seven pounds), and the persistence of some symptoms indicated the diagnosis. Schmidt gave her Brucel. 10m. Without any delay, the patient informed Schmidt that this was the first remedy that gave her almost instantaneous result. She soon took up weight, but after six weeks she complained anew of serious vertigo and the stubborn constipation. She was given Brucel. 30c, and for 3 months her condition was satisfactory. On December 6th, 1951, her fever returned with profuse sweat and abdominal pains. Schmidt gave her Brucel. 10m, which caused a moderate aggravation but clearly ameliorated during the next two weeks, with a maximum temperature of 100° F during the day, which ended in a long period of amelioration lasting for 3 years. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Nat-m. - Emaciation with anemia, cachexia, depression, headaches, constipation, sensitiveness to cold, desire for salt, mapped tongue. (2) Gels. - General weakness with tremblings; headache with heaviness; weakness of limbs, slow pulse. (3) Ferr-p - Febrile states with full, rapid and soft pulse, thirst and sweats that does not ameliorate. REFERENCES - Julian. Murphy.

CLINICAL - Headaches. Paralysis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lepelletier noted that Brucin. caused sudden jerking, especially of the lower limbs, spreading generally, but not accompanied by trismus or tetanus, and not extending to the esophagus and pharynx as with Strychnia. Twitching in the paralyzed as well as healthy muscles. A fever of short duration ends the attacks, after which deep sleep comes on. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Stry., Nux-v., Brucea antidys. REFERENCES - Clarke.

PHARMACY - bry. Bryonia alba. Wild hops. Bryonia dioica. White Bryony. N. O. Cucur- bitaceae. Tincture of root procured before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Amenorrhea. Anger, effects. Angina pectoris. Ankle, injuries. Appendicitis. Aphthae. Arthritis. Asthma. Backache. Bilious attack. Bones, broken. Brain disorders. Breast-feeding, disorders. Breast inflamed. Bronchitis. Cancer. Chills. Chlorosis. Constipation. Coryza. Coughs. Dehydration. Dentition. Diaphragm, rheumatism. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Edema. Enteric fever. Gastroenteritis. Glaucoma. Hemorrhages. Hands, swollen. Headaches. Heart, pain. Hernias. Hiccoughs. Hydrocele. Hy- drocephalus. Influenza. Injuries. Intermittent fevers. Jaundice. Joints,pain. Knee, injuries. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Lymphangitis. Mastitis. Measles. Meningitis. Menstruation, vicarious. Migraine. Milk fever. Muscle pain. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Ovaritis. Peritonitis. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Pleurodynia. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Pregnancy. Puerperal fever. Pyuria. Relapsing fever. Remittent fever. Rheumatism. Scarlatina. Sciatica. Spina bifida. Stiff-neck. Strokes. Suppressed, eruptions. Tongue, coated. Toothache. Trachea, pain. Tuberculosis. Vertigo. Waterbrash. Whooping cough. Yellow fever.

HERBAL - The commonBryony of England is the Bryonia dioica, which has been substituted for the Bryonia alba and has probably identical properties, but the alba alone has been proved, and consequently this should always be dispensed. Bryonia dioica is a popular remedy for “black-eye” as a local application.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bry. is one of the polycrest remedies of the homeopathic Materia Medica. Less rapid in its action than Aeon., but it goes deeper in its effects and often takes up the work where Aeon, leaves off. It not only disorders the circulation, but alters the blood itself. Vicarious bleeding. Corresponds to fevers of almost all kinds, especially rheumatic, typhoid, bilious and remitting. Affects on all serous membranes and the viscera they contain, causing inflammation and exudation. Mucus membranes are all dry. Discharges are scanty and adherent. Dryness everywhere, of mouth, throat etc. Dry hacking painful coughs in pleurisy, pneumonia. Streaks of red in lymphangitis. Dry, parched lips and mouth. Excessive thirst, bitter taste in the mouth. Rheumatic pains and swellings, dropsical effusions into synovial and serous membranes. Aching in joints and muscles. Injury of the joints (when Arn. fails). Every spot in the body is painful to pressure. Pains are bursting, stitching or heavy sore, going backwards, tearing, worse by motion, better rest. Stitching pains in the chest. Muscles become hard after neuralgia. Pressure headaches. Severe headaches. Bursting, splitting headaches. Vertigo from raising the head. Physical weakness, on slightest exertion. Dropsical swellings gradually increase as the day progresses and disappear during the night. Sensitive epigastrium and feeling of a stone in the stomach. Stools large, dry, hard. Complaints develop slowly but forcibly. Aggravation from motion, movement of all kinds. Avoids even the movement of the eyes, raising head from pillow causes faintness, nausea and vomiting. Betterfrom pressure, from lying on painful side. Rightsided effects. Tendency to great irritability and bad temper. Children dislike to be carried or raised. Persons who over-eat or eat excessively of meat, and have strong constitutions. MIND - Effects of anger, fright, chagrin or pain. Exceedingly irritable, everything puts him out of humor. Very morose, ill-humored. Ugly in behavior. Easily angered, with biliousness, headache, dyspepsia. Quarrelsome. Worse from arguments, which will give them a headache and pain. Capricious, hard to please and satisfy. Desire for things that are rejected when offered (Cham., Calc-p.). Desire for things that can't be had. Weeping mood, with headache and other complaints. Hasty disposition. Easily startled, during headache. Restlessness, wants change. Determined. Taciturn. Aversion to being disturbed. Intolerance of contradiction. Contradiction causes anger. Irritability during menses. Wants to be let alone. Aversion to company. Desire to be independent, difficulty asking for help. Aversion to being touched. Fright, fear and vexation. Apprehension anddreadforfuture. Talks of business. Worried about money and the future. Fearful of poverty. Fear of thunderstorm. Insecure. Despair of being cured with fear of death. Worry about their health. Despair of recovery. Anxiety better open air. Mental state, better from cool temperature, wants windows open. Oversensitiveness of senses to external impressions. Child dislikes to be carried or to be touched. Dullness of mind. Weakness of mind, so that his ideas disappear. Delirium, wants to go home, thinking he is not there.

Head - Gastric, rheumatic, congestive, bilious headaches. Migraine headaches, worse on any motion, even that of the eyeballs, better from closing eyes. Pressure in head, as if brain were too full, worse sitting. Bursting, splitting headache, as if everything would be pressed out. Bursting pain, with dry, parched lips. As if hit by a hammer from within, worse from motion, stooping, opening eyes. Pain over left eye, pressive, going to occiput, then spreading over whole body. Severe sharp pains in head, worse motion. Headache in occiput. Headache from ironing. Headache when constipated. Frontal headache, frontal sinuses involved. Bones drawing in towards zygoma. Vertex as if bruised. Headaches better from tying up head. Mental exertion aggravates head pains. Rheumatic pains, in cold, damp, wet seasons. Scalp very sensitive, can't bear even a soft brush, every hair pains. Dandruff, rough and uneven. Hair very greasy. Cold sweat on head.

Eyes - Eyeballs sore. Burning in eyes, inflammation, worse warmth. Pains behind the eyeballs. Glaucoma. Pressing, crushing, aching pains. Aching and pulsation in left orbit. Lachrymation during day, especially in the sun. Lids swollen and puffed. Sore to touch. Sore when moving eyes. Sharp pain like a needle going through eye. Itching and burning of margins of lids. Sensation as if sand in eyes. Gout shifting to eyes. Aversion to light, especially sunlight.

Ears - As if stopped-up. Otorrhea following inflammation. Boil in front of ear. Vicarious bleeding from ears. Intolerance of noise. Aural vertigo. Roaring, buzzing, ringing, humming in ears. Chirping, as from locusts. Humming in left ear. resembling pouring of water over a dam.

Nose - Fluent coryza, watery or greenish. Headache following checked coryza. Descending colds. Dry nasal catarrh. Coryza with shooting and aching in the forehead. Vicarious nosebleeds, when menses should appear. Nosebleeds in pregnancy. Nosebleeds in the morning relieving the headache. Swelling of tip of nose, feels as if it would ulcerate when touched. Inflamed and ulcerated nostrils. Boils. Sneezing between coughs. Loss of smell.

Face - Dark red, hot, bloated. Yellowish paleness. Heat of face with redness and thirst. Redness of face after getting angry. Face bluish-red, during difficult respiration. Lips, dry, as if burnt, parched, cracked, wants to moisten them. Picking of lips. Burning of lower lip in old smokers. Chewing motions in brain disorders of children. Twitching in corners of mouth. Small nodules and induration. Tetters in face.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth, tongue and throat with excessive thirst. Offensive smell from mouth, with hawking of offensive, tough mucus. Taste bitter, cannot swallow food, better cold drinks. Soapy, frothy saliva. Burning in lower lip in old smokers. Lips parched, dry, cracked. Sore mouth in infants, child does not want to take hold of breast, but after mouth becomes moist it nurses well.

Throat - Hoarseness, worse in open air. Dryness, sticking on swallowing, scraped and constricted (Bell.). Hawks brown lumps with effort. Dryness and rawness of throat worse in warm room. Back of throat seems swollen. Aphthous patches, recurring. Sharp pain when swallowing. Pressive pain in right tonsil. Pain, pres- sure and soreness in trachea, pain worse talking and smoking. Soreness in larynx and trachea. Tough mucus in larynx and trachea, loosened only after much hawking, worsecoming intowarmroom. Voice nasal or raised.

Stomach - Dyspeptic ailments during summer heat. Burning pain in stomach. Tasteless eructations. Stomach sensitive to touch. Throbbing in pit. Pressure in stomach after eating, as of a stone. Soreness in stomach when coughing. Shooting pain, with belching. Sharp pain in stomach on motion, arresting breathing. Numbness in stomach. Constant nausea with constipation. Nausea and faintness when rising up. Nausea lying on right side. Nauseaand vomitingfrom slightest motion. Bitter vomiting of bile and water, immediately after eating. Vomiting of blood. Vomits solid food only. Vomiting of bitter, musty or putrid liquid, which leaves a similar taste in mouth. Worse warm drinks, which are vomited. Stools - Stools, large dry, very hard. Stools, as if burnt. Stools, brown, thick, bloody. Stools, loose, painless, undigested. Stools, worse in morning, worse from moving, worse after being heated from cold drinks, worse every spell of hot weather. Involuntary stool during sleep. Yellow, mushy stools. Lumps of tough mucus after stools. Gushing diarrhea, worse in the morning, on rising, eating cabbage. Stools offensive, bilious, acrid, smelling like old cheese.

Abdomen - Distension of abdomen with colic after eating. Abdomen very sore to touch, with constipation. Appendicitis. Peritonitis. Gastroenteritis. Abdominal wall very tender. Griping, pinching colic. Burning, sharp pain, worse from pressure, coughing, breathing. Movements, loud rumbling or a gurgling and soreness and dragging downward. Pain from movement of flatus. Epigastrium, tender, throbbing. Groin sore before menses.

Rectum - Burning in anus with stools. Burning in rectum during evacuation of stool and urine. As if a plug in anus. Constipation. Hard stool passed with great exertion, with confusion of head. Constipation on going to sea. Constipation of nursing babies and lying-in women. Constipation during pregnancy. Diarrhea after castor oil. Diarrhea alternating with constipation. Diarrhea after suppression of exanthemata. Aching hemorrhoids. Passage of offensive flatus. Prolapse of rectum during stool.

Male - Sharp pains in right testicle and spermatic cord. Sharp pains in testicles when sitting. Red, itching eruption on glans penis. Increased sexual desire.

Female - Menstrual irregularities with gastric symptoms. Menses, dark, foul. Menses too early, too profuse, worse from motion, with tearing pains in legs. Menses suppressed with vicarious discharge or splitting headache. Frequent bleeding of nose at appearance of menses. Ovaritis. Inter-menstrual pain with a great abdominal and pelvic soreness (Ham.). Pain in right ovary as if torn, extending to thigh (Lil-t., Croc.). Sharp pains in ovaries on taking a deep inspiration, very sensitive to touch. Food - Craves what he cannot relish. Loathing for food. Canine hunger after nausea. Irritability after eating. Aversion to greasy food. Aversion to milk, but when he takes it he relishes it. Great desire for coffee, wine and acid drinks. Desire for meat, oysters, sweets. Desire for warm drink, and better by it. Worse bread. Cabbage causes diarrhea. Sauerkraut, cabbage, potatoes and other vegetables, disagree. Worse w#rm drinks, which are vomited. Gastric derangement after old sausages, old cheese, cabbage, sauerkraut, fruit, turnips, salads, milk, etc. Drinks hastily and eagerly. Thirst, for large quantity of cold water, also for warm drinks, which ameliorate.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Holds chest or presses the sternum when coughing. Sharp pains in chest, worse motion, deep breathing and coughing. Sticking pain, in chest, better pressure or lying upon painful side. Sticking pain in sternum when pressing upon it. Heaviness beneath the sternum extending towards the right shoulder. Internal heat in chest. Sharp pains in cardiac region. Sharp pain from left to right side of chest, during inspiration. Rheumatism of muscles of chest. Ribs sore, as if beaten. Constitutions - Suited to a robust, firm fiber and dark complexion with tendency to leanness and irritability. Gastro-bilious- rheumatic constitutions. Choleric, bilious tendency with firm fleshy fiber. Adapted to nervous, dry, slender people.

Heart - Angina pectoris. Sharp pain in cardiac region, worse motion. Sharp pain, cramp in region of heart, worse walking, motion or slightest exertion. Heart beats violently and rapidly. Palpitations with dyspnea. Fluttering and palpitations on going up stairs. Burning in veins. Endocarditis. Pulse frequent at night, slower during day. Pulse tense and hard. Pulse full and quick. Intermittent pulse with strong orgasm of blood.

Back - Painful stiffness of neck, worse motion. Drawing and stiffness in muscles of right side of neck. Cervical glands sore to touch. Spina bifida. Breasts - Pain in breasts at menstrual period. Mastitis, stony hard breasts. Breasts hot and painful, hard. Abscess of breasts. Milk fever. Swollen breasts. Causations - Ill effects of anger, fright, chagrin. Complaints from taking cold drinks in hot weather. Alcohol. Gluttony. Suppressed eruptions and discharges. Constipation. Broken bones, joint injury, wounds. Cold winds.

Limbs - Joints with sharp and tearing pains, worse on least movement. Sprained, injured and painful joints, worse motion. Severe pain from broken bones. Joints red, swollen, hot. Swelling of elbow. Painful stiffness of limbs. Pains in joints and limbs better warmth. Every spot is painful on pressure. Constant motion of left arm and leg with sighing (Hell.). Sciatica, better lying quietly and on painful side. Knees stiff and painful. Ankle or knee injury, swollen, painful and worse motion. Knees totter and bend under him when walking. Hot swelling of feet. Pins and needles in soles, preventing walking. Ulcers on fingers and toes. Weariness and heaviness in all limbs.

Sleep - Drowsy, starting when falling asleep. Sleepiness during and after stool. Frequent yawning the whole day. Somnambulism. Restless sleep before midnight. Sleeplessness on account of heat and thirst. Sleeplessness from crowding of thoughts. Sleeps on back. Kicks covers off. Talks irrationally when he first wakes out of sleep. Dreams of hard work. Dreams about household affairs, business of the day. Anxious dreams and screaming out. Dreams of dispute and vexation.

Skin - Dry skin. Skin, yellow, pale swollen, dropsical. Slow development or sudden receding of rash in eruptive fevers. Undeveloped measles. Burning, itching eruptions. Itching, better scratching, worse walking rapidly. Erysipelas. Seborrhea. Nettle-rash. Red elevated rash, like eruptions, over whole body. Rash, better getting warm in bed. Hard nodes in various parts of body. Cold feeling in putrid ulcers.

Modalities - Worse from least motion. Worse lying on the painless side. Worse raising up, stooping. Worse coughing, deep breathing. Worse exertion, touch. Worse from dry cold or heat. Worse becoming hot. Worse in room. Worse hot weather. Worse drinking while hot. Worse from eating, vegetables, acids. Worse from anger, vexation. Worse calomel. Worse suppressions. Worse taking cold. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evening, 9 p.m. Worse in the early morning. Worse summer.

Teeth - Gums pain as if sore and raw, with painful loose teeth. Aching of gums with teething children (Dol.). Toothache when coughing. Toothache, better cold water, worse brushing teeth. Jerking pain when smoking or chewing tobacco. Toothache about 3 a.m. Teeth feel too long. Toothache, as if an exposed nerve in a hollow tooth was in pain from cold air.

Tongue - Dryness of tongue. Dry, white, filthy tongue. Aphthae on tip of tongue. Tongue coated yellowish, dark brown. Tongue coated heavily white in gastric derangement. Tongue coated along centre, red at base. Trembling of tongue. Tongue thinly coated yellow, with longitudinal fissure. White tongue with red edges. Vertigo - Aural vertigo (Aur., Nat-sal., Sil., Chin.). Vertigo, nausea, confusion. Vertigo, dizzy or faint on rising up. Vertigo felt in occiput. Vertigo, as though all objects are whirling. Vertigo worse on least motion. Vertigo, as if sinking deep down in the bed, better cold. Vertigo, as if brain were turning around. Vertigo on turning head or on stooping. Vision - Dim vision. Every object appears covered with rainbow colors, followed by photophobia. Letters run together when reading. Bluish haze. COMMENTS - Primary distinguishing symptoms are a slow onset of a disease, dryness of the mouth and skin and a thirst for cold drinks. Any complaint is worse motion, patient will immobilize affected area, frozen with pain. Intermitting fever, chill mixed with heat. During chill, head hot, cheeks deep red, decided thirst, generally for large quantities at long intervals, sweat worse by least motion, sour or oily. Fever with a stupid, drowsy condition or mild delirium in which the patient has the delusion that he is somewhere else and “wants to go home.” Chilliness predominates. Dry, burning heat as if blood burning in veins. Sweat profuse at night and morning, sour or oily. Headache or neuralgia in (left) side of head and face, better from hard pressure and cold applications, worse moving. Dull headache, frontal or bursting, splitting. Headache is worse by any motion or by the concussion of cough, and it goes from the front to back of head. The headache of alcoholics, of over-feeding or constipation. Nausea and faintness when rising up, better when lying still. Migraines with splitting, sharp pain, throbbing nausea and vomiting. They want to go into a dark room and be left alone. Sensation of hammers hitting their head (Nat-m.). Better hard pressure, can be worse light touch. Worse motion, light, sound, any stimulation. Headache with bursting pain, as if their head will explode. Eye movement can cause severe pain, occipital pain is sharp. With sinus headache, sinuses become dry. Dry mucus membranes, especially those of the mouth and stomach, deficient secretion. Serous membranes are inflamed, the seat of sharp, stitching pains, worse from motion. later on there is exudation. Muscles are inflamed and sore. Flu with soreness and aching in the joints, pain, worse motion. The respiratory organs and heart are profoundly affected. Lungs are dry, good for dry, hacking cough that goes into the chest in pneumonia and bronchitis. Respiration becomes worse with deep breathing, try to breath as little as possible. Cough, worse morning. “Frequent desire to take a long breath, must expand the lungs” Want open, fresh air, felt better in cold air. Hemorrhages. Nosebleeds, especially in the night, 3 to 4 a.m., which is characteristic. This may or may not be preceded by a sense of fullness in the head. Nosebleeds consequent on suppression of the menses is characteristic. Mouth very dry, tongue coated white down the middle, the edges may be quite clean, later it becomes yellow with bitter taste. Lips are dry and cracked. Toothache, better by pressing head into pillow, by cold applications. Tendency to chew lips, pick nose or cracked lips, or grind teeth. Brain disorders with a constant motion of the mouth as if chewing. Dirty wash- leather, foul tongue, congested eyes, bitter nausea. Food lies at the epigastrium like a stone, better bringing up wind. The digestion is worse in summer. Symptoms worse after a meal. A coarse feeder. Bry. is a gourmand (Nux-v., an epicure). There is intolerance of vegetable food. Everything tastes bitter. Gastric derangement “absolutely requires water as a dissolvent.” Thirst for large quantities. Burning thirst, for cold drinks, worse from beer. Dehydration in the GI, causing constipation, and joint, causing arthritis. “Belchings of tasteless gas.” Sour stomach. Constipation, atony of the bowels. Stool large, dry, hard, brown or black, as if burnt or charred, crumbling (Plat, has sticky, tenacious stool, sticks to rectum). Stools smell of old cheese. Can have no desire to stool. Diarrhea worse in the morning. The liver is tender and inflamed. The kidneys also are inflamed, the urine being dark red without deposit (from excess of coloring matter). Appendicitis with nausea, vomiting, fever and rebound tenderness (Bell.). Mastitis, hard, tender. Left ovarian pain, better lying on painful side. Dropsical swellings, swellings of the legs, sensitive to touch. “Joints red, swollen, stiff with stitching pain from slightest motion.” Synovial swellings. Symptoms are worse with stiffness. Ankle injuries, the slightest movement causes severe pain. Trauma injuries. Low back problems, slipped disks. Whiplash where the neck is frozen with pain and they don't want to be touched, will immobilize neck as movement causes great pain. Fixation due to pain worse from motion. Worse with any effort, they move only because there is pain. Will cling to support. Lying on the painful part keeps the part at rest. There is also an intense headache, dull throbbing or sharp stabbing pains, sharp pain in or over eyes. Head greasy, scalp tender, eyeballs tender. All their symptoms become worse at 9 p.m. and 3 a.m. Irritable. Constantly finding dissatisfaction. Hasty speech. Dreams of the occupations of the day. The child kicks the covers off. PHARMACY - buth-aust. Buthus australis. Scorpion venom. Buthus prionuris. Androc- tonos funestus. Buthus occitanus. Algerian scorpion. Common yellow scorpion. N. O. Arachnida. Tincture is prepared from the scorpion venom. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chills. Fever. Headaches. Hypotension. Prostration. Salivation.

HOMEOPATHIC - Buthus Australis is a scorpion belonging to the arthropod order of the arachnid class. The scorpions are insects distinguished by the division of their bodies into three sections: the head and thorax, the pre-abdomen (seven segments) of the same form as the head and thorax, and the post-abdomen (six segments), mistakenly called the tail, which is very mobile and ends with a venomous, curved sting. The chelicerae have three joints, the last sections forming the pincers. The leg-jaws are very long and end in fat pincers. These animals are viviparous, carnivorous, feed on insects and spiders, which they catch with their pincers and have a defense organ. Azam first carried out a proving on himself by taking one drop of pure venom orally. A second proving was undertaken by Azam and carried out with the help of eight pro vers (three women and five men), using the 6x potency for thirty days. Only four provers continued to the end of the thirty days. Symptoms included an inhibition of will power and reduced activity. Head heavy, frontal headache. Vertigo on walking. Excessive salivation. Attacks of fever with shivering. Limbs are cold with burning pain in the skin. Upset by climatic changes with mental depression and shivering. Anguish, thoracic constriction. Sensation of a piece of wood nailed between the heart and lungs. Hypotension in infectious conditions. Infectious conditions with fever, shivering, prostration, aggravated at night. Respiratory difficulty during pulmonary or cardiac illnesses. MIND - Intellectual work arduous or trying. Alternating moods, at times loquacious, at times taciturn, sometimes prostrate, sometimes restless. Irresistible need to speak. Anguish. Indecision and worry. Weepy. Fear of the future, especially after 7 p.m. Sensation of being in a dream.

Head - Throbbing headaches, wandering, very intense.

Eyes - Red, weeping with photophobia. Eyeballs sunken. Strabismus.

Nose - Sneezing.

Mouth - Profuse salivation. Difficult swallowing.

Throat - Constriction in the throat. Vertigo - Vertigo on walking. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lach. - Aggravated by lying down. Spontaneous hematoma. (2) Merc. - Excessive salivation and tongue has a yellowish coating, which retains the imprint of the teeth. (3) Apis - Sensation of being pierced by red hot needles, but with a predominance coldness at the limbs and sensation of icy needles. (4) Verat. - Sensation of icy coldness. (5) Sil. - Throbbing headache, weeping, sneezing, difficulty in swallowing, chilliness, shivering and sweating, but without the feeling of a piece of wood nailed between the heart and lungs. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Pain and chill.

Rectum - Diarrhea.

Heart - Feeling of heat in heart of a piece of wood nailed between heart and lungs.

Back - Cervical muscular pains and stiffness of the nape of the neck.

Limbs - Trembling of the limbs. Hands cold, especially during shivering. Walking painful, and the legs seem to want to move backwards instead of forwards. Lungs - Difficult respiration, palpitations. Male - Erection not achieved.

Sleep - Strong feeling of fatigue, sleepiness and insensitivity.

Skin - Red spots. Formication. Itching. Cold sweating, especially at night. Sensation of coldness, like icy needles pricking the skin. /

Modalities - Better from eating, rest. Worse from effort, intellectual work. Worse in the late afternoon. Worse when shivering. Periodicity is worse yearly.

PHARMACY - but-ac. Butyricum acidum. Butyric acid. A volatile acid obtained chiefly from butter, being found there in the form of an ester, a triglyceride, and as such constitutes thechieffatofbutterandmilk. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Butyric acid occurs in the animal organism undera variety of conditions. It constitutes the chief fat of butter and milk. Butyric acid set free by fermentation causes a rancid taste and the odor of contaminated butter. When milk sours, milk sugar is converted into lactic acid by the lactic ferment of various bacteria. The lactic acid is then acted upon by butyric acid ferment contained in the air. It may be present in the gastric contents under abnormal conditions, with a markedly diminished hydrochloric acid secretion. In excessive fermentation in the enteric tract, butyric acid may be formed in significant amounts. Abdominal flatulence. Tremendous formation of gas in the whole belly, much belching of gas, a great deal of gas is passed at the call to stool, which in many cases fails to come. Marked straining at stool. Stools are small like lumps. Intermittent belly cramps which are below the umbilicus. Pain in the ileocecal region. Complete loss of appetite. Fetid leucorrhea. Offensive sweating of the soles of feet. MIND - Anxiety and fear. Worries over trifles. Constant fear and nervousness. Impulsive thoughts of suicide, brooding.

Head - Headache makes him apprehensive about trifles, worse going upstairs or rapid motion. Dull, hazy ache of head.

Mouth - Fetid odor in the mouth. Profuse salivation. Gingivitis. Gums tinged with blood. Gingival secretions, which are offensive smelling and more profuse during menses. Painful gums, worse during menses.

Stomach - Much gas in stomach and bowels. Cramps in pit of stomach, worse at night. Stomach feels heavy and overloaded. COMMENTS - The following provings were conducted at the Hahnemann Hospital of Philadelphia, upon students at that institution. The students took the 3 c potency of the remedy every two hours; in all, the proving was carried on for approximately seven weeks. The remedy induces a peculiar effect on the superficial part of the body. Pronounced and awfully malodorous foot sweat. Students at the Hahnemann College often had to constantly change their socks, a thing quite foreign to the provers under normal conditions. Crumbling away of the fingernails. Aggravated backache. All the symptoms are decidedly worse at night. Pronounced sleeplessness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bapt. - Putrid smelling breath. Fetid diarrhea and putrid stools. Mental confusion, illusion that the body is double. (2) Verat. - Prostration intense delirium, feeling of chill running over the whole body and cold sweating on forehead, hands and fee . Abdominal colic with copious diarrhea, followed by extreme weakness. (3) Nux-m. - Dryness of the mucus membranes, thirst, gastric and abdominal distention. Constipation with difficulty in expelling stools. Amenorrhea with leucorrhea. REFERENCES - Anshutz.

Abdomen - Gastric and abdominal flatulence. Cramp in abdomen below umbilicus. Bowels irregular. Atony of the liver and stomach. Epigastric and peri-umbilical pains, awaking at about 2 a.m. Pain in the ileocecal region with feeling of cramp, relieved by expulsion of gas.

Rectum - Sudden nocturnal cramps with an urgent need to go to stool. Offensive smelling stools, chestnut or light yellow in color. Feeling of heaviness in rectum with pain in the anus. Stool accompanied by pain and straining.

Female - Foul-smelling leucorrhea, like horses urine. Purulent cervicitis. Dysuria. Food - Anorexia. Poor appetite.

Heart - Palpitations, aggravated by eating, with a feeling of abdominal plethora.

Back - Tired feeling and dull pain in small of back, worse walking. Pain in ankles and up back of leg. Pain low down in back and limbs. Ankylosing spondylitis. Morbus coxae senilis.

Limbs - Dull aching of lumbar and sacral regions, worse standing, spreading towards the hip. Dull aching of arms, legs and calves. Cold feet, with abundant, fetid perspiration. Edema of the feet during menses.

Sleep - Sleep disturbed, owing to digestive complaints. Pronounced sleeplessness, dreams of serious nature while asleep.

Skin - The fingernails crumble away. Su- damina. Dysidrosis of the palms and soles. Onychomycosis.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse fast walking. Worse going upstairs. Worse during menses.

Kidneys - Urgent and pressing need to urinate, especially for women. Urine malodorous, smelling like asparagus. Amorphous urate deposits.

Perspiration - Perspiration on slight exertion. Profuse, offensive foot sweat.
