full:
PHARMACY - calc-sil. Calcarea silicata. Calcium silicate. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anal fistula. Atrophy. Cataracts. Chilliness. Cold. Cornea, ulcers. Diabetes. Dropsy. Emaciation. Epithelioma. Flatulence. Goiter. Hydrocele. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Polyps. Scrofula. Ulcers. Uterus, prolapsed. Weak.

HOMEOPATHIC - This preparation of Calcarea silicata has been used by Ussher in the lx and 6x potencies in cases of atrophy of children. He found it succeeded where Sil. failed in these cases and in corneal disorders. It causes absorption of corneal exudations. Indicated by ulcers with punched-out edges. Kent said it cured cataracts, polyps, goiter, epithelioma and lupus. Diabetes mellitus. Hydrocele. Useful in restraining malignant ulceration in the breasts. Calc-sil. is a deep, long acting medicine for complaints which come on slowly and reach their final development after long periods. Weak, emaciated, cold and chilly, worse from being overheated, generally sensitive. Atrophy of children. Aversion to the open air. Lack of vital heat. Very sensitive to the cold. Extreme sensitiveness to drafts. Catching colds constantly. Thick greenish-yellow expectoration. Abscesses, catarrhal discharges, ulcers, are marked with thick, greenish-yellow pus. MIND - Absent-minded. Inability to concentrate. Confusion of mind in the morning. Irritable, irresolute. Lacks self-confidence. Discontent and despair. Weary. Fearful. Anxiety about health. Fear of brain lesion. Discouraged about her disease, thinks it an incurable disease. Excitable and easily angered, worse after anger. Consolation irritates. She sits long in one place and looks into space and does not answer when spoken to. Passive delirium, talks and acts like one insane. Talks to people who have long been dead. Mutters foolish things.

Head - Coldness of the head, especially of occiput and vertex. Congestion of the head at night. Constriction of the forehead. Eruptions on the scalp, crusts, eczema, pustules. Perspiration of the whole scalp.

Eyes - Corneal exudation. Eyelids are agglutinated with pus. Cataracts. Itching of the eyes. Lachrymation in open air. Paralysis of the optic nerve. Photophobia.

Ears - Offensive, purulent, thick and greenish yellow discharge. Itching deep in ears. Noises in ears, cracking in ears when chewing. Increased wax in ears.

Nose - Head colds, catarrh of nose and posterior sinus, discharge thick, yellow, hard crusts. Extreme dryness inside, of nose. Nosebleed, bright red blood, on blowing nose. Polyps.

Face - Very pale, an earthy color. Lips bluish, dry and cracked. Red face during headache, circumscribed red cheeks. Eruptions of the face, acne, boils, comedones, eczema, herpes, pimples.

Mouth - Mouth covered with aphthae. Very dry, but at times copious mucus. Offensive, even putrid odor from the mouth. Bad taste, alkaline, bitter in the morning, metallic, putrid, sour. White coated tongue. Tongue is very sore. Difficult speech. Swollen gums and tongue. Bleeding gums.

Throat - Inflammation of the throat, pharynx and tonsils with dryness and redness. Constant effort to clear the throat. Lump in the throat. Splinter-like pain on swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo, in morning, on rising, after rising, in evening, while lying, looking upwards, from mental exertion. Vertigo with a tendency to fall backward during headache. COMMENTS - The silicate of lime is a very deep-acting remedy. It acts profoundly upon the skin, mucus membranes, bones and glands. Marked emaciation, especially in children who have inherited tuberculosis. Great weakness, especially in the morning on waking, after least exertion, from mental exertion, or walking in open air. Great nervous weakness. Weakness, night sweats and seminal emission. The least exertion prostrates and increases many symptoms. Stiffness in body, back and limbs when cold, after exertion and after sweating. Wet weather brings out all his sufferings. Hemorrhage from throat, nose, larynx and chest. Swelling from dropsy and inflammation, swelling of affected parts, of glands with hardness. Mucus secretions increased and greenish-yellow. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ars„ Tub., Bar-c., lod. (2) Fl-ac., Lap-a. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Kent.

Stomach - Anxiety in the stomach. Sinking Calcarea silicata sensation at pit. Sensation of coldness, especially when empty. Flatulence and distention after eating. Heartburn. Hiccough. Vomiting and belchings. Vomiting bile, black blood, food, mucus and watery substances.

Abdomen - Slow digestion, slow action of bowels and liver. Dropsy of the abdomen, enlarged liver. Distention of the abdomen after eating. Flatulence with much rumbling and fullness.

Rectum - Extreme constipation with inactivity of the rectum. Difficult stool, paralyzed feeling in rectum. Constriction of anus. Stricture of the rectum. Fistula in anus. Painless diarrhea. Dysentery with bloody, scanty stools.

Male - Enlarged and tender prostate gland. Emission of prostatic fluid when straining to pass stool. Erection at night without thought or dreams. Eruptions on the prepuce. Hydrocele and induration of testes. Foul sweat on genitals.

Female - Menstrual flow absent or suppressed, painful and irregular. Flow between periods. Leucorrhea, painful and irregular menses. Uterus is heavy, prolapsed. Ulceration of labia, vagina. Food - Great thirst. Aversion to food, especially to meat and milk. Some desire for sour things, milk. Many complaints worse from cold food and cold drinks.

Chest - Pain in chest walls. Constriction of chest. Eruption on chest. Pain in chest during cough, on inspiration, deep breathing. Constitutions - Hydrogenoid constitution. Constitutional condition in patients suffering from epilepsy, making the fits lighter and farther apart.

Back - Back feels cold and there is a sensation of coldness in back of neck and sacrum. Hard aching in the back, when rising from a seat. The spine is sore to touch. Stiff neck. Breasts - Useful in restraining malignant ulceration in the breasts. Excoriation of the nipples. Suppressed or absent milk.

Limbs - The muscles, tendons and joints are weak and easily strained. Stiffness of all the limbs, joints. Heaviness of all the limbs. Gouty nodosities. Cramps in hands, lower limbs, calves, feet, soles, toes. Boils on the upper limbs. Cracked hands and fingers. Nails have ceased to grow. Lungs - Difficult respiration. Breathing fast, asthmatic. Chronic irritation of air passages. Coughs with coldness, weakness, emaciation, worse from cold air. Coughs in tubercular subjects. Copious expectoration, greenish- yellow, bloody.

Sleep - Restless sleep. Easily startled during sleep. Shrieks during sleep. Confused, amorous, frightful, fantastic dreams. Dreams of the dead, of death, murder, disease, fire, anger.

Skin - Cold and blue, very sensitive. Cracked skin. Dry, burning skin and inability to perspire. Burning of the skin after scratching. Pimples, comedones, wens. Eczema and herpes. Psoric eruptions. Pimples, pustules, and red rashes. Warts painful, hard. Liver spots.

Modalities - Worse from change of weather. Worse from warm to cold. Worse cold air. Worse becoming cold. Worse after becoming cold, and cold, wet weather. Great aggravation from being overheated. Worse after sex. Worse exertion. Worse motion.

Teeth - Loose teeth, feel too long. Decay of the teeth. Pain in the teeth at night. Very sore when chewing.

Kidneys - Sudden ineffectual urging. Frequent urination during the night. Involuntary urination during sleep.

Temperature - Cold all the time, lack of vital heat. Cold sweat mostly on the limbs. Hectic fevers. When perspiring, a slight draft or cold air will suppress the sweat and he becomes lame and the symptoms in general are worse. Marked periodicity in many symptoms.

name: Calcareasulphurica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air. Better bathing. Better eating. Better local heat. Better uncovering. Worse from drafts. Worse cold, wet. Worse touch. Worse heat of the room. Worse standing. Worse walking fast..
constitution: Abscesses. Anus, abscess. Boils. Buboes. Burns. Carbuncles. Chilblains. Concussion. Conjunctivitis. Cornea, ulceration. Cough. Crusta, lactea. Cysts. Deafness. Dropsy. Dysentery. Eczema. Fistula. Gland, swellings. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Injuries. Lupus, vulgaris. Pimples. Pneumonia. Polyps. Pustules. Scarlatina. Skin, disorders. Spermatorrhea. Syphilis. Tonsillitis. Tumors. Ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - calc-s. Calcarea sulphurica. Calcium sulphate. Plaster of Paris. Gypsum. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Anus, abscess. Boils. Buboes. Burns. Carbuncles. Chilblains. Concussion. Conjunctivitis. Cornea, ulceration.…
full:
PHARMACY - calc-s. Calcarea sulphurica. Calcium sulphate. Plaster of Paris. Gypsum. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Anus, abscess. Boils. Buboes. Burns. Carbuncles. Chilblains. Concussion. Conjunctivitis. Cornea, ulceration. Cough. Crusta, lactea. Cysts. Deafness. Dropsy. Dysentery. Eczema. Fistula. Gland, swellings. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Injuries. Lupus, vulgaris. Pimples. Pneumonia. Polyps. Pustules. Scarlatina. Skin, disorders. Spermatorrhea. Syphilis. Tonsillitis. Tumors. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calc-s., which is an impure sulphide of calcium, has a wide sphere and deep action in suppurative processes. Calc-s. is closely related to Hep. It is Dr. Schiissler's connective tissue remedy, and most of the indications for its use are derived from his clinical experience. Calc-s. affects glands, mucus membranes, bones and skin. Mucus discharges are yellow, thick and lumpy. Abscess formation. Recurrent or running abscesses. Tendency to suppuration. Suppurative processes come after pus finds a vent. Pus is thick, yellow, lumpy, bloody. Burns and scalds after suppuration starts in. Malignant growth after ulceration has set in. Torpid glandular swellings. Tendency to form pus easily. Every cut or scratch will suppurate, create pus. Boils with a lot of pus, boils all over the body (Calc-pic.). Tendency to get boils. Severe acnés with yellow pus coming out and leaving pock marks. Eczema and torpid glandular swellings. Cystic tumors. Fibroids. Ulcers, malignant, corneal, deep. Fistula. Cutting pains. Poor reaction. Infants with bloody coryza, diarrhea or eczema. Lupus vulgaris. MIND - Confusion from mental exertion. Forgetful after eating. Loses memory and power of thought suddenly, after lunch. Sits and meditates over imaginary misfortune. Changeable moods. Liveliness and good spirits change to grief and melancholy, afternoon and evening. Sad in morning, but mirthful in evening. Inclination to weep during perspiration. Hurnedfeeling.Anxréíy in evening. Anxiety in bed, at night, better open air. Timidity. Fear of birds. Sometimes a desire to walk, to attend to something, as soon as she sets out to do it the desire is gone. Easily angered, followed by weakness. Jealousy. Despises those who do not agree with him. Irritability in evening. Lamenting because he feels he is not appreciated. Grumbles that others do not understand him.

Head - Chronic and periodic headache, worse looking up. Severe frontal headache, worse after dinner. Ache across forehead and in vertex. Headache from concussion. Tearing pain around whole head, with nausea. Pulsating headache from becoming cold, better cold air. Painful pimples on scalp leave a yellow scab. Hard tender swellings in scalp in edge of hair, bleeding when scratched. Boil over left eye. Scald head of children, with purulent, yellow discharge or crusts.

Eyes - Inflammation of eyes, evening and night. Conjunctivitis with discharge of thick, yellow matter. Conjunctiva yellow. Eyes red like raw beef. Red, itching tarsi. Inflammation of the eyes with discharge of thick, yellow matter. Sensation as if eyes were sunken, during menses, during headache. Cornea smoky. Deep ulcers on cornea. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Severe inflammation in canthi. Smarting pain in inner canthi. Injury to eye from a splinter with pus formation. Twitching of eye muscles. Sees only one-half of an object. Diplopia. Occasional blindness, with twitching of eyelids.

Ears - Deafness with discharge of matter from the middle ear, sometimes mixed with blood. Chronic otorrhea. Otorrhea after scarlet fever, pus thick, bloody and offensive. Otorrhea with sore and enlarged parotids. Flow of dark wax from right ear. Otitis after a slap on ear. Pimple on top of right ear. Pimples around ear.

Nose - Influenza and sneezing, better open air. Cold in the head with thick,yellowish, purulent secretion, frequently tinged with

Face - Exceedingly pale, sickly appearance. Flushes with heat. Pimples and pustules on the face. Many tender pimples under beard discharge blood or oily transparent matter. Herpes. Boils. Darting pain in right side of face. Soreness of right parotid gland, better walking in open air. Swollen hard pimple on left cheek.

Mouth - Inside of lips sore. Gumboils. Gums bleed while brushing teeth. Soreness, left side of roof as if burned, while eating. Sour, soapy, acrid taste. Taste bitter. Sour, soapy, acrid taste. Blister-like sores on right lower lip. ulcerate, ooze bloody matter. On outer lower lip a raw sore, forming a scab. Cracked lips. Swollen cheek with toothache, if suppuration threatens. Pains in right upper jaw, with swollen and tender gums about a decayed molar. Toothache, molar sensitive to cold air, water. Toothache with swollen cheek. Toothache after dark and in sleep. Toothache first worse cold water, soon better.

Throat - Last stage of ulcerated sore throat with discharge of yellow matter. Tonsillitis. Suppurating stage of tonsillitis, when abscess is discharging. Discharge of pus is anticipated. Pharynx red and sore, tonsils affected.

Stomach - Indigestion on least provocation. Pains in stomach and burnings. Nausea during vertigo. Nausea during headache. Nausea during pain in pelvis. Sensations of weakness in stomach.

Abdomen - Colic with rumbling. Colic with diarrhea. Coldness and distension of abdomen after eating. Pain in right side of pelvis, followed by weakness, nausea and pain in stomach. Sensations in lower part of abdomen as if skin was too tight, with pain. Pains in liver region, in right side of pelvis, followed by weakness, nausea and pain in stomach. Buboes, to prevent suppuration.

Rectum - Constipation with hectic fever. Constipation with difficult breathing. Diarrhea of children with discharge of pus or bloody pus. Diarrhea with pain in abdomen and from change of weather. Diarrhea after maple sugar and from change of weather. Purulent diarrhea mixed with blood. Painful abscesses about the anus. Anal fistula. Pus-like, slimy discharge from the bowels. Stools, coated white. Moisture about anus causes itching and smarting.

Male - Gonorrhea in suppurative stage. Chronic syphilis. Spermatorrhea with impotence.

Female - Menses late, long-lasting, with headache, twitching, and great weakness. Vagintis. Thick, white leucorrhea. Itching high up in vagina. Mastitis, when pus begins to form or to prevent suppuration. Twitching during menses. Cutting pain in right ovary. Food - Excessive appetite and thirst. No appetite for meat. Craves stimulants to overcome the weakness. Desires for both sour and salt. Desires sweets, acid fruit, green fruit. Desires tea, claret, green sour vegetables and fruit. Diarrhea after maple sugar.

Chest - Pain in sternum, becoming so much worse that she was obliged to double up. Pains across chest. Pains in chest with headache. Abscess in axilla. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Heart - Pains from anterior of heart down extending to lower part of thigh.

Back - Curvature of lumbar spine, difficult to sit up. Pains across back of neck. Pains in lower part of back. Chronic pain in os coccygis was greatly aggravated.

Limbs - Pains in joints. Chilblains, when suppurating. Swelling of phalanges of fingers. Burning in soles with hectic fever. Burning, itching of soles of feet. Inflammation and swelling of little finger. Whitlow when suppuration begins. Weakness of legs. Weariness in knees after walking. Lameness in inner part of left knee when in bath. Pains in lower limbs worse stretching limb. Sciatica. Stitches in knee. Inflammation of hip-joint. Suppurative stage of hip disease. Painful stiffness of legs. Legs tender to touch. Feet slightly swollen and tender.

Sleep - Starts from sleep, as if wanting air. Sleepy during day, wakeful at night. Before going to bed, pain in head. Internal lassitude after siesta. Dreamed she had a convulsion from fright, awoke screaming and much exhausted.

Skin - Unhealthy skin. Cuts, wounds, discharging pus, do not heal readily. Boils and abscesses. Skin affections with yellowish brownish or greenish scabs. Skin suppurates easily. Many little pimples under the hair, bleeding when scratched. Dry eczema in children. Acne with pus filled pimples. Eczema, eruption has yellowish scales, and there are many pimples and points of suppuration. Skin cracked in winter, especially the hands after washing. Scarlet rash. Scarlatina with excessive swelling of soft palate. Yellow, purulent crusts or discharge. Purulent exudation in or upon the skin. Yellowish scabs. Many little pimples under the hair, bleeding when scratched. Dry eczema, worse in infants.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better bathing. Better eating. Better local heat. Better uncovering. Worse from drafts. Worse cold, wet. Worse touch. Worse heat of the room. Worse standing. Worse walking fast.

Tongue - Slightly puckered sensation at base of tongue. Tongue seamed with a deep red line. Glossitis, when suppuration begins. Tongue flabby, resembling a layer of dried clay. Yellow coating at base. Vertigo - Vertigo better open air but worse walking fast. Vertigo while walking. Dizzy in head and weakness. Vertigo with deathly nausea. COMMENTARY - Calc-s. is a synthetic remedy, useful for a Sulph. and Calc, states. Similar to Hep., which is calcium sulphide (this is calcium sulphate), it's useful for following Hep., or dealing with residue. Better in open air, better walking in it, desire for it (Hep. cannot bear the slightest exposure). Worse from change of weather (Hep.). Calc-s. has not the excessive sensitiveness to touch found in Hep. Nash cured a case of suppurating kidney with it. Hansen recommended it in dry eczema in children. Has cured cystic tumors, fibroids and polyps. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calen., Hep., Kali-m. (2) Nat-s. - post-scarlatinal dropsy. (3) Sil. - hard or suppurating glands, ulcers of comea tonsillitis, mastitis, frostbite. Follows well: Kali-m., Nat-s., Sil.. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Liver - Pain in region of liver. Lungs - Asthma with hectic fever. Difficult breathing, worse evening and night. Difficult breathing, worse ascending, cough and lying, better cool air. Short-breathed, constipated and cachectic. Pneumonia, late stage. Empyema, pus forming in lungs or pleural cavities. Rattling of mucus in lungs. Choking croup. Cough with purulent and bloody sputum and hectic fever. Chronic cough with tuberculosis. Purulent, bloody expectoration. Catarrh with thick, lumpy, white-yellow or pus-like secretions.

Kidneys - Pyelitis. Chronic nephritis. Pain in kidneys. Severe pain, followed by pus in urine, which weakens one rapidly. Catarrh of bladder. Copious, yellow pus in urine. Red urine with hectic fever.

Perspiration - Foul, cold foot sweat. Easy sweating, worse coughing. Profuse sweats with hectic fever.

Temperature - Chills beginning in feet. Hectic fever, caused by formation of pus. Averse to covers when cold. Dry heat at night. Easy sweating, worse coughing. Hectic fever with cough and burning in soles.

name: Calculus Renalis
author: Murphy
constitution: Arthritis. Arthritis, nodosities. Bladder, stones. Gout. Gravel. Joints, nodosities. Kidney, pain. Kidney stones. Rheumatism. Rigg's disease. Teeth, tartar. Uric acid, stones. Urinary gravel. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - calcul-r. Calculus renalis. Kidney stones. Calculi urinae. Lapidus renalis. Calcarea renalis. Renal calculi. (Urate of lime, or phosphate of lime, kidney stones) Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthritis. Arthritis, nodosities.…
full:
PHARMACY - calcul-r. Calculus renalis. Kidney stones. Calculi urinae. Lapidus renalis. Calcarea renalis. Renal calculi. (Urate of lime, or phosphate of lime, kidney stones) Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthritis. Arthritis, nodosities. Bladder, stones. Gout. Gravel. Joints, nodosities. Kidney, pain. Kidney stones. Rheumatism. Rigg's disease. Teeth, tartar. Uric acid, stones. Urinary gravel. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bredenoll considered the kidney stones, tartar on the teeth and arthritic nodosities very similar morbid products. Calcul-r. is reported to be peculiarly beneficial in Rigg's disease of the teeth. Arthritic nodosities. It is called for in gouty conditions : in. renal calculi and nodosities of fingers. Lessens the tendency to the accumulation of tartar on teeth, gravel and kidney stones. Useful where teeth acquire abundant tartar with inflamed gums. Horrible anguish and pain from kidney stones. Frequent desire to urinate. Urinary gravel. Urine is turbid and bloody. Vomiting of mucus, bile ingesta. Joints - Arthritis nodosities. Stiffness. Rheumatism.

Teeth - Tartar on teeth. Rigg's disease. COMMENTS - The Hom. Recorder of Aug., 1895, reprinted a paper by Dr. Bredenoll of Erwitte in which he gave his experience with this remedy in his own case of intense kidney colic with the passage of uric acid stones. One of these stones was triturated in the proportion of 5 parts to 95 of milk sugar. Of this, he took 1/2 grain doses for a considerable time, resulting in the formation of stones ceasing. The tartar which had formed on his teeth dropped off, and a nodosity of stony hardness disappeared from the extensor tendon of the right middle finger. Dr. Bredenoll writes: “In November, 1837, I was suddenly attacked with vomiting, accompanied with violent lancinating, sore or pinching pains in the region of the left kidney. The horrible anguish and pain which I experienced extorted from me involuntary screams, I was writhing like a worm in the dust. “A calculus had descended into the ureter and had become incarcerated in it. Repeated doses of Nux-v relieved the incarceration and 1 distinctly felt that the calculus was descending towards the bladder. After twenty-four hours of horrible suffering the vomiting ceased. The pain became duller and was felt in the region where the ureter dips into and becomes interwoven with the tissue of the bladder. “It continued for three days and then disappeared all of a sudden (the stone had not got into the bladder). Thirty-six hours afterwards the calculus entered the bulb of the urethra. I felt a frequent desire to urinate, the urine was turbid and bloody, until at last a calculus of four grains made its appearance in the urine. “After this I frequently passed gravel and stones, at times with slight, at times violent pains, sometimes accompanied with vomiting, I kept the larger stones with a view of using them hereafter as a curative agent. “Professor Nasser of Bonn, where my son studied medicine at the time, has analyzed the stones and has found them to be urate of lime. He advised me to take Merc-d. and the Sulphate of soda for some time, it is scarcely necessary for me to say that I did not follow his advice. “On the 15th of February, 1839, I felt the precursory symptoms of a new attack, which really did break out in all its fury on the 16th and continued on the 17th and 18th. I now took 5 grains of my kidney stones to be triturated in my presence with 95 grains of sugar of milk, according to the fashion of Hahnemann and took 1/2 grain in the evening of the 17th, another 1/2 grain in the morning of the 18th. “On this day I passed very turbid urine with a considerable quantity of gravel, however in the region where the ureter dips into the bladder, I experienced an uncomfortable sensation, but was well otherwise. “On the 19th I was obliged to visit a patient at the distance of two miles, on my journey I felt that the calculus was descending into the bladder, the urine which I emitted shortly afterwards was very turbid and bloody. “That same evening after returning home, I left the stone in the bulb of the urethra and on the morning of the 20th it came off during stool, but unfortunately got lost among the excrement. “To judge from my feeling it must have been larger than any of the preceding stones and also rougher, for its passage through the urethra was very painful and followed by an oozing out of blood. “The uncomfortable feeling in the region of the left kidney never disappeared completely, it became especially painful when pressing upon that place, when riding on horseback or in a carriage, when taking exercise or turning the body. “It seems to me that the whole pelvis of the kidneys must have been full of gravel and stones. I now took 1/2 grain at intervals of eight days, the result was that I passed gravel and small stones at every urination. “On the 30th of November my condition got worse and I continued to take 1/2 grain of Calcul-r., at longer or shorter intervals, until October 18th, 1840. After this period I ceased to pass any gravel and I felt entirely well. On the kidneys must have been full of gravel and stones. I now took 1/2 grain of Calcul-r., another dose on June 3rd. “On June 17th precursors of another attack, on the 18 th vomiting accompanied by all the frightful circumstances which I have detailed above, the vomiting of mucus, bile ingesta, continued at short intervals until the 26th, my tongue was coated with yellow mucus and my appetite had completely disappeared. “Bry., Nux-v. and Puls, relieved the gastric symptom, on the 26th in the afternoon, I passed a calculus of the size of a pea. I now resumed the use of Calcul-r. in 1/2 grain doses, at irregular intervals. “On the 23rd of October I passed a stone of the size of a pea without vomiting, there were no other precursory symptoms except the uncomfortable feeling in the region of the kidneys a few days previous. I have felt well ever since and free from all complaint, although I continue the occasional use of 1/2 grain of Calcul-r., lest I should have a relapse. “Every time I took a dose of Calcul-r. I found that the so-called tartar on the teeth became detached a few days afterwards. A short while ago a nodosity, hard as a stone, which had appeared on the extensor tendon of the right middle finger, about nine months ago and which threatened to increase more and more, disappeared.” RELATIONS - Compare: Berb., Ox-ac. REFERENCES - Anshutz.

Kidneys - Severe pain in region of kidneys. Kidney colic. Violent lancinating, sore or pinching pains. Kidney stones. Uric acid stones.

full:
PHARMACY - calea. Calea zacatechchichi. Dream herb. Bitter grass. Leaf of God. N. O. Compositae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Dreams. Dysentery. Fever. Gastrointestinal, disorders. Nausea. Nightmares. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Calea zacatechichi is a medium sized shrub that has reportedly been used by the Chantal indians of Mexico as a hallucinogen. Its dried leaves are used before sleep to increase dreaming. Its effects are not well documented.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calea actions during wakefulness were tested in five subjects after several inhalations and the administration of an infusion. With high doses, effects included: sensations of well-being and light-headedness, difficulty in bringing events to mind, somnolence, and an intensification of visual imagery, but only with the eyes closed. Symptoms include lack of physical stamina. Nausea and vomiting. Severe leg cramping. Swelling of the limbs with rash on the feet, between toes. Swelling in the hands, with redness on the fingers. Severe bitter taste in mouth. Drowsiness, mild vertigo. Euphoria. Mental clarity. It alters the perception of time so that it appears that time is passing more slowly. Makes one feel more ‘in control' of things. Vivid dreams. More lucid in dreams. Dreams seem more realistic. RELATIONS - Compare: Salv-d. Anh. REFERENCES - Buttimer. Murphy.

name: Calendula Officinalis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from walking about. Better lying perfectly still. Better warmth. Worse in damp. Worse heavy, cloudy weather. Worse during chill. Worse evening..

Gunshot, wounds. Injuries. Jaundice. Knife, wounds. Lacerated, tissue. Muscle, tears. Nails, inflamed. Nipples, sore. Perineum, tears. Puncture, wounds. Septic, wounds. Sunburn. Suppuration. full:
PHARMACY - calen. Calendula officinalis. Pot Marigold. N. O. Composite. Tincture of leaves and flowers. Calendula Succus is made from the fresh plant juice. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally, use tincture for all wounds, one of the greatest healing agents. Also as an injection in leucorrhea internally.

CLINICAL - Abrasions. Abscess. Balanitis. Breast, infection. Bubo. Bums. Carbuncles. Chilblains. Cornea, injuries. Cuts. Deafness. Erysipelas. Eyes, injuries. Fever. Fistula. Glandular, swellings. Gunshot, wounds. Injuries. Jaundice. Knife, wounds. Lacerated, tissue. Muscle, tears. Nails, inflamed. Nipples, sore. Perineum, tears. Puncture, wounds. Septic, wounds. Sunburn. Suppuration. Surgery, effects. Tetanus. Ulcers. Uteres, inflammation. Uterus, cancer, discharge. Varicose, ulcers. Whitlow. Wounds.

HERBAL - Calen, belongs to the same family as those other great vulneraries: Am. and Bd\- p.Thegreatherbalanti-septic,itrestores the vitality of an wounded part, making it impregnable against the forces of putrefaction. Indicated in lacerated and suppurative wounds. Unlike Arnica, it has no irritating property capable of producing erysipelas, it is therefore suitable to all cases of injury where the skin is broken. Calendula is all the dressing needed for any open wound or severe laceration. It takes away the local pain and suffering. Hot lotions are generally preferable to cold, as they conserve the vitality of the injured parts. Hot compresses in pneumonia. Hot fomentations, when intermittently applied, are far better than poultices as applications to forming abscesses. If they Calendula officinalis do not abort the process, they favor the maturation and ultimate healing. Kent noted that Calen, tincture cannot be ignored in injuries, in cuts with laceration, surface or open injuries. Diluted Calendula used locally will keep the wound odorless, will reduce the amount of pus and favor granulation in the very best possible manner. Thus it assists the surgeon in healing up surface wounds. A correspondent of the Hom. World, 1891, “C. W.,” mentions that a friend of his who chewed for a few minutes a Calen, leaf noticed that it entirely removed for some days the difficulty of passing water such as is commonly met with in old men. The application of a sponge saturated with a hot solution of calendula after delivery gives the greatest comfort to the patient.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calen, has not been largely proved, but very definite fever symptoms have been elicited. Fever and chills. Goose bumps. Cases of jaundice have been treated with it successfully. Calen, acts on muscles, spine, liver and skin. A most remarkable healing agent, applied locally or given internally in potency. Exhaustion from loss of blood and excessive pain. Calen, is used for open, tom, cut, lacerated, ragged or suppurating wounds. Wounds raw and inflamed. Wounds painful as if beaten. Pain is excessive and out of all proportion to injury. The parts around the wound become red, with stinging in the wound during the febrile heat. Flesh wounds. Rapid healing of wounds. Wounds, cuts, abrasions, lacerations, broken skin surface. Promotes healthy granulations and rapid healing by first intention. Prevents scar tissue formation. Arrests bleeding from wounds, especially to scalp, mouth. Both prevents and heals infection, pus formation. Antiseptic for sores, abscesses, infection at the site of a wounds. Pain appears or is worse after bandage is put on. Muscle injuries. Give Calen, before and after surgery. Exhaustion from blood loss or pain. Pains after cuts or surgery. Ruptures of muscles, tendon. Fractures or compound fracture. Head injury or concussion. Stab wounds. Penetrating wounds into joints. Soft tissue injuries. Useful for open wounds, parts that will not heal, ulcers, etc. It is useful in preventing excessive suppuration and putridity, both keep septic germs from sores and wounds (Sul- ac). Prevents pyemia. Prevents gangrene. Calen, has the power to produce local exudation and helps to make the acrid discharge healthy and free. Burns, scalds, sunburns. Caesarean operation. Constitutional tendency to erysipelas. General pallor and insensibility. Nearly all symptoms appear with a chill. Deafness. Catarrhal conditions. Hemostatic after tooth extraction. Neuroma. Great disposition to take cold, especially in damp weather. Sensitive to damp or open air. Cold hands. Paralysis after a stroke. Cancer, intercurrent remedy. Valuable in healing or reproducing bone. Sensation as if he would faint, with movements in stomach and abdomen. Feels best when walking about, or when lying perfectly still. Moving causes pain, even after the wound is dressed, rheumatism worse motion. MIND - Great irritability. Easily frightened. Fretful, sleepy, dreamy. Extremely nervous. Starts with fright. Dread of something bad happening. Bulimia. Anxious, morose and solicitous during the chill.

Head - Pains after mechanical injuries. Concussion of brain. Lacerated scalp wounds. Hemorrhages in scalp wounds. Compound fractures of skull. Dull, pres- sive sensation in occiput. Dull headache, as after a debauch. Fungus of cranium. Tearing pains. Sensation of a weight on brain. Submaxillary glands swollen, painful to touch. Pain in right side of neck. Pain and heat in forehead after eating.

Eyes - Eyewash for irritations, abrasions, infections, conjunctivitis. Eye inflammation after trauma. Scratched cornea. Injuries to the eyes which tend to suppuration. Eye pains after surgery. Blenorrhea of lachrymal sac, yellow vision. Lacerated and incised wounds of eyes. Eyes black and blue from extravasated blood. Foreign objects in the eye. Traumatic conjunctivitis, keratitis and iritis. White of eye inflamed, with pressive headache, in forehead, temples. Pupils dilated. Dryness and biting in margin of lid, as from smoke. Lid very much swollen. Wounds of eyelids and brows badly treated with plasters and where suppuration takes place.

Ears - Rupturedeardrum. Deafness, worse in damp surroundings, with eczematous conditions. Hears best on a train and distant sounds. Hearing acute.

Nose - Coryza in one nostril, with much green discharge.

Face - Face puffy, much swollen under eyes. Eruption of small vesicles in left corner of lips and on right side of mouth. Lips as if swollen. Burning and stinging. Submaxillary glands swollen and about to suppurate, painful on touch. Drawing, tensive pains, in gland behind left ramus of lower jaw, on moving head.

Mouth - Bitter phlegm in mouth. Bleeding gums. Bleeding after tooth extraction. Pains after gum surgery.

Throat - Scalds, burns of throat. Injuries to air passages, in form of cuts or lacerations. Foreign bodies in air passages. Bitter phlegm in throat. Painful swelling of submaxillary gland, worse on moving head. Pressure in throat when swallowing. Wounds of esophagus, to prevent esopha- gitis. Foreign bodies in esophagus having produced laceration. Voice stronger and deeper as soon as fever heat abates, in evening. COMMENTS - Calendula, largely diluted with water, is highly esteemed by many physicians as a dressing for lacerated wounds, ulcers, and burns. Burns are dressed by applying muslin cloth saturated with dilute calendula night and morning. The cloth should be kept constantly saturated with the agent. It is also used an injection in vaginal and uterine leucorrhoea. Useful for surgeries, given before and after. Hemorrhage, cuts that keep bleeding and won't heal. Sharp stinging, cutting feelings, redness and rawness. Very good for preventing septic wounds (Pyrog., once septic situations have set in). Torn or wounded muscles. Bedsores. Hansen noted it for open wounds, very sore and painful, difficult granulation, tendency to inflammation and suppuration. Useful for burns when applied topically (Canth., Urt-u.). Good as local application in phlegmonous erysipelas. For severe nerve pain (Coff., Phos. is numb and tingling). Nerve injury (when Hyper, fails). Excessive pain out of proportion to the injury (Coff.). Pain under right scapula, or bruised feeling under the right scapula. Can be used as an eyewash for bloodshot eyes from dust or irritation (Euphr.). Injuries to the eyes from foreign objects and irritants. Tendency to catch colds. Carious root toothache. An excellent hemostatic in tooth extractions and for gum surgery. Very acute hearing. Hypersensitive hearing (Coff.). Deafness from inflammation. Boericke noted it as being specific for ruptured or torn eardrums (Thiosin. is for eardrum adhesions and ossification of the bones, Kali- m., if deafness is caused by blocked Eustachian tubes). Ulcers, heartburn, bleeding ulcers. Bleeding hemorrhoids, internally is best. Diuretic (urine feels hot like Bell.). Nodosities in breast. Helpful for episiotomies, the stinging, cutting pains. Hemorrhage after childbirth. Bad ulcers of Calendula officinalis os uteri. Offensive leucorrhea. Ludlam recommended it in chronic endocervicitis and scrofulous ulcerations with much purulent leucorrhea. Useful topically after childbirth. Jahr, who was in Paris during the Coup d'Etat of 1849, treated a number of cases of gunshot wounds with comminuted bones and saved several limbs by means of Calen. It prevented suppuration and pyemia. In some cases of carbuncle it acts with great promptitude, subduing pain and fever. In obstetric practice it is invaluable. Calen, as been used in Germany in tincture on cancer areas. It helped to stop the spread of cancer and helped to reabsorb it. Almost all the symptoms appear during the chilly stage of the fever, he feels most comfortable when walking about or else when lying perfectly still. Cooper said that calen, is worse in cloudy weather. Drinking causes a shaking chill or creeping crawls, even during heat. Very sensitive to cold air. Restless, can't get comfortable in bed. Fear of some overwhelming calamity. C. R. Crosby gave it internally in the 3x potency, as well as externally. He had excellent results from its use as a hot compress (an ounce to the pint) in pneumonia and other inflammations. C. W., himself a pharmacist, noticed the following effect on himself when making the fresh-plant tincture: “There was such a feeling as if some overwhelming calamity was hovering over me as to be almost unbearable. “Three years ago, just after making the tincture, my old enemy the gout nipped me in the middle of the spine and in three days spoiled all my powers of walking and then the dreadful feeling became very much exaggerated.” His experience led him to conclude that Calen, has an action on the spinal cord. RELATIONS - Antidote: Chel., Rheum. Antidoted by: Am. Compare: (1) Staph., Am., Ars., Bry., Calc-s., Carb-an., Carb-v., Ham., Hep., Hyper., Led., Nit-ac„ Phos., Rhus-t., Ruta, Sal-ac., Sul-ac., Symph. (2) in deaf- ness: Ferr-pic., Kali-i., Calc., Mag-ac, Graph. Compatible: Am., Ars., Bry., Nit-ac., Phos., Rhus-t. Complementary: Hep. Calendula contains much nitrogen and phosphoric acid. Followed well by: Am., Hep. Incompatible: Camph. Follows well: Ars. i. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Kent. Murphy.

Stomach - Hunger immediately after nursing. Heartburn. Nausea in chest. Vomiting. Sinking sensation. Hiccough, when smoking. Sinking feeling. Movements in stomach causes faint feeling. Vomiting with pain in uterine region, after taking cold. Induration in stomach and uterus.

Abdomen - Epigastric distention. Stretching and dragging in groin. Sticking in the left side of the abdomen. Movements in abdomen causes faint feeling. Griping and anxiety in abdomen during stool. Constant soreness of abdomen and tenderness in left iliac region. Enteritis from foreign body. Dull, coarse stitches in middle of right side of abdomen, on moving. Boring, digging, deep in region of navel, when walking.

Rectum - Stools curdy. Frequent almost entirely mucus stools. Stool in morning, preceded by griping and anxiety in abdomen, with chill. Diarrhea with vomiting of food, with heartburn. Constipation. Perineal abscess. To close the wound after operation. Ruptures of perineum.

Male - Excoriation of prepuce after sex.

Female - Menses suppressed with cough. Menorrhagia. Chronic cervicitis. Warts on cervix. Os lower than natural. Profuse offensive watery discharge after forceps delivery. Vaginal tears after childbirth. Hypertrophy of uterus. Lacerated vagina from childbirth, sex, surgery, wounds. Sensation of weight and fullness in pelvis. Stretching and dragging pain in pelvis. Pain on sudden movements. Uterine pain after taking cold. Cancer of womb with bleeding. Ruptures of cervix and perineum during childbirth. Excoriated and cracked nipples. Food - Hunger immediately after nursing. Hiccough when smoking. Bulimia. Diminished appetite for dinner, though he relishes food when he eats. Drinks much at night with fever. Aversion to drinks. Crawls on back from cold drinks.

Chest - Pressure on last rib, left side. Drawing pressure in left side of chest, also in sternum. Stitches in right side of chest. Nausea felt in chest. Ribs ache as if pressed together. Pressure and oppression in left side of chest, in evening, when lying in bed. Stitches in right side of chest. Axillary glands sore to touch. Axillae very hot. Constitutions - Constitutional tendency to erysipelas.

Back - Bruised pain at angle of right scapula. Tearing with pressure between the scapulae. Pains after back surgery. Pain under the right scapula. Rheumatic drawing in the right side of neck. Pressive drawing pain, between scapula. Causations - Burns. Cuts, punctures, stabs. Wounds. Surgery.

Limbs - Drawing, pressive pains in wrists and ankles during rest. Wounds about joints. Pains after surgical operations, to prevent caries or necrosis. Torn tendons and muscles. Cold hands and feet. The axillary glands are painful to the touch. Varicose swellings and ulcers. Foot crushed, erysipelas and gangrene. Pressure and drawing tension in the hand. Tearing, burning in the calf. Spasmodic drawing of the foot, when sitting. Lungs - Cough with green expectoration, hoarseness, with distention of inguinal ring. Great efforts made to inflate lower lobes of lungs, which were only successful when sitting up. Breathing easier after fever abates.

Sleep - Restless at night, can rest in no position. Wakes continually. Must urinate frequently and drinks very much. Feels as if he would fall from a height, when falling asleep.

Skin - Topical treatment of fissures, varicose ulcers, bedsores, gangrene. Stinging and cutting pains. Skin feels warm to touch. Jaundice. Yellow skin. Goose bumps. Slough, proud flesh and raised edges. Burns and scalds. Erysipelas (use topically). Promotes favorable scar tissue with least amount of suppuration. Ulcers, irritable and inflamed. Sloughing of tissues from wounds, ulcers. Varicose ulcers, painful, as if beaten. Excessive secretion of pus from ulcers or wounds. Wounds, ulcers with surrounding parts red.

Modalities - Better from walking about. Better lying perfectly still. Better warmth. Worse in damp. Worse heavy, cloudy weather. Worse during chill. Worse evening.

Kidneys - Frequent urination, with emission of pale, clear, hot, and even burning urine. Tearing in the urethra during the chilliness. Has to urinate often at night. Urine suppressed. Urine colorless as water. Urine is very hot and burning. Urine suppressed, passes less than half her usual quantity of urine.

Temperature - Shivering and shaking chill from drinking. Violent chill after trauma. Feels shivery and has a kind of gooseflesh, while skin seems warm to touch. Coldness, a great sensitiveness to open air. Shuddering in back. Heat in evening. After dinner, heat in face, hands and feet.

The fresh juice is considered a valuable remedy in skin disorders.

PHARMACY - calo. Calotropis gigantea. Madar bark. N. O. Asclepiadacae. East India. The root-bark is called Mudar, Mirdar, Yercum. Tincture or trituration of bark of root. Tincture of the milky juice or gum. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Dysentery. Feet,pains. Fevers. Hand, pains. Leprosy, tubercular. Lupus. Obesity. Syphilis. Tuberculosis. -HERBAL - The expressed juice, root and bark have been extensively used in the East for their emetic, sudorific, alterative and purgative qualities. The fresh juice is considered a valuable remedy in skin disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Calotropis has been used with marked success in the treatment of syphilis (following Mercury), elephantiasis, leprosy and acute dysentery. Pneumonic tuberculosis. Tuberculosis. Increases the circulation of the skin. Has a powerful effect as a sudorific. In the secondary symptoms of syphilis, where Mercury has been used but cannot be pushed safely any farther, it rapidly recruits the constitution, heals the ulcers and blotches from the skin and perfects the cure. Primary anemia of syphilis. Heat in stomach is a guiding symptom. Obesity, while flesh decreases, muscles become harder and firmer. A short proving brought out a weak, tired feeling, coldness, dizziness, pain and confusion in head, nausea and vomiting of bile. Frequent urination, pain, soreness and redness of thigh, pain in both legs, swelling of knees, and stiffness and inability to walk. Pains in hands and feet, first left then right, worse movement or putting weight on them. COMMENTS - Dr. Gramm of Philadelphia used the tincture with great success in cases of syphilis when Mercury can no longer be given, in the anemia of syphilis, secondary syphilis. A sense of warmth in the scrobiculus cordis is a leading indication for the remedy. In one case of severe and advanced syphilis with enormous thickening of the ends of all the nails, Calo, effected a cure. The remedy was given in one- to five-drop doses of the tincture or in pellets saturated with equal parts of the tincture and 95 percent alcohol. RELATIONS - Coffee caused vomiting when before there was only nausea, but antidoted many effects. Camph. also antidoted. Compare: (l)Merc.,Kali-i.,Berb-a.,Sars. (2) Asc- c., Asc-t. (3) Ip. - emetic. (4) Berb-a. - syphilis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

PHARMACY - calth. Calthapalustris. Cowslip. Marsh marigold. N. O. Ranunculacee. Tincture of fresh shoots and flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - This is an unproved remedy, but it has irritant properties like the other Ranunculacee. Hansen gave as indications: “Pemphigus, bullae are surrounded by a ring, much itching. On the third day they are transformed into crusts.” Cooper used it with excellent effect in a case of uterine cancer, giving single doses of the tincture at long intervals. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hansen.

author: Murphy

PHARMACY - camph. Camphora. Camphor. Laurus camphora. N. O. Lauracae. A gum obtained from Laurus camphora. Solution in rectified spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies, tincture in drop doses, repeated frequently or smelling of Spirits of Camphor.

CLINICAL - Angina, pectoris. Anxiety. Asphyxia, neonatorum. Bedsores. Chills. Cholera. Colds. Colic. Collapse. Congestion. Convulsions. Coughs. Cramps. Delirium. Diarrhea. Epilepsy. Eruptions. Erysipelas. Fevers. Gonorrhea. Heart, disorders. Hematuria. High, fever. Influenza. Measles. Memory, loss. Nausea. Priapism. Rheumatism. Sexual, mania. Shiverings. Sleeplessness. Snakebites. Spasms. Strangury. Taste, disordered. Tetanus. Tobacco, habit. Twitching. Urethra, stricture. Urine, suppression. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Marked coldness, cramps and convulsions with mental anguish. Affects the digestive tract and cerebro-spinal nerves, urinary organs and nose. For colds and chills. Scrofulous, weakly, irritable children are especially affected. Shock. State of collapse. Sudden collapse from over-powering influences acting on nervous centers. Sunstroke with ebbing vitality, fainting spells, cold sweat and icy cold body. First stages of a cold with chilliness and sneezing. Very sensitive to cold and to touch. Great sensitiveness to cold and cold air, which worse pains, takes cold easily. Icy coldness of the whole body, sudden sinking of strength, pulse small and weak. Low blood pressure after operations, if temperature is subnormal. Patient will not be covered, notwithstanding the icy coldness of the body, or wants them off and then on alternately with internal burning heat and anxiousness. Limbs cold with cramps. Camph. has a direct relationship to muscles and fascia. Local rheumatic disorders in cold climates. Awkwardness. Trembling and extreme restlessness. Pain better while thinking of it. Cracking of joints. Distention of veins. Convulsions with blue lips, froth at mouth and lock-jaw. Epileptiform convulsions. After effects of measles. Violent convulsions with wandering and hysterical excitement. Tetanic spasms. Camph. achieved classical fame in cholera epidemics. In some epidemics, Camph. given early has cured a majority of the cases treated, whether it was given as drop doses of the tincture or in the 30c. In the collapse of cholera it corresponds rather to the initial chill before either vomiting or diarrhea. The tongue is cold. If he can speak, the voice is either high pitched or husky. Coldness (Verat.), with marked nausea and vomiting, upper lip drawn up. Acts on the genito-urinary sphere (similar to and antidotes Canth.). Strangury and priapism. MIND - Afraid of his own thoughts, wants to be diverted from thoughts of himself. Fears to be left alone. Does not like any one near him. Memory lost. Most pains are felt during ahalf-conscious condition and disappear when thinking of them. Worse from inattention. Insensibility, vanishing of all senses or anxiety. Awkwardness. Nothing satisfies. Delirium. Mania, religious, puerperal. Wants to jump out of bed or window. Excited, talks constantly, scolds in indecent language. Feeling that she is going to die, relieved, when she finds herself alive. Attacks of anguish at night. State of frenzy, hysterical, scratches, spits, bites, tears her clothes. Screams and calls for help. Closes her eyes and answers no questions.

Head - Influenza, headache with catarrhal symptoms, sneezing, etc. Cold sweat. Head sore. Feels knotted up. Beating pain in cerebellum. Occipital throbbing, synchronous with the pulse, better standing, when deprived of sexual intercourse. Fleeting stitches in temporal region and orbits. Head is drawn to one side (in spasms). Pains run from head to fingertips.

Eyes - Fixed, starinfe, turned upwards or outwards, pupils dilated. Sensation as if all objects were too bright and glittering. Objects appear too bright or move to one side with ajerk. Eyes protrude with mania. Eyes deeply sunken.

Ears - Heat and redness of the ears, especially in the lobes. Abscess in the meatus with deep redness and pressive shooting pain.

Nose - Cold and pinched. Inhaled air seems cold. Persistent nosebleed with goose bumps. Stopped up, sneezing. Fluent coryza on sudden change of weather. Coryza in old age.

Face - Pale, haggard, anxious, distorted, bluish, cold. Cold sweat. Pale and red by turns. Distorted. Grimaces. Upper lip retracted. Lockjaw. Froth or foam at the mouth.

Mouth - Breath fetid in the morning. Cold breath. Foam at the mouth. Abundant accumulation of a viscid and slimy saliva. Tongue cold, flabby, trembling, bluish. Speech, broken, feeble, hoarse. Boiling hot tea seems cold.

Throat - Soreness in the throat on swallowing. Dry, scraping sensation of the palate. Burning heat in the throat. Constriction of larynx, feeling as if throat tied. Vertigo - Vertigo, with a tendency to unconsciousness, feeling as if he would die. COMMENTS -Camphor has a special place in homeopathy because it's the major antidote of the remedies along with coffee. Camph. corrects spoiled cases and antidotes most of the medicines, especially from the vegetable kingdom. Useful as a heart stimulant for emergency use. Give drop doses on sugar as often as every five minutes. Hahnemann gave it as a remedy for cholera along with Cupr. and Verat. (Cupr. has spasms and cramps, Verat. has voracious thirst), and used it prophylactically. Useful for dehydration. Rice-water stools. Collapse and coldness (Carb-v.). Internal heat and external coldness. Great coldness of surface with sudden and complete prostration of the vital forces. Feeling as if a cold wind were blowing over body. For all kinds of sudden internal pains arising from chill or other causes. Tetanic spasms, with drawing up the corners of the mouth, showing the teeth (like NUXT-V. andPhyt.), and coldness. Spasmodic movement of head, head drawn to right side, rest of body relaxed, unconscious. Spasmodic drawing of head laterally or backwards with deathly coldness. Erysipelas spreading to central membranes. Eruptions. Soft parts drawn in. Skin painfully sensitive. Salzer said the cases calling for it are those in which “arterial spasm,” with difficult breathing (spasm of pulmonary arteries), coldness and lividity are the leading features. In the form of the ordinary Camph. pilules, Clarke found it an excellent remedy for sleeplessness. In this, as in its effect on colds, it resembles Aeon. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Opium, Nit-s-d., Phos. Camph. has very important antidotal relations. Camphorantidotesormodifies the action of nearly every vegetable medicine-tobacco, opium, worm medicines, etc. It is Antidoted by: Op., Nit-s-d., Dulc. and Phos. It antidotes: Am-c., Canth., Carb-v., Cupr., Lyc., Squil., Nat-m., so-called worm-medicines tobacco, bitter almonds and other fruits containing prussic acid. Also the secondary disorders remaining after poisoning with acids, salts, metals, poisonous mushrooms, etc. Compare: ( 1) Cupr., Ars., Verat., Aloe. (2) Carb-v. - coldness from undeveloped exanthema, collapse, nosebleed, dark, persistent, low hemorrhages generally. (3) Canth., Dulc. (4) Sec. - skin cold with desire to uncover. (5) Lyc. - head drawn to one side, Lyc. to left, Plb. and Stram. to right, Bufo to either. (6) Op. - narcotism, heart disorders. (7) Phos. - anguish and burning in cholera. (8) Nit-s-d., Squil., Verat. (9) Teste puts Camph. in his Belladonna group with Agar., Lach., Cedr., Stram., Tab. and others. Complementary: Canth. Incompatible: Kalin. Nitrum. Tea, coffee and lemonade, as a rule, do not interfere, but sometimes coffee worse. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Pressive pain in pit of stomach. Coldness, followed by burning. Burning in stomach, in abdomen. Little vomiting or purging with dry collapse. Vomiting of bile or blood. Sour, bilious vomiting in the morning. Strong pressure in the epigastrium.

Abdomen - Cramps in the abdomen. Cutting colic at night. Bellyache as if diarrhea would follow. Drawing pain, as from a bruise. Sensation of fullness in the abdomen. Cold or of burning heat in the epigastrium and in the abdomen.

Rectum - Black stools, involuntary. Rice water stools. Asiatic cholera with cramps in calves, coldness of body, anguish, great weakness, collapse, tongue and mouth cold.

Male - Sexual excitement. Chordee. Priapism, during dreams Nightly emissions. Satyriasis. Impotence.

Female - Menses too profuse, or absent. Sexual desire increased. Hot flushes with coldness of abdomen and limbs, at menopause. Labor-like pains. Weakness of sexual system. Food - Bitter taste of food, especially of meat. Dislike and repugnance to tobacco smoke. Excessive thirst.

Chest - A cold feeling in chest followed by cold breath. Dry feeling at bifurcation of trachea. Cramps in the chest. Shootings in the chest.

Heart - Anxiety at heart. Spasmodic stitches in region of heart. Precordial distress. Palpitations, after eating. Pulse, weak, not perceptible, frequent, small.

Back - Tension and stiffness of the neck. Drawing stitches between shoulder blades. Pressure in small of back. Sensation as if cool air was blowing on back. Causations - Ill effects of shock from injury, operations, sunstroke, snakebites. Vexation.

Limbs - Rheumatic pain between the shoulders. Difficult motion. Numbness, tingling and coldness. Cramps in calves. Cracking in joints. Feet cold, pains as if sprained. Icy cold feet, ache as if sprained. Fingers stiff, open, distorted. Thumbs drawn backwards. Lungs - Asphyxia neonatorum. Asthma, worse from bodily exertion. Breath cold. Breathing anxious, oppressed, sighing, quiet, deep and slow, snoring. Cutting, cold feeling deep in windpipe, causes a slight cough. Hoarse, squeaking voice. Suspended respiration. Violent attacks of dry cough. Suffocative dyspnea.

Sleep - Comatose sleep. Insomnia with cold limbs. Trembling and extreme restlessness.

Skin - Dryness of the skin. Skin, bluish and cold, with coldness of the body. Old looking, pale, blue, livid. Cannot bear to be covered (Sec.). Erysipelas. Sequelae of measles. Skin sensitive, even to the slightest touch.

Modalities - Better from free discharges, sweat. Better warmth. Better thinking of it. Better drinking cold water. Worse motion. Worse contact. Worse mental exertion, shock. Worse night. Worse when half asleep. Worse from cold air, drafts. Worse suppressions.

Teeth - Toothache, as if from swelling of the sub-maxillary glands. Toothache better beer. Sensation of lengthening of the teeth. Acute shocks in the roots of the incisors. Painful looseness of the teeth.

Kidneys - Burning and strangury with tenesmus of the neck of the bladder. Retention with full bladder. Hematuria.

Temperature - Pulse small, weak, slow. Cold perspiration. Icy coldness of the whole body. Shaking chill with cold skin, wants covers during the hot stage only. Congestive chill. Tongue cold, flabby, trembling. Sudden inflammatory fevers with rapid alternation of heat and cold, followed by rapid prostration. Heat or sweat, better covers. Sweats when covered, body becomes cold when uncovered. Chilly, below scapula, before colds.

full:

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Cooper found Camph- br. of wide utility in all cases where nervous excitability is present. He has given it chiefly in single doses of 3x trituration. Hale noted it for hysteria, weeping and laughter alternately. Nervous excitability. Headache in women and young girls due toe to mental excitement and excessive study. Delirium tremens. Parkinson's disease. Cholera infantum and infantile convulsions. Chordee. Neuralgia of testes and prostate. Impotence. Spermatorrhea. Nightly emissions. Painful erections. Suppression of breast milk. Intensifies the action of Quinine and renders it more permanent. MIND - Sense of direction is lost. Directions appear reversed, i.e., north seems south and east seems west. Nervous excitability. Mental excitement and excessive study. Hysteria, weeping and laughing alternately. Trance-like state. COMMENTS - In a case reported by Dr. E. M. Beard, a young man suffered from gastric catarrh in paroxysms which were induced by the sight of physical deformity, the touch of a cold, clammy hand and the mention of odors, the actual presence of which did not affect him. Complete relief was afforded by 3 gram doses of Camph-br. every 3 or 4 hours. The drug, however, set up some singular symptoms including: directions appeared to be reversed, north seemed south and east seemed west, innumerable black flies Camphora bromata seemed to be flitting over the field of vision, he was sleepless and when he did sleep it was restless and vexed with ghastly dreams. The reversal of directions lasted many days and the strain on the faculty of attention was so torturing that he became prostrate in mind and body. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

CLINICAL - Chills. Constipation. Influenza. Intermittents. Nausea. Sleeplessness.

HERBAL - Canch. has been used extensively as a fever remedy and bitter tonic (Gent-b.), anti-malarial and anti-septic.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Richter proved Canch., experiencing symptoms including a congested feeling in the heard, scalp tight, felt as if drawn together by India rubber. Stitches, pain, buzzing and roaring in ears. Indicated in severe intermittents of hot countries, and influenza. General sore, bruised feeling, nausea and retching. The skin becomes wrinkled like a washer woman's. Sensation of drops falling from and upon different spots. Constipation, hard, knotty stools. Chills repeatedly down back worse in bed, at night. Sleeplessness. After the proving, a cold wind could be borne better than before.

Head - Congested. Scalp feels tight, head feels as if bound, burning in eyes, buzzing in ears.

Skin - Wrinkled like a washerwoman's. Sca/p feels tight, as if drawn together by India-rubber.

Temperature - Chill all over, worse in bed at night. Sensitive to cold, trade-winds. General sore and bruised feeling, nausea and retching. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The Gentians, Chin., Ip. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - cand-p. Candida parapsilosis. N. O. Fungi, Ascomycetes, Endomycetidae. Saccharomycetaceae. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Candidiasis. Flatulence. Headache. Indigestion. Itching. Leucorrhea. Thrush. Vaginitis. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Candida parapsilosis is a common yeast-like organism that has been implicated in human infection. It has been recovered from respiratory secretions, urine, gastric washings, blood, vagina, oropharynx, skin, transtracheal aspiration, stool, pleural fluid, ear, and nails. It is implicated in the following human infections: Endopthalmitis, endocarditis, vaginitis, mycotic keratitis, external otomycosis, paronychia, and fungemia. In the vagina, it is found less frequently than Candida albicans and Torulopsis glabrata and is only rarely associated with vulvovaginal candidiasis as it is a less adherent organism. The people most infected with Candida are those with natural defences depressed by excessive use of antibiotics and steroids or by certain diseases or operative procedures. Oral candidiasis is called thrush. MIND - Very tired and scatter-brained. Total ‘loss of mind': seeing red lights and thinking they were green. Spacey and poor concentration. Unusually irritable. Explosive anger at minor incidents - as though their rights were being infringed upon. Mind races and words come out in wrong order or mispronounced. Abdomen - Bloating, fullness, cramping of abdomen. Bloating with flatulence.

Head - Wakes with a headache. Banging sensation. Frontal constriction. Lightheaded feeling. Itching of scalp, dry, flaking, reddening spot along hairline. Eczema-like patches on hairline. Red, scaly and itching.

Nose - Stuffiness of nose.

Stomach - Bloating, fullness, cramping of stomach. Vertigo - Vertigo and hot flushes. RELATIONS - Compare: Cand-a.. Carbo-v, Chin., Lyc., Sul-ac. REFERENCES - Brown. Lange. Murphy.

Female - Egg-white leucorrhea. Dripping discharge. Food - Increased appetite. Great thirst. Desires salt, garlic, pickles.

Heart - Sensation of arrhythmias with light-headed feeling. Prominent, quick heartbeat which reverberates through the chest.

Skin - Eczema-like patches. Red, scaly and itching.

Modalities - Better open air. Worse direct sunlight.

full:
PHARMACY - cann-i. Cannabis indica. Indian marijuana. Hashish. Bhang. Ganja. N. O. Cannabinacae. East India. Tincture of young leaves and twigs. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Absent-minded. Anxiety. Backache. Catalepsy. Chordee. Clairvoyance Delirium, tremens. Delusions. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Flatulence. Fears. Gonorrhea. Headache. Infertility. Insomnia. Intoxication. Kidney, disorders. Mania. Memory, weak. Menorrhagia. Miscarriage. Nervousness. Paralysis. Paranoia. Prostatitis. Satyriasis. Stammering. Uremia. Urinary, disorders.

HERBAL - The use of Cann-i. in the East as an intoxicant gives the leading note of its sphere of action. Cannabis sativa and Cannabis indica are botanical ly identical, the difference in their properties is solely due to the difference of soil and climate in which they are grown.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cann-i. produces a state of exaltation with sublime visions, delusions and hallucinations in great variety. Time seems too long, space illimitable. Paranoid. Apprehensive of approaching death. Fixed ideas. Fear of becoming insane or losing control. Horror of darkness. Great desire to lie down in the daytime. Thoroughly exhausted after a short walk. Felt so weak that he could scarcely speak and soon fell into a deep sleep. Soothing influence in many nervous disorders like epilepsy, mania, dementia and irritable reflexes. Catalepsy. Delirium tremens, trembling. Hallucinations. Tendency to become furious. Nausea, unquenchable thirst. Feels weak and all gone to nothing. Diabetes. Exophthalmic goiter. MIND - Remarkable hallucinations and imaginations. Exaggeration of the duration of time and extent of space. Misperceptions of time and space. Time seems too long, seconds seem ages. A few miles an immense distance. Heat and cold sensations of the body. Loss of identity. Clairvoyance. Imagines himself in a room of which the walls gradually close in upon him. Double consciousness, subconscious or dual nature state. Absent-minded. Poor short-term memory. Poor concentration and foggy mind. Sudden loss of memory. Inability to fix his thoughts on one subject. Forgets what he intends to write or speak. Sudden loss of speech, begins a sentence but cannot finish it. Lazy but restless. Chronic insomnia due to over activity of the mind. Drug-induced spaciness, pathologically happy state. Full of fun, mischief and laughs. Uncontrollable laughter. Extremely happy and contented, nothing troubles. Emotional excitement, rapid change of moods. Exaltation of spirits with excessive loquacity. Stammering and stuttering. Constantly theorizing. Fixed ideas. Ideas crowd upon each other. Lost in thoughts. Great agitation, anxiety and nervousness. Mania, must constantly move. Panic attacks, paranoia. Anguish, better in the open air. Constant fear of becoming insane. Horror of darkness. Fear of approaching death. Depression, constant fear of becoming insane. Abdomen - Throbbing here and there. Rumbling in bowels at night. Flatulence, on rising in morning, with headache. The abdomen feels swollen, better by belching. Sensation of extreme tension in abdominal vessels feel distended to bursting. Sensation as if something alive in abdomen (Thuj.).

Head - Violent headaches and hallucinations. Vertex seems to open and shut, worse noise. Head seems separated from the body. Feels as if top of head were opening and shutting. Shocks through brain (Aloe., Coca.). Involuntary shaking of head. Uremic headache. Headache with flatulence. Migraine attack preceded by unusual excitement with loquacity. Pain in the whole right side of the head. Throbbing and weight at occiput. Heavy pressure on the brain, forcing him to stoop. Dull, heavy, throbbing pain with sensation as from a blow, on back of head and neck.

Eyes - Eyes bright and shiny. Injection of vessels of conjunctiva of both eyes. Glaucoma. Jerking in corner of the eye and eyelids. Fixed gaze. Weak vision. Twinkling, trembling and glimmering before the eyes. Letters run together when reading. Sees objects outside of visual field. Visual clairvoyance.

Ears - Aching, throbbing and fullness in both ears. Extreme sensitiveness to noise, very acute hearing. Noise like boiling water, buzzing and ringing. Periodical singing in the ears during a dreamy spell, ceasing when he came to himself.

Face - Dejected, careworn, wearied, exhausted appearance. Drowsy, stupid look. Skin of face, especially of forehead and chin, feels as if drawn tight.

Mouth - Gritting and grinding of teeth while sleeping. Tongue is white, thick, frothy and sticky saliva. Dryness of the mouth and lips. Lips feel as if glued together. Every article of food is extremely palatable. Stammering and stuttering speech.

Throat - Throat is parched, accompanied by intense thirst for cold water. Vertigo - Chronic vertigo, as of floating off the ground. Worse on rising with stunning pain in back part of head. Sensation as if the room were falling in pieces about her. COMMENTS - Cann-i. inhibits the higher faculties and stimulates the imagination to a remarkable degree. A major remedy for drug flashbacks, fears, phobias or panic attacks since a drug overdose. DTs. Clairvoyance and clairaudience. A condition of intense exaltation in which all perceptions and conceptions, all sensations and emotions are exaggerated to the utmost degree. Hypersensitivity of all the senses. Extreme sensitivity to noise, can hear a whisper in adjoining room and is irritated from it. Startles easily. Fear of loss of control. Sensation of levitation. Sensation as if in a dream. Vertigo on rising with stunning pain in back part of head. Cann-i. removed a vertigo in which the patient felt as if the house were falling in ruins about her. Starting, talking, nightmares, during sleep. Grinds teeth while asleep. Wants to sleep but cannot (Gels.). Palpitations, awakens from sleep. Stitches in heart with oppression, better deep breathing. Dryness of the mouth. Stammering and stuttering. Thirst for cold water, worse warm, stuffy rooms. Craves sweets. Useful when treating hypoglycemia related to smoking marijuana. Affects the urinary and generative organs. History of kidney problems, cystitis, or gonorrhea. Constant dull pain in region of right kidney. Pains in kidneys when laughing. Sensation in anus as if sitting on a ball, as if anus and part of urethra were filled by a hard, round body. Frequent urination with burning pain in evening. Urging and straining, but cannot pass a drop. Burning, scalding or stinging in urethra before during and after urination. Dribbling of urine (Thuj., Sabah, Sep.). Urine loaded with slimy mucus after exposure to damp and cold. Backache worse during menses, which occur every two weeks and are scanty. Very profuse, painful, dark menstruation, but without clots. Tendency to get vaginitis. Catalepsy. Tingling of paralyzed parts. Paralysis of lower limbs and right arm. Muscle cramps and weak knees. Headache with flatulence, lasts until flatus can be passed up or down, throbbing of occiput. Scalp sore feeling, crawling on vertex, sensation as though skin tightly stretched over bones of face. Weight at occiput from which pains start up sides of head to temples and vertex. Warmth of spine extending to head. Sensation as of brain boiling over and lifting cranial arch like a lid, opening and shutting sensation. Shocks through brain on regaining consciousness. Guided by this symptom, Clarke removed a “noise like a crash or explosion during sleep.” Nash related the case of a woman suffering from cardiac dropsy, who, when relieved of the latter, suddenly lost the power of speech. In answer to a question she could begin a sentence, but could not finish it as she could not remember what she wished to say. She was very impatient about it, would cry, but could not finish the sentence, though she could signify assent if any one did finish it for her. Cann-i. cured rapidly. In one case of overdose the observer experienced a modification of this: absolute forgetfulness of the thought, speech or acts of the previous moment, startled by hearing the echo of the last words of a sentence he has just spoken. Having suggested a walk to a companion and meeting him at the street door, wondered why they were there. Afterwards, he could remember everything. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-s., Bell., Hyos., Stram., Lach., Agar. (2) Anhalon. - time sense disordered, time periods enormously overestimated, thus, minutes seem hours. (3) Cann-s. - in extreme sensitiveness to noise. (4) Nit-ac. - to jarring and rumbling of wagon in street. (5) Coff. - to all sounds. Borax - slightest noise, fall of door latch, rumpling of paper, rustling of silk. (6) Asar. - to scratching of linen or silk or even the thought of it. (7) Levitation -Asar., Calc., Cocc., Ph- ac., Sil., Stict., Sulph., Thuj. (8) Asif in adream - Ambr., Anae., Calc., Con., Cupr., Med., Rheum., Stram., Valer., Verat., Zinc. (9) Horror of darkness - Am-m., Bar-c., Calc., Carb-an., Phos., Stram., Stroph., Valer. (10) Noise like a crash or explosion in head - Aloe. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Pain in the cardiac orifice, relieved by pressure. Suffocative feeling while eating. Distention. Pyloric spasm.

Rectum - Sensation in anus as if sitting on a ball. Painless, yellow diarrhea.

Male - Sexual desire increased. Satyriasis, priapism. Prolonged thrill. Erections not caused by amorous thoughts. Violent painful erections. Backache after sexual intercourse. Oozing of white, glairy mucus from glans. Chordee. Sensation of swelling in perineum or near anus, as if sitting on a ball. Penis relaxed and shrunken. Itching in the glans penis. Sharp pricking like needles in urethra, so severe as to send a thrill to cheeks and hands. Gonorrhea without pain with a very profuse yellowish-white discharge. Feeling as if discharge in urethra.

Female - Menses with violent uterine colic with dysuria. Menses profuse, dark, painful, without clots. Backache during menses. Spasmodic uterine pains returning like labor pains, great agitation and sleeplessness. Sexual desire increased in infertile women or with dysmenorrhea. Infertility (Bor., Sep.). Threatened miscarriage in eighth month, burning on urination with purulent discharge. Food - Increased appetite. Ravenous hunger. Craves sweets. Very thirsty for cold drinks.

Chest - Oppression of chest with deep, labored breathing. Feels suffocated, has to be fanned.

Heart - Palpitations, awaking from sleep. Piercing pain with great oppression. Pulse very slow (Dig., Kalm., Apoc.). Pressing pain in the heart with dyspnea the whole night. Sensation as if drops were falling from the heart. Stitches in the heart, accompanied by great oppression, the latter relieved by deep breathing.

Back - Backache, worse during menses, which occur every two weeks and are scanty. Warmth in spine extending to head. Torticollis, chin drawn to the sternum. Pain across shoulders and spine, must stoop, cannot walk erect. Breasts - Stitches extending from both nipples through chest.

Limbs - Weariness in limbs and stiffness and aching in knees, almost paralysis. Thrilling through arms and hands, and from knees down. Entire paralysis of the lower limbs. Pain in soles and calves, sharp pains in knees and ankles, very exhausted after a short walk. Paralysis of the right arm. Coldness of right hand with stiffness and numbness of right thumb. On attempting to walk, intensely violent pain as if treading on spikes, which penetrated the soles and ran upward through the limbs. Shooting pains in the joints of the toes of the left foot, worse in great toe, aching and stitching pain in ball of left great toe. Lungs - Humid asthma. Chest oppressed with deep, labored breathing. Rough cough with scraping immediately under the sternum. Great effort to take a deep inspiration.

Sleep - Sleepy but cannot sleep. Chronic insomnia. Excessive sleepiness, sound sleep with melancholy dreams. Jerking of the limbs while sleeping, causing him to awake. Talks during sleeps. Gritting teeth during sleep. Catalepsy. Nightmares every night as soon as he falls asleep. Dreams are prophetic, of dead bodies, danger and perils to be encountered. Erotic dreams with erection and profuse seminal emission.

Modalities - Better from walking about outdoors. Better fresh air. Better cold water. Better rest. Worse from coffee, liquor and tobacco. Worse lying on right side. Worse mornings.

Kidneys - Dull pain in region of right kidney. Pain in the kidneys when laughing. Bunting, aching or sharp stitches in the kidneys. Urging to urinate, but cannot pass a drop. Must wait some time before the urine flows, strain. The urine dribbles out after the stream ceases. Must force out the last few drops with the hand. Profuse, colorless urine, can have mucus. A white glairy mucus may be squeezed from the urethra. Burning and scalding or stinging pain in the urethra before, during, and after urination.

Temperature - Loss of vital heat. General chilliness. Coldness of the face, nose and hands after dinner. Profuse sticky sweat, standing out in drops on his forehead.
