full:
PHARMACY - cann-s. Cannabis sativa. Marijuana. Hemp. Europeanhemp. American hemp. N. O. Cannabinacae. Tincture of male and female flowering tops. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascites. Asthma. Cataract. Choking. Cystitis. Fatigue. Forgetful. Glaucoma. Gonorrhea. Headache. Hysteria. Infertility. Impotence. Leucorrhea. Memory, weak. Miscarriages. Nausea. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Opacity, cornea. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Paralysis. Phimosis. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Post- partum hemorrhage. Polyuria. Priapism. Sexual, disorders. Stammering. Teranus. Trachea, mucus. Urethral discharges, caruncle. Vaginitis. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Cann-s. and Cann-i. are similar, the difference in their properties is solely due to the difference of soil and climate in which they are grown. Cann-s. has less pronounced mental symptoms and head symptoms and the eye and genito-urinary symptoms are more so than Cann-i.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cann-s. seems to affect especially the urinary and sexual organs. Acute and chronic gonorrhea, especially when the patient walks with the legs apart. Sexual excitement in both the sexes. Threatened miscarriage from too frequent sexual intercourse or complicated with gonorrhea. Vaginitis. Characteristic sensations as of dropping water. Choking in swallowing, things go down the wrong way. Great fatigue from having spoken or written. Feels exhausted after a short walk. Feet feel heavy on going upstairs. Acute drawing and contractive, pressive pains with sensation of paralysis. Drawing pains in regions of kidneys extending into inguinal glands with anxious sensation of nausea at epigastrium. Tetanus, chiefly in the upper limbs and in the trunk. Paralysis with tingling of the affected part. Unendurable fine stitching over whole body, as from a thousand needle points, at night, when sweating from warm covering, better uncovering. MIND - Confusion of thought and speech. Stuttering and stammering. Embarrassed speech, at one time words are wanting, at another the voicefails. Veryforgetful cannot finish the sentence. Vanishing of thoughts, want of words. Wavering speech, hasty, incoherent. Speech stops with anxiety and agony on account of pain in the back. Many errors in writing. Ideas seem to stand still, he stares in front of him is absorbed in higher thoughts, but in unconscious of them. Time seems too long. Thinks everything is unreal, as if in a dream. Voices including her own, seem to come from a distance, her own voice s-^ ems strange, as if it were somebody else speaking. Clairvoyance. Loquacity. Laughs immoderately, at mere trifles. Laughs and weeps. Ecstatic, heavenly. Fixed ideas. Mania, sometimes happy, sometimes serious or furious. Sadness and indifference. Irresolution and uncertainty. Moaning and crying. Disposition to be easily frightened or irritated. Fear of going to bed. Abdomen - Pain as from a bruise in the intestines. Hard and painful swelling of the liver region. Cramp-like pains in the epigastrium. Sensation of soreness. Shuddering sensation, as if cold water were running through abdomen. Painful jerks. Shaking of the intestines, as if they were detached, when the arms are moved. Shocks and pressure towards the outside in the regions of the groins. Pulsation of abdomen from within outward.

Head - Headache, as if there were a stone pressing upon it. Sensation of a heavy weight on the vertex. Pressure and tension on the temples. Pressure on root of nose. Congestion in the head, throbbings in the brain, cheeks red and hot with pulsation. Sensation at the scalp, as if something were creeping on it and as if drops of cold water were falling on the head.

Eyes - Glaucoma. Pressure from back of eyes, forward. Eyeballs ache. Cataract from nervous disturbances, abuse of alcohol and tobacco, patient feels deeply approaching blindness. Gonorrheal ophthalmia. Opacity of cornea. Scrofulous eye troubles (Sulph., Calc.). Cramp-like pulling in the eyes. Misty sight. Weakness and confusion of sight, on viewing objects either distant or near. Appearance of a circle of whitish flames before the eyes.

Ears - Throbbing and pressure in the ears, that disappears when one is stooping and reappearing when raising the head again. Hears voices, bells, music. Buzzing in the ears and sensation as if a skin were before them.

Nose - Swelling of the nose with copper- like redness. Stupefying pressure on the root of the nose. Heat and dryness of the nose. Nosebleed, preceded by a sensation of burning in the nose.

Face - Paleness of the face. Heat of the face and redness of the cheeks. Tingling, itching and smarting in the face, as if from salt. Twitching of the muscles of the face.

Mouth - Grinding of teeth in sleep. Dryness of the mouth with viscid saliva and absence of thirst. Saliva, white, thick, frothy. Eruption on the border of the lips.

Throat - Cannot control voice. Loss of voice. Accumulation of tenacious mucus in the larynx with scraping and difficulty of breathing. Vertigo - Vertigo, sensation of dropping water on head. Attacks of vertigo on walking or when standing for some time to such an extent as to cause falling. Sensation as if intoxicated. COMMENTS - In Cann-i., the drug state is often the etiology, but Cann-s stands on its own. Closely related to Med. And Thuj., will often follow Med. Boericke said that lemon juice antidotes Cann-s. Strong affinity for the genital area and infections. High sex drive (Med.). Acute gonorrhea remedy, with spaciness and a history of drug use. Yellow-green discharges. Urethral symptoms with burning and smarting (Canth. has more tenesmus). Mucus in urine, burning on urination. The bladder feels full. Non-specific urethritis. Pain in right kidney. Cramps of any kind. The urethra is very sensitive to touch and pressure, the patient cannot bear the legs close together. Urethral caruncle. Phimosis. Dry mouth, craves sweets, thirst for cold water. Hypoglycemia. Sensitive to stimulants. Limbs feel weak and heavy. Glaucoma. Cataract and opacities of the cornea, gonorrhea of the eyes. Eyeballs aches, pressure in back of the eyes. Sudden changes from agitation to restless to calm. Distortion in perception, spacey, bad memory. Better with fresh, open air and cold water on their face. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Lemon juice. Antidotes of large doses: lemon juice, Strychnia, Camph., Merc. Compare: ( 1 ) Cann- i., Thuj. Med., Canth., Petros. (2) Sars. - worse going up stairs. (3) In phimosis - Merc., Sulph., Nit-ac., Sep., Thuj. Rhus-t.. Sabin. (4) as if something alive in abdomen - Croc., Thuj. (5) Apis, Cop., Cimic., Kali-n. (6) Hedysa- rum - gonorrhea and inflammation of penis. Compatible: Bell., Hyos., Lyc., Nux-v., Op., Puls., Rhus-t., Verat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Empty risings. Regurgitation of acrid substances of a bitter sourness. Attack of violent cramps in the stomach. Nausea with inclination for food. Vomiting with sensation of strangulation from the epigastrium to the throat. Vomiting of green bile. Pain in the stomach, on being touched, as if it were ulcerated, better by eating. Aching, pinchings and cuttings in the epigastrium and in the upper part of the stomach.

Rectum - Diarrhea, accompanied by cramplike pains in the abdomen. Pressure in the rectum towards the outside. Sensation as of cold water running from the anus. Constipation and hard feces. Sensations - As if hot water were poured over him. As if drops of cold water were falling on the head, from anus, or from heart. As if pinched with pincers in back. Pressure as with a sharp point in coccyx.

Male - Sexual desire increased. Priapism. Strong sexual desire or aversion to sex. Erections without amorous thoughts. Erections with tensive pains. Acute gonorrhea. Itching and inflammatory swelling of the prepuce, glans and penis with deep redness and phimosis. The penis feels sore and burnt when walking, walks with legs apart. Cold genitals. Dragging, aching in the testes and tension in the spermatic cord, when standing upright. Swelling of the prostate gland.

Female - Acute gonorrhea. Threatened abortion, complicated with gonorrhea or on account of frequent sexual intercourse. Leucorrhea. Infantile leucorrhea. Amenorrhea, also with constipation. Profuse menstruation. Miscarriage with convulsions. Great sexual excitement with infertility. Food - Desires sweets and cold drinks. Every article of food is extremely palatable. Aversion to meat, of which she was fond.

Chest - Weight on chest, rattling wheezing breathing. Shootings in the bottom of the chest, especially on breathing, speaking or during movement.

Heart - Great anxiety of heart. Painful tension in the heart with palpitations of the heart and anxiety. Beatings of the heart, which are felt lower than their ordinary place. Pulse weak, slow and scarcely perceptible. Pericarditis. Inflammation of the heart. Sensation as if drops were falling from the heart.

Back - Pains in the back, which impede speech and suspend respiration. Shooting pains between the shoulder blades. Pressure towards the outside in the sacral region and coccyx.

Limbs - Pain in the limbs, worse deep breathing. Pain, as from a bruise in the shoulder and forearm during movement. Entire paralysis of lower limbs. Cramps in the thighs, the calves of the legs and the hams. Weakness, staggering and pains of the knees. Displacement of the patella on going up the stairs. Pulsation and stretching pain in the feet and in the joints of the foot, as after a long walk. Spasmodic contraction of the Achilles tendon with violent pains. Cramps in the hands and the fingers. Sudden paralytic weakness of the hand with trembling on laying hold of an object and inability to hold it firmly. Lungs - Suffocative attacks. Humid asthma. Difficulty in breathing and palpitations, then must stand up. As if there were a weight on the chest, with wheezing and rattling in the bronchials. Difficulty of respiration with uneasiness in the throat, worse lying down. Rattling breathing. Inflammation of the lungs, with greenish vomiting and delirium. Cough with green viscid, bloody, expectoration. Cough, violent and dry.

Sleep - Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Frightful or erotic dreams. Dreams of the dead. Sensation of greater fatigue on waking in the morning, then when going to bed in the evening. Sleepy during the day.

Skin - At night, pricking and sensation of burning over the whole skin, as if from boiling water.

Modalities - Better from fresh air. Better cold water. Better rest. Worse from urinating. Worse after a meal. Worse coffee, liquorortobacco. Worse darkness. Worse at night. Worse after midnight. Worse open air, and heat. Worse from exercise, exertion. Worse talking. Worse walking. Worse going upstairs. Worse touch. Worse lying down.

Kidneys - Inflamed sensation with soreness to touch. Acute gonorrhea, urethra sensitive, walks with the legs apart. Kidney colic and pains. Pain in kidney, while laughing. Painful urging. Must strain to urinate, has to wait for some time before the urine flows, dribbles after flow ceases. Scanty burning urine passed drop by drop. Urination in split stream. Burning while urinating, extending to bladder. Urine scalding with spasmodic closure of sphincter. Stitches, zigzag pain along urethra. Urethral caruncle (Eucal.), phimosis. Stoppage of urethra by mucus and pus. Discharge of yellow, watery mucus from the urethra (gonorrhea).Urine, turbid, white or reddish and as if mixed with blood and pus. Incontinence of urine. Ejection of a kidney stone on urinating. Retained urine with constipation.

Temperature - Typhoid fevers, where strangury exists. Shuddering, shivering with thirst. Uneasiness and external cold. Coldness of the body with heat in the face. Heat only in the face. Burning heat over the whole body at night.

name: Cantharis Vesicatoria
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from rubbing. Better warm applications. Better warmth. Better rest. Worse during or after urination. Worse drinking cold water or coffee. Worse sound of water. Worse bright objects. Worse touch, especially the larynx..
constitution: Bladder, infections. Blisters. Burns. Chordee. Cystitis. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Eczema. Emissions. Erysipelas. Eyes inflammation. Gastritis. Gonorrhea. Herpes zoster. Hydrophobia. Kidneys, disorders. Mania. Neuralgia. Nymphomania. Ovaries, disorders. Peritonitis. Pleurisy. Pregnancy, disorders. Retained, placenta. Satyriasis. Scarlatina. Sexual, mania. Spermatorrhea. Strangury. Sunburn. Thirst. Th

PHARMACY - canth. Cantharis vesicatoria. Spanish Fly. Lytta vesicator. Meloe vesica- torius. N. O. Insecta, Coleóptera. Tincture or trituration of whole insect. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bladder, infections. Blisters. Burns. Chordee.…
full:
PHARMACY - canth. Cantharis vesicatoria. Spanish Fly. Lytta vesicator. Meloe vesica- torius. N. O. Insecta, Coleóptera. Tincture or trituration of whole insect. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bladder, infections. Blisters. Burns. Chordee. Cystitis. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Eczema. Emissions. Erysipelas. Eyes inflammation. Gastritis. Gonorrhea. Herpes zoster. Hydrophobia. Kidneys, disorders. Mania. Neuralgia. Nymphomania. Ovaries, disorders. Peritonitis. Pleurisy. Pregnancy, disorders. Retained, placenta. Satyriasis. Scarlatina. Sexual, mania. Spermatorrhea. Strangury. Sunburn. Thirst. Throat, sore. Tongue inflammation. Urine, abnormal. Vesicles.

HOMEOPATHIC - Commonly known as Span- ish fly, Canth. belongs to the animal kingdom and finds its most prominent sphere of action in exciting the animal passions. There is anger in a very acute degree amounting to paroxysms of rage and a corresponding condition of the bodily tissues. Rapid and intense action. Characteristic irritation. Hypersensitiveness of all parts. Burns and scalds. Vesication. Erysipelas, blisters. Burning, stitches, shooting pains and exudation are the indications. Pains are cutting, smarting or burning, biting or as if raw, causing mental excitement. Raw, burning pains. Inflammations are violently acute or rapidly destructive in the mucus and serous membranes. Violent inflammation of the whole gastro-intestinal canal, especially lower bowel. Puerperal convulsions. Inflam- mations are often associated with bladder irritation. In any condition when the urine is scanty, cutting and burning. Intolerable, constant urging to urinate. Dysuria with any other complaints. Painful urination, as a concomitant in any diseased condition. Acute nephritis. Gastric, hepatic and abdominal complaints, aggravated by drinking coffee. Gastric derangements of pregnancy. Inñameásexualorgans, causing frenzied delirium. Amorous frenzy, unbounded sexual desire. Sexual weakness and excitability. Sexual excitement during pains. Expels dead fetus, placenta, promotes fecundity. Discharges are bloody, acrid, watery, tenacious. Hemorrhages. Serous effusions. Sudden attacks of weakness that takes the voice away. Hemiplegia of (right) side with aphasia. Convulsions with dysuria and hydrophobic symptoms. Moles. MIND - Great restlessness, obliging him to move constantly. Anxious restlessness, ending in rage. Paroxysms of rage with crying, barking, biting and worse by bright objects, by touching the larynx, drinking cold water. Despondent and low-spirited, says she must die. Weeping aggra,vates. Furious delirium. Delirium, with dread. Acute mania after erysipelas. Wildness. Excessive sexual desire, not better by sex. Acute mania, generally of a sexual type, amorous frenzy, fiery sexual desire. Sings lewd songs. Striking at imaginary objects about him. Fear of mirrors in room. Constantly attempts to do something but accomplishes nothing. Insolent, contradictory mood. Disposition to contradict. Irritable, dissatisfied with every one and everything. Whining and complaining, with anxious restlessness, worse motion, better lying quiet. Exceedingly sensitive to all impressions. Uneasiness day and night, with hot head. Strange ideas crowd on him against his will. Prattles about genitals, urine, feces. Delusion bed were raised. Insanity with increased strength. Sudden loss of consciousness with red face.

Head - Burning in brain. Sensation as if boiling water in brain. Head heavy, aches from bathing or washing. Hair falls when combing.

Eyes - Objects look yellow. Yellow vision (Sant.). Fiery, sparkling, staring look. Burning in eyes.

Ears - Sensation as if wind were coming from ear or hot air. Bones about ear painful (Caps.).

Face - Pale and wretched, death-like appearance. Expression of extreme suffering, terror or despair. Hot and red. Jaws tightly closed, acute mania. Itching vesicles on face, burning when touched. Erysipelas of face with burning, biting heat with urinary symptoms.

Mouth - Tongue covered with vesicles, deeply furred, edges red. Swollen tremulous tongue, edges raw. Burning in mouth, pharynx and throat. Vesicles in mouth. Grinding of the teeth with lockjaw. Saliva disgustingly sweet.

Throat - Burnt after taking hot food. As if on fire. Burning in mouth, pharynx and throat. Scalding feeling. Great difficulty when swallowing liquids. Painfully constricted, aphthous ulceration. Full of blisters. Very tenacious mucus (Kali-bi.). Violent spasms reproduced by touching larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo, worse in open air. COMMENTS - In Canth., the pains are burning and sharp, sharp along the course of a nerve. Tyler wrote that it was “Another vehement drug of storm and stress, tamed by Hahnemann.” Burns and blisters. Severe pain from burns. The part may be treated with a lotion containing a few drops or pills of the Canth. 30c or 200c to the ounce of water, a dilution given internally. An ointment made with the 3x is a good application for herpes zoster. Useful forbladder infections (Staph.), with a constant, severe, painful urging, cutting in the urethra (Sars.). Hematuria, blood in the urine, with a severe bladder infection. Pus in the urine. Can pass only a few drops like molten lead. Strangury. Cutting, burning pains from the kidney down to urethra. Irritation of all grades. Worse from a catheter. The pains are burning and sharp, sharp along the course of a nerve. Neuralgia of head and face from taking cold with loud screams and jerking of muscles. The slightest touch or approach aggravates the mental symptoms. Violent spasms reproduced by touching larynx. It acts on the brain, producing inflammation of the tissues. Irritation on the skin and serous membranes. Pleurisy with effusion. Diphtheria, inflammation of throat, severe burning, constriction, thirst with aversion to drinking. The face is generally pale or yellowish with an expression of deep-seated suffering. Erysipelas commencing in nose. The eyes are bright, pupils widely dilated. Conjunctivitis where the eye has burning pains, clawing at the eye (Euphr.). Pain in abdomen, colic-like, doubling the patient up, cutting, burning, lancinating. Dysenteric stools with tenesmus. Violent dysentery, painful dysentery, with burning on passing the stool with blood and mucus. Extreme superficial sensitiveness in hypogastrium (especially when the bladder is full), attended with unbearable tenesmus of bladder. Inflamed stomach. The sexual appetite is aroused to the point of mania. H. N. Guernsey observed that Canth. is almost always the remedy for whatever other sufferings there may be, when there is as well frequent urination with burning, cutting pain or if cutting burning pain attends the flow, even when urination is not very frequent. Guernsey noted that “Canth. expels moles, dead fetus, placenta, promotes fecundity.” He also pointed out that Canth. should be studied in treating disorders of the airpassages when the mucus is tenacious. Guernsey gave as the special indications in rabies and hydrophobia as “moaning and violent cries interspersed with barking.” Glassy eyes, dilated pupil, flushed face, and the person is in a violent frenzy. Worse from dazzling objects and by water, completing the hydrophobia picture. Nash recorded a case in which this observation led him to make a cure. Kali-bi. had completely failed to relieve a woman who had long suffered from bronchitis. The mucus was profuse, tenacious and ropy. One day the patient mentioned that she had great cutting and burning on urinating, which she was obliged to do very frequently. Canth. made a rapid cure. Canth. has cured a case of malarial cachexia in which the symptoms were always worse when the urine was scanty. RELATIONS-Antidotes: Aeon., Puls. Camph. antidotes the strangury and retention of urine of Canth., Apis the cystitis, Kali-n. the kidney symptoms. For its throat symptoms it is nearest to Capsicum. Canth. is Antidote to: Camph., V inegar, Alcohol. Compare: ( 1 ) Apis, Staph., Ars., Merc-c., Bell. (2) Cann-s. - more burning and smarting, Canth. more tenesmus. (3) Petros. - sudden urging, Caps, Puls. - retained placenta, Ars. - delayed urination after childbirth. (4) Erections, those of Canth. prevent urination, those of Thuj do not. (5) Merc. - semen mixed with blood, Sars. (urine bums like fire, shreddy particles and blood in it). Arum, Am., Rhus-t., Ran-s. (6) Teste classes Canth. with Senega and Ph-ac. in his Conium group. (7) Cantharidin - Glomerular nephritis. (8) Vesicaria - urinary and kidney remedy. Smarting, burning sensation along urethra and in bladder with frequent desire to void urine often with strangury. Cystitis irritable bladder. (9) Fuschina - Nephritis with albuminuria. Redness of ears, mouth, swollen gums, deep, red urine, red, profuse diarrhea with severe ab- dominal pains. ( 10) Androsace lactea - urinary troubles, diuretic, dropsy. Compatible with: Bell., Merc., Phos., Puls., Sep. Complementary: Camph. Incompatible: Coffea. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Burning sensation of esophagus and stomach (Carb.). Very sensitive, vio- lentburning. Vomiting of blood-streaked membrane. Violent retching and vomiting. Sensitiveness over stomach, slightest pressure produces convulsions.

Abdomen - Pain in loins with incessant desire to urinate. Violent burning pain through the whole intestinal tract, with painful sensitiveness to touch.

Rectum - Dysentery, mucus stools like scrapings of intestines. Shreddy burning stools with tenesmus of rectum and bladder, with shuddering after stools. Bloody with burning, tenesmus and shuddering after stool. Dysentery or diarrhea with dysuria. Constipation with retention of urine. Desire for stool while urinating. Cutting in rectum partially better by flatus, entirely by stools.

Male - Painful swelling of genitals. Priapism. Pulls at penis. Sexual desire increased not better by sex. Bloody semen. Pollutions. Burning in urethra after sex. Strong desire, painful erection. Pain in glans. Gonorrhea with priapism.

Female - Retained placenta (Sep.), with painful urination. Expels dead fetuses, membranes, etc. Nymphomania (Plat.). Pruritus with strong sexual desire, at menopause. Leucorrhea with sexual excitement, causing severe itching and masturbation. Puerperal metritis with inflammation of bladder. Menses too early and too profuse, black. Swelling of vulva with irritation. Constant discharge from uterus, worse false step. Cutting burning in ovaries, ovaritis. Sharp, tearing pain in os coccyx. Food - Disgust for everything, drink, food, tobacco. Thirst unquenchable. Burning thirst, but aversion to all fluids. Aversion to water. Aggravation from drinking coffee. drinking the smallest quantity increases pain in bladder and is vomited.

Chest - Chest pains better belchings. Burning pains in chest. Stitches in chest, at sternum (Bry., Kali-c., Squil.). Pleurisy, as soon as effusion has taken place.

Heart - Palpitation, pulse feeble, irregular, tendency to syncope. Pericarditis with effusion.

Back - Emprosthotonos and opisthotonos. Pain in loins with frequent desire to urinate.

Limbs - Knees totter when ascending steps. Ulcerative pain in soles, cannot step. Tearing in limbs. Lungs - Voice low, weak feeling. Tenacious mucus in air passages. Pleurisy with exudation. Dyspnea, palpitation, frequent, dry cough. Tendency to syncope. Short, hacking cough, blood-streaked, tenacious mucus.

Skin - Burns and scalds with rawness and smarting, relieved by cold applications, followed by undue inflammation. Severe sunburns. Eruptions burn when touched. Dermatitis with bleb formation. Eruption with mealy scales. Vesicular eruptions, turning black with burning and itching. Erysipelas, vesicular type with great restlessness. Secondary eczema about scrotum and genitals, following excessive perspiration. Tendency to gangrene. Burning in soles of feet at night.

Modalities - Better from rubbing. Better warm applications. Better warmth. Better rest. Worse during or after urination. Worse drinking cold water or coffee. Worse sound of water. Worse bright objects. Worse touch, especially the larynx.

Kidneys - Acute nephritis. Nephritis with bloody urine. Diabetes insipidus. Bright's disease. Kidney colic. Kidney region very sensitive. Kidney pains and urging to urinate, steadily increasing in severity. Dropsy. Urine, burning, scalding with cutting pains and intolerable urging. Strangury. Violent paroxysms of cutting and burning in whole renal region, with painful urging to urinate. Urine is passed drop by drop, dribbling. Bloody urine. Membranous scales looking like bran in water. Urinejelly-like, shreddy. Paroxysmal cutting and burning, in both kidneys, the region very sensitive to slightest touch.

Bladder - Acute severe cystitis. Constant desire to urinate. Urging to urinate from smallest quantity of urine in bladder. Intolerable tenesmus. Burning, cutting pains before, during and after urination. Severe burning pains in bladder. Intense burningpain in urethra, worse motion, better lying on back. Violent burning, cutting pains in neck of bladder. Atony of bladder from long retention of urine. Griping in bladder. Heaviness in bladder, feels sore on slightest motion. Terrible pains from being catheterized. Bladder pains, worse drinking, even small quantities of water. Burning pains when urinating and when not. Must double herself and scream from fearful cutting pains in urethra. Breasts - Breasts painful, with dysuria.

Temperature - Chilly, as if cold water poured over him during stool. Cold hands and feet, cold sweat. Urinous sweat, on genitals. Soles burn.

name: Capsicum Annuum

full:
PHARMACY - caps. Capsicum annuum. Cayenne pepper. N. O. Solanaceae. South America. West Indies. Tincture of the dried pods. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Asthma. Brain, irritation. Delirium tremens. Cough. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Ear disorders. Esophagus, stricture. Colic. Gland, disorders. Hemorrhoid. Headache. Heartbum. Hernia. Homesickness. Intermittents. Lungs, disorders. Mastoiditis. Measles. Mouth, ulcers. Neuralgia. Nose, disorders. Obesity. Paralysis. Pleuro-pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Rectum, diseases. Rheumatic gout. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scrofula. Seasickness. Stomatitis. Throat, sore. Tongue, paralysis. Trachea, tickling. Urine, disorders. Whooping cough. Yellow fever.

HERBAL - Capsicum should be studied in connection with the other great members of the Solanum family, Bell., Stram., Hyos., Dulc., Solan, carolin., Solan, nig., Solan, tub. (Potato) and Lycoper. (Tomato).

HOMEOPATHIC - The well-known burning effects of red pepper is a leading indication for its use. Burning pains, wherever they occur, demand that Caps, should have consideration, if there are no other determining symptoms in favor of another remedy. Burning, worse from cold water. Pains are burning, smarting, pungent or strangling, threadlike, worse by cold water. Burning and pungent pains, worse by application of cold water. Burning, pungent sensation in face worse by slightest draft of cold air. Burning pains and general chilliness. Burning in throat. Burning blisters in roof of mouth (diphtheria or gangrene). Constriction of throat, spasmodic closure. Throat pain when not swallowing. Burning in rectum, tenesmus. Burning in bladder. Burning on urination. Fever. Redness of the skin, scarlet eruption (Bell.). Mucus membranes become dark, red, spongy or ooze bloody mucus. Mucus Capsicum annuum membranes have a sensation of constriction. Disorders of bones. Pains in bones of face. Inflammation of petrous bone. Mastoiditis. Marked tendency to suppuration in every inflammatory process. Deep abscesses. Discharges are very foul. Violent pains in various places, now here now there. Muscle pain, aching and jerking of muscles. Neuralgias. Sensation of soreness and constriction. Sensation as if cayenne pepper were sprinkled on parts. Sensation as if parts go to sleep. Shuddering during pain or drinking. Lack of reaction, particularly in persons of lax tissue. Sluggish circulation. Hemorrhages. Bodily irritability. Parts pinched remain in raised position for a long time. Extreme sensitiveness to cold and damp (Dulc.), aggravates most symptoms. Shuns open air, dreads uncovering, dreads air. especially a draft. Better from heat. Patients who cannot get to sleep without a hot bottle at their back. Spirits become lower as body becomes cooler. Symptoms generally appear on left side. A general uncleanliness of body. Thirsty, but drinking causes shuddering. Absence of thirst during heat. Prostration and feeble digestion of alcoholics. Abstainers from accustomed alcohol. MIND - Capricious and changeable mood. If she wants a certain thing, she will oppose, if proposed by someone else. Homesickness with red cheeks and sleeplessness with hot feeling in fauces. Homesickness with sleeplessness and disposition to suicide. Sentimental, nostalgic moods. Peevish, irritable, angry, easily offended. Irritability during chill. Confusion during chill. Peppery disposition. Always on the lookout for insults. Obstinacy. Refractory, especially children. Wants to be left alone. Red cheeks after emotions, fever. Alternating states, laughs and weeps by turns is now jocose and sings, but becomes angry from slightest cause. Clumsy. Awkward, runs 'Moeverything.Delirium tremens. Alcoholism. Dreads any kind of exercise. Anxiety and fear, as though he was going to die. Fearfulness. Fear of slightest draft. Fear of being censured. Frightened easily on waking. Awakens with fright, screams, and remains full of fear. Sensitive to noise. Abdomen - Flatulent colic. Colic about umbilicus with mucus stools. Violent pulsations of arteries in abdomen.

Head - Bursting headache, worse coughing, better heat, movement, lying with head high. Hot face. Red cheeks. Face red, though cold (Asaf.).

Eyes - Objects appear black. Eyes prominent, with burning and lachrymation during cough.

Ears - Swelling and pain behind ears, inflammation of mastoid. Mastoiditis. Otorrhea and mastoid disease before suppuration. Tenderness over the petrous bone, extremely sore and tender to touch (Onos.). Hot ears. Burning and stinging in ears. Otalgia, then deafness. Tympanum perforated. Sub-acute inflammation of Eustachian tube with great pain. Ear affections during pregnancy.

Nose - Red but cold, tip very hot. Nosebleed in the morning in bed.

Face - Red, but cold, or pale and red alternately. Pain in fine line coursing along the nerve. Lips, swollen, cracked, burning.

Mouth - Stomatitis. Tongue greenish at base. Burning in tip of tongue. Vesicles or flat painful aphthae. Gums, hot, spongy, retracted. Saliva increased. Taste, foul like putrid water, sour to food. Fetid odorfrom mouth. Herpes of lips (apply one drop of the mother tincture.).

Throat - Burning, smarting in throat. Hot feeling in fauces. Constriction of throat with urging to swallow. Inflamed uvula and palate, swollen, elongated and relaxed, feeling as if it were pressing on something hard. Pain and dryness in throat extending to the ears. Sore throat of smokers and drinkers. Paralytic dysphagia. Hot, pungent air comes up from the throat, tasting foul when coughing. Pains when coughing. COMMENTS - A case of poisoning in a worker in a capsicum-plaster factory brought out a severe chill with shaking and it ended in an intense coryza. Mastoiditis. Glossitis. Cystitis. Dysentery (Canth.). Bloody mucus. Hemorrhage, helps stop blood flow. Ulcers and burning. Herpes, where there is a smarting, burning sensation on the sores. Characteristic cough with fetid breath or bad taste. Cough causing splitting pain in head. Chill at 10:30 a.m., beginning between shoulders and running down back. Homesickness (Calc-p., Ign., Nat-m.). Weight loss, insomnia, loss of appetite, depression. “Pining.” A lot of sighing, respiration- Clarke cured completely with a few doses of Caps., an Australian girl of florid complexion, who had come to London to study and who was quite incapacitated by homesickness. Delirium. Successful in delirium tremens, mostly in drachm doses of the tincture, given in milk or tincture of orange peel. Equal parts of tincture of Caps, and glycerin make a liniment for external use in many cases of chronic rheumatism and neuralgia. Caps. 30c brought speedy relief in a case of tympanites following laparotomy, the concomitant symptoms included cold nose and limbs and cyanosis. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Calad., Camph., Cina, Chin., Sul-ac. or vapor of burning sulphur. It antidotes: Effects of Alcohol, Coffee, Opium or Quinine. Compare: (1) Am., Bell., Bry. - headache from cough, Canth. - burning pains, throat symptoms, dysentery, urinary symptoms. (2) Psor. - lack of reaction, despair of recovery, Caps, in persons of lax tissue. (3) Lach - thirst before chill, continues into chill, drinking Worse also Elaps. (4) Nat-m., Carb-v. and Meny. (5) intermittents, Nat-m. is the “chronic" of Caps. (6) Carb-an. and Nit-ac. - inflammation behind ears, Aur. and Nit-ac. preferable in abscess, Sil. in chronic suppuration. (7) Ph-ac. - homesickness, Caps, has red face. (8) Ars., Alum., Carb-v., Lyc. have burning pains better by heat. (9) Merc., Nit-ac., Sulph. have passage of blood from bowels. (10) Crot-t. after drinking urging to stool. (11) Hell. - colic with spasm of bladder. (12) Plat. - burning, pungent pain in face, worse slightest drought of air, warm or cold. (13) Puls., Lyc., Bell. (14) Centaurea - surging of blood, homesickness intermittent fever. Compatible: Bell., Lyc., Puls., Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Much flatulence, especially in debilitated subjects. Vomiting, sinking at pit of stomach. Water brash. Acid dyspepsia, burning or trembling in stomach or icy coldness or as if cold water.

Rectum - Dysentery. Mucus diarrhea. Bloody mucus with burning and tenesmus, drawing pain in back after stool. Small, hot, burning stools. Thirsty after stool with shivering, worse drinking. Stinging pain during stool. Burning, bleeding from hemorrhoids with soreness of anus.

Male - Coldness of the scrotum, with im- potency, with softening and dwindling. Atrophy, softening of testes with loss of sensibility, spermatic cord shriveled. Prepuce swollen. Cramps in testes after emission. Trembling of the whole body during amorous caresses. Gonorrhea with chordee, excessive burning, pain in prostate.

Female - Menopausal disturbances with burning of tip of tongue. Pushing or sticking sensation in ovarian (left) region with disorders of menses. Uterine hemorrhage near the menopause, with nausea. Sticking sensation in left ovarian region. Food - Craves stimulating, pungent things, wants a bracer. Much thirst, but drinking causes shuddering. Desire for coffee, but it nauseates. Vegetables cause flatulence.

Chest - Constriction of chest, arrests breathing. Constitutions - Suited to those of lax tissues, weak, lazy indolent, fat, red, clumsy, awkward and of unclean habits. Such persons are opposed to physical exertion, averse to go outside of their routine and get homesick easily. Old people who have exhausted their vitality, especially by mental work and poor living. Persons react poorly and are afraid of cold. Abstainers from accustomed alcohol.

Back - Lumbar pain after stools. Pain in sacrum with hemorrhoids and dysentery. Pain in the back while drinking water. Sensation as if cold water dropping down back. Causations - Homesickness.

Limbs - Joints crack, stiff, painful on beginning to move, pain as if paralyzed. Sciatica, worse bending backwards and coughing. Leg (left) atrophied with violent pain. Staggers when walking. Pain from hips to feet, worse coughing. Tensive pain in the knee. Lungs - Pain at apex of heart or in rib region, worse touch. Dry, hacking cough, expelling an offensive breath from lungs. Dyspnea. Explosive cough. Feels as if chest and head would fly to pieces. Ribs seem dislocated. Pain in distant parts on coughing, bladder, legs, ears, etc. Wants to take deep breath, thinking that it would relieve all her symptoms. Too weak to cough out expectoration. Asthma with redness of face, worse ascending. Hoarsenessin singers and preachers. Threatening gangrene of lung.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from emotions, homesickness or cough. Sleepy after meals. Yawning by day. As if falling from a height during sleep.

Skin - Burning. Bloated, flabby.

Modalities - Better from continued motion. Better heat. Better while eating. Worse from slight draft, even warm. Worse cold air. Worse cold water. Worse uncovering. Worse dampness. Worse bathing. Worse touch. Worse from empty swallowing. Worse drinking. After eating, the throat or excited urination is worse, in alcoholics. Rest aggravates some forms of headache and improves others. Motion causes headache as if skull would split, as if bruised, asthma, chilliness, stiff joints to crack. Ascending causes asthma.

Kidneys - Strangury, frequent, almost ineffectual urging. Burning in orifice. Comes first in drops, then in spurts, neck of bladder spasmodically contracted. Thick, white creamy discharge from urethra, with gonorrhea. Drinking excites urination and stool. Meatus everted.

Temperature - Coldness with ill-humor. Chilly with the pains. Thirst before chill. Shivering after drinking. Chill begins in back with violent thirst, but shivers from every drink with excruciating backache. Chill alternating with heat, mounting to head, then sweat. Coldness of affected part. Sweats easily. Cold sweat on thighs. Fevers afteremotions with homesickness. Must have something hot to back.

full:
PHARMACY - carb-an. Carbo animalis. Animal charcoal. Made from charred ox-hide. Contains Calc-p. Trituration. Historicaldose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne, rosacea. Aneurysm. As- phyxiation. Appetite, disordered. Belchings. Breast, cancer. Breast-feeding. Bronchitis. Bubo. Cancer. Cataract Constipation. Coccyx, pain. Cough. Empyema. Face, eruption. Gangrene. Glandular, indurations. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Homesickness. Hookworm. Hypertrophy. Legs, pain. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Nose, disorders. Otorrhea. Pancreas, indurated. Perspiration, altered. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Polyps. Scrofula. Strabismus. Syphilis. Tonguedisorders. Trachea, disorders. Ulceration. Uterus, cancer. Vision, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Carb-an., or animal charcoal, is made from charred ox hide, it contains Calc-p. in small quantity. The Carbon group all have putriddischargesandexhalations. All act on the skin, causing interrigo and excoriations and Carb-tcl. is said to cause fatty liver (Phos., Kreos., Chlf.). Carb-an. is often indicated in the last stage of cancer, pneumonia, bronchitis, tuberculosis. Breast cancer with burning, drawing pains through breast. Right chest is most affected. Uterine cancer, burning pains down thigh. Tendency to malignancy. Glands enlarge slowly and painfully, burning. Glandular enlargements with catarrhal states, flatulency and asphyxiation. Painful swelling, lancinating, cutting and burning (Con., Merc-i-f.). Glands are indurated, veins distended, skin blue. Glands are stony hard. Neglected buboes. Marked tendency to induration of glands and tissues. Indurations after inflammations. Ulceration and decomposition. Hemorrhages. Gangrene. Offensive secretions. Discharges are acrid and foul. Slow, hard, painful processes. Sensations of looseness, crawling as of bugs. Stitch remaining after pleurisy (Bry.). Venous stasis, blue skin. Local congestions without heat. Copper- colored eruptions. Constitutional syphilis. Gummae. Paralysis of muscles of feet and hands. Patients are susceptible to colds and easy sprains. Easily strained from lifting. Hookworm disease (Thymol.). Especially adapted to scrofulous and venous constitutions. Suited to weak, broken- down constitutions and to the infirmities of old age or those prematurely aged. After debilitating disease with feeble circulation and lowered vitality. Weakness of nursing women, they weep while eating, unable to walk even across the room. MIND - Alternations of mood and overexcitability, alternating with fretful sadness. Sadness in morning. Aversion to company. Desire to be alone, sad and reflective. Avoids conversation. Weeps during meals. Whining. Cheerfulness alternating with sadness. Homesickness, longing for the past. Homesickness in morning. Forsaken feeling in morning. Anger about former vexations, about past events. Easily frightened. Fear of the dark, worse on closing eyes. Anxiety at night with orgasm of blood. Fearofsuffocation on closing eyes. Frightful images before sleep. Starting on falling asleep. Stupefaction, with vertigo, has to close eyes, when rising after stool. Confusion better epistaxis. Confusion in morning, did not know whether he had been asleep or awake. Difficulty in expressing ideas when writing. Hastiness. Irritability in morning, with heavy and dull head.

Head - Rush of blood with confusion. Headache, As if skull had been split or blown to pieces, must press it with both hands, better eating. Brain feels loose, worse motion and coughing. Throbbing headache after menses. Sensation as if something lay above eyes so that she could not look up.

Eyes - Pains down through (right) eyeball. Sensation as if something lay above eyes, so that she could not look up. As if eyeball were loose in the socket. Objects seem to be far off. Dimness of vision when reading. better rubbing eyes. Senile cataract.

Ears - Parotid gland swollen. Otorrhea with swelling of mastoid. Sharp pain. Hearing confused, cannot tell direction of sound. Ringing in ears, when blowing the nose.

Nose - Hard, red, swollen, hot with itchin pimples and desquamation. Brown strip across the nose. Nose swollen, tip bluisl small tumor on it. Fluent coryza with los of smell with yawning and sneezing.

Face - Bluish cheeks and lips. Copper colored eruptions. Acne, large number of pimples.

Mouth - Salty or sour water runs from th mouth. Knotty indurations in the tongue Bites cheeks while eating. Teeth loose worse chewing and least cold. Toothach better eating salty things.

Throat - Raw feeling like heartburn, better eating. Vertigo - Vertigo after shaving, better reeling. Vertigo followed by nosebleed. COMMENTS - Carb-an. is animal charcoal (Carb-v. is plant ash) and has similar affects as Bufo. Swollen glands with suppuration. Glands become indurated, have bluish color. Often used in the last stages of cancer with decomposition of tissue and sloughing off of tissue. Swollen inguinal glands that suppurate. Inflamed axillary glands. Buboes. Affections from loss of animal fluids, especially nursing women. Weakness of nursing women, can hardly walk across the room. “Gone” feeling from loss of fluids. Too weak to eat. Weeps when eating. Aversion to dark. Aversion to cold (Carb- v. to heat). Sensations of coldness, particularly in chest, about stomach. Coldness of the stomach, better pressure from hand. Nausea at night. Hunger in early morning. Emptiness, not better by eating (Carb-v. bettereating). Constipation where patient thinks bowels will be moved but only wind passes. Discharges are ichorous, but the discharge from hemorrhoids is odorless. Secretions stain yellow, particularly sweat and leucorrhea. Ichorous otorrhea and swelling of the periosteum over the mastoid bone. Hearing is confused, cannot tell the direction from which sounds come. Carb-an. 3x trituration has been used for ear polyps. Hoarse, suffocating cough producing a shaking of the brain as if it were loose. Expectoration is greenish, purulent offensive (Carb-v. yellow, more fetid). Tip of nose red or blue. Disagreeable smoothness of the teeth. Smothering feeling on closing eyes. Feeling of looseness of eyes in sockets, on motion or coughing. Far- sighted (Carb-v. is near-sighted). Objects seem farther apart and brighter. Neuralgia of the bone. Injured coccyx, with a dragging, bruised pain, burning when touched. Gnawing pains in tibia (during the night), such as usually followed cold feet. Lumbago when walking, standing and lying, feels as if the back were broken. A. W. K. Choudhury reports a case of cough of two years' duration in an unhealthy boy of twelve, cured by Carb-an. The symptoms were: “Cough evening and morning or after lying down, especially at night, thick or frothy whitish or yellowish sputa, sweetish when thick, worse lying on right side, worse from exposure to air to which he is very sensitive. Great tendency to catch cold.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars., Camph., Nux-v. Vinegar. Antidote to: Effects of Quinine. Compare: (1) Thymol., Badiaga, Sep., Sulph., Plb. iod. (2) Calc-p. - nearest analog, Carb-an. contains Calc-p. (3) in indurations, suppurations etc., Bad., Brom. (4) loss of fluids. Chin. (5 ) Graph., nostrils adhere to sepmm. (6) Phos., gone feeling, loss of fluids induration of cervix, pressure on back, groins and thighs during menses. (6) Cocc. has similar weakness and prostration as Carb-an. (7) Puls., Sil. (8) in vertigo with nosebleed. Sulph. (9) aversion to darkness, Am-m., Bar-c. Calc., Stroph., Stram. (10) hunger in early morning, Ant-c„ Asar., Calc.. Sabad. (11) swelling behind ear, Caps., Aur. (12) burning pains, Caps. (13) weakness of nursing women, Olnd. Complementary: Calc-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - All food distresses the stomach. Repugnance to fat food. Eating tires patient. Weak, empty feeling in stomach. Burning and griping. Weak digestion, flatulence. Heartburn. Retching, vomiting, hiccough with stomach cancer. Sensation of coldness around the stomach better rubbing and pressure. Nausea from smoking, whichcauses aversion to tobacco. Nausea, worse at night, of pregnancy. Faint gone feeling in stomach not better by eating in nursing women. Ptomaine poisoning.

Abdomen - Great distention after a operation. As of a hard body in groin (left) worse sitting, better pressure and passing flatus. Feeling of coldness rising into the throat. Induration of pancreas. Neglected bubo.

Rectum - Anus sore. Moisture, oozing froi anus and on perineum.

Male - Syphilis. Bubo.

Female - Menses too early, frequent, long lasting, dark, clotted, putrid, followed by great exhaustion. So weak can hardly speak (Cocc.). Flow only in the morning (Bor., Sep.). Leucorrhea, watery, burning, biting. Worse walking or standing, stains linen yellow. Nausea of pregnancy, worse at night. Offensive lochia (Kreos., Rhus-t., Sec.), thin, long lasting, with numb limbs. Right ovary seems a heavy ball. Burning in vagina and labia. Indurated os with burning. Uterine hemorrhage with disorders of glands. Cancer of uterus, burning pain down thighs, pelvic bones pain on sitting.

Heart - Palpitations when hearing singing in church or in public places. Coldness in precordial region with goose bumps.

Back - Coccyx feels bruised, burns when touched, worse sitting or lying. Coldness and aching in lumbar region with cough. Breasts - Weakness of nursing women. Darting in breast, painful indurations in breast, especially right, while nursing, arresting breathing. Hard painful nodes in breast. Last stages of breast cancer. Causations - Ill effects of eating spoiled fish or decayed vegetables. They are over affected by small vital losses. Sprains. Constitutions - Constitutional syphilis. Suited to old persons, greatly debilitated, especially when there is venous plethora and blueness of skin. Persons whose vitality becomes low on account of some serious or deep seated diseased condition or loss of fluids.

Limbs - Axillary glands, swollen, indurated. Night sweat fetid and profuse. Wrist pain. Hands numb with chest disorders. Joints weak, easy dislocation. Ankles turn easily. Pain in hip joints at night. Pain in coccyx, burns when touched. Straining and over-lifting produces a great debility Easy discoloration. Lungs - Nervous dyspnea. Suffocation or closing eyes. Pleurisy, typhoid character with remaining stitch. Ulceration of lung: with feeling of coldness in lungs. Cougl with discharge of greenish pus. Sputum dark, brown tough, syrup-like.

Sleep - Full of vivid fancies. Talks, groans, sheds tears in sleep. Talking and weeping in sleep.

Skin - Unsightly scars from eruption Spongy ulcers, copper-colored erut tion. Acne rosacea. Chilblains, worse i evening in bed and from cold. Warts c hands and face of elderly people, wil bluish color of limbs. Burning, rawne: and fissures, moisture. Bubo. Carbo animalis

Modalities - Better in warm room. Bette from laying hand on affected part. Worsi from slight causes. Worse losses of vita fluids. Worse after or during menses Worse from sprains. Worse lifting. Wors, touch. Worse taking cold. Worse dry, coli air. Worse after shaving. Worse while eat ing. Cough is worse lying on right side Throbbing headache worse in open ait Weakness worse during menses.

Temperature - Hot flushes. Sweat, foul, exhausting, at night, staining yellow.

name: Carbo Vegetabilis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from belchings. Better elevating feet. Better cool air. Betterfrom fanning. Worse from high living, rich food. Worse decayed food. Worse from poultry, fat food, butter, coffee, milk, Worse wine. Worse icy drinks. Worse from warmth, warm, damp weather, humid, cooling off. Worse walking in open air. Worse cold night air, frosty, wind on head. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse from depletions. Worse exhausting diseases. Worse dissipation. Worse suppressions. Worse over lifting. Worse pressure of clothes. Worse old age. Worse reading aloud, singing..

ARMACY - carb-v. Carbo vegetabilis. 'egetable charcoal. Carbo ligni. Contains npure carbon. Trituration. Historical dose: nturation and all potencies. .INICAL - Acidity, Acne. Air hunger. anemia. Angina Pectoris. Aortitis. Apho- iia. Asphyxiation. Asthenopia. Asthma, lelching. Body, cold. Breast, erysipelas. Hood, loss. Breathing, labored. Bronchitis. Sums. Carbuncle. Catarrh. Chilblains. Chilis. Cholera. Coldness. Colds. Collapse. Coma. Constipation. Cough. Deafness. Debility. 'dehydration. Diarrhea. Digestion, weak. Distention. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Em- rhysema. Erysipelas. Fainting. Feet, cold. Flatulence. Gangrene. Hair, loss. Headache. Heart, diseases. Heartburn. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hypothermia. Influenza. Intermittents. Intertrigo. Irritation. Laryn- gitis. Lungs, congested. Measles. Mumps. Nosebleeds. Esophagitis. Orchitis. Otorrhea. Pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Purpura. Scabies. Scurvy. Shiverings. Shock. Sleep, disorders. Stomach, disordered. Stomatitis. Trachea, dryness.Tympanites.Typhus. Ulcers. Vitality, low. Yellow fever. Weakness. 1OMEOPATHIC - Carb-v„ or vegetable charcoal, is itself a product of imperfect oxidation and disintegration, which are the keynotes of this remedy. It contains small quantity of Kali-carb., potassium carbonate. Provings with the crude Carb-v. and the potentized substances showed that the latter were much more powerful in their effect on the organism. These brought out the fact that there is an exact correspondence between the effect of crude charcoal and potentized Carb-v. Both are anti-septic and deodorant. The deodorant and disinfectant properties of charcoal in bulk had already been discovered when Hahnemann was at work on the Materia Medica. Its a deodorant, disinfectant and anti-septic properties are more enhanced in potencies. The signs and symptoms of decay and putrefaction are the leading indication for its medicinal use. Carb-v. antidotes the effects of putrid meats or fish, rancid fats, salt or salt meats, and also the pathogenic actions of Chin., Lach, and Merc. Decomposition of food in the stomach, putrid diseases and ulcerations, symptoms of imperfect oxygenation of the blood. Carb-v. acts upon the venous circulation and capillaries. Hemorrhage, blood dark, oozing from shock after surgical operations, persistent for hours or days. Hemorrhage from any mucus surface. The blood seems to stagnate, causing blueness, coldness and ecchymoses. Body becomes blue, icy-cold. Vitality becomes low from loss of vital fluids. Bacteria find a rich soil in the nearly lifeless blood stream and sepsis and typhoid states ensue. Putrid (septic) condition of all its affections, coupled with a burning sensation. Very debilitated. Almost lifeless, but the head is hot, coldness, breath cool, pulse imperceptible, oppressed and quickened respiration. Must have air, must be fanned hard, must have all the windowsopen. Cold, but wants air to be fanned or thirst for cold water. Faints easily, is worn out. Tremulous. Always weak, sick and exhausted, but those states may occur suddenly. State of collapse in cholera, typhoid or other grave diseases. When the patient is almost lifeless, cold body, breath cold, pulse imperceptible, respiration quickened. Lack of reaction after some violent attack, violent shock, violent suffering. Never well since. Patient seems to be too weak to hold out. Persons who have neverfully recovered from the effects of some previous illness. Weakness from grave or serious diseases, from effects of drug and disease, or from obstinate complications. Septic conditions. Lymphatic glands, are swollen, indurated or suppurating. Gangrene, humid, senile. Thick, acrid discharges. Ulcerations, aphthous. Blueness and decomposition. Flatulence, fetor. Sensation of fullness. Sense of weight, as in the head (occiput), eyes and eyelids, before the ears in the stomach and elsewhere in the body. General bruised soreness, old catarrhs. Bedwetting, which is worse in morning after the first sleep. Burning itching on skin. Frozen limbs. Chilblains, excoriations between toes. Numbness of parts lain on. Burning, sense of weight or heavy aching in bones, ulcers etc. Tinea capitis or scald-head. Scalp very sensitive, feels as if bruised. Whooping cough with pain at base of brain. Excessive gagging cough in the morning, compelling him to vomit everything, immediately after breakfast (Dros.). MIND - Confusion, which makes thinking difficult. Confusion better mental exertion. Torpor and indolence. Slow thinking, worse in morning on waking. Sudden loss of memory. Indifference to everything he hears or sees. Indifference, hears everything without pleasure or pain. Indifference to music which he loves. Sluggish, slow, lazy. Peevish, irritable and inclined to anger. Anxiety in evening, could scarcely remain lying still. Anxiety in morning on waking. Anxiety on closing eyes. Restlessness in company. Indolent. Irritable. Dejected. Child wishes to vent itself in rage, strikes, kicks, bites, in worm affections. Oversensitive to noise. Timidity about appearing in public. Aversion to presence of strangers. Fear of people. Easily frightened or startled. Aversion to darkness. Fear of ghosts. Fear of accidents. Sees frightful images in the dark.

Head - Cold sweat on forehead. Head hot with cold limbs. Takes cold in head easily. Dull, compressive, heavy. Headaches, worse occiput, worse overheating, lying or pressure of hat,over-indulgence. Pimples on forehead and face. Hair, sore, falls off easily in handfuls, after severe illness, after childbirth. Scalp itches when warm in bed. Hat pressed upon head like a heavy weight.

Eyes - As of heavy weight on eyes. Hemorrhages from eyes with congestion to head. Vision of floating black spots. Burning in eyes. Muscles of eyes painful when looking up. Pupils do not react to light. Asthenopia.

Ears - Deafness or otorrhea, following exanthemata. Ears dry. Something heavy seems to lie before the ears. Deficient or badly smelling yellow wax. Mumps with metastases.

Nose - Nosebleed in daily attacks with pale face. Bleeding after straining, with pale face. Tip of nose red and scabby, itching around nostrils. Eruption in corner of nose. Varicose veins on nose. Descending colds. Nose cold, hay asthma. Coryza with cough, especially in moist, warm weather. Sneezing from irritation in larynx, worse blowing nose. Ineffectual effort to sneeze.

Face - Face blue, cold with cold sweat. Puffy, cyanotic, pale, hippocratic, pinched (Cupr., Op.). Mottled cheeks and red nose. Twitching upper lip. Brown or black looking, cracked lips. F emale - Too early and too copious menses, pale blood. During menstruation, burning in hands and soles. Menorrhagia, burning across sacrum, passive flow. Leucorrhea, thick, greenish, milky, causing itching and burning, worse before menses. Feels best with a free leucorrhea. Sore, hot, itching, swollen, vulva. Vulva swollen, aphthae. Varicose veins on pudendum and yulva with burning, bluish ulcers. Vaginal fistula, burning pains. Food - Aversion to fat things, meat and milk, which causes flatulence. Aversion to the most digestible and the best kind of food. Desire for salty, sour things or sweet things, coffee. Worse from brandy.

Mouth - Breath cold. Bad smell from mouth. Bitter, sour, taste. Increased saliva. Tongue, cold, black, swollen, covered with white, yellow-brown mucus. Aphthae, bluish, black ulcers with burning. Loose teeth. Tooth pain while eating hot or cold things. Teeth very sensitive when chewing. Scorbutic gums. Blood oozes from gums when cleaning teeth. Gums retracted and bleed easily, painful while chewing. Gums black. Pyorrhea.

Throat - Sensation as if closed. Aphthous, sore. Hawking of bloody, black mucus. Painful on swallowing food. Vertigo - Vertigo with nausea and tinnitus. COMMENTS - Suited to conditions where there is lack of reaction (Op.) to low states of the vital powers, where the venous system is engorged. Lack of reaction in pupils (Op.). For near death states. “The corpse reviver.” In India, they say it pulls back souls from the jaws of death. Comas (Op., Chin.). Diabetic comas. Usually given for the last stage of processes. Last stage of pneumonia, cyanotic, weak, debilitated, faint. Shock from heart failure (Arn. first). Never well since a traumatic accident where they feel weak and sluggish. Hypo-oxygenation, with shortness of breath, varicose veins, hemorrhoids, gas and bloating. Weakness after hemorrhage. Listless and indifferent. Feebleness. Collapse (Camph.), with short, shallow breathing. Collapse with cold knees. The patient sinks and breaks out in a cold sweat, faints and collapses from weakness and lack of air (Aeon., Ign., or Gels, if from emotional trauma). Debility of greater intensity than Carbo an. in children or old people after exhausting diseases. Great debility as soon as he makes the least effort. Debility following childbirth, causing falling out of hair. Cannot be aroused, cannot think, so weak they cannot lift their head off the pillow (Stann. is weak in the chest, can barely speak). Frequent hemorrhages. Nosebleeds or hemorrhage from throat in dysentery. Hemorrhage from the bowels, lungs. Dyspnea, from chronic aortitis. Congestive symptoms like those of poisoning by carbonic acid. Pulse thready, face pale, covered with cold sweat, desire to be fanned, anxiety without restlessness. Fever, intermittent, hectic, typhoid, yellow fever and cholera. In intermittents of long standing where quinine has been abused. Thirst only during chill. Feet ice-cold up to knees. Heat in burning flushes. Sweat sour or offensive. Weak, befogged mind. Characteristic coldness. Worse from warmth. Great desire for air, must be fanned. Cold breath (cholera), cold knees, cold, but wants to be fanned. Dull headache in occiput with confusion of mind, proceeding from occiput to forehead, dull, heavy aching over eyes in warm room, buzzing in ears, very sensitive to pressure of hat. Hippocratic countenance. Vertigo from stomach with fainting, especially at meals. Burning pains (Carb-an.), especially in the limbs, with varicose veins. Numbness of limbs. Lividity, mottled skin. Round ulcers. Indolent gangrene. Varicose veins of arms, legs, vulva. Catarrh from warm, moist atmosphere. Cough is worse on entering cold air from a warm room. Hoarseness from damp air, worse morning or evening. Cough caused by a sensation as if sulphur fumes were in larynx. Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia with burning pains across sacrum and spine. Corrosive menstrual discharge, strong pungent odor. Premature and profuse menses. Headache during menses. Preceded and followed by leucorrhea. Greenish yellow leucorrhea, worse in morning. Leucorrhea excoriates. Perineum moist, raw, oozing. Itching, burning soreness and smarting at vulva and anus. Hemorrhoids. Excessive accumulation of gas in stomach and intestines. “Stomach feels full and tense from flatulence. Great pain in stomach on account of flatulence, worse especially on lying down.” Weak digestion with much flatulence, better by eructation. Flatulence accompanies many other complaints, including asthma and heart disorders. Heaviness in the stomach, full feeling and burning. Aversion to fat, meat, and milk, which causes flatulence. Desire for coffee (which does not relieve), for acids, for sweet and salt things. Guernsey considered Carb-v. especially suited to cachectic individuals whose vital powers has become weakened. In cases where disease seems to have been engrafted on the system by reason of the depressing influence of some prior derangement. A. H. Birdsall recorded a typical case of Carb-v. intermittent. “A man, 36, had fever eight months, partially suppressed by Arsenic and Quinine. Type, tertian. Headache for one or two hours before chill. “Chill always from 9 to 10 a.m., beginning in feet and hands, spreading over body, nails very blue. Thirst with chill. Cold stage lasts two to three hours, followed immediately by hot stage, much heat in head and face, which is flushed red, thirstlessness. Sweating stage short, sweat sour. “Apyrexia: Sweats easily, especially from least warmth, awakens in morning always with slight sour-smelling sweat. Weak, dispirited, flatulent. A single dose of Carb-v. cured. There were only three more attacks, each of diminished intensity.” A carbon ointment made by carbonizing a wine cork by plunging it into a clear fire and then, in its still glowing state, into Vaseline and mixing thoroughly is regarded as a sovereign remedy in anal irritation and hemorrhoid troubles. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars., Ambra, Camph., Coff., Lach., Nit-s-d., Ferr. (Teste). It antidotes: Effects of putrid meats of fish, rancid fats, salt or salt meats. Chin., Lach., Merc. Compare: (1) Raph. in flatulence. Caust., Lach., Eup-per., Phos. and Rumex in hoarseness, Rumex is worse 4 a.m. and 11 p.m. Caust. worse in morning from dry cold. Carb-v. worse evening from damp evening air. (2) Camph., China in hemorrhages intermittents, hectic disorders of alcoholics, Ip. in hemorrhages and intermittents, Meny. in intermittents with coldness of legs. (3) Op., Sulph. and Psor. in deficient reaction. (4) Sul- ac. in dyspepsia of alcoholics. Carb-v. has more putridity, Sul-ac. more sourness. (5) Phos. in easily bleeding ulcers, Puls., bad effect from fat food and pastry, Sulph. in acrid-smelling menses, erysipelas of breasts, Ars. and Bellis in effects of ice-cream and ice-water in hot weather. (6) Nux-v. in dyspepsia, easily angered, effects of debauchery. Nux- v. is thin, spare, yellow, wiry, Carb-v sluggish, stout, lazy. (7) Sec. in hemorrhages, cold breath, coldness worse by warmth. Calc., Carb-an. and Stram. in aversion to darkness. (8) Lach, in weak digestion. Lach, craves milk, Carb-v. has aversion to it. Intolerance of clothing around waist intermittent fever, flashes of burning heat without thirst. (9) Sep. in bearing-down in rectum and vagina. Carb-v. has strong odor of menses which Sep. has not. (10) Rhus-t. in strains in typhus, Colch. in cholera, coldbreath, prostration. Cupr. (11) Carboneum - Spasms commencing in tongue, down trachea and limbs. Tingling sensation. (12) Lyc., Ars., Chin., Carb-v. contains potash. Complementary: Chin., Dros., Kali-c. - stitches in heart. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Burning in stomach, extending to back along spine, with coldness. Contractive pains extending to chest with distention of abdomen. Epigastric region is very sensitive. Faint empty feeling in stomach, not relieved by eating. Loathes even the thought of food. Crampy pains forcing patient to bend double. Digestion slow, food putrefies before it digests. The simplest food distresses. Distress comes on a half-hour after eating. Rancid, sour orputridbelchings. Belchings after eating and drinking, temporary relief from belch ing. Heartburn. Water brash, asthmatic breathing from flatulence. Heaviness, fullness and sleepiness, tense from flatulence, with pain, worse lying down. Stomach ulcers, cancer. Vomiting of blood. Nausea in the morning. Stomach pain of nursing women.

Abdomen - Greatly distended, especially upper part, worse lying down, better passing wind. Flatulent colic, forcing the patient to bend double. Obstructed flatulence, giving rise to complaints. Pain as from lifting a weight. Abdomen feels as if hanging down, walks bent. Cannot bear tight clothing around waist and abdomen. Epigastric region very tender. Ailments from intestinal fistulae. Abdominal sufferings, worse from the smallest portion of food.

Rectum - Hot, moist offensive flatus. Itching, gnawing and burning in rectum and anus. Acrid, corrosive moisture from rectum. A musty, glutinous moisture exudes. Excoriation of anus. Soreness, itching, moisture of perineum, especially at night. Discharge of blood from rectum. Burning varicose veins (Mur-ac.). Bluish, white, burning hemorrhoids, pain after stools. Ineffectual urging, even soft stool passed with difficulty. Frequent, involuntary, putrid, cadaverous smelling stools, followed by burning. Feces escape with flatus. Painful diarrhea of old people.

Male - Discharge of prostatic fluid, while straining at stool. Itching and moisture at thigh near scrotum. Seminal discharge too soon during sex, followed by roaring in head. Swelling of testes from metastasis of mumps.

Chest - Heavy sore or weak chest, on awakening. Burning in chest with hemoptysis. Brown yellow spots on chest. Sore ribs. Constitutions - Suited to atonic conditions where there is lack of reaction. The typical Carb-v, patient is fat, sluggish, lazy and has a tendency to chronicity of complaints. Complaints of old people. Persons who have never fully recovered from the effects of some previous illness. School girls and boys are sluggish, slow to learn, suffer from night terrors, will not sleep alone or go to bed in the dark.

Heart - Continuous anxious palpitation, worse eating, sitting. Thread-like, weak and small, intermittent pulse. Burning around the heart. Pulsation throughout the body.

Back - Severe pain in small of back, with a sensation of a plug, unable to sit down, had to put a pillow under it when lying. Burning behind shoulder. Breasts - Lumps in breasts with indurations of axillary glands. Breasts, hard, swollen with impending abscess. Prostration after nursing. Causations - Carbon monoxide poisoning. Blood loss. Shock. Surgery. Effects of alcohol, meat, fish, especially if tainted, ice-water, vegetables, salt or salt meats. Disorders from high living and especially butter- eating.

Limbs - Heavy, stiff, feel paralyzed. Limbs go to sleep. Want of muscular energy, joints weak. Burning pain in bones and limbs. Numbness when lying on limbs. Pain in shins. Cold from knees down. Cramp in soles. Feet numb and sweaty. Foul foot sweat, worse walking. Toes red, swollen. Senile gangrene of fingers and toes with fiery burning vesicles, oozing bloody water. Paralytic weakness of the wrists and of the fingers, when seizing anything. Arms weary when writing.

Sleep - Unrefreshing. Awakes often from cold limbs especially cold knees. Comatose sleep with rattling in throat. Frequent yawning and stretching which seems to agree. Horror during sleep.

Skin - Blue, cold and bruised. Purpura. Wounds heal and break out again. Marbled with venous over- distention. Moist skin, hot perspiration. Fine moist rash with burning. Burning in various places. Itching, worse on evening, when warm in bed. Bedsores, bleed easily. Foul ulcers, indolent, burning and bleeding. Varicose ulcers, bleeding easily, pus smells like asafetida. Ulcers heal and break out again. Ichorous, offensive discharge. Tendency to gangrene of the margins. Senile gangrene beginning in the toes. Carbuncles (Ars., Anthr.). Varicose veins during pregnancy. Falling out of hair from a general weakened condition.

Modalities - Better from belchings. Better elevating feet. Better cool air. Betterfrom fanning. Worse from high living, rich food. Worse decayed food. Worse from poultry, fat food, butter, coffee, milk, Worse wine. Worse icy drinks. Worse from warmth, warm, damp weather, humid, cooling off. Worse walking in open air. Worse cold night air, frosty, wind on head. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse from depletions. Worse exhausting diseases. Worse dissipation. Worse suppressions. Worse over lifting. Worse pressure of clothes. Worse old age. Worse reading aloud, singing.

Liver - Pain in liver. Jaundice from over eating or eating too rich food. Lungs -Asphyxiation. Breathing, laborious, quick and short, worse walking. Wants to take a deep breath. Breath cold, must be fanned. Cheyne-Stokes breathing in organic heart disease. Destructive lung diseases. Cough with itching in larynx, spasmodic with gagging and vomiting of mucus. Cough with burning in chest. worse in evening, in open air, after eating and talking. Spasmodic cough, bluish face, offensive expectoration. Occasional Carbo vegetabilis spells of long coughing attacks. Wheezing and rattling of mucus in chest. Expectoration with retching. Expectoration is very thick, sticky, yellow and profuse. Hemorrhage from lungs. Neglected pneumonia. Whooping cough, especially in the beginning, with bluish face, and its complications. Asthma in aged with blue skin. Hoarseness, worse evenings, talking, evening oppression of breathing, sore and raw chest. Roughness in larynx with deep rough voice.

Kidneys - Albumin, protein in the urine. Nephritis, septic or from alcohol. Urine, copious, clear yellow or thick and whitish. Diabetes. Bedwetting at night. Urine, suppressed in cholera and retained from standing on the cold pavements.

Temperature - Icy coldness, unilateral of tongue, knees, legs, foot, at night. Coldness with thirst. Chill begins in forearm. Cold worse coughing. Alternate chill and heat. Warm head and cold limbs. Internal burning heat, at heart, chest with cold icy skin and cold sweat. Burning in various places. Yellow fever. Hectic fever, ex- hausting sweats. Sweats easily, on eating. Sweat sour on face.

name: Carbolicum Acidum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from smoking. Better strong tea. Better rubbing, binding. There is intolerance of a warm room, but also sensitiveness to cold air which aggravate many symptoms. Worse from jar. Worse reading. Worse pregnancy. Worse combing hair..
constitution: Acne. Allergic, reactions. Anaphylactic, shock. Backache. Bee stings. Belchings.Burns. Carbuncles. Cholera. Colds. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Erysipelas. Flatulence. Gangrene. Heartburn. Hydrocephalus. Influenza. Intermittent, fever. Irritation. Leprosy. Leucorrhea. Meningitis. Neuralgias. Pneumonia. Psoriasis. Pityriasis, versicolor. Prostration . Scarlatina.
keynote:
