CLINICAL - Acne. Allergic, reactions. Anaphylactic, shock. Backache. Bee stings.…
full:
PHARMACY - carb-ac. Carbolicum acidum. Carbolic acid. Phenolum. Phenol. Monoxy benzine. Phenic acid. Phenyl alcohol. Solution in rectified spirit. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Allergic, reactions. Anaphylactic, shock. Backache. Bee stings. Belchings.Burns. Carbuncles. Cholera. Colds. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Erysipelas. Flatulence. Gangrene. Heartburn. Hydrocephalus. Influenza. Intermittent, fever. Irritation. Leprosy. Leucorrhea. Meningitis. Neuralgias. Pneumonia. Psoriasis. Pityriasis, versicolor. Prostration . Scarlatina. Smallpox. Smell, disordered. Stomach, disorders. Toothaches. Ulcers. Uremia. Uterus, displacements. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Carb-ac., like the Carbons, is a powerful anti-septic and its use as such in surgery has led, incidentally, to the poisoning of both patients and surgeons. These experienceshave provided a number of the symptoms indicating its medicinal use. Carb-ac. is a languid, painless, foul and destructive remedy. Acts primarily on the central nervous system. It affects the mucus membranes, heart, blood and respiration. Stomach symptoms are also important. Marked prostration, even paralytic with loss of sensation and motion. Collapse. Stupor. Paralysis of sensation and motion. Feeble pulse and depressed breathing. Death due to paralysis of respiratory centers. Malignant and septic conditions. Physical exertion brings on abscess somewhere. Discharges are foul, burning. Putrid discharges (Bapt.). Bloody discharges. Scarlet fever with marked tendency to destruction of tissue internally and fetid odor. Terrible pains coming and going suddenly. Pricking, burning sensation. Trembling with an uncertain, staggering walk. Arthritis. Mental and bodily languor, disinclination to study with headache like a band. Very marked acuteness of smell. Increased olfactory sensibility. Spasmodic coughs. Allergic reactions to bee stings (Apis). In cholera when Verat. is indicated but fails. MIND - Mental and bodily languor. Disinclination to do any mental or physical work. Unfit for study, as reading aggravates all symptoms. Periods of mental abstraction. Mental exertion aggravates. Unconsciousness. Absent minded, starts when spoken to. Difficulty of remembering passed events. Forgetful, can't remember anything, becomes easily confused. Starts to do something and forgets it. Entire disinclination to study, what he had accomplished seemed very trifling. Very irritable. Fear of impending disease at night in bed. Sense of bewilderment. Mental and physical exhilaration. Constantly agitated, moaning continuously and occasionally uttering a piercing cry. recognizes no one, acute hydrocephalus.

Head - Orbital neuralgia over right eye. Headache, better from green tea, while smoking. Headaches appearing at the time of menses. Tight feeling as if compressed by a rubber band (Gels.). As of a hot ball in forehead. Tender scalp.

Eyes - Severe orbital neuralgia over right eye. Contraction alternating with dilatation of pupils in hydrocephalus. Neuralgic twitching in eyeballs. Photophobia during headache.

Nose - Smell very acute. Putrid discharge. Ozaena with fetor and ulceration. Influenza and resulting debility.

Face - Dusky face. Pale about nose and mouth. Face pale, pinched, with cold sweat. Face cyanotic. Lips covered with a white membrane. Swelling of face and tongue from bee stings. Twitching in cheeks and temples. Lupus.

Mouth - Intensely foul breath with constipation. Burning in mouth to stomach. Lips dry, cracked, painful or black.

Throat - Glazed. Fauces red and covered with exudation. Uvula whitened and shriveled. Ulcerated patches on inside of lips and cheeks. Burning in mouth to stomach. Putrid discharge. Almost impossible to swallow. Diphtheria, fetid breath, regurgitation on swallowing liquids, but little pain (Bapt.). Face dusky red, white about mouth and nose. Rapid sinking of vital forces. Vertigo - Vertigo, felt as if staggering, like a drunken man. Giddiness, not better closing eyes. Vertigo on going up and down stairs, better walking fast in open air, worse sitting down. Vertigo with fear of falling, trembling. COMMENTS - Anaphylactic shock from bee stings (Apis, Hist.). The skin is inflamed, and other symptoms appear with burning, tingling, itching and numbness. Pains come suddenly. Burning, pricking, sticking pains. Numbness and twitching. Profound prostration and fatigue, convulsions, collapse, cold, clammy sweat. Constant yawning. Palpitations of the heart at night. Putrid discharges. The urine is very dark, black or black olivegreen, grass or olive-green. Great flatulent distention of the abdomen with belching of wind. Desire for stimulants. Vomiting in alcoholic, in pregnant women, with violent frontal headache. Many poisoning cases show pneumonia. single or double, affecting the bases principally. Gangrene has been caused by the application of 2 to 5 percent solutions, prescribed by Dr. Streintz. Fahnestock observed a case of poisoning from inhaling the fumes. The patient, a woman, feeling ill, ran across the street to a neighbor's. Before reaching the house she fell prostrate, pale, gasping for breath. When taken in, she had to be propped up in order to breathe, trembled all over, wanted her hands held, “pricking like needles,” all over body, unable to raise right arm. Cold hands and feet. Wanted a drink of water every few minutes, nausea but no vomiting, pain in lumbar region. Symptoms lasted four hours. Allen noted that it relieved cases of cancer of the stomach, and epithelioma of the cheek and nose with hemorrhages. Deschere found Carb-ac. 30c of great service in uterine displacements with or without discharges but these, if present, are always offensive. The symptoms first relieved are the agonizing backache across the loins with a dragging sensation down the buttocks into the thighs. Cooper regarded it as specific in influenza in the 3x for the attack and 30c for resulting debility. Dr. Proctor recorded a brilliant cure of a double basal pneumonia with drop doses of the B. P. solution after failure of more commonly used remedies. Nervous dyspepsia of intensely painful character has frequently been cured by it. R. K. Ghosh found it admirable in cases of cholera where V erat. seems indicated and fails. There is intolerance of warm room, but also sensitiveness to cold air which aggravates many symptoms. Ghosh also reported great improvement in a case of diabetes when the remedy was given for something else. Proell recorded his own case of idiopathic erysipelas affecting the back of the right hand, first three fingers and arm with violetcolored swelling and roughness. Rhus-t. removed the fever, but did nothing to stop the erysipelas. Carb-ac. 30c did so promptly. RELATIONS - Antidote: Alcohol, Vinegar, Chalk, Iodine. Glauber’s Salt in watery solution. Compare: (1) Apis, Gels. Merc, and Sulph. (2) In band-like headache, Ars., Carb-v., Chin, and Kreos. (3) in bums, ulcers, unhealthy offensive discharges, Pic-ac. (4) Ant-t. and Vario, in smallpox. (5) Chrysarobin, locally in ringworm of the scalp, 5-10 per cent, in glycerin and alcohol. Equal parts. (6) Ars., Kreos., Carbo, Guano. - Violent headache as from a band around head. Itching of nostrils, back, thighs, genitals. (6) Symptoms like hay fever, All-c, Ars. Incompatible: Glycerin and vegetable oils. In bums from carbolic acid, Elias Price found milk give immediate relief. He suggests A draft of milk in poisoning cases. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Fermentative dyspepsia with bad taste and breath. Heat rises up esophagus. Constant belching, nausea, vomiting. heartburn. Flatulent distention of stomach and abdomen. Painful flatulence often marked in one part of the bowel. Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy, from seasickness, cancer. Dark, olive green vomit. Sore stomach.

Abdomen - Flatulence. Colic of nursing infants. Soreness of hypochondria worse motion. Abdominal muscles sore.

Rectum - Constipation with retraction of abdomen. Constipation with very offensive breath. Passes mucus from anus while urinating. Fetid, rice water diarrhea. Thin, black, putrid diarrhea. Bloody, like scrapings of intestines. Shreddy stools. Great tenesmus.

Female - Discharges always offensive (Nit- ac., Nux-v., Sep.). Pustules about vulva containing bloody pus. Severe backache across loins with dragging down thighs, from uterine displacement. Painful swelling of left ovary, worse walking in open air. Induration of cervix. Erosions of cervix, fetid, acrid discharge. Thick, irritating leucorrhea, causing itching and burning (Kreos.). Leucorrhea in children (Cann-s., Merc., Puls., Sep.). Puerperal fever with offensive discharge. Food - Appetite lost. Cheerful while eating. Desire for stimulants and tobacco. Desire for whiskey. Nausea from cold water. Hiccough after dinner.

Heart - Heart worse after indiscretion in eating. Stitches in region of heart. Palpitation. or violent action of heart at night. Bellows murmur over mitral valves. Organic valvular heart disease. Thready pulse. Pulse rapid, weak or intermittent, irregular.

Back - Aching between scapula. Pains in loins, worse straightening up and better pressure. Stitching pain, in right side of neck. Drawing in muscles of neck. Severe pain, in lumbosacral region. Soreness of muscles of back and limbs.

Limbs - Cramps in fore part of leg, close to tibia, during walking. Stiffness of limbs, hydrocephaloid. Cold hands and feet. Gnawing pains in shin bones. Arthritis.

Sleep - Very sleepy.

Skin - Burning, itching vesicles and pustules. Bloody vesicles or pustules. Burns tend to ulcerate. Erysipelas.

Modalities - Better from smoking. Better strong tea. Better rubbing, binding. There is intolerance of a warm room, but also sensitiveness to cold air which aggravate many symptoms. Worse from jar. Worse reading. Worse pregnancy. Worse combing hair.

Kidneys - Tired sensation in renal region. Urine, scanty, green. Urine alkaline. Urine scanty and red, in scarlatina. Urine dark, almost black. Albuminuria. Urine contained albumen in meningitis. Urinated freely an excessive quantity of saccharine urine. Diabetes.

Bladder - Frequent urination. Irritable bladder in old men. with frequent urination at night, of prostatic nature. Straining on passing urine.

Perspiration - Profuse, cold sweat. Profoundprostration, collapse and bathed in cold sweat. Clammy sweat on head, face and hands. Profuse sweat with restlessness. Sweats at night

Temperature - General chilliness and coldness of surface. Chills runs from head downward. Chilly sensation while in a warm room. Chilly in open air.

name: Carbon Tetrachloride
author: Murphy
keynote: PHARMACY - carb-tcl. Carbon tetrachloride. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies. CLINICAL - Hookworms. Parasites. Worms. HOMEOPATHIC - Carbon tetrachloride is a worm antiparasite remedy of great potency. It has shown itself to be the best vermifuge for treatment of…
full: PHARMACY - carb-tcl. Carbon tetrachloride. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies. CLINICAL - Hookworms. Parasites. Worms. HOMEOPATHIC - Carbon tetrachloride is a worm antiparasite remedy of great potency. It has shown itself to be the best vermifuge for treatment of hookworm in a country where this disease predominates. It gives little discomfort to the patient, is palatable, requires no preparation of the patient and, when pure, is apparently not toxic in homeopathic doses, all of which features are of advantage in a popular campaign. It was brought to notice by its effects on workers in rubber works. Pains come and go quickly. The periodicity shows itself, as in diarrhea, which comes every six weeks. The worse from warmth common to Carb-v. and Sulph. shows itself in Carb-s. A feeling of vibration and trembling in whole body, particularly in hands. Carb-s. has the flatulence of Carb-v. and the abdominal soreness of Sulph. In many cases, the action on vision was very marked. Myopia, asthenopia, achromatopsia, dyschromatopsia. Cloudiness and atrophy of optic disc. Optic discs pale. Central scotoma for light and colors. Retinal congestion. Arteries and veins tortuous. Veins are distended and arteries contracted. Everything seemed in a fog, as if a spider's web over objects, green or red. One patient had complete right side hemiplegia, following sudden loss of consciousness, blindness of right eye and great impairment of vision of left. Loss of memory, especially for words, was a very frequent symptom. Delusions were common: “Heard voices and believed he had committed a robbery,” “sensation of a hole close by into which he was in danger of falling.” One acute case concerned a girl, aged 15, who was employed in vulcanizing works, and was exposed to the fumes one whole day. Before this, she had, from smaller exposures to the fumes, frontal pains and heaviness of the head. After this, the pains became more violent and were accompanied by painful contraction of masseters, then by stiffness of neck and vertebral column, finally of legs and arms. He used Care, in treating depraved inherited conditions in children, such as infantile self-abuse, with good effects, which Clarke later confirmed. Kent used Care, for cases of incurable cancer with sharp, burning,' tearing pains. He claimed it would palliate the cancer for years, although it would not cure it. HERBAL - Indigenous to the Mediterranean region and brought to Central Europe as a medicine as early as the M iddle Ages, where it is still cultivated. The Carline thistle has an enormous root and purple composite flowers surrounded by radical spinous leaves. Flourishes on dry stony ground and wasteland. This thistle was used externally for wounds, especially burns. It is said to have obtained its name ‘benedictus' from its high reputation as a heal-all, being supposed even to cure the plague. It is a basic ingredient of the Benedictine Liqueur and other bitter tonics, stomach bitters.

Burning in the arms on exerting them. Tension in tendons. Cracking and aching in joints. Aching, cutting pain. Red, and afterwards, yellow, spots on the skin. The respiratory sphere is strongly affected and there is pain and contractive sensation in the trachea with hoarseness. Inspired air feels cold. Feeling as if buccal cavity were contracted. Slight swelling of the veins.

CLINICAL - Alcohol, abuse. Asthma. Biliousness. Bronchitis. Cirrhosis. Constipation. Debility. Diaphragm, high. Dropsy. Edema. Fever.Gallstone, colic. Gallstones. Headaches. Heartburn. Hematemesis. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Influenza. Intermittents. Jaundice. Kidney, stones. Liver, disorders. Melaena. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Neuralgias. Nosebleeds. Pleurisy. Rheumatism. Salivation. Sciatica. Spleen, disorders. Tuberculosis. Typhlitis. Ulcers. Varicose, ulcers. Varicose, veins. Vomiting. Waterbrash.

HERBAL - Rademacher, the medical alchemist, found Card-m. to be a primarily liver remedy, all its manifestations originating in some disorder of the liver. Burnett agreed, noting that it is primarily a liver and spleen remedy.

HOMEOPATHIC - The action of this remedy is centered in the liver and portal system. causing soreness, pain, and jaundice. It has a specific relation to the vascular system. Useful for a history of a toxic liver. It establishes a healthy flow of bile, and helps reduce the tendency for reformation of gallstones. Chronic liver weakness and cirrhosis of the liver, especially with ascites, a water- filled abdomen, and edema. Cirrhosis with swollen legs and varicose veins. Liver enlargement in the transverse direction (Chel. is more vertical). Gallstone colic. Jaundice. Hepatitis with hot flashes, flushing of heat. Damaged liver (Nux-v.). May help liver cancer. Dropsical conditions depending on liver disease and when due to pelvic congestion. Hemorrhages, especially connected with hepatic disease. Bilious fever. Infection of the gallbladder. Liver headaches (Sang., Chel.), migraines, often worse on the right side. Liver disorders associated with lung disorders. Influenza when liver is affected. Low blood sugar. Never well since mononucleosis or hepatitis. For the abuse of alcoholic beverages, especially beer. Characteristic bitter taste in the back of the mouth. The tongue has white down the center with a red tip. Portal stasis. Hemorrhoids with itching, burning in the rectum, dark urine. Spleen disease (Cean.). Associated with digestion problems and with a bitter taste in the mouth. Vomiting of bile-like substances. Chronic heartburn, fatigue after eating. Drawing pain up the abdomen, from the umbilicus to the solar plexus. Rumbling in the abdomen, clay-colored stools, blood in the stool. Diseases of miners associated with difficult breathing, asthma (Sil.). Debility, fatigue, worse eating and riding with frequent yawning. Varicose veins and ulcers. Stitching, drawing, burning pains. MIND - Melancholy with liver disorders. Joyless, apathetic. Despondency. Disposition to become angry. Hypochondriacal. Forgets what he has just intended to do.

Head - Headache better eating. Headache shortly before meals, disappearing after eating. Dull frontal headache with foul tongue. Liver headaches. Bilious headaches. Burning and pressure in head. Constriction, contractive feeling skull, over eyebrows. Pain in left parietal bone.

Eyes - Pressure as if eyeballs were pressed against side of orbits. Burning and pressure in eyeballs and lids.

Nose - Burning in right nostril. Tickling, first in right, then left nostril, with watery discharge- Habitual nosebleed. Sudden profuse nosebleed, relieving vertigo.

Throat - Irritation in posterior part of larynx causing cough. Fauces as if rough and dry, with scraping, causes coughing. Swallowing painful. Larynx as if dry. Pressing pain on speaking and swallowing.

Stomach - Bitter taste. Sour eructations. Repeated belchings of air with burning in esophagus. Burning as of acidity. Sensation of emptiness. Pressure in the stomach. Griping pain. Colicky pain with waterbrash. Stitches in left side of stomach, near spleen (Cean.). Sour contents of stomach and intestines. Nausea, retching and vomiting of green acid fluid or blood. Nausea with salivation. Hematemesis. Tendency to attacks of bilious vomiting. Continual nausea with desire to vomit. Vomiting of pregnancy.

Abdomen - Sluggish peristalsis in colon. Fullness and soreness in hepatic region, with moist skin. Distention with rumbling, cutting pains. Painless flatulence in small intestine. Pain in region of liver. Cutting pain in bowels, changing from place to place. Stitches in spleen, worse on inspiration, stooping. Stitches in small intestine, better pressure. Sensation of motion in intestines on expiration, around navel. Pressure with sensation of warmth in small intestine, on left side of abdomen. Pulsation in abdomen.

Female - Menses too profuse or suppressed. Metrorrhagia. Chronic uterine hemorrhage with portal derangement. Food - Poor appetite. Voracious appetite. Aversion to salt meat. Abuse of beer. Great fatigue after eating. Low blood sugar. Soups salted as usual tasted insipid, at other times well salted food is repugnant.

Chest - Pain in chest going to shoulders, back, loins and abdomen with urging to urinate. Stitching pains in lower right ribs and front, worse moving, walking. Pain during breathing. Stitches in chest, from left nipple to right downward. Diaphragm high. Constitutions - Choleric constitutions.

Heart - Pain, pressure, and stitches in region of heart. Oppression on deep breathing.

Back - Sensitiveness in dorsal and cervical vertebrae. Drawing pains in back. Drawing, tearing, burning in left shoulder blade.

Sleep - Restless sleep with frequent awakening and many dreams. Nightmares from lying on back. Fatigue with yawning. Uncontrollable yawning.

Skin - Varicose veins and ulcers. Broken or hard thrombosed veins. Itching on lying down at night. Eruption on lower part of sternum.

Modalities - Better from bleeding. Worse frorn lying on left side. Worse motion. Worse touch. Worse eating. Worse beer. Worse cellars. Mouth ' Bitter taste. Collection of water in mouth- Smooth sensation of mucus membrane °f palate, as though covered with fat-

Tongue - Tongue furred. Tongue white, white center, red tip and edges. Tongue white-coated on side, and weak. Vertigo - Vertigo with tendency to fall forward, better by nosebleed. COMMENTS - G. F. Laidlaw gave acondensed translation of Rademacher's remarks about Card-m.: “He regards hematemesis as most frequently due to chronic disease of the spleen, less frequently to disease of the liver. People who have long suffered from pains in the left hypochondrium are apt to vomit blood after which they are relieved. “Rademacher regards the bleeding as often beneficial and says it should not be checked too soon. In the treatment of hematemesis he says it is best to use a remedy that acts on the epigastric region without irritating the stomach and interfering with the healing of the lesion. Such a remedv he found in a decoction of the seeds of Card-m. “He used to give Opium before, but this, he says in some people ‘produces an array of symptoms similar to those seen in severe hemorrhage and might aggravate and condition.'” Rademacher added: “It is probable that many small hemorrhages of the stomach escape notice because there is no vomiting and that it is in this manner that obscure abdominal complaints are sometimes suddenly relieved or cured.” Burnett related the case of a girl of sixteen who had severe attacks of vomiting for three months with pains in abdomen. The vomiting was relieved by remedies symptomatically related, but the pains were not. An examination showed the “liver and spleen both very much enlarged so that they seem to fill the abdomen.” Card-m. tincture in 5 drop doses, night and morning soon cured the patient. Dudgeon gave an account of Windelband and Kunze's experience with the remedy. Windelband, in treating a woman forchronic swelling of the liver with Card-m., incidentally cured at the same time some “colossal varicose ulcers.” This experience led Dudgeon to cure a large number of similar cases with the same remedy. He also cured cases of gastrointestinal catarrh, nosebleeds, metrorrhagia, hemorrhoidal flux, dependent on portal congestion. Tenderness of the liver, bilious fever, symptoms resembling peritonitis and stitch-in-the-side have been cured by it. Kunze commended the remedy in cases of stomach spasms, contractive pains, vomiting occurring at the climax, cold rising from precordium to throat, feeling of spasmodic constriction, pressive, shooting pain in right side of abdomen spreading to back or shoulder. Kunze cured with it pains in the hepatic and splenic regions accompanied with hemoptysis, or expectoration of viscid, lumpy mucus, and evening fever. Even tuberculosis pituitosa has been cured by it. Local muscular rheumatisms dependent on liver disease. E. A. Cook gave Card-m. 1c to a patient suffering from liver congestion, swollen veins of legs, hemorrhoids and headache with great benefit to all the symptoms. On the second day the patient developed new symptoms, which she had never had before and which alarmed her greatly : “Great giddiness with inclination to fall forward and a sudden and profuse nosebleed followed by great relief.” A striking cure by Card-m. in “Miner's Disease" is recorded by Proell.: “An old miner in the gold minesof Bockstein suffered from the so-called “Bergsucht" (miner's disease). His chief symptoms were: earthy complexion, eyes dim, hardness of hearing, mucus coating on tongue, loss of appetite even for his favorite food and tobacco. “Great dyspnea and palpitations on going up-hill, spleen and stomach distended, with much gas eructated, constant borborygmus, constipation alternating with diarrhea, but the latter more frequent, evacuations gray, urine scanty and pale, skin dry as if withered, great weakness, pulse slow and weak. “Especially remarkable was the disposition of this man. Formerly cheerful, he is now joyless and apathetic, the most important events he took no notice. “He was given the tincture of Card-m., a few drops four times a day. Unable to effect any alteration in his food, drink or regimen. “A month after this he returned looking much better. On asking him how he was, he replied: ‘You have made a new man of me.' Almost all the former symptoms had disappeared and given place to the opposite. “His complexion was fresh, his eyes sparkled, he was cheerful, wished to live and work, had good appetite, motions brown, more urine passed, pulse normal. He said for the first time he knew what it was to be well and he remained so for many years.” Proell also recommended it in disorders of the liver, spleen and kidneys caused by abuse of alcoholic beverages, especially beer. He related two cases, one in a cook who had symptoms of cirrhosis of the liver and general dropsy which made her features unrecognizable, and one in a worker in a brewery who developed dropsy. Both were cured by the tincture. The brewery man, thinking the remedy was intended to be purgative and thinking the 4 drops prescribed would not be sufficient took the whole amount, 2 1/2 drachms, at one dose, without markedly bad effects and was quickly cured. Proell added that Card-m. is indicated where there is a relaxed state of the mucus membrane of the stomach. Evidenced by flatulence and diarrhea, especially when the stools are clay-colored. Much fatigue is experienced, worse after eating, when riding, on awaking, frequently accompanied by yawning. Chilliness is prominent, on awaking, at night, worse uncovering. Coldness of knees. Head very sensitive to cold. Sweating of forehead and back after meals. Stitches, drawing pressure are prominent, also radiating paints, constriction, band-sensation and cramps. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lyc., Chel. Chion., Nux-v., Podo. (2) Card, benedictus - strong action on eyes and sensation of contraction in many parts, stomach symptoms similar. (3) Merc., Bry., Aloe. (4) Bry. - nosebleed. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - L*ver, engorged, swollen laterally, painful to pressure. Hyperemia of liver. Pains in region of liver, with dizziness, ba(j taste in mouth and jaundiced skin. Cirrhosis of liver with general edema. Jaunie with dull headache, bitter taste in mouth, and white tongue. Left lobe is very sensitive. Gallstones. Gallstone diseases with an enlarged liver. Terrible attacks of gallst°ne colic. Swelling of gallbladder with painful tenderness. Stitches in liver, worse lying on left side. Liver disorders cause lung diseases, causing hemoptysis. Tens>on *n Hver when lying on right side, worse pressure. Crawling sensation. Lungs ' Asthmatic respiration. Asthma of miners. Cough with stitches in sides of chest with bloody sputum. Expectoration of pure blood, mucus mixed with blood. Splenic or hepatic cough.

Kidney stones. Limbs rheumatic pains in right deltoid. right arm. Pain in hip joint spreading through buttocks down the thighs, worse stoop*n8’ with difficult rising. Weakness fe|t jn feet, especially after sitting. Drawing Pæn *n muscles. Cramp-like pain in muscles of arms, hands, calves, and feet.

Perspiration - Sweat on forehead and back after meals. Sweats over whole body, with lassitude, on awakening. Rectum ’ Burning pain in the rectum and anus, which interferes with sitting. Itching. paste-like, clay stools. Bright yellow stools- Constipation. Stools hard, difficult, knotty, alternates with diarrhea. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Prolapse of rectum. Profuse diarrhea due to rectal cancer. Melaena. Stools either bileless or black.

Karlsbad, Dilutions. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blushing. Constipation. Cramp. Debility. Diabetes. Gout. Hot,flashes. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Sprains. Urination, urgings. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Carl, is famous for its action on the liver and in the treatment of obesity, diabetes and gout. Clarke found Carlsbad in the potencies responded admirably to its indications. General weakness with discomfort. General anxious sensation as if blood in artery would stagnate, with constant flushes of heat. Pains are dislocated and spraining, drawing, tearing, stitching, burning, dull shocks and jerks. Sensation of weakness, prostration, so that she trembled and could hold nothing securely. Tired, dejected, sluggish, anxious trembling. Great liability to take cold. Hot flashes. Flushes ofheatallover. Periodicity, effects repeated after from two to four weeks (Ox-ac., Sulph.). Itching on various parts. In homeopathic doses, Carl, is useful in weakness of all organs. Weakness of all organs of organs of speech. Weakness of bladder, stream weak and slow, only passed with assistance of abdominal muscles. Weakness of rectum, stool slow and only passed with help of distant parts of intestinal canal. Constipation. MIND - General anxious state. Excited and peevish. Feels weak and incapable. Poor self confidence. Discouraged and anxious about domestic duties. Discouraged before menses. Homesickness. Irritability. Absorbed, buried in thought. Anxiety in the house, better open air. Confusion better walking in open air. Excitement over trifles. Sympathetic, weeping from sympathy with others. Sensitive, affected to tears by the sorrows of others. Difficult thinking, indisposition to all mental exertions. Absent-minded, forgets names. Aversion to reading. Difficulty writing, often omits letters.

Eyes - Heat streams from eyes with burning and pressing in them. Violent pressure above orbits. Twitching, quivering in upper lids. Excessive lachrymation, worse using eyes. Eyes weak, water, lids agglutinated. Cannot do fine, near work. Objects swim before sight. Appearance of black spots swimming about.

Ears - Increased warmth in ear, which itches. Fine twitching from Eustachian tube to tympanum. Humming, roaring, ringing. Transient loss of hearing.

Nose - Catarrh of nose and throat, with hoarseness. Frequent sneezing, blowing out thick mucus. Swelling of nasal veins. Habitual bleeding of nose. Nosebleed on suppression of menses. Loss of smell after stoppage of nose.

Face - Face yellow, sallow, changes color. Red and hot. Pain in zygomatic process, feels as if cobwebs were on it.

Mouth - Offensive smell from mouth. Sour or salty taste. Clayey, pappy taste with salivation. Flow of saliva and frequent spitting. Dryness of whole mouth, especially roof, as if dried up, with increased thirst.

Throat - Hoarseness and roughness of voice. Constantly hawking up of much mucus.

Stomach - Sensation of emptiness. Pressure and heaviness after eating. Heartburn (Carb-v.). Frequent belching, sometimes smelling and tasting of the food, sometimes very bitter. Hiccough and yawning at same time, worse after drinking and eating. Nausea with salivation and shuddering.

Abdomen - Pressing, pinching in the hypochondria. Twitching in jerks. Burning pain in spleen. Sensation of ring stretched around abdomen.

Rectum - Burning in rectum with constant pressure. Feces held back. Stool slow and only passed by much abdominal pressure. Mucus diarrhea. Stools green, or dark green. Discharge of bloody mucus, with itching. Bleeding from hemorrhoids. Shooting pain. Gallstones passed.

Male - Testicles swollen without sign of inflammation, pressive pain.

Female - Three days aftercessation of menstruation, discharge of lumps of tenacious black blood. Hot flashes. Leucorrhea. Food - Appetite and thirst much increased. Head - Aches with swollen temporal veins (Sang.), better motion in open air. Rush of blood to head, with heaviness and confusion. Pressing, stupefying, tearing headache. Throbbing and beating in head. Hair falls out.

Chest - Heaviness, fullness, oppression, anxiety. Peculiar sensation of oppression in lower part of chest, as if lung had not room enough to expand. Stitching in chest. Weakness in the chest while writing.

Heart - Painfulness in heart, frequent transient stitching and painful drawing. Tension and contraction in heart region.

Back - Drawing pain in nape of neck and shoulder blade. Stiffness, paralysis, pressure. Heat and burning and at times a shudder over back. Tensive and pressing pains from small of back.

Limbs - Cracking in all the joints. Trembling and crawling. Restlessness of limbs, with yawning. Sensation of falling asleep, stiffness. Going-to-sleep sensation in fingertips. Heaviness of the arms after writing, with coldness. Varicoses of superficial veins of lower limbs. Lungs - Frequent hawking of mucus. Sensation of soreness, sensitiveness, scraping and tickling. Difficult breathing on ascending steps.

Sleep - Constant yawning and sleepiness, worse after a meal. Frightful dreams with tossing. Dreams are not remembered.

Modalities - Better in open air. Better on motion. Even the headaches are better by motion. Worse morning and evening. Worse after lying down in bed. Worse after eating and drinking. Worse on ascending.

Teeth - Thick, pappy mucus coating on teeth. Gums painfully swollen. Teeth loosen and fall out. Prominent teeth. Tearing in roots of upper molars, worse after every meal. Toothache, worse cold or warmth.

Tongue - Tongue coated white, with offensive smell from mouth. Vertigo - Dizzy confusion and heaviness, worse after eating, better open air. Momentary attacks of vertigo, had to hold himself up. Vertigo with turning as if in a circle, better open air. COMMENTS - The action of Carl, has been observed on some healthy persons, but the bulk of the symptoms, many of which are strikingly peculiar, have been obtained from patients under treatment. They are. however, characteristic and have furnished the indications for many homeopathic cures. W. J. Guernsey cured with it sciatica in an old man with a cramp in his left ankle. About a month after ceasing the remedy the patient complained that he felt paralyzed in the loins for several hours after rising from bed, better as the day advanced. This was a new symptom very like the Carlsbad effects. Noted periodicity, effects repeated after two to four weeks. The skin has red spots and streaks, frequently burning like fire. Pimples and pustules. Crawling and prickling on various parts with sweat breaking out. Itching on various parts. Much itching and increased sweat of genitals. Increased sensitiveness of the skin. Sensitiveness to cold air, great liability to take cold. Frequent alternations of shuddering, chilliness and heat. Flushes of heat all over, especially in face with sweat on forehead. Heat of head with redness of face and creeping shudders. Sweats more easily. Sweat stains linen yellow. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Nat-s. - sensitive to cold. (2) Carb-an. - sweat staining yellow. (3) All-c. - lachrymation, Nux-v. - worse after eating, Puls., Carb-v. - better in open air. (4) Bell., Glon. - headache. (5) Anae., Apis, Nux- m., Ph-ac. - absent-minded. Aloe. - cracking in head. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Stream weak and slow, only passed by pressing abdominal muscles. Frequent urging with discharge of copious, watery urine. Brick red sediment. Tenacious, like frog-spawn. Urine stains linen dark yellow.

Perspiration - Sweats more easily. Stains linen yellow.

full:
PHARMACY - case. Cascarilla. Sweet bark. Croton eleuteria. N. O. Euphorbiacae. Tincture of dried bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Anus, bleeding. Backache. Colic. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Intermittents. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Cascarilla has a family similarity to the other Euphorbian plants. Case, acts prominently on the digestive tract, constipation.

HOMEOPATHIC - The leading symptoms include a sensation of swelling deep down in throat. Accumulation of mucus in throat. Hunger after meals and a feeling of emptiness. Aversion to the smell of tobacco smoke. Abdominal symptoms are better by warm drinks. Feeling of movement in abdomen as if hot water undulating there. The concussion of every step is felt painfully in the stomach. Marked inclination to vomit. Griping preceding morning stool. Boils in inguinal region. Constipation. Diarrhea with backache and lassitude.

Ears - Buzzing in the ears. Internal and external heat of the ears. Food - Desire for hot drinks. Aversion to tobacco smoke. Hunger after meals.

Mouth - Roughness of the tongue. Bitter taste in the mouth. Aversion to tobacco smoke.

Throat - Sore throat on swallowing, as if from an internal swelling. COMMENTS - Marked lassitude and muscular weakness. Backache and weakness. Inclination to lie down. Sleep with clear consciousness. Heat with thirst from warm drinks (intermittents). Short, dry cough from tickling in trachea, hemoptysis. Stitch upward in left side of chest. Constant slight urging with gnawing pain high up in rectum. Constipation, stools hard in pieces, covered with mucus. Passes bright blood with or without stool in large quantities, causing weakness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crot-t. - better from warm drinks. (2) Chin. - effects of loss of blood intermittents. (3) Graph. - mucus with stools. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Heat in the stomach and burning pain in the epigastrium. Pressure on the stomach, as if from fullness. Pain in the stomach as from concussion. Pain in stomach as from a shock. Nausea and vomiting. Pressing colic.

Abdomen - Tension and pressure on the hypochondria. Movement in the abdomen as if hot water were undulating there. Flatulent, aching colic.

Rectum - Constipation, stools hard, covered with mucus (Graph.). Bright blood with stool. Diarrhea alternating with hard, lumpy stool, with backache and lassitude, preceded by griping. Gnawing pain high up in rectum .

Chest - Hemoptysis. Stitch upwards on left side.

Back - Backache and weakness, muscles pained violently.

full:
PHARMACY - cassi-s.Cassiasophera. Senna sophera. Senna esculenta. N. O. Legumino- sae, Caesalpinioideae.

CLINICAL - Dyspnea. Knee, pain. Osteoarthritis.

HERBAL - Cassia sophera is indigenous to India and has been frequently used by ancient Indian physicians for its efficacy in respiratory disorders. Its Sanskrit name ‘Kasamarda' which means ‘Destroyer of Cough.' An effective herbal laxative is made from the senna pods, and leaves. The purgative constituents are closely allied to those of Aloes and Rhubarb. The active substances are glycosides called sennosides. Senna pods have a milder effect and have fewer side-effects than Senna leaves. The main effect is an increase in intestinal peristalsis and a reduction in the water absorption of the intestinal wall, which leads to accelerated stools. Side effects, especially from fresh senna leaves, are intense cramp, excessive abdominal cramps, and irritation of bladder and uterus. Senna should not be administered to people who suffer from hemorrhoids or enteritis. Their use during pregnancy or the lactation period is not recommended because of their excretion via the mother's milk.

HOMEOPATHIC - Two provings were undertaken by the Indian Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy. The first proving (1972-74) included 21 males and 9 females, the second (1974-76) 24 males and 13 females. Both provings were carried out with the mother tincture, 30th and 200th centesimal potencies. MIND - Anxiety about future. Causeless anxiety. Anxiety and restlessness. Fear to go to sleep lest heart would stop beating. Anxiety and fear of losing his way home. Forgetful of duties and of facts. Forgets to lock his room. Changeable moods. Intolerant of contradiction. Angry when contradicted. Desire to be alone. Desire to lie down quietly. Aversion to talk to others.

Head - Dull pain in temporal and frontal regions. Headaches, worse heat, daytime. Headaches, better cold applications, tight bandaging. Bursting pain in forehead, worse motion, exertion, stooping, Bursting pain in forehead, better pressure, tight bandage, open air, lying down. Hammering pain in forehead, worse heat, better gentle pressure. Sensation of heat in forehead, worse sun, better cold bath. Heaviness sensation, worse talking, better keeping quiet. Heaviness in forehead, worse evening, exertion, stooping. Heaviness in forehead, better morning, lying down, pressure. Heaviness in occiput, worse exertion, warmth. Heaviness in occiput, better washing head with cold water, better lying down, pressure.

Eyes - Itching of upper lids, worse sunlight, better cold applications. Heaviness of eyelids, better cold open air. Burning pain in eyes, worse motion, pressure, warmth. Burning pain in eyes, better lying down, after sleep, cold applications. Pain in eyes, worse bending head forward, better closing eyes. Food - Diminished appetite. Excessive hunger. Thirstlessness. Thirst for large quantities of water at frequent and long intervals. Thirst for small quantities of water at frequent intervals. Aversion to bread. Desires curd, eggs, pickles. Desires salty things, sweets. Desires warm drinks, warm food. Better milk. Better hot tea. Better cold drinks. Worse fatty foods.

Ears - Aching pain in ears, worse eating. Heat flushes in ears during vertigo.

Nose - Nasal obstruction at night, worse cold. Nasal obstruction, better daytime, warmth. Followed by watery nasal discharge. Profuse, thin, watery, bland discharge. Dryness of nose in morning, followed by watery discharge during daytime.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth and increased thirst. Excessive salivation and impaired taste.

Throat - Dryness better sipping cold water. Sensation of heat spreading over whole body, better cold drinks. Burning pain, worse cold air, cold applications, swallowing, better hot tea. Vertigo - Vertigo better lying down. Vertigo with a tendency to fall forward or backward. Heat flushes in ears during vertigo. Dim vision during vertigo. Nausea preceded by vertigo. Vision - Blurred vision during menses. Dim vision during vertigo, better cold applications. COMMENTS - Clarke mentions for Senna: “a nasty unclean smell from the body.” “Of 16 patients presenting unspecific pain in the knee joints, with the modalities mentioned above, 15 were relieved after taking Cassia. This indicates its possible use in osteoarthritis.” (Central Council). "Although dyspnea was observed in a prover during the course of proving, the modalities have only been obtained and confirmed during the clinical studies.” (Central Council). “While proving the vertigo symptom was accompanied by a tendency to fall forward, the clinically confirmed symptom was accompanied by a tendency to fall backward.” (Central Council). RELATIONS - Antidotes: Nux-v., Cham. Compare: (V)Bry. Kali-c., Nux-v. (2)Senn., (Cassia acutifolia.. Cassia angustifolia., Cassia obovata). REFERENCES - Central Council. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Excessive hunger and gnawing sensation in epigastrium, better eating, milk. Nausea preceded by vertigo.

Abdomen - Fldtulence and distension of abdomen, worse morning, evening, better after eating, drinking water. Intense abdominal cramps. Squeezing, crampy, colicky pain in right hypochondrium, worse after eating, worse fatty foods. Colicky pain worse changing position, bending forward. Colicky pain better fasting, gentle pressure and rest. Colicky pain worse lying on right side, better lying on left side.

Chest - Chest pain with coughs. In the proving the chest pain was confined to the left side.

Back - Backache in dorsal region, scapula, worse cold air, better heat of sun, pressure. Pain in lumbar region, worse bending forward, better pressure. Sensation of heaviness in cervical region, worse bending forward, better pressure. Perspiration at cervical region during fever.

Limbs - Pain in knee joints, worse first movement, rising from seat, better continued motion, pressure. Lungs - Difficult breathing, worse dust, smoke. Dyspnea, worse winter, change of weather. Dyspnea, worse cold drinks, walking. Thick, yellow expectoration.

Sleep - Disturbed sleep. Sleeplessness before midnight.

Skin - Eruptions, like ringworm on thighs. Itching, worse night, better scratching.

Modalities - Better rest and pressure. Better lying quietly. Better cold, cold applications. Better cold air. Better cold drinks. Worse warmth. Worse motion (pains).

Teeth - Pain in teeth and gums with earache, worse eating, pressing teeth together.

Bladder - Irritation of bladder.

Cough - Dry cough worse lying on right side. Cough with pain in chest. Cough and thick, yellow expectoration. Cough worse in morning and evening. Cough better from warmth.

Perspiration - Profuse perspiration, face and axilla. Unclean smell from the body. Rectum - Ineffectual urge to pass stool. Constipation, no urge for 3 to 4 days. Stool passed after great straining.

full:
PHARMACY - cast-eq. Castor equi. Rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Triturations are made from the scales of rudimentary thumbnail of the horse. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Breasts, swollen. Coccyx, pain. Fainting. Epilepsy. Nails, disorders. Nipples, cracked. Nipples, ulcerated. Psoriasis. Skin, disorders. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - This is a very ancient remedy and was proved and introduced into homeopathy by Hering. The clinical experience of Hering and his fellow-provers has shown this to be highly useful remedy in cracked and ulcerated nipples. Cast-eq. especially acts on the nipples, the nails and bones, causing pains in right tibia and coccyx. General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Nails become brittle and fall off. Chapped hands. Affects principally female organs, especially the nipples. Cracked and ulcerated nipples of nursing women, excessively tender, cannot bear the touch of clothing. Warts on forehead, breasts. Psoriasis of the tongue. Bones, especially tibia and coccyx are painful. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco. MIND - Unusual laughter about things not funny.

Head - Sensation as if occiput had gone to sleep. Scalp goes to sleep, numb. As if something crawling in hair. Pressure in forehead. Pressive pain in temples. Deep pressure in occiput. Headache with vertigo and nausea, sour stomach and lack of appetite.

Eyes - Frequent twitching in right eyelid. Itching in canthi.

Ears - Sensation of dryness in left ear, compelling to scratch. Twitching, internally in left ear.

Nose - Pressive pain in nasal bones. Coryza, fluent, with constant sensation of hunger, even after eating

Face - Sensation as if trismus. Transitory, burning, prickling pain in face and also on body. Prickling and heat on both cheeks. Dry lips with thirst in evening. Food - Sense of hunger, even after eating, during coryza. Lack of appetite during headache. Desire to smoke tobacco. Great accumulation of saliva, immediately after eating. Soon after pains in teeth, loud rumbling in abdomen.

Mouth - Burning, on front of tongue. Psoriasis of the tongue. Pain in hollow teeth of left side, must pick them.

Throat - Disagreeable, sick feeling in larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo, headache and nausea in mornings, sour stomach and lack of appetite. COMMENTS - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Principally affects the female organs. Cracked and ulcerated nipples (Sars., Sil., Petr., Calen.), especially of nursing women. Nipples excessively tender, cannot bear touch of clothing. Chapped hands. Fainting. Epilepsy. Desire to smoke tobacco. Psoriasis of tongue. Warts on forehead and breasts. Burnett cured with it a case of wart on forehead. RELATIONS - Compare: (I) Calc-ox., Hipp., Cast., Mosch. Graph. (2) Hep. relieves the sore nipples. (3) Thuj. has removed warts caused by Cast-eq. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak. Murphy.

Stomach - Repeated empty eructations.

Abdomen - Colic with urging wakes him in the morning, followed by a very thin, watery, somewhat burning stool, with passage of offensive flatus. Pain in left inguinal region.

Rectum - Urgent stool, preceded by colic and passage of flatus.

Chest - Burning pains on chest.

Heart - Peculiar sensation about heart as of something alive struggling.

Back - Weakness of spine. Pain in coccyx, worse every evening, while sitting. Breasts - Breasts swollen, sensitive, worse descending stairs. Nipples almost hanging. Cracked, sore nipples in nursing women, excessively tender, cannot bear touch of clothing, even in neglected cases, ragged. Swelling of breasts. Violent itching in breasts. Reddened areola.

Limbs - Repeated pain in right tibia. Arms and legs sore as if beaten. Pain in left elbow and right knee. Right wrist-joint as if sprained. Very brittle nails. Crumbling of fingernails from slightest knock against them.

Sleep - Restless sleep with numbness of right arm. Sleepiness in early evening. Stretches arms up over head and cracks fingers during sleep. Restless sleep, with many dreams. In winter dreams of fresh fruit hanging on trees.

Skin - General action on thickening of the skin and epithelium. Warts. Psoriasis. Nails drop off. Brittle nails.

name: Castoreum Canadense
author: Murphy

Pregnancy, vomiting. Prostration. Reaction, deficient. Sexual, disorders. Sycosis. Tetanus. Typhoid. Typhus. Warts. Yawning.
keynote: PHARMACY - cast. Castoreum canadense. Beaver secretion. N. O. Rodentia. Tincture of secretion, found in preputial sacs of beaver. Castoreum when fresh is yellow and of the consistence of syrup, when dry it is dark red or brown and of the consistence of hard wax. Historical dose:…
full:
PHARMACY - cast. Castoreum canadense. Beaver secretion. N. O. Rodentia. Tincture of secretion, found in preputial sacs of beaver. Castoreum when fresh is yellow and of the consistence of syrup, when dry it is dark red or brown and of the consistence of hard wax. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chorea. Colic. Convulsions. Day-blindness. Digestion, disordered. Dysmenorrhea. Eclampsia. Epilepsy. Flatulence. Hernia.Hysteria. Ileus. Menstrual colic. Paralysis. Pregnancy, vomiting. Prostration. Reaction, deficient. Sexual, disorders. Sycosis. Tetanus. Typhoid. Typhus. Warts. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caspari proved Russian Cast., Nenning, that of Southern Europe. Teste remarked that Cast, has been regarded as a resinous substance and he observed, moreover, that the beaver feeds almost entirely on the resinous bark of pine trees. In Siberia, beavers feed on the bark of the birch, which may make a difference in the effects of Cast, from different countries. Cast, is a great remedy for hysteria. Weakness and lack of reaction. Marked prostration. Nervous palpitations. Nervous women who do not recover fully, but are continually irritable and suffer from debilitating sweats. Constant yawning. Restless sleep with frightful dreams and starts. Day blindness, cannot endure the light. Spasmodic disorders after debilitating diseases. Creeping, tingling sensation, worse sleep. Chorea. Epilepsy. Fibrillar twitch- ings. Heaviness of the whole body. Pains are better by pressure, rubbing. Reflex uterine effects, are nervous and spasmodic. Menstrual colic with pallor and cold sweat. Feeling of fullness in the stomach as if too much had been eaten. MIND - Irritability. Easily sheds tears. Melancholic and full of anxious longings.

Eyes - Day blindness. Cannot endure the light.

Ears - Acute dragging in the ears. Tinkling, buzzing, and gurgling in the ears, dispersed by boring the ear with the finger.

Nose - Obstruction of the nose. Flow of aqueous, acrid, corrosive mucus from the nose.

Mouth - Tongue, swollen, twitching. Round pea-like elevation in center of tongue with redness around. Tongue sensitive to touch or food, with drawing pain towards hyoid bone.

Throat - Hoarseness, with disposition to clear throat. Dryness of esophagus. Burning pain in the throat, as from heartburn. COMMENTS - Cast, resembles Ambr., Mosch., Ign. and Valer. Teste placed Cast, in the Thuj. group with Plat, and Bism. Teste concluded from analogy that Cast, would be an anti- sycotic, and he proved his point by initiating with it the cure of a case of pedunculated vegetations around the anus in a hysterical young woman. Thuj. completed the cure. Teste quoted from Trousseau and Pi- deux the following indications, which he confirmed: ( 1 ) Amenorrhea, accompanied with painful and tympanitic swelling of the abdomen. We mean the cases where only a few drops of blood escape from the uterus with a sort of uterine tenesmus. (2) The cases of colic to which Castoreum seems to be principally adapted are of the nervous kind, that seem to be particularly seated in the small intestine. They are accompanied with paleness and cold sweats, a sudden sinking of strength, as if the very principle of life had been struck down. They are without any alvine evacuations, come suddenly after lively emotions, a cold on the bowels or by the feet, as after long exposure to a cold rain. Cast, causes jerking in small groups of muscular tissues, a sensation of heaviness of whole body, trembling of limbs. RELATIONS -Antidote: Colch. Compare: (Ï) Ambra, Mosch., Mur-ac., Valer. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Regurgitation of a bitter acidity. Vomiting of white, bitter mucus. Sensation of contraction and pain of ulceration.

Abdomen - Colic or other abdominal complaints, accompanied with yawning. Colic with weakness, better pressure.

Rectum - Summer diarrhea with green, mucus stools.

Male - Seminal emissions with great excitability.

Female - Pain commences in middle of thighs. Violent, cutting dysmenorrheal colic with a few drops of blood, then cold sweat. Amenorrhea with a painful tympanites. Food - Repugnance to food and constant nausea. Violent thirst, could not drink enough.

Chest - Stitches in chest, heat as if fire were burning in it. Constitutions - Suited to nervous women with pains, cramps, and weakness after severe illness. Hysterical individuals. Abdominal soreness. Nervous attacks when the aura starts from abdomen.

Back - Pain as from excoriation, in the sacral region and back. Drawing pains in nape of the neck.

Limbs - Nocturnal dragging in shoulders and arms. Spasms of hands and feet. Hands hot with swelling of veins. Weakness of the lower limbs. Lungs - Breathing is short, difficult. Short breath when ascending. Slow, deep inspiration with short expiration.

Sleep - Constant yawning as accompanied symptom. Yawns in sleep. Restless sleep with frightful dreams and starts.

Modalities - Better from pressure. Worse from emotions. Worse cold. Worse during menses. Worse debilitating diseases.

Teeth - Toothache when eating, provoked by cold and mitigated by hot things. Toothache with acute drawing pains. Swelling of the gums at night, with acute pulling in the temples.

Kidneys - Frequent emission of urine, with burning thirst, day and night. After the emission of urine, desire to vomit with disgust.

Temperature - Predominant chilliness. Chilliness with icy coldness in back. Exhausting sweats after fevers.

name: Caulophyllum Thalictroides
author: Murphy
constitution: After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera, morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ovarian, neuralgia. Paraplegia. Pityriasis. Pregnancy, Caulophyllum thalictroides disorders. Premature, labor. Rheumati

full:
PHARMACY - caul. Caulophyllum thalic- troides. Blue cohosh. Squaw root. Leontice thalictroides. N. O. Berberidacae. Tincture or trituration of mol. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - After-pains. Amenorrhea. Aphthae. Bearing-down, pains. Breast, pains. Chloasma. Cholera, morbus. Chorea. Dysmenorrhea. False, labor. Feet, disorders. Gonorrhea. Hands, disorders. Infertility. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Menopause. Menorrhagia. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriages. Ovarian, neuralgia. Paraplegia. Pityriasis. Pregnancy, Caulophyllum thalictroides disorders. Premature, labor. Rheumatic, gout. Rheumatism. Thrush. Trembling. Uterine, spasm. Uterine atony. Weakness.

HERBAL - Caul., the Blue Cohosh, is closely related in action to Cimic., the Black Cohosh, though they belong to different families of plants.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caul, has only had one proving, by Dr. Burt, the majority of the indications were derived from tradition and clinical experience. Caul, acts most markedly on the female generative organs and on rheumatic states. Lack of tone of the uterus. Left ovarian and left infra-breast pains. Leucorrhea in young girls or during pregnancy. Complaints due to uterine disorders. Bearing-down pains. Uterine spasms (Sep.). False labor pains. During labor, when the pains are deficient and the patient is exhausted and fretful. Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or they are too painful. Internal trembling with weakness. Exhaustion and general debility. Reflex symptoms having a uterine origin, like headaches, hoarseness, rheumatism, vomiting, cramps and spasms. Hysterical or epileptiform spasms at puberty, during dysmenorrhea. Chorea at puberty. A rheumatic remedy, especially acting on small joints. Erratic pains flying about from place to place, drawing, cramping, shooting, rheumatic in character, ending in neck which gets stiff. Thrush, locally and internally. Paraplegia from disorders of the uterus. Paraplegia after childbirth. MIND - Nervous. Excitable. Fretful, irritable and apprehensive. Easily displeased.

Head - Headaches from uterine or spinal troubles. Headaches over left eye, pressure behind eye, severe by spells, worse stooping, from light, from noon until night.

Eyes - Drawing pains over the left eye. Eyes aching, with a feeling of something under the lids. Profuse secretion of tears. Face - Moth spots on forehead, with leucor- rhea. Heavy upper lid, has to raise them with fingers, with leucorrhea.

Mouth - Aphthae. Thrush. Tongue coated white. Teeth feel sore and elongated.

Throat - Pain in the fauces. Frequent inclination to swallow. COMMENTS - Threatened miscarriage due to uterine atony, with a history of habitual abortion or miscarriage. Weak, atonic uterus (Sep.). Inertia of the uterus. False conception or pregnancy. Sterility with a history of uterine atony or a prolapsed or weak uterus. Can be used for tendency to miscarriage, long ineffectual labor, weakness after childbirth, postpartum depression, but not in general during pregnancy because it can stimulate labor. Labor with a full feeling, bearing down with a rigid os, severe labor pains accompanied by severe exhaustion. Exhausting labor, weak pains. Ineffectual labor (Puls.), false labor, premature labor. Rigid os, will not dilate further during labor, with thirst (Gels, is not thirsty, Bell., Verat-v.). 1 Lack of expulsive power where the placenta is retained, internal trembling. White, milk-like vaginal discharge after childbirth that persists for weeks with exhaustion. Postpartum hemorrhage with passive oozing coupled with exhaustion, venous hemorrhage. Cervical erosion with a milky white discharge and chorine fatigue. Cervicitis (yellow-green discharge. Thuj.), indurated cervix (Con.). Extreme fatigue and uterine weakness (Helon., keynote is they have a consciousness of the womb). Antispasmodic. Menstrual cramps with severe fatigue and exhaustion, labor-like pains. Drawing pain in the thigh, feels heavy and tired. Vaginitis with bearing down pains in the uterus, acrid and burning leucorrhea. Exhausted with vaginitis, thirsty. Menopause and hot flashes with weakness (Sep.). Chorea at puberty. Problems at puberty, including weakness, menstrual cramps that come since first menses (Puls.). Was given, with some success, for chloasma and pityriasis versicolor, curing dysmenorrhea at the same time. Great nervous excitement, tremulous weakness over whole body. Sleepless and restless, but exhausted. Can scarcely speak. Sleepless, restless, nervous, recalling the effects of coffee, which is incompatible with it. Generally chilly and wants warm clothing. Arthritis in the smalljoints, fingers, wrists, toes and ankles, especially if since childbirth or menopause, or since some problem with the uterus. Painful, swollen joints during pregnancy. Drawing pains in the joints with the menstrual cramps, as though the tendons had contracted. Rheumatic disorders of the small joints and muscles. Pains are intermittent and paroxysmal and fly about from place to place, generally worse at night. Erratic, wandering pains from joint to joint, stiffness in the fingers. Joints are swollen and painful. Stiff neck. Nash regarded “internal trembling” as a strong characteristic when associated with the weakness, he cured long-continued passive hemorrhage associated with these symptoms. Nash prescribed Caul. 3c for a woman of forty, seven months pregnant, who was attacked with severe pain and swelling of all the finger joints, wrapping them in mustard was the only thing that relieved her sufficiently to allow her to get sleep. Caul, relieved the finger pains, but caused such severe labor-like pains that it had to be discontinued for fear of causing miscarriage. The bearing-down then ceased and the finger pains returned and continued until delivery, when they ceased for a few days. Then the lochia increased to a flooding, a passive, dark, liquid with great weakness and internal trembling. Now the terrible finger pains returned. Afraid to give Caul., other remedies were tried, but in vain. At last Nash gave Caul. 200c, which rapidly cleared up the whole case. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Viol-o. - rheumatic carpal and metacarpal joints. (2) Cimic., Sep. (3) Gels, in dysmenorrhea, it is like Gels, and follows it well. (4) Puls, in labor-pains, but the mental condition is opposite, Cimic. (5) Bell, in intermittent and paroxysmal pains, Calc. - leucorrhea in little girls. (6) Lil-t., Lach., Sulph., Ust. and Vib-od. in left ovarian and infrabreast pains. (7) Mag-m. in uterine spasms, Bry. in rheumatism. (8) Sec., Sep., Goss. Incompatible: Coffea. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Cardialgía, spasms of the stomach. Dyspepsia with spasmodic symptoms. Frequent gulping of sour, bitter fluid, with vertigo. Vomiting of uterine origin.

Abdomen - Drawing pains in the right side over the liver. Severe colic. Pain in the umbilicus.

Rectum - Stool, soft white. Watery stools, great quantity.

Male - Sharp, stinging pains in glans penis. Modalities - Worse from pregnancy. Worse suppressed menses. Worse open air. Worse coffee.

Female - Habitual or threaten miscarriage from uterine atony (Helon., Puls., Sep.). False labor pains. Labor pains are weak or irregular, they cease from exhaustion or they are too painful. Revives labor pains and furthers progress of labor. Spasmodic and severe pains, which fly in all directions, shivering without prog- ress. Extraordinary rigidity of os (Bell., Gels., Verat-v.). After-pains. Profuse and prolonged lochia. Menorrhagia after hasty labor, flow very profuse. Profuse menses, late. Violent, intermittent cramping pains with little flow. Dysmenorrhea. Uterus retroverted. Irritable vagina, spasmodic intense pains. Leucorrhea with moth-spots on forehead. Profuse acrid leucorrhea, often in little girls. Needle-like pains in cervix. Placenta is retained.

Back - Rheumatic stiffness of neck. Severe drawing in sternocleidomastoid, drawing head to left. Dull pains in lumbar region. Causations - Childbirth. Miscarriages. Constitutions - Rheumatic constitutions.

Neck - Stiff, with head drawn to left. Nose - Drawing pains in the nose.

Limbs - Rheumatism of small joints. Severe drawing, erratic pain and stiffness in small joints, fingers, toes, ankles, etc. Aching in wrists. Sore nodes on finger joints. Cutting pain in fingers joints on closing hands. Erratic pains, changing place every few minutes. Aching, sore lower limbs, before menses. Paraplegia after childbirth. Lungs - Hoarseness and loss of voice. Panting breathing.

Skin - Chloasma, on neck. Discoloration of skin in women with menstrual and uterine disorder. Hot and dry skin.

Temperature - As if too full of blood. High fever.

name: Causticum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cold drinks (even chill). Better damp wet weather. Better washing. Better warmth of bed. Better gentle motion. Worse in clear fine weather. Worse dry cold air. Worse winds, drafts. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse change of weather. Worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Worse evenings at 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. Worse twilight. Worse darkness. Worse exertion. Worse stooping. Worse motion of carriage. Worse taking hold of anything. Worse bathing in the river in summer. Worse after stool. Worse from suppressed eruptions. Worse coffee, fats, sour things..
constitution: Acne rosacea. Amaurosis. Arthritis. Bell's palsy. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Bronchitis. Bums. Cataract. Chorea. Coccyx, pain. Constipation. Convulsions. Cough. Deafness. Dentition. Diphtheria. Ears, otorrhea. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eye, disorders. Facial, paralysis. Fistula. Goiter. Hemorrhoids. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heel, blistered. Herpes, zoster. Hip, disease. Impotence. Influenza.
