CLINICAL - Aphthae. Asthma. Catarrh. Chlorosis. Colds. Convulsions. Coughs. Croup. Dentition. Diphtheria. Gastritis. Hemoptysis. Impotence. Laryngismus. Pleurisy. Sore throat. Tuberculosis. Typhus. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Chlorum has been proved in the form of “Chlorine water, ” and has been tested clinically. Marked effect on the respiratory organs, producing spasm of the glottis as the chief symptom of the drug. Asthma to relieve the spasm of glottis. Useful externally and internally in gangrene. Spasms and convulsions. Laryngeal spasm is especially pronounced, the chief difficulty is in exhaling, can draw in the air well enough. Coryza and catarrh. Convulsive attacks on cutting eye-teeth. Mouth inflamed, ulcerated. Rapid emaciation. Acute rheumatic pains. MIND - Irritability, inclined to anger. Marked loss of memory, especially for names. Apprehension. Fear of becoming crazy. Fear of poverty. Inclined to anger. Want of selfconfidence. Effects of excitement. Quiet de- lirium, alternating with greatest restlessness and desire to run away. Coma, fainting with cold, viscous sweats.

Head - Painful aching in vertex and down left side, with inclination to lie down. Warm sweat breaks out on forehead while coughing.

Eyes - Running of tears, worse in open air. Suddenly numerous, fantastic images appeared before the eyes, disappearing with lightning-like rapidity.

Nose - Nose dry, smoky or sooty. Corrosive feeling in corners of nose. Violent sneezing, in the morning. Sudden running in drops of sharp corroding fluid with tears in eyes, dry tongue, palate and fauces. Coryza with headache. Thin coryza, soon changing to yellow, copious mucus. Loss of smell.

Face - Face swollen with protruding eyes. Face pale, often greenish. Heightened color.

Mouth - Mouth dry. Putridodorfrommouth. Very acid saliva. Aphthae. Tongue black, as if burnt.

Throat - Dry, sore from uvula to bronchi. Choking sensation, inability to swallow. COMMENTS - Excessive sensitiveness of skin. Nettle rash with fever. Cutis anserina. Skin dry, yellow, shriveled. Malignant pustule and car- buncle. Typhoid state. Fears he will go crazy, that he won't be able to make a living. Cannot remember names of people he sees, or if he sees the names, cannot remember the person. E. Z. Bacon recorded two cases of chlorine poisoning. The first case was in a boy of 5, who, after passing through diphtheria to apparent complete recovery, was suddenly seized with symptoms of croup. Loss of voice, crowing inspiration, prolonged expiration incessant dry cough, great restlessness, high fever, and profuse perspiration. The symptoms were worse lying on a lounge by the fire, better when lying in his mother's lap and still more relieved by being carried about. During the previous illness, Platt's chlorides had been placed in the room as a disinfectant and it occurred to the doctor that chlorine vapor is much heavier than air. He himself lay down, and in a few minutes felt the irritating vapor and began to cough and hack. This soon passed away on sitting up. The removal of the chlorides has a remarkable effect on the child, cough and respiration were greatly relieved. But the relief came too late, as the cause was not discovered for several days during which time the patient had become steadily weaker, and he died the same afternoon. The other case was that of an old woman who suffered from chronic bronchitis and on January 2,1892, developed an attack of laryngitis. In three days she was well, but in the two subsequent weeks, on exactly the same day, a fresh attack occurred. As the doctor soon discovered, his patient went to the back room, where chlorides were kept, every Monday to wash a few things she did not care to send to the laundry. The chlorides were banished, and though the washing was continued, there were no more attacks of laryngitis. Dr. Bacon added, that since giving up the use of disinfectants, other than plenty of fresh air, he has never had laryngeal complications in scarlatina or diphtheria, though his neighbors have had plenty. Whitman recommended chlorine water as a efficient palliative in a fit of asthma. He began with 10 drops, then in five minutes 20 more, and than in another five minutes, half a teaspoonful in a little water. It greatly facilitates expectoration. In typhus fever, Goullon recommended chlorine water, five drops every two or three hours until the tongue is dry. Clarke had excellent results from the 12c and 30c in nasal catarrh and in breathlessness remaining after acute bronchitis. RELATIONS - It is antidote to: Hydrocyanic acid and Sulfuretted hydrogen. Albumen. Compare: (1) Meph. - inability to exhale, closely resembles Bromine and Iodine. (2) Nat-m. - sore mouth and other chlorides. (3) Lyc. - impotence. (4) Plb-a. - blood-spitting and pleurisy. Follows well: Phos. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Acid stomach and other gastric troubles (in workmen exposed to chlorine fumes and who eat chalk for it). Desire to vomit when coughing, without nausea.

Stool - Diarrhea in the morning, with dry mouth, after the eruption appears with typhus. Bright blood stools. Hemorrhage in typhus, blood black, coagulated or thin, smelling like carrion.

Male - Sudden impotence and aversion to sexual intercourse.

Heart - Increased action of the heart. Lungs - Constriction with suffocation. Inspiration free with obstructed expiration (Meph.). Sudden dyspnea from spasm of the vocal cords with staring protruding eyes, blue face, cold sweat, pulse small. Spasm of the glottis. Irritation of epiglottis, larynx and bronchials. Coryza with sudden gushes of sharp, corroding fluid, making nose sore inside. Prolonged, loud, whistling rales. Loss of voice from damp air. Sooty, smoky nostrils, livid face.

Modalities - Chest affections better from open air, causes running of tears. Spasm of glottis worse from midnight to 7 a.m. Nasal complaints worse lying down. Inclination to lie down with headache. Restless, worse walking up and down. Sitting with sun shining on back causes shuddering. Damp air causes loss of voice.

Teeth - Sensation as if teeth were too full, as if injured by acids. Black teeth.

Temperature - Chilliness and crawls, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Burning, dry heat with anxiety and raving. Genial glow all over with night-sweat. Cold sweat. Viscous sweat. Typhus.

name: Chocolate
author: Murphy
constitution: Anxiety. Fears. Poor memory.
keynote:
PHARMACY - choc. Chocolate. Cocoa. Theobroma cocoa. Theobroma cacao. N. O. Sterculiaceae. Tribe, Buettnerieae. Tropical America. Trituration of the seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anxiety. Fears. Poor memory.

HOMEOPATHIC - “Theobroma” is Greek…
full:
PHARMACY - choc. Chocolate. Cocoa. Theobroma cocoa. Theobroma cacao. N. O. Sterculiaceae. Tribe, Buettnerieae. Tropical America. Trituration of the seeds. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anxiety. Fears. Poor memory.

HOMEOPATHIC - “Theobroma” is Greek for “Food of the Gods." Mayan Indian legend has it that the cocoa tree was a gift from the gods. The Mayas believed the drink made from the cocoa seeds would nourish them after death. The Aztecs believed cocoa would relieve their fatigue and stimulate their mental and psychic abilities. The Spanish invaders were surprised to find that the cocoa beans were valued more than any other substance, even more than gold. The Aztecs used a chocolate drink as a base in many of their medicinal formulas. The Aztec nobility used the chocolate drink favored with vanilla and spices as a pleasurable drink. The main ingredients of chocolate are caffeine, phenyl ethylamine, theobromine and theophylline. Feeding with waste chocolate led to fatal poisoning in calves. The animals showed excitement, stared about in all directions, walked with exaggerated strides and had convulsions. One calf died, possibly from heart failure. Sherr wrote “My 22 month old male Tibetan Terrier ate a large bar of Bourneville chocolate. He became extremely hyperactive, panting, restless, couldn’t stay still in one place, ran up and down stairs. He came up and licked me, went away, came back, went outside, came inside and two hours after eating the chocolate, he gave a large moan, wail and died instantly, outside in the sun from a heart attack.” Scalp warm and itchy. Back of neck itchy. Under axilla itchy. Skin dry and rough. Skin burns easily. Gums bleeding while cleaning teeth. Catarrhal congestion in head. Catarrhal deafness ameliorated when ears pop. Ache in big toe joints. Mind rushing and jumping from one thing to another. Irritability. Startled by sudden noises. Unease and discomfort with men. Anxiety before meeting people. Poor memory. Vivid and prolonged dreams. Dreams of fire. Desire for chocolate and ice cream. MIND - Moods changeable. Emotional highs and lows, Very depressed. Activity alternating with lethargy. Slow mind, has to think before answering questions. Weepy during menses, took everything to heart. More sensitive to music. Selfish, impatient and intolerant. Irritable. Sarcastic, mocking people, aggressive in ajoking way. Humorless, intolerant, almost cruel. Anxiety that something would happen. Feels open and vulnerable. Fear of accidents, cars, being attacked. Fear of dogs. Fear of something happening. Paranoid. Anxiety about health. Apprehensive. Nervous thinks someone would notice. Feels panicky about work things to do. Difficult concentration. Forgetful, absent minded. Reading is impossible. Aversion to writing. Mistakes in writing. Mind is repeating the same things over and over. Jumping from subject to subject while speaking. Nervous and stuttering. Grief and despair. Lost interest in loved ones, feels totally indifferent. Self-conscious, anxious and vulnerable as if being watched. Feels rejected and oversensitive. Hid away from the world, feels life would fall apart. Felt isolated. Unsociable, averse company and conversation. Desire to be alone in the evening.

Head - Sensation of congestion in head. Sensation of tightness around head. Sensation of forehead protruding. Head feels big, worse right side. Head is heavy. Dull sensation between vertex and occiput on mid-line. Top of head feels sensitive, better after eating. Sutures feels more pointed, like the top of a roof. Sensation as if something loose in head, as if a string connected uvula to sinuses. Sensation as if a cold spot went through head. Frontal headache. Sharp pain at top of forehead. Headache like a band around head. Throbbing pain over left eye. Headache feels like rod pushing my head apart from inside. Pounding inside head. Headache behind eyes and throbbing pain around temples. Pressure over eyes, better lying down. Headache, worse coughing, better holding head. Headache with earache. Awake from severe headache. Vomiting with migraines. Dry, very large, flaky dandruff. Hair is very dry and lifeless.

Eyes - Right eye sticky and closed. Eyes tired and smarting, desire to clench lids together. Eyes inflamed with flushed face. Tension in the eyeballs. Eyes feel heavy, with dryness and pressure at the back of the eyes. Eyelids feel wider and higher. Eyes painful and feel swollen. Eyes ache, sensitive to pressure. Deep pain overright eye. Bruised feeling over right eye. Right eye felt lower than left eye. Eyes sore and stinging, better pressing lids with fingers. Heavy feeling over eyes. Pupils dilated during headache. Looking down when walking, ground seems further away. Dark specks falling down in profusion while reading. Tired feeling in artificial light. Photophobia.

Ears - Feeling of fullness, buzzing or fuzziness in both ears, worse left. Tingling sensation left ear, worse loud music. Ears feel blocked. Ears popped and buzzed while eating. Dullness of hearing until ears popped. Flushed and hot ears. Left ear burning and red. Ears burning, extending occasionally to mastoids. Sensitive feeling in ears. Intense pain behind right ear. Pulsations in ear and neck. Hearing more acute, especially for deeper tones which have more resonance.

Nose - Nose feels smaller or longer and face feels sharper. Nose is cold, wet and dripping. Nose blocked with thick mucus in warm indoors. Nose stuffy and runny. Awakes with runny nose, phlegm in throat. Clear discharge with itching at end of nostrils. Constant desire to blow nose. Green oryellow mucus, with small amount blood. Clear, white, bubbly discharge in evening. Sneezing, followed by coryza. Nosebleed. Pimple inside upper right nostril. Acute sense of smell, especially to flowers.

Face - Skin of face dry, chapped, very thin, blotchy and wrinkly. Face flushed and hot, red after supper. Red and livid spot on left cheek. Skin on cheekbones tingles and burns. Twitching under right eye. Deep ache in left jaw, extending to ear. Numbness around lips extending to nostrils. Rash around mouth, worse left side. Lips dry and cracked. Cold sore on lips.

Mouth - Dry mouth. Bad taste in mouth with thirst. Taste of nicotine in mouth, like an old ashtray. Tea tasted of nothing, just hot water. Tea or orange juice tasteless. Hollow feeling in mouth. Tenderness in left rear palate of mouth when touched with tongue. Salivation increased. Salivation when lying down, with heartburn. Ulcers on inside of mouth and cheeks and at corners of lips. Chewing lips.

Throat - Terrible dry feeling in throat on waking. Awakes with runny nose, Chocolate phlegm in throat. Mucus plug in throat, coughs to dislodge it. Constant desire to clear throat because of a plug of mucus behind sternum. Hawking beige mucus from posterior sinuses. Raw and sore throat, peppery feeling, especially high in the fauces. Soreness and tenderness in throat and glands both sides. Dark red throat, internal, worse left side. Tingling in throat. Desire not to swallow, but very hungry. Difficult swallowing with sore left throat.

Stomach - Sensation of weakness in stomach and wooziness in the head with general weakness. Stomach feels aggravated and full. Dull pain like indigestion. Pain comes in waves and with big belches. Belching in evenings, followed by acid taste in mouth. Intense, frequent bouts of heartburn while sitting. Heartburn while smoking cigarettes and from hot drinks, but not from hot food. Heartburn worse 2 to 4 p.m. Feeling queasy after a cup of tea. Nausea with bad taste in mouth. Nausea and vomiting at midnight with migraines.

Abdomen - Bloated abdomen with belching, flatus and nausea, worse after supper. Rumbling and gas in the abdomen. Loud rumbling in abdomen while lying. Woke with pain from gas in upper abdomen. Pain dull, becoming sharper. Aching lower pelvic region when sitting. Sharp pain in liver.

Rectum - Profuse, watery, very smelly diarrhea, with a lot of rumbling. Explosive diarrhea with flatus. Light brown stools, worse as day went on. Stool difficult to pass, yet not very hard. Sour smelling flatus. Offensive flatus in the evening. Rectum sore.

Stool - Stool hard and in very small pieces. Stool soft and less dry. Very loose, frequent stool, verging on diarrhea. Watery stools, smelly, light brown.

Female - Menses lighter then usual, then becoming very heavy. Menses heavier and longer than usual. No desire for sex. Sexual desire increased. Food - Appetite improved. Wakes up feeling hungry. Lack of appetite and thirst. Averse food. Aversion to sweets, to usual tea. Desires hot drinks, but aggravates. Desire for hot, black currant juice, orange juice, soda water, cold water, refreshing things. Desires sweet food, sauerkraut, and fruit, especially citrus. Desire to eat red things, red peppers, red fruit, red grapes, beetroot soup.

Chest - Feeling of a powerful explosion inside chest, taking breath away, as if diaphragm went into a spasm. Pain in chest with belching. Chest heavy, aches inside. Tenderness in sternum and lower ribs. Tighmess in xiphoid. Left clavicle has itch and pain. Whole upper left quadrant of chest has some tight dull pain. Pain under the ribs. Stitching pains at base of right lung. Stabbing pain in back between spine and left shoulder, worse inhalation. Tingling in chest, creeping down from spine. Cold feeling in the lungs. Cough hurts chest and head. Catarrhal feeling behind the sternum. Coughs - Cough from throat, from deep in center of chest by xiphoid of sternum. Painful cough, chest worse movement. Cough with nausea and a sensation of mucus behind the sternum. Sudden attack of a retching and gagging cough. Loose cough with thick, pale green mucus, from trachea and lungs. Dry coughs, in evening, after swallowing. Spasms of hard dry cough on going to bed, better cold water. Lying in bed coughing. Wakes coughing at 4 a.m. Dreams - Dreamless sleep. Dreams are not remembered. Dreams are fragmented, confused, obscure. Dreams of familiar people, friends. Dream of selling fruit and vegetables in the market. Dreaming flying and jumping, being on a boat journey, falling from a window. Dreams of babies bathing, the babies were like helpless little animals, almost dead. Dreams of pain in the right ovarian/pelvic region. Vivid dream of worms.

Heart - Tightness in back of heart. As if back of heart pushing against back. Feeling of heart bulging through ribs, better when lying on left side. As if heart is beating more towards the back and sides between the scapulae. Feels heart banging and bulging through the ribs. Doesn't feel the heart at all. In the night, the heart stops beating.

Back - Shivers up spine with chill in evening. Strong itching at middle of spine, shoulder blade. Prickly feeling on the back of the neck. Stabbing pain in back, between spine and left shoulder. Tightness around thoracic vertebrae. Back pains. Stiff feeling with painful neck, while sleeping on back. Feels very vulnerable in the base of the spine. Spine and back feel uncomfortable with a deep restlessness, uneasiness and irritability. Sensation that back is larger and wider. Breasts - Breasts feel fuller. Desire to rub breasts. Stitching pains, sensation as if fine threads were being drawn through breasts. Painful breasts before menstrual period.

Neck - Tension in the shoulders extending to the base of the neck, in the spine where dorsal and cervical regions meet. Back of neck stiff and tight. The muscles on either side of the cervical vertebrae feel as if they are being laced up tight together. Intense tension, bends the neck back, leads to a sensation as if the back of the head is horribly elongated.

Limbs - Aching in joints. Wandering pain in hands and feet, in muscles, joints and small bones. Clumsy, drops things, bumps into things. Hands less capable of doing fine movements, such as writing. Wrists feel weaker and flatter. Aching muscles of arms, in bed. Sharp, deep pain in the legs, on the inside of the malleolus. Tightness in thigh muscle. Sharp, shooting, momentary pain up inside of right gluteal muscle. Feet feel like blocks of ice, so cold, bones are painful. Toes are like ice. Deep ache in joints of both big toes. Legs felt powerless and like heavy rubber. When legs are moved there is a time lapse between the thought and the action. Lungs - More air going in with less effort, breaths much slower and further apart. On breathing in, chest felt tight. Breathing from lower down in the lungs. During cough, expectoration of very clear mucus mixed with saliva. Thick, pale green mucus on coughing from deep in chest. Cough of green sticky chunks.

Sleep - Yawning a lot. Overcome with sleepiness. Deep sleep. Sleeps poorly, restless, waking often. Sleeps on back. Wakes with painful and stiff neck, needs to change positions. When on side, pain went away. Wakes at 2 to 3 a.m., feeling hot and sweaty, at 5 a.m. very alert and alive. Very tired on waking. Sleepiness during menses.

Skin - Dry skin, itching. Itching scapulae, shins, forearms, pelvis and forehead. Scratching until it bled. Small, dry pimples. Lips very dry. Hands feel coarser and more leathery. Skin feels numb, less sensitive to touch. Feels crawly and “sensitive” to touch of clothes.

Larynx - Sudden loss of voice during cold. Voice slides up and down the scale, high pitched to low and husky, breaks, almost lost. Lack of control over voice.

Teeth - Aching pain gums and around roots of teeth. Toothache in right upper canine tooth.

Tongue - Small, white, raised spots on tongue. Small, red spots on base of tongue. Tongue coated yellow brown at back, as if smoked many cigarettes. Whitish-yellow tongue. Tongue looks as if it is painted a beige color. Vertigo - Faint buzzing all over head. Blurred, fuzzy feeling comes over head in waves, pleasant and relaxing. Thick and fuzzy head, like a hangover. Not quite with it, like looking through a cloud. Felt dizzy on rising, with nausea after drinking tea. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cacao. REFERENCES - Allen. Sherr.

Perspiration - Perspiration increased. Woke in night feeling hot and sweaty. Sweet smell of perspiration at night. Restless and hot, sweat all night. Relieved by beginning to sweat.

Temperature - Tired, as if a cold or flu would come on. Wakes with flue or cold symptoms. Tendency to take colds. Uncoordinated, feel heavy and slow (Gels.). Fever and chills, all night. Alternates between being chilled, feverish and sweating. Face hot, body chilled. Chilled easily. Shaking and trembling, teeth chatter when in bed. Restless and hot, sweat all night, desire to sleep in cold part of house.

name: Cholesterinum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from touch or jar. Worse lying on side. Worse bending or sudden motion..
constitution: Cancer. Cirrhosis. Eyes, opacities. Fibroids. Gallstone, colic. Gallstones. Insomnia. Jaundice. Liver, diseases. Tumors.
keynote:
PHARMACY - chol. Cholesterinum. Cholesterine. Gallstones. Trituration of gallstones. From the epithelium lining of gallbladder and the larger ducts. Sarcode. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cancer. Cirrhosis. Eyes, opacities. Fibroids. Gallstone,…
full:
PHARMACY - chol. Cholesterinum. Cholesterine. Gallstones. Trituration of gallstones. From the epithelium lining of gallbladder and the larger ducts. Sarcode. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cancer. Cirrhosis. Eyes, opacities. Fibroids. Gallstone, colic. Gallstones. Insomnia. Jaundice. Liver, diseases. Tumors.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cholesterinum crystallizes in leaflets with a mother-of-pearl luster and a fatty feel. It is soluble in alcohol and ether. It occurs in the blood and brain, yolk of eggs, seeds and buds of plants, but most abundantly in the bile and gallstones. Dr. Wilhelm Ameke of Berlin first mentioned this remedy. Dr. Burnett, at Ameke's suggestion, used the lower potencies with more or less success for several years, a description of which Burnett gives in his Diseases of the Liver. Choi, was introduced by Swan. He appeared to have taken his hint from Burnett's work and potentized the remedy, using a gallstone for his preparations. Swan affirmed, after much experience, that it is almost a specific for gallstone colic. It relieves the distress at once and this after failure with Nux-v., Chin., Card-m„ Podo, and other apparently well-selected remedies. Ameke recommended Choi, as a remedy in cancer of the liver. Choi, is the physiological opponent of Lee., both seem to play some unknown part in the growth of tumors. Benign tumors, uterine fibroids. Gallstones. Chronic jaundice. Obstinate hepatic engorgements. Opacities of the vitreous. Insomnia. MIND - Irritable. Delirium. Moody.

Eyes - Vitreous opacities of eyes.

Face - Discolored bluish.

Abdomen - Burning pain in side, on walking holds his hand on side.

Female - Tumors, benign, fibroids.

Back - Itching of coccyx.

Limbs - Leg cramps.

Skin - Red, coppery spots after the desquamation. COMMENTS - Potentized cholesterol gallstones. Gallstones and gallstone colic. Liver cancer, palliates dying liver cancer patients. Yingling reported some cures of gallstone colic and other diseases of the liver in the Medical Advance, August, 1908 and noted that “In gallstone colic, the patient suffers so severely that it is almost impossible to obtain symptoms. In such a case, when one cannot give a well-selected remedy, give Cholesterinum and thus far it has never failed. “It can be used instead of Morphine in cases where the symptoms cannot be obtained for the proper selection of a remedy. It is very improbable that a person suffering from gallstone colic will wait very long for the physician to study the case.” Ameke claimed to have derived great advantages from its use in cases diagnosed as cancer of the liver, or in such obstinate engorgements that malignancy was suspected. Clarke cured a case in the last stage of liver disease. He had been given up by his medical attendant, who ordered him to make his will without delay. B urnett c laimed to have twice cured cancer of the liver with it and “in hepatic engorgements that by reason of their intractable and slow yielding to well-selected remedies make one think of cancer.” In such conditions, where the diagnosis is in doubt, especially if the patient has been subjected to repeated attacks of biliary colic, Choi., he claimed is very satisfactory and at times its action even striking. It has been used with success in the removal of opacities of the vitreous. Burnett used the 3x or the 3c trituration and substantial doses. He commended it in “obstinate hepatic engorgements, which by reason of their obstinacy make one think interrogatively of cancer.” Also in “cases in which there appears to be a semi-malignant affection involving the left lobe of the liver and what lies between it and the pylorus and the pancreas.” In such cases Burnett gave alternately Choi. 3x and Iodoform 3x. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Taurocholate of Soda. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Modalities - Worse from touch or jar. Worse lying on side. Worse bending or sudden motion.

Liver - Hepatic engorgements. Gallstones and gallstone colic. Jaundice. Liver cancer. Liver diseases.

name: Chromicum Acidum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse least draft of air. Worse cold water. Worse at night and early in morning. Worse 2 a.m. to 6 a.m. Pain worse on left side..
constitution: Angina pectoris. Brain, inflammation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Eyes, disorders. Gangrene. Gout. Hemorrhoids. Lumbago. Lupus. Ranula. Rheumatism. Stiff, neck. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Toothaches. Trismus. Tuberculosis, laryngeal. Ulcers. Warts.
keynote:
PHARMACY - chr-ac. Chromicum acidum. Chromic acid. Chromium sesquioxide. Anhydrous solution or Chromic oxide. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Brain, inflammation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Eyes, disorders. Gangrene. Gout.…
full:
PHARMACY - chr-ac. Chromicum acidum. Chromic acid. Chromium sesquioxide. Anhydrous solution or Chromic oxide. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Brain, inflammation. Coughs. Diarrhea. Eyes, disorders. Gangrene. Gout. Hemorrhoids. Lumbago. Lupus. Ranula. Rheumatism. Stiff, neck. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Toothaches. Trismus. Tuberculosis, laryngeal. Ulcers. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Chromic acid is a powerful antiseptic which has been used for disinfecting purposes to arrest fetid discharge and correct fetid odors. Offensive discharge. “Foul smelling, bloody lochia.” Inflammation and destruction of epithelium and mucus membranes, a false membrane, gangrene. On the skin it has been used to destroy warts. Cutting pains in eyes. Cough, hard, sometimes deep, swallows sputa. Vomits breakfast. Diphtheria. Post-nasal tumors. Epithelioma of the tongue. Symptoms come and go suddenly and return periodically.

Nose - Ulcer and scabs in nose. Offensive smell. Corrosive pain. Ozaena (Aur.).

Throat - Diphtheria, sore throat. Tough mucus with inclination to swallow it, worse causing hawking. Post- nasal tumors. COMMENTS - Suddenness of many of the symptoms. Symptoms appear and disappear suddenly and return periodically. Disagreeable pricking and itching here and there with uneasiness in limbs. Pains suddenly shifting to various parts of trunk, on waking. On turning to right side, pain in left side goes off. Sensation of a vacuum at heart of emptiness in chest. Well-marked rheumatic symptoms. Clarke frequently obtained good results in rheumatic cases with both preparations. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Daph. has cured the rheumatic pains. Merc-c. in small doses has counteracted the general effects in workmen. The restlessness and relief from motion suggest Rhus-t. Compare: (1) Kali-bi., Rhus-t. (2) Chromium sulphate in locomotor ataxia, goiter, serve us as a remedy in cases of hypertrophy. Herpes preputialis. Wry neck. Also exophthalmia inhibits the vagus, relieving tachycardia. Acts like a nerve tonic where there is lack of nervous tone. Fibroid tumors. Infantile paralysis. Dose for adults, 3 to 5 grains after meals and at bedtime. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Rectum - Frequent, copious water, with nausea and vertigo. Hemorrhoids internal and bleeding. Weakness in small of back.

Limbs - Uneasiness in limbs. Pain in shoulder blades and back of neck. Pain in knees and balls of feet. Drawing pain in soles while walking.

Modalities - Worse least draft of air. Worse cold water. Worse at night and early in morning. Worse 2 a.m. to 6 a.m. Pain worse on left side.

keynote:
PHARMACY - chrom-k-s. Chromium kali sulphuratum. Chromic sulphate. Chrome alum potassic. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Catarrh. Hay asthma. Hay fever. HOMEOPATHIC - Chrom-k-s. was introduced into homeopathic practice some years ago by Dr. Mersch of…
full:
PHARMACY - chrom-k-s. Chromium kali sulphuratum. Chromic sulphate. Chrome alum potassic. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Catarrh. Hay asthma. Hay fever. HOMEOPATHIC - Chrom-k-s. was introduced into homeopathic practice some years ago by Dr. Mersch of Brussels. Clarke used it on Dr. Mersch's indications in the 6x trituration and downwards. It sometimes succeeds in the 3x, and even the 1 x, when higher numbers fail. There is no proving, but it can be used on general indications for coughs and catarrhs which its constituents will readily suggest. Valuable for hay fever. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) All-c, Psor., Sabad., Naph., Sang. Kali-bi. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Chromium Metallicum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better motion. Worse morning. Worse 5 a.m. to 9 a.m. Worse cold. Worse least draft of air. Worse cold water. Worse night and early morning. Worse 2 a.m. to 6 a.m..
constitution: Anemia. Arteriosclerosis. Cancer. Coma. Cystic fibrosis. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Ear, infections. Epithelioma. Flatus. Headache. Heart, diseases. Hyper-cholesterolemia. Kidney, diseases. Meningitis. Mucus, secretions. Nausea. Pancreas, diseases. Paralysis. Ranula. Rheumatic, pains. Sciatica. Sinusitis. Stomach, complaints. Vertigo. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - chrom. Chromium metallicum. Chromium metal. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Arteriosclerosis. Cancer. Coma. Cystic fibrosis. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Ear, infections. Epithelioma. Flatus. Headache. Heart, diseases. Hyper-cholesterolemia.…
full:
PHARMACY - chrom. Chromium metallicum. Chromium metal. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Arteriosclerosis. Cancer. Coma. Cystic fibrosis. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Ear, infections. Epithelioma. Flatus. Headache. Heart, diseases. Hyper-cholesterolemia. Kidney, diseases. Meningitis. Mucus, secretions. Nausea. Pancreas, diseases. Paralysis. Ranula. Rheumatic, pains. Sciatica. Sinusitis. Stomach, complaints. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Discharges thick, tough, stringy, sticky, green and yellow. Pains changing place or in one spot. Boring, scraping pains. Cancer. Paralysis. Collapse, coma. Ear infections. Sinusitis. Heart diseases. Arteriosclerosis. Anemia. Pain under the heart. Hypercholesterolemia. Stomach complaints. Vom- iting blue or green. Affections of pancreas. Diabetes. Cystic fibrosis. Diarrhea, green or bluish. Flatus. Affections of kidneys. Blood and albumin in urine. Sciatica. Itching. Suddenness. “Symptoms appear and disappear suddenly and return periodically.” [Clarke] Wandering pains. “Disagreeable pricking and itching here and there, with uneasiness in limbs, so that he was obliged to get up from sitting or lying and walk about.” [Hering] “The rheumatic pains shift suddenly from one part to another. This type of pains are felt in the eyes, when they are sudden, and momentary in both eyes.” [Blackwood] Mucus secretions increased, tough, stringy. At night sensation as if eyes were enlarged. Fetid, musty smell in posterior nares, chiefly perceived during expiration. “Sensation during the eating of the food, which tastes well and natural, as if the exhaled air smelt putrid, almost causing nausea. He smells several times of the food, thinking that the stench might proceed from that.” [Allen] MIND - Weakness of memory, how to make several letters. Restlessness during pain. Restlessness in morning, better rising. Restlessness in morning before rising. Delirium in meningitis cerebrospinalis or encephalitis. Scolding in meningitis. Delusion of being heavy. Comes across as a closed personality. Have difficulty in expressing themselves. When answering, always considering whether they are revealing bad things about themselves.

Head - Headache. Fullness at night, with peculiar sensation of lightness at the heart.

Eyes - Sensation of enlargement at night. Cutting pain in evening.

Ears - Sensation of water in right ear, appearing and disappearing suddenly.

Nose - Tumor, posterior nares.

Face - Heat at 10 p.m.

Mouth - Epithelioma of tongue. Putrid odor while eating. Prickling of tongue. Ranula, periodic. Metallic taste during dinner.

Throat - Constant disposition to swallow from thick mucus. Vertigo - Vertigo with inclination to fall to the right side. Vertigo while walking. REFERENCES - Allen. Blackwood.

Stomach - Nausea better walking. Transient nausea when stomach is empty. Vomiting, breakfast.

Abdomen - Rumbling in morning, better emission of flatus. Rumbling in morning on waking.

Rectum - Sudden urging for stool. Diarrhea, green or bluish. Watery, stool.

Female - Offensive, fetid lochia. Food - Worse cold drinks. Worse tea.

Heart - Sensation of emptiness at region of heart. Lungs - Like fine twine threads.

Back - Pain in dorsal region, at inner angle of left scapula. Aching pain in lumbar region in morning in bed (Chr-o.).

Sleep - Waking with heart symptoms. Dreams of riding horses through a stream. Dreams of being poisoned. Dreams of urinating. Dreams that he had an attack of strangury, which the next morning proved to be the fact, he did not get over it for two hours. Dreams of crossing a stream of water on horseback, and water froze.

Skin - Wounds, bites of rabid dogs.

Modalities - Better motion. Worse morning. Worse 5 a.m. to 9 a.m. Worse cold. Worse least draft of air. Worse cold water. Worse night and early morning. Worse 2 a.m. to 6 a.m.

Teeth - Pain extending to ear, extending to forehead.

PHARMACY - chrysar. Chrysarobinum. Goa powder. Andira araroba. N. O. Papilionoideae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis. Herpes. Itching. Keratitis. Photophobia. Psoriasis. Ringworm.

HOMEOPATHIC - Chrysar. has been used successfully in skin diseases especially in ringworm, psoriasis, herpes, and acne rosacea. Vesicular or squamous lesions, associated with foul smelling discharge and crust formation, tend to become confluent and to give the appearance of a single crust covering the entire area. Violent itching of thighs, legs and ears. Dry, scaly eruption, especially around eyes and ears. Scabs with pus underneath (Mez.).

Eyes - Optical hyperesthesia. Intense photophobia. Blepharitis, conjunctivitis, keratitis. COMMENTS - It contains chrysophan, which is rapidly oxidized into chrysophanic acid. This is also contained in Rheum and Senn. Acts as a powerful irritant of the skin. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rhubarb and Senn. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Ears - Eczema behind ears. Filthy, scabby condition with tendency to form thick crust. Whole ear and surrounding tissue appears to be one scab.

full:
PHARMACY - chrys-ac. Chrysophanicum acidum. Chrysophanic acid. An organic acid obtained from rhubarb and some lichens. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blepharitis. Conjunctivitis. Ophthalmia. Psoriasis. Ringworm.

HOMEOPATHIC - Chrys-ac. is a constituent of “Goa powder. ” Tried as a local application in the form of ointment in bad cases of psoriasis on one limb, Chrys-ac. has caused the disappearance of the eruption on the other limb as well, showing a constitutional action. A. B. Norton used it successfully internally and externally in blepharitis, conjunctivitis and keratitis, the phlyctenular variety, also in eczema behind ears. G. C. McDermott confirmed this. Used locally (grains 4 to grains 8 with Vaseline), internally, or both, it is a magnificent remedy in eye and ear cases where a filthy, scabby condition exists with a tendency to form thick crusts. Cases in which the whole ear and surrounding tissue appeared to be one great scab from the center of which oozed the pus which came from a suppurative otitis media cleared up in two or three weeks under internal and external use of Chrys-ac. Also cases where a similar condition of eyelids and skin of face obtained. Clarke often saw a ringworm disappear rapidly from a few applications of the ointment. It has been used with some success in the lower triturations internally for psoriasis, ringworm and other skin affections, also as a local application in ringworm. COMMENTS - It is a powerful irritant of the skin and mucus membranes. Given internally in crude form it has caused nausea, vomiting and purging. E. W. Beebe of Milwaukee related the effect on a friend, troubled with blepharitis, who applied to his eyelid a one-in-ten ointment made with Vaseline. The effect was immediate. Marked conjunctiva inflammation of globe and eyelid, contraction of pupils, intense photophobia, the least ray of light producing great pain increased by a throbbing sensation synchronous with the pulse. This was accompanied with phosphorescent flashes of light. On forcing eyes to look at objects, retinal impressions remained some time after closing them. Swelling of lids and irritation of skin around. After lasting a week there was marked improvement and a second, milder application completed the cure. Beebe regarded the condition set up as one of “Retinal asthenopia.” Graafe called it “optical hyperesthesia.” RELATIONS - Compare: Physostigma and Pilocarpine are its analogs. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

A chicory-roaster observed that he “could not read at night, not from any external irritation of the eyes, but from afeeling of deadness in them.”

HOMEOPATHIC - Chicory has been proved and symptoms have been observed including a general heaviness and headaches. Weight at stomach and great indisposition to bodily and mental exertion. Want of energy. Bowels relaxed. RELATIONS - Compare: Chicory, a Bach Flower Essence. REFERENCES Clarke.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from thinking of pain. Better warmth. Worse from concussions. Worse from injury to brain and spine. Worse turning the head. Worse from cold, drafts. Worse tobacco smoke. Worse jar. Worse noise. Worse slightest touch. Worse dentition. Worse suppressed eruptions. Worse from worms. Worse from splinters in flesh. Worse turning the head..

keynote:
PHARMACY - cic. Cicuta virosa. Water hemlock. Cowbane. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of fresh root gathered at time of flowering. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bladder, paralysis. Cancer. Catalepsy. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Coccyx, pain. Colic. Concussions.…
full:
PHARMACY - cic. Cicuta virosa. Water hemlock. Cowbane. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of fresh root gathered at time of flowering. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bladder, paralysis. Cancer. Catalepsy. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Coccyx, pain. Colic. Concussions. Convulsions. Delirium. Delusions. Diarrhea. Eczema. Epilepsy. Epithelioma. Esophagus, stricture. Eyes, inflammation. Face, eruptions. Fever. Hallucinations. Headaches. Head, injuries. Hemorrhage. Hiccoughs. Hysteria. Impetigo. Injuries. Mania. Meningitis. Myelitis. Nightmares. Numbness. Opisthotonos. Paralysis. Psoriasis. Puerperal, convulsions. Screaming. Snow-blindness. Spasms. Stra- bismus. Stuttering. Suppressed, eruptions. Tetanus. Trismus. Twitching. Vomiting. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cicuta virosa is one of the most active of the poisonous umbelliferae. Chiefly acts on the brain, medulla oblongata, nervous system, the gastro-intestinal tract, and the skin. The action producing spasmodic affections including hiccough, trismus, tetanus and convulsions, and locked jaws. Violent general action with frightful distortions. Bending of the head, neck and spine backwards. Strange desires. Moaning and howling. Does absurd things. Sensation of internal chill. Dilated pupils. Shocks from head down body. Face bluish. Froths at mouth. Bites the tongue. Violent spasmodic effects. Great agitation. Frightful contortions. Epilepsy. Gesticulations, odd motions. “Jerking of the left arm all day.” Tremor when touched. Trembling palpitations. Spasms of diaphragm, hic- cough of gullet. Spasms move downwards with terrific violence with sudden shocks through body or head. “Head turned or twisted to one side”in convulsions. Convulsions followed by sudden rigidity, shrieks, then jerks and violent distortions, then prolonged unconsciousness. Utter prostration follows the convulsive attacks. Opisthotonos and frightful facial distortions. Bloody foam from the mouth. Muscles become rigid. Catalepsy. Tearing, jerking in coccyx. Spasms are renewed by touch, by noise, loud talking. . Falls and the effects of concussions. Convergent strabismus from fall or blow. Concussion of brain. Cerebro-spinal meningitis. Sleeps and weeps on being aroused, distorts facial muscles and stares vacantly. Troubles arising from shaving. Marked action on the skin. Hungry immediately after a meal. MIND - Dullness after injuries of head. Anxiety about future. Excitement and apprehension about future. Excessively affected by sad stories. Horrible things, sad stories affect her profoundly. Sad when seeing others happy. Worse from fright (Op., Ig.). Fright can cause epilepsy. Suspicious. Mistrustful, shuns men. Aversion to presence of strangers. Despises others. Aversion to company. Desires to be alone during menses. Contemptuous. Melancholy with indifference. Sadness after concussion of brain. Does notremember what has happened, does not recognize anybody but answers well. Feels as if he was in a strange place. Everything appears strange and terrible. Avoids the sight of people. Confounds present with the past, feels like a child. Memory blank, for hours or days. Thinking of complaints helps. Falls to ground and rolls about with or without convulsions. Moaning, howling and weeping. Epilepsy with moaning and whining. Stupefaction between convulsions. Shrieking before convulsions. Delirium with gestures. Mania with dancing, laughing and ridiculous gestures. Sings, dances, shouts. Violent. Impulsive. Rash behavior. Childish behavior. Hallucinations and convulsions after typhoid.

Head - Headache on waking in morning. Convulsions from concussion of brain. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Head turned or twisted to one side. Congestion of head with vomiting and purging. Head retracted, spine rigid. Neck muscles are contracted. Headache alternating with pain in abdomen. Head symptoms relieved by emission of flatus. Cerebrospinal meningitis. One-sided headache, stupefying, as from a rush of blood, better sitting erect. Cerebral diseases following suppressed eruptions. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Jerks the head. Thick, yellow scabs on head. Sweat during sleep.

Eyes - Pupils dilated in concussion of the brain, contracted in spasms. Strabismus, periodic, spasmodic after a fall or blow. Eyelids twitch. Spasmodic disorders of eyes. Eyes roll, jerk and stare. Stares persistently at objects. Objects recede, approach and seem double, black. Letters go up and down or disappear, when reading. Effects of exposure to snow.

Ears - Ears hot or cold. Earache caused by filling teeth with gold. Hemorrhage from ears. Sore behind ear as after a blow. Suppurating, burning eruption on and about ears. Oversensitiveness of hearing. Difficult hearing. Doesn't hear well unless one speaks loudly to her, and she pays attention. Sudden detonation, especially on swallowing. Roaring noises in ears.

Nose - Slight touch causes it to bleed. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Nostrils seem stopped. Nostrils ulcerated, with yellow, purulent discharge from nose.

Face - Ashy paleness of face, during convulsions. Flushed face, with headache and restless sleep. Red or pale face and drawn, sweaty. Face is distorted horrible or ridiculously. Trismus, disposition to grind teeth. Lockjaw. Twitching of facial muscles. Faceache caused by filling teeth with gold. Pustules which run together forming thick, yellow scabs on face and head. Dark red pimples on face. Epithelioma of lips. Painful ulcers on lips.

Mouth - Foam in and around mouth. Swelling of the tongue, speech difficult. Bites the tongue. Grinding of the teeth with lockjaw. Water brash, saliva flows from mouth with heat all over. Thirst, burning pressure. White, painful, burning ulcers on edges of tongue, painful to touch. Tongue coated, dry. Speech difficul. Stuttering. Couldn't speak from having no control over movements of tongue and mouth. Speechlessness from wounded esophagus. Speechlessness in cerebrospinal meningitis.

Throat - Effects of swallowing sharp fish bones. Dry. Feels as if grown together. Spasms of esophagus, cannot swallow from injury of fish bone etc. Stricture of esophagus. Strangling on attempting to swallow. Danger of suffocation from swallowing sharp pieces of bone. Choking on attempting to examine the throat. Constriction of esophagus from intestinal irritation. Constriction with spasmodic contraction of muscles of neck, almost like tetanus. Vertigo - Vertigo with stomach pain and muscular spasms. Objects move from side to side or approach and recede. Vertigo with desire to hold on to something when standing still. Vertigo with reeling, falling to the ground. Vertigo on stooping. Vertigo after injuries to head. Vertigo on rising from bed. Vision - Momentary loss of vision. Frequent vanishing of sight. Letters disappear or go up and down. Colors of rainbow around letters. Letters seem to turn when reading. Objects appear black. Objects vacillate. Diplopia. Iris-like circles around candle. Can scarcely see in sunlight. COMMENTS - Characteristic twitching and spasmodic jerks. “Bending the head back- wrd.”Useful forresidue from a trauma that included convulsions, or if current treatment masks residue symptoms. Convulsions, epilepsy, severe neck and spinal trauma, head injuries. Keynote arching of the back. Epilepsy, spasms, trauma cases, or spinal diseases with severe back spasms. Contortions of the body. The body takes on strange postures and contortions of the limbs. Chorea (Caust.), involuntary contractions, jerking, and rigidity of the limbs. Mania, dancing, singing, grotesque postures (Hyos.). Moans and howls with great agitation, makes gesticulations, odd motions, head turned or twisted to one side. Cataleptic after contortions, no recall of the attack, tranquil feeling (Op.). Utter prostration after the convulsions. Drug overdoses with convulsions, paralysis, respiratory failure, twitching and jerking of the limbs. Cerebrospinal meningitis, the opisthotonos being the leading indication. Meningitis, where the neck goes back, eyes are glassy and body is twitching and jerking with spasms and a high fever (Bell, without the flushed face). Delirium in meningitis, pupils are fixed and staring. Tetanus (Hyper., Led.), with violent spasms and severe lockjaw. Usually later stages of clinical tetanus. Head injuries that cause visual disturbances, twitchings of the eyes, double vision. Lazy eye, strabismus. Eclampsia, toxemia. Convulsions during pregnancy. Convulsions due to uremia, too much uric acid in the blood or kidney failure. Strange desires, such as to eat coal. Marked action on the skin, including the eruption of pustules which run together with yellowish honey-colored scabs, especially about mouth and matting the whiskers. Epithelioma, growths covered with honeycolored scabs. Nash cured eczema capitis in a young woman with Cic. Her whole scalp was covered as with a solid cap. Grimmer used it for cancers of the skin, epithelioma, convulsive violence as in cerebrospinal meningitis. Also in opisthotonos, strabismus, violent spasmodic jerks, paralysis, especially of the bladder, stricture of the esophagus. Teste mentioned the case of a woman of 58 who ceased to menstruate at 30 in consequence of a fright, and who was of “robust constitution, irritable, nervous and excessively fanciful and odd.” She had a chronic swelling of the left ovary. Cic. had a remarkably quieting effect for several weeks, and during that time the swelling diminished considerably. The patient had to leave Paris, so the treatment could not be followed up. Dr. H. Von Musits treated a case of acute meningitis in J. N. R., 43, male, married, a user of alcohol and tobacco, bookkeeper. After the intense summer heat, symptoms developed including convulsions, distortion of limbs, head turned backward. Trismus. Froth from mouth. Biting of the tongue. Oppression of breathing. Entire loss of consciousness and of power of swallowing. Convulsions, followed by complete exhaustion. Stupor. Swelling of face. Inability to move the tongue. The whole body seems to be of enormous size. The patient had three convulsions during twenty-four hours, followed by the swelling of the tongue and body. Extreme trembling of the hands. Articulation difficult. Next day, profuse watery diarrhea stools, worse by any noise, sudden entrance of any person into the room or loud talking. Better by rest and in a dark room. Several times previously he had symptoms of nervous exhaustion. His brother, a physician, died the previous spring from paresis in consequence of excessive use of alcohol and drugging. After two doses of Cic. 200c there were no more convulsions and the patient was perfectly cured in two weeks. There was no relapse. Banerjee recorded the case of “A lad, aged five years, had an attack of cholera three days before my visit. Had been treated by a homeopath from beginning of attack. The patient was suffering from convulsions, when I first saw him on the fourth day. The convulsive fits were very severe since the third day of the attack of cholera. “The symptoms were: eyes half turned, head drawn toward the left side and the hands and feet of the same side were contracted. He was given Bell., Hyos., Cina and Bryonia without effect. Cicuta virosa was then given. The first dose mitigated the severity of the fits, the second dose put the child to sleep and thus he was saved from imminent death.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Am., Op., for massive doses tobacco. Antidote to: Opium. Compare: (1) Cicuta maculata. (2) Con., En- anth., Stry., Bell. (3) Con., Aeth., Oena. Croc., Hyper. - spinal concussion, Hyos. - twitchings. Hell, Hydr-ac. - body thrown back, cramps in neck. (4) Nux-v. and Stry. - tetanus, but with Nux-v. there is not the utter prostration and great oppression of breathing of Cie., Nux-v. is less epileptiform and has more excitability. Compatible after: Lach after Ars. and Con. (Cancer of lip), Cupr. (Aphasia in chorea). REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Burning heat in stomach. Hiccoughs. Loud hiccough with crying, alternating with thoracic spasms. Indigestion, with insensibility, frothing at mouth. Vomiting of bile of blood on stooping, on rising in pregnancy. Throbbing in pit of the stomach with distention. Pains with vomiting, painful distension of abdomen and spasm of pectoral muscles. Vomiting during convulsions. Vomit yellow, like mucus. Vomiting during headache.

Abdomen - Distended and painful. Rumbling in abdomen. Flatulence with anxiety and crossness. Colic with convulsions with vomiting. Heat and burning in abdomen. Sudden, sharp, pains from navel extending to neck of bladder. Tearing pain deep in abdomen. Observed: Flatulence with anxiety and crossness. Rumbling in abdomen. Distended and painful. Chronic painful hernia. Back - Spasms and cramps in muscles of neck. The head drawn backwards. Opisthotonos. Back bent backward like an arch. Muscles of neck contract and become hard as wood. Weakness in muscles of back after standing only a short time. Jerking, tearing in coccyx, especially during menses. Right scapula as if bruised. Neuralgia at nape with dull occipital headache. Causations - Bad effects from falls, blows and concussions. Tetanus. Splinters in flesh.

Rectum - Diarrhea in morning with irresistible desire to urinate. Itching in rectum with burning pain after rubbing. Diarrheic stool followed by constipation. Prolapsed rectum. Frequent liquid stools. Cholera when purging ceases, and congestion to brain and chest. Desire to urinate after stool. Stools thin, slimy. Stools expelled suddenly, sudden urging. Scarcely able to retain stool.

Male - Testes drawn up towards external abdominal rings. Sharp pains in fossa navicularis, with nightly emissions. Sore, drawing pains in urethra, as far as glans, obliging one to urinate. Pollutions without lascivious dreams.

Female - Spasmodic states when menses do not appear. Coccyx painful during menses. Puerperal convulsions. Eclampsia during childbirth. Convulsions during pregnancy, delivery. Food - Inability to distinguish between edible and inedible. Stomachache, sleepiness, feel satisfied immediately after eating. Great hunger soon after a meal. Craves coal, chalk and many other strange articles. Longing for wine. Thirst, extreme, with convulsions.

Chest - Chest feels tight, can hardly breathe. Heat or cold sensation in chest. Tonic spasm in pectoral muscles. Sensations as if something the size of a fist was lodged in chest and throat. Lower end of sternum as if sore or bruised, when walking. Constitutions - Suited to nervous elderly people and children.

Heart - Trembling palpitations of the heart. Feels as if the heart stopped beating with faint feeling. Heart's action weak. Rapid pulse. Pulse weak, slow, at times imperceptible.

Limbs - Curved limbs which cannot be straightened, nor straight ones bent. Jerking and twitching in the arms and fingers. Jerking in left arm all day. Cramps and spasms. Trembling of left leg. Feet turned inward and toes turned upwards in spasms, while walking. Swings feet in half circle while walking. Forearms and legs as if bruised. Complete powerlessness of limbs after sudden jerks. Great weakness in arms and legs, after slight exertion. Rigid limbs. Trembling in upper and lower limbs. Cold limbs. Lungs - Oppressed, can scarcely breathe, may arise from tonic spasm of pectoral muscles. Snoring. Interrupted, in spells. Want of breath the whole day. Difficult, chest feels too tight. Suspended, at times gasping.

Sleep - Complete sleeplessness in hysterical spasms. Frequent waking, with sweat all over, from which he feels refreshed. Bites the tongue in sleep. Starting during sleep. Deep sleep. Dreams vivid, but not remembered. Vivid dreams about events of previous day. Nightmares after movies and sad stories. Nightmares of people being mutilated, attacked, tortured.

Skin - Eczema, no itching, exudation forms into a/¡art/, lemon-colored crust. Pustules coalesce into thick, yellow massive scabs, worse head and face. Suppressed eruption causes brain disease. Elevated eruptions, as large as peas. Barber's, baker's itch. Red vesicles on right scapula, painful to touch. Burning, itching of skin over whole body. Impetigo, honeycomb-like crusts, which fall off and leave a bright red smooth surface.

Modalities - Better from thinking of pain. Better warmth. Worse from concussions. Worse from injury to brain and spine. Worse turning the head. Worse from cold, drafts. Worse tobacco smoke. Worse jar. Worse noise. Worse slightest touch. Worse dentition. Worse suppressed eruptions. Worse from worms. Worse from splinters in flesh. Worse turning the head.

Teeth - Toothache caused by filling teeth with gold. Grinding of teeth with pressing of jaws together like lockjaw.

Kidneys - Involuntary urination in old men. Urine is passed with great force. Stricture of urethra after inflammation, gonorrhea. Paralysis of bladder with great anxiety about it. Passes large quantities of urine or else none at all.

Perspiration - Sweats at night and in morning. Sweats on abdomen. Profuse sweats at night, without being able to sleep.

Temperature - Chilliness, constant desire to be near a warm stove. Chill starts in chest and runs down legs and into arms with staring look. Cold internally and externally. Typhoid fever. Nervous fever, characterized by great stupidity. Worm fevers in children, with colic and convulsions.

constitution: Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain. Muscle, contractions. Seminal, emissions. Skin, disorders. Tendons, disorders. Yawning.

PHARMACY - cimx. Cimex lectularius. Bedbug. Acanthia lectularia. N. O. Hemiptera. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain.…
full:
PHARMACY - cimx. Cimex lectularius. Bedbug. Acanthia lectularia. N. O. Hemiptera. Tincture or trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chill. Colic. Constipation. Contractures. Cough. Fever. Hamstrings. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent, fever. Liver, pain. Muscle, contractions. Seminal, emissions. Skin, disorders. Tendons, disorders. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cimex is an ancient remedy for intermittent fever. Nash recorded the following cure by Dr. BrewsterofSyracuse. After driving a fractious horse that tried to run away over a very rough road, a man was so bruised and sprained about the buttocks and legs that he was confined to the house for a long time. It settled finally into what appeared likely to be permanent contraction of the lower limbs. No remedy relieved until Dr. Brewster remembered a case of intermittent fever that he had cured twenty years before, being guided by this symptom. Cimex 600c (Jenichen) promptly cured. Characteristic weariness and inclination to stretch. The flexors are most affected, pains in all joints as if tendons were contracted and too short, every motion or stretching of arms or legs causes tightening pain in them. Hamstrings feel too short (Am-m.). Sensation of retraction of arm tendons. The whole right side is especially affected. MIND - Anxiety, after chill. Clenching of hands with violent rage at beginning of chill. Sensation as if he could creep into himself and on that account could not sufficiently crouch together. His own sweat is disgusting to him. Abdomen - Pain in the liver, as if it had been strained by bending the right side inward, the spot is painful when touching it or coughing. Colic, followed by emissions of flatulence or liquid stools.

Head - Confusion of head as if headache would ensue. Pain like needle stitches in vertex with cough. Pain under right frontal bone. Violent headache, caused by drinking. Great rage, vehement at beginning of chilly stage. Would like to tear everything to pieces. Sweating on head, nose and chest.

Nose - Annoying dryness of nostrils. Fluent coryza with pressure in frontal sinuses. Constant sneezing in forenoon. Sweat on nose, morning during rest.

Mouth - Tongue coated white. Swollen feeling of the tongue. Feeling as if burnt on the tongue in the region of the palate and the upper anterior gums.

Throat - Dryness, causing him to drink all day. Esophagus becomes constricted during the hot stage. COMMENTS - Tertian and quartan intermittents. Musty smelling sweats. Night-sweats. Heat with gagging, esophagus feels constricted. Before chill, thirst and heaviness in legs, less thirst with chill, still less with dry heat, none with sweat. Chill commences with clenching of hands and violent raging. Pains in all joints as if tendons contracted during chill. Sensation as of a cold wind blowing on knees. After the chill, thirst, but drinking causes violent headache, tickling in larynx causing dry, continuous cough. Gagging and belching at end of cough. Urging to stool. Hard stool, in small balls. Discharges of a small piece of white stool, then rectum closes firmly. Stools with hemorrhoidal sufferings. Incontinence of urine. Hot urine, brown or red sediment. Urticarious eruption. Irresistible sleepiness. Frequent yawning. Frequent erections in morning, seminal emissions. A. W. K. Choudhury related a case of intermittent (quotidian) cured with Cimex 30c, the chiefindicationsbeing: “Chill slight, thirst some days, none other days, shiverings, passed water twice during chill, chill worse by lying down increase of cough if he drinks water during chill.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 )Nat-m. - headache lessens in the sweating stage. (2) Ars. - headache remains or increases in the sweating stage. (3) Bell. - throbbing of the head in intermittents. (4) Ars. and Bry. - gagging at end of cough. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Sour belchings.

Rectum - Constipation, feces dry, hard, and in small balls (Op., Plum., Thuj.). Rectal ulcer.

Stool - Stools hard, in small balls. After the discharge of a small piece of white stool, the rectum closes firmly. Stools with hemorrhoidal sufferings.

Female - Shooting pain from vagina up towards left ovary.

Chest - Chest feels oppressed during chill. After chill, heaviness in chest, anxiety.

Heart - Pulse feeble, intermitting.

Back - Pain in the small of the back, extending over the abdomen with distention of the abdomen, worse when sitting. Weariness in loins, must sit down.

Limbs - Hamstrings feel too short, knees flexed, attempting to stretch them causes pain in thighs. Pains in all joints, as if tendons were too short, especially knee joints. Knees feel cold, as from a cold wind. Pain in right shoulder and the anterior muscles of the chest, extending through the whole arm down to the nails, the fingers feel as if they had gone to sleep. Lungs - Dry cough with gagging, as if he would vomit with perspiration. Breathing oppressed after chill.

Sleep - Great drowsiness, falls asleep when sitting in the morning. Irresistible sleepiness during chill. Frequent yawning with cold feeling on skin.

Modalities - Worse motion. Worse stretching or extending the part. Worse in morning. Worse from drinking. Weariness compels to lie down. Pain in small of back worse sitting. Sweat on nose during rest in morning.

Kidneys - Urine brown with a deposit of sediment (during the fever, when he drinks).

Temperature - Chilliness of whole body, worse lying down. Thirst during apyrexia, but little during chilly stage, still less during hot stage and none during sweating. Before the cold stage, thirst, heaviness in the lower limbs. At the beginning of the chill, clenching of the hands and violent rage. The perspiration after the hot stage is accompanied by hunger. Perspiration mostly on the head and chest. Musty offensive sweat. During the intermittent fever, constipation, stools dry.

name: Cimicifuga Racemosa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from warm wraps. Better open air. Better continued motion. Better pressure. Better grasping things. Better rest, and eating. Worse from damp, cold air. Worse change of weather. Worse heat and cold, draft. Worse alcohol, especially wine. Worse from motion. Worse sitting. Worse puberty. Worse during menses, labor, menopause. Worse emotions. Worse in the morning, and at night (malar neuralgia better at night). Pains in arms and Achilles tendon worse as evening approaches..
constitution: Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Faintness. Fevers. Gout. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hot, flashes. Hysteria. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Melancholy. Meningitis. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Neura
keynote: PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - cimic. Cimicifuga racemosa. Black cohosh. Actea racemosa. Macrotys racemosa. Actea monogynia. Cimicifuga serpentaria. Black snakeroot. Botroflus serpentaria. N. O. Ranunculacee. North America. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abortion, tendency. Angina, pectoris. Appetite, disordered. Back, pains. Breast, disorders. Cerebrospinal, meningitis. Chest, pains. Chorea. Colic. Cramps. Delirium, tremens. Diaphragm. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Faintness. Fevers. Gout. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hot, flashes. Hysteria. Labor, pains. Lumbago. Melancholy. Meningitis. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Miscarriage. Muscle, pain. Neuralgia. Ovaries, disorders. Perichondritis. Pleurodynia. Pregnancy, disorders. Puerperal, fever. Puerperal, mania. Rheumatism. Sciatica, pains. Sleeplessness. Spinal irritation. Stiff-neck. Tinnitus. Tremors. Uterus, disorders. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Wide action upon the cerebrospinal and muscular system, as well as upon the uterus and ovaries. The generative organs in the female are particularly affected. Uterine and ovarian pains are very marked. Infra-breast pains. Tenderness of the uterine region. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Left ovarian pains. Leucorrhea with feeling of weight in uterus. Painful and irregular menses. Menses with backache, nervousness, irregular in time and amount, more flow, more pain. Labor-like pains. Displaced labor pains to hips, thighs or back. Pains are violent, aching, shooting, wander here and there. Compressive pains. Pains like electric shocks, with cries, faints etc. Pains go upwards or side to side, up the neck, about the throat from ovary to ovary. Belly of the muscles feel bruised, sore, heavy aching. Muscular andcrampypains, primarily of neurotic origin, occurring in nearly every part of the body. Sore and tender along the tract of pain. Trembling, twitching in various organs or of part lain on. Alternating clonic and tonic spasms. Nervous shuddering. Spasms of cerebro-spinal fever. Chorea, at puberty with delayed menses, cardiac. Hysterical and epileptic convulsions at the time of menses. Agitation. General sick feeling with exhaustion. Many of the symptoms are irregular, changeful or they alternate in groups, alternation of physical and mental effects. Alternate mental and rheumatic symptoms. Symptoms referable to the pelvic organs prominent. Lumbago. Muscle pain. Useful in rheumatic, nervous subjects with ovarian irritation, uterine cramps and heavy limbs. Children during dentition. Influenza. Cold air seems to penetrate the system, very sensitive to it. Headache is better in open air, worse in warm room. Migraine. MIND - Melanchol y. Depression with low spirits and exhaustion. Gloom and dejection, as if there was a black cloud over everything. Forebodings of death, insanity, impending evil etc. Fear of death. Fear of riding in a closed carriage. Fear that those in house will kill him. Fear of rats. Thinks she is going crazy. Vision of rats, mice, various colors and forms. Nervous, fidgety, excitable and jerky. Incessant talking, changing from one subject to another, as in delirium tremens (Lach.). Desire to wander from place to place. Hysteria. Mania, before menses. Mania, alcoholic, tries to injure himself. Puerperal mania, following disappearance of neuralgias. Weak will. Indifferent. Suspicious. Oversensitive, especially for pain. Hypochondriasis. Sits and mopes in great sadness, when questioned breaks into tears. Mental symptoms are better by diarrhea or menses, worse after rheumatism.

Head - Waving or wild sensation in brain. Head retracted (meningitis). Opening and shutting sensation in brain. Brain feels too large. Shooting, throbbing pains, headache after mental worry, over-study or from reflex uterine disease, better open air. Pressing outward pain. Feeling as of a blow or as if a bolt has been driven from occiput to vertex up to the eyes (left).

Eyes - Eyes feel big, wild look. Asthenopia associated with pelvic trouble. Deep- seated throbbing and shooting pains in eyes. Intense aching in eyeballs or behind them, better pressure, worse slightest motion. Pain from eyes to vertex. Ciliary neuralgia. As if a needle were run into the eyeballs, worse closing eyes. Photophobia from artificial light. Sees red flashes with dark borders.

Ears - Tinnitus. Sensitive to least noise with spasmodic labor pains. Violent noises in ear with deafness.

Nose - Sensitive to cold air, every inhalation seems to bring the cold air in contact with the brain.

Face - Pale, hot. Wild, fearful expression. Neuralgia affecting malar bones, better night, reappears the next day. Facial blemishes in young women. Forehead feels cold.

Mouth - Saliva thick. Coppery taste. Hawks up viscid coppery tasting mucus. Thick mucus on teeth. Cannot speak a word though she tries. Tongue and mouth feel warm. Tongue pointed and trembling, swollen.

Throat - Burning. Thyroid aches before menses. COMMENTS - Frontal, vertical or occipital headache, accompanied by great pain in the eyeballs, better pressure, worse slightest motion. Headache with a feeling as if going crazy. Headaches reflected from pelvic organs. Depression as if a black cloud has settled over them. Rheumatism affecting the vertebral joints and especially in the neck. Cerebrospinal meningitis, head and neck retracted. Clarke found a pain at the nape of the neck very characteristic. Sciatica with sharp, shooting pains down the limbs with back spasms. Hip and lum- . bosacral problems that affect uterus and other organs (Aesc.). Back spasms from injury to the spine (Mag-p.). Arthritis that came on with menopause, large joints (small joints, Caul.). Pains in the joints and limbs. Pains like electric shocks, here and there, sharp in various parts, chest and uterine pains shoot Cimicifuga racemosa from side to side. A general bruised feeling all over as if sore, worse by touch. Malar neuralgia, ceasing at night. Bad taste and breath. Coated tongue, sticky saliva, viscid mucus in throat. Disordered digestion. Marked sinking at epigastrium. Dry, teasing cough, worse at night and from every attempt to speak. Sharp pains in the heart and chest. Pains down left arm, which is numb (Aeon., Puls., Rhus-t.), as if bound to the side. Palpitation from the least motion. Heartbeat ceases suddenly. Premenstrual syndrome with cramps. Backache with painful menses, muscle spasms in the back with the period. Pain in the hip with menstrual cramps, hip can lock up. Symptoms worse during the period. Depression with menses. Menopausal depression. Painful prolapse of the uterus with cramps, spasms, backaches and hip aches, because pelvis is out of alignment (Sep. has prolapse due to weakness and lack of tone). Labor pains felt in the back or thighs. Muscle contractions in their thighs with labor pains, or they feel as if their back will break (Kali-c., Cham.). Puerperal mania. According to Lippe a characteristic indication is: “The recently delivered uterus becomes actually jammed in the pelvis with great pain.” Cimic. should be given in daily doses in low lx potency two months before term, when indicated. It ensures living births in women who have previously borne only dead children without any discoverable cause. If given before the term, it renders labor easier, cures sickness of pregnancy, and prevents the after pains. In cases of tinnitus aurium it has proved curative in old-school practice in 15 to 30 drops of the tincture, whether due to direct or reflex irritation. Clarke greatly relieved an inveterate case of epilepsy in which the aura was a “waving sensation in the brain,” which is a leading symptom of the remedy. A patient who was taking 6-drop doses of the tincture complained of a feeling as if his heart had stopped. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rham-cal. - muscular pains, lumbago, pleurodynia, acute rheumatism. (2) Derris pinnata - neuralgic headachesof rheumatic origin. (3) Aristolochia milhom. - pain in achilles tendon, diabetes. Caul., Puls., Lil-t., Agar. (4) Macrotin - especially for lumbago. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sinking in the epigastrium (Sep., Sulph. ). Gnawing pain .Nausea and vomiting from pressure on spine and cervical region, pregnancy, alcohol. Vomits green substance, groans, raves and presses the head with both the hands for relief. Belch- ings with nausea, vomiting and headache.

Abdomen - Colic better bending double and after stools. Sharp pains across hy- pogastrium.

Rectum - Frequent thin, dark offensive stools. Alternate diarrhea and constipation. Morning diarrhea of children. Sensations - As of lifting up of skull, as if top of head would fly off, as of a bolt through from base of skull to vertex. Inspired air seems to penetrate skull and into brain, causing a cold sensation. Intense pain in and around the eyes (lancinating), worse moving head or eyes.

Female - Menses are profuse, dark, coagulated, scanty with backache, nervousness, irregular in time and amount, more flow, more pain. Menses suppressed from emotions, cold. Hysteric or epileptic spasms at the time of menses. Great debility between menses. Amenorrhea. Leucorrhea with a sensation of weight in the uterus. Pain across pelvis from hip to hip. Ovarian neuralgia, pain across pelvis from ovary to ovary or goes upwards or downwards along the thighs. Uterine atony. Mania. Slow labor pains with nervous shivers. Puerperal fever. After-pains with great sensitiveness and intolerance to pain. worse in groins. Lochia suppressed by cold or emotions. Food - No thirst, slight feeling of hunger in stomach, rumbling in abdomen. Great thirst. Appetite variable. No appetite for dinner, wants to drink cold water, little at a time suffices.

Chest - Intercostal rheumatism. Sharp stitches in left chest, motion exhorting cries. Left-sided infra-breast pain. Pleurodynia. Constitutions - Suited to the menopausal period, to nervous persons, to children during dentition, diarrhea. Nervousness from anxiety or overexertion. Rheumatic persons. Plump, delicate, sensitive, nervous, chilly women who coinplain of aching pain in back, neck, here and there. Many of the complaints are dependent upon uterine or ovarian irritation.

Heart - Heart's action ceases suddenly, impending suffocation. Sore, as if swollen or enlarged. Pulse weak, irregular, trembling, drops every third or fourth beat. Tremulous action. Numbness of left arm. feels as if bound to side. Needle-like pains at heart. Angina pectoris, pain spreads all over the chest to the back and down the left arm which feels numb and as if bound to the side. Cardiac neuralgia in childbirth.

Back - Rheumatic pains in muscles of back and neck. Stiffness and contraction in neckandback. Stiff neck, sensitive, worse pain or pressure, causes nausea and retching. Neck aches, throws the head back. Pain in the angle of left scapula. Spine very sensitive, especially upper part. Pain in lumbar and sacral region, down thighs and through hips. Crick in back. Breasts - Burning in breasts. Infra-breast pains, worse left side. Presses breasts as though in pain. Causations - Ill effects of anxiety, fright, disappointed love, overexertion, business failures, or childbirth.

Limbs - Alternation of rheumatic and mental symptoms. Uneasy and restless feeling in the limbs. Chorea movements, accompanied by rheumatism. Rheumatism affecting the belly of muscles, especially large muscles. Aching in limbs and muscular soreness. Jerking of limbs. Numbness of limbs. Cramps. Left arm feels as if bound to the side, constant irregular motion of left arm (chorea). Hands tremble while writing. Cold sweat on hands and feet. Soles itching. Cramps in calves. Stiffness and contracted Achilles tendon. Trembling of legs, can scarcely walk. Lungs - Tickling, short, dry, constant cough worse at night, speaking. Cough when secretion is scanty- spasmodic, dry, with muscular soreness and nervous irritation. Nervous cough.

Sleep - Sleeplessness. Sleeps with arms overhead or yawning. Comatose, as if drunk. Brain irritation of children during dentition.

Skin - Locally and internally for ivy poisoning.

Modalities - Better from warm wraps. Better open air. Better continued motion. Better pressure. Better grasping things. Better rest, and eating. Worse from damp, cold air. Worse change of weather. Worse heat and cold, draft. Worse alcohol, especially wine. Worse from motion. Worse sitting. Worse puberty. Worse during menses, labor, menopause. Worse emotions. Worse in the morning, and at night (malar neuralgia better at night). Pains in arms and Achilles tendon worse as evening approaches.

Kidneys - Profuse clear urine, causing weakness, with yellow sand. Nervous urination.

name: Cina Maritima
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind..
constitution: Abdomen, distended. Anemia. Anal, itching. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Borborygmi. Cachexia. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Eyes, disorders. Grinding, teeth. Headaches. Hiccough. Hydrocephaloid. Hypoglycemia. Indigestion. Intermittent, fever. Itching. Leucorrhea. Malassimilation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Paraplegia. Parasites
