PHARMACY - ciña. Cina maritima. Wormseed. Cinaartemisia. Artemisia maritima. Artemisia cintra. Semen cine. Flores cine. Tartarian southernwood. N. O. Composite. Tincture. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL -…
full:
PHARMACY - ciña. Cina maritima. Wormseed. Cinaartemisia. Artemisia maritima. Artemisia cintra. Semen cine. Flores cine. Tartarian southernwood. N. O. Composite. Tincture. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, distended. Anemia. Anal, itching. Asthenopia. Asthma. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Borborygmi. Cachexia. Chorea. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coughs. Dentition. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Eyes, disorders. Grinding, teeth. Headaches. Hiccough. Hydrocephaloid. Hypoglycemia. Indigestion. Intermittent, fever. Itching. Leucorrhea. Malassimilation. Nausea. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Paraplegia. Parasites. Pinworms. Remittent, fever. Roundworms. Scarlatina. Spasms. Strabismus. Threadworms. Twitch- ings. Urine, milky. Vision, disorders. Vomiting. Whooping cough. Worms.

HERBAL - This remedy is a preparation of Artemisia cintra, Tartarian southernwood or wormseed. The Artemisiae held a prominent place among the drugs of the ancient physicians from Hippocrates to Serapion. They were recommended as febrifuge, stomachic and anthelmintic. Cina is the source of the alkaloid Santonin which has a very strong anti-helminthic action. Cina is a powerful remedy for the elimination of round worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cina is preeminently a worm remedy, as it causes all the symptoms which characterize worm infestation, both mental, nervous and bodily. It corresponds more to the effects of lumbrici then to those of other worms. Reflex symptoms from abdominal irritation. Extreme sensitiveness of mind and body : offended by the slightest thing, peevish and obstinate, aversion to be caressed. Child cannot bear to have hair combed or brushed. Irritation of the nose, causing constant desire to rub, prick or press into it. Grinding teeth during sleep. Restless sleep, tossing all about the bed. Child lies on belly or on hands and knees during sleep. Nocturnal bedwetting, urine white, turbid, at times fetid. Over-sensitiveness of skin, cannot endure to be approached touched or pressed upon. Whole body is painfully sore to motion and touch, bruised soreness. Hair is sensitive to touch. Touch induces or aggravates spasms. Twitching, spasms. Convulsions with screams and violent jerkings of the hands and feet. Convulsions with consciousness. Chorea. Unilateral. Children throw arms from side to side during spasms. Paraplegia with unnatural hunger. Variable appetite. Greater the hunger, greater the emaciation. Scrofulous. Sour smell of body especially children. Children during dentition. Pain comes in shocks. Jumps suddenly as though he felt pain. Trembling with shivering, when yawning. Complaints concomitant to yawning, which comes on whenever someone yawns. MIND - Extreme ill-humor and naughtiness in children. Wants to be carried, but carrying gives no relief. Wants to be rocked. Irritability better rocking fast. Very touchy, irritable, petulant and dissatisfied. Child is very cross, does not want to be touched or carried. WardZop/ease. Desires many things, but rejects everything offered. Nervous. Child can't be quieted. Irritability of temper. Irritability during dentition. Violent screaming attacks at night. Child lying on the back and striking and kicking with hands and feet. Screaming, striking and biting. Nothing pleases them for any length of time. Crying out as if in delirium. Morose in daytime. Indisposition to play, in children. Convulsions in children when they are scolded or punished. Dislike of strangers (Bar-c.). Indifference to caresses. Worse if being looked at (Ant-t.). Unreal feeling of having done something wrong, abnormal consciousness. Unconscious with frothing at mouth. Sensitive, nervous women who get pain in head and eyes from sewing (Ruta). Irritability during menses. Earnest and sensitive, offended at the slightest joke. Fear of evil while walking in open air, in evening. Throws things away. Causeless weeping. Starting from sleep. Complaining on waking. Frightened easily on waking. Hallucinations of sight, smell and taste. As if frightened, jumps out of bed, sees imaginary objects, screams, trembles, talks hurriedly, anxious in evening and before midnight. Abdomen - Bloated and hard abdomen. Abdomen as if empty. Twisting pain about the navel, better pressure (Spig.). Pressing outward in belly. Pain on pressing upon navel. Colic with cutting, pinching pains from worms. Unpleasant, warm feeling. Pinching or cramplike pressure transversely across epigastric region after a meal.

Head - Headache, alternating with pain in abdomen, relieved by stooping (Mez.). Headache from straining eyes. Headache from sewing. Pain in head when reading or staring. Headache, before and after epileptic attack. Turning the head from one side to other. Child leans his head sideways all the time. Women must let hair down during headache. Children cannot tolerate to have their hair combed. Anemic headache, better stooping, worse mental exertion. Weak, hollow, empty sensation in head with inclination to vomit. Stupefying headache. Meningeal irritability, from worms.

Eyes - Dark rings around the eyes. Dilated pupils. Photophobia. Pulsation of ciliary muscle. Eyestrain, especially when presbyopia sets in. Strabismus from abdominal irritation, from worms. Eyebrows twitch when staring at any object. Drooping and heaviness of lids. Fatigue of eyes from sewing. Eyestrain with headache. Pain in eyes when reading or staring. Sensations as if sand had got into eyes, worse when reading. Lachrymation during cough. Spots on cornea. Itching of inner canthus.

Ears - Cramplike jerking in external ear, like earache. Digging and scratching in ears. Dull stitches below mastoid process. Hearing impaired.

Nose - Itching of nose all the time. Picks and bores at nose, until it bleeds. Wants to rub nose and pick at it. Child picks its nose and cries out in sleep. Sneezing with whooping cough. Nostrils drawn in. Violent sneezing with stitches in temples. Slimy discharge from nose. Bleeding from nose and mouth, with burning in nose. Nosebleed, dark blood, with pain in forehead. Stoppage of nose in evening.

Face - Face alternately pale and cold, or red and hot. Face puffy. Bluish white about the mouth. Pale with dark rings around eyes. Pale with sickly look during cough. Pale streak down centre of face. Cold perspiration. Grinds teeth during sleep. Chorea movements of face and hands. Tearing pain, in malar bones, worse touch and pressure. One cheek red, the other pale. Twitching of muscles about eyes and face, with disordered stomach and bowels.

Mouth - Sensitiveness of teeth to cold air and to cold drinks. Grinds teeth at night during sleep. Chews and swallows in sleep. Much frothy saliva with rattling mucus on chest. Foul breath. Bitter taste before chill. Dryness and rawness of mouth, palate. Clean tongue. Whitish sore place on margin of tongue, very painful to touch. Tongue coated brownish-yellow.

Stomach - Ravenous hunger, worse two hours after meals better when stomach is full. Loss of appetite. COMMENTS - Has cured attacks of pain occurring two hours after meals, relieved by a cup of milk or light food. With the first trituration, Nash cured a boy of eight who had several abscesses in and around the knee joint. The tibia was ulcerated and the ragged edge of the bone protruded through the surface. There was emaciation, loss of appetite and he was as pale as a corpse. The appetite returned at once in great force. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Calc-p., Calc-i., Glon., Bar-c. (2) Kali-c. - excessive sweating, weakness, pallor, Cact. - heart and arteries. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Sore throbbing in spleen. Mesenteric tuberculosis.

Rectum - Diarrhea of tuberculosis.

Male - Bad effects on masturbation, weakness of sight. Itching of genitals.

Female - Child refuses breast. Aversion to mother's milk. Uterine hemorrhage before puberty. Menses too early and profuse. Labor-like pains frequently recurring, as if menses would appear. Labor-like pains during pregnancy. Spasmodic yawning in amenorrhea. Food - Hunger voracious after eating. Gets hungry soon after a meal with feeling of emptiness. Indigestion. Canine hunger. Hunger during or before intermittent fever. Aversion to mother's milk. Bread tastes bitter. Desires many and different things. Craving for sweets, bread. Refuses ordinary food and desires dainties. Eats alot but doesn't gain weight. Malassimilation. Children are hungry, the greater the hunger the greater the emaciation. Hypoglycemia. Thirst for cold drinks. Difficult swallowing of liquids.

Chest - Veins stand out like whip-cord. Ears - Frying or sizzling in ears.

Heart - Angina pectoris.

Back - Drawing, tearing pains down along whole spine. Tearing, jerking pain in middle of spine. Paralytic feeling in nape. Bruised pain in lumbar region, not worse motion. Lancinating pain in upper part of spinal column extendind to right scapula. Causations - Ill effects of parasites, worms. Chest - Sternum as if lying too close to back. Cramplike, contracted sensation. Constriction of right side, with difficult breathing. Chest as if pressed together from both sides. As if chest was full of mucus. Sharp pain in left side. Burning and soreness in chest. Two dull piercing pains in quick succession near sternum. Constitutions - Generally hungry, cross, ugly and wants to be rocked. Children who are big, fat, rosy and scrofulous, they stiffen out, when looked at, during cough or when they become cross.

Limbs - Habitually cold limbs. Lungs - Acute pain in chest. Tuberculosis cough. Bleeding from the lungs. Asthma. Bronchitis.

Sleep - Starts in sleep.

Skin - Exhausting night sweat (Merc.). Acne with pustules all over the body.

Modalities - Worse from vital losses. Worse cold wind.

Kidneys - Urine, turbid, white, milky. Urine, turns milky on standing. Involuntary at night. Bedwetting, worse every full moon. Frequent urging with passage of much urine, all day. Involuntary urination. Urine becomes turbid immediately.

Cough - Gagging cough in the morning. Whooping cough. Violent cough recurring paroxysms, as of down in throat. Cough ends in spasm. Cough so violent as to bring tears and sternum pains, feels as if something had been torn off. Child is afraid to speak of move for fear of bringing on paroxysm of coughing. Periodic cough, returning spring and fall. Swallows after coughing. After coughing, moaning, anxious, gasps for air and turns pale.

Perspiration - Cold sweat on forehead, nose and hands. Sour smell of body especially children. After the sweat or before the chill, vomiting of food, with canine hunger at the same time.

name: Cineraria Maritima
author: Murphy
constitution: Cataract. Corneal, opacity. Eye, injuries.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cine. Cineraria marítima. Dusty miller. Senecio cineraria. N. 0. Composite. Corybiferae. Tincture or succus of the fresh plant, growing wild, gathered just before the flower-buds open. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Corneal,…
full:
PHARMACY - cine. Cineraria marítima. Dusty miller. Senecio cineraria. N. 0. Composite. Corybiferae. Tincture or succus of the fresh plant, growing wild, gathered just before the flower-buds open. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Corneal, opacity. Eye, injuries.

HERBAL - This is an unproved drug, but it has been used with a good deal of success in cases of cataract as an external application. The method adopted is to instill one drop four or five times a day into the affected eye, for several months.

HOMEOPATHIC - Most effective in traumatic eye cases. Traumatic cataract and corneal opacities, as well as senile cataract. No reports of cures by internal use of the remedy alone, but in some cases it was given internally as well as used externally. Generally, the patients have received specific homeopathic treatment internally at the same time. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) In cataract, Calc-f. Phos., Platanus, Cann-i., Caust., Naph., Led., Nat-m., Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

PHARMACY - cinnb. Cinnabaris. Red mercuric sulphide. Mercuric sulphide. Mercurius sulphuratus ruber. Hydrargyrum sulphuratum rubrum. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cinnb. corresponds to sycosis as well as to syphilis and to combinations of the two. Warts on the prepuce (Thuj.), especially for fan-shaped warts. General ner- vous, uneasy sensation. Weariness, languor. Tired and prostrated, worse before eating, better when riding in the open air. General sensitiveness to touch, bones of skull, scalp, roots of hair, bridge of nose, warts bleed when touched. Sensation on bridge of nose as if touched with metallic substance. Uneasy creeping and pressing sensation about nasal bones as from wearing spectacles when not used to them. Headache with nosebleed. Frequent jerkings and pullings. Certain forms of ciliary neuralgia and ulceration upon a syphilitic base. Cold and chilly in warm room. Symptoms intermit in severity. MIND - Indolence and indisposition to mental labor. Forgetful. Fretful, easily provoked. Sleepless during night. Sensation of fullness in the head from mental application. Desire to be alone.

Head - Congestion to head, face purple red. Congestion of blood to the head, worse after eating. Violent and frightful attack of headaches, better by compression of the head. Intense headache, he cannot raise his head from the pillow, relieved by external pressure. Dull pain in the forehead, which is cold, relieved by heat. Shooting pain in the left side of the head. Painful sensitiveness of the cranium and of the hair on being touched. Stupefying buzzing in the head.

Eyes - Redness of whole eye. Eye infections. Lids granulated, canthi and lids red. Severe shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running from inner to outer canthus in the bone. Pains from lachrymal duct around eye to temple from inner canthus across brows to ear.

Ears - Roaring in the ears with swelling of the face, after eating. Scurfy eruption in right external ear. Itching in right ear.

Nose - Nasal catarrh. Hawks stringy mucus from throat or lumpy mucus drops from the posterior sinuses. Discharge from the nose is acrid, foul, burning, watery or dark lumps. Coryza with lumps of dirty, yellow mucus are discharged from the posterior sinuses. Violent, fluent, burning coryza. Itching of the nose, with bleeding after blowing it. Pain about root, extending into bones on each side (Aur.).

Face - Heat and swelling, mostly about the eyes.

Mouth - Dry mouth and throat, wakes from sleep, must rinse the mouth Both corners of the mouth are chapped. Tongue coated white with a putrid, bitter taste in the morning. Burning, constrictive sensation in the palate. Salivation and increased flow of urine.

Throat - Stringy mucus passed through posterior sinuses into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat, must rinse the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and throat. Vertigo - Giddiness in the morning after rising, when stooping with nausea. COMMENTS - The skin is much affected. Redness predominates (the color of the drug). Red spots. Heat, redness and swelling of face, especially about eyes. Eruption on posterior cervical region, on inner and lower part of thigh with itching. Warts, pimples, pustules, ulcers, violent itching and pricking, especially about joints. Glands enlarged. The back of the neck is affected. Pain extending to occiput when head is thrown back. Pain right side of neck on turning head. Muscles seem contracted. Leucorrhea, discharge causes a pressure in the vagina. Jerking in penis, occurring during sleep. Tearing stitches in glans. Burning, stinging, itching of corona glandis. Frequent hemorrhages, nosebleed, bleeding hemorrhoids. Dysenteric symptoms. Obstinate constipation, stools hard and too large. Protrusion of anus during stool. Formication as from a large worm. Little pimples around anus with burning and itching. Berridge reported this symptom cured: “Left leg feels shorter than right while walking.” . Guernsey said “We are led to use this for very red and very fiery-looking ulcers, which may occur in the throat or on any other part of the body. Ulcers in the mouth, on the legs, particularly if there be nodes on the shin- bones. In very angry looking chancres.” RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Hep., Nit-ac., Opium and Sulphur.

Stomach - Soreness in the stomach, with dizziness and lightness in the head and tightness in the temples. Nausea, alleviated by belchings. Nausea with water brash, in the evening.

Abdomen - Flashes of heat confined to the abdomen with great flatulence, worse in the forenoon.

Rectum - Formication in the anus, as from a large worm. Little pimples around the anus with burning and itching. Bloody dysentery. Tenesmus. Evacuations, soft and frequent. Thin, white stools. Green mucus diarrhea, which stains the skin about anus and scrotum a copper color.

Male - Jerking in penis during sleep. Foul acrid sweat between scrotum and thighs. Warts on prepuce, fan- shaped and bleed easily. Small red pimples on glans. Itching of corona glandis. Redness and swelling of prepuce, testicles enlarged, buboes, angry looking chancres. Syphilis, squamous and vesicular. Old hard chancres.

Female - Leucorrhea, discharge with a feeling of pressure in vagina.

Chest - Chest oppressed, feels contracted, relieved by stretching. Pain running over the ensiform cartilage from the seventh rib on the right side diagonally through the chest. Pulsating and shooting pains in the chest, especially when walking. Constitutions - Anti-sycotic and antisyphilitic.

Heart - Heart flutters, then rushes of blood to the head.

Back - Pain in back part of neck when head is thrown back, extending to occiput. Wrenching pains in the vertebrae of the neck. The muscles of the neck seem as if contracted. Tearing in the side of the back. Aching in the small of the back, as if bruised. Pain all over the back down to the loins.

Limbs - Sensation of lameness in all the limbs. Pulling and shuddering in the arms and legs. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers. Cold knees or joints. Left leg feels shorter than the right, while walking. Cramp in calves after walking. Pain in Achilles tendon and os calcis when walking. Nodes on shin bones. Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Lungs - Dyspnea with heat. Cough from tickling in the throat. Dry cough in single shocks, when lying down, better by sitting up. Hoarseness in the evening.

Sleep - Sleepiness in the daytime and sleeplessness at night, unconquerable desire to sleep after dinner, early in the evening. Restlessness and sleeplessness at night from a constant flow of ideas changing from one thing to another. Restless sleep with vivid dreams and much talking. Nightmares after midnight.

Skin - Red eruptions. Violent itching and pricking. Honeycombed ulcers. Very fiery-red looking ulcers. Condyloma, easily bleeding. Buboes. Nodes on the shin bones. Sweat on nose.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better open air. Better sunshine. Better after dinner. Worse from light. Worse summer. Worse dampness. Worse walking. Worse night. Worse touch. Worse lying on right side, feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side. Sweat worse at noon. Headache worse after sleep.

Compare - (1) Hep., Camph. (red spots), Lach., Merc., Nit-ac. (2) Thuj. - Cinnb. is better than Thuj in warts on prepuce. (3) Sep. - warts on margin of prepuce, Ant-t. - warts at back of glans. (4) Seneg. has better bending head backward, Clem, has headache worse from same, Clem, also has vertigo on lifting head up or moving head, Cinnb. has pain in back of neck when head is thrown back. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Frequent and increasing emission of watery urine, also during the night. Pain, as if from a sore in the urethra, when urinating, this pain wakes him up at night.

Temperature - Pulse slower in the forepart of the day, accelerated in the evening. Coldness and chilliness in the warm room. Heat of the body during the whole night. Profuse perspiration between the thighs. Perspiration most at noon.

name: Cinnamonum Ceylanicum
author: Murphy
constitution: Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness. Hemorrhages. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Post- partum, hemorrhage. Vomiting.
keynote:

full:
PHARMACY - cinnam. Cinnamonum ceylanicum. Cinnamon tree. Cinnamomum zeylanicum. Cinnamomum cassia. N. O. Lauracae. Tincture. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascites. Decay. Cancer. Chilliness. Constipation. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Forgetfulness. Hemorrhages. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Leucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Post- partum, hemorrhage. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Cinnam. has been used in large doses by the old school in cases of uterine cancer and some success has been claimed for it. Cancer where pain and fetor are present. For cancer, use a strong decoction, one-half pint a day. Oil of cinnamon in water solution is the best local disinfectant. 3-4 drops in two quarts of water as a douche, wherever a germicide and disinfectant is needed. Three drops on sugar for hiccough.

HOMEOPATHIC - A leading feature of Cinnamon is hemorrhage, and has had abundant clinical verification. Hemorrhage is bright red and clear, worse by any physical exertion. Nosebleeds. Hemorrhage during the pregnancy, threatening miscarriage. A strain in loins or false step brings on a profuse flow of bright blood. Post-partum hemorrhage. Hemorrhages from bowels, hemoptysis, etc. Great weakness as after loss of fluids. Hysterical attacks, going off with belchings with nausea or vomiting. Talking causes hysterical attacks. Feeble patients with languid circulation. Gastric disturbances. Flatulency and diarrhea. Pains in bones and muscles. Symptoms are worse while riding, exertion, talking, afternoon, and evening up to midnight. MIND - Forgetfulness. Anxiety. Child screams and weeps until midnight. Delusion left side of body is diminished, smaller. Hysteria. Great stupor in hysteria. Hysteria when nothing brings on the attacks more surely than talking.

Eyes - Pain from left eye up to vertex in a line along the middle. Itching of the eyes. Improves weakness of vision.

Ears - Heat around left ear.

Nose - Frequent attacks of nosebleed. Tough mucus from nose.

Face - Whole face turned red.

Mouth - Toothache. Offensive taste in mouth. Ptyalism, particularly with pain in back.

Throat - Sore throat. Hoarseness with cough. Clears the voice when muffled by secretions, scatters the phlegm and is useful for tickling in larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness and oppression of breathing. Fainting. COMMENTS - Particularly useful for hemorrhage. Uterine hemorrhage, bleeding fibroids, any emergency hemorrhage. Profuse diarrhea. Can be used easily as a home remedy, either in potency or as a tea in an emergency. Boericke said “a profuse flow of bright blood.” One case documented a woman who had a uterine hemorrhage after childbirth and she craved cinnamon, Cinnam. helped. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon. It antidotes: Opium. Compare: (1) Ip., Phos., Sil., Trill. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Tonic effect on stomach. Pressure and cramps in stomach. Hiccough jyjfh diarrhea, want of appetite and acidity Cinnamonum ceylanicum of stomach. Belching with colic. Nausea while riding with gagging and vomiting of mucus. Nausea and retching every day at same hour for four days. Chronic vomiting. Paroxysms subside as soon as vomiting sets in. Vomiting of pregnancy. Stool - Long continued constipation, stool in hard balls. Diarrhea, worse after drinking with acidity. Hemorrhage from bowels, bright red and clear blood, occurring especially after any physical exertion.

Abdomen - Much flatulence with colic and pain in uterus. Metastasis of gout to stomach and intestines.

Male - Excessive irritability of sexual organs, causes erections. Impotence, sensation of weakness in legs.

Female - Menses early, profuse, prolonged, bright red. Menorrhagia, with itching at nose, bright red blood, worse after false step or strain. Bearing-down sensation. Uterine hemorrhages caused by overlifting. Repeated small hemorrhages during pregnancy and puerperal state. Metrorrhagia. Sleepy. Fingers seem swollen. No desire for anything. Worse on any exertion, lifting, straining, over-stretching arms, false step. Food - Canine hunger with nausea and debility when passing the meal hour. Want of appetite with diarrhea and acidity of stomach.

Chest - Pain in chest. Anxiety and oppression in precordial region, causing constriction of chest. Constitutions - Lymphatic, feeble, cachectic women with lax tissues and languid circulation. A women advanced in years, hysterical convulsions.

Heart - Great cardiac anxiety and loss of pulse with attacks. Heart weakness. Strengthens the heart. Hysteria.

Sleep - Profound sleep with attacks.

Liver - Obstructions or induration of liver. Lungs - Oppressed breathing, with vertigo and weakness.

Kidneys - Retention of urine.

Temperature - Chilliness with trembling of limbs. Great fever in evening. Transient heat with sweat. Nervous and typhoid fevers with great impairment of digestion, vomiting, diarrhea and exhaustion.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - cipr. Cipro. Ciprofloxacin. Cipro is a fluorinated quinolone, belonging to a class of fluorinated antibiotics. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdominal pain. Acid, reflux. Acidosis. Allergies. Anemia. Anginapecto- ris. Agranulocytosis. Antrax. Ataxia. Blisters. Blood, clots. Convulsions. Diarrhea. Diplopia. Dyspnea. Edema. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Heartburn. Hematuria. Hepatitis. Hives. Hyperpigmentation. Insomnia. Itching. Jaundice. Ijver, disorders. Kidney, disorders. Kidney, stones. Musculoskeletal, disorders. Nausea. Nephritis. Nightmares. Nosebleed. Palpitations. Rhabdomyolysis. Sun, allergy. Sunburns. Swelling. Tendon, rupture. Tendonitis. Thrush. Tinnitus. Tremors. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cipro is a very toxic antibiotic drug used for the treatment of antrax and other infections. As many as 20% of people taking Cipro have reported severe side effects. The most common side-effects reported are gastrointestinal in nature such as nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Ciprofloxacin administration results in elevated serum fluoride levels. Cipro can cause musculo-skeletal disorders such as rhabdomyolysis. Tendonitis and tendon rupture. Achilles tendon rupture was shown to even after withdrawal of the drug. Other fluoroquinolones are now withdrawn from the market because they had caused severe liver and kidney damage and even deaths. Fatal liver failure associated with ciprofloxacin has been reported. Ciprofloxacin has been implicated in several cases of acute kidney failure and dysfunc- - tion. Respiratory distress is a side- effect of ciprofloxacin. Photosensitivity can result when light interacts with chemical agents in the skin and eyes. This process can produce undesirable clinical consequences, such as phototoxicity, exaggerated sunburn, sun allergy or sun-carcinogenicity. People receiving Patients taking Cipro are warned not to expose themselves to direct sunlight. Rashes develop on the areas exposed. This medication may stimulate the central nervous system, which may lead to tremors, restlessness, light- headedness, confusion, depression, and hallucinations. Other central nervous system reactions include nervousness, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, nightmares, and paranoia. Cipro can cause increased pressure within the brain. Convulsions have been reported in people receiving the drug. Seizures. Slug gishness. Tingling sensation. Vague feeling of illness. Weakness. Swelling of the face, lips, neck, eyes, or hands. Agranulocytosis, potentially fatal condition where the white blood cell count goes extremely low. Blood and albumin in the urine, elevated serum potassium, glucose, and albumin. Elevation of triglycerides and cholesterol. MIND - Abnormal dread or fear. Anxiety. Nervousness. Agitation and restlessness. Mental confusion. Depersonalization. Loss of sense of identity. Depression. Irritability. Delirium. Hallucinations. Manic attacks. Paranoia. Toxic psychosis.

Head - Headache. Light-headedness. Blood clot to the brain.

Eyes - Eye pain. Yellow eyes. Involuntary eye movement. Blurred vision. Double vision. Decreased vision. Change in color perception. Sensitivity to light.

Ears - Hearing loss. Ringing in the ears.

Nose - Nosebleed. Loss of sense of smell.

Face - Swelling of the face.

Mouth - Mouth sores. Bad taste in mouth. Thrush. Oral fungal infection.

Stomach - Acid, reflux. Heartburn. Indigestion. Bleeding in the stomach. Hiccoughs. Nausea and vomiting.

Abdomen - Bleeding in the intestines. Flatus. Intestinal inflammation. Intestinal perforation. Swelling of the pancreas.

Rectum - Diarrhea. Constipation. Pale or dark stools.

Male - Burning in penis. Prostatitis.

Female - Vaginal inflammation. Food - Lack of appetite. Loss of appetite.

Heart - Angina pectoris. Cardiopulmonary arrest. Irregular heartbeat. Palpitations. Pounding heartbeat. High blood pressure. Heart attack. Heart flutters.

Back - Back pain. Neck pain.

Limbs - Achiness. Joint stiffness. Joint pain. Gout flare-up. Convulsions. Ataxia, lack of muscle coordination. Tendon, rupture. Achilles tendon rupture. Tendonitis.

Sleep - Drowsiness. Inability to fall or stay asleep. Insomnia. Nightmares.

Skin - Blistering of skin. Burning sensations. Severe allergic reaction. Skin hypersensitivity. Cuticle candidiasis (yeast). Skin peeling. Itching. Hives. Redness. Red bumps on skin. Skin sensitivity to sunlight. Sunburns. Hyperpigmentation. Unusual darkening of the skin. Yellow skin.

Liver - Hepatitis. Liver damage. Jaundice. Liver failure. Lungs - Dyspnea. Respiratory distress. Labored breathing. Blood clots in the lungs. Coughing up blood. Difficult breathing. Bronchial spasms.

Kidneys - Inability to urinate. Kidney damage. Large volumes of urine. Kidney failure. Urinary retention. Urethral bleeding. Acidosis. Nephritis. Increased urinary output. Kidney stones. Dark urine. Blood in urine.

Blood - Acidosis. Anemia. Agranulocytosis. Swelling of the blood vessels or lymph system.

Temperature - Chills. Fever. Heat flushing. Throat - Difficulty in swallowing. Swelling of the throat. Speech difficulties. Vertigo - Dizziness. Light-headedness. Fainting. RELATIONS - Compare: Calc-f., Fl-ac. REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Cistus Canadensis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from eating. Better swallowing. Better expectoration. Great sensitiveness to touch. Worse from touch. Worse slightest exposure to cold air. Worse drafts. Worse cold water. Worse evening, night, morning. Worse mental exertion. Worse excitement. Worse touch. Worse motion. Diarrhea worse from drinking coffee..
constitution: Bone disorders. Breast, cancer. Cancer. Diarrhea. Erysipelas. Glandular swellings. Herpes zoster. Hip joint disease. Hospital gangrene. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Mastitis. Ophthalmia. Panaritium. Parotiditis. Pharyngitis. Pyorrhea. Scorbutus. Scrofula. Sore, throat. Ulcers.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cist. Cistus canadensis. Rock rose. Helianthemum canadense. Ice-plant. Frost-weed. N. O. Cistacae. Tincture of whole flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally as a wash to arrest fetid discharges.

CLINICAL - Bone disorders. Breast, cancer.…
full:
PHARMACY - cist. Cistus canadensis. Rock rose. Helianthemum canadense. Ice-plant. Frost-weed. N. O. Cistacae. Tincture of whole flowering plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally as a wash to arrest fetid discharges.

CLINICAL - Bone disorders. Breast, cancer. Cancer. Diarrhea. Erysipelas. Glandular swellings. Herpes zoster. Hip joint disease. Hospital gangrene. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Mastitis. Ophthalmia. Panaritium. Parotiditis. Pharyngitis. Pyorrhea. Scorbutus. Scrofula. Sore, throat. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cistus is a very ancient remedy for scrofulous disorders, in scorbutic states, and for gangrenous ulcerations. The provings and homeopathic uses confirm its suitability in these respects and bring out clearer indications. Affects the glands, especially of nasopharynx, neck and breasts (left). Malignant disease of the glands of the neck. Indurated glandular swelling of the neck and throat. Suppuration of the glands of the neck. Breast cancer, hardness of the breasts. Cancer of the lower lip. Scorbutic, swollen gums separating from the teeth, gums bleed easily, putrid, disgusting. Cold tongue. Decay of the lower jaw. Desire for acid food and fruits. Saliva in throat. Belchings in stomach. Affinity for the naso-pharynx, aborts colds that center in posterior nose. Sniffling. Mucus discharges are thick, yellow, foul, leave a painful rawness. Worse sweating, discharges. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Herpetic eruptions, scorbutic states, chronic swellings and gangrenous ulcerations. Poisoned wounds, bites, phagadenic ulcers. Suppurations. Lupus. Internal and external itching. Burnings. Formication through the whole body with anxious, difficult breathing. Indurations. Callosities with cracks. Extreme sensitivity to cold. Sensation of coldness in various parts. Inhaled air feels cool. Cold breath. Grimmer said “This patient is extremely sensitive to cold and all complaints become worse after exposure to cold.” All mental excitement aggravates. MIND - Fear. Bad effects from vexation. All mental excitement aggravates (stitches in throat, cough).

Head - Head drawn to one side by swelling in the neck. Forehead cold, and sensation of coolness inside forehead, in a very warm room. Pressive pain at root of nose with headache. Headache from missed meals, better eating.

Eyes - Feeling as if something passing around the eye. Weight above eyes. Scrofulous inflammation. Canthi cracked. Stitches in eyes.

Ears - Watery discharge, fetid pus, after eruptive diseases. Discharge of water and bad-smelling pus. Tetter on and around ears, extending to external meatus. Inner swelling of ears with discharge.

Nose - Cold feeling or burning in nose. Tip painful. Eczema of the nose. As of a lump in naso-pharynx. Pressing pain at the root of the nose with headache. Chronic nasal catarrh, frequent violent sneezing.

Face - Decay of the lower jaw with suppurating glands on neck. Swelling of parotid glands. Open, bleeding, cancer on lower lip. Lips cracked. Tip of nose painful. Itching, burning and crusts, on zygoma. Vesicular erysipelas. Lupus.

Mouth - Scorbutic, receding gums, easily bleeding, putrid. Pyorrhea (Merc-c., Caust., Staph., Kreos.). Mouth feels cold. putrid, impure breath. Tongue feels cold. Hurts to protrude the tongue. Breath cool. Saliva cold.

Throat - Soft, spongy feeling, itching in the throat. Heat and itching in throat. Small, dry spot in throat, must sip water frequently. Throat, very dry and becomes sore on inhaling least cold air. Breath, tongue, and throat feel cold. Uvula and tonsils swollen. Glands swollen and suppurating. Goiter with frequent diarrhea. Head drawn to one side by swellings in neck. Pains when coughing. Hawking of mucus. COMMENTS - “Sensitive to cold air” and feelings of coldness. Cold feelings in larynx, in abdomen. “Inhaling the slightest cold air causes sore-throat, which he has not when inhaling in a warm room.” Indurated glandular swelling of the neck and throat. Trembling with the fever. Sensation as if ants were running through the whole body (in evening with anxious, difficult breathing). Prominent stitches. Characteristic soft or spongy feeling. Clarke cured with Cist, a case of sore throat that had lasted for years under allopathic treatment with local swabbings. There was an accumulation of thick yellow, leathery phlegm that had to be cleared away by a local means. The patient complained of a “spongy” feeling in the throat and the led him to the remedy. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Rhus-t., Camph. and Sep. Compare: (1) Con., Calc., Arg-n., Bell., (2) Carb-v. - cold breath. (3) Sulph. - morning diarrhea. Compatible: Magnesium - the plant grows on a magnesium soil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

Stomach - Cool feeling in stomach before and after eating. Empty and cool belching. Frequent nausea with diarrhea. Diarrhea after drinking coffee.

Abdomen - Stitches in left hypochondrium. Cool feeling in abdomen. Pain in groin coming from back.

Rectum - Chronic dysentery. Stool, thin, yellow, urgent, worse in morning. Diarrhea from coffee and fruit, with goiter and nausea. Chronic diarrhea in wet weather in scrawny scrofulous children.

Male - Itching on scrotum.

Female - Sensitive to cold air. Bad smelling leucorrhea. Cancer. Food - Desire for acid food and fruits, cheese, pungent things.

Chest - Coldness in chest. Chest feels raw after expectoration. Trachea feels narrow. Hemorrhage from lungs. Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous subjects who are very sensitive to cold air.

Back - Hard, swollen glands in the neck. Neck is studded with tumors. Burning, bruised pain in the coccyx, preventing sitting, touch. Breasts - Induration of breasts, sensitive to cold air. Mastitis. Breast cancer. Causations - Bad effects from anger, vexation.

Limbs - Sprained pain in wrist. Cold feet. Cracked finger tips, sensitive to cold. Workmen develop hard place on their hands with cracks. Tetter on hands. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs with hard swelling around. White swelling. Lungs - Asthmatic after lying down. Larynx and trachea feel cool on inhaling cold air. Trachea feels narrow and breathing becomes difficult, preceded by formication. Expectoration of quantities of glairy, tenacious mucus, on lying down. Chest feels raw after expectoration.

Sleep - Very restless at night. Sleepless from coldness or dryness in throat. Night sweats.

Skin - General itching which prevents sleep. Itching, crawling all over without eruptions. Small, painful pimples. Skin of hands hard, thick, dry, fissured, deep cracks. Itching of swollen hands and arms. Mercurio-syphilitic ulcers. Hemicrania. Lupus. Glands inflamed and indurated.

Modalities - Better from eating. Better swallowing. Better expectoration. Great sensitiveness to touch. Worse from touch. Worse slightest exposure to cold air. Worse drafts. Worse cold water. Worse evening, night, morning. Worse mental exertion. Worse excitement. Worse touch. Worse motion. Diarrhea worse from drinking coffee.

HOMEOPATHIC - That their action is homeopathic has been proved by the occurrence of scurvy from the excessive use of the acid when taken for other purposes. Cit-1. has a powerful effect on the circulation and on the blood itself. Faintness, a weak pulse, hemorrhages and swellings. Excessive menstruation. Inflammation and painful enlargement of the spleen, dyspnea. Stiffness in the joints, particularly in the fingers, bruised feeling, particularly in the feet. Herpetic eruptions. Cancer pains. Sore throats. Daily headache. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon., Asarum, Datura, Euphorbia, Hep., Sepia. It antidotes: Aeon., Euphorb., Stram., snakebites and all animal poisons. It increases the curative effects of Bell. Compare: (1) It should be compared with Acetic acid and the “bruisedpain in the joints” recalls the action of its congener, Ruta, Bell., Lach. (2) As an antidote against Stram. It has been employed with great success, the juice of the fruit being administered by the teaspoonful. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Boiled dried orange peel excites the intestine in a manner similar to other forms of cellulose or agar. There is an increased flow of bile which continues for hours. It unites both a chola- gogue action with a mechanical stimulus to peristalsis. An orange eaten before breakfast is said to destroy the craving for alcohol in alcoholics.

HOMEOPATHIC - One patient could never eat an orange without experiencing a fearful taste at the back of the nose and throat. This lasted many days and caused choking sensations and faintness. For diseases of the elderly with coldness and chilliness. Neuralgias and skin symptoms. Facial neuralgias, mostly right-sided. Itching, redness and swelling of hands. Headache with nausea, vomiting and vertigo. Frequent and irresistible yawning. Disturbed sleep. Great excitement, quick motions. Pains in kidneys and bladder. Too copious menses. Pleurodynia. Palpitations. Thoracic oppression.

Head - Right sided headache.

Face - Neuralgia of face, shooting, gnawing pains, in temples, especially right side.

Throat - Something seems to rise in throat and choke. Fearful taste at back of nose and throat, lasting for days and causing choking sensation and faintness. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ruta, Angustura. (2) Citrus limonum. (3) Citric acid. (4) Citrus decumana. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Skin - Itching, general or more often only in upper limbs, with redness and swelling of hands. Eruption and other symptoms like scarlatina.

Teeth - Constant toothache. Teeth become decayed, wear off.

PHARMACY - clem-b. Clematis. Clematis vitalba. Flowers are picked with the stalk, placed in a bowl of water and allowed to sit in the sun for several hours. The water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.

HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy belongs to the group of Not Sufficient Interest in Present Circumstances, as classified by Bach. The additional remedies of this group are Honey- b., Wld-r-b., Oliv-b„ Wh-ch-b., Must- b. and Ch-bd-b.. This group of remedies helps those not fully engaged in the here and now. Shocked by sudden noise and startles easily when touched. Sleepiness, drowsiness, fainting and vertigo. In some comatose states, Clem-b. may restore consciousness. The body may seem as if not “inhabited,” as the mind draws to future dream castles or removes due to exhaustion or emotional hardship. Out-of-body experiences. MIND - Hazy reality. Passive. Tendency to suddenly lose touch and become drowsy or sleepy. Lightheaded or vacant feeling. Lack of concentration. Prevalent absent-mindedness, interrupted by spurts of interest. Delusions with ecstatic content (Verv-b.), pleasant visions and reveries. Set on dreams of future fulfillment, rather than seeing the present as promising and trying to find happiness therein. States from daydreaming about future happiness, fatigue, strenuous or saddening daily routines. Hopeful. Happy when dreaming, reality seems harsh, void of meaning, lonely or sad. REFERENCES - Bach.

CLINICAL - Acne. Arthritic, nodosities. Blepharitis. Cancer. Conjunctivitis. Eyes, disorders. Face, pimples. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Homesickness. Nausea. Orchitis. Rheumatism. Skin, rashes. Testicles, infections. Toothache. Urethra, stricture.

HOMEOPATHIC - Clematis, like other Ranunculi, is a direct irritant of the skin producing inflammation and vesication. In the provings, the external head (left), eyes, teeth (left), skin, urinary and male sexual organs show the greatest number of symptoms. Acts especially on the skin, mucus membranes of eyes and urethra, glands, breasts, ovaries and genito- urinary organs, especially the testicles. Glands become very hard and painfully swollen. Herpes, stricture of the urethra, cancer of the breast and testes. Inflammation of eyes, worse left, smarting, burning, stitches, redness, lachrymation, photophobia. Sensation as if fire were streaming from eyes. Neuralgic pains in various parts. Pains relieved by perspiration. Burning, itching, stinging, crawling. Muscles flaccid or twitch. Distant pulsation in whole body. Vibrating sensation through the body after lying down. Strictures. Emaciation. Great sleepiness. Great debility from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m. Aversion to be washed. MIND - Confused feeling, better in open air. Peevish, dissatisfied without any cause. Melancholy, preoccupied with sad thoughts. General sadness and dread of misfortune. Sadness better after eating. Cheerful alternating with sadness, followed by irritability and prostration. Homesick (Caps.). Ailments from homesickness. Memory weak. Indifference. Aversion to talking. Indolence in morning, better evening. Aversion to reading, desires to be read to. Irritable, taciturn, doesn't want to go out. Low sex drive. Fear of being alone, but disinclined to meet even agreeable company. Sleepy, dreamy.

Head - Confused feeling, better in open air. Hammering and strokes in the head. Boring pain in temples. Headaches, worse bending head backward. Head feels full and heavy, hanging down. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive. Itching on the hairy scalp.

Eyes - Complaints from bright sunlight. Chronic conjunctivitis. Pustular conjunctivitis with tinea capitis, eyes inflamed and protruding. Chronic blepharitis with sore and swollen meibomian glands. Iritis with great sensitiveness to cold. Heat in eyes, sensitive to air, must close them. Burning, as if fire were streaming out and smarting, worse closing eyes. Lachrymation. Flickering before eyes.

Ears - Burning pain in exterior of the ear. Tinkling, ringing in the ear.

Face - White blisters on face and nose, as if sunburned. Pain in right side of face to eye, ear and temple, better holding cold water in the mouth. Swelling of the submaxillary glands with hard tubercles, throbbing, aggravated on being touched. Lip cancer.

Mouth - Breath offensive to others. Dryness of the tongue in the morning. Dull shootings and piercings in the root of the tongue. Small blisters on the tongue and in the throat, which soon become ulcers.

Throat - Heat and burning in the mouth and throat. Sensation of roughness in the throat. Vertigo - Giddiness if he lifts his head up, or when moving the head. COMMENTS - Clematis was used by Stoerck before Hahnemann's time in cancerous and other foul ulcers, inveterate skin eruptions, syphilis and rheumatism. Affections of the urethra, penis in general, prepuce in particular. May have to wait a long time before he can urinate with intense pain along fore part of urethra. Flow of urine by fits and starts. Mucus in the urine, but not pus. Beginning of inflammatory stricture. Stricture of the urethra Swelling of inguinal glands. Painful inflamed, swollen testicles. Great affinity for the testes. Useful for cases of undescended testicles, painful, partially descended testicles, and hydroceles where the scrotum swells with fluid (Con., Spong.). Indurated testicles. Testicular cancer. Gonorrhea that goes to the testes. Herpes. Breast cancer. Generally a right-sided remedy. Great debility, twitching of muscles, vibrating sensation through body. Giddiness when lifting up head or when moving head. Useful for poison ivy and poison oak. Vesicles and weeping of yellow, acrid fluid on body (Rhus-t.). Fluid stings, worse bathing. Impetigo, fluid seeping from beneath the scabs. RELATIONS - It is antidoted by: Bry. (Toothache, urinary symptoms), Camph. Antidote to: Merc. Compare: ( 1 ) Clematis vitalba - varicose andotherulcers. (2) Sil., Staph., Petr., Oleand., Canth., Phos. acid. (3) Ars. - skin, Clem, has more redness is worse from washing, has moist, alternating with dry scabs. (4) Puls. - gonorrheal orchitis, testicle tender and hard as a stone. (5) Bell., Bry., Calc., Canth., Con., Caust., Dulc. (syphilitic ulcerations), Graph., Merc, (iritis sensitive to cold), Petr, (impetigo on neck and occiput). (6) Sars. - syphilitic ulcers. (7) In “aversion to be washed,” compare Ant-c., Hep., Phos., Sep., Spig., Sulph. (8) In bending head back, Cinnb., Cobalt, has worse bending head forward. Compatible: Sil. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Disagreeable sensation of coldness in the stomach. Weakness in all the limbs after eating with pulsation in arteries. Nausea on smoking tobacco with weakness of legs.

Abdomen - Pain from abdomen to chest, worse breathing and during urination. Swelling of inguinal glands with jerking pains, with scirrhus or suppressed gonorrhea, rheumatism of joints.

Male - Orchitis. Testes hang heavy or retracted. Testicles indurated with bruised feeling. Swelling of right half of the scrotum. Ilio-scrotal neuralgia. Swelling of the spermatic cord with burning and soreness, extending to abdomen. Violent erections with stitches in urethra. Burning in penis during seminal discharge during sex. Aversion for sex.

Female - Menses too early. Swelling and induration of the mammary glands. Breast and uterine cancer. Food - Weakness, nausea and sleepiness after eating. Prolonged satiety, though the food continues pleasant to the taste. Increased thirst, with desire for ice. Aversion to beer. Nausea on smoking tobacco, with weakness of the legs.

Heart - Sharp stitches at heart, from within outwards.

Back - Itching pustules around the neck, with excoriation after scratching .Humid tetters from the nape of the neck to the occiput. Eruption of pustules in the lumbar region. Breasts - Breast and uterine cancer. Swelling and induration of breasts. Glandular induration and tumors of breast.' Breast cancer with stitches in shoulders and uterus. Shooting pain in breast, worse urinating. Full, heavy, sensitive breasts. Causations - Homesickness. Constitutions - Suited to light-haired people with torpid, cachectic conditions, swellings and indurations of the glandular system. Syphilitic taint. Scrofulous, rheú- matic, gonorrheal and syphilitic patients.

Limbs - Arthritic nodosities in the joints of the fingers. Axillary glands swollen. Weakness in limbs after eating or with nausea on smoking tobacco. Scaly tetters in the thigh. Lungs - Breathing impaired, worse ascending the hill or walking over uneven road. Barking, dry cough with stitches in chest. Expectoration of bloody saliva.

Sleep - Sleepiness. Restless, dreamy sleep with vibratory sensation throughout the body.

Skin - Glands hot, painful, swollen, worse inguinal glands. Vesicles, pustules. Red, burning, scaly, scabby. Corroding eruptions, ending in flat eating ulcers with thick crusts and eczema worse occiput and lower legs. Varicose ulcers. Herpes zoster. Itches terribly, worse washing in cold water, worse face and hands and scalp around occiput.

Modalities - Better from sweating. Better open air. Worse from gonorrhea. Worse touch. Worse motion. Worse moist poul tices. Worse from heat of bed. Worse night. Worse cold washing or air, cold water. Worse during increasing and new moon, better during the waning moon. Monthly aggravations. Headache and toothache are worse lying down in evening.

Teeth - Toothache, worse at night andfrom tobacco, temporarily worse from heat of bed. Toothache in a decayed molar tooth, much better by cold water. Shooting pains or successive pullings in the teeth. Sensation as if the decayed tooth were too long. The least contact is exceedingly painful.

Kidneys - Urethra feels constricted, like a large whip-cord painful on pressure. Stricture of urethra. Frequent, scanty urination, burning at orifice. Burning in urethra during urination. Urine stops and starts, emitted drop by drop. Must strain to pass a few drops, then full stream follows. Inability to pass all the urine, dribbling after urinating. Last drops of urine cause violent burning. Tingling in urethra lasting some time after urinating. Pain along the spermatic cord, worse at night.

Temperature - Pulse accelerated. Quartan fever, characterized by shuddering, followed by sweat. Sweat on waking, and sensitiveness of the skin, which the patient cannot bear to be uncovered. Dry heat, with sensation of general heat.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cobaltum is useful for neurasthenic states of spinal origin with sexual disturbances. Affects the spine, lumbarregion, genitals, kidneys and bones. Fatigue, agitation and bone pains, worse in morning. Aching in bones. Soreness. Characteristic very severe backache, worse sitting, better rising up, walking or lying down. Backache with seminal emissions. Discharges frothy. Sourness of taste, stomach, foot, sweat etc. Fatigue. MIND - Great exhilaration of spirits, vivacity and rapid flow of thoughts. All mental excitement increases suffering. Constant interchange of mental moods. Sense of guilt. Thinks too little of himself. Delusion he is a criminal and others know it. Confusion from motion. Reproaches himself. Desire for mental work.

Head - Headache, worse stooping, jarring. Sensation as if the brain went up and down, on stepping. Headache, worse bending head forward. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.

Eyes - Photophobia in spring. Darting pain in the eyes on coming into sunshine. Spring catarrh.

Face - Disposition to keep jaws tightly closed.

Mouth - Teeth feel too long. Tongue coated white (Ant-c.), with cracks across the middle. Sour taste.

Stomach - Sour or bitter water rises up with pain in stomach. Vertigo - Vertigo with feeling as if head grows large, worse stools. COMMENTS - Frequent nocturnal emissions with lewd dreams, with partial or no erections. Impotence. Drowsiness, unrefreshing sleep. Headache worse bending head forward. Pimples on the head and elsewhere, itching of the skin when warm in bed at night. Smarting and darting pains in eyes. Lachrymation in open air. Pain in hollow tooth, which feels too long and is sensitive to touch. Tongue thickly coated white, cracks across middle. No appetite for supper. Urine has strong pungent smell. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i., Sep., Sei. (2) Zinc. - in pain in back worse sitting. (3) Agn. - impotency, Nux-v. (4) effects of masturbation. Sei., Titan., Thallium. Abdomen - Empty feeling at navel. Y ello w spots on abdomen. Sharp pains in the region of spleen, worse taking deep breath.

Rectum - Desire for stool, while walking, worse on standing, followed by diarrhea. Constant dropping of blood from the anus, no blood from the stools.

Male - Pain in end of urethra, greenish discharge, brown spots on genitals and abdomen. Pain in right testicle, better urinating. Discharge of semen without erections. Frequent nocturnal emissions with lewd dreams, headache and backache. Impotency. Yellow-brown spots on genitals.

Back - Backache in lumbar region and weak legs. Pain in back and sacrum, worse while sitting, better walking or lying. Weakness in legs and backache after emissions. Aching pain in lumbar, worse sex, sitting, better on rising, walking or lying down with weak knees, cannot straighten up. Pain along the spine and from the sacrum down through the legs into the feet.

Limbs - Trembling of limbs especially legs, aching when sitting. Flushes of heat along legs. Shooting into thighs from liver. Sudden weakness in left hip, worse walking. Weak knees. Tingling, pricking in feet. Foot sweat, mostly between the toes, smelling sour. Aching in wrist joints.

Sleep - Wakeful, can do with less sleep. Drowsy and can hardly get enough sleep. Unrefreshing. Disturbed by lewd dreams.

Skin - Pimples about buttocks, chin, hairy scalp. Itching all over whengetting warm in bed.

Liver - Shooting pains in the region of the liver. Shooting from liver region down into the thighs. Lungs - Cough with copious, frothy, sweetish white mucus with lumps in it.

Kidneys - Smarting at the meatus at the end of urination. Albuminuria. Urine has a strong pungent smell.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Anemia. Arthritis. Blood, tumors. Chlorosis. Conjunctivitis. Deafness. Emaciation. Encephalitis. Fatigue. Fibroids. Hemiplegia. Infertility. Meningitis. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Neuritis. Orchitis. Paralysis. Paraplegia. Pericarditis. Pleurodynia. Sterility. Syphilis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cobalt has been known since ancient times and it was introduced for used in the manufacture of blue china, Dutch delftware, Moutier and Gien’s crockery and Sévre porcelain. A great deal of research is carried out on it in industry and agriculture, including experiments concerning the toxicity of cobalt and its salts. In 1899, Pettini and Messina, by administering cobalt chloride in the food of dogs, cats and rabbits, noticed an increase in the level of hemoglobin. More recently, Polonowski, Sutter and Briska, showed an increase of red corpuscles due to cobalt. Canjolle pointed to the complaints of pulmonary ventilation with a fall in arterial tension. According to Zarone, this hypotension is linked to a toxic attack on the myocardium. In occupational medicine, Desoille, Merk- len and Cotteril reported cases of poisoning of workers in which the clinical symptoms noted respiratory complaints and an increase in the level of red corpuscles. A lack of fertility and miscarriage due to bleeding under the placenta. Emaciation, bluish-red coloring of the muscles and viscera, serous effusion. The thyroid gland is the location for pseudo-carcinomatous changes. The homeopathic proving was re-evaluat- edby G. Maring in 1955 with fifteen provers, seven men and eight women. He used the 3x, 6x, 12x, and 30x potencies. Symptoms included general fatigue in the morning, immediately on waking, lasting through the day with the feeling of being sleepy and heavy. General lassitude. Face pale, discolored. Frontal headache, vertigo. Nervous. General emaciation. Irregular appetite, diarrhea. Better during the afternoon. Trembling hands. Loss of libido. Heaviness of the limbs. Pains in the bones. Pleurodynia on the left side. Cardiac pain. Metrorrhagia. Syphilitic hemiplegia and paraplegia. Syphilitic radicular neuritis. Tabes. Diffuse meningitis and encephalitis or general paralysis. Spasmodic dorsal tabes. Thyroid problems. Every morbid manifestation developing either from hereditary or acquired syphilis. Hardening processes. MIND - Anxiety. Excitability and over-activity, followed by inhibition and general depression. Depressive state with difficulty in concentrating as a result of a persistent headache. Sullen. Sadness on waking. Memory poor on first waking.

Head - Frontal pressing headache with feeling of the skull sunken above the eyes. Itching of the scalp. Head numb, as though tied by a band. Sensation of heat in the head with icy cold feet.

Eyes - Purulent conjunctivitis. Interstitial keratitis. Iritis. Inflammation of the choroid and retina. Eyelids heavy, swollen. Sensation of sand in the eyes. Boring pain around the left eye. Sensation of a veil over the eyes, when writing. Vision complaints, cannot focus for close work.

Ears - Noise like roaring in the ears. Deafness. Edema of the ear.

Nose - Snuffling with frequent sneezing and tickling feeling in the nose. Purulent coryza. Sudden nosebleeds.

Mouth - Vesicles around the lips. Mouth and throat dry. Need to clear the throat. Difficult swallowing. Sensation of swelling and inflammation of the gums. Pain in the gums and around the sockets of absent teeth.

Stomach - Nausea in the morning with eructation and headache. Sensation of acidity and emptiness in the stomach after eating. Gastric pains. Vertigo - Vertigoon rising, cannot stand up, aggravated by moving the head. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ferr. - Congestive headache, paleness of mucus membranes, pains in the bones, amenorrhea with vicarious hemorrhage, nosebleeds, or hemoptysis. HERBAL - The Divine Plant of the Incas, Coca, has been used for centuries by natives of Western South America as an intoxicant and also as a remedy for “veta,” the condition induced in persons on coming to five in highlands that is characterized by faintness, throbbing heart and head, and dysentery. Coca is like tea and coffee in arresting tissue-change and enabling those who take it to undergo unusual fatigues.

HOMEOPATHIC - Complaints related to mountain climbing. Altitude, mountain sickness. Palpitations, dyspnea, anxiety and insomnia. Dizziness, dyspnea and exhaustion on going to high altitudes, mountain climbing, airplane flying etc. Exhaustion of the brain and nervous system from physical and mental strain. Muscle exhaustion. Ringing in the ears, deafness and also fever (Chin.). Tooth decay. Voice loss. Nocturnal bedwetting. Emphysema(Queb.). Characteristic sensation as if a worm or small foreign bodies were under the skin, moving away when touched. Cocaine poisoning causes a sensation as if small foreign bodies were under the skin, generally like grains of sand or else as of a worm under the skin. It is known as Magnan's Symptom, after the neurologist who first described it. His description is “a sensation as if foreign bodies were under the skin, generally small round substances like grains of sand.” Korkasoff reported a case of multiple neuritis in which this symptom was present. The patient was a woman who was being treated for a uterine affection by means of vaginal tampons containing cocaine. A discontinuance of these caused the disappearance of the symptom. MIND - Lively mood, inclination for mental work. Clearness of mind at night. Hurry in movements. Timidity. Bashful, ill at ease in society. Craves solitude, obscurity and darkness. Irritability on waking in morning. Confusion of mind. Personal appearance neglected. Deceitful. Sense of right and wrong abolished. Melancholy from nervous exhaustion. Mental prostration alternating with exhilaration. Mental depression and drowsiness. Muddled feeling in brain. Want of will power. Forsaken feeling. Loss of energy. Unpleasant feeling about himself. Slow in finding words to express oneself. Loquacious excitement with blissful visions. Great mental excitement. Exhilaration, before menses. Wonderful visions. Hallucinations of hearing. Very changeable mood. Pleasant fancies. Loquacious excitement with blissful visions. Sense of impending death. Overpowered by indescribable anxiety. Nervousness and nightly restlessness of children during dentition. Fear of falling when walking.

Head - Fainting fit from climbing mountains. Headaches of high altitudes. Headache with vertigo, preceded by flashes of light. Shocks coming from occiput with vertigo. Like a band across forehead. Migraine, worse coughing, better eating, sunset. Pressive pain in occiput. Sensation as if brain was muddled. Fullness and pressive pain in forehead. Occiput painful and tender to touch, worse coughing. Occipital headache with chilliness. Violent headache, just over eyes with low ringing in ears.

Eyes - Pressure and pain in eyes. Aching pain behind eyes causing feeling as if squinting inwards. Diplopia. Intolerance of light with dilated pupils. White, dark and fiery spots before the eyes. Flickering before the eyes. Dark cloud before eyes. Indistinct vision soon followed by headache and nausea. Pupils dilated with great photophobia. Heaviness of lids.

Ears - Tinnitus. Noises in ears. Ringing, buzzing, and humming in ears with fever. Acute and painful hearing.

Nose - Sense of smell greatly diminished. Nosebleedfrom high altitudes. Nosebleed passing from right to left. Sneezing, and running of clear water from nose. Heat and irritation in nostrils.

Mouth - Mouth dry, especially on waking. Peppery sensation in the mouth. Tongue furred. Tooth decay. Lips blue, swollen, chapped. Lips and gums pale. Dryness Coca erythroxylon of lips and mouth. Ulceration at corners of mouth. Taste salty, slimy, bitter. Taste lost in morning. Fetid breath.

Throat - Hoarseness, worse after talking. Voice loss. Weak vocal cords. Uvula feels swollen, swallowing difficult. Dryness early in morning. Tuberculosis of larynx. Belchings, rise with noise and violence, as if it would split the esophagus. Tickling in fauces and pharynx. Hawking of small, transparent lumps of mucus, chiefly in morning. Vertigo - Fainting fit from climbing mountains. Vertigo and fainting after exertion. Vertigo with shocks coming from occiput. Vertigo with involuntary quick stepping when walking. COMMENTS - Dr. J. W. Springthorpe described a variety of this symptoms experienced by himself and recorded in a paper entitled “The Confessions of the Cocainist.” He called it “Hunting the Cocaine bug.” “You imagine,” he says, “that in your skin are worms or similar things, moving along. “If you touch them with wool and especially with absorbent wool, they run away and disappear, only to peep cautiously out of some corner to see if there is any danger. These worms are projected only on the Cocainist's own person or clothing. He sees them on his linen in his skin, creeping along his penholder, but not on other, people or things and not on clothes brought clean from the laundry.” Cooper cured a case of chronic rheumatism in an aged woman who had this symptom with the fraction of a grain of cocaine given in single doses at long intervals. In a case reported in Lancet, June, 1886, a man who had a 4 percent solution of cocaine applied to a tooth swallowed twenty to thirty drops of the solution. Half an hour after, he was seized with a feeling of faintness and giddiness followed by an attack of palpitation with a sense of flushing, especially up the back. There was a marked diminution of smell, great difficulty in producing vomiting, a scarlatina-like rash over the body, especially about the neck, dimness of vision, relaxation of sphincters and weakness of limbs. The mind remained clear, but the pulse was fast, weak and intermittent. A striking case was recorded in the British Medical Journal of December 13,1890. At a meeting of the Paris Academie de Medecine on December 2nd, M. Hallopeau presented a communication after distinguishing two forms of cocaine poisoning: the acute in which the symptoms are produced immediately after a dose and speedily pass off, and the chronic in which they are due to the prolonged use of the drug. He then related a case that in his opinion showed that the poisonous effects, while coming on acutely, might last for a considerable time. On March 7, 1890, a man had about eight milligrams oí hydrochlorate of cocaine injected into his gum as a preliminary to the extraction of a tooth. Toxic symptoms at once supervened. There was intense precordial oppression with thready pulse and extreme excitement and loquacity. The patient walked about the room, hitting out at random with his fists and crying out that he was dying. In ten minutes he became quiet and the tooth was extracted after which he was able to walk home, but arrived there in a state of extreme prostration. Then ensued a train of nervous symptoms, such as continual headache, intractable sleeplessness, a bad taste in the mouth with attacks of excitement accompanied by giddiness, faintness, and a sense of impending death. All brain work was impossible, the patient could not do the simplest sum in arithmetic and was in a state of profound depression. A sense of formication and numbness in the hands and forearms was almost incessant. This condition lasted four months. It was two months after the injection before the least improvement was observed, and then progress towards recovery was very slow. M. Hallopeau thought the symptoms indicated a poisonous action of cocaine on the nervous centers and especially the brain. As it is impossible to suppose that so small a quantity of the drug should have remained in the circulation, he was driven to conclude either that it was stored up in the cells of certain nervous centers or that it produced in them persistent lesions. Among other effects observed from its use in dentistry are “mental depression and drowsiness and intense oppression in chest, dilatation of pupils, acceleration of pulse and breathing and mental excitement.” W. J. Guernsey quoted in H. P., November, 1888 from Med. Register, August 11, 1888, the experience of J. E. Shadle, who applied pledgets of a 4 percent solution of cocaine to the nasal cavities of a man of 35, preparatory to operation. On each occasion he complained of a “cold, gone, relaxed feeling about the external genitals and a sensation as if he penis were absent. Towards the end of treatment he noticed a permanent weakness of the sexual organs and finally seminal losses and impotence set in and continued until the Cocaine was entirely withheld.” R. K. Ghosh noted experiences with Coca (which he finds in drop doses act better in such cases than in the potencies) in palpitation and dyspnea on ascending, when arising from nervous causes, especially in complaints from self-abuse generally. After the invigorating effects of cocaine have passed off, including the sense of lightness and ability to climb a mountain without fatigue, or when the intoxication has been carried to a further degree, there is a sense of heaviness, numbness and drowsiness with a disinclination to move. Extreme weariness, especially weakness of the legs. Extreme affects from altitude sickness. Fatigue. Characteristic headache, headaches of high altitudes. Tight headache, as if a rubber band were stretched across the forehead. After affects from altitude sickness (Carb- V., Sil., Calc.). Can be used prophylactically if there's a history of altitude sickness or lung weakness. Asthma aggravated by altitude. Effects of cold, cough from cold air, rheu- matism from slightest cold. Excessive secretion of urine with or without sugar. Nocturnal bedwetting. General affect of relaxing the sphincters. Sensation as if the esophagus would be rent by force of rising flatus. Nymphomania after childbirth during menses, from irritation of eczema or other disorders of the vulva in satyriasis. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Gundlach discovered the best antidote to be Gels. Compare: (1) Ars., Guar., Cypr., Cham. (2) Arn., Calc., Ars. - effects of climbing. (3) Stram. likes company and light, Coca likes solitude and darkness. (4) Scutel., Valer., Cann-i., Thea, Coffea, Tab. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.Phatak.

Stomach - Empty feeling or full feeling in stomach. Incarcerated flatus, rises with noise and violence, as if it would split the esophagus. Dyspepsia, especially in hypochondriacs. Hiccough after supper. Active digestion. Frequent eructations. Weak and difficult digestion.

Abdomen - Tympanitic distention of abdomen. Pressure and tension in hypochondria after meals. Violent pains with bloated distention. Colic. Passage of much flatulence. Violent bellyache, better frequent discharges of inodorous flatus. Causations - Ascending, high altitudes.

Hemorrhoids, painful on walking or sitting. Urging to stool, followed by natural evacuation. Constipation. Constant desire to stool after gonorrhea.

Male - Diabetes with impotency (Ph-ac.). Sensation as if penis were absent. Emissions. Spermatorrhea and partial impotence. Nervous prostration from sexual excess. Satyriasis. Weakness, seminal emissions with voluptuous dreams.

Very little need of nourishment, even during heavy work and remarkable vigor. Great satiety for a long time. No appetite except for sweets. Aversion to solid food. Desires stimulants. Craving for alcohol and tobacco. Ailments from salt food. Can't eat salty food. Great thirst. Bad effects of stimulants, alcohol and tobacco.

Chest - Sudden attack of cramp in chest, became cold and unable to continue the ascent. Intense oppression in chest. Rush of blood to chest with slight headache. Heaviness and oppression of chest. Pain under clavicles, worse under left. Transient, shooting, in chest, between third and sixth ribs, worse during deep inspiration. Constitutions - Suited to old people. Short- breathed people, weakly, nervous, fat, plethoric people. Children with marasmus.

Pulse extremely slow and intermittent, loses one beat in four. Palpitations with weak heart and dyspnea. Pulse weak and accelerated, increased arterial tension. Throbbing of heart against ribs audible. Exhaustion of heart with irregular action.

Limbs - Weakness of limbs. Feeling of internal cold with numbness of hands and feet. Crawling, numbness of arms. When walking, takes involuntary quick steps, head inclined forward with vertigo. Rheumatism, coming from slightest cold. Lungs - Oppressed breathing at night. Altitudes sickness. Rapid breathing. Want of breath, worse ascending, high altitudes. Cough from cold air or fast walking. Short of breath, especially in aged athletes. Dyspnea of those who use tobacco or whiskey to excess. Emphysema. Asthma, spasmodic variety. Senile asthma. Obstructed breathing and heaviness in chest oblige him to walk slowly. Incessant dyspnea, with desire to take a deep breath. Hawking of small, transparent pieces of mucus. Expectoration of small limps like boiled starch, after rising in morning. Hemoptysis. Upper portion of both lungs as if constricted, during whole day.

Sleep - Nervousness with nightly restlessness during teething. Chronic sleeplessness. Inclination to sleep, but can find no rest. Great drowsiness. Awakens with a shock in brain. Can find no rest anywhere, but sleepy. Awakes with a shock in brain when lying on back.

Skin - Itching and prickling under the skin. Like a worm or insects crawling under the skin, moving away when touched. Scarlatina-like rash over body. Increased heat of skin.

Face - Rush of blood to face. Cheeks red, especially right. Face ache. Pressure and heaviness, especially over right eye. Food - Appetite lost.

COMMENTS - Most of the symptoms appear in the teeth and nerves of the face and mouth. Neuralgia, worse at night, accompanied by icy cold limbs and cold, moist skin, the right side is most affected. Pains extend from one part to another and may jump from side to side. Attacks recur periodically, often of brief duration but quickly recurring. Attacks are generally worse at night, but may be entirely absent in the night. Returning every eight, ten, twelve, fourteen or twenty days. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Canth., Mang. (2) in tic douloureux, Spig., Thuj. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Sleep - Nocturnal attacks of pain entirely preventing sleep, but could not sleep even when pain did not appear. Pain ends in a general heat and sleep of two or three hours, from which he wakes without any pain.

Teeth - Chronic pain extending from superior molars to forehead. Throbbing toothache. Sensation of coldness in all the teeth. Painful sensation in back teeth as if they were hollow and air were forced into them. Pulsative jerking in back teeth.

HERBAL - Cocculus has been used from ancient times as a poison for stupefying fish and making them easy to catch. It produces great disturbance of the sensorium and the symptoms of intoxication in human beings. Commonly used as an adulteration of beer to heighten its intoxicating properties. A deCoction of cocculus is a domestic remedy used locally for destroying head or body lice.

HOMEOPATHIC - Paralysis of face tongue, pharynx, paraplegia with numbness and tingling. Numbness. Sensation of hollowness or emptiness, head, chest, abdomen. As if single parts had gone to sleep. Too weak to hold up head, stand or even speak. Feels too weak to talk loud. Symptoms are worse riding in a cars, airplanes, trains or on shipboard, hence its use in motion sickness, seasickness. Sleep loss and fatigue from travels. Vertigo and dizziness with nausea and vomiting. Ailments from loss of sleep or nursing of loved ones. Speech difficult at beginning of attacks of vertigo, afterwards, difficulty in reading and thinking. Alternating symptoms. Unilateral disorders. Sensitive to cold. Falls down to ground unconscious. Senses acute. Slowness in moving, answering, wants plenty of time to do everything. Adenitis with cold, hard glandular swellings. Valuable remedy in hernias, both umbilical and inguinal, is particularly indicated when abdominal muscles are weak and it seems as if a hernia would easily take place. Shuddering. Painful contracture of limbs and trunk, tetanus. Tremors of head, lower jaw from excitement, exertion, pain. Intentional tremors. Twitching of isolated groups of muscles. Spasms, through the body like electric shocks. Cramps in muscles, in masseters, in abdomen, dysmenorrhea in the heart. Convulsions from non-appearance or suddenly checked menses.
