Sits as if absorbed in deep and sad thoughts and observes nothing about her. Indulges in sad reveries. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences. Answers slowly reflects long. Tearful chagrin about least trifle. Weeping spells, especially if they can't function and do the things they want to. Cocculus indicus Mental confusion after drinking and eating. Very anxious about health of others, but little concerned as to his own health. Sudden great anxiety. Anxiety before menses. Anxiety from night-watching. Anxiety during sleep. Mind is worse from suppressed menses. Weeping during menses. Fear of not getting proper amount of sleep. Fear of death. Fears the unknown, danger. Especially fear surrounding health and illness of others. Fear of ghosts and specters. Excitement after hearing horrible things. Frighten easily from noises. Fear of sudden noises. Oversensitive to everything. Very sensitive to fear, anger, grief and all mental disturbances. Sensitive moods, everything worries and offends. Startles very easily. Easily offended, cannot bear contradiction. Sentimental. Sensitive to noise and touch. Intolerance of noise. Intolerance of any disturbing influence. Sensitive to insults, slights and disappointment. Capricious. Vacillatory, doesn't accomplish anything at her work. Excessive irritability, excited by loud talking or least increase of temperature. Anger from any interruptions. Anger from contradiction. Enlargement of liver after anger. Starting, with trembling all over body, from slight noise or slight unexpected touch. Irresistible inclination to sing. Absorbed in reveries. Sensitive to all external impressions. Speaks hastily. Talkative, witty, joking, dancing, gesticulating. Sees something alive on walls, floor, chair etc. Time passes too quickly. Alcoholics, reeling, roaring, quarrelsome, singing. Loud cries of despair and irritation, alternating with stupefaction of brain. Feeling as after committing a wicked deed, with desire to escape.

Head - Congestion of blood to head, with mental derangement. Sick headachefrom carriage riding, cannot lie on back part of head. Pain in occiput and nape worse lying on it, better bending backwards, worse coffee. Migrain headaches. Headaches unable to bear least light, noise causes nausea and vomiting. Headaches from working in sun. Headache as if skull would burst. Headache returning at each menstrual period. Sensation of emptiness or hollowness in head. Opening and shutting sensation, especially in occiput. Dullness and confusion of head, worse reading. Heavy head. Convulsive trembling of head from weakness of muscles of neck. Cramps in left temporal muscles. Trembling of the head. Throbbing in forehead. Tossing of head and incessant trembling of hands.

Eyes - Pain as if eyes torn out of head, during headache. Eyes open and immovable. Eyes dull and glassy. Eyes closed with the balls constantly rolling about in spasms. Protruding eyes. Jerking of eyelids. Pressure as from dust in eyes. Eyelids inflame4. Dryness of lids. Eyelids feel as if paralyzed. Bruised pain in eyes, with inability to open lids at night. Sharp or shooting pains in eyes from within outward. Pupils, contracted or dilated.

Ears - Sensitive to hearing, dreads sudden noise. Feel closed (right). Noises as from rushing water. Hardness of hearing. Pain as if ears torn out of head with headache. Meniere's disease, ringing in the ears, oozy and loss of balance. Roaring or ringing in ears.

Nose - Swelling of the nose. Coryza, with ulcerated nostrils. Very acute sense of smell. Worse from strong odors. Sense of smell weak. Ulcerated nostrils. Discharge from nose bloody, pus-like.

Face - Bloated, distorted and cold to touch. Blue margins around eyes. Flushed hot face and head during vertigo or unconsciousness. Countenance devoid of any signs of mental activity. Heat in face, and redness of cheeks, even in a cold room. Earthy countenance, with painful expression. Paralysis of facial nerve of one sided. Lines of face deepened, it seems drawn. Cramp-like pain in masseter muscle, worse opening the mouth. Prosopalgia in afternoon with wide radiations of pain. Tearing pains. Swelling of parotid glands. Swelling and induration of submaxillary glands.

Mouth - Dryness and burning of mouth and throat. Dryness of mouth at night, without thirst. Metallic taste with loss of appetite. Coppery, metallic, sour taste after coughing. Taste, sour, offensive. Taste like sulphur, putrid, nauseous. Food tastes as if salted too little, tobacco tastes bitter. Tremor of lower jaw and chattering of teeth, when attempting to speak. Foamy phlegm from mouth. Salivation during nausea and vertigo. Thick saliva. Corner of mouth, wing of nose and tip of tongue distorted. Lips parched and dry. Corners of mouth sore.

Throat - Constriction in throat, with difficult breathing and inclination to cough. Paralysis of the muscles preventing swallowirig. Tickling in throat with lachrymation. Tightness in larynx. Voice whimpering and tremulous. Speech difficult, during vertigo. Sensation of constriction. Pressive pain in tonsils, worse when swallowirig saliva than when swallowing food.

Stomach - Esophagus is dry, burning. Putrid eructations. Gastralgia from suppression of menses. Violent cramp in stomach, griping, squeezing, lacerating sensation. Cramps in stomach with flatulence and much saliva. Motion sickness. Seasickness. Sensation of hunger or emptiness, even to fainting. Nausea and vomiting from riding in cars, boats or looking at boat in motion. Nausea with faintness and vomiting, worse on becoming cold or taking cold. Nausea, rising to head or felt in head. Retching. Vomiting of sour bitter. Bad odor, of vomit, with profuse flow of saliva. Vomiting with headache, pain in bowels. Vomiting on taking cold, with syncope. Vomiting from cerebral tumors. Vomiting from loud talk. Cramp in stomach during and after meal. Hiccough and spasmodic yawning. Chronic dyspepsia from prolong study. Morning sickness.

Abdomen - Bloated with intestinal gas. Great rumbling in bowels. Colic, flatus, twisting pain with faintness and salivation. Flatulent colic in pregnancy. Cramps in epigastrium with difficulty in breathing. Cramps deep in abdomen, instead of menses. Abdominal muscles weak, as if a hernia would take place. Inguinal hernia is apt to protrude and become incarcerated. Umbilical hernia, with obstinate constipation. Pain in abdominal ring, as if something were forced through. Pains in region of spleen. As if full of sharp stones, on every movement. Emptiness and sensation of hollowness in abdomen. Sensation as if bowels would fall out. Hypochondria as if beaten. Ulcerative colitis.

Rectum - Burning pain in rectum with soft, loose stool, sometimes yellow. Diarrhea brought on by riding in cars or carriage. Diarrhea is better lying on sides. Diarrhea with bilious vomiting. Constipation, with ineffectual urging to stool on account of lack of peristaltic motion. Bleeding hemorrhoids. Prolapsed rectum after stool. After stool, violent tenesmus, even unto fainting. Contraction of rectum, during too early menses.

Stool - Small, frequent stools with flatus. Foul-smelling stool, during colic. Hard stool every other day, expelled with great difficulty. Watery stools, none in night, but comes on directly after rising from bed. Simultaneous with vomiting, sudden, thin, black, slimy, very fetid stool. Disposition to stool, but peristaltic motion in upper intestines is wanting. Thin, whitish-yellow watery stool. Fetid or hot flatus, emission of hot flatus before stool.

Male - Drawing, sore pain in testes when touched. Genitals sensitive with desire for sex. Sexual desire increased alternating with decreased. Seminal emissions at night. Itching of scrotum.

Female - Amenorrhea causes mental alienation. Sudden cessation of menses. Menses, too early, profuse. Menses too often. Menses gushes out in stream when rising on feet on tiptoe. Menses clotted, with spasmodic colic. Cutting, cramping pain in region of uterus and ovaries, on appearance of menses. Weak during menstruation, scarcely able to stand. Dysmenorrhea with profuse dark menses. As if uterus were distended, during dysmenorrhea. Dysmenorrhea followed by hemorrhoids. Clutching in uterus. Purulent, gushing leucorrhea between menses or in place of menses. Leucorrhea very weakening, can scarcely speak. Leucorrhea gushing, when squatting and stooping during pregnancy with frequent urging to urinate. Discharge of bloody mucus from uterus during pregnancy. Hour-glass contraction of uterus with ter rible pain in lumbar region. Labor pains spasmodic and irregular. Food - All symptoms and affections, worse eating or drinking. Loss of appetite. Loathing of food and drink. Disgust for smell of food (Colch.). Nausea when merely looking at the food, at the thought or smell of food. Aversion to beer, acids, sour things. Aversion tofood. A version to drink, tobacco. Desire for cold drinks, but eating or drinking anything cold causes tearing in limbs. Desires beer. Worse from coffee. Thirst, without desire to drink. Confusion and vertigo after drinking, eating. Will eat nothing but bread and water, at other times eats ravenously. Bulimia. Food tastes as if salted too little, tobacco tastes bitter. Thirstless.

Chest - Sensation of emptiness or of cramps in chest. Audible rumbling in chest (left side), as from emptiness, worse walking. Hysterical cramps in chest with sighing and moaning. Cramping, in chest during menstrual period. Pressure under ribs, better belching. Fine stitches in various parts of chest. Contractive tension of right side of chest, taking away the breath. Oppression in chest, better after vomiting of green mucus. Constitutions - Suited to light haired, timid, nervous, persons, bookworms, unmarried, childless women. Sensitive, romantic girls. Light-haired females, especially during pregnancy, causing much nausea and backache.

Heart - Palpitations, worse quick motion, mental excitement, with vertigo and faintness. Endocarditis. Nervous palpitations. Palpitations after rheumatism. During an attack of palpitation has vertigo and sensation as if about to faint. Pulse small, hard and frequent. Pulse often imperceptible, weak. Pulse seldom hard and somewhat accelerated. Feels pulse beat through whole body during heat, at times palpitation.

Back - Drawing, lacerating or boring pains. Pressure in scapula and nape. Pain in shoulder and arms as if bruised. Stiffness on moving shoulders. Stiffness in cervical muscles, with great weakness. Paralytic pain in small of the back. Paralysis from lumbar region downward. Spinal weakness in lumbar region, worse walking. Weak neck, cannot hold up head. Trembling in back. Cracking or stiffness of vertebrae. Breasts - Shivering over breasts. Causations - Ill effects of anger, fright, grief, anxiety, disappointment. Sleep loss. Nursing loved ones. Ill effects of nightwatching. Overstrain mental and physical, traveling. Motion sickness. Noise. Hot or cold air. Sun. Tea-drinking.

Limbs - Limbs go to sleep. Lower limbs are very weak, numb and unsteady. Lameness, worse by bending. Paraplegia. One-sided paralysis, worse after sleep. Painful stiffness in all joints. Acute rheumatism, pain springing from joint to joint, with redness, swelling and stiffness. Limbs straightened out, painful when flexed or vice versa. Trembling and pain in limbs. Clumsy gait. Edema of feet with paralysis of lower limbs. Knees crack on motion. Humerus feels broken. Soles numb, while sitting. Involuntary motion of right arm and right leg, better during sleep. Alternation of pain between arms. Pain in shoulder and arms as if bruised. Hands, numb or hot and cold alternately become numb on grasping objects, trembles while eating. Hands and feet become cold after change of position. Violent spasms of armstand legs. Takes hold of things awkwardly and drops them. Bones feel as if they were broken.

Sleep - Loss of sleep, complaints from night-watching, nursing. Slightest loss of sleep aggravates. Coma vigil. Insomnia. Sleepless from mental orphysical exhaustion. Constant drowsiness, after loss of sleep, night- watching, nursing. Sleep deprivation. Spasmodic yawning with hiccough. Sleepless from nursing ofothers. Sleeplessness from business thoughts, from anxiety and restlessness. Anxious frightful dreams. Sleep frequently interrupted by waking and starting. Sleep unrefreshing. Maniacal sleeplessness. Dreams are anxious, frightful.

Skin - Skin feels soft, is white and moist. Paleness of skin, wretched color. Itching of skin from warmth. Burning and itching as from nettles. Great itching, especially in the evening, worse undressing, in a featherbed. Ulcers very sensitive to touch. Red pimples, like grains of millet. Miliary eruptions or red spots, worse undressing. Induration, cold swelling of the glands, with stinging pains. Red irregular spots on chest and behind ears. Pimples filling with pus, and then drying up and disappearing.

Modalities - Better from sitting. Better lying quiet, on side. Better in a warm room. Worse eating or drinking. Worse from motion of trains, boat, cars. Worse from motion. Worse exertion. Worse rising from bed. Worse bending over or stooping. Worse kneeling, walking. Worse swimming. Worse swallowing saliva. Worse from loss of sleep. Worse from touch, pressure. Worse jar, pain. Worse emotions, anxiety. Worse from nursing others. Worse at menses. Worse eating. Worse noise. Worse sun, cold, open air. Worse evening, night. Worse midnight and 1 a.m. Worse warmth of bed.

Teeth - Teeth feel chilly. Teeth as if long and loose. Pain in teeth, better when biting with empty mouth. Toothache in hollow tooth, pains only when chewing, even soft food. Toothache in upper incisors. Toothache with headache and ringing in ears. Drawing pain in dental nerves. Fine drawing pain in borders of teeth.

Tongue - Bitter taste at root of tongue. Complains of dryness of tongue, which is moist and clean. Dry, rough tongue. Dry tongue, with whitish-yellow coat, without thirst. Tongue coated white and dry upon edges. Pains at base of tongue when stretching tongue out. Tongue, as if paralyzed, speech difficult or hasty, pains at the base when protruded. Root of tongue as if swollen. Vertigo - Vertigo, nausea when riding or sitting up. Seasickness and motion sickness (Tab.). Vertigo and dizziness, with nausea and vomiting. Vertigo when riding in a car or train. Vertigo on sitting up. Vertigo worse watching moving surroundings. Vertigo with palpitations, worse in morning, raising head, felt in forehead. Vertigo from loss of sleep. Constant sensation as if about to faint. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Vision - Dim vision with black spots before eyes. Dark spots before eyes, though objects appear clearly. While reading, can only see left half of line of writing. Black spots seen after reading. COMMENTS - Chiefly affects the right hypochondrium (especially liver), inner hypogastrium, inner forehead, back, upper arm and the bones of the arm. Irritable weakness. Slowness and numbness over their body (Calc., Alum.). Vertigo and dizziness, with nausea and vomiting. Attacks of vertigo with confusion as if they are lost. Nauseated with whirling sensation. Sensation as if drunk because everything spins (Con., when turning in bed). Seasickness and motion sickness (Tab.). Motion sickness brought on by trying to read while riding in a car or train, or from looking out the window at things going by, from seeing a moving object. Jet lag. Nerve exhaustion, weakness. Too tired to sleep. Chronic fatigue since loss of sleep or stress. Twilight sleepers, chronic insomnia with no recollection of sleeping, although they sleep for small amounts. Wake unrefreshed. excited nervous system (Coff.), worse coffee. All symptoms worse from loss of sleep. Conditions caused by loss of sleep and night-watching. May be used prophylactically to prevent conditions arising from loss of sleep. Stinging pains, stitches, constriction in the hands, a pithy feeling. Sensitive to touch. The least jar is unbearable. Keynote empty, hollow feeling in the body, lungs, stomach, legs. Hollow weakness. Sensation of hollowness or emptiness in the head or other parts. Sense of lightness of the body. Opening and shutting sensation, especially in the occiput. Sinking feeling. Paralytic pains or pains as of dislocation. Paralytic weakness, lax muscles. Weakness of neck muscles with heaviness of head. Migratory numbness. Sensation as if single parts have gone to sleep. Neurological problems, locomotor ataxia, incoordination, stumbling, lack of control, and the knees tend to give out. Immovability of parts affected. Ataxia, staggering gait. Paralytic rigidity. Limbs become very painful to flex, but they often continuously bend them to obtain relief. Rigid limbs, chorea, involuntary motions (Caust.). Cramp, spasm, etc., coupled with electric-like shooting pain. Faintness from the pain. Joint rheumatism, ulcers, neuralgic disorders of bones. Esophageal spasms. In the elderly, spasms can cause food to get stuck, inability to swallow (Caust.). Sensation of worms crawling in the stomach, pinches and scrapes in the stomach (Coloc.). Inguinal hernias (Nux-v., Lyc.). Hemorrhoids during menses. Metallic, bitter taste in the mouth. Desires beer. Drunkenness and hangovers (Nux-v.). Meniere's disease, ringing in the ears, oozy and loss of balance. Poor vision with weak eye muscles. Dimness of eyesight. Severe occipital headache, sense that head opens and closes. Flu or mononucleosis with loss of sleep. Morning sickness, when they can’t stand the sight, thought and smell of food, especially when they are in the car (Colch.). Amenorrhea, may have vaginal discharge instead of period. Symptoms may be worse with menses. Cocc. cured a case of delirium at onset of menses during first and second days, the patient said, “I always see something alive, on wall, floor, chairs or anywhere, always rolling and will roll on me.” A case of “spasmodic, flatulent colic, about midnight, flatus passed without relief,” recurring several nights, was cured by Cocc. 3x. Lippe cured a case of enlargement of the liver after childbirth, the indication being “the liver was more painful after anger.” RELATIONS -Antidotes: Coff., Nux-v. Compare: (1) Picrotoxin - alkaloid of Cocculus - epilepsy, attacks in the morning on leaving horizontal position, hernia, locomotor ataxia, night-sweats. (2) Symphoricarpus - morning sickness. (3) Petr., Calad., Puls.. Ign. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Liver more painful after anger, worse least jar. Enlargement of liver after anger. Sharp pains in liver region. Pressive pain in hepatic region worse coughing and bending over. Lungs - Dyspnea as from constriction of trachea, as if irritated by smoke. Choking constriction in upper part of esophagus, oppressing breathing and inducing cough. Hysterical asthma. Dyspnea, oppressing breathing and inducing cough. Shortness of breath, on account of tension in abdomen. Quick, anxious and oppressed breathing. Slow, heavy and laborious breathing. Panting. Dyspnea from pain in bowels during diarrheic stool, in amenorrhea.

Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate with small discharge in pregnant women. Watery urine. Tensive, aching pain in orifice of urethra, between acts of urination. Itching and stinging near fossa navicularis. Involuntary urination during epileptic attack. Diuresis, during prosopalgia.

Cough - Cough from choking in throat. Fatiguing, from oppression of chest. Cough worse indulging disposition to cough. Spasmodic cough, in anemic and hysterical women. Cough from choking in throat.

Perspiration - Sweat from slight exertion, on affected part. Cold sweat now of one, now of the other hand. Cold sweat only on face. Sweat stands out in drops on face, is now cold and then again hot. Exhausting sweat over whole body. Sweat in morning, principally on chest. Sweat from pain in bowels. Sweat during diarrheic stool.

Temperature - Chills alternating with fever. Chills in evening and shivering. Chilliness with perspiration and heat of skin. Chills with flatulent colic, nausea, vertigo, coldness of lower limbs and heat of head. Chills with great disgust at even smell of food. Internal chill with great trembling of head. Upward and downward shaking chills. Chills running down back, in evening. Nervous form of low fever from fits of anger. Dry heat, the whole night through. Flushes of heat, with burning heat of cheeks and cold feet. Heat in head, chilliness in body. Burning heat arid redness of cheeks. ;

name: Coccus Cacti
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from washing in cold water. Better cold drinks. Better walking. Worse left side. Worse after sleep. Worse touch, pressure of clothing. Worse slightest exertion. Worse periodically, from heat, cold exposure, lying down, night and early morning, awakening, brushing teeth, irritation of throat, rinsing mouth. Cough worse on waking..
constitution: Anasarca. Anuria. Ascites. Asthma. Backache. Dysuria. Catarrh. Coughs. Gonorrhea. Gravel. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Impotence. Irritation, nerves. Labia. inflammation. Menorrhagia. Nephritis. Spasrps. Tinnitus. Tuberculosis. Uric acid, diathesis. Vomiting. Whooping, cough.
keynote: PHARMACY - coc-c. Coccus cacti. Cochineal. Dactylopius coccus. N. O. Hemiptera. An insect infesting cactus plants. The tincture is prepared from the dried bodies of the female insects. They also constitute a well-known dye. Historical dose: Trituration and all…
full:
PHARMACY - coc-c. Coccus cacti. Cochineal. Dactylopius coccus. N. O. Hemiptera. An insect infesting cactus plants. The tincture is prepared from the dried bodies of the female insects. They also constitute a well-known dye. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anasarca. Anuria. Ascites. Asthma. Backache. Dysuria. Catarrh. Coughs. Gonorrhea. Gravel. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Impotence. Irritation, nerves. Labia. inflammation. Menorrhagia. Nephritis. Spasrps. Tinnitus. Tuberculosis. Uric acid, diathesis. Vomiting. Whooping, cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Coccus Cacti has sometimes been confounded with the Coccinella septempunctata, both are insects known as “Cochenille” in French. Coc-c. causes a catarrhal condition and irritation of the throat, respiratory and genito-urinary organs. Affects the mucus membranes. Spasmodic morning cough. Whooping cough attacks end with vomiting of tough mucus. Regular paroxysms or violent tickling, hacking cough ending in vomiting or raising much clear ropy mucus, hanging from mouth. General lassitude. The least exertion causes lassitude and tendency to perspire or cough, worse during exercise. Pain in occiput is worse mental exertion. Intolerable internal itchings, burning like pepper. Pulsation in different organs. Sensation as of a fluid forcing its way during pain. Spasms. Spasmodic pains in kidneys with visceral tenesmus. Catarrhal conditions of the bladder. Anuria. Ascites. Anasarca. Discharges are stringy, including hemorrhages, which are apt to be in large, black clots. Rising up causes hemorrhage with passage of large clots from uterus. Periodic symptoms. MIND - Confusion, better open air. Apprehensive, irritable, fretful. Anxiety after eating. Anxiety from irregular action of heart. Lively, talkative mood. Excitement after beer. Delusions of being enlarged. Sadness, early morning on waking. Sadness afternoon 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.

Head - Throbbing pain with sensation as if fluid were forcing its way. Suboccipital soreness, worse after sleep and exertion. Headache, worse from lying on back, better with the head high. Dull pain over right eye in morning. Sensation of a foreign body between upper lid and eyeball. Distress from cinders in eye.

Eyes - Sensation as of a foreign body between the upper lid and the eyeball.

Ears - Cracking in ears, when swallowing.

Nose - Burning as of pepper in nostrils. Accumulation of thick viscid mucus in naso-pharynx. Sensations - As if a ball or stone lying in stomach. Raging pain as though a fluid were injected into a small blood vessel. As if something ascending towards stomach. As of mucus ascending and descending trachea, as of a plug of mucus moving in chest. As if head would split.

Face - Crawling sensation. Becomes purple, red worse coughing.

Mouth - Tip of tongue burns like pepper. Sweetish, metallic taste. Salivation, constant desire to spit. Loud speaking or brushing of teeth causes cough.

Stomach - Irritation of throat, hawking, brushing of the teeth causes retching and vomiting. Thirst, drinks water often and in large quantities. _ . _ ---------- Temperature - Burning, as of pepper. Throat - Sensation as of a thread hanging down the back of the throat. Sensation as if uvula is elongated. Tickling in larynx. Any irritation in throat causes cough, retching and vomiting. Constricted throat or as of a plug lodged in it. Profuse postnasal discharge. Accumulation of much viscid mucus, hawking it, excites cough, retching and vomiting. COMMENTS - Coc-c. acts especially on mucus membranes, kidneys (Canth.), and in causing hemorrhages in disturbing the heart (Cact.). Hemorrhages are apt to be in large black clots, especially hemorrhages from kidneys and uterus. Sensation as if a hair or crumb were lodged behind the larynx and as if a thread were hanging down the back of the throat causing a cough. “Cough, worse in morning, the child awakens and is immediately seized with a paroxysm of coughing ending in vomiting clear, ropy mucus hanging in long string from the mouth.” Rapid, spasmodic coughs in periodic attacks. Constant irritating cough. Sense of dry spot or tickle. Hoarseness. Fatigue of vocal organs. Violent tickling in larynx. Stitching and ulcerating pains below clavicles, especially left. Whooping cough (Dros., Cupr.), bronchitis. Lancinating, stitching and pricking sensations. Itching, sticking and biting in various parts of the skin, red spots and itching pimples. Sharp pains and itching of glans penis, symptoms of the passage of small stones. General sensitiveness to touch and pressure, rinsing mouth or brushing teeth causes cough and vomiting. Most symptoms worse from warmth, cough worse entering warm room, throat worse by warmth of bed. Tickling in trachea and cough better open air. Teeth very sensitive to cold. Catarrh worse on slightest exposure. Catarrh from autumn until warm weather. Berridge cured with Coc-c. a case of gonorrhea, guided by the symptom “excruciating pain in left iliac region extending to groin and halfway down thigh, as if a fluid were forcing its way there.” Kunkel recorded the case of a man, 75. who suffered from nocturnal bedwetting up to the age of seven. When almost 20 he frequently passed large quantities of uric acid and at the same time he began to have symptoms of chronic catarrh of the colon, frequent scanty stools, much mucus, cross humor, itching anus, threatening of hemorrhoids but no bleeding. Insomnia soon followed. Coc-c. 2c and 3c was given without benefit. Aqua calcis did some good, but not much. In three successive years he was sent to Carlsbad with good results to the intestinal catarrh, the sleeplessness was untouched. Gradually all kinds of arthritic symptoms developed, especially in knees. There was occasionally a considerable flow of urine and the more copious it was the better the patient slept and the less pain in the joints. The same relief followed an attack of diarrhea. Four weeks at Assmanhausen caused the excretion of large quantities of uric acid one year, but had no effect the next and the knee got worse. Wiesbaden helped one year but not the next. Half a tumbler of Kronenquelle water drunk every morning helped the knee and enabled him to walk better than he had for a long time. In three or four years, the excretions of uric acid had ceased and the patient's state grew worse, insomnia recurred, diarrhea became much more frequent. A fortnight previous to such attack, the patient noticed he had great aversion to butcher's meat. Coc-c. 30c morning and evening was given. Gradually sleep returned. There was almost daily excretion of uric acid, sometimes in the form of large shot, the diarrhea ceased and the patient went about his work with pleasure. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Canth., Cact., Oci., Sars. (2) apices of lungs sore, tenacious mucus, Kali-bi. (3) Many Cactus symptoms, like the pricking and sticking pains, heart disturbances, reappear in the pathogenesis of this Cactus-fed insect. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Abdomen - Excruciating pain from left iliac region, extending to the groins half way down the thighs, as if fluid were forcing its way there.

Male - Pulsation in glans.

Female - Menses too early, profuse, black and thick, dark clots with dysuria. Large clots escape from the vagina when passing urine, when quiet or when rising up. Intermittent menses, flow only in the evening or at night. Inflamed labia. Vulva sensitive, worse when urinating.

Heart - Sensation as if everything were pressed toward the heart.

Back - Coldness in back. Constitutions - Uric acid, gouty, rheumatic diathesis.

Limbs - Sensation as if a fine splinter were under the fingernails. Lungs - Fauces very sensitive. Walking against wind takes breath away. Shortness of breath. Chronic bronchitis complicated with gravel, large quantities of albuminous, tenacious mucus, are expectorated. Constant hawking from enlarged uvula, coryza with inflamed fauces.

Modalities - Better from washing in cold water. Better cold drinks. Better walking. Worse left side. Worse after sleep. Worse touch, pressure of clothing. Worse slightest exertion. Worse periodically, from heat, cold exposure, lying down, night and early morning, awakening, brushing teeth, irritation of throat, rinsing mouth. Cough worse on waking.

Kidneys - Region of kidneys painful to pressure. Constant urging to urinate, better after passing blood clots from the vagina in females. Sticking pain along ureters. Lancinating, violent pain from kidneys to bladder with dysuria. Urine, brick-red sediment, urinary stones, hematuria, urates and uric acid. Deep-colored, thick urine. Nephritis. Nephritic colic.

Cough - Cough from rawness in air-passages. Short paroxysms, followed by easy expectoration of globules of mucus. Suffocative cough, worse first waking, with tough, white mucus, which strangles. Whooping cough attacks end with vomiting of tough mucus. Spasmodic cough in morning, worse 6 a.m. or 7 a.m. Spasmodic cough on first rising. Regular attacks of violent, tickling, racking coughs ending in vomiting or raising much clear ropy mucus. Periodical coughs, slowly increasing then gradually decreasing in its intensity, better cold air or cold drinks. Cough worse warm room. Violent cough, caused by brushing teeth, by rinsing mouth, by trying to clear throat of viscid mucus. Coughs of alcoholics.

name: Cochlearia Armoracia
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Bending forward better. Touch or slight pressure aggravates many symptoms. Worse evening and night..
constitution: Albuminuria. Aphonia. Asthma. Backache .Cataract. Colic. Cornea, spots. Coryza. Eruptions. Eyes, disorders. Flatulence. Gonorrhea. Gravel. Headaches. Impotency. Leucorrhea. Lungs, edema. Rheumatism. Scurvy. Strangury. Toothache. Ulcers. Urinary, disorders.
keynote:
PHARMACY - coch. Cochlearia armoracia. Horse radish. Armoracia sativa. Armoracia rusticana. N. O. Crucifer. Tincture of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

HERBAL - Early Spanish explorers called it coco, which means “monkey face” because the three indentations (eyes) on the hairy nut resembles the head and face of a monkey. Nucífera means “nut-bearing.” Coconut oil is of special interest because it possesses healing properties far beyond that of any other dietary oil and is extensively used in traditional medicine among Asian and Pacific populations. Pacific islanders consider coconut oil to be the cure for all illness. Coconut oil does not form harmful byproducts when heated to normal cooking temperature like other vegetable oils do. It has no harmful or discomforting side effects. It is non-toxic to humans. Root - In Java, a concoction from the root is used to treat dysentery. Leaves - In India, the hairs on the lower surface of the leaves are used to stop bleeding. Bark - In Ghana, the bark is used as an antiseptic, to clean the teeth and the ashes are used to treat scabies. Milk - In Mexico, the milk is considered to be diuretic and is used to combat intestinal worms. Oil - The Tahitians use the oil of coconut with perfumed flowers to apply to their hair. It is also used to heal wounds and sprains. Husk - It is also said in Tahiti that for skull fractures, the husk was used to cover the head and it would fit nicely and hold the head injury in place until complete healing had occurred. This way the patient was protected against any further shock to his head. MIND - Feeling trapped. Feeling like she is losing her freedom.

Throat - Dry throat. Feel like something is stuck in the throat, like a piece of shredded coconut. Croaky voice. Vertigo - Dizziness before meal time. Vertigo in the morning, on waking. Vertigo after eating. Vertigo feeling of swaying, feels like going to fall. Vertigo feel drunk. Vertigo with no sense of balance, has to hold on. Vertigo, with nausea. COMMENTS - Nutritional studies show that coconut and coconut oil, in one form or another, may provide a wide range of health benefits. Kills bacteria that cause ulcers, throat infections, urinary tract infections, gum disease and cavities, pneumonia, and gon- onhea. Kills fungi and yeasts that cause candidiasis, ringworm, athlete's foot, thrush, diaper rash, and other infections. Expels or kills tapeworms, lice, giardia, and other parasites. Provides a nutritional source of quick energy. Boosts energy and endurance, enhancing physical and athletic performance. Helps relieve symptoms associated with chronic fatigue syndrome. Improves digestion and absorption of other nutrients including vitamins, minerals, and amino acids. Reduces problems associated with malabsorption syndrome and cystic fibrosis. Improves calcium and magnesium absorption and supports the development of strong bones and teeth. Helps protect against osteoporosis. Supports thyroid function. Promotes loss of excess weight by increasing metabolic rate. Is utilized by the body to produce energy in preference to being stored as body fat like other dietary fats. Helps prevent obesity and overweight problems. Improves insulin secretion and utilization of blood glucose. Relieves stress on pancreas and enzyme systems of the body. Reduces symptoms associated with pancreatitis. Helps relieve symptoms and reduce health risks associated with diabetes. Helps protect against kidney disease and bladder infections. Dissolves kidney stones. Helps prevent liver disease. Helps relieve symptoms associated with gallbladder disease. Relieves symptoms associated with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, and stomach ulcers. Improves digestion and bowel function. Relieves pain and irritation caused by hemorrhoids. Reduces inflammation. Supports tissue healing and repair. Supports and aids immune system function. Functions as a protective antioxidant. Helps to protect the body from harmful free radicals that promote premature aging and degenerative disease. Does not deplete the body's antioxidant reserves like other oils do. Helps protect the body from breast, colon, and other cancers. Relieves symptoms associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia (prostate enlargement). Reduces epileptic seizures. Helps prevent periodontal disease and tooth decay. Applied topically helps to form a chemical barrier on the skin to ward of infection. Reduces symptoms associated the psoriasis, eczema, and dermatitis. Supports the natural chemical balance of the skin. Softens skin and helps relieve dryness and flaking. Prevents wrinkles, sagging skin, and age spots. Promotes healthy looking hair and complexion. Provides protection form damaging effects of ultraviolet radiation form the sun. Helps control dandruff. HOMEOPATHIC - Codeine possesses many of the properties of opium, from which it is derived, but it is sufficiently distinctive to entitle it to a separate description. Cod. seems to possess in great degree the exhilarating properties some persons experience when taking opium, though it is not without strong soporific effects as well. Disorders of sensation, notably troublesome itching. Marked sensitiveness of surface. Itching with feeling of warmth, numbness and prickling. Characteristic “Itching with warmth. Itching and heat of face and head. A sensation of agreeable warmth.” Trembling of whole body. Chorea. Involuntary twitching of muscles of arms and lower limbs. Convulsive twitchings of muscles and limbs and especially of orbital muscles, are very marked. Twitchings prevent sleep at night. Numbness and prickling. Extreme restlessness. Symptoms are periodic, paroxysmal, at times sudden. Diabetes. MIND - Great exhilaration of spirits. Depression with desire to sleep, frightful dreams and dull headache on awaking. Increased or diminished power of fixing attention or applying mind. Confusion of the mind. Depression with dull headache. Inability to apply mind. Lascivious thoughts. Bewildered on waking.

Head - Pain from occiput to back of neck. Skin of face and scalp sore after neuralgia. Dull headache in morning, gradually diminishes towards noon, when it disappears. Headache with dry lips and constant desire to moisten them. Headache from fatigue and excessive mental excitement.

Eyes - Involuntary twitching of eyelid (Agar.), sometimes better by rubbing. Pupils contracted. Sudden failure of vision. On blowing nose sparks before eyes. Food - Great thirst with desire for bitter substances.

Mouth - Mouth dry. Unable to articulate. Nose - Mucus discharge with irritation of the Schneiderian membrane. Entire loss of smell for several days.

Throat - Strong pulsations in both carotids Tickling sensation in throat in afternoons and evenings. Vertigo - Dizziness on blowing nose. When closing eyes objects appear to turnaround. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Agar., Hyos., Am-be. (2) Op. in sickness, pains in stomach and region of solar plexus, constipation, sexual excitement. (3) Agar. - twitching of eyelids. (4) Ars. - pains in legs, nightly restlessness. (5) Hyos. - twitching of eyelids after reading. (6) Lach. - sensitiveness of surface. (7) Rhus-t., Sulph., Sul-ac. - trembling. (8) Culex - vertigo on blowing nose. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Spasmodic pain at pit of stomach. Belchings. Empty belchings with acute pains in stomach. Nausea and vomiting, sometimes preceded by an agreeable glow at epigastrium. Violent spasmodic pain at pit of stomach (solar plexus).

Rectum - Constipation with tenderness of bowels, especi ally transverse and descending colon, with some flatulence.

Male - Sexual excitement during the night, leading to pollutions.

Heart - Uneasy feeling about heart. Fluttering and oppression, with great desire to walk in open air. Violent pulsations of heart and carotids. Painful pulsation when attempting to study or write.

Back - Neuralgic pains from occiput to back of neck. Convulsions in muscles of back. Sharp pains extending from stomach and chest through to back, between shoulders, worse on right side.

Limbs - Paralytic weakness in arms and legs. Spasmodic twitches in arms and legs. Numbness of hands and feet, prickling and numb sensation in various parts of the body. Lungs - Dry cough worse at night. Tickling in larynx and coughing. Short and irritating cough, worse at night. Copious, purulent expectoration. Night cough of tuberculosis. Troublesome cough with copious mucus and sometimes purulent, expectoration with nervous excitability.

Sleep - Sleepy and drowsy. Cough disturbing sleep. Twitchings in sleep. Frightful dreams.

Skin - Itchy, dry and prickling. Eczematous eruption with troublesome itching. Itching with feeling of warmth.

Modalities - Worse by motion and better by rest. Headaches are worse in morning. Restlessness and cough worse at night.

Bladder - Semi-paralysis of bladder. Quantity of urine increased. Sugar in urine. Causations - Fatigue and excessive mental excitement causes headache.

Palpitations. Prosopalgia. Sciatica. Shocks. Sleeplessness. Strokes. Toothaches. Unconsciousnes. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - The effects of Coffea cruda have to be considered separately from those of Coffea tosta, since the roasting converts much of the caffeine into caffeone or methylamine, which gives coffee its aroma. But the effects are very similar.

HOMEOPATHIC - The provings of Coff. were made with the raw berries. Coff. belongs to the same family as Chin, and Ip., and like these remedies has many symptoms like intermittent fever. It has been noticed that coffee-drinkers with malaria are more difficult to cure than those who do not drink coffee. Over excitable and over sensitive nerves, special senses become over acute. Hyperactivity of mind and body. Sudden emotions, especially joy and pleasurable surprise, can produce dangerous symptoms. Severe insomnia. Great nervous agitation and restlessness. Hysteria, screaming weeping. Convulsions of teething children with grinding of the teeth and coldness of the limbs. Convulsions from excessive playing or laughing in weakly children. Skin hypersensitive. Touch, noise, odors, pain become intolerable. Neuralgia in various parts, always with great nervous excitability. Intolerance of pain, driving to despair. Nervous palpitations. Stimulates the functional activity of all organs increasing the nervous and vascular activity. Sensation of warmth. Coffee drinking is likely to increased production of uric acid, causing irritation of kidneys, muscle and joint pains, and should be curtailed or careful watching in the elderly as they are more susceptible to the stimulating action of coffee or tea. Clarke noted that although it is believed that coffee antidotes almost all homeopathic medicines, it is doubtful whether it could do so, especially when remedies are given in high potency. Experience shows that correctly selected homeopathic remedies act in spite of taking coffee. MIND - Clearness of mind in evening, at night. Unusual activity of mind and body. Full of ideas, quick to act. Easy comprehension, irritability, excited, senses acute. Sentimental. Faints easily. Fright from sudden pleasant surprise. Complaints from fright. Ailments from disappointed love. Ailments from excessive laughing and playing. Trembles. Clinging to persons or furniture. Confusion during paroxysm of pain. Tossing about Coffea cruda in anguish (Aeon.). Throws things about. Pains seem intolerable, driving to despair with weeping. Fear of death during labor or after-pains. Fear of death from pains. Fear of danger on falling asleep. Fear of fresh air. Pangs of conscience. Weeps, laments and tosses about, over trifles. Immoderate activity and vigour. Increased feeling of energy and health. Ecstasy. Buoyancy. Great loquacity, brain feels clear and is active, he feels strong enough to do anything. Hasty eating and drinking. Hurried in movements. Memory becomes very acute. Memory active until midnight. Wakeful, full of ideas. Lively fancies, full of plans for the future. Theorizing. Weeping from delight. Capriciousness. Cry and laugh easily. Now joyous now gloomy. Mental and physical exhaustion. Delirium tremens, with trembling of hands. Thinks that he is not at home, restlessness. Annoyed by voices. Resents sympathy. Weeping during headache, during menses. All senses more acute, reads fine print easier. Hearing, smell, taste and touch acute. Excitement as if hurried. Sensitive to noises, even if anyone walks across the floor. Fear of least noise. Impressionable to pleasurable impressions. Unconsciousness, fainting after strong emotions. Unconsciousness during childbirth.

Head - Headaches from mental overexertion, thinking or talking. Sensation as if brain were torn to pieces. As if a nail were driven into the head. Sensation as if brain is shattered or crushed. Headaches worse motion, noise, music or light. Tight pain, worse from noise, smell, narcotics. Head feels too small. Feels and hears a cracking in vertex. Coffee and caffeine headaches (Cham.). Temples throbbing with burning in eyes. Pains driving to despair, patient runs wildly about room. Rush of blood to head, after exhausting joy. Threatening apoplexy. Hyperemia of brain after abuse of Bell.

Eyes - Burning in eyes and throbbing in temples, during sick headache. Eyes half open during sleep, with convulsive motion of eyes when awake. Eyes reddish and shining. Pupils dilated. Bright eyes. Can read fine print more distinctly. Power of vision increased, esp. in open air. Scintillations. Dim vision during cough.

Ears - Sensitive hearing. Noise is painful, even footsteps. Sensitive to noise, music, voices. Hearing acute, overhears distant sounds. Hardness of hearing with buzzing as of a swarm of bees. Noises and singing in ears, with nervous people. Crackling noise in head, synchronous with pulse, worse mornings and in open air, better indoors.

Nose - Acute, sensitive smell. Nosebleed with heaviness of head and ill humor during straining at stool.

Face - Shining red face with much fever. Flushed face during sick headache. Transitory flushes in face. One cheek hot and red, with constant shuddering. Dry heat with red cheeks. Acfiing, sharp, radiating pains. Prosopalgia extending to molar teeth, ears, forehead and scalp. Sweat on face with internal chilliness.

Mouth - Excessive dryness of mouth at night. Hot breath. Taste more acute. Delicate taste. Taste sweetish. Loss of taste. Salivation during pregnancy. Hasty eating and drinking.

Throat - Sore throat, worse cold air. Sore throat, parts very sensitive. Swelling and painfulness of throat, worse swallowing. Pain as from a plug with constant desire to swallow. Uvula too long, swollen. Larynx as if covered with dry mucus. Trachea as if raw. Roughness and hoarseness in larynx, in morning on waking. Spasm of glottis, starts from sleep with short inhalation or gasping. Vertigo - Dizziness and confusion in the head. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo when stooping. Vertigo during cough. Vertigo with whirling sensation in head, occasionally a general faint feeling, worse thinking. Vertigo with burning in stomach. Vertigo during sick headache, worse change of position or from moderate outdoor exercise. COMMENTS - Teste grouped Coff. with Caust. He remarked that potentized Coff. prevents or neutralizes in many persons the effects of roasted coffee. Teste noted that this quasi-isopathic action is by no means confined to Coff., potentizations of many other drugs being antidotal to secondary effects of the crude substances. Hahnemann described the migraine of coffee-drinkers thus: “It comes in the morning after waking increasing little by little. The pain becomes intolerable and sometimes burning integument of head very sensitive and painful on slightest touch. Body and mind excessively sensitive. Patients look exhausted, retire to dark places, close their Coffea cruda eyes to avoid light of day, remain seated in an armchair or stretched on a bed. “The least noise or motion excites the pain. They avoid talking, being talked to or hearing others talk. The body is colder than usual though no chills are experienced, the hands and feet are especially cold. “They loathe everything, especially food and drink, on account of a continual sickness at the stomach. If the attack is very violent a vomiting of mucus takes place, which, however, does notrelieve the headache. There are no alvine discharges. This kind of megrim scarcely ever leaves before evening. “If the paroxysm is less violent, a little strong coffee which was the first cause of such a headache will produce a temporary palliation of the pain, but the disposition to relapse becomes so much greater. The attacks come irregularly, every fortnight or every few weeks without any apparent cause and quite suddenly, so much so that the patient often does not feel a single unpleasant symptom the evening preceding the attack. Such a headache has never been seen by me except in real coffee-drinkers.” More recently. Dr. Gilles de la Tourette (Lancet, July 20, 1895) has described the effects of coffee. In his opinion they are very frequently mistaken for the effects of alcohol. “Morning vomiting of glairy mucus, pain in the pit of the stomach, thickly-coated tongue, loss of appetite. The disgust excited by even the idea of solid food is such that these patients eat nothing else but bread soaked in their poison—coffee. There supervene then nausea, vomiting and painful acid belchings.” The effects of coffee are less deep than those of alcohol and quickly disappear when the habit is discontinued. Characteristic exaltation of the senses and sensibility in general (Aeon.). Sight is improved, fine print can be read easily, hearing is more acute and noises are intolerable and are accompanied with fear of death. The mental activities are exalted. Great sensitiveness to touch or contact. Nervous energy, anxious, wide awake, and hypersensitive to all light and noise, any stimulus. Ailments due to over-excitement (Arg-n., Phos.), pleasant surprises, joy. Happy excitement. Very sensitive to the cold and the wind. Over excitement from severe pain, hypersensitive to the pain. Frets over the pain. Cannot stand the pain, pain out of proportion. Pain leads to sleeplessness and over excitability. An emergency remedy for amputation pain and severe nerve pain with burning. Tendency to be intellectual, very quick minded, clear thinkers with brilliant memories, but can't turn their sensitivity off, an increased nervous system. Voracious mental appetite (Sulph.). Hyperactivity. Severe insomnia from an overactive mind. Sleep is disturbed by terrifying dreams. Slowed pulse. Headaches (Cham, for coffee headache). One-sided headaches with the sensation as if a nail was being pounded in (Ign., Thuja, Anae., Nux-v.), usually right over the eye. Sense of lightness of movement, the head feels light, full of vigor. Ringing in the ears or a roaring sensation in the head. For teething and toothache. Tendency to colic. Diarrhea in housewives who have much care and trouble in managing their households. Labor pains. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Nux-v., Coff., Tab. Strong black coffee, drunk as hot as possible is indispensable as an antidote in a large number of poisons, especially narcotics. Hot coffee by rectum in cases of extreme collapse. Compare: (1) Coff-t. (2) Cypr. - ecstasy. (3) Bry. and Cham. - toothache better by cold. (4) Aeon. - predicts hour of death. Coca, Codeine. Complementary: Aeon. Incompatible: Camph., Cocc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Intolerance of tight clothing. Bilious vomiting and restlessness at commencement of variola. Gastric derangements of infants. Anguish and pressure in stomach pit. Burning in stomach during vertigo. Stomach feels over loaded during colic. Burning, sour eructations. Hiccoughs. Eructation like rotten eggs. Violent spasmodic eructations, with rising of the ingesta. Continual nausea during headache. Constant inclination to vomit, felt in throat. Vomiting of mucus during violent attacks of megrim.

Abdomen - Flatulence. Intolerance of tight clothing. Clothes are oppressive. Abdominalpains with despair.Tensionof epigastric region, with sensitivity to touch. Colic, which seems to be unendurable. Pains as if abdomen would burst. Pressure in abdomen as from incarcerated flatus. Distended abdomen, extreme emaciation. Incarcerated hernia.

Rectum - Constant alternations of constipation and diarrhea. Constipation and hemorrhoids. Constipation in sick headache. Diarrhea, watery, painless all day. Diarrhea in housewives from too much care about domestic affairs. Diarrhea during dentition, after the use of chamomile tea. Hemorrhoidal conditions. Spasmodic contraction of sphincter, with burning and itching in anus. Fetid flatus. Liquid, fecal, offensive stools, from sudden joy or taking cold in open air. Sensations - As if head too small, as if something hard pressing on surface of brain, as if head would burst and fly to pieces if she moved. As if intestines were being cut. As if body would burst. Tight pains and sensations. Sensation of warmth.

Male - Hypersensitiveness of sexual organs. Scrotum relaxed. Hot, itching genitals. Emissions at night, followed by great languor and irritability of temper. Greatly excited sexual desire, with dry heat of body.

Female - Menses too early and long lasting. Profuse menses with excessive sensitiveness of organs and voluptuous itching. Dysmenorrhea, large clots of blackblood, with extreme sensitiveness of genitals. Toothache during menses. Bearing down in genitals with frequent urination. Metrorrhagia. Severe after pains or labor pains with fear of death. Voluptuous itching in the vulva. Hypersensitive vulva and vagina. Vagina and vulva are too sensitive to rub or scratch, aversion to sex. Leucorrhea like mucus, or milky, worse while urinating. Severe after-pains or labor pains, with fear of death. Labor-pains ceasing, with loquacity. Irregular, ineffectual labor-pains. Puerperal fever from mental excitement. Nymphomania. Food - Diminished appetite. Hasty eating and drinking. Excessive hunger. Aversion to coffee. Bad effects from wine and liquor. Bad effects from drinking too much wine. Thirst increased, esp. at night. Worse from drinking too much coffee. Thirst during sweat. Headache from eating too much.

Chest - Sharp pains in sides during cough. Constitutions - Complaints during infancy and dentition. Suited to tall, lean, and stooping persons with dark complexions. Sanguine choleric temperament.

Heart - Violent irregular palpitations, especially after excessive joy or surprise. Nervous palpitation with trembling of limbs, worse sun, heat. Hypertension. Sudden rise of blood pressure and urinary suppression. Pulse full and frequent. Pulse intermitting. Pulse more frequent, but less vigorous, even small and weak.

Back - Small of back as if lame, while sitting or standing. Breasts - Agalactia. Emaciation of breasts. Breast cysts from coffee drinking. Causations - Effects of sudden emotion, especially pleasurable ones. Ill effects of fear, fright, disappointed love, over fatigue, excessive laughing, long journey. Wine. Slight passive movements are perceived as enormous, children at times cannot bear to be carried about.

Limbs - Trembling of hands, cannot hold the pen. Twitching of limbs. Crural neu- ralgia, worse motion afternoon and night, better by pressure. Pain in limbs, worse noise. Coldness of limbs, hands and feet. Sciatica, worse motion, afternoon and night with restlessness and sleeplessness at night. Lungs - Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children. Asthmatic attacks in morning, wants to move continually. Short inspiration, chest heaves visibly. Suffocative fits.

Sleep - Restless sleep, frequent, sudden starting and waking. Nervous sleeplessness. Insomnia. Sleeplessness, before or after midnight, from nursing the sick. Sleeps until 3 a.m., after which only dozing. Sleeplessness from excessive use of coffee. Wakes with a start, sleep disturbed by dreams. Sleepless, on account of mental activity, flow of ideas. Disturbed sleep from itching of anus. Sleeplessness after pleasurable excitement. Sleepless with nervous excitability. Sleepless so long as any noise or light continues, at night. Sleeplessness after acute diseases. Long and vivid dreams. Pleasant dreams, even merry.

Skin - Skin very sensitive, eruptions become extremely irritable. Painfully sensitive. Itching, scratches until it bleeds. Itching of eruption changes into burning. Measly spots on the skin, with dry heat. Purple miliary eruptions all over. Scarlet fever, may aid in bringing out the eruption in cases of extreme wakefulness and nervous excitement. Scarlet rash with overwhelming pains and lamenting. Varicella, smallpox. Dryness of skin, but not in febrile diseases. Stinging and smarting on skin.

Modalities - Better warmth. Better from lying down, sleep. Better cold drinks. Better holding ice in mouth. Worse excessive excitement. Worse strong emotions, joy. Worse mental exertion. Worse overeating. Worse alcohol, wine, narcotics. Worse from strong odors, noise. Worse open air. Worse cold, wind. Worse from touch, would like to rub the part but it is too sensitive. Worse at night, sleeps until 3 a.m. Warm drinks aggravate toothache.

Teeth - Dentition of anemic, sensitive children. Convulsive grinding of teeth. Toothache during menses. Toothache, Coffea cruda better holding ice water in mouth, worse as it warms. Severe toothache, intolerant of the pain with restlessness, anxiety and weeping.

Kidneys - Suppression of urine. Frequent, profuse urination of colorless urine. Pressure on bladder. Urine passes off drop by drop.

Cough - Short, dry cough of measles in nervous, delicate children. Short, dry, hacking, constant, [5] as from constriction of larynx. [4] Cough and sleeplessness after measles. Feels exhausted after coughing. [5] Irritable, nervous, at night, with anxiety and sleeplessness. [11] Irritation tocough, with coryza, worse open air. Single, sudden shocks, quickly following each other. From irritation in throat, phlegm in back part of throat. When falling asleep or soon after. Dry, hacking, like whooping cough, with this difference, that the spasms are principally experienced during inspirations, not during expirations.

Perspiration - Cold, clammy sweat, over whole body, but chiefly on palms of hands. Slight sweat, mostly in face.

Temperature - Chilliness worse every movement. Internal chills with external heat of face and body. Chills with heat of head and sweat of face. Chills running down back. Running all through limbs. Shivering, from least exposure to cold air. Chills without thirst. Traumatic fever. Even with mild fever patient is very nervous and sensitive. Ague, paroxysms every fourth day, two well days intervening. Intermittent fever. Feverish with pain and always ready to weep.

name: Coffea Tosta
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse least noise. Worse light. Worse motion..
constitution: Antidote, poisons. Chills. Cholera. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Hyperesthesia. Insomnia. Labor, pains. Migraine. Nervousness. Neuritis. Pains. Palpitations. Seminal, emissions. Toothaches. Urinary, disorders. Vertigo. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - coff-t. Coffea tosta. Roasted coffee berries. N. O. Rubiacae. Infusion of the well-roasted berries. Historical dose: Tritura- tion and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Antidote, poisons. Chills. Cholera. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fever. Headaches. Heart,…
full:
PHARMACY - coff-t. Coffea tosta. Roasted coffee berries. N. O. Rubiacae. Infusion of the well-roasted berries. Historical dose: Tritura- tion and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Antidote, poisons. Chills. Cholera. Delirium tremens. Diarrhea. Fainting. Fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Hyperesthesia. Insomnia. Labor, pains. Migraine. Nervousness. Neuritis. Pains. Palpitations. Seminal, emissions. Toothaches. Urinary, disorders. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - The roasting of coffee develops certain vitamin-like substances. Pigeons which had developed “deficiency” neuritis and paralysis on diet of polished rice lost their disabilities on the addition of 8 cc to a 5% infusion of coffee to their food. Unroasted coffee was useless.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Coff-t. have been principally obtained from sensitive persons on whom strong coffee has acted injuriously and the clinical uses have been mainly based on these. But there is a definite and extensive proving of Coff-t. given in Allen. While it is often given in the form of black coffee, it is also available for use in the potencies. Coff-t. is serviceable against both cold and heat. Beneficial to persons who live in the open air. Toothache, better by cold (Coff.), “cold water better intense pain in sound teeth of right lowerjaw.” Clarke has several times cured a toothache like this with Coff. 30c. Heart disorders with troublesome palpitations from heart-irritability and in general nervous excitement. Tense arteries. Periodic headaches in hysterical women. Nervous and gastric headaches. Vomiting on least exertion. Diarrhea from overwork and too much care. Gout and rheumatism with tendency to form chalkstone. Labor pains are intolerable. Useful in confinements to relieve the excess of suffering which some women experience. Body and mind excessively sensitive. Looks exhausted, retires to lonely and dark places and closes eyes in order to avoid light. Least noise or motion excites pains. Avoids talking or being talked to or hearing others talk. Body colder than usual, although no chills are experienced. Hands and feet very cold. MIND - Increased intellectual activity and perception of sounds, motion. Great excitement. Full of apprehension of terrible things happening. Depression and despair. Thinks she will die during labor. Begs that some one might end her life. Strange feeling in her head with palpitations, trembling and chilliness. Doesn't know where she is. Delirium tremens.

Head - Nervous and gastric headaches. Periodical headaches of hysterical women. Migraine coming on in morning shortly after awaking. Pains increasing little by little. Pains become intolerable. Burning pains. Coffee and caffeine headaches (Cham.). Scalp sensitive, hurts when touched ever so slightly. Headaches come on irregularly, without premonitory symptoms. If headache attack is very violent, vomiting of mucus, which doesn't diminish the pain. Headaches worse least noise or motion.

Eyes - Shining bright eyes during labor. Sees dazzling colors, principally blue and yellow, before eyes.

Ears - Ringing and noises as if falling rain, during vertigo.

Face - Pale face during vertigo with fainting. Face hot and deeply flushed, during labor. Excruciating facial neuralgia from decayed teeth.

Stomach - Tight feeling in stomach after eating. Cramp of stomach. Vomits without least exertion. Epidemic cholera, particularly against the weakening vomiting and tormenting thirst, and it was useful in subduing the premonitory symptoms.

Abdomen - Cramplike drawing pains in umbilical region with severe pains in lumbar region. Pains in abdomen during labor.

Rectum - Diarrhea from overwork or too much worry. Obstinate diarrhea of elderly people occurring after an attack of cholera. Chronic diarrhea. Hemorrhoidal complaints.

Male - Seminal emission at 3 a.m. Seminal emission with voluptuous itching, followed by chill and cold, clammy sweat.

Female - Very severe labor pains. Patient becoming greatly excited, constant tossing about with violent movements of limbs, she complains of the severity of pains and is sure she will die. After rupture of bag of waters, very severe pains in lumbar region. Food - Loathes all food and drinks on account of continual nausea.

Heart - Palpitations from irritable heart. Small and frequent pulse, during labor. Arteries tense.

Limbs - Gout and rheumatism, where there is a disposition to the formation of chalk- stones in joints. Pains in left shoulder-joint. Trembling of hands. Iliac pains. Pains in left foot and joint of big toe. Lungs - Spasmodic asthma. Asthma thy- micum. Whooping cough.

Sleep - Nervous andrestless sleep. Obstinate sleeplessness. Insomniafrom overactivity of the mind. Sleepless from sensitivity to noise, light.

Modalities - Worse least noise. Worse light. Worse motion.

Teeth - Intense pain in sound teeth of right lower jaw nearly driving him crazy. No application relieves except cold water in mouth. Toothache returns as water becomes warm. Premature decay of teeth in children.

Kidneys - Assists the passage of gravel and small urinary calculi, and impedes their further formation in bladder. Catarrh of bladder, especially of old debauchees. Diabetes mellitus.

Temperature - Feels chilly, without being cold, and trembles. Intermittent fever. Continued fever with disposition to diarrhea. Inflammatory fever in children with excitability, starting and twitching in sleep, restlessness and crying. Vertigo - Vertigo comes in attacks. Vertigo with obscured vision, unable to distinguish surrounding objects. Vertigo with ringing in ears and noise as of falling rain. Vertigo, suddenly falls to the ground insensible. Vertigo with palpitation of heart. Vertigo with easy vomiting and paleness of face during paroxysms. COMMENTS - Its value is well known as an allopathic antidote to opium and its derivatives in poisonous doses. Additionally, it counteracts the effects of Nux-v., Bell., Coloc., Valer., Cic., Cham., Phos, Ph-ac., lead. Salts of Antimony, narcotic mushrooms, poisonous sumac, tobacco, bitter almonds, and prussic acid. On account of its extensive antidotal properties coffee has largely been condemned by homeopathic practitioners, but it should be remembered that it does not antidote all remedies. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Caps., Cham., Coff. Crud., Nux-v. Compare: (1 ) Coff. crud.. Caffeine. (2) Cham., Nux-v., Valer., REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy.

name: Colchicinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Arthritis. Convulsive, jerkings. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Fevers. Gout. Intestinal, catarrh. Pleurisy. Prostration. Rheumatic, fever. Rheumatism. Sleeplessness. Spasms.
keynote:
PHARMACY - colchin. Colchicinum. Colchicine. Alkaloid of Colchicum autumnale. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthritis. Convulsive, jerkings. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Fevers. Gout. Intestinal, catarrh. Pleurisy. Prostration. Rheumatic,…
full:
PHARMACY - colchin. Colchicinum. Colchicine. Alkaloid of Colchicum autumnale. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthritis. Convulsive, jerkings. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Fevers. Gout. Intestinal, catarrh. Pleurisy. Prostration. Rheumatic, fever. Rheumatism. Sleeplessness. Spasms.

HOMEOPATHIC - This colchine alkaloid has been proved and the symptoms are sufficiently distinctive. The symptoms point strongly to its use in that form of intestinal catarrh characterized by the appearance of shreddy membranes. Arthritis deformans in early stages. Intense pain of rheumatism. Rheumatic fever, gout. Convulsive jerkings of right hand. Endocarditis and pericarditis. Pleurisy. Very great exhaustion increasing to feverish excitement.

Eyes - Pupils widely dilated.

Face - Tearing pains in face.

Mouth - Increased secretion of saliva.

Stomach - Pains and sensitiveness in epigastrium. On rising from bed, at night, nausea suddenly increased and was followed by vomiting of undigested food, and afterwards of a bitter greenish fluid. Vomiting early in the morning. Vomiting of blood for nine or ten days.

Abdomen - Distention and sensitiveness. Frequent rumbling.

Rectum - Urging, causing him to leave the bed. Copious pasty evacuation. Stools with tenesmus and consisting of a thin fluid with numerous flakes looking like cooked egg white in pieces from two to four inches long. Stools thin, yellowish green, slimy, accompanied by pain. Liquid stools.

Limbs - Convulsive jerkings of right hand.

Sleep - Awakened from sleep soon after midnight by uneasy dreams. Somnolency and collapse.

Kidneys - Urine turbid, depositing a copious white sediment.

Pulse - Pulse during the first two hours sank about eleven beats.

Temperature - Chill about noon on first day, followed by violent heat lasting several hours with increased thirst, very rapid pulse, confusion of the head, uneasiness and sleeplessness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ars., Caust., Colch. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Colchicum Autumnale
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from warmth. Better rest. Better doubling up. Better sitting. Better stooping. Better after stools. Better lying quietly. Better open air. Oppression and colic better bending forward. Worse from motion (Bry.). Can't lie on left side. Worse touch, vibrations. Worse stubbing toes. Worse bodily or mental exertion. Worse from stretching. Worse checked sweat. Worse vomiting. Worse loss of sleep. Worsefrom smell of food. Worse at night, evening. Worse sundown to sunrise. Worse from changing weather. Worse cold, autumn. Symptoms generally worse cold damp, worse getting wet, bathing, living in damp dwellings, changes to damp weather. Worse from rising up in bed..
constitution: Albuminuria. Appendicitis. Arthritis. Ascites. Asiatic, cholera. Asthma. Backache. Bright’s disease. Cataracts. Cholera. Colic. Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Cramps. Debility. Dehydration. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysentery. Eye, disorders. Feet, painful. Flatulence. Gout. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hydrothorax. Ileus. Intermittent, fever. Intestinal, catarrh. Iritis. Joint, pain
