full:
PHARMACY - colch. Colchicum autumnale. Meadow saffron. N. O. Melanthacae of the Liliaceae. Colchicaceae. Tincture of the bulb dug in spring. The flowers of the plant appear in autumn, the leaves not until the following spring. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Appendicitis. Arthritis. Ascites. Asiatic, cholera. Asthma. Backache. Bright’s disease. Cataracts. Cholera. Colic. Colitis. Coryza. Coughs. Cramps. Debility. Dehydration. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Dysentery. Eye, disorders. Feet, painful. Flatulence. Gout. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hydrothorax. Ileus. Intermittent, fever. Intestinal, catarrh. Iritis. Joint, pains. Lumbago. Memory weak. Morning sickness. Muscle, pains. Nausea. Nephritis. Night- watching. Nosebleed. Pericarditis. Pleurodynia. Proctalgia. Prostatitis. Prostration. Rectum, prolapsed. Rheumatism. Smell, acute. Sneezing. Stiff- neck. Styes. Suppressed sweat. Tongue, sensation lost.Torticollis. Typhlitis. Typhoid, fever. Uric aciddiathesis. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Colchicum is best known as a remedy for gout and rheumatism. It markedly affects muscles, fibrous tissue, serous membranes, and joints, especially the small ones. Colch. relieves gouty paroxysms. Red, hot and swollen parts. Tearing pain, worse in the evening, at night, and from touch. Stubbing the toes hurts exceedingly. Many joints are affected at the same time. Small, rapidly shifting areas of severe pain, but little swelling. Pains are tearing, digging, drawing. Tingling, crawling. Stitching, jerking, drawing pains in muscles, periosteum and joints. Pains worse from mental exertion, emotions, slightest touch and vibrations. There is the irritability and aversion to touch so common in gout, pain in small joints and especially the great toes. Affects the periosteum and synovial membranes of joints. The stomach is acutely disordered, nausea and vomiting. Nausea at thought, sight or smell of food, especially of cooking. Dysentery. Uric acid diathesis, pale yellow sediment like fine flour. Urine black as ink. Urine loaded with albumen and casts. Extreme relaxation of the muscular system, the head falls forward on the chest or falls back when the patient is raised from the pillow, arms fall helpless by the side. Great prostration, internal coldness. Tendency to collapse. Moist collapse, due to dehydration, as after repeated vomiting or purging. Cardiac and arthritic disorders. Dropsy. Hydropericardium, hydrothorax, ascites, hydrometra. The patient must rest and lie down. Cannot lie on left side. Effects of night-watching and over study. Shocks as from electricity through one half of body. Bad effects from suppressed sweat. Dreams of mice. MIND - Mind befogged, but answers correctly. Intellect beclouded, though he gives correct answers. Mind generally distracted. Can read, but cannot understand a short sentence. Memory weak. Weakness of memory from fatigue. Deficiency of ideas. Disorders in comprehension and association of ideas. Lacks words to express ideas. When writing, forgets syllables and entire words. Confounds objects. Very irritable with the pains (Cham.). Pains worse mental exertion or by emotions. Intolerant of pain, his suffering seem unendurable . Depressed, irritable and sensitive. Peevish, nothing satisfies him. Discontented, not satisfied with anything. Misdeeds of others make him quite beside himself. Extreme impressions such as bright light, strong odors, contact aggravate him. Sensitive to all external impressions. Hatred of odors. Frequent starting and trembling are felt through body. Delirium during headache. Starting during sleep. Delusions, sees mice, hears noises. Vision heightened, but intellectual faculties dulled. Carphologia. Sardonic laughing. Indifference, doesn't complain unless questioned, then says nothing of his condition. Absence of apprehension, no fear of death. Abdomen - Mucus colitis, after dysentery. Pain in transverse colon. Distention of abdomen. Distended cecum and ascending colon. Fullness and continuous rumbling. Borborygmi. Colicky pains. Colic, worse eating, after flatulent food, with great distension, better bending double. Icy coldness of abdomen with colic. Ascites with fold over the pubic region. Surface of abdomen hotter than rest of body and extremely sensitive to touch. Pulsation in abdomen. Pain over liver. Tearing pain about sigmoid flexure of colon, worse pressure and at night. Griping pains.

Head - Difficulty in moving head. Creeping in forehead and over head. Pressive headache, better supper, warmth, lying quiet. Headache chiefly frontal and temporal, but also occipital and in nape of neck, worse afternoon and evening. Aching in occiput, worse mental effort. Neuralgic, tearing pain in scalp in small spots. Headache over left eye, worse open air. Hemicrania, either of right or left side, changing about. Very violent headache, coming in evening and lasting until morning. Hot forehead. Forehead covered with cold sweat. Great falling off of hair.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, staring, hollow, congested, protruding. Diffused inflammation and congestion. Pain in and around the eyeball extending to occiput. Eyes half open. Visible contraction in lower lid. Acrid tears, worse in open air. Violent tearing pain in eyes. Edges of lids red and burning. Soft cataract. Kerato-iritis, with pus in anterior chamber of eye. Rheumatic iritis with great soreness of eyeballs. Stye on left lower lids. Ulceration of meibomian glands. Pupils unequal, left pupil contracted.

Ears - Itching, crawling in ears. Dryness of ears. Ears feel stopped up with roaring. Tingling of ears as after being frosted. Sharp, shooting, below right tragus. Earache with lacerating pains. Earache with discharge. Hearing very acute.

Nose - Nostrils dry and black. Smell morbidly acute. Odors of eggs, meat nauseate even to fainting. Strong odors make him quite beside himself. Smell so acute that he smells odors others can't smell. Obstinate coryza, discharge thin, tenacious, never watery. Sore pain in septum. Nosebleed, evenings. Sneezing, with crawling sensation in nose.

Face - Edematous swelling, cheeks red, hot, sweaty. Edema of lids and face. Pinched, sunken as in collapse. Sickly, sad, suffering expression. Pain in facial muscles, moving about. Tingling and edematous swelling, cheeks red, hot, sweaty. Pain behind angle of right lower jaw. Very irritable with the pains (Cham.). Tingling in face as after being frozen. Cheeks, lips and eyelids purple. Risus sardonicus. Blotchy papular rash on face.

Mouth - Sensation of warmth and dryness in mouth. Cracked lips. Thick, brownish coating on lips, teeth and tongue. Taste, flat, bitter. Flow of saliva with a sense of dryness. Mouth hangs open. Heat in the mouth with thirst. Profuse salivation with dryness of throat. Affection of salivary glands in Bright's disease. Cold breath. Lossofspeech. Inflammation and redness of palate and fauces.

Throat - Much greenish, thin mucus in the throat, comes involuntarily in the mouth. Voice hoarse, ordeeperthan usual. Hoarseness in morning, with roughness of throat. Itching in larynx and trachea. Throat as if dry. Constriction of esophagus. Tickling as if coryza were setting in, inducing cough and clearing throat. Tonsils inflamed and swollen, spots covered with pus, swallowing difficult. Heat in pharynx and whole length of esophagus.

Stomach - Gastric affections before and during an attack of rheumatism. Burning pains. Eructations, with burning in stomach. Icy coldness of stomach with colic. Pain in stomach and flatulence. Dry mouth, tongue burns, gums and teeth pain. Profuse salivary secretion. Gouty gastralgia. Gastralgia from sudden suppressed sweat. Stomach as if full and swollen, as if he had eaten too much. Nausea and retching. Nausea and inclination to vomit, caused by swallowing saliva. Nausea from odor of fat meat, eggs, fish. Vomiting of mucus, bile and food, worse any motion. Vomiting of the water he drank. Vomiting and purging of rice-water stools, with thirst. Vomiting first food, then fluid. Stools - Changeable stools, greenish, reddish, excoriating, slightly sour smelling, copious, frequent, watery or bilious. Stools are painful, scanty, transparent, jelly-like mucus. Bloody stools. Stools scanty, discharged only by hard straining, even if soft, with pain in lumbar region. Stools contain white shreddy particles in large quantities. Stools frequently orange-yellow, slimy with bright-yellow flakes. Scanty stool with tenesmus, salivation and copious urination. Stools pass insensibly, involuntary. Feces mixed with light blue matter. Profuse watery stools in hot, damp weather.

Rectum - Mucus colitis after dysentery. Autumn dysentery, when days are warm and nights are cold. Hemorrhage from bowels in autumnal, cold, damp weather. Very offensive flatus, in evening. Diarrhea, then gouty effects. Ineffectual pressing, feels feces in rectum, but cannot expel them. Pain, as if anus were torn open with prolapse. Agonizing pains remain long after stool. Spasmodic constriction of sphincter, followed by urging to stool. Unsatisfactory urging to stool, better passing flatus. Tingling, itching, burning and tearing in anus. Protrusion of rectum. Obstinate constipation in ileus.

Urine - Urine, hot, highly colored, watery, black sediment. Albuminuria. Profuse secretion of urine. Urine of sour smell and acid reaction. Dark, scanty or suppressed urine. Pale yellow, greenish urine. Urine turbid, leaves an orange-colored ring in vessel. Bloody, brown, black, inky urine. Whitish sediment in urine. Vertigo - Vertigo while sitting, after walking. Vertigo on rising. Vision - Spots before eyes. Variations in visual acuity. Dim vision after reading. Lost vision, for a minute or two on getting out of bed. COMMENTS - Coldness in the abdomen, stomach, and limbs. Profuse cold sweat, marked chills with or without periodicity. Burning in the cavities, especially the abdomen. Sensation of icy coldness or burning in stomach. Bloated abdomen. Diarrhea. Cholera. Dysentery with bloody stools and mucus. Autumn dysentery. Spring rheumatism. Dysentery and rheumatism are exceedingly painful. Stools have jelly-like mucus, membranous shreds. Rice-water stool, with hippocratic face, coldness, cramps, prostration. Stool accompanied by violent tenesmus. Protrusion of rectum. Affinity for the kidneys. Kidney failure with high uric acid. Effective for gout and joint conditions. In gouty diabetes, the uric acid reappears as the sugar disappears. Rheumatism can appear on disappearance of uric acid from urine. Arthritis in the small joints. Stiffness that's better with motion (Rhus-t.). Arthritis, worse motion (Nux-v., Bry.). Conditions worse in the autumn, damp weather and change of weather (Dulc., Rhus-t., Nat-s.). Cold and chilly, dampness penetrates. Ailments from getting wet and chilled, changes to damp weather. Oppression and anxiety in the heart, better by walking. Stitches about heart and loss of consciousness. Pericarditis on the disappearance of symptoms from limbs. All functions, mental and bodily, are slow. Nutrition and digestion are at a stand and Colchicum autumnale yet the patient does not emaciate rapidly. Great prostration, debility from loss of sleep, the prostration of typhoid fever and typhoid states. Extreme disinclination to move, worse from motion. Convulsions, cramps and restlessness. Pains are very acute and unendurable. Very sensitive and irritable. Cannot endure strong smells. Smell of food nauseates. Morning sickness with sensitive to the smell of food (Sep.). Nash recorded a striking cure by Colch. 200c. The patient was an old woman who was vomiting blood and passing as many as sixteen bloody stools in the day. The doors of the room had to be mostcarefully kept closed to prevent any smell of cooking reaching her as that immediately provoked nausea. Guernsey noted that “after evacuation, as in dysenteric, there is generally relief but in typhus fever, sometimes a terrific spasmodic pain of the anal sphincter comes on after stool. This may occur in diarrhea.” The rice-water stool, hippocratic face, coldness, cramps, and prostration, led Salzer to use it for certain epidemics of Asiatic cholera. J. R. Simson of Tonawanda, N. Y., cured a very bad case of typhoid presenting symptoms including “his left pupil was contracted so as to be almost imperceptible, while the right was dilated to the full extent.” This is peculiar to Colch. and no remedy relieved the patient until he received this. B. Simmons called attention to the powerlessness of the affected parts, especially when occurring in leuco- phlegmatic subjects and when there is edematous swelling of the parts. He cured a woman, 36, mother of two children, of leuco-phlegmatic temperament. who complained of rheumatism of the hands, which were swollen, joints stiff and powerless, pain as if bruised, the arms being affected but in less degree. “She was unable to brush her own hair, not so much from the pain as from the extreme weakness and powerlessness of the parts affected. ” T. F. Allen gave “Tingling in finger-nails” as characteristic of Colch., no other remedy has it as strong. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Thuj., Camph., Cocc., Nux-v., Puls. Compare: (1) Col- chicinum - intestinal catarrh and shreddy membranes, convulsivejerkings of right hand, rheumatic fever, gout, endo and pericarditis, pleurisy, arthritis deformans in early stages intense pain of rheumatism 3x trituration. (2) Carb-v., Am., Lil-t., Ars., Cocc., Kali-c., Verat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Edema of scrotum. Tearing in glands and left spermatic cord. Itching at prepuce and orifice of urethra. Chordee after gonorrhea.

Female - Menses too early and scanty. Itching of genitals. Sensation of swelling in vulva and clitoris. Coldness of thighs after menses. Feverish restlessness in last month of pregnancy. Intense boring or tensive pain in ovary, must bend double, with great restlessness. Dropsy of uterus from suppression of menses. Hemorrhage of uterus. Morning sickness with sensitivity to the smell of food (Sep.). Puerperal fever. Food - Gags from mere mention of food. Craving for various things but averse to them when smelling them. Loathes the smell or sight of food, better lying quietly. Nausea and anxiety from smell of cooking, or from fat food. Nausea from odor of fat meat, eggs, fish. Eggs disagree cause derangement of stomach. Tastelessness of food. Thirst for effervescent, aerated waters, alcoholic beverages. No thirst.

Chest - Violent cutting pains, interruptirig breathing. Stinging and tearing pains in muscles of chest. Chest as if squeezed by a tight band. Tensive feeling in chest. Sharp pain in chest on inspiration and coughing. Lacerating, tearing pain in chest. Lancinating pain, as with a knife, in right side of chest. Dull stitches in posterior part of thorax during expiration. Pleurodynia from catching cold or from living in damp dwellings. Serous effusion in chest with rheumatic and gouty persons. Hydrothorax, with marked dyspnea and edema of limbs. Spitting blood after chest injuries. Rheumatism of pectoral muscles. Constitutions - Complaints of old people, asthmatic people. It corresponds to the gouty constitution. Leuco- phlegmatic and melancholic, venous constitutions, uric acid diathesis.

Heart - Cardiac dyspnea. Heart disease, following rheumatism. Anxiety in region of heart. Violent palpitations with oppression of chest. Pressure and oppression in the region of the heart, better walking. Cutting or stinging at heart, weak heart. Trembling in precordial region, with sticking pains. Sound of heart becomes weaker, pulse of low tension. Heart disease and rheumatism. Hydropericardium. Pericarditis, with severe pain, oppression and dyspnea. Effusion into pericardium. Weak heart. Pulse not felt. Pulse is thready, imperceptible.

Back - Backache, better rest and pressure. Lumbago. Aching in lumbar and lumbosacral region. Ache better pressure and rest. Tension in neck muscles felt even on swallowing. Violent pain in region of kidneys, better lying on back only. Dull pain across loins. Spot on sacrum feels sore and bruised as if ulcerated, very sensitive to touch. Stinging and tension between scapulae. Torticollis. Breasts - Breast full, skin hot, pulse strong. Tearing, lancinating pain, deep in right breast, extending to back. Nipples dark, brownish-red, protruding. Nipples, unbearable pain on slightest touch by child. Causations - Bad effects of grief, nightwatching, over study. Misbehavior of others. Getting wet. Suppressed sweat. Complaints from getting overheated.

Limbs - Limbs, lame, weak, tingling, cold. Arthritic pain, patient screams with pain on touching a joint. Joints stiff and hot, shifting rheumatism, pains worse at night. Rheumatic pain in joints of fingers, toes, wrists and ankles. Painful gout in big toe, cannot bear to have it touched or moved. Pain worse in evening and warm weather. Tearing in limbs during warm weather, stinging during cold. Sharp pain down left arm. Pins and needles in hands and wrists, fingertips numb. Tingling in finger-nails. Finger joints distorted, fingers flexed but in constant motion. Knees knock together, can hardly walk. Buttocks hot. Right plantar reflex abolished. Edematous swelling and coldness of legs and feet. Bloating of hands andfeet with dysentery. Rheumatism in spring. Lungs - Chest seems squeezed by a hand. Night cough with involuntary spurting of urine. Great dyspnea. Cardiac dyspnea. Dyspnea with palpitations of heart from 11 a.m. to 3 a.m. Lies in bed gasping for breath, with pericarditis. Difficult breathing, better bending forward. Accelerated and audible breathing. Slow, irregular breathing. Asthmatic breathing with moist sound. Asthma with hydrothorax or hydropericardium. Asthma with dropsy of lower limbs. Hurried breathing with groans. Rapid and short, quick breathing.

Sleep - Falls asleep while reading. Lies prostrate on back. Sleeplessness from restlessness of limbs. At night, disturbed sleep or driven away by pains. Irresistible sleepiness, drowsiness, when not in too much pain. Drowsiness during day. Starting, jerking in sleep. Frightful dreams, awakening from sleep.

Skin - Skin dry, sweat suppressed or profuse. Blotchy papular rash on face. Pink spots on back, chest and abdomen. Urticaria. Stitches in skin. Tingling here and there, as after being frozen. Skin dry and pale, swollen, parts cold and glistening. Dryness of skin. Itching as in nettle-rash, unchanged by scratching. Erysipelas, smooth. Purple efflorescence on face, neck, and upper anterior part of thorax, inside of thighs, scrotum and groins in patches.

Modalities - Better from warmth. Better rest. Better doubling up. Better sitting. Better stooping. Better after stools. Better lying quietly. Better open air. Oppression and colic better bending forward. Worse from motion (Bry.). Can't lie on left side. Worse touch, vibrations. Worse stubbing toes. Worse bodily or mental exertion. Worse from stretching. Worse checked sweat. Worse vomiting. Worse loss of sleep. Worsefrom smell of food. Worse at night, evening. Worse sundown to sunrise. Worse from changing weather. Worse cold, autumn. Symptoms generally worse cold damp, worse getting wet, bathing, living in damp dwellings, changes to damp weather. Worse from rising up in bed.

Teeth - Gums and teeth painful. Teeth very sensitive when pressing them together. Grinding of teeth. Teeth feel too long. Tearing pain in roots of teeth and gums. Toothache, worse cold and immediately after warm things. Toothache, worse at night.

Tongue - Glossitis. Tongue burns. Tongue, bright red, heavy, stiff and numb, protruded with difficulty. Brown tongue. Loss of sensibility in tongue. Tongue cold. Tearing, burning and sticking pain in tongue. Tongue coated white.

Kidneys - Kidney failure with high uric acid. Uremia. Burning in urinary passages before urination. More urging, more discharge of urine. Diabetes. Nephritis with extreme pain in region of kidneys. Burning in urethra, as if urine were very warm. Tickling burning in urethra and discharge of a few drops, after urination. Raw pain, in urethra during urination.

Cough - Frequent, short, dry cough from tickling in larynx. Cough at night, compelling him to sit up, excited by scraping in chest, with much expectoration. Cough at night, with involuntary spurting of urine. Slight cough with coryza.

Perspiration - Copious, cold sweat, without relief. Copious sour sweat suddenly coming and going with rheumatism. Sweat cold on face. Sour sweat, nightly. Clammy sweat on whole surface, with low temperature of skin, in acute rheumatism. Acid reaction of sweat and urine. Suppressed sweat.

Temperature - Chilliness and coldness running through all limbs down back. Shuddering and creeping chills in isolated parts. Chills even near warm stove, intermingled with short flushes of heat. Cold sensation of head and limbs, in acute rheumatism. Dry heat at night with excessive thirst. Dry heat of whole body, constantly increasing and palpitations, thirst. Body hot, limbs cold. Intermittent, fever.

Traveller's diarrhea. Typhoid fever. Vaginitis. Vomiting. Weakness. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - The bacteria species, E. coli, occurs normally in the intestines of man and other vertebrates. It is widely distributed in nature, and is a frequent cause of food poisoning and infections of the urogenital tract and of diarrhea in infants. In babies and young children, profuse weakening diarrhea with hypothermia, bradycardia, dehydration. Hypotension, tendency to weakness, even collapse. Paleness, anxiety, vertigo, sweats, sound of the heart become muffed, and lowering of the blood pressure. General fatigue and depression which goes on aggravating with digestive and urinary troubles. Progressive asthenia. Mental and physical weakness. Permanent worn out condition. MIND - Mental weakness. Great timidity. Irresolution and lack of self-confidence. Always hesitating, cannot decide on any thing. Constant mental confusion because of the loss of memory. Forgets proper names. Loss of memory. Amnesia of recent events. Weakness of memory with great difficulty to find out the right word. Uses very often one word for another. Depressive melancholia. Sadness and weariness. Obsessional neurosis. Confused deliriums. Schizophrenic states, loss of contact with his environment and with his own reality. Catatonic condition with somnolence and dreams.

Head - Empty feeling in the head. Frontal and suborditary headache, worse by humid coldness. Headaches after contrariety and strong emotions.

Eyes - Swelling of the upper eyelids, sometimes left, sometimes right.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting after eating spoiled foods. Very slow digestion with the sensation of the stomach remaining heavy for a long time.

Abdomen - Bloating after eating. Slow intestinal transit. Flatulence, intestinal spasms. Gastroenteritis. Heaviness and drawing in the intestines. Rumbling. Expulsion of putrid gas. Spasmodic colitis.

Rectum - Infants with diarrhea and dehydration. Diarrhea. Profuse weakening diarrhea. Constipation. Traveller's diarrhea. Alternating diarrhea and constipation. Bloody, foul smelling stools. Worms.

Male - Erection and ejaculation sometimes painful, with the sensation of burning in the urethra after sex. Cystitis, prostatitis. Relapsing epididymitis.

Female - Salpingitis, metritis, vaginitis. Vaginitis with burning pains. Leucorrhea. Heaviness of the lower abdomen with ovarian pains. Menorrhea. Yellow leucorrhea, sightly irritating. Sexual relation becomes difficult, with vulvo-vaginal burning sensation. Food - Capricious appetite or anorexia. Food poisoning. Worse dairy products, milk. Worse eggs. Worse from eating undercooked meat, fish.

Heart - Bradycardia. Hypotension. Sound of the heart become muffed.

Back - Backaches. Lumbar pains.

Limbs - Polyarticular pains. Swelling of small joints of legs and hands. Rheumatism. Chronic degenerative rheumatism.

Sleep - Deep and heavy sleep. Insomnia.

Modalities - Better by heat. Better warmth. Worse by cold. Worse humid cold. Worse by the sea. Worse after rest. Worse milk. Worse slightest mental or physical exertion. Worse cold, damp weather.

Tongue - Tongue, coated yellowish-white. Tongue with a red clear stripe down the center. White tongue. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Pyrog., Chin., Ars., Lyc., Sepia, Psor., Med., Thuj. (2) Bowel nosodes. (3) Thymol., Folliculium. Cynodon dactylon. REFERENCES - Julian.

Liver - Hepatitis. Enlarged sensitive liver. Gall bladder, painful.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Heat and burning after urination. Cystitis. Painful sensation in the region of kidney. Frequent urination of little quantity. Painful urination with the sensation of burning at the end of the flow. Sensation as if he must go again to pass urine immediately after urination. Urine smells bad. Hematuria. Aggravation of urinary troubles in cold humid weather.

Temperature - Chilly, specially after eating. Nocturnal chill. Sensation of intense coldness with chill immediately after meals. Fever with great weakness. Typhoid fever. Septic fever. Puerperal fever.

full:
PHARMACY - coll. Collinsonia canadensis. Stone-root. Horse balm. Richweed. N. O. Labiate. Tincture of fresh root. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Atony. Catarrh. Colic. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Labor. Pregnancy, disorders. Proctitis. Pruritus, vulvae. Rheumatism.

HERBAL - Collinsonia is native to North America. It has a very tough, hard, knotted root. As a domestic remedy, it is known for chronic catarrhal conditions, especially of the stomach, bowels and bladder. Also of the nose, pharynx and larynx and in tubular and capillary bronchitis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Congestion in pelvic organs, especially anus, rectum and uterus, resulting in hemorrhoids and constipation, especially in females. Constipation of children from intestinal atony. It is said to be of special value when given before operations, for rectal diseases. Sense of weight and constriction. Venous engorgement. Depressed arterial tension, general atony of muscular fiber. Chronic nasal, gastric andpharyngeal catarrh, due to portal obstruction. Pruritus in pregnancy with hemorrhoids. Irritation of cardiac nerves, palpitation, faintness, oppression. Dropsy from cardiac disease. Heart disorders that alternate with suppressed bleeding hemorrhoids. Sensitiveness about the heart, fullness, oppressed breathing, faintness. MIND - Gloomy. Sullen. Excitable. Irresolution.

Head - Dull, frontal headache with constipation or hemorrhoids. Headache from suppressed hemorrhoidal discharge. Headache with frequent flying pains in legs, tearing in knees.

Nose - Chronic catarrh. Sinus congestion.

Face - Yellow discoloration around the eyes.

Mouth - Tongue yellow with bitter taste (Coloc., Bry.).

Throat - Hoarseness. Speaker's sore throat, sharp pain in larynx. Vertigo - Vertigo with gastric and hemorrhoidal troubles. Periodical spells of faintness. COMMENTS - It has been proved twice, first by Burt and later by Dowla. The former took the tincture, the latter the powder. Both experienced headache, the former in connection with abdominal and rectal disturbance. The latter with flushing, sensation of heat, numbness, feeling of enlargement. The legs felt light, as if he could run like a deer. Nux-v. relieved the sensations, the symptoms passing off from above downwards. In Dr. Burt's case, the symptoms generally passed from above downwards. The greatest number of Dr. Burt's symptoms were experienced in the bowels and rectum, including pains in umbilicus and hypogastrium, constipation with hard light stools, great straining, faintness, stools of mucus and blood. These symptoms suggested the use of the remedy in cases of hemorrhoids, where it has proved most efficacious. Hemorrhoids during the menses. Prolapse of the rectum with hemorrhoids. It reduces complications when given before operations on rectal disease. It is, according to Hammond, “a stimulant, a most valuable tonic, a positive diuretic and mild laxative.” Hammond commended it in the palpitations of the menopause. Irritation of cardiac nerves, palpitation, faintness, oppression. F. S. Smith mentioned that it has adomes- tic reputation in rheumatism. He recorded a case (sub-acute) in a woodsman of 30. It began in the foot and ankle and traveled over nearly every joint in the body. A few drops of Coll, tincture was mixed in a tumbler of water and a teaspoonful given every two hours. Rapid cure resulted. Dewey mentioned that it cured a case in which there was severe constrictive pain about the heart in a man who habitually passed blood by stool, the heart symptoms coming on when the bleeding ceased and disappearing when it was re-established. Coll, cured both. Nash cured cases of the most obstinate constipation with Coll. In one there was severe colic, which had recurred for several years, the concomitant symptoms being great flatulence and hemorrhoidal troubles. He differentiated between Aesc. and Coll., in that Aesc. has a sense of fullness in the rectum, which Coll, does not. and Aesc. hemorrhoids do not bleed as a rule, while those of Coll, bleed persistently. Aesc. has pain, soreness and aching in the back. Coll, has more persistently constipation with colic on account of it. Aesc. may have constipation or may not. Coll, has shown marked power of disturbing the circulation and causing hemorrhages and also of disturbing cutaneous sensation. Symptoms are worse in the evening and night, better in the morning. Worse by slightest emotion or excitement. Inveterate cases of dyspepsia with a weight in epigastrium and hemorrhoids. Neuralgia and rheumatic pains were experienced by the provers in many parts: upper jaw, arms, hands, knees, joints. Sensitiveness about the heart, fullness, oppressed breathing, faintness. Heart disorders alternate with suppressed bleeding hemorrhoids. RELATIONS - Antidote: Nux-v. Compare: (1) Aesc.. Aloes, Ham., Lycopus, Negundo, Sulph., Nux-v. REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Constant heaviness in stomach. Cramplike pains in stomach with nausea. Sharp, cutting pains in stomach, every five minutes while sitting. Nausea with obstinate constipation, during pregnancy. V om- iting with pain and heat in stomach. Stools - Sluggish stool with distended abdomen. Chronic diarrhea of children. Diarrhea after delivery. Acrid diarrhea. Light colored stools, lumpy with hard straining, mucus or black stools. Dry feces.

Abdomen - Distended abdomen. Colic with flatulence and nausea. Heavy, digging ache in pelvis. Sharp, cutting pain in hypogastric region. Severe pain in lower part of abdomen. Congestion of portal system and of pelvic viscera. Flatulent rumbling in stomach and bowels.

Rectum - Sensation as if rectum is full of sharp sticks. Chronic hemorrhoids, alternating with heart, chest or rheumatic Collinsonia canadensis symptoms. Painful bleeding hemorrhoids. Vascular engorgement of rectum. Sense of constriction. Rectum, aches, burns. Rectum seems dry and full of sand, with cardiac pain. Most obstinate constipation with protruding hemorrhoids. Constipation during pregnancy with dysmenorrhea, following labor. Alternate constipation and diarrhea and great flatulence. Prolapsed anus. Itching of anus (Teucr., Rat.). Dysentery with tenesmus. Sensations - Constriction and feeling of enlargement in various parts and organs of the body, limbs, vulva, clitoris etc.

Male - Varicocele with rectal symptoms. Spermatorrhea kept up by hemorrhoids and constipation.

Female - Genitals considerably swollen and inflamed. Amenorrhea from pelvic congestion. Dysmenorrhea, swelling and dark redness of genitals, pain on sitting down. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Terrible dysmenorrhea, with hemorrhoids, diarrhea and loss of appetite. Cold feeling in thighs after menses. Sensation of swelling of labia and of clitoris. Lancinating pain in ovaries, worse right side. Prolapsed uterus, hemorrhoids during pregnancy. Leucorrhea with pruritus. Itching of vulva with hemorrhoids during pregnancy. Food - Loss of appetite. Excessive appetite with spasms of stomach and flatulence. Loss of appetite with dysmenorrhea.

Chest - Chest pains alternating with hemorrhoids. Fullness and oppression of chest.

Heart - Palpitations, rapid but weak. Dropsy after heart symptoms are relieved, hemorrhoids or menses return. Palpitations in patients subject to hemorrhoids and indigestion. Rapid pulse. Heart's action rapid, regular or irregular, slightest motion or excitement aggravates. Valvular heart disease, following a severe and prolonged attack of acute rheumatism.

Limbs - Sensation as if limbs were enlarged. Lower limbs seem not to belong to him. Tearing pain in arms, hands and legs. Cold feeling in thighs after menses. Tearingpain in both knees, extending down inside of legs to feet, while sitting.

Sleep - Disposition to sleep during day. Sleep disturbed by hypogastric pains.

Modalities - Better from heat. Better morning. Worse during hemorrhoids or from suppressed hemorrhoids. Worse from the slightest emotion. Worse excitement. Worse during pregnancy. Worse at night. Worse from cold.

Liver - Dull pain in liver region. Portal vein congestion. Lungs - Difficult breathing and faintness. Severe attacks of dyspnea with great weakness. Oppression, faintness and dyspnea (Acon-f.). Cough from excessive use of voice. Harassing, dry cough. Chest pains alternate with hemorrhoids. Spitting of blood after suppression of hemorrhoids. Dark, tough coagula, enveloped in viscid mucus. Hemorrhage from lungs.

Kidneys - Chronic nephritis and cystitis. Catarrh of bladder. Urine increased.

Temperature - Flushes of heat with oppressive breathing, with hemorrhoids.

HOMEOPATHIC - Having had a separate proving, Colocynthinum must be considered apart from Coloc., from which it is derived, although the symptoms of the two bear a close resemblance. Prominent neuralgic symptoms. Stitches and sensations of heat are found in many parts. Pulsation in the pit ofthe stomach, with prickling stitches on back in neighborhood of middle thoracic vertebrae. Diarrhea and colic, better bending forward. Congestion to male genital organs and pain in them. Burning pains in soles of the feet.

Modalities - Better by bending over, black coffee. Worse by motion, better by rest, herein appears the relationship of the glucoside to Bry., the botanical relative of Coloc. Worse evening. Worse riding in cars. REFERENCES Clarke.

name: Colocynthis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better coffee, smoking. Warmth ameliorates most pains. Better lying with head bent forward. Better lying on abdomen. Better bending double. Better rest, motion. Better hardpressure, warmth. Betterafterstoolorflatus. Worse from emotions, chagrin. Worse anger, vexation and indignation. Worse from lying on painless side. Worse before and after urination. Worse drafts, taking cold. Worse at 4 p.m. Worse lying in bed, evening and night. Worse eating, drinking..

Vaginal, pains.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Ciliary, neuralgia. Colic. Colitis. Coxalgia. Cramps. Delirium. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Dysmenorrhea. Gallbladder, colic. Glaucoma. Headaches. Hoarseness. Humiliation. Kidney, colic. Lead, poisoning. Menstrual, pains. Nausea. Neuralgias. Ovarian, cysts. Ovary, disorders. Pazn.s', severe. Phimosis. Peritonitis. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Toothaches. Tumor. Uterus, pains. Vaginal, pains. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Colocynth was used as a drastic purgative in allopathic practice. Coloc. should be compared to Bry. as they both have the same general features. Pain in muscles, nerves and joints, gastroenteric disturbance and the same condition in regard to rheumatic joints, worse by movement. Great irritability and ailments from mental emotion, though the latter feature is more marked in Coloc. Coloc. is useful in acute disorders of digestive tract and intestines. It develops most of its symptoms in the abdomen and head, causing intense neuralgias. Neuralgic pains are cutting, pinching, clamping, gnawing or boring. Neuralgic pains followed by numbness, better by pressure. Long-lasting action on large nerves, especially tri-facial, sciatic and spinal nerves. Agonizing pain in abdomen. Colic causing patient to bend double. Cries out from pains, wriggles for relief, or must bend him double. Sudden, atrocious, crampings, tearing pains which make the patient twist and turn. The patient will press something hard against the abdomen. Sensations of cutting, twisting, grinding, contracting and bruised pains. Pains as if clamped with iron bands. Pains are accompanied by nausea and diuresis and the patient vomits from intensity of pain. Faints with pain and with coldness. Rheumatic pain Colocynthis in the limbs is better by discharge of flatus. Cramps and twitching and shortening of muscles. Constrictions and contractions. Formication in affected part. Bladder cramps or spasms following operations on orifices (Hyper.). Urine odor of perspiration (Berb., Nit-ac.). Prostration, as if all his strength was failing. Especially suitable for irritable persons easily angered and ill effects there from. Women with painful, profuse menstruation and of sedentary habits. MIND-Angerwith indignation (Staph., Cham., Bry.,Nw-v.). Extremely irritable. Impatient. Anger, easily vexed during pain. Humiliation causedby offense. Ailments after anger, with silent grief. Children are worse when reprimanded (Cham.). Easily offended, aggravated when questioned (Bry.). Morose, becomes offended at everything. Greatly affected by the misfortunes of others. Want of religious feeling. Wants to be alone, even friends irritate. Offended at everything. Screams with pain, wants to walk about. Restlessness before menses. Restlessness, anguish, agony, suppressed rage. Depressed and joyless. Disposition to weep and cry. Complaining bitterly day and night. Walks about room in great agony from headache. Delirium alternating with sopor, with constant desire to escape, eyes half closed. Disinclined to talk, to answer. Becomes angry when questioned. Confusion from beer, wine.

Head - Head hot, red face, glistening eyes. Dullness of head and giddiness at beginning of colic. Lateral cutting pains with nausea, vomiting. Headache better coffee. Pains, better pressure and heat. Burning pains, digging, rending and tearing. Headache with nausea and vomiting. Headache with soreness of scalp. Roots of hair painful. Head pains worse stooping. Headache worse lying on back and moving eyelids. Heaviness in forehead with stupefaction. Pressure in both temples.

Eyes - Pain and twitching in eyelids. Burning eyelids. Severe burning, sticking and cutting pains. Pains sharp, boring, better from pressure. Violent pain in eyeballs which precede the development of glaucoma. Sensation as if eye would fall out on stooping. Gouty disorders of eyes. Smarting in eyes, with pain in eyeballs. Great itching in right eyeball, must rub. Discharge of acrid fluid. Bluish-white ring around cornea, in rheumatic form of iritis. Redness and lachrymation. Dimness of vision. Region around eye very sensitive to touch, during headache. Conjunctivitis, with tendency to ulceration.

Ears - Sounds re-echo in ears. Crawling, itching, stitching, aching, better by putting finger into ear. Roaring and throbbing, especially in left ear.

Nose - Throbbing, burrowing pains from left side of nose to glabella. Nose stopped up. Purulent nasal discharge. Fluent coryza, worse open air, better indoors. Sense of smell impaired during headache.

Face - Face distorted from pains. Cheeks cold. Tearing, shooting and swelling of face, left side great soreness, relieved by pressure (Chin.). Prosopalgia with eye symptoms. Neuralgia with chilliness. Pain anywhere is reflected on the face. Sensation as if left side of face were being torn from right side. Deathly color of face, during colicky pains in bowels. Face red and purple. Pimples on face.

Mouth - Persistent bitter taste. Teeth feel too long. Offensive smell from mouth from decayed teeth. Bitter taste of food and drink. Offensive ormetallic taste. Stinging in velum palati. Burning on the tip of the tongue. Tongue rough, as from sand. As if tongue had been scalded. Burning on anterior surface of tongue.

Throat - Cramps in gullet, with empty belch- ings and palpitation of the heart. Throat as if constricted, with empty eructations and palpitation of heart. Dryness, rawness, roughness or scraping in throat. Sensation of constriction of larynx, better open air. Frequent tickling and irritation in larynx induces cough at night.

Stomach - Burning pain in stomach. Violent cutting, tearingpains. Feeling in stomach as if something would not yield, drawing ,.ain. Cramps in stomach at night, bet- ter eructations. Sensation of fullness in epigastric region. Pain in stomach with toothache or headache. Sharp pains before menses, with extreme nausea and vomiting. Nausea, with greenish vomiting. Retching and bending body forward. Vomiting and diarrhea from anger, with indignation. Vomiting of food without nausea. Vomits from pain. Vomiting of bitter water.

Abdomen - Agonizing cutting pain causing patient to bend over double and pressing on the abdomen. Violent, cutting, gripping, grasping, clutching pains. Radiating, colicky pains. Cutting pain in abdomen after anger. Colic with cramps in calves. Cutting pains in bowels at navel. Colic pains, come in waves, better doubling up, hard pressure. Pains are worse least food or drink, except coffee and tobacco smoking. Colic from drinking while overheated. Pressure improves the pain in abdomen in acute stage but when pain remains for a long time, parts become tender and pressure aggravates the pain. Intestines feel squeezed between stones. Intestines feel as if bruised. Flatulent colic. Colic with cramps in calves. During colic, infant lies on abdomen and screams when he is slightly moved.

Rectum - Constipation, hard stools, as if passing stones. Diarrhea from pain, from anger, with indignation. Ineffectual urging to stool, followed by sudden stool. Burning pain in anus, after green, yellowish, slimy, watery discharges, streaked with pure blood. Slippery bubbles escape from anus. Pricking at anus, with constant discharge of mucus. Painful swollen hemorrhoids. Musty odor.

Stool - Chronic watery diarrhea, worse in the morning. Bloody diarrhea with violent pain in bowels. Jelly-like stools. Stools frothy, watery, shreddy, yellow. Dysenteric stool renewed each time by the least food or drink. Stools sour or gelatinous. Stools with flatulence and pain. Stools, sourish, with flatulence and pain.

Urine - Urine, gelatinous, sticky, stringy. Tough mucus sediment in urine which can be drawn out into strings. Urine milky white. Urine coagulates on standing. Red hard crystals adhering to the vessels. Urine like brown beer, becoming turbid as soon as cold, depositing copious sediment. Vertigo - Vertigo when quickly turning head. Vertigo when turning head to the left. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo with slight delirium and deafness. Vertigo from stimulants. COMMENTS - Guernsey wrote ‘ The strongest characteristic calling for the use of this remedy is an agonizing pain in the abdomen causing the patient to bend over double. Relief is obtained by motion, such as twisting, turning and wriggling around and the motion is kept up steadily while the pain lasts. The pain is worse by eating or drinking the least amount. This pain may occur alone or in the dysentery, cholera, etc. The doubling over the patient is the chief characteristic.” The patient bends double or presses something hard against the abdomen, leans over chairs, the table or bed- posts to get relief. The characteristic griping, forcing the patient to bend double, may be accompanied by cramps in other parts, with or without stool. If a stool occurs it gives immediate relief (Nux-v. the opposite), worse any attempt to eat or drink. Griping, cutting, tearing and spasmodic pains in the body, burning pains, pulsations through the body, sensation as of hard stones or potatoes in the body. Pains accompanied by stiffness and retarded motion of the affected parts, especially the hip joints. Pains affecting joints are worse from motion. Sciatica. Arthritis and gouty headaches with ophthalmia. Facial neuralgia with pains extending to eye. Neuralgic pains are better by rest. Cramps occur in the legs, uterus and ovaries. A sensation as if clamped with iron bands is very characteristic in coxalgia and dysmenorrhea. Dragging in uterus and vagina. Suppressed lochia from indignation. Diabetes with milky, gelatinous or colloid urine. Perspiration may smell like urine. Bitter taste in mouth, strong aversion to food. Worse raw fruits or something cold on a hot day (Bell-p., Ruta.). Worse tobacco, better coffee. Easily intoxicated by any stimulants. Diarrhea from grief, indignation, or chagrin. Severe, painful dysentery. As if hard stones are rubbing the intestines, or hot knifes stabbing the intestines. Vomiting yellow, bitter fluid. Tension of the bowels as they are forced inward right below the navel, forcing the person to bend double. Babies with colic may have severe pain radiating from the umbilicus. According to Nash, Mag-p. comes nearest to it in colic and neuralgic disorders. Cham, is also very close, both having colic from disturbing emotions, but the Cham, child does not double up, they toss about. The Staph, patient is likely to have black or decayed teeth and sore eyelids and there is a chronic tendency to colic. Verat. has colic better bending double, but it has also cold sweat. Dioscorea has wind colic, but is better by stretching out. The Stann. child wants to be carried with the abdomen on the mother's shoulder. Chilly, sensitive to cold and damp, cold winds. Better heat. Affections of the left side generally. 4 p.m. aggravation (Lyc., Hell., Caust.). One prover experienced that “at 4 p.m. the colic came on, six days in succession.” RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Camph., Caust., Cham., Coff., Op., Staph. Large doses are counteracted by tepid milk, infusion of galls, Camph., and Op.Itantidotes: Caust., Magnes. Also Coloc. is the best antidote to lead poisoning. (Royal). Compare: (1) Lobelia erinus - violent cork-screw-like pains in abdomen. (2) Dipodium punctatum - writhing, twisting like a dying snake. Intractable insomnia. (3) Dios., Cham., Cocc., Merc, Plum., Mag-p. (4) Merc. - dysentery with much tenesmus). (5) Bry. -nearest analog. (6) Elat.,Cucúrbita pepo. (7) Dios. - griping, tearing, cutting, spasmodic pains in body, but better stretching body and motion. (8) Caust. - joint rheumatism, follows Coloc. in colic. (9) Canth., Cham., Chel., Chin, (beer intoxicates easily), Cocc., Gamb., Lyc., Merc., Nux-v. ( 10) Plb. - inclination to assume strange attitudes in bed. (11) Staph. - anger with vexation, abdominal pains, neuralgia—they follow one another well. (12) From emotions. Cham., Bty., Gels., Ph-ac. Ign. Compatible: Staph., Cham., Caust. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Sensation as if everything were flowing towards genitals from both sides of the abdomen, causing seminal emission. Pain and swelling of testicles and spermatic cord. Retraction of testicles and priapism, with retention of urine. Paraphimosis. Retraction of prepuce behind glans during sleep. Strong sexual desire with erections. Impotency.

Female - Amenorrhea and chronic diarrhea. Suppression of menses or lochia from indignation. Menses copious in women with sedentary habits. Menses increased and too frequent. Dysmenorrhea, worse eating and drinking. Bearing-down cramps, causing her to bend double (Sep.). Metritis from indignation. Boring pain in ovary. Must bend over double with great pain and restlessness. Uterus prolapsed. Clutching pain in ovarian region. Ovarian tumors, cysts. Ovaritis. Round, small cystic tumors in ovaries or broad ligaments. Ovarian cysts with pain better flexing thigh on pelvis. Wants abdomen supported by pressure. Puerperal fever brought on by indignation or grief because of unkind treatment. Swelling of labia with dragging pain and heat in vagina. Yellow, thick, offensive leucorrhea between menses. Food - Appetite variable, mostly poor. Canine hunger. Food and drink taste bitter. Aversion to food. Coffee helps the colic, headache. Desires forbread and beer. Potatoes and starchy food disagree. Potatoes causes bellyache. Confusion from beer, after wine. Constipation from cheese. Very thirsty. Drinks much, without thirst.

Chest - Oppression of chest. Pain in intercostal muscles. Stitching, in right or left side of chest. Swelling and suppuration of axillary glands. Constitutions - Suited to easily angered, irritable persons with tendency to corpulence. For women of sedentary habits with copious menstruation. To blondes, persons of choleric temperament and those liable to cramps and colic from fruit, lead poisoning or excessive venery.

Heart - Strong throbbing in all blood vessels. Heart feels pushed up by a distended stomach. Stitches in cardiac region. Pulse generally hard, full, accelerated. Pulse small and weak.

Back - Pain under right scapula, better pressure. Lumbar ache, better pressure. Bruised pain in lumbar region. As of a heavy weight in lumbar-dorsal region, better lying on left side. Cramp like pains in the hips, better lying on the affected side. Neck stiff, worse moving head. Muscles of nape as if stiff when moving head.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains in limbs ánd joints, after catching cold. Contraction of muscles. Cramps in muscles during sex. All the limbs are drawn together. Stiffness of joints and shortening of tendons. Cramp-like pain in hip, lies on affected side, pain from hip to knee. Heaviness of limbs during headache. Spontaneous luxation of the hip joints. Sciatic pain, left side, drawing, tearing. Sciatic pain, better pressure and heat, worse gentle touch. Pain in right deltoid. Pain down right thigh, muscles and tendons feel too short, numbness with pains (Gnaph.). Icy coldness of hands and feet. Cold hands with warm feet. Knees feel stiff, cold. Pain in left knee joint. Feet cold with colic.

Sleep - Sleepless and restless, with pains after anger. Y awning and sleepiness. Sleeps badly, often wakes tired and irritable. Dreams disturb sleep. Vivid, anxious, voluptuous dreams.

Skin - Itching, prickling, crawling, formication. Desquamation over whole body. Dryness and heat of skin. Smarting, itching, followed by perspiration. Itching, burning ulcers. Carbuncles, with continuous burning pain. Boils on neck and face. Corns. Herpes on face. Itch-like eruptions.

Modalities - Better coffee, smoking. Warmth ameliorates most pains. Better lying with head bent forward. Better lying on abdomen. Better bending double. Better rest, motion. Better hardpressure, warmth. Betterafterstoolorflatus. Worse from emotions, chagrin. Worse anger, vexation and indignation. Worse from lying on painless side. Worse before and after urination. Worse drafts, taking cold. Worse at 4 p.m. Worse lying in bed, evening and night. Worse eating, drinking.

Teeth - Teeth feel too long. As if nerves were compressed or stretched. Neuralgic pains, on one side, recurring daily. Drawing pain. Throbbing, first in one, then in another tooth.

Liver - Gallbladder, colic. Lungs - Short cough when smoking tobacco. Difficulty breathing during menses, ovarian tumor. Asthmatic attacks at night with slow, difficult breathing, which provokes cough. Anxious and oppressed, sensation as if about to smother. Tickling cough frequently during night. Dry cough from tickling in throat.

Kidneys - Kidney colic with diuresis. Fetid, small quantities of urine with frequent urging. Diabetes.

Bladder - Tenesmus of bladder. Bladder catarrh, discharge like fresh white of egg, viscid (Ph-ac.). Pains on urinating over whole abdomen. Burning along urethra during stools. Itching at orifice. Bladder spasms after operation on the orifices. Sudden violent pressure upon bladder, which was full, passed off suddenly on emission of flatus. Retention of urine. Breasts - Painful nodes in breasts. Sharp pains. Causations - Ill effects of anger indignation, chagrin, grief, catching cold, or excessive venery.

Perspiration - Sweats at night. Cold sweat. Sweat smelling like urine. Sweat causes itching of skin. Sweats mainly on head and limbs. Profuse, warm sweat on forehead and neck.

Temperature - Coldness of hands and soles, rest of the body warm. Chill and shivering with pains. Cold sweat at night, smelling like urine. Feeling of coldness in whole body. Internal chill with external heat. Chill proceeding from abdomen. Chill during headache. Chill with inclination to perspire. Partial coldness and partial heat of skin. Bilious fever with cardialgía, spasmodic colic, diarrheic stool.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Colostrum are purely clinical. Its use in diarrhea was probably suggested by the purgative effect of Colos. on the infant. Colicky pains in hypogastrium. Green, watery, yellow, watery, mucus, bilious stools. Profuse, sour-smelling, excoriating stools. Great nervous irritability or listlessness. Fever. Pale face. Tongue coated white or yellow. Vomiting of sourorbittersubstances. Loss of appetite. Emaciation. The whole body smells sour.

Face - Pale face. Food - Loss of appetite.

Mouth - Tongue coated white or yellow.

Stomach - Nausea. Vomiting of sour or bitter substances. Stools - Green, watery stools. Yellow stools. Watery stools. Mucus stools. Bilious stools. Profuse stools. Sour-smelling stools. Excoriating stools. REFERENCES-Clarke.

Abdomen - Colicky pains in the hypogastrium during stool.

Rectum - Aggravation of the diarrhea in nursing infants. Diarrhea during dentition.

Modalities - Worse in nursing infants during dentition. Worse during stool.

Perspiration - The whole body smells sour.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air. Better motion, scratching. Better pressure. Worse from touch. Worse warmth. Worse rest. Worse at night (Rhus-t.). full:
PHARMACY - com. Comocladia dentata. Guao. N. O. Anacardiacae. Cuba. Tincture of leaves and bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Antrum of Highmore, disorders. Breasts, disorders. Ciliary, neuralgia. Ears, disorders. Eczema. Erysipelas. Eyes, disorders. Glaucoma. Herpes, zoster. Leprosy. Neuralgia. Skin, malignant inflammations. Toothaches. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Comocladia shows its affinity with the Rhus family by the virulence of its effects on the skin, the slightest contact, and at times even walking in the neighborhood of the growing tree, being sufficient to cause violent inflammation. Both are irritant poisons. The trunk and branches of the tree contain a milky fluid, turning black on exposure to sunlight, discoloring the skin, linen, etc. Compare with Anacardium. The plant causes tormenting itching, swelling, redness, vesication, ulceration. Important eye and skin symptoms. Malignant skin inflammation with enormous swelling or edema of left leg and foot. Deep ulcers with hard edges. Skin red all over. Recurrent eczema. Leprosy. Throbbing pains, worse by heat. Sacroiliac and abdominal pain. Wandering rheumatic pains. Pain in joints and ankles. Burning, itching of the eyes, which feel too large. Right eye very painful, feels large, protruded than left. Ciliary neuralgia. Burning itching of the nose with violent sneezing. Affections of antrum. Pain under the left breast or nipple extending to left scapula, when coughing.

Eyes - Glaucoma, sense of fullness, eyeball feels too large. Ciliary neuralgia with eyes feeling large and protruded, worse right eye. Eyes are worse near warm stove, feels as if pressed outward. Sees only glimmer of light with left eye. Motion of the eyes aggravates.

Ears - Heat and fullness in right ear. Left ear cracked and desquamating a substance like powered starch.

Face - Swollen, with projecting eyes.

Mouth - Mouth dry. Tongue coated dirty yellow. Sensation as if a tooth were being drawn out of its socket. Pain in teeth better by pressure. When toothache stops, head feels large. Gums of lower jaw inflamed.

Abdomen - Severe flatulent pain in abdomen preceding and during a diarrhea stool, followed by a feeling of weakness and perspiration on face and neck.

Male - Intense itching on lower part of penis, also on inner side of prepuce. Continued tingling, itching of scrotum during night.

Chest - Pain from right side of chest down arm to fingers. Cough with pain under left breast, going through to left scapula.

Back - On moving head, sense of fullness, rigidity and lameness of muscles of neck. Rheumatic pains and stitches in back, stitches leave a burning. Breasts - Sharp pain in left breast, about one inch above nipple, leaves a burning sensation. Sloughing ulcer on right breast.

Limbs - Sharp pains through right shoulder to scapula. Painful burning on arms. Crampy sensation in muscles of right upper arm. Drawing, cramping in fingers. Vesicular eruption on arms and hands. Herpes on legs. Lungs - Spasmodic, dry cough at night. Soreness in left lung. Cannot draw a long breath on account of sharp pain at center of thorax on left side.

Sleep - Dreamy, refreshing sleep with pleasant dreams, almost clairvoyant. COMMENTS - Peculiar eye symptoms, including a pain in the right eye, the sensation as if it were larger and more protruded than the left. Throbbing pains as if the eyeballs are bulging or would burst. Glaucoma (Jab. ). Ciliary neuralgia, eye pains. Eye symptoms are worse warm rooms, heat, even that of the sun. Cough with pain under the left breast going through to the left scapula. Sacroiliac pain (Aesc.). Hale quoted from Navarro about cures of ulcers “Sloughing ulcer of right breast. An indolent ulcer, in the lower third of right leg, deep, discharging bloody fetid pus. Inflammation of left leg and foot with enormous swelling and fever.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rhus-t., Anae., Euphor. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Skin - Itches, red and pimples. Redness all over like a scarlatina. Red stripes on skin (Euph.). Erysipelas. Pustular eczema of the trunk and limbs. Deep ulcers with hard edges. Leprosy.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better motion, scratching. Better pressure. Worse from touch. Worse warmth. Worse rest. Worse at night (Rhus-t.). Rheumatic pains are better by motion and worse by rest (Rhus- t.). Heat aggravates and open air ameliorates most of the symptoms (opposite Rhus-t.).

full:
PHARMACY - conch. Conchiolinum. Mother of pearl. Mater perlarum. Triturations. ZZistori- cal dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bone, disorders. Fever. Lung, disorders. Osteitis. Pyemia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Conch, has a wide range of action in disorders of bones, especially when the growing ends are affected. Calc-p. and Calc, are its nearest analogs. Observations made on workers in mother- of-pearl factories showed that inhalation of the dust produces catarrh of the respiratory organs and, later on inflammation of the ends of bones. This begins in the diaphyses, but may spread to the epiphyses. It attacks young subjects. First there is a more or less intense pain in the bone, comes suddenly, at first continuous, later intermittent. Soon after the appearance of the pain there is fever, thirst, loss of appetite, sleeplessness, dark-colored urine with sediment. Then swelling occurs, developing on one or the other end of a diaphysis, never in the middle of it nor in the epiphysis. The swell- ing has a clear, sharp margin. Swelling is very painful to the slightest touch, at first soft, elastic and slightly fluctuating. It may become as hard as a bone. Suppuration may occur. The bones that have been affected are lower jaw, scapula, humerus, radius, ulna, tibia, fibula, tarsal and metatarsal bones. COMMENTS - Clarke cured with Conch. 3c a delicate boy who at three different times had had pain in his left knee. The left inner condyle was swollen and tender. The cure was rapid and the general health much improved at the same time. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Conium Maculatum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better while fasting. Better from letting limbs hang down. Better walking bent. Better sitting down. Better stooping. Better walking. Better motion. Better pressure. Better sun. Better dark. Worse from seeing moving objects. W orse sexual abuse or excess. Worse from celibacy. Worse before and during menses. Worse old age. Worse alcohol. Worse pressure of tight clothing. Worse raising arms. Worse standing. Worse lying down with head low. Worse turning in bed. Worse jar. Worse after exertion. Worse bodily or mental injury. Worse at night. Worse cold, taking cold. Worse snowy air. Worse spring. Worse dry, hot air..
