full:
PHARMACY - con. Conium maculatura. Poison hemlock. N. O. Umbelliferae. Coniinum. Tincture of fresh plant in flower. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abstinence. Asthma. Arteriosclerosis. Belching. Bladder, disorders. Breast, cancer. Bronchitis. Bruises. Debility. Cancer. Cataract. Cervicitis. Chorea. Coughs. Cysts. Depression. Diphtheria, paralysis. Dysmenorrhea. Emaciation. Etysipelas. Eye, disorders. Galactorrhea. Heartburn. Herpes. Hypochondriasis. Indurations. Infertility. Injuries. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Melancholia. Menstruation, disorders. Multiple, sclerosis. Muscular, weakness.Nerve,disorders. Neuritis. Numbness. Ovaries, disorders. Paralysis. Peritonitis. Photophobia. Pregnancy, disorders. Prostate, cancer. Ptosis. Scrofula. Spermatorrhea. Stomach, disorders. Testicle, disorders. Tetters. Trembling. Trismus. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Ulcers. Uterine, cancer. Vertigo. Vision, disorders. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - An ancient remedy, rendered classical by Plato's graphic description of this poison given to the Greek philosopher Socrates to cause his death. The ascending paralysis it produces, ending in respiration failure, shows the ultimate tendency of many symptoms produced in the provings. Con. has difficult gait, trembling, sudden loss of strength while walking, painful stiffness of legs, urinary troubles, weakened memory, sexual debility, etc. Affects the nerves and muscles, causing incoordination and paralysis, uncertain gait, difficult speech. Patient becomes gradually weak. Irregular, action, and development of symptoms. Progressive debility. Great debility in the morning in bed. General feeling as if bruised by blows. Weakness of body and mind. Trembling of all the limbs, with palpitations. Suddenly sick and weak with numbness. Paroxysms of hysteria and hypochondriasis from sexual abstinence or sexual excess. Hysterical convulsions. Faints at stool. Glands, especially breasts and ovaries, are affected with engorgement and stony indurations. Alters glandular structure to scrofulous and cancerous conditions. Sensation as of a lump in brain, in epigastrium. Tearing, stabbing pains. New growths. Cancerous diathesis. Ascending symptoms, paralysis after diphtheria. Arteriosclerosis. Decay of sternum. Insomnia of multiple neuritis. Easily intoxicated (Zinc.). Sensation as of a hoop or band or something tight around the part. Desire for warmth, especially that of sun. Great liability to take cold. Night and morning sweat with offensive odor and smarting in skin or offensive odor without sweat. Often found in old age, a time of debility, weakness, languor, local congestions and sluggishness. Useful in old age or for those persons who become old early. Troubles at the change of life, old maids, bachelors. For youths who suffer from ill effects of masturbation. Tumor growth invites it. Tonic after influenza. MIND - Slow, impaired comprehension. Difficulty in understanding what is read. Difficulty concentrating. Cannot think after using eyes. Poor memory, symptoms similar to Alzheimer's disease. Benumbed sensation. Inability to sustain mental effort, tired sensation in brain, imbecility. Senility, weakness. Timid. Indifferent. Depression. Grief, especially from loss of personal property (Aur.). Grief after death of a loved one, after a prolonged illness. Consolation aggravates (Nat-m.). Sad, dissatisfied with herself and surroundings. As if great guilt weighed upon him. Excitement causes mental depression. Feel as if they were to cry and swallow and choke as from a lump in the throat. Tired of life. Discouraged. Broken down feeling. Trifles seem important. Cares very little for things. No inclination for business or study. Makes useless purchases, wastes or ruins them. Sensation of unreality, as if in a dream. Insanity, periodical or alternating. Superstitious. Worse when idle. Averse to society, yet fears being alone, especially during menses. Ill effects of repressed sexual desire. While walking on the road wants to grab and abuse somebody. Likes to wear his best clothes. Thinks that animals are jumping on his bed.

Head - Stupefying headache, with nausea and vomiting of mucus with a feeling as of foreign body under the skull. Temples compressed, worse after meals. Sensation as of a lump in right half of brain. Sick headaches with inability to urinate. Pain in head from sinciput to occiput, better stooping and moving the head. Bruised, semi-lateral pains. Dull occipital pain on rising in morning. Sensation of fullness, bursting in brain during headache. One side numb and cold. Hot spots on head.

Eyes - Paralysis of ocular muscles (Caust.). Feel crossed. Lids, heavy, droop worse outside. Ptosis of eyelids. Conjunctivitis and keratitis. Photophobia and excessive lachrymation without inflammation or from slightest abrasion or ulceration of the eye. Burning in eyes. Sweats on closing eyes. Corneal pustules. Cataract after eye injury. Diplopia. Myopia. Dim-sighted, worse artificial light. Vision colored, red. As if fringe falling over eyes. Black spots before eyes with vertigo. Vision becomes more blurred when vexed.

Ears - Accumulation of ear wax like paper pulp or blood. Red, hard wax, causing hardness of hearing. Ears feel stopped on blowing nose. Oversensitive to noise. Parotid gland swollen and hard.

Nose - Polyps. Bleeds easily, becomes sore. Picks nose constantly. Frequent sneezing. Obstinate obstruction of nose. Acute smell.

Face - Moist and spreading herpes on face. Cancer of the lip from pressure of pipe. Sub-maxillary glands are swollen and hard.

Mouth - Toothache, worse cold food, but not cold drinks. Tongue cancer. Sour saliva. Soreness about the root of tongue. Distortion of tongue and mouth. Speech difficult from paralysis of tongue.

Throat - As if a round body were ascending from stomach (globus). Food goes down the wrong way and stops. Paresis of esophagus. Constant inclination to swallow as from a lump in the throat worse walking in open air. Tonsils enlarged. Vertigo - Vertigo, when lying down and when turning over in bed, when turning headsidewise or turning eyes, worse shaking head, slight noise or conversation of others, especially towards the left. COMMENTS - Hahnemann noted that it is exceedingly difficult to distinguish between the primary and secondary effects of Con. He thought that the primary action is one of “rigidity, condensation and constriction of the tissues with swelling of the glands and diminution of the senses.” Teste concurred, adding that the action is primarily inflammatory and that this accounts for its suitability for “persons of a lively, quick, sanguine disposition with a marked development of the glandular system.” It is characteristically adapted to painful glandular affections, “principally such as result from a strain or blow, but the precise cause of which may have escaped our recollection.” Teste placed Con. at the head of the analogs of Aeon. Con. is to the glands and capillary system what Aeon, is to the heart and arterial system. In many cases Con. may be regarded as the “Aconite of chronic diseases.” The other Aeon, analogs, according to him, are Cham., Seneg., Canth. and Ph-ac. Scirrhus tumors, ulcerating and otherwise. Chronic or sub-acute inflammation with bloody engorgement of the parenchyma, induration, and even subsequent ulceration of the tissues. Induration and inflammations of the breast and nipples. Useful for treating indurated, precancerous tissues. Breast cancer with a history of trauma to the breast. Hard lumps in breast, induration, can be painless. Breast can shrivel, atrophy (lod.). Effects of hurts to the breast by falls or blows. Pains in breast before menses, worse by every step. Scanty menses, especially in old maids. Checked lochia. Indurated cervix, cervical cancer. Prostate and testicular cancer. Sexual conditions including hypertrophy or atrophy of glands, excess of function or abrogation. Unsatisfied sexual desire, ailments from suppressed sex drive. Hysteria and hypochondriasis from abstinence from sexual intercourse. Pronounced constipation or diarrhea. Weakness, tremulousness and palpitation after every evacuation. Faintness after stool. Burning or coldness in the rectum. Flatulent tendency (Ammc., Asaf.). Pancreatic cancer (Calc-ar., Phos.). Photophobia, ptosis. Red vision. Sweat on closing the eyes. Eye symptoms are worse night and early morning. Accumulation of earwax. Hot spots on the head. Erysipelas, pain piercing to brain. Numbness and deadness of limbs. Stabbing pains. Weak-spells, faintness, sudden loss of strength while walking. Ascending paralysis. Multiple sclerosis. Vertigo, particularly in the elderly, worse on turning in bed or sudden turns from side to side. Symptoms worse when idle. Grimmer noted its usefulness in breast cancer after bruises orinjuries. Sterck used Con. and made some notable cures of scirrhus tumors, ulcerating and otherwise. A. H. Birdsall reported a case of contusion of the testicle. He found the patient writhing in agony, the pain complained of being “sharp, cutting, running up spermatic cord to lower part of back and also through scrotum to root of penis.” Con. 200c relieved in five minutes and at the end of twenty minutes the pain was gone. Clarke used the remedy with success in many cases of weakness from masturbation in men and youths. “Emission on the slightest stimulus, such as merely being in the society of a woman.” Goodno cured a girl of 25 of severe dysmenorrhea with scanty, almost arrested flow, which had existed since the periods commenced. She also had nosebleed, cough and stitches through the left lung at times. Two years previously, after unusual excitement. she had bearing-down pains, prolapse and ante-version. The dysmenorrhea pains were relieved by Sepia and other remedies, but the prolapse increased with bearing- down as though the womb would be forced from the vulva, worse standing and walking, before and during menses. Intermittent flow of urine. Cutting pain after urination. Obstinate constipation of long standing. Stool (once in seven days) large, hard, followed by tremulous weakness, she must lie down. Dull pain below left breast. Prompt relief and speedy cure were effected by Con. 1,000c. Proell mentioned excellent results with Con. 10c in strangury and ischuria, when the urine cannot be discharged from nervousness or swelling of the prostate (Nat-s. 5c trituration was effective where the bladder could not be entirely emptied.). Sircar recorded a striking case of a patient who had severe diarrhea, for which he was about to give Sulph., when he asked if the stools were hot. “On the contrary, they are cold,” replied the patient. Sircar found “cold flatulence” under Con. and gave it on analogy with brilliant effect. Guernsey wrote “This remedy is characterized by a great dizziness, brought on when lying down and moving the head ever so slightly or even the eyes—all the contents of the room appear to whirl around, patient wishes to keep the head perfectly still. In urinating the water flows at first in a full stream, then stops, flows again, again stops.” Nash thought “turning the head sideways” is the most characteristic form of the modality “worse by moving the head.” Some give it is as “lying down in bed and turning over,” but he regards the “lying down” as the least important part. Nash cured a patient who had all the symptoms of locomotor ataxia and who could not, when walking, turn the head the least bit sideways without staggering or falling. A case of lumbago was cured with Con. in six days after seven months' suffering. Symptoms include an inability to turn over in bed without being dizzy, worse ascending, by exercise. Feeling of ball pressing into back over left hip. Pain shooting down left leg, ending in a spot that felt as though pricked by a bunch of hot needles. Yellow nails. Nash mentioned the characteristic “Sweats day or night, as soon as one sleeps or even on closing the eyes.” This enabled Lippe to cure a man of 80 of hemiplegia. R. C. Markham cured with Con. 1,000c. an obstinate cough, dry, hard, frequent with Conium maculatum asthmatic wheezing or fine rattling in chest on deep breathing, worse slightest exposure to cold air, getting into cold bed or out of a warm one or even putting arms out was sufficient to bring on severe coughing. The guiding symptom which appeared last and led to the remedy was a pain in the apex of the left lung with soreness in a small spot midway between neck and shoulder just back of the clavicle. The pain, cutting and stitch-like, ran downward and inward toward the sternum. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bar-c., Hydr., lod., Kali-p., Hyos., Cur. (2) Scirr. a cancer nosode - cancerous diathesis, enlarged glands, cancer of breast, worms. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Phatak.

Stomach - Attacks of sick feeling. Painful spasms of the stomach. Distention of stomach after taking milk. Better from eating, aggravation a few hours after meals. Acrid heartburn and acid belchings, worse on going to bed. Acidity and burning, painful spot the level of the sternum. Cancerous ulcers. Terrible nausea. Vomiting of coffee grounds, chocolate colored lumps or clear sour water. Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy. Heartburn in pregnant women where an excessive heartburn comes on, when going to bed at night.

Abdomen - Abdomen hard and distended. Distention, worse after taking milk. Cutting pain before passitig flatus. Trembling of whole abdomen. Tremulous weakness, palpitation of heart after every stool. Hypogastric pain goes down legs. Sensitive, bruised, swollen, knife-like pains. Painful tightness.

Rectum - Ineffective urging to stool. Involuntary stools while sleeping. Constipation on alternate days. Burning or coldness in rectum during stool. Cold flatus, stool. Tremulous weakness after every stool (Verat., Ars., Arg-n.). Sensations - Sensation as if a hoop, band or something tight was around the parts. Deficiency of irritability of the body, the body has very little sensation. Darting from within outwards, tension in inner parts, also in outer parts, pricking in the bones.

Male - Ill effects of suppressed sexual desires. Desire increased, power decreased. Sexual desire without erection. Sexual nervousness with feeble erection. Erections imperfect and of too short duration. Impotence. Seminal discharge, provoked by mere presence of a woman or contact. Cutting in urethra while semen passes. Sexual nervousness, dejection after sex. Prostatitis. Dribbling of prostatic fluid, worse stools, emotions, etc. Prostate cancer. Testicles hard and enlarged. Itching in prepuce.

Female - Menses, irregular, too late, scanty. Dysmenorrhea with drawing down thighs. Rash before menses. Small, red, burning pimples appear with scanty menses and disappear after menses. Itching around pudenda or deep in vagina. Leucorrhea, white, acrid, preceded by griping in abdomen after urination. Cervicitis, Induration ofos and cervix. Ovaritis. Ovary enlarged, indurated. Cutting pain in ovaries and uterus. Prolapse of uterus from straining at a hard stool. Ill effects of repressed sexual desire or suppressed menses or from excessive indulgence. Motion of child painful during pregnancy. Food - Craving for salt, coffee and sour things. Aversion to bread. Amelioration from eating and aggravation a few hours after meals.

Chest - Sharp pain from sternum to spine. Decay of the sternum. Tightness of chest better by coughing. The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders. Constitutions - Corresponds to elderly persons, old, feeble men, old maids and bachelors. Persons of strong, sedentary habit more than to lively. Persons who are easily intoxicated with stimulants (Zinc.). Slender persons and children. Scrofulous constitutions, cancers and glandular enlargements. Cancerous diathesis.

Heart - Palpitations, worse exertion, drinking, at stools, etc. Pulse unequal, irregular.

Back - Spinal injuries. Ill effects of bruises and shocks to spine. Coccyodynia. Dull aching in lumbar and sacral region. Pain between shoulders. Drawing pain in the lumbar vertebrae worse standing. Coccyx pain. Neck cold. Enlargement of neck. Pediculated tumor at the center of back. Small, flat wart like growths on buttocks. Breasts - Breasts enlarge and become painful before and during menses (Calc., Lac-c.), worse at every step. Wants to press breast hard with hand. Breast cancer with hard tumor. Tumors after injury. Breasts lax and shrunken with or without sexual desire. Hard tumors in breasts with stitches or piercing pain. Stitches in breasts and in nipples, on taking deep breath or walking. Too much milk before menses. Causations - The effects of blows, contusions or falls. Effects of bruises and shocks to spine. Over straining, over work, over study. Grief. Sexual excess, sexual abstinence.

Limbs - Shoulders feel bruised, clothes lie like a weight on them. Axillary glands enlarged. Axillary glands pain with numb feeling down arm. Hands, weary, heavy, trembling, unsteady. Perspiration of hands. Nails yellow. Fingers and toes numb. Heels, as if bone would push through them. Shooting in heels. Putting feet on chair relieves pain. Cracking in knee joint. Muscularweakness, especially of lower limbs. Can walk straight and steadily with eyes closed, but staggers, becomes giddy, is nauseated when walking with open eyes.

Sleep - Sweat as soon as one sleeps, even when closing eyes. Drowsiness by day. Sleeps after midnight. Inclination to sleep in the evening, with falling down of the eyelids. Disturbed and unrefreshing sleep. Starting of the limbs during sleep. Anxious and frightful dreams, of disease, mutilation, death, danger, and quarrels. Nightmares.

Skin - Greenish, like an old bruise. Yellow skin with papular eruption, yellow fingernails. Red spots turning yellow or green. Glands enlarged and indurated, also mesenteric. Flying stitches through the glands. Tumors, piercing pains, worse at night. Induration after contusions. Foul, eczematous eruptions. Chronic ulcers with fetid discharge. Gangrenous ulcers. Urticaria from violent bodily exertion. Anesthesia or inactivity of the skin. Night and morning sweat with offensive odor and smarting in skin.

Modalities - Better while fasting. Better from letting limbs hang down. Better walking bent. Better sitting down. Better stooping. Better walking. Better motion. Better pressure. Better sun. Better dark. Worse from seeing moving objects. W orse sexual abuse or excess. Worse from celibacy. Worse before and during menses. Worse old age. Worse alcohol. Worse pressure of tight clothing. Worse raising arms. Worse standing. Worse lying down with head low. Worse turning in bed. Worse jar. Worse after exertion. Worse bodily or mental injury. Worse at night. Worse cold, taking cold. Worse snowy air. Worse spring. Worse dry, hot air.

Liver - Severe aching in and around the liver. Chronic jaundice and pain in ripht hypochondrium. Lungs - Shortness of breath on taking the least exercise, oppressed breathing, constriction of chest, pains in chest. Constant tormenting cough from dry spot in the larynx or tickling in chest and throat pit, worse when lying down, laughing, talking and during pregnancy, has to sit up. Cough seems to come from abdomen. Cough on taking deep breath. Loose coughs without expectoration, has to swallow what he coughs up.

Kidneys - Difficulty in passing urine in the beginning even when standing, then it flows freely. Interrupted urination, urine stops and starts, better standing. Dribbling in old men (Cop.). Urine feels very hot. Interrupted discharge (Clem.). Cutting and burning after urination.

Temperature - Coldness of nape, of calf, etc. Hot flushes or sweat, on dropping to sleep or when closing the eyes. Sweat, under the eyes, on chin, cold on nape and palms offensive causing smarting of skin.

name: Convallaria Majalis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air. Worse from lying on back. Worse in warm room (All-c.)..
constitution: Anasarca. Angina pectoris. Aneurysm. Diarrhea.Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Morning, sickness. Orthopnea. Pruritus, vulvae. Tobacco, heart. Venous, stasis. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - conv. Convallaria majalis. Lily of the Valley. N. O. Liliaceae. Convallariaceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anasarca. Angina pectoris. Aneurysm. Diarrhea.Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Morning, sickness. Orthopnea.…
full:
PHARMACY - conv. Convallaria majalis. Lily of the Valley. N. O. Liliaceae. Convallariaceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anasarca. Angina pectoris. Aneurysm. Diarrhea.Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Heart, disorders. Herpes. Morning, sickness. Orthopnea. Pruritus, vulvae. Tobacco, heart. Venous, stasis. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Convallaria is a popular remedy in Russia for heart disorders and it has been introduced into old- school medicine principally as a heart remedy. It compares closely in its action with Lil-t. Conv. also resembles its other botanical relatives, Aloe., All-c. and All-s. It is strongly purgative and causes morning vomiting. The symptoms from its proving show that its nearest analog is Lilium tigrinum.

HOMEOPATHIC - Increases energy of heart's action, renders it more regular. It is of use when the ventricles are over distended and dilatation begins, and when there is an absence of compensatory hypertrophy and venous stasis is marked. Dyspnea, dropsy, aneurysm tendency. Anasarca. Sensation as if heart ceased beating, then starting very suddenly. Tobacco heart. Soreness of uterine region with palpitation of heart. Movement in abdomen as from a fist of a child. MIND - Dull intellect, can hardly think. Mind wanders from subject when reading. Irritable, when asked a question. Depression. Grieves easily. Hysterical manifestations.

Head - Dull headache, worse ascending, hawking. Scalp sensitive.

Face - Hydroa in nose and lips, raw and sore. Nosebleed. Sees imaginary gray spot about three inches square.

Mouth - Grating of teeth in the morning. Coppery taste. Tongue feels sore and scalded, broad and thick with heavy, dirty coating.

Throat - Raw feeling in back of throat when inspiring. COMMENTS - Nash used it in the 30c with very satisfactory results in women complaining of great soreness in uterine region with sympathetic palpitation of the heart. He also removed cardiac dropsy when this uterine soreness was present. Berridge credited it with this symptom: “Movement in the abdomen as from the fist of a child,” like Sulph., Thuj., and Croc. In the caseofConv., the symptom occurs when lying on the back. Sleepiness accompanies many symptoms. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dig., Crat., Lil-t. (2) Adonis - feeble heart action due only to functional disturbance. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Abdomen - Sensitive. Colicky pains. Gurgling and pain on taking deep breath. Clothes feel too tight. Movement in abdomen like fist of a child.

Female - Great soreness in uterine region with sympathetic palpitations of heart. Pain in sacro-iliac joints, running down leg. Itching of urinary meatus and vaginal orifice.

Heart - Heart disorders. Extremely rapid and irregularpulse. Feeling as if heartbeat throughout the chest. Sensation as if heart ceased beating, then starting very suddenly. Palpitation from the least exertion. Endocarditis with orthopnea. Angina pectoris. Tobacco heart, especially when due to cigarettes.

Back - Pain and aching in lumbar region.

Limbs - Aching of legs and big toe. Trembling of hands. Aching in wrists and ankles. Lungs - Pulmonary congestion. Orthopnea. Dyspnea while walking. Hot feeling in throat.

Modalities - Better in open air. Worse from lying on back. Worse in warm room (All-c.).

Kidneys - Aching in bladder, feels distended. Frequent, offensive urination, scanty urine. Dropsy, anuric tendency.

Temperature - Chilly in back and down spine, followed by fever, little sweat. Thirst and headache during chill. Dyspnea during fever.

name: Convolvulus Arvensis
author: Murphy
constitution: Very few experiments have been made with this plant, and in those the resinoid of the root and pure Convolvulin were used. The few symptoms recorded are all in the gastro-intestinal sphere. Eructation after eating. Colic and diarrhea, liquid stool. Stools are soft, semi-fluid evacuation, preceded by flatulence and violent colic. Stools with pain. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC -…
full:
PHARMACY - convo-d. Convolvulus duar- tinus. Morning glory. Ipomoeabona. N. O. Convolvulacae. Tincture of flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Constipation. Eye, inflammation. Headaches. Numbness. Rheumatism. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Convo-d.was proved under Mure. Recorded symptoms include reveries in the daytime, dreams of dead persons, and ni.mbness in limbs. Symptoms are worse in Convolvulus duartinus morning and better after cold bath. MIND - Moral weakness. Reveries in the daytime.

Head - Burning in frontal region, ceasing after a cold bath. Pain in frontal region with heat at root of nose. Pain in left temple (corresponding to inflamed left eye).

Eyes - Inflammation of the left eye.

Throat - Heat and dryness at anterior and upper part of esophagus.

Abdomen - Pain in abdomen with internal heat. Violent colic with drawings.

Stool - Constipation.

Limbs - Numbness of arms, worse when hanging down. Pains in left shoulder in left wrist. Numbness of right index and middle fingers. Sharp pain in right knee. Pain fore part of left leg for four days. Deep-seated pain in calves.

Sleep - Drowsiness in daytime. Dreams about quarreling, about dead persons, falling out of his front teeth, of flying along a lighted street, appearance of a ghost. Wakes with a start.

Teeth - Toothache. Swelling of gums. Tongue feels swollen. Vertigo - Vertigo with faintness. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Kidneys - Red urine. Yellow sediment in urine.

name: Copaiva
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from morning. Worse taking cold..
constitution: Acne. Anus, itching. Bladder, catarrh. Blenorrhagia. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Colitis. Coughs. Cystitis. Dysentery. Dysuria. Fistula. Gastritis. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hives. Measles. Nosebleeds. Prostatitis. Pruritus. Roseola. Urethritis. Urticaria. Vulva, inflammation.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cop. Copaiva.Balsamofcopaiva. Balsamumcopaivae. Copaiferaofficinalis. Copaifera reticulata. N. O. Leguminosae. Caesalpinioideae. Tincture of the balsam. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Anus, itching. Bladder, catarrh. Blenorrhagia.…
full:
PHARMACY - cop. Copaiva.Balsamofcopaiva. Balsamumcopaivae. Copaiferaofficinalis. Copaifera reticulata. N. O. Leguminosae. Caesalpinioideae. Tincture of the balsam. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Anus, itching. Bladder, catarrh. Blenorrhagia. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Colitis. Coughs. Cystitis. Dysentery. Dysuria. Fistula. Gastritis. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hives. Measles. Nosebleeds. Prostatitis. Pruritus. Roseola. Urethritis. Urticaria. Vulva, inflammation.

HERBAL - Copaiva is an old world remedy for gonorrhea and it has been used for other blennorrhagie conditions. It has been proved Copaiva and observations have also been made on patients who have overdosed with the remedy. A. P. Bowie verified the indication “In old persons, (men) who from cold or other causes cannot urinate or where there is frequent desire and only a few drops pass with much straining. Frequently with a mucus discharge from the bowels with much rumbling and rolling in the bowels.” Bowie gave 5-drop doses of the first dilution. He also recommended an ointment of 10 drops of the balsam in vaseline, “to relieve the burning and itching at the anus caused by hemorrhoids.”

HOMEOPATHIC - The chief action is on the genito-urinary organs and rectum. Irritation accompanying thickening of bladder. Burning at neck of bladder and in urethra, discharge milky, corrosive, meatus tumid and inflamed. Affects the mucus membranes of the respiratory organs and the skin, producing a well-marked nettle-rash. Chronic bronchitis, with profuse, greenish-gray, disgusting-smelling sputa. Colds and catarrhs. Excessive discharge. Foul, blenor- rhea, bronchorrhea, suppuration. MIND - Weeps on hearing a piano.

Head - Flushes of blood to the head and face. Scalp sensitive. Excessive sensitive- ness, pain in occiput. Occipital headache, better gentle hand pressure. Dull, frontal headache, passes to occiput and back again with throbbing. Worse right side and motion. Lungs - Bronchial catarrh with profuse, greenish, offensive discharge. Bronchiectasis. Tickling in larynx, trachea and bronchials. Painful cough with heat and oppression of chest. Burning in lungs. Cough with profuse, gray, purulent, greenish, offensive sputum. Foul bloody expectoration.

Ears - Excessive sensitiveness to sharp sounds.

Nose - Rawness and soreness of nostrils with stopped-up feeling, dryness of posterior sinuses. Burning and dryness, crusts on turbinated bones. Profuse, thick, fetid discharge from nasal passages, running down throat at night. Marked catarrhal condition in upper respiratory tract. Nosebleed, lasting several days in small boys.

Face - Acne, disfiguring the face. Face red, flushed.

Mouth - Teeth cold.

Throat - Chronic catarrh of the throat. RELATIONS - Antidote: Bell., Merc. Compare: (1) Santalum - aching in kidneys. (2) Cann-i., Canth., Barosma, Cub., Apis, Vespa, Erig., Senecio, Sepia. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Food seems too salty. Gastric troubles during menstruation or following urticaria. Gas and intestinal flatulence, urging to stool and difficult passage with pain.

Rectum - Mucus colitis. Stools covered with mucus with colic and chilliness. Burning and itching of anus, caused by hemorrhoids.

Male - Prostatitis. Testicles sensitive and swollen. Blenorrhagia. Pulsations in penis.

Female - Itching of vulva and anus with bloody purulent discharge. Profuse, strong-smelling menstrual discharge with pains radiating to hip bones, with nausea. Food - Tastes too salty.

Skin - Hives with fever and constipation. Roseola. Erysipelatous inflammation, around the abdomen. Bullous eruptions. Circumscribed, lenticular patches with itching, mottled appearance. Chronic urticaria in children.

Modalities - Worse from morning. Worse taking cold.

Bladder - Catarrh of bladder. Dysuria. Retention with pain in bladder, anus and rectum. Burning pressure, painful urination by drops. Constant desire to urinate. Urine acrid, scanty, bloody, odor of violets. Greenish, turbid color, peculiar pungent odor. Swelling of orifice. Urethra feels wide open. Suppuration, ascends urinary tract. Purulent or acrid milky gonorrhea. Constitutions - Suited to the irritable bladder of elderly women.

name: Corallium Rubrum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better - covering. Worse from inhaling air. Worse open air. Worse changing from a warm to cold room. Worse eating. Worse towards morning. Worse stooping. Worse after dinner. Worse touch. Worse uncovering..
constitution: Asthma. Catarrh. Chancre. Constipation. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Eruptions. Glands, inflamed. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Measles. Nosebleed. Post-nasal, catarrh. Psoriasis. Purpura. Sore, throat. Syphilis. Whooping cough.
keynote:
PHARMACY - cor-r. Corallium rubrum. Red coral. Gorgonio nobilis. N. O. Gorgoniaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrh. Chancre. Constipation. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Eruptions. Glands, inflamed. Headaches. Hoarseness.…
full:
PHARMACY - cor-r. Corallium rubrum. Red coral. Gorgonio nobilis. N. O. Gorgoniaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrh. Chancre. Constipation. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Eruptions. Glands, inflamed. Headaches. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Measles. Nosebleed. Post-nasal, catarrh. Psoriasis. Purpura. Sore, throat. Syphilis. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Red coral, the product of a coralligene zoophyte, contains calcium carbonate and iron oxide (the origin of its color), gelatin and otherelements. In medical alchemy, red coral was considered to have “strengthening tonic properties, ” and to be astringent, sudorific, diuretic and absorbent. Cor-r. affects the mucus membranes, especially of respiratory organs. The provings of coral develop much coryza, nosebleed and even ulceration within the nostrils. Eruptions, which are for the most part of its own color, coral-red. Red spots on the palms of the hands, at first coral, then darker, and finally coppery. Coral-red chancres. Whooping and spasmodic coughs, especially when the attack comes on with a very rapid coughs and the attacks follow so closely as to almost run into each other. Violent coughing attacks. Coughs often preceded by sensation of smothering, followed by exhaustion. Coughs with expectoration of blood. Congestion of face, purple colored face, after dinner. Ulcerations in the respiratory organs with a stringy discharge. Feeling as if cold air were streaming through skull and air-passages. Too cold when uncovered and too hot when covered, better by artificial heat. MIND - Peevish, inclined to scold and swear at his pains. Irascibility and ill-humor. Wine has a natural taste, but immediately stupefies him. Delusion, feels as if newly born in the world and overwhelmed with wonder at the novelty of his surroundings. Stupefaction after wine. Confusion after beer. Confusion from spirituous liquors. Fear of suffering.

Head - Hot cheeks and forehead with cold feet, after dinner. Confusion in the head, feels empty, hollow, very large. Congestion of blood to head on stooping. Violent pain as if parietal bones were forced apart, worse stooping. Headache with severe pain in back of the eyeballs, worse inhaling cold air. Pressing pain in forehead. Pain aggravated by breathing cold air through nose. Head feels large, empty, hollow. As if cold air were blowing through, when head is moved quietly or shaken. Asif forehead were flattened. Meningeal inflammation threatening in yellow fever.

Eyes - Hot and painful eyes, bathed in tears on closing. Sensation of compression in the orbit. Pain, as from excoriation in the eyes. Eye pain, violently worse during every motion. Sensation of burning in the eyes. Burning of eyes from candlelight. Pressure as from sand in reddened eyes - in evening. Enlarged pupils in whooping cough. Extremely sensitive drawing pain in left orbit.

Nose - Great dryness of mucus membrane of nose and throat. Nosebleed at night. B leeding from one nostril at a time. B leed- ing of the nose from one nostril at a time. Nose stopped up and ulcerated. Post-nasal catarrh. Fluent coryza. Profuse secretion of mucus dropping through posterior sinuses. Violent fluent catarrh of odorless mucus. Dry coryza, nose stopped up and ulcerated. Smells odors of smoke, onions, etc. Inspired air feels cold (Cist.). Painful ulcer in nostrils.

Face - Grows purple and black with coughing. Heat in the face, worse on bending head forward, by stooping. Pain, as from dislocation in the maxillary joint. Left zygoma painful, as if bruised, worse touch. Left articulation of lower jaw as if sprained, when moving jaw. Painful swelling of left submaxillary gland worse swallowing or bending head forward. Food - No appetite. Violentthirst. Insipidity of food. Food tastes like sawdust. Bread, farinaceous foods tastes like straw. Sweetish taste of beer. Craves salty foods and acids. Intoxication after drinking very little wine.

Mouth - Food tastes like sawdust. Bread tastes like straw. Beer tastes sweet. Pain in articulation of left lower jaw. White coated tongue in whooping cough. Lips cracked and painful. Lips chapped, painful and swollen.

Throat - Great dryness of fauces. Throat very sensitive, especially to cold air, causes coughing. Great dryness of the palate, fauces and throat. Constant hawking, from the accumulation of mucus in the posterior sinuses. Sensation of excoriation on swallowing. Laryngismus stridulus resembling whooping cough. Hawking of profuse mucus. Left submaxillary glands swollen and painful, worse swallowing or bending head forward. COMMENTS - Cor-r. corresponds to a combination of syphilis and psora. Cough like whooping cough. Cough in machine-gun paroxysms. Crowing inspiration, sensation as if inspired air was icy cold. May cough up blood. Useful for chronic bronchitis. Smothering sensation before cough, after, great exhaustion. Change of air causes coughing. Sensation of emptiness or hollowness in the head. Head feels very large. Sensation as if forehead were flattened. Feels cold when uncovered and too hot when covered. Very sensitive to cold air and drafts. Much drowsiness, many symptoms appear during sleep. J. N. Lowe cured with Cor-r. an infant, a year old, suffering from laryngismus stridulus, the indications being worse during sleep and after waking. Lach., given first, failed to relieve. Guernsey's indication is “Whooping cough or any other kind of cough when the attack comes on with a very rapid cough and the attacks follow so closely as to almost run into each other.” Found most effective in the nervous “machine-gun” cough where the patient gives an isolated cough at regular intervals through the day. Nash found it the most useful of all remedies in post-nasal catarrh. Guernsey's other indication is “red. flat ulcers on the glans and inner surface of the prepuce with secretion of a quantity of yellow ichor.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bell., Dros., Meph., Caust. Complementary: Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Nausea, with dryness of the tongue and violent headache, worse when sitting up. Vomiting of quantities of tough, ropy, stringy mucus. Vomiting with loose cough.

Male - Balanitis. Ulcers on gians and inner prepuce with yellow ichor. Very red flat ulcers, on glans and under surface of prepuce. Ulcers very sensitive to touch. Emissions and weakened sexual power. Swelling of prepuce. Margin of prepuce feels sore when linen touches it. Frenum painful, as if pricked by needles. Profuse sweat on genitals. Involuntary seminal emissions during sleep.

Chest - Sensation as if cold air were streaming through air-passages in morning on deep inspiration, with provocation to cough. Difficult hawking of bronchial mucus. Pain in sternum during cough.

Heart - Pulse full and hard. Quick pulse; in whooping cough.

Back - Stiffness in nape of neck. Pain as if the small of the back were broken. Pressing pain in scapulae during cough. Neck stiff.

Limbs - Great lassitude in all limbs after a short walk in evening. Smooth spots of a deep-red color. Pressive pain in the shoulder blades, aggravated by coughing. Pain in the wrists, as if he had been writing much and rapidly. Pain in the knees, tibia and tarsal joint, as if he had walked a great deal. Red. itching, miliary eruption rough, feeling like a grater to the touch, on both elbows. Lungs - Crowing during inspiration. Asthma. Smothering sensation before paroxysms of cough. Air passages feel cold on deep inspiration (Cist.). Hawking of profuse mucus. Difficult, oppressed breathing. Profuse secretion of mucus droppingthroughposteriorsinuses. Feels suffocated and greatly exhausted after whooping cough. Cold expectoration.

Sleep - Yawning, violent, frequent and in rapid succession. Great sleepiness, falls asleep while standing. Sleeps with head under covers. If he uncovers himself, he feels too cold, and when covered, feels too hot. Can’t sleep before midnight, tosses about. Starts as soon as she falls asleep, from a frightened dream.

Skin - Psoriasis of palms and soles. Coralcolored, then dark red spots, changing to copper-colored spots. Red, flat ulcers. Psoriasis smooth, copper-coloured spots.

Modalities - Better - covering. Worse from inhaling air. Worse open air. Worse changing from a warm to cold room. Worse eating. Worse towards morning. Worse stooping. Worse after dinner. Worse touch. Worse uncovering.

Teeth - Every tooth on the left side feels as if set on edge. As if the teeth were too close to one another or as if a tenacious body were lodged between them.

Kidneys - Loam or clay-colored urine, with similar sediment. Burning urine.

Cough - Dry, spasmodic, suffocative cough. Very rapid cough. Short, barking cough. Nervous cough. Reverberating machine-gun like cough. Continuous hysterical cough. Violent spasmodic cough. Coughs begins with gasping for breath. Almost continuous paroxysms of violent spasmodic cough. Cough as soon as he eats. Coughs with a purple face, followed by vomiting of stringy mucus and exhaustion. Cough with bleeding from mouth and nose. Cough followed by vomiting of stringy mucus and by exhaustion. Isolated cough at regular intervals throughout the day. Feels suffocated and greatly exhausted after whooping cough. Whooping cough when attacks comes on with a very rapid cough, and attacks follow so closely as to almost run into each other. Coughs and coughs until patient falls back as limber as a rag.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat on genitals. Rectum - Constipation, followed by copious papescentstool. Profuse discharge of mucus from anus at night.

Temperature - Chill, but skin of usual warmth. Chill with headache and violent thirst. Chill better by external heat. Febrile shivering, with burning thirst. Dry heat internally and externally, with full and hard pulse. Dry heat without thirst, and not followed by perspiration. Hot parts feel cold when uncovered.

HERBAL - Cordyceps is used for a wide range of conditions including fatigue, sexual dysfunction, coughs. It is an adaptogen or immune stimulant. Over a thousand years ago, Tibetan herdsman in the Himalayas observed their yaks became vitalized after eating this fungus. Cordyceps is an energy and stamina booster. Cordyceps is a renown star of the Chinese tonic herbal system, and is an extremely effective and powerful health enhancing agent, equal to Ginseng and Reishi. This rare and precious fungus is considered to be an tonic of the highest stature. Cordyceps is used to strengthen the body and mind at a constitutional level. It is thought to be able to increase the “vital force for all activities.” It restores the energy reserves consumed by excessive exertion, adaption to stress or aging. It is said to build sexual and physical power, mental energy, the immune system and is universally believed in Asia to prolong life. Cordyceps is considered in Asia to be a powerful tonic for athletes. It greatly improves performance and muscle building capability. It can be used to strengthen respiratory power in those who require extra energy in order to perform physical work, labor, sports or exercise. Cordyceps is also a major lung tonic. It can be used by those who suffer from lung weakness. It is especially beneficial to those who suffer chronic lung problems with cough, wheezing or shortness of breath. Cordyceps is highly regarded in China as a tonic for those who are recovering from an illness or an operation, or after giving birth. In these cases, the Cordyceps helps the patient recover their physical power, to improve their appetite, and to protect the body from infection. It is used for backache due to injury, fatigue, stress or simple aging. Long term use of Cordyceps helps to strengthen the skeletal structure, and specifically benefits the lower back region, the knees and ankles.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mental and physical exhaustion due to over work. Nerve weakness. Chronic fatigue. Mountain sickness. Shortness of breath. Lack of strength and endurance. Weak stamina. It increases athletic and general performance, especially in long distance races. Alzheimer's disease. Antidotes opium and narcotic withdrawal symptoms (Aven.).

Male - Sexual hypofunction. Loss of sexual drive. Impotence. Seminal emissions with aching of loins and knees. Nerves - Sedative and hypnotic action, tranquilizer.

Female - Metrorrhagia, abnormal menstruation. Sexual frigidity and infertility. Loss of sexual drive. Food - Increased appetite. Cordyceps General - Tiredness. Chronic fatigue syndrome. Debility. Immune weakness. Anemia. Hypercholesterolemia. Lymphoma.

Heart - Arrhythmias. Weakness of heart. Liver - Chronic obstructive hepatic diseases. Prevention of liver and spleen atrophy. Lungs - Difficult breathing, worse exertion. Constricted bronchials. Asthma. Persistent cough. Shortness of breath. Mountain sickness. Emphysema. Lung cancer. Tuberculosis.

Back - Backache due to injury, fatigue, stress or simple aging. Lumbar weakness.

Skin - Fungus infections. COMMENTS - Cordyceps is one of the primary herbal substances used daily as an anti-aging agent and for the purposes of rejuvenation. Cordyceps as a sexual tonic is considered to have a profound long range strengthening capacity. It is commonly used for impotence, sexual debility, frigidity and infertility. Sexual debility. Cordyceps helps the body resist a wide range of pathogenic bacteria, fungi and viruses. It is used in Asia to help treat fungus and yeast infections. Intensive research is being conducted in China and Japan relating to Cordyceps and treating certain varieties of cancer. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Very unpleasant sensations continued for two hours more when, after great flushing of the face with all but intolerable heat, the effects passed away. Coriaria produces intoxication very like that of alcohol. Great muscular activity as in acute mania, requiring several persons to hold a person when under the influence of the drug. His method was to give a wine glassful three times a day for three days. Then, for the next three days, apply it locally or wash the part with it, then administer it internally for another three days and so on. He cured, with this method, all his cases in eighteen days. This was the first acquain- tance Lutze had with the remedy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Later on he made a proving on himself and another, eliciting symptoms of fever, restlessness and insomnia. Di sturbed sleep. Weak and tired. Cold feeling in chest, as if full of ice. Skin eruptions with emaciation. Eczema, skin cracked.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Bilious, headache. Coryza. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Eczema. Hepatitis. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, derangement. Mucus membranes, ulcers. Pruritus vulvae. Urticaria.

HERBAL - A popular remedy for aphthous and ulcerated conditions of the mucus membranes. Hale said he had seen it cure chronic ulceration of the mouth and throat, which had recurred for many years. A remedy for old malaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - Corn, has had an extensive proving. The fever symptoms are identical with those of Cornus f. Liver derangement with aching eyeballs. Chronic malaria, hepatitis, jaundice. Pain in pit of stomach with distended abdomen. Dark, foul stools with burning in anus. Diarrhea, dark bilious offensive with sallow complexion. Vesicular eruption associated with liver disease or aphthous stomatitis. Vesicular eczema of face of infants with nursing sore mouth. Sleepy before chill, with heat after meals. Disturbed sleep. Weakness in morning. Weak and depressed. MIND - Forgetful. Unable to concentrate attention. Indolence with loss of mental and physical energy. Mind confused on rising in the morning. Indifferent, with drowsiness. Depression and petulance.

Head - Dullness and weight in head, especially temples, better by coffee. Heaviness of head, with nausea. Aching and throbbing pain over left eyebrow. Dull pains over eyeballs, unusual pulsation extending to back of head. Pulsating headache in temples.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, hollow, as after a debauch, dark circles under them. Conjunctiva tinged yellow. Soreness of eyeballs, aching pains through them. Eyeballs and lids heavy. Herpes of lids.

Ears - Ringing in ears.

Nose - Prickling in nose and nasal bones. Coryza early in morning.

Face - Heat and burning in face, without redness. Countenance yellow, or pale, sallow, and sunken, indicating suffering and debility.

Mouth - Ulceration of tongue, gums and mouth. Aphthae. Burning in mouth, throat and stomach.

Stomach - Acid heartburn, painful and slow digestion. Sense of faintness and emptiness in stomach and bowels. Distention, burning, oppression. Pulsating pain in stomach. Belchings. Gagging as if to vomit in morning. Nausea, with confused and heavy pain in head. Nausea with bitter taste and aversion to all kinds of food.

Abdomen - Chronic hepatitis and bilious derangement. Borborygmus. Distention, better after loose stool. Griping in umbilical region, worse during stool. Constant working in bowels as if all in motion.

Rectum - Burning in anus. Dysentery and diarrhea with inactivity of liver. Loose, dark stool, immediately after dinner. Ulceration of rectum. Dark, bilious offensive diarrhea with sallow complexion. Diarrhea with excessive debility and nervous irritability. Urgency to stool, early in morning in bed.

Male - Increased desire, but lack of power. Frequent strong and persistent erections during the night. Pruritus.

Female - Leucorrhea. Pruritus. Food - Thirst for cold drinks, desire for sour drinks.

Chest - Choking sensation in upper part of thorax. Soreness of chest. Stitches, bruised feeling, in chest and back. Dragging down on each side of chest. Intermittent shooting pains in chest and abdomen. Rheumatic or neuralgic pains. Fine, scarlet rash on chest with itching.

Heart - Perceptible pulsations in chest. Palpitations of heart. Circulation accelerated.

Back - Drawing pains at nape of neck. Dull pains in back. Sore pains in lumbar region, worse bending forward.

Limbs - Weakness of limbs. Legs weak and tremulous, particularly when ascending. Pain in right hip while lying in bed. Itching on legs and thighs, burning sensation in feet. Coldness of hands and feet after a loose stool. Burning and itching sensation in hands and arms. Lungs - Frequent inclination to expand chest by taking a long breath. Cough with sharp stitches in chest. Dry, spasmodic cough, or tedious, chronic cough, with mucus expectoration.

Sleep - Drowsiness with entire loss of mental and physical energy, heavy feeling in head, depression of spirits. Sleep unrefreshing and disturbed by unpleasant dreams. Tendency to perspire.

Skin - Yellow or earthy appearance of skin. Itching, burning or prickling sensations, worse by scratching or rubbing. Eczema, pruritus and similar disorders of external genitals. Vesicular eczema of face in infants with nursing sore mouth.

Modalities - Better by coffee. Worse from taking cold. Worse summer heat. Worse at night. Worse on waking. Worse motion of any kind.

Kidneys - Frequent desire to pass water. Urine scanty and high-colored.

Temperature - Chilliness with nausea, dull pain in head, debility, and languor. Chilly sensation, followed by transient flushing. Flushes of heat and coldness in alternation, followed by cold perspiration. Transient flushes of heat pervading whole body, with shooting pains through brain. General clammy sweat, with headache, nausea, pain in back, lassitude, and confusion of ideas. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cornus alter- nifolia. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hale commended Com-f. in obstinate intermittents where quinine had been abused and where there was sleepiness for days before chill, a sluggish flow of ideas, and a dull, heavy headache. Intermittent fever with drowsiness. Feels cold, but is warm to touch. Great exhaustion in intervals. General clammy sweat. Chill is preceded by drowsiness, heat is associated with drowsiness. Headache after quinine. Hale also commended it in old cases of dyspepsia where the chief symptom is acid heartburn. Chronic malaria indigestion and distressing acid heartburn. Paroxysms attended with nausea, vomiting and sometimes with watery or bilious diarrhea. Chills, with cold, clammy skin. Violent headache with throbbing, stupor, confusion of intellect and vomiting. General debility from loss of fluids and night sweats. Neuralgic pains in arms, chest and trunk. Sensation as if broken in two. Pneumonia, with stitches in the chest. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Other Cornels. (2) Eup-per., Nux-v., Chin., Kali-c., Abies-n., Abies-c. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hale.

PHARMACY - cortiso. Cortisone. Cortisone is used in an acetate form and is prepared today by synthesis. It is a cortico-suprarenal hormone, belonging to the groupof 11 steroids or 11-oxycorticosteroid hormones. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Addison's disease. Allergic, rhinitis. Amenorrhea. Cataract. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cushing's syndrome. Depression. Dyspepsia. Edema. Goiter. Hay fever. Heatstroke. Hyperten- sion. Hypothyroidism. Lupus, erythematosis. Memory weak. Moon-faced. Muscular, atrophy. Obesity. Ophthalmic, migraine. Osteoporosis. Osteo-necrosis. Psoriasis. Styes. Sunstroke. Ulcers. Virilism.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Corticoid are a group of synthetic bodies whose action is analogous to that of Cortisone, but with greater power at equal weight and theoretically with greater tolerance. All corticoids can have side effects including the perforation of gastric and duodenal ulcers, gastric and duodenal hemorrhaging, psychological complaints, virilism, acne, osteoporosis, diminution of resistance to infections and to tuberculosis, amenorrhea and Cushing's syndrome. Prednisone and prednisolone cause less retention of water and salt and less potassium reduction in the blood than cortisone, but on the other hand, can be the cause of myopathy. The homeopathic proving of cortisone was carried out during May and June 1963 by W. L. Templeton on eight provers and five controls, using the potencies 6c, 12c and 30c, prepared by A. Nelson and Co. Ltd. Symptoms included a general lack of reaction and decrease of the organic reactional capacity. Slowness of the body and of the mind with irritability. Bradycardia torpor. Rhythmic disorders of glands, especially the pituitary, adrenal, pancreas. Dysthy- roidism with tendency to hypothyroidism. Inhibition of secretion of ACTH. Goiter. Hypercorticism, moon-faced. Virilism. Polydipsia. Morbid hunger. Tendency to obesity with retention of water. Acrid dyspepsia, which can lead to gastric ulcers. Vomiting. Headache. Intra-cranial hypertension. Right frontal and orbital pain, aggravated by the heat in a room, by pressure and in the afternoon. Impaired vision. Dryness of nasal and pharyngeal mucus membranes with coughing and dry, sticky eyes. Vertigo. Convulsions, the back of the eye reveals papillary edema. Skin discolored, vesicular eruption, dryness and cracking of the skin on the face and hands with exfoliation of the nail beds. Face round, puffy, moon-faced. Legs swollen with edema. Sacroiliac pain, as if the back were about to break. MIND - Unstable mood, alternating between euphoria, melancholy and excitement. Excitability with increased activity. Action calms him. Fatigue with weariness. Loss of willpower. Heavy, confused, irritable, impatient. Memory weak, mental effort arduous, aggravating the general condition. Difficulty in concentrating. Melancholic state. Thoughts of death. Depressive conditions.

Head - Headache, as from a band around the head. Pulsating headache around the right eye, the vertex and the left side of the occiput. Sensation of frontal and occipital rending. Pain stronger around the right eye and forehead. Pain aggravated by pressure, heat, movement, sun. Ameliorated in the open air.

Eyes - Tension behind the eyeballs. Eyeballs painful, dry, edges of the eyelids agglutinated. Inflammation of the inner canthus. Allergic conjunctivitis. Styes. Cataract. Accommodation difficult. Foggy vision.

Ears - Ringing in the ears.

Nose - Allergic rhinitis. Hay fever. Sneezing, worse in the morning, better by washing.

Face - Acne of the face, shoulders, and back.

Mouth - Dryness of the mouth, especially in the morning. Dryness of the throat and pharynx, worse with swallowing, ameliorated by eating warm honey. Uvula red.

Stomach - Amelioration by empty swallowing, aggravated in the morning and by hot drinks. Gastric ulcer.

Abdomen - Hepatic deficiency. Spasmodic entero-colitis.

Rectum - Diarrhea on rising in the morning, after breakfast, after a meal. Constipation and incomplete evacuation of hard stools in balls.

Urine - Loss of potassium, calcium, phosphorus. Diminution of ascorbic acid. Retention of chloride and sodium. Increase of creatinine, cholesterol, uric acid. Glycosuria. Proteinuria. Tubular casts in the urine. Vertigo - Vertigo, aggravated in a warm room. COMMENTS - Its fundamental properties are promotion of the formation of glycogen, diminution of the use of glucide by the tissues, negation of the nitrogen balance, elevation of urinary elimination of uric acid of creatine (without any change in the level of creatinine in the urine) and of potassium, sodium retention, varying action on the urinary elimination of phosphorous and calcium. Degeneration of the lymphoid organs with lymphocytopenia. Increase of globulins in the plasma and inhibition of conjunctival inflammatory reactions. Inhibits the production of ACTH and produces atrophy of the suprarenal cortex. It gives the impression of well being and euphoria, but there is the possibility of maniacal or depressive psychological complaints. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Ars., Sep., Sulph. - Impatient, quarrelsome, has grandiose ideas, pain and burning eruptions. (2) Psor. - Sad, periodic migraines, anxious, scabby, weeping eruptions, weakness of the back and limbs as if dislocated. (3) Puls. - changing, variable, weeps at the slightest trifle, alternation of smiles and tears. Erratic pains, dry cough, congestion of the veins. REFERENCES - Julian.

Male - Diminution of sexual desire.

Female - Amenorrhea in young girls. Menses copious, blood thick. Pelvic congestion. Heaviness in the lower abdomen. Sensation of repletion in the stomach, ameliorated by menstrual flow and by walking. Vulvar eczema. Food - Insatiable appetite, has butterflies if he does not eat. Milk and fats provoke nausea.

Chest - Skin of the thorax discolored. Red rash on the lower part of the sternum. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Slow, irritable subjects with a dull mind. Suitable especially, but not exclusively, for carbonic type and for Bernard's fat Sulphur types. Subjects fleshy with round face, sad, weeping for no reason.

Heart - Arterial hypertension. Purpura. Ecchymosis.

Back - Dorsal pain, under the ribs on the left side, spreading to the anterior sacroiliac, ameliorated by movement and pressure, as if broken, aggravated in a sitting position, by bending down and in the morning. Pain between the bones.

Limbs - Osteoporosis. Painful post-traumatic osteoporosis. Osteo-necrosis of the hip in particular. Painful joints. Muscular atrophy of the quadriceps of the lower limbs. Legs restless, not ameliorated by movement in bed. Drawing pain behind the knees. Pain in the loin, worse when seated or lying down. Sacroiliac pain, as if it were about to break. Vesicular eruption on the backs of the hands, itching with round marks, worse with the heat. Dryness and irritation of the back of the hands. Lungs - Dyspnea, aggravated in a warm room. Heaviness behind the sternum, respiration difficult. Short of breath, from nervous irritation, from warming himself and when in a hot room. Respiratory allergies, hay fever. Bronchitis with much sputum. Gray, gelatinous sputum. Laryngeal cough with sneezing in the morning. Cough aggravated by laughing, becoming excited, by walking, by physical fatigue, worse by undressing and by shaving.

Sleep - Sleep light. Agitated, easily disturbed, cannot sleep. Does not refresh, wakes tired.

Skin - Eczema with puffiness of the face. Round, raised marks, slightly hard, on the hands, ankle, cheek and left side of the neck. Itching rash on the legs, feet and hands. Red rash at the nail beds and on the backs of the fingers. Rash worse with heat. Red streaks on the skin, streaked with weals. Face and hands rough, chapping. Slow healing of wounds. Increased growth of hair in the usual places.

Modalities - Better from menstrual flow. Better walking. Better in the evening. Worse in the morning. Worse from external heat. Worse immobility. Worse scratching. Worse coughing. Worse pressure. Worse predominantly on the left side.

Kidneys - Nephrotic syndrome. Frequent, pressing urination. Urination at night, oliguria. Edema.

Blood - Increased production of the thrombocyte. Erythroid hyperplasia. Polymorphism of the leukocytes.

Head - Right-sided headache. Pain in forehead, temple, occiput. Pressing or shooting pain. Headaches, worse motion. Headaches, better open air. Heat of head.

Nose - Obstruction of nose. Yellowish mucus discharge.

Throat - Swollen sensation in throat when, lying down. Sensation as if thyroid were enlarged. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if ground gave way. Vertigo worse closing eyes. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains, especially in hands and fingers, worse motion, better warmth. Lungs - Anxiety and dyspnea. Dyspnea, anxiety, palpitations, cold sweat on forehead. Modalites - Worse rest. Worse warmth.

It has not been used in the potencies, a usual dose has been ten drops of the tincture four times a day.

HOMEOPATHIC - It is an unproved remedy, but clinical experience has revealed a specific relation of the manifestation of syphilis, including Hunterian chancre, syphilitic nodes, falling of the hair, and syphilitic ulcerations of scalp. Dry, scaly scabs on the faces of old people. Swollen lymphatic glands. Pronounced cancer cachexia. Gum- mata and night-pains. Chronic diseases with atony. Tongue clean, broad and full. Tissues flabby, doughy, cold. Gastric catarrh (Hydr. ) Syphilitic and non-syphilitic ulcerations of fauces. Ulcers of mouth and fauces. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Nit-ac., Kali-i., Fl-ac. full:
PHARMACY - cot. Cotyledon umbilicus. Pennywort. Navelwort. Kidneywort. Umbilicus pendulinus. Le Nombril de Venus. N. O. Crassulaceae. House-leek-family. Tincture of the plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Epilepsy. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hysteria. Sciatica. Sinuses. Spleen, disorders. Rheumatism.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cotyledon has had aconsid- erable proving. Cooper considered it a cancer remedy. He cured with it sinuses in buttock. A patient to whom he gave it for polyps said it made him stagger as if drunk. Marked action on the heart, oppression of the chest, and fullness in the throat. Oppressed breathing, disturbed heart. Catarrh of larynx and trachea. Well-marked pains through the breast to scapula. Pains in the region of the spleen. Rheumatic symptoms. Sciatica. Hysterical joint. Numb aching in muscular and fibrous tissue. Weak, faint feeling. Stitching, pricking, jerking pains are predominant sensations. A feeling as if some part of the body, like a foot or the head, were absent. The senses of sight and hearing are dulled. A yellow patch follows the eyesight. Disagreeable surging in ears, ears feel stuffed. Pressing vertex headache. Epilepsy. MIND - Lost and confused feeling. Could not articulate for some time on awaking. Feeling as if a part of the body were absent. Ailments from suppressed emotion.

Head - Headache, causing desire for open air, which ameliorates. Dull headache with cold feet. Dull, heavy, stupefying pain in forehead and vertex, shifting suddenly between them.

Throat - Constant choking in throat, feeling as if he would burst into tears. Back of throat feels as if covered with thick mucus. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ambr., Asaf., Hepat., Ign., Lach., Sedum acre. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Pain at epigastrium through to shoulder, with nausea. On swallowing, the morsel seems to pass and press against some swelling in cardiac region.

Abdomen - Long stitching in left hypochondrium. Dull pains in left hypochondrium. Dull pushing in region of spleen recurring at intervals.

Rectum - Bowels freely opened, later, constipation.

Chest - Full, bursting feeling, as if from obstruction at heart.

Heart - Heat about heart. Uneasiness. Clawing, dragging pain on riding, better by compressing side.

Back - Pain through to scapula from region of left breast. Pain at angles of scapulae. Breasts - Pain under left nipple and aching in right breast.

Limbs - Aching in back and thighs. Aching in all joints. Skin sensitive, rubbing of trousers causes an acute sting. Aching in left thigh followed by numbness. Stinging pain under left gluteus maximus in region of sciatic nerve. Legs and arms feel heavy and sore. Between attacks of headache, gnawing, rheumatic pain in right shoulder. Aching, bruised pain in wrists. Aching, tingling in hands, especially at night, preventing sleep, tingling down arm when the nerve is struck. Lungs - Oppressed breathing. Tickling in larynx with dry cough. Shooting in all directions in chest, particularly under right scapula and left nipple during evening. Stitches below both nipples.

Modalities - Worse morning and evening.

Kidneys - Calls to urinate frequent. Increased flow of clear urine.

keynote: PHARMACY - crb-a-b. Crab apple. Malus pumila. Pyrus malus. Small twigs with whole clusters of flowers are boiled for half an hour. The water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or…
full:
PHARMACY - crb-a-b. Crab apple. Malus pumila. Pyrus malus. Small twigs with whole clusters of flowers are boiled for half an hour. The water is strained and used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.

HOMEOPATHIC - The remedy Crab Apple, together with Oak-b., Will-b., Star-b-b., Sw- ch-b., Elm-b., Pine- b., and Lar-b., belongs to the group of For Despondency or Despair, as classified by Bach. States of severity. Burdening condition, without sufficient power or possibility to grow above. Unclean skin, acne. Accumulated wastes in the blood stream. Cleansing of digestive tract. Long-lasting viral infections. Chronic poisoning due toenvironmental hazards. Helps draw out impurities from a wound, if applied to the bandage. Chronic diarrhea. Feelings of disgust or repulsion. Strong repulsion toward the food consumed with the urge to vomit. Vomiting, nausea and emaciation (Chic-b., Must-b.). Anorexia and bulimia, tendency to obsess with weight problems. MIND - Self-centered. Concentrates on the unclean, shameful, bothering and burdensome. Obsessive preoccupation with beauty flaws or states of sickness considered unclean and unbecoming. Fear of contamination, by germs or unclean surroundings. Obsessive-compulsive disorder with deep shame (Cher-p-b., Pine-b.). Shame about appearance or inner guilt and uncleanness. Regrets sinful or shameful behavior. Feels soiled or dirty after abuse or molestation. Intense craving or desire to be cleansed and purified. Feels helpless in regard to the problem. Unable to shake off or overcome the condition. Minor problems assume disproportionate importance. Despair. REFERENCES Bach.
