PHARMACY - daph. Daphne indica. Spurge laurel. Daphne odora. Sweet-scented spurge laurel. N. O. Thymelaceae. Tincture of fresh bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies, esp. the first to sixth potencies.

CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Amblyopia. Constipation. Coughs. Exhaustion. Eyes disorders. Exostosis. Fever. Gastralgia. Gonorrheal rheumatism. Gout. Halitosis. Leprosy. Mer- curio-syphilis. Prostatorrhea. Rheumatism. Splenitis. Sleeplessness. Syphilis. Tobacco, craving. Toothache.

HOMEOPATHIC - Daphne indica was proved by G. Bute. It, like its relative Daph. mezereon, produces disorders of the muscles, bones and skin, hence its relation to syphilis and the anti- syphilitic remedies Aur., Merc., and Staph. Clammy skin. Red rash in spots on legs in evening. Itching. Daph. oleoides is credited by Hering with relieving leprosy. Daph. acts on the tissues, muscles, bones and skin. Fetid breath, urine, sweat. Erratic and electric-like pains. Sudden, lightning jerks in different parts of the body. Exostoses with stitching, pressing or dull pain, worse at night. Bruised pain. Exhaustion. Parts of the body feel separated (Bapt.). Burning in stomach. Gastric symptoms, worse from alcohol. For the craving for tobacco (Calad.). Prostate discharges, worse from tobacco. MIND - Despondent and sad. Mental dejection. Timidity. Exhaustion. Absent-minded. Indecisive, walks about room and can't make up his mind to anything. Agitated. Irritability. Over-excitement and trembling, during the pains. Any effort at thinking causes pain or soreness in brain. Fearful and trembling, from pain about heart.

Head - Headache, provoked by all kinds of intellectual labor. Bursting pain on rising in bed. Heat in head, especially in vertex. Feels as if skull would burst. Sensation as if head were separated from body. Soft nodular swellings on bones about vertex, pain worse at night and touch. Itching on scalp. Painful pulsation in temples with soreness when touched.

Eyes - Scraping in the eyes. Violent pains in the eyeballs, in the evening, with great nervous excitement. Painful sensation as if the eyes were pushed outwards from the head. Sensation around the eyes and eyelids with dryness and heaviness of eyelids. Contraction of the pupils. Eyes inflamed, weak, dull, as it were swim- ming in tears.

Ears - Burning about ears and on vertex with constant inclination to yawn. Buzzing, roaring in ears. Roaring and humming.

Nose - Nose scurfy, with some heat.

Face - Heat and burning sensation in the cheeks, around the ears, and in the vertex, sometimes with constant inclination to yawn. Sensation of swelling. Stiffness and tension in the temporo-maxillary joint, with burning, smarting in the skin. Food - Loss of appetite, moderate thirst. Craving to smoke tobacco. Gouty pains ■worse aicohof.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth as if burnt, after sleep. Tongue coated on one side only (Rhus-t.). Fetor of the tongue. Dryness of the tongue after sleep, as if it had been burned. Saliva, hot. Foul smelling breath. Salivation, with toothache.

Throat - Soreness in left side of throat on pressure. Inflammation of throat and suppuration of tonsils. Feeble voice. Vision - Floating black spots. Weak sight, with confusion of the letters when reading. While reading, the letters fade and appear as a black line. Diplopia. COMMENTS - Tongue coated on one side only (Rhus-t.). Foul-smelling tongue. Ptyalism with hot saliva. Fetidity is a marked feature of breath, urine, sweat. Sensation that parts of the body are separated from one another. Sudden pains, wander suddenly from limbs. Pain shoots into the region of the heart or abdomen. Sudden stitch in region of spleen. Ball of right great toe swollen and very painful. Cold feeling on buttocks. Daphne indica RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Bry., Dig., Rhus- t., Sil., Sep., Zinc. Antidote to: Chr-ac.. Merc. Compare: (1) Fl- ac., Aur., Mez., Staph. (2) Thuj. - effects of suppressed gonorrhea. (3) Benz-ac. - fetid urine, Puls., Chin., (4) Taxus - erratic pains, Verat. - lightning pains, Bapt. - limbs seem scattered about the bed, Ars. - body seems divided at waist. (5) Dirca belongs to the same family. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Burning in stomach and sensation of soreness after each meal. Pressure in stomach after drinking. Sensation of fullness and ebullition in the precordial region. Aching in the stomach after drinking. Heartburn and sour vomiting. Frequent cramps in the stomach. After each meal, burning pain and sensation of excoriation in the stomach, with frequent risings of flatus, the pains extend to left hypochondrium and to the back. Nausea and vomiting after breakfast.

Abdomen - Colic with chilliness. Pain in the abdomen, with shiverings. Contraction of the abdomen. Shootings and pains in the region of the spleen. Arthritic pains which pass rapidly from the limbs to the abdomen. Trembling in abdominal muscles.

Rectum - Stools scanty, bloody at end. Constipation.

Male - Toothache with erections, after sex. Sweating of scrotum. Discharge of prostatic fluid, after making water. Prostatic discharge worse smoking.

Heart - Palpitations and starting of the heart, with inability to remain lying on the left side. Acute pains in the region of the heart, with discouragement and trembling.

Back - Pain in the nape of the neck with headache. Screwing pain from the ear to the shoulder. Sensation as though the cervical glands were much swollen. Sharp pain beneath left scapula. Burning itching in the back. Painful pulling along the spinal marrow, worse by stooping.

Limbs - Shooting pains, shift rapidly, worse cold air. Pains shift upwards towards the abdomen and heart. Bone-ache, piercing pains in the bones and acute shooting pains in the fingers. Excessive itching on the arms and hands. Rheumatic pains in thighs and knees. Buttocks cold. Right toe swollen, painful. Lungs - Cough, fatigues and hinders sleep. Thin, slimy, copious, and bloody expectoration. Cough, with vomiting, and yellowish frothy expectoration, mixed sometimes with streaks of blood. Suffocative feeling with throat complaints. Yellow, often frothy, blood-streaked expectoration. Copious, thin, slimy mucus. Suffocating fits at night.

Sleep - Inclination to sleep with inability to accomplish it. Sleeplessness from aching in bones. Starting on falling to sleep, with fright, with chilliness, shivering, clamminess and viscid sweat. Agitated, unrefreshing sleep. Nightmares. Dreams of black cats. Dreams of fire.

Skin - Clammy skin. Red rash in spots on legs, in evening.

Modalities - Worse from cold air. Worse touch, pressure. Worse evening in bed. Worse at night. Worse waning moon. Cold air aggravates wandering gout. Lying down aggravates gouty pains, backache. Pains are worse from warmth of bed. Stooping or bending aggravates pains in spinal cord. Walking aggravates rheumatic pains in thighs. Gastric symptoms worse akohoL Pains worse warmth of bed-

Teeth - Pulsation in the teeth and gums. Acute drawing pains in all the teeth. Toothache, with and without salivation. Toothache with fits of shivering, or disposition to perspire. Toothache with erections, after sex.

Kidneys - Frequent and abundant emission of urine. Pain, as from excoriation in the urethra, when urinating. Urine fetid, turbid, thick, yellowish like rotten eggs. Reddish sediment, which adheres to the side of the vessel. Frequent bedwetting at night.

Perspiration - Clammy, offensive sweat, with a putrid smell. Viscid sweat over the whole body.

Temperature - Chilliness with stretching and yawning. Fever, similar to typhus, with excessive shivering, followed by continued heat, and complete loss of appetite. Fever with gastric and nervous suffering.

Heartburn. Burning sensation around cardiac end of stomach, extending to esophagus, with sense of constriction. Heat and fullness over liver region. MIND - Confusion of ideas with nervous irritation. Can't concentrate thoughts. Floating sensation as if ideas were floating outside of brain. Brain floats in thousands of problems and grand ideas. Strange feeling of pleasant and easy comfort, as if he scarcely touched earth with his feet and had to gather ideas from afar. Sensation as if they were floating in the clouds. Involved in a most beautiful atmosphere, bright and calm as the sunlight at noon. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Stram. REFERENCES-Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Poisoning with this drug causes raving madness. A girl who ate half an unripe fruit was completely out of her mind in a quarter of an hour, dizzy. Sleepy, slept with eyes open. If disturbed, she sprang up raving and uttered unintelligible words, if one sang she began to dance in the Favanese fashion. This symptom may prove a keynote in certain cases of mental alienation. Dryness of the mouth was also noted in this case, as with Bell, and other Solanaceae. REFERENCES-Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dat-m. causes a sleepy condition and later delirium and spasms. The soporose state may be absent. Delirium may be vociferous or merely garrulous. Patient usually manifests excessive timidity. Picks at real or imaginary objects. Performs ridiculous antics. Several movements appear due to perverted vision and inability tojudge distances. After the delirium, patient remembers nothing of what has occurred. Extreme dilatation of pupils. Flickering before eyes with sensitive- ness to light. Pulse and temperature undergo extremes of exaltation and depression. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Other Solanaceae. REFERENCES - Clarke.

PHARMACY - des-ac. Deoxyribonucleic acidum. DNA. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Amnesia. Cancer. Down's Syndrome. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Fatigue. Hypersensitivity. Hyperthyroidism. Insomnia. Manic, depression. Neuralgia. Neurosis. Premature senility.

HOMEOPATHIC - The proving of DNA. following the method indicated by Hahnemann, was conducted from 1970 to 1972 by O. A. Julian. Thirty people took part in this proving, four of whom were women, and all were doctors. Using the single blind method, the 30c, 7c, and 3x potencies were used, along with a placebo. The symptoms of that proving were incorporated with indications given by some Belgian homeopathic authors, who carried out some clinical research using potencies of DNA. Symptoms include a sense of general well being, more so in the morning. Difficulty in assembling thoughts, poor powers of concentration. Does not want to be idle, need to work. Difficulty working, but better when body fatigue wears off. General hypersensitivity, with asthenia. Tendency to hyperthyroidism. MIND - Hot-tempered, nervous disposition. Bad-tempered. Extremely irritable, with general feeling of discomfort in the morning. General feeling of uneasiness. Personality disorders, periods of dual personality. Narcissistic neurosis. Neurosis from anguish. Manic depression psychosis. General amnesia. Lack of willpower. Physical and psychological slowness, backwardness. Impossible for him to work, cannot concentrate. Mental slowness from the after effects of poliomyelitis. Down's syndrome.

Head - Neuritis and neuralgia of the brain. Headache and nausea after drinking a little wine. Pulsating headache over the whole head. Headache concomitant with need to go to stool, which does not provide relief. Ophthalmic migraine.

Eyes - Persistent bilateral conjunctivitis. Asthenopia. Extreme ocular fatigue, difficulty in seeing things in the distance clearly. Myopia. Bright spots before the eyes, which disappear when closed, appearing around 10:30 a.m., and last for an hour.

Nose - Frontal sinusitis.

Mouth - White coating over the whole tongue reaching even the edges, not removed easily by brushing. Burning sensation in mouth mucus membranes, with sensitive gums. Gingivitis. Angina. Gums bleed when brushing the teeth.

Throat - Laryngitis. Splinter-like feeling in the throat in the morning on waking. Raw feeling in the throat. Feeling of a foreign body, especially on the left side, ameliorated by cold water and by swallowing. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Plat., Nep., Arg-n. REFERENCES-Julian.

Stomach - Acid dyspepsia. Burning in the stomach and esophagus. Chilliness after meals, with a cold feeling between the shoulders and feeling of heat on the face, disappearing with movement.

Abdomen - Pain in the epigastrium. Distention, not eased by food. Flatulence and rumbling. Disorders of the liver, pancreas. Biliary sycosis.

Rectum - Tendency to constipation, with dry, dark stools. Tendency to diarrhea after meals, with flatulence. Anal eczema, with burning and oozing.

Male - Sexual mania. Diminution of libido. Hypertrophy of the prostate. Eczema of the scrotum.

Female - Anal and vulvar pruritus. food-Increases the appetite. Hungerpangs between meals. Anorexia.

Back - Pain in the left shoulder, in the acromion and the clavicular joints. Torticollis. Arthrosis of the neck and back. Intercostal neuralgia.

Limbs - White spot on the left index finger. Arm very painful, aggravated by pressure. Nightly recurring cramps in the calves. Osteomyelitis. Fractures repair slowly. Peri-arthritis of the scapula and humerus. Arthrosis of hips and shoulders. Patches of sclerosis.

Sleep - Twilight sleep. In the evening, irresistible desire to sleep, once in bed, no longer wants to sleep. Insomnia. Disturbed sleep. Sleepwalking. Erotic dreams at the end of the night. Dreams of dead bodies.

Skin - Burns. Psoriasis. Eczema. Marginal and eczematous rash, with burning and oozing. Reappearance of an eczematous dermatitis. Inflammatory folliculitis of the thighs. Alopecia. Seborrhea.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better lying in the dark. Better laterality left side. Worse from movement.

Kidneys - Painful urination. Urinates, especially about half an hour after meals. Irregular diuresis, sometimes copious, with yellow urine, sometimes copious and pale. Oliguria.

Blood - Peripheral circulatory complaints: hands cold during the day, hot in the evening. Leucopenia. Hemorrhage. Nightly acroparesthesia. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions. Cancerous condition.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. X. Roussel is the authority for this plant. Peculiar symptoms include “He walks as if stepping on down,” Painful and convulsive tic douloureux .Electric shocks and cramps. Exalted sense of smell. “He perceives celestial odors,” also “intolerable smells after frequent sneezing.” Heat helps toothache. Viscid urine and viscid saliva. Many symptoms, including diarrhea, come on at night. Worse from touch. Derris pinnata MIND - Delusion that he is seasick. Fear of falling on turning head. Censorious with dearest friends. He is afraid of killing some one with a knife. Singing alternating with weeping. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anae. - sense of smell. (2) Stict. - levitation. (3) Ign. - ball in throat, hysteria. REFERENCES Clarke.

PHARMACY - desm-g. Desmodium gange- ticum. N. O. Leguminosae. India. Tincture of plant. Historieal dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Catarrhal. Cough. Dropsy. Fever. Headache. Heat, flushes. Intermittent, fever. Meningitis. Neuralgia. Pleurodynia. Rheumatism. Typhoid, fever. Ulcers. Vomiting. Wry-neck.

HERBAL - It is a small tree growing in the forest and is found throughout the plains of India, also the lower Himalayan regions. The Hindu physicians have highly extolled it as an alternative, tonic, and bitter remedy. They have found it efficacious in vomiting, fevers, dropsy, ulcers, cough, respiratory troubles and affections due to worms. It is a bitter tonic and febrifuge. It is also digestive and anti-catarrhal. It is one of the principal ingredients of Dashamula, an ayurvedic decoction of reputation successfully used in many diseases, namely typhoid fever, cough, asthma, pleurodynia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Desmodium gangeticum can safely be used in typhoid fever and cere- bro-spinal meningitis when the patient feels pain all over the body, there is sleepiness, or comatose sleep, headache is present, and there is feeling as if the head is bound up with a tape or rope. In intermittent or remittent fevers of children it can be used when there are sleepiness or drowsiness and pains over the body. In this respect it bears a close resemblance to Gelsemium and in place of which it may be given. It may be employed in remittent and typhoid fevers and cerebro-spinal meningitis associated with pains over the whole body, specially over the spine, headache and sleepiness with a feeling as if a tape lay around the head. The fever comes on in the morning generally at 7 a.m. There is slight chilliness, lasting for 2 or 3 hours. From the onset burning sensation is felt over the face and eyes and in the hands and feet. Flushes of heat come out of the face. There is remission of fever with perspiration over forehead and back part of the hands and in feet. The fever indicating this drug is quotidian in character, regularly returning daily. The pains all over the body and headache and other symptoms may also be present. The above are the characteristic symptoms in which Desmodium gangeticum will be found an excellent remedy in intermittent fevers. It is also a valuable remedy for wry-neck. COMMENTS - The late Dr. Aghore Ch. Bhaduri. with his three pupils made a proving of this drug. The result of the proving is given below. He felt pains all over the body. Nervous pain, specially in the legs and neck. Burning sensation was felt in the hands and feet. Sleepiness. Pains like rheumatism and neuralgia were felt in hands, feet, legs and the rest of the body. Could not sit straight on account of spinal pain. Burning sensation was felt in the eyes, face hands and feet and flushes of heat ignited from the face. Neuralgic pain was felt in the stomach. Pain was felt in knee joint. Headache associated with a sensation as if all sides of the head are bound up with a tape. The above were the symptoms which were noticed by Dr. Bhaduri during the course of the proving. RELATIONS - Compare: In burning sensations, it can be compared with Azadirachta, Kalmegha, Rohitaka, Sulphur, etc. REFERENCES Ghose.

PHARMACY - dicha. Dichapetalum thunbergh. Dichapetalaceae or Chailletiaceae family. The flowerinhabits tropical the regions. Tincture of leaves and bark. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthrosis. Cellulitis. Duodenal, ulcer. Eczema. Hernia. Joint, pain. Lichen planus. Migraines. Neuralgias. Rhinitis. Sinusitis. Tonsillitis. Vertigo.

HERBAL - Dicha, is a dicotyledonous family with super-ovarized dialypetals, growing as trees or shrubs with simple alternate leaves, flowers in clusters or corymbs. The fruit is a drupe with a pendant seed, which has no albumen.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dicha, was brought to Europe by Dr. Willmar-Schwabe of Germany. The symptomatology was established by G. Mating on a group of four women and three men. all doctors. Using adouble blind method, the 3x, 4x, 6x, 15x, and 30x potencies were used, along with a placebo. General fatigue of the body, despite a state of euphoria when working. Sudden lack of energy with fatigue and a feeling of hunger, ameliorated by food and alcohol. Sullen mood. Inner trembling. Snuffles. Sensation of trembling inside the entire body. Stiffness at the nape of the neck, back, loins and sacrum. Occipital headaches. Migraines. Vertigo, buzzing in the ears, visual and psychosomatic complaints. Radicular neuritis. Chronic infection of the mucus membranes. Cervical and brachial neuralgia. Lichen planus. MIND - Sullen moods. Mental fatigue. Disinterested, must make an effort to work.

Head - Migraines. Occipital headaches. Pounding headache on all sides of the head, better by rest and fresh air. Diffuse, dull head pain with numbness of the head. Pain and stiffness at the nape of the neck.

Nose - Itching of the nose and face. Feeling of having acold with blocked nose. Painful drawing sensation at the root of the nose, especially when the eyes converge to read. Sinusitis. Rhinitis.

Mouth - Dryness, formication and tension at the lips. Quick, short, drawing pains in the teeth of the lower jaw.

Throat - Tonsillitis. Painful pulling on the right tonsil. Feeling of a grating lump in the throat. Fit of laryngeal coughing. Aphonia, ameliorated after speaking for a long time. Swallowing painful on the right side of the throat. Dysphagia. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Rhus-t. - Aching, stiffness, ameliorated by prolonged movement, vesicular eruptions, burning and itching. (2) Tub. - Joint pains with stiffness, dragging, worse on waking and after meals. (3) Zinc - Occipital pain with heavy feeling on the vertex or the root of the nose. Nose blocked, burning pains in the back, fidgety feet. REFERENCES-Julian.

Abdomen - Rumbling and pinching feeling in the abdomen, amelioratedby eating and expelling wind. Passage through intestines accelerated with more frequent stools. Duodenal ulcer. Diaphragmatic hernia.

Rectum - Bleeding hemorrhoids.

Female - Premature, too frequent menses. Amelioration of rheumatic pains at the beginning of menses. Food - Low blood sugar. Fatigue is ameliorated by food and alcohol.

Chest - A retro-sternal pain, worse when swallowing.

Heart - Pain in the precordial region with palpitations, followed by ascending hot flushes. Cardiac anguish with feeling of uneasiness and difficulty in falling asleep.

Back - Pain between the shoulders. Pain in the right shoulder, spreading towards the neck. Dorsal pain and stiffness like ankylosis. Severe pain and stiffness in the lumbar region, when seated or when walking. Pain in the lumbar region with drawing pains around the thighs. Drawing pains in the sacrum, ameliorated by urinating or expelling wind, worse when standing. Cellulitis of the nape of the neck.

Limbs - Fatigue and rheumatic pains in the limbs. Joint pain. Arthrosis. Legs feel like rubber. Heaviness in the calves.

Skin - Deep eczematic fissure on the palm of the hand, stretching along the ‘lifeline,' with scaly eruption at the edges. Herpestype eruptions, which itch, on the inner side of the left ankle with burning and scratching. Lichen- type eczema, in cement workers and bakers. Lichen planus.

Modalities - Better from fresh air. Better resting. Better eating. Better from menses. Worse on right side. Worse from standing. Worse walking.

Temperature - Shivering and sensation of cold, even when in a warm room. Rising heat, as if about to have a fever.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dictamnus acts on the female organs. Increased secretions. Early menses, of black clots, preceded by blindness. Profuse, corrosive leucorrhea with tenesmus. Bearing down with bilious vomiting, worse standing. Cramps from anterior thighs into the uterus before the menses. Sensation of milk flowing into breasts. Increased flow of urine. Frequent emission of copious, offensive flatus. Sensation of a lump rising in the throat. Worse from standing. Sleepwalking. Dreams of piecing bodies of her children together. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Digitalinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma. Diarrhea. Emissions. Exophthalmus. Fainting. Heart disorders. Palpitations. Spermatorrhea. Vertigo. Vision, hallucinations.
keynote:
PHARMACY - digin. Digitalinum. Active principle, glucoside of Digitalis purpurea. N. O. Scrophulariaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Diarrhea. Emissions. Exophthalmus. Fainting. Heart disorders. Palpitations. Spermatorrhea.…
full:
PHARMACY - digin. Digitalinum. Active principle, glucoside of Digitalis purpurea. N. O. Scrophulariaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Diarrhea. Emissions. Exophthalmus. Fainting. Heart disorders. Palpitations. Spermatorrhea. Vertigo. Vision, hallucinations.

HOMEOPATHIC - Digin. is a poison of great activity. It produces a profound effect on muscular tissue, both voluntary and involuntary, more especially on the heart. Irregular and intermittent action. Digin. causes profound prostration, even to inability to move a muscle. The heart is slowed or else its action is made rapid and feeble. Sensation as if the heart stood still. Paralytic weakness, numbness, tremulousness of the limbs. Cold, clammy surface. Goose-flesh. A sinking, faint sensation at the epigastrium. Shivering. Diarrhea, the stools are not characteristically white as are those of the plant. Nausea and vomiting of egg yolk matter. Drinking causes nausea and vomiting. Symptoms are better after dinner. Sensitiveness of eyes to light and nose to odors. Disorders of vision and hearing. Confusion of the head, better walking in open air. Chilliness and fever worse in afternoon and evening. Heart pains are worse lying on left side. Pains in trunk worse during rest. Many symptoms appear on waking in the morning. COMMENTS - According to Hale, Digin. is indicated in cases of “overburdened heart where it is constantly laboring." Digin. cured the case of Mrs. X, who had for over a year swelling ofherright hand and fingers, which she thought to be rheumatic. Digitalis has the symptoms, “swelling of right hand and fingers,” and this would have been given, but only Digin. was at hand. It was given in 4x potency. After the second dose the swelling began to subside, and in two or three days was completely gone. One prover noted “frontal headache, dazzlings, loss of appetite, sinking at epigastrium with intestinal flatulence, borbo- rygmi, eructation. Slight abdominal pains, urine abundant, great fatigue, painful heat in evening but no thirst.” For a whole day pressure in supra orbital region towards frontal sinus and when walking a feeling as if the ground gave way under his feet. Sexual weakness is shown in “Deep sleep in which an emission occurs without waking him.” “Sexual power diminished or quite abolished temporarily.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Dam., Dig., Con., Grat., Tab., Gels., Sec. REFERENCES-Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - dig. Digitalis purpurea. Foxglove. N. O. Scrofulariaceae. Tincture from the leaves of the second year of the plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Angina pectoris. Aphthae. Ascites. Asthma. Balanitis. Bright'sdisease. Cataract. Collapse. Congestive heart failure. Coryza. Cyanosis. Cystitis. Delirium tremens. Diplopia. Dropsy. Dyspnea. Emphysema. Faintness. Fevers. Gonorrhea. Headache. Heart, disorders. Heart, weakness. Hepatitis. Hot, flushes. Hydrocele. Hydrocephalus. Hydrothorax. Impotence. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Lungs, congestion. Melancholy. Memory, lost. Meningitis. Mitral valve, disease. Nausea. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Noises, in head. Pericarditis. Phimosis. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Prostate, enlarged. Prostration. Pulmonary, edema. Pulse, slow. Ptyalism. Spermatorrhea. Stomatitis. Toothache. Uremia. Urethritis. Urinary, disorders. Vertigo. Vision, disorders. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Digitalis is a heart remedy, but also affects the liver, lungs, stomach and genito-urinary organs. Dig. should be considered in all diseases where the heart is chiefly involved with abnormally slow, irregular or intermittent pulse, along with indefinite and causeless symptoms. Weakness and dilation of the myocardium. Indicated in failure of compensation. Auricular flutter andfibrillation, especially when subsequent to rheumatic fever. Useful for people with side effects from the digitalis drug. Symptoms of organic heart disease, such as great weakness and sinking of strength, faintness, coldness of skin and irregular respiration, cardiac irritability. Faint, as if dying. Bluish appearance of face. Cardiac muscular failure when systole is present. Stimulates the heart's muscles, increases force of systole, increases length. Heart blockage with a very slow pulse. The pulse is weak, irregular intermittent, abnormally slow and dropsy of external Digitalis purpurea and internal parts. Slow pulse in recumbent posture, but irregular and dicrotic on sitting up. Irregular pulse. Pulse can be slow or it can be intermittent. Slow pulse with menopause, puberty, or after sexual abuse. Congestive heart failure, especially in elderly people with dizziness and ringing in the ears. Tightness of the chest and weak heart. Constriction of the chest (Cact.). Weary feeling and their limbs feel heavy (Gels., Con.). Fluttering of the heart (Nat-m.). High blood pressure, with kidney involvement or prostate problems. Sense of suffocation, a fear of suffocation relating to a weak heart. Sinking feeling in the stomach with heart palpitations. Faintness. Sensation as i fhe would die if he moves during the palpitations. Great weakness, can hardly talk, sinking of strength. Collapse. Prostration from slight exertion. As of an electric shock going through the body. Cyanosis. Must walk about, with precordial anxiety, with urging to urinate. Dropsy with suppression of urine. Jaundice from induration and hypertrophy of the liver. Jaundice with heart disease. Tongue is blue and clean, thick and flabby. Eye troubles after tobacco. MIND - Great anxiety, as from troubled conscience. Reproaches himself. Great guilt, better weeping. Anxious, low-spirited and tearful. Extreme anxiety related to the heart. Anxious about the future. Excitement, stammers when talking to strangers. Excitement at night. Suspicious. Fearful. Fear of suffocation at night. Fear of insanity. Fear from music. Fear of death while walking. Feels as if he would fly to pieces. Every emotional shock strikes in epigastrium. Fear arising from stomach. Hurried, abrupt speech. Deep sighing and grief with heart problems (Ign., Calc-p.). Arrhythmias and palpitations that are worse since grief (Nat- m). Despair. Despondent. Sadness from unhappy love. Sadness, great depression, with sleeplessness. Weeping improves symptoms. Weeping from music. A broken heart with the sensation that the heart will fly to pieces. Melancholy, dull lethargic withslowpulse. Excessive desire to be alone. Tries to escape if others force themselves on her. Stammers when talking to strangers. Converses with absent people. Unsympathetic. Dullness of senses. Thinking difficult. Weak memory. Forgets everything immediately. Insane obstinacy and disobedience, with desire to escape. Suspicious. Irritability after sex. Lascivious thoughts in old men with enlarged prostate.

Head - Face bluish. Dullness of head as from intoxication, with increased mental activity. Heaviness of head with sensation as if it would fall backward. Brain feels fatigued and weak, from weak action of heart. Confusion, fullness and noises in head. Crashes, cracking in head, on dropping to sleep. Bores head in the pillow. Pulls the hair. Violent, lancinating pains, in vertex and occiput. Spastic hemicrania. Throbbing, in forehead. Sharp, shooting pains in forehead, after drinking cold water or eating ice cream. Pressure in forehead when exerting mind or thinking of it. Sharp pains in temples, evening and night.

Eyes - Yellowish, red eyes. Both the eyes turned to left. Burning in eyes and stitches darting through them. Lachrymation, worse in bright light or cold air. Veins distended on eyes. Blueness of eyelids. Swelling of lower lid. Mydriasis. Lid margins red, swollen. Agglutinated lids in morning. Catarrhal inflammation of eye. Meibomian glands inflamed. Chronic conjunctivitis. Detachment of retina. Cataract. Painless obscuration of lens. Irregular pupils. Pupils dilated and insensible.

Ears - Otalgia with contractive pains in the ears. Swelling of the parotids and behind the ear. Veins distended on ears. Single stitches behind the ears. Hissing before the ears like boiling water, with hardness of hearing.

Nose - Coryza with hoarseness. Pain at the root of the nose, after vomiting. Nosebleeds.

Face - Paleness of the face. Cyanosis. Blue color of the lips and eyelids. Bluish swelling of the lips. Dryness of the lips. Eruptions on the lips. Eruptions with gnawing itching in the cheeks and in the chin. Cramp-like and drawing pains in the cheekbones. Distended veins. Pores of the face black and suppurating.

Mouth - Soreness of mouth, gums and tongue. Aphthae. Stomatitis. Bitter taste. Taste flat, clammy, slimy. Sweet taste, with constant salivation. Copious salivation. Salivation after smoking tobacco. Scraped feeling in mouth. Severe toothache in a hollow tooth.

Throat - Scraped feeling in throat. Stinging in throat between acts of swallowing. Choking when he tries to swallow. Spasm of glottis with diarrhea and thirst. Edema of larynx. Frequent painless hoarseness. Hoarseness in early morning.

Stomach - Discomfort in stomach, even after a small quantity of food, or from mere sight or smell. Burning in stomach and into esophagus. Faintness, great weakness in stomach. Extreme anxiety in pit causing frequent deep sighs. Epi- gastric region tender. Neuralgic pain in stomach. Stomach burning, extending to esophagus. Gulping up of an acrid or tasteless fluid. Deathly nausea, with faint sinking in stomach. Persistent nausea and vomiting with clean tongue (Ip.). Excessive nausea, not better vomiting. Nausea before and after urination. The mere sight or smell of food excites nausea. Nausea early on rising, with thirst. Faintness and vomiting from motion. Nausea and vomiting of pregnancy. Vomits easily, on taking anything into stomach. Vomiting, with extremely feeble and irregular pulse. Vomiting of bile, mucus.

Abdomen - Ascites. Severe abdominal pains. Pain in left side apparently in descending colon and under false ribs. Tenderness of epigastrium. Pulsation in the abdominal aorta and epigastric constriction. After a meal, pressure and inflation of the abdomen and of the stomach. Sensation as if intestines were twisted. Gripingpain. Incarcerated hernia. Bowel symptoms alternating with chest symptoms.

Rectum - Evacuation forcible. Constipation. White, chalk-like, ashy, pasty stool. Diarrhea during jaundice. Watery diarrhea. Stool mixed with mucus. Frequent, distressing and exceedingly offensive stools. Stools, perfectly flat and shaped like a boat. Renewed desire and urging in rectum after stool. Sensations - As if the heart would stand still if he moved, must hold the breath and keep still (Gels, has “must keep moving or the heart would stop”). As if heart had torn itself loose and were swaying to and fro by a thin thread. As if the lungs were constricted and tied up in bundles. As if the stomach would sink into abdomen. As if something were running out of urethra, as of a weight attached to stomach, as if the internal parts were grown together. As if the brain were loose, as if something fell forward in the head on stooping, as if the brain were made of fine glass and shattered at a blow.

Male - Dropsical swelling of genitals (Sulph.). Prostate enlarged, in elderly men. Hydrocele (left), scrotum looks like a bladder filled with water. Testicles swollen. Bruise-like pain in testes with swelling. Contusive pain in right testicle. Balanitis with edema of prepuce. Gonorrhea (Med.). Profuse, thick, yellow-white gonorrheal discharge. As if something were running out in urethra after emission. Irritation of sexual organs, with painful erections, night and day. Desire strongly excited, frequent erections and pollutions. Atonic nightly emissions after sex. Spermatorrhea. Pollutions always with lewd dreams and subsequent pains in penis. Early morning erections. Sexual desire without ability.

Female - Menses scanty and too late. Labor-like pains in abdomen and back before menses. Menorrhagia. Uterine hemorrhage. Dropsy of uterus. Bleeding from lungs instead of menses. Menopausal period, sudden flushes of heat followed by great debility, least motion causes palpitations. Leucorrhea. Lascivious state of fancy day and night. Nymphomania. Food - Want of appetite, sometimes even with a clean tongue. Smell of food causes violent nausea and gagging. Desirefor bitter things. Desire for beer. Bread tastes bitter. Continuous thirst with dry lips. Thirst for acid, sour, cold drinks. Cough worse cold drinks. Worse after meals. Worse cold food or drinks, alcohol. Worse after drinking. Worse from spirituous liquors. After cold water or ice cream, sharp pain in forehead extending to nose.

Chest - Angiria pectoris. Great weakness in chest, can't bear to talk. Suffocative painful constriction ofchest, as if internal parts were grown together. Creeping all Digitalis purpurea over skin. Smarting in the chest. Tension in the chest with necessity to breathe deeply. Contractive, pressing pain in the chest, when sitting with the body bent. Sensation of soreness. Congestion in the chest. Raw, sore feeling in chest, with cough. Trembling in chest. Constitutions - Nervous lymphatic constitutions. Children with very pale complexions, light hair, scrofulous.

Heart - Sinking feeling at heart. Sudden sensation as if heart stood still. Sensation as if heart would cease beating if he moves, must hold the breath and keep still (opposite of Gels.). Precordial anxiety, with sensation of weakness in forearm. Audible throbbing of heart. Metallic sounding heart-beat. The least movement causes violent palpitations. Palpitations with depression from grief. Angina pectoris. Attacks of angina, worse raising arms with tingling in arm and fingers. Constant pain or anguish in region of heart. Frequent sharp pains in heart. Irregular heartbeat especially with mitral valve disease. Cardiac failure following fevers. Heart tired after sprains. Hypertrophy with dilatation. Cardiacfailurefollowing fevers. Cardiac dropsy. Pericarditis, copious serous exudation. Rheumatism of heart with irregular pulse. Pulse weak and quickened by least movement. Pulse small, weak and excessively slow, irregular, intermitting. Very slow pulse. Especially slow when at rest, every other beat intermits, but accelerated by the slightest movement. Thready pulse.

Back - Stiffness and tension of the muscles of the neck and of the nape of the neck. Drawing pains in the back and in the loins, as after a chill. Bruise-like pains in the loins on blowing the nose. Tearing, sharp, aching and cutting pains, in neck. Lacerating, and sharp pains in lumbar region.

Limbs - Rheumatic pain in joints. Swelling of the feet. Sensation as if a red-hot wire suddenly darted through legs. Stinging pains in muscles of upper and lower limbs. Piercing pains in joints. Shining, white swelling of joints. Muscular debility. Numbness, heaviness or paralytic weakness, worse left arm. Fingers become numb easily and frequently. Coldness of hands and feet. One hand hot, the other cold. Nails blue. Fingers swell at night.

Sleep - Lethargy. Continuous sleepiness. Drowsy in the day. Unrefreshing, agitated sleep. Somnolency interrupted by fits of convulsive vomiting. Uneasy sleep at night on account of constant desire to urinate. Frequent waking, as from anxiety. Nightmares. Starts from sleep in alarm that he is falling from a height in a dream. Dreams of falling from a height or into water. Dreams with jerking and electriclike sensations through the body.

Skin - Dry, arid heat of skin. Paleness of the skin. Cyanosis. Bluish skin particularly at the eyelids, lips tongue and nails. Blue distended veins. Cold skin. Dropsy. Elastic white swelling of whole body. Itching and jaundiced. Gnawing itching increasing to intolerable burning pricking. Corrosive itching. Erythema, deep red, worse on back like measles. Measly eruptions on back. Sebaceous follicles ulcerate. Skin painful to touch. Desquamation of the skin.

Modalities - Better when stomach is empty. Better from weeping. Better lying flat on back. Better sitting erect. Better rest. Better in open air, cool air. Worse from lying on left side. Worse sitting erect. Worse being raised up in bed. Worse touch, pressure. Worse motion. Worse exertion. Worse sexual abuse or excess. Worse from food. Worse smell of food. Worse cold food or drinks, alcohol. Worse after meals. Worse music. Worse from cold air, cold weather. Worse changes of weather. Worse heat. Worse night. Worse waking in the morning.

Tongue - Blue tongue and lips. Tongue blue, thick, flabby. Tongue clean with nausea and vomiting. Veins distended on tongue. Tongue pale. Tongue coated white. Vertigo - Constant dizziness with ringing in ears. Vertigo, when walking or riding. Vertigo with trembling. Vertigo on rising from sitting, with very slow pulse. Vertigo from cardiac or hepatic disorders. Vertigo with anxiety and faintness. Vertigo as if faintness would occur. Vision - Diplopia. Dim vision. Dark bodies like flies, before eyes. Change in acuteness of perception of shades of green. Objects appear green and yellow. Sees Digitalis purpurea hairs before his eyes. Loss of vision and many symptoms with anemia of retina and optic nerve. Hemiopia, as if upper part of field of vision were covered by a dark cloud. Optical illusions in bright or prismatic colors. COMMENTS - Slow, weak, irregular and intermittent pulse. Acute cyanosis (Carb-v.). Palpitations, with hot flashes. Prostration from slight exertion. Restlessness with a great nervous weakness. Lassitude, mental and bodily. Faintness. Convulsions with retraction of head, syncope and collapse. History of helping reduce or control aneurysm. Vertigo, dizziness as if intoxicated. Pneumonia and pleurisy. Senile pneumonia. Asthmatic sufferings as from hydrothorax. Respiration is painfully restricted at night, when lying down or in the day, when walking or seated. In the morning, suffocating constriction of the chest, forcing the patient to rise up in the bed. Delirium tremens in high livers, stomach and liver diseases with the mental state of the drug. Enlarged, sore, and painful liver. Deathly sinking in the epigastrium. Every shock, like bad news, strikes her in the epigastrium. Portal engorgement. White, pasty stools. Constant irritation or urge to urinate. Urine can be dark brown. Dribbling of the urine. Nausea and vomiting, worse from smell of food, not better by vomiting. Violent nausea with clean tongue. The food eaten comes up by mouthfuls, cannot expectorate without vomiting. Terrible pain at root of nose after vomiting. Thirst for water. Enlarged prostate in elderly men, with lascivious thoughts. Prostate enlargement and weaknesses with concomitant heart disease. Impotence. History of gonorrhea. Yellow-white urethral discharge. People with a history of excess, particularly sex and alcohol, with weakened heart or liver. Discharged blood coagulates slowly or not at all. Distended veins in eyes, ears, lips and tongue. Blue skin. Absence of fever. Teste classed Dig. with Bry. and Ign. He noted that there is an “anxious and concentrated sadness with sleeplessness at night. owing to pains at the heart: for instance from unhappy love, especially in women of brown complexions, firm and obstinate dispositions. In such cases far preferable to Ignatia.” Ross regarded the indications as being: “dry cough with mucus rales and no expectoration or only "prune juice' expectoration, cyanosis, cold limbs, feeble intermittent pulse, deathly nausea or gone sensation at epigastrium.” Malcolm Macfarlan reported Dig. having produced severe urethritis, phimosis and strangury. He cured with it many cases of gonorrhea. Ballard cured a man of headache and dizziness, originating probably in gonorrhea suppressed several years before. He complained of feeling bad about the head after drinking and this keynote symptom was elicited: “after drinking cold water the pain would seat itself in the forehead and extend down the nose.” RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., China. Compare: (1) Crat. - a true heart tonic. (2) Adon., Kalm., Spig., Liatris, Serum ang. (3) Nerium odorum - resembles in heart effects Digitalis, but also has an action like Stry. on spinal cord. Spasms appear more in upper part of body. Palpitations, weak heart will be strengthened by it. Lock-jaw. (4) Digitoxinum. Nit-s-dulc. increases actionofDig. (5)Conval- laria - heart disease with vertigo and digestive disturbances. Compatible: Bell., Bry., Cham., Lyc., Nux-v. Incompatible: China. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Enlarged, sore, painful liver. Soreness over region of liver, with jaundice. Liver, hard and painful. Jaundice from induration. Hypertrophy of the liver. Jaundice with heart disease. Lungs - Cardiac asthma. Slow, asthmatic attack early in morning. Great weakness in the lungs. Lungs feel compressed. Dyspnea, constant desire to breathe deeply. Breathing irregular, difficult. Deep sighing. Breathing slow, worse talking, walking, drinking cold things. Cannot bear to talk (Stan.). Suffocates when he drops to sleep, fearof suffocation at night. Can only breathe in gasps, each one seeming as if it would be the last. Chronic bronchitis, passive congestion of the lungs, giving bloody sputum due to failing myocardium. Expectoration, sweetish like boiled starch, mixed with bloody mucus. Yellow, jellylike mucus, difficult expectoration. Cannot expectorate without vomiting. Moist rales, yet cough dry. Senile pneumonia. Emphysema with heart disease. Edema of lungs. Hydrothorax.

Kidneys - Nephritis after scarlatina. Uremia. Contracted kidneys. Profuse and frequent emission of clear pale urine. Frequent urination at night. Continued urging, urine in drops, dark, hot. burning. Suppressed urine. Ammoniacal and turbid urine. Brick-dust sediment. Urine thick, turbid, yellowish-brown, blackish, acrid. Diminished secretion alternating with copious secretion of watery urine.

Bladder - Cystitis, after passing a few drops the desire to urinate is increased and the patient walks about in great distress. Urethritis, phimosis, strangury. Full feeling after urination. Urine, suppressed. Sharp cutting or throbbing pain at neck of bladder. Difficult urination. Pain, as if a straw was being thrust back and forth, worse at night. Constriction and burning, as if urethra was too small. Dragging in bladder as if distended, not better frequent urination. Contractive pain in bladder, during urination. Urine more easily retained in recumbent position. After urination pressure in bladder and burning in urethra. Breasts - Shuddering at the breasts. Causations - Ill effects of high living, sexual abuse or excessive alcohol intake.

Cough - Dry cough, on deep inspiration. Cough followed by great prostration. Cough after eating, with vomiting of food. Cough causes pain in shoulders and arms or sore, raw feeling in the chest. Cough from suppressed menses. Hemoptysis with weak heart or from chronic bronchitis, before menses. Hollow, deep, spasmodic cough, excited by roughness and scratching in palate and in trachea.

Perspiration - Cold, clammy sweat. Copious sweat at night. Perspiration after the chill, no heat intervening. Sweats on upper part of body, on face. Sweats during cough. Covered with copious perspiration, without relief of heart symptoms. Cold sweat, on body, warm on palms of hands.

Temperature - Chills alternating with heat. Coldness in the hands and in the feet with cold perspiration. Chilliness and shivering of the whole body. Chills with head and redness of the face. Internal chills with external heat. Chilliness before stool. Frequent and sudden flushes of heat, followed by nervous weakness, at menopausal period. Sudden hot flushes, with palpitation from least motion. Heat of body with cold sweat of face. During cough. General violent heat, with swollen veins and rapid pulse. Fever with profuse sweat. Heat of one hand and coldness of the other.

name: Digitoxinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Faintness. Phlegmon. Suppuration. Vision disordered. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - digox. Digitoxinum. Digitoxin. “Crystallized digitaline” of Nativelle. Neither a glucoside, nor an alkaloid. N. O. Scrophu- lariaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Faintness. Phlegmon. Suppuration. Vision disordered. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC…
full:
PHARMACY - digox. Digitoxinum. Digitoxin. “Crystallized digitaline” of Nativelle. Neither a glucoside, nor an alkaloid. N. O. Scrophu- lariaceae. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Faintness. Phlegmon. Suppuration. Vision disordered. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Digitoxinumis made from Digitalis dissolved in chloroform. The most active principle of Digitalis, Digox. has yellow vision, phlegmonous inflammation going on to suppuration, and very marked and distressing nausea, aggravated by champagne and aerated waters. Faintness, rapid loss of power. Prostration, limbs refuse their service, cannot rise from bed without assistance.

Eyes - Weak sight. Features of friends seemed to swim and become indistinct. Objects in room run together without any outlines, can only distinguish some very dark or bright, or large or small images in the field of vision. All objects, especially bright ones, seem in a slightly yellow light.

Face - Paleness and collapsed appearance of face. Food - Aversion to food.

Stomach - Faint feelings, nausea and discomfort. Carbonated waters and ordinary drinking water aggravated the nausea. Violent vomiting, bilious-colored masses of mucus, preceded, accompanied and followed by retchings. Vertigo - Faintness, rapid loss of power. Slight vertigo with nausea and faintness. COMMENTS - Digitox. was proved by Kopfe, who took a single dose of 2 mg. at 10 a. m. It began to take effect in an hour, producing faintness, nausea and slight vertigo, which increased until he was obliged to hurry home at 1 o'clock to avoid vomiting in the street. He was too weak to walk and had to take a carriage. He went to bed immediately and remained in bed three days and part of the fourth. The pulse had remained regular and at the usual rate. 80 to 84, but at 2 o'clock was 58 and intermitting. Constant excessive nausea preventing sleep. Vomiting dark greenish masses of mucus gave instant relief, which only lasted a short time. Then, the pulse went down to 42 intermitting after every two beats, the heart- beats and intermission being plainly felt in the chest. The limbs refused service in spite of the greatest exertion of will power. Sight became weak, faces of friends were indistinguishable and he knew them only by their voices. Objects ran together without outlines, so that he could only distinguish some very dark or bright, or large or small images in the field of vision. All objects, especially bright ones, seemed in a slightly yellow light. Yellow vision was persistent, lasting eight days. The nausea continued and was aggravated by drinking champagne, aerated waters and ordinary water. The second night was very restless with partial sleep interrupted four times in an hour by confused, anxious dreams and frightful fantasies. In the evening of the third day he was able with effort to eat a little and did not vomit. On the fourth day he was up a little and felt better, was able to eat a little meat and drink as much water as he wished. On the fifth day he was able to walk out a little, leaning on the arm of another. During the three succeeding days the symptoms gradually disappeared. With sound sleep and extraordinary appetite, physical strength and normal vision returned. In some experiments made on dogs, it was noted that subcutaneous injections were invariably followed with phlegmonous inflammation proceeding to suppuration. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dig. - worse from drinking' is marked in both. (2) Digitalinum. Cina and Santonine in yellow vision. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Chest - Oppression and anxiety in chest. Heartbeat and intermissions plainly felt.

Limbs - Prostration. Limbs refuse their service, cannot rise from bed without assistance. Phlegmonous inflammation going on to suppuration.

Sleep - No rest on account of distressing nausea and weakness. Restless sleep with partial sleep, interrupted by confused, anxious and frightful dreams.

Pulse - Slow, intermittent pulse. Pulse at first normal and regular, then markedly slow, intermittent, dicrotic and then tric- rotic. Pulse easily excited by the slightest excitement or physical exertion.

Whitlow.

HOMEOPATHIC - Burt, who made a proving of this remedy, said “The grand sphere for the use ofDioscoreais among colic of the intestines and stomach, where the celiac and umbilical plexuses are in a state of great hyperesthesia, the pain and spasm being unbearable.” Dios, resembles Coloc. in colicky pains, but is better by stretching out and by moving about, while Coloc. is better bending double and worse by motion. Colic pain, better from bending backwards. Gallstone colic. Kidney colic. Pains are remittent and paroxysmal. Pains are unbearable, sharp, cutting, twisting, griping, grinding, that dart about or radiate to distant parts. Pains suddenly cease in one part, then start in another part. Nervous shuddering from pain. Pain in the bowels, spasmodic, twisting, writhing, drawing, lancinating, pulsating, burning. Pains radiate upwards and downwards. Frequent sharp, darting pains from one part to another. Pains spread, especially from abdomen to distant parts. Flatulence after meals in stomach or bowels. Violent colic from fasting, some excess in eating, or some dietary error, as eating old cheese or uncooked fruit, pastry, etc., especially if they are great tea drinkers. Acts on the nerves, abdominal, sciatic and on spinal cord. Chorea with seminal emissions. Painful disorders of abdominal or pelvic viscera. Persons of feeble digestive powers, tea-drinkers with much flatulence. Useful for whitlow. MIND - Cross, nervous and easily troubled. Depressed after seminal emissions. Uses wrong words, opposite, putting right for left or vice versa. Calls things by wrong names. Conversation aggravates. Fear in a crowd. Fear of people. Aversion to women. Restlessness better walking. Feels tired, yet still keeps walking around room.

Head - Dull pain in both the temples. Temples as if squeezed in a vice, better pressure but worse afterwards. Sharp pain in temples. Head feels as if tied with a band. Sensation as if head were crushed down. Digging, cutting pain in the temples in occiput, over eyes. Buzzing in head. Confused, full head. Fullness in head speedily followed by spasmodic pains in abdomen.

Eyes - Eyes weak, sore and smarting. Sharp pain from right eye to occiput. As if a round ball or stick in the eyes. Hot air steaming out of them. Lachrymation, hot tears, smarting, wants to keep lids closed. Eyelids stiff in morning. Agglutination of the lids mornings.

Ears - Dull, pressing pains in front of both ears. Both ears feel suddenly stopped up, and are sore to touch. Sharp pain in front and behind the ears. Pains in ears, worse blowing nose or coughing. Itching in internal ears, worse right. Nausea felt in ears. Small balls of wax fall out. Buzzing noise in head. Ringing, buzzing, during headache.

Nose - Soreness of nostrils. Irritation of nasal passages with much sneezing. Nose stopped up, dry. Discharge of bright red blood from left nostril. Watery discharge. Any bad smell remains in the nose for a long time. Offensive, bad smell in nose as if bilious.

Face - Full, grinding, drawing, digging or sharp, darting pains at angle of left lower jaw. Spasmodic closing of jaws, biting tongue when neither eating nor drinking. Lips dry, commissures sore. Little pimples with black heads. Corners of mouth sore. Soreness and sharp aching pain in both parotid glands.

Mouth - Mouth dry and bitter in morning. Bitter, bad taste. Dry mouth, but full of sticky mucus, no thirst. Saliva runs out while asleep. Soreness of gums and roof of mouth. Spasmodic closure of the jaw.

Throat - Irritation, burning and smarting in throat and fauces. Fauces rough, dry, frequent inclination to swallow, but it causes nausea and shudderings. Belching gas, but throat so dry it prevents the escape of gas. Constricted feeling as from something tight about neck, makes breathing difficult. Itching in left tonsil. Sharp pain in tonsil up to ear. Left tonsil smarts and itches, with inclination to cough. Constant desire to swallow, but it causes nausea and irritated feeling in throat, left side.

Stomach - Dyspepsia of a flatulent character, resulting from tea, after excess in eating, errors in diet. Belching of large quantities of offensive gas, sour, bitter gas. Heartburn. Burning in the stomach. Burning, aching pains in stomach during pregnancy. Heartburn in pregnant women. Violent, colicky pains, causing desire to bend double, which makes him worse, must walk erect. Painful cramps in stomach. Hiccoughs. Neuralgia of stomach. Faint, uneasy feeling at stomach. Sinking at the pit of the stomach. Sensation as if a stone in stomach. Sharp cramping pain in the pit of the stomach, then belching, hiccough and passing flatus, better standing erect. Gastrodynia. Nausea. Vomiting, heartburn and gastralgia during menses. Vomiting and purging.

Abdomen - Colic, pains radiate from abdomen to back, chest, arms. Colic, worse bendingforwards and while lying. Colic, better bending backwards, walking about. Twisting and sharp, cutting pains in bowels. Excessive flatulent colic, after excess in eating, errors in diet, or in tea drinkers. Flatulent distension after meals in persons of weak digestion. Rumbling with emission of much flatus. Side pains. Pains suddenly shift to different parts, appear in remote localities, as fingers and toes. Pains in a small spot. Griping, cutting in hypogastric region with intermittent cutting in stomach and small intestines. Bowels sore and tender on pressure. Abdomen tympanitic and very sensitive to pressure. Pressure causes rumbling.

Rectum - Burning at anus, after loose morning stool. Burning in rectum during stool. Frequent, urgent, hurried desire for stool. Loose stools with much straining. Constipation. Diarrhea, worse in morning, driving out of bed, followed by exhaustion and weakness. Yellowish diarrhea, followed by exhaustion, as if flatus and feces were hot. Very offensive flatulence. Alternate constipation and relaxation during pregnancy. Stools do not relieve the pain in abdomen. Darting from anus to liver. Itching in rectum. Hemorrhoids with darting pains to liver. Hemorrhoids look like bunches of grapes or red cherries, protrude after stool with pain in anus. Involuntary discharge of slimy mucus from anus. Stools slimy, dark-colored, bilious, very offensive, light mushy. Black, hard, dry, lumpy stool. Sensations - As if top of head was lifted off. As if temples were in a vice. As if head tied with a band (also neck). As if sticks, etc. in eyes, as if hot air streamed out of them. As if tongue burnt. As if a stone were in stomach. In a small spot in abdomen sensation as if drawn forcibly upward and backward to spine.

Male - Relaxation and coldness of organs. Pains shoot into testicles from region of kidneys. Strong smelling sweat on scrotum and pubes. Pain and spasm of spermatic cord. Erections lasting all night. Diminished sexual desire. Emission of semen during sleep. Seminal emission without erection, then weakness, especially in the knees. Constant excitement of genitals.

Female - Violent dysmenorrhea, pains radiate from the uterus. Dysmenorrhea, spasmodic uterine colic, pains suddenly fly to distant parts. False labor pains. After-pains. Cramps in fingers and toes alternating with uterine pains. Pregnancy with severe pain with cramps in fingers and toes, alternating with false labor pains. Food - Disgust for food, with flat, clammy, bitter orsweet taste. Flatulence after meals. Very sleepy after dinner. Thirst during pain in bowels. After eating, nausea and faintness. Colic, after excess in eating, errors in diet, or in tea drinkers.

Chest - Angina pectoris with labored breathing and feeble action of the heart. Chest pains radiate to both the arms. Pain along sternum and extending into arms. Tight feeling all along sternum. Chest doesn't seem to expand on breathing. Burning behind top of sternum. Constitutions - Suited to persons of feeble digestive powers, old or young.

Heart - Angina pectoris, pain back of sternum into arms, labored breathing. Feeble action of heart. Pain through chest and tightness across, especially with flatulence. Sharp pain in region of heart, arrests breathing, worse lying left side. Pulse intermitting.

Back - Lameness in back, in morning. Lameness worse stooping. Dull pain in back of neck, stiff. Severe backache. Sharp pains in the back. Spinal cord feels bruised all the way up and down. Spinal hyperesthesia. Itching over right scapula. Drawing pains in sacrum, sacroiliac joint. Breasts - Pain in region of nipples. Causations - Ill effects of excessive eating, tea drinking, fasting. Masturbation. Errors in diet.

Limbs - Aching and stiffness in joints. Cold limbs during colic. Sciatic pain (right) shoot down the thighs with burning or numbness worse motion, sitting up, better standing on toes, lying still. Limbs feel weak, especially knees, after seminal emission. Hamstring seems too short (Cimx.). Cramps in flexors of fingers and toes. Numbness of left hand. Pain in left shoulder. Grinding in elbows. Panaritium, early stage, pain, pricking, sharp, agonizing. Paronychia. Felons in beginning, when pricking is first felt.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from too intent thinking. Restless after 2 a. m„ must move, yet it hurts, he is so sore. First sleep late, wakes early. Many symptoms are worse after sleep, bitter mouth, pains in bowels, hard beating of heart. Aroused suddenly with slow, but hard beating of heart. Vivid dreams. Dreams of women. Dreams all night. Dreams with seminal emissions.

Skin - Itching and burning of various parts. Little pimples with black heads. Panaritium, early when pains are sharp and agonizing or when pricking is felt. Brittle nails.

Modalities - Better from stretching out. Better standing erect. Better bending back. Better motion, hard pressure. Better open air. Worse from tea. Worse eating. Worse night. Worse lying down. Worse evening. Worse bending forwards. Worse seminal emissions.

Teeth - Pains in front teeth. Sharp aching pain in an upper right molar. Toothache, as if the bare nerve was touched. Soreness of gums. Gums on inner side of front upper teeth swollen.

Tongue - Heavy brown coating on the tongue, in mornings, no thirst. Sides of tongue sore as if burnt. Bites the tongue, when not eating or drinking. Tip of tongue sore and brown, worse morning. Vertigo - Vertigo and dizziness, goes to right while walking. Vertigo inclined to fall backward. Faintness, worse sitting up in bed. Vertigo with numbness, worse lying down. Vertigo from onanism. Vertigo with heat in head, with sharp pains in forehead extending to ears. COMMENTS - Hale considered as a characteristic: “A constant pain, aggravated at regular intervals by paroxysms of intense suffering.” Any kind of colic or neuralgia with these characteristics may indicate Dios., which stands in the highest rank among stomach and abdominal remedies with important actions in many other spheres. Great faintness at stomach. Morning diarrhea. Pains worse at meals, better moving about, cannot sit still. Seminal emissions (passive) with weakness of knees. According to Cushing's proving, the primary effect of Dios, was to cause strongsmelling perspiration of the genitals, constant excitement with strong and frequent erections day and night, amorous dreams with emissions. Afterwards came relaxed genitals, absence of desire and emissions without erections. In the female sphere it has frequently cured dysmenorrhea, uterine colic and after-pains, also gastric disorders during pregnancy and the menses. J. B. Bell pointed out how closely the throat symptoms of Dios, resemble the initial stage of a cold when it has attacked the fauces and before it has spread to the nose or chest. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Cham., Camph. Tamus belongs to the same N. O. Verat. relieved pain in right temple. Compare: (1) Coloc. - differs in modalities. (2) Bism., Bry. (3) Nux-v. - stomach,Cham.,Coloc., Ip., Kali- bi., Podo., Rhus-t., Rum., Stann., Sulph., (4) Aesc., Aloe., Coll., Nux-v. (hemorrhoids), Sars. (urinary symptoms). (5) Calc., Cann-i. Gels., Calad., Agn., Nux-v. Phos. (sexual organs), Cimic., Aesc., Aloe., Bry., Nux-v. (headache), Sil. (whitlow). Verat., (6) Caps. - pain in ears on coughing. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Sharp pains from liver, shooting upward to right nipple. Gallbladder colic, pain extending to the chest, back and arms. Gallbladder colic worse bendingforward, better bending backwards. Lungs - Tight feeling all along sternum. Chest does not seem to expand on breathing. Short-winded. Dyspnea from slight exertion. Hacking cough from irritation and tickling low down in the throat. Cough, with pain in region of umbilicus and temples, brown tongue, weak knees. Dull, aching or sharp, cutting pains in both lungs from front to back or vice versa. Sharp cutting pain from left axilla tonipple and down side deep in lung.

Kidneys - Kidney colic, pain extending to testicles and the limbs. Writhing with crampy pains with passing of kidney stone. Spasmodic stricture of urethra with pain about navel, better by pressure, pressure on rectum, paroxysmal colic. Constant desire to pass urine.

Cough - Hacking cough from irritation and tickling low down in throat. Cough with pain in epigastrium. Cough with dull pain in temples, brownish-yellow tongue, weak knees.

Perspiration - Sweats easily when chilly. Sweat, cold, clammy or of strong odor, on genitals. Sweats from least exertion. Cold, clammy sweat, all over, in angina pectoris.

Temperature - Chills with bitter mouth. Chills with aching bones, backache. Chills pains in lungs, sore throat, etc. Chills commences over left scapula, spreading over back. Chills running down back. Chill on rising. Chills, couldn't get warm.

HOMEOPATHIC - In addition to the DPT, this vaccine contains formaldehyde, a mercury derivative and aluminum phosphate, and was incubated in animal entrails. Can attack and damage the immune and nervous systems. DPT vaccinations have been linked to sudden infant death syndrome, brain damage, autism, blindness, epilepsy and death. Learning disabilities and hyperactivity in children. Fevers, febrile convulsions, seizures, and diarrheas. Tendency to colds, flus, earaches, sore throats, etc. Terrible screams, rigid body with head bent back, eyes open. High pitched, inconsolable crying. Cri encéphalique, thin high-pitched eerie wailing. Persistent crying, continues for hours or days. Brief periods of sleep interrupted by long bouts of screaming. Insomnia and emaciation. Profoundprostration. Anorexia and weight loss. Hemolytic anemia, yellow skin, colorless lips. Respiratory distress, asthma, coughs, etc. Brain damage, comas, seizures and blindness. Dyslexia. Visual perception problems, auditory processing deficit, fine motor delay, and an attention span deficit. Learning disabilities. Cerebral palsy. Viral meningitis. MIND - Brain damaged children. Learning disabilities. Autism. Dyslexia, visual perception problems, auditory processing deficit. Hyperactivity, restless. Explosive, out of control emotions. Unable to sit still formore than a few minutes, cries easily without warning. Screaming temper tantrums. Cri encéphalique. Timid, nervous trembling fearful child. Passive, in a daze as if sleepwalking. Doesn't want to be held, rocked or fed. Screaming as if afraid of being dropped. Runs around the house and hid as if was frightened to death. Sudden fear while playing, with desire to be held. A great feeling of anxiety and doom. Hallucinations. Periods of unconsciousness. Coma.

Head - Head bent back with a rigid body. Viral meningitis.

Eyes - Eye twitching. Visual perception problems. Hallucinations. Blindness. Food - Anorexia and chronic weight loss. Pushes the food away. Hypoglycemia. Allergies to milk.

Ears - Chronic ear infections. Auditory processing deficit. Deafness.

Nose - Nasal congestion. Allergies, worse spring and fall. Constant runny nose, clear discharge. Nosebleed.

Mouth - Speech disorders.

Throat - Sore throat. COMMENTS - Harris Coulter recorded some reactions to DPT vaccines in his book A Shot In Die Dark: “Child collapses with white or ashen skin, and death-like unconsciousness. She'd turn blue and didn't appear to be breathing. She'd start breathing on being shaken with white skin and blue or purple blue around the mouth going to death. Nonresponsive, limp, flaccid, with screaming eyes rolled back in his head. “Sitting, staring ahead with eyes dilated and mouth open, her lips were blue and her body stiff. The right side of her body would tremble and she'd occasionally make sucking sounds. Brief ‘generalized bending' or ‘jack knife' spasms with sudden forward dropping of the head with adduction and flexion of the arms. “After a short period of staring, dropping head to chest and falling asleep with eyes open, progressed to starring and sudden violent jerking of upper body forward. Her hands would go straight up in the air, her feet would go straight out, she would clench her fists and hold her breath for 2 to 3 seconds, and then cry a high shrill cry.” “Tremor of intensity” in the hands and feet. “Opens eyes and mouth and utters a brief shout shortly after falling asleep” with or without fever. “Generally tonic-clonic, resistant to routine anticonvulsant therapy, and with poor intellectual prognosis.” Difficult or impossible to control with medication. Chronic seizures, grand mal, petit mal and localized. RELATIONS - To antidote the bad effects of DPT shots considerone of the following: Acute reactions - Ledum, Apis, Hyper., Bell., Cic., DPT in potency. Chronic reactions - Sil., Thuj., DPT in potency. Compare: ( 1 ) Diphtherinum., Pertussin. (2) Silica, Thuja. (3) Cham., Bell., Mosch., Nat-m., Apis, Cicuta, Cupr., Zinc. REFERENCES - Coulter.

Stomach - Projectile vomiting. Anorexia and chronic weight loss.

Rectum - Chronic diarrhea, yellow, curdy, strange smelling, offensive, and curdish. Dark green, almost black diarrhea, with clumps of mucus. Violent, explosive gas every few minutes.

Back - Arches back when crying, especially if being held.

Limbs - Loss of muscle control. Spasms of lower limbs. Flaccidparalysis. Hemiplegia. Hemiparesis. Paresis. Diptheria, pertussis, tetanus Lungs - Respiratory distress. Pneumonia. Bronchial asthma. Dyspnea. Spasmodic coughs day and night. Prolonged coughing attacks. Croupy hard cough with vomiting, must sit up. The coughs are like whooping cough.

Sleep - Excessive sleepiness. Deep stuporous sleep, unable to be awakened. Brief periods of sleep interrupted by long bouts of high pitched screaming.

Skin - Local reaction to injection, pain, redness. Hives. Red. purple, hot, swollen, walnut-size lump. Induration. Abscess. Swelling of face hands and feet.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse during sleep. Worse after vaccinations.

Blood - Hypoglycemia. Hemolytic anemia. Thrombocytopenia. Causations - Vaccinations. Reactions to the DPT vaccine. Constitutions - Delicate and sensitive children with a weak, damaged or undeveloped immune system.

Temperature - Fever occurring rapidly. Fever with hallucinations, convulsions.

HERBAL - Dirca palustris belongs to the same family as Daphne Indica and Mezereum and is the only American member of the family. Dirca has symptoms showing its relationship to the other two, but it has not been used extensively in practice.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dire, is a gastro-intestinal irritant inducing salivation, vomiting and purgation. Cerebral hyperemia, neuralgic pains with depression, palpitations and dyspnea. MIND - Time seemed to pass slowly. Absentminded.

Head - Pains all through the head, extending down into spine. Headache in temples extending inwards, better by hard pressure. Headache, throbbing and beating, worse by coughing or moving. Scalp feels dry and tight.

Eyes - Eyes sore and painful to touch. Photophobia on waking, continuing all day, especially from gaslight. Lids heavy. Sensation as if brows corrugated and as if brain were also drawn down.

Nose - Mucus coryza. Yellow thick nasal discharge. Bad smelling, nasal crusts with fetid secretion. Reflux of liquids by the nose or while vomiting. Nosebleeds. Fanning of the alae nasi with snoring.

Face - Face red, full and bloated in morning.

Mouth - Tongue coated smoothly ande venly white, dirty. Sour taste.

Throat - Stinging pains in larynx from without inwards, very sharp pricking pain and sensation of suffocation. Throat red, raw, acrid feeling, hurts to swallow food or liquids. Vertigo - Vertigo on walking, seems as if he would fall to left. COMMENTS - Vital depression, neuralgic pains in the head, trunk and limbs, many of the pains proceeding from without inward. Oppression and pains in the chest. Excitability of the heart’s action from the slightest motion. Disordered digestion. Weight at the stomach. Moist, white coated tongue. Sweetish expectoration. Rumbling of flatulence, colic better by bending forward, diarrhea and tenesmus, later constipation. Hot and restless at night, cannot sleep, dreams of dead bodies. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cann-i. - time passes slowly. (2) Ant-c. - tongue, Lyc. - constipation and flatulence. (3) Bry., Puls., Abies-n. - weight at stomach. (4) Stann. - sweet expectoration. REFERENCES Clarke.

Stomach - Empty belchings. Uneasy feeling as if a lump or weight in stomach.

Abdomen - Burning below umbilicus. Lancinations in the left hypochondrium with tympanites. Dull ache low down in pelvis, bearing down, not better by sitting or lying. Rumbling in bowels. Burning and uncomfortable sensation in bowels. Colic better bending forward and better by stool, but smarting in anus remains.

Rectum - Throbbing, stitching pains in anus. Soreness and smarting, worse after stool. Tenesmus and straining. Constipation, urgent desire, but passes only frothy mucus. Dry, sticky feces. Diarrhea stools, sudden, gushing, watery, thin, yellowish fecal.

Female - Uterus seems too low and as if it would prolapse during stool. Menses two days too early, less copious and prolonged than usual. Food - No thirst.

Heart - Excitability of heart's action from least motion. Palpitations on going up slight elevation. Pulse suddenly becomes weak and irregular.

Back - Heavy pain across back and through loins in region of kidneys.

Limbs - Dull, neuralgic pain in both shoulders, cannot keep them still. Neuralgic pains in legs. Muscles of thighs sore and stiff. Lungs - Sharp pain in right thorax running down into abdomen and up into left shoulder. Great dyspnea from exertion, from walking up a slight elevation. Cough, worse morning, raising offensive, sweetish-tasting mucus.

Sleep - Sleepy, but unable to sleep. Dreams of dead bodies.

Skin - Dry, hot palms, feel withered. Dry skin.

Modalities - Colic better by bending forward, headache better by pressure. Pains in the bowels are better by stool. Motion aggravates most symptoms, walking aggravates vertigo and pain in bowels.

Bladder - Pain and soreness in region of bladder.

Temperature - Low temperature, chilliness with palpitations, hypotension. Chilly, then hot. Subfebrile state.
