Itching is better from cold water, but it burns the skin and causes trembling. Senile pruritus. Itching excessively at night. Neuralgia following herpes zoster. Exalted nervous sensibility, as in dentition. Gums intensely sensitive, seem to itch. Pain in the throat on right side below angle of jaw as if a splinter were embedded vertically in it. Yellow spots all over. Jaundice. Hemorrhoidal diathesis. A right-sided medicine with pronounced liver and skin symptoms.

Eyes - Eyes yellow. Pain in right eye. Eruption on margin of eyelids.

Ears - Sudden dart of pain in right ear, later in left.

Face - Face yellow. Circumscribed redness of one cheek. Swelling of face, especially of lips. Prickling, itching of face. Pain in right maxilla.

Mouth - Strong taste of blood in mouth with cough. Gums irritated, wants them continually rubbed, dentition. Pain in gums prevents sleep. Soreness and tenderness of gums, even in teething children. Dull aching in a carious tooth, right side. Pregnancy - Intolerable itching all over body in pregnant women, worse at night, preventing sleep, worse from scratching, no perceptible eruption on the skin.

Throat - Pain in throat, worse swallowing, below right angle of jaw, as if splinter were imbedded vertically. Pain in right throat, a subdued, contraction sensation, went to left side. Sudden sensation of a choking lump in throat. Slight fullness just behind posterior palatine arch. Roughness of throat. COMMENTS - Dry skin with severe itching without eruption, can scratch until they bleed (Alum.). Scratching increases the itching. Violent itching that prevents the person from sleeping at night. Restless. Severe idiopathic pruritus. Senile pruritus, yellow spots on the skin. Shingles, and pain after shingles (Mez., Rhus-t.). Herpes zoster. Itching with jaundice, hepatitis, liver involvement. Hepatitis. Jaundice. Gas and bloating (Lyc.), rumbling in the abdomen. Constipation, hemorrhoids. Worms. Ailments from a food allergy that aggravated the liver. Hodgkin's disease. Worse tight clothing (Lyc., Chin.), at night, in the heat of the bed. Generally a right sided remedy. Kraft recorded a striking cure with Dol. 1,200c of a woman who had symptoms of jaundice, white stools and desperate itching, preventing sleep at night. There was in addition, enormous distention of abdomen with continuous rattling of gas, intolerance of anything tight around neck or body intense restlessness, unable to sit still a minute. RELATIONS - Aconite antidotes it, and in “cases of dentition with fever Aconite should be given before Dolichos to prevent convulsions” (Hering). Dolichos follows Rhus-t. in herpes. Compare: (1) Rhus-t. cured herpes zoster afterfailure of Rhus-t. (2) Fago., Bell, -dentition. (3) Arg-n., Hep., Nit-ac. - throat. (4) Cann-i. - time passes slowly. Ant-c. - tongue. (5) Lyc. -constipation and flatulence. (6) Bry., Puls., Abies-n. - weight at stomach. (7) Stann. - sweet expectoration. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.Phatak.

Stomach - Noisy movement of flatus in stomach. Flatulent eructation. Vomits bile.

Abdomen - Bloated, swollen abdomen with constipation. Colic from getting feet wet. Pain in abdomen in right lumbar region. Bruised pain below umbilicus. Bruised pain left inguinal region. Pains in spleen with gravel.

Rectum - Constipation with intense itching. Constipation with liver complaint, during teething or pregnancy. White stools. Tenesmus with looseness of bowels. Pain in anus with stool. Hemorrhoids with burning sensation. Worms, threadworms.

Male - Impotence.

Chest - Pains through the apices of both lungs. Eruption on left axilla, spreading in rings forward to sternum and back to spine with much burning and smarting. Herpes zoster. Constitutions - Psoric and allergic constitutions.

Back - Pain over right carotid artery, as if a splinter was sticking there. Pain in muscles on right side of neck. Pain under left scapula continuing until herpes zoster breaks out.

Limbs - Dry, tettery eruptions on arms and legs, resembling herpes zoster. Aching pain in right arm and shoulder. Pain on the top of right shoulder. Aching soreness in last phalanx of right middle finger. Pain at root of nail of right index finger.

Sleep - Burning in skin is intolerable at night in bed. Sleepless.

Skin - Violent itching all over body without any visible eruption, swelling or rash, worse across shoulders, about elbows and knees, and hairy parts. Itching excessively at night. Skin burns at night in bed. Herpes zoster. Jaundice, skin yellow in spots or all over.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse scratching. Worse right side. Warmth aggravates itching at night. Cold water burns on the itching skin. Colic from getting feet wet.

Liver - Hepatitis. Jaundice. Swelling of liver, pain goes through from left lobe. Liver problems with itching. Lungs - Coughs on lying down at night, with wheezing and dyspnea.

Kidneys - Bedwetting with gravel. Small stonespass away. Ischuria with or without gravel.

name: Doryphora Decemlineata
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air. Worse from smoking. Worse warm room. Worse motion. Worse pressure aggravates (pain in kidneys)..
constitution: Backache. Delirium. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Fevers. Gastric, disorders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Kidneys, disorders. Myxedema. Parotiditis. Spleen, pain. Typhoid. Ulcerations. Urethritis.
keynote:
PHARMACY - dor. Doryphora decemlineata. Colorado potato-bug. Leptinotarsa decemlineata. Colorado Beetle. N. O. Coleóptera. Insecta. Tincture prepared by covering the crushed live beetles with alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Backache. Delirium.…
full:
PHARMACY - dor. Doryphora decemlineata. Colorado potato-bug. Leptinotarsa decemlineata. Colorado Beetle. N. O. Coleóptera. Insecta. Tincture prepared by covering the crushed live beetles with alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Backache. Delirium. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Fevers. Gastric, disorders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Kidneys, disorders. Myxedema. Parotiditis. Spleen, pain. Typhoid. Ulcerations. Urethritis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Doryphora in its general effects bears a strong resemblance to Cantharis. An extensive proving has been made and to this have been added the effects of poisoning from handling the insects and from inhaling the vapor when they have been burned or scalded. Two children inhaled vapor from a kettle in which some beetles had been placed, one died and the other recovered after a serious illness resembling typhoid fever. Local application causes ulceration. The blood will not coagulate, blood globules disorganized, enormous swelling of the whole body, swelling of the feet with burning, elastic swelling of whole body which will not pit on pressure (suggesting its applicability in myxedema). Acts on the urinary organs. Burning sensations. Burning and inflammation of glans penis. Burning in mouth, throat, gullet, stomach, abdomen, rectum and urinary passages (Canth.), strangury with urethritis and itching. Urethritis in children from local irritation. Gonorrhea and gleet. Swelling of body. A feeling of weight or heaviness. Great trembling in limbs. Fainting, weakness, prostration, collapse. Weakness, worse by talking (Stan.). Prostration after typhoid and diphtheria have been cured. MIND - Irritability. Bad temper. Delirium, talkative. Stupor with muttering and loud rumbling in bowels.

Eyes - Eyes red, sore, protruding, pupils much dilated, sight much impaired.

Face - Face bloated and red, giving appearance of a confirmed drunkard. Food - Loss of appetite, great thirst. Craving for something sour, symptoms worse by smoking.

Mouth - Violent heat in mouth. Dark brown coating on tongue. Offensive taste. Parotiditis.

Throat - Dry feeling in throat with desire to swallow. Throat raw and constricted. Burning in throat and down esophagus with stomachache and cough. RELATIONS - The local effect is antidoted by: earth, other antidotes are: vinegar and other vegetable acids, Stram. Compare: (1) Agar., Ail., Apis, Canth., Crot-h., Lach. (2) The Solanaceae. generally, as the beetle partakes of the properties of the plants it infests. (3) In non-coagulation of the blood, Hirudo. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting. Vomits dark, grumous acrid matter of dirty brown fluid with diarrhea.

Abdomen - Abdomen feels heavy, sore and tender, burning. Pain in spleen. Pain in bowels, worse by eating and drinking and by deep inspiration. Rumbling in bowels (with stupor).

Rectum - Morning diarrhea with pain in abdomen and burning in rectum. Bloody, slimy stools. Heaviness, intense pain in rectum.

Male - Itching and burning of glans penis, which is swollen and bluish red. Urethra inflamed with severe pain, especially when urinating.

Chest - Soreness and oppression of chest with sore throat.

Back - Pain in lumbar region.

Limbs - Severe trembling in limbs, especially right arm and leg.

Sleep - Sleepless until 12 a.m., then restless sleep with terrifying dreams. Tossing about all night. While sleeping, wild dreams, screams as if in great distress.

Skin - An abraded surface on the wrist of one engaged in picking the bugs became painful, a deep sloughing ulcer developed and the bones were laid bare.

Modalities - Better in open air. Worse from smoking. Worse warm room. Worse motion. Worse pressure aggravates (pain in kidneys).

Kidneys - Difficult urination. Retention of urine. Dysuria with burning, stinging pain. Urethritis. Urethra inflamed with excruciating pain when urinating. Pain in back and loins. Gonorrhea.

Temperature - Skin alternately cold, clammy and hot with fever. Coldness of hands and feet. High fever during night, restless and sleepless. Violent fever 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.

name: Drosera Rotundifolia
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from pressure. Better open air. Better motion. Better sitting up in bed. Better remaining quiet. Worse towards evening. Worse after midnight. Worse on lying down. Worse getting warm in bed, warmth. Worse drinking, cold food. Worse sour things, acids. Worse vomiting. Worse laughing, talking, singing. Worse stooping. Worse after measles. Worse during rest. Worse weeping..
constitution: Amblyopia. Anxiety. Asthma. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Colic. Coughs. Coxal- gias. Delusions. Epilepsy. Fears. Hemorrhage. Headaches. Hoarseness. Laryngitis. Measles. Nausea. Sciatica. Tuberculosis. Vomiting. Whooping, cough.
keynote:
PHARMACY - dros. Drosera rotundifolia. Round-leaved sundew. Drosera longifolia. N. O. Droseraceae. Tincture of active fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anxiety. Asthma. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Colic. Coughs. Coxal- gias. Delusions.…
full:
PHARMACY - dros. Drosera rotundifolia. Round-leaved sundew. Drosera longifolia. N. O. Droseraceae. Tincture of active fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Anxiety. Asthma. Bronchitis. Catarrhs. Colic. Coughs. Coxal- gias. Delusions. Epilepsy. Fears. Hemorrhage. Headaches. Hoarseness. Laryngitis. Measles. Nausea. Sciatica. Tuberculosis. Vomiting. Whooping, cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Teste, who placed Drosera in his Zincum group of medicines, mentioned that it grows in damp prairies, along the border of marshes and is avoided by animals. Barrich stated that when eaten by sheep it gives them a fatal cough. Hahnemann noted Dros. was the principal remedy for whooping cough. It was recommended by German physicians of the eighteenth century as a panacea for hoarseness, chest disorders and even for tuberculosis. Markedly affects the respiratory organs. Spasmodic, catarrhal and hemorrhagic effects. Spasmodic cough resembling whooping cough. Whooping cough, spasmodic cough of tuberculosis. Frequent spells of barking cough, worse evening and after midnight, where the patient holds his side. Every effort to raise a little phlegm ends in retching and vomiting, vomits if he cannot get up phlegm. Spasmodic and constricting pains in the abdomen, larynx, throat, chest, and hypochondria. Crawling in larynx. Feeling as if a soft substance were lodged in larynx, as a feather. Difficulty swallowing solids. Voice fails. Hemorrhages of bright red blood from nose and mouth (bloody saliva). Hemorrhages with vomit, stool, or expectoration. Bleeding, burning ulcers, cutting pains. Prickling, burning, itching eruptions, worse undressing, better scratching. Lancinations in brain. Convulsions. Epileptic attacks with rigidity, after, twitching limbs, hemoptysis and sleep. Sticking sharp pains. Gnawing, stinging pains in joints and long bones. Pains about hip joints. Sciatica with “pressing pains, worse from pressure from stooping from lying on painful part, better after rising from bed.” Stitches from left loin into penis, itching stitches in glans. MIND - Self-willed, obstinate, insists upon carrying out his plans. Pertinacity in executing resolutions. Very irritable. Easily angered, a trifle makes him besides himself. Impatience. Restlessness. Extremely uneasy. Can't concentrate on one subject, must change, changes to something else. Anxiety when alone. Anxiety with flushes of heat. Anxiety respecting the future. Anxiety in evenings. Dread of the night. Fear of ghosts. Fears being alone, but suspicious of friends. Great mistrust. Depressed mood, with gloomy forebodings. Homesickness. Discouraged. Sadness when alone in daytime. Delusions of persecution. Imagines he was being deceived by spiteful, envious people. Inclination to drown oneself. Anxiety in evening, as if it would impel him to commit suicide by drowning.

Head - Pressive pains in the head, especially in the forehead and cheekbones, sometimes with nausea and dizziness. Painful perplexity of the head, as after loud speaking. Pressing headache with stupefaction and nausea. Headache worse when stooping, better from motion and cold air. Beating and hammering in the forehead. Brain painfully affected by stepping. Pains, as if excoriation in the scalp. Smarting, burning pain in scalp. Corrosive itching on scalp. Itching, gnawing on forepart of scalp, better rubbing.

Eyes - Eyes very dry. Prominent from coughing, during measles, in convulsions. Shooting in the eyes towards the outside, especially on stooping. Severe sharp pains, from within outward, in eyes. Presbyopia and weakness of the eyes. Photophobia. Suspension of the sight or confusion and paleness of the letters while reading. As if gauze before the eyes. Dazzling by candlelight and daylight. Contraction of the pupils. Pupils first contracted, later dilated.

Ears - Shootings and squeezing in the ears, especially on swallowing. Right internal ear as if painfully pressed together. Sharp pain in ears. Hardness of hearing with buzzing, roaring, humming and drumming in the ears.

Nose - Profuse fluent coryza, in morning. Constant dryness of the nose. Black pores on the nose. Nosebleed, in the evening. Bleeding from coughing, stooping, on blowing the nose. Painful sneezing. Fluent coryza with sneezing. Sensitive to sour smells.

Face - Cold sweat oñ forehead. Pale with hollow cheeks and sunken eyes. Coldness of left half of face with stinging pains and dry heat of right half. Faceache worse pressure and touch. Burning and pricking sensation in the skin of the cheeks, below the eyes. Face hot and red with cold hands. Pressure in the cheekbones towards the outside, aggravated by pressure and contact. Lips cracked and constantly dry. Small pustules here and there on face with fine stitching sensation, worse when touched. Black pores in the chin.

Mouth - Putrid taste. Offensive breath during cough. Bleeding of the mouth. Bloody saliva. Profuse flow of watery saliva. Small round painless swelling in middle of tongue. Shooting pains in teeth from hot drinks. Fine prickings on dorsum of tongue. Stitching, smarting, in right side and tip of tongue. Loss of taste. Ulceration of velum palate. Ulcers on tongue. Whitish ulcer on tip of tongue.

Throat - Clergyman's sore throat with rough, scraping, dry sensation deep in the fauces. Hoarseness, laryngitis. Deep, hoarse voice. Voice, hollow, toneless, cracked, requires exertion to speak. Difficulty swallowing solid food, as from contraction of the throat. Stinging in throat when swallowing. Sensation in the throat, as if crumbs of bread had been stopped in it. Sensation as if a feather in larynx. Hawking of yellowish or greenish mucus. Ulceration of soft palate. Laryngeal tuberculosis with rapid emaciation. Vertigo - Vertigo when walking in open air. Vertigo with inclination to fall to the left side. Vision - Farsighted. Weakness of eyes when looking carefully at small things. Quivering before eyes. Dazzling, worse light, daylight or candlelight. Light or glare of fire dazzles before eyes. When reading, letters run together. Frequent vanishing of sight, when reading. Letters look pale and blurred. COMMENTS - A strong history of use in whooping cough. Spasmodic coughing at night ending in vomiting or nosebleeds. Choking, suffocating cough. Coughing spasms, worse lying down. Patients hold their chest when coughing (Bry.). Hoarseness. Worse after sleep, lying down, and stuffy rooms, better open air. Indications in the premonitory stage by pallor, weakness, anemia. Pallor of larynx, dry cough. Loss of appetite, emaciation. Chronic bronchitis, especially in the elderly. Difficulty swallowing during bronchitis or whooping cough, especially solids. Spasmodic croup (Aeon., Spong., Hep.). Redness and swelling of mucus membrane covering and between the arytenoid cartilages. Speaker's sore throat (Rhus-t., Arg., Arg-n.). Raises the resistance against tuberculosis, useful for tuberculosis of the lungs, larynx and bones in the joints. Laryngeal tuberculosis. Tuberculosis with vomiting of food from coughing, with gastric irritation and profuse expectoration. Tubercular glands. Tuberculosis with swollen glands, spasmodic coughing, and coughing up blood. Dr. Serrand of Paris maintained that Dros. has an important place in the prophylaxis of tubercle. He noted that sheep eating Drosera leaves acquire a nocturnal cough and die, and that the pleura of cats to which Drosera had been administered were found studded with tubercles. He commended it in cases of declared tuberculosis as well. He gave it in the low potencies. Buchmann of Alvensleben agreed with Hahnemann that Dros. in high potency should not be often repeated. Buchmann had a bronchial catarrh which used to attack him every spring and fall, characterized by a violent tickling cough, which almost drove him to distraction at night. Buchmann cured himself with Dros. lx. and tincture. A single dose as soon as the tickling in the larynx commenced sufficed to allay it at once and allowed him to rest and it was only repeated when the tickling returned. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph. Compare: (1) Bell., Cor-r., Cupr., Hyos., Ip., Samb., Meph., Op., Coc- c. (2) In inability to expectorate, Caust., Sep., Arn., Kali-c. (3) Teste considers Meny. the closest analog. (4) Fluoroform, 2 per cent, watery solution, 2 to 4 drops after paroxysms, considered specific for whooping cough. (5) Ouabain from leaves of Carissa schimperi, an arrow poison - respiratory spasm, whooping cough is cut short in first stage and reduced in frequency of attacks and hastens convalescence. (6) Chel., Corail., Cupr., Cast., Arg-n., Meny. Complementary: Nux-v. Compatible: Calc., Puls., Verat., Gnaph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Shootings and beatings in the pit of the stomach. Clawing sensation in the pit of the stomach. Difficulty in swallowing solid foods. Water brash. Bitter belching. Frequent hiccough. Nausea after fatty foods. Nausea at night or before dinner. Nausea with stupefying pressure in forehead. Vomiting at night and after dinner. V omiting ofblood. V omiting ofbile in the morning. Vomiting of slimy matter and of food during the cough.

Abdomen - Colic after taking acids, sour foods. Anxious feeling in hypochondria. Pains in the hypochondria, on coughing and on being touched. Must press on pain with the hand when he coughs.

Rectum - Frequent evacuations of bloody mucus, with cutting pains after the stool in the abdomen and small of the back. Outward pressing in rectum, independent of stool. Frequent stool with colic. Stools, soft fluid. Stools, white, slimy and stinking. Stools, with watery, odorless urine. Discharge of bloody mucus.

Male - Itching stitches in glans.

Female - Delay of first menses. Menses too late. Menses too scanty. Dark blood. Suppressed or retarded menses. Leucorrhea with labor-like pains, spasmodic pains in the abdomen. Food - Food seems tasteless. Bitter taste of food, especially of bread. Bitter taste of all food during pregnancy. Aversion to pork. Aversion to acids and sour foods. Thirst in the morning. Worse acids and sour foods. Worse after fatty food. Worse tobacco smoke.

Chest - Pains, like a subcutaneous ulceration in the sternum, on pressing upon chest. Pains in the chest on coughing and on sneezing, has to press his chest with the hand (Bry.). Stitches below axilla. Sharp pains in chest when sneezing or coughing. Constriction of chest, worse talking, singing. Oppression of the chest, as if something stopped the voice on coughing or speaking, or as if the breath could not be expelled. Tightness of the chest on coughing. Black pores on chest and shoulder. Constitutions - Tubercular constitution. Coughs - Coughs takes breath away. Whooping cough. Spasmodic, dry irritative cough. Attacks follow each other very rapidly, can scarcely breathe. Cough very deep and hoarse, worse after midnight. Deep barking or choking coughs. Cough and chokes, worse singing, talking. Periodicalfits of rapid coughing. Harassing and titillating cough in children, not during the day, but commencing as soon as the head touches the pillow at night. Prolonged and incessant coughs. Cough with violent tickling in larynx arouses one from sleep. Hemoptysis after convulsions. Yellow sputum, with bleeding from nose and mouth. Coughs followed by retching, vomiting.

Back - Stiffness at the nape of the neck with pains during movement. Bruise-like pains in the back, particularly early in the morning. Itching stitch in coccyx when sitting. Nape painful to touch. Neck stiff and painful on motion.

Limbs - All limbs feel lame. Bed feels too hard. Limbs feel as if beaten. Pain in the long bones. Pain in humerus at night only. Paralytic pains in the coxo-femoral joint and thighs. Laming pain in right hip joint and thigh with pain in ankle, must limp when walking. Stiffness in joints Drosera rotundifolia of feet. Fingers contract spasmodically with rigidity when grasping anything. Writer's cramp. Lungs - Asthma when talking. Asthma with contraction of the throat at every word uttered. Severe dyspnea threatening suffocation. Dyspnea with blueness of face and lips. Dyspnea with cold sweat on forehead. Dyspnea with vomiting of tough mucus. Oppressed breathing, as if holding back the breath. Yellow expectoration with bleedingfrom nose and mouth, retching. Bitter, or offensive expectoration. Salty expectoration. Bloody and purulent. Black clotted or bright red frothy blood.

Sleep - Sleepless, feels too wakeful. Sleep at noon and in the evening at sunset. Snoring during sleep and when lying on the back. Frequent starts with fright during sleep. Frequent waking with perspiration. Great weariness on waking. Vivid dreams. Anxious dreams. Dreams, over the wrong-doings of others. Dreams of thirst and drinking, awakes, is thirsty and must drink.

Skin - Eruption with painful soreness or stinging. Violent itching, while undressing. Itching better by rubbing or wiping with hand. Prickling, stinging, itching, gnawing in skin. Skin readily peels off when scratching. Measles. Black pores on chest and shoulder. Bleeding, burning ulcers.

Modalities - Better from pressure. Better open air. Better motion. Better sitting up in bed. Better remaining quiet. Worse towards evening. Worse after midnight. Worse on lying down. Worse getting warm in bed, warmth. Worse drinking, cold food. Worse sour things, acids. Worse vomiting. Worse laughing, talking, singing. Worse stooping. Worse after measles. Worse during rest. Worse weeping.

Kidneys - Frequent, profuse urination. Frequent urging with scanty emission, often drop by drop. Emission of urine at night. Brownish urine of a strong smell. Watery, inodorous urine with fetid stool of white mucus. Urine dark and of strong smell.

Perspiration - Warm perspiration at night. Copious sweat all over body. Sweats with cough bringing on violent retching. Cold sweat, on forehead, face, abdomen and feet. Warm sweat, at night. Sweats after midnight and in morning hours. Perspires immediately on waking from sleep.

Temperature - Too cold, even in bed. Chilliness during the day, heat during the night. Shivers when at rest, better moving. Fever with headache and convulsive cough. Fever with whooping cough. Measles. Intermittent fever with nausea and inclination to vomit and other gastric sufferings, or with sore throat. Hot face and cold hands with shivering. Thirst in the morning during the hot stage of the fever and not during the cold stage.

name: Duboisinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Delirium. Drowsiness. Eye, disorders. Locomotor, ataxia. Mouth, dryness. Paralysis. Presbyopia. Pupils, dilated. Throat, dryness. Vertigo. Vision, disorders.
keynote:
PHARMACY - dubin. Duboisinum. Corkwood tree alkaloid. Duboisiamy oporoides. Duboisia hopwoodii. N. O. Solanaceae. Queensland. Tincture and solution of alkaloid prepared from extract of the leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Delirium. Drowsiness.…
full:
PHARMACY - dubin. Duboisinum. Corkwood tree alkaloid. Duboisiamy oporoides. Duboisia hopwoodii. N. O. Solanaceae. Queensland. Tincture and solution of alkaloid prepared from extract of the leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Delirium. Drowsiness. Eye, disorders. Locomotor, ataxia. Mouth, dryness. Paralysis. Presbyopia. Pupils, dilated. Throat, dryness. Vertigo. Vision, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Duboisia belongs to the same order as belladonna, and its alkaloid, sulphate of duboisia, has been used as a substitute of atropine. Its application to the eye has caused marked constitutional symptoms of fever, delirium, stupor and dry mouth. Characteristic dryness of mucus membranes. Cool feeling in the eyes. Feeling of largeness in eyes, tongue. Inability to stand with the eyes shut, locomotor ataxia. Sensation as if stepping on empty space. COMMENTS - Dubin, has been proved. A symptom which may prove a keynote is “ a red spot floating in the field of vision.” Guided by this, C. H. Helfrich cured a case of hyperemia of optic nerve with Dubin. 3c. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: coffee, lemon juice. Compare: (1) Bell., Atro., Dulc., Stram. (2) Anhal. - colored vision. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Duboisia Myoporoides
author: Murphy
constitution: Conjunctivitis. Delirium. Drowsiness. Exophthalmic goiter. Eyes, dilated pupils. Locomotor, ataxia. Mouth, dryness. Mydriasis. Paralysis. Pharyngitis. Presbyopia. Scarlet, fever. Throat, dryness. Vertigo. Vision, disorders.
keynote:
PHARMACY - dubo-m. Duboisia myopo- roides. Corkwood tree. Corkwood elm. N. O. Solanaceae. Queensland. Tincture from the leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Conjunctivitis. Delirium. Drowsiness. Exophthalmic goiter. Eyes, dilated pupils. Locomotor,…
full:
PHARMACY - dubo-m. Duboisia myopo- roides. Corkwood tree. Corkwood elm. N. O. Solanaceae. Queensland. Tincture from the leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Conjunctivitis. Delirium. Drowsiness. Exophthalmic goiter. Eyes, dilated pupils. Locomotor, ataxia. Mouth, dryness. Mydriasis. Paralysis. Pharyngitis. Presbyopia. Scarlet, fever. Throat, dryness. Vertigo. Vision, disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Duboisia acts chiefly on the nervous system, eyes, upper respiratory tract. Recommended in pharyngitis with black, stringy mucus. Palliative for exophthalmic goiter. Dilated pupil. Red spot floats in the field of vision. On the eye it acts more promptly than Atropine, much stronger as a mydriatic. Dry mouth. Checked perspiration. Scarlet fever. Headache and drowsiness. Vertigo with pale face, not gastric in origin. Sensation as if stepping on empty space. Locomotor ataxia. MIND - Memory impaired. Absent-minded. Incoherent. Silly and nonsensicaL

Head - Impossible to stand with eyes shut, tendency to fall backwards.

Eyes - Acute and chronic conjunctivitis. Hyperemia of retina. Fundus red, blood vessels full and tortuous. Paralysis or weakness of accommodation. Mydriasis. Pupils dilated with dim vision. Pain over eye, between it and brow.

Limbs - Trembling, numbness and weakness. Loss of power in limbs, staggers, feels as if he stepped on empty space. Lungs - Larynx dry, hoarse voice, difficult phonation. Dry cough with oppressed breathing. Vertigo - Vertigo with pale face, not gastric in origin. RELATIONS -Antidotes: Morphine, Pilocarp. It antagonizes Muscarine. Hystero-epilepsy. Motor restlessness of insane. It has been used as a substitute for atropine. Compare: ( 1 ) Bell., Stram., Hyos. REFERENCES - Boericke.

name: Dulcamara
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better lying on side. Better moving the affected part. Better external warmth. Better dry weather. Worse from being chilled while hot, Worse hot days and cold nights. Worse sudden changes of temperature. Worse cold wet, damp, rainy weather. Worse cellars. Worse getting wet. Worse using water. Worse autumn, night. Worse from damp ground. Worse cold drinks, ice cream. Worse cold to feet, Worse suppressed discharges. Worse eruptions or sweat. Worse beds, and rest. Worse getting feet cold. Worse injuries. Worse before storms..
constitution: Adenitis. Anasarca. Aphonia. Bladder, disorders. Blepharophthalmia. Catarrh. Cholera. Colds. Crusta, lactea. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Emaciation. Exostoses. Fevers. Glands, swollen. Hemorrhages. Hay fever. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Influenza. Irritation. Lichen. Lumbago. Measles. Meningitis. Mononucleosis. Muscle, pain. Myelitis. Nettle-rash. Neuralgias. Ophthalmia. Paralyze

full:
PHARMACY - dulc. Dulcamara. Woody nightshade. Bitter-sweet. Solanum dulcamara. N. O. Solanaceae. Not to be confounded with “Deadly Nightshade,” Belladonna, nor with “Climbing Bitter-sweet,” Celastrus. Dulca- mara tincture prepared from fresh green stems and leaves, gathered just before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Adenitis. Anasarca. Aphonia. Bladder, disorders. Blepharophthalmia. Catarrh. Cholera. Colds. Crusta, lactea. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Emaciation. Exostoses. Fevers. Glands, swollen. Hemorrhages. Hay fever. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Influenza. Irritation. Lichen. Lumbago. Measles. Meningitis. Mononucleosis. Muscle, pain. Myelitis. Nettle-rash. Neuralgias. Ophthalmia. Paralyzes. Pem- phigus. Rheumatism. Scarlatina. Scrofula. Stammering. Sore, throat. Stiff-neck. Tibia, pains. Tongue, disorders. Tonsillitis. Tumor. Typhoid.Urination,difficult.Urticaria. Warts. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - The leading indication for Dulcamara is found in its modality, worse from cold and damp. Effects of lying on damp ground (e.g., paralysis), conditions which are worse in cold, damp weather or from changes from hot to cold weather. Effects of damp weather, colds after exposure to wet, especially diarrhea. Results from sitting on cold, damp ground. Hot days and cold nights toward the close of summer. Patients living or working in damp, cold basements (Nat-s.). Rheumatic troubles induced by damp cold are aggravated by every cold change, somewhat relieved by moving about. Stiffness, numbness, aching and soreness of muscles on every exposure to cold especially of back and loins. Tearing pains. Dropsy, anasarca. Onesided spasms with speechlessness. Paralysis of single parts, vocal cords, tongue, etc. Paralyzed parts icy cold. Congestive headache with neuralgia and dry nose. Adenitis, glands, swollen and indurated. Enlarged glands. Exostoses. Hemorrhages, blood watery or bright red. Eruptions on hands, arms or face around the menstrual period. Griping in bowels around the umbilicus in testes. MIND - Mental confusion, cannot concentrate. Difficult speech, cannot find the right word. Dullness and painful stupefaction of head. Dullness of senses. Rejects the things asked for. Haughty. Domineering, strong-minded and possessive. Scolds without being angry. Quarrelsome without anger. Depression. Easily becomes delirious with pain. Restless and impatient. Weeping after hallucinations. Delusions as if bed were sinking. Sees spectres on waking. Impatience in morning. Irritability during daytime. Starting on falling asleep. Throws things away in morning.

Head - Congestion to head with buzzing in ears. Headache, relieved by conversation. Headache with great uneasiness, depressed spirits. Occiput feels large, cold. Occipital pain ascending from nape of neck. Back part of head chilled, heavy, aching during cold weather. Sensation as if a board were pressing against the forehead. Sensation as if hair stood on end. Tinea capitis, crusta lactea and dandruff, worse change of weather. Scald head, thick brown crusts, bleeding when scratched, causing hair to fall out. Ringworm of scalp.

Eyes - Every time he takes cold it settles in eyes. Aching pain when reading. Aching with dimness of sight. Ophthalmia neonatorum. Chemosis of conjunctiva. Ophthalmia from catching cold. Hay fever with aprofuse, watery discharge, worse in open air. Thick, yellow discharge, granular lids. Twitching of eyelids in cold air. Jerking in muscles of eyes. Paralysis of upper lid. Pupils much dilated. Idiopathic iritis after exposure in damp weather. Threatened amaurosis in scrofulous children. Dim vision. Sees as through a gauze. Sees sparks.

Ears - Child very susceptible to earache. Stitching earache with nausea, whole night, preventing sleep. Buzzing in ears. Swelling of parotids after measles. Middle-ear catarrh (Merc-d„ Kali-m.). Earache with nausea. Impaired hearing with humming in ears and dull pain.

Nose - Hayfever, profuse, watery discharge. worse open air. Hay fever, sensitive to newly mown grass. Hay fever in August. Discharge suppressed from least contact with cold air. Complete stoppage of nose. Nose stuffs up when there is a cold rain. Wants nose kept warm, least cold air stops the nose. Aching pain. Thick, yellow mucus, bloody crusts. Severe coryza with hot, dry skin, limbs cold, stiff, numb and painful; general offensive sweat. Dry or profuse coryza. Coryza of the newborn. Summer colds with diarrhea. Nosebleed in place of menses. Nosebleed blood bright red, and hot, with pressure above nose.

Face - Face bloated. Faceache and asthma, after disappearance of tetters in face. Facial neuralgia, worse from the slightest exposure to cold. Tearing in cheek extending to ear orbit and jaw, preceded by coldness of parts and attended by canine hunger. Twitching of lips in cold air. Humid eruptions on cheeks and face generally. Thick, brown, yellow crusts on face. Swelling of parotids after measles. Pimples and little ulcers around mouth. Warts. Herpes about lips. Cold sores on lips (Nat-m.).

Mouth - Mouth and tongue dry. Distorted, drawn to one side. Bitter taste. Saliva, tenacious. Saliva, ropy with toothache. Cold sores on lips. Putrid sore mouth with salivation and swollen cervical glands. Mucus membrane of mouth greatly swollen and very red. Holds cold water constantly in mouth, as pain and heat is better thereby. Scurvy from cold.

Throat - Adenitis. Pressure as if uvula were too long. Tonsillitis from every change of weather. Much mucus in fauces. Rough, hoarse voice. Continual hawking up of very tough saliva, with much rawness in fauces. Constant titillation in larynx, with desire to cough. Trachea full of mucus, tough, greenish sputum with moderate cough. Swelling and indurated glands from cold.

Stomach - Indigestion with chilliness from every cold change of weather. Belchings with shuddering. Heartburn. Nausea with desire for stool. Vomiting of white, tenacious mucus. Shivering, chilliness while vomiting. Vomiting of mucus after cold drinks. Vomiting of greenish, yellow, slimy substances.

Abdomen - Dropsy of abdomen. Eruptions or pain about the navel. Cutting pain at navel followed by painful, green, slimy stools. Colic from cold. Cold feeling in bowels. Cutting pain about navel, followed by painful, green, slimy stools. Swelling of inguinal glands (Merc.).

Rectum - Itching of rectum. Burning in anus after stool. Biting pain in rectum as from salt. Constipation and painful strangury. Cutting pain at navel followed by painful, green, slimy stools. Profuse thin stools in morning. Diarrhea of green, sour, watery. Diarrhea slimy, bloody, mucus, worse at night. Diarrhea especially in the summer. Diarrhea when the weather suddenly becomes cold. Diarrhea from damp, cold weather. Diarrhea from repelled eruptions. Diarrhea after suppression of eczema. Watery, slimy, lienteric stool after eating. Green, watery, slimy, bloody, mucus stools. Sour, watery stools, worse at night, summer, damp cold weather. Yellow diarrhea, alternating with greenish. Sensations - As of a board pressing against forehead, as if head were enlarged, as if hair stood on end. As if fire were darting out of eyes. As if worms were crawling up and down in abdomen, biting in rectum as from salt. As if lung moved in waves. As if arms were of wood, as of needles over whole body. Crawling, tickling itching of various parts, tip of tongue.

Male - Enlarged testes with griping pain. Impotence. Herpes. Eruptions, brown, dry, humid or furfuraceous. Eruptions, red, pale red. Eruptions with a red areola. Eruptions, round, scaly and small. Eruptions, suppurating, yellow.

Female - Rash appears on the skin before menses. Menses watery. Menses delayed and too short. Dysmenorrhea with blotches all over. Menses, milk, suppressed by cold or dampness. Suppression of menses from cold or dampness. Herpetic eruptions on vulva, worse every cold change of weather, or by exposure in cold, damp situations. Lochia suppressed by cold or damp. Threatened miscarriage induced by exposure in a damp, cold place. Pruritus with heat and sexual desire. Food - Hunger without appetite. Hunger after fever. Aversion to food. Aversion to coffee. Great thirst for cold drinks.

Chest - Great oppression of the chest, especially when breathing. Pain in left chest as if lung moved in waves. Dull shooting, as from blows in and upon the sides of the chest. Sharp pains, here and there in chest. Small pimples on chest and abdomen. Constitutions - Suited to phlegmatic, torpid. scrofulous patients, who are restless and irritable and who take cold on damp changes. Coughs - Coughs in infants and elderly people. Whooping cough with excessive secretion of mucus. Panting cough, like whooping cough, worse each deep inspiration. Cough after physical exertion. Hoarse, spasmodic cough. Loose, rattling cough, worse cold, wet weather. Dry, teasing, winter coughs. Cough, caused by tickling in the back of throat in prolonged fits with much loose easy expectoration. Must cough a long time to expel phlegm. Copious mucus with loose cough. Barking cough, after a deep breath.

Heart - Palpitations at night. Pulse hard, small and tense, worse at night. Pulse soft, full, slow, bounding. Pulse slower than beat of heart. Pulse frequent at night, slow during day. Pulse collapsed.

Back - Heat and burning in back. Pain in small of back, as after long stooping. Backache, worse damp cold weather. Lumbar region and sacrum feel cold. Spinal meningitis during scarlatina or measles, eruption doesn't develop. Myelitis after taking cold during menses. Hyperemia of spinal cord. Rheumatic affections of spinal cord. Swelling of glands of neck. Stiffness and lameness across neck and shoulders after getting cold and wet. Stiff neck.

Limbs - Rheumatic symptoms alternating with diarrhea or acute eruptions. Rheumatism after exposure to wet. Paralyzed limbs. Feet icy cold. Cold feeling in bones. Sudden swelling of body and puffiness of limbs. Swelling of calf of leg. Pain in shinbones. Exostosis on arms after suppressed scabies. Trembling of arm (right) with urinary difficulty. Perspiration on palms of hands. Warts on hands and fingers. Lungs - Asthma with dyspnea. Asthma with faceache after disappearance of tetters in face. Oppressed breathing from a cold. Dyspnea with accumulation of mucus. Impending paralysis of lungs. Copious mucus. Easy expectoration of taste less mucus, often streaked with blood. Rheumatic pleuritis and pleuro-pneu- monia, with tough, difficult, discoloured sputa. Hydrothorax, worse wet weather. Bronchitis with offensive smelling night sweat. Tuberculosis, worse in changes from warm to cold. Tuberculosis, sputum tough, green.

Sleep - Uneasy, restless sleep, with confused dreams, frequent sweat, tossing from side to side. During sleep mouth open, snoring. Falling asleep in evening, starting as if frightened. Sleep worse after 3 a.m. Fearfully confused dreams.

Skin - Pruritus, worse in cold, wet weather. Herpes zoster, pemphigus. Eruptions, scaly, thick, crusty, moist, bleeding or herpetic, worse before menses. Humid eruptions on face, genitals, hands etc. Urticaria, red spots, brought on by exposure or sour stomach. Nettle-rash over whole body with violent itching. Thick, brown-yellow crusts, bleeding when scratched. Sensitive bleeding ulcers. Little boils. Warts, large, smooth, on face and palmar surface of hands. Small furuncles on places hurt. Eczema, rash of infants. Red spots, as from fleabites. Ringworm in the hair in children. Anasarca. Impetigo, little boil-like eruptions that spread. Skin callous.

Modalities - Better lying on side. Better moving the affected part. Better external warmth. Better dry weather. Worse from being chilled while hot, Worse hot days and cold nights. Worse sudden changes of temperature. Worse cold wet, damp, rainy weather. Worse cellars. Worse getting wet. Worse using water. Worse autumn, night. Worse from damp ground. Worse cold drinks, ice cream. Worse cold to feet, Worse suppressed discharges. Worse eruptions or sweat. Worse beds, and rest. Worse getting feet cold. Worse injuries. Worse before storms.

Teeth - Teeth thickly coated with tenacious, foul mucus. Teeth deeply imprinting cheeks and edges of tongue. Toothache from cold with diarrhea. Toothache with confusion in head, profuse salivation. Teeth feel blunt, or numb. Receding, spongy gums with salivation.

Tongue - Tongue, swollen, hindering speech, paralyzed inarticulate or difficult speech. Dry, rough tongue, rough scraping in throat after taking cold in damp weather. Itching, crawling on tip of tongue. Tongue and jaw become lame if cold air or water chills him. Vertigo - Vertigo on waking in morning. Giddy and dizzy. Vertigo with trembling and weakness. Momentary vertigo, when walking, with darkness before eyes. COMMENTS - Sensitiveness to cold and damp runs through the Solanaceae. and is marked in Bell, and Caps., but it is supreme in Dulc. This feature among others renders them all good antidotes to Merc. Bar-c. is the complement of Dulc. in “worse from cold weather, especially in scrofulous children.” Every cold settles in the eyes, throat or affects the bladder, respiration or bowels. In poisoning cases, Dulc. produces hard, griping pains in the bowels, unconsciousness, tetanic spasms, trismus, loud, rattling breathing, and death. One-sided spasms. Convulsions beginning in the face. Trembling, especially of the right arm. Paralysis, of the tongue, lungs, and heart (pneumogastric paralysis). Paralysis of the bladder. Rheumatic paralyzes. Paralyzed part feels icy cold. “Paralysis of vocal cords (aphonia) from sleeping over a damp cellar.” Scrofulous-looking eruptions. Moist or dry, red, tettery eruptions, especially on the face. Furfuraceous, herpetic. Urticaria. Small furuncles appear on places hurt by concussion. Skin callous. Warts, fleshy or large, smooth. Painless ulcers. Skin eruptions are sensitive to touch, pressure better. Dropsical disorders. Catarrhal troubles. Dry mucus membranes. Offensive sweat, effects of sudden cooling while sweating. Results of suppressed eruptions. Diarrhea, vomiting with the stool. Bladder infections. Mucous-like sediment in the urine. Mucopurulent urine is often associated with general one-sided sensitiveness, especially of the abdomen. Dulc. 30c cured in two doses a rash like mosquito-stings appearing every month before the menses, worse when warm, compelled to sit where it is cold. Clarke gave Dulc. 30c with complete relief to the pain in a case of sarcoma of the bones at the base of the skull in which there were stabbing pains in the front of the head and partial paralysis of the tongue. It was the latter symptom that determined the choice of the remedy. McLaren cured with a single dose the following case, which was the result of a wetting. Facial paralysis, following neuralgia, the eye having remained unclosed for eight months. Red rash with itching worse in damp weather. After a slight aggravation improvement began in two weeks and continued steadily. RELATIONS -Antidoted by: Camph., Cupr., Ip., Kali-c., Merc. Follows well: Bry., Calc., Lyc.. Rhus-t., Sep., V erat. Compare: ( 1 ) Aeon.. Ars.,Cham„ Hell., Nit-ac., Puls., Staph., Sulph. (2) In faintness during stool, Crot- t., Verat. (3) Effects of cold, moist winds, Ars., Calc., Nux-v. m. (cold dry, winds, Aeon.. Bry.). (4) Effects of exposure to wet and better by motion, Rhus-t. Rheumatic paralysis, Rhus-t., Caust. Hasty speech and actions, Hep., Bell., Lach., Sulph. Paralysis of lungs, Solanum. (5) Pimpinello - Bibernell - respiratory mucus membrane sensitive to drafts, pain and coldness in occiput and nape. Whole body weak, heavy head and drowsiness, lumbago and stiff neck, pain from nape to shoulder, chilliness. (6) Rhus-t., Cimic., Calc., Puls., Bry., Nat-s. Complementary: Baryta c. Incompatible: Bell., Lach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Burning in meatus while urinating. Must urinate when getting chilled. Nephritisfrom cold. Ischuria from wading with bare feet in cold water. Pain in region of kidneys, with dropsy and albumen in urine. Urine increases with every little cold. Cloudy, slimy or foul urine. Urine with thick, mucus, purulent sediment. Urine offensive, turbid when passed, and excoriating the skin.

Bladder - Cystitis. Catarrh of bladder from taking cold. Bladder wall thickened. Must urinate when getting chilled. Frequent urination. Strangury, painful urination. Retention of urine from cold or cold drinks. Involuntary urination from paralysis of bladder. Ischuria from wading with bare feet in cold water. Strangury, painful urination. Breasts - Breasts, engorged and sore, delicate, sensitive to cold. Sore nipples after weaning. Breasts, swollen with absent menses or leucorrhea. Herpes on breasts in nursing women. Breasts, engorged, hard, sore, with amenorrhea or leucorrhea. Eruptions on skin after weaning. Suppressed milk from taking cold. Causations - Damp with cold, wading, washing. Injuries. Checked eruptions or perspiration. Complaints of workers in ice factory. People who are exposed to a constant change of temperature, air conditioning.

Perspiration - Foul sweat. Sweats with skin diseases. Sweats with copious limpid urine. Sweats at night, over whole body, often offensive. Offensive sweat, night and morning. Sweats in axilla and palms. Suppressed sweat. Conditions arising from sudden cooling of body whilst sweating.

Temperature - Chill alternating with heat. Icy coldness with pains. Coldness in different parts, icy of paralyzed parts. Chill starts in the back, not better by warmth, worse evening. Chill with urging in stool and urination. Chilliness with thirst. Dry, burning heat all over.

name: Dysentery Bacillus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from 3 a.m. to 6 a.m. Patients feel the cold, chilly and want warmth, yet are easily heated up by the exertion and warm room. Feels cold, chilly and rapidly perspire from excitement and mental exertion. Nausea and faintness in warm room, relieved by open air. Desires air and space..
constitution: Anemia. Anxiety. Arthritis. Backache. Blepharitis, Bruises. Colitis. Diarrhea. Duodenal, ulcer. Dysmenorrhea. Colitis. Fears. Fibrositis. Flatus. Headaches. Heartburn. Indigestion. Migraines .Nausea. Osteoporosis. Otorrhea. Pharyngitis. Pleurodynia. Rheumatism. Spondylitis. Styes. Tachycardia. Thyrotoxicosis. Tonsillitis. Ulcers. Vomiting.

PHARMACY - dys-co. Dysentery bacillus. Dysentery co. Bacillus dy senteriae. Shigella dy senteriae. ABowel nosode. Historicaldose: All potencies.

full:
PHARMACY - dys-co. Dysentery bacillus. Dysentery co. Bacillus dy senteriae. Shigella dy senteriae. ABowel nosode. Historicaldose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Anxiety. Arthritis. Backache. Blepharitis, Bruises. Colitis. Diarrhea. Duodenal, ulcer. Dysmenorrhea. Colitis. Fears. Fibrositis. Flatus. Headaches. Heartburn. Indigestion. Migraines .Nausea. Osteoporosis. Otorrhea. Pharyngitis. Pleurodynia. Rheumatism. Spondylitis. Styes. Tachycardia. Thyrotoxicosis. Tonsillitis. Ulcers. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - This is the nosode prepared from Bacillus dysenteriae. Dys-co. affects every tissue of the body and is suitable for many slow and insidious chronic states. Dys-co., patients are typically the Arg-n. type. Fearful and phobic, abdominal symptoms due to apprehension. “Anticipatory”nervous tension. Inhibition and insecurity. Mental aberrations and nervous symptoms precede and are associated with myocardial and circulatory disease. Least excitement exhausts and aggravates symptoms. “Anxiety and excitement felt in the epigastrium,” “nausea from excitement” and “diarrhea from excitement.” Excitement, anxiety or any agitation causes palpita- tions, flushing, perspiration, breathlessness and even pain in the heart region. Involuntary movements, tics or twitching (like chorea). Instability of the capillary circulation, causing blushing, frontal headaches from excitement. Dry skin, scaly, with circinate lesions. Dilation of stomach. Spasm in the pylorus. Retention of digested contents. Indigestion pain with distention and discomfort. Heartburn. Cyclical vomiting in children. Diarrhea or indigestion from eating sweets and fat, which they are fond of. MIND - High strung and very sensitive to all impressions. Tense and nervous. Easily excited and flustered. Forgetful, especially after interruptions. Full of worries about little things. Anticipating fear of difficulties that might arise (Arg-n.). Full of fears. Claustrophobia. Shy, lacks confidence.

Head - Headache, frontal, over the eyes or in vertex, brought on by excitement. Blinding headaches with looseness of bowel. Migraines, more headache than vomiting. Headaches often occur at regular time periods of 7 to 14 day cycles. Fuzzy head. Scalp is painful to comb. Dry, scaly painful spots.

Eyes - Blepharitis, styes. Conjunctivitis with photophobia. Twitching of eyelids. Sensation of floating bodies, woolly spots before eyes. Yellow color vision.

Ears - Otorrhea. Sudden swelling of ears, blue, red, thin, scalding.

Nose - Hay fever. Vasomotor rhinorrhea. Frequent coryza. Pain at the root of nose.

Face - Both children and adults show a marked anemia, watery, bluish pallor with puffiness of eyelids and cheeks. Veins frequently dilated and bluish lips that are apt to get dry and cracked. Neuralgia, supra and infra orbital. Twitching of muscles of face.

Mouth - Bad taste .Tongue raw and burning. Lips are dry and cracked. Rheumatism of jaw.

Throat - Enlarged thyroid. Recurrent tonsillitis. Pharyngitis. Dry throat.

Stomach - Pain, worse from eating, better lying down. Ptosis stomach, dilation, splashing. Emptiness between meals and sometimes nausea in the morning on awakening relieved by eating. Sinking emptiness during day with relief from rest and food. Chronic indigestion. Eructation, heartburn, some hours after food. Acrid vomiting burning up throat, bilious vomiting. Thirst and desire for cold drink, but worse afterwards. Mental strain reacts on stomach and aggravates the stomach stasis.

Abdomen - Distention and flatus. Colitis. Pain and tenderness over gallbladder.

Rectum - Constipation and diarrhea. Weak expulsion of hard knotted stool with mucus. Loose morning diarrhea, stools forcibly expelled and acrid, burning. Looseness, frequent motions 5 or 6 per day. Diarrhea on excitement or worry. Throbbing rectum with sense of block or cork. Hemorrhoids and anal fissures. Hem- orrhoids come down when walking.

Urine - Urge to urination in tram or train. COMMENTS - Selective action on cardiac muscles. Cardiac disorder. Function disturbance of heart action, associated with nerve tension. Affects the venous circulation. Walls of veins get thin and veins dilated. Varicose veins. “Bruises very early and bleeds easily.” Stasis of abdominal circulation. Tendency to blush, with pallor. Flabbiness. Limbs, cold, bluish and perspiring. Rheumatism. “Growing pains,” associated with valvular heart disease. Weak reaction. Hypotonic stomach. Delayed digestion with pain, relieved by eating. Duodenal ulcer, with nervous tension felt in stomach and heart area (Prot., has unperceived tension). Ulcers (Lyc., Nux-v.). Dry skin. Ribbed brittle nails, dandruff and dry brittle hair. Cracked fingertips. The cracks and fissures are deeper with an indurated base. Eruptions are dry and sluggish, come out slowly. Tendency to scale and crust, gummy discharge (Graph.). Herpes on face, neck, chest. Blisters between fingers. Scaly eruptions on flexures. Dermatitis of hands and palms, dry, cracked and painful. Flat warts on hands. Psoriasis. Urticaria attacks. Brain fatigue. Little power of concentration. “Loses train of ideas from interruption.” “Forgets what he was going to say.” “Forgets what she went for.” Lack of initiative, easily deflected. Hypersensitive, expressed as shyness or timidity. Unsociable. Aversion to meeting strangers. Tense around strangers, alert. Fear of being alone. “I desire to be left to myself, but have a fear of being alone.” Mental uneasiness, physical restlessness, fidgets, chorea movements of facial muscles or limbs. Nervous tension, constant, triggered by anticipation. Impatience, hurry. Restless, desire to go from place to place (Tub.). Depression, from tiredness, constant tension. Anxiety. “Feels miserable from the fear that she can not accomplish what she was to do.” Desire to be left alone, and indulge in tears. Consolation aggravates the weeping and brings out irritability. Burdened with over conscientiousness. Easily upset by criticism. Fear, in train, tram, bus and church, afraid in theater, lift office etc. Fear of the future, dark, thunder and storms. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) There is close relationship between Dys-co., Arg-n. and Ars. (2) It is also related to Kalm., Nux-v. and Lycopodium also follow it well in gastric disorders. (3) Proteus. REFERENCES - Bach. Paterson.

Female - Menses irregular. Dysmenorrhea. Throbbing pelvis and perineum. Infantile masturbation. Food - Fond of sweets, salt, milk and fat.

Chest - Pleurodynia. Pain in chest on exertion. Tightness in lower ribs. Constitutions - Tense facial expression, not fearful but alert and ready to react. Anxious, restless, fidgety, timid and uneasy among strangers, easily upset by criticism.

Heart - Tachycardia, palpitations, extra systoles. Palpitations before important events. Anticipatory discomfort in the cardiac area. Heart rate is fast and may be irregular.

Back - Fibrositis, rheumatism of neck and shoulders. Backache. Spondylitis.

Limbs - Osteoporosis. Arthritis and periostitis. Pain in knees, ankles. Lungs - Shortness of breath. Bronchial catarrh. Pertussis-like cough. Blood stained sputum.

Sleep - Insomnia, from crowding of thoughts, excitement, and palpitations. Sudden shocks through the body on falling to sleep, awakening with fear, palpitation and breathlessness. Wakes at 2 or 3 a.m. with pain and discomfort in epigastrium.

Modalities - Worse from 3 a.m. to 6 a.m. Patients feel the cold, chilly and want warmth, yet are easily heated up by the exertion and warm room. Feels cold, chilly and rapidly perspire from excitement and mental exertion. Nausea and faintness in warm room, relieved by open air. Desires air and space.

name: Echinacea Angustifolia
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from lying down. Better rest. Pains come and go suddenly and are better by bending double. Worse after physical ormental exertion. Worse injury, operations. Worse cold air. Worse evening. Worse after eating..
constitution: Abscess. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Auto-infection. Bites'. Blood, disorders. Blood, poisoning. Boils. Canker sores. Carbuncles. Colds. Cramps. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Enteric, fever. Erysipelas. Fevers. Gangrene. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Impetigo. Immune, disorders. Influenza. Leucor- rhea. Lymphangitis. Meningitis. Ozaena. Poisoned, wounds. Post-partum infections. Pustules. Pyemia. R
keynote: PHARMACY - echi. Echinacea angustifolia. Purple cone-flower. Echinacea rudbeckia. N. O. Composite, allied to Rudbeckia. (Echinacea angustifolia, is the western species not to be confounded with Echinacea purpurea, or Black Sampson, the eastern species.) Tincture of whole fresh…
full:
PHARMACY - echi. Echinacea angustifolia. Purple cone-flower. Echinacea rudbeckia. N. O. Composite, allied to Rudbeckia. (Echinacea angustifolia, is the western species not to be confounded with Echinacea purpurea, or Black Sampson, the eastern species.) Tincture of whole fresh plant. The whole plant including the root is pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Locally, as a cleansing and antiseptic wash.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Aphthae. Appendicitis. Auto-infection. Bites'. Blood, disorders. Blood, poisoning. Boils. Canker sores. Carbuncles. Colds. Cramps. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Enteric, fever. Erysipelas. Fevers. Gangrene. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhoids. Hepatitis. Impetigo. Immune, disorders. Influenza. Leucor- rhea. Lymphangitis. Meningitis. Ozaena. Poisoned, wounds. Post-partum infections. Pustules. Pyemia. Rheumatism. Rhus, poisoning. Scarlatina. Septicemia. Snake, bites. Sore, throats. Struma. Syphilis. Tonsilitis. Typhoid, fever. Ulcers. Vaccinations, effects. Wounds.

HERBAL - Echi. is a blood and immune tonic. This well-known drug came to notice as “Meyers's Blood Purifier,” the proprietor did not know the name of the drug used and sent a whole plant to Professors King and Lloyd of Cincinnati, who identified it as Echinacea angustifolia. Echi. has long been used by herbalists in typhoid conditions, diphtheria, malignant scarlatina, carbuncles and boils. Also as a septic remedy in snake, animal or insect bites. Dr. H. W. Felled noted in the Eclectic Medical Journal, that “if any single statement were to be made concerning the virtues of Echinacea it would read something like this: ‘A corrector of the depravation of the body fluids' and even this does not sufficiently cover the ground.” Antiseptic, anti-fermentative and antizymotic. Tissue alterations as are exhibited in boils, carbuncles, abscesses or cellular glandular inflammations. Locally useful for cleansing and as an antiseptic wash for wounds (Calen.). Potency is not well proven, so it is used primarily in tincture to stimulate the immune system. Homeopaths have generally followed the herbalists in using substantial doses of the tincture (5 to 40 drops), adjusted to the particulars of the case.

HOMEOPATHIC - Bloodpoisoning or weak blood. Septicemia from a cut or wound, or after surgery (Pyrog.). Acute auto-infection, septic conditions, bites of poisonous animals, lymphangitis. Tendency to ma- lignancy in acute and sub-acute disorders. Gangrene (Rhus-t., Ars.). Snakebites, insect bites and stings. Venomous infection. Lymphatic inflammation, after crushing injuries. Foul discharges with emaciation and great debility. Cerebrospinal meningitis. Post-partum infections. Infections at the site of a vaccination. Ear infections. Fetid ozaena. Recurring strep throat. Beneficial in some cases of leucorrhea with bright yellow discharge, as from a suppurating surface. Boils, db not suppurate. Carbuncles, bluish-red color and intense pain. Erysipelas and foul ulcers. Goiter with exophthalmic symptoms. Pustules. Hemorrhoids. Diarrhea in typhoid. Gonorrhea. Asthenia, adynamia. Weak and tired, aching in muscles. Weakness felt more in stomach, bowels, heart, in knees, with vertigo. Useful in the last stages of cancer to ease pain (Ars.). MIND - Prostration of mind. Slowness in every action, speech, pace. Confused, cannot exert mind. Depressed or cross. Brain fag and vertigo. Very nervous could not study. Aversion to thinking. Does not wish to think or study. Dullness from headache, with cross, irritable feelings. Becomes angry when corrected, does not wish to be contradicted.

Head - Headaches with a peculiar, periodical flushing of the face, dizziness and profound prostration. Enlarged sensation in brain. Sharp pain deep in brain, seems too large. Fullness in temples. Pain in temples on motion. Pulsating headache. Throbbing through the temples. Hot burning forehead. Dullness in head with cross, irritable feeling. Pain in forehead on sneezing (Nat-m.). Headache over eyes with sneezing.

Eyes - Brows twitch. Feel hot on closing them. Lachrymation from cold air. Sharp pains in eyes and temples. Pains back of right eye. Eyes pain on looking at an object and will fill with tears, better by closing them. Eyes ache when reading. Sleepy sensation in eyes, but cannot sleep.

Ears - Shooting pain in right ear.

Nose - Stuffiness of nostrils with mucus in sinuses and pharynx. Foul smelling discharge, membranous formations protruding. Post-nasal catarrh with ulceration and fetor. Nose feels stuffed up. Right nostril raw, bleeding. Nostrils sore.

Face - Bluish. Face flushed. Red flushes from pain in head. Pale face with headache, vomiting. Fine eruptions on forehead and cheeks. Neuralgic pain in left upper branch of fifth nerve. Numbness of lips.

Mouth - Biting, tingling on lips. Corners of mouth and lips crack. Canker sores. Aphthae. Gums recede and bleed easily. Dry sensation in back part of mouth. Metallic taste. Bad taste in the mouth in the morning. Burning, peppery taste when taking remedy. Promotes the flow of saliva.

Throat - Sore throat, worse left side. Ulcerated sore throat. Mucus in throat with raw sensation. Constant clearing of mucus from throat. Frothy mucus, hawks from throat. Tonsilitis. Tonsils purple or black, gray exudation extending to posterior sinuses and air-passages. Irritation of larynx. Voice husky.

Stomach - Sense of something large and hard in stomach. Dull pain in stomach. Distension, eructations do not relieve (Chin.). Pain in stomach, going down through bowels, followed by diarrhea. Nausea with chilliness, better lying down. Sour, bloody vomit like coffee grounds. Nausea with eructation of gas. Sour belching, burning the throat, or tasteless. Heartburn.

Abdomen - Abdomen tender, sensitive and tympanitic. Pain in right hypochondrium. Appendicitis. Pain about umbilicus, better by bending double. Cramping pain better passing flatus. Sharp, cutting, pains coming and going suddenly. Full feeling with borborygmus.

Rectum - Griping pains folio wed by passing offensive flatus or a loose yellowish stool, producing great exhaustion. Diarrhea following pain in stomach, going through bowels. Blood flows after stools.

Male - Seminal emissions. Soreness, pain in perineum. Perineum seems stretched. Pain in right spermatic cord. Testicles drawn up and sore. Pain in meatus while urinating.

Female - Discharges suppressed. Mucus from vagina in evening. Excoriating leucorrhea. Puerperal septicemia. Pain in right iliac region, which seems deep, lasting but a short time. Food - Loss of appetite. Nausea, could not eat. Desire cold drinks. Desire for cold water.

Chest - Pain as of a lump in chest and under sternum. Sharp, burning pain in sternum. Pain in pectoral muscles, diaphragm, right lung. Full feeling in upper part of lungs. Sore feeling. Constitutions - Broken-down and weak constitutions.

Heart - Anxiety about the heart. Increasing but variable pulse. Rapid beating of heart. Slight pain over heart. Stitching pain in left chest (apex of heart). Tongue, lipsand Echinacea angustifolia fauces tingle with sense of fear about heart (Aeon.). Accelerated full pulse.

Back - Chills up the back. Pain in back of neck. Dull pain in small of back over kidneys. Pain in lumbar region, worse from stooping.

Limbs - Rheumatic pain after tonsillitis. Aching in limbs and general lassitude, weakness. Pain between shoulders, which extends to axilla and down the arms. Sharp pain in left elbow. Pain in wrists and fingers. Pain in right thumb. Cold hands and feet. Hands are alternately numb or restless, on awakening. Chilliness in right leg. Left hip and knee pains. Pain in right leg.

Sleep - Drowsy, could not read, with yawning. Sleepiness with confusion and weakness. Sleep disturbed, wakes often. Sleepiness after eating. Dreams about difficulties, laborious or quarrelsome, about exciting things, about dead relations.

Skin - Dry skin. Intense itching and burning of skin on neck. Blackness of external parts. Little papules on skin with redness, feeling like nettles. Small red pimples on neck and face. Recurring boils. Carbuncles. Irritations from insect bites and poisonous plants. Dissecting wounds. Lymphatics enlarged. Gangrene. Old tibial ulcers.

Modalities - Better from lying down. Better rest. Pains come and go suddenly and are better by bending double. Worse after physical ormental exertion. Worse injury, operations. Worse cold air. Worse evening. Worse after eating.

Teeth - Teeth sensitive to draft of air. Darting pains in the teeth, worse on right side. Neuralgic pains in superior and inferior maxilla. Dull aching of the teeth.

Tongue - Tongue dry and swollen, sores, dirty brownish. White coating of tongue with red edges. Tongue, lips and fauces tingle with sense of fear about heart (Aeon.). Slight burning of tongue. Tongue, numb, with a peppery taste. Vertigo - Vertigo with weakness, dizziness Echinacea angustifolia and profound prostration. Vertigo when changing position of head. COMMENTS - J. C. Fahnestock extensively proved the remedy, and additional symptoms were contributed by T. C. Duncan. With one exception the provers were males. The first symptom noticed was a biting, tingling sensation on the tongue, lips and fauces (Aeon.), with a sense of fear and pain about the heart. Febrile symptoms, full head, flushed face and accelerated pulse followed. Languor was experienced by many provers, and neuralgic, sharp, darting, shifting pains. Marked drowsiness. Catarrh of the digestive and respiratory tracts. Griping pains, offensive flatus and loose, yellowish stool. In two pro vers there was found a diminution of red blood corpuscles after the proving. Chilliness (coldness of right leg) and sensitiveness to cold, worse from exposure to cold air. A remarkable case of vaccination poisoning is recorded in a man, 45, cured mainly by Echi. in 20-drop doses. The symptoms included an ebbed vitality. He became so weak he could not sit up, his hair fell out. and an eruption of psoriasis appeared on his limbs that extended to his body. The disease advanced rapidly, the nails fell off. Left iritis supervened and then keratitis of the right eye. Under Kali-i. and phosphoalbumen as a food, the hair ceased to fall out, but other symptoms became rapidly worse. Echi. was now given, and slowly the disease was arrested, then gradual improvement and an ultimate cure ensued. The report does not mention if the patient recovered sight in the left eye. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cench.. Both.. Ars., Lach., Bapt., Rhus-t., Cistus, Hepar. (2) the vulnerary Composites, Arn., Calen, and Bell-p. (3) The closest analog is Bapt. (4) In snakebites it compares with Lobelia purpura- scens. (5) in boils with Anthr. (6) Head feels enlarged, Arg-n., Bapt.. Bov., Glon., Nux-v. Mosch., Nux- v. (7) Cases of Rhus-poisoning have been cured with Echin. a. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Liver - Hepatitis. As if a load in back part of liver. Lungs - Pain as of a lump under the sternum. Burning under the left scapula.

Kidneys - Desire for frequent urination. Involuntary urination. Albuminous, scanty, dark urine. Urine increased, pale and copious. Sense of heat while passing urine. Pain and burning on urination.

Perspiration - Sweat chiefly on upper part of body. Sweats on forehead.

Temperature - Irregular, chills, rise of temperature and sweat. Chilliness with nausea. Cold flashes all over back. Chill in left occiput. Temperature raised adegree with flushed face and fullness of head. Malarial fever.

name: Echinacea Purpurea

full:
PHARMACY - echi-p. Echinacea purpurea. Black Sampson. N. O. Composite. Eastern States of America. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Boils. Carbuncles. Diphtheria. Fatigue. Furuncles. Impetigo. Putrid fevers. Pyemia. Scarlatina. Septicemia. Suppuration. Vaccination, effects. Wounds.

HERBAL - Echinacea purpurea is a popular remedy in the eastern states because it has been used in place of Echi. Echi-p. has probably a very similar action and the root causes the same pungent sensation on lips and tongue as the tincture of Echi.

HOMEOPATHIC - Echi-p. treats changes in the blood, simulating typhoid, pyemia, diphtheria, scarlatina, septicemia, and the effects of vaccination (Thuj.). Tendency to suppuration. Offensive discharges (Arn., Bapt.). Biting, tingling sensations. Listless feeling, worse evening. High fever and flushed face (Bapt., Bell.). Marked chilliness. The black root has been taken as a “signature” of the remedy in cases of low fevers where a black tongue was observed. MIND - Mental confusion. Tired, drowsy. Fever - High fever, with fatigue. Typhoid fever. Low fevers where a black tongue was observed.

Skin - Infected wounds. Lacerated wounds. Impetigo. Dry skin. Boils, carbuncles and furuncles. COMMENTS - George Royal wrote of his experiences with Echi-p. He used it for furuncles with a dry skin. Small boils (“catboils”), very sensitive and seemed to come in crops, more about the neck and shoulders. Carbuncles with profuse sanguino-purulent discharge, marked large sloughing, coming in crops mostly about the neck, sometimes on perineum. Royal would usually give such patients Echinacea purpurea five drops of the 1st every three hours and apply a hot solution of 1 part of the tincture to 9 of water; changing the application often. He noted that it could be used in a similar manner to treat bruised or lacerated wounds. It cured a case of a strumous, young bricklayer whose hand and fingers were to be amputated because of symptoms of sepsis (i. e., enlargement of the glands under the arms and temperature). Echinacea 1c internally and tincture locally checked the sepsis and saved the fingers. In this case the skin and muscles were brought as nearly as possible to normal position and the Echinacea applied and changed every hour for 48 hours. Royal used it successfully, only once, for suppurative appendicitis, i.e., after pus had formed and evacuated into the intestines. Merc, and Hepar had both failed to heal but Echinacea 1c, five drops every night and morning for three weeks, cured. Used with success in recurring attacks of chronic inflammation about the cecum, and in a few cases of typhoid when the tired feeling was the ranking symptom. RELATIONS - Compare: Echi., Bapt., Pyrogen. REFERENCES - Clarke. Royal.

Modalities - Better from rest in bed. Better pressure. Better bending double. Worse in the evening. Worse stooping.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from rest. Worse from cold drinks. Colic worse from descending stairs. Lancinations worse from deep breathing..
