full:
PHARMACY - elae. Elaeis guineensis. Palm oil. Aouara. Avoira. N. O. Palmaceae. Triturations of the fruit. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Elephantiasis, arabum. Gastric, disorders. Headaches. Leprosy. Scleroderma. Sight, defective. Skin, disorders. Sore, throat.

HOMEOPATHIC - Elae. was proved by Mure. Notable symptoms of leprosy and of scleroderma appear in the provings including anesthesia, and swelling and hardening of the skin. Aching, lancinations, burning, bruised and throbbing pains. Sensation as if a peg stuck in false ribs. Swelling of parts. The greatest number of symptoms appeared on the lower limbs and skin. MIND - Merry mood. Disobedient.

Eyes - Swelling of eyes. Unable to look steadily at an object. Sight weak, confused vision by candlelight. He makes letters much too large.

Mouth - Burning in tongue, has to stop eating. Bad odor from mouth.

Throat - Lancinations in throat when swallowing, stinging when swallowing saliva. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Anae., Rhus-t. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Stomach - Foul belchings. Vomiting of a cake immediately after eating it.

Abdomen - Colic after a cold drink. Pain with bruised sensation in abdomen.

Rectum - Frequent diarrhea. Black stools. Skin - Skin seems thicker. Swelling, roughness and itching of skin on left leg. Small vesicles appear on swollen right leg and left arm and on other parts without swelling. Itching all over, preventing sleep.

Chest - Pain in middle of chest as if pricked by needles. Lancinations every five minutes in right chest.

Neck - Constrictive pains around neck as if from tight string. Throbbing in nape.

Limbs - Staggering gait. Weakness of legs. Swelling of right leg. Throbbing in calves. Hammering in tibia, nape of neck and right foot. Soreness of soles of feet when walking and when touched. Swelling of left arm. Beating in left arm. Insensibility of head to heat, but an hour after he feels it badly. Lungs - Breathing embarrassed. Pricking in larynx on breathing. Cough with lancination in sides.

Modalities - Better from rest. Worse from cold drinks. Colic worse from descending stairs. Lancinations worse from deep breathing.

Kidneys - White urine.

name: Elaps Corallinus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from rest. Better lying on abdomen. Walking relieves nosebleed, pain in abdomen and chest. Worse cold drinks, food, air. Worse drafts, wind. Worse night. Worse wet weather. Worse dampness. Worse approach of storms. Worse exertion. Worse touch. Worse warmth of bed. Cold things disagree..
constitution: Acidity. Amaurosis. Axilla, itching. Black, discharges. Cancer. Deafness. Ear disorders. Ear, WM.Hemorrhages. Headache. Hemiplegia. Knee, pain in. Metrorrhagia. Nasal, catarrh. Naso-pharyngitis. Nosebleed. Ozaena. Paralysis. Pneumonia. Throat, ulcerated. Tuberculosis.
keynote:
PHARMACY - elaps. Elaps corallinus. Brazilian coral snake. Micrurus frontalis. Micrurus corallinus. N. O. Elapidae. Poison pressed from the venom-sac of the living snake and triturated with sugar of milk. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Amaurosis. Axilla,…
full:
PHARMACY - elaps. Elaps corallinus. Brazilian coral snake. Micrurus frontalis. Micrurus corallinus. N. O. Elapidae. Poison pressed from the venom-sac of the living snake and triturated with sugar of milk. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Amaurosis. Axilla, itching. Black, discharges. Cancer. Deafness. Ear disorders. Ear, WM.Hemorrhages. Headache. Hemiplegia. Knee, pain in. Metrorrhagia. Nasal, catarrh. Naso-pharyngitis. Nosebleed. Ozaena. Paralysis. Pneumonia. Throat, ulcerated. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Like other snake poisons, the poison of the coral snake disorganizes the blood, producing black discharges, especially hemorrhages. Characteristic pre-eminent blackness of its discharges and hemorrhages. Sensation as if all the blood were collected in head. Black earwax. Adynamic sepsis. Spasms, then paralysis. Oscillatory movements. Right-sided paralysis. The right side feels weak insensible or even paralyzed. Must have oscillatory motion. Sensation of internal coldness. Twisting sensation. As of a heavy load or weight on the affected part. Sudden pain in stomach. Cold feeling in stomach. Acidity of stomach with faint feeling. Spasm of esophagus, pharynx constricted, food and liquids suddenly arrested and then fall heavily into stomach. Spasms followed by paresis. Cold things disagree. Fruit and cold drinks lie like ice on stomach and cause a cold feeling in chest. Desire for sweetened buttermilk. Nausea and vomiting. The prostrating diarrhea of tuberculosis. Ear, nose and throat symptoms. Sudden deafness at night with roaring and cracking in ear. Mucus membranes wrinkled. Dreams of dead people. Shuddering from least contradiction, with pricking. MIND - Depressed. Absorbed, buried in thoughts in daytime. Absent minded. Angry about one's self, does not wish to be spoken to. Desire to strike. Shuddering from least contradiction. Can speak, but cannot understand speech. Imagines he hears someone talking. Fear as if something horrible might happen. Fear of the rain. Never feels happy in wet weather. Fear of having a stroke. Fear of getting a fatal disease. Fear being left alone. Fear causes chattering of the teeth and trembling. Aversion to company. Avoids the sight of people, wants to get into the country away from people. Desire to travel. Hysteria before menses. Taciturn during menses. Playful. Delusion he is being beaten. Delusion he is falling forward. Delusion of being injured.

Head - Congestion of blood to head on stooping. Violent headache, extending from forehead to occiput. Headache pain in one eye, then the other. Fullness in head. Rushes of blood to the head. Pain in occiput, worse mental exertion. Weight and pain in forehead. Lancinating pain, left then right side. Severe sharp pain in forehead, with heaviness of head. Stinging pain with sleeplessness.

Eyes - Eyes red and inflamed. Watery eyes. Eyes look glassy. Stye on left eye, with lancinating pain. Bloated around the eyes Elaps corallinus in the morning. Burning and dryness in both eyes on waking. Burning in lids. Eyeballs feel sticky under lids. Violent itching in left eye. Aversion to light, desire to close eyes.

Ears - Crusty eruption on ear. Earwax. black and hard with difficult hearing. Offensive, serous greenish discharge. Intolerable itching in ear. Otorrhea. Watery, yellow oryellow-green discharge with deafness. Sudden attack of nightly deafness with roaring and crackling in ears. Cracking in ears on swallowing. Buzzing noise. Illusions of hearing.

Nose - Coryza from least draft of air. White and watery nasal discharge. Mucus membrane wrinkled. Chronic nasal catarrh with fetid odor and greenish crusts. Ozaena with a yellowish-green discharge. Nostrils plugged up with dry mucus. Nosebleeds, black like ink after a blow. Sudden, profuse nosebleed while walking. Pain at root of nose. Pains from nose to ears on swallowing. Eruptions about nose. Sneezing at night.

Face - Bloated around eyes in morning. Red spots on face. Red blotches on bloated face. Dull, yellowish color. Crusty eruption on cheek. Redness and swelling of right cheek. Swelling of face.

Throat - Tonsils swollen. Sides of throat sore to touch. Red blotches in throat. Painful, difficult swallowing of solids and liquids. Pressure pain in throat. Thick, very offensive, dry, greenish-yellow crusts upon the posterior pharyngeal wall and extremely foul breath. Ulceration of throat, worse left side. Vertigo - Fainting caused by stooping. Vertigo with tendency to fall forward. Faints with vomiting or on stooping. Vision - Letters run together when reading. Veil before eyes. Large red fiery spots before eyes. Red bar before eyes when opening them. Dirty red spot before eyes. Black rings before eyes (left). COMMENTS - Rumbling in ears as of thunder. Sensation in brain as if shaken. Sensation as if food turned like a corkscrew on swallowing, as if intestines were twisted by a cord and strung together in a knot. Fluids roll audibly into stomach. Marked pains in the lungs (especially right). Sensation within chest and at sternum as if pleura were pulled off and the lungs violently drawn apart. Sensation as if a heavy load, iron bar or weight on parts. Mail ed periodicity. Affects the glands and skin of axilla. Clarke cured with Elaps. 200c a very old- standing case of irritating rash in axilla, (right) with recurrent suppuration of axillary glands. E. V. Moffatt found Elaps 6c almost a specific in chronic naso-pharyngeal catarrh with greenish crusts and subjective disagreeable odor. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Radiated heat, Alcohol, Ars. Compare: (1) Dr. Higgins used the gallbladder of the coral snake, Fei Elapidis Corallini. (2) Ars., Carb-v.,Crot-h., Lach., Mur- ac., Nit-ac., Rhus-t. (3) red spot before sight, Dub., (4) effects of cold, wet weather, Dulc. (5) Eucal. rostrata - offensive dark discharge from right ear. (6) Crot-h., Alumn., Carb-v., Ars., Lach. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomach feels cold. Sensation as if food turned like corkscrew on swallowing. Burning in stomach. Acidity after every mouthful. Sinking, faint feeling in stomach. Pain in stomach better lying on abdomen. Paralysis of esophagus. Sensation of a sponge in esophagus. Spasmodic contractions of esophagus and pharynx, food and liquids are suddenly arrested and then fall heavily into the stomach. Sour eructations. Vomiting followed by diarrhea. Vomiting of mucus. Vomiting of green bile.

Abdomen - Colic with urging to stool. Bowels feel twisted together in a knot. Painful pressure in right side of liver. Lancinating pain from both groins to symphysis pubis.

Rectum - Constipation. Constriction of sphincter after bloody stools. Cholera. Diarrhea, copious liquid stools, watery, frothy. Diarrhea of an olive green color. Stools of black, frothy blood. Prolapsed anus. Formication at anus as from worms.

Female - Itching of vulva and vagina. Dysmenorrhea with a flow of black blood. Discharge of black blood between menses. Sensation as if something burst in the womb, then continuous stream of dark colored blood, better when urinating. Itching of vulva and vagina. Weight at uterus and vagina after an hysterical attack. Food - Canine hunger, yet unable to eat. Acidity after every mouthful. Aversion to meat. Aversion to bananas. Desire for ice. Desires milk, whipping-cream. Desire for sweetened buttermilk. Desires sweets. Desires salads. Cold drinks and fruit feel like ice in stomach, and cause coldness in chest. Worse fruits. Thirst during fever.

Chest - Oppression of chest on going upstairs. Feeling of a heavy load on chest. Coldness in chest after drinking. Itching eruption in axilla. Rush of blood to chest in morning. Sharp pain and soreness to touch across chest. Soreness from right to left axilla Constitutions - Rheumatic constitutions.

Heart - Sensation of laceration in region of heart. Palpitations with anxiety and trembling of hands.

Back - Stiffness in the right side of neck. Lancinations in left side of neck. Lancinations in the whole Spinal marrow from occiput to sacrum. Pressure between the shoulders. Coldness in back. Pain in the back with chilliness, cold feet and strangury.

Limbs - Soreness of limbs worse at night. Arms weak. Arms and hands swollen bluish. Pricking under the nails. Skin peeling off on palms and finger tips. Vesicular eruptions on feet. Icy cold feet. Knee joints feel sprained. Lungs - Air hunger. Pneumonia. Each inspiration causes a crackling sound in lungs. Cough with terrible pain through lungs. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhage from lungs, black as ink and watery. Sharp pain in apex of lungs, better walking. Stitches in apex of right lung. Sharp pain in left side of chest, worse breathing. Lungs feel forcibly separated. Worse right lung and expectoration of black blood.

Sleep - Drowsy all day, no sleep at night. Sleeplessness from sharp headache. Bites hand during sleep. Dreams of business. Dreams of dead people.

Skin - Skin hot, dry. Glands and skin of axilla affected. Itching with tetters, eruptions. Yellow spots on hands and fingers. Small blisters, on limbs. Fingertips peel off. Red pimples on fingertips. Little pimples, followed by desquamation. Typhoid when ulcers have eaten into tissues and black blood is discharged.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better lying on abdomen. Walking relieves nosebleed, pain in abdomen and chest. Worse cold drinks, food, air. Worse drafts, wind. Worse night. Worse wet weather. Worse dampness. Worse approach of storms. Worse exertion. Worse touch. Worse warmth of bed. Cold things disagree.

Kidneys - Urine red. Discharge of mucus from urethra. Red urine with cloudy sediment. Thick urine with red sediment. Suppression of urine. Strangury.

Perspiration - Sweats on forehead and neck. Profuse sweat. Cold perspiration all over.

Temperature - Terrible coldness after drinking, as if ice water were rising and falling through left lung. Feels cold, cold things disagree. Shivering after cold drinks. Coldness in back. Shaking chill, felt internally as if in bones. Dry heat and burning redness of face. Skin hot, dry, but complains of feeling cold. Fever with thirst. Heat alternating with chill. Heat flushes, in evening.

name: Elaterium Officinarum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse from damp weather. Worse standing on damp ground..
constitution: Abscesses. Beriberi Bilious, fever. Bladder, disorders. Boils. Cholera. Colic. Cramps.Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Measles. Nettle rash. Neuralgias. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scurvy. Vomiting. Yawning.
keynote:
PHARMACY - elat. Elaterium officinarum. Squirting cucumber. Ecballium elaterium. Momordica elaterium. N. O. Cucurbitaceae. Tincture of unripe fruit. Trituration of Elat- erinum. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Beriberi Bilious, fever.…
full:
PHARMACY - elat. Elaterium officinarum. Squirting cucumber. Ecballium elaterium. Momordica elaterium. N. O. Cucurbitaceae. Tincture of unripe fruit. Trituration of Elat- erinum. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Beriberi Bilious, fever. Bladder, disorders. Boils. Cholera. Colic. Cramps.Diarrhea. Dropsy. Dysentery. Erysipelas. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Measles. Nettle rash. Neuralgias. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scurvy. Vomiting. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Characteristic explosion, as how the ripe fruit scatters its seeds. Profuse watery stools, coming out with a gush. Violent vomiting and purging with copious forceful watery, olive green, bilious or frothy evacuations. Dull, olive-green discharges and frothy stools. Cholera, cholerine and infantile diarrhea. Jaundice of newborns, with bilious stools, urine staining the diaper. Causes tissues to drain of their watery contents. Used in the absorption of dropsical fluids, minute doses will often affect this. Promotes the opening of abscesses and boils. Elaterium officinarum Urticaria, better rubbing. Chilliness with much yawning and stretching. Gaping and yawning, with fever before the chill or before the chill of cholera. Y awning throughout the chill. For the effects of damp weather or standing on damp ground, worse by damp. Irresistible desire to wander from home to home. MIND - Depression of spirits. Fear of some approaching disaster. Mental disorders com- ing on as a consequence of suppressed malaria. Desire to leave home. Irresistible desire to wander from home at night.

Head - Confusion of the head, followed by headache. Violent headache with sensation of constriction of the temples and forehead. Dull pain, pain in the temples.

Eyes - Sticking, as of a splinter, in the inner canthus of left eye. Food - Loss of appetite.

Ears - Sticking pain near the rim of the cartilage of left ear.

Nose - Nosebleed.

Mouth - Tongue coated with a dirty-brown fur. Bitter taste in the mouth, with salivation. Unpleasant smell to the breath.

Throat - Pain in the back of the throat, as if scalded. Scraping in the throat. A feeling as if the choana and upper part of the esophagus were enlarged. COMMENTS - According to Cooper, Beriberi has been greatly helped by Elat. Used with good effect in scurvy where gushing diarrhea is a marked symptom. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crot-t., Gamb. (2) Bry. and Coloc. (sciatica). , Verat. (neuralgia), Colch., Crot-t., Verat. - choleraic affections, Sec. - olive green diarrhea., Canth. - dysenteric diarrhea with painful urination. (3) Apis, Hep., Ign., Rhus-t. - urticaria during intermittent fever. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Pain in the pit of the stomach. Griping pains in bowels. Belching of gas. Nausea and vomiting with great weakness. Vomiting a dark brown fluid mixed with food.

Abdomen - Abdomen retracted. Feeling of stricture or oppression at the epigastrium. Dull pain in the epigastrium. Dull pain in the right of hypochondrium. Cutting, griping pains in the bowels. Rumbling of flatus in the course of the cecum and colon.

Rectum - Bleeding hemorrhoids. Soreness of the anus. Discharges from the bowels of frothy water, coming out with a gush. Stools are watery, copious, forceful. Squirting diarrhea, frothy, dull, olive green with cutting in abdomen. Sensations - As if a splinter in left eye. As if posterior sinuses and upper part of esophagus were enlarged.

Chest - Sharp pains at the lower part of the sternum, passing through to the spine.

Back - Pains in the left sterno-mastoideus muscle, near its insertion into the sternum. Pains under the right shoulder blade. Sticking pains in the lumbar region. Aching pain in the region of the left kidney. Causations - Effects of damp weather.

Limbs - Arthritic nodules. Pain in limbs, darting into fingers and toes. Pain extends down limbs, pain in hip joints with diarrhea. Shooting, also dull aching pains in the course of left sciatic nerve to the instep and toes. Sharp pains in fingers and thumbs, knees, toes and instep. Gouty pain in great toes.

Sleep - Incessant gaping. Much yawning and stretching.

Skin - Dropsical. Orange-colored skin. Smarts, stings and burns. Urticaria from suppressed intermittent.

Modalities - Worse from damp weather. Worse standing on damp ground.

Kidneys - Increased flow of limpid urine.

Temperature - Chill comes on with much yawning and stretching, lasting all through chill. Chills and fever with spurting diarrhea. Perspiration relieves all the symptoms. If the intermittent fever is suppressed, urticaria break out all over the body.

author: Murphy
constitution: Chorea. Headaches. Hysteria. Paralysis. Rheumatism.
keynote:
PHARMACY - electr. Electricitas. Electricity. Potencies are made from sugar of milk saturated with the current. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chorea. Headaches. Hysteria. Paralysis. Rheumatism.

HOMEOPATHIC - While Caspari is the authority for the…
full:
PHARMACY - electr. Electricitas. Electricity. Potencies are made from sugar of milk saturated with the current. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chorea. Headaches. Hysteria. Paralysis. Rheumatism.

HOMEOPATHIC - While Caspari is the authority for the symptoms caused by electricity, the powerful effect exercised on some by the approach of a thunderstorm and the influence of an electric current is well known. In those who have been electrified, there is shaking of the whole body, commencing in the maxillary bones, tingling in the parts electrified, and violent burning. Effects of atmospheric electricity and static electricity. Dreads approach of thunderstorms. General relaxation, sometimes with moral depression and headache. Anxiety, nervous tremors, restlessness, palpitations. Relaxation of the nerves and muscles. Lassitude and stiffness of the limbs. Heaviness of limbs, swelling of parts. Heat in the whole body. Loss of the weight of the body, weakness of the parts shaken. Dragging sensations in all the limbs, as far as the ends of the fingers and toes, nocturnal shootings in parts that are paralyzed. St. Vitus' dance. Epileptic fits hastened and aggravated. MIND - Intense nervous anxiety. Nervous tremors. Restlessness, anxiety and anguish. Fear on the approach of a thunderstorm. Anxiety, restlessness with palpitations and headaches. Internal anguish. Violent agitation. Timidity. Sighs and screams through nervous fear. Weeps in paroxysms. General depression after a meal. Depression and weariness, sometimes with giddiness or drowsiness. Ill- humor. Furor. Errors in the perception of time. Loss of memory. Involuntary laughter. Insensibility, foolish actions. Loss of consciousness.

Head - Pains in the head, sometimes drawing. Bruise-like pain in occiput. Crushing pressure in forehead, as from a stone. Shootings in right side of head or from vertex to the temple and right side of forehead. Tearings in the occiput from the nape of the neck to the forehead. Painful cramps in the head. Violent pulsations (beatings), or else heat throughout the head. Disagreeable shaking, most frequently from behind.

Eyes - Haggard eyes. Wandering and haggard looks. Gnawing sensation in left eye or violent drawing pains, extending to forehead. Sensation as if the eyes were much sunken. Sensation as if something were passing out of the eye. Aching in the eyes, as from dryness. Redness of conjunctiva. Inflammation of the eyes. Swelling of edges of eyelids, at the external angle. Lachrymation, especially of right eye. Contraction of pupils, which were abnormally dilated.

Ears - Pains in the ear. Drawing pains from the jaws to the ears. Lancinations in right ear, proceeding from the neck. Pulsations in the ear. Redness and heat of the ear. Swelling of the interior of the ear. Suppuration and a small pustule in the auditory duct. Vesicles full of acrid serum behind the ear. Augmented secretion of wax. Murmuring, sometimes with a sensation as if a flock of wool were before the ears.

Nose - Tingling or outward pressure in the nose. Sneezing. Augmented secretion of nasal mucus. Discharge, on blowing the nose of a liquid like milk, aggravation of preexisting coryza. Nosebleed. Loss of smell.

Face - Bright red. Expression of terror. Increase of sweat on the face. Swelling of the face. Violent drawing pain above left eyebrow. Contraction of the muscles of the face, especially of the mouth. Scabby eruption on the face, on the arms and over the body. Eruption about the mouth and on the chin. Large blisters on the cheeks. Lips cracked, the upper lip puffed out.

Mouth - Great dryness of the mouth. Augmented secretion of saliva, foam at the mouth. Increased excoriation, painful, in the interior of right cheek. On the palate, vesicles with desquamation of the epidermis. Dumbness, inability to utter a sound.

Throat - Constant tickling in the throat. Pressure on swallowing. Difficult deglutition. Inflammation of the gullet.

Stomach - Fullness of the stomach after eating the least thing. Loathing. Abundant saliva. Sour taste. Heartburn. Nausea, after a meal. Retching and vomiting with inflammation of throat and cough. Vomiting of blood.

Abdomen - Spasmodic tension and contraction in the abdomen. Aching in the abdomen. Colic. Cutting pains, on the approach of a storm, or with diarrhea. Darting pains from left to right side. Shivering in the abdomen dr else burning, sometimes with tension. Inflation of the abdomen, borborygmi in the abdomen, sometimes with fermentation.

Rectum - Fruitless inclination. The stools are at first facilitated and afterwards restricted. Tenesmus and cutting pains. Violent pressure in the rectum during the stools. Burning in the anus. Hemorrhoidal flux.

Stool - Diarrhea, with colic, or at the approach of a storm. Diarrhea with retraction of the testicles, constriction in anus with dry stools after diarrhea. Frequent stools, liquid, hot, black, yellow and fetid.

Female - Copious menses, sometimes with pressure in the rectum. Black and thick blood of the menses. Appearance of the menses (in the electric bath). Food - Increased appetite, great inclination to eat between meals. Thirst during febrile shivering.

Chest - Constriction of the chest. Pains in the chest, sensation of coldness in the left side. Chest and shoulders feel like marble.

Heart - Palpitations, especially at the approach of a storm. Palpitations with fever, headache, or with restlessness and vivid redness of the face. Disposition to fall in syncope. Painful and rapid, sharp pain proceeding from the heart across the chest.

Back - Difficulty in moving the neck. Tingling in a muscle shortened by suppuration. Tingling in the vertebral column. Darting pains in an enlarged gland of the neck. Furunculi on the back and nape of the neck. Drawing pains across the shoulder blades, as by a thread. Burning in the shoulder.

Limbs - Grievous pains in the limbs, pains in old wounds or in enfeebled bodies from a change of temperature. Stiffness of the limbs. Paralysis, especially of the inferior limbs. Trembling of the limbs, chiefly of those which have been shaken, general trembling. Springing up of the tendons. Convulsions of the limbs. Lungs - Respiration accelerated. Feeble and faint respiration. Respiration arrested. Dyspnea. Oppression of the chest. Asthma, with palpitations and disposition to syncope. Cough, with much tickling in throat, or pressure in forehead from within outwards. Short, irritable cough. Spitting of blood. Rough larynx.

Sleep - Great drowsiness. Yawning and stretching, sometimes with shuddering over the whole body. Profound sleep. Sleeplessness, with tossing, for long periods. Confused and disquieting dreams.

Skin - Itching or tingling over the whole body. Eruption of small nodosities on the spots touched by electrical sparks, eruption like miliary or measles, white vesicles, itch-like eruption at the joints of carbuncles, which proceed to suppuration. The skin becomes black, wheals on the skin. Violent pains and swelling of one of the feet which had been frozen twelve years before.

Teeth - Tearing pains in upper teeth, proceeding from the head. Drawings in the gums, proceeding from right ear. Quick, darting pain, as of subcutaneous ulceration, in places once occupied by molar teeth. Quick growth of the teeth in children.

Tongue - Sensitiveness of the tongue, at the point, which is also red. Papillae very prominent. Dry tongue, charged with a yellow coating. Swelling, thickness of the tongue. Vesicles on the tongue with excoriation pain. Vertigo - Giddiness, especially on stooping. Confusion of head. Syncope and tendency to fall down. Vision - Clouded vision. Objects all appear yellow to the sight. Everything appears pale. A dark room appears to be illuminated. Little black spots before right eye. Blindness. Sight improved (curative symptom). COMMENTS - Dr. Seward related a number of cases in which the injudicious use of electric baths brought on tuberculosis. In another case, the chest and arms became stiff and paralyzed. A young married woman, who had general and local (uterine) electric treatment, complained after it of feeling very heavy, as if she weighed a ton. One patient after a bath, said his chest and shoulders “felt like marble.” He became tubercular and died. The paralysis caused by electricity was in several cases quickly relieved by Morph-acet., both in the solution and in the potencies. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Morph-acet. Electr. antidotes Merc. Compare: (1) Phos. is the best antidote to the effects of storms. (2) Rhod. is worse before a storm. (3) Galvanismus and Magnetismus. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Kidneys - Sensations as though the bladder were going to burst. Augmented secretion of urine. Very frequent emission of urine. Involuntary emission of urine. Orangeyellow urine in the morning; during the day, like water in which meat has been washed. Urine thick, deep-colored, red like blood, abundantly charged with mucus. White sediment. Discharge of blood with the urine. Leucorrhea, at first serous, afterwards thick in pieces of the size of a hazelnut.

Perspiration - Increased perspiration. Excessive nocturnal sweat, in gouty persons without mitigation, with anxiety during a storm.

HOMEOPATHIC - Elm belongs to Bach's group of Despondency and Despair, along with Crb-a-b., Oak-b., Will-b., Star-b-b., Sw-ch-b., Pine-b. and Lar-b. The group deals with states of oppressive, burdening hardship. Tendency to exhaustion in mind, emotions and body. Listlessness and lethargy. Unresolved, overwhelming conflicts or over work leading to the formation of chronic diseases (Wh-ch-b.). MIND - High expectations for self. Strong sense of duty. Difficulty planning. Overwhelmed by duty. Feeling of being lost in details, lack of progress. Anxiety over future challenges or duties. Dread, anxiety, intimidation. Internal exhaustion, feelings ofinadequacy. Disillusionment and despair. Sadness over unrealistic goals. REFERENCES - Bach.

HERBAL - The pulp is purgative. The fresh juice is…
full:
PHARMACY - emb. Embelia ribes. Krimighna. N. O. Myrsineae. The medicine was prepared from the seeds. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Constipation. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Flatulence. Indigestion. Rheumatism. Worms.

HERBAL - The pulp is purgative. The fresh juice is cooling, diuretic and laxative. The fruit is carminative, anthelmintic, alternative and stimulant. It is employed in habitual constipation of children and in acute capillary bronchitis. Asa carminative the fruit is given dyspepsia and flatulence. As an alternative in skin diseases and rheumatism. If taken for a long time, it is found to turn the urine acid and red. (R. N. Khory : Materia Medica of India, Vol. II, p. 426.). Charaka states that it is a grand medicine to kill worms. It is also called Krimighna which literally means killer of worms. Su- shruta says it is good for piles and worms. If it be regularly used in special seasons it will increase longevity. The seeds of this plant are used as an anthelmintic. Powdered seeds in doses of one to two drams are administered with sugar or honey in an empty stomach to expel tape worms. (R. N. Chopra: Indigenous Drugs of India, p. 577.) Clinicaly it is very useful in diseases of children associated with or proceeding from worms. It is a grand medicine in diarrhea, dyspepsia and flatulence owing to worms. If Nux vomica, cina, santonine and other remedies for worms be ineffective, Embelia ribes will be found to be a sovereign remedy in those complaints. In this new remedy, the urine becomes pungent and blood colored and this is one of the characteristic symptoms for the administration of this remedy. Other symptoms are fretfulness, moroseness and irritability of the patient. Grinding of the teeth. Patient always picks his nose. Tongue is dry, nausea exists. The abdomen gets distended. Stools are undigested. Urine is blood colored and pungent. Patient shrieks during sleep. Itching in the rectum, itching in the nose, and worms come out with the stool.

HOMEOPATHIC - Name of the Prover - Babu sris Chandra Ghose, age 28, or robust physique and of excellent health. MIND - Became morose. The prover became fretful and irritable.

Nose - Itching sensation was felt in both the nostrils.

Stomach - There was distension of the stomach.

Rectum - Itching sensation was felt in the rectum. Large number of worms came out of the rectum and was expelled with the stool. Passed three undigested stools in quick succession. Worms were expelled with the stools.

Urine - Urine became red colored and strong smelling. COMMENTS - Case 1 - The son of Babu srish Ch. Roy, B. A., was suffering from remittent fever continued with unabated fury for six days without any remission. I was called in to treat the son, aged 6 years, on the 6th March. 1931.1 continued to treat the boy with Gelsemium and Bryonia for four days, but unfortunately no improvement took place. 10th March - 1 went to see the boy this morning and gathered the following symptoms: The patient was morose and fretful. Patient always picked his nose. Tongue was dry. There was terrible nausea. Abdomen was greatly distended. Passed undigested stools. Urine red colored and pungent. The boy was found to shriek out during sleep. Fever in the morning it was found to be 101° and it generally rose up to 103° in the evening. I gave Cina 20 and 200 for two days on account of the predominance of worm symptoms. Cina did no good. At last I gave him Embelia ribes 1 x thrice on the 12th March. It acted very nicely to bring down the temperature to 99° in the morning next day. 13th March - At 11 a.m. temperature rose, but again fell down to 99° at 4 a.m. on that day and complete remission took place at eleven PM 14th March - There was no fever. Urine was clear, fretfulness was gone, there was no distension of abdomen, no loose stools passed and the patient was cured within 3 days. All along these days he took 2 doses of the new remedy. And since that time the patient did not suffer from worm troubles any more. Case 2 - The daughter of Babu Ram Ratan Chatterjee, B. L., aged 4 years, suffered off and on from worm troubles. Ordinary homeopathic remedies were given by a homeopath, but there was no perceptible improvement. I was sent for on the 2nd November, 1932. I marked the following symptoms: The child was ill-humored and restless. There was great hunger soon after a meal. Could not be quieted by any persuasion. The patient always bored her finger into the nose. The abdomen was distended. Always disturbed sleep. Loose stool with undigested particles of food. Grinding of teeth. Blood colored urine. As the above were clear-cut symptoms of the presence of worms in the system, I prescribed Embelia ribes lx twice daily. After using this remedy for a fortnight, the patient was perfectly cured. I prescribed this new drug in 1 x potency in several cases suffering from worm troubles and I am glad to say that all of those patients were radically cured. REFERENCES - Ghose.

full:
PHARMACY - emer. Emerald. Gemstone. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Alzheimer's, disease. Amenorrhea. Asthma. Cancer. Cataract. Chronic, fatigue. Dyslexia. Endometriosis. Epilepsy. Fainting. Glaucoma. Grief. Hemorrhages. Nursing, others. Senility. Stammering. Sycosis. Tinnitus. Trauma. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Useful for conditions of exhaustion and debility due to an overtaxed nervous system. Alzheimer’s disease, senility. Epilepsy. After strokes and brain injuries. Encourages regeneration of nervous tissue. Desire to sleep, to give up the struggle, for “all the problems to go away.” Useful in desperate cases when the patient seems to be giving up. Feeling of being “not in the body,” when the body has been so injured that it is no longer a wholly viable vehicle. Chronic fatigue. Post traumatic stress, with disorientated. Weeps, especially at night, when alone. More cheerful during the day. Inhibition and lack of confidence. Allergy to peanuts. MIND - Arrogance and haughtiness. Negative, bitter thoughts. Frustration. Resentment and bitterness from the past. Inability to forgive. Envy and jealousy. Hatred for those who have done well or better. Great negativity. Wakes with vengeful feelings. Easily manipulated, or becomes manipulative. Addictive personalities, do not see the threat of their addiction, particularly in relationships. Fosters the strength to face deep issues that otherwise would lie buried. Grief after sustained traumas or sadness. Rekindles imagination and intuition after emotional distress. Distracted and hard to concentrate. Calms the mind and improves memory. Fearful accepting their fate. Indecisive and changeable. Mistakes and misinterprets meanings. Poor moral judgment. Encourages the id over the ego.

Head - Headaches at night, worse left side. Light headed and dizzy. Stroke, affecting the left side of head and body. Intestines - Bowel cancer, especially if it is secondary to cancer of the generative organs or from suppressed sycosis (i.e. polyps or warts). Kidney - Kidney pains, worse right.

Eyes - Glaucoma and cataract. Watering eyes when sneezing and laughing. Long or short sight becomes exaggerated.

Ears - Tinnitus comes and goes. Hardness of hearing.

Nose - Frequent need to blow nose, but little mucous.

Throat - Dryness of throat and mouth. Sensations of constriction and of lump in the throat. Allergies that cause swelling of the throat. Throat cancer. COMMENTS - Sycotic, syphilitic and tubercular. Useful in treating pathology (Cars.), especially for cancer of internal organs (given 30c or higher once a week). Cleanses the lymph system. Improves circulation. Useful to support the action of heart remedies (Carb-v., Ars., Phos., and the snake poisons). Angina, where indicated remedies do not work. For drainage in cancer and blood problems (in the x potencies). x Radiation exposure. For emotional distress after general anesthetics. Mood or temperature swings. Relates to the heart chakra. Encourages verbal expression of what would otherwise not be expressed due to grief (Nat-m., Aur., Lach., Caust.). Useful for deep grief. Works well when given repetition. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Stomach - Throat, esophagus and stomach all feel connected in discomfort (Ign., Nux-v.). Indigestion with painful trapped wind in the chest. Nausea, comes in waves. Better from limes and bitter fruit. Allergy to peanuts. Unable to lose weight in spite of dieting.

Female - Uterine problems after grief or trauma. Endometriosis. Hemorrhages. Amenorrhea. Cancer of the uterus or the ovaries. History of frequent miscarriages. Useful for anxiety, weakness and debility during pregnancy. Useful for reducing the side effects upon ending hormone treatment. Food - Poor assimilation of food.

Heart - Sluggish circulation with cold extremities, especially the feet and lower legs, worse night. Can become too hot in the daytime.

Back - Pain in the spine, especially after injuries. Tightness of the shoulders and cervical vertebrae. Lumbar and sacral areas are painful, worse menstrual problems.

Limbs - Legs and feet very cold, but upper part and hands can be hot. Feels draft on the lower half of the body. Stiffness of the joints, especially hands and wrists. Lungs - Difficulty breathing, worse night. Pressure on the chest, mediastinal region. Left side of chest most affected. Shallow breathing. Useful as a support or intercurrent remedy in asthma.

Skin - Dryness of complaints, hot, burning itching (Apis.). Recurrent abscesses.

May produce hepatization of lungs, rapid heart action, and lobarpneumonia. Tendency to fall forward. Pyorrhea. Psoriasis. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In hematemesis and other hemorrhages, compare Gelin., which has a marked effect on the coagulability of the blood. Hypodermically or if by mouth, a 10 per cent, jelly, about 4 oz., three times a day. REFERENCES - Boericke.

full:
PHARMACY - ephe. Ephedra vulgaris.Ma huang. Ephedra distachya. N. O. Gnetacee. Ephedraceae. Tincture of branches and flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Exophthalmic goiter. Headaches.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ephedra has been proved in Russia by Dr. B. H. Mouravow. Ephedra produced symptoms when twenty drops of a strong alcoholic extract were taken five times a day, fifteen drops four times a day were taken without apparent effect. General weakness from early morning, great fatigue. Extreme apathy. Asthma. Stiff-neck and backward pulling of whole body on turning the head. Starting of the eyes from the orbits as if pushed out. To Mouravow, these symptoms suggested exophthalmic goiter. He also considered that the remedy acted on the ganglions of the sympathetic nerve and caused congestion of the spinal cord. MIND - Extreme apathy and fatigue.

Head - Violent headache, nausea, general weakness, with a slow pulse. Left side hemicrania with numbness of entire left arm.

Eyes - Heavy eyes. Pain in the eye. Starting from their orbits, as if pushed out.

Abdomen - Dull pain in region of spleen (Cean.).

Heart - Abatement of the pulse, increases rapidity of action of heart. Strong heartbeat with weakening of pulse, respiration is accelerated.

Back - Stiffness of neck with exophthalmos. Stiffness of neck and backward pulling of all the body on turning head, with a dull pain in region of spleen.

Limbs - Heaviness in all the limbs, in evening. Numbness of entire left arm with left-side hemicrania.

Sleep - Longing for sleep. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ferr., lod., Lyco- pus v„ Spong., (2) Thyroid. - exophthalmos. REFERENCES Clarke.

Kidneys - Retention of the urine (fourth day).

The common appellation of “gravel root” shows that the popular belief points in the direction of its use. Hale mentioned Epig. as having been a popular remedy in kidney stones throughout the United States ever since the settlement. It has been successful in removing dysuria and strangury as well as urinary tenesmus.

Burning in neck of bladder while urinating. Tenesmus after urination. Croaking noise and rumbling in bowels. COMMENTS - Hale gave ten drops of the tincture six times a day to a patient who had a bloody muco-purulent sediment in the urine with intense dysuria. A copious deposit of fine brown sand was observed and all symptoms were relieved. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Mitch., Chim., Cann-i., Calc, ren., Urt-u., Uric acid. (2) Uva, Lyc. Pareira. (3) Epigea contains Arbutin, Formic acid. (4) Arbutus, Uva ursi. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Clarke. Hale.

HOMEOPATHIC - Epip. is a remedy for sick, neurasthenic and nervous headaches, especially in women, brought on or made worse by exertion, nervous strain, etc. Headaches with pressive pain, as if fingertips were pressing into the temples inwards or compressive pain going backwards, worse until 4 p.m., then better with spitting of viscid saliva and nausea. Neurasthenia. Languid feeling. Drowsy after meals. Tongue coated yellow, bitter taste. Loose stools. Sub- involution of the uterus with painful menstruation and congestion. MIND - Confusion of mind, makes wrong letters or words in writing. Fears death from heart palpitations, injury to her health from the drug. Causations - Physical or nervous overstrain. Any unusual exertion or excitement, as going on a visit or doing a day's shopping.

Head - Nervous headaches. Pain, worse left side. Pressing pain in temples from without inwards. Headaches from nervous strain caused by mental or physical exhaustion, preceded by hunger. Sick headache coming on when deviating from ordinary pursuits, weekly sickheadaches. Viscid salivation, constant inclination to spit.

Eyes - Smarting. Could not read because the words seemed to be blurred.

Mouth - Tongue coated yellow, bitter taste. Saliva viscid, almost constant desire to spit. Sticky viscid, bitter taste in mouth.

Stomach - Nausea.

Rectum - Loose stools. Stool passed with difficulty, though feces soft.

Female - Subinvolution of uterus, with painful menses and congestion.

Heart - Palpitations, causing weakness. Limbs - Pain in left shoulder, left knee.

Modalities - Betterfrom sleep. Worse from fatigue. Worse nervous strain. Worse eyestrain. Worse working in open air. Worse rising up in bed.

Teeth - Tartar on teeth. COMMENTS - Grimmer noted skin cancers, palpitations with weakness, and a constant desire to spit viscid saliva. Severe headache brought on by exertion, relieved by a good sleep. Symptoms travel right to left. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Iris, Meh., Sang. (2) Fagus - beech-nuts - headache and salivation, swelling on mouth, dread of water. (3) It is allied to the Scrofulariaceae. (4) Phos. - in better from sleep, Lach., Sulph. and Nat-m. have the opposite, worse from sleep in the most marked degree. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

full:
PHARMACY - equis. Equisetum hyemale. Horse-tail. Scouring-rush. N. O. Equisetaceae. A rush growing in damp soil in Europe and America. Tincture of fresh plant chopped and pounded to a pulp. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Bedwetting. Bladder, disorders. Cystitis. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dysuria. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gravel. Hematuria. Involuntary, urination. Kidney, disorders. Kidney, weakness. Paralysis. Polyuria. Urinary, retention.

HERBAL - Equisetum contains silica in an appreciable quantity. Horsetail tea is widely know as a kidney and bladder tonic. It is a natural and soothing diuretic used for polyuria and urinary retention. Teaspoonful doses of the decoction or the tincture in hot water is found useful to allay irritability of the urinary tract, kidney stones, dysuria, pleuritis effusion and dropsy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Affinity for the urinary organs. Pain in the kidneys (especially right), in the bladder and urinary passages. Irritation of the bladder and kidneys. Urinary retention and dysuria, especially in women during pregnancy and after confinement. Constant desire to urinate and passes large quantities of clear, lightcolored urine without relief. Cystitis. Severe, dull pain that does not lessen after urination. Aching, full, tender bladder, not better after urinating. Pain in bladder as from distention. Pricking, burning, cutting pain in urethra while urinating. Dribbling urine in old women with involuntary stool. Much mucus in urine. Bedwetting (Lyc., Nat-m., Sil.. Sep.). Nocturnal bedwetting of children without causes except habit. Bedwetting when he dreams, he always sees a crowd of people. Pain in sacroiliac joints. MIND - Very irritable and easily fatigued.

Head - Severe headache with intense pain in upper part of eyes or roof of orbit. Headache with heat of face without redness. Constrictive feeling across forehead. Sticking and darting pains, changing locality. Constriction of whole scalp, as if drawn tightly over whole skull. Feeling of skin continuing to contract, continual desire to wrinkle up forehead.

Eyes - Severe pain in roof of right orbit. Sharp pain in outer angle of right eye.

Ears - Dull, transient pain and stiff feeling behind left mastoid. Confused feeling in ears. Confusion of sounds, confused noises, fearful rumbling.

Face - Face flushed, feeling of heat. Disposed to frown. As if blood pressed into face. Heat and burning without redness.

Throat - Sharp sticking in throat.

Stomach - Excessive hunger, appetite greatly increased.

Abdomen - Distended feeling. Sharp pains on either side of hypogastrium, extending to middle line. Dull, heavy pains in either side of lower abdomen and bladder with frequent desire to urinate, not better by urinating. Severe pain in lower abdomen with passage of fetid flatus.

Rectum - Smarting in anus during and after stool. Stool with aching in anus and feeling as if rectum would protrude. Feeling as if some feces still remained. Sticking-like pains in anus (Ila. m.). Stool with great flatulence.

Urine - Copious amounts of watery urine. Urine flows only drop by drop. Profuse urination of clear, watery urine. Passes large quantities of clear, light-colored urine withoutrelief. Albuminuria. Urine cloudy. Great excess of mucus on standing. COMMENTS - Equis, is a deep anti-sycotic. Pain in the kidneys, especially the right. Pain in the bladder and urinary passages, as from distention. Retention and dysuria, especially in women during pregnancy and after confinement. Severe cystitis. Acute bladder infections, especially when passing large amounts of pale urine. Polyuria. Frequent urination or lack of urination. Paralysis of the bladder, urinary retention (Aeon., Apis., Caust.). Constant desire to urinate, passes large quantities of clear, light-colored urine without relief. Severe, dull pain that does not lessen after urination, irritation of the bladder, especially in women. Burning pain at the end of urination (Sars.). Diabetes with frequent urination. General paralysis with loss of control over bladder and rectum. Multiple sclerosis cases with incontinence of the urine. For the side effects of strong diuretics. Loss of hair, and weak nails. Mending broken bones, can help retain calcium and prevent osteoporosis. Hot flashes. The tincture is a natural diuretic and tonic for weak kidneys, and is also good for hemorrhoids. Farrington noted the bedwetting with frequent painful urging to urinate, causing the patient to rise at night. According to Grimmer, this remedy cured a case of uterine cancer. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Sars., Apis, Berb., Hydrang., Ferr-p., Linaria, Chim. (2) Cann-i., Puls., (3) Canth. comes closest, there is less bleeding, tenesmus, scalding and fibrinous flakes than with Canth., but more mucus. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Violent erections in the afternoon. Soreness of testicles and cords, worse left.

Heart - Sharp pain in region of heart, worse by inspiration.

Back - Pains in back, especially while sitting, better lying on back and walking. Right lumbar region painful. Heavy sensation like a lump in right lumbar region. Severe rheumatic pains in region of sacral-lumbar joint and through left hip joint extending down outer side of left leg, ending in front three inches above knee.

Limbs - Pain in upper part of shoulders and in region of vertebra prominence, worse by least motion or contact. Pain in right shoulder to middle of upper arm. Pain in left shoulder with shi veringo vet body and great heat of head. Pain in right hip joint and near knee joint. Knees very weak on least exertion. Dull, heavy pain under left patella. On awakening, sharp pain inner side of left knee, better after moving about a short time.

Sleep - Very sleepy, heavy eyelids. Sleep disturbed by tiresome dreams. Dreams of many persons, places and things. Dreams of crowds of people. Nightmare when passing urine.

Modalities - Better in afternoon. Better lying down. Better continued motion. Worse right side. Worse movement. Worse touch. Worse pressure. Worse contact. Worse sitting down. Worse at close of urination.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Diabetes insipidus. Weak and sensitive kidneys from abuse of diuretics. Slight pain in right kidney, then in left, extending down left side of sacrum. Frequent urination at night. Deep pain in region of right kidney, extending to lower abdomen with urgent desire to urinate. Polyuria associated with diabetes. Frequent urging, with severe pain at the close of urination.

Bladder - Frequent, profuse urination of clear, watery urine. Urgent desire to urinate with prickling, biting, itching, and soreness of meatus from contact and pressure, worse scratching. Retention of urine after childbirth. Retention and dysuria during pregnancy. Pricking in urethra a short distance back from meatus. Severe, dull pain in bladder. Feeling of fullness in bladder, not relieved by urinating. Profuse urination with burning in urethra and sharp pain at root of penis. Sharp, burning, cutting pain in urethra while urinating. Involuntary urination during daytime. Bedwetting, nocturnal and diurnal. Bedwetting in children with dreams or nightmares when passing urine. Obliged to rise several times at night to urinate. Incontinence in old women, with involuntary stools. Breasts - Sharp stitch in left breast, one inch to left and over nipple.

Temperature - Creeping chills beginning below and creeping up back.

PHARMACY - erech. Erechthites hieracifolia. Fireweed. Senecio hieracifolia. Erechthites praealta. N. O. Composite. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Eczema. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhages. Herpes. Metrorrhagia. Nausea. Nosebleeds. Psoriasis. Orchitis. Rhus poisoning. Ulcers.

HERBAL - Erechthites belongs to the composite and closely allied to erigeron and the groundsel family (Senec.). “Fireweed” is so called because it grows abundantly in clearings which have been burnt out. According to Hale, “Oil of Fireweed” is also extracted from erigeron and is said by alchemists to be similar to turpentine. All three cause active and passive hemorrhages, the former being the primary and the latter the secondary action.

HOMEOPATHIC - Erech. is indicated in hemorrhages of bright red blood from nose, mouth, bowels, kidneys, uterus and especially the lungs. Hemorrhagefrom any part, always attended by excitement of the circulation. Passive hemorrhages of dark fluid blood. Nosebleed of bright blood. Metrorrhagia. Flashes of heat that suddenly give way to coldness. Scanty urine, edema of the limbs. Useful as a local application in skin affections, herpes, eczema, psoriasis and indolent ulcers. Increased appetite. Increased feeling of strength and desire for exercise. Hale commended it in gonorrhea and orchitis.

Head - Giddiness with nausea. Dull frontal headache. Throbbing of temporal arteries with flushes of heat running across the back from one shoulder to the other. The sensation of heat suddenly gives way to that of coldness.

Throat - Sore throat. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rhus-t. Senec., Erigeron, Ham. Mill., Calc., Canth., Terebe., Puls., Clem. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Enormous appetite. Feeling in stomach as if it would be dissolved after drinking coid water. Belchings and heartburn after eating warm bread and coffee (cured).

Rectum - Griping followed by three copious discharges of semi-solid, yellow fecal matter.

Male - Prolonged erections with dreams of nudity, towards morning. Orchitis from suppressed discharge. Gonorrhea with scanty discharges and great pain.

Female - Premature and profuse menses. Metrorrhagia.

Back - Stitches in middle of back. Aching across small of back.

Limbs - Cold feeling in back of legs. Legs feel stiff and painful.

Skin - Symptoms like rhus poisoning. Sleep - Dreams of nudity and shame.

Kidneys - Increased flow of urine. Slight burning at meatus during urination.

full:
PHARMACY - ergot. Ergotinum. Ergotin. Alkaloids of Secale comutum. Trituration. His- torieal dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alopecia. Anal, incontinence. Bedwetting. Dysmenorrhea. Faintness. Gangrene. Heart, paralysis. Hemorrhages. Menorrhagia. Migraines. Miscarriage. Neurological, disorders. Pre-menstrual, migraines. Sphincters, paralysis. Urticaria.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ergotinum is the total extract of the ergot Claviceps Purpurea. The ergot is the intermediary stage through which this mushroom passes in order to complete its development. Claviceps Pupurea, other- wise known as Secale Comutum, is widely used in homeopathic medicine, with its own indications. This Ascomycetes Pyrenomycetes is a parasite on the ears of rye, as well as on other grain such as wheat or oats, and on other plants such as Cypetaceae and palm trees. The toxicity of ergot has been known for a long time, manifested by the medieval epidemics of Saint Anthony's Fire due to the consumption of contaminated flour. Its oxytocic and abortive powers are also well known. The insoluble polypeptide alkaloids are stimulants of smooth tissues, especially uterine and vascular. Affects the sympathetic system, counteracts the effects of adrenalin. Ergotinine, the extract of ergot of rye, is used in allopathic medicine, as a constrictor of blood vessels to encourage hemostasis, as in uterine and pulmonary hemorrhages. Ergot, acts by causing contraction of the arterioles and its effect is produced most promptly when it is administered by subcutaneous injection. Its homeopathic use are in the main identical with those of Sec., but Ergot, will sometimes succeed when Sec. fails. Ergot, is primarily a female remedy, functional complaints of the female genitalia. Pre-menstrual migraines. Menstrual complaints. Vulvar itching. General ill-defined discomforts, head feeling empty, misty vision, noise in the ears, vertigo, nausea, occasional vomiting. Nervous system disturbed, anxiety, faintness. Nerve attacks with sudden strokes, abrupt clouding of consciousness, both psychological and physical. For cases with a loss of consciousness. Certain forms of alopecia or allergy. Urticaria. Bedwetting in both sexes with no anatomical lesion or any urinary infection, with an increase in the level of neurosis from anguish. MIND - Anxious, hyper-emotiional state. Instability of the character. Slowing down of mental processes. Chronic mental depression. Depressive state, particularly before menstruation. Sadness and weeping before menses. Loss of consciousness. Breasts - Premenstrual swelling of the breasts and abdomen.

Head - Migraines. Habitual headaches. Premenstrual migraines. Diffuse alopecia. Round patches of alopecia.

Eyes - Visual complaints such as mistiness, cloudy vision, luminous spots before the eyes. Black patches, black or glinting spots across the field of vision.

Ears - Buzzing, intermittent deafness.

Female - Pre-menstrual syndrome. Painful menstruation with no clinically discernible lesion. Dysmenorrhea with red, non-clotting blood. Menorrhagia in young virgins from the beginning of menses in the young woman. Vulvo-vaginal itching, congestion, redness, dryness of the mucus membranes. Hyper functioning of the pituitary and ovaries.

Sleep - Insomnia, especially in women. Vertigo - Attacks of faintness. COMMENTS - “Wide-open anus sensation” (Sec., Phos.). Koeck of Munich recorded a case of a patient who suffered from diarrhea since the Franco-German war and latterly had lost all power of retention. The rectum had lost all sensation, so that the patient had no warning and was never clean. Old school treatment had failed to relieve him. He was about to be pensioned by his employers and had thoughts of suicide. Sec. 3x ameliorated slightly, the 2x had the same result. “Remembering Kafka's advice to use the alkaloid when the indicated drug did not seem to act, he prescribed Ergotin 2x.” After taking this for four days the patient regained control. Demange recorded the case of a young woman suffering from typhoid fever and threatened with heart paralysis. Stimulating injections of ether and of rum and frictions completely failed to rally her. Cyanosis increased rapidly and threatened the trunk. Fainting spells occurred in rapid succession, pulse filiform. Ergot, was then injected and the pulse rose and the symptoms of collapse disappeared. Most of the symptoms of this patient may be found under Sec. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sec. - Dysmenorrhea with blood clotting and black blood. (2) Folliculinum - Pre- menstrual syndrome with swelling, headaches, hypermenorrhea. (3) Thyr. - Depressive condition, anxious with hyperthyroid tendency, trembling and pigmentation, especially of the eyelids. (4) Ign. - Nervous, paradoxical instability, anguish with feeling of constriction in the throat and the epigastrium. (5) Lil-t. - Complaints in the uterus and ovarian region, heaviness of the lower abdomen. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian.

Skin - Alopecia-type areas. Urticaria. Pruritus. Edema.

PHARMACY - erig. Erigeron canadensis. Fleabane. Leptilon canadense. N. O. Compositae. Canada. Tincture from the fresh plant when in bloom. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Black, eye. Bruises. Coughs. Dysentery. Dysuria. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hematocele. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoids. Injuries. Leucorrhea. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Placenta, previa. Proctalgia. Spermatorrhea. Tympanites. Uterus, weak. Wounds.

HERBAL - Native Americans used Erigeron as an application to wounds. It compares as a vulnerary with Arn. Erig. is chiefly known as a remedy for hemorrhages and congestions in all parts of the bodÿ. Bnght red hemorrhages.

HOMEOPATHIC - Erig. has been proved by Burt and others. Wilmot Moore gave it with success in three cases of placenta previa. He gave the lx trituration (of what part of the plant is not mentioned) on the tongue. Hemorrhagic remedy, especially when hemorrhages are profuse, bright red, gushing. Persistent hemorrhage from the bladder. Uterine hemorrhage with painful urination. Pain in left ovary and hip. Chronic gonorrhea with burning urination, continual dribbling. Gleet. Burning congestions. Hard aching. Sensation as if something had lodged in upper part of esophagus. Dysentery with soreness and burning in the bladder. Tympanites. Prominent pains in umbilical region. Feeling as if anus had been torn. Urination is painful or suppressed, sharp stinging pains in region of left kidney. MIND - Great despondency. Excessive fatigue in morning, all day with great depression. No ambition to move in afternoon and evening. Sadness with feeling of great languor. Weeping during urination.

Head - Congestion of the head, red face, nosebleed, febrile action. Awakened with dull headache, with aching distress in all the large joints. Dull frontal headache with smarting in eyes.

Eyes - Smarting, burning, in afternoon or evening. Ecchymosis around from below. Slight agglutination of lids in morning.

Ears - Loud singing in right ear.

Nose - Nosebleed of bright red blood. Increased secretion of mucus all forenoon. Nosebleed.

Face - Congested, red face.

Mouth - Bad taste in mouth.

Throat - Increased secretion of mucus in nostrils all forenoon. Feeling of roughness of pharynx. Sensation as if something had lodged in the upper part of the esophagus that caused frequent inclination to swallow. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Ip., Phos., Ham., Arn., Canth., Cop., Sabin. (2) Terebinthina similar. (3) It is related to Senec., Erech. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Sharp cutting pains in epigastric region every few minutes followed by dull pains. Burning in stomach and abdomen. Belchings of air. Violent retching and burning in the stomach. Vomit or stool of pure blood.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended. Frequent distress in umbilicus with hard, aching distress in whole dorsal region. Frequent dull pain in umbilical region, can be severe, cutting, with a feeling in anus as if it had been torn.

Rectum - Hemorrhages from the bowels. Burning in the bowels and rectum, hard lumps of feces mixed with the discharges. Hemorrhoids, bleeding with ahard, lumpy stools, burning in the margin of anus, it feels as if torn. Rheumatic pains in abdominal muscles. Stools small, streaked with blood. Mushy stools.

Male - Sticky sweat on genitals. Gonorrhea and gleet. Blue, black spots on genitals. Pain in right lumbar region passing down to testicle.

Female - Miscarriage, because of exertion. Pregnant women with a weak uterus. Bloody discharge on slight exertion. Metrorrhagia with violent irritation of rectum and bladder and prolapse uterus. Metrorrhagia after miscarriage with diarrhea or dysentery after least motion. Uterine hemorrhage, bright-red flow (Phos. ). Bloody lochia returns after least motion, comes in gushes, between periods. Bleeding hemorrhoids, nosebleed instead of menses (Bry. ) Leucorrhea with urinary irritation, profuse.

Heart - Palpitations.

Back - Dull, aching distress in whole dorsal region. Dull pains in lumbar and sacral regions. Severe sticking, stabbing pain in region of left kidney, passing to right kidney.

Limbs - Aching dullness in all the joints and limbs. Hard aching in all the limbs. Lungs - Cough, bloody expectoration. Incipient tuberculosis.

Skin - Ecchymosis. Slightly elevated, sharply defined vesicles on skin.

Modalities - Worse from exertion. Worse rest. Worse left side. Worse rainy weather. Every movement aggravates flow, causes bloody lochia to return.

Kidneys - Persistent hemorrhage from the bladder. Bladder, rectal tenesmus with metrorrhagia. Aching in bladder. Retention of urine. Dysuria during dentition, crying when urinating.

Bladder - Frequent desire. Dysuria of teething children. Urination painful or suppressed. Crying when urinating. Urine profuse, with strong odor. External parts (female) inflamed or irritated with considerable mucus discharge.

IERBAL - Yerba Santa, the holy plant, is a popular expectorant remedy in Mexico and California. Allen said “Eriodyction has a strong terebinthine taste and abounds in a resinous matter which sometimes exudes so copiously that in drying, the specimens stick firmly together and to the paper.” IOMEOPATHIC - Erio. is a remedy for asthmatic and bronchial disorders. Asthmatic breathing with accumulation of mucus, relieved when the mucus is cleared. Coryza and catarrh. Coughs after influenza. Whooping cough. Furthers absorption of effusion in pleural cavity. Tubercular conditions, especially bronchial tuberculosis. Tuberculosis as the result of frequent bronchial catarrhs. Impaired digestion, poor appetite, intolerance of food. Wasting, night-sweats.

Head - Pressure outwards, worse occiput. Aching at base of cranium, 8 a.m. Sensation of pressure outwards on all sides of head, greatest at cerebellum upwards. Intense, dull, heavy pain in back of head and over eyes. Burning in occiput, heavy pain as if occiput was being pressed out. Lungs - Asthma, coryza and mucus secretions. Wheezing. Chronic bronchitis, bronchial tuberculosis with profuse, easily raised bronchial secretion, giving relief. Wheezing voice, at 5 p.m. Dull pain in right lung, front.

Ears - Pain in ears. Sharp, shooting pain in right ear, at intervals or on suddenly changing position of head to right or left, changing to just below external ear.

Nose - Coryza with dizziness and sneezing. Yellowish-green catarrh.

Mouth - Foul mouth in morning. Burning in fauces.

Throat - Burning sensation in fauces and throat. Vertigo - Dizziness and a sense of intoxication. COMMENTS-G. M. Payne's proving brought out marked preference for the right lung. Foul mouth in the morning on rising. J. Perry Seward gave it with great success in two cases of cough remaining after influenza. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Grind., Aral., Eucal., Ip. (2) Balsam of Peru, Pix liquida, Stann. (3) afternoon aggravation. Lyc., Grind., Phos., Hep., Rumex, Caust., Dros. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Great appetite. Nausea. Deathly sickness, worse by running.

Male - Sore, dragging, tender feeling in testicles, worse left, could not bear any pressure, better gentle support. Dreaded to move because of its tenderness. Slight fluttering at intervals at bottom of testicles.

Modalities - Worse in afternoon. Nausea, worse on running. Symptoms come at intervals or on any sudden changes of position.

Temperature - Slight fever, cheeks flushed and burning.

PHARMACY - ery-a. Eryngium aquaticum. Button snake-root. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anus, prolapse. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dropsy. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhoids. Influenza. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Kidney,colic. Prostate, weakness. Sclerotitis. Sexual, weakness. Strabismus. Spermatorrhea. Urine incontinence. Wounds.

HERBAL - Eryngium is a remedy for urinary disorders. The English Eryngo, the E. Maritinum, is noted as an aphrodisiac and is very similar in appearance to the Eryngium aquaticum.

HOMEOPATHIC - Acts on the mucus membranes, producing thick yellow mucus discharges from eyes, ears, nose, mouth, bowels, urethra and vagina. Cough with a sense of constriction. Hemorrhages from stomach and bowels. Influenza. It is a vulnerary, antidoting the effect of blows. Headaches, expanding sensation in forehead, dull, dragging pain in occiput, neck and shoulders. Seminal and prostate weakness. For spermatorrhea properly so called or emission of semen without erections. Strangury with nervous weakness. Sweat smells like urine, in evening. MIND - Thoughts are confused. Verysoberand depressed in spirits. Very dull at night. Not able to think steadily on any subject. Cannot concentrate on any subject, the effort causes heavy full, pain if persisted at.

Head - Sharp, shooting pain over left eye, when sitting in stooping posture leaves eye, passes into neck and along muscles of shoulder and beneath scapula. Shooting in coronary region and in right side of face from eyes to teeth in morning. Dull, dragging pain in occiput, neck and shoulders, when less severe in head is worse in shoulder. Scalp sore, combing hair causes pain (Cina.).

Eyes - Purulent inflammation of left eye, sticking discharge causing gumming of lids, conjunctiva granular and rough. Muscles of eyes feel stiff, pain on moving them quickly. Burning, sensitive to light. Effects of exposure to strong light, squinting, sclerotitis, watery or purulent discharges.

Ears - Bruised tearing pain, as if ears being torn off. Inflammation of Eustachian tube, left ear swollen in and out, tender to pressure, constant aching, bleeding readily, thick white, bloody, foul-smelling pus. Continued singing and ringing with creaking sound in left ear.

Nose - Profuse, thick, yellow mucus discharge.

Mouth - Thick, tenacious, disagreeable mucus in mouth.

Throat - Chronic laryngitis. Smarting, raw pain along left side of throat, dry tongue. Intense redness, slight swelling without pain, profuse secretion of thick whitish mucus. Vertigo - Vertigo with an expanding sensation in frontal region above eyes, worse stooping, causing dimness of sight. COMMENTS - Ery-a. has two remarkable cures, reported by Dr. Parks. In the first, a married man injured his testicles by jumping upon a horse, this was followed by discharge of what was considered semen for fifteen years during which time he was treated by allopaths and homeopaths. The emissions were without erections, day or night, and followed by great lassitude. Dr. Parks tried a number of the usual remedies without permanent benefit. He then gave a half grain dose, three times a day of the third decimal trituration of the “Eryngium aquaticum.” In five days the emissions were entirely suppressed and did not return. The second case concerned a married man who was not conscious of having sustained any injury, who was troubled for eight to ten years with emissions at night with erections The semen also passed by day with urine. The loss of semen was followed by great lassitude and depression, continuing from twelve to forty-eight hours. There was also partial impotence. He had been treated al- lopathically. Dr. Parks gave him Ph-ac. for two weeks without material benefit. He then the Ery- a., as above with the same excellent and prompt result. J. Whitfield cured three cases of kidney colic with stones (two left side, the other not stated) with Ery-a. Hale found it useful in epidemic influenza when there was raw, smarting burning in throat and larynx, with constant irritating cough and expectoration of yellow mucus. Loss of energy and nervous weakness. W. K. Leonard reported the following case of a young Methodist minister, apparently healthy, who was just over his twelfth attack of kidney colic. The attacks had recurred at intervals of two to four weeks and lasted from one to three days. They were so weakening as to keep him incapacitated in the intervals. He had old-school treatment including morphine and quinine, without benefit. The attacks were accompanied with severe nervous chills and it was for these that the quinine had been prescribed. Ery-a. tincture, five drops three times a day, put an end to the trouble. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Con., Cann-i., Dios., Oci., Clem. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Partial anorexia. Hollowness or emptiness in stomach with heavy, dragging pain. Nausea, followed by acrid belchings. Spitting of bright arterial blood, mixed with black clots, with burning in epigastrium after a blow on the stomach. Burning in stomach or esophagus after taking the drug.

Abdomen - Severe colicky or cramping pains in small intestines. Severe pain in left groin and testicle.

Rectum - Constipation. Tenesmus at stool, with a sensation of cutting as they pass through anus. Stools dark leaden color, dry and very hard. Mucus diarrhea of children. Hemorrhoids and prolapsed anus.

Male - Discharge of prostatic fluid from slight causes. Desire suppressed, then excited with lewd dreams and pollutions. Seminal emissions without erections, with lassitude (Dios., Phos-ac). Emissions without erections, day and night, followed by great lassitude after injury to testicles. Gonorrhea with painful erections. Gleet.

Female - Leucorrhea.

Chest - Oppression of chest, feeling of fulness, inability to take a full breath.

Back - When headache is less severe, it is worse in neck and shoulders. Weakness and heavy dragging pain in lumbar region.

Modalities - Better from heat. Worse from motion, mental exertion. Bending head forward aggravates head symptoms. Turning eyes causes pain in them. Most symptoms occur on left side and extend or move from part to part.

Kidneys - Congestion of kidneys with dull pain in back, running down the ureters and limbs. Pain behind pubes. Kidney pain, colic (Berb., Pareir., Calc.). Spasmodic stricture. Tenesmus of bladder and urethra. Difficult and frequent urination. Must urinate every five minutes, urine dropping away all the time and burning like fire. Stinging, burning pain in urethra, behind glans during urination. Irritable bladder from enlarged prostate gland or from pressure of uterus. Lungs - Oppression of chest, feeling of fullness inability to take a long breath. Short, hacking cough. Cough with sensation of constriction in throat. Smarting in throat and larynx.

CLINICAL - Cough. Debility. Fever. Herpes. Sexual weakness. Skin eruption.

HERBAL - The maritime Eryngium is a beautiful plant growing on sand-hills by the sea with holly-like leaves of a pale blue color with metallic luster, in general appearance much more resembling a thistle than an Umbelliferae.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ery-m. was proved by one pro ver only, E. B. Ivatts, but the symptoms showed considerable resemblance to those of Ery-a. Pains in the eyes, groins, larynx, nape of neck, sinking at epigastrium and weakness of the male sexual organs appear in both. Ery-m. has its symptoms more prominently on the right side. Circulation deadened or as if stagnated, but great determination of blood to surface. MIND - Light and unusually cheerful. On awaking in the morning feeling so merry commences to sing in bed (usually heavy and drowsy).

Eyes - Pain at back of right eye, left eye feeling weak. Inclination to close eyes to shut out moving objects.

Throat - Voice low, larynx feels weak. Great dryness of throat, larynx and lips.

Stomach - Loss of appetite. Sinking feeling at pit of stomach.

Abdomen - All viscera seemed prostrated and as heavy as lead. Dull, continuous pain in bowels. Pain in one spot in right groin.

Urine - Increased flow of urine, very red, thick on standing. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Phel., Con. and other Umbelliferae. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Male - Insensibility of corona glandis. Absence of desire (secondary action), power of erection quite gone.

Back - Pain at nape, compelling the support of head on hand or against something. Occasional shooting pains under left scapula.

Limbs - Veins of hands at back appear contracted and depressed so as to be hardly visible, though generally full and prominent. Sore pain in muscles inside right thigh just above knee. Lungs - Occasional darting pains through lungs to back. Occasional stomach cough during the day, sending a spasmodic pain to the head.

Skin - Patch of eruption half the size of palm of hand came out in cluster where pain had been the day previous like fine pin-heads, points feeling rough to fingers, died away next day leaving red areola.

Fever - Chills commencing at nape, going down shoulders and back. Chills predominate, little fever heat

COMMENTS - Burnett cured with it a case of pityriasis rubra appearing in a large patch on the chest, and benefited other cases. He believed this form of skin affection to be a manifestation of syphilis in the second generation, the father of the patient he cured having had syphilis. RELATIONS - Aur-m. is the complementary remedy. REFERENCES Clarke.

PHARMACY - esin. Eserinum physostigminum. Eserine. Physostigmine. The alkaloid of Physostigma venenosum, Calabar Bean. Trituration or solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Astigmatism. Blepharospasm. Ciliary, spasm. Glaucoma. Headaches. Heart, weakness. Pupil, contracted. Salivation. Sweat, excessive. Vision, blurred. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Eserine, the alkaloid of physostigma, is best known as used by oculists to procure contraction of the pupils in glaucoma. Esin, contracts the pupils dilated by atropine, but not those by Gels. It slows the action of the heart and increases arterial tension. Ciliary spasm and spasmodic astigmatism due to irregular action of ciliary muscles. Blepharospasms with pupils contracted. Twitching of lids, soreness of eyeballs. Blurred vision after using eyes. Pains around eyes and head.

Head - Violent headache with repeated vomiting.

Eyes - Contraction of pupils. Spasm of accommodation. Ciliary spasm. Blepharospasm. Pain and irritation of eyes on continued reading. Used locally to contract the pupil.

Face - Pale color.

Mouth - Saliva, first increased, later arrested.

Stomach - Vomited profusely, with headache. Repeated vomiting with signs of cardiac weakness. COMMENTS - A remark of Mittendorf that “spasm of the accommodation is also produced artificially by Eserine,” led R. B. Leach to prescribe successfully the 6x trituration in cases of ciliary spasm and of astigmatism due to irregular action of the ciliary muscles. Esin, has also produced blepharospasm. A solution of one grain to the drachm (mixed in mistake for a grain to the ounce) was instilled into the eye of a woman of 60 suffering from cataract. Sweating and lach rymation followed and, as these passed off in a quarter of an hour “clonic spasm of the eyelids’’ set in, “the upper lid falling down on the lower every few seconds.” Spasmodic feeling in lips and the same sensation under jaw of left side followed. Feeling of tremor and spasm without retinal movement, followed in an hour. Pupils contracted to small point. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Phys., Jab., Opium. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Heart - Signs of cardiac weakness increased, after repeated vomiting. Pulse small and thready.

Perspiration - Face and upper part of the body covered with profuse perspiration.

Eyes - Vision changes. Yellowing of the eyes.

Male - Gynecomastia. Libido decreased.

Chest - Pain in your chest or calves.

Limbs - Peripheral edema. Weakness or numbness of an arm or leg. Thrombophlebitis.

Skin - Dryness of skin. Skin irritation, redness, or rash. Darkening of skin. Yellowing of skin.

Liver - Gallbladder obstruction. Hepatitis. Lungs - Sudden shortness of breath. Coughing up blood. Pulmonary embolism.

Temperature - Hot flushes and sweats.
