full:
PHARMACY - euphr. Euphrasia officinalis. Eyebright. N. O. Scrofulariaceae. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Anus, prolapse. Blepharitis. Cataract. Colds. Colic. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Cough. Eye, disorders. Glandular swellings. Granular, eyelids.Hayfever. Influenza. ïntis.Lachryma- tion. Lips, stiffness. Measles. Nasal, catarrh. Nose, cancer. Parotiditis. Phlyctenule. Pimples. Ptosis. Prostate gland, disorders. Scrofula. Staphyloma. Sycosis.

HERBAL - The common name of “eyebright” gives the indication for the use of this remedy. According to Grauvogl, the plant has a “signature of a black spot in the corolla which looks like the eye's pupil.”

HOMEOPATHIC - Produces inflammation of the conjunctiva membranes and profuse lachrymation. It affects the mucus membranes of the eyes, nose and chest, producing acute catarrh with free, acrid, watery secretions. Irritation extends to the skin around the eye and nose, disorders of the external nose. Allergies and hay fever. Tears are acrid, nasal discharge is bland, worse in the evening. Sensation as if sand in the eyes. Acrid pus. Catarrh in the chest, producing hoarseness and cough with profuse expec- toration. Hawking up of offensive mucus, may cause vomiting. Cough after the disappearance of hemorrhoids. Colic, hemorrhoids and condylomata at anus. Drowsiness without being able to sleep, frequent waking in the night as from fright. Symptoms are better in open air. Frequent yawning when walking in the open air. MIND - Taciturn and repugnant to conversation. Aversion to answering. Disinclined to talk. Hypochondriacal mood, takes no interest in his surroundings. Indolence. Melancholy. Abstraction of the mind. Weakness of memory. Confusion better cold bath, better washing face. Inclination to sit. Starting from sleep.

Head - Headaches with coryza. Pressive headache with photophobia and heat, chiefly in the forehead. Sensation as if the head would burst. Catarrhal headache with profuse discharge from eyes and nose. Shootings pain in the temples and in the forehead. Pulsations of head. Beating in the head, perceptible on the outside. Dullness of head with pressure on vertex. Sharp pains in brain.

Eyes - Hay fever with watery eyes. Catarrhal conjunctivitis, discharge of acrid matter. Eyes water all the time. Conjunctivitis with measles. Conjunctivitis instead of the menses. Acrid lachrymation, bland coryza (All-c., opposite). Thick, acrid, yellow discharge from the eyes (Merc.). Profuse hot or acrid tears, worse open air, lying or coughing. Sensation as if sand in the eyes. Little blister on cornea. Sticky mucus on cornea, must wink to remove it. Frequent inclination to blink. Photophobia with spasms of the lids. Sharp pains in eyeballs from bright light. Ptosis (Gels., Caust.). Burning and swelling of the lids. Burning, sharp pains in eyes. Pressive, cutting pains in the eyes. Pain in the eye, alternating with pain in abdomen. Pressure in eyes. Chronic sore eyes. Rheumatic iritis. Cataract with watery eyes. Opacities of cornea after injury.

Ears - Otalgia with piercing pains in the region of the tympanum. Earache. Impaired, during catarrhal fever. Ringing in ear.

Nose - Hay fever and allergies. Profuse bland, fluent coryza, with scalding tears and aversion to light. Profuse, blandfluent coryza. Fluent coryza by day, obstruction of the nose at night. Violent irritation to sneeze, without cold or apparent cause. Excoriation and painful sensibility of the nostrils. Nosebleeds. Purulent pimples on the ale nasi. Small red spots, like pimples, on upper right side of nose. Eruption on wings of nose. Flat cancer on the right side of the nose.

Face - Redness of the face. Rash on face, itching in warmth, becoming red and burning when moistened. Miliary eruption on the face with sensation of burning and redness, on wetting the face. Stiffness of left cheek, tongue. Upper lip stiff as if made of wood. Shootings in the lower jaw and chin.

Mouth - Paralytic stiffness of the tongue and of the cheeks, making speech difficult. Stammering and frequent interruptions in the speech. Sensation of clucking, which mounts into the throat. Shooting pains in lower teeth. Copious bleeding of gums. Nausea and bitterness in the mouth after smoking.

Throat - Gagging when clearing throat in morning. Catarrhal hoarseness, mornings. Irritation of larynx impelling him to cough, followed by tensive pressure beneath sternum. Vertigo - Vertigo with heaviness of head. Vertigo with tendency to fall. Vision - Dim vision hysterical. Everything seems enveloped in a mist and to move. Blurred vision, better wiping. Dim vision, as through a veil, in evening. Dim vision by candlelight, the light seems to vary. Light of candle seems to be dark and to flicker, during headache. Obscuration of vision for distant objects, while walking in open air. COMMENTS - Great affinity for the eyes. Nonspecific organ remedy for the eyes. Good for concomitant symptoms relating to the eyes, particularly tearing or watery eyes, unrelated to current condition. Great value as an eye-lotion, can remove corneal opacities. Allergy infections where the eyes are prominently involved, where the eye swells and waters. Watery, runny eyes, the whites of the eyes are red. Copious tearing, hot, acrid tears that irritate the skin. Eyes smart. Conjunctivitis (Arg-n., Puls.). Conjunctivitis with measles, eye problems since measles. Pink eye, with yellow discharge, better walking around slowly (Puls.). Acute bacterial infections. Sensation that sand or gravel is under the eyelid, constant irritation or itchiness. For dry eyes or blocked ducts. Migraine headaches with eye symptoms. Whooping cough with lachrymation. Photophobia. Colds, hay fever. Sneezing attacks. Coryza worse lying down, at night and in the open air. Worse windy weather. Chilly. Hering noted a cure of “flat cancer on right side of nose.” Ames of Rockland, Ohio, recorded the case of an old man of 79 to whom he gave Euphr. 3x for lachrymation and sneezing. It relieved him of those symptoms in addition to prostatic trouble he had for some years, which compelled him to rise frequently in the night to urinate. This led Ames to give Euphr. in other cases of prostatic trouble with good results. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Puls. Compare: (1) Hydrophyllum, Burr-flower, (catarrhal infl animation of eyes, hot lachrymation with itching, swollen lids, dull headache, alsoforeffectsofPoison-Oak).(2)All-c.,Ars., Gels., Kali-hp„ Sabadilla. (3) Aeth., All-c. - tears bland of Euphr., corrosive. (4) Apis, Arg-n„ Ars., Hep., Kali-bi., Kali-i., Merc., Merc-c. (5) Puls.. Grat., Dig., Tab. Compatible: Aeon., Calc., Con., Nux-v., Phos., Puls., Rhus- t., Sil., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Hiccough. Risings with taste of food. Nausea and bitterness after smoking. Vomiting from hawking mucus.

Abdomen - Frequent colic. Pinchings in abdomen by short fits. Pressive squeezing and burning across abdomen. Colic, alternately with disorders of eyes.

Rectum - Constipation. Hard and scanty evacuations. Dysentery. Prolapse anus. Pressi ve in anus while sitting with hemorrhoids. Old flat condylomata at anus with severe burning, worse at night. Daily stool, but it is hard and scanty. Sensations - As if dust or sand in eyes, as if a hair hung over eyes. As if upper lip were made of wood, stiffness of left cheek and tongue.

Male - Spasmodic retraction of genitals with pressure above the pubic bone. Retraction and tingling of the testes. Prostatitis. Nocturnal irritability of bladder, dribbling urine. Lancination and voluptuous itching in the glans and in the prepuce. Condylomata and sycotic growths, itching, stinging with sore and burning pain when touched.

Female - Menses late, painful, flow lasts only an hour or day. Menses scanty, and short. Amenorrhea with ophthalmia and ulcer on right side of the nose. Stitching pains and itching when walking in open air. Condylomata. Food - Better from coffee. Nausea and bitterness after smoking. Cough better eating. Tickling in trachea worse tobacco smoke.

Chest - Pressive pain beneath sternum. Transient sticking here and there in chest. Sharp pains under the sternum during an inspiration.

Back - Cramp-like, pressive pains in back. Swelling of cervical glands.

Limbs - Numbness in the arms and hands. Cramp-like pressive pains in the hands and the fingers. Fits of (painless) swelling in the joints of the hand or of the fingers on moving them. Cramp pain in the metacarpus. Torpor of the fingers. Shootings in the legs during repose. Stitches in the hip and knee joints when walking. Tension, as from contraction of the tendons, Achilles tendon, on walking. Cracking in the outer ankle of left foot, when stepping. Lungs - Difficulty of breathing, shortness of breath, even when seated. Cough with suspension of respiration. Cough with much, easy expectoration in day, less on lying down, at night. Frequent yawning when walking in open air. Cough in the morning with copious expectoration of mucus and fluent coryza. Whooping cough only in day with profuse lachrymation.

Sleep - Usually worse after sleep. Yawning when walking in open air. Sleepy during the day. Frequent waking (as from fright) at and after 3 a.m., lasting until 6 a.m., when he falls in a stupor from which he wakens with many complaints. Frightful dreams with frequent waking and starting with fright. Dreams of fire, lightning, flames, etc.

Skin - First stage of measles, eye symptoms marked. In measles with watery eyes and fluent coryza it is sometimes the best remedy. Condylomata, itching when walking, burning when touched. Touching skin produces aggravation. Consequences of blows, bruises and contusions. Fine eruption around eyes and on nose. Warts.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better winking. Better wiping eyes. Better dark. Better in bed or getting out of bed. Better from coffee. Worse wind. Worse south winds. Worse warmth. Worse from sunlight. Worse room, indoor. Worse evening. Worse after sleep. Lying down aggravates coryza, better cough. Cold air and wind causes lachrymation. Walking in open air causes yawning.

Kidneys - Frequent and copious emission of clear urine. Nocturnal irritability of bladder. Dribbling urine. Urine too often and copious.

Cough - Cough with easy expectoration, in daytime only, better lying down, better at night. Cough caused by irritation in larynx. Cough with profuse expectoration of mucus. Cough from smoke of wood. Cough after disappearance of hemorrhoids. Cough can be suppressed by a sip of water. Cough after influenza. Whooping cough only in daytime, with profuse lachrymation.

Perspiration - Copious nocturnal sweat. Sweats, mostly on chest, at night during sleep. Sweat often has a strong odor. Very offensive sweat and most copious on front of chest.

Temperature - Chilly and cold. Chill in the forenoon. Descending fever. Attacks of heat during day. Fever with redness of face and cold hands.

name: Eupionum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Bending forward ameliorates pain in abdomen. Bending backwards ameliorates backache. Rest ameliorates headache and pains in abdomen, aggravates other symptoms. Coughing and sneezing aggravates pains in abdomen. Cough returning every winter. Hot drink aggravates toothache. Worse morning and night. Worse blowing the nose..
constitution: Amenorrhea. Cough. Cramps. Dreams. Glandular swellings. Groin, pains. Hemorrhages. Headache. I^eucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Night-sweats. Ovarian, pain. Pruritus. Toothache. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Uterine, displacements. Vicarious, menstruation.
keynote:
PHARMACY - eupi. Eupionum. Wood tar. On distilling wood tar of the rubber tree a volatile oil is obtained which separates into a lighter and heavier oil, the heavier oil is Kreosote, the lighter is Eupion. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea.…
full:
PHARMACY - eupi. Eupionum. Wood tar. On distilling wood tar of the rubber tree a volatile oil is obtained which separates into a lighter and heavier oil, the heavier oil is Kreosote, the lighter is Eupion. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Cough. Cramps. Dreams. Glandular swellings. Groin, pains. Hemorrhages. Headache. I^eucorrhea. Menorrhagia. Neuralgia. Nosebleed. Night-sweats. Ovarian, pain. Pruritus. Toothache. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Uterine, displacements. Vicarious, menstruation.

HOMEOPATHIC - Eupionum is a lighter volatile oil obtained from distillation of wood tar. It was proved by Wahle in Rome, who also proved paraffin. The effects of Eupi. bear a close resemblance to those of Kreos., but are by no means identical with them. Eupi. has a large number of symptoms centered in the female sexual organs. Uterine displacements. Pain in back, followed by a bland leucorrhea. Menses too early and copious, thin flow. Sacrum pains as if broken, backache extends to pelvis, better leaning against anything for support orbending backwards. Cramps in calves at night. Intense sweat from slightest exertion. A sense in the feet as if walking on needles. Sensation as if whole body were made of jelly. Disgusting dreams. MIND - Cheerful, joyous disposition. Irritable, angers easily. Frightened on waking. Great weakness of memory.

Head - Heat at vertex, stitches from vertex down limbs into abdomen and genitals. Sore painful spots on head. Painful pulsation in forehead.

Eyes - Eyes weak, as if she had cried. Pressure above eyes as if the globes would be pushed out. Burning, pressive pains in eye, copious lachrymation. Lachrymation worse in fresh air, better in room. Everything appears pale, as if a thin veil were before eyes.

Ears - Pressing in ears as if the wind was blown forcibly into them for a long time, the external parts being equally affected. Shooting and tearing in left ear, extending to external temporal region.

Nose - Sneezing, each time he blows his nose the sneezing reappears. Sneezing with fluent coryza in morning. Left nostril cracked, bleeding. Bleeding, blood thin and fluid, when blowing nose. Menstrual flow intermits with nosebleed. Soreness in upper nose on drawing air through nostrils in evening.

Face - Hard nodule, the size of a pea, on lower portion of inner side of right cheek. Upper lip fissured and painful, as if raw. Lips and throat always dry, yet without thirst. Lips painful as if sore.

Mouth - Whole tongue red, covered with raised pimples like herring roe. Tip of tongue dry, back covered with thin, dirty white coating. Anterior part of tongue rough like a grater. Insensible feeling in mouth, as if scalded by fat. Pappy and sticky in mouth, early in morning. Sour, putrid taste after eating.

Throat - Sensation below larynx as if something was sticking there, with a short, dry, hacking cough. In morning, much white bad-tasting mucus in throat, expectorated after slight paroxysms of coughing. Sensation of mucus in throat without being able to expectorate. Sensation of dryness of uvula. Vertigo - Everything turns around on sitting up in bed. COMMENTS - Menstruation is too early and too copious, thin and fluid flow. Cutting in abdomen ceases when flow comes on. Nosebleed, when menstrual flow intermits. Yellow leucorrhea after menses, staining yellow. Eupionum Leucorrhea with severe backache, has to lean against something to give relief, when the backache ceases the discharge gushes out. Palpitation with slow pulse. Painless pulsation in the head. Pulsations all over body while sitting quietly. Sticking pains in head and other parts. Cramps in the calves when accompanying uterine or chest complaints. Weak eyes and obscured vision. Pressing in ears as if wind were blown in with force and for a long time. Teeth stick together when jaws are closed in morning sensation as if teeth were embedded in some soft matter. Tongue covered with raised nodules. Pain in inguinal region. Nodules appear on inner side of right cheek, left side of neck and left forearm. Painful glandular swellings in groins. Spasmodic, periodic pain an inch up rectum. Bloody stool. Headache and chilliness. Coldness of whole right side of the body. Colliquative perspiration. Perspires from least exertion, when eating, all night (with tuberculosis). Wobbling sensation in upper part of body, everything becomes dark to her. Great irritability. RELATIONS - Graph, antidoted the effects on eyelids. Compare: (1) Kreos. and the Carbons. (2) Lach. - pain ceases when discharges appear. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

Stomach - Region of stomach feels internally sore and distended, pains under both short ribs. Bloated and sensation of fullness of stomach with internal chilliness in evening. Belchings tasting of food. Vomiting of food. Vomit emanating from lower abdomen, dark green, tasteless mucus.

Abdomen - Stitches when walking in left anterior crest of ilium. Squeezing, pressing pain in left groin when quiet. Pains better passing flatus. Contracting pain and twisting better by bending over, day before menstruation. Cutting pains during menstruation, when the pains cease discharge is always copious, blood red and very thin.

Rectum - Itching after stool. Ineffectual inclination and straining. Tenesmus, better when blood is passed, this weakens her. Constipation, stool every three or four days with great straining and prolapsed uterus. Hard, dry stools with great straining. Dark blood in painless stools. Sensations - As if dislocation of joints. As if muscles torn from bones, as if skin and muscles were too short. Soles of feet numb as if walking on needles, sticking in heels.

Female - Menses too early and copious, irritable. During menses, irritable and disinclined to talk, burning and stitches in chest and heart. Gushing leucorrhea, yellow, staining. Leucorrhea with severe backache after menses, when pain in the back ceases, leucorrhea gushes out. Sore pain between labia during urination. Pruritus pudendi, labia swollen. Burning in right ovary. Chronic tubal disease. Uterine flexions. Uterine displacements.

Chest - Heaviness, oppression, stitches and tickling in chest. Stitches and pressure in sternum.

Heart - Palpitations with slow pulse, believes her heart must be heard some distance away. Severe palpitations before menses, ceasing when the flow begins.

Back - Sacrum pains as if broken. Pressive heaviness in lumbar vertebrae. Severe backache, must lean against something for support. Pains extend into pelvis. Backache alternating with leucorrhea. Backache during menses. Breasts - Breasts increase in size with pres- sive pains in them, as if something painful were drawn through them, with oppression. Stitches under right breast.

Limbs - Cramps in the calves, worse at night. Paralytic, dislocation pain in right knee. Stitches in either knee. Tearing in limbs and restlessness in legs preventing sleep. Dislocation pains in joints of right hand. Heads of bones of fingers feel too large. Hands go to sleep easily. Lungs - Crawling in upper bronchi causing dry cough. Rough, scraping, metallic, dry cough. Hard, suffocating, dry cough with stitches in chest, returning every winter. Cough better by warm drinks, by sitting up on bed with breaking out of perspiration.

Sleep - Yawning with chilliness and shivering. Sleepiness towards noon. Dreams of disgusting things, of naked persons, anxious dreams of her child falling into the water. Frightful dreams, the same dream repeated, that she is pursued, or falling into an abyss. Wakes bathed in perspiration.

Skin - Nodule on left forearm. Itching, biting in skin, in genitals, penetrating whole body, worse night, better during motion.

Modalities - Bending forward ameliorates pain in abdomen. Bending backwards ameliorates backache. Rest ameliorates headache and pains in abdomen, aggravates other symptoms. Coughing and sneezing aggravates pains in abdomen. Cough returning every winter. Hot drink aggravates toothache. Worse morning and night. Worse blowing the nose.

Teeth - The teeth stick together when the jaws are closed. Teeth painful as if loose, gums swollen, scorbutic, worse by hot soup. Toothache-like numbness in carious molars, coming on immediately on lying down, better on rising and moving about. Sensation as if gums swollen and teeth would drop out. Gums swollen. Painful jerking-tearing in gums.

Kidneys - Frequent inclination, scanty discharge, worse when standing than sitting. Copious urine, lemon color, chestnut brown before menses. Hot urine passed without pain.

Temperature - Chilliness, with headache, stitching, better by warm drink. Dry heat towards noon. Foul smelling sweat on least exertion, when eating, all night. Copious night-sweat towards morning.

PHARMACY - fago. Fagopyrum esculentum. Buckwheat. Polygonum fagopyrum. N. O. Polygonacae. Tincture of the whole mature plant. The fresh mature plant is pounded to a pulp and macerated in two parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincmre and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Arteries, throbbing. Belching. Depression. Diarrhea. Eczema. Eyes, disorders. Genitals, sweat. Granular, eyelids. Hands, sweat. Headache. Heart, disorders. Heartburn. Intertrigo. Itching. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Mumps. Nausea. Nose, crusts. Ophthalmia. Palpitations. Pruritus, pudendi. Pruritus, vulvae. Rheumatism. Skin, eruptions. Styes. Taste, altered. Throat, sore.

HOMEOPATHIC - Fagopyrum, commonly known as buckwheat, acts upon the skin and the digestive organs. It has had an extensive proving. Though there is little clinical experience with this herbal remedy on record, some features are sufficiently well marked to justify their being classed as characteristics. Itching, felt in different parts of the body, eyes, posterior sinuses, anus, deep in hands, legs etc. Intense an itching of the arms and legs, becoming worse toward evening. Senile itching,pruritus. Itching erythema. Blotches like fleabites, sometimes all over the body, sore to the touch and are multiplied by scratching. Persistent eruptions. Large blind boils. The itching of the face is especially marked about the roots of the whiskers. Persistent itching of the hands which is “deep in,” being supposed to be the result of irritation of the coats of the arteries. Offensive excretions. Fluent coryza. Postnasal catarrh, dry crusts, granular appearance of posterior sinuses with itching. Pain in streaks. Visible pulsation of the carotids and other arteries. MIND - Depressed and irritable. Irritable, cross. Exceedingly happy. Inability to fix attention, study or to remember what has been read. Aversion to being spoken to. Confusion of mind better after eating. Restlessness during mental labor, when attempting to study.

Head - Itching in and around eyes and ears. Pains deep in head with upward pressure. Headaches with a tired neck, better bending backwards. Head hot, better bending backward with tired neck. Occipital headache. Bursting pains. Cerebral hyperemia.

Eyes - Eyes swollen, red, hot, itching, as if sand in eyes. Itching and smarting, swelling, heat and sorenéss. Itching in the margins. Aching deep in eyeballs. As if eyeballs were pushed out. Lachrymation, worse by reading. Pain along lachrymal duct. Meibomian glands of left lower lid inflamed.

Ears - Itching in and around ears. Heat, itching and neuralgic pains in external ears. Itching along Eustachian tubes.

Nose - Itching in posterior sinuses. Postnasal catarrh. Fluent coryza with sneezing, followed by dryness and crust formation. Nose red and sore externally. Septum deeply cracked.

Face - Face flushed. Soreness of left malar bone, also of temporal region. Lips dry and cracked, vertical crack on upper lip.

Mouth - Soreness of teeth on closing them, worse by cold water. Gums sore and bleed easily. Swelling in roof of mouth. Bad taste in mouth in morning. Taste of ingesta after dinner, with belchings.

Throat - Soreness and a feeling of excoriation deep down pharynx. Uvula elongated, tonsils swollen. Thick mucus collects in throat on rising. Badly-smelling cheesy mass coughed up. Feeling as if a lump in esophagus, painful on swallowing. Throbbing of carotids. COMMENTS - Berridge recorded two cases in which Fago, was of service. The first case concerned a dull, bruised pain in top of left shoulder, rather posteriorly, extending up neck, worse on moving the part, appearing on waking, going off after breakfast and returning later in the day. Constipation. Nausea a little before 11 a.m., afterwards dull pain in left temple and a feeling of heat all over. After aggravating the pain in the shoulder, Fago, removed the symptoms. In the second case. Fago, permanently removed, after a week's aggravation, sinking in the stomach about 6 p.m. or 7 p.m., and temporarily removed a chronic diarrhea about 6 p.m. or 7 a.m. The diarrhea was later increased and was met by Lach. Hale mentioned that there was a popular belief that indulgence in buckwheat cakes is a prolific cause of skin eruptions. He found it curative in cases of eczema, erythema and intertrigo. Deep-seated and persistent effects upon the head. Vertigo, confusion. Severe pres- sive or bursting pain in many parts of head with upward pressure. Pain in forehead, back of eyes, through temporal region on either side. Congestive headaches (Bell., Glon., Nux-v., Sep.). Itching, smarting, swelling, heat and soreness in the eyes. Soreness in the ears. Erysipelas, frostbite (Agar.). Swollen, red, inflamed and sore nose. Fluent coryza with sneezing, followed by fullness, dryness and the formation of crusts. Burning, sore- Fagopyrum esculentum ness and persistent pain from even gentle pressure. The face is pale or unevenly flushed with dark semicircles below the eyes. Swollen, hot and dry, as though severely sunburned, with cracked and sore lips. The mouth feels dry and hot and yet saliva is not wanting. Soreness and swelling of roof of mouth. Tongue is red and fissured along its edges. Bad taste in the morning (Puls.). Soreness with pain in throat, just back of the isthmus of the fauces. Feeling of excoriation and soreness extending deep down in the pharynx. Elongated uvula, swollen and red tonsils. Sensation of rawness in the throat (Phyt.). Scarlet redness of the neck below the mastoid process. Throbbing of the carotids. Neck feels tired, the head heavy. Parotid glands are swollen and painful. Persistent morning nausea, vomiting of pregnancy. Appetite improved by eating (opposite of Lyc., Nux-m.). Empty or “all- gone” feeling at the stomach (Sep.). Fullness and pain in the abdomen, but no rumbling. Frequent discharges of flatus. The region of the liver is painful, tender, worse from pressure, compelling the patient to lie on the left side. Stools are pappy or watery, profuse, offensive, followed by tenesmus. Scalding urine, pain extends from testicles to abdomen. Profuse, offensive smelling perspiration on the male genital organ. Bruised or burning pain in the right ovary, particularly when walking. Pruritus with slight yellow leucorrhea, more when at rest than when exercising. Persistent, heavy, pulsating pain in chest, worse from deep inspiration. Dull pains around the heart, with oppression and occasional sharp pains passing through the heart. Pressure with the hand increases the oppression. Increased pulse, extremely variable. Stiffness and soreness of all the muscles of the neck, with pain and a feeling as if the neck would hardly support the head. Dull pains in small of back with stitching pains in the region of the kidneys. Pains with occasional sharp stitches extend from the arms to muscles of both sides of chest. Dull, aching, rheumatic pains in the shoulder. Stinging and burning pains extend the whole length of fingers, aggravated by motion. Streaking pains pass through arms and legs with sharp pains extending to feet. Pains extend from hips to small of back, frequently run down to the feet. Sleepiness in the evening, stretching and yawning. Easily wakened when the mind is diverted, but soon falls again into sleepiness. Sleep is disturbed by troublesome dreams and frequent waking. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dolichos, Bov., Psor., Sulph., Urtica. (2) Rhus-t. - better by motion. Senega - better bending head back. (3) Lyc. - hours of aggravation 3 to 6 p.m. (4) Puls., Polygonum. (5) Coffee relieves stomach symptoms. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Clarke.

Stomach - Bruised, sore feeling in stomach. Uneasy, empty feeling in stomach. Belchings of scalding, hot, acid, watery substance, better coffee. Drooling. Persistent nausea, better eating.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended with flatulence, worse by pressure of clothes. Soreness in hypogastrium.

Rectum - Itching in anus. Burning in rectum after stool, creeping, urging, tenesmus. Diarrhea with tenesmus, stools watery or pappy with flatulence, very offensive.

Male - Profuse offensive sweat of genital organs.

Female - Itching, better by cold water. Pruritus vulvae with yellow leucorrhea, worse rest. Leucorrhea staining yellow. Burning in right ovary. Pains in right ovary, on walking in afternoon.

Chest - Heavy feeling, bruised pains and stitches in chest. Twinges of pain up and down left breast, outer side. Sharp, stitch-like needle prick in right breast on inspiration. After retiring, severe sticking through breast from nipple backward, better by pressure. Constitutions - Weak constitutions.

Heart - Pain around heart, better lying on back, extending to left shoulder and arm. Palpitations with oppression. Pulse irregular intermittent, rapid. Light feeling in chest. Throbbing in all arteries after retiring.

Back - Stiffness and bruised feeling in the muscles of the neck with sensation as if nape would not support the head. Breasts - Breast less painful than usual before period.

Neck - Parotid and submaxillary glands swollen, sore and painful. Stiffness of neck and soreness of all neck muscles. Neck tired, as if unable to support head. Dull pain in back of neck, at base of occiput,’ better bending head backwards.

Limbs - Stiffness and bruised sensation in the muscles of the neck, with sensation as if nape of neck could not support head. Pain in shoulder with pain along fingers. Itching in arms and legs, worse towards evening. Itching deep in hands. Streaking pains in arms and legs. Feet numb and pricking.

Sleep - Constant desire to yawn and stretch, 5 to 6 p.m. Restless night, wakes 5 a.m. and sleeps again, many dreams.

Skin - Eczema. Erythema. Intertrigo. Blind boils. Skin hot. swollen. Severe itching, better by bathing in cold water, worse scratching, and touch. Itching of hands, deep within.Itching of knees, elbows and hairy portions. Senile pruritus. Sore, red blotches. Vesicular, pustular and phlegmonous dermatitis.

Modalities - Better coffee. Better cold water. Better cold applications. Better cold air. Better sitting still. Better in a warm room. Better pressure and motion. Worse in the afternoon. Worse from sunlight. Worse walking. Worse in bright sunlight. Worse from motion. Worse deep inspiration. Worse stooping. Worse ascending. Worse writing. Worse scratching. Worse riding in cars. Worse lying on right side. Worse after retiring.

Liver - Pain in region of liver on stooping. Bruised, sore feeling at 10 a.m., worse lying on right side. Sharp sticking through liver from the back. Lungs - Touching the neck occasions a cough with a smarting sensation extending to the ear and throat, under lobe of right ear. Breath very offensive.

Kidneys - Stitching pains in region of right kidney. Cutting in urethra. Difficulty in voiding last drops of urine, several drops pass after he thinks he has finished.

Temperature - Chills along back in afternoon. Cold, clammy sweat at night, very profuse. Sweat of hands, though cold. Hands and feet alternately hot and cold. Soles of feet moist, disagreeable odor in axilla. Face, head and hands burn in afternoon. Heat and restlessness after retiring.

PHARMACY - fagu. Fagus silvática. Beechnut. Fagus farfara. N. O. Cupuliferae. Fagaceae. Tincture or trituration of the nuts. The beechnuts are pounded to a pulp and macerated in five parts by weight of alcohol. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Convulsions. Epilepsy. Headaches. Hydrophobia. Rabies. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Knowledge of this remedy is derived from the ill effects of eating the nuts, among which are dread of liquids and salivation, suggesting its use in hydrophobia or rabies. John Bauhin said that the nuts would disorderthe head like darnel; hogs grow stupid and drowsy by feeding on them. Ray and Mangetus agree. Trembling, convulsions with periodic spasms, stiffness and coldness have been observed, pointing to nerve irritation. Swelling of the mouth and headache were noted in one case. In some instances, death has resulted from the effects of the nuts. COMMENTS - Dr. E. Berridge contributed a case in which “a boy aged 13 had eaten four days ago a large quantity of beech nuts. I found him in great pain, languid and terrified. Also, with apprehensions of present death. Pulse very unequal, sometimes extremely quick, sometimes languid and intermittent, skin burning violently, mouth flowing with froth and saliva. “Intolerable thirst, entreating fordrink, but so soon as any liquid was brought he seemed to shudder with equal horror, as if he had been eating unripe grapes. Soon after eating the nuts he had been seized with torpor, gloominess and dread of liquids. He had not been bitten by any rabid animal. “Next day, early in the morning, he was the same, but seemed to talk more in his wildness and perturbation of mind and his mouth flowed with foam more abundantly, the urine he had voided by night was red and fiery, depositing a copious turbid white sediment, resembling an emulsion of beech nuts, subsiding as deep as the breadth of the finger at the bottom of the vessel. “A few hours before he died he vomited a porraceous bile after which he died quietly.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Epiphegus in headache and salivation, Epiphegus which grows on the beech and partakes of its properties. (2) Rabies - Bell., Lyssin. REFERENCES - Anshutz.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ox gall is a remedy of very ancient use. It is used in the old school mostly as a purgative, for preventing putrefactive changes in the intestines, and for increasing peristalsis. It was proved by Buchner. Disordered digestion, diarrhea, constipation. Chronic gastric and intestinal catarrh. Much flatus, ascites. Diabetes. Obstruction of the gall ducts. Gallstones. Jaundice. Cirrhosis of liver. Increases the duodenal secretion, emulsifies fats and increases the action of the intestines. Liquefies bile and acts as a purgative and chologogue. Nape of neck pains. Pains in joints and cramps. Headache. Tendency to sleep after eating. MIND - Peevish, irritable mood. Greatly inclined to al 1 kinds of business, unpleasant impression did not affect him.

Head - Confusion. Violent headache in morning, on pressure upon right temple, extending to occiput and nape of neck.

Stomach - Gurgling in stomach and epigastric region. Odorless and tasteless belchings.

Abdomen - Violent peristaltic movements. Rumblings and motions in abdomen.

Rectum - Stool with urging and sensation of warmth in anus. Stool thin, pasty, followed by pressing, although with crumbling feces.

Male - Scrotum itching, moist.

Chest - Anxiety in chest. Constriction, on walking at 3 a.m. cannot sleep again for tightness of breath and cannot remain lying, it seems as though something in throat prevented free passage of the air, better by deep inspiration and sitting upright. Food - Increased thirst.

Back - Tension in nape.

Limbs - Some tearings in left shoulder joint, extending up to nape of neck. Cramp in right toe.

Sleep - Tendency to sleep after eating. Sound sleep in morning with some perspiration. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Merc-d. (2) Choi. in gallstones. (3) Calcul-b. - triturate Gallstones up to 10 to 12x. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Kidneys - Urging. Offensive urine.

full:
PHARMACY - feld. Feldspar. Mineral varieties, containing alumina, silica and oxygen. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Arteriosclerosis. Fainting. Otosclerosis. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - It is a silicate compound containing potassium, sodium and aluminium. Kaolin is a disintegrated feldspar which has lost its potassium and sodium but has retained the silicate of aluminium. It is not similar to feldspar in its use. The chemical composition suggests a use in arteriosclerosis and those illnesses showing sclerosis and fibrosis of the tissue. COMMENTS - Two cases of otosclerosis were cured clinically, both occurring in patients forty-one years old. Both were nervous, disposed to tremble, and complained of weakness. One said he felt if he had been struck on the head and was about to faint. He had sensations of heat on hands and feet. His head pained on moving. Both cases recovered after many weeks of treatment. These symptoms are common to silica and the kalis, hence, the weakness is characteristic of Feld. A woman age 38, had had varicose veins for many years. Her skin injured easily. Under Feld, she was freed of the pains in the legs. The tendency of the skin to injure disappeared at the start of treatment, the varicose veins remained. A woman age 48, was given Feld, for retinal hemorrhages five months after the attack. At times she showed glycosuria and was very nervous. After two months treatment, the nervousness and eye affects improved fifty percent, and she experienced a feeling of general well being. A woman age 53, received Feld, for fainting spells resulting from an arteriosclerotic heart. She suffered from incipient arcus seniles; by resting in bed she regained normalcy, at least concerning her domestic work. A man age 70, with an arteriosclerotic kidney, suffered from hematuria. Under Feld, he was on his feet again as an ambulatory patient. A woman age 84, with marked arteriosclerosis, cardiac decompensation and edema received Feld, and a decoction of Apoc. The dropsy disappeared. Several weeks later the dropsy returned, gangrene of the foot developed, and she died. A man age 70, with severe dropsy of both feet, received Feld, and Apoc. He recovered in two months. We can only guess what the future holds in store for him. A woman age 50, with high arterial pressure, spells of weakness, and nervous exhaustion, received Feld, in a series of doses. Her complaints disappeared. Chronic cases improve slowly, quick results should not be expected in these cases. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil., Calc-f., Calc. REFERENCES - Thompson.

PHARMACY - ferr-ar. Ferrum arsenicosum. Iron arseniate. Tri-ferric diarsenate. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anemia. Bright's disease. Chilly. Chlorosis. Constipation. Debility. Diarrhea. Eczema. Headache. Impetigo. Leucorrhea. Liver, enlargement. Psoriasis. Spleen, enlargement.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hale was the first to use Ferr-ar., giving the 2x with a promptly curative result to an anemic girl who had been given iron and arsenic separately, under old-school treatment, in vain. P. C. Majumdar put Ferr-ar. to excellent use in cases of enlarged liver and spleen with fever. When there is no fever Ferr-i. is better. Enlarged liver and spleen with high fever of a continued type. During fever the face is flushed and sweaty, but during the intermission the face is pale. No thirst during any stage of the fever, heat intense and prolonged with slight burning of the whole body, emaciation and debility. Undigested stool. Constipation, sometimes, colliquative diarrhea, the stools consisting of undigested matter and mucus. Albuminuria. Skin dry. Eczema, psoriasis, impetigo. Simple and pernicious anemia and chlorosis. Disinclination to work, even to leave his bed. MINDS - Conscientious about trifles. Restlessness at night, driving out of bed. Sensitive to noise. Fear in a crowd. Fear of evil. Fear of people. Tossing about in bed. COMMENTS - Majumdar reported two cases. The first, concerning a robust, healthy man, 25, who went into a malaria district of Bengal and had his first attack of fever. He was given large does of quinine, which suppressed the paroxysms for a time, but they continually recurred. After four years he returned home achanged man: pale, jaundiced, emaciated, abdomen filled with enlarged and indurated liver and spleen, slightly tender to pressure. His organs left no room for food. Obstinate constipation. High fever generally appearing in afternoon, no chill or thirst, but copious sweat without much relief to fever. Ferr-ar. 6c, twice daily, made an improvement in three days. It was continued for a month and a half with occasional stoppages and in six months he was completely restored to health. The second case concerned a boy, 15, who suffered from fever and enlarged spleen. The liver was not enlarged. Voracious appetite, but no digestion, undigested diarrhea stools. Continued fever, 102 to 104, burning of body. Some thirst. Great emaciation. Ferr-ar. 6c was given night and morning. He was cured perfectly in a year. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ferr-i., Ferr., Ars., Calc-a., Chin. REFERENCES - Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Sarah N. Smith of New York proved Ferr-br., using the sixth dilution, made by Boericke andTafel. Ferr-br. Produced, in this order, were very distinct symptoms in the head and eyes, dry mouth and nose, relieved by coryza, a feeling that she might die, diarrhea, burning in urethra when urinating, sticky, excoriating leucorrhea, and weight and discomfort in uterus. The symptoms that made the most impression on the prover were the “dead, numbness" feeling of the scalp, the unconscious moaning after stool and the sticky, excoriating leucorrhea. Heaviness and discomfort in the uterus was so severe that she declined to continue the proving as it interfered with her work. COMMENTS - Hale mentioned this remedy as having been highly commended in cases of spermatorrhea with anemia, debility and depression. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Heavy eyes. Con., Caust., Gels. (2) Smarting while urinating, Cann-s. - has burning while urinating and after. REFERENCES - Clarke.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Alcohol, effects. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Boils. Breast, tumors. Bronchorrhea. Cancer. Catarrh. Coryza. Debility. Diabetes. Dyspepsia. Exophthalmic, goiter. Eyes, scrofulous. HOMEOPATHIC - Ferrum iodatum has been independently proved, and corresponds more particularly to scrofulous affection, glandular enlargement and tumors. Grimmer used Ferr-i. for breast tumors, cancer, exophthalmic goiter inflammation and enlargement of glands, symptoms and conditions based on the tubercular diathesis. Berridge removed with Fen-i. “Morning catarrh, hot and restless in bed, sweet smell of urine.” “Food seems to push up to throat as if it has not been swallowed,” somewhat like the Ferr. symptom “as if something rolled into ihroal and closed il like a valve. "Sharpor cutting pains in the eyes, ears and root of nose to occiput. Sensation as if lying in a cramped position. Anemia. Body emaciated. Debility following drain upon vital forces. Impetigo of the cheek. Crops of boils. Acute nephritis following eruptive diseases. Exophthalmic goiter following suppression of menses. Uterine displacements. Breast tumors, cancer and conditions based on the tubercular diathesis. MIND - Dullness of mind and confusion in head worse when reading aloud. Anxiety. Aversion to company. Conscientious about trifles. Confusion worse putting hat on. Confusion while reading. Confusion after smoking. Confusion while writing.

Head - Headache with a confused sensation. Headache with feeling of heaviness and pressure. Sharp pain from below eye up through head to vertex. Cutting pain from bridge of nose to occiput. Headache on going to bed. Throbbing pain in head on right side and forehead. Headache worse smoking.

Eyes - Eyes shut on account of pain. Lids swollen, discharging copious quantities of pus when forcibly opened. Exophthalmic goiter, after menses suppressed. Burning in eyelids. Photophobia. Trachoma. Bright objects floating before eyes, like sparks of fire, after breakfast.

Ears - Roaring in ears.

Nose - Nose dry, stopped up. Blowing nose gives no relief. Coryza. Scrofulous swelling of nose, with ulcers and crusts inside. Discharge of mucus from nose, trachea, and larynx. Discharge all day, with stuffed-up feeling at night. Discharge thick, yellow or green.

Face - Red, chlorotic look. Itching of right cheek, reddening when rubbed. Submaxillary and cervical glands swollen and hard. Vesicles, when rubbed, become raw.

Mouth - Salivation. Sudden bleeding of gums. Offensive taste. Metallic, bitter taste. Flat, insipid taste. Taste of peppermint. Dryness of mouth and throat. Mucus membrane of mouth bright red or dotted with red.

Throat - Sore pain, as if of a splinter, shooting in different directions. Hoarse. Violent scraping and tickling in throat and nose. Frequent rattling of mucus in throat.

Stomach - Dyspepsia with nausea and headache. Impaired digestion. Food seems to push up in the throat, as if it had not been swallowed. Violent eructations. Sour and bitter risings. Stomach full of gas.

Abdomen - Abdomen bloated after food or drink. Fullness, even after a little food, stuffed feeling, as if she could not lean forward. Abdomen swollen. As if a cord were drawn connecting the navel and anus.

Rectum - Crawling in rectum. Constriction in rectum and anus. Sensation as if worms were in it. Small, hard stool, with sticking pain. Constipation then loose stools, preceded by griping pain. Sensations - As if anus were compressed. As if worms were in anus. As if something twisted around about in a circle, as if a cord were drawn connecting navel and anus, as if a screw were boring in anus.

Male - Nocturnal emissions with violent pain and burning in urethra. Inability to urinate. Tenesmus of neck of bladder Prickling itching in urethra, with frequent urging to urinate, but scanty flow. Gonorrhea.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses is absent with exophthalmic goiter. Menses suppressed or scanty. Constant bearing down. When sitting, a feeling as if something pressed upward in vagina. Retroversion and prolapse of uterus. Prolapsed uterus, difficult to retain the urine. Itching and soreness of vulva and vagina. Leucorrhea like boiled starch. Food - No appetite. Craving for sardines or salty fish. Great thirst.

Chest - Oppression of chest with inclination to lie on back. Pressure beneath sternum. Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous or mercurial diathesis to subjects of relaxed tissue (tuberculosis in the third stage, bronchorrhea, pneumonia).

Heart - Palpitations at night. Heartbeats seems to go into stomach, and cause a nervous, trembling feeling. Bloodvessels throb all over, even when quiet. Violent beating of heart on rising or when turning in bed.

Back - Small of back as if broken. Pain as if lying in a cramped position. Neck sore when touched or on moving. Dull pain in back. Stiffness on getting up from bed, better during day.

Limbs - Weak, trembling feeling in limbs on using hands and on walking. Paralyzed and bruised feeling in all limbs, with great aversion to moving about. Lungs - Bronchorrhea. Chronic pneumonia. Shortness of breath, obliged to take a deep breath. Greenish, purulent, containing small, cheesy particles. Grayish-white, rather tenacious mucus drawn out in threads.

Sleep - Frequent starting in sleep and waking with feeling as if paralyzed. Restless sleep with frequent waking. Dreams of long past events. Dreams of thieves. Dreams of fighting with them.

Skin - Pale skin. Eczema. Lichen. Shortlasting skin eruptions. Eruptions like urticaria.

Modalities - Better from open air. Worse from motion. Worse touch. Worse warmth. Worse at night and in the morning.

Tongue - Burning on tongue. Tongue coated thickly yellow. Vertigo - Dizziness worse moving. COMMENTS - P. C. MajumdarusedFerr-i. with success in cases of enlarged liver and spleen when unaccompanied by fever. When fever is present Ferr-ars. is the better remedy. “Feels as if she has eaten too much, a sort of upward pressure. Stuffed feeling in abdomen as if she could not lean forward, costiveness,” especially incasesof enlarged spleen. “Sweet-smelling urine.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Alum. - anemia, leucorrhea, prolapse uterus. Alumn. - swollen vagina, prolapse uterus. (2) Caul. - prolapse uterus and leucorrhea from atony, fitful, crampy pains. (3) Melon. - pruritus, prolapse, leucorrhea. albuminuria. (4) Hydr. - debility and atony, tenacious, profuse leucorrhea, palpitations. (5) Graph. - chlorosis, leucorrhea profuse, hot, watery. (6) lod. - red face, irritability, corroding leucorrhea, emaciation marked. (7) Kali-bi. - has stringy, albuminous leucorrhea, stringy expectoration. (8) Thyr. - palpitations, exophthalmic goiter. (9) Ferr-br. - leucorrhea, prolapsed uterus. (10) Ferr-a. - enlarged liver and spleen. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Difficulty in retaining urine. Incontinence in anemic children. Crawling sensation in urethra and rectum. Sensation as if urine were stopped at fossa navicularis. Urine, sweet smelling. Urine, dark colored. Urine, depositing thick white sediment.

Cough - Hemoptysis. Short, hacking cough with yellowish-white, thick expectoration.

Perspiration - Sweat at night is cold and copious, and comes from the least exertion.

Magnetic Ferric Oxide)

PHARMACY - ferr-ma. Ferrum magneticum. Magnetic ferric oxide. Loadstone. Iron ses- quioxide. A black oxide of iron. Historical dose: All potencies. /

CLINICAL - Amaurosis. Diarrhea. Flatus. Ganglions. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Vision, disorders. Warts. Weakness. Whitlow.

HOMEOPATHIC - Caspari is the authority for Ferr-ma. Teste, who put Ferr-ma. in the Arnica group along with Led., Crot-t., Rhus- t. and Spig., had some experience with it. Indicated for the sycotic constitution. Small warts on hands. Ferr-ma. produces paralytic weaknesses like the other iron preparations, of which this; is the most peculiar: after perspiring during a moderate walk, weakness and lassitude, which seem to proceed from the abdomen. Difficulty of movement and relaxation of muscles. Prickings, lancinations, tingling and itching in different parts. Pains and itchings, some of which reappear at intervals of four weeks. Pain in nape of neck. Trembling in the legs and arms. Excessive lassitude. Fatigue on taking the slightest exercise. Worse during a meal, flatulency, grumblings, movements in abdomen with urgent diarrhea after a meal (Ferr.). Abdominal sufferings are felt more on the left side. Very abundant and frequent emission of fetid wind. MIND - Indecision and long reflection before undertaking anything. Indolence, slowness of movement. Air of importance and self-sufficiency. Irascibility.

Head - Pulsative headache, by fits. Circumscribed headache in the morning, generally on right side. Headache on stooping, on moving the arms, and on going up stairs. Itching in the scalp. Small, painful eruption on the scalp. Falling off of the hair.

Eyes - Pricking itching in the canthi. Painful sensibility of the lachrymal sac with profuse lachrymation. Pressive pain on the eyelid, which impedes the sight. Swelling of the lower lid, which makes the eye appear smaller. Darkness before the right eye, causing it to wink.

Ears - Tingling in the ears. Itching, wringing and cold lancinations in the auditory duct. Pullings in the ears and the pharynx when swallowing.

Nose - Sneezing, with stoppage of one nostril and catarrh.

Face - Face dejected with general heat, followed by redness of the face. Itching and tingling in the face and on the lips. Eruptions on the forehead in the eyebrows, at the root of the nose, on the cheeks, the lips and the chin.

Mouth - Accumulation of water and saliva in the mouth. Itching sensation in the posterior part of the palate.

Throat - Bitter and rancid taste in the pharynx, on hawking. Sensation as if mucus were adhering to the uvula. Lancinations in the throat. Pressure in the esophagus, as if too much had been swallowed at one time. COMMENTS - Ferr-ma. relieved, after Spig. failed, in an old man suffering from chronic rheumatism of the nape of the neck with irritable disposition. Cured a case of compound capsular cataract in a gouty patient. A third patient had rheumatism of both thighs, coming on after violent exercise. This patient was treated in two attacks. In the first attack he received Arn. first and then Ferr-ma. In the second, Ferr-ma. was given at once and the effect was speedy and marked. Teste noted the case of a patient who had a very unpleasant experience with the medicine. He suffered from a mercurial neurosis and was very sensitive to medicines. Teste was led to give the medicine due to a painful contraction of the posterior cervical muscles, against which no remedy he had tried had produced any effect. Teste gave Ferr-ma., four globules in a tumbler of water, two tablespoonfuls every day. The first tablespoonful, taken in the morning, seemed to produce a sensible improvement. A quarter of an hour after the second dose, taken at 4 p.m., the sight became dim, a halo of fire, red and violet, was seen first in front of the right eye, and afterwards in front of the left eye. Soon after, this halo, which formed a circular zigzag-shaped line, became narrower and narrower. Finally produced such a complete blindness, that the patient assured Teste he was unable to distinguish night from daylight. This lasted one hour and did not pass off entirely until after a meal. Much more distressing phenomena followed towards 8 p.m. The pain in the nape, which first was seated on the left side, passed Ferrum magneticum to the right invading the whole extent of the trapezoid muscle, where it became literally frightful. “For two days and nights the patient, who was a brave and strong man and whom I had seen bear the most painful surgical operations without uttering a sound, suffered to such an extent that he uttered heart-rending cries.” Camph., Puls, and Bry failed to relieve, the first rather aggravated. Rhus-t. effected some relief. But it did not prevent the recurrence, for eight days in succession of the visual phenomena, though with less intensity then the first time, at irregular intervals, generally 6 or 7 a.m. and sometimes even at night in perfect darkness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ferr., Elect., Galv., Magn. arct., Magn. aust. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Flatulence during a meal, afterwards fatigue and burning pain in epigastrium, especially on breathing. Nausea. Abortive risings.

Abdomen - Movements and grumbling in abdomen. Loose evacuations with much flatulency, especially left side, with pullings in legs. Abundant and frequent emission of fetid flatus.

Rectum - Urgent want to evacuate with expulsion of flatus only. Small, liquid evacuation when expelling flatus. Itching and shooting in the anus. Tingling and itching in the rectum.

Male - Itching and lancination in the scrotum and in the extremity of the glans. Increased sexual desire, with and without erection, or absence of all sexual desire, yet without importance.

Chest - Tearing and lancination in the left side of the chest, when breathing. Sensation of emptiness in the chest.

Neck - In the morning, pain in the nape of the neck, as if from having lain in an inconvenient position.

Limbs - Cramp-like, paralytic pullings or jerking pullings in the forearms and hands. Paralytic pulling in the right arm. Pain, as from dislocation in the wrist. Dryness and tension in the hands. Small warts on the back of the hands and on the wrist. Whitlow. Acute lancination in the knee. Ganglion of the foot. Tingling and pricking in the heels. Starting in the soles of the feet. Painful little toe. Lungs - Frequent hawking of mucus. Dry cough after dinner, proceeding from an irritation in the trachea, as if one had swallowed dust.

Sleep - Violent and noisy yawnings with accumulation of water in the mouth. Drowsiness with prompt sleep on lying do wn or even when seated. Absurd dreams at night. Dreams immediately after lying down, waking with a start, coldness causing trembling. Inclination to remain in bed in the morning. After rising, weakness in the knees.

Skin - Itching and tingling in different parts, especially in the evening, mitigated by scratching, but appearing in other parts. Red spots, sometimes of a bright red or bluish red. some disappear on being pressed. Small warts on the hands.

Teeth - Bleeding of the gums, when slightly pressed upon. Painful sensibility of the teeth during mastication.

Kidneys - Urine red and copious, which becomes the color of clay after having stood some time.

Temperature - Shivering and cold in the side opposite to that on which the patient has lair Heat, as if a catarrh were developing its. If with lassitude and downcast eyes. Internal heat with perspiration and slow pulse after washing the body. The pulse is slow and small. Perspiration on the slightest exercise. Sweat in the morning on the body and on the occiput. Sweat of an acid smell, as in measles.

full:
PHARMACY - ferr. Ferrum metallicum. Iron metal (Fe, At. Wt. 56). Includes symptomsof the acetate and the carbonate. Triturations of the pure metal and of the carbonate, solution of the acetate. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Aphonia. Asthma. Biliousness. Blood, disorders. Blood, loss. Bruises. Cachexia. Catalepsy. Chlorosis. Chorea. Constipation. Cough. Cramps, Debility. Diarrhea. Bedwetting. Fever, intermittent. Goiter, exophthalmic. Gonorrhea. Hemorrhages. Heart, disorders. Hectic, fever. Hydrocephalus. Iron, poisoning. Jaundice. Kidneys, disorders. Lienteria. Morning, sickness. Menstruation. disorders. Miscarriages. Nausea. Neuralgia. Paralysis, viscera. Pregnancy, disorders. Rectum, prolapsed. Rectum, weak. Rheumatism. Shoulder, pains. Spasms. Syphilis. Toothache. Tuberculosis. Urinary, incontinence. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Vomiting. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ferr. is one of the prominent constituents of the animal body, present in considerable quantity in the blood. It is present in many articles of daily food and, when given in excess, its first effect is to increase the amount of iron in the blood. Ferr. is adapted to young, weakly persons, anemic and chlorotic with pseudo-plethora. Over-sensitive, weakness, but looks strong. Delicate girls, constipated, with low spirits. Red-faced old men. Iron poisoning, symptoms including nausea and vomiting, varicose veins (Sep.), easy bruising, nosebleeds of pale blood, swelling of the limbs, anemia, and sensitivity to smell. Bad affects of iron pills, particularly during pregnancy. Anemia with weakness. Anemia in those subject to irregular distributions of blood, particularly the young. Flushed cheeks, pallor of lips and mucus membranes, fatigue and breathlessness, and any motion will set up the symptoms. Useful in anemia of cancer and syphilis as a secondary remedy. Hemorrhages, bright blood or with small clots. Veins dilate during neuralgia, menses orfever. Irregular distribution of blood. Congestions, surgings of blood and pulsations. Orgasms of blood to face, chest, head and lungs. Flushes easily, worse after any active effort. Chlorosis, worse in winter. Hemorrhagic tuberculosis, but it may aggravate. Dropsy or paralysis after loss of vital fluids, hemorrhages. Rapid emaciation. Cachexia. Pressure, on chest, stomach etc. Cold limbs, muscles relaxed and flabby. Catalepsy. Red parts become pale. Cracking in joints. Softening of bones. Nightly pains that compel motion of part. Ferr. stimulates the appetite, augment the heart's beats and the bodily vigor. Dryness of mouth, vagina. Exophthalmic goiter from suppressed menses. Spleen, digestion and left deltoid are also affected. MIND - Mind confused. Can't collect his thoughts. Confusion better washing face. Brain-fag. Always in the right. Proud and haughty. Excitement after menses. Sensitive, excitable. Slight noises unbearable. Irritability from noise. Oversensitive to pain. Ailments from anger. Irritable mind and body. Excited from slightest opposition. Anger from contradiction. Intolerant of contradiction. Changeable mood. Nervous, hysterical. Great alternations of mood, excessively lively, then sad and melancholic. Weeps and laughs immoderately. Restlessness, must walk about slowly. Anxiety from slight causes. Anxiety as after committing a crime. Fear of having a stroke. Great anxiety about family. Restlessness, driving out of bed, wants to go from one bed to another. Despondent after menses. Desire for solitude. Aversion to friends. Sadness better exertion. Conversation aggravates. Occupation relieves. Great indifference. Not inclined to talk or study, from nervous restlessness. Constant thoughts of death. Abdomen - Colic with watery diarrhea. Rumbling in bowels. Flatulent colic at night. Bowels feel sore to touch. Hard, distended, sore, bruised when walking. Soreness of abdominal walls. Soreness all over abdomen, better warmth. Sharp pain in abdomen. Sensation as if bowels were bruised, or weakened by cathartics. Shooting pain in left hypochondrium. Cramp- like in region of spleen.

Head - Head hot, feet cold. Rush of blood to head with flushes of heat in face. Congestion of head with pale face. Headache after menses, with hot head and cold feet. Hammering, pulsating, congestive headache, pain extends to teeth with cold limbs. Severe, frontal headache with cold feet. Pain in back of head with roaring in neck. Sudden pain over left eye. Stinging headache. Long continued headache, often lasting 2 to 3 days. Headache during coryza. Feeling of an iron band around head, better external pressure, with red face. Writing causes headache to reappear. Scalp and hair painful to touch. Must take down the hair. Falling out of hair. Hydrocephalus with open fontanels and great anemia.

Eyes - Eyes cloudy, watery, dull with blue rings around them. Eyes red with burning pain. Swelling and redness of the eyelids. Puffy eyelids. Pain over eyes (left). Exophthalmic goiter after suppression of menses. Photophobia. Weakness of eyes with lachrymation. Pupils contracted. Suppurating stye on upper lid.

Ears - Sharp pain in ears in morning. Ulcerative pain of outer ear. Fetid discharge from left ear. Oversensitive to noise. Noises in ears better leaning the head on table. Ringing in the ears, worse before menses. Ringing in right ear. Singing, humming.

Nose - Nostrils dilated during expiration. Nosebleed in anemic patients .Nosebleed alternating with hemoptysis. Nosebleed in anemic children, with changing of color of face. Nosebleed in mornings when stooping. Clots of blood constantly accumulate in nose, during coryza. Mucus membranes relaxed, boggy, anemic, pale. Dripping of fluid from posterior nares or frontal sinuses, with headache. Bloody, purulent, greenish, slimy, acrid discharges. Scabs come out of nose or are coughed up every few weeks.

Face - False plethora. Face feels as if bloated. Blushes easily. Pale face and flushes red from least pain, emotions or exertion. Florid. Lips pale. Face pale with red spots on each cheek. Neuralgia after cold washing and overheating. Red parts become white, bloodless and puffy. Blue rings around eyes, which are dul I and lustreless. Distended veins. Easy flushing of face, after drinking wine. Face fiery red during vomiting.

Mouth - Breath hot. Dry mouth in morning. Canker sores. Mouth dry, food seems too dry, all solid food tastes dry and insipid. Sweet or bitter taste. Earthy, pasty taste, like rotten eggs. Taste of blood. Toothache from tea. Toothache better icy cold water. Pain in teeth, relieved by icy-cold water. Numb, pithy feeling of tongue, as if burned. Burnt sensation on back and middle portion of tongue. Tongue coated white.

Throat - Sore throat with burning pains. Burning in larynx and trachea after talking. Sensation as if a lump (left side), worse swallowing empty .Asif something rolling in the throat and closing it like a valve. Sensation as if something was in larynx, which he wished to remove by hawking or coughing. Aching, pressing pain in throat while swallowing. Hoarseness, with sense of roughness in larynx. Voice changeable. Complete aphonia, causes much anxiety. Speaking causes general weakness. Exophthalmic goiter. Vertigo - Vertigo on suddenly rising. Vertigo as if balancing to and fro. Vertigo on seeing flowing water. Vertigo on crossing a bridge over water. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo during headache. Vertigo with nausea, prostration, lethargy. Vertigo with disposition to fall forward. Vertigo on descending. Giddy as if drunk, when walking. Vision - Letters run together when reading or writing. At night can see in the dark, hysteria. Darkness before eyes, giddy. Darkness before eyes in evening, with aching pains and slight nosebleed. Attacks of blindness. COMMENTS - Hahnemann described the effects of iron on persons who habitually drink chalybeate waters: “In such localities there are few persons who can resist the noxious influence of the continued use of such waters and remain quite well, each being affected according to his peculiar nature.” “There we find more than anywhere else chronic disorders of great gravity and peculiar character, even when the regimen is otherwise faultless. “Weakness, almost amounting to paralysis of the whole body and of single parts. Some kinds of violent limb pains. Abdominal disorders of various sorts, vomiting of food by day or by night. Tuberculosis. Tubercular pulmonary ailments often with blood spitting, deficient vital warmth. “Suppression of the menses, miscarriages, impotence, in both sexes infertility. Jaundice and many other rare cachexias are common occurrences.” Blood diseases, especially if with exhaustion. Anemia, hemophilia. Hemorrhages from over-fullness of blood vessels, from vasomotor paralysis, or from delicacy of the vessels themselves. Throbbing pains, the blood vessels all over the body throb violently. Bleeding, pale or watery blood, (Phos.) and weakness (Chin.). Uterine hemorrhage. Weakness and tiredness since hemorrhage (Chin.). Irregular distribution of blood in chlorotics. Abnormally pale mucus membranes. Bruises easily, nosebleeds. Palpitations, worse least exertion, excitement. Face flushes. Varicose veins. Legs swell and bruise easily. Hands and feet swell. Anemia, chronic fatigue since blood loss, chemotherapy or radiation. Lack of stamina. Menses that cause anemia and weakness. Paralytic weakness. Restlessness. Tremor. Rheumatic symptoms, especially of left shoulder and deltoid. Neuralgia, brought on by washing in cold water, especially after being over-heated. Hammering headache, pain worse after midnight. Pain in os on lying down. Feeling of dryness in vagina. Gastralgia, heavy pressure in the region of the stomach. Walls of abdomen are sore. A feeling as if something rolled into the throat and closed it like a valve. Frequent spells of nausea, periodic vomiting. Intolerance of eggs. Marked cramps. Irritability of the bowels causing diarrhea while eating. Diarrhea coming on when the patient beings to eat. Constipation. Irritability of the bladder, causing incontinence of urine when standing. The liver and spleen are affected. Neonatal jaundice. Good for over-dosing from quinine. Kunkel noted the case of a patient about forty-five, who had repeated attacks of joint rheumatism. Kunkel cured the case based on the symptom “intolerance to eggs” after he had been dosed for three weeks with salicylate of soda by allopaths. RELATIONS-Antidotes: Ars., Hep. Compare: ( 1 ) All Ferrums. (2) Rumex - similar in respiratory and digestive sphere and contains organic iron. (3) Graph., Mang., Cupr. Complementary: Chin., Alum., Ham. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomach won't tolerate any food, causes distention and pressure. Heat and burning in stomach. Spits up food by the mouthful (Phos.). Belchings of food. Bitter eructations after fat food. Flatulent dyspepsia. Cramp-like pain in stomach. Hemorrhage from stomach. Nausea during headache. Nausea and vomiting after eating. Vomits after eggs. Easy vomiting without nausea. Vomiting after midnight. Vomiting during pregnancy. Vomiting in morning after breakfast. Vomiting of everything eaten without being digested. Vomiting of food after exertion.

Rectum - Chronic constipation with easily flushed head and face, cold hands and feet. Constipation from taking iron pills. Constipation during pregnancy. Contractive pain in rectum. Cramping, in rectum, after stool. Prolapsed rectum in children. Hemorrhoids, copious bleeding or ichorous oozing. Hemorrhoids with itching and gnawing, tearing pains. Itching of anus due to ascarides or worms in children. Evacuation of mucus, with worms. Attempts to eat bring on diarrhea. Diarrhea, painless, worse while eating. Summer diarrhea of children with emaciation. Nightly, gushing and spluttering of undigested food, alternating with constipation, worse if nervous or tired. Diarrhea during pregnancy. Frequent diarrhea, stools watery, with or without tenesmus. Rice-water discharges. Stools, hard difficult, followed by backache or cramps in rectum, prolapsed rectum. Acrid, watery diarrhea, excoriating anus.

Male - Nightly emissions, with backache after over-exertion. Impotency. Increased sexual desire. Erections night and day, Sterility, low sperm count. Discharge of mucus from urethra after a cold. Gleet, copious, painless, milky.

Female - Women who are weak, delicate, chlorotic, yet have a fiery-red face. Amenorrhea. Suppression of menses with extremenervousness. Menses, pale, watery. Passive flow, dark, clotted. Menses too early, too profuse and protracted. During menses, must keep perfectly still, least Ferrum metallicum movement greatly worse flow. Menses with labor-like pains. Menses remit a day or two and then return. Dysmenorrhea with scanty discharge of pale blood with violent colic. Sticking, shooting pains in uterus. Discharge of long pieces of mucus from uterus. Uterine hemorrhage with labor-like pain in abdomen and small of back. Leucorrhea, milky, acrid, watery, at puberty. Leucorrhea resembling watery milk, smarting and corroding when first appearing, not afterward. Itching of vulva. Sensitive vagina. Vagina too dry, pain as if raw. Swellings and indurations in vagina. Vagina insensible during sex. Prolapse of vagina. Promotes expulsion of moles. Sexual desire diminished. Sterility. Tendency to miscarriage. Uterine hemorrhage with threatened premature labour, at end of eight month. Morning sickness, constipation, nausea, worse from iron pills. Eruption on genitals or inflamed. Ascarides in vulva. Gonorrhea. Food - Appetite good and bad alternately. Voracious appetite. Loss of appetite. All food tastes bitter. Unquenchable thirst or thirstlessness. Aversion to eating and drinking during headache. Aversion to meat, children accustomed to meat suddenly become disgusted with it. Aversion to beer. Aversion to sour things, sour fruits. Aversion to accustomed tobacco. Desire for raw tomatoes. Desire for sweets. Desire for bread and butter. Worse from eggs. Worse abuse of tea, quinine, brandy. Worse tobacco smoke. Intolerance of eggs. Worse tomatoes. Worse hot things. Worse fat food. Worse drinking milk. Worse sourfruit. Worse after drinking beer. Bread tastes dry and bitter. Wine agrees, if not acid. Meat and acids, sour fruit, as well as beer, causes nausea.

Chest - Anxiety in chest. Chest oppressed, breathing difficult. Constriction of chest, worse walking. Flying stitches in the chest. Feeling of dryness in chest. Surging of blood to chest. Rush of blood to chest and head, with cold hands and feet. Pressure under sternum, with catarrh and cough. Sharp pain in chest when coughing. Burning pain in sternum after coughing. Constitutions - Sanguine temperament. Adapted to young, anemic, pseudo-plethoric persons, who though looking strong are so weak that they are unable even to speak or walk, want to lie down. Coughs - Cough dry, spasmodic. Dry, tickling cough, worse moving, better lying down. Cough with pain in the occiput. Breath fails at end of coughing fit. Cough, worse abuse of tea, quinine, brandy. Cough after loss of fluids. Tickling cough in trachea, worse moving, better lying down. Cough from tobacco smoke. Cough after eating. Cough, must sit up to raise sputum. Hemoptysis (Mill.). Dry, tickling cough with blood spitting. Spasmodic whooping cough at once better eating a small quantity of food.

Heart - Anemic murmurs. Hypertrophy of heart. Fatty degeneration of heart. Endocarditis with chlorotic symptoms. Sense of oppression. Throbbing in all blood vessels. Heart suddenly bleeds into the blood vessels and as suddenly draws a reflux, leaving pallor of surface. Palpitations, worse least motion, better walking slowly. Palpitations with fear, has to move about, can neither sit nor stand. Palpitations of masturbators after loss of fluids. Constrictive pain in region of heart. Pulse full, but soft and yielding. Pulse increased by exertion. Pulse small and weak.

Back - Neck and shoulder painful. Rheumatism of the neck and shoulder. Neck sore and stiff. Lumbago all night, goes off on rising. Lumbago, better slow walking. Stitch-like jerks in small of back when walking. Pain between scapula.

Limbs - Dropsy after loss of vital fluids. Swollen hands and feet. Sudden cramps or tearing pains in the limbs. Restlessness in limbs. Contraction of limbs. Cracking in joints. Pain in hip joint, tibia, soles and heel. Heels pain, worse lying on back. Rheumatism of the shoulder. Rheumatism of the left deltoid muscle. Tearing pains in deltoid, worse at night, driving him out of bed, and motion diminishes the pain. Difficulty raising the arm. Deltoid muscle soreness and pain. Irresistible desire to bend the arm with intense pain. Hands tremble when writing, better when writing fast.

Sleep - Falls asleep from debility, while sewing, sitting and studying. Must lie on back at night. Sleepy at night with inability to sleep. Sleeplessness. Child doesn't sleep because of itching from worms. Restless sleep at night. Anxious tossing in bed. Sleep disturbed by dreams; much weariness in morning. Vivid dreams. Nightmares. Confused, unpleasant dreams. Dreams of being engaged in war. Dreams of falling into water.

Skin - Pale skin. Flushes easily. Skin pits on pressure. Skin withered, flabby. Dry skin in pneumonia. Jaundice. Yellow-brown spots, sore to touch. Black or dark violet spots. Burning, with pain as if excoriated when touched. Scarlatina during desquamation. Skin peels off on shoulders and left hand. Ulcers pale, edematous. Warts on fingers and backs of hands.

Modalities - Better in summer. Better solitude. Better moving about slowly. Better from gentle motion. Better slight bleeding (Puls.). Better from leaning head on something. Better after rising. Worse at night, midnight. Worse heat. Worse cold. Worse while sitting still. Worse after cold washing. Worse overheating. Worse from sudden motion. Worse raising arms. Worse loss of vital fluids. Worse eating, drinking. Worse from emotions, anger. Worse violent exertion. Worse while sweating. Worse during menses. Worse noise. Worse conversation.

Liver - Tightness and fullness in region of liver. Liver enlarged. Neonataljaudice in childfrom mother taking iron pills during pregnancy. Liver sensitive to pressure. Lungs - Asthma worse after 12 p.m., must sit up, worse sitting still, better walking slowly about. Catarrhal asthma every morning from 10 a.m. to 11a.m. Dyspnea better walking slowly and talking. Dyspnea after midnight, also when sitting up. Suffocative fits in evening in bed. Slowly increasing dyspnea, in pneumonia. Shortness of breath from tension in abdomen. Difficult inspiration, as from heaviness of chest. Neglected pleuro-pneumonia, absorbs exudation. Hemoptysis (Mill.). Spitting of blood in tuberculosis. Spitting of blood, of masturbators. Pneumonia.

Kidneys - Chronic nephritis. Albuminuria. Diabetes. Kidney pain with desire to urinate. Involuntary urination, especially during the day, when standing, from sudden movement, walking in children. Copious urination with nervousness. Tickling in urethra extending to bladder. Chronic catarrh of bladder and gleet. Burning in urethra during urination, as if urine were hot. Urine hot with menorrhagia. Urine clear as water, in anemia.

Blood - Blood diseases, with exhaustion. Anemia with exhaustion. Anemia with pregnancy. Chlorosis. Hemorrhages. Ailments from blood loss. Bleeding, pale or watery blood and weakness (Chin., Phos.). Weak blood. Hemophilia. Throbbing pains, the blood vessels all over the body throb violently. Hemorrhages from over-fullness of blood vessels Hemorrhages from vasomotor paralysis, Hemorrhages from delicacy of the blood vessels themselves.

Perspiration - Profuse, debilitating sweats. Profuse sweats at every motion. Anxious, cold sweat, during cramps of different parts. Cold sweat during convulsions. Clammy, yellow, cold, acrid sweats. Worse while sweating. Sweats often confined to lower part of body. Sweats preceded by headache. Nausea during sweat. Sweats lessened while speaking. Fetid sweats on going to sleep. Sweat at night of a very strong odor.

Temperature - Chill with red face and thirst. General coldness of limbs, head and face hot. Chilly every evening. Frequent short attacks of chilly shivering. Chill at 4 a.m. Chills with great thirst, preceded and succeeded by headache. Chills with trembling all over. Heat with distended veins. Heat in palms and soles. Heat flushes over body as if sweat would break out. Hectic fever. Sensation of heat all over body, which is cold to touch. Heat with very red face and inclination to uncover. Fever abating when moving about. Intermittent fever.

name: Ferrum Muriaticum
author: Murphy
constitution: Anemia. Anorexia. Cramps. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Erysipelas. Hemoptysis. Insomnia. Afolaría. Nephritis. Pyelitis. Shoulder, pain. Spleen, enlarged. Vertigo.

full:
PHARMACY - ferr-m. Ferrum muriaticum. Iron chloride. Sesquichloratum. Ferrous chloride. Ferrous dichloride. Tincture consisting of 25 parts of crystals to 225 parts of alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Anorexia. Cramps. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Erysipelas. Hemoptysis. Insomnia. Afolaría. Nephritis. Pyelitis. Shoulder, pain. Spleen, enlarged. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy has been employed in enlargement of the spleen due to malaria. There is great pain in the left hypochondrium which is worse at night. The face is pale and anemic. Vertigo, anorexia, sleeplessness and a sensation of coldness alternating with heat and lasting for several hours It is also of service in chronic diarrhea, with loss of appetite, pain and tenesmus. The passages consist of blood and membranous shreds. Phlegmonous erysipelas. Pain in right shoulder, right elbow. Marked tendency to cramps. Round red spots on cheeks. Hemoptysis of dark, blood clot. Suppressed menstruation. Chronic interstitialnephritis. Pyelitis. Bright crystals in urine. Copiousurinationatpuberty. Diphtheria. Very dark and watery stools. Painful sexual intercourse. Tendency to seminal emissions. COMMENTS - Useful for anemia, given in the 3x after meals. Forchronic interstitial nephritis, 1 to 5 drops of the tincture, 3 times daily. RELATIONS - Compare: Cean., Ferr. REFERENCES - Blackwood. Boericke.
