full:
PHARMACY - germ. Germanium metal- licum. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amyloidosis. Anemia. Arthritis. Bronchitis. Cancer. Diabetes. Headaches. Hypertension. Kidney, failure. Malaria. Palpitations. Paralysis. Pneumonia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Severe illnesses with dysfunction of nerves, liver, kidney. Démyélinisation of the nerves. Numbness. Ataxia, cerebellum. Chronic fatigue. Extreme weakness, as if the vitalforce is leaving the body. Feeling of heaviness, present throughout the pathogenesis. MIND - Absent minded. Mentally slow and confused. Forgetful. Cannot adapt. Inept. Incapability. Makes mistakes in writing and speaking. Dyslexia. Difficulties with concentration, confusion. The answer is there but it can not come out. Moody. Feels weak, dull, empty, flat. Indifferent. Everything appears unreal. Lack of romantic feelings. Hopeless. Feels helpless. Guiltyfeelings. Self reproach, hates himself. Disgusted with himself. Gloomy. Doomed feelings. Restlessness. Fear of responsibilities. Fear of being criticized. Fear of being a total failure. Fear of being unmasked. Fear of falling. Fear of paralysis. Irritable when having to answer questions. Feeling of isolation. Feels like a stranger in society. Does not feel connected. Feels invaded, somebody has entered their territory. Feels trapped. Emotions are strong but cannot come out or are kept under strict control. Suppressed anger or outburst of anger. Holding anger inside, aggravates. Such outburts are very quickly forgotten with no feeling of remorse. Delusion, that he is a prisoner. Delusion that the world is shabby. Delusion that she estranged, isolated. Delusion, everything looks smaller or lower. Time going more slowly. Hearing voices. Delusions, hands don't belong to him.

Head - Headache with sharp, stabbing pains. Headache, worse moving. Head feels loose inside. Headache over left eye better cold bathing on waking. Head congestion with catarrhal symptoms. Heaviness sensation, occiput. Pressing pain in temples. Dull pain between the temples. Crawling sensation, right side of head. Light- headed, better eating. Slight dizziness in head with throbbing pain in temples. Dandruff and itchy scalp.

Eyes - Burning pain with lachrymation and discharge from nose. Dry, gritty eyes. Burning and itching of eyelids. Cold sensation of the eyes. Eyes cold and watery as if exposed to a cold draft. Stiffness with swelling upper eyelids and below eyebrows. Cannot open eyes properly.

Ears - Aching pain moved into ear with pressure in both ear drums. Cracking in the ears from yawning. Pain, throbbing behind the ears. Sharp pain in right ear. Tightness in ear drum. Noises in ear. Ringing noise. Low, whispering sounds. Humming vibrating sound in head. Sensitive to noises.

Nose - Itching of nose, external and internal, better rubbing. Abundant sneezing during coryza. Sneezing with watery coryza. Sneezing with mucus on waking. Head congestion with catarrhal' symptoms. Nasal discharge clear and bland. Clear discharge following chest cough. Discharge thin watery pale and yellow. Nasal discharge salty.

Face - Whole face swollen. Rash then extends behind ears. Face more greasy than usual. Purulent eruptions. Pain on cheekbone and above gum like sinusitis. Submaxillary glands swollen and sore to touch.

Mouth - Dry mouth. Metallic taste in mouth, better glass of water. Greenish-white coating on the tongue and inside of upper lip. Salivation increased. Pain aching in jaw as if chewing something. Tingling in the middle of lower lip.

Throat - Sore throats, with much mucus. Sore and prickling throat on waking. Rasping, grating feeling in trachea while coughing and sneezing. Sore throat started in top of pharynx, worse eating oranges. Difficulty speaking. Vertigo - Vertigo on turning head. Vertigo on writing and studying. Vertigo on going to bed, as soon as head hit the pillow. Vertigo worse closing eyes and opening again. Dizziness after massage. Vision - Black in front of eyes on rising up from lying in the evening. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Gallium., Ferr. REFERENCES Sherr.

Stomach - Eructations while eating. Eructations very bitter and sour. Stomach feels cold, better warm drinks. Stomach feels bloated and full of air during and after eating. Tightness in the stomach. Heaviness and bubbling pain in stomach after eating. Sore pain if pressed. Nausea, wobbly queasy feeling worse after eating. Nausea after drinking beer. Nausea better lying down. Vomits suddenly with extra salivation. Vomitinginmorning. Vomiting after alcohol. Stools - Stool yellow, loose and offensive, alternating with hard stool. Stool scanty, dry dark brown, with mucus. Loose stools. Stools frequent. Stools, frequent.

Abdomen - Feels as if a lump in the solar plexus.

Rectum - Itching of the anus. Constipation, difficult stool. Stools on alternate days. Stools alternating between hard and soft. Explosive flatulence. Flatulence offensive. Diarrhea and flatulence. Diarrhea with thirstlessness. Diarrhea, followed by increased energy. Intense pain in rectum from sexual excitement. Pressing tearing in rectum after stool, extending towards genitals. Sharp pain in rectum extends to ovaries, worse stool.

Male - Coldness in the whole penis with formication in the prepuce. Desire for sex with strong erection which remained long after emission. No sexual interest. Desire absent. Shooting pain in right testicle. Intense sharp pain in the tip of the prepuce of very short duration. Emissions smelling of fish. Emissions profuse.

Female - Menses early. Pain-free menses. Menses started with brown-black discharge followed by red blood. Menses with protracted heavy flow. Dark clotting flow. Bright heavy clots on rising. Tiredness with ovulation. Tiredness during and after period. Leucorrhea thick and yellow. Vaginal discharge offensive. Internal itching with slight yellow discharge turning slightly pink. Itching in vulva. Irresistible itching around vagina. Itching bump on clitoris. White discharge from bump on clitoris. Flatus from vagina. Intense, tearing, bearing down pains in vagina and anal before menses. Sharp pain like hot needles lower abdomen and ovaries. Cramp-like labor pains. Pain before the flow starts, pacing and restlessness. Bleeding very scanty but clotted. Sudden stabbing pain right ovary. Twinge of pain in left ovary. Soreness in opening of vagina, worse by touch. Sexual desire increased. Heightened sexual sensations. Food - Appetite increased.

Chest - Constriction in chest on coughing with clear expectoration. Pain on left side when coughing. Twinge, both breasts, lateral. Aching pain in lateral side of left breast. Aching pain in right breast. Aching on inspiration, worse bending, moving forward, lifting arm. Cramping lateral side right breast. Sensation of a lump in chest on waking. Tightness in the chest in a small spot. Tickling behind sternum.

Heart - Palpitations. Palpitations could start at any moment, as if with anxiety in the chest.

Back - Back spasms. Ache lower sacrum, left side, better stretching and deep pressure. Tension in neck as if nerve was trapped. Aching back of neck extending to right side of occiput, tender to touch, better massage. On waking, intense pain between last cervical and first thoracic vertebrae. Twinges of pain. Muscles feel sore on pressure. Sudden sharp pains appear and disappear quickly. Sharp pain on waking, like a sharp point in shoulder, worse turning head to right. Sharp pain, left scapula. Spasm, left lumbar region, extending to leg.

Limbs - Paralysis. Legs trembling. Inflammation of joints. Cold hands. Cold, wet, clammy feet. Feet very sweaty, odorless. Warm sensation of arms. Incoordination. Hands very dry rough and papery, palms red. Blood blister on finger, sore to touch. Itchy eruptions on shins, better in hot water. Rash slightly raised and a bit itchy, extending down arms. Itchy eruptions on right shin after shower or bath. Pimples on right buttock and thigh. Pain, aching in right shoulder as if bone is sensitive. Pain, aching, left hand near bone. Sciatic pain, leg, right, while standing. Aching in thigh muscles in bed. Knee pains, when walking, worse descending. Dragging pain in knee. Tension in knees when sitting. Stiffness, and soreness calves. Cramping pain in the right big toe. Prickling sensation in arms and hands.

Sleep - Sleepy, must lie down and sleep. Waking 3.30 a.m. Wakes at 5 a.m. Couldn't sleep. Sleep interrupted by cold feeling in the stomach. Stays awake in spite of sleepiness because of pain in the head and eyes. Sleep interrupted by splattering sound inside head. Sleeping on right side impossible with aching in kidney. Yawning constantly with sleepiness. Yawning, paroxysmal. Yawning, which provokes crackling in the ears. Y awning throughout day. Dreams of being pursued. Dreams of accidents. Dreams of war. Dreams of being raped. Dreams of burglars. Dreams of invasion.

Skin - Rash on chest. Very fine itchy rash, behind ears, worse left side. Inflamed pimples on skin of back. Molloscum contagiousum. Eruption red, soft, tender. Right palm very dry and flaky. Skin feels as if an ant were rapidly crawling, then biting. Tingling. Itching on the right side of the chin. Biting, prickling and itching after bath or shower. Swelling, on waking. Eyes swollen virtually shut, rash and swelling now extending to right side of face with red blotches and terrible burning, worse water, worse scratching and rubbing. Skin very oily all over. Skin greasy, and sticky, better washing.

Teeth - Sharp cutting pain in all gums. Pain in teeth from cold water. Sharp pain in teeth. Sudden nerve pains in teeth and gums.

Liver - Liver injuries. Lungs - Pneumonia. Bronchitis. Soreness with slight wheeze in bronchi. Slow, deep respiration. Out of breath on climbing one flight of stairs. Sighing. Restriction in lungs with coughing. Funny sensation on breathing. Once the air passed through the throat felt fluttering sensation in chest and bronchi. Can't breathe deeply, air can't get through properly.

Kidneys - Sudden stabbing pain, right kidney while sitting. Kidney injuries. Kidney failure. Diabetes. Frequent urination. Frequent urging for small amounts. Feeling of heat while passing urine. Stabbing sudden pain right kidney while sitting. Aromatic odor of urine. Powerful stream. Copious urine. Very dark urine with reddish hue and very strong smell. Concentrated, urine, with acid quality.

Bladder - Cutting, pressing pain in the right side of the bladder.

Blood - Hemolysis. Anemia. High blood pressure. Amyloidosis. Breasts - Tenderness in breasts. Wart on right breast with cheesy discharge. Sharp pain in right nipple. Sharp pain in right breast pulling from inside to outside. Sharp pain in left lower breast while walking in the open air. Sensation in right breast as if something is trying to come out through the duct.

Cough - Cough in evening. Cough better hot drinks. Dry cough, with tickle in throat while lying in bed, worse cold water. Dry cough in pairs, with irritation in throat. Dry, racking cough better lying down, with no expectoration. Dry, tickling cough. Hard, dry cough waking from sleep at night. Hollow, barking cough in bed. Sharp, tickling, barking cough, worse evening, cold drinks, better warm drinks. Spasm across lower abdomen with cough.

Perspiration - Perspiration absent at night. Sweats during eating. Sweats with hot flushes. Perspiration from smelling soap.

Cannot lift things. Pain not perceived when quiet. Pain in ligaments relieved by rest. Stringy mucus from throat and posterior sinuses. Rawness. Neck muscles rigid. Subacute gouty state. White coated tongue. High colored urine with red sandy sediment.

Modalities - Better rest. Worse in the morning. Worse from moving, especially in lumbar region and joints of hips, shoulders and wrists. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Lyc., Phos. Rhus- t. (2) Puls., but modalities differ. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

PHARMACY - gins. Ginseng. Wild ginseng. Panax quinquefolia. Panax ginseng. Aralia quinquefolia. Schinseng. N. O. Araliacee. Trituration and tincture of the root. Historical dose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Backache. Borbo- rygmi. Debility. Flatus. Headaches. Hiccough. Lumbago. Memory, weak. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Sexual excitement. Typhlitis.

HERBAL - The symptoms of the Chinese and the American Ginseng are taken together, as the two are probably identical. The root is forked like that of the mandrake. The name ginseng is said to signify “the resemblance of a man” or a man's thigh. The shape of the root might indicate an action on the pelvis and lower limbs.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lembke and others have proved it. It is an aromatic stimulant and removes feelings of fatigue, imparting a joyous sense of vigor and elasticity to the limbs, especially the upper limbs, and clearness of mind. Malaise. Y awning. Drowsiness with headache. Feeling of extreme heat and intense coldness, longing to expose the body to cool air. Stimulates the secretory glands, especially salivary. Dry mouth, tongue and lips. Mouth and throat are sensitive to the ordinary air of room. Hiccoughs. Affects the respiratory organs. Acts on the lower part of the spinal cord, lumbago, sciatica and rheumatism. Paralytic weakness. Skin symptoms, itching pimples on neck and chest. The right side of the body is most affected. Pain in right side of hypogastrium, extending into groin. MIND - Mood quiet and contented with good courage. Calm, but impatient impulses. Disposition to weep. Anxious about the future. Fear of misfortunes. Fear of accidents. Thinking is difficult. Memory weak.

Head - Head seems at times enlarged and to sway to one side. Pressure in longitudinal sinuses. Drawing pains. Painful sensitiveness of the head. One-sided head pain. Lancinations from right side of the forehead as far as the orbit with heaviness of the eyelids. Sudden shock in occiput, followed by pains, as of a bruise.

Eyes - Pressure on the eyes. Pupils alternately large and small. Unpleasant sensation of coldness on surface of eyeball. Great difficulty in opening the eyelids, which are heavy and painful, itching of the eyelids. Biting and itching in margins of lids. Vision indistinct. Sensation of fatigue when exposed to the light. Objects appear double when looked at fixedly in reading, the characters become confused.

Ears - Buzzing noises.

Face - Alternation of redness and paleness. Burning erythematous redness on right cheek, alae nasi, chin. Lips red, dry, rough, thick, cracked and bleeding, especially the lower lip. Drawing in jaws and bones of face.

Mouth - Tongue red and smarting with thirst. Tongue white, dry with large glistening papilla. Green saliva. Swallowing of saliva, very difficult on account of dryness. Mouth, lips and teeth very dry, voice rough and scraping.

Throat - Tonsillitis (Bell.), in dark-complexioned people. Vertigo - Vertigo, cloudiness, confusion, giddiness and heaviness of the head. Vertigo on going down winding stairs. Vertigo while standing, the ground seems to waver. Vertigo with gray spots before eyes. Vertigo with semi-lateral headache, occipital. Vertigo difficult opening of eyelids, objects appear double. COMMENTS - Very valuable herb in China, the wild ginseng of Siberia is said to be the best. Natives along the Ussuri river use it boiled for headaches, colds, fevers, and stomach pains. In America, it is a domestic remedy for the after pains of labor. J. H. Henry said it acts on the lower part of the spinal marrow. He noted that it is also useful for “bruised pains in small of back and thighs (on rising from bed). Great languor with paralytic, rheumatic pains in lower limbs. Arthritic swelling of the foot, which had been exerted a long time. Violent pain in big toe.” Henry also mentioned a “nightly digging in right lower limb from hip to big toe, cramp, pains from right hip to toes, lancinating, tearing in right tarsal joint.” He considered it specific in lumbago, sciatica and chronic rheumatism that are accompanied by a frequent desire to urinate and sexual excitement. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aral., Coca. (2) Hed. - depression and skin irritation antidoted by Gunpowder. (3) In “Drowsiness with head- ache”Bruce., Hera., Gels., Nat-s. (4) Nux-m. and Sulph. in dry lips, Bry. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Pressure on the stomach. Oppression and pressure of clothing intolerable. Painful drawings in the stomach, as from hunger. Swelling and pulsation of the stomach. Contractive pain in the stomach with anguish, difficulty of respiration. Drawing pains in the stomach and lancinations in right side, which stop respiration. Inclination to vomit.

Abdomen - Tense, painful, rumbling. Pain in right side. Loud gurgling in ileo-cecal region. Dull borborygmi in the abdomen, tension and feeling of inflation, emission of wind, uneasiness and yawning. Peri-typhlitis.

Rectum - Evacuation difficult. Sticking in rectum. Tenesmus and lancinations. Hard stool, which is not emitted without efforts, followed by burning in the anus. Thin stools preceded by short violent pain, extending from within the pelvis to the thighs, as though one must sink to the ground. Liquid stools in the evening, preceded by colic.

Male - Voluptuous tickling at end of urethra. Pressure in testicles. Weakness of genital organs. Sexual excitement. Nocturnal erections without pollutions. Painful erections while sitting at engrossing business. Rheumatic pains after frequent emissions.

Female - Premature menses. Premenstrual lumbar pains. Leucorrhea.

Chest - Aching and oppression in the chest with great difficulty of respiration. Oppression of the chest with anxiety and lancinations in pit of stomach and lumbar region. Prostration of strength and lassitude in the limbs.

Heart - Severe pain, cutting, dagger-like lancinations and stitches in précordia. Some violent beats while sitting and followed by sensation of floundering of heart with rapid, small indistinct pulse. Pulse very irregular.

Back - Stiffness in back. Coldness in back and spine. Pressure in dorsal vertebrae. Frequent cracking in upper cervical vertebrae on moving head. Heaviness and stiffness in nape. Drawings in neck muscles. Weight in nape of neck with contusive pain along back of sacrum. Pulsation in vessels of right side of neck. Painful lassitude along back with bruised feeling down to and in sacrum. Deep lancinations around loins, between the shoulder blades, extending to right shoulder.

Limbs - Skin feels tight, contracted. Stiff, contracted joints. Much cracking in joints on moving. Bruised pain in limbs alternating in different parts. Heaviness of lower limbs. Bruised pain in small of back and thighs, nightly digging in right lower limb to toes. Eruption on upper inner thighs. Hands feel swollen. Violent burning heat in fingertips. Lungs - Short anxious respiration or slow and deep with exertion. Frequent deep inspiration and tightness of chest as if he could not get enough air, better while walking. Contractive pain across lower thorax. Dry cough in paroxysms. Voice rough and hoarse.

Sleep - Much yawning and drowsiness. Vivid, lascivious dreams, of which the recollection remains. Awakens with difficulty or else with a start.

Skin - Itching pimples on the skin of the neck and of the chest. Itching below right foot.

Modalities - Better at dinner. Worse in open air. Worse night. Worse from talking. Worse bending, turning. Worse descending stairs. Worse sitting.

Kidneys - Sticking and voluptuous twitching in navicular fossa. Pruritus and burning in urethra with frequent urging to urinate. Yellowish lemon-colored urine, depositing a red sediment.

Temperature - Coldness, numbness, trembling of hands, fingers white. Chilliness through the back extending into arms, into bones of back, cold hands, blue nails.

CLINICAL - Anginapectoris. Aphasia. Brain, congestion. Bright's disease. Colic. Convulsions. Epilepsy. Fright. Goiter. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hypertension. Mania. Meningitis. Menses, suppression. Migraines. Neuralgias. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Paralysis. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Seasickness. Snow-headache. Strokes. Sun-headaches. Sunstroke. Toothache. Trauma.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering said that Sobrero discovered nitroglycerine in 1847, but none could be obtained for physiological experiment until Morris Davis, after long and laborious trials, and under Hering's own direction, succeeded in producing the substance in sufficient quantities for a proving. Nitroglycerine is an explosive substance, therefore its action is quick and violent, a tempestuous remedy. The signature of this potent explosive may be said to be “bursting” and “expansion.” The keynote action is the tendency to sudden congestion and violent irregularities of the circulation. Sudden vascular congestion. Surges of blood. Violent pulsations, ebullitions and irregular congestions. Blood rushes upwards, to head and heart. Small, wiry pulse, pallor, arterial spasm, anemia of brain. Collapse, feeble heart, syncope, dicrotic pulse. Affinity for the arteries (Ham., for veins). Stimulates the heart and circulatory system, usually going to the head and chest producing violent pain. Throbbing and pulsation in the area. Quick and violent action. Arterial tension, in chronic interstitial nephritis. Strokes. General pulsations throughout body, often with numbness. Pulsating pains. Pains that come long after injuries. Burning in small areas or in a single parts. Congestive headaches, hyperemia of the brain from excess of heat or cold. Bursting and expansion sensations. Great vertigo on assuming an upright posture from rising up in bed, rising from a seat, etc. Heat in the head, throbbing headache. Violent convulsions, associated with cerebral congestion. Extreme irritability, easily excited by the slightest opposition, ending in congestive head symptoms. Intercranial, menopausal disturbances or due to menstrual suppression. Convulsions, epileptiform from cerebral congestion or suppressed menses. Eclampsia. Sciatica in atheromatous subjects with cold shriveled limb. Itching all over body, with later acne and furuncle formation. Old scars break out again. Clothing seems tight. Seasickness. Bulimia. Ailments from sunstroke or heat, can't bear heat about the head, the sun, the heat from a stove. MIND - Confused, bewildered. Mental confusion with dizziness. Confusion on waking, at night, better open air. Conversation difficult, with confused ideas. Forgetful during headache. Worse mental exhaustion. Great lassitude, no inclination to work. Disinclined to speak. Ailments from mental excitement, fright, fear, mechanical injuries and their later consequences. Desires death during headache. Suicidal, attempts to jump from window during headache. Shock, sudden attacks of terror. Fear from sensation of swelling of throat. Apprehensive of approaching death. Fears she has been poisoned. Fear of having a stroke on waking. Shudders and weeps during intermissions of pain. Frantic with pain, attempts to run away or jump out of a window. Very irritable. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences, recalls old grievances. Aversion to husband, dislikes her own children. Dare not go out into the street. Sits with head on hands and elbow on knees. Familiar places seemed strange after headache. Cannot recognize localities. Recognizes nobody. Loses senses, sinks down unconscious. Delusion house is not in right place, while walking in street after headache. As if in a dream, doesn't know where he is. Time passes too slowly. Delusion distances are enlarged. Insanity from long continued heat of sun. Exalted ideas, thinks she is God and everyone her inferior. Unusually bright and loquacious, with great flow of ideas. Desires room perfectly still, is worse noise. Abdomen - Rumbling in lower part of the abdomen, principally when lying on left side. Rumbling in hypogastrium. Gallstone colic. Colic, cutting pain principally below the navel, waking in the morning, before and after loose stools.

Head - Rush of blood to head. Cerebral congestion. Throbbing and bursting headache. Sudden, violent congestion to head, throbbing felt with every pulse, at every step. As if blood were surging back and forth. Waves of terrible, pounding pain. Cracking, snapping, shocks, explosions or soreness deep in brain. Head heavy, but cannot lay it on pillow. Headache, before, during, after, or in place of menses. Headache with nausea. Shocks in head, synchronous with pulse. Headache better from sleep. Holds the head tightly. Throb- bingin temples, worse walking. Veins of temples distended. Neuralgia of head and face. Head feels large, as if skull were too small for brain. Headache with protrusion of eyeballs. As if standing on the head with expanding and contracting sensation. Headache and pulse increase and diminish together. Threatened strokes. Meningitis. Cri encéphalique. Knocks head against wall, during frightful bursting headache. Sun headache, increases and decreases with the sun. Sunstroke. Effects of sunstroke, heat on head, as in type- setters and workers under gas and electric light. Headache from injury to spine.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, dry. Red, lower eyeballs or lids. Eyes protrude, look wild, upturned or rolled outwards and upwards in convulsions. Sharp pain, soreness or pressure in eyeballs. Lids stick to ball. Photophobia. Pupils dilated, eyes rolled upward and outward. Pupils contracted in sunstroke.

Ears - Ears red. Sharp shooting pain behind ears. Throbbing, piercing from within outward in right ear, each beat of heart is heard in ears, full feeling. Ringing, singing or cracking in the ears. Deafness, paralysis of auditory nerve. Ears sensitive to jarring. Sensation of fullness in and around the ears. Mastoiditis. Menière's disease.

Nose - Nosebleeds on going out into the heat of the sun, face flushed, hot, red. Pain at root of nose. The headache extends into the nose. Sudden sneezing, fluent coryza. Pains - Bursting, throbbing, pulsative, tearing, piercing, stabbing, gnawing. Sensation of fullness.

Face - Redness of face, which comes and goes. Flushed face alternating with pale. Flushed, hot face. Dusky face. Face bluish. Faceache with twitching of facial muscles. Pain at the root of the nose. Neuralgia of face with pulsating pains. Chin feels too long. Trigeminal neuralgia, left side of face. Periodical attacks of facial neuralgia. Lower lip feels swollen or numb. Jaws clenched in sunstroke. Pain in malar bones, ending in headache. Veins of temples swollen. Cold sweat on face during congestion to head. Sweat on face.

Mouth - Saliva increased, thick in a.m. Froth at mouth. Bitter taste with nausea. Aromatic, sweet, warm things, leave a fatty taste. Lower lip feels swollen. Throbbing pain in teeth, teeth feel elongated. Pulsating toothache. Itching of soft palate and throat. Hard palate sensitive as if swollen.

Throat - Throat feels full. Sensation as if the throat were swelling. As if string were tied around neck, which prevented blood from returning to head. Collar must be opened. Chokes and swells up under ear. The soft palate feels contracted and dry. Itching of the soft palate and throat. In the throat tickling, heat, soreness.

Stomach - Gastralgia in anemic patients with feeble circulation. Faint, gnawing and empty feeling at pit of stomach. Stomach pain in anemic patients with feeble circulation. Horrible faint feeling at the pit of stomach with throbbing. Rumbling in hypogastrium, worse lying on left side. Nausea with faint feeling. Nausea and vomiting in brain congestions or during sunstroke. Spasmodic vomiting in hydrocephalus. Seasickness.

Rectum - Constipation with itching, painful hemorrhoids, with pinching in abdomen before and after stool. Diarrhea, copious black, lumpy stools. Diarrhea with sudden stoppage of menses. Morning diarrhea with sharp burning with rumbling. Diarrhea evening and night after eating peaches. Stools, loose, scanty, with much rumbling. Diarrhoeic stools with rumbling and discharge of flatus. Frequent passage of flatus during stools, with a loud, sharp noise. Sensations - Brain as if expanding, as if moving in waves, as if hanging with head downwards, as if something were pumped into vertex, as if everything were crowded out at forehead. Sensation as if warm water were running upwards from nape of neck. As if the neck were held by a hand. Sensation as if some one were pulling eyes from within outward. Noise in left ear as if it came from heart. As if heart would rise to throat. Sensation as if chin feels too long.

Female - Delayed menses. Sudden cessation of menses with congestion to head and chest, with headache and fainting. Menses scanty. Menses with lumbar pain. Headaches after profuse menses. Since menarche, congestion to head, with loss of consciousness. Menopausal flushing. During pregnancy, headache, congestions of blood to the head and chest. Eclampsia, unconscious, face bright-red, puffed, pulse full, hard, urine copious and albuminous. Food - Loss of appetite. Abnormal hunger. Wants cold water, dry parched feeling. Increased desire to smoke. Alcoholic stimulants cause delirium, congestion, stupor, sleepiness and subsequent depression. Wine aggravates all symptoms.

Chest - Congestions to chest alternating with congestions to head. Oppression of the chest, alternating with headache. Heat, rising from chest to face and head. Chest feels screwed together. Constriction. Numbness moves upwards in chest and down left arm. Sweats on the chest. Constitutions - Suited to florid, plethoric, sensitive women. Nervous, sanguine, readily affected persons.

Heart - Angina pectoris. Anxiety in précordia. Cardiac pain radiates to all parts. Heart pain, worse from wine. Sharp pain in heart on stooping. Laborious action. Violent palpitations with throbbing carotids. Palpitations with dyspnea with heat in face. Heart seems full, quivers. Boiling sensation in the region. Fluttering of heart. Pressure in heart as if it was being contracted. High blood pressure and headaches. Throbbing in the whole body to the fingertips. Purring noise at the region of the heart. Any exertion brings on rush of blood to heart and fainting spells. Cannot go uphill because of heart pain. Full, tense pulse. Venous pulse. Pulse rapid when walking. Pulse rapidduring headache. Pulse rises and falls alternately. Pulse low and feeble in sunstroke.

Back - Burning heat between the shoulder blades. Hot sensation down back, along the spine. Burning between scapula. Pain in the whole spinal column or heat andchilli- ness. Stiffness, tightness around the neck, clothing seems to be too tight. Neck feels weak and tired, cannot support the head. Sensation of fullness, tension, pulsation. Stiffness of neck during headache. Breasts - Throbbing pain begins in left breast, darts suddenly to head, worse motion. Causations - Ill effects of sun, heat, bright snow, fear or fright, and jarring injuries.

Limbs - Itching all over, worse limbs. Drawing pain in all limbs. Limbs feel bloated. Weak and tremulous feeling in limbs. Numbness in left limbs. Sciatica better flexing legs on abdomen. Unsteady gait. Knees give way. Thighs and knees weak and knock together during headache. Pain in left biceps. Trembling hands. Fingers and toes spread apart during convulsions. Lungs - Heavy, labored breathing. Desire to take a long, deep inspiration. Sighing. Numbness moves upwards in chest and down left arm. Oppression of chest alternating with headache. As if a load on chest. Frequent, expectoration of thick mucus.

Sleep - Weakness as from loss of sleep. Yawning with the headache, congestion of blood to the head. Sleepiness early in the evening. Difficult to waken. Awakes with fear of having a stroke. Confused dreams. Dreams of homesickness. Dreams with tears.

Skin - Itching all over, the limbs. Old scars break out again.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better cold things, cold application. Better elevating head. Better lying still (opposite Bell.). Worse bending head backward. Worse stooping. Worse left side. Worse motion, shakingjarring. Worse stimulants, wine. Worse fruits, peaches. Worse gaslight. Worse cutting hair. Worse weight of hat. Worse suppressed menses. Worse lying down. Worse from 6 a.m. to noon. Worse in sun. Worse open fire. Worse heat on head. Worse becoming overheated. Worse hot weather. Worse from injury.

Teeth - Gums swollen and sensitive to touch. Teeth feel elongated. Throbbing pain in the teeth. Pulsating toothache with headache. Toothache from taking cold, after having been overheated. Stabbing pains in gums right side passing to left, worse from hot, better from cold applications. Toothache after hitting, in chewing a hard substance, a bad tooth. Teeth decay after mercury.

Tongue - Tongue is milk-white without coating. Tongue coated heavily at back. Tongue, heavy, cannot protrude straight. Tongue numb. Tongue as if burnt. Tongue prickling, smarting, and stinging. Tongue feels swollen and raw with spasmodic twitchings. Vertigo - Vertigo on assuming upright position. Vertigo with confusion. Vertigo, worse from stooping or moving head. Vertigo in open air. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo with dim vision. Vertigo with black spots before eyes. Vertigo with headache. Vertigo with nausea. Vertigo in sunstroke. Vertigo after a head injury. Vision - Dim vision during vertigo. Impaired vision during raging headache. Letters appear smaller. Sparks before eyes. Spells of blindness. Black spots, during headache, when turning quickly. Black specks, sparks, flashes, before eyes. Objects dance with every pulsation. Black floating spots on attempting to stoop. COMMENTS - Guernsey recorded that Glon. is suited to troubles of the head in type-setters and in men who work under a gaslight steadily, so that the heat falls on the head. Severe, painful palpitations and sudden rushes of blood to the head with a threatened stroke. Palpitations with trembling limbs. Heart attack (Aeon.). High blood pressure. Panic attacks when the blood rushes to the head, can get painful palpitations and a fear of having a heart attack. Cardiac neuralgia (angina pectoris) with radiating pains. Vascular headache, with pounding, throbbing and a red face. Violent action of the heart, rush of blood to the head. Vascular headaches due to high blood pressure with flushed face, dilated pupils, palpitated heart. Bursting and throbbing headaches. Worse light touch to the head. Sensation of waves in the blood with headache. Headaches ever since heat stroke or from exposure to the sun. Sense of constriction in the throat with headache, throbbing carotid arteries. Headaches after having hair cut (Bell.). Meningitis. Nausea and vomiting of cerebral origin. Great sensitivity to the least motion. Will carry his head very carefully in order to avoid any motion (Bry.). The headache is in the whole head, worse with exposure to the sun, better with pressure. Pains appear in occiput and at the base of the brain. Gnawing in occiput, sore pain, pressure, severe pain extending to the eyes and temples. Pains move from within outward, from front to back. Sensation of expanding in head and body. Sensation as if something were moving in the nerves from the back of the neck upward to the head. The eyes may be fixed or protrude. Aversion to bright light, black spots before sight. Both hands and feet are cold. Flushes of heat rising from the chest to the head, then throbbing pain in head (Bell.). Heat stroke. For ailments from working under strong lights or the sun. Faint from hot place. Neuralgias are accompanied with throbbing, often worse at night, preventing sleep. Supra-orbital neuralgia, pulsating, retinal congestion from exposure to strong light. Facial neuralgia, extending through head. Violent, stabbing, neuralgic pains, so violent as to make patient frantic, he wants to escape to jump out of window. Menopausal disturbances. Hot flashes with pulsation, heat, severe palpitation with wave sensation resulting in headaches. Face is flushed or pale. Fainting, sudden unconsciousness, convulsions, especially during labor. Horrible apprehension, fear of being poisoned. Ailments from fear. Loss of a sense of location. Bad effects of having hair cut, of exposure to heat from the sun or fire. Ailments from too much riding or driving, seasickness. Sensitive to alcohol (Zinc). Cannot bear weight of hair, clothing seems too tight. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Aeon. Camph., Coff., Nux-v. Compare: ( 1 ) Op., Stram.. Verat- v. (2) Amyl-n. (3) Cimic. - waving in brain. (4) Petr, and Crot-h. - loss of location. (5) Bell. - cephalic cry but not as marked in Bell., also Bell, has better bending head back and better covering head. (6) Glon. - better uncovered, Apis. (7)Hyos. -fearsbeingpoisoned. (8)Gels. - inclination tojump out of window. (9) Stram., Sang. - headache with the sun, ear sensitive to jar. ( 10) Nit-ac. and Bell. - sensitiveness to jar. (11) Meli. - headache with crimson face. (12) Lyc. and Phos. - burning between shoulders. (13) Dig. and Dios. - headache extending into nose. (14) Sec. - fingers spread apart. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Acute and chronic interstitial nephritis with high bloodpressure. Tubal nephritis with headache, brought on by walking in sun, numbness in arms and hands alternating with intense tingling. Profuse pale, albuminous urine, more frequent at night. Increased secretion of pale urine, has to rise frequently during the night. Urine high-colored, burning while passing. Red sediment and muddy, reddish-yellow slime.

Perspiration - Perspiration, principally in the face, after sleeping. Perspiration on forehead. Profuse sweat, mostly on face and chest. Sweats principally on face, after sleeping. Sweats on hands. Perspiration relieves the nausea. Sweats alternates with chilliness. Feeling as if sweat would break out all over. Cold sweat on face, during congestion to head.

Temperature - Chill after getting heated, alternates with sweat, vomiting. Intermittent fever. Fever with hot sweat. Heat in face, ascending from pit of stomach to head. Heat flushes. General warmth, flushes of heat, waves of heat upward.

name: Glycerinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Carbuncle. Diabetes. Influenza. Pneumonia. Pernicious anemia. Rheumatic pains. Weakness.

PHARMACY - glyc. Glycerinum. Glycerine. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Pure glycerine in teaspoonful doses, 3 times a day with lemon juice for pernicious anemia.

CLINICAL - Carbuncle. Diabetes. Influenza. Pneumonia. Pernicious anemia. Rheumatic pains.…
full:
PHARMACY - glyc. Glycerinum. Glycerine. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Pure glycerine in teaspoonful doses, 3 times a day with lemon juice for pernicious anemia.

CLINICAL - Carbuncle. Diabetes. Influenza. Pneumonia. Pernicious anemia. Rheumatic pains. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Glycerine is a liquid obtained by the decomposition of vegetable or animal fats or fixed oils, containing not less than 95 percent of absolute glycerol, a triatomic alcohol existing in fats and fixed oils in combination with the fatty acids. Dr. Wm. B. Griggs noted that potentized glycerine seems to act deeply and long, building up tissue, hence of great use in marasmus, mental and physical debility, diabetes, etc. It disturbs nutrition in its primary action and, secondarily, seems to improve the general state of nutrition. Builds tissue. Seems to affect most of the organs and tissues of the body. General sense of exhaustion. Neurasthenia. Headache with a sense of fullness in the head and throbbing, aggravated by motion. Dullness of the mind, a sense of mental and physical weakness, restless sleep and dreaming, much physical languor, almost to a state of utter prostration. Balances the general metabolism. Loss of appetite, constipation, profuse urination with traces of sugar. Gastro- intestinal disease. Senile debility. Acute catarrhal conditions of the mucus membrane of the naso-pharynx and nephritis in the aged. Influenza, pneumonia.

Head - Feels full, throbs, especially occiput. Mentally confused. Severe headache two days before menstruation.

Nose - Stopped up, sneezing, irritating coryza. Sensation of crawling on mucus membrane. Post-nasal dripping.

Stomach - Fermentation, burning in stomach and esophagus. COMMENTS - Anshutz reported three cases. The first concerned a homeopathic physician in Philadelphia, aged 61 years. He was refused insurance on account of albumen casts and sugar in urine, and had been under his own care for months. He developed a severe infection on his neck, six inches in diameter, a carbuncle was operated on by Dr. Herbert S. Leopold very successfully. He had extreme nervousness, profuse urination with a specific gravity of 1.030. Sugar, etc. in urine examined by a Philadelphia chemist, extreme debility, prostration, etc. Glyc. in 30c and 200c eliminated sugar and albumin in three months and the patient gained fifteen pounds. The second case concerned Mr. S., baker, age 66 years. Diabetes for years, weakness, dyspnea, headache, urine with sugar, acetone, great debility. No albumin or casts. He was placed on strict diet and given Sulph., Ph-ac., Uran-n., Ars., Syzyg. and potentized blood. Glyc. was then given with the result that the urine cleared up, a good appetite developed and after a period of two years sexual vigor returned. Finally, the third case was C. H., a baby two years old. Drs. Yeager and Macfarlan assisted in the case. Influenza pneumonia. Profuse coryza and dyspnea. Consolidation in both lungs, weakness and debility after twelve days. Glyc. 200c was given and a complete recovery ensued with improvement at once. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lac-ac., Lee. Gels., Calc. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke.

Female - Profuse, long-lasting flow, with bearing down heaviness in uterus.

Chest - Chest seems full.

Limbs - Rheumatic pains of aremittent type. Feet painful and hot, feel enlarged. Lungs - Hacking cough with sense of weakness. Influenza pneumonia.

Kidneys - Profuse and frequent urination. Increased specific gravity and sugar. Diabetes.

full:
PHARMACY - glyc-g. Glycyrrhiza glabra. Licorice root. Liquiritia officinalis. Sweetwort. Europe and Asia. N. O. Leguminosae. Papilionoideae. Historicaldose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Addison's disease. Allergies. Athlete's foot. Arthritis. Asthma. Baldness. Bronchitis. Bursitis. Canker sores. Catarrh. Chronic fatigue. Colds. Coughs. Dandruff. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emphysema. Gastri- tis. Gingivitis. Gout. Fungal, infections. Heartburn. Herpes. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Influenza. Liver problems. Lyme disease. Menopause. Mouth, ulcers. Peptic ulcers. Prostate, enlargement. Psoriasis. Shingles. Stomach, ulcers. Sore throat. Tendonitis. Tooth, decay. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Viral, infections. Yeast, infections.

HERBAL - Liquorice his one of the most commonly used herbs in herbal medicine and has a very long history of use, both as a medicine and also as a flavoring to disguise the unpleasant flavor of other medications. Liquorice was known to the ancients as far back as the third century B. C. for its efficacy in the case of dry coughs. The Greeks, recommended it for the treatment of gastric and peptic ulcers. Later, Arab physicians used Licorice to relieve coughs and side effects associated with laxatives. It is a very sweet, moist, soothing herb that detoxifies and protects the liver and is also powerfully anti- inflammatory, being used in conditions as varied as arthritis and mouth ulcers. The root is alterative, antispasmodic, demulcent, diuretic, emollient, expectorant, laxative, moderately pectoral and tonic. The root has also been shown to have a hormonal effect similar to the ovarian hormones. Liquorice root is much used in cough medicines and also in the treatment of catarrhal infections of the urinary tract. It is taken internally in the treatment of Addison's disease, asthma, bronchitis, coughs, peptic ulcer, arthritis, allergic complaints. Exter nally, the root is used in the treatment of psoriasis, herpes, eczema and shingles. Licorice root has an impressive list of well documented uses and is probably one of the most over-looked of all herbal remedies. It is used for many ailments including asthma, athlete's foot, baldness, body odor, bursitis, canker sores. Chronic fatigue, depression. Colds, coughs and influenza. Dandruff. Emphysema. Gingivitis and tooth decay. Gout. Heartburn. Viral infections. Fungal infections. Ulcers. Liver problems, Lyme disease. Menopause. Psoriasis. Shingles. Sore throats. Tendonitis. Tuberculosis. Yeast infections. Prostate enlargement. Arthritis. Other uses of the plant include the treatment of hormone imbalances and menopausal symptoms in women. RELATIONS - Compare: Ulmus fuva, Melaleuca alternifolia. REFERENCES Murphy.

name: Gnaphalium Polycephalum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from flexing limbs. Better sitting in a chair. Worse from walking. Worse lying. Worse cold damp..
constitution: Anterior crural neuralgia. Chills. Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Colic. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Gout. Lumbago. Neuralgia. Night-sweats. Numbness. Polyuria. Prostate gland. Rheumatism. Sciatica.
keynote:
PHARMACY - gnaph. Gnaphalium polyceph- alum. Cud-weed. Old balsam. Gnaphalium dioica. Gnaphalium uliginosum. Sweet- scented everlasting flower. N. O. Composite. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anterior crural neuralgia. Chills.…
full:
PHARMACY - gnaph. Gnaphalium polyceph- alum. Cud-weed. Old balsam. Gnaphalium dioica. Gnaphalium uliginosum. Sweet- scented everlasting flower. N. O. Composite. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anterior crural neuralgia. Chills. Cholera. Cholera, infantum. Colic. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Gout. Lumbago. Neuralgia. Night-sweats. Numbness. Polyuria. Prostate gland. Rheumatism. Sciatica.

HOMEOPATHIC - Gnaph. has been used mainly in disorders of the sciatic nerve, but it also has an action on the abdominal organs, causing vomiting, colic and diarrhea, thus comparing with Coloc. in both spheres. Sciatica and lumbago with numbness alternating with the pain. Intense sciatic pain (Mag-p., Rhus-t., Coloc., Hyper.), alternating with or followed by numbness. Lumbago with numbness of part. Rheumatism. Anterior crural neuralgia. Pain in joints as if they lacked oil. Pain worse lying down, motion, stepping, by sitting in a chair, better by flexing the limbs on abdomen (Colo.). Sticking pain and numbness. Sharp, shooting pains, or electric-like sensation down the backs of the legs. Offensive diarrhea with colic, worse in the morning. Polyuria. Weight and heaviness in the pelvis. Dysmenorrhea with scanty menses, very painful during the first day. MIND - Very irritable for two or three days after the diarrhea.

Face - Intermittent pains of superior maxillary of both sides. Dull, heavy, bloated appearance. Neuralgic pain of an intermittent from in both upper maxillary bones.

Mouth - Mouth feels parched and tastes badly. Flat, sweetish, sickening taste. Tongue covered with long white fur, better by thorough washing with cold water.

Stomach - Vomiting and purging like cholera morbus in the night and all next day. Flatus, windy belchings, nausea and hiccough. Vertigo - Giddy, especially afterrising from recumbent position. COMMENTS - Cramps i n cal ves and back of thighs, hamstrings. Sciatica pain in worse on lying down, by motion, by stepping, better when sitting in a chair, better drawing up the limb. Diarrhea is watery and offensive, occurs in the morning and is repeated during the day. Rumbling in the bowels, colicky pains and the patient is cross and irritable. Urine is scanty. Appetite and taste are lost. Dr. W. McGeorge recorded that Gnaph. has a reputation for colds, fevers and night-sweats. The last was caused in one of the provers. It cured one case of chills. The periodicity appears in the intermittent neuralgia of the upper jaws. McGeorge noted a sense of “weight and fullness in the pelvis” for dysmenorrhea. Dysmenorrhea when the menses are scanty and very painful during the first day. Sexual excitement in male provers, pain and irritation in the prostate gland. Headache better by washing in cold water. Fur on tongue removed by thorough washing with cold water. McGeorge cured a very aggravated case of sciatica in a man, resulting from a strain. The left leg was cramped and drawn up, worse in cold and damp weather. Dr. George Shelton recorded two cases. The first, a clergyman, 27, had sharp cutting pains, starting from inner side right thigh, just below Poupart's ligament, extending down course of anterior crural nerve to a GnaphaKum polycephalum point about its lower third. The pains were paroxysmal, came on when walking, occasionally when lying down. He had one or two attacks in the pulpit. In several instances the pain had extended down the right cord into the testicle and caused him to draw up the leg, flexing the thigh on the abdomen. This condition was also present in Dr. McGeorge's case. A few doses of Gnaph. 1c cured him completely. The second case occurred in a widow, 68, who had severe pains in the outer side of her right thigh for six years, part of which she had been confined to bed. The pains were paroxysmal, cutting, tearing, extending down the course of the sciatic nerve. Attacks were worse at night and more frequent, causing her to roll about the bed and cry out with the pain. All the resources of allopathy had been in vain. Rhus-t., Coloc., Sulph., gave no help. Bell, relieved slightly. Gnaph. 1c wrought gradual improvement, and in eight weeks the cure was complete. Clarke had acase, cured with Gnaph. 30c., of a very gouty man, with the alternation of numbness with pain. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Xanth., Cham., Coloc., Ip., Merc., Puls., Lyc., Caul. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Abdomen - Colic, pain in various parts of the abdomen. Cecum is sensitive. Borbo- rygmus with emission of much flatus.

Rectum - First stage of cholera infantum, vomiting and purging. Rumbling in bowels with stool before breakfast. Looseness of bowels with passage of pale-colored feces. Diarrhea discharge in morning and during day with irritable temper. Dark-colored, liquid offensive stool in morning afterwards pain in bowels all day, in children.

Male - Irritation of prostate gland. Increased sexual passion.

Female - Dysmenorrhea with scanty and painful menses. Sensation of weight in pelvis. Sensation of fullness in pelvis.

Back - Chronic backache in lumbar region, better resting on back. Lumbago with numbness in lower part of back and weight in pelvis.

Limbs - Rheumatic pain in ankle joints and legs. Intense pain along the sciatic nerve, numbness alternates with pain. Feeling of weakness, as if incapable of raising the slightest weight. Rheumatic pains in elbows and shoulders. Frequent pains in calves and feet. Cramps in calves of legs and feet when in bed. Gouty pains in big toes. Gouty concretions. Anterior crural neuralgia (Staph.). Chronic muscular rheumatism of back and neck. Pain in joints as if they lacked oil. Better drawing limbs up, flexing thigh on abdomen.

Modalities - Better from flexing limbs. Better sitting in a chair. Worse from walking. Worse lying. Worse cold damp.

Kidneys - Pains in kidneys with frequent slight pain in prostate gland. Sensation of pain and fullness in bladder, even when just emptied.

full:
PHARMACY - gors-b. Gorse. Ulex euro- paeus. Flowers from the bush are placed in a bowl of water and allowed to stand in the sun for several hours. The strained water is used as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle, (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.

HOMEOPATHIC - This remedy belongs to Bach's group For Those who Suffer Uncertainty, along with Cer- b„ Scler-b., Gent-b., Hom-b. and Wld-o-b. Forthose suffering from doubt, hopelessness, uncertainty and lack of clarity of purpose in daily affairs. Gorse Will raise spirits in cases of true hopelessness, such as terminal illness. Lowered vitality and sinking of strength. Sense of resignation to a hopeless situation. MIND - Deep-hopelessness (Aur.). Calm, with underlying sadness and a sense of misfortune and suffering. Denial and recurring disappointment. Negativity. Uncertainty about the future. REFERENCES - Bach.

full:
PHARMACY - goss. Gossypium herbaceum. Cotton plant. N. O. Malvaceae. Tincture of fresh inner root bark, chopped and pounded to a pulp. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chills. Dysmenorrhea. Fibroids. Infertility. Labia, abscess. Miscarriage. Morning sickness. Nausea. Ovaries, pains. Pregnancy, vomiting. Retained, placenta. Tumor. Uterus, bearing down.

HERBAL - In herbal practice, Gossypium was used as a powerful emmenagogue.

HOMEOPATHIC - Goss, has been mainly used in affection of the female generative organs. It has been taken in the form of the extract stimulate the uterus and ovaries. Nausea with flow of saliva and inclination to vomit in the morning, before breakfast with sensitive uterine region. Sensitive stomach with much gas. Vomits on motion or raising up. Morning sickness of pregnancy. Hyperemesis. Menses, late, scanty, watery. Tardy menses, with sensation that the flow is about to start and yet does not. Bearing down pains in the uterus. ’Intermittent pains in the ovaries,” extending towards uterus. Sterility from uterine torpor. Sensitive womb. Subinvolution. Fibroids. Tumors in breast with swelling of axillary glands. Pain in neck. Sympathetic symptoms of stomach, heart, bowels and nervous system ari sing from disturbance of uterine functions. Stinging, drawing, tearing and sometimes burning pains. Pains extend from one place to another, jumping from one place to another. Move from above downward.

Head - Pain in cervical region with tendency for head to draw backward with nervousness. Pain, first burning, then stinging, extending from both temporal bones to middle of frontal bone.

Eyes - Drawing pain over eyes with stinging pain in pupils.

Nose - Nostrils swollen and inflamed.

Throat - Tonsils swollen, worse right side. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Action similar to Ergot when made from fresh green root. (2) Lil-t., Sabin., Cimic., Apis. Asar., Bell., Bry., Puls., Sec., Sep., Ust. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Nausea with accumulation of saliva in mouth inclination to vomit before breakfast. Rotating pain in pit of stomach.

Abdomen - Sharp pain in right hypochondrium, lasting for a few minutes. Drawing pain from both hypochondriac regions extending to stomach.

Female - Labia swollen and itching. Suppressed menstruation. Menses too watery. Backache, weight and dragging in pelvis. Intermittent pain in ovaries. Uterine subinvolution and fibroids with gastric pain and debility. Retained placenta. Morning sickness with sensitive uterine region. Food - Anorexia with uneasy, depressed feeling at scrobiculum cordis at time of menses.

Back - Pain in back. Pain in cervical region with tendency for head to draw backward, with nervousness. Backache, weight and dragging pain in pelvis. Breasts - Tumor of the breast with swelling of axillary glands. Constitution - Tall, anemic patients with nervous chills.

Limbs - Heavy feeling in both hands, better hanging them down, worse in warmth of bed.

Sleep - Caused her to sleep a great part of the time.

Modalities - Pains are generally worse by motion, better by rest.

Kidneys - Frequent desire to urinate with burning pains.

Temperature - General external chilliness, with internal heat.

constitution: Ascarides. Emaciation. Gastralgia. Heart, weakness. Hernia. Jaw, cracking. Nausea. Tapeworm. Toothache. Salivation. Vertigo. Worms.
keynote:
PHARMACY - gran. Granatum pomegranate. Pomegranate. Púnica granatum. N. O. Grana- tee. Lythraceae. Homeopathic provings were made with a tincture or trituration of bark of root. Historicaldose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascarides. Emaciation.…
full:
PHARMACY - gran. Granatum pomegranate. Pomegranate. Púnica granatum. N. O. Grana- tee. Lythraceae. Homeopathic provings were made with a tincture or trituration of bark of root. Historicaldose: Trituration, tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ascarides. Emaciation. Gastralgia. Heart, weakness. Hernia. Jaw, cracking. Nausea. Tapeworm. Toothache. Salivation. Vertigo. Worms.

HERBAL - Pomegranate is a well-known vermifuge, especially used for the expulsion of tinea. For this a decoction of the rind of the fruit is used in the following manner: An alkaloid, Pelletierine, discovered by Bertrand Pelletier, is obtained from the rind of the fruit. After a mild purge the previous night in the morning, 30 grams of Sulphate of Pelletierine is administered in a solution containing 50 grams of tannic acid. This is followed by a glass of water in ten minutes and a brisk purge in half an hour. Granatum is used as a vermifuge for the expulsion of tapeworm. Salivation with nausea and vertigo. Spasm of the glottis.

HOMEOPATHIC - The provings bring out many symptoms of helminthiasis, including pale blue rings around eyes, and itching, crawling and tickling of the nose. Ravenous hunger, craving for sourorjuicy things, fruit, coffee. Loss of appetite. Emaciation. Swelling of navel. Nausea, fermenting in abdomen, griping, dragging in inguinal region as if hernia would protrude. Itching and tickling in anus frequently during the day. Discomfort. Great weariness and exhaustion, scarcely able to keep upright. Trembling. Convulsive movements. Itching of the skin of various places, face and body, as if pimples would break out. Biting and itching in palms of hands. Yawning. Great sensitiveness. MIND - Great sensitiveness and impressibility. Fear, dread of work during headache. Confusion of mind after a carousal. Stupefaction and intellectual embarrassment. Hypochondriacal. Dejection and discouragement. Quarrelsome humor. Melancholy, gloomy temper. Irritability and arrogance. Censorious. Reproaches others.

Head - Feels empty. Stupefying pain and painful heaviness in the head, forehead. Pressure on the forehead and the occiput. Acute drawing pains chiefly on right side of head shooting in forehead.

Eyes - Sunken eyes, pupils dilated, weak sight. Food - Ravenous hunger, craving for sour or juicy things, fruit, coffee. Loss of appetite. Great thirst for water.

Stomach - Constant hunger. Poor digestion. Loses flesh. Vomiting at night. Vertigo - Vertigo very persistent. Vertigo during intellectual labor or in the morning on rising. Vertigo with obscuration of the eyes. Vertigo with nausea and aching in the stomach. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Pelletierine - one of its constituents - an anthelmintic, especially for tapeworm. (2) Cina, Kou. Ars., lod., Teucr., Cue. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Pain in stomach and abdomen, worse about umbilicus (Cocc., Nux-m., Plum.). Ineffectual urging. Dragging in vaginal region, as if hernia would protrude. Swelling resembling umbilical hernia.

Rectum - Burning, itching in the anus, on the buttocks and perineum, scrotum and thighs. Diarrhea with frequent stools. Evacuation of fecal matter and mucus. Pressure in rectum afterwards. Burning heat in rectum. Prolapsed rectum during the stool. Shooting pains in anus and rectum.

Chest - Oppressed with sighing. Pain between shoulders, even clothing is oppressive.

Back - Pain between shoulders, even clothing is oppressive. Pain around shoulders, as if heavy load had been carried.

Limbs - Pain around shoulders, as if heavy load had been carried. Pain in all finger joints. Tearing pain in knee joint. Convulsive movements.

Skin - Itching in the palms. Sensation as if pimples would break out. Jaundiced complexion.

Modalities - Better after dinner. Pain in abdomen is better after drinking cold water.

Worse during and after menses. Worse empty swallowing. Worse fats. Worse hot drinks..
