full:
PHARMACY - graph. Graphites naturalis. Black lead. Plumbago. Trituration of prepared from finest English drawing-pencils. A modification of carbon. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies. Locally as a cerate in sore nipples.

CLINICAL - Acne. Amenorrhea. Anus, disorders. Blepharitis. Breasts, cancer. Breasts, indurated. Cancer. Catarrh. Chaps. Chlorosis. Colic. Constipation. Deafness. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Ears, disorders. Eczema. Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Face. Erythema. Feet, disorders. Fissures. Gastro-intestinal disorders. Glandular, swellings. Gleet. Gravel. Headaches. Hemorrhoid. Herpes. Hydrocele. Indurations. Influenza. Irritation. Lachrymal duct, inflamed. Leucorrhea. Lips, cracked. Liver, indurated. Menstruation, disorders. Leucorrhea. Nails, disorders. Noises, head. Nose, disorders. Nosebleeds. Obesity. Ovarian, tumors. Palpitations. Paralysis. Parotiditis. Pityriasis. Priapism. Pruritus, vagina. Psoriasis. Ptosis. Rectum, disorders. Rhus, poisoning. Scars. Scrofula. Seminal, emission. Skin, disorders. Smell, disorders. Stomach, cramps. Stomach, pain. Sycotic, diathesis. Syphilis. Trichinosis. Tumors. Ulcers. Urine, disordered. Uterus, cancer. Vaccination, effects. Wens. Whooping, cough. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Graphites is a mineral carbon, related to Carb-an. and Carb-v. It contains a small percentage of iron, and so is also related to Ferr. Weinhold first thought of using this substance as a drug. He was led to it by seeing workmen in a mirror-factory use it as a local application for tetters. Ruggeri followed him, using it both internally and locally. Tendency to produce excoriations, cracks or fissures, at muco-cutaneous junction of eyes, nostrils, mouth, anus, nipples, fingertips, folds of skin. Mucus membranes are cracked and fissured and have scanty secre- tions. Excoriations between toes. Thickening and induration of skin, glands, tarsi, nail, scars. Thick crusts on the skin. Tendency to callosities. Aids the absorption of scar tissue (Thiosin.). Cancerous diathesis in old scars. Recrudescence of scars. Syphilitic and constitutional ulcers. Tendency to grow cystic tumors, wens. Eradicates tendency to erysipelas. Watery hemorrhages. Dropsy. Edema. Paralysis or sensation of paralysis. Contractions of muscles. Cramps and burning in different places. Offensive discharges and secretions. Discharges are, thin, foul, scanty and acrid. Sweat stains are yellow, sour, offensive. Gushing leucorrhea. Swollen genitals. Alternating digestive and skin symptoms. Gastro-intestinal disorders alternating with acne and erythema of face, herpetic lesions or scrofulous hypochondriasis. Sourness of taste, belchings, stools, urine, blood about teeth etc. Frequently feels faint with partial loss of senses. Sensitive to cold. Cold aggravates bone pains, coryza and stomach. Emanation of suffering parts. Sensation of burning, numbness and deadness. Pains go to parts not lain on. General sense of uneasiness, tremulousness, which elicits groans. Sudden sinking of strength. Cancer of pylorus. Duodenal ulcer. Infiltrations. Weakness, then a relaxed condition, anemia, and chlorosis. Lymphatic glands are swollen. Take colds easily. Anemia with redness of face. Tendency to obesity. MIND - Mentally sluggish, poor memory. Forgetful, makes mistakes in speaking and writing. Remembers all the events of youth, recent events are forgotten. Fatigue from scientific labor. Dread of work. Fidgety while sitting at work. Energized from work, followed by apathy, anxiety. Very irritable and fretful. Obstinate and moody. Miserable and unhappy. Impulse to groan. Insolent. Offended easily. Periodic depressions. Anxiety about spiritual welfare. Full of fear in morning. Ailments from grief or fright. Sad, fearsome, irresolute, hesitates at trifles. Grief about slightest occurrences. Internal grief and despair. Despair over trifles. Thinks of nothing but death. Weepingameliorates symptoms. Weeping alternating with irritability and laughter at trifles. Weeps without cause. Weepingfrom music. Weeping during menses. Apprehensive, despondent. Fearofinsanity. Fears are better after weeping. Great tendency to start. Anxiety in morning on waking. Excitement at night. Intense restlessness, which drives him out of bed at night. Anxiety better warmth. Restlessness better walking in open air. Persistent thoughts, haunted by unpleasant subjects, better walking in open air. Restlessness while working. Dwells upon past disagreeable occurrences at night. Slowness of purpose. Dullness in morning. Dullness after a siesta. Inability to think from weakness in brain. Indolence, better open air. Feels indifferent to everybody and everything, from exhaustion. Absent-minded. Unable to decide. Timid. Child impudent, teasing, laughing at reprimands. Anguish before menses. Cataleptic conditions, consciousness but without the power to move or speak.

Head - Rush of blood to head, with flushed face, nosebleed or distention and flatulence. Burning on vertex, in a small spot. Headache in morning on waking, mostly on one side with inclination to vomit. Headache with nausea during menses. Heavy weight or dull pressure at the occiput, as if head is drawn back. Pain as if constricted in occiput, which pains as if broken on looking up. Desolate, empty feeling in head. Rheumatic pains on one side of head, extending to teeth and neck. Pressive pain or burning spot on vertex. Sensation of cobweb on forehead. Skin of forehead as if drawn into folds. Brain feels numb. Humid, itching eruption on hairy scalp, emitting a fetid odor. Much scaliness on head, causing distressing itching, becomes scurf, which disappears on washing, and is then humid. Hair, matted, brittle or falling out of hair, worse vertex and sides. Milk crusts. Eczema capitis, scabs sore to touch. Bald spots. Herpes. Hair falls out, even on sides of head.

Eyes - Recurrent keratitis. Blepharitis. Ophthalmia with intolerance of artificial light. Hot tears. Eyelids, red and swollen. Dryness of the lids. Eczema of lids, fissured. Eyelids, heavy and falling. Cystic tumors on eyelids. Sore or cracked outer canthi. Ingrown lashes. Phlyctenae. Sight vanishes during menses. Shuns daylight. Photophobia. Letters appear double, when writing, seem together when reading. Eace-Flushes of heat in face. Pale, bloated, haggard, flushed. Feels as if cobwebs were on it. Acne before the menses. Itching pimples, moist after scratching. Moist eczema around the mouth, chin and nose. Erysipelas, burning and stinging. Lips cracked and sore. Formication on lips during menses. Painful nodules on the lower jaw. Barber's itch. Facial paralysis with distortion of muscles and difficult speech. Falling of hair from chin.

Ears - Moisture and eruptions, fissures in and behind the ear. Thin, white scaly membrane covering the eardrum. Eczema behind the ears. Briny otorrhea. As if hard body behind ear. Cracks andfissures behind the ears. Feel stuffed at full moon. As if air inside, as if filled with water. Dryness of inner ear. Snapping after every eructation. Hardness of hearing. Hears better in noise. Tinnitus. Hissing in the ears. Detonation in ear like report of agun. Cracking in ears when eating.

Nose - Stuffed coryza. Coryza from cold. Colds at menses. Chronic catarrh. Sore on blowing it is painful internally. Discharge offensive especially during menses. Excoriated. Scabs and fissures in the nostrils. Painful internally. Eczema of nose. Sneezing on opening the eyes. Smell acute, cannot bear the smell of flowers. Dryness with loss of smell. Nosebleed with rush of blood to the head, worse before menses.

Mouth - Angles of the mouth ulcerated. Taste, sour like rotten eggs. Rotten, sour, foul odor from mouth. Breath smells like urine. Salivation, at night. Dots of thick, white fur on tongue. Burning blisters on tongue. Teeth on edge. Blood from teeth, tastes sour. Easy bleeding and swelling of the gums.

Throat - Chronic sore throat. Chronic hoarseness with skin disorders. Tonsils enlarged. Nodulated goiter. Choking, on swallowing from goiter. As of a lump in throat worse empty swallowing, urging to swallow from constant spasms. Asif food would not go down from spasms. Hoarseness as soon as he starts singing. Voice lacks control, better using it. Ulcerative pain in throat when swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo, worse looking upwards, reading or sewing. Vertigo with nausea and sour vomiting. Vertigo with hyperesthesia of eyes. Vertigo from overexertion of eyes. Vertigo from venous stagnation. Confusion and vertigo in morning on waking. COMMENTS - Hahnemann was quick to perceive that Graph, was much more than a mere remedy for skin disorders, it proved to be a leading anti-psoric, similar to Sulph. Hahnemann's provings and observations de- fined its powers over skin disorders. The skin of Graph, is rough, hard and dry. Eczematous and herpetic eruptions predominate. Poor healing of the skin, tendency to scarring, keloids. Impetigo, eczema. Psoriasis. Cracks between fingers and toes (Petr.), behind the ears, in the bends of joints, folds of skin, around the lips and anus, and margin of the hair. Intertrigo, infection in the folds of the skin, can fester and form pus. Yellow, sticky, honey-like discharge underneath the scabs. Pimples, acne. Wens. For the results of repelled eruptions of any kind. Fungal infections that deform the nails, tend to split. Brittle, crack and split down the middle. Pus and infection under the nails (Ant-c.). The circulation is at first excited, then there is a loss of energy and consequent venous hyperemia. Irregularities in the distribution of the blood occur, leading to pallor of skin and mucus membranes. Fainting readily occurs with great anxiety, motion is impaired and the tissues relaxed, but paralysis is not complete. Characteristic rush of blood to the head with a flushed face. Hemorrhages. Strong affinity for the breasts. Cracked nipples (Petr., Sars.). Blocked milk ducts, abscess of the breast. For cancer, particularly of the breast, where the cancer occurs on the site of a scar, where the cancer regrows in the scar of a lumpectomy. Also if there is a history of cracked nipples and abscessed breasts. Pain under left breast at menstrual period, often waking patient in the night. Scanty menses, with headache, skin-affection. Getting feet wet causes delayed menses. Hysterical melancholia with occipital headache. Profuse, gushing leucorrhea, excoriating. Cracks along the labia. Moist itching excoriation around anus and fissures. Very low sex drive (Sep.). Uncontrollable sexual excitement with violent erections. Priapism. Impotence. Clean tongue. Fishy taste in the morning, disappearing later in the day. Milk agrees, especially when hot. Roasted, but not boiled meat or potatoes. Diarrhea, thin offensive, partly digested stools. Constipation, stools coming in lumps coated with mucus and with mucus shreds. Anal fissures, can pass blood and painful stools. Weak, exhaustion of whole body. Spasms, contractions of muscles, twitching of eyelids. Cataleptic condition. Sensitiveness of internal parts, numbness in various parts, drawing pain in whole body. Bathing after measles causes paralysis of face. Attacks occur during summer and autumn. Suffering parts emaciated. General obesity with a thick, white, profuse irritating discharge. Suffocative spells which arouse the patient from sleep, he must jump out of bed, worse after midnight (Lach., worse after sleep). General condition is not sensitive (opposite of Hep.). Abnormally acute senses, cannot tolerate the smell of flowers. Music causes weeping. Sadness. Ears feel stuffed during the full moon. Hardness of hearing is better when riding in a carriage. Easy to over-lift. Teste classed Graph, in the Puls, group with Sil., Calc., Hep. and Phos. It affects the nutrition in a peculiar way, it is a remedy for those persons who have a tendency to put on unhealthy fat or for those who begin to emaciate. Graph, is an anti-psoric. Typically “fat, chilly and costive. ” Especially active in patients who are rather stout, of fair complexion with a tendency to skin disorders and constipation, with a delayed menstrual history. Hufeland related the cure of a lady, 41, by the internal and external use of Graph, of an acne rosacea which had defied all other modes of treatment. Kent and Grimmer noted cases of late stage breast cancer that they treated with high potencies. Graph, caused the tumors, and in one case the entire breast, to slough off and heal. Nash recorded a case of a child who was relieved of an eczema capitis under old- school treatment, whereupon entero-colitis set in and became so alarming that it was pronounced “tuberculosis of the bowels.” Nash found the child greatly emaciated with little or no appetite, very restless, passing “stools of brown fluid mixed with undigested substances and of an intolerably fetid odor.” Graph. 6,000c cured promptly. Goullon cured two notable cases of cramps in the stomach with “improvement of the cramps by eating.” Clarke cured two very severe cases of nosebleed in elderly people. In one case, there had been flushing of head and neck for many months previous to the attack, and flushing preceded and accompanied each occurrence of the bleeding. In the other case, the patient said the precursory flush seemed to come up from his toes. He had his nostrils plugged without avail. Graph, in a high potency, cured promptly in both instances. When giving Graph, internally in cases of anal eruption, the external use of an ointment made with a drachm of the 3x trituration to an ounce of Cetacean ointment is of great service. Hirsh or Prague used Graph, locally in cases of disease of the nails with very good results. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Aeon., Ars. Nux- v. Antidote to: Ars-i., Rhus-t. Compare: (1) Petr., Lach., Carb- v., Carb-a., Caust., Nit-ac., Rhus-t. - erysipelas, left then right, Graph., right then left. Ant-c., Rat., Peon, Nit- ac., Sil. (2) In priapism. - Pic-ac. (3) In disorders of right ovary, Pall. (4) Aur, Puls., Lyc. Stram., Alum. (5) hears better in cars - Nit-ac. (6) Obesity, Calc-a. Trichiasis, Borax. Fat constitutions, Calc. (7) Sulph. has margins of lids reddened with Graph, they are paler then usual, Euphr. has thick, purulent discharge, Graph, has thin. (8) Graph, is achronic or overgrown Puls. - but Puls, has Worse and Graph, has better from milk. (9) The associated constipation with mucus-covered stools and gastric flatulency should be taken into consideration and differentiate it from such remedies as Petr, and Lyc. Complementary: Arg-n. - follows well in gastric derangements, Caust., Hep., Lyc., Ars., Tub. It follows: Calc., Calc-f., Lyc., Puls., Sep., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Gastralgia with burning pains radiating through abdomen. Sour or foul belchings. Frequent eructations, tasting of ingesta. Eructation of sour green water. Eructations while walking. Pressure in stomach. Constrictive pain in stomach. Recurrent stomach pain with vomiting of food immediately after eating, stom- ach worse by cold. Burning in stomach, causing hunger, better from eating or hot drinks especially milk, lying down. Periodical gastralgia, with vomiting of food immediately after eating. Morning sickness during menses. Nausea like faintness, prevents sleep. Nausea with spasm in throat. Nausea during headache. Nausea with sour vomiting. Vomiting of sour of food. Vomiting and purging and icy cold sweat with headache. Cancer of pylorus.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended, as from incarcerated flatus. Cannot bear tight clothes around the waist. Flatulence. Very fetid gas preceded by colic. Pain of gas opposite the side on which he lies. Intestinal torpor. Pain as if intestines were torn. Nauseous feeling in abdomen. Cramp like pain in abdomen with deficient secretion of urine, at night. Inguinal region sensitive, swollen.

Rectum - Fissures of anus, cutting pain during stool, followed by constriction and aching for hours. Fissures bleed and ulcerate. Constipation, large, difficult, knotty stools united by mucus threads. Chronic diarrhea, brownish, liquid, undigested offensive. Stools, large, difficult, slimy coated or loose, brown, lienteric and very foul. Lump of stool, conjoined with threads of mucus, masses of mucus. Stools are slender, pasty. Diarrhea from slightest indiscretion in eating. Burning hemorrhoids, pain on sitting down or on taking a wide step. Anus and pudenda, smarting, itching, sore, on wiping anus, before menses. Prolapse of rectum. Varicose veins of the rectum. Tapeworms. Sensations - As if skin of forehead was drawn into folds. As if a skin were before ear. As if a hard body as large as an egg were behind ear. As of a cobweb over the face. As of a lump in stomach with beating as of two hammers. As if intestines were torn, croaking as of a frog in abdomen. As if everything would be torn to pieces during menstruation.

Male - Herpetic eruption on organs. Hydrocele. Sexual debility with increased desire. Priapism. Ejaculation too early or failing during sex. Cramps in calves during sex. Averse to sex, lack of sexual enjoyment. Impotence from excessive indulgence or masturbation.

Female - Menses, too late. Menses scanty, pale, irregular, painful. Sighing during menses. Hoarseness, coryza, cough, morning sickness, sweats, swelling of feet or headache during menses. Leucorrhea, pale, thin, profuse, white, excoriating in gushes with weakness in back. Leucorrhea worse before and after menses. Leucorrhea in place of menses. Acrid, excoriating leucorrhea in gushes day or night, before and after menses. Swelling and hardness of ovary (left) worse after menses. Induration of ovaries, uterus and breasts. Pain in the uterus when reaching high with arms. Retro-version of uterus, heaviness in hypogastrium with cutting pain down thighs. Uterus feels as if coming out through vagina. Vagina, dry, hot or cold. Eczematous eruptions around the vulva. Great aversion to sex. Food - Excessive hunger or no appetite, worse when hungry. A version to meat, fish. Aversion to cooked food, salt. Aversion to soup. Sweets nauseate. Better warm milk, worse cold drinks. Desires chicken, beer, sweets. Worse sweets. Worse boiled meat. Hot drinks disagree.

Chest - Constriction of chest, as if too narrow. Feels as if about to suffocate when falling asleep, jumps out of bed, takes hold of something and must eat something, worse after midnight. Cramps in the chest. Pain in middle of chest with cough, scraping and soreness. Constitutions - Suited to persons who have a tendency to put on unhealthy fat. Fat, relaxed, chilly and costive. Defective animal heat from defective oxygenation, always cold indoors or out. Chlorotics. Affections of glands, skin and mucus membranes, especially at orifices. Syphilitic and “constitutional” ulcers. Coughs - Dry cough, troublesome with sweat on face. Cough at night, caused by deep inspiration. Loose cough from tickling deep in chest. Cough with strangling, red face, watery eyes, straining all over. Fatiguing cough, before and during menses.

Heart - As if an electric shock from heart to neck. Strong pulsations in the whole body. Palpitations of heart with anxiety with nosebleeds. Palpitations from least exertion. Cold feeling in precordium. Pulse slows during day, fast in the morning

Back - Spinal pains. Pain in small of back with great weakness. Pain in the nape of neck and shoulders, worse looking up and stooping the head. Sacral pains with crawling. Painless swollen glands on side of neck. Numbness of sacrum, down the legs. Pain in the lumbar region as if vertebrae were broken. Breasts - Induration of breasts and ovaries. Breasts swollen and hard. Cracks in nipples. Breast cancer from old scars, remaining after mammary abscess. Nipples, sore, cracked and blistered. Causations - Ill effects of grief, fear, over lifting, surgery.

Limbs - Edema of legs. Paralyzed feeling in the limbs. Cannot stretch enough. Burnings, cramps, jerking. Arms and legs go to sleep. Excoriation of thighs while walking. Bunions worse fire heat, better pressure. Burning in soles and heels. Feet cold, wet. Acrid, foot sweat, chafes the toes. Stiffness and contraction of toes. Foul excoriating sweat, worse evening. Burning pressure beneath the armpit. Hands or feet either hot or cold. Pain in thumb joint as if sprained. Nails, brittle and crumbling. Nails deformed, Graphites naturalis painful, sore, thick and crippled. Nails, thick, rough ingrown. Horny callosities on hands with cracks. Cracks and fissures in fingertips. Swelling of feet. Lungs - Spasmodic asthma, suffocative attacks wake from sleep, must eat something. Dry, troublesome cough with sweat on face. Lachrymation, worse taking deep breath.

Sleep - Excessively tired and sleepy. Sleepy during day. Sleeplessness until midnight. Constant talking during sleep. Nightly pains felt in sleep. Amazingly weary and sleepy. Does not feel fresh in the morning. Amorous dreams with emissions. Horrible Graphites naturalis dreams. Dreams about fatal accidents.

Skin - Dry, rough skin, irritable. Skin breaks easily and exudes a gluey honey like moisture, worse in folds and slow to heal. Unhealthy skin, every little injury suppurates. Eruptions worse from heat. Eczema. Pimples and acne. Wandering or recurrent erysipelas. Moist, crusty eruptions, oozing out a sticky exudation. Phlegmonous erysipelas of face, burning and stinging pain. Rawness in bends of limbs, groins, neck, behind ears. Cracks in nipples, mouth, between toes, anus. Old scars ulcerate. Burning pain in old scars. Old scars with indurated base and margins with burning. Wens. Chronic poison oak. Psoriasis. Gouty nodosities. Swelling and induration of the glands. Ulcers discharging a glutinous fluid, thin and sticky.

Modalities - Better in the dark. Better from wrapping up. Better after walking. Better in open air. Better hot drinks, especially milk. Better eating. Better belchings. Better touch. Worse from cold. Worse drafts. Worse warmth of bed. Worse night. Worse wet feet. Worse light. Worse motion. Worse scratching. Worse suppression of eruptions or secretions. Worse during and after menses. Worse empty swallowing. Worse fats. Worse hot drinks.

Kidneys - Burning between acts of urinating. Biting pain in urethra after urination. Stricture of urethra. Pain in sacrum or coccyx while urinating. Nocturnal bedwetting. Frequent urination at night. Dark brown urine. Urine, sour smelling, turbid, stream slender. Urine turbid, with white sediment. Sour smelling urine.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat at night. Profuse sweat during menses. Sweats often on front of body only. Offensive, sour sweat, stains yellow. Cold sweat. Entire inability to sweat. Sweats from slightest motion.

Temperature - Chill in the evening worse eating better open air and drinking water. Chill with coldness of whole body. Chill in morning in bed. Chill during menses. Wants covers in all stages of fever. Recurrent periodical fever. Fever with restlessness, unable to sleep, or remain in bed on account of it. Flushes of heat. Dry heat every evening and night. Burning heat in hands and soles and feet. Heat when riding in a carriage.

PHARMACY - grat. Gratiola officinalis. Hedge hyssop. Herb of Grace. N. O. Scrophulariacae. Grows in moist places. Tincture of fresh plant before flowering. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Brain disorders. Cholera. Coccyx, pain. Colic. Constipation. Cramps, Diarrhea. Dropsy. Eye disorders. Gout. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Hydrocephalus. Hysteria. Mania. Masturbation. Mesenteric glands. Nausea. Neuralgias. Nymphomania. Palpitations. Rheumatic pain. Stomach pains. Tetanus. Vision, disordered.

HERBAL - Gratiola, “the Herbof Grace,” is one of the most important members of the great Scrophularian group, which includes Dig., Euphr., Tab., Scroph.. and should be carefully studied with these. Cooper used it with great success in a case of gouty acidity with great constipation and in the constipation of cancer. He regards it as “the vegetable antacid.” It is said to have formed the basis for a once famous nostrum for gout, “Eau Médicinale.”

HOMEOPATHIC - Symptoms of a fully developed, rapid attack of Asiatic cholera are produced. A large proportion of the effects of Gratiola are expended on the gastro-intestinal tract. It is an inodorous plant of bitter taste and very poisonous, causing violent colic, bloody stools, enteritis, jaundice. Affection of the solar plexus. Constant sinking but cannot eat, bitter taste. Cramps beginning at pit of stomach; pains radiating from stomach. Urine is diminished, reddish, turbid. Diarrhea, yellowish, gushing, watery, as though rushing from a hydrant. Vomiting of yellowish fluid. Summer diarrhea from excessive drinking of water whether cold or hot. Soreness, burning or irritation of anus follows the stools. Teste considered Grat, the Cham, of chronic diseases. Teste saw four cases of nymphomania in females to whom herb doctors had given injections of a decoction of freshly gathered Gratiola. Burnett considered it specific in female masturbation and nymphomania. Especially useful in females, Nux-v.-like symptoms in females. Chronic catarrhal conditions, leucorrhea and gonorrhea. Obstinate ulcers. Trembling in limbs, convulsions, cramps, excitement and disordered condition of the sexual powers. Paralytic pains and feeling of coldness especially in the abdomen. Cerebral disorders without fever. Nervous prostration. Neuralgia due to abuse of coffee. MIND- Anxiety, gnawing, empty feeling, rolling about in epigastric region. Peevishness. Confusion when lying down. Ill humor, tired of life. Mental troubles from overweening pride. Answers, reflects long. Taciturn. Great depression and disinclination to do anything. Weak will. Lack of perseverance. Ill-humor. Irresolution. Violent anger from contradiction. Delirium tremens. Hysterical. Loquacity and gaiety. Delusion being diminished, smaller. Absorbed in reveries. Nymphomania. Apprehensive about the future. Fear of eating when hungry. Hypochondriasis and hysteria arising from abdominal troubles. Abdomen - Shooting pains in the abdomen. Inflation of the abdomen. Rumbling with nausea, eructation and vertigo. Flatulent and pressive colic with nausea and disagreeable risings. Feeling of coldness in abdomen, lasting half an hour.

Head - Rush of blood with vanishing of sight. Sick headache. Tightness in forehead with wrinkles in skin. Sensation as if brain was contracting and head became smaller.

Eyes - Eyes feel dry as if sand were in them. Dry, burning eyes. Itching about eyelashes.

Ears - Itching of ears.

Nose - Frequent sneezing. Stoppage of the nose. Smarting, itching in left nostril. Pressure at upper part of nose.

Face - Burning heat and redness of the face. Sensation of tension in the face, it feels swollen. Swelling of upper lip. Tearing on one side of face. Painful crack in left side of chin. Tingling, burning in malar bones.

Mouth - Accumulation of much saliva in the mouth. Mouth bitter or clammy. Fetid breath in the morning after waking. Tongue rough, covered with mucus. Sensation of cold in the teeth. Nocturnal tearing or piercing in the molars.

Throat - Pressure in throat, as from thick mucus. Accumulation of mucus in throat. Phlegm in throat with inability to throw it off. Pain in throat obliging one to swallow constantly. Stinging in throat. Tingling, roughness and scraping in throat. Vertigo - Vertigo during and after meals, hunger and feeling of emptiness after meals. Vision - Myopia. Shortsightedness with burning heat in face. All objects seem white, even green trees. Mist before eyes when reading or writing. Sudden vanishing of sight while writing or looking at light objects, better closing eyes, but constantly returns. COMMENTS - Two excellent cures with Grat, have been recorded by C. W. Sonnenschmidt. The first case, Mrs. C., 53, was attacked in June with diarrhea, yellow, watery, frothy stools gushing out with force. Severe cutting pains in abdomen, rumbling of flatulence. Occasional nausea and vomiting. Coloc. and Ip. failed to relieve. Then on close inquiry it was elicited that “a cold feeling in the abdomen” had been a feature throughout. Grat. off. 3c, cured promptly. In the second case, a three-weeks' old infant was attacked with diarrhea and colic. There were two or three stools in quick succession and then an interval of an hour or two. Stools, green or yellow watery, frothy, expelled suddenly. Nausea and vomiting. Severe pain before stools, relieved afterwards, for a short time. Cham., Coloc., and Verat. failed, then Grat, rapidly cured. It also removed “redness around anus and on the side an abrasion of half an inch in extent, which caused some oozing of blood.” E. E. Case cured a woman, age 50, of hemorrhoids with Constipation, difficult stools. External hemorrhoids from any exertion and after stool. Biting, stinging tension in tumors. During stool, a sensation as if the rectal membrane was torn. After stool, all the nerve of the pelvis seem in a high state of tension, the flesh on the perineum feels as if torn from the bone. Sleepless before midnight, peevish, melancholy. Grat. 200c cured. The left side is more affected than the right. The head and eye symptoms are of the first importance. Rush of blood to head with vanishing of sight is a keynote. Heat ascending to face with redness and increased external warmth. A number of pains are experienced in the coccyx. Chilly, shuddering on entering a warm room. Constant vaporous emanations from body. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Caust., Bell., Euph., Nux-v. It antidotes: lod. Compare: (1) Dig., Euph., Tab., Cham., Am-c., Nux- v. Apis, Bell., Hell., Cham., Nux-v., Elat., Podo. (2) Hunger after meals with feeling of emptiness, Lauro., Calc., Case., Chin., Cina, (3) Emptiness after stool, Petr. (4) Vanishing of sight and headache, Gels. (5) Dig., Tab., Euphr., Scroph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Dyspepsia with much distention of the stomach. Emptiness after eating. Cramps and colic after supper and during night with swelling of abdomen and constipation. Dysphagia for liquids. As of a cold water or loose, heavy load in stomach.

Rectum - Diarrhea, green, frothy water, followed by anal burning. Diarrhea, forcibly evacuated without pain. Summer diarrhea from drinking of excess of water. Rectum constricted. Constipation with gouty acidity. Hemorrhoids with hypochondriasis. Sensations - As if brain contracted, as if head grew smaller, as if brain would fall forward. As if sand in eyes, as if throat contracted. As if a stone rolling from side to side in stomach.

Male - Painful rigidity of the penis after seminal emission, nightly. Stitches in left spermatic cord, ascending though the abdomen up to the chest. Drawing pain in glans.

Female - Menses too profuse, premature and too long. Persistent leucorrhea. Tendency to masturbation. Nymphomania. Irritable condition of sexual organs with congestions. Food - Hunger after a meal with feeling of emptiness. Craves nothing but bread. Worse during and after eating, vertigo during and after a meal.

Chest - Heat in the chest, then the head and hands with redness of the face. Pressure on the chest. Shootings in the chest on breathing. Pimples on the chest, which burn after having been scratched.

Heart - Palpitations after stools, with oppression of the chest. Pulse small, intermittent.

Back - Pain in coccyx after stool. Neck as if seized by hands. Breasts - Darting pain in breasts. Shootings in right breast, worse on rising during menses. Causations - Coffee causes neuralgia.

Limbs - Limb gives way with sciatic pain. Rheumatic pains in the shoulders, arms, fingers, particularly in elbow and wrist joint. Itching in the palm of the hand. Lungs - Dry cough, excited by a sensation of roughness in the chest in the morning or at night. Nocturnal cough with pain as from excoriation in trachea, oppression of the chest and shivering.

Sleep - Insomnia. Irresistible drowsiness with yawning and involuntary closure of eyes. Great sleepiness and lassitude after meals. Deep sleep, like stupor.

Skin - Itching with burning after scratching. Running and corrosive eruptions, which resemble scabies. Small boils. Miliary pimples with yellow tips.

Modalities - Better from open air. Better rest. Worse from eating. Worse drinking too much water. Worse hot or cold. Worse abuse of coffee. Worse dinner. Worse warm room. Worse summer. Worse motion.

Kidneys - Burning in the urethra during and after urination. Diminished secretion of urine. Scanty and reddish urine, which becomes turbid on standing with cloudy sediment.

Perspiration - Constant vaporous exhalation from body.

Temperature - Tendency to chilliness. Chilliness in a warm room during sleep, after an evacuation, with the hair standing on end. Heat ascending to the face with redness and increased external warmth.

full:
PHARMACY - grin. Grindelia robusta. Rosinwood. Grindelia squarrosa. N. O. Composite. A tincture is made of the leaves and unexpanded flowers. Bundy’s proving of G. squarrosa was made with a tincture of the dried plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies. Tincture in 1 to 15 drop doses.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Bites. Blisters. Bronchitis. Burns. Cheyne-Stokes. Conjunctivitis. Emphysema. Erythema. Eyes, pains. Flea- bites. Glaucoma. Heart, disorders. Herpes, zoster. Hyperchlorhydria. Iritis. Itching. Liver, pain. Lung, disorders. Malaria. Nausea. Ophthalmia. Pruritus, vulvae. Pruritus, vagina. Rash. Rheumatism. Rhus poisoning. Roseola. Skin, disorders. Spleen, disorders. Stings. Ulcers.

HERBAL - The Grindelia are a genus of asteroid composites growing on the Pacific coast and inland on the mountains. The terminal heads of yellow flowers and the leaves are usually covered with a viscid balsamic secretion, after which they have been called “gum plants. ” There is practically no difference in the action between Grindelia robusta and Grindelia squarrosa, although G. squarrosa is credited with more spleen symptoms. Following Hering, Grindelia robusta Clarke did not think it necessary to separate the two Grindelias. Several species have been used in cased of asthma, bronchitis, rhus poisoning, and heart and skin disorders.

HOMEOPATHIC - Grindeliaproduces paresis of the pneumo-gastric nerve, interfering with respiration and producing profuse secretion in bronchial tubes. Dull pains and fullness in left hypochondrium, chronic malaria, gastric pains associated with spleen congestion. Induces paralysis, beginning in the limbs. Its action is shown on the heart, first quickening, then retarding it. Raises the blood pressure. Acts on the cardio-pulmonary distribution of the pneumo gastric in dry catarrh (Ant- t. in muco-purulent). Smothering after falling asleep or on awakening. Asthmatic conditions, chronic bronchitis. Bronchorrhea with tough, tenacious, whitish mucus. Asthma and emphysema with dilated heart. Rattling breathing. Cannot breathe when lying down. Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Hyperchlorhydria when attended with asthmatic and other neurotic symptoms. Hyperemia of gastric mucus membrane with difficult respiration. Nausea and retching of gastric ulcer. Sugar in urine. Cutting sore pain in the region of spleen extending to hips. Spleen enlarged. An effective antidote to Rhus-poisoning, locally and internally, also for burns, blisters, vaginal catarrh and herpes zoster. MIND - Longing for sunshine, light and company.

Head - Terrible fullness in head, as though he had taken ten or more grains of quinine.

Eyes - Conjunctiva injected. Pupils dilated. Pain in eyeballs, running back to brain, worse moving eyes. Purulent ophthalmia and iritis. Iritis, traumatic, or arising from cold or a metastasis of rheumatism. Pain in left eye and right knee joint like rheumatism.

Face - Face livid. Burning in chin.

Abdomen - Unbearable pain in region of liver and spleen, so severe he cannot lie still a moment. Cutting pain in region of spleen, extending to hips. Spleen enlarged (Cean.. Card-m.). Soreness like that of acute rheumatism.

Female - Pruritus of vagina and vulva, whether from leucorrhea, aphthae or of venous origin.

Heart - Weak heart and respiration.

Limbs - Legs greatly swollen, especially about ankle-joint. Severe pain, can hardly getabout. Large ulcers over tibia. Chronic ulceration of leg. Lungs - Acts on the pulmonary circulation. Wheezing and oppression in bronchitis patients. Bronchitis with heart disease. Asthma with a profuse tenacious expectoration, which relieves. Stops breathing when fallingasleep, wakes with a start and gasps for breath. Must sit up to breathe, cannot breathe when lying down. Whooping cough with profuse mucus secretion (Coc-c.). Rales are disseminated with foamy mucus, very difficult to detach. Sibilant rales. Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Bronchorrhea with tough, whitish, mucus expectoration. Tough, muco-purulent expectoration, after pneumonia or in chronic bronchitis.

Skin - Bites of insects, fleabites. Itching and burning. Rash-like roseola with severe burning and itching. Vesicular and papular eruptions. Poison oak (locally as a wash). Herpes zoster. Ulcers with swollen, purplish skin. COMMENTS - In the clinical experiences recorded, it is Grindelia robusta that is chiefly mentioned, though sometimes it is not specified. History of results for asthma and emphysema with a dilated heart. Good in tonic for asthma, particularly in cases with a great deal of previous medication (Lob.). Chronic bronchial asthma and spasmodic bronchial cough, with profuse, tenacious expectoration. which gives relief. Cheyne-Stokes respiration. The breath stops when the patient goes to sleep and awakes with a start, gasping for breath. Irregular heart action and hay fever when associated with difficult breathing. Sense of suffocation on falling asleep (Lach.). Symptoms are worse by movement, worse in the dark, worse on falling asleep. It removed aversion to darkness in one patient who wanted a light in the room all night. One writer obtained excellentresults from “Grindelia” in a number of cases of asthma and emphysema with dilated heart. H. W. Foster reported the cure of a case of asthma with G. robusta that shows that Dr. Bundy's proving of G. squarrosa is good for both remedies. Dr. Foster's patient was awakened by asthmatic attacks, the room seeming too small. After getting quiet, just as he would commence to lose himself in sleep he would suddenly awaken again because he seemed to have forgotten to breathe. Grin. 30c relieved at once. Gatchell recommended an external application of a lotion, one part Grindelia robusta in ten parts water, for itching and painful erythematous eruptions. It is also useful for bites and stings of insects. Used locally and internally as an antidote for Rhus toxicodendron skin rashes. The only proving is by Dr. T. H. Bundy, who took a teaspoonful of a tincture of the dried plant of G. squarrosa and in half an hour followed it by another. The result was that he produced some intensely severe pains in head and eyes (left, then right), and symptoms in liver, spleen, nervous system and lungs. Altogether, he passed “the most terrible night of his life.” The proving is remarkable for the number of peculiar symptoms induced. First there was “fullness in head as after a heavy dose of quinine.” Then, intense pain in the left eye and right knee joint exactly like acute rheumatism. The knee pain lasted only half an hour, and then the third teaspoonful was taken. The eye pain became agonizing, the pupil became widely dilated. It was two hours before the right eye became affected. At this time, unbearable pain in whole of liver and spleen came on. It was so severe it was impossible to lie still. There was intense soreness of the region, like that of acute rheumatism. The eye pains were in the eyeballs running directly back into the brain, worse by movement. There was a kind of paralysis of the vagus nerve. On falling asleep, the respiratory movement would cease and would not be resumed until he woke up from the resulting suffocation. RELATIONS -Itantidotes: Rhus-t. Compare: (1) Tart-emet. Erio., Lach., Sang. (2) Am-m., Ant-t., Kali-bi. (3) Lach. - worse from sleep, left then right. (4) Gels. - worse from sleep. Gels, has waking up feeling the heart has stopped, must keep moving to keep it going. Grind, feels respiration has stopped. (5) Stram. - fear of the dark. (6) Op., Lach., Carb-an. - fears to go to sleep. (2) Dyspnea on falling asleep: Am-c., Ant-t., Arum-t., Bad., Bry., Cadm-s„ Carb-an., Carb-v„ Graph., Lach., Nux-m., Op. (8) Ran-b. and both the Grindelias. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Modalities - Sitting position in bed on account of difficult breathing. Worse from falling asleep. Worse motion. Worse in the dark.

HERBAL - Mikania guaco is a climbing composite of tropical America. Guaco has a local repute as a remedy for the bites of serpents, hydrophobia, cholera and cancer.

HOMEOPATHIC - Gua. acts on the nervous system and female organs. Bulbar paralysis. Spinal irritation. Syphilis. Cancer. Cholera. Diarrhea and dysentery with aching in sacrum and loins. Deafness. Tongue heavy and difficult to move. Beer drinkers threatened with strokes.

Head - Headache, red face. Heaviness and difficulty in moving tongue.

Ears - Deafness.

Mouth - Tongue heavy, difficult to move.

Throat - Larynx and trachea constricted, difficult deglutition. COMMENTS - In the homeopathic provings, rice-water stools occurred along with difficult swallowing, as in hydrophobia. One proving also showed an action on the bladder and urinary organs, producing excess phosphates. A woman who took a decoction for four moths steadily was obliged to discontinue because it produced copious, corrosive, putrid leucorrhea, causing great debility, tanning the inside of the thighs and staining linen yellow. She felt as if fire was running out of her. Terrible itching and smarting. Another prover had severe spinal and occipital pains, paresis of tongue and difficult deglutition. Burning and tearing in soles. Pain as if beaten. Pains extend to other parts, mostly from above downwards. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Kreos. andSulph. (leucorrhea). Compare: (1) Ox-ac., Lathyr., Caust. Alum. (2) Bell. - menstrual flow feels hot. (3) Ph-ac. - Phosphaturia. (4) Leucorrhea staining yellow, Carb-an., Kreos., Nit-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Pain and rumbling in bowels, followed by watery stools.

Female - Copious, corroding, putrid, debilitating leucorrhea. Itching and smarting at night, as if fire were running out of parts.

Back - Pain between scapulae, extending to forearm. Burning in nape of shoulders. Pain along spine, worse from bending. Guaco Weariness through hips and lumbar region. Causations - Antidote to bites of scorpions and snakes (Golondrina).

Limbs - Pain in deltoid, shoulders, elbows, arms and fingers. Paralysis of lower limbs. Legs heavy. Pain about hip joint. Pain in ankle-joints and soles.

Modalities - Worse from motion. Worse bending. Worse at night.

Kidneys - Unusual flow of urine with excess phosphates. Pain over region of bladder and weight and weariness through hips and loins.

PHARMACY - guai. Guaiacum officinale. Lignum vite resin. Lignum sanctum resin. Gum guaiacum. N. O. Zygophyllaceae. The gum resin of a large tree growing in West Indies. Tincture of the gum resin. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

Gout. Growing, pains. Headache. Hernia. Membranous, dysmenorrhea. Mercury, effects. Neuralgia. Osteomalacia. Otitis. Ovaries inflammation. Pleurisy. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Stomach disorders. Syphilis. Throat, disorders. Tonsillitis. Toothaches. Torticollis. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Guai., which is one of Hahnemann's anti-psorics, is best known as a remedy in govt and rheumatism and as a diuretic, but it has also taken a place in old-school therapeutics as a remedy for tuberculosis. Guai. was first recommended by Brinton in the Lancet in 1857 for quinsy, was given in full doses and produced a crisis of sweat and profuse urination. Homeopathic provings developed and defined the sphere of its utility in these respects and many more. It acts on mucus membranes, muscles, fibrous tissue, joints and bones. Arthritic diathesis. Acute rheumatism. Gouty nodosities on joints. Nodes. Exostosis. Growing pains. Tonsillitis with rheumatism. Secondary syphilis. Contraction of limbs, stiffness and immobility. Muscles and tendons are contracted, resulting in pain, rigidity and swelling of the joints, and deformity. Muscles and tendons seem too short or feel sore. Contractions between scapulae, palms etc., causing distortions and immobility. Unclean odor from whole body. Promotes suppuration of abscesses. Free foul, secretions, expectoration, sweat, etc. Bones become spongy or suppurate. Burning heat in affected part. Sensitiveness and aggravation from local heat. Gnawing or sticking pains in chest. Pains often end in stitch, especially head. Contractive pain between scapula. Violent pains in limbs after a cold. Feeling that he must yawn, stretch with uneasy feeling in the whole body. Violent, spasmodic inflammatory disorders of windpipe and larynx with palpitation, preventing motion or calling for help, feels suffocating. Cough dry or with copious bloody or purulent expectoration of very offensive odor. Heat, swelling and blotchiness of face. Prosopalgia every day from 6 p.m. to 4 a.m. Toothache when biting jaws together. Progressive emaciation. Desire for apples, which helps the gastric symptoms, and a general aversion to milk and food. “Violent hunger afternoon and evening,” similar to the “sinking” sensations of Sulph. and the anti- psorics. Nausea from sensation of phlegm in throat. Marked flatulence. “Every morning vomits a mass of watery phlegm with great exertion, followed by great exhaustion.” Morning diarrhea with dry skin and chilliness. Cholera infantum, the face is like that of an old person. Constipation, dry, hard, crumbling and very offensive stool. Continuous urging even after urination with profuse fetid urine. Stitches in neck of bladder after ineffectual pressure to urinate. Cutting while urinating. General ill feeling, better yawning and stretching, worse from the least motion. Clothes feel damp. Perspiration on head on walking in open air. Chilly crawls over breasts. Chilliness in back. Cannot bear heat with pains in limbs. Marked periodicity. Stomach illness returns every summer. MIND - Indolent, obstinate, fretful. Disinclina- tion to labor. Sadanddepressed. Weakmemory. Forgetful, thoughtless, staring. Forgetful of names. Slow to comprehend. Delusion everything seems narrow. Strong desire to criticize and despise everything. Inclination to blame everybody and scold. Defiant. Disobedience. Shrieking during sleep. Weeping after nightmare.

Head - Gouty and rheumatic pain in head and face, extending to neck. Tearing pain in skull, worse cold, wet weather. Pains often end in a stitch, especially in head. Head feels swollen and blood vessels distended. Brain feels loose. Headache better walking and pressure, worse sitting and standing.

Eyes - Exophthalmos. Pupils dilated. Eyeballs seem too big to be covered by the eyelids, or eyelids appear too short. Hard pimples around the eyes.

Ears - Aching in left ear.

Nose - Pains in bones of nose. Nose swollen. Fluent coryza.

Face - Neuralgia of the left side of the face, daily from 6 p.m. to 4 a.m. Face like an old person.

Mouth - Tongue furred.

Throat - Dry. burning, swollen. Sharp stitches towards the ear on swallowing, cannot swallow without a drink. Acute tonsillitis, painful to touch. Recurrent tonsillitis followed by rheumati sm. Syphilitic sore throat. Rheumatic sore throat with weak throat muscles. Vertigo - Vertigo on rising. COMMENTS - Affected parts are very sensitive to touch, worse from heat. Offensive secretions. Rheumatism in syphilitic and mercurial patients. Growing pains in children. Acute tonsillitis, simple or rheumatic. Syphilitic sore throat. “Burning in the throat.” Erythematous or inflammatory angina with bright redness (Bell.). Edema (Apis.). Phlegmon with tendency to suppuration of tonsils (Bar-c., Apis.). Burning sensations in mouth, throat and stomach. Stitches in chest going from front to back or from below upward in region of apex, worse from motion and deep inspiration. “Sharp pain about mid-day under right breast to shoulder.” Neuralgia of left side of head and face, extending to neck. Sharp stitches in brain. Sensation as if the brain were loose. External headache with sensation as if blood vessels were over-filled, extending to face and neck. Tearing pains in skull. Swelling and sensation of swelling in eyes and nose. Eyes feel protruded. Ozanam gave it in the 1c, 2c and 3c dilutions and found that he got the curative effects without crisis, which was an unnecessary effect of the drug. Guai., said Ozanam, seems to combine the properties of Bell., Apis and Bar-c. Houghton cured with Guai. 3x a case of gouty inflammation of the meatus of the ear and tympanum after failure with Ferr-p. Concomitant rheumatic lameness and soreness led him to Guai. Verwey treated a woman, who for several years had a frequently recurring gouty inflammation of the knees. After Chin. 30c had failed to relieve, Guai. 30c was given without obvious benefit. Guai. 1c was then given, and after a few hours the swelling broke and the pains quickly subsided. A short time after, the same patient accidentally injured the same knee. Under Guai. 1c the swelling soon broke and the pain was relieved, but an abscess formed at the same time on the upper thigh. The pain became unbearable and the patient's husband “begged for more of the drops that had twice before made the swelling break.” It was again given and in six hours the abscess evacuated. On two later occasions Dr. Verwey saw Guai. act in the same way on scrofulous and gouty abscesses. This is probably analogous to its action in quinsy. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Nwi-v. Antidote to: Caust., Rhus-t. Compare: (1 ) Merc., Caust., Rhus-t., Mez., Rhod. (2) Ph-ac. - growing pains. (3) Cimic. - pleurodynia and tuberculosis. (4) Bry. - chronic rheumatism when the joints are distorted, worse motion, pleurisy in second stage of tuberculosis. (5) Coloc. - contractions after rheumatism. (6) Caust. - Guai. is better than Caust., which it follows well, when either gout or rheumatism causes distortion of limbs. (7) Araceae - late tuberculosis, pleuritic pains left apex. (8) Kali-i., Phyt., Still. Compatible: After Merc. - Rheumatism, gout and syphilis, after Sulph. in cholera infantum, after Caust. in torticollis. Follows: Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Thick, white fur on tongue. Constricted epigastric region. Burning in stomach. Vomits a mass of watery mucus, then exhaustion. Stomach disorders return in summer.

Abdomen - Distention, flatulent. Intestinal fermentation. Sensation of constriction or stoppage in epigastrium, causing cough, dyspnea.

Rectum - Cholera infantum, face like an old person, emaciation. Diarrhea.

Male - Seminal emissions without dreams. Discharge from urethra.

Female - Ovaritis in the rheumatism, with irregular menstruation, dysmenorrhea and irritable bladder. Food - Aversion to milk, to all food, could not eat anything. Desire for apples and other fruits, which relieve gastric symptoms.

Chest - Pleuritic stitches. Chest pains in articulations of ribs, with shortness of breathing until expectoration sets in. Pain in the chest while riding in the open air, better pressure and walking, worse sitting and standing.

Back - Pain from head to neck. Aching in nape. Stiffneck and sore shoulders. Contractive pain between scapulae. Stitches between scapulae to occiput. One-sided stiffness of back from neck to sacrum. Breasts - Cold crawling over breasts. Shuddering in breasts with goose bumps.

Limbs - Growing pains (Calc-p.). Arthritis deformans. Arthritic lancinations fol- lov/ed by contraction of limbs. Sciatica and lumbago. Gouty tearing pains with contractions. Immovable stiffness. Joints swollen, painful and intolerant of pressure, can bearno heat. Stinging pain in the limbs. Feeling of heat in the affected limbs. Rheumatic pain in shoulders, arms and hands. Rheumaticpain in wrists. Pricking in buttocks, as if sitting on needles. Hamstrings too short. Ankle pain extending up the leg, causing lameness. Lungs - Feels suffocated. Recurrent pleurisy. Pleuritic stitches, worse deep breathing. Stitching in apex of (left) lung. Tuberculosis. Dry. tight cough. Fetid breath after coughing.

Sleep - Yawns and stretches for relief of general ill feeling. Frequent waking from sleep, as if from falling.

Modalities - Better external pressure. Better apples. Better yawning and stretching. Better from cold locally. Worsefrom heat. Worse cold, wet weather. Worse touch. Worse motion. Worse exertion. Worse rapid growth. Worse mercury. Worse puberty. Worse 6 p.m. to 4 a.m.

Kidneys - Continuous urging, even after urination. Sharp stitches during or after urination.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat on single parts, face, etc. Sweats at night. Much sweat, especially on head and face. Sweats on walking in open air. Sweat is usually offensive.

Temperature - Sweat profuse on single parts, face etc. Night sweats. Burning of body. Hot palms. Burning fever with hot face and dry cough. Fever with chill in the evening.

HERBAL - Guaraña is a climbing shrub of Brazil, the seeds of which contain caffeine and are used by the natives for making a stimulating beverage.

HOMEOPATHIC - Guar, is used in conditions of nervous exhaustion, sick headache in those who have abused tea and coffee. Headache followed by vomiting and excited by any error in diet or depression of mind. Throbbing, congestive headache after excessive use of liquor. Neuralgia. Persistent twitching of eyelids. Paralysis. Restlessness, nervousness, weariness. Reduced vital powers, with grief, depression of spirits, loss of appetite. Debility after prostrating diseases. Chlorosis. Diarrhea. MIND - Intellectual excitement, mental hyperesthesia. Extravagant behavior. Grief, depression of spirits.

Head - Sick headache from excess of tea or coffee. Throbbing, congestive headache after excessive use of alcohol.

Eyes - Persistent twitching of eyelids.

Rectum - Cholera infantum. Stools profuse, bloody, bright green, mucus, flakes intermixed, odorless. Diarrhea of tuberculosis.

Sleep - Uncontrollable sleepiness and heaviness of head, with flushed face after eating. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Agar. - Twitching of eyelids. (2) Ign., Nux-v. (3) in sick headache, Coff., Coca., Thea. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Skin - Chloasma on temples and arms. Urticaria (Dulc., Apis, Chlol.). Prurigo.

Bladder - Spasm of bladder. Causations - Ill effects of alcohol or coffee.

PHARMACY - guare. Guareatrichiloides. Ballwood. Redwood. N. O. Meliacee. Caribbean. Central America. Tincture and trituration of dried bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Bones disorders. Chemosis. Dysphagia. Eyes disorders. Hernia. Intermittent fever. Liver spots. Lupus. Pterygium. Ptosis. Strokes. Tongue disorders. Tonsils, swollen. Vertigo. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Petroz is the authority for this remedy, which produces a number of symptoms in the eyes. R. K. Ghosh cured a number of cases of chemosis and pterygium. He found a lotion of Guarea tincture of great assistance. Lupus of an ochre-red color. Eye symptoms alternate with diminished hearing. A number of symptoms were experienced in the umbilicus and inguinal rings. Flow of blood between menses. On the skin there were liver spots and an eruption with burning vesicles. Aromatic- smelling sweat. Sweat during or after eat ing. Suppuration of glands. Steatoma, hot swelling, swelling of affected parts. Sensation of constriction. Sudden shocks of whole body. Bruised pains. Pains in periosteum. In the head there is a sensation as if the brain were falling forward and a sensation as of a blow on the head leaving numbness and diminished thinking power. MIND - Anxiety during fever. Irresolution. Loquacity. Indifference. Fear of losing reason.

Head - Sensation as if brain were falling forwards, as from a blow on head.

Eyes - Conjunctiva inflamed, swollen. Tearing pain in eyeballs, tension, forced-out feeling. Objects appear gray, upside down. Eye symptoms alternate with diminished hearing.

Ears - Swelling of periosteum behind ears. Sensation in ears as of a peg of a worm, pushing-out feeling. Roaring in ears.

Nose - Coryza with hardened secretion with heat. Nose stuffed, ineffectual desire to sneeze, constriction at root of nose.

Face - Suppurating swellings on face. Swelling of upper lip.

Mouth - Mouth smells of cheese. Sweet taste, food tastes insipid.

Throat - Tonsils swollen. Esophagus has raw pain, sensation of contraction and burning heat. Swallowing difficult.

Stomach - Constriction in stomach, bruised. Sour belchings with tension and pressure at stomach. Inclination to vomit during fever. Vomiting, sour, green.

Abdomen - Hardness at umbilicus. Abdomen distended with lancination in groins and inguinal ring. Bruised pain externally.

Rectum - Constriction of anus and rectum. Urging to stool. Constipation.

Female - Fetid leucorrhea after menses. Flow of blood between menstrual periods. Itching of pudenda. Labor pains suppressed. Lochia is scanty. Food - Canine hunger in evening, speedy satiety. Aversion to milk, fish and hot, greasy, cooked food.

Chest - Sensation of hollowness and dilatation of chest.

Limbs - Jactitation of limbs. Cracking in joints. Nightly pains in bones. Bruised pain in bones. Caries. Lungs - Cough with sweat, pain and tightness of chest, larynx irritated. Cough dry barking, violent, deep- seated. Breathing, sobbing, difficult during chill. Respiratory symptoms worse from putting hand to throat.

Sleep - Sleepy in open air. Dreams, anxious, melancholy, full of strife.

Skin - Yellow spots on temples! Liver spots on arms. Eruptions behind ears. Herpes. Itching. Lupus of ochre- red color.

Modalities - Better hot drinks. Better wrapping warmly. Acids and cold water aggravates. Bone pains worse at night.

Tongue - Tongue coated during the fever, grayish yellow, swollen, paralyzed, bleeding. Tongue feels cold and dry. Lancinations in tongue. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bov. - flow of blood between menses. (2) Crot-h. - as if had a blow on the head. Anae. - peg in ear. Gels - vertigo, ptosis. Aza., Apis - chemosis, asthmamillari. Am. - injuries. Phos. - steatoma. Ign. - nerves. Merc, and Sil. - Bone-pains, suppuration. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Temperature - Coldness followed by heat with sweat. Heat of upper part of body, coldness of bones. Sweat chiefly during and after eating. Sweat aromatic.

full:
PHARMACY - guat. Guatteria guameria. Elemuy. Yumel. N.O. Anonaceae family. Central and Southern America. Tincture from the dried bark of the plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Anorexia. Belching. Jaundice. Gallbladder, disorders. Gallstones. Hematuria. Hepatitis. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Nausea. Palpitations. Pneumonia. Tachycardia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Described in 1790 by J. B. Guatteria and in 1906 by G. F. Gaumer. The symptomatology was established by Castro on seventeen adults of both sexes, using 3x and 6x, in 1944. There are grounds for thinking that Guat. will take one of the first places among the homeotherapeutic remedies for liver conditions, alongside Chlorpr. Guat. acts on the liver, gallbladder, kidneys and pancreas. Digestive complaints with liver and biliary manifestation. Predominantly on the right side, lungs, scapulae, shoulders, kidneys. MIND - Irresolute, weak memory. Sad. Obsessive ideas.

Head - Occipital pain, aggravated in a warm room and by lying down. Frontal pulsating headache.

Eyes - Conjunctival jaundice 'vith photophobia, myosis and itching, ameliorated by rubbing.

Mouth - Tongue dirty, yellow, furred, especially at the root. Bad breath, mouth tastes bitter. Excessive, thick salivation.

Stomach - Acrid dyspepsia. Bilious yellow and green vomiting, aggravated by hot food, movement. Burning in the esophagus and stomach, aggravated by condiments and sweets. Vertigo - Vertigo with headaches, heavy head. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Chel. - Same side and located on the right, stools golden yellow. (2) Chin. - Extreme abdominal distentions, aggravation from loss of fluids, diarrhea. (3) Lyc. - Melancholy, irritable, dyspepsia, hepatic disorders, aggravated ffom4 p.m. to 8 p.m. (4) Lac-c. - Perspiration stains the underwear yellow, symptoms move from right to left. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Epigastric pain, spreading towards the right hypochondrium, right kidney and the base of the right lung. Abdominal distention, ameliorated by belching. Constitutions - Allergic, psoric or sycotic constitutions.

Rectum - Diarrhea with cramping colic or constipation, followed by burning and tenesmus after stools passed. Stools bright green or bright yellow, hard or liquid, mucous, with a nauseating odor.

Female - Excoriating, white leucorrheal discharge. Food - Extreme thirst. Anorexia, nausea. Aggravated by hot foods, condiments and sweets.

Heart - Palpitationsand tachycardia, worse after eating.

Limbs - Pain and joint aching, especially of the fingers, knees and shoulders, predominantly on the right, with stiffness.

Skin - Skin dirty, especially on the face, discolored, pigmented with brown spots on the forehead and cheeks. Brownish stains on the arms and backs of the hands. Perspiration stains underwear yellow. Eruptions with itching, yellowness, aggravated by eating, ameliorated by prolonged rest. Vesicular tension disorders.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better food, if administered in small, repeated quantities. Worse in a warm room. Worse movement. Worse on right side. Worse after meals.

Liver - Congestion of the liver. Liver deficiency. Jaundice from hepatitis or gallstones. Gallstones. Inflammation of the gallbladder. Lungs - Lung infections on the right side, bronchitis. Viral pneumonia. Dry cough with blockage in the base of the right lung, linked with congestion of the liver, aggravated by lying on the right side. Painful cough, with palpitations and tachycardia, worse after eating.

Kidneys - Hematuria, urine thick with muddy deposits of calcium oxalate. Urinary density increased. Urinary urea diminished.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Acne. Bites. Blood, poisoning. Boils. Carbuncles. Cuts, poisoned. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Fistula. Food, poisoning. Foot-rot. Glands, disorders. Gonorrhea. Gunshot, wounds. Herpes. Herpes, zoster. Infections. Injuries. Ivy, poisoning. Leucoderma. Methane, poisoning. Ophthal mia. Osteomyelitis. Ptomaine, poisoning. Pyorrhea. Septicemia. Shingles. Syphilis. Tonsillitis. Toxicity. Ulcers. Vaccinosis. Worms. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Gunpowder was first published in the Homeopathic World, London in 1914 by Clarke. A combination remedy of carbon, sulphur and potassium nitrate. Useful for all kinds of blood poisoning, for septic wounds and ptomaine poisoning. Strong history of use in wartime, particularly useful in World War I and II. Gunshot wounds, surgical septicemia, boils. Methane poisoning. Wartime ailments. Blood disorders. Blood poisoning from pyorrhea alveolaris. Septic suppurations. Infected wounds. Wounds that refuse to heal. Abscessed bites, infections and wounds, antiseptic. Swollen and abscessed glands. Osteomyelitis. Poisoning from bad food or water. Poisoning from meats that have been unsuccessfully tinned. Acute infections, boils, abscesses, carbuncles, and bites. Antidote to ivy and primula rash. Antidoting the ill effects of vaccinations. Preventative for various kinds of inoculations. Gonorrhea and syphilis. Shingles of the face and eyes. In some country districts a decoction of gunpowder is given to children for worms with much success.

Mouth - Sores, boils. Gum abscesses. Pyorrhea.

Male - Gonorrhea and syphilis.

Skin - Boils, abscesses, carbuncles and bites. Fistula. Infected wounds. Shingles. COMMENTS - Dr. Clarke referred to the old fashioned gunpowder that was in use before the era of high explosives and smokeless powder. Black gunpowder is a mixture and not a chemical compound. It contains three remedies, two of them polycrests. Gunpowder Nitre with sulphur and charcoal forms gunpowder. A teaspoonful of this in hot water was a favorite remedy for gonorrhea among soldiers when black powder was used. In the lower triturations, gunpowder has cured ascarides in adults. The London Police Force also knew it as a boil remedy. “Get six-penny worth of gunpowder from an oil store and take as much as would lie on a sixpence night and morning for four days and then leave it off for the same time and resume if necessary” is one such prescription. Canon Roland Upcher noted that Norfolk shepherds rubbed gunpowder onto the sheep's wounds made during sheep-shearing, and took it to cure or prevent ill effects from handling sheep who suffered from “foot-rot.” Upcher published cases of skin eruption mistaken for scabies, actually caused by handling ivy. Cured with Gunp. 3x. Clarke experimented with Gunp. 2x and developed severe herpes facialis involving the right eyebrow and the right side of the nose. Clarke confirmed the proving by curing shingles. He heard of a case of lumbrici cured with an infusion of Gunpowder by the patient. A woman, who had a very sensitive skin, was bitten by a gnat on the foot, resulting in swelling inflammation and suppuration. There was a ring of inflammation around the bite, constantly spreading and detaching the epidermis as it spread. After the failure of several remedies, Gunpowder 3x rapidly cured. A man had a bad cut with a knife on the left index finger. The wound refused to heal. An inflammatory ring stripped off the epidermis and spread more and more. Lachesis and other remedies failed to make any impres- sion. Gunp. 3x rapidly cured. Another woman was very severely poisoned by sewer-gas. There followed swelling of the right arm and axillary glands of the right side. Three months after the accident the right arm was almost fixed at the elbowjoint with swelling. 11 threatened suppuration Gunpowder above and below. The axillary glands were as large as a hen's egg. Gunp. 3x gradually resolved the trouble and, though the cure was interrupted by an attack of measles, the motility of the arm was fully restored. Canon Upcher found that occasional doses of Hep. highly increase its effects. RELATIONS - Calen, externally is also complementary. Compare: Thuja, Sil., Bar-c. - septic tonsils. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Blood - Blood disorders. Blood poisoning. Causations - Bites. Blood poisoning. Vaccinations. Wounds. Gonorrhea. Herpes zoster. Worms. Glands - Swollen and inflamed. Swollen axillary glands. Abscessed glands.

HOMEOPATHIC - The leaves have a bitter, astringent andslightly acid taste. Immediately after chewing them, the sense of taste for sugar and for bitters were lost, the effect lasting some hours. Sense of taste altered. Everything else could be tasted, for instance, the ginger in gingerbread, but not the sweet. Quinine tasted like chalk. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Gymn. causes numbness and blueness, especially of the tongue. Bluish-white coating of tongue. Sore throat, dark livid redness of fauces. “Erysipelatous swelling of face and head, hot face, it feels swollen is compelled to rub the eyes.” Hives. Headache, throbbing in forehead, temples and over eyes. Full, tight headache, with sensation as if the eyes were pushed forward. Burning in eyes. Full sensations and burning pains. Desire for heat and quiet. C. T. Bingham cured a man of headache following influenza “a constant severe pain in front part of head, especially under eyebrows and upper part of nose.” It lasted over two weeks, ne ver ceasing and at times intolerable. Bones of eye-sockets were sore to touch. Tongue was covered all over with bluish-white coat, did not enjoy food. Very weak. Gym. 2x cured. Epidemic fevers of typhoid character have been cured by it. MIND - Forgets everything. Slow grasp, cannot think, comprehend or study. Indifference to what happens around him.

Head - Tight feeling, as if bound.

Eyes - As if were pushed forward, wants to rub them. Pain under brows into the nose.

Face - Erysipelatous swelling. Crawling as of flies over the face.

Mouth - Great sensibility of teeth, especially to cold air. Toothache from slightest cold air or drink. Lungs - Tickling with dry, hard, racking cough. Tickling in throat in morning causing cough, increasing through day.

Throat - Sore throat, dark livid redness of fauces and tonsils. Smarting in larynx. Sticking pain. Mucus in throat and hawking.

Stomach - Hot, sour belchings. Burning spot in stomach.

Abdomen - Pain in left side as if spleen were swollen. Soreness and tenderness of abdomen. Stitches in bowels and umbilical region.

Stool - Constipation with ineffectual desire. Aching fullness in rectum after stool.

Male - Itching of gland and prepuce.

Chest - Pressure on chest and sternum.

Limbs - Violent pain in left forearm, in radius, as if bones were crushed and broken. Pulsation in left index finger, as if panaritium were forming.

Modalities - Better from rest. Better rubbing eyes. Better leaning against something. Worse from cold. Worse cold drinks. Worse drafts. Worse walking. Aversion to motion, easily fatigued.

Tongue - Bluish, white tongue. COMMENTS - Fever symptoms. Desire for heat, wants to be near the fire. Cold chills and pains in bowels. Perspiration in axillary regions and palms. Toothache from slightest cold air or drink. Violent pain in left forearm as if the bones were crushed. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lachn., Lach., Ail., Rhus-t. (2) Nux-v., Agar. Aeth., Bell., Cic., Hyos., Sol-n., Stram. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Bladder - Pressure on bladder. Frequent desire to urinate, urine passed in a small stream.

HOMEOPATHIC - Logwood is a well- known dye of commerce. The tincture was proved by Jouve in 1939 and some very distinctive symptoms were produced including general uneasiness with anxiety arising from the stomach, and colic. Weak digestion accompanies and complicates most other conditions. General sensitiveness. Painful sensibility of the limbs with lassitude. Constriction in many parts, culminating in the stomach and abdomen. Colic with chest symptoms like angina pectoris. Sensation as if a bar lay across chest. Chilliness predominates, but the symptoms are better in open air. MIND - Ill humor, sadness, melancholy. Inclination to repose, desire to weep. Difficulty when reflectingandexpressingone'sideas. Vexation. Anxiety at night. Anxiety arising from the stomach. Mistakes in speaking.

Head - Head feels constricted, heavy, hot, painful. Constriction in the forehead and in the occiput with burning heat in the head. Headache at night, as from indigestion, with swelling of the stomach and abdomen, anxiety, inclination to vomit, sour risings of food. Headache in the forehead with inclination to vomit on stooping. Pain in left forehead, spreading over face and affecting left teeth.

Eyes - Redness of the conjunctiva. Redness of the eyes with blue margins. Eyes downcast and surrounded by a livid circle. Heaviness in the eyes. Heaviness of the eyelids, compels them to close. Painful pressure on the eyes with sensation of constriction. Sensation as if sand were introduced into the eyes. Pupils contracted and sight confused. Mist before the eyes, on reading, the letters vanish. Amelioration of the symptoms when in open air.

Ears - Violent pain in right ear, extending to throat.

Face - Face pale, dejected and changed, discomposed. Pain in face.

Throat - Lower jaw with stinging in teeth and cheek. Throat feels contracted with burning pain during swallowing. Sore throat with difficult swallowing, inclination to swallow, salivation and smarting. Sensation of a-foreign substance in the throat with yawning and stretching. Vertigo - Vertigo, so as to occasion falling and dullness of ideas. COMMENTS - Sensation as if a bar lay transversely across from region of heart to right side with acute pain in left upper portion of chest. Haem. cured a case of herpes zoster with agonizing pain as if a bar lay across the chest, arresting the breathing. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph. Compare: ( 1 ) Cact. (2) in compressive pains, Cact., Lil-t., Coloc., Aur., Naja. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Painful digging from abdomen to throat, causing pain in region of heart with oppression. Painful swelling in the stomach with pressure at the epigastrium and risings of flatus. Colic, tympanitis. Borborygmi and diarrhea. Inclination to vomit, sour risings of food.

Abdomen - Tympanitic distention of the abdomen and rising of air. Tension and digging in the abdomen. Pain in the abdomen with yawning inclination to vomit and stretch. Borborygmi. Colic with painful sensibility of the abdomen to the touch, inflation. Colic and diarrhea in morning. After the colic, general cold with burning heat in the palms of he hands.

Rectum - Borborygmi. Colic and diarrhea in morning.

Female - Colic, as if the menses were going to appear with slimy, whitish discharge from the vagina. Weak feeling with painful bearing down sensation at menstrual period. Pain in hypogastrium, attended with slimy, whitish leucorrhea.

Chest - Sensation as if a bur lay transversely across chest from region of heart to right side with acute pain in left upper portion of chest. Constriction, extending from the chest to the epigastrium, with smarting and burning pain increased by the touch. Angina pectoris.

Heart - Con vulsi ve pain in heart region with oppression. Great soreness in the region of the heart with anguish, redoubled throbbing, small pulse, burning in the hands and shivering of the body. Palpitations of the heart with diminished perspiration of the feet.

Back - Pain and chilliness between the shoulders.

Sleep - Irresistible drowsiness. Frequent yawning.

Skin - Dry skin. Herpes zoster.

Modalities - Worse at night. Worse on stooping. Worse pressure. Worse touch.

Kidneys - Urine red, scanty and burning. Limbs - The limbs are painful and languid. Pain in left shoulder, as if inflamed. Suppression of the habitual sweat of the feet.

Temperature - Chilliness predominates, shuddering, goose flesh.

HOMEOPATHIC - Halcion is a drug used for short-term treatment of insomnia. It is a member of the benzodiazepine class of drugs, many of which are used as tranquilizers. It's homeopathic used can be surmised from the side effects of this medication. Coordination problems. Dizziness, drowsiness. Nervousness. Changes in sexual drive. Chest pain. Congestion. Cramping pains. Dreaming and sleep abnormalities. Tendency to fall, stumble. Chronic fatigue. Impaired urination. Morning “hangover” effects. Tiredness and weakness. MIND - Mental confusion. Perceptual problems. Loss of sense of reality. Disorientation. Anxiety and depression. Increased anxiety during the daytime. Inappropriate behavior. Irritability. Aggressiveness, agita- tion. Behavior problems. Restlessness. Memory impairment, memory loss. Traveler's amnesia has been reported by patients who took Halcion to induce sleep while traveling. Anterograde amnesia, forgetting events after an injury. Nervousness. Sense of well-being, excitement. Hallucinations and delusions. Coma.

Head - Headaches. Light-headedness.

Eyes - Visual disturbances. Yellowing of the whites of the eyes.

Ears - Ringing in the ears.

Mouth - Dry mouth. Burning tongue. Inflammation of the tongue and mouth. Slurred or difficult speech. Taste changes.

Stomach - Nausea and vomiting. Vertigo - Fainting. Dizziness and impaired coordination. COMMENTS - The drug Halcion has been associated with the following withdrawal symptoms: Convulsions, cramps, tremors, vomiting, sweating, feeling ill, perceptual problems, and insomnia. Symptoms of the Halcion overdose may include: Apnea (temporary cessation of breathing), coma, confusion, excessive sleepiness, problems in coordination, seizures, shallow or difficult breathing, slurred speech RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cocc., Coff. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Rectum - Diarrhea. Constipation.

Male - Changes in sexual drive.

Female - Menstrual irregularities. Changes in sexual drive. Food - Loss of appetite. Worse from alcohol. Worse grapefruit juice.

Heart - Rapid heart rate.

Back - Muscle spasms in the shoulders or neck.

Limbs - Stiff awkward movements. Tingling or pins and needles. Lungs - Shallow or difficult breathing.

Sleep - Sleep disturbances including insomnia, sleepwalking. Drowsiness during the daytime. Insomnia. Rebound insomnia in patients who have stopped taking the Halcion drug. Sleep apnea. Nightmares.

Skin - Skin inflammation. Itching. Yellowing of the skin.

Kidneys - Incontinence.

HOMEOPATHIC - The salt springs of Hall contains chlorides, iodides, bromides, carbonates of the alkalies and alkaline earths and iron, but by far the largest ingredient is chloride of sodium. Provings have been made of this water, many of them on patients suffering from goiter. In the provings, many marked symptoms appeared in the breast glands. Great weakness and exhausting night- sweats were produced, and all the symptoms of cold in the head and chest. A number of symptoms occured after sleep and some of them woke the provers in the night. One prover had a sensation as if her stomach would fall out and as if her breasts would fall off. In many cases the pains were transient, acute and returned after a short interval. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Nat-m., Sil-mar. - stitches shooting out of nipple. (2) 01-an. REFERENCES - Clarke.
