full:
PHARMACY - helo. Heloderma suspectum. Gila monster. Heloderma horridus. N. O. Helodermide of the Lacertilia. Trituration of sugar of milk saturated with the venom. Solution of the venom in alcohol. Historical dose: All potencies, thirtieth potency.

CLINICAL - Brain, affected. Cerebrospinal meningitis. Coldness. Cyanosis. Depression. Headache. Heart failure. Locomotor ataxia. Melancholy. Neuralgia. Numbness. Paralysis. Paralysis agitans. Parkinson's disease.

HOMEOPATHIC - The first notice of the remedy is from Dr. Charles D. Belden, who supplied Boericke and Tafel with a living specimen and poison he obtained. Heloderma is sluggish and slow of movement when kept in the dark, but may develop great activity when brought into the sunlight. The only vulnerable part seems to be at the junction of the head with the spine, a blow on which will kill it. Belden noted that this animal does not bite frequently, but when it does it is understood that the result is abenumbing paralysis similar to Parkinson's disease or to locomotor ataxia. There is no tetanic phase, a condition almost reverse in objective symptoms to Hydrocy. acid or Strychnia. Helo, is indicated in many forms of disease characterized by great coldness, “an arctic” coldness as the intense icy coldness is the most peculiar symptom of the poison. Cold waves from occiput to feet or ascending, as if frozen from within outwards. Breath and tongue are cold, cold feeling in lungs and chest, coldness across scapula, burning in the spine. Cold, creeping ring around the body. The eyeball becomes more prominent and the cornea shows opacities. Boyd noted that the exophthalmus is due to the pressure of the blood behind the eyeball. Steps high and puts heel down hard, sensation as if walking on a sponge or as if with swollen feet. Turns to right when walking. Stitch pains going from left to right. Weak, giddy, making it difficult to stand. Unable to balance himself. Patient staggers while walking. Movement does not increase the pain. Throbbing all over body. Bone pains. MIND - Melancholy with weeping. Depression. No inclination for exertion in any way. Passively indifferent. Forgetfulness. Difficulty in remembering the spelling of simple words. Unable to confine mind to any object. Startling easily with trembling, on slight noise. In spite of very severe symptoms, not alarmed.

Head - Cold pressure within the skull. Cold band around head. Heat on vertex. Benumbed feeling all over head. Soreness and stiffness in occiput. Throbbing on vertex. Pain beginning in right ear, extending around back of head to left ear. Sensation as if head would fall to right side. As if scalp were drawn tight over skull. Bores head in pillow. Awakes suddenly with jerk in head.

Eyes - Itching of eyelids, heavy, hard to keep open. Eyeballs become more prominent and the cornea shows opacities. Lachrymation.

Ears - Pressure behind left ear, pressure in ear from within outward. Copious flow of wax. Ears dry and scurfy. Ringing in ear like night-bell.

Nose - Left nostril sore, ulcerated. Dry, itching scurfs in nostrils. Severe attack of sneezing. Fluent discharge.

Face - Cold, crawling feeling, from temple down right cheek, as if facial muscles were drawn tight over the bones. Stiffness of jaw. Dry lips. As if pricked with points of ice. Sensation of heat. Flushes of heat.

Mouth - Breath cold. Tongue dry and cracked in the morning. Tongue cold, tender and dry. Very thirsty. Swallowing difficult. Dryness of lips. Soreness. Nerves - Startled easily. Tired feeling, very weak and nervous. Trembling, of left side, hands shaky, can be controlled with effort. Intense aching in bones and all parts of body.

Throat - Swallowing difficult. Dryness, parched sensation. Tingling. Soreness, tenderness to touch. Stinging, sore feeling in right tonsil. Vertigo - Sensation as if would fall to right side. COMMENTS - The Gila monster is a native of Arizona, New Mexico and Texas. It is smaller than the Mexican variety, called Heloderma suspectum Heloderma horridum, the “Crust lizard” or the “Gila monster,” which is generally regarded as harmless. Belden described it as “an ugly, disagreeable-looking creature, the head long and blunt, eyes black and bead- like, tail half the length of the body, thick-set and club-like. The entire body cased in a thinly coated armor, marked curiously with yellow and black.” Its skin is studded with nail or tu- bercle-like heads. The venom is alkaline in reaction. A number of cases of bites are on record. A dog bitten in the nose “uttered fearful howls and when after great difficulty, he was released, had symptoms like ‘blind staggers,' began turning around in a circle and died in twenty minutes.” A young miner bitten in the leg, through in robust health at the time, at once began to lose flesh, became melancholic and died in a few months like a person with rapid tuberculosis. A Native American woman bitten in the leg survived, but the leg shriveled and she became a semi-idiot, though she lived over thirty years after. The writer of an article quoted by the Recorder from the New York Sun related her case, describing the effect as: “Where the person survives an hour or two after the bite, the agony is described as awful to witness. The poison goes through the human system with rapidity and causes unspeakable pain and excruciating agony from head to foot. Though paralyzed, every muscle, bone, sinew and nerve is keenly alive to intense pain. The sufferer's head seems as if it would split open. Very few persons bitten can speak after the first fifteen minutes, but unconsciousness seldom comes until a few minutes before death.” Belden noted its reputation of being fatal to drinkers and to affect non-drinkers less severely. This is borne out somewhat by the recovery of Mr. Vail of Tucson, a man of temperate habits, after a bite: and the death of a man bitten while drunk, after lingering several months. This lingering nature of the poison is markedly different from snake poisons, which generally kill quickly, if at all. Mr. Vail said his suffering was intense, the pain proceeding from the wounded part to the head and back. Immediately after receiving the wound, which was on his index finger, both wrist and finger were tightly bandaged. Two hours later, the wound was cleansed and dressed and the bandages reapplied. For three days those intense pains would shoot toward the head and spine on loosening the bandages in the least degree. After three months the only perceptible result was a swollen tongue that seemed then unwilling to resume its proper size. The treatment he received was profuse sweating by administration of Jab. This much was known when Dr. Robert Boocock made his proving. His first experience was with three or four drops of a solution of the 6x trituration, one drachm in four ounces of alcohol. He was seized with an internal coldness from the heart as if being frozen to death internally and had no way of warming himself. “Coldness from within outward.” The coldness of this remedy is more intense than that of any other. The prover called it “arctic coldness.” The coldness was at times followed by sensations of heat and burning. Dr. Boocock's observation of the cold sensations of Helo, was confirmed by a young clerk in the employment of Messrs. Boericke and Tafel, who took six doses of Helo. 6c out of bravado. The second night he awoke and felt a cold sensation creeping down his body and legs and was in a very cold clammy sweat. This lasted all the rest of the night and he could get no more sleep. It began to pass off by morning, and he felt no more of it. Helo, produced the constricting sensations of the serpent venoms as well as the numbness, darting pains and the sensitiveness to external pressure. Many of the symptoms came on in the night waking the pro ver from sleep (Lach, is “worse from sleep”). Tremors, spongy feeling of feet on walking. Pains in back and limbs. Belden recommended it for locomotor ataxia and Parkinson's disease (Merc., Rhus-t., Ars., Zinc), particularly with depression. Raynaud's disease. Polyneuritis, peripheral neuralgias. May be useful for hypothermia. Dr. Boocock gave great relief with the medicine in a case of Parkinson's disease. E. E. Case effected great improvement in a case of locomotor ataxia in an auburnhaired woman, 55. She had the classical symptoms of the complaint and “tingling, creeping sensations in legs as if from insects. She was worse lying in bed at night, worse from exposure from touch. Arms numb. Legs insensible to battery. Tongue dry and cracked. Swallowing difficult.” Under Helo. 900c and later, 45,000c after the appearance of an eruption, she recovered a fair degree of health and usefulness. C. E. Johnson reported to Dr. Boocock the relief of a woman who had many of the symptoms of the proving (and had been pronounced incurable), complaining especially of the intense coldness. She received Helo. 200c and the coldness disappeared almost completely. Boocock cured a case of “blue hands,” remaining long after diphtheria paralysis and he restored two patients apparently moribund. In one case the breathing was slow, “tongue cold and slate-colored, breath cold.” The other case was that of a woman, 65. In the act of dressing, strength suddenly left her, mouth fell open tongue and breath cold and she was apparently dying and felt so. There was intense pain at the back of the head. Helo. 200c was given, as in the other case, and she made a good recovery. Dr. Boocock compared the weakness he experienced in the proving to that of Gels., only Gels, did not dry up the mouth and secretions as Helo. did. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lacer. - skin eruptions. Vesicles under tongue. Increased mental acumen. Difficult swallowing. Constant accumulation of saliva in the mouth. Nausea, violent pressure in stomach. Camph., Lach. (2) Crot-h., Camph. - coldness. (3) Arg-n., Alum. - locomotor ataxia. (4) Ant-t. and Merc. - Parkinson's disease, Gels., Con., Lyss. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Empty belchings, especially before breakfast. Empty, gone sensation in the stomach. Acid burning in stomach.

Abdomen - Sensation of constriction about the whole abdomen. Throbbing, rumbling in bowels. Sharp, shooting, stitching pain in bowels, more on left side. Pain across pubic bones, extending down into left testicle.

Rectum - Constipation from torpor of the rectum. Loose, copious stool, lumpy, mushy, preceded by stitches in abdomen, with considerable flatus. Stool soft, dark, difficult to expel. Hemorrhoids, swollen, itch and bleed. Itching of the anus.

Male - Cold penis and testicle with gluey discharge. Pain and enlargement of left testicle.

Female - Burning and dryness of the vagina. Food - Dislikes sweet things, worse from taking them.

Chest - Cold feeling in lungs and in heart. Sharp stitch through right nipple to inside of the right arms.

Heart - Palpitations and dyspnea from slight exertion. Slow labored thumping of heart. Pressure at heart. Tingling, trembling, oppression and coldness around heart. Sticking pains, shooting from left to right. Stitches in heart. Soreness in heat, more under left nipple.

Back - Stiff neck, aching in bones of neck. Painfulness of upper neck. Chill in back from base of brain downwards. Coldness across scapulae. Pain in back, pain in lumbar muscles awakening him. Burning along spine.

Limbs - Stretching relives pains in muscles and limbs. Numbness and trembling. Coldness. Numbness of the arms from the hands to the elbows. Cyanosis of hands. Tingling, creeping sensation on the legs as if from insects. Leg is insensible to an electric battery. Leg is wasting away, skin very dry and inelastic. Ankle turn easily when trying to walk. Sensation as if walking on sponge and as if feet were swollen. Staggering gait. Cock's gait. When walking, lifts feet higher than usual and puts down heel hard. Feet cold as ice or burn. Lungs - Slight, hacking cough with pain in the left scapulae. Fullness in chest, requiring an effort to inflate the lungs. Oppressed for breath from least exertion.

Sleep - Drowsiness, but inability to sleep. Restless sleep, awakens at 3 a.m. Awakened from sleep by jerking in head, trembling of limbs, pain in lumbar muscles.

Skin - Yellow skin. Itching, as from insects.

Modalities - Better from stretching. Better warmth. Worse when thinking of her ailments. Worse being cheered by company. Worse from cold. Worse exposure to cold air. Worse stormy weather. Worse lying in bed at night. Worse after sleep.

Kidneys - Aching, stitching in right kidney. Bladder irritable, frequent urging to pass urine. Tenderness in urethra with sensation of discharge. Urine not as free as usual, muddy. Intermittent flow. Urine is greenish- yellow, fetid like decaying fruit. Burning in the urethra during and after urination.

Pulse - Full and jerky.

Temperature - Internal coldness, as if frozen to death. Temperature subnormal (Camph.). Cold spots. Cold rings around body. Arctic coldness. Severe chill ran down back. Cold waves (Abies-c., Aeon.), ascend from feet or downward from base of brain. Hot flushes and burning in head and along spine.

full:
PHARMACY - helon. Helonias dioica. Uni- com-root. Helonias lútea. False unicorn. Devil's Bit. Blazing Star. N. O. Melanthacee. Tincture of the root. Triturations of the resinoid Helonin. Historical dose: Trimration, tincmre and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Atony, uterus. Backaches. Breast, disorders. Chlorosis. Cramps. Debility. Depression. Diabetes. Dysmenorrhea. Impotency. Kidney, pains. Leucorrhea. Lochia, prolonged. Menopausal, disorders. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pruritus vulva. Rheumatism. Splenalgia. Infertility. Uterus, disorders.

HERBAL - Helonias has been called a uterine tonic.

HOMEOPATHIC - Helonias has an extensive range of action, as its provings show, but it predominantly affects the uterus. One of the keynote indications for its use is a “consciousness of the womb.” Relaxation of the uterine ligaments, misplacements and prolapse (Sep.). Exhaustion from the least mental or physical exertion. Emaciation or chronic fatigue since childbirth (Sep., Caul.), or multiple abortions ormiscarriages. Tendency toprolapse and other malposition of the womb, from uterineatony. Uterine reflexes. Dropsy after uterine hemorrhage. Toxemia of pregnancy with great fatigue. Premenstrual syndrome with fatigue, swollen breasts, and metrorrhagia. Suppressed menses. Congested kidneys, as if the monthly congestion, instead of venting itself through the uterine vessels, had extended to the kidneys. Bearing down pain, and chronic vaginal infections since childbirth. Sensation of weakness, dragging in the sacrum and pelvis with great languor and prostration. Tired backaches in females. Constant aching and tenderness over kidneys. Muscles, heavy, sore, aching, burning. Sleepless, with a worn out feeling. Diabetes mellitus and insipidus. Anemia. MIND - Extreme depression, gloom. Profound melancholia. May have a preliminary feeling of wellness depression. Irritable, cannot endure the least contradiction. Finds faults with everyone. Conversation unpleasant, desires to be left alone. Better when busy. Patient must be doing something to engage mind. Consciousness of the womb.

Head - Burning sensation on top. Heat or upward pressure in vertex, as if skull were too full. Headache, better mental exertion.

Face - Pale, earthy. Sallow, having an expression of suffering.

Mouth - Salivation of pregnant women and teething children. Aphthae during pregnancy. Bitter taste in early a.m.

Stomach - Cramp-like pain in the stomach. Burning in stomach, belchings. Irritable stomach with general dropsy.

Abdomen - Burning in the lower third of abdomen. Pain in left side, as if in spleen, which feels as if distended, causing a dull ache. Colic-like pains in hypogastric region off and on all day. Motion and rumbling in abdomen, as if diarrhea would come on, cramps in the stomach.

Rectum - Stool loose, yellow in the morning, lumps of feces in the evening.

Male - Sexual desire and power increased. Erections unusually strong and frequent. Impotence.

Female - Conscious of womb. Uterus, weak. heavy, sore, tender, ulcerated or prolapsed or other malpositions. Weight and soreness in womb. Dragging in sacral region with prolapse, especially after a miscarriage. Backache after miscarriage (Kali-c.). Heavy dragging in pelvis. Menses too frequent, too profuse. Menses, suppressed, kidneys congested. Foul, lumpy orcurdled leucorrhea. Albuminuria during pregnancy. Debility attending menopause. Hemorrhage from atony of dark, foul blood. Pruritus vulvae. Parts hot, red, swollen, bum and itch terribly. Vulva, aphthous inflamed. Loss of sexual desire and power with or without sterility. Food - Loss of appetite, food tasteless. Belchings, cramps. Fullness and painful congestion ofthe stomach. Bilious, sleepy during the day.

Chest - Chest sensitive to the air. Aching, as if the front of chest had been compressed in a vice, as if squeezed. Constitutions - Suited to nervous, run-down females, easily fatigued by any work, who complain of a tired backache, a tired feeling extending into the limbs. Some of this passes off after commencing to work.

Heart - Palpitations.

Back - Pain and weight in back, tired and weak. Aching and burning across the lumbar region, can trace outlines of kidneys by constant burning. Boring pain in lumbar region, extending down legs. Aching between scapulae. Weakness, weight and dragging down in sacrum, down to buttocks. Great languor, better exercising.

Limbs - Severe pains in right hip joint, worse during motion. Sore pain in outer side of thighs. Sensation as if cool wind streamed up calves. Feet feel numb, when sitting.

Sleep - Drowsy, heavy. Sleepy during the day.

Skin - Pale, earthy, sallow. Epidermis of the labia peels off thin, transparent exfoliation.

Modalities - Better if busy. Better from diversion. Better holding abdomen. Worse from fatigue. Worse pregnancy. Worse stooping. Worse motion. Worse touch, pressure of clothes. Worse pressure on breasts, nipples or kidneys.

Kidneys - Burning sensation at the kidneys. Constant aching, extreme tenderness of kidneys. Dull ache and heat in region of the kidneys instead of menses. Nephritis of pregnancy with obstinate vomiting.

Bladder - Frequent desire and urging. Involuntary discharge of urine after the bladder feels empty. Profuse urine, clear, albuminous, saccharine, phosphatic. Strangury. Burning, scalding when urinating. Diabetes mellitus and insipidus. Breasts - Breasts swollen, nipples painful and tender, worse pressure of clothes.

Temperature - Feels hot when tired. Flushes of heat pass over him with every movement while in a room. Chills, seemingly radiating from solar plexus all over body, caused by motion of arms. COMMENTS - Alternate sensations of heat and cold. Burning sensations, particularly at the epigastrium. Useful for menopausal temperature disturbances. Irritation in mucous membranes, sore mouth, irritable stomach, burning and scalding when urinating, irritated vaginal mucous membrane. Backache in the lumbar region, over the kidneys or in the sacrum. Pains are worse on commencing to work, better after working a little (Rhus-t.). Pain from the kidneys, especially the right. Generally scanty urine. Marvin A. Custis reported a case. “Mrs. L, 28, has two children, both living. Has prolapse of uterus, ulceration of cervix, dark offensive leucorrhea. Her system is worn out and her expression one of great distress. “Irritable, finds fault with every one and cannot bear contradiction. Restless, wants to move around, as she feels better when mind and body are employed. “She had a severe backache and a sore and heavy feeling in the womb, she said she was always ‘conscious of her womb.' “Helon. 30c every three hours for two days, and then every night, was prescribed with a warm water injection night and morning. At the end of three weeks the leucorrhea had almost ceased, the womb was in the first position and she ‘forgets that she has such an organ.'” L. L. Danforth treated Mrs. W., who had intense pruritus, vulvar and vaginal, for several weeks. “She could tear the flesh out” it was so intense. There was vulvovaginitis, the labia and adjoining skin were red, swollen and covered with thin, white, curdy deposits. Further examination showed a thin, albuminous leucorrhea pouring from a congested cervix, evidently the cause of the pruritus. The leucorrhea coagulated on the vagina, forming small curds covering the mucous membrane of vagina and vulva. Helon. tincture on tablets speedily relieved. S. A. Jones found that Helon. turned an alkaline urine acid, and increased the amount of urea as well as the amount of urine secreted. Jones considered this the result of a condition of debility, venous paresis, the result of previous arterial tonic contraction. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Alet., Lil-t, Puls., Senec., Stann. (2) Agri. - painful kidneys, indigestion and menstrual difficulties, bron- chorrhea and catarrh of bladder. Cough with profuse expectoration attended with expulsion of urine. Tincture 1 to 10 drops. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

name: Hepar Sulphuris Calcareum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in damp weather. Better warmth, wrapping head up. Better pressure, after eating. Worse inhaling air. Worse cold air. dry winds. Worse slightest draft. Worse open air. Worse single parts of the body getting cold. Worse from touch. Worse motion. Worse washing. Worse slight bleeding. Worse blowing the nose. Worse on waking. Worse at night..

full:
PHARMACY - hep. Hepar sulphuris calcareum. Calcium sulphide. Calcarea sulphurata Hahnemanni. An impure Sulphide of Calcium prepared by burning in a crucible the white interior of oyster shells with pure flowers of sulphur. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Amaurosis. Angina, pectoris. Asthma. Axilla, abscess. Beard, eruptions. Blepharitis. Bo/iv. Breast, disorders. Bronchitis. Bubo. Bums. Carbuncle. Decay. Chilblains. Chlorosis. Colds. Constipation. Cornea, ulceration. Cornea, opacity. Coughs. Croup. Diaphragmitis. Diarrhea. Ear, infections. Ears, polyps. Eczema. Emphysema. Erysipelas. Eyes, disorders. Glandular, swellings. Headaches. Hectic, fever. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Hip joint disease. Hoarseness. Jaundice. Joints, disorders. Laryngitis. Leucorrhea. Lips, swollen. Liver, disorders. Lungs, disorders. Lupus. Marasmus. Menorrhagia. Mouth, sore. Nipples, sore. Ovaries, disorders. Pleurisy. Pneumonia. Pylorus, disorders. Quinsy. Rheumatism. Scarlatina. Scrofula. Skin, disorders. Spinal, irritation. Syphilis. Styes. Suppuration. Syphilis. Tenesmus. Throat, sore. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Urticaria. Wens. Whitlow. Whooping, cough

HOMEOPATHIC - “Liver of Sulphur" is a name given by the old alchemists to several sulphur compounds whose color was supposed to resemble that of the liver. Before Hahnemann's time, Hep., Sulfuret of lime, was used as an external remedy for itch, rheumatism, gout, goiter and scrofulous swellings. Hahnemann prepared Hep. with oyster shells instead of ordinary lime. As it is a chemical combination of Calc, and Sulph., it has some of the properties of both, but is very different from either and though it is useful to compare them. Hep. must be studied as a separate entity. Material doses were used in pellagra. The higher potencies may abort the suppuration, the lower promote it. If it is necessary to hasten it, give 2x. Hep.; lx will often start secretions and profuse drainage in stuffy colds. In 1794, Hahnemann proposed to use it internally to arrest mercurial salivation. A few years later it was tried for asthma and pulmonary tuberculosis, with success. It acts on the mucous membranes, causing croupy, catarrhal process with a tendency to hemorrhage and ulceration. Tendency to suppuration. Lesions spread by the formation of small papules around the side of the old lesions. The catarrh may be in the throat, stomach, uterus, or urethra, and is characterized by thick, yellow, acrid, ropy discharge. Mucus in the stools, the urine, and is hawked up. Easy perspiration with mucus. Infected sinus with pus formation. Great sensitiveness to all impressions. Hypersensitiveness. Chilliness. Sweating, but desire to pull blanket around him. Feeling as if wind were blowing on some part. Splinter-like pains. The side of the body on which he lies at night becomes gradually insufferably painful, he must turn. Craving for sour and strong things. Syphilis after gross medication. For the abuse of mercury. MIND - Mental dullness. Forgetful. Weak memory. Depression. Dejected and sad. Remorse. Bitter crying. Dissatisfaction with one's self and others. Anguish in the evening and night with thoughts of suicide. Delicate, oversensitive to impressions, people and places. Hypersensitive. Hasty speech and hasty drinking. Restlessness, desires a constant change. Hurried. Child does not laugh, and is not inclined to play or to amuse itself in any way. Children who lose their tempers and hit, kick and scream (Cham., Cina.). Quarrelsome. Extreme irritability, peevishness. Abusive and vehement. Ferocious. Slightest upset irritates him. Everybody disturbs him. Bad tempered. Angry because of pain, at the least trifle. Impulsive. Impulse to do violence and to destroy, to start fires. Impulse to kill, to stab with a knife, especially if annoyed. Insanity and mania.

Head - Boring pain in the right temple and in root of nose every morning. Eczema on forehead along the line of hair, worse after washing. Scalp sensitive and sore. Humid scald-head itching and burning. Cold sweat on head.

Eyes - Purulent conjunctivitis with chemosis, profuse discharge, great sensitiveness to touch and air. Iritis with pus in anterior chamber. Ophthalmia, thick mucous discharge. Corneal ulcers. Eyes and lids red and inflamed. Pain in the eyes, as if pulled back into the head. Boring pain in upper bones of the orbits. Eyeballs sore to touch. Hypopion. Yellow. Photophobia. Vision obscured by reading, field reduced one- half. Bright circles before eyes. Objects appear red and too large.

Ears - Otitis media, painful (Cham.). Ears are sensitive to touch, wind. Discharge of fetid pus from the ears. Pustules in auditory canal and auricle. Scurfs on and behind the ears. Mastoiditis. Whizzing and throbbing in ears with hardness of hearing. Roaring. Deafness from Eustachian catarrh after scarlet fever.

Nose - Hay fever. Sinusitis after coryza. Sneezes every time he goes into a cold, dry wind with running from nose, later, thick offensive discharge. Stopped up every time he goes out into cold air. Ozaena. Offensive discharge, smells like old cheese. Post nasal dripping. Sore, bleeds, bloody crusts. Soreness of nostrils with catarrhal troubles. Air feels cold in nose.

Face - Yellowish, sunken complexion. Vesicular erysipelas with pricking in parts. Cancer on lips. Middle of lower lip cracked. Ulcers in corners of mouth. Shooting in jaw on opening mouth. Neuralgia of right side, extending in streak into temple, ear, ale and lip. Pains in bones of face, especially when being touched.

Mouth - Tongue, white, yellow, dirty, swollen, large, tabby, slimy, with imprints of teeth, feels as if scalded. Bitter taste. Aphthae. Ptyalism. Gums and mouth painful to touch and bleed readily. Bleeding painful cancerous growth on hard palate. Stomatitis of nursing mothers or weakly children.

Throat - Follicular pharyngitis. Hawks up yellow tenacious mucus. Quinsy with impending suppuration. Stitches in throat extending to the ear when swallowing. When swallowing, sensation as if a plug. Sensation of a splinter in throat. Hoarse- Hepar sulphuris calcareum ness with loss of voice. Vertigo - Vertigo, with headache, nausea, with a tendency to fall. Vertigo in mornings. Worse on rising, when shaking the head, from motion. COMMENTS - Guernsey noted the effects on the skin and touch, “any trouble occurring on the skin where there is a great sensitiveness to the slightest touch, patient can't bear to have even the clothes touch the part or have it touched in any way. Exanthema like nettle rash, sore to the slightest touch. Skin hard to heal, inflammation, sensitive soreness of skin.” Teste added that the sensitiveness is not confined to touch. There is excessive sensitiveness to the air, patient can't bear the least draft and if a hand accidentally gets outside the bedclothes it brings on an aggravation. Characteristic over-sensitiveness. Sensitivity to touch, to pain, can suffer intensely (Cham.). The slightest pain causes fainting. Sensitive to the stimulation of light, noise and odors. Desires constant change, can't adjust to find comfort. Very chilly, particularly when sick. Very sensitive to drafts, even uncovering a hand or foot can bring on a coughing spasm (Rumx., Rhus-t.). Worse from air conditioning, better warmth and heat. Sensitiveness to cold, dry air (Aeon., Bry.). Restlessness and anxiety (Ars.). Anxious about pain (Ign. ), and worse pain, can overreact and become hysterical or violent (Nux-v., Cham.). Frenzy because of pain, impulsive. Very irritable, abusive. Can have an impulse to kill or throw someone in a fire or out the window. Can have a desire to set fires, desire to kill her child. Swears and curses, fears they may do something violent. Painful, inflamed sores and wounds, slow to heal. Painful, hypersensitive boils (Bell., Tarent.), with sticking pains. Tendency to boils, painful eruptions, ulcers, abscesses and pus. Suppuration, inflammation and severe pain from foreign bodies under the skin or in eye (Sil.). Sensation of foreign body under the skin or in the eye. Abscesses anywhere in the body, with sensitivity. Throbbing, stabbing pains, splinter-like sensations. Splinters under the nail that abscess (Sil., Myris.). Sticking pains in the nails. Itching, particularly in affects the bends of the elbows and popliteal spaces. Itching in connection with jaundice. Pruritus, especially when of mercurial origin. Inflammations, especially of respiratory organs, bowels and kidneys and the skin. Colds and flus from exposure to drafts or cold dry winds (Kali-c.). Chronic sinusitis or bronchitis from exposure to cold winds, drafts or cold dry weather. Sinusitis with yellow, thick discharge (Puls.) with irritability. Coryza, nose swollen and sore to the touch, especially inside the ale. Boring at root of nose with catarrhal symptoms or headaches. Suffocative attacks in the respiratory organs. Asthma. Whooping cough. Croup that's worse from dry cold (Aeon., Spong.). Yellow discharge. Dry, painful, hacking cough, as though a feather were in the throat. Loose cough with wheezing and rattling, as if mucus would come up but it does not. Choking cough. Cough, worse drafts, more often in the early morning (Aeon, in evening). Inflammation of the throat. Painful, swollen tonsils. Abscessed tonsillitis. Discharge from the tonsils. Quinsy, with throbbing pains, where suppuration is imminent (Calc-s. after it breaks). Sore throats with pain on swallowing, as though a splinter or fish bone were caught in the throat. Sticking pains. Hoarseness. Earaches in children, with night sweats that don't relieve (Merc.). Tearing and pressure as though it would burst. Pus. Side of face is sensitive, hypersensitive to noise. Sensitive to the least touch or draft (Caust.). Abscess in the ear with bloody, yellow, or pus-like discharge from the ear. Ear canal is very painful. Sticking pains in the ears. Eye disorders, likes to have eyes tightly covered. Toothaches, especially if there is an abscess or boil. Very irritable because of the sharp, dental pain. Food or drink aggravates. Drinking water goes to the bone. Desires acids and sour things. Semi-paralytic condition of the rectum and bladder (Alum.). Stools are passed with great difficulty even when clay-like and soft. Diarrhea with sour stools. Fetid stools with a sour body smell in children. Impeded urination, obliged to wait before urine passes, then flows slowly for many days. Never able to finish urinating, seems as if some always remains in bladder. Urine drops vertically down. Acrid urine. Complaints during urination and after. Nocturnal emissions. Escape of prostatic fluid at any time and at stool. Affections of the sexual organs occurring on the right side. Vaginitis with thick, cheesy, fetid discharge. with a bad odor like rotten cheese (Kali-p., Kreos.). Anti-psoric. Marked periodicity, every day, every fourweeks (attack ofparalysis). Every four months (scabby eruptions on head). Whitlows every winter. Bilious attacks in the spring and autumn. In Hahnemann's article, “Medicine of Experience,” he speaks of the itch-like eruptions caused by Hep. and its corrective properties in wool-workers' itch. Guernsey noted that there is respiration with mucous rattle, expiration in the morning, none in the evening, cough with expectoration during the day, none in the night (in croup no expectoration at night but only in the daytime with the suffocative coughing spells, low, weak voice). P. Foster distinguished between Hep., Calc-s. and Kali-s. in their action on tissues. Kali-s. acts on the epidermis, Hep. on lymphatic glandular system, skin and respiratory mucous membrane, Calc-s. acts much as Hep., only more deeply. Hep. acts on abscesses before they open, Calc-s. after. Foster cured a woman with Calc-s. of “several large ulcers in the gluteal region 3 inches in diameter and 3/4 inches deep, exposing the bone.” The pain ceased immediately and the cure was completed in two months. The relation of Hepar to the suppuration process is very marked. It meets the hectic condition generally and the process locally. Clarke once cured with Hep. 6c a case of axillary abscess with a large collection of pus. The whole was absorbed without breaking. A case of pustular ophthalmia of the left eye was cured after Sulph. and Calc, had failed. It was better keeping the eye closely covered with some soft fabric, worse mornings, better as the day advanced. Pimples surrounded affected eye. In a case of eczema pudendi in a young girl, 11, three months after puberty, the parts red and itching, Merc, was given and the whole body became covered with the rash. Hep. was then given and removed all symptoms immediately. “Sweats day and night without relief.” It antidotes the sensitiveness of Merc, to atmospheric conditions. In the old days of mercurialization, one of the chief things to be avoided by a patient under the “course” was exposure to chill. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Acet-ac., Bell., Cham., S'ñ. It antidotes: Metals and especially mercurial preparations, Nit-ac., Calc., lod., Kali-i. Compare: (1) Croup - Aeon., Spong. (2) Sil., Calc-s., Calen., Sulph., Staph., Myris. (3) Hep. antidotes bad effects from mercury, iodine, potassium, (4) Cod-liver oil removes the weakening effects of ether. Compatible with: Aeon., Am., Bell., Lach., Merc., Nit-ac., Sil., Spon., Zinc. Complementary to: Calen, in injuries. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomach ulcers and cancer. Painful epigastric tumors with pulsations. Distention of stomach, compelling one to loosen the clothing. Burning in stomach. Heaviness and pressure in stomach after a slight meal. Gone feeling in stomach with loathing of food or as of a sharp lump in stomach. Weak digestion. Frequent belch- ings without taste or smell. Apt to vomit all food, retaining only milk or water, mixed. Cannot eat bread or vegetables.

Abdomen - Distended, tense, chronic abdominal disorders. Pain in the groins as if sprained. Atrophy, cancer of liver. Baek - Neuralgia of neck. Dull, dragging, heavy pain across lumbar region, uses arms to raise himself from a seat. Breasts - Pain in right breast on sneezing. Breasts cancer. Retracted, sore nipples, cracked in nursing women. Causations - Cold, dry winds. Injuries. Suppressed eruptions. Abuse of mercury.

Rectum - Loss of power to expel even a soft stool. Clay-colored, soft, sour, white, undigested, fetid stools. Lumpy stools, coated or mixed with mucus. Raw smarting in the rectum during stools, remaining long afterwards. Obstinate constipation of pregnancy, after purgatives. Hemorrhoids, even slight bleeding exhausts.

Male - Obstinate gonorrhea “does not get well.” Herpes, sensitive, bleed easily. Figwarts of offensive odor. Ulcers externally on prepuce similar to chancre (Nit-ac.). Suppurating inguinal glands. Humid soreness on genitals and between scrotum and thigh. Itching of glans, frenum and scrotum. Excitement and emission without amorous fancies.

Female - Menorrhagia and metrorrhagia with fibroids. Menses late and scanty. Pruritus vul vae with profuse leucorrhea with sexual excitement. Thick, acrid, yellow, ropy leucorrhea. Leucorrhea smells like old cheese (Sanie.). Vagina sore during sex, bleeding after. Itching of pudenda and nipples, worse during menses. Abscesses of labia with great sensitiveness. Profuse perspiration at the menopause (Til., Jab.). Erosion of cervix. Removes the tendency to habitual adherent placenta. Hot, watery, discharge from uterus. Food - Desire for acids, pickles, vinegar, sour food. Desires wine, fruit, spicy and strong-tasting food, warm drinks. Better from spicy foods. Aversion to fat food, butter, cheese, which aggravate. Worse from alcohol, brandy, whiskey, tea, sweets, cold food, drinks and ice.

Chest - Constriction and tightness, oppression. Anxiety and heat in chest. Burning, sharp, sore, pressing pains, worse motion. Weakness of the chest, preventing talking. Pleuritis. Empyema. Angina pectoris. Inflammation of diaphragm. Axilla abscessed, offensive perspiration. Boils, eczema, herpes, pimples. Constitutions - Slow, torpid constitutions with lax tissue and light hair, great sensitiveness to slightest contact of ulcers, eruptions and affected parts. Suited to the psoric. scrofulous, diathesis. Debilitated subjects. Tendency to suppurations. Cross children. Torpid, lymphatic constitutions, persons with light hair and complexion, slow to act, muscles soft and flabby.

Heart - Anxiety in heart. Enlarged heart. Murmurs. Violent palpitations, with anxiety, worse after fright, eating. Palpitations from a slowly progressing weakness. Palpitations in the morning on waking. Angina pectoris. Stenocardia. Pericarditis. Gouty heart.

Limbs - Finger joints swollen, tendency to easy dislocation. Nail of great toe painful on slight pressure.

Skin - Unhealthy skin, every little injury suppurates (Psor., Sil.). Boils and abscesses. Suppurating glands. Chronic and recurring urticaria. Ulcers very sensitive to contact, burning, stinging, easily bleeding. Cancerous ulcers. Atonic ulcers, following removal of tumors. Putrid ulcers, surrounded by little pimples. Ulcers with bloody suppuration, smelling like old cheese. Papules, pimples prone to suppurate and extend. Acne in youth, suppurate with prickly pain, bleeds easily. Cold-sores, very sensitive. Ringworm. Smallpox. Chapped skin with deep cracks on hands andfeet. Great sensitiveness to slightest touch. Cannot bear to be uncovered, wants to be wrapped up warmly. Sticking or pricking in afflicted parts. Angio-neurotic edema.

Modalities - Better in damp weather. Better warmth, wrapping head up. Better pressure, after eating. Worse inhaling air. Worse cold air. dry winds. Worse slightest draft. Worse open air. Worse single parts of the body getting cold. Worse from touch. Worse motion. Worse washing. Worse slight bleeding. Worse blowing the nose. Worse on waking. Worse at night.

Liver - Jaundice. Hepatitis, hepatic abscess. Stitching in region of liver when walking, coughing, breathing or touching it (Bry., Merc.). Cutting pain from liver to right scapula worse lying on back or right side. Lungs - Bronchiectasis. Bronchitis of elderly, exhausted people. Emphysema. Pleuritis. Breathing difficult worse lying on left side. Anxious, wheezing, moist breathing. Asthma worse in dry cold air, better in damp. Pneumonia in suppurative stage with fever. Lobar pneumonia. Chronic pneumonia, with profuse purulent expectoration. Empyema. Sputum varies from scanty to tenacious mucopurulent. Hepar sulphuris calcareum First stage of pulmonary tuberculosis. Sputum pus-like, bloody tuberculous masses, or small balls, when crushed, emit a carrion-like odor. Paralysis of lungs.

Kidneys - Bladder difficulties of elderly men (Phos., Sulph., Cop.). Voided slowly without force, drops vertically, weak bladder. Seems as if some urine always remained. Mucus, greasy pellicle on urine. Gleety discharge, thick, yellow. Putrid odor of urine.

Cough - Loose cough, bloody or thick, yellow, tenacious sputum, raises much mucus. Cough from exposure to cold, especially to dry, cold air, west or northwest winds. Dry, hoarse, rattling cough. Croupy, choking cough. Croup with loose, rattling cough, worse in morning. Suffocative attacks, has to rise up and bend head backwards. Cough worse whenever any part of the body gets cold or uncovered or from eating anything cold. Loses voice and coughs when exposed to dry. cold wind. Cough troublesome when walking. Cough ameliorated by wrapping up, keeping warm.

Perspiration - Clammy, cold sweat. Constant offensive exhalation from the body. Offensive sweats. Sour, fetid, cheesy odors. Profuse sweat, sour, sticky, offensive, debilitating. Sweats day and night without relief, better from warmth, covers, worse from eating, exertion, uncovering. Night-sweats with tuberculosis. Perspira- tion with menopause

Temperature - Chilly in open air. Chilly from slightest draft. Chills and shi verings. Heat alternating with chill. Hectic fever. Dry, burning heat at night. Intermittent fever. Malaria. Typhoid, yellow fever. Catarrhal fever. Eruptive fever, measles, smallpox. Fever with teething.

full:
PHARMACY - hepat. Hepática triloba. Liverwort. Hepática nobilis. Anemone hepática. N. O. Ranunculacee. Tincture of full-grown leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Catarrh. Dyspepsia. Hoarseness. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia. Throat, sore.

HERBAL - Hepática is an ancient remedy which received its name from a fancied resemblance of its leaves to the shape of the liver.

HOMEOPATHIC - Definite knowledge of Hepat. began with an experiment made by Dr. D. G. Kimball, who chewed the leaves every day for a chronic irritation of the throat and lungs. Tickling irritation in the throat and sensation about epiglottis as of particles of food remaining. Scraping and rough sensation. Pharyngeal catarrh with profuse, serous sputa and hoarseness. Accumulation of viscid, tenacious phlegm with frequent hawking. Sputa sweet, profuse, creamy. Induces free and easy expectoration. Soreness at the nostrils.

Eyes - Eyes somewhat sensitive to light. Itching and smarting eyes. Slightly agglutinated in morning. Lungs - Some pain and constriction of right chest. Irritation of the fauces. Bronchitis with circumscribed pneumonia. Sputa bloody, purulent, profuse, yellow, creamy and exceedingly sweet. Free and easy expectoration.

Nose - Nosebleeds. Bloody mucus frequently blown from left nostril, for three or four days in succession. Soreness of end of nose at entrance of nostrils.

Throat - Rough scraping, irritative and tickling sensation in throat and fauces. Pharyngeal catarrh with profuse serous expectoration and hoarseness. Irritation of fauces, tickling, itching, scraping, almost constant, worse by eating or inhalation of dust. COMMENTS - Hale experienced an attack of circumscribed pneumonia with bloody expectoration orelse, profuse, yellow, creamy, exceedingly sweet. Some pain andconstriction in right chest, tickling in fauces, worse by eating or from inhalation of dust. Hale chewed the dry leaves and in a few days was well. Wegge of Copenhagen confirmed its value in pharyngeal catarrh with profuse serous sputa and hoarseness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Stann., Cist., Caust., Hydr., Phos., Sang., Rumx., Lach., Kali-bi. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Aids digestion.

name: Heracleum Sphondylium
author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - hera. (bran.). Heracleum sphondylium. Hogweed. Branca ursina. Bears breech. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of whole plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Debility. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Gout. Headaches. Migraines. Seborrhea, capitis. Skin, disorders. Spleen, pain. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hera, was found to exercise a pronounced action on the digestion, producing hunger with inability to eat, nausea, vomiting, colic, diarrhea and pain in the spleen. It also affected the sexual organs and the skin. Headache with drowsiness, worse on moving in open air, better tying up the head with a cloth. Exhaustion indolence and weakness. Recommended as a spinal stimulant in epilepsy with flatulency, gouty and skin symptoms. MIND - Hypochondriac troubles. Fretfulness and ill-humor, taciturn.

Head - Migraines. Sick headaches. Headaches with drowsiness, worse moving in open air, better tying up head with cloth. Much perspiration on head, and violent itching. Seborrhea capitis. Excessive oily secretion on the head.

Eyes - Lachrymation and weakness of the eyes while reading.

Nose - Frequent sneezing, with stitches in the region of the spleen.

Mouth - Bitter taste in the mouth.

Throat - Increased collection of mucus, crawling, rawness and scraping in the throat. Pressure in the throat, as from tenacious mucus. Vertigo - Vertigo while reading and sitting. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1) Con., Abies-n. (2) Cean. in headache with drowsiness. (3) Bruc., Gins., Gels., Nat-s., Nux-m., Sulph. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Pain with inclination to vomit. Bitter risings and taste. Sweet and bitter eructations, with gulping up of bitter fluid. Qualmish nausea, bitter, bilious vomiting, with pains in the stomach, and violent congestion of the head. Pressive in the stomach, with nausea and pressure in the pit of the stomach, after eating, as from a stone.

Abdomen - Abdominal and splenic pain. Throbbing and pain in the region of the spleen. Flatulence and colic, with nausea and offensive eructations. Sticking and griping colic, obliging him to bend up.

Rectum - Slimy, offensive diarrhea. Stool delayed, with urging and pain in the anus.

Male - Drawings in the penis. Sharp pain in the glans penis. Emissions.

Female - Transient sticking pain in the labia. Food - Hungry but unable to eat. Hunger, with nausea, and dread of all food. Increased thirst.

Chest - Oppression of the chest, with palpitation. Oppression of the chest and chilliness. Sharp pain in the chest on inspiration.

Limbs - Gouty, tearing pains in the limbs. Sticking and burning in the feet. Lungs - Dry, hacking cough, with feeling of soreness and transient stitches in the chest. Arrest of breathing on ascending a mountain.

Skin - Violent itching on the skin, and moist eruption, like the itch. Dry eruption on the chest, burning after scratching. Itching and biting on the scrotum.

Temperature - Chilliness, with frequent yawning and inclination to sleep in afternoon.

name: Heroinum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better open air. Better after rain. Better hot bathing. Better after sex. Worse in afternoon..
constitution: Addictions. Amenorrhea. Belching. Blisters. Coma. Constipation. Coryza. Cramps. Diarrhea. Drug, addiction. Drug, overdose. Eczema. Emaciation. Euthanasia. Faintness. Headaches. Heartburn. Insomnia. Mania. Narcotic, abuse. Nausea. Numbness. Sinusitis. Stiffness. Tinnitus. Tobacco. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Wounds.
keynote:
PHARMACY - herin. Heroinum. Heroin. Diamorphine. Papaveraceae.

CLINICAL - Addictions. Amenorrhea. Belching. Blisters. Coma. Constipation. Coryza. Cramps. Diarrhea. Drug, addiction. Drug, overdose. Eczema. Emaciation. Euthanasia. Faintness. Headaches. Heartburn. Insomnia. Mania.…
full:
PHARMACY - herin. Heroinum. Heroin. Diamorphine. Papaveraceae.

CLINICAL - Addictions. Amenorrhea. Belching. Blisters. Coma. Constipation. Coryza. Cramps. Diarrhea. Drug, addiction. Drug, overdose. Eczema. Emaciation. Euthanasia. Faintness. Headaches. Heartburn. Insomnia. Mania. Narcotic, abuse. Nausea. Numbness. Sinusitis. Stiffness. Tinnitus. Tobacco. Urticaria. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Addiction to drugs, allopathic medicines. Ailments from narcotics. Desire for narcotics. Physical euphoria. Drug overdose. Lack of reaction, with weakness. Faintness. Weakness, accompanied by nausea. Weariness, in the afternoon. Sluggishness of the body. Emaciation. Sore, aching, bruised pain in joints, muscles. Stiffness. Wounds. Inflammation of sinuses. Pulse frequent. Coma. Desire to be in the wind, near a warm stove. Trembling, externally with coldness, better warmth, eating. Aversion to smell of tobacco, sensitive to tobacco. MIND - Confusion, difficult concentration. Weak memory. Dullness. Mentally absorbed. Abstraction of mind. Depersonalization. Awkward, drops things. Spaced-out feeling. Everything seems unreal. Apathy to external impressions. Activity alternating with lassitude. Indifference. Mental shock. Ailments from embarrassment, wounded honor. Ailments from mortification. Drug addiction and alcoholism. Morphine abuse. Disposition to become a criminal. Euphoria alternating with sadness. Contentment. Full of desires for unattainable things. Fearless in spite of danger. No sense of danger, reckless. Frightened easily. Anxiety, alternating with indifference. Anxiety about his family, when alone, about the future. Fear of losing control, that something bad will happen. Claustrophobia. Self-destructive. Insecure. Critical of oneself, feels underappreciated. Despair of life, of social position. Childish behavior. Forsaken feeling. Irresolution and indecision. Discontented. Restlessness. Antisocial behavior. Desire for solitude. Aversion to company, to answering questions. Unfeeling, hardhearted with his family. Dictatorial. Fastidious. Abrupt, rough behavior. Impatience. Irritability when disturbed. Offended easily. Violent anger. Rage, fury with cursing. Anger from contradiction. Anger al ternating with tranquility. Chaotic behavior. Knocking his head against wall and things. Mutilates his body. Manic depression. Lascivious, lustful. Sexual mania. Religious affections, too occupied with religion. Feels doomed. Delusions that he is accused of committing a crime, betrayed. Delusions of being alone in the world. Thinks he is a criminal and others know it. Delusions of being double, of having two wills. Sees faces in the air around her. Imagines that he has been poisoned.

Head - Congestion. Constriction, band or hoop sensation, from forehead, extending to neck. Sensation of contraction, fullness, heavy, light. Numbness in the forehead, extending to nose in the evening, or in the vertex. Pain, with nausea, when bending head forward, after sex. Pain better lying down, in the morning, rising from lying, worse from motion. Cutting pain in the temples, right side. Pinching pain. Press- ing, like a cap, in the vertex, extending to forehead. Sore pain on vertex. Shaking, tingling, pulsating sensation, on vertex extending to ears. Headache, above left or right eye, behind the eyes, in temples, vertex extending to ear, eyes. Headache from riding in a carriage, from exposure to sun. Headache better from vomiting.

Eyes - Itching, lachrymation. Sore pain in left eye. Tired sensation. Photophobia. Pupils contracted to a pinpoint. Heavy eyelids, difficult to open.

Ears - Heat in right ear. Ear pain, on the left. Stopped sensation. Tinnitus. Noises in ear, humming, singing, especially on the right. Hearing impaired, as if from cotton in ear, in right ear. Acute hearing.

Nose - Coldness, heaviness. Perspiration on nose. Sinus complaints. Catarrh. Obstruction or coryza in the morning. Sneezing after rising. Tipof nostrils itching, tingling. Burning, smarting pain in root of nose. Acute sense of smell.

Face - Urticaria. Red eruptions on cheeks, right. Herpes about upper lips. Painful lips, as if excoriated. Swollen lips. Tingling of lips, extending to nose. Sore, bruised pain, in lower jaws, lips. Corners of mouth cracked, especially left. Stitching pain, lower jaws. Heat flushes.

Mouth - Burning pain, heat. Burning pain inside of lips. Painless ulcers, inside of lips. Cool, frothy, sour saliva. Itching, sore pain in palate. Biting cheek when talking orchewing. Spongy gums. Bleedinggums when cleaning them.

Throat - Choking. Narrow sensation. Constriction. Lump sensation. Pain on empty swallowing. Thick, yellow mucus, with constant disposition to swallow. Coated. Sensation of mucus. Inflammation, right side. Aching pain, better from warmth. Sore pain in esophagus. Sore throat, better eating, warm drinks. Heat in throat, after cough, extending to stomach. Cold sensation in throat, esophagus. Dryness.

Stomach - Cramping, pressing pain, extending to abdomen, into chest. Sensation of a ball. Empty sensation, without hunger, during nausea. Fullness, after eating, with oppression of breathing. Belching. Heartburn. Nausea while riding in a carriage. Nausea before eating, better from eating. Easy, painless vomiting. Vomiting after eating, late at night. Hernia, hiatus.

Abdomen - Distension, elongated. Cramping. griping, pressing, sore pain. Tension, pressure, better bending double. Sore pain in iliac region, worse pressure. Stitching pain in umbilicus, sides, especially on right. Restlessness, uneasiness. Eczema.

Rectum - Constipation, ineffectual urging and straining. Insufficient bowel movements. Lack of peristaltic action. Painful urging. Diarrhea. Cutting pain, when sitting, extending to ovaries. Sensations - Internal knotted sensation. Analgesia. Insensibility. Heaviness in the afternoon. External numbness. Tingling of affected parts.

Urine - Pale color. Vertigo - Vertigo accompanied by heaviness in head. Vertigo while lying, standing, on rising. Vertigo with nausea. Vision - Blue colors before the eyes. Blue halo of fire. Rays. Swimming of objects. Vision foggy, better from closing eyes. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Nux-v. Anae. (2) Op. Cann-i. Hyos. REFERENCES - Snowdon.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses, too frequent, copious, dark, painless, scanty. Traces of menses between the periods. Ovarian pain during menses, at ovulation. Sore pain in ovaries, uterus. Sexual desire, increased, in morning in bed. Sexual desire, diminished, wanting. Orgasm, wanting. Food - Appetite diminished. Ravenous appetite, accompanied by nausea, after eating, on waking, during perspiration. Thirst on waking. Desirescold water, wine, warmer hot drinks, coffee, soda water, carbonated drinks, fruit juice. Desires canots, raw food, fruit, meat, bacon, pastry, sweets, spices, ginger. Desires alcohol, but aggravates, excessive hangover. Aversion to meat, dairy, chocolate, sweets, and tea.

Chest - Anxiety in chest. Internal coldness. Heat flushes. Constriction, extending to throat, on left side, with sighing, after sex. Burning pain under left breast. Cutting pain on coughing, on inspiration. Chest pain, during cough or fever, worse inspiration. Griping pain on left side. Pain lying on side, worse motion. Pain in sides, on motion. Stitching pain in sternum on waking. Axillary glands inflamed, especially right. Coughs - Dry cough from tickling in larynx. Tickling cough, worse lying down. Cough on first lying down. Cough from talking, in the afternoon, 3 p.m.

Heart - Conscious of heart's action. Cutting pain. Palpitations, extending to throat, in the morning after breakfast.

Back - Thoracic pain, between or under right scapulae. Tearing pain below left scapulae. Stiffness in lumbar region, pain, worse exertion, on right side. Breasts - Sensitive breasts. Softness of breasts. Breast swelling and pain. Burning pain, under left breast. Breathing - Respiration impeded, arrested, obstructed with anxiety. Respiration difficult if hurried. Causations - Drug addiction. Alcoholism. Mental shock. Ailments from embarrassment, mortification, wounded honor.

Neck - Stiffness in cervical region, when bending forward. Pain in neck region, extending to right scapulae. Pain and swelling in cervical glands.

Limbs - Awkwardness. Weakness, especially in lower legs, in afternoon. Aching pain, in lower limbs, ankles, feet, heels, knees, and hips. Aching in the morning. Burning pain, in joints. Sensation of heaviness in the lower limbs. Hip pain when ascending stairs, knee pain on motion, while sitting, particularly the left. Shooting pain in leg, stitching pain in thigh. Twitching in the lower limbs, foot and thighs. Tingling in hands, legs, feet while standing, upper limbs. Sensation that legs will buckle. Lower limbs itch. Warts and heat on the feet, soles. Stiff ankles. Coldness on the hands and feet. Hands hot and dry, finger joints inflamed. Pains in first joints of fingers. Brittle fingernails, felon. Hands drop things. Pain in upper arm, in shoulder, followed by pain in right shoulder, better pressure.

Sleep - Sleepiness in afternoon, evening, while driving. Insomnia from anxiety, from coldness. Anxious, restless sleep. Disturbed sleep, from anxiety, by cough. Unrefreshing sleep. Heavy or light sleep. Prolonged sleep. Sleeps curled up. Frequent waking with anxiety. Waking after midnight from chill. Waking too early.

Skin - Contraction, as if skin would burst. Itching blisters, eruptions, worse from soap. Eruptions from sun. Urticaria. Itching without eruptions. Stinging pain, as from needles and pins. Bitten, as if by an insect, like fleabites. Sensitiveness to touch. Warts. Radiant skin unnaturally.

Modalities - Better open air. Better after rain. Better hot bathing. Better after sex. Worse in afternoon.

Larynx - Cold sensation. Constriction. Voice, croaking.

Teeth - Chattering teeth. Sensitive, tender teeth, from brushing. Sore, bruised pain. Corroded sensation.

Tongue - Burning pain. Burnt sensation on sides of tongue. Pain on right side. Tongue yellow, white, heavily coated. Acute, metallic, sour taste. Loss of taste.

Kidneys - Stitching pain in right kidney. Male - Sexual desire diminished, wanting, or increased.

Temperature - Heat sensation, alternating with sensation of cold. Lack of vital heat. Chilly in general, especially in afternoon. Icy coldness of the body. Flushes of heat, with perspiration, in evenings, in room.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hippocampus kuda is found along the eastern coast of India and in the waters surrounding all of Indonesia up into the Sea of Japan. Alternating states. Desire to go outside, amelioration from open air. General fatigue and heaviness sensation. Oversensitive to noise, odors, and tastes. MIND - Mood swings. Alternating emotions. Aversion to company, yet aversion to being alone. Feels trapped. Claustrophobia.

Head - One sided headaches. Hearing - Muffled sounds. Hearing acute or impaired.

Ears - Roaring, ringing noises in the ear, vibrations. Ears feel clogged, as if filled with water, or as if under water (Kali-m.). Food - Desires fruit, juicy things, particularly melons. Worse from salt, salty foods and coffee.

Stomach - Nausea, comes in waves. As if seasick. Heartburn. Vertigo - Light headed feeling. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sep. Kali-m. REFERENCES - Sonz. Stewart.

Rectum - Involuntary stool, sudden urging to stool.

Male - Sexual desire diminished.

Back - Back pain, with heaviness in the back and neck. Stiffness in cervical region.

Limbs - Heavy, aching, tired, feeling in the extremities. Aching and cramping pains. Numbness.

Sleep - Difficulty going to sleep. Light and very restless sleep, with lots of waking at night. Wakes earlier in the morning. Wakes unrefreshed. Daytime sleepiness. Strong desire or need to nap. Short naps ameliorate (Phos.). Smell - Sensitive to strange or unpleasant odors.

PHARMACY - hipp. Hippomanes. Horse meconium. A meconium deposit out of the amniotic fluid taken from the Colt. Trituration of the dried substance taken from the tongue of a newly-born filly. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chills. Chorea. Headaches. Melancholy. Prostatitis. Rheumatism. Twitching. Wrist, paralysis.

HOMEOPATHIC - A famous aphrodisiac of the Greeks. Hering said it is soft, glutinous mucous substance of a urinous odor, which floats in the allantois fluid or is attached of the allantois membrane of the mare or cow, chiefly during the last months of pregnancy. Melancholy. Weakness, restlessness. Chilliness, better from being covered. Violent pain in wrists. Paralysis of wrist, in morning. Weakness of hands and fingers so that nothing can be held. Desire to lie down, but no relief on doing so. Headache, better lying on painful side, worse walking in sun. Sensation as if the head would fall forward on walking. As if a plug in the throat. Icy coldness in stomach. Sensation as if a swelling retarded the flow of the urine. MIND - Melancholy, has no use for the world. Doesn't want to have anything to do with the world. Homesickness in evening. Fear from noise. Desire to travel. Restlessness, must move from place to place. Aversion to being approached. Aversion to company. Inclination to sit. Sits in a corner. Sits still. Sits as if wrapped in deep sad thoughts and notices nothing. Averse to being spoken to. Wants to be let alone. Chest - Sharp pains in left side of chest. Eyes - Sharp pains in eyes. Painfulness of eyes when moving them with headache. Light of the candle looks blue.

Head - Pressive pain in temples. Violent headache, better when lying on painful side, worse when walking in sun. Head feels so heavy that it falls forward if he raises himself. Sensation of lightness. Dry hair, falling off of hair.

Nose - Sensation of coldness when drawing the air in. Nosebleed in morning.

Face - Involuntary twitching of under lip. Female - Menstruation too early. Food - Confusion betterfrom coffee. Desire for acids. Aversion to sweet things.

Mouth - Bitter taste in mouth. Tongue coated white with red tip. Increased secretion of saliva with headache or sore throat.

Throat - Larynx feels, raw, as if air were too cold. Tickling in throat when breathing. Painfulness of left tonsil. Sensation of plug in throat, left side. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Coffee. Caust. relieved the paralysis of wrist. Compare: (1) Caust. (2) Anae. - plug sensation. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer.

Stomach - Icy coldness in stomach. Nausea, in a draft of air. Sensation of emptiness in stomach and head. Nausea during headache.

Rectum - Spasmodic contraction of anal sphincter. Hard stool in balls. Soft stool with vomiting, discharge of prostatic fluid after urination.

Male - Sexual desire increased. Prostatitis. Drawing pain in testicles.

Limbs - Chorea. Weakness in joints of feet, knee, soles, hands and fingers. Paralysis of wrists. Violent pain in wrist. Sprained sensation in wrist. Weakness after growing too fast. Heaviness in limbs. Lungs - Barking cough during sleep.

Skin - Itching as from flannel on skin, worse or, chest and between shoulders. Hippomanes

Kidneys - Frequent discharge of watery urine. Urine discharge in a small stream with straining, feels as if a swelling retarded it, prostatitis. Drawing pain from anus through urethra.

Temperature - Chill, beginning in back, better being warmly covered in bed. Heat in evening with dull headache.

full:
PHARMACY - hippoz. Hippozaeninum. Glanders nosode. Glanderinum malleinum. Farcin. The nosode of glanders or farcy. Triturations of sugar of milk saturated with the virus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Bedsores. Boils. Bronchitis. Cancer. Carbuncles. Decay. Catarrh, chronic. Cold, chronic. Diphtheria. Elephantiasis. Erysipelas. Glanders. Glands, inflamed. Hip-disease. Liver, enlarged. Lupus. Nasal, cartilages, ulceration. Edema. Ozaena. Parotiditis. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Phlegmon. Plague. Pustules. Putrid, fever. Pyemia. Scrofula. Smallpox. Syphilis. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hippoz. is a powerful nosode introduced by Dr. Garth Wilkinson. The disease is called “Glanders” when the catarrhal symptoms are pronounced, “Farcy,” when these are not noticeable, the skin being chiefly affected with deposits in the lungs. Homeopathic preparations of both have been made. In horses, glanders affects the lungs and the upper respiratory tract, causing coughs and disseminated ulcerations and deposits throughout the lungs. Mallein, a toxin prepared from glanders, was used in veterinary practice as a test injection for deciding whether a horse suspected of glanders actually has the disease or not. Hippozaeninum If the horse reacts it is concluded there is glanders. In a number of cases in which animals reacted to the first injections, repetition of the test has failed to elicit reaction, thus suggesting that Mallein is curative as well as diagnostic. The nosode has been used by homeopaths, at the suggestion of Wilkinson, on the phenomena of the disease as guides. It has been used in a large number of cases involving low forms of suppuration and catarrh. Ma- lignant ulcerations and swellings, abscesses and enlarged glands and also in conditions similar in kind, but less in severity. Weakness, fatigue, general discomfort. General prostration with considerable emaciation. Numerous ecchymoses in internal organs. Inflammation of lymphatic vessels and swelling of glands. Phlegmasia alba dolens. Pyemia, erysipelas. Chronic rhinitis, bloody secretion. Symptoms suggesting tuberculosis, cancer, syphilis, etc. It promises useful service in the treatment of ozaena, scrofulous swellings.

Head - Fainting turns with headache. Inflammation of membranes of brain. Scattered abscesses in brain substance. Purulent collections between bones of skull and dura mater. Tubercles may appear in periosteum of skull in dura mater in plexus choroides. A diffused myelitis malleolus, attributable to infiltration. Bones of skull and face (frontal most) decayed. Hair loses its glisten.

Eyes - Full of tears or slime. Pupils dilated with collapse. Papules on choroid coat of eye.

Ears - Tinkling sounds in ears. Hoarse and deafness. Inflammation of parotid gland.

Nose - Cartilage exposed and decayed. Decay of nasal bones. Nose and mouth ulcerated. Swelling and redness of nose and adjacent parts, with severe pain. Discharge often one-sided, albuminous tough, viscous, discolored, gray, greenish. Bloody Hippozaeninum and offensive, acrid, corroding discharge. Obstinate catarrh. Chronic ozaena.

Face - Maxillary gland swollen, firmly attached to the maxilla, uneven, rugged, mostly painless, burning at times. Submaxillary and sublingual glands swollen and painful at times, abscesses are formed which open externally.

Mouth - Difficulty speaking. Tongue dry, thickly covered with a black, sooty deposit. Gums covered with a black, sooty deposit. Bleeding gums. Breath putrid. Ulcers in mouth. Buccal passages filled with tenacious lymph and mucus. Scrofulous swelling of left parotid gland in a child.

Throat - Hoarseness. Swollen tonsils closing posterior channels. Ulcerations on velum of palate. Upon mucous membrane of pharynx ecchymoses, redness, swelling, eruptions and foul ulcers. COMMENTS - Clarke used Hippoz. with excellent effects in cases of inveterate nasal catarrh and of glandular enlargement. The nasal affection may go on to ozaena, ulceration of nasal cartilages and bones. Papules and ulcerations in frontal sinuses, pharynx, larynx and trachea. Hoarseness. Old cases of bronchitis, especially in old persons where suffocation from excessive secretion seemed imminent. Bronchial asthma. Whooping cough. Long-lasting coughs. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Bacil., Syph., Variol. (2) The serpent poisons. (3) Aur.. Cadm-s., Kali-bi„ Hep., Psor. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Abdomen - Gastro-intestinal catarrh, indigestion, constipation in later stage, diarrhea. Spleen enlarged, filled with blood, softened and liquefied, of a grayish or dark color. Wedge-shaped abscess in spleen. Swollen inguinal glands. Coughs - Cough and obstructed respiration, resulting from scar contraction of mucous membrane of nose and larynx. Whooping cough. Severe cough with profuse expectoration.

Rectum - Colliquative diarrhea with a general cachexia and exhaustion precede the fatal termination. Constipation.

Male - Tubercles and abscesses of glans penis, testicles.

Female - Slimy discharge from vagina. Uterine phlebitis. Miscarriage. Hippozaeninum Food - Loss of appetite. Thirst excessive, especially with diarrhea.

Limbs - Obscure pain in limbs, mostly in muscles and joints. Swollen arm with sore finger. Phlegmonous and erysipelatous with pustules and ulcers. Hip-disease. Psoas and lumbar abscesses. Old. bad leg ulcers. Anasarca of lower limbs.

Sleep - Insomnia and great restlessness. Nocturnal delirium.

Skin - Erysipelatous erythema. Malignant erysipelas, particularly if attended by large formations of pus and destruction of parts. Confluent smallpox. Abscesses, pustules and ulcers over all of body. Ulcers have no disposition to heal, livid appearance.

Liver - Enlarged liver, signs of fatty degeneration. Hepatitis with gangrenous and ulcerative inflammation of gall-ducts. Lungs - Papules and ulcerations in frontal sinuses, pharynx, larynx and trachea. Bronchitis, especially in elderly persons, where suffocation from excessive secretion is imminent. Noisy breathing. Loud, snoring respiration before fatal termination, breath fetid. Tubercles, size of millet seed to a pea, of a gray, yellowish or reddish color. Tuberculosis, diminishes expectoration and recurring aggravations and checks liability to catarrhal disorders. Lung disease of cattle.

Kidneys - Tubercles and abscesses in kidneys. Albumen in urine, also leucine and tyrosine.

Pulse - Frequent and small pulse, 110 to 120. Retarded pulse.

Temperature - Frequent chilliness. Chills and fever in cases of abscesses and ulcers. Skin becomes cool with collapse. Fever when a series of abscesses follow in rapid succession. Putrid fever. Plague. May be tried in scarlatina, where odor of breath is putrid, mouth filled with tenacious lymph and mucus tonsils greatly swollen.

keynote:

CLINICAL - Arthritic pains. Backaches. Blepharitis. Chemosis. Cirrhosis. Dacryocystitis. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Gastritis. Headaches. Jaundice. Laryngitis. Menorrhagia. Migraine. Pimples.…
full:
PHARMACY - hip-ac. Hippuricum acidum. Hippuric acid. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Arthritic pains. Backaches. Blepharitis. Chemosis. Cirrhosis. Dacryocystitis. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Gastritis. Headaches. Jaundice. Laryngitis. Menorrhagia. Migraine. Pimples. Premenstrual syndrome. Vincent's angina.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hippuric acid is present in urine, very rarely as an amorphous and crystalline deposit. The proving was carried out in 1952-53 by Dr. W. B. Griggs on seven men and three women over a period of forty- five days using potencies ranging from lx to 6x. Its chief action is on the external tissues of the eyes and naso-pharynx, joint surfaces, liver and mucous membranes. Nasal secretion viscous, yellow evil-smelling. Inflammation of the throat with a dry cough, especially at night. Pain in the liver with bouts of nausea and ajaundiced complexion. Hyper-productivity of the ovarian follicles. Eruption of pimples on back, chest, legs. Severe headache on the right side, aggravated by heat and amelio- rated in the open air. General muscular soreness and tenderness. Muscular and joint pains in the shoulders, back, lower limbs. Right side is especially affected. Rheumatic and poisoned subjects. Allergic mesenchymatic with arthritic ten- dencies. Arthritic and tubercular conditions in elderly patients. Weak exhausted types. MIND - Concealed anxiety. Irritability.

Head - Dull, constant pain over right eye, worse in warm room. Dull aching, aggravated in warm room, ameliorated by fresh air. Occipital headaches, vertigo. Migraine.

Eyes - Eyelids inflamed and swollen, edema. Jaundiced, yellow conjunctiva. Painful inflammation, especially of the lower lid, on the right side. Dacryocystitis. Blepharitis. Chemosis. Visual complaints.

Ears - Buzzing in the ears.

Nose - Sensation of a blocked nose. Swelling over lower ethmoid bone. Sinusitis. Secretion thick, viscous, yellow, evil-smelling. Acute rhinitis. Adenoids. Nasal polyps.

Mouth - Offensive breath.

Throat - Acute laryngitis. Dry throat. Pain and difficulty in swallowing. Sore, raw, dry. foul odor, gummy exudate, thickness and infiltration of tissues around throat. Eructation with a lump in the throat. Exudation thick and membranous around the tonsils and the back of the throat. Gangrenous inflammation of throat. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Benzoic acid seems to be an analog. Benz-ac. - A uremic type with brown, strong urine, whitish, fetid diarrhea, joint pains especially in the big toe and Achilles' tendon. (2) Merc-cy. - Infectious, weak conditions. Diphtheria. Inflammation of the anus and rectum. Bad breath and cervical inflammation. (3) Guai. - Red, burning tonsillitis. Pleurodynia with a dry cough. Diarrhea resembling that of cholera. Joint pains. (4) Rhus-t. - Erythematous and vesicular rash. Muscular and joint pains, worse during rest, ameliorated by a change of position or by continued movement. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian.

Stomach - Feeling of a lump in the pit of the stomach. Lump in pit of stomach. Soreness and pressure over liver. Acid rising. Acrid belching. Nausea, vomiting, hepatic pains, especially when pressure is applied.

Abdomen - Pain and heaviness in the liver. Entero-colitis. Abscess beneath the diaphragm. Infectious epidemic jaundice. Cirrhosis. Acute cholecystitis.

Rectum - Diarrhea with watery, fetid stools.

Female - Premenstrual syndrome. Menstruation prolonged yet scanty. Menstrual flow for three weeks with complete relief of muscular and joint pains. Menorrhagia. Hyper-productivity of the ovarian follicle.

Chest - Pain on the right side of the chest when coughing.

Back - Lumbar aching, especially at the end of the day. Backache extending down hips. Breasts - Breasts painful during menses.

Limbs - Pain in shoulders and limbs. Pain in middle of thigh posteriorly shooting down right leg. Sore, swollen joints. Tired, grating sensation in the joints. Lungs - Cough dry, irregular, gasping, worse at the end of the day. Dry rightsided pleurisy.

Skin - Itching, burning, tingling and shuddering sensations. Yellow coloring of the skin. Eruption of spots and pimples, on the back, chest and legs. Papules looking like goose flesh on chest. Erythema.

Modalities - Better in the open air. Better with pressure. Worse in a warm room, heat. Worse with movement. Worse in late afternoon or at night.

Kidneys - Hot, pungent urine, smelling strongly.
