PHARMACY - kali-bi. Kali bichromicum. Potassium bichromate. Red Chromate of Potash. Bichromate of Potash. Potassium dichromate. Potasse bichromas. Solution in distilled water. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Anemia. Asthma. Blotches. Bone, disorders. Bronchitis. Burns. Cachexia. Catarrh. Coccyx, pain. Conjunctivitis. Constipation. Cornea, opacities. Colds. Coryza. Descemetitis. Duodenum, ulcers. Dyspepsia. Ears, inflammation. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Eyes, inflamed. Farcy. Gastric, ulcer. Glanders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gout. Hay fever. Headache. Intermittent, fever. Intestines, ulceration. Iritis. Keratitis. Leucorrhea. Lumbago. Lupus. Measles. Menopausal, flushes. Migraines. Mucus, plugs. Mumps. Nasal, congestion. Neuralgia. Nightmares. Nodes. Nosebleeds. Nose, soreness. Obesity. Ophthalmia. Ozaena. Polyps. Post- nasal, catarrh. Pruritus, vulvae. Rheumatism. Rhinitis, atrophic. Sciatica. Scrofula. Sinusitis. Smell, illusions. Sun-headache. Sycosis. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tobacco, intolerance. Trachea, disorders. Ulcers. Urethritis. Warts. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-bi., with the other chromium preparations, Chr-ac. and Chr- ox., was introduced into the Materia Medica by Dr. J. Drysdale. All chromium salts are derived from potassium bichromate, which is manufactured in large quantities from chrome-iron-ore. The association of chromium with ferrum is noteworthy. The bichromate is largely used in dying, calico-printing, wood staining, photography and as a solution for producing the current in electric batteries. Many symptoms were obtained from workmen engaged in the preparation of the salt, some of which had been noted before Drysdale studied the drug. Drysdale published his first proving in 1844 in the British Journal of Homeopathy. The Austrian Society proved it the following year. Kali-bi. has an affinity for the mucus membranes of the air passages, nose, pharynx, stomach and duodenum. Keynote thick, sticky, ropy, stringy, tough, yellow, green mucus discharges. The mucus adheres to the part and can be drawn out in strings. Formation of crusts on mucus membranes and skin. Membranes look furred. Catarrh of pharynx, larynx, bronchi and nose and atough, stringy, viscid secretion is produced. Perforation of the nasal septum. Chronic atonic catarrh. Ozaena. Shooting from root of nose to external angle of eye, begins in the morning, increases to noon, and ceases toward evening. Itching in vagina, ear, lungs etc. As if a hair on tongue, in nostrils etc. Sore throat. Yellowness of discharges, eyes, vision tongue etc. Keratitis and iritis. Epilepsy, ropy saliva from mouth during convulsions. Dilatation of stomach and heart. Ulcers on the skin, mucus membranes and bones. Ulcers with dark dots, deep, perforating, round, punched out with over-hanging edges or thick crusts. Septic or peptic ulcers. Stubborn suppurations, inflammations. Polyps. Bone-pains and nodes. Pains wander from part to part. Diagonal pains. Pains migrate quickly from place to place and finally attack the stomach. Pains occur in small spots. Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Sharp stitching pains. Neuralgia, daily at the same hour. Weakness and weariness after pains. Cracking of joints. Alternating and shifting conditions. Headache alternates with blindness. Rheumatic pains alternate with gastric symptoms or with dysentery. Ascending symptoms, gastric pains, chills, heat etc. Plastic or fibrous exudations spread downwards. Sensation of heaviness in different parts. Indolent or sluggish reaction in many conditions. Diseased conditions progress slowly but deeply, causing great weakness bordering on paralysis but little fever. More adapted to sub-acute rather than the violent acute stage. Sickly, chilly and cachetic. Affections of autumn and spring. Complaints of hot weather. “ Great liability to take cold in open air,” and “ moderately cold air is felt very unpleasantly.” Eruptions begin in warm weather (opp. Rhus-t.). Sun headaches. Secondary and tertiary syphilis. Syphilitic rheumatism. Kali-bi. as “chrome-water” was also remarkably successful. It been used as a local application for ulcers in very weak solutions, about 1 to 2,000. MIND - Mentally ill-humored and low in spirit. Listless. Indifference to business affairs. Indolent, aversion to mental and physical exertion. Weak memory, vanishing thoughts. Impatience. Irritability, sadness, better after eating. Anxiety arising from chest. Anxiety before menses. Anthropophobia. Avoids human society. Doesn't recognize his relatives. Senseless staring at an object. Feeling as if losing their reason. Talks to himself. Abdomen - Stitches in region of liver and spleen, through to spine. Feeling of constriction from liver to shoulder (right). Cutting pain in abdomen, soon after eating. Cutting pains to loins, cannot walk, extends to groins. Chronic intestinal ulceration with vomiting and emaciation. Painful retraction, soreness and burning. As if something eating in bowels.

Head - Periodical headaches with vertigo and nausea. Headaches, over eyebrows, preceded by blurred vision. Headache with persistent retching and vomiting of food, bile. Migraines in small spots and from suppressed catarrh. Violent headache from occiput to forehead if nasal discharge ceases. Blindness, followed by violent headache, over eyebrows or outward along the brows. Headache, worse from cold, sinus congestion. Headache better pressing at the root of the nose, better from warm soup. Sensation as if a solid block in forehead. Sinus headache with stopped-up sensation in nose. Violent shooting pains from root of nose. Aching and fullness in glabella. Sharp pains in bones. Bones of head feel sore. Frontal pain, usually over one eye. Dull, heavy throbbing above eyes, as if head would burst. Supraorbital neuralgia, right side. Eczema of scalp, raw and oozing a thin moisture which dries into yellow scabs. Eruption of painful small boils on back of head.

Eyes - Descemetitis with only moderate irritation of eye. Dense opacities of cornea. Ulcers on cornea, no pain or photophobia. Conjunctiva, yellow, puffy, covered with yellow-brown spots. Conjunctivitis, granular lids with pannus. Iritis with punctate deposits on inner surface of cornea. Slight pain with severe ulceration or inflammation (Con. opposite.). Ropy and yellow discharge. Eyelids, swollen, winking during convulsions, itching, granular. Eyelids twitch on opening. Supra-orbital neuralgia, right side. Photophobia only by daylight.

Ears - Redness. Eruption covering both ears. Violent tickling in ears. Sharp stitches in ears. Swollen ear with tearing pains. Pulsating in ears at night, external meatus swollen and inflamed. Stinging from external meatus into internal ear. Lancinating pain, chronic suppuration. Thick, yellow, stringy, fetid discharge. Tympanum perforated. Ulcers upon tympanum. Stitches in left ear and left parotid gland, during headache.

Nose - Pressure and pain at root or bridge of nose. Nose feels heavy, dry. Sinusitis with distress and fullness at root of nose. Chronic rhinitis. Profuse, watery nasal discharge. Nasal discharges, thick, stringy, ropy, lumpy, sticky, greenish, yellow, acrid. Post-nasal drip of thick mucus (Hydr.). Much hawking of thick mucus. Coryza with obstruction of nose. Ozaena. Suppressed catarrh. Fetid smell from retention of discharge in nose. Loss of smell. Violent sneezing, worse in the morning. Tickling as from a hair in left nostril. Inability to breathe through nose. Large mucus plugs. Tough, elastic plugs, leave a raw surface. Clinkers in nose. Snuffles, especially in overweight children. Nasal septum ulcerates, round ulcer. Abscess. Thick, dark red blood from nose. Nasal polyps. Sensation as if two loose bones were rubbing together on blowing the nose. Nasal diphtheria. Expired air feels hot.

Face - Pale, yellowish, blotchy, red, florid. Acne (Kali-br., Kali-ar.). Mumps on the right side. Sweat on upper lip. Bones sensitive, especially beneath orbits.

Mouth - Dry mouth, better by drinking cold water. Sticky mouth. Dry, viscid saliva. Sweet, metallic, taste. Tongue glistens, cracked, red, dry, shining, smooth or heavy, lemon yellow, furred in dysentery. Tongue thickly coated, broad, flat, indented. Tongue pains at the root when protruded. As of a hair on back part of the tongue, not better by eating or drinking. Aphthous ulcers deeply corroding. Toothache, radiating with swelling of the glands.

Throat - Dry, burning and rough. Burning, extending to the stomach. Fauces red and inflamed. Tickling in larynx with cough and belchings, then vertigo, worse eating, better heat. Fissured pharynx. Aphthae. Something sticks in with pain into neck and shoulders. Throat pains when putting the tongue out. Voice is hoarse, worse evening. Catarrhal laryngitis, cough has a brassy sound. Hawks up thick mucus, must wipe it away. Diphtheria with profound prostration and soft pulse. Tough and stringy dischargefrom mouth and throat. Sensation of choking on lying down. Uvula relaxed, edematous, bladder-like. Pseudo membranous deposit on tonsils and softpalate. Parotidglands swollen. Tonsils swollen with deafness in children.

Stomach - Dilatation of stomach. Gastritis. Sore spot in stomach or food lies like a load. Feels as if digestion had stopped. Round ulcer of stomach. Nausea with heat in the body, better eating and open air. Nausea with burning in anus and erections. Nausea and vomiting after beer. Regurgitates liquids. Vomiting more than he drinks of bright, yellow water. Gastric symptoms are relieved after eating, and the rheumatic symptoms reappear.

Rectum - Sensation of a plug in anus. Periodic constipation with pain across the loins and brown urine. Dysentery, tenesmus, stools are brown, frothy. Stools, jelly-like, gelatinous, worse mornings.

Urine - Scanty, high-colored urine, with a white film and copious whitish sediment and pain in back. Urine alkaline and ropy. Ropy mucus in urine. Hematochyluria. Bloody urine and pain in back. Vertigo - Vertigo in many complaints, on stooping or when rising from a seat. Vertigo with nausea and inclination to vomit. Vertigo followed by vomiting of acid, white mucus fluid. Vertigo better from walking in open air. Vision - Dim vision, confused, during vertigo. Blindness before headache, sight returns with the increasing headache. Vision seems crossed, better looking with one eye. Sees double. Figures vanish on looking at them. All objects seem to be enveloped in a yellow mist. Yellow sight. Sees various colors and bright sparks. COMMENTS - Characteristic formation of large mucus plugs orclinkers on membranes, especially in the nose. This may be regarded as an advanced stage of the stringy mucus secretions. Formation of false membranes in croup and diphtheria with hoarse, metallic cough. Formation of casts of the bronchial tubes in fibrinous bronchitis. Sinus infections, sinusitis, nasal discharges. Sinusitis after a cold, particularly if a history. Keynote of thick yellow-green mucus that can be so thick that they may not be able to blow it out. Viscous, sticky, lumpy, stringy mucus (Hydr., Puls., Merc.). Mucus in lumps, can have blood. Jelly-like mucus. Loss of smell. Severe pain at the root of the nose when the discharge stops. Sinusitis with bone pains in the face. Very severe sinus headaches. Headaches over the eye or at the root of the nose. Severe headaches with suppressed discharge. Blinding migraine headaches, severe pain (Iris, Nat-m.). Pains over either eye, often followed by sinus congestion. Mucus in the chest, difficult to expectorate (Caust., Ant-t.). Copious mucus in the lungs, especially in the bronchioles. Gelatinous mucus in the elderly, coughed up in the morning, dark green, jelly mucus. Cough with stringy, difficult expectoration. worse early morning. A pain from mid sternum through to back. Brassy cough. Coughs up sticky mucus. Cough caused by eating. Sensation as if a hair on the back part of the tongue or in the left nostril. Wet asthma (Kali-c., Puls., Ant-t.). Asthma in children, stringy mucus that relieves. Otitis media with a discharge (Merc.). Stringy vomit. Vaginitis with stringy discharge. Stringy breast milk. Circular ulcers, as if someone punched them out of the skin. Ulcers from burns. Sores and ulcers that don't heal with ropy mucus. Internal and external ulceration. Shifting pains and sudden pains (Lac-c.). Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Diagonal pains. Localized pain. Stinging pains all over. Pains in short jerks as if a nerve were suddenly pulled. Cramps in various parts. Twitches in hands and feet. Arthritis with wandering pains or pains in small spots. Joints crack with arthritis. Rheumatic-like or shooting and pricking pains. Rheumatic pains were worse and the gastric pains better after eating. Great prostration, discomfort, debility and desire to lie down. Neuralgic attacks, recurring every day, at the same hour. Epilepsy with a flow of tough, stringy fluid from the mouth during the attacks. Vertigo with many complaints, on stooping or rising from a seat. Mentally ill-humored and low in spirit. Listless, aversion to mental and physical exertion. Weak memory, vanishing of thoughts. Anxiety arising from chest. Swollen abdomen immediately after a full meal. Food lies like a load, as if digestion were suspended. Weight in pit of stomach immediately after eating, flatulence. Severe diarrhea, stools are lumpy, mucus and jelly- like substances. Odorless stools. Painful vomiting, sour, mixed with clear mucus, may be bitter from the presence of bile. Vomiting from attempt to eat or drink, with distress and burning rawness about the stomach. Vomiting in alcoholics, especially beer- drinkers. Gastric ulcers. Aversion to meat, desires for beer, acid drinks. Beer and malt liquors aggravate, more pronounced in hot weather, autumn, and spring. Chronic effects of drinking too much malt liquor, especially lager beer. Some of the workmen found they could not drink coffee as it made them worse and they were obliged to take to tea instead. This bears out Hering's dictum that “winedrinkers shou Id take coffee and beer drinkers should take tea.” Coffee antidotes wine and tea antidotes beer. W. J. Pierce recorded the case of James S., 40. For four months past, as soon as he swallowed food (not liquids), a tickling in the throat excited a severe cough, which stopped only on vomiting and was followed by a watery coryza. This was so distressing that for two months he had eaten only two meals a day. There was pharyngeal catarrh with stringy mucus hanging from naso-pharynx. Kali-bi. 1c, a tablet every two hours, was given. He had no more vomiting and only coughed twice in the next five days and was soon quite cured. J. B. Garrison recorded the rapid action of Kali-bi. in two cases of intermittent fever on an indication given to him by Martin Dischere. Dischere once mistakenly took an overdose of Kali-bi., which was followed by vomiting of a large quantity of bright yellow water, tasting very bitter. Garrison's first case was that of a laborer, ill amonth with fever, pains and paroxysm at 1 p.m. Just before Garrison saw him he had vomited “a large quantity of bright yellow water.” Kali-bi. lx, one grain dissolved in a tumbler of water, a teaspoonful every two hours, cured at once. The second case was that of a woman who had been nine months under allopathic treatment. She had not been out of the house for two months and had been told she could not recover. Among other symptoms, she vomited much more than she drank. In the morning, she vomited a large bowlful of bright yellow fluid. Goullon gave the case of an enormously fat man of “formless colossal body” who complained of chronic accumulation of phlegm. He seemed fairly filled up with it, especially in the morning, for which all domestic remedies and mineral waters had been given in vain. Kali-bi. 2x was ordered, a few grains in hot water every evening. In two weeks, the patient could resume his walks. He felt easy on his chest, the accumulation of phlegm disappeared, his bowels became regular instead of constipated. Kali-bi. is particularly suited to fat people. Storer cured with Kali-bi. a case of asthma in a man who noticed that the attacks were caused by and always followed sex. Kali- bi. was prescribed on other indications, but this symptom must be noted. Marked worse from sex and from emissions. Nash related a cure with Kali-bi. 30c, in which a women had deep, punched-out ulcers with regular edges. One of them had perforated the soft palate and threatened the whole palate. It had a syphilitic appearance and also a stringy discharge, but not to a great amount. In three weeks, the local condition entirely healed and the patient's general state improved correspondingly. H. W. Champlin cited a case of chronic rheumatism in a woman over 70. She was restless and sleepless at night and Rhus-t. relieved this somewhat. Closer investigation brought out that the pains changed rapidly from one place to another and that they occupied small spots that could be covered with the point of a finger. Kali-bi. cured rapidly. Grimmer noted that the anemia and cachexia in its pathogenesis, together with the fact that it has cured lupus, puts this remedy in the anticancer group. It affects the skin and mucus membranes (the internal skin) markedly. Catarrhal and rheumatic states are prominent features calling for its use. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Ars., Lach. Compare: ( 1) Ant-t., Brom., Hep., Ind., Calc., Ant-c. (2) In the production of false membranes: Brom., Caust., Sul-ac., Ip. (3) Oxyg., Caust., Kali-c. - fat subjects. (4) Kali- i.,Nit-ac. - syphilis. (5) Bor. - croup, fair subjects. (6) Mez., Sil., Phyt. - bone diseases. (7) Hydr. and Iris. - viscous, tough secretions. (8) Sep. andTeucr. “clinkers.” (9) Puls. - wandering rheumatism, gonorrheal rheumatism, pains worse in warm room, measles, catarrhal deafness, swelling of salivary glands. (10) Coc-c., whooping cough, mucus, clear stringy, Kali-bi. yellow stringy. Rhus-t. - better of pain on moving affected part, Rhus-t. has better by warmth, eruptions of Kali-bi. begin in hot weather, those of Rhus-t. in cold. ( 11) Sulph. - sensation of hair in throat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Grimmer. Murphy. Phatak.

Male - Pricking and itching at glans penis. Itching and pain of penis with pustules. Ulcers with paroxysmal stitches, aggravated at night. Syphilitic ulcers with cheesy, tenacious exudation. Chancres ulcerating deeply. Constriction at root of penis, at night, on waking. Gleet with stringy or jelly-like profuse discharge, clogging the urethra. Prostatic fluid escapes during stool. Stitches in prostate when walking, must stand still. Erections (Pic- ac.). Sexual desire absent in fleshy persons.

Female - Menses too early, with vertigo, nausea and headache. Menses with suppression of urine or red urine. Membranous dysmenorrhea. Yellow, green tenacious leucorrhea. Leucorrhea, acrid, yellow, ropy with pain across sacrum. Leucorrhea that can be drawn out in long strings. Subinvolution of uterus. Prolapsed uterus, worse hot weather. Pruritus of vulva, with great burning and excitement. Itching, burning of vulva with sexual excitement. Soreness and rawness in vagina. Swelling of genitals. Vomiting during pregnancy. Food - Desire for acid foods and drinks. Desires beer and malt liquors, but they aggravate. Dislikes water. Cannot digest meat. Overeats.

Chest - Pressure and heaviness on chest, as from a weight. Stitches in sides of chest. Pain at trachea bifurcation, on coughing from mid-sternum to back. Burning, pain at sternum. Rawness under sternum. Itching behind sternum, causes violent, racking, paroxysmal cough. Constitutions - Adapted to fat, fair, fleshy, light complexioned persons, subject to catarrhs or with syphilitic or scrofulous history. Suited to sluggish people and fair-haired, fat persons, especially fat, chubby children.

Heart - Weak heart. Dilated with kidney lesions, insufficiency of aortic valves. Pricking in region of heart. Cold feeling around heart (Kali-n.). Pressure on heart after eating. Pulsation felt in all the arteries. Palpitations with rattling in throat, during cough. Pulse irregular, small, contracted, with nosebleed.

Back - Violent aching. Stiffness of neck worse bending head forward. Stabbing pain from third cervical to fifth dorsal vertebra. Stitches at lower angle of left scapula. Aching in back and down left side into hip. As if something cracked across sacrum, worse stooping. Pain in coccyx and sacrum extending up and down, worse walking, sitting and touching it. Coccyx pains before urination, better after. Cutting through loins, cannot walk.

Limbs - Pain, swelling, stiffness and crackling of all joints. Pains fly rapidly from on^place to another (Kali-s., Puls.). Pains in small spots (Ox-ac.). Wandering pains along the bones, worse cold. Bones feels sore and bruised. Tearing pains in tibia. Shin bones, painful, periostitis from blow. Very weak limbs. Paralytic weakness of hands. Syphilitic rheumatism (Mez.). Rheumatic pains worse eating. Rheumatic pain in hip joints and knees. Heaviness of legs. Left-sided sciatica, better motion and flexing the leg, worse standing, sitting or lying in bed. Pain in tendons of muscles of calf, as if stretched, causes lameness. Achilles tendon swollen and tender. Left ankle as if dislocated. Pain along border of the foot. Soreness of heels when walking.

Sleep - Drowsiness in open air. Great inclination to stretch and yawn. During sleep frequent starts, incoherent talk, tossing of arms. Unrefreshing, feels debilitated in limbs. Wakened by dyspnea, palpitation. Wakened with desire to urinate. Worse on waking.

Skin - Skin is hot, dry and red, better cool air. Brown spots. Acne. Lupus with burning. Burning, tingling in skin. Herpes zoster. Blisters on soles. Skin eruptions, worse summer. Dryness of skin, with itching of whole body. Itching with vesicular eruption. Papular eruptions. Pustular eruption, resembling smallpox with burning pains. Pustules with black tops. Ulcers with punched-out edges. Ulcers with tendency to penetrate and tenacious exudation. Ulcers painful in cold weather. Depressed, round scars after healing of eruptions or ulcers.

Modalities - Better from heat, wrapping up, pressure, motion, short sleep. Skin symptoms better cold weather. Open air ameliorates, especially vertigo, but aggravates the gastric complaints and chilliness. Worse from cold, damp, open air, spring, hot weather. Worse from undressing, stooping, sitting, after sleep, morning, 2 a.m. to 3 a.m. Worse from suppressed catarrh, protruding tongue, alcohol, beer. Worse by eating, causes cough, weight in stomach.

Liver - Soreness in right hypochondrium, fatty infiltration of liver and increase in soft fibrous tissue. Lungs - Acute capillary bronchitis. Chronic bronchitis. Bronchial dilatation with fetid breath and expectoration. Dry, metallic, hacking cough. Cough with pain in sternum, extending to shoulders, worse when undressing. Profuse, yellow expectoration, very glutinous and sticky, coming out in a long, stringy and very tenacious mass. Cough better expectoration. Membranous croup, extending to larynx and sinuses. Asthma worse from sex. Wheezing, panting on awaking, then cough which forces him to sit up, bent forward. Wheezing at night after whooping cough. Wheezing with retching and expectoration of tough mucus, which can be drawn in strings to the feet.

Kidneys - Heaviness sensation in kidneys. Constant aching. Shooting in kidney region with suppressed urine and prostration. Sharp shooting, first in left then right kidney. Congestion of kidneys. Nephritis with scanty, albuminous urine and casts. Pyelitis, urine with epithelial cells, mucus, pus or blood.

Bladder - Continuous desire to urinate during day. Frequent discharge of watery urine, of strong smell, awaking him at night. Burning in urethra. Stitches in urethra after urinating. After urinating a drop seems to remain which cannot be expelled. Urethra becomes clogged up. Suppression of urine following cholera. Breasts - Milk is stringy, watery. Causations - Ill effects from indulgence in beer and malt liquor.

Perspiration - Cold sweat on forehead, hands, feet and thighs. Perspiration on back during effort at stool. Profuse sweats while sitting quietly.

Temperature - Hot flushes, followed by sticky sweat, then chill. Burning of upper part of body and face with internal chilliness and violent thirst. Chilliness alternating with flushes of heat. Chill with sweat. Cold sweat on hands and feet. Attacks of chilliness from feet upwards, and sensation as if skull on vertex became contracted, in frequently returning paroxysms. Chilliness in back, with sleepiness. Chills with giddiness and nausea, followed by heat. Sensation of coldness and trembling.

name: Kali Bromatum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better when busy mentally and physically. Skin better in cold weather. Worse from mental exertion. Worse from emotions, anger, fright, worry, grief. Worse at night. Worse at 2 a.m. Worse periodically, new moon. Worse at summer, hot weather. Worse from puberty. Worse before, during and after menses. Worse unsatisfied sexual desire. Worse sexual excess. Cough worse lying down..
constitution: Acne. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Amnesia. Aphasia. Asthma. Backache. Cholera, infantum. Chorea. Chordee. Colic. Convulsions. Delirium. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes mellitus. Epilepsy. Erythema nodosum. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Imbecility. Impotency. Insanity. Insomnia. Laryngeal, spasms. Laryngismus. Locomotor, ataxia. Mania. Manic depression. Melancholy. Memory, weakness. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagi

full:
PHARMACY - kali-br. Kali bromatum. Potassium bromide. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Albuminuria. Alcoholism. Amnesia. Aphasia. Asthma. Backache. Cholera, infantum. Chorea. Chordee. Colic. Convulsions. Delirium. Delusions. Depression. Diabetes mellitus. Epilepsy. Erythema nodosum. Headaches. Hemorrhoids. Imbecility. Impotency. Insanity. Insomnia. Laryngeal, spasms. Laryngismus. Locomotor, ataxia. Mania. Manic depression. Melancholy. Memory, weakness. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Nightmares. Night-terrors. Nose, eruption. Numbness. Nymphomania. Ovaries, disorders. Paralysis. Parkinson's disease. Pityriasis. Polyps, rectal. Prostration. Psoriasis. Schizophrenia. Screaming. Sebaceous, cysts. Seborrhea. Self-abuse. Senility. Sensibility, loss. Sleeplessness. Sleepwalking. Speech, disorders. Sterility. Strokes. Syphilis. Tabes dorsalis. Tetanus. Uremia. Urine, incontinence. Uterine, fibroids. Vaginismus. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Like all potash salts, this weakens the heart and lowers temperature. Causes brominism. Symptoms of allopathic overdoses are added to the proving symptoms and the clinical experience of homeopaths. Alberton noted that Kali-br. has been given allopathically in epileptic and other convulsive disorders with the idea of overwhelming the disease rather than of curing it. The effect has been to reduce or prevent the recurrence of epileptic attacks at the expense of keeping the patient constantly under the influence of the drug and producing a state of mental imbecility, “decreasing the excitability and power of the motor cells of the brain.” Hare noted that the keynotes for the bromides include general weakness and feebleness of the nervous system, posttyphoid and post-puerperal insanity, senile softening of the brain and irritation of the gastro- intestinal mucus membrane. Kali-br. affects the mind and nerves, producing failure of mental power, loss of memory. Melancholy. General numbness and anesthesia of mucus membranes especially of eyes, throat and skin. Skin eruptions, psoriasis. Acne, especially at puberty and at the menstrual period. Clarke knew of no remedy of such universal usefulness in cases of simple acne as in Kali-br. 30c. Moist eruptions and pityriasis of the scalp. Seborrhea. Erythema nodosum. Epilepsy, associated with sexual excess or abuse in men and with menses in women. Attacks during the new moon, followed by headaches. Onset of diseased condition is slow without any pain. Convulsions. Parkinson's disease. Numbness of whole body. Symptoms of strokes. Paralysis. Aphasia, somnolence and stertor. Loss of sexual desire. Sexual fantasies, satyriasis and nymphomania. Uremia. Albuminuria. Nodular form of chronic gout. Kali bromatum MIND - Brain fag from grief and anxiety. Failing brain-power (Anae., Bar-c., Phos.). Loss of memory. Forgetful on waking in morning. Senile softening of the brain. Weak memory, confused thoughts. Perception slow, answers slowly. Mistakes in speaking or writing. Confusion as to his identity, over daily affairs. Amnesic aphasia. Aphasia, from embolism of middle cerebral artery. Forgets how to talk, has to be told the word before he can speak it. Ailments after emotional excitement. Nervous irritability from severe illness or death of a friend, loss of property or reputation. Wrings hands, hands and fingers in constant motion. Feeling of helplessness, in afternoon. Fits of uncontrollable weeping. Extremely sensitive to pain. Fidgety, busy hands, fumbles in his pockets. Hurried when eating. Moves arms about wildly. Headstrong and haughty when sick. Domineering. Loss of self-confidence. Constant fear of breaking down under stress. Constant worry, fears to see people or to be spoken to. Fear of being alone, of his own shadow, to walk past certain corners, of a ringing doorbell. Fear of new people. Fear of insanity. Fear of being poisoned (Hyos.). Sadness in morning on waking. Melancholy, much concerned about health, complains without cause. Deep depression with painful delusions andpersistentinsomnia. Profound indifference and disgust for life. Suicidal depression, mania with trembling. Manic depression. Schizophrenia. Religious depression. Feeling of moral deficiency; want of moral feeling. Imagines he is singled out as an object of divine wrath. Dread of impending destruction of all near to her. Remorse, wrings hands, bursts into tears. Active delirium. Delirium with delusions. Paranoid delusions, thinks he is pursued. Suspicious, delusions of conspiracies, that his life is threatened. Delusion he will commit some great crime, that she will murder her children or husband, that her child is dead. Delusion that he is a devil. Hallucinations of sight and sound, with or without mania, precede brain and paralytic symptoms. Horrible visions, can't be comforted by friends. Mental symptoms after a stroke. Chronic alcoholism.

Head - Heaviness of head, confusion, slow speech, staggers as if drunk. Numbfeeling in head, worse occiput. Severe throbbing, aching, in occipital region. Headache from concussion of brain. Headache after epileptic attack. Migraine with flushed face, throbbing temples, injected conjunctiva, photophobia. Congestive headaches. Mercurial headache. Brain irritated. Anemia of brain from loss of fluids. Symptoms of apoplexy. Constrictive sensation in brain as if too tight. Drooping of head, cannot hold it erect. Incipient meningitis. Hydrocephalus. Scalp feels tight. Seborrhea. Pityriasis.

Eyes - Eyes sunken, lusterless, gaze fixed. Eyeballs move in every direction. Squinting after night terrors of children. Vision dim. Pupils dilated, with heavy lids and drowsiness. Vessels of fundus enlarged, conjunctiva congested.

Ears - Hardness of hearing. Ringing in ear. Sounds echo in ears, headache. Roaring synchronous with pulse, at night.

Nose - Smell impaired. Erythematous swelling of nose. Coryza with tendency to extension into throat. Thick mucus and yellow scabs in nostrils.

Face - Acne in young people. Acne worse before menses. Pimples on face, cheeks and forehead. Bluish- red eruptions. Itching pimples, pustules leave scars. Complexion yellow, cachectic. Face flushed. Face pale, appeared as one drunk with hallucinations. Expression wearied, anxious, dull, stupefied, imbecile, expressionless. Papular rash.

Mouth - Fetid breath, a peculiar sickening odor, profuse saliva. Suppressed salivation in teething children. Foul, salty taste. Loss of taste. Numbness. Difficult speech, stammering.

Throat - Congestion of uvula and fauces, then edematous. Anesthesia of fauces, pharynx and larynx. Hoarseness, extremely painful and disagreeable. Dryness of throat. Dysphagia of liquids, can swallow only solids, especially in children (Hyos.). Laryngismus stridulus, uncomplicated, from neurosis or reflex irritation. Spasmodic croup. Chronic catarrh. Diphtheria with quick pulse, fever, dry tongue, and offensive breath.

Stomach - Dyspepsia. Weakness of stomach. Persistent hiccough (Sul-ac.). Vomiting of all drinks and intense thirst, with cholera infantum. Vomiting with intense thirst after each meal. Vomiting of mucus. Hysterical vomiting after exciting emotions. Vomiting of alcoholics after a debauch. Morning sickness.

Abdomen - Abdomen sunken, almost stuck to vertebral column. Retraction of abdomen with spasms. Prostration. Ascites of hepatic or splenic origin. Flatulent colic. Colic in young children. Cutting colic. Internal coldness of abdomen during painless diarrhea. Sensation as if bowels were falling out. Trembling sensation in bowels. Enlargement of liver and spleen. Small tumor in region of spleen.

Rectum - Asiatic cholera, first stage, vomiting, cramps, rice-water discharges. Cholera infantum with reflex cerebral irritation, jerking and twitching of muscles. Persistent diarrhea, much blood expelled. Painless diarrhea, with great chilliness, even in a hot room. Constipation, stools very dry, hard and infrequent. Painful hemorrhoids. Blind hemorrhoids, intensely painful varices with black stools. Fissure of rectum and painful growths. Spasmodic stricture of sphincter ani. Rectal polyps. Sensations - Parts feel as if growing large. Paroxysms of numbness, feels as if needles were pricking him. Trembling sensation.

Stool - Green, watery, rice-water stools with rapid collapse, painless. Frequent, green, water stools, with violent abdominal spasms. Bloody mucopurulent diarrhea. Stools painless.

Male - Spermatorrhea. Chordee during gonorrhea. Effects of sexual excesses, especially loss of memory, impaired co-ordination, numbness and tingling in limbs. Lessened desire, debility and impotence, with melancholy, epilepsy, nervous prostration. Lascivious fancies and dreams. Erections at night, with backache, uncontrollable fidgetiness. Impotence with melancholy, loss of memory, nervous prostration, epilepsy. Excessive sexual desire with constant erections at night. Satyriasis. Sexual excitement during partial slumber.

Female - Menses scanty. Epileptic attacks at or near menstrual periods. Menorrhagia with strong sexual desire. Headache, insomnia, and heat in genitals after menses. Metrorrhagia. Flooding in young women with sexual desire. Sterility from excessive sexual indulgence. Sexual feeling lost. Aversion to sex (Sep.). Excessive sexual desire during menses. Nymphomania during puerperal state. Pruritus of external genitals. Voluptuous itching, tingling and irritation in external genitals. Ovarian neuralgia. with great nervous uneasiness from ungratified sexual desire. Cystic tumors of ovaries. Ovarian swelling, tenderness of left ovary. Uterine fibroids. Induration of uterus. Enlargement of uterus. Subinvolution. Vaginismus. Convulsions during labor. Painful heat flushings and congestion to head during menopause. Food - Taste foul, salty, lost. Intense thirst with dry mouth. Dysphagia of liquids (Hyos.). Troublesome pressure at stomach after diner, lassitude. Anorexia.

Chest - Burning in chest. Tightness of chest when breathing. Constitutions - Nervous constitutions. Children who can swallow solids with ease from birth, yet choke when they try to drink.

Heart - Weakens the heart and lowers temperature. Feeble heart with intermitting action. Action of heart slow and fluttering. Heart's beat weak, sounds distant and feeble. Pulse, accelerated, later becomes slower and small. Cardiac neuroses from spinal or uterine irritation.

Back - Backache, tired lameness of legs. Tabes dorsalis from sexual excesses. Causations - Ill effects of worry, anger, fright, emotional disturbance. Chorea from fright. Loss of business, reputation and embarrassment. Illness or death of a near friend. Sexual excess, sexual abuse.

Limbs - Jerking and twitching of muscles. Fidgety hands, busy twitching of fingers. Hands and fingers in constant motion. Trembling of hands during voluntary motion. Unsteady gait. Cannot stand erect, legs weak. Lungs - Asthma with dry cough, tosses arms about wildly. Asthma of nervous origin. Spasmodic asthma of children. Infantile capillary bronchitis with severe dyspnea. Pneumonia in alcoholics. Great dyspnea, breath hot, hurried. Spasmodic croup. Cough dry, fatiguing, hacking cough at night. Copious, whitish expectoration in torpid cases of bronchitis. Reflex cough during pregnancy.

Sleep - Extreme drowsiness. Insomnia. Sleeplessness due to worry, grief and sexual excess. Sleeplessness in anemic patients or nervous persons. Sleepless, restless can only calm herself by incessant occupation. Sleeplessness during convalescence from acute diseases. Restless sleep. Deep, profound sleep. Grinding teeth in sleep. Night terrors in children, awake screaming, unconscious, recognizes no one, followed by squinting. Sleepwalking in children. Waking with severe headache in a child. Horrible dreams.

Skin - Anesthesia of skin. Skin cold, clammy .Acne simplex andindurate, bluish red, pustular, worse on face and chest. Acne of face, cheeks and forehead. Pimples leave scars. Itching, worse on chest, shoulders and face. Psoriasis, syphilitic psoriasis. Moist eczema of legs. Moist eruptions, scars remaining after eruptions. Eruption of small boils in successive crops with troublesome itching. Large indolent, painful pustules, boils. Seborrhea. Pityriasis. Rose-colored eruption on lower limbs. Long lasting scrofulous ulcerations. Sebaceous cysts. Scars remaining after eruptions.

Modalities - Better when busy mentally and physically. Skin better in cold weather. Worse from mental exertion. Worse from emotions, anger, fright, worry, grief. Worse at night. Worse at 2 a.m. Worse periodically, new moon. Worse at summer, hot weather. Worse from puberty. Worse before, during and after menses. Worse unsatisfied sexual desire. Worse sexual excess. Cough worse lying down.

Teeth - Odontitis of children. Difficult dentition in children, with vomiting and diarrhea. Gums as if numb. Grinding teeth in sleep with moans and cries.

Tongue - Tongue protrudes with a jerk, chorea. Tongue is red, brown, dry, enlarged, tender. White tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if ground gave way, worse stooping. Vertigo with palpitations, nausea and even unconsciousness. Dizziness, noises in ear, nervous excitement, sleepless. Staggering gait. COMMENTS - Kali-br. has a very profound action on the generative organs and the mental side of the generative sphere causing sensual, lascivious fancies, satyriasis and nymphomania, and finally impotence and wasting of the sexual organs. Epilepsy, particularly cases associated with sexual excess or abuse in men and those in which the fits occur during or near the menstrual period in women. Epilepsy after fright, anger, or childbirth. Can be affected by phases of the moon. Headache after the attack. Spasms from fright, anger or emotions. Spasms in nervous, plethoric persons during childbirth. Staggering gait, ataxia, numbness and tingling in legs and spine with increase in sexual appetite. Paralysis with twitchings of the limbs. Fidgeting of the hands and feet (Hyos.). Reflexes are diminished and there is loss of general sensibility and also of certain parts, particularly fauces, larynx and urethra. Benumbed sensation of the brain. Schizophrenia, manic depression. Suicidal depression. Depressed, melancholic, uncontrollable weeping. Laughing and crying fits. Disordered faculties. Fear of going insane, fear of losing mental or emotional control. Memory loss, amnesia (Anae.). Aphasia. Chronic insomnia, especially in the elderly (Calc., Ars.). Insomnia due to worry, mortification, grief, financial shock and loss (Aur.). Restlessness and sleeplessness from worry. Drowsiness. Deep sleep may be broken by a start, though waking is very difficult. Confused dreams. Night terrors in children where they scream, without recollection of the terror (Tub., Calc.). Grind teeth and moan while sleeping. Sleepwalking. Cholera infantum with hydrocephalic symptoms. Dentition. Whooping cough. Bright's disease. Acne, particularly relating to hormonal changes. Sebaceous cysts and wens. Growths. Ovarian cysts, fibroids and fatty tumors. Uterine hemorrhage, with ovarian tumors. Metrorrhagia or menorrhagia, may arise from reflected irritation and may be accompanied with sexual excitement. Hering noted that Kali-br. is useful for “flooding, especially in young women.” Amory Hare noted that pulmonary edema or suffocative bronchitis may develop in the lungs. The patient may become cachectic and the condition can resemble typhoid fever. Wenzel Heyberger recorded a case of diabetes in a woman, 68, cured with Kali- br. The patient had been ill five months and was reduced to a skeleton. She first noticed a remarkably good appetite, but after meals had heartburn and belchings. She had polyuria and frequent disturbances at night to pass water. Weak in the head, confused, memory impaired. Vision was almost gone. Rushing and roaring in ears. Tormenting thirst. Stools difficult and delayed. Powders medicated with Kali-br. 2c were given, one every six hours. The first night the patient slept without disturbance and the quantity of urine and proportion of sugar diminished. After about six weeks, the improvement seemed to stop and Kali-br. was given in allopathic doses, but this aggravated the condition. Kali-br. 2c was resumed and the case went to a cure. Hale cured with Kali-br. many cases of cholera infantum and one case of “violent periodic umbilical colic, leaving tenderness on pressure.” The characteristic hour of recurrence was 5 p.m. Buford used it extensively in such cases and in potencies approaching the crude form. Kali-br. is more particularly adapted to persons inclined to obesity, to children, and to nervous women. More symptoms have been noted on the right side than on the left. RELATIONS - Kali-br. is Antidoted by: Vegetable acids, oils, Camp., Nux-v., Zinc. It antidotes: Lead poisoning. It follows well: Aeon, and Spong, in croup, Eug. in acne. Compare: (1) Camph. Am-br., Aur. (2) Bor. - night-terrors. (3) Kali-c. - persons inclined to obesity, also Am-c., Calc., Graph. (4) Kali- i. - acne, syphilis, Kali-p. and Calc. - night terrors. (5) Hyos. - mania, excited sensorium without inflammation of brain, fears being poisoned, sees ghosts, sexual excitement. (6) Plat. - sees ghosts, demons. (7) Arg-n. - fearful apprehensive mood, imagines cannot pass a certain point. (8) Glon. - fears being poisoned, also Rhus-t. (9) Staph. - mental depression, weakness of legs from masturbation. (10) Gels. - incoordination of muscles. (11) Con. - nervous cough during pregnancy. (12) Bov., Stram. - slow, difficult speech, stammering. ( 13) Ip. - cholera infantum. (14) Zinc. - fidgety restlessness, Zinc, of feet, Kali-br. of hands. (15) Tarent. - reflex symptoms, any little irritation such as dentition or indigestion may causes convulsions. Fidgety hands. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Diabetes mellitus (Ph-ac.).i Urethra numb, sensibility diminished. Incontinence of urine. Involuntary nocturnal emissions of urine. Neuralgia of neck of bladder. Urine profuse with thirst. Urine copious, pale, abundance of phosphates. Urine scanty, even suppressed in collapse. Urine dribbling a few drops at beginning of every stool.

Cough - Cough dry, hard and almost incessant. Dry, fatiguing, paroxysmal cough. Dry, spasmodic cough in weak, nervous children. Dry cough due to reflex action from stomach, intestines or uterus. Hacking cough at night. Whooping cough. Nervous cough during pregnancy.

Perspiration - Sweat abundant, viscid, all over, long lasting and exhausting (ague).

Temperature - Body cold, skin corrugated and mottled. Cold limbs. Shivering with cold and cold skin. Heat like cold stage, not very strongly marked. Head hot. feels as if in a furnace with coldness and chills. Chilliness in a hot room and itching during high fever. Painful hot flushing of the face during menopause.

Worse 2 a.m. to 4 a.m., lying on left side, lying on painful side. Worse exertion, sudden or unguarded motion, touch, stooping, sex. Worse soup, coffee, water, loss of fluids. Worse since pneumonia. Worse before menses, after childbirth, miscarriage..

full:
PHARMACY - kali-c. Kali carbonicum. Potassium carbonate. Potassic carbonate. Salt of Tartar. Solution. Trituration. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Anemia. Asthma. Axilla, perspiration. Backaches. Biliousness. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Chilblains. Colds. Coughs. Debility. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Ear, inflammation. Eyes, inflammation. Face, blotches. Fears. Freckles. Hair, disorders. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhage. Hemorrhoids. Hip joint disease. Hydrothorax. Hysteria. Kidneys, disorders. Larynx, catarrh. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Lumbago. Lungs, disorders. Menopause, disorders. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Pleurisy. Pleurodynia. Pneumonia. Pregnancy, disorders. Premenstrual, syndrome. Sciatica. Sleeplessness. Spinal, irritation. Stomach, disorders. Stomach, pain. Throat, sore. Toothaches. Tuberculosis. Typhoid. Urination, frequent. Urticaria. Uterus, cancer. Wens. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-c. is potassium carbonate. sometimes called “vegetable alkali," and existing in all plants. It was originally obtained from the ashes left after burning wood and vegetable structures, although it is not limited to vegetable structures. Kali-c. is typical of the Kali group of rem- Kali carbonicum edies. The potassium salts have an affinity for solid tissues and blood corpuscles. The fibrous tissues and ligaments of the joints, uterus and back are particularly affected. Tissues are often relaxed, joints give way, the back feels as if broken, the patient feels compelled to lie down or lean on something. Goullon specifically mentioned Kali-c. usefulness in chronic laryngeal catarrh and knee conditions. Useful for conditions of the uterus, heart, lungs, pleura, bronchi and larynx. Keynote sweat, backache and weakness. Weakness of the muscles, heart, the back, limbs, weakness of intellect. Useful for patients with vague symptoms, or for those who withhold their symptoms. Soft pulse, coldness. General depression. Soporific. Sharp stitching, cutting pains. Jerking, stabbing or catching pains, better by motion, worse during rest and lying on affected side. Stinging pains from within out, in muscles and internal parts. Throbbing pains, numbness or coldness of single parts, abdomen, fingers. Pain in small spot, on left side, on uncovered parts. Parts lain on are painful or go to sleep. Twitching of the muscles, rigidity and atony of the muscles. Convulsions, seems to pass off with belchings. Tendency to start with a loud cry, when touched, even lightly, especially in the soles, which leads a thrill throughout the whole body. Giving- out sensation. Tendency to dropsy. Bag-like swellings over the eyes, between the eyebrows and the upper lids. For fleshy, elderly people with dropsical and paretic tendencies. Fatty degeneration. Hypothyroidism. Tuberculosis. Tubercular diathesis. Old gouty cases, advanced Bright's. Discharges are profuse and acrid. Sudden unconsciousness. Closing of ulcers or fistulous openings, catching cold and over strain. Disposition to phlebitis. Goullon noted the importance of this polycrest in female complaints. It is similar to Sep., although it differs in having pains and trouble before protracted and frequent menses. Menopausal flushings, associated with disturbance of the heart, violent palpitations. Miscarriage, and the consequent debilitated states. Useful after labor. Sensitive to every atmospheric change and intolerance of cold weather. Early morning aggravation. Generally worse 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. MIND - Obstinate and dogmatic. Narrowminded, rigid, strong imprinted beliefs. Deep desire for routine, propriety. Impractical, stoic. Refusal to admit to sickness. May mislead others by acting healthier than they are. Antagonism with herself. Quarrels with family. Peevish and irritable, after sex. Impetuous. Desirefor company, yet treats them outrageously and worse from consolation. Alternating mood, at one time good and quiet, at another excited and angry at trifles. Frequently hopeful, frequently despondent. Indifference with bodily exhaustion. Sadness in open air. Great depression. Want of self-confidence. Mental dullness. Weakness of memory for expressing oneself. Impaired intellect. Absentminded, forgetful. At a loss to know how to say what she wishes. Sudden attack of unconsciousness. Sensation as if bed were sinking. Desire to be carried. Full offear and imaginations. Frightened from touch. Fear of death when alone. Imagines himself sick. Fears of the future, of the unknown, of ghosts. Fear of losing control. Kleptomania. Anxiety, in stomach. Anxious about his own diseased condition. Anxiety from flatulence when lying on right side. Anxiety, excitement when hungry. Nervous excitability, hysteria, sudden shrieking. Hypersensitive to pain, noise touch. Easily startled, starts when touched especially on feet, on dropping to sleep. Starting from noise. Never quiet or contented. Admonitions causes weeping. Weeping when telling of her sickness. Weeping with headache. Abdomen - Yellow, scaly spots on ab domen. Distension and coldness of abdomen. Hard, tympanitic and cold. Abdomen feels as if it would burst. Hard distension of abdomen with painfulness Kali carbonicum of umbilical region. Throbbing at navel. Much flatulence. Incarceration of flatus with colic. Pain from left side through abdomen, must turn on right side before he can rise. Cutting pain as if intestines were torn. Feeling as if a cold fluid passed through intestines during menses. Sensation of a lump rising from the abdomen, to throat and on coughing. Swelling of inguinal glands.

Head - Burning in top of head and soles of feet. Headache from riding in cold wind. Headache comes on with yawning. Wakes from headache. Headache into eyes, worse motion, sneezing, coughing, stooping, yawning. Headache better when raising the head and pressing the forehead. Headache on riding in carriage. Catarrhal, congestive headaches, better free discharge from nose. One-sided headache with nausea. Throbbing and humming. Sensation as if something loose in head, turning, twisting towards the forehead. Aching in occiput. Sharp pains in forehead, temples. Pressing as of a stone in forehead and vertex. Pressure and drawing tearing in forehead. Great dryness of hair. Hair, dry, falls out (Fl-ac.) from eyebrows, temples and beard. Painful tumors on scalp. Wens on scalp.

Eyes - Asthenopia. Sharp pains in eyes. Pressure in and above eyes. Eyes as if pressed inward, while reading. Soreness of external canthus, with burning pain. Small round ulcers on cornea. Painful sensation of light penetrating the brain on shutting the eyes. Deep pain in eyes, with lachrymation and photophobia. Lachrymation when yawning. Lids stick together in morning. Swelling of eyelids. Enormous bag-like swelling under and over eyes. Swelling of glabella between brows. Cold eyelids.

Ears - Stitches in ears from within outwards. Itching in ears. Purulent discharge from ears. Discharge of yellow liquid cerumen. Right ear is hot, left is pale and cold. Itching, cracking, ringing and roaring. Noises in ear with headache. Noise is disagreeable. Intolerance of human voice.

Nose - Swollen, hard, red, covered with pimples. Itching, burning in nose. Sore, scurfy, crusty nostrils. Ulcerated nostrils. Dryness of nose alternating with obstruction. Chronic catarrh. Chronic colds. Breathes through mouth. Obstruction better walking in open air. Stuffs up in warm room. Descending coryza. Coryza during menses. Post-nasal dripping (Spig.). Fetid, thick, fluent, yellow-green, crusty discharge. Bloody nasal mucus. Nosebleed on washing face in morning. Ulcerative pain in right nostril.

Face - Haggard, exhausted look. Bloated in morning. Pale, sickly, sallow with sunken eyes. Freckles. Light brown spots, old warts, papulous eruptions. Pimples on face and eyebrows, with redness and swelling. Inflammation and swelling of parotids. Swelling of lower jaw and submaxillary glands. Tearing stitches in cheek. Cramps in jaws. Drawing pain in face. One cheek hot, the other cold. Scurf on upper lip. Lips peel, chapped.

Mouth - Offensive odor from mouth every morning, like old cheese. Much saliva constantly in mouth. Bad, slimy taste. Mouth covered with painful, burning vesicles. Aphthae. General dryness of mouth without thirst, with stricture of esophagus in gastritis. Sticking and biting in posterior portion of palate. Burning, soreness or painful pimples on tip of tongue. Gums separate from teeth. Itching in gums, pus oozes out.

Throat - Dry, parched, rough. Hoarseness and loss of voice. Stricture of esophagus. Swallowing difficult, food slowly descends, remains halfway in esophagus with gagging and vomiting. Small particles of food go easily in windpipe. Sticking pain as from fish bone or splinters. Stinging pain when swallowing. Sore throat, always takes cold and the cold settles in throat. Throat feels as if squeezed, as if lungs came into throat. Catarrhal aphonia with violent sneezing. Scratching and stinging in throat and chest during cough. Hawks up tough mucus in morning. Tonsils enlarged. Swelling of cervical glands.

Stomach - Anxiety felt in stomach. Easy choking when eating. Gagging. Fullness even after little drink or food. Feeling of lump in pit of stomach. Stomach feels as if it would burst. Constant feeling as if stomach were full of water. Epigastric pain to back. Epigastrium is very sensitive externally. Gastric disorders from ice water. Dyspepsia of old people, burning acidity, bloating. Everything eaten seems to turn into gas. Flatulence, distended and sensitive. Salty, sour regurgitation. Sour belchings. Sour eructations before menses. Nausea on every inward emotion. Nausea with faintness and anxiety. Nausea, better lying down. Nausea at sight of food, in morning. Vomiting of sour mucus, ingesta and slime. Nocturnal vomiting of food. Nausea during pregnancy. Stools - Stools, difficult, large, hard lumps, with sharp pains. Stool like sheep's dung. Large discharge of blood with natural stool. Stools followed by burning or torn feeling. Insufficient soft stool after much pressure most of it remains.

Rectum - Discharge of much flatus. Ascarides. Constipation, after or during menses, in women after frequent miscarriages or multiple and difficult childbirths (Sep.). Constipation alternating with diarrhea. Ineffectual urging to stool, rectum feels too weak to expel it. Chronic diarrhea of dyspeptics, only during the day. Painless diarrhea with rumbling in abdomen and burning at anus. Stitching like fine needles during pregnancy or red-hot poker in rectum, better cool bathing. Burning in rectum and anus. Itching of rectum (Ign.). Itching, ulcerated pimples around anus. Easy prolapse of rectum (Graph., Podo.). Anal fistula. Hemorrhoids, large, swollen, painful, burn like fire, Hemorrhoids extremely sensitive to touch, inflamed, bleeding. Pain in hemorrhoids when coughing. Sensations - Sensation as if bed were sinking. Sensation of a lump rolling over on coughing, rising from right abdomen to throat. Pulsative pains and throbbings. Burning sensation and burning pains. Whole body as if it were hollow.

Male - Copious, painful pollutions with painful erections. Strange, uneasy feeling in genitals. Chronic gonorrhea, painful scanty discharge, burning during and after urination. Complaints after sex. Excessive emissions, followed by weakness. Prostration after sex, often with shuddering. Sleeplessness and uneasiness for 2 or 3 days after sex. Aversion to sex.

Female - Amenorrhea with backache. Difficult first menses. Menses, delayed in young girls with chest symptoms and ascites. Suppressed menses with anasarca or ascites. Itching of vulva before menses. Premenstrual syndrome, swollen breasts, water retention. Menses irritating, pungent odor. Violent colicky pain before menses. Menses, early with profuse discharge (Calc.). Menses too late, Kali carbonicum pale, scanty with soreness about genitals. Profuse and long-continued menses of bright red blood. Menorrhagia, better taking bath. Uterine hemorrhage, constant oozing after copious flow with violent backache, relieved from sitting and pressure. Hemorrhages after curetting or other treatments. Leucorrhea with labor-like pains causing itching and burning, better washing. Soreness of genitals during sex and during menses. Uterine tumors, cysts. Eclampsia, better belchings. Impending miscarriage with pains from back into buttocks and thighs. Labor pains inefficient. Labor pains felt in back, down the hips and thighs. Complaints after childbirth or miscarriage. After miscarriage, when there is great weakness of back. Puerperal fever with cutting pain in hypogastrium with black and scanty urine. Promotes expulsion of moles. Food - Disgust forfood or ravenous appetite. When hungry, feels anxious, nauseated, nervous, tingling, palpitation etc. Wants to eat frequently but least food oppresses her. Disgust for food. Milk and warm food disagree. Diarrhea worse milk. Ice water disagrees. Aversion to meat. Desire for sweets or acids.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Stabbing, stitching pains. Cutting pain in chest, worse lying on right side. Sore pain in chest. Coldness of chest. Lungs seem to stick to the ribs. Whole chest very sensitive during coughing. Weakness of chest from rapid walking, also tightness and oppression. Dull, painful stitches in chest. Pressure in thechest. Small pimplesonchestandback. Painful swelling of axillary glands. Sweat in axilla. Hydrothorax. Pleurisy. Constitutions - Suited to dark haired, aged persons of lax tissue, inclined to be fat. To diseases after childbirth or after loss of fluids. Suited for those who are thin blooded, cold, sensitive to atmospheric changes to every draft of air, always shivering with dropsical and paralytic tendency. Tubercular diathesis. Kali carbonicum Coughs - Dry, hard, suffocative, choking cough about 3 a.m. with sharp pains. Tormenting cough, wakens from sleep. Cough with acute pain in chest. Cough with relaxed uvula. Incessant, hard retching or choking, futile cough, then vomiting. Spasmodic cough with gagging or vomiting of ingesta and sour phlegm. Cough after measles, worse eating or drinking.

Heart - Angina pectoris. Tendency to fatty degeneration of heart. Dyspnea with violent and irregular beating of heart. Threatened heart failure. Insufficiency of mitral valves. Pulse is small, soft, variable, intermittent or dicrotic. Weak, rapid pulse intermits, due to digestive disturbance. Heart's action intermittent, irregular, tumultuous, weak. Arrhythmia. Palpitations, then weakness, in valvular disease. Palpitations and burning in heart region. Palpitations on slightest effort. Violent palpitations, shakes the whole body, throbbing extending to fingertips and toes. Sensation as if heart were suspended, seems to hang by a thread. Sharp pains about heart and through to scapula.

Back - Backache as if broken. Severe backache before and during menses, during pregnancy, labor or after a miscarriage. Stiffness and paralytic feeling in back. Backache with weak feeling, must lie down. Backache, must rise in order to turn over in bed. Lumbago with sudden sharp pains extending up and down, back and down the thighs. Lower back feels weak. Burning in spine (Gua.). Spine painful while eating. Pulsations in back. Gnawing pain in coccyx. Pain in buttocks and thighs and hip joint. Sharp pain in region of kidneys and right scapula. Tearing pain in lumbar region, impeding respiration. Swelling of cervical glands. Breasts - Fine stitches in breasts. Swollen, sensitive and painful breasts, before menses. Causations - Ill effects of suppressions of eruptions in childhood. Never well since pneumonia, catching cold, overstrain.

Limbs - Arthritis. Deformative arthritis, worse in small joints. Rheumatic joint pains. Nightly rheumatic pains. Sharp, aching pains in the joints and tendons. Pressive pain in joints. Limbs go to sleep easily. Back and legs give out. Limbs feel numb and heavy. Uneasiness, heaviness, jerking, tearing and swelling in limbs. Limbs sensitive to pressure. Jerks the limbs, especially when the feet are touched. Cold hands and cold feet in bed. Sciatica, tearing pain in the thighs with jerking of muscles. Paralysis of elderly people and dropsical disorders. Hip joint disease. Weakness in arms, feel numb, cold. Tearing in arms from shoulder to wrist. Lacerating in wrist joint. Pain from hip to knee. Knees painful, worse going downstairs or upstairs. White swelling of knees. Soles very sensitive. Itching of great toes with pain. Spasmodic contraction of fingers and toes. Tips of toes and fingers Kali carbonicum painful. Burning like fire in fingers.

Sleep - Yawns with headache. Sleepiness during forepart of day and during day. Drowsy after eating, falls asleep while eating. Sleeplessness from cough. Nocturnal restlessness before menses. Restless, dreamful sleep during menses. Twitching of limbs, grinding of teeth, crying while sleeping. Talks in sleep. Wakes at 1 a.m. or 2 a.m., cannot sleep again. Wakes at about 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. with nearly all complaints. Horrid, anxious dreams with frequent awaking and desire to urinate. Dreams of water, thieves, misfortunes, diseases, dead people. Erotic, imaginative, fantastic, sentimental.

Skin - Skin dry, sensitive, itching, better scratching. Eczema eruption dry at first, but when scratched exuding moisture. Burning as from mustard plaster. General itching or hives during menses. Nettle rash before menses. Itching of warts. Tension, pressure, rending in scars. Herpetic spots on face. Ulcers bleed at night.

Modalities - Better in warm weather, warmth, open air, moving about, sitting with elbows on knees. Worse from cold air, cold weather, draft, change of weather, after overheating. Worse 2 a.m. to 4 a.m., lying on left side, lying on painful side. Worse exertion, sudden or unguarded motion, touch, stooping, sex. Worse soup, coffee, water, loss of fluids. Worse since pneumonia. Worse before menses, after childbirth, miscarriage.

Teeth - Tearing, lancinating pains. Drawing pains. Tearing pain in teeth, jaws. Stitches in teeth with swelling of cheeks. Toothache only while eating. Toothache, alternating with stitching pains in left breast, only while eating. Looseness of teeth. Gums separate from teeth. Pyorrhea. Itching in gums, pus oozes out.

Tongue - Tongue, gray-white. Tip of tongue burns as if raw. Burning, soreness or painful pimples on tip of tongue. Tongue covered with painful, burning vesicles. Tongue coated gray, in sick headache. Vertigo - Vertigo on turning around, when rapidly turning head or body, when walking. Vertigo from riding in a carriage. Vertigo, as if proceeding from stomach. Must lie down as soon as vertigo comes on, otherwise he is thrown down. Vertigo, as after intoxication. Vision - Vision weak after measles, miscarriage, after sex. Spots, gauze and black points before the eyes. Bright sparks, blue, green spots, drops. Muscae volitantes while reading or looking at a bright light. Sees sparks, during cough. Can't fix sight of any object steadily without water running from eyes and feeling of dizziness. COMMENTS - Generally very sensitive to changes in weather, particularly sensitive in affected area. Chilly, tendency to take cold. Symptoms worse when body temperature is low, aversion to open air. Very sensitive to drafts, will catch a cold at every little draft. Cannot tolerate drafts (Nux-v., Calc., Hep., Sulph.). Easily startled by any noise, especially if unexpected. Cannot bear to be touched, starts when touched ever so lightly, especially on the feet. Generally right sided, particularly the base of the right lung, and the apices, according to Goullon. Worse exertion. Characteristic sweat, backache and weakness, particularly in conditions of debility from loss of fluids. Keynote bag-like swellings or puffiness around the upper eye, eyebrow, can be between the eyebrows. Alternating symptoms. Organ pathology due to suppressed mental symptoms. Constant backache, with a giving out feeling in the back and legs, or as if the back was broken. The pain may extend downwards to the buttocks and even to the knee. Pain from hip to knee (more especially if right sided). Lower backache, especially during labor, menstrual cramps. Lumbago. Hip joint disease. Spasms, puerperal convulsions and paralysis. Twitching of muscles, rigidity of muscles, muscular atony. Disposition to over lifting. Stitching pains, pulsations, better by pressure and by lying flat on the back. Sharp, stabbing pains that are worse motion. Sticking, burning, sharp pains like knives or needles. Sharp pains, wandering and stabbing, especially with arthritis. Osteoarthritis, deformative arthritis and migratory arthritis, pains that go from joint to joint. Burning and stabbing pains in the fingers and toes. Gout, gouty arthritis. Stiffness in neck and shoulders. Pain worse motion, with sharp pains. Edema. Peripheral edema, varicose veins. Affinity for tissues. Tumors, cancers and fibroids. Affects the blood and circulation. Anemia with great debility, skin watery, milky white. Hemorrhages. Dropsical disorders. Ulcers, bleeding at night. Throbbing of blood vessels all over body and to ends of fingers and toes. Irregular heart. Fatty degeneration of the heart and other muscles. Sensation as if the heart were suspended by a thread. History of heart attack. Great affinity for the lungs. Pneumonia and pleurisy (Bry.), worse coughing or movement, better pressure. Chronic respiratory problems in the elderly (Phos.). Sharp, stabbing, and stitching pains in the lungs. Oppression of breathing. Shortness of breath. Asthma, better sitting up in bed or on all fours. May sit up in bed with pillows (Ars.), may sleep sitting up. Coughs worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Dry, paroxysmal cough, loosens viscid mucus or pus which must be swallowed. Spasms with gagging or vomiting of ingesta. Expectoration of hard, white or smoky masses, which fly from the throat when coughing, with globules of pus. Tendency to sinus headaches. Useful for sick headaches. Violent headaches about the inner temples, violent stitching or jerking pains, on one side of the head or both. Onesided headache with nausea. Pressure and drawing in forehead extending into eyes and root of nose. Congestion to head and heat of face often accompany the headaches. Toothache, only when eating. Easy choking, foodeasily gets into windpipe. Difficulty swallowing. Pain in the back when swallowing. Fish bone sensation in the throat, general tendency to stitching pains. Disordered digestion, flatulence, distention, constipation. Gas, bloating, craving for sweets (Lyc.). Intolerance for milk, aversion to brown bread. Colic pains, severe colitis. Lack of muscular control especially with urologic things. History of diabetes. Premenstrual syndrome with bloating, water retention. Very sensitive breasts, painful before the period. Backache with period, or preceding period. Insufficient labor pains, transferred labor. Labor pains felt in back (Cimic., felt in thighs). Insomnia, cannot relax, without reason. Unrefreshed sleep. Drowsiness, while eating. Worse after sex, feel weak and prostrated (Sil., Calc.), sleepless after sex. Complaints after sex in males, especially complaints of the eyes. One case of a headache that Clarke cured was better by lying down, better by a tight band around the head. A man had an ulcer of the right leg with swelling of the ankle and he complained of waking at 2 a.m. Kali-c. 30c cured, but in the meantime he developed a great weakness of the right thigh, as if it would give out when walking. The symptom “pain from the hip to the knee” led to a cure in a woman, 73, stout, short, pale and of very soft tissue, who had for four months suffered from rheumatic pains, and an offensive vaginal discharge. A local practitioner was consulted and pronounced it cancer of the womb in an advanced stage and gave her four months to live. She described to Clarke the pain as being all around the lower abdomen and a ‘‘dull, heavy, depressing, dead pain, commencing at the inner part of the top of the right hip, iliac crest and extending to the knee.” The pain was so severe it made her feel quite sick and faint. The discharge was very offensive like decaying meat. Great weakness and trembling accompanied the discharge. Urine was almost like blood at times, and had a sandy sediment. Kali-c. 1,000c. was given and at once improvement set in. In a few months all the bad symptoms had disappeared and never returned. The patient lived ten years after this episode. Id of Stettin, Germany, recorded the case of a woman, 65, who suffered from chronic bronchial catarrh and emphysema. In November, 1886, she had asthmatic complaints, depriving her of sleep with cough and mucus expectoration difficult to raise. She was so weary when eating that she fell asleep and could not finish her meal. Tired after eating. In the morning, passed much flatulence. Kali-c. 10c removed the condition in a few days. The following March after a cold there was a recurrence, but without the weariness, and Kali-c. failed. Ars. 15c rapidly cured. The same patient also had a toothache alternating with tearing, stitching pain in left breast and under left false ribs. The side pains were worse at night, especially in evening as soon as she lay down, worse lying down, particularly worse lying on the right (painless) side. Not influenced by pressure or motion. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Camph., Coff. Compare: (1) Kali-sal. - vomiting, especially of pregnancy, arteriosclerosis with chronic rheumatism. (2) Kali-sil. - gouty nodosities. (3) Kali-acet. - diabetes, diarrhea, dropsy, alkaline urine, very much increased in quantity. (4) Kali-cit. - Bright's disease-1 grains to wineglass of water. (5) Kali-ox - lumbago, convulsions. . (6) Kali-pic. - jaundice, violent belchings. (7) Kali-t. - paraplegia. (8) Kali-tel. - garlicky odor of breath, salivation, swollen tongue. (9) Calc., Am-p., Phos., Lyc., Bry., Nat-m, Stann., Sep. Complementary: Carb-v. - lowness of vitality may suggest a preliminary course of Carb-v. to nurse up recuperation to the point that Kali-c. would come in helpfully. Follows: Nux-v. often in stomach and bladder troubles. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Sharp pain or soreness. Chronic liver troubles, with soreness. Jaundice and dropsy. Lungs - Shortness of breath in morning. Dyspnea, as if no air could get into lungs. Labored breathing, after paroxysms of cough. Arrest of breath awakens at night. Leaning forward relieves chest symptoms. Asthmatic, wheezing, worse least motion or walking. Asthma, worse from 2 a.m. to 4 a.m. Asthma, alternating with diarrhea with vertigo. Asthma, better when sitting up or bending forward. Asthma, better from rocking back and forth. Asthma with loss of appetite. Tendency to colds, better in warm climate. Bronchitis, whole chest very sensitive. Pneumonia. Pneumonia, after measles. Never well since pneumonia. Pleurisy. Pleuritis with violent palpitations. Hydrothorax. Tendency to tuberculosis. Whooping cough. Expectoration must be swallowed, cheesy taste, copious, offensive, lumpy. Expectoration scanty and tenacious.

Kidneys - Sharp pain in kidneys, going from buttocks to thighs. Burning in left kidney. Nephritis from exposure to cold or injury. Pressure on bladder long before urination, the more it is pressed less the urine flows. Slow urination with burning in urethra. Urine, foamy with thick red sediment. Rises several times at night to urinate. Nocturnal bedwetting of adults. Involuntary urination when coughing, sneezing, etc.

Perspiration - Offensive or sour smelling sweat. Scanty sweat, foul on feet. Perspires on slightest exertion. General inability to sweat. Sweats on painful part, on affected part. Sweats mostly on upper parts. Sweats at night, without relief, with cough. Perspires on every mental exertion, reading, writing. Perspires after pneumonia. Perspires after eating. Easily sweats, excited by exercise during day. Warm drinks aggravates.

Temperature - Chills with dyspnea, hot hands and sleepiness in open air. Frequent shuddering during day. Chilly in morning. Internal heat with external chilliness. Internal burning. Fever with surging of blood or throbbing in blood vessels. Fever with dyspnea.

full:
PHARMACY - kali-chl. Kali Chloricum. Potassium chlorate. Potassic chlorate. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Anemia. Aphthae. Asthma. Cancrum oris. Clumsiness. Colic. Convulsions. Crusta lactea. Cystitis. Dysentery. Edema. Epithelioma. Facial, paralysis. Hangnails. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hem- orrhoids. Hepatitis. Mercurial, poisoning. Mouth, inflammation. Nephritis. Neuralgias. Noma. Paralysis. Pharyngitis. Pimples. Proctalgia. Purpura. Scurvy. Stomatitis. Syphilis. Tic douloureux. Toxemia. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-chl. is not to be confused with the chloride that constitutes Schiissler's Kali-m. Hering amalgamated the symptoms of the two under the heading Kali- m., but Clarke kept them separate. Kali-chl. is an exceedingly active poison. It has long been used in the old school in solution as a wash for sore mouth and foul ulcers. Hutchinson observed a number of cases in which it produced the very condition that it was give to cure, the “most acute ulceration and follicular stomatitis. The whole mucus surface was red and tumid and in the cheeks, lips, etc., were numerous gray-based ulcers.” Fatal poisoning has occurred, death occurring in convulsions. The blood is disorganized and after death, the liver, spleen and kidneys are found softened and filled with disorganized blood, this should give it a place in cases of lardaceous and fatty degeneration of solid viscera. The mouth, hypochondria and rectum are the most affected. Profound prostration, coldness in different parts and organs. Easy hemorrhages, nosebleed, bloody stools etc. Hemoglobinuria. Anemia. Septicemia. Noma. Discharges are fetid. Gray, white, plastic exudates. Chronic nephritis. Parenchymatous nephritis with stomatitis. Acute ulcerative and follicular stomatitis. Scurvy. Hepatitis. Lardaceous and fatty degeneration of liver, spleen and kidneys and other solid organs. Toxemic conditions of pregnancy with urinary symptoms. MIND - Cheerfulness alternating with sadness. Confusion while walking in open air. Confusion from wine. Delusion he must starve. Refuses to eat. Desires death during chill.

Nose - Bleeding at night, only from right nostril.

Face - Swollen, she can hardly see in the morning. Neuralgic pains, worse talking, eating or slight touch, followed by numbness.

Mouth - Whole mucus surface red, tumid with gray-based ulcers. Stomatitis, aphthous and gangrenous. Fetor. Noma. Scurvy. Salivation, profuse secretion of acid saliva. Tongue, swollen, cold. Mercurial stomatitis (as a mouth wash).

Throat - Cold feeling in throat. COMMENTS - Rushmore recorded a proving of Kali-chl. in an unmarried woman, 50, short, brunette, who had goiter in early life, which disappeared under the application of iodine. Later on, a fibroid tumor developed in the uterus. For this the patient was advised to take crude potassium chlorate, dissolved in water, daily. Symptoms observed included an increased moral irritability. Felt dreadfully dull and stupid. Dizzy on stooping and rising. Slight headache over eyes, objects appear double, beside each other. Face swollen so she could hardly see on rising in morning. Smarting of tongue. Kali-chl. took away her desire for acids. Diminished appetite. Much commotion and flatulence in abdomen. Increased urine. Dreams of terrible things never thought. Great coolness, shivering on cold days, seemed as if it cooled off her blood. Clumsiness. General bloated feeling. In the provers, great weakness manifested. Rheumatic and neuralgic pains, many occurring in the facial nerves. Facial paralysis. Pimples in various parts, between lip and chin. The heart was the seat of much dis- turbance, and a coldness was felt about the précordia. Disordered stomach and bowels. Excited sexual organs. Allen credited Kali-chl. with the cure of “Dysentery with most violent cutting pains as from knives, frequent stools, tenesmus, making the patient cry out, evacuations very small, almost pure blood, great prostration.” Allen noted that it cured epithelioma of the face and of the great toe. RELATIONS - Antidote to: Merc. Compare: (1) Especially Kali-m. (2) Caust. - facial paralysis. (3) Kali-bi. - follicular pharyngitis. (4) Zinc., Cadm-s. and Cact. - asthma with great constriction of chest. (5) Graph., Kali-n. and Nat-m. - cold feeling about heart. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Sudden, incessant vomiting of all food, of offensive dark green mucus. Stomach cold. Sensations of a weight in the epigastric and umbilical regions. Flatulence.

Abdomen - Griping colic with shifting of flatulence and diarrhea, followed by continuous rectal pain.

Rectum - Diarrhea, profuse, greenish mucus. Griping colic with shifting of flatulence and diarrhea, followed by continuous rectal pain. Dysentery, much blood passing with mucus, profuse greenish. Cries with violent cutting pain in the rectum in dysentery and diarrhea.

Chest - Constriction of chest, as from sulphur fumes.

Heart - Coldness in precordial region. Right pulse full, left small. Coldness in blood.

Limbs - Ankles swell in the evening. Arms, feet cold.

Skin - Cold. Jaundice. Discolored, chocolate tint. Pimples between lip and chin. Itching miliary or papular eruptions.

Modalities - Better from nosebleed, mental symptoms. Worse from cold, coughing, sneezing, ajar, mercury.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Urine albuminous, scanty, suppressed. Albumin and bile, high phosphoric acid with low total solids. Hematuria, diuresis.

HOMEOPATHIC - The…
full:
PHARMACY - kali-chls. Kali chlorosum. Javelle water. Bleaching fluid. Formula variable, contains potassium hypochlorate principally, chloride and some carbonate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphonia. Asthma. Coryza. Diphtheria.

HOMEOPATHIC - The observations with Javelle water are from poisoning cases. The most notable symptoms were watery eyes, pale, puffy face, and constriction of the throat and chest. Much sensitivity. Sensitiveness of epigastrium and especially of larynx and whole anterior portion of neck. Cramps and restlessness. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Kali-chl., Calc- m., Chlor., Nat-hchls. REFERENCES - Clarke.
