CLINICAL - Arthritic nodes. Asthma. Bronchitis. Cataract. Catarrh. Chorea. Colds. Constipation. Dandruff. Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Epithelioma. Eustachian catarrh. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headache. Hemorrhoids. Intermittent fever. Leucorrhea. Metrorrhagia. Nails, diseased. Nasal, catarrh. Nettle-rash. Ophthalmia. Orchitis. Otorrhea. Ozaena. Palpitations. Pneumonia. Polyps. Psoriasis. Rheumatism. Rhus poisoning. Scabies. Scaldhead. Seborrhea. Sinusitis. Skin, disorders. Suppurations. Toothache. Vertigo. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kali-s., introduced by Schiissler, affects respiration, mucus membranes and skin where it causes desquamation. Schiissler explains that Kali-s., in reciprocal action with iron, effects the transfer of the inhaled oxygen to all the cells and is contained in all the cells containing iron. When a sulphate and any oxide of iron come into contact with decomposing organic substances they surrender their oxygen and form sulphate of iron. With more oxygen added, this may be further decomposed into sulphuric acid and an oxide of iron. A deficiency of Kali-s. causes a sensation of heaviness and weariness, vertigo, chilliness, palpitations of the heart, anxiety, sadness, toothache, headache and pain in the limbs. Symptoms are worse in a warm room and towards evening, better in open, cool air. Catarrh of larynx, bronchi, nostrils, etc., with yellow discharges. Catarrh of the stomach where the tongue has a yellowish mucus coating. Profuse and deep yellow discharges, thin or sticky. Ailments accompanied by profuse desquamation. Suppurations. Yellow, mucus and serous discharges, profuse and intermittent. Later stages of inflammation. Wandering pains, wandering rheumatism (Puls., Kali- bi.). Stitching, tearing, festering pains that shift about. Torpid processes. Lack of reaction. Warmblooded. Oxaluria. Facilitates the formation of new epithelium. Epithelial cancer. Interrupted growth of nails. Gonorrhea and ophthalmia neonatorum (Puls.). MIND-Alwayshurried. Irritable. Timid. Confusion and restlessness, worse in a warm room. Mental exertion aggravates. Desires and then rejects things. Desire to lie down, but lying aggravates so must walk for relief. . Anxiety, better in the open air. Anxiety in evening. Frightened at trifles. Fear of falling, of losing her reason. Claustrophobia with fear of suffocation.

Head - Rheumatic headache, beginning in evening. Headaches worse warm room, better open air. Headache during menses. Great pain on moving head from side to side or backwards. Dandruff yellow, moist and sticky. Scaldhead. Bald spots, after gonorrhea.

Eyes - Purulent yellow mucus in eye diseases. Sticky, watery discharge from eyes. Thin, yellow crusts on eyelids. Cataract. Ophthalmia neonatorum.

Ears - Eustachian deafness. Stinking otorrhea. Bro wn offensive secretion from right ear. Offensive discharge with polyps. Discharge of yellow matter (Hydr.). Watery, sticky, thin discharge.

Nose - Colds with ayellow,slimy discharge. Yellow, thick discharge, alternating with watery discharge. Sinusitis with thick yellow, green discharges. Nose obstructed. Loss of smell and taste (Nat-m.). Swelling of the nasal pharyngeal mucus membrane, remaining after removal of adenoids.

Face - Aches in heated room, better cool open air. Epithelioma.

Mouth - Mouth breathing, snoring. Insipid, pappy taste. Loss of taste and smell. Tongue coated yellow and slimy. Yellow mucus coating on tongue. Painful gums. Toothache, worse warm room and toward evening, better cool open air. Blistered lips and mouth. Lower lip swollen. Epithelioma on lip.

Throat - Croupy hoarseness (Hep., Spong.). Constant scraping. Sore throat and hoarseness after catching a cold. Every cold settles in larynx. Vertigo - Dreadful vertigo on rising from lying, on standing from sitting. Vertigo when looking upwards. Vertigo with a fear of falling. COMMENTS - Useful for chronic Puls, conditions, recurring earaches, asthma, respiratory problems, when Puls, doesn't cure completely. Yellow discharges, thick and bland, especially from the sinuses and lungs. Rattling mucus (Ant-t.). Wandering arthritis, worse hot applications and hot baths. Desquamation. Skin conditions with flaking and peeling. Psoriasis, eczema, dandruff. Scabs with yellow pus. Ulcers ooze yellow, watery fluid. Skin cancer. Tongue can be yellow with a slimy coating. General sluggishness. Modalities similarto Puls. Worse in warm, stuffy rooms, at twilight, better fresh air. Thirstless. Better walking in the fresh, open air. Mood changes and can weep easily. Claustrophobic with fear of suffocation. M. E. Douglass reported an asthma case with a lot of thick, yellow expectoration. Much rattling in chest, with labored breathing and talking almost impossible, this was cured with Kali-s. 3x, five grains every hour in the attack. Hansen cured with Kali-s. a case of psoriasis beginning on the right leg, later attacking the left elbow and left leg. Eruption, papular, oval and annular with paler centers, covered with whitish scales, skin beneath red and smooth. The guiding symptom was “great desquamation of the epidermis.” RELATIONS - Antidote to: Rhus poisoning. Compare: (1) Kali-s., Puls., Kali-bi., Nairn. (2) Puls., Kali-bi. (3) Hydr. - dyspepsia, epithelioma. (4) Chr-ac. 3x. - produces in the nasal passages very fine threads from the septum to external wall, disorders of nasal fosse and hay fever. Chronic colds. Sneezing, red, watery eyes, irritation of mucus membrane. Compatible: Acet- ac. (itching and redness of skin), Calc., Hep., Puls., Rhus-t., Sep., Sil., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Burning thirst. Pressure and feeling of fullness in stomach. Sensation as if a heavy load on stomach. Sensation of faintness in stomach with befogged feeling in head. Catarrh of stomach and duodenum. Nausea, and vomiting.

Abdomen - Colicky pains, abdomen feels cold to touch. Abdomen cold and distended after eating. Hard, ascites, in whooping cough. Empty feeling in hypogastrium, better passing flatus.

Rectum - Constipation with hemorrhoids (Sulph.). Stools large like sheep's dung. Black, thin, offensive stools. Stools light-colored and bilious. Yellow, slimy diarrhea.

Male - Gonorrhea, slimy, yellowish, green discharges. Gleet. Orchitis after suppressed gonorrhea.

Female - Menses too late, scanty. Menses with a feeling of weight in the abdomen. Metrorrhagia. Leucorrhea, yellowish, watery. Food - Burning thirst. Craves sweets, cold food, cold drinks. Dread of hot drinks. Averse to and worse from eggs.

Chest - Anxiety in chest.

Back - Pain in nape. Stiff neck, head inclined towards left. Rheumatic pains in back and limbs, worse in warm room, better cool open air. Causations - Ill effects of chill when over heated. Injuries.

Limbs - Rheumatism. Rheumatic pains, worse heat, evening, better cold weather or cold applications. Pain in back and limbs, worse in a warm room. Shifting, wanderingpains. Arthritic nodes. Cold hands and feet. Scaly eruption on arms, better hot water. Diseased condition of nails. Lungs - Asthma with yellow, slimy expectoration, easily expelled. Coarse rales in lungs. Bronchitis, mucus is distinctly yellow and slimy, thin, or watery matter and profuse. Rattling of mucus in lungs (Ant-t.). Post- influenza cough, especially in children. Cough, worse in evening and in hot atmosphere. Croupy cough (Hep., Spong.). Pneumonia with wheezing. Yellow, loose rattling mucus is coughed up with difficulty. Sputum consists of watery matter. Whooping cough.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from heat, warm room. Vivid, terrifying dreams of ghosts, death, robbers, murder. Dreams with violent struggling in their sleep.

Skin - Dry skin. Itching, worse heat. Peeling, flaking of skin. Psoriasis (Ars., Thyr.). Intertrigo. Eczema, burning, itching, papular eruption. Desquamation of skin. Promotes desquamation after erysipelas. Accelerates removal of scabs in smallpox. Nettle rash. Yellow scales. Favus. Yellow skin jaundice. Skin affections with yellow, slimy discharge. Ulcers, ooze thinyeZ/ow water. Polyps. Epithelioma. Suppressed rash of measles or other eruptive diseases, with harsh and dry skin. Seborrhea. Scabs with yellow pus. Ringworm of scalp or beard with abundant scales. Scabies. Rhus poisoning.

Modalities - Better from walking, fasting, discharge of flatus, cool, open air. Worse in evening (Puls.), noise, consolation. Cannot stand warm rooms or other forms of heat. Worse warm air, warm wraps, warm weather, heated room.

Kidneys - Albuminuria after scarlatina. Oxaluria. Pyelitis.

Perspiration - Profuse, easy sweat.

Temperature - Chilliness. Cold hands and feet. Intermittent fever. Temperature rises at night.

full:
PHARMACY - kalm. Kalmia latifolia. Mountain laurel. Ledum floribus bullatis. American laurel. Calico bush. Cistus chamerhododen- dros. N. O. Ericaceae. Rocky sterile hills, near water in New England States. Flowers May and June. Tincture of fresh leaves when the plant is in flower. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Angina, pectoris. Arthritis. Blindness. Bright's disease. Coryza. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Gastralgia. Globus hystericus. Gout. Headache. Heart, disease. Hoarseness. Locomotor, ataxia. Lumbago. Nausea. Neuralgias. Palpitations. Ptosis. Pregnancy, albuminuria. Rheumatic, fever. Rheumatism. Retinitis. Scleroderma. Sunheadaches. Syphilitic, sore throat. Tachycardia. Tinnitus. Tobacco, effects. Tobacco, heart. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Kalmia is the name of a genus of heath worts native to North America. Kalmia latifolia, which has large and showy flowers, is found in the northern parts of the United States. Its flowers yield a honey said to be deleterious, and its leaves and shoots certainly are so to cattle. Dr. Meadows says cattle eat Kalmia in the latter part of the winter when they are in want of something green. Kalmia latifolia K. angustifolia, probably for the same reason, has the name of lamb-kill. The powdered leaves are used as a local remedy in some skin diseases. The hard wood of K. latifolia is used in the manufacture of various articles. The Treasury of Botany noted that the Canadian partridge is said to become poisonous to humans after feeding on Kalmia berries.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering introduced Kalm. into homeopathic practice, and he, and some friends, completed the first proving. The head, including the eyes and face, shows the majority of its action, followed by the heart. A number of skin symptoms confirm the popular use of the leaves, among them a stiffness of the skin, especially of the eyelids. A heart, nerve, circulation and rheumatic remedy. In small doses, it accelerates the heart’s action, in larger doses, it moderates it greatly. Nausea and slow pulse frequently accompany conditions. Neuralgic pains, shoot downwards with numbness, tingling, trembling or paralytic weakness. Neuralgia after the disappearance of herpetic eruptions. Great weakness with neuralgia. Pains of locomotor ataxia. Protracted and continuous fevers with tympanites. Albuminuria. Paralytic sensations, pains and achings in the limbs. Pains shift rapidly, shooting outward along the nerves with much nausea and slow pulse. Aching, bruised, stiff feeling. Dull tearing, crushing pain, moving downwards. Pain alternating with cardiac symptoms or between upper and lower limbs. Rheumatism, syphilitic. Motion brings on complaints. MIND - Confusion of brain. Memory and mental faculties are perfect in a recumbent posture, but vertigo on attempting to move. Anxiety and palpitations. Irritable, cross. Talk of others aggravates.

Head - Cracking in head, sounds like a horn blowing in the ears, frightens him. Headache worse and better with sun. Headache begins at sunrise, worse at noon and leaves at sunset. Headache worse bright sunlight. Headache better profuse urina- tion. Shooting pain from nape to vertex and face. Maddening supra-orbital pain (right). Pain in front and temporal region from head, to nape, and to teeth, from cardiac origin. Aching in forehead.

Eyes - Stiff drawing sensation when moving eyes. Pains increased by moving the eye. Pressure in and above right eye. Paralysis of upper lids. Stiff eyelids. Retinitis, albuminuria especially during pregnancy. Rheumatic iritis. Scleritis. Itching in eyes, stinging when rubbing them. Eye symptoms worse evening and in open air.

Ears - Sharp pain in and behind right ear, at night. Acute inflammation of meatus. Sound like blowing a horn after cracking in head. Meniere's disease.

Nose - Coryza, with increased sense of smell. Coryza with sneezing, dullness, headache and hoarseness. Tearing in root of nose and nasal bones, with nausea.

Face - Anxious expression. Flushing with vertigo. Redness of face during throbbing headache. Neuralgia, worse right side. Neuralgia from exposure to cold, better eating, worse from worry or mental exertion. Trigeminal neuralgia. Facial neuralgia after herpes zoster. Sharp and tearing pains in bones of jaw and face. Itching of face at night. Tired feeling in masseters. Cracked lips with dry skin.

Mouth - Tingling in salivary gland. Sublingual salivary gland inflamed. Bitter taste with nausea, better eating. Tongue white, dry. Sharp pain in tongue. Tongue, sore left side, hurts when talking. Teeth tender, during facial neuralgia. Pressing in molars, late in evening. Tired feeling in chewing muscles. Lips, stiff, dry, swollen.

Throat - Throat feels swollen. Sensation as of a ball rising. Pressure in throat, stitches in eyes and nausea. Dryness in throat with aching pains, causing cough, difficult swallowing and thirst. Chronic syphilitic sore throat. Tickling in trachea. Noise as from spasm in glottis when breathing. Hoarseness during coryza. Vertigo - Vertigo with headache, nausea, blindness, pains in the limbs and weariness. Vertigo worse from motion (Bry.), worse stooping, looking down. Vertigo with blindness. Vision - Impaired vision. Vision becomes black on looking downward. Diplopia, from paralysis of ocular muscles. Glimmering vision, with dimness. COMMENTS - For paralytic weakness and trembling. Neuralgias in almost all regions, generally on the right side. Wandering arthritis, sharp, shooting pain jumps from joint to joint. Arthritis with heart conditions or neuralgias. Wandering rheumatic pains that travel from above downwards. Rheumatic fever. Pain, followed by numbness in the joints (Naphtin. with sciatica). Joints can swell, become red, hot and throbbing (Bell. ). Pains worse sunrise to sunset (Nat-m., Spig.). Painful facial neuralgias (Spig., Mag-p.). Neuralgic pains are better from food. Pain in the back, shuns all exertion, can hardly go up stairs. Pains in the periosteum preventing sleep. Pain between shoulders coming up over the head. Pain with nausea and slow pulse. Pain during the early part of the night or soon after going to sleep. Pain from a sudden chill or exposure to a sudden wind. Tumultuous action of the heart and slow pulse. Every heartbeat has a strumming as if it would burst, along sternum to throat. Palpitations are better lying on back and breathing, worse on left side, from mental effort. Generally acts on the right side of the head, the left side of the chest and the left arm. Vertigo from least motion, worse from motion (Bry.), even motion of eyes and eyelids is painful. Vertigo is worse on stooping, on looking down, on rising from a seat. Headache comes on in the morning, worse again in evening. Headache, worse heat, better cold. Sun headache, worse or better with the sun. Headache and eye symptoms are worse in evening, from open air. Rubbing eyes causes stinging in them. Scleroderma. Cheek roughness every summer. Much external sensitiveness, face, pit of stomach, muscles of neck sore, worse by touch. Dry throat. Feeling as if a ball was rising in the throat. Dry, stiff, swollen, cracked lips. Tingling in the salivary glands immediately after eating. Stitches in the tongue. Sensation of weakness in abdomen extending to throat. Vomiting with ruminating action, without the least nausea, better with wine. Pressure on rectum after stool. Symptoms worse during leucorrhea. Vonder Luhe cured with Kalm. 200c an intercostal neuralgia of the left side, so intense that the patient could not lie down or sleep at night. The chief guiding symptom was a concomitant numb sensation of the whole left arm. Lambert recorded the case of a gatekeeper, age 54, who had smoked since he was seven years old. He suffered from “tobacco heart” palpitations, occurring on the least exertion or fright and sometimes awakening him in the night. Intermittent pulse, no valvular lesion, tingling in the left arm and leg and sensation as if the blood did not circulate in them. He could walk, but not far. The chief complaint was a sharp pain in the right temple like pins and needles, of eighteen months' duration. It was induced by touch and turning the head quickly. Kalm. 3x cured the temporal neuralgia and greatly alleviated all the other symptoms. Proell cured with Kalm. 1c, 2c and 3c headaches and weak memory in a boy of 13 that were preventing him from continuing his studies. He also had insufficiency of the mitral value. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Aeon., Bell.Antidote to: Tab. Compare: (1) Kalm. contains Arbutin. (2) Der. of great service in neuralgic headaches of rheumatic origin). (3) Spig., Puls. Complementary: Benz-ac. Follows well: Nux-v., Thyr., Spig. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Crampy pain with eructation of gas. Pain in pit of stomach, worse by bendingforward, relieved by sitting erect. Sensation of something being pressed under the epigastrium. Warm, glowing sensation in epigastrium. Gastralgia with empty eructations. Bilious attacks with nausea, vertigo and headache. Nausea and vomiting. Wine relieves vomiting.

Abdomen - Incarcerated flatus with nausea. Sensation of weakness in abdomen extending to throat, better by eructation. Sudden pains in paroxysms, across abdomen, above umbilicus. Neuralgia of bowels.

Rectum - Diarrhea with dullness, dizziness, weariness, nausea and bellyache. Stools like mush, easily discharged. Stools as if glazed, followed by pressure on rectum. Sensations - As if something loose in head diagonally across the top. As if the body was surcharged with electricity, as shuddering without coldness. As if something was being pressed away from under sternum.

Male - Frequent, spontaneous, lasting erections without desire. Pain in the right testicle in morning, in the left testicle in afternoon.

Female - Menses too soon. Menses regular but painful. Suppressed menses, with severe neuralgic pains throughout whole body, with pain in limbs, back and inside of thighs. Leucorrhea, one week after menses, aggravating other symptoms.

Chest - Angina pectoris with dyspnea and pain. Feverish heat with great pain in chest, worse when breathing and from slightest motion. Pain in chest as from a sprain. Sharp pain in lower chest. Shooting through chest above heart into shoulder blade. Pain in left arm. False pleurisy of winter season. Rheumatism of muscles of thorax and back, worse from every motion.

Heart - Angina pectoris with empty eructations. Heart disease, after frequent attacks of rheumatism, or alternating with it. Tumultuous action, rapid and visible. Paroxysms of anguish around heart. Fluttering of heart with anxiety. Pains, sharp, burning shooting, stabbing, radiating to left scapula and arm. Sharp pains take away the breath. Tachycardia with pains (Thyr.). Severe palpitations with constriction of throat, worse motion. Palpitations, worse leaning forward, better sitting erect. Gouty and rheumatic metastasis of heart. Shooting through chest above heart into shoulder blades. Tobacco heart. Hypertrophy, valvular insufficiency. Aortic obstruction. Pulse slow, weak, tremulous (Dig., Apoc.). Frequent pulse.

Back - Pain from neck down arm, brachial- gia. Pain down back, as if it would break. Kalmia latifolia Pain in localized regions of spine, through the shoulders. Sharp pain in lower part • of left scapula. Lumbar pain of nervous origin, with heat and burning. Sensation of lameness in small of back. Drawing or sharp pain in spine.

Limbs - Pains affects a large part of a limb or several joints and pass through quickly. Weakness, numbness, pricking and sense of coldness in limbs. Joints red, hot, swollen. Pains from hips to knees and feet. Pains along ulnar nerve, goes into third or fourth fingers. Tingling and numbness of left arm (heart pains). Deltoid rheumatism, especially right.

Sleep - Sleepless. Restless sleep, turns often. Periosteal pains prevent sleep. While sleeping, stands up and walks about. Talks in sleep. Fantastic dreams. Dreams of murder. Wakes very early in morning.

Skin - Stiff, dry skin. Sensation of rigidity. Pricking sensation in skin with moderate sweat. Erysipelatous on hand with oppressed breathing. Scabies-like eruptions. Red inflamed places here and there, exceedingly painful, as if boils would form. Scleroderma.

Modalities - Better from eating cloudy weather, continued motion, sitting, or standing upright. Worse looking down, turning eyes, stooping, bendingforward, motion, lying on left side. Worse from heat of sun, open air, becoming cold, from sunrise to sunset. Worse during leucorrhea.

Liver - Pains in region of liver. Lungs - Dyspnea and pressure from epigastrium toward the heart. Short-breathed, must breathe quickly, involuntary. Difficult and oppressed breathing, throat feels swollen, nausea, with palpitations and anxiety. Noise as from spasm of glottis when breathing. Hoarseness with coryza. Tickling in trachea. Frequent cough caused by dryness or scraping in the throat. Expectoration easy, smooth, gray, tasting putrid, salty.

Kidneys - Frequent urination of large quantity of yellow urine, with sharp pains in lumbar region. Frequent urination of scanty, hot urine. Profuse urination, better headache. Post-scarlatinal nephritis. Albuminuria with pains in lower limbs, dropsy. Albuminuria during pregnancy.

Perspiration - Cold sweat.

Temperature - Shivering and coldness. Shaking chill in cold air; chills run over back. Protracted and continued fevers with tympanites. Fever with burning and pain in back and loins.

HERBAL - Kamala is best known in medicine as a remedy for tapeworms. It is given in doses of half to two drachms. The Treasury of Botany noted that “Among the Arabs of Aden it is given internally in leprosy, and used in solution to remove freckles and pustules, while in this country it has been used successfully in treating the eruption known as ‘wildfire’ (Strophulus volaticus) in children, by rubbing the powder over the affected part with moist lint.“Kam. appears, however, to be most valued as an anthelmintic, and has been extensively used with much success in India in cases of tapeworms, three drachms being sufficient for a robust person, and half that quantity for one of feeble habit.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Kam. shows by its clinical uses it relationship with Croton and the other Euphorbians. CLINICAL - Convulsions. Pains. Paralysis.

HOMEOPATHIC - The Treasury of Botany noted that karaka seeds contain a tasteless farinaceous substance and are eaten in times of scarcity. The raw seeds are poisonous and produce spasmodic pains, giddiness and partial paralysis. To render them edible, they are steamed for twenty-four hours and then either buried in the ground or allowed to soak in water for some days. G. Bennett recorded a few symptoms observed in the case of a Maori chief poisoned with the seeds. Spasm with pains. Violent pain lasting a week. Partial paralysis. Heat anesthesia, when warm water was applied he did not feel any warmth from it. Violent spasms and convulsions of whole body, arms and legs stretched violently and rigidly out. Permanent rigid distortion. COMMENTS - C. F. Fischer proved Kara, and used it clinically in cases of convulsions. He recorded an account of its effect from the proceedings of the New Zealand Institute. “Violent spasms and convulsions of whole body, arms and legs stretched violently and rigidly out, great flushings of heat, protrusion of eyes and tongue, gnashing of jaws. The poison proves rapidly fatal if the patient is not attended to immediately and the limbs are permanently and rigidly distorted if they are not fixed in proper positions until the crisis is passed. “The general treatment is to bind the patient (generally a child) with the limbs in right positions, dig a pit and place him in it, standing, buried up to the chin with a gag in his mouth. “The writer described a youth, age 12, who had recovered after being poisoned, but whose limbs had not been properly secured and were ever after absolutely useless. “One leg was curved up behind his loins, the other bent up with the foot outwards. One arm inclined behind his shoulder, the other slightly bent and extended forward and all, as to muscles inflexibly rigid. He could not move himself or even drive away the flies.” REFERENCES-Clarke.

CLINICAL - Acute poliomyelitis. Acute bulbar paralysis. Amyotrophy. Bedsores. Dyspnea. Encephalitis. Paralysis. Paresis.Poliomyelitis. Quadriplegia.

HERBAL - The plant Karwinskia belongs to the Rhamnacae family, it is found in the northern states of Mexico. It is known locally under different names including Tullidora, the “little coyote,” “wild capuli,” “little black rod,” and “cacachila.” It is a small shrub, but can grow up to 9 meters in some places. The leaves are elliptical or oblong, rounded at the end, the flowers are small, yellow-green in color. The fruits are small in clusters from 6 to 9 mm in diameter, dark violet in color, usually containing four seeds of which only two are reproductive. The seeds are toxic, causing paralysis of the limbs, which becomes generalized and can terminate in death. They contain a fatty acid, a yellow substance and a glucoside, which is the cause of the paralysis of the motor nerves.

HOMEOPATHIC - The clinical observation of the mass intoxication of one hundred and six soldiers constitutes the first Memoirs of Dr. Castillo Najeros, published in Mexico in 1918. A homeopathic proving of Karw-h. was carried out by Luis de Legarreta and published in 1961 in his Materia Medica of Mexican Plants. Karw-h. is a remedy with neurotrophic action, paralyzing the motor nerves. Flaccid paralysis, which increases, ending in quadriplegia. Ascending progressive paralysis, flaccid and painless, predominantly on the left side, with amyotrophy of the lower limbs. Acute spinal paralysis, sub-acute atrophic spinal paralysis. Chronic anterior paralysis. Loss of contractility and mobility of the leg muscles. Reduction of tendons reflexes and skin. Paresis of paralysis, rising to the upper limbs and muscles of the thorax and diaphragm. Paralysis of the lips, tongue and larynx. No diminution of reflexes of the bladder and intestines. Poliomyelitis. Acute and sub-acute, polioencephalitis. Bedsores.

Head - Severe headache. Constant headache with feeling of heaviness.

Ears - Buzzing in both ears.

Stomach - Nausea with vomiting. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Lath. - Weakness, then paralysis of the lower limbs with exaggerated reflexes and complaints of sensitivity. (2) Hydroph. - Paralysis with muscular dystrophy. (3) Plb. - Rapid emaciation, progressive paralysis of the limbs with amyotrophy and starting in the extensor muscles. REFERENCES - Julian.

Abdomen - Lack of intestinal inactivity, partial obstruction.

Rectum - Diarrhea in the first 48 hours, followed by intestinal paralysis with difficulty in evacuating.

Heart - Pulse slower with fever.

Back - Cramping pains in the back.

Limbs - Progressive paralysis. Cramping pains in the arms and legs. Loss of contractility and mobility of the leg muscles. Lungs - Dyspnea, which becomes worse and can end in respiratory paralysis. Bronchopneumonia, paralytic alveolitis, which can cause fatal asphyxia. Difficult speech.

Skin - Bedsores.

PHARMACY - keroso. Kerosolenum. Kerosene. One of the lighter products, obtained by distillation from the crude oil. Kerosolene being the trade name given by the “Downer Kerosene Oil Company,” nearly identical with gasoline. Solution in rectified spirit. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anesthesia. Asphyxia. Convulsions. Delirium. Ecstasy. Laughter.

HOMEOPATHIC - The effects of Keroso. have been observed on workmen, andexperi- ments have been made with it for the purpose of testing its anesthetic properties. Keroso. causes a pleasurable kind of intoxication, but too much muscular rigidity, asphyxia and intermittent pulse to render it a safe anesthetic. Moderate convulsions. Laughter was noticed in two cases and this should prove an indication in some kinds of delirium and insanity. Partially or wholly insensible, but rapidly recovers when brought into open air. Insensibility complete, though eyes not closed. MIND - Sense of complete loneliness. Insensible, with inclination to laugh. Cannot keep still Chest - Breathing checked during convulsions due to rigid contraction of chest muscles.

Head - Peculiar lightness of head. Slight headache.

Eyes - Eyes a little unnaturally open and staring.

Face - Momentary dusky redness of face at each convulsion (as in epilepsy).

Limbs - Weakness of the limbs. Modalities - Better in open air.

Pulse - Accelerated intermittent, volume diminished during insensibility.

Temperature - Some sweating. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Petr., Paraf., Benzin. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Kissingen Aqua
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse in the forenoon, at night, on waking, while reading and writing. Vertigo worse while eating. Toothache worse during menstruation. COMMENTS - Constantin James, recorded in Allen, noted that the dose is from three to six glasses of the water in the morning and two glasses at 4 p.m., but the general rule is that no more it to be drunk than the stomach can digest without difficulty. In the first days, appetite and force is increase, but as the water is absorbed the effects become general. Then an elimina- tory “crisis” comes on. The stools become brownish, loose, bilious. The urine is turbid, depositing a sediment which rapidly putrefies. The secretion of the bronchial, genital, and ocular mucus membranes, as well as the skin, is increased and changed in character. Moral and physical prostration, old and long-forgotten troubles reappear. This crisis, which appears in the first or second week, soon disappears of itself and the cure proceeds. In one case, a patient vomited blood after the disappearance of a hemorrhoidal flux. Kiss, restored the latter, and the bloodvomiting ceased. Trembling, pulsation of the whole body. Weariness. Stitches here and there. Muscle volitantes. Noises in the ears. Chills, heat and perspiration. Tearful disposition, especially at 10 a.m. “If he only looks at any one he must weep.” RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Nat-m. - weeping disposition, chill at 10 a.m., catarrh, constipation. (2) Ant-c. - saburral condition. (3) Urt-u. - gout. (4) Ferr-pic. - warts and corns. REFERENCES - Clarke..

Gout where the asthmatic principle appears to be repercussed upon the abdominal viscera, for then the waters draw it out to the joints. The dosage must be managed with extreme prudence, too much can bring on a true attack of gout.

PHARMACY - kou. Kousso. Brayera anthelminthica. Hagenia abyssinica. Kuso. Cosso. N. O. Rosacee. Abyssinia. Infusion of dried flowers. Tincture of flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Miscarriage. Tapeworm. Worms.

HERBAL - The flowers of Kousso are a favorite remedy for tapeworm with the natives of Abyssinia. The use of them in European practice for that purpose has led to the observation of the few recorded symptoms, among which thirst, nausea and vomiting are prominent. In one case miscarriage was caused. To use as a vermifuge, take a quarter of an ounce of the dried flowers and boil in four ounces of distilled water. Infuse for fifteen minutes without straining. The powder is to be taken with the infusion in the morning, fasting. Two such drafts may be given. It is best to give a purgative before and an hour or two after the draft. Nausea and vomiting. Vertigo. Precordial anxiety, slowing and irregular pulse, delirium and collapse. Rapid and extreme prostration.

HOMEOPATHIC - Alexander Milne remarked “Though Kousso leads to the expulsion of the worm, it seems not to improve the morbid condition which favors its production.” The prostration caused by the treatment is so great that Milne advises a course of Cinch, and Ferr. to follow. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cuc-c„ Gran., Fil. (2) Kam., an efficient remedy for tapeworm in 30-60 minims of tincture taken in cinnamon water. REFERENCES - Clarke.

modalities: Modalities: Better from warmth, hot food, motion, pressure, after sleep. Worse from dentition, pregnancy, during and after menses, sex. Worse when lying down, rest, touch, sprains, eating. Worse in summer, open air, cold, 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., bad smells.

full:
PHARMACY - kreos. Kreosotum. Beech wood kreosote. Carbo pyroligneus. A product of distillation of wood tar from Fagus syl- vaticus. This remedy is a mixture of phenols obtained from distillation of wood tar. Solution in Rectified Spirit. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Acne. Amenorrhea. Bedwetting. Belchings. Blood, poisoning. Cancer. Carbuncles. Cholera infantum. Coccyx, pain. Colic. Congenital syphilis. Constipation. Dentition. Diarrhea. Ear, disorders. Epithelioma. Eruptions. Flushings. Gangrene. Hemorrhages. Herpes. Hoarseness. Hysterical, vomiting. Impetigo. Irritations. Leucorrhea. Lupus. Menopause. Menstruation. Neuralgias. Ovary, disorders. Prostate, irritation. Pregnancy, vomiting. Pustules. Putrid, odor. Rheumatism. Seasickness. Septic, wounds. Stomach, disorders. Syphilis. Syphilitic deafness. Tongue, inflammation. Toothache, decay. Tuberculosis. Ulcers. Urine, incontinence. Uterus disorders. Vaginitis. Vomiting. Whooping cough. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - The preservative principle of smoke was discovered by Reichenbach, a Moravian alchemist, early in the nineteenth century. Reichenbach discovered Kreosotum, and introduced it into medical practice and there was a rush for the new remedy. Its name, derived from the Greek, means ‘ ‘flesh-preserver.” For a short time, it was a panacea and then fell into neglect, except among homeopaths. Meredith proved on himself “the first heavy distillate from hard green wood,” obtained at charcoal works in the 4x potency. The symptoms observed were so similar to those of Kreos. that they need not be separated, including a great thirst in the evening, enormous appetite, stabbings here and there, eyes feel as if in a woody smoke, sneezing, nasal pus, and spleen pain. Teste grouped Kreos with Ars., Merc-c. Plb., Stann., Nit-ac., Sul-ac., Croc, and Arg- met. in his Merc, group. He noted that several members of this group, while preserving dead organic matter from decomposition, have just the opposite effect on living tissues. The entire group shows symptoms including suppressed or, more frequently, increased secretions with putridity. Foul breath, bloating, decay of teeth and bones. Cadaverous coldness. Ravenous hunger, to anorexia. Predominant left-sidedness. The group favors the production of intestinal parasites and all are therefore anthelmintic. Teste added that Kermes of Weinsberg had collected 135 cases in which death has occurred apparently from eating smoked food. The leading symptoms in all were a burning pain at the epigastrium, bloody vomiting, meteorism, violent colic with constipation, slow breathing, sinking of pulse and dilatation of pupils. Kreos. is the most active of the carbons, producing rapid ulcerations and destructions of tissues. Disorganizes the blood. Pulsations all over the body and profuse bleeding from small wounds. Very severe, old neuralgic affections, pains aggravated by rest. Great debility with miserable feeling. Inflammatory ulcerations, cancers, epitheliomas. Useful in treating cancerous ulcers of the gastrointestinal tract and uterus. Affinity for the glands and mucus membranes, particularly the digestive tract and genitals. Tumefaction, puffiness, gangrene. Rapid decomposition of fluids and secretions and burning pains. Excoriating, burning and offensive discharges. Profuse, acrid, hot, foul, discharges, belchings, sputum etc., that redden the part. Lumpy discharges, menses etc. Hemorrhages, passive, brown, dark from small wounds. Blackness of teeth, leucorrhea, lochia. Fullness. Heaviness. Rapid emaciation. Scurvy. Complaints accompanying yawning. Pulsations all over the body. Congenital syphilis. Overgrown, poorly developed children. Ailments of teething children. Post- menopausal diseases. Kreosotum MIND - Deep, nervous and mental derangement, violent oscillation of symptoms. Ailments from strong emotions. Stupefaction, dizziness and vacancy in head with complete loss of thought, sight and hearing. V anishing of thoughts. Stupid, forgetful. Cross, willful and obstinate. Peevish, fretful, irritable, especially during headache. Dissatisfied, with everything. Child wants everything but throws it away when given. Apprehensive. Starting from fright. Fear at the thought of sex in women. Fear of fasting. Shrieking in children during stool. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences. Longs for death. Delusions, visions of fire, things seem taller. Says he is well when very sick. Sensitive. Music causes weeping and palpitations. Prostration and restlessness. Restlessness at night, after midnight, at 3 a.m. Children scream at night. Children would not sleep unless caressed and fondled. Child moans constantly or dozes with half open eyes, or is cross and sleepless during dentition. Restlessness before menses. Excitement before menses. Weak minded with suppressed menses.

Head - Heaviness or pressure in various parts of head. Pressing outward in forehead. . Buzzing in head. Pulsation in forehead and vertex. Dull pain as from a board pressing against the forehead. Occipital pain (Gels., Zinc-pic.). Headache with sleepiness. Severe headache before and during menses. Scalp sensitive, worse combing hair. Falling of hair.

Lids red and swollen. Agglutination of eyelids. Constant quivering of eyelids. Uncontrollable twitching. Intense itching of margins of eyelids. Suffering of eyes alternating with limbs.

Lupus on nose and face, with burning (Ars.).

Face - Sick, suffering expression. Face hot, cheeks red. Yellow pallor with red blotches during chill or heat. Burning pains, worse talking or exertion, better lying on affected side. Lips red, bleeding. Upper lip sore and cracked. Moistens lips frequently without being thirsty. Scaly herpes on eyelids, cheeks and around mouth. Acne. Old looking children.

Mouth - Aphthae or salivation during pregnancy. Bitter, flat taste, low down in throat. Putrid odor. Tongue coated white, sometimes dry. Pus, bluish, spongy, bleeding gums. Very painful dentition, child will not sleep. Intolerable toothache during pregnancy. Lips red, bleeding.

Throat - Putrid odor. Bitter taste when swallowing food or drinking water. Burning pain with inflammation. Burning, choking sensation. Hoarseness with pain in larynx, better sneezing. Scraping in throat with roughness and dryness. Vertigo - Vertigo on turning around quickly, with staggering. Vertigo in morning, in open air, passes off in a room. Must hold on to something. Vision - Confused, as when looking through a veil. Dim vision, as if something was floating before eyes, obliging to wipe them constantly. Dim vision during vomiting. COMMENTS - A remedy for decomposition of tissue or rotting away of flesh (Pyrog., Carb-an.). Discharges are brownish, yellow, and very offensive, a carrion-like odor, cadaver-like odor, putrid, like rotten flesh. Tendencies toward bacterial infections. Tendency to hemorrhage. Stomach and uterine cancers, gangrene, and injuries where the tissue decomposes and smells putrid. Breath or discharges that smell of rotting flesh. Cadaverous-smelling stools. Emaciation with decomposition. History of use in typhoid. Intermittent fevers, marked periodicity. According to Grauvogl, Kreos. has a short period of action, one or two days. He noted the incompatibility in intermittents. Chin., which has a period of two to three weeks, may be given after Kreos., but not Kreos. after Chin. Marked burning and stitching pains. Lupus of nose with burning pains. Chronic pneumonia with pain like red- hot coals in the chest. Pain and stiffness across hips and sacrum, at 7 a.m. sitting up in bed, continuing through the day. Knees give way and joints crack, particularly in the overweight. Guernsey noted that Kreos. particularly affects the inner temples, external ears and lobe of the ear. Chronic headache accompanied with great drowsiness, with moaning in their sleep. Intense itching. General sensitiveness to touch and contact. Large purulent blisters on concha of both ears with a red base like smallpox pustules. Small warts on the scalp after a headache. W. P. Wesselheft noted the indication of coarse, red, elevated acne pimples. Clarke used it for toothache cases where the teeth are decayed, especially if the gums are scorbutic. Foul breath. Useful for infections, abscesses and a bad taste after a pulled tooth. Teeth decay, fall out, with swollen gums that bleed easily (Staph., Merc.). Gums are dark red or blue and very painful. Pyorrhea. Nash noted the specific action on children, <K$e&\31ty dwimg dmitm. PawÁAl dentition. Useful for teeth that come in rotten and brown, then break. Cough compels sitting up all night, causes involuntary urination. Eye symptoms alternate with drawing in the limbs. Incessant vomiting, due to stomach weakness, inability to digest and rejection of a meal hours after it was eaten. Vomiting sweetish water during pregnancy, with pty- alism. Incessant vomiting with cadaverous stools in malignant disease of the stomach. Cholera infantum. Nocturnal bedwetting from too profound sleep, child cannot be awakened when taken up. Bedwetting when the urine smells foul, offensive (Benz-ac.). Prostate and bladder irritation during night. Frequently rises to pass very little urine, urine comes in a spray. Sudden, great urging, the patient cannot go quickly enough. Copious, pale urine. Complaints after menstruation or menopause. Foul smelling vaginitis where the chief complaint is the odor and not itching or burning. Guernsey notes the putrid leucorrhea, especially when it's fetid and exhausting. Discharge stains the clothing yellow or brown. Leucorrhea is better sitting, worse standing and walking. Foul and offensive lochia after childbirth. Sufferings from the non-appearance of menses, at menopause. General symptoms are worse after menstruation, during leucor- rhea, when yawning. Grauvogl cured with Kreos. 3x a young woman, 20, of suppression of menses with a concomitant state of imbecility. In another woman who had suppressed menses with tertian intermittent fever, the intermittent was cured with Chin-s. one grain four times a day and then Grauvogl, hearing for the first time of the suppression of the menses, gave Kreos. 3x with the result that the fever returned in full force. Quinine was again given and the fever again disappeared. Before the next period, as the patient was of the Nux-v. type, that remedy was given and the period was reestablished. Gentry recorded a case of a woman, 45, on visiting a friend ill with dysentery, was struck by the odor, went home, commenced to vomit, and vomited all food or drink and continued without ceasing, vomiting or retching for three weeks, being fed by the rectum all the time. She was greatly emaciated and had to be held up by the nurse. One dose of Kreos. 200c was given. In twenty minutes the retching ceased. The patient fell asleep, had no more vomiting and rapidly recovered. Up to this time she had been under allopaths, who advised that homeopathy should be tried, as they could do no more. James H. Freer cured a woman, over 80, who suffered from incontinence of urine during bronchial attacks, which compelled her to keep to bed. Villers had reported a case of incontinence, worse when lying down, that was cured by Kreos. This led Freer to the remedy, which rapidly cleared up the case, bronchitis and all. Freer also cured incontinence in a case of locomotor ataxia in a man, 74, with Kreos. 6c. An allopathic authority, Vladimir de Holstein of Paris, accidentally cured aggravated constipation in a chlorotic girl with 6 drop doses of Kreos., given in beer or milk. He gave it with the idea of “disinfecting” the intestines. Meredith cured with it a young woman, 17, of intense urethral scalding after urination. Cooper cured with Kreos. 30c a case of auditory vertigo in a patient with pegged teeth. No other medicine would touch the case. It is also frequently called for in acquired syphilis, especially in the skin manifestations. Kreos. cured at the same time constipation of ten to twelve days' duration. Harmar Smith cured a girl, 10, of very frequent and violent eructation, she was apparently healthy in other respects. Bell, and Puls, did no good. Arg-n., aggravated. Kreos. 2x at once did good and cured in a few days. Nausea during pregnancy, with constant inclination to vomit without doing so. Sympathetic vomiting. Vomiting sweetish water in the morning during pregnancy. Vomitingundigestedfood with uterine ulcer. Vomiting of large quantities of sour, acrid fluid or of white, foamy mucus. Hematemesis. Stools - Diarrhea, bloody, fetid, dark, brown, lienteric. Stools grayish or white, chopped. Very fetid, offensive, cadaverous-smelling stools. Bloody stools. Green stools during dentition.

Abdomen - Burning pain in bowels. Pressure in region of spleen. Griping pain about navel before menses. Inflation and tension of abdomen. Contractive pain in abdomen. Shooting pain in abdomen. Pain, as from ulceration in abdomen, when breathing and moving. Painful sensation of coldness in abdomen with too scanty emission of urine. Violent abdominal cramps, worse in groins. Colic, resembling labor pains. Obstinate flatus in old abdominal disease. Tabes mesenterica.

Constipation, evacuation very difficult, with burning. Cramp-like pain in rectum during stool. Sore pain, worse deep breathing. Child struggles and screams during stool, as if it would go into a fit. Constriction of rectum with uterine cancer. Burning hemorrhoids. Sensations - As if a board was across forehead. As if brain would force through forehead. As if something floating before eyes. As if a hard twisted ball was lying in umbilical region, burning as of hot ■ coals deep in pelvis, as if small of back would break. As if scapula and other parts bruised. As if tendon of elbow joint too short. As if hip dislocated, as if leg too long when standing.

Menstrual flow intermits (Puls.), ceases on sitting or walking, reappears on lying down. Profuse, lumpy menses. Discharge of clots of blood having a foul smell. Vaginitis. Yellow, acrid leucorrhea, smells like green corn, worse between periods. Offensive, corrosive leucorrhea, gushing like bloody water, staining the linen yellow. Milky leucorrhea following pain in coccyx. Leucorrhea during pregnancy. Vomiting of pregnancy with salivation. Lochia blackish, lumpy and very offensive. Hemorrhage after sex. Awful burning, as of red hot coal in pelvis. Corrosive itching within vulva, between labia and thighs, burning and swelling of labia. Scirrhus of vagina, painful to slight touch. Warty or cauliflower excrescences of cervix. Cancer, erosion of cervix. Uterine cancer. Food - Loss of appetite, everything tastes bitter. Aversion to meat. Craving for smoked meat. Disgust of food during convalescence. Better warm food, worse cold food, fasting.

Chest - Anxious feeling of heaviness and oppression in chest. Deep pain in chest. Sharp pain in chest, just over heart. Raw burning in chest, as if a hot coal. Sensation as if sternum were being crushed in. Constitutions - Dark complexion, slight, lean. Livid complexion, sad and irritable disposition. Old women with post-menopausal disease. Torpid, leuco-phlegmatic temperament. Old-looking children, hard to awaken. Blondes. Over grown, and poorly developed children with marasmus. Hemorrhagic diathesis.

Heart - Anxiety at heart with oppressed breathing. Sharp pain in heart region. Pulsation in all arteries when at rest. Pulse small, hard, slow. Pulse soft, weak, quick and trembling.

Back - Great debility with backache. Sharp pain from small of back. Burning in sacrum. Scapulae as if bruised. Dragging pain in back extending to genitals and down the thighs. Sensation as if everything would come out (in women), with urging to stool and urination, with leucorrhea. Burning in back before menses. Glands of neck swollen. Breasts - Sharp pain in breasts. Dwindling of breasts with small, hard, painful lumps. Breast cancer with hard, bluish red, and covered with little, scurfy protuberances.

Limbs - Skin on limbs dry and rough. Bruised pain in limbs. Paralytic sensation in limbs on waking. Boring pain in hip and knee joints, with sensation as if leg was too long when standing. Sharp pain in joints. Swelling of knee joints and wrists alternating with sensation of numbness and rigidity of limbs. Pain in left thumb as if sprained. Burning in soles. Ecchymosis, dorsal surface of fingers and hands eczematous. Sore scapulae.

Sleep - Great desire to sleep, with frequent yawning. Sleeplessness, worse before midnight. Children would not sleep unless caressed and fondled. Starting, when scarcely fallen asleep. Disturbed, restlessness of the whole body or sensation of fatigue and pains in all limbs. Tosses about without any apparent cause. Laughing during sleep. Child very difficult to waken out of sleep. Anxious dreams of pursuit, fire, falling from a height, being poisoned. Dreams of urinating, erections.

Skin - Dry, scaly eruptions, like psoriasis. Violently itching, moist or scruffy eczema on eyelids, face, joints, back of hands. Itching, worse towards evening. Nodosities and blisters like bug bites. Pustules and herpes. Wheals like urticaria. Urticaria after menses. Herpetic eruptions, better warmth. Old ulcers, painful, putrid. Ulcers break out and heal. Ulcers bleed after sex. Small wounds bleed freely (Crot-h., Lach., Phos.). Senile gangrene.

Modalities - Better from warmth, hot food, motion, pressure, after sleep. Worse from dentition, pregnancy, during and after menses, sex. Worse when lying down, rest, touch, sprains, eating. Worse in summer, open air, cold, 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., bad smells

Teeth - Very painful dentition, child will not sleep. Pegged teeth. Black spots on teeth. Teeth dark and crumbly (Staph., Ant-c.). Very rapid decay of teeth with spongy, bleeding gums. Toothache from decayed teeth. Intolerable toothache during pregnancy. Gums puffy, bluish. Bleeding of gums and nose, blood dark, quickly coagulating. Protruding gums infiltrated with dark watery fluid. Persistent oozing of dark, slightly coagulated blood after extraction of tooth.

Liver - Shooting and pressive pains in hepatic region. Sensation of fullness and pain as from contusion in liver. Lungs - Raw burning in lungs, pains and oppression. Sternum feels pressed in. Shortness of breath with sensation of heaviness in chest. Difficult breathing with anxiety. Gangrene of lungs. Copious, purulent expectoration, after every cough. Hemoptysis, periodic attacks. Black, coagulated blood expectorated. White mucus, easily detached. Neglected tuberculosis. Bronchitis with heavy pressure on sternum. Bronchial irritation during dentition.

Kidneys - Must hurry when desire comes to urinate. As if a lump pressing down on bladder. Hurried, involuntary urination when lying, on coughing. Can urinate only when lying. Bedwetting in the first part of night. Frequent urination with copious urine during day. Diabetes. Drinks much but passes little at a time. Urine offensive. Urine chestnut brown, clouded, reddish. Urine with red or white sediment. Urine colorless. Violent itching of vulva and vagina, worse when urinating.

Cough - Cough, worse evening, with efforts to vomit, with pain in chest. Dry, spasmodic cough in morning, causes retching. Cough after influenza (Erio.). Cough during dentition. Winter coughs of old people with heavy pressure on sternum. Fatiguing cough with old people, with copious sputa, thick, yellow or white. Cough with little sputum.

Perspiration - Cold sweat, feels weak. Sweats with heat and redness of cheeks. Sweats after coughing. Scanty sweat, only during morning.

Temperature - Predominance of cold, tendency to shiver. Thirst after shiverings. Transient chill without thirst. Chilly while at rest. Chill with great bodily restlessness. Always feels chilly at menstrual period. Coldness of face and hands. Feverish sensation over whole body, with good appetite. Flushes of heat with circumscribed redness of the cheeks.

PHARMACY - lac-c. Lac caninum. Dog's milk. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Arms, varicose. Arthritis. Backache. Bedwetting. Breast infections. Breasts, painful. Chancre. Colic. Croup. Cough. Delusions. Depression. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dysmenorrhea. Epulis. Eye, disorders. Fatty, degeneration. Galactorrhea. Gonorrhea. Headaches. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Hysteria. Ichthyosis. Leucorrhea. Mastitis. Migraines. Menses, disorders. Nephritis. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Otitis. Ovarian, disorders. Photophobia. Polyuria. Prostration. Ranula. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scurvy. Spinal, irritation. Stomach, disorders. Syphilis. Throat, sore. Tonsillitis. Toxemia. Tumors. Ulcers. Uterus, disorders. Vaccinosis. Varicose, veins. Warts. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Sammonicus and Sextus praised Lac-c. forphotophobiaand otitis. Pliny claimed that it cures ulceration of the uterine cervical os. Historically, it was considered an antidote to deadly poisons. The Lac-c. provings were made with the 30c and upwards, and were published by Swan and Berridge. As in the cases of Bufo., Cast-eq., and other historical remedies, homeopathy has confirmed the accuracy of older observations. Disorganizes the blood and affects the throat, breasts, kidneys and rectum. Great lassitude. Great weakness and prostration. Sinking spells every morning. Feels as if walking on air or of not touching the bed when lying down. Keynote erratic pains, alternating sides, often very rapid. Diphtheria, both as a curative and as a prophylactic. Mouth and throat covered with aphthous yellowish-white ulcerations, easily bleeding. Sore throats, that cease entirely, only to commence on the opposite side, and often returning to its first location. Sore throats apt to begin and end with the menses. Headaches where there is a sharp pain over the left eye, alternates to the right, then back again, with photophobia. Headaches, better cold compresses. Violent frontal and occipital headaches, migraines. The pains moves from side to side. Sensitive to light and noise, the least touch aggravates. Cannot bear one part of the body to touch another, must keep even the fingers separate. The spine aches and is sensitive to the touch (Agar.). Arthritis (Puls., Led.), particularly when moving cross-wise. Arthritis, better with ice on the joints, worse motion and heat (Apis.). Wandering rheumatic pains. Sciatica, pains alternating from the left to the right. Swelling of the joints with wandering pains. Coldness in different parts and organs, in blood. Easy hemorrhages, nosebleed, bloody stools. Fetid discharges. Gray, white, plastic exudates. Fatty degeneration of liver, spleen and kidneys and other solid organs. Scurvy. Toxemia of pregnancy. Breast infections. Decided effect in drying up milk in women who cannot nurse the baby. MIND - Alternation of moods. Mental symptoms worse before menses. Fixed ideas. Feels weak, nerves out of order. Paroxysms of nervousness. Very nervous, easily startled. Oversensitive, can't bear anything to touch her. Very restless, cannot concentrate her thoughts or mind to read, wants to leave everything as soon as it is begun. Absentminded. Very forgetful, makes mistakes in writing, speaking. Makes purchases and walks away without them. Pessimism. Severe hopelessness. Despondent. Want of self-confidence. Self loathing, especially of the body. Feeling of disgust and horror. Fits of weeping two or three times a day. Depression, doubts ability and success. Thinks himself of little consequence. Undertakes many things, perseveres in nothing. Feels she is not herself. Feels that everything she says is a lie, that she is full of strange, peculiar feelings. Imagines that he wears someone else's nose. Desire for company, light. Hysteria, delusions, fears. Hysteria at height of sexual orgasm. Cross and irritable, with headache. Hatred. Insolent. Intense hatefulness. Attacks of rage, cursing and swearing at the slightest provocation. Child cross and irritable, screams all the time, especially at night, will not be pacified in any way. Anxiety about health. Fear of disease, of tuberculosis, heart disease, heart attacks, dying. Fears she will become unable to perform her duties. Fear of going insane because of tormenting thoughts. Fear of fainting, of falling down the stairs. Fears to be alone. Fear of snakes (Calc., Lach.). Delusions while sitting and thinking Delusions, dreams of snakes, vermin, insects, spiders. Sees big eyes and creeping things. Sees faces, worse in the dark. Delusion that the air surrounding her is full of hovering spirits. Delusion that she wears someone else's nose. Delusions of having a horrible disease, that her whole body is filled with pus.

Head - Headache with blurred vision, nausea and vomiting. Sick headaches. Headaches that alternates sides. Headaches over left eye on first awaking. Occipital pain with shooting extending to forehead. Migraines. Sensation as if brain were alternately contracted and relaxed. Severe pressure on brain. Pains and throbbing in temples. Constant noise in head. Head very sore and itches almost all the time. Sore pimples on scalp, discharging and forming scabs.

Eyes - Dark brown ring under eyes. Eyes dull and lusterless. Eyes sensitive to light, cold air. Heaviness in eyeballs, with outward pressure. Eyes slightly swollen, profuse lachrymation with catarrh. Eyes watery and discharging. Agglutination of eyelids. Sharp pain in back of socket or right eye. Intense darting pain around left eye. Upper eyelids very heavy, can scarcely keep eyes open, very sleepy.

Ears - Ear infections that alternates from ear to ear. Green odorless discharge. Sensation as if ears were full. Intense pain in right ear. Very sharp pain in right middle ear, must cover ear when walking in wind. Wakened at night by aching pains in the ear of the side she is lying on. Noises in ears. Reverberation of voice, as if speaking in a large empty room. Ringing in the right ear, buzzing at night. Sounds seems very far off. Deafness from hereditary syphilis.

Nose - Fluids escape through nose, while drinking. Profuse, purulent nasal discharge at night. Discharge acrid, nose and lips raw. Watery discharge, followed by dry sensation in nose. Coryza, one nostril stuffed up, the other free, alternating sides. Stuffed feeling in nose and throat. Bones of nose sore to pressure. Coryza with discharge of thick white mucus. Fluent catarrh from tubal nasal discharge like gonorrhea, staining pillow greenish yellow. Discharge of bloody pus. Nosebleed when speaking or swallowing. Nosebleeds at night, only from right nostril. Alae nasi and corners of mouth cracked. Smell of flowers seems to send chill over her.

Face - Burning, flushing of face. Face very red, and then suddenly pale. Pale, careworn, anxious. Marked pallor of face. Swollen, she can hardly see in the morning. Neuralgic pains, worse talking. eating or slight touch, followed by numbness. Cracking of jaw while eating (Nit-ac. Rhus-t.). Swelling of submaxillary glands. Swelling of parotid passes from right to left.

Mouth - Mouth very dry without thirst. Putrid taste increased by sweets. Breath very offensive, putrid. Profuse salivation, slightly viscid, ran from mouth during sleep. Mouth constantly full of mucus, constant inclination to swallow, which causes pain. Drooling in diphtheria. Roof of mouth sore with blisters. Fetor. Acute ulceration and follicular stomatitis, aphthous and gangrenous. Nursing sore mouth. Noma. Jaw cracks while eating (Nit- ac, Rhus-t.). Dry and peeling lips. Scurvy. Stutters when talking fast, has to speak slowly.

Throat - Sore throat, from constant inclination to swallow saliva. Painful swallowing, pain extends to ears. Sore throat and cough with menstruation. Sensitive to touch. Swelling of throat, worse after sleep. Throat cold, feels burned raw. Sensation as if throat were closing and he would choke. Shining glazed appearance of deposit,pearly-white or like white porcelain. Throat glistens like fish scales. Uvula coated. White ulcers on tonsils. Both tonsils swollen and covered with spots of exudation. Tonsils swollen as almost to close throat. Tonsillitis, diphtheria, symptoms change repeatedly from side to side. Larynx sensitive to pressure. Lac caninum Lump in throat. Wakes with mouth and throat painfully dry. Throat feels stiff as a board. Pricking sensation in throat. Tickling sensation causes constant cough. Hoarseness during menses.

Stomach - Stomach tender and bloated. Coldness in stomach. Burning in epigastric region, feeling of a weight and pressure of a stone in stomach. Weak, sinking feeling at stomach-pit, with nausea, on waking. Gnawing, hungry feeling, not better eating. Severe throbbing in region of solar plexus. Nausea on waking, with headache. Nausea at beginning of diphtheria. Nausea better by belchings of wind. Sudden, incessant vomiting of all food. Frequent attacks of severe vomiting. Vomiting of offensive, dark green mucus.

Abdomen - Extreme heat in abdomen. Abdomen very swollen and hard. Abdomen very sensitive, can't bear it touched. Bearing-down pains in abdomen. Pressure from within outwards, as if contents of abdomen would be forced outwards. Severe shooting pains in abdomen. Severe burning, in right hypochondriac and iliac region. Griping colic with shifting of flatulence and diarrhea, followed by continuous rectal pain. Feeling of tension in left groin, does not want to walk or stand.

Rectum - Dysentery, blood with profuse, greenish mucus, cries with violent cutting pain in the rectum. Profuse diarrhea with colic pain. Diarrhea coming out with great force. Obstinate constipation. Great tenesmus, rectum as if it could not expel feces because they are soft. Urgent desire for stool, but passes only wind. Mucus yellow liquid stools. Stools large, whitish, rough, scaly, hard.

Male - Right spermatic cord, low down, sore to touch. Red, smooth, glistening, cauliflower-like chancre on prepuce, left side of frenum, penis greatly swollen. Buboes and chancres. Gonorrheal with intermittent pains in the urethra. When gonorrhea is better, nasal catarrh sets in. Marked sexual desire.

Female - Menses too early, profuse. Menses scanty at first with pain in left ovary. Menses flow in gushes. Dysmenorrhea, abdomen sensitive even to weight of clothing. Membranous dysmenorrhea, pain in left groin. Leuconhea all day, but none at night, even after taking a long walk. Foul smell from genitals. Intense painful soreness of vulva. Itching of vulva. Herpes. Raw and bad smelling sores between labia and thighs. Sexual organs easily excited. Flatus from vagina. Bearing down pains as if everything would fall out through vagina. Sharp pains in ovaries, alternating sides. Pain in left ovarian region. Heat in ovarian and uterine region. Retroverted uterus. Very severe after pains, shooting down into thighs. Food - Great hunger for large quantities, cannot satisfy her hunger. No appetite. Considerable thirst. Drinks little and often. Pain in throat better warm or cold drinks. Aversion to liquids, water, anything sweet, fat, greasy food. Desire for highly seasoned foods, salt, pepper, mustard, pungent things. Desires warm drinks, whiskey. Craves milk and drinks much of it, aggravates. Thought of milk makes sick, during sick headache.

Chest - Constriction of chest, as from sulphur fumes. Clavicles sore to touch. Feeling of oppression and tightness behind sternum, with desire to draw a deep breath. Stabbing pain in right chest, just below nipple. Trembling, jerking and fluttering through chest. Fetid sweat in axilla, staining linen brown. Herpetic eruption in axilla with brownish scab.

Heart - Coldness in precordial region, in blood. Heart beats rapidly from slight causes. Pulse rapid, quick. Full right pulse, small on the left. Palpitations of heart, irregular, causing shortness of breath. Violent palpitations when lying on left side, better turning on right. Pains when going up and down stairs.

Back - Backache, nearly all day between scapula, worse after becoming warm. Cold creeping down back. Spine aches from base of brain to coccyx. Spine very sensitive to touch or pressure. Sharp neuralgic pain under right scapula. Lameness and cutting pain under left scapula, worse turning in bed. Stiffness of neck. Aching in neck, wants to bend head forwards. Breasts - Breasts seem very full. Breasts swollen, painful before menses (Calc., Con., Kali-c., Puls.), and better on appearance of menses. Breasts sensitive to touch, pressure. Breasts sore when going up or down stairs, during menses. Mastitis, worse from the least movement. Breasts very painful with sharp, darting pain in right ovarian region. Constant pain in breasts, nipples. Breasts feel as if full of hard lumps. Breasts tumors and cancer. Tumors re-appear in opposite breast after being surgically removed. Knots and cakes in breasts, after miscarriage. Galactorrhea. Loss of milk while nursing without any known cause. Milk scanty. Dries up the breast-milk. Causations - Result of fall. Diphtheria.

Limbs - Alternating pains. Pain in limbs as if beaten. Aching pains in limbs and back. Rheumatic pains,flyingfromjoint tojoint and side to side. Rheumatism, better cold and cold applications. Wandering pains from joint to joint. Sciatica, right side. Pain in arms to fingers. Arms, feet cold. Burning of hands and feet at night. Ankles swell in the evening. Legs feel numb and stiff, cramps in feet. Lungs - Very labored breathing, couldn't lie down flat. Lungs feel as though fastened to chest. Profuse, sticky, tough, white mucus in masses, with coryza.

Sleep - Great desire to sleep. Sleeplessness from emotional strain, with entire nervous debility, crying. Can't find any comfortable position in bed. Cries out and talks in sleep. Dreams of snakes. Dreams of urinating, of going on a journey. Wakes at night with a sensation as if bed were in motion. Symptoms worse after sleep.

Skin - Dry, hot skin. Pimples between lip and chin. Herpetic eruption in both axilla. Ichthyosis with bran like desquamation of skin. Very small blotches like fleabites. Shining, glazed and red appearance of ulcers on shin and wrist. Crusts on skin, grayish yellow matter formed underneath and squeezed out.

Modalities - Better cold, cold drinks. Better open air, walking. Better turning on right side. Better from nosebleed, mental symptoms. Worse from cold, drafts, sharp winds. Worse touch. Worse pressure, motion. Worse a jar. Worse coughing, sneezing. Worse empty swallowing. Worse from rest. Worse at night. Worse after sleep. Worse during menses. Worse mercury. Worse morning of one day and in the evening of next.

Teeth - Pain in left upper molars, coming from left temple through left ear. Teeth sensitive to cold water. Teeth loose, caused by defective nutrition and exposure. Gums swollen, ulcerated, retracted, bleeding.

Tongue - Dryness of tip of tongue. Tongue, swollen, cold, stiff, looks patched. Tongue coated white with bright red edges, profuse salivation. Tongue coated whitish gray. brown, yellow. Vertigo - Dizzy sensation with slight nausea. Sensation of walking or floating in air (Stict.). Waking at night with sensation as if bed were in motion. Vertigo before menses. Vision - Blurred vision, nausea and vomiting at height of attack of headache. Sensation of a film before eyes. Tendency in retina to retain the impression of objects and colors, or the old image is projected into the next. Difficulty in distinguishing objects. Colored spots before the eyes. Difficulty in reading, letters run together, page doesn't look clear. COMMENTS - Hering stated that “Di- oscorides, Rhasis, Pliny and Sextus recommended it for the removal of the dead fetus.” Hering added that the remedy was revived by Dr. Reisig of New York, who used it successfully in the treatment of diphtheria. After Dr. Reisig, the remedy was used by Bayard and Swan. Swan's potencies were prepared from Reisig's 17c. Lac-c. was one of the major remedies for the diphtheria epidemics in the United States. Diphtheria with fetid discharges. Diphtheria paralysis. For the affects of diphtheria. Glistening, inflamed membranes, particularly of the throat. Glistening, ulcerated tonsils. Tonsillitis. Swollen mucus follicles, covered with cream-colored mucus. Glossy throat, may have white patches on the tonsils. Sore throats, worse on the left, alternates sides. Sensitive, externally and internally (Hep.). Difficult swallowing, sharp pain that shoots to the ear (Phyt.). Tickling sensation in the throat or a lump in the throat. Corners of the mouth and alae nasi are cracked. Hay fever and sinusitis where the discharges alternate. Ozaena. Discharges of the upper palate. Bloody pus discharges several times a day. Crusts, under which gray matter forms. Bones of the nose are sore to pressure. Hormonal and breast problems. Premenstrual syndrome with irritability, impulsiveness. Premenstrual syndrome with swollen, hypersensitive breasts, so sensitive the clothes cannot touch the breasts (Calc., Con.). Hysteria, especially before menses, can get violent (Lach.). Crying and weeping spells. Sore throats and headaches before menses. Menses ameliorate symptoms. Ovarian cysts (Thuj.). After a rupture or surgery of an ovarian cyst, cysts appear on other side. Breast cancer after surgery that metastasized to the other breast. Mastitis, worse least motion (Bry.). Hypersensitive nipples in nursing mothers, cannot continue nursing. More milk in one breast than the other, or pain in one breast while the baby nurses the other. For conditions causing milk to dry up, or to dry up milk. Lack of milk (Urt-u.). Restless, nervous and prostration. Vertigo (Con., Phos., Cocc, Asar.). Sensation of lightness or levitation, seemed to walk on air (Asar., Calc.), as if they are floating up off the bed. Makes mistakes in writing and speaking, poor memory. Periodic symptoms, worse in the morning of one day and in the afternoon of the next. Generally left sided, but will often move to the right. Alternating sides. Worse after sleep (Lach.). Very sensitive to the cold and cold wind, but better cold applications, worse heat. Desire milk and spicy foods. The modality “alternation of sides” once led Clarke to the cure of an eczematous condition of the eyelids in a child. The child's aunt, who brought her to him, causally remarked that it often left one side entirely and went to the other and then back again. Lac-c. cleared it up in a very short time. E. T. Balch asked for advice in the case of Maud, age 10, a brunette of healthy parents. She had fallen forward and hurt her chest while playing one and a half years earlier. Nothing was thought of it at the time, but when brought to Dr. Balch, she was pale, emaciated, capricious, with no desire for play. Her sleep was disturbed by frightful dreams. During the day, piteously begged her mother to take her, she was so afraid. She felt as though snakes were on her back. In response to advice, Balch gave one dose of Lac-c. 50,000c. dry, and in twenty-four hours the child became more lively and cheerful and very soon all abnormal sensations disappeared. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lach., Cong. (2) Lac-v. - headache, rheumatic pains, constipation. (3) Lac-v-c., curds - nausea of pregnancy. (4) Lac-v-f. - diphtheria, leucorrhea, menorrhagia, dysphagia. (5) Lac-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Nephritis. Constant desire to urinate, passing large quantities frequently, or scanty urine. Urination causes intense pain in urethra, soon passing off. Urine albuminous, scanty, infrequent, suppressed. Urine dark, heavily loaded with thick reddish sediment. Hematuria. Sensation after urinating as if bladder still full. Dreams of urinating and wakes with urgent need. Nocturnal bedwetting.

Cough - Cough from tickling under middle of sternum. Cough from constant tickling in throat. Hard, metallic cough. Croupy, dry cough. Hoarse barking cough. Cough with pain and oppression of chest.

Perspiration - Bathed in warm sweat, about face, neck and hands. Clammy sweat all over. Copious sweat of rank smell. Exhausting sweat after sleep, at night.

Temperature - Chilly feeling lasting all day. Internal chilliness with external warmth. Fever and chills for a few days, up and down every few hours. Heat alternating with chill. Intense fever on waking, with perspiration. Exhausting sweats after sleep. Wakes at night in cold perspiration with fearful foreboding.

HOMEOPATHIC - Joint, pains. Wandering pains. Sharp, stitching pains. Cracking in joints. Stiff, painful neck, worse turning head, worse draft, cold with dull, heavy sensation in head. Chilliness. Digestive disturbances. Pain in stomach, very tense, gurgling around 11 a.m. to 12 a.m. Sensation as if passage is obstructed. Headache above left eye, disappearing quickly, later on the right side. Icy cold feet in bed preventing sleep. Worse after eating, as if stomach expands. Fetid odor from axilla, genitals, or feet. Vertigo better lying. Palpitations, worsecoffee, fright, fear of heart disease. MIND - Anticipatory anxieties. Anxiety in chest. Impatience. Restlessness, nervousness, driving from place to place. Hurry, haste, everybody moves too slowly. Startled Lac caprinum easily. Fear of being taken by surprise or attacked. Fear of sharp things. Fear of having aheartattack. Fear of heights. Oversensitive to noise. Sensitive to odors. Capricious. Sadness, melancholy, especially during headache. Weeping, tearful mood, with headache. Homesickness. Desire for company, worse when alone. Averse to company with head pain. Aversion to music. Strong sexual desires. Fear of own sexual impulses. Contemptuous. Indifference to opinion of others. Censorious. Suspicious, mistrustful. Indignation. Sulking. Indolence, aversion to work. Irritability from trifles. Easy anger, lying down ameliorates. Anger, on waking. Anger from being interrupted. Uncontrollable anger, rage. Shrieking, screaming, desire to strike. Quarrelsomeness, scolding. Malicious. Threatening. Complaining. Rudeness.

Head - Headache above left eye, disappearing quickly, then on the right side. Fullness in the forehead. Heaviness in the forehead, above the eyes, better from pulling hair. Headache in the morning, 10 a.m. until 3 p.m. Pain accompanied by eye-blinking, sneezing, compelled to close eyes. Pain in forehead, left temple, better after sleep. Pressing pain in vertex, from exposure to sun, worse slightest motion.

Eyes - Pain in the morning. Winking.

Nose - Pain at root of nose. Acute smell. Sneezing.

Throat - Hoarseness.

Stomach - Appetite diminished, from anxiety. Burning pain, after eating, better bending double.

Abdomen - Heaviness.

Urine - Burning, hot. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if everything were turning in a circle, better lying down. RELATIONS - Compare: Lac-c., Kali-c., Lac- f., Lac-h., Lac-v., Lac-v-c., Lac-d. REFERENCES - Sankaran.

Male - Sexual, disorders. Sexual perversions. Night dreams with pollutions.

Female - Leucorrhea, curdy. Scanty menses with sensation of profuse flow. Food - Desires fried foods, cold milk, cold tea, spices, sweets.

Heart - Palpitations, worse from coffee, fright.

Back - Backache. Pain, between scapulae. Chest - Anxiety, in chest. Dreams - Anxious dreams of quarrels, being pursued. Dreams of old friends, animals, goats, vegetables, fruits, flowers. Amorous dreams with pollutions.

Neck - Stiff and painful, worse turning head, draft, cold.

Limbs - Arthritis. Joint,pains. Rheumatism. Wandering pains. Sharp, stitchingpains. Pain in left thigh.

Sleep - Icy cold feet in bed preventing sleep. Unrefreshing sleep.

Modalities - Desire for cold bathing with intolerance for warm bathing. Warmth aggravates.

Perspiration - Fetid odor from axilla, genitals, or feet.

PHARMACY - lac-del. Lac delphinum. Dolphin's milk. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

HOMEOPATHIC - Delirium during chill. MIND - Feels he is alone. Sensation of isolation. Insecurity. Introverted. Spaced-out feeling. Desire for company. Wants to be watched constantly. Conscientious about trifles. Irritability. Clairvoyant. Tranquility. Affectionate. Amorous disposition. Communicative, expansive. Jesting. Antics, plays. Laughing easily. Desire for amusement. Sentimental with music. Desires bright colors. Love for animals. Loss of self- control. Impelled to touch things. Fearlessness. Ailments from fright or fear. Anxiety about his family, children. Anxiety after eating. Fear of impending danger, of accidents, robbers. Fear in a crowd. Oversensitive to noise, on going to sleep.

Head - Headaches, occiput, temples. Dull pains, worse right side.

Eyes - Photophobia. Burning pain, redness. Eye pain during fever. Burning eyes from reaction to perfume.

Ears - Redness. Sensation of dryness. Stopped sensation. Hearing acute.

Nose - Nasal catarrh. Coryza with fever. Post-nasal discharge, watery. Sense of fullness. Pressing, pain.

Face - Pressing pain. Maxillary sinus pain. Food - Appetite diminished, enjoyment lost. Increased, hunger in morning. Thirst for cold drinks.

Mouth - Aphthae. Discoloration of tongue, red edges.

Throat - Dryness, painful on swallowing, worse morning. Burning pain. Sore throat, left side. Lump in throat. Voice loss. Vertigo - Vertigo during chill. Vertigo, with spaciness, obscurity of vision. Vertigo swaying toward left. Vertigo turning in a circle to the right. Vertigo as if floating. Vision - Blurred, foggy vision. Acute vision for small objects. Objects seem large. RELATIONS - Compare: Lac-c., Lac-f., Lac-h., Lac-v., Lac-v-c., Lac-d. REFERENCES - Herrick.

Stomach - Gnawing, pressing, burning pain, pressure, better warm applications, worse lying down on back. Burning pain, heartburn, after eating, coffee. Nausea in the morning.

Abdomen - Flatulence.

Rectum - Inactive bowels. Constipation. Diarrhea. Stools dark, dry, infrequent, loose, small and watery. Flatus after dinner. Burning, smarting hemorrhoids.

Male - Sexual desire increased.

Chest - Gurgling sounds. Sensation of a bubble, sides. Rib pain.

Back - Dull pain, on lying down.

Limbs - Numbness, better motion, rubbing, walking. Numbness in upper limbs during sleep. Numbness in leg, in morning. Cramp-like pains. Throbbing pain. Heavy feeling. Swelling of lower limbs, ankles. Sensation as if blister on toe. Foot perspiration. Eruption on foot. Itching on thigh, forearm, palm, in spots. Lungs - Tickling in the air passages. Dry, short coughs. Expectoration grayish. Pneumonia.

Sleep - Light, restless sleep, turning left to right all night. Sleep interrupted. Position changes frequently. Sleep, semi-conscious, hears everything. Unrefreshing sleep. Anxious to wake up on time.

Bladder - Burning, sore pains. Frequent urging to urinate, morbid desire. Urine odor strong, offensive.
