full:
PHARMACY - lac-ac. Lacticum acidum. Lactic acid. Milk acid. Lactis acidum. Dilutions. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Aching, pain. Aphonia. Belchings. Bones, swelling. Breasts, disorders. Canker, sores. Coryza. Cough. Debility. Diabetes. Foot sweat. Gastroenteritis. Glands, enlarged. Hoarseness. Indigestion. Leucorrhea. Morning, sickness. Nausea. Nosebleed. Pregnancy, sickness. Rheumatic, pains. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Throat, constricted. Throat, sore. Trembling. Vomiting. Water brash. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hering noted that lactic acid was discovered by Scheele in sour milk, the result of the spontaneous fermentation of sugar of milk under the influence of casein. It is also met with in many vegetable products which have turned sour. Reisig first introduced it into homeopathy. Lactic acid has been proved in both the lower and higher potencies, but many valuable observations have been made on patients taking substantial doses for diabetes as it was often given for diabetes in the past. In these cases, the symptoms of rheumatic fever were directly traced to the acid. Pain, swelling, stiffness and tenderness of joints, worse by motion (as with Bry., which antidotes Lac-ac.). Flying pains about limbs. One pro ver had pain along the right sciatic nerve. The well-known effects of milk that has soured on the stomach and remained undigested were produced. Nausea, vomiting, burning and sense of weight. Weakness, as if from exercise, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic affections. Rheumatic pains in joints, knees, worse by motion. Trembling of whole body, while walking. Debility, weariness of the limbs. Acidity. Hot acrid belchings, worse smoking. Salivation, water brash. Morning sickness. Fullness or lump like puff ball in throat. Frequent passing of large quantities of saccharine urine. Diabetes. Sweaty feet. Breast troubles. MIND - Confusion. Forgetful, can’t remember a thing an hour after it has happened. Dislikes to read or think. Lazy. Aversion to business or what formerly was pleasant to do. Contemptuous. Sarcastic. Finds fault, very exacting. Believes all she says is a lie. Great discouragement during pregnancy.

Head - Congestion of head, painless with strong pulsation of vessels of neck. Head feels very large. Headache with sensation of fullness in vertex. Dull pain in forehead, just over eyes and extending into eyes. Pain in head and back all night. Pain in occiput and alternating between there and forehead. Head sore to touch. Fine miliary eruption on scalp.

Eyes - Sensation of fullness in eyes with headache. Eyes feel tired. Eyes feel as if they would burst. Marked protrusion of eyes. Hyperesthesia of retina, steady aching in and behind eyeball. Pupils dilated. Photophobia, direct light painful. Jerking of left upper lid.

Ears - Disturbed and troubled by noise. Roaring in left ear on rising, in afternoon. Singing, snapping in left ear. Pain from parotids into ear, stiff feeling in parotids.

Nose - Great sensitiveness of smell. Severe coryza. Stopped nose. Sneezing. Thick, yellow mucus from head to throat. Dryness of posterior nares, with hawking of mucus. Nosebleed every morning.

Face - Face flushed or congested from headache. Erysipelatous redness on left cheek and side of nose. Small vesicles on nose in morning. Parotids feel stiff. Pains from parotids into ear.

Mouth - Mouth and fauces very dry and hot. Much saliva in mouth, tasting salty. Copious salivation and water brash, especially during pregnancy. Acrid taste with nausea. Sour, coppery taste. Very sore mouth. Roof of mouth dry, feels burnt. Canker sores.

Throat - Dryness of throat with hoarseness. Dryness and rawness, extending to larynx. Sensation of aplug in the throat. Excessive hawking with or without nausea. Keeps swallowing. Difficulty of swallowing solids, liquids more easily. Fullness or lump like a puffball. Sense of constriction low down in throat, rough and dry. Intense burning in throat, fauces and esophagus worse by eructation. Fauces hot, dry and swollen. Aphonia. Hoarseness.

Stomach - Burning and weight in stomach. Burning, hot gas from stomach to throat, causing profuse secretion of tenacious mucus, worse smoking. Hot, acridbelchings. Food sours. Uneasiness in stomach after food and drink. Nausea with water brash or vomiting, better from eating. Nausea, morning sickness, especially in pale, anemic women. Nausea on rising in morning. Nausea after breakfast, not severe, but very persistent. Nausea like seasickness. Constant nausea, persisting for days.

Abdomen - Pains across bowels and lower right side. Bearing down pain in upper part of abdomen. Sharp pain across lower abdomen before stool. Left hypochondrium sensitive to touch. Sharp cutting pains and jerking in muscle. Dull pain in left groin over hip bone.

Rectum - Aching pain in anus. Soft, mushy stool, diarrhea. Greenish yellow stools with tenesmus. Very costive, stool once a week, hard, black.

Male - Annoying erections in morning, but loins ache too much to attempt sex. Seminal emissions three successive nights.

Female - Menses scanty, more profuse than usual. Itching of vulva during flow. Leucorrhea, staining linen yellow, when checked, nasal catarrh ensues. Pain as if menstruating, sitting with feet high lessens uterine soreness. Pain in small of back and lower abdomen. Aching pain in region of right ovary, worse by rapid walking or exercise. Morning sickness with salivation, nausea and vomiting, water brash better by breakfast. Food- Appetite impaired. Voracious appetite and great thirst. Eating generally improves symptoms. Nausea on waking, better by eating in diabetes or pregnancy.

Chest - Left side of chest sore and painful. Cutting or sticking pain in upper third of right side. Constitutions - Suited to anemic, pale women. Large doses disagreed with melancholic, choleric constitution, dark hair and eyes.

Heart - Sharp pains around heart, causes palpitations.

Back - Pain in small of back, extending into shoulders. Sore aching in lower part of back, worse when walking. Stiff neck. Stiff down between scapulae and across shoulders. Breasts - Pain in breasts with enlargement of axillary glands.

Limbs - Limbs feel chilly. Debility, weariness of the limbs. Weakness as if from exercise with rheumatic pains in the bones, aversion to exercise. Rheumatic pain in joints and shoulders, wrists, knees, with much weakness. Joints swollen, not tender, stiff. Severe, sharp pains in joints, stiffness. All pains worse by movement. Trembling of whole body while walking. Lungs - Saw-like rasping sound. Frequent deep sighing inspirations and expirations. Spasmodic, ringing cough, caused by irritation in throat.

Sleep - Stupid, drowsy all day, restless all night. Sleeplessness from vertigo, from backache. Dreams of sexual intercourse, with erections, no emission. Horrible dreams, of abysses.

Skin - Skin harsh and dry, no sweat. Itching and burning, worse by cold. Red spots or blotches on various parts of the body, particularly thighs and lower limbs.

Modalities - Smoking aggravates all symptoms.

Compare - (1) Sarcol-ac. (2) Lith., Ph-ac. Lac-c., Lac-v-c., Lac-d., Sac-1. (3) In nausea of pregnancy, Nux-v., Puls., Ph-ac., Colch., Lyc., Lac-d. (4) Ip. - excessive hawking with or without nausea. (5) Caust. - phlegm in throat, cannot be hawked up, causing nausea. (6) Diabetes, Ph-ac., Acet-ac., Lac-d., Uran-n. (7) Flying rheumatism, Puls., Rhus-t. (8) Great discouragement, Psor. Incompatible: Coffee worse symptoms. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Tongue - Tongue dry, parched, red and raw. Thick yellow coating on tongue with bad taste in morning. Tongue sticky, coated thick white. Tongue sore on left side. Vertigo - Vertigo when turning head suddenly, on stooping, on rising. Vertigo at night. Vertigo worse with heat. Vertigo as if tossed on a rough sea. with nausea like seasickness. COMMENTS - Cartier noted its use for acute gastroenteritis, six to ten drops in a small glass of water. It was used locally in the tuberculous ulceration of vocal cords. Nash regarded the concomitance of rheumatic pains as the chief guiding symptom here. He recorded a case of diabetes with rheumatic fever supervening, cured with Lac-ac. 200c. Constant nausea, nausea on awaking, before rising. Nausea in diabetes, pregnancy, or rheumatism. Nausea, better from eating, belchings, worse from smoking. Smoking • aggravates the belchings. Diabetes. Severe pains in muscles and joints after exertion. Chronic fatigue with flu-like symptoms since physical over- exertion. Chronic fatigue with muscle aches. Inoffensive, copious foot-sweat (Sil.). RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Bry. (relieved sharp pains upper third right side, but soreness remained).

Kidneys - Frequent pain in kidneys. Frequent desire to urinate large quantities. Urinates day and night, the attempt to retain it causes pain. Copious urine, deep brownish red, with much reddish sediment. Sugar in urine. Morning urine contained a large amount of salt, in evening a large excess of sugar.

Cough - Hoarse, hard, dry cough with dryness of glottis. Spasmodic, ringing cough from irritation in throat. Cough from hot eructations. Cough with nausea and constricted feeling in throat. Constant cough worse spring and fall, with foot sweat. Cough worse from smoking.

Perspiration - Copious perspiration. Unusual perspiration of feet.

Temperature - Cold and chilly at times, mostly on limbs. Flushes of heat with headaches.

name: Lactuca Virosa
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better in open air, bending, sitting up. Worse from touch, crossing legs, sneezing, in a warm room. Yawning and stretching helps pressure in chest..
constitution: Angina pectoris. Anus, disorders. Ascites. Asthma. Breast-feeding, disorders. Constipation. Cough. Cramps. Diarrhea. Globus, hystericus. Gonorrhea. Headache. Heartburn. Hemiopia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Levitation. Liver, disorders. Musca, volitantes. Noises, eats. Pylorus, pain. Sleep, excessive. Smell, illusions. Spinal cord, pains. Spleen, disorders. Whooping cough. Yawning.
keynote: PHARMACY - lact. Lactuca virosa. Acrid lettuce. Poison lettuce. Opium lettuce. “Lactucarium” or Lettuce opium. N. O. Compositae. Genus, Cicoracee. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Specimens of both Lactuca vir. and Lactuca sat. might be included in the tincture. Tincture of…
full:
PHARMACY - lact. Lactuca virosa. Acrid lettuce. Poison lettuce. Opium lettuce. “Lactucarium” or Lettuce opium. N. O. Compositae. Genus, Cicoracee. Tincture of fresh flowering plant. Specimens of both Lactuca vir. and Lactuca sat. might be included in the tincture. Tincture of impissated juice. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Anus, disorders. Ascites. Asthma. Breast-feeding, disorders. Constipation. Cough. Cramps. Diarrhea. Globus, hystericus. Gonorrhea. Headache. Heartburn. Hemiopia. Hysteria. Insomnia. Levitation. Liver, disorders. Musca, volitantes. Noises, eats. Pylorus, pain. Sleep, excessive. Smell, illusions. Spinal cord, pains. Spleen, disorders. Whooping cough. Yawning.

HERBAL - The leaves of garden lettuce, Lactuca sativa, when too old and going to seed, have a bitter taste and the stalk contains a milky juice which is intensely bitter. This juice contains Lactucin and is common to all lettuces, but is especially virulent in Lact. vir. from which (as well as well as from Lact. sat.) Lactucarium or “Lettuce Opium,” is prepared.

HOMEOPATHIC - Brunton noted that Lact. has a soporific action and is used “instead of Opium to allay cough, quiet nervousness and induce sleep in cases where from idiosyncrasy, Opium is not borne.” This use of lettuces has been known from very remote times and has not been added to by old-school observers. The sleep-provoking power of Lact. is recognizable in sensitive persons who eat ordinary garden lettuce in salad. Boericke specified Lact. as a “true galact- agogue,” as it increases the milk in breasts. This remedy also acts upon the brain and circulatory system. Delirium tremens with sleeplessness, coldness and tremor. Hydrothorax and ascites. Impotence. Sense of lightness and tightness affecting whole body, especially chest. Marked action on limbs. MIND - Stupefaction of sense. Difficulty in thinking. Loss of memory. Anxiety and disturbed sleep. Great restlessness. Fear driving him from place to place. Negative thinking. Contrary. Excessive ill humor, provoked by slightest contradiction. Repulsive mood. Prolonged emotional suffering, resulting in emotional deadness orcoldness. Forsaken feeling. Disposition melancholy, fretful. Sadness with extravagant and exaggerated notions. Headache after grief. Foolish behavior. Plays antics. Jumping. Singing or sighing. Delusions, sees soldiers on his bed. Delusions, that he would be murdered. Vivid, exaggerated fancies.

Head - Empty sensation. Sensation of looseness of brain. Dull, heavy, confused, dizzy. Heat of face and headache with general coldness. Pain, stupefying headache, after grief. Headache with disorders of respira- tory organs.

Eyes - Biting in the eyes. Burning in eyes, especially in the lids. Redness of conjunctiva with increased mucus secretion in elderly persons. Pupils dilated. Cloudiness of vision, weakness of sight. Hemiopia. Flying insects before eyes, on stooping after a meal. Itching above the eyebrows.

Ears - Drawing pains in ears, shootings followed by tension in left ear. Buzzing in ears, ringing sound before ears, in evening, in bed.

Nose - Sensation as though end of nose were distended. Peculiar smell before nose and a similar taste in mouth. Coryza, followed by excoriation and dryness in nose. Frequent sneezing.

Face - Pale. Heat of face with trembling and sensation of swelling of lips. Quivering in lips. Tingling with a feeling of tightness on face. Lancinations in chin at extremity of sub-maxillary nerve. Swelling of the lymphatic glands.

Mouth - Dry mouth, without thirst. White coating on tongue, thick mucus, sore, as if burned at tip. Contraction under tongue. Sharp pain in molars on left side of lower jaw, as if they were being twisted. Soreness of gums, on an empty socket on masticating.

Throat - Slight burning in throat. Difficult swallowing with sensation as if uvula were raw with burning. Sensation of coldness in esophagus from eructations. Accumulation of mucus in throat, viscid mucus in throat in morning. Vertigo - Vertigo with heaviness of head and lower limbs. Vertigo with blackness before eyes. Vertigo with sensation as if head were too large and expanded. COMMENTS - There are several recorded instances of poisoning. A man, 25, ate Lact. in a salad, 7 p.m. and went to bed at 9. He woke at 11 with sharp, colicky pains, soon followed by nausea and vomiting that lasted all night. He fell asleep at 5 a.m., but in the morning was astonished to find himself unable to distinguish objects clearly. A boy of 10 who ate the same meal became affected with lively delirium at midnight that lasted until morning. He jumped about on the bed, played all sorts of pranks and nobody could quiet him. He had no colic or vomiting. His pupils were dilated until the iris was a mere rim. Trying to read he mistook M for P and O for V. In his delirium, he had hallucinations, saw on his bed a soldier, an inkstand, etc. Both these patients as well as another had liquid stools. The dilated pupils persisted some time. Keynote indescribable sensation of tightness, affecting the whole body, but especially the chest. Intolerance to touch and pressure. Pain in spinal marrow even to cauda equina, streaming along coccyx. Right arm is much affected. Much yawning and stretching to relieve the squeezing of the lower chest. Squeezing in left breast. Feeling as if a hundredweight on chest. Feeling of relaxation in the chest. Angina pectoris. Asthma. Spasmodic cough in frequent paroxysms with feeling of suffocation. Attacks come suddenly without any apparent cause, induced by a violent tickling in pharynx and roof of mouth. Whooping cough, paroxysms preceded by anxiety. Antispasmodic. Chest symptoms are better sitting up. Lactuca virosa Tightness in the liver region. Enlargements of the liver with tightness. Stomach pain, better bending. Pinching in umbilical region, better crossing the legs. Constipation and diarrhea with many concomitant anal symptoms. Sensation as of a drop continually passing along the urethra when seated. Urine smells like violets. Hering noted “painful gonorrhea in females.” Used as a galactagogue (Aven.. Alf.). Extraordinary lightness of body, more pronounced in open air. Feels as if swimming in bed. Dreams of swimming in the air or of walking above the ground. The head feels light, empty. Sensation as if head too large, as if brain loose. Sensation as if looking through gauze. Mild sedative. Cured a case of hypertrophy of the ovaries in a woman of fifty as a consequence of a miscarriage twenty-five years before. The tumor was excessively large and the patient could get no rest because of the pain from the pressure. The rectum was contracted and feces evacuated with great pain. “Fatigue during stool,” and also “sleepiness during stool” were peculiar and may prove characteristic. Ebullitions rising up from abdomen suggest globus hystericus. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Vegetable acids and coffee. (In a proving of Lact., Acet-ac., aether and hoch. were more effectual than coffee). Compare: (1) Drowsiness, dryness and constipation - Op., Nux-m. (2) levitation, Stict. Puls., Ph-ac., Lac-c., Asar., Thuj., etc. (3) intolerance of anything tight around neck, Lach. (4) gonorrhea, urine smells of violets, Terebe. (5) squeezing in left breast, Bor. (6) Bor. has empty feeling. Coldness. (7) Helo., pain in soles as if he had jumped on a stone. (8) Bor., heart symptoms, Kali-c. and Kali- i., cough Dros. (9) Nabal. (10) Lach., Kali-c., (11) Spira. - galactagogue. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sensation of icy coldness in stomach. Sensation of retraction. Pains in stomach with contraction of pit of stomach, worse by pressure. After a meal, sensation of fullness in stomach with pressure downwards. Pain better passing flatus. Loathing, nausea, vomiting, sometimes with uneasiness at pit of stomach.

Abdomen - Sensation of weight, fullness. Movements in abdomen. Borborygmi, abundant emission of wind. Colic in early morning, tense abdomen, relieved somewhat by evacuation and passing of wind. Cramping pain, better passing flatus. Dull shocks or else lancinations in right hypochondrium. Contusive pain in liver region, in morning.

Rectum - Constipation, no stool the first day or else a tardy and hard evacuation (habitual constipation diminishes). Stool only after urgent calls and griping. Sensations - As if chest would fly to pieces. As if circulation in legs was suspended. Coldness of stomach, throat, chest, feet.

Male - Drawing pains at root of penis, in right spermatic cord and along internal surface of thigh. Diminished sexual appetite, chases away lasciviousness and voluptuous fancies. Painful erections during morning sleep. Swelling of a lym- phatic vessel in penis, following morning erections.

Female - Promotes menses. Menses too early. Bearing down and weak feeling about pelvic organs and general relaxed feeling. Painful gonorrhea. Food - Want of appetite, food is repugnant, no appetite for bread and meat. Food tastes sickly, bitter. Appetite and thirst increased. Desires milk, pickles, sour. Aversion to bread, meat, wine. Better from bread, coffee, vegetable acids, worse from milk.

Chest - Constriction. Sense of oppression of chest. Squeezing sensation in lower chest. Sensation of warmth. Pain on bending forward. Shaking of chest during cough.

Back - Tension in muscles of neck or right side, sometimes spasmodic. Lancinations under right armpit. Pains in spinal marrow, as far as the cauda equina and extending to sacrum. Contusive pain in lumbar region. Drawing pains in loins towards the groins. Breasts - Milk absent. Increase of milk in breasts (Asaf.).

Limbs - Cramp-like pains. Rush of blood to lower limbs. Sensation as if circulation in legs were suspended. Numbness while sitting. Coldness and numbness of feet and legs. Lame hip down left side, worse walking. Cramps in shin bones, extending to toes and side of leg involving calves. Tension in hollow of knee on rising from a seat, while walking. Tremor of hands and arms. Lungs - Difficult breathing. Suffocative breathing from dropsy of the chest. Irritating, suffocating cough. Constant tickling cough. Incessant, spasmodic cough, as if chest would fly to pieces.

Sleep - Irresistible drowsiness in daytime. Frequent yawning and stretching of limbs. Restless, impossible to get to sleep. Insomnia. Disturbed sleep from anxiety, cough. Position, lying on back impossible. Sound, refreshing sleep. Deep, comatose sleep.

Skin - Subcutaneous lancinating and pinching in various places. Inflammation and eruptions.

Modalities - Better in open air, bending, sitting up. Worse from touch, crossing legs, sneezing, in a warm room. Yawning and stretching helps pressure in chest.

Kidneys - Dragging pressure in region of bladder, as from urgency to urinate. Burning in urethra. Urine smells of violets. Urine clear as water, copious. Sensation as of a drop continuously passing along the urethra when seated.

Cough - Cough as from dust. Must hold chest with both hands.

Temperature - Slight shivering chill. Frequent coldness over back and head, with heat in face. Chilliness in a warm room with coldness of hands and feet. Dry heat of upper part of body, with icy coldness of feet.

name: Laetrile
author: Murphy
constitution: Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Tumors. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - laetr. Laetrile. Amygdalin. Pangamic acid. Vitamin B-17. Anti-cancer drug. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism.…
full:
PHARMACY - laetr. Laetrile. Amygdalin. Pangamic acid. Vitamin B-17. Anti-cancer drug. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Cancer. Cyanosis. Dizziness. Fatigue. Hair, loss. Headache. Hypotension. Liver, damage. Muscular, weakness. Nausea. Ptosis. Rheumatism. Tumors. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Laetrile formula is laevo- D-mandelonitrile-B-glucoronide. Laetrile is a decomposition product resulting from the hydrolysis of amygdalin. This compound is chemically related to amygdalin, a substance found naturally in the pits of apricots and various other fruits. The term “laetrile” was first proposed by Ernest T. Krebs, Jr. in 1949. Most proponents of laetrile for the treatment of cancer use the terms “laetrile” and “amygdalin” interchangeably. Amygdalin is one of the first and best known cyanogenic glycosides. Neither amygdalin nor laetrile contain free cyanide. Amygdalin is a herbal constituent derived from the kernels of various fruits of the Genus Prunus (synonym amygdalus), which includes the plum, prune, cherry, peach and apricot. It is among the most ancient herbal remedies used against cancer. Apricot kernels have been in medical use since the days of Pen T'sao (an herbalist), in 2800 B.C., in China. The great Persian master of pharmacy, medicine and natural sciences. Avicenna (980-1037), recommended the use of apricot bitter oil in the treatment of tumors of the spleen, uterus, stomach and liver. Some doctors believe that laetrile relieves the pain of cancer. Experimental results show effects of amygdalin on breast tumors. Adenocarcinomas. Stoppage of growth of small tumors. Prevents the development of lung cancer metastases. Other reported uses have been in the treatment of high blood pressure and rheumatism. Toxicities are generally mild when patients adhered to treatment schedules. The side effects associated with treatment mirror the symptoms of cyanide poisoning, including nausea, vomiting, and headache. Fatigue, muscular weakness, pain. Respiratory difficulties. Decreased blood cell counts. Hair loss and mouth sores. More severe side effects are experienced when laetrile is given by mouth than when it is given by injection, including mental confusion, dizziness. Cyanosis, anemia, hypotension. Liver damage. Ptosis. Ataxic neuropathies, difficulty walking due to damaged nerves. Coma. RELATIONS - Compare: Ars., Cadm-s., Hydr. REFERENCES - Murphy.

Hemor- rhoids and hard stool with blood. Menses appeared too early and were scanty. HOMEOPATHIC - Lapa, was proved by Widenhorn. It produced some rather severe headaches and nosebleeds. Hansen said it is indicated in nosebleed following headache. Weight in stomach. Pain in kidneys with pressure from without inwards. Weak feeling in genitals. Leucorrhea with uterine bearing down pain. Weariness. MIND - Sadness and morose, alternating with gaiety. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Rumx., Rheum., Phyt. (2) Sep., Lil-t. (3) Kidney pain, Santa. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - lap-a. Lapisalbus. White stone. Calcarea silico-fluorica. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscesses. Anemia. Bronchocèle. Cancer. Cretinism. Dyspepsia. Dysmenorrhea. Epithelioma. Fibroids. Fibroma. Glands, disorders. Goiter. Growths. Hemorrhages. Leucorrhea. Lipoma. Otitis media. Pruritus, vulva. Sarcoma. Scirrhous. Scrofula. Sores. Tuberculosis. Tumors. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lapis albus is silico-fluo- ride of calcium. A kind of gneiss, it was found by Grauvogl in the mineral springs of Gastein, Germany. These waters flow over gneiss formations into the valley of the Achen, where goiter and cretinism abound. The mineral waters have a reputation for curing ulcers, cancers and tumors. Grauvogl cured with it a case of carcinoma and he and others have cured cases of goiter and scrofulous glands. Uterine cancer. Fibroid tumors with intense burning pains through the part with profuse hemorrhage. Pre-ulcerative stage of carcinoma. Sarcoma. Lipoma. Growths. Glandular disorders, glands are elastic and pliable (Calc-f. and Cist, have a stony hardness). Goiter. Especially affects the connective tissue about the glands. Glandular swellings where no glands are usually found. Scrofulous affections, except in malarial cases. Fat, anemic babies with a ravenous appetite. Burning, shooting, stinging pains in the stomach, pylorus, in the breasts and uterus. Severe menstrual pains causing weakness and swooning.

Head - Sick headache.

Ears - Suppurative otitis media.

Face - Opening in cheek as large as a silver dollar, in carcinoma. Epithelioma of lip, crusts coming off leave raw surface. Tumor of lower lip with burning, stinging pains, that make him jump off his feet.

Female - Painful menses, suddenly taken with pain so severe that she swoons. Lapis albus Severe pain preceding the flow. Pruritus vulva. Burning, shooting, stingingpains in breasts and uterus. Uterine carcinoma. Food - Ravenous appetite.

Chest - Persistent pains in breast region. Glandular hardening.

Skin - Scrofulous abscesses and sores. Pruritus. Enlargement and induration of glands, especially the cervical glands. Lipoma, sarcoma, carcinoma. COMMENTS - In two cases of cervical glands cured by Lap-a. 6c, Dewey related that a ravenous appetite developed while the remedy was being taken. He also noted that the swelling of the glands was elastic rather than of stony hardness. In one patient, the swelling was as large as a goose-egg in the right sternoclavicular region. This patient, a young woman, was a blonde, as also was a woman of thirty-five whom he cured of goiter with the remedy. Whiting recorded a fragmentary proving of Lap-a. Mrs. Smith., 40, fair, stout, no children, had a large bronchocele. Averse to all animal food, craved sweets. Craved and drank much ice-water in all seasons since a child. Feet and legs cold to knees. Lap-a. 6x was given, 2 grains, powders, one four times a day. She reported in a month that the tumor was rapidly diminishing in size, but she was having much pain in it. No further medicine was given. Two months later, the tumor had diminished to one-half, and the patient stated that since taking the powders she had had no pain at her menstrual period, no dyspepsia and no sick-headaches. She had experienced severe dysmenorrhea since the menses first appeared. Since leaving off the medicine, the pain in the tumor ceased and also the decrease in size. Lap-a. 6x was again given and again the pain in the tumor came on and in addition, itching of the external genitals. The 30c and 200c caused such intense itching that the patient refused to take any more medicine of any kind. Since then, Whiting cured many cases of pruritus and also of dysmenorrhea with Lap-a. The pains come on before the flow and cause swooning. One patient, 19, had dysmenorrhea from the first. Pain so severe she would fall unconscious wherever she might happen to be, the swoon lasting half an hour at times. Better when flow established. Lap-a. 200c cured. Miss X., 34, normal until she had measles at age 20; since then, pain at commencement of menstruation, so severe as to cause fainting. “This severe pain would continue less for a day or until the flow was established.” Lap-a. 200c cured in six months. W. P. Wesselheft, discussing Whiting's paper, narrated the cure of a case of epithelioma of the lip in a man of seventy with Lap-a. 12x in water. Dr. Gregory cured a young man of a tumor of the lip with Lap-a. 30c. It recurred two years later with “burning, stinging pain, which made him jump off his feet.” More Lap-a. 30c was given and cured in a year. There was in further recurrence. Bellows noted that where Sil. is indicated, progress is hastened by Lap-a. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Sil., Bad., Ars-i., Calc-i., Con., Kali-i., Aster. (2) Gast. - effect on scar tissues. (3) Ars., Calc., Cund., lod., Kali-c., Spong. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - lap-gr-m. Lapis granites murvey. Granite rock. Murvey granite from near Barna. Co. Galway, Ireland. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chronic fatigue. Constipation. Dandruff. Diarrhea. Exhaustion. Fevers. Flatulence. Headache. Influenza. Nausea. Rheumatism. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lap-gr-m. wasfirstused as a medicine by ancient Egyptian physicians and it is mention in many of the medical scrolls. It has recently been proved in England by Nuala Eising. Connemara granite of Ireland has one of the highest levels of radioactivity of the granites found in Britain and Ireland. The pink granite has a particularly high level of radioactivity. Granite in Ireland is considered responsible for a higher rate of cancer and Down's syndrome in that country. Eising obtained a sample of the granite by breaking through a rock and taking a piece from the center which was previously not exposed. This was sent to the Galen Pharmacy and was potentized to the 30c potency, which was used by the provers. Extreme exhaustion and weakness. Inability to move. Drags oneself around the place, having to lie down, sleep often. No inclination to do anything, pleasurable. Profound introversion and withdrawal. Occasional bursts of energy or nervous high energy. Heavy and painful limbs. Rheumatic pains. Pressure, bruised and sore feeling. Headaches, frontal pain, or in temples. Delirious fevers or milder, recurring fevers, with profuse sweating. Marked effect on the liver and digestive system, with nausea. Yellow skin. Lost or diminished sexual energy. Pain and discomfort in genital areas generally. Disturbed menstrual cycle and menstruation. MIND - Apathy and weakness. Making decisions was a great effort. Spaced out all day and very giddy. Lack of concentration, very forgetful. Deep feeling of sadness and worthlessness. Weepy. Self-pity. Vulnerable feeling. Self-doubt, poor self-confidence. Restlessness. Easily startled by sudden noises. Great fear for no apparent reason. Fear or panic attacks. Claustrophobia. Feeling of anticipation. Uneasy feelings as if something were about to happen or as if she had something to do and couldn't remember what. Extremely introverted, detached and indifferent. Lonely.Introversion with arrogance. Believes that others are trivial or petty. Aversion to company, to socializing. Contempt for others. Insolent and rude. Suspicious of motives of others. Outbursts of anger. Irritability or anger at being invaded or disturbed by others.

Head - Frontal pressure. Temples felt bruised and sore. Headache as if a tight band. Frontal headache, in morning. Head hot, scalp and forehead very itchy. Dandruff. Scalp scaly, itching with hair falling out.

Eyes - Eyes were stinging, burning and watering. Burning sensation and pressure behind eyes. Eyelids felt heavy all day. Short-sighted.

Ears - Ear infections. Ears itchy inside and a thick discharge following. Eruption like a cold sore appeared on the left ear lobe, scabby, pus, itching. Ears felt like they were stuffed with cotton wool. Pressure and popping in ears, affecting hearing. Difficult hearing, voices and sounds seemed distant.

Nose - Acute sense of smell.

Face - Pale. Face looks strained, frowns a lot.

Throat - Throat sore and raw. Tickling it throat causing a cough. Vertigo - Feels giddy and exhausted. COMMENTS - Occasional desire forthe com pany of one close friend, where no social effor was necessary, marked during anxiety. Asser tive. Fear or panic attacks. Anxiety rising suddenly without apparent cause. Restless ness, have to keep moving. Trembling al over, particularly hands. Easily startled b; sudden noises or while driving. Eruptions. Red patches on skin, dry itchin; with aggravations from dairy products. Ski and scalp symptoms. Inner ear infection; with pressure and popping. Weakness an nausea aggravated by smoking. One case concerned a man who had move to Galway two years earlier and was havin recurring panic attacks since then. He wi very introverted, with profound feelings c loneliness and isolation. He was prone 1 outbursts of anger. Granite 200c cured. A second case concerned a woman wf suffered from severe headaches, pain fro her eyes. She had been diagnosed as nea sighted and needed glasses. She was tin all the time and had difficulty getting out bed in the morning. Introverted, strong feelings of hatred and jealousy. Enjoyed trying to provoke her passive husband into fighting. Granite 200c cured. She has hadhereyes tested again since the remedy and her sight became perfect. RELATIONS - Sulph. antidoted one proving and Zinc, the other. Compare: (1) Sil., Sep., Staph., Plat., Nat- m. REFERENCES - Eising. Watson.

Stomach - Nausea with lost of appetite.

Abdomen - Dull, heavy, dragging pain in lower abdomen, has to bend double. Pain radiates down thighs. Tension in the solar plexus. Spluttery and full of gas with cramps in abdomen.

Rectum - Constipation and diarrhea. Chalky colored diarrhea, in the morning. Diarrhea with pains like premenstrual pains in her lower abdomen.

Male - Sexual energy lost or diminished.

Female - Disturbed menstrual cycle and menstruation, with pain and discomfort. Menses with severe pain in lower abdomen and lower back. Sharp pain in right ovary. Sexual urge diminished or lost. Food - Appetite lost, with nausea. Hungry but couldn't find any food that interested her. Nibbling at food all the time out of boredom. Craving for sweets. Thirsty most of the time.

Back - Neck felt tense and painful. Aching, dull, heavy pain in the lower back. Pain in kidney region. Breasts - Breasts sore and swollen.

Limbs - Limbs sore and achy. Rheumatic pains, in right arm and left thigh at night. Sore, bruised type in left shoulder, over left kidney and in left hip. Arms were very heavy, had no power in them, lifting things was very difficult. Lungs - Cough, like she was clearing her throat all the time. Short, phlegmy cough.

Sleep - Confused, exhausted on waking. Unrefreshing sleep. Dreams about the past, grandparents, mother, elderly relatives dying. Very aggressive dreams, attaching people, being in a war, being raped dead babies.

Skin - Very yellowish skin. Skin generally itchy, particularly the scalp. Pimples on neck and back. Eruptions, red patches of dry skin, intensely itching and burning. Must scratch, scratching brings up little lumps.

Modalities - Better lying down, from alcohol. Worse from cold, even when hot. Worse from tobacco, particularly the weakness and nausea.

Kidneys - Sharp, stabbing pains over kidneys. Aching pain in back over kidneys. Pressure on bladder. Frequent urination.

Temperature - Fever with sweat. Hot anc feverish, sweating on palms and back Sweating in bed.

PHARMACY - lap-laz. Lapis lazuli. Gemstone. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Boils. Anal, itching. Conjunctivitis. Coryza. Diarrhea. Flatulence. Glands, swelling. Hair, loss. Headaches. Heartburn. Hemorrhoids. Hoarseness. Itching. Lachrymation. Leucorrhea. Meniere's, disease. Nausea. Night-sweats. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Thyroid swollen. Tinnitus. Trembling. Vesicles. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - The name lapis lazuli originated from Arabic “lazaward,” meaning blue, and developed into azul, meaning blue sky. It is a combination of natrium- alumina-silicea with the golden lines and spots of pyrite. In folk medicine, lapis lazuli was used to treat cataract, headache, laryngitis, pharyngitis, and to regulate the thyroid gland. Neuritis, neuralgic pains, cramping pains, joint pains, dysmenorrhea. Melancholy, fever, apoplexy, epilepsy. Spleen diseases. Respiratory tract. MIND - Absent-minded. Difficult concentration. Mistakes in speaking. Awkward, drops things. Weariness, worse in morning. Apathy, with sleepiness. Mind active. Fretful. Vexation. Anger, bad temper. Irritable. Offended easily, take s everything in a bad light. Conscientious about trifles. Haughty. Indifferent. Averse to company, presence of other people aggravate symptoms. Tranquility, serenity, yielding disposition. Forsaken feeling. Sense of isolation. Despondent, depressed, gloomy, melancholy. Causeless sadness. Taciturn, desire to be silent. Cannot cry, though sad. Weeping suddenly. Full of indefinite desires. Desire for retirement. Fear of rain, water. Fear of being hurt, of impending disease. Anxiety from the pains in the heart. Presentiment of death. Delusions eyes are falling out, that she is pregnant. Dreams of water, churches, witches. Prophetic dreams. Clairvoyance.

Head - Hair, loss. Headaches. Itching of scalp.

Eyes - Conjunctivitis. Itching. Lachrymation from eye pain. Dim vision. Tired expression and sensation.

Ears - Heat sensation. Ear pain on blowing nose. Tinnitus. Noises in ears, rushing, whistling.

Nose - Nasal obstruction. Coryza. Fluent discharges. Nosebleeds, during headache or vertigo, on blowing the nose.

Face - Acne rosacea. Pale or red color. Boils. Crusty, scabby eruptions.

Mouth - Dryness. Cracked, dry lips.

Throat - Cold sensation. Sore throat. Burning in throat. Sharp pains, on empty swallowing. Hoarseness. Nasal voice. Thyroid swollen.

Stomach - Nausea. Heartburn.

Abdomen - Distended. Flatulence, rumbling. Cutting, drawing and sharp pains.

Rectum - Flatus, offensive like rotten eggs. Diarrhea. Stools, bloody, thin, liquid. Putrid odor of stool. Stools like balls. Anal itching. Rectal bleeding. Hemorrhoids.

Male - Increased sexual desire.

Female - Brown leucorrhea. Food - Thirstless. Desires chocolate, alcohol.

Chest - Constriction, tension, tightness, on waking. Oppression of chest. Axillary glands swelling. Stitching pain in axilla.

Heart - As if heart would cease to beat. Pressing, stitching pain. Sore, bruised pain. Pain in heart, better walking. Palpitations with vertigo.

Back - Backache in lumbar region. Lancinating, sharp, and pressing pains. Eruptions like flea bites. Itching.

Neck - Swelling glands.

Limbs - Numbness, upper limbs. Tottering gait. Cracking joints. Joint pains, burning, stitching. Trembling, worse after anger. Weak knees. Felon, onychia, paronychia, panaritium.

Sleep - Disturbed, during the full moon. Wakes after midnight. Wakes from vertigo.

Skin - Acne rosacea. Dry and itching. Night-sweats. Boils. Eruptions, crusty, scabby. Vesicles.

Tongue - Burning sensation. Vesicles on tip. Metallic taste. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning, on waking, with nosebleed, during headache. Vertigo and tinnitus like Meniere's disease. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Chin-s., Thios. REFERENCES - Schadde.

Kidneys - Drawing pains in kidneys.

Bladder - Urging to urinate. Burning pains.

PHARMACY - lappa. Lappa arctium. Burdock. Arctium lappa. Lappa major. Lappa officinalis. Arcion. Gobo. Great dote burre. N. O. Composite. Tincture of fresh root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Backache. Belching. Boils. Bunions. Diarrhea. Dupuytren's contraction. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Eruptions. Flatus. Glands, disorders. Gonorrhea. Gout. Impotency. Infertility. Leucorrhea. Phosphaturia. Prolapsed, uterus. Rheumatism. Ringworm. Scrofula. Sour, stomach. Styes. Ulcers. Uterus, prolapsed. Vaginitis. Vertigo.

HERBAL - A writer in the Amer. Homeopath recommended the local use of the seedling roots in acne. The roots are softened by soaking in water for two hours, then the blunt end is rubbed on each individual pimple. It is not to be repeated more often than once a week.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lappa arctium has been extensively proved, notably by Dr. Jeanes and Dr. S. A. Jones. The provings generally confirm older teachings. Lappa chiefly affects the skin, liver joints and uterus. Historically, it was given for prolapsed uterus, infertility, milky urine and sores about the joints. It was one of Culpepper's remedies for fetid sweat of axilla. Useful in skin therapeutics. A large number of symptoms were observed upon the skin and mucus membranes. Acne, eczema, especially of the scalp, with discharge. Eruptions on the head, face and neck. In skin disorders, it has been used externally as a glycerol, as well as internally. Styes and ulcerations on the edge of the eyelids. Crops of boils and styes (Anthr.). Profuse and frequent urination. Heavy, sore aching, as if lying uncomfortably. Numbness, lumbar region of aching calves. Constriction.

Head - Weight on vertex. Pain in head. Eczema of scalp.

Eyes - Redness about eyes. Crops of styes. Feeling as if the eye was small and constricted.

Nose - Red discoloration across the nose.

Face - Inveterate acne, worse touch. Spreading vesicular eruption, great tearing and itching. Herpetic eruption on right ala nasi.

Stomach - Sour stomach, sour taste, all food turns sour, vomits it. Diarrhea alternating with rheumatic symptoms. Vertigo - Vertigo with nausea and vomiting. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) The composites, Am., Calen., Ciña. (2) Bry. - rheumatism. (3) Frax., Lil-t. and Sep. - in uterine prolapse. (4) Calc-p. - phosphaturia. (5) Vine., Viol-t. - skin. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Abdomen - Flatulent dyspepsia, belching inodorous gas.

Rectum - Frequent yellow stools in forenoon, with some nausea. Diarrhea alternating with rheumatic symptoms.

Male - Cutting, squeezed pain in whole length of urethra, scalding on urination. Ringworm-like patch of eruption on thigh beside testicles, groins raw. Loss of sexual desire.

Female - Uterine displacement, worse standing, walking, sudden jar. Bruised, sore, heavy feeling in uterus with great relaxation of vaginal tissue. Prolapsed uterus with much bearing down pain. Leucorrhea.

Chest - Trembling in chest. Acute tingling, cutting pain under middle of sternum, extending across breast.

Heart - Pain in heart with indescribable movement under sternum. Exceedingly rapid pulse with frequent intermissions.

Back - Pains in back about eighth dorsal vertebra.

Limbs - Eruption on limbs. Soreness of muscles. Pain in all joints. Old sores about joints. Rheumatic and gouty pains. Rheumatic pains entirely relieved by onset of diarrhea. Sharp, darting, fugitive pains in tendons. Dupuytren's contraction. Front of thigh weak. Pain in hands, knees and ankles extending downward to fingers and toes. Bunion. Lungs - Tickling in glottidis, loose-sounding cough, no expectoration. Short breath on exertion.

Skin - Eruptions, sticky on head, face. Many small painful boils. Moist, offensive eruptions, grayish white crusts, especially when glands are swollen. Moist, foul eczema of infants. Old sores, about joints. Axillary sweat cold, runs down chest, foul.

Modalities - Better from cloudy weather. Worse cold, wet, shaking, violent exertion, lying on right side.

Kidneys - Profuse and frequent urination. Milky phosphatic urine.

name: Lapsana Communis
author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - laps. Lapsana communis. Nipple-wort. N. O. Composite. Genus Cicora- cee. Tincture of infusion of whole fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Hemorrhoids. Nipples, sore.

HERBAL - As the common name of Lapsana would imply, it is a popular remedy for sore nipples, a decoction of it being used as a lotion for that purpose. Cooper published documents in proof of its efficiency in hemorrhoids. Three ounces of the green plant (or four of the dry) are boiled in three pints of thin water gruel until it is reduced to a pint and a half. The decoction is then strained. Half a pint is to be drunk on three mornings following, fasting immediately on getting out of bed. One patient who was cured in this way said he had no swallowed the draft more than a few minutes before he felt his stomach as warm as if he had drunk hot brandy and water. Only three doses were ordered and the patient was told, if not cured, to wait a fortnight before repeating the treatment.

HOMEOPATHIC - Laps, is a remedy for sore nipples and hemorrhoids. Cooper confirmed the power of Laps, over hemorrhoids, using single doses of the tincture. RELATIONS - Compare: Calen. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Lax and dampened, without energy or incentive. REFERENCES - Bach.

full:
PHARMACY - lath. Lathyrus sativus. Wild vetch. Lathyrus cicera. Lesser chick-pea. “Jesse,” “Jarosse.” N. O. Leguminose. Papil- ionoideae. Trituration of seeds. Tincture of the flower. Tincture of the green pods. Trituration of the dried pea. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Athetosis. Beriberi. Constipation. Cramps. Depression. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Emaciated, limbs. Emaciation. Heartburn. Impotence. Infantile, paralysis. Locomotor ataxia. Lumbago. Multiple sclerosis. Nausea. Paralysis. Paralysis, spinal. Paraplegia. Parkinson's disease. Poliomyelitis. Rheumatic, paralysis. Rheumatism. Roaring (in horses). Spinal, sclerosis. Urine, incontinence. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lathyrus is a vetch, a member of the Leguminosae family that grows in India. Lathyrus contains variable amounts of a toxin that, when ingested, may cause lathyrism, a paralytic affection. Produces a perfect picture of certain spinal affections. In Christison's Toxicology, it is stated that Lath, causes paraplegia, dragging gait, turning-in of the toes, stiffness and semiflexion of the knee joints. The clinical record of Lath, indicates that it may prove useful in numerous cases of bedridden paraplegias and infantile spinal paralysis, as well as in certain forms of myelitis. In 1877, Clarke published cases relieved by Lath., two of paralysis, one of multiple sclerosis, one of rheumatic paralysis with stiff knees. Affects the anterior and lateral columns of the cord, causing paralytic disorders of lower limbs, spastic paralysis, lateral sclerosis, beriberi. Infantile paralysis. Athetosis. Trembling of arms, worse on attempting to do anything. Increased reflexes. Lack of pain. Wasting, exhaustive diseases with weakness and heaviness, slow recovery of nerve power. Sleepy, constant yawning. MIND - Depressed, hypochondriacal. Lack of inner strength. Sense of being trapped by circumstances. Suppressed emotions.

Ears - Singing in ears.

Mouth - Burning pain, tip of tongue. Tingling and numbness of tongue and lips, as if scalded.

Stomach - Weight in stomach and indigestion. Heartburn. Nausea and vomiting. Vomiting of blood. Vertigo - Vertigo when standing with eyes closed. COMMENTS -The two varieties of Lathyrus that have occasioned poisonings are Lath, sativus and Lath, cícera. The peas are very alike in appearance. Those of Lath, cicera are rather smaller than Lath, sativus, more square, and are a lighter brown. Except for this brownish color they could easily be mistaken for ordinary peas. Lath, cicera has red flowers. Lath, sativus, bluish. Both are cultivated for food and are sometimes cut green for fodder. In the British Journal of Homeopathy there is an account of a wheat famine in India, where the peas of the plant were substituted for wheat and used as a food. Those who subsisted on it were taken, even during sleep, with sudden paralysis of the lower limbs. This occurred without warning in young men more than in young women, and was never recovered from. Another observer recorded fifty cases of people who had eaten the lathyrus bread and all stated that they became paralytic during the wet season of the country. They went to bed quite well and woke with stiff legs, unsteady gait and aching, but no severe pain. The upper limbs were free. Another saw the disease in Algeria and described the symptoms in ten cases. Symptoms came on suddenly in damp weather with some pains in the loins, trembling, motor paralysis and exaggerated reflexes. He attributed these phenomena to an acute transverse myelitis with degenerative changes in the cord. Polio (Gels.). Post-polio neuralgia syndrome (Rhus-t, Gels.). Guillain-Barre syndrome, ascending paralysis. Multiple sclerosis. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Characteristic increased reflexes. Weak and lame joints. Severe muscle cramps in the calves. Pain induced by touch. Emaciation of the paralyzed muscles (Plb., Caust.). Burning pain on the tip of the tongue. Weak bladder with sudden urgencies to urinate. Never well since an influenza or a virus. Symptoms may be brought on or be made worse by cold or damp wind. Burning heat, better uncovering. O'Connor found that marked benefit followed its use in old cases of myelitis with marked spastic symptoms. Bartlett recommended Lath, for excessive kneejerk and rigidity. Hart spoke of it as a remedy for locomotor ataxia, but the absence of sensory symptoms and the presence of exaggerated reflexes would seem to contraindicate it in this disease. He also spoke of Lath, in spinal anemia, giving as symptoms “numbness, followed by pain in the lower limbs, sensation of a band around the body, unable to step or distinguish one limb from another.” In a case related by Bojanus, the general symptoms were the same. Lath, was the cause of the trouble, arising during the great Russian famine. Horses fed with Lath, along with oats manifested symptoms of paralysis of the limbs and also of the throat and wind-pipe, setting up the condition called “roaring.” Some died of suffocation. Clarke relieved several cases of spastic paralysis, including Miss R., 25, who had been ill four years with the usual symptoms of spastic paralysis. Excessive constipation and violent urging to pass water, if she attempted to retain it, it passed of itself. The muscles were hard and unyielding. She was heavily drugged under allopathic treatment before coming under his care. Hyper, was first given with considerable benefit. As the improvement went no further, Lath. 1c and 30c were given and then the improvement was much more marked. W. A. Dewey recorded a cure with Lath. 3x in a case of spastic paralysis in a man of twenty-eight. The attack had been coming on six months. The patient was a hunchback, having been deformed since the age of five, but this had given no more than the usual inconvenience. Lathyrus sativus On admission to the hospital (December 1, 1898), he was unable to make the slightest movement of the lower limbs, even of the toes. The adductors were in a constant state of irritable contraction, so that the thighs were constantly crossed. Reflexes greatly exaggerated. No pain. Spine not tender. General health was normal. The only other symptom was a girdle sensation, as if he had a cold, damp cloth around his waist. Three weeks after commencing Lath., there was slight lessening of rigidity. On April 5, 1899, he could raise his limbs and move his toes. On July 2nd he walked out of the hospital without difficulty, the abnormal irritability of the muscles having disappeared. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Oxyt., Sec. (2) Peti., a South American plant. - paralysis, paraplegia with numbness. Sensation of internal coldness. (3) Agrostema githago - burning sensation in stomach, through esophagus into throat in lower abdomen and anus, nausea, bittervomiting. impaired locomotion, difficulty in remaining erect, vertigo and headache, burning from lower jaw to vertex. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Abdomen - Colic. Sensation as if a damp cloth around waist.

Rectum - Diarrhea, with urgent pressure on intestines. Dysentery. Constipation. Sensations - Sensation as of a damp cloth around the waist.

Male - Impotence. Occasional erections and pollutions.

Back - Lumbago. Pain in back so severe as to prevent movement, worse or excited by touch.

Limbs - Polio myelitis with marked spastic symptoms. Rheumatic paralysis. Excessive rigidity of legs, spastic gait. Tremulous, tottering gait. Knees knock together when walking. Knee jerks exaggerated. Cannot extend or cross legs when sitting. Sits bent forward, straightens up with difficulty. Stiffness and lameness of the ankles and knees. Heels do not touch the ground when walking. Feet are dragged or put down suddenly and forcibly while walking. While lying down legs can be moved from side to side but cannot be lifted. Legs blue, swollen, if hanging down. Cramps in legs, worse cold and cold feet. Legs are cold during day. become hot and burn at night better uncovering. Gluteal muscles and muscles of lower limbs are emaciated.

Sleep - Continuous yawning and sleepiness.

Modalities - Better uncovering, lying down (lower limbs move freely). Worse from cold, damp weather, touch, movement.

Kidneys - Pressure on bladder, if not immediately satisfied, urine, rushes out with great force. Incontinence of urine. Increased bladder reflex.

Bladder - Increased bladder reflexes. Frequent urge to urinate, must hurry, or else voided involuntarily.

full:
PHARMACY - lat-k. Latrodectus katipo. Red- back spider. N. O. Arachnida. New Zealand spider. Tincture of living spider. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Chorea. Delirium. Depression. Edema. Faintness. Heart, slow. Lymphangitis. Nettle-rash. Twitchings.

HOMEOPATHIC - Lat-k. is a venomous spider found in New Zealand and some parts of California. The symptoms recorded are the effects of bites. The seat of a bite becomes immediately painful and swelling occurs. In some cases, the swelling does not come on until some days after the bite. In one case, five days after the bite, a scarlet papulous rash appeared on both limbs, burning like fire. The symptoms were somewhat slow in evolution. In a fatal case, that of a girl bitten on the abdomen, death did not occur until six weeks after the bite. Lassitude, faintness, twitchings and trismus. Scarlet and burning eruptions. Lymphangitis with nervous twitchings. Long suffering, wasting. Loss of energy. Faint and pale. MIND - Delirium, half smothered by imperfect intoxication. Semi-intoxicated state. Nervous depression.

Face - Anxious expression. Extreme pallor changing to blue tint of face and body. Jaws stiff, could not open mouth to eat and could scarcely articulate. Food - Loss of desire for food.

Abdomen - Very severe drawing or cramping sensation in abdomen.

Heart - Almost pulseless. Pulse slow, scarcely more than twelve or fourteen beats to the minute.

Limbs - Severe shaking, burning pains ran from the bite on the foot up the limbs to back, with nervous twitching all over body. Pain felt almost equally in both limbs and seemed to center about heel. Feet felt as if rudely lacerated by dull instrument, walking him from sleep. Lungs - Breathing almost ceased.

Skin - Small, red spot like flea-bite. Bitten surface raised, the raised part white with red halo with swelling and pain. Swelling size and shape of hen's egg. The bite remained a small purple point for nine days, on the tenth began to swell and turn white like a bee sting, pain and swelling rapidly increased, dorsurn of foot and ankle like a puff-ball, red streak running up leg. A bright scarlet, papular eruption on both lower limbs, which stung and burned like fire.

Temperature - Limbs cold and flaccid. Cold, clammy sweat covered left lower extremity in morning. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lat-m., Tarent., MygaL, Aran. (2) Apis, Vesp. and serpent poisons. REFERENCES Clarke.

full:
PHARMACY - lat-m. Latrodectus mactans. Black widow spider. N. O. Arachnida. Southern North America, South America. Tincture of living spider. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Chest, pains. Colic. Cramping, pain. Heart, attacks. Heart, disorders. Hematuria. Hemorrhages. Idiopathic thrombocytopenia. Infectious, purpura. Proteinuria.

HOMEOPATHIC - S.A. Jones and A. J. Tafel introduced Lat-m. into the Materia Medica. The bite produces tetanic effects that last several days. From the time a man was bitten he took 3 1/2 quart bottles of the best rectified whisky without any sign of intoxication. Affects the heart, producing angina pectoris. Heart attacks. The precordial region seems to be the center of attack. Restless with heart pains and prostration. Constriction of chest muscles with radiation to shoulders and back. Fear of suffocating or dying. Blood becomes thin, watery. Lowered coagulability. Inflammation of the coronary arteries. Pain in the solar plexus. Infectious purpura. Chronic hemorrhaging endothelial plasmatic condition. Chronic idiopathic thrombocytopenia. Itching and redness of the part bitten, at first without pain, but violent pain soon commenced there (back of left hand), and extended in a short time up forearm and arm to shoulder and then to precordial region. Painful sensations extended up arm to shoulder, along neck to back of head, later, pain in précordia and apnea, screaming fearfully. Nervous tremors. MIND - Speech hesitant with tears. Apparently moribund. Depression. Mental fatigue. Amnesia. Memory gives no answer to logical deduction. Reading impossible. Staring up at ceiling, vague, in a stupor. Emotional disturbances. Very nervous. Acute and enormous anxiety, with sensation of imminent death. Anxiety about the heart. Intense anguish with the sensation of severe thoracic constriction. Screams fearfully with pain, exclaiming that she would lose her breath and die. Thinks he will suffocate. Fear of dying. Lamenting helplessly. Wailing. Agitation. Mental irritability and restlessness. Sensitive to noise. Writhing and rolling in pain. Extreme state of nervous irritation with fear of going mad. Psychosis, becomes mad and psychotic, with hallucinations.

Head - Pain in neck to back of head. Occipital pain. Headache, aggravated between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m.

Eyes - Constant pulsating pain in the eyes.

Ears - Pain in the right middle ear.

Nose - Nose blocked, thick, yellow discharge.

Face - Expression of deep anxiety. Food - Extreme thirst, vomits what he drinks.

Mouth - Labial fissure. Copious salivation. Trembling of the tongue. White coloring of the tongue. Hypertrophy of the lingual papillae.

Throat - Throat red, dry. Tonsillitis with glairy deposit on tonsils. Pain on swallowing. Vertigo - Vertigo and constrictive headache. COMMENTS - Heart attack (Cact.), with sharp, shooting pains. Chest pain. Gasping for breath, difficulty breathing with a fear of dying. Semple recorded a case of a man bitten on the prepuce. At first there was itching, in less than half an hour nausea, followed by severe abdominal pains. Soon after, violent precordial pains, extending to axilla and down left arm and forearm to fingers with numbness of the limbs and apnea. Dry cupping was resorted to and the blood that flowed was thin, florid and un-coagulable. When Semple arrived, he found violent precordial pains, the left arm almost paralyzed, pulse 130, very feeble, Skin cold as marble, countenance expressive of deep anxiety. At eight the next morning, in spite of stimulants, the symptoms were worse and continued to increase until 2:30 p.m. The pulse was uncountable and scarcely felt. Vomited black vomit, a quart or more. Soon after, reaction set in and the man gradually recovered. He had two copious stools like the black matter vomited earlier, and after that felt quite well. Jones noted that the precordial region is the chief locus of attack. He considered the order of the occurrence of these symptoms of great importance. Linnell recorded a case of angina pectoris, pain in precordial region and left arm, brought on by the slightest exertion, that was cured with Lat-m. 3c. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lat-k. and other Arachnida. (2) Helo. - coldness. (3) Lach., Spig., Cimic., Cact., Kalm., Lycps. in angina pectoris. (4) Hir. - non-coagulating hemorrhages. (5) the Aran., Mygal., Ther., Lat-h., Lat-k. spider venoms. (6) Triât., Kissing bug - swelling with violent itching of fingers and toes. A smothering sensation and difficult breathing succeeded by fainting and rapid pulse. (7) Helo. - Intense chill, going from the inside to the outside. Vertigo with tendency to fall backwards. Numbness of the limbs. (8) Kalm. - Palpitations, aggravated when lying on the left side, pulse slow. Lightning pains, suddenly changing place. (9) Cact. - Feeling of constriction of the heart, as if a vice, spreading to the left arm, which feels numb. Hemorrhaging of black blood. (10) Spig. - Violent contractions of the heart with oppression, anxiety. Feels soothed when lying on the right side with head raised. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke. Julian. Mtuphy.

Stomach - Eructation and loss of appetite. Nausea, then abdominal pains. Vomiting of black blood, which soothes the condition. Transfixation of pain or sinking at epigastrium. Feeling of weakness in epigastric region.

Abdomen - Severe abdominal pain with nausea and a sinking sensation at epigastrium. Colic and hardness of the abdominal wall. Chronic cramp of the abdominal muscles without painful tenderness on palpation.

Rectum - Constriction of the anus with tarry stools. Copious evacuations similar to the black vomit.

Male - Frequent erections. Testicularpains, aggravated by movement. Very acute pains in the right testicle. Perspiration in the genital regions. Itching of prepuce with a little redness of the part.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Violent, precordial pain extending to the axilla and down the arm and forearm to fingers, with numbness of the extremity. Sinking sensation. Cramping pain from chest to abdomen.

Heart - Precordial anxiety. Angina pectoris. Pain in précordia with a loss of breath, screaming fearfully, exclaiming that she would lose her breath and die. Violent heart pains, sharp, extending to shoulders or both arms to fingers with numbness. Restless with cardiac pain and prostration. Pulse feeble and rapid.

Back - Dorsal and lumbar cramps, going from the nape to the loins.

Limbs - Left arm partially paralyzed, or feels paralyzed, with pain. Hard, aching pain in axilla. Stinging in right wrist with itching and redness of bitten spot. Paresthesia of lower limbs. Weakness of legs followed by cramps in the abdominal muscles.

Sleep - Insomnia. Sleep disturbed, anxious. Dreams of flying.

Skin - Skin cold like ice, marble-white. Blue coloring. Heavy, cold perspiration. Skin very painful at the slightest touch. Burning of the soles of the feet. Eruption, which itches. Formication and extreme sensitivity. Loss of hair.

Modalities - Better by sitting quietly. Worse from the slightest movement, even of the hands, exertion.

Kidneys - Burning pains on urinating in the urethra. Urine red, albuminous with casts. Proteinuria, hematuria, glycosuria, diminution in the level of nitrogen eliminated through the urine. Lungs - Bronchial rales. Cough with hawking, yellow, thick, acrid sputum. Pulmonary edema. Gasping for breath. Extreme apnea. Respiration only occasional, gasping. Respiration very slow, thinks he will suffocate. Fear of losing breath and dying.

Pulse - Pulse, feeble and rapid. Pulse so frequent it could not be counted and so feeble it could scarcely be felt. Left pulse extinct, right pulse doubtful.

full:
PHARMACY - laur. Laurocerasus officinalis. Cherry laurel. Common laurel. Aqua lauroc- erasi. Cerasus laurocerasus. Prunus laurocerasus. N. O. Rosacea. Tincture of young leaves. Dilutions of Aqua Laurocerasi. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asphyxia, neonatorum. Asthma. Breathing, difficult. Cholera. Cholera infantum. Chorea. Convulsions. Coughs. Cramps. Cyanosis. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysmenorrhea. Epilepsy. Heart, disorders. Hemorrhages. Liver disorders. Lock-jaw. Memory, lost. Menopause. Metrorrhagia. Palpitations. Pneumonia, typhoid. Strokes. Tetanus. Tumors. Twitchings. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Laurocerasus, the so-called “Laurel” of our gardens, is not a member of the Lauracae, though the Bay Laurel, Laurus nobilis, is. The Aqua Laurocerasi, prepared by distilling the fresh leaves, contains hydrocyanic acid and is supposed to owe all its medicinal virtue to this fact. Symptoms accompanied by sudden debility and lack of reaction, especially in chest and heart disorders. Asphyxia neonatorum. Cyanosis, of heart disorders. Suffocating spells about heart compel him to lie down. General coldness not ameliorated by warmth. Coldness and blueness with epileptiform convulsions. Hemorrhages of thin, bright blood mixed with gelatinous clots. Dry, tickling cough. Cough with jelly-like expectoration dotted with bloody points. Spasmodic tickling cough in cardiac patients. Internal burning. Nervous collapse. Long lasting faints. Sensation of falling down in brain, in abdomen, in heart etc. Bluntness of special senses. Strokes. Spasm of facial muscles and esophagus. Epilepsy, clonic spasms of all limbs with paralytic weakness. Chorea, emotional with constant jerks, cannot keep still. Twitchings. Gasping, before during and after spasms. The speech indistinct after every excitement, gasping for breath. Drink rolls audibly through esophagus and intestines. Weak sphincters. Violent pain in stomach with loss of speech. MIND - Insensibility and complete loss of sensation. Loss of consciousness, with loss of speech and motion. Sudden loss of memory from fright, pain etc. Forgetful on motion. Dullness of special senses. Angry when not understood. Want of moral feeling. Feels unloved. Cries easily when criticized. Sadness with impeded respiration. Fear and anxiety about imaginary evils. Fear of insanity. Delusions, sees old men with long beards and distorted faces. Thinks she is accused, that she is criticized. Sees distorted faces on lying down during day. Visions of fire.

Head - Head pain worse 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. Nightly tearing in vertex. As if a cold wind were blowing on head. As if brain were falling. Brain feels contracted and painful.

Eyes - Dry eyes. Eyes widely open or halfclosed, convulsed, prominent and fixed. Burning pain in eyes. Pupils dilated and immovable. Eyes distorted. Objects look larger. Darkness before the eyes, with obscuration of sight.

Ears - Hardness of hearing. Tingling, itching in ears.

Face - Blue with gasping. Lock-jaw. Twitching of the muscles of face. As if flies and spiders are crawling over the skin.

Mouth - Tongue, stiff, cold, burnt or numb. Speechlessness from pain in stomach. Foam at the mouth, with convulsions.

Throat - Spasmodic contraction of throat and esophagus. Larynx and trachea raw. Low voice. Vertigo - Vertigo with sleepiness. COMMENTS - Laur. has a peculiar “gasping,” gasping without really breathing. Blueness and twitching of the muscles of the face. Cyanosis, particularly in newborns (Aeon., Carb-v.). Valvular problems, regurgitation, weak hearts. Suffocative spells about the heart, worse by sitting up, the patient is compelled to lie down (Psor.). Some heart symptoms compel the patient to sit up. Blue around fingertips. Clubbing of fingers, common in cyanosis and tuberculosis. Guernsey gave these leading symptoms, “gasping for breath, the patient puts his hand to the heart as if there was some trouble there, this may result from running a short distance, which puts him completely out of breath, going upstairs, walking or any exercise may bring the gasping on.” Cough with valvular heart disease, incessant cough, especially on lying down, fluttering in heart and gasping with cough. Spasmodic cough of later stages of whooping cough, when patient is much prostrated and has nervous spasmodic symptoms. Dry, harassing cough of tuberculosis. Alternation of chill, fever and sweat in tuberculosis. Long-lasting faints (Camph. has sudden fainting), seems to have no reactive power, face pale, blue, cold surface. Prostrate before getting up in the morning with difficulty opening the eyes. Nervous disorders with constant jerks, cannot keep still. Allen noted an extremely nervous, excitable condition accompanying ailments. Attacks of indigestion and pains across lower abdomen that come suddenly in the morning and generally disappear on getting up. Gnawing pain in lower abdomen, with occasional looseness of stool, particularly in old men. Green mucus diarrhea, with suffocative spells about heart. Fluids roll audibly into the stomach. Digestion is weak, bowels confined. Low- spirited with flatulence and burning in chest after food. Audible and gurgling flatus, rolls about the upper abdomen. Constricted sensations in gullet, in rectum. Symptoms worse before eating. Inclined to lose flesh and hemorrhages that are small in quantity and bright in color. Menorrhagia and dysmenorrhea. Eruptions are livid after pressure with the finger, the skin is long in regaining its color. Constant tired and sick feeling. Sleepless with a great desire for sleep. Coldness, internal coldness and external heat. Cold tongue. Heat of single parts. Warmth on center of forehead, then a coldness as from a draft of air lasting a long time. The left chest is most affected. Pains start from the lower part of the spine and extend either around the pelvis or up to the head. Pains are accompanied with a sense of suffocation, a sick feeling with drowsiness, and a great desire to sleep that generally brings relief. Cooper, in his work in Cancer and Cancer Symptoms, offered cases emphasizing the uterine symptoms. The indications of Laur., according to Cooper, are a sense of fatigue that pervades the whole system with a very painful condition of the hard and indurated tissue of the parts affected. Pain is much better by sleep. Tendency to ooze blood, which is generally bright and mixed with gelatinous clots. This applies to the chest as well as to uterine and rectal symptoms, only the blood comes painlessly into the mouth, but with great pain in the vagina. E. Wigg related the case of May S., 7, who had been troubled for some time with an almost incessant cough, for which many remedies were given without benefit. At last Wigg came to the conclusion that Laur. was the remedy and put ten drops of Laur. 200c into five tablespoonfuls of water ordering a teaspoonful of this to be taken every two hours when the child was awake. This was at 4 p.m. After the third dose she fell asleep. At 3 a.m. she awoke in a very excited condition. Her mother asked her if she had not been dreaming, but her tongue was so stiff she could not answer. Suddenly she began to tremble all over as if in a chill. After ten minutes she began to twitch and jerk. Wigg was sent for and found her in this convulsed state. She could not articulate for the thickness and heaviness of the tongue. The mind was clear. Recognizing the action of Laur., Wigg antidoted it with camphor, and later a cup of coffee, and symptoms ceased in a few hours. She had no more of the cough. RELATIONS -Antidotes: the effects of digitalis given in crude doses. Antidoted by: Camph., Coff,Ip., Op.Compare: ( 1 ) Hydr-ac., Camph., Sec., Am-c., Ambr. (2) Amyg., Prun., Prun-v., and other Rosacea. (3) In hunger after meals with feeling of emptiness, Calc., Chin., Cas-s., Chion., Grat. (4) after meals and after stool, Petr. (5) in semi-lateral swelling of tongue, Calc., Sil., Thuj. Laur. has loss of speech with it. Compatible: Bell. Phos., Puls., Verat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.

Stomach - Disgust for food during pregnancy. Drinks roll audibly through esophagus and intestines. Violent pain in stomach with loss of speech. Stomach pains during urination. Persistent hiccough. Bitter belchings. Nausea near a hot stove. Vomiting of food during cough.

Abdomen - Falling down sensation of a lump in abdomen from above the navel to small of back, worse talking or overexertion. Gurgling flatulence.

Rectum - Paralysis of anal sphincter, involuntary stools. Rectal cancer, with bleeding of bright red blood. Sensations - Coolness of forehead as from draft of air. Weight on top of head. As if brain loose and falling into forehead when stooping. As if a veil before eyes. As if lungs could not be sufficiently expanded. As if lungs pressed against spine. As if mucus membranes were dry. Stitches are very prominent, also stiffness and pres- sure, especially pressure outward.

Female - Pain in uterus with cancer, with oozing of bright blood with gelatinous clots, better sleep. Faints with coldness during menses. Burning and stinking in and below breasts.

Chest - Constriction of chest. Burning in chest on taking inspiration. Dyspnea with sensation that he is unable to raise the chest walls, better lying down.

Heart - Clutching at heart, folds hands over the heart, as if there were some trouble there worse by any exercise. Pains in the region of heart. Pulse, weak, variable, slow or irregular. Mitral regurgitation. Palpitations.

Back - Painful stiffness in left side of neck and nape. Compressed feeling in shoulders and nape. Causations - Effects of fright.

Limbs - Skin blue. Veins of hands distended. Clubbing of fingers. Toes and fingernails become knotty. Cold clammy feet up to the knees in chorea, heart disease. Feet numb on crossing the legs. Sprained pains in hips, thighs and heels.

Sleep - Frequent yawning. Coma vigil. Sleeplessness from over-excitement and sudden heat. Fearful anxiety and restless, cannot fall to sleep. Spells of deep sleep with snoring and stertorous breathing. Troublesome and agitated dreams.

Skin - Cool, livid.

Modalities - Better sitting up. Better lying with head low. Better sleep. Better eating. Better open air. Worse sitting up. Worse stooping. Worse exertion. Worse cold. Worse fright. Worse in the evening and night.

Liver - Pain in the liver as though abscess were forming. Liver indurated, atrophied. Lungs - Shallow breathing. Gasping for breath, clutches at heart. Suffocation, gasps for breath, on sitting up. Exercise causes pain around heart. Small and feeble pulse. Threatening paralysis of lungs. Asphyxia neonatorum. Cyanosis neonatorum. Cough with valvular dis ease. Tickling, dry cough. with a copious, jelly-like, bloody expectoration.

Kidneys - Urine, retained, suppressed, involuntary, with palpitations, suffocation and fainting.

Temperature - Coldness, chills and heat alternate. Shuddering, followed by burning heat. Heat running down the back. Thirst with dry mouth in afternoon.

HERBAL - The bay tree is indigenous to Asia Minor, from where it spread to the Mediterranean and then to other countries with similar climates. Bay leaves and berries have been used for their astringent, carminative, diaphoretic, digestive, diuretic, emetic and stomachic properties. It has a long history of folk use in the treatment of many ailments, particularly as an aid to digestion and in the treatment of . bronchitis and influenza. It has been used to treat various types of cancer. Bay leaf has been used as an herbal remedy for headaches. It contains compounds called parthenolides, which have proven useful in the treatment of migraines. It has also been shown to help the body process insulin more efficiently, leading to lower blood sugar levels. Reduces the effects of stomach ulcers. Bay leaves also contain eugenol, which has anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant properties. They are also anti- fungal and anti-bacterial. The leaves have been used to treat rheumatism, arthritic aches and pains. Upper respiratory tract disorders. Hysteria. Amenorrhea. Flatulent colic. Bay oil, Oleum Lauri, has been used in liniments for bruising and sprains. The essential oil has narcotic, antibacterial and fungicidal properties. An infusion has been used to improve the appetite and as an em- menagogue. The fruit is antiseptic, aromatic, digestive, narcotic and a stimulant. It has been used in making carminative medicines and was used in the past to promote digestion. It has a tonic effect, stimulating the appetite and the secretion of digestive juices. COMMENTS - Bay Laurel is the source of the bay leaves which are used for their flavor in cooking. It was also the source of the laurel victory wreath of ancient Greece, and therefore the origin of the expression of “resting on one's laurels.” According to legend, the Delphi oracle chewed bay leaves, or sniffed the smoke of burning leaves to promote visionary trances. In the Middle Ages it was believed to have many magical qualities. It has also been used to keep moths away; the leaves' lauric acid content gives it insecticidal properties. RELATIONS - Compare: Cham., Catar., Mag-p. REFERENCES - Murphy.
