CLINICAL - Colic. Coma.…
full:
PHARMACY - m-ambo. (m-p-a.) Magnetis poli ambo. Magnet. Both poles of the magnet. Trituration of Sugar of Milk after exposure of the influence of the both poles of the magnet. Dilution of distilled water similarly exposed. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Colic. Coma. Constipation. Cough. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Fainting. Flatulence. Headaches. Hemorrhage. Hemorrhoids. Orchitis. Pains. Paraphimosis. Prolapsed, anus. Rheumatism. Toothache. Ulcers. Vertigo. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - General symptoms of the magnet produced by touching either magnetic pole indiscriminately while handling the magnet or by laying the whole of the magnetic surface upon the body. Marked sensations of coldness. The eyeball feels cold, as if it were a lump of ice in the socket. Sensation as if the blood was rushing towards points. Burning sensation in the limbs and joints. Burning lancinations across all parts of body in different directions. Pains as if broken in joints, when cartilages of two bones touch. Wrenching pain in the limbs. Shooting and jerkings. Shuddering, which traverses the whole body. Shaking in the body with fright or shocks, which cause violent bending and straightening of the body, sometimes with the loss of consciousness. Headaches as if a nail were driven in. Long-lasting swoons during which she feels her pains, but is not able to speak or move. Tendency of old wounds to bleed afresh. MIND - Irresolution. Inadvertence. Hurried, heedless and forgetful. Busy precipitation. Absence of mind. Talks aloud to himself without being aware of it. Does things he doesn't intend to. Tendency to anger and rage.

Head - Headache from over-strained memory and reflection. Digging, stupefying headache, which is immediately dispersed by movements of flatus. Head pain, as if a nail were driven into the head, as if caused by a wound, especially after a fit of anger. Jerking, tearing in head, appearing at intervals. Rushing or buzzing noises in whole head. Pain, as of a bruise in head, on waking in morning.

Eyes - Itching in eyes, especially the lids. Pupils dilated. Scintillation of white light, beyond the range of vision in the twilight. Sparks before the eyes.

Ears - Humming in ears. Diminution of hearing.

Nose - Aberration of smell, a smoky or moldy scent is perceived.

Face - Perspiration on face without heat in morning. Jerking, tearing in upper jaw. Small pimples with pain like that of a wound, on lips. Violent burning lancination in muscles of face in evening. Swelling of lips with salivation in evening.

Stomach - Stomachache with cramp towards upper part, agitation, which allows no rest whatever, heaviness of tongue, paleness of face and coldness of body. Abortive risings. Risings with smell and taste of horn scrapings. Sour regurgitation, when stooping.

Abdomen - Pressure and anxious fullness in abdomen, especially during mental exertion. Noisy, gas, grumbling and borborygmi in abdomen. Flatulent colic. Production of much flatus. Expulsion of flatulence with painful pressure.

Rectum - Constipation, as from contraction of rectum. Painless diarrhea with flatulence. Hemorrhoids, smarting pain in anus after evacuation with constriction in rectum. Blind hemorrhoids. Prolapsed rectum.

Male - Burning sensation in region of spermatic vesicles, which excites sexual desire. Dullness of sexual feeling and aversion to sex. Erection without amorous thoughts. Retraction of prepuce behind the glans. Swelling of epididymis with pain during movement and when touched.

Female - Menses premature, profuse and of too long duration. Food - Fetid breath. Metallic taste in mouth. Insipid taste of tobacco and beer. Many things have a moldy taste. Speedy satiety. Good appetite in evening.

Chest - Burning insupportable lancinations in muscles of chest.

Back - Jerking in the spine, as from something alive. Painful sensibility of the joint of the sacrum in morning in bed, when lying on side or by day, when stooping. Wrenching pain in shoulder joint or pain as from the starting of a tendon in wrist.

Limbs - Drawing pains in joints and muscles of arms, often from head to fingers. Tearing, jerking in muscles of arms after remaining some time in the cold. Red spots in palms like vesicles. Attacks of cramp in calves of legs and toes after waking in morning. Burning lancinations in heels and in corns on the feet. Lungs - Paroxysms of dry cough at night. Spasmodic cough, especially after midnight, when awake or during reflection. Nocturnal dyspnea, excited by mucus in trachea, which is easily detached in morning.

Sleep - Jerking of the body before going to sleep. Disturbed sleep with talking, snoring and continued tossing.Wakingat3a.m. and falling into a drowsy lethargy towards sunrise. Lying on the back with the hand under the head, the legs wide apart and the mouth half open with snoring respiration. Amorous, lascivious dreams. After waking in morning, headache with pain, as of a fracture in all the joints, which forces constant change in position of limbs. .

Skin - Tendency of old wounds to bleed afresh. Ulcers painful, like new wounds. Small furunculi. Small pustules with lancinating, drawing pain.

Modalities - Worse by motion and on waking. Toothache is worse from cold and on contact with anything cold. Touch aggravates pain in joints. Heat is better from uncovering.

Teeth - Pressive, jerking toothache in isolated shocks. Toothache after drinking anything cold or from contact with cold air. Toothache in carious teeth with swelling of gums.

Temperature - Dry heat with need to be uncovered, at night and in morning in bed. Vertigo - Vertigo, especially in evening after lying down, as if about to fall or as from concussion in head. Vertigo with staggering, when walking, objects seem to waver before eyes. COMMENTS - The effect of the magnet as a whole and of each pole separately was tested by Hahnemann, and the symptoms are mainly from his pathogenesis. He said he did not expect “ordinary mechanical, materialistic and atomistic heads” to be able to regard diseases as “immaterial alternations of the vitality or pure dynamic derangements of our state of health and medicinal powers as merely virtual, almost spiritual, forces.” Hahnemann asked how they can reconcile with their materialistic notions the fact that “a single imponderable spark from a Leyden jar gives a shock to the strongest man and yet to ascertainable ponderable substance is communicated to his body?” Clarke’s experience with magnetism is confined to M-ambo. 2,000c, but that is sufficient to give him confidence in prescribing potencies of these remedies when their indications arise, particularly burning lancinations throughout the body, pains as if broken in joints, where cartilages of two bones touch, shootings and jerkings, disturbed sleep, headache as if a nail were driven in. Hahnemann said the symptoms “occurred from various powerful magnets brought in contact with various sensitive individuals without distinction of the poles. “They were observed in experiments conducted for half a year for the purpose of ascertaining the proper and most efficacious mode of stroking the steel with magnets in which a horse-shoe magnet, capable of lifting a weight of twelve pounds, was held in the hands, which were held in contact with both poles for an hour at a time.” Additional symptoms came from Andry, Thouret, Unzer and De Harsu. Hahnemann noted that “Although each of the poles presents something peculiar in its power of altering the human health, yet each of them seems, when applied twice of oftener to produce alternating actions which resemble those of the opposite pole.” For curative purposes, Hahnemann recommended a much milder application of the magnet. The popular use of magnetic rings for rheumatism is analogous to this. The method of attenuating media saturated with emanations from the magnet does not seem to have occurred to Hahnemann. RELATIONS-Antidotedby: Ign., Electr., Galv., Zinc. (imposition of Zinc plate). Compare: ( 1 ) M-arct., M- aust„ Ferr-ma., Mang-o. (2) Burnt smell in nose, Anae. (3) Prolapsed anus, Podo., Caust., Ign. (4) Bell., Lyc., Nux-v., Petr., Puls., Stram., Sabin., Teucr. REFERENCES-Clarke.

name: Magnetis Polus Arcticus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from uncovering, worse on waking. Toothache, worse breathing through the mouth..
constitution: Amenorrhea. Clairvoyance. Coma. Constipation. Cough. Flatulence. Headache. Heartburn. Hernia. Menses, suppressed. Nosebleed. Panaritium. Salivation. Sleep, disturbed. Sleepwalking. Toothache. Vertebra, cracking. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - m-arct. Magnetis polus arcti- cus. North pole of the magnet. Potencies of saccharum lactis or water charged with the influence of this pole. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Clairvoyance. Coma. Constipation. Cough. Flatulence. Headache.…
full:
PHARMACY - m-arct. Magnetis polus arcti- cus. North pole of the magnet. Potencies of saccharum lactis or water charged with the influence of this pole. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Clairvoyance. Coma. Constipation. Cough. Flatulence. Headache. Heartburn. Hernia. Menses, suppressed. Nosebleed. Panaritium. Salivation. Sleep, disturbed. Sleepwalking. Toothache. Vertebra, cracking. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - The symptoms of Mag-arct. were obtained by applying it in the region of the 4th to 6th thoracic vertebra, at a distance of four or five finger's breadth from the body. Over-excitement with trembling, uneasy restlessness in limbs and great nervous weakness. Great lassitude and painful weariness of the whole body with dejection, especially in morning and in open air, as during sultry weather. Sharp shocks, throbbing, trembling, coldness and sensation as if the blood were driven toward parts. Drawing sensation in periosteum of all bones, as at commencement of intermittent fever. Cracking in cervical vertebrae. Marked affect in the teeth and jaws. Sensation of coldness with toothache. Increased flow of saliva. Swelling, heat and redness of one cheek. Coldness of eyes as if a piece of ice lay in orbit. Disturbed sleep, sleep- walking. Constipation, sopor, trembling. Abdominal flatulence. MIND - Mildness, submission. Anxious hesitation and restlessness. Fickleness. Irresolution, followed by prompt execution after a resolution has been once formed. Indolence when seated, as if power of mov- ing were lost. Peevishness. Sensitive to noises. Weakness of memory. Tendency to make mistakes when writing. Loss of ideas. Loss of sense. Speaking loud while quite alone and engaged in business. Inclination to weep with shivering.

Head - Headache is worse lifting or moving arm.

Eyes - Restless movements of eyes. Eyes prominent and fixed. Icy coldness of (weak) eye, as if a lump of ice lay in orbit instead of the eye. Lancinations, itching and jerking drawing in eyelids with lachrymation. Painful sensation of dryness in eyelids, on awaking in morning.

Ears - Murmuring in ears and internal heat, as from boiling water. Deafness, as if caused by a band over ears.

Nose - Aberration of smell, smell of rotten eggs, fresh plaster or dust. Nosebleed, preceded by pressive head pain in forehead. Redness and heat in point of nose, followed by red spots, hot and plainly circumscribed, on cheeks.

Face - Paleness in face. Tension in face. Painful squeezing in maxillary joint with sensation, while moving it, as if it were dislocated. Swelling of one cheek only. Trismus.

Mouth - At night, collection of saliva in mouth, so profuse that every time he wakes the pillow is quite wet. Itching in point of tongue, compels him to scratch it.

Stomach - Frequent empty risings. Continued heartburn, especially after supper.

Abdomen - Inflation of abdomen. Shocks in abdomen, as if something in it were falling or blows proceeding from abdomen and passing upwards through chest, as far as the throat. Pressure and boring towards inguinal ring, as if preparatory to a rupture with relaxation of the inguinal ring. Production and incarceration of much flatus. Flatulent, pressive colic.

Rectum - Obstinate constriction of abdomen and constipation. Hard feces of a large size, difficult to evacuate often preceded by drawing, dysenteric pains in the hypogastrium.

Male - Excitement of sexual desire. Immoderate erections with frequent pollutions.

Female - Menses too feeble. Menses suppressed. Food - Voracity in evening. Loss of taste. Acid taste in the mouth. Tobacco has a bitter taste.

Back - Cracking in the cervical vertebra during movement. Pains in back, as if broken, on bending it backwards.

Limbs - Inflammation of back of hand with pulsative pain. Heaviness in arms, hands and fingers. Great lassitude in lower limbs, which feel as if they would break, when walking. Pains, as of a fracture in hip joints and lower limbs. Pain, as from excoriation in toes and corns on the feet. Lungs - Dry, asthmatic, suffocating cough. worse by walking in open air. Constant want to cough in evening, which is removed only by restraining the cough. Spasmodic, shaking cough in evening, on going to sleep, which hinders sleep. Spasmodic, suffocating cough towards midnight, produced by irritation in bronchia. Cough shaking the head and whole body and exciting heat until a general perspiration ensues with cessation of the cough.

Sleep - Violent, spasmodic yawning, with wrenching pain in maxillary joint. Strong disposition to sleep by day. Coma. Profound sleep at night during which the patient generally ties on the back. Tossing during sleep, with troublesome heat and urgent inclination to be uncovered without thirst. Waking in the evening after sleep, in consequence of a violent shock in the head and muscles of the neck. Many vivid dreams, sometimes lascivious. Sings in her sleep, is wakened by it, falls asleep again, recommences to sing and again wakes up from it. Imperfect waking in morning (2 a.m.), with perfect inner consciousness, vivid memory, great concourse of ideas and reflections on some important subject.

Skin - Tingling and lancination itching in skin. Burning sensation or burning tearing in tetters. Panaritium.

Modalities - Better from uncovering, worse on waking. Toothache, worse breathing through the mouth.

Teeth - Toothache in carious teeth, at intervals, as if they were being extracted. Pains in carious teeth with gums swollen and painful when touched, worse after a meal and by heat, better in open air and when walking. Toothache with red, hot, swollen cheeks. Toothache with shocks, which traverse the periosteum of the jaw or with drawing, pressive or else tearing, digging or burning sharp pains. Incisors set on edge, when breathing through the mouth. Numbness and insensibility of the gums, on the cessation of the toothache.

Kidneys - Increased secretion of urine. Deep-colored urine.

Temperature - Sensation of coldness or of coolness over whole body. Chilliness. Cool hands with cool perspiration upon them and over whole body. Cold sweat on hands and soles of feet. Shuddering, followed by transient heat and swelling of veins of hands. Sensation of heat over whole body with coldness of hands and lower limbs. Vertigo - Vertigo, as from intoxication with staggering, when walking in open air and instability when standing. COMMENTS - Swan reported a case cured by C. M. Conant in which Mrs. S., age 31, blonde, had pain in her left lower jaw as if out of joint, worse morning, on moving it. Sensation as if head of bone were squeezed and crowded into socket. Mag-arct. 1,000c cured. One symptom of the proving, occurring in a half-waking state, suggests an approach to sleepwalking. He thinks out a “difficult subject in the best form in a foreign language,” but when awake he cannot remember distinctly the subject. Several provers complained of faintness. One had “sensation of dryness and lightness in the body with want of strength.” Sensation as if scalp adhered to skull. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: M-aust., Ign., Zinc. Compare: (1) M-ambo. M-aust. (2) Sensation as if teeth being pulled out, Ip. (3) Worse raising arm, Bar-c.,Con., Cupr., Ferr. (4) One cheek red, Cham. (5) Coff., Cham. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Magnetis Polus Australis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse when walking in open air, sitting, hanging limb down..
constitution: Amblyopia. Borborygmi. Bulimia. Colds. Coryzas. Coughs. Dislocation, easy. Frostbite. Heart, palpitations. Hernia. Ingrown, toenails. Lachrymation. Levitation. Menorrhagia. Pains. Palpitations. Toothaches. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Wisdom tooth.
keynote:
PHARMACY - m-aust. Magnetis polus australis. South pole of the magnet. Potencies of alcohol saturated with emanations of the south pole. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Borborygmi. Bulimia. Colds. Coryzas. Coughs. Dislocation, easy. Frostbite. Heart,…
full:
PHARMACY - m-aust. Magnetis polus australis. South pole of the magnet. Potencies of alcohol saturated with emanations of the south pole. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Borborygmi. Bulimia. Colds. Coryzas. Coughs. Dislocation, easy. Frostbite. Heart, palpitations. Hernia. Ingrown, toenails. Lachrymation. Levitation. Menorrhagia. Pains. Palpitations. Toothaches. Varicose, veins. Vertigo. Wisdom tooth.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann first noticed the symptoms that led to the use for ingrown toenails, including a sore pain on the inner side of the nail of the big toe when walking. As if the nail had grown into the flesh on the side, very painful on being slightly touched. The shoe presses on the toes and on the nail of the big toe when walking, as from corns. The accurate response of M-aust. to these symptoms proved to Clarke the possibility of attenuating and so fixing this “energy” for use as an ordinary homeopathic remedy. Clarke cured so many cases of ingrown toenail with M-aust. 2,000c., that he invariably gave it in the first place when there were no symptoms plainly indicating another remedy. Sharp, pulsative pains in roots of nails, as if about to suppurate. Easy dislocation of joints of foot, feet are painful when letting them hang down. Aching in patella, shooting in soles. Drawings in fingers, feet and ankles. Pains with pinching or burning, lancinations in different parts of the body. Contusive pains in limbs and joints, as if the patient had been lying on flints. Dryness of eyelids. Tendency of nose, ears, hands and feet to be frozen by a moderate degree of coldness. Liability to suffer from achill. Sudden lassitude when walking with anxiety and heat or sudden inclination to sleep. Lightness of whole body. MIND - Mood is changeable, variable. Capriciousness. Abrupt. Irritability. Instability of ideas. Inconstancy. Irresolution, indecision. Confused, wandering thoughts. Absentminded. Indifference, apathy. Indolence, aversion to work. Anxiety with fear. Frightened easily. Fear of people, anthropophobia. Timidity. Aversion to anyone who comes near, even loved ones. Forsaken feeling. Weeping, tearful mood after anger, vexation. Guilt. Morose and ill-humor, with aversion to conversation. Society is disagreeable, wants to be alone. Dislike to society and to laughing faces. Wants to say something hateful. Sulky. Ill-humor, peevish. Asserts himself with vehemence and despises others. Anger at trifles. Anger with trembling. Harshness, rough. Abusive, insulting. Quarrelsome, scolding. Reproaches others. Violence, vehemence. Wild, hasty, harsh, violent in word and deed. Passion and rage. Dreams of animals, fire. Nightmares. Amorous disposition. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated. Crawling around like a animal. Abdomen - Noisy borborygmi and grum bling in abdomen. Pressive, flatulent colic with pinchings and inflation of abdomen. Sensation, as if inguinal ring were dilated, preparatory to the rupture with painful sensibility of that part, when coughing.

Head - Great rush of blood to brain early in morning in bed. Heaviness, tingling and digging in head. Shocks in head, sometimes with tearing.

Eyes - Dryness and smarting in eyelids, especially when moving them, worse morning and evening. Lachrymation. Amblyopia.

Mouth - Metallic taste, at one time sweetish, at another acidulous, on and under the tongue. Accumulation of watery saliva in the mouth. Speech embarrassed, as by a swelling of the tongue.

Throat - Burning sensation in gullet. Vertigo - Vertigo, as from intoxication with staggering gait. COMMENTS - Ingrown toenails, toothache, insomnia, and arthritis. Pinching, squeezing sensations and bruised pains. Faintness, comes on when walking, worse when sitting. Great rush of blood to the brain early in the morning in bed. Berridge reported the case of Miss X, who had for three weeks aching in the middle of front of left lower leg, where she had varicose veins for eight months, when standing or when the leg is hanging down. Aching pain is removed by placing it horizontally. Frequent feeling of hot water running down the affected part, but only when leg is down, at times throbbing when leg hangs down. She was given M-aust. 100,000c, one dose. The hot-water feeling never returned and the pain ceased in two days. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: M-arct., Ign., Zinc. Compare: (1) M-ambo., Galv., Electr. in fetid cough, Caps. (2) Rush of blood to head, Aster. (3) Toenails, Graph., Sil., Nit- ac.,Thuj. REFERENCES - Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - All kinds of food appear insipid. Extreme indifference to food, drink and tobacco-smoke. Bulimia at noon and Magnetis polus australis evening, sometimes during the febrile shiverings. Aching in scrobiculus during mental exertion.

Rectum - Stools, soft, loose, preceded by gripings. Evacuation of liquid feces with a sensation as if flatus were about to be discharged. Contractions and painful constriction in rectum and anus, which hinder the expulsion of wind.

Male - Strong disposition to emission. Emissions in a hemiplegia patient, paralysis worse after the emission. Impotence with sudden cessation of all enjoyment in the moment of greatest excitement. Pain in penis, as if some tissues were torn or plucked away. Painful retraction of testes at night. Swelling of testes with tearing shocks and sensation of contraction.

Female - Menses premature and profuse. Metrorrhagia.

Chest - Oppression of the chest, as if the respiration were tremulous and produced an impression of coolness. Drawing pressure in both sides of sternum with anguish of conscience, which allows no rest.

Heart - Violent palpitations of the heart with great heat in cardiac region. Palpitation of the heart during which it seems that it is not the heart that palpitates.

Back - Pressive, burning pain in loins during repose and movement. Pain, as of a fracture or wrenching pain in joint of sacrum and lumbar vertebra. Causations - Ailments from anger, vexation, emotional excitement.

Sleep - Urgent inclination to sleep, evening and morning. Closing the eyes without power to sleep. Sleeplessness with overexcitement before midnight. Confused, frightful dreams. Prolonged dreams on the same subject with fatigue. Dreams of incendiary fires. Lying on the back during the night. Slow, noisy, snoring expiration. Congestion in head in morning, which compels lying with head high.

Modalities - Worse when walking in open air, sitting, hanging limb down.

Teeth - Tearing, jerking toothache, worse by hot things.

Kidneys - Involuntary emission of urine from paralysis of bladder sphincter, especially at night. Frequent emission of urine at night. Very feeble stream of urine. Emission of urine, drop by drop with torpor of urethra. Lungs - Coughs and coryzas with expectoration of greenish mucus and shortness of breath. Paroxysms of fetid cough at night, when sleeping. Want to take full, sighing inspirations, with involuntary deglutition.

Temperature - Excessive dread of open air, which penetrates to the very marrow of the bones, even when the weather is hot, with ill-humor and inclination to weep. Shuddering with cloudiness before eyes. Trembling and tossing of limbs without shivering, followed by heat in head and face.

name: Magnolia Glauca
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma. Fainting. Gout.
keynote:
PHARMACY - magn-gl. Magnolia glauca. Sweet magnolia. Sweet bay. Beaver-tree. N. O. Magnoliacee. Tincture of the flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Fainting. Gout.

HERBAL - The Treasury of Botany said “M. glauca is a low-growing, deciduous…
full:
PHARMACY - magn-gl. Magnolia glauca. Sweet magnolia. Sweet bay. Beaver-tree. N. O. Magnoliacee. Tincture of the flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Fainting. Gout.

HERBAL - The Treasury of Botany said “M. glauca is a low-growing, deciduous tree, called in America Swamp Sassafras from the nature of the locality in which it grows and from the resemblance in its properties to Laurus sassafras. It is also called Beavertree, because the root is eaten by beavers, which the animals also make use of the wood in constructing their nests.”

HOMEOPATHIC - S.A. Jones and T. F. Allen observed the effects of the flowers on three persons. Symptoms included a sense of great oppression about his chest, and a strong tendency to fainting. A woman had oppression of chest, could not expand the lungs with a feeling as if she had swallowed food without chewing and it distressed her stomach. In a doctor, it increased the pain of inflammatory gout and evidently increased the paroxysm of a pain which came on every afternoon. REFERENCES - Allen. Clarke.

name: Magnolia Grandiflora
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better dry weather, motion. Better inter-menstrual flow (Ham., Bov., Bell., Elaps.). Worse damp air, in morning, lying on left side..
constitution: Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Constipation. Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Flatulence. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Inter-menstrual flow. Leucorrhea. Migraines. Nausea. Pains. Pericarditis. Rheumatism. Stiffness. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - magn-gr. Magnolia grandiflora. Talauma mexicana. Magnolia yolotxochitl. N. O. Magnoliacee. Mexico. Tincture of the flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Constipation. Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Flatulence. Headaches.…
full:
PHARMACY - magn-gr. Magnolia grandiflora. Talauma mexicana. Magnolia yolotxochitl. N. O. Magnoliacee. Mexico. Tincture of the flowers. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aneurysm. Angina pectoris. Constipation. Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Flatulence. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Inter-menstrual flow. Leucorrhea. Migraines. Nausea. Pains. Pericarditis. Rheumatism. Stiffness. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allen, in his Handbook, gives a full pathogenesis of Magn-gr. Rheumatism and heart lesions are prominent features in the symptomatology of this drug. Alternating pains between spleen and heart. Erratic shifting of pains. Pains rapidly change their place or alternate. Rheumatic action, particularly manifested in the chest and heart. Stiffness and soreness. Bruised, constrictive and rheumatic pains in various parts, particularly the joints. Patient tired and stiff. Tiredness impeding motion. Soreness when quiet. Marked action was developed in the female sexual sphere and an inter-menstrual flow was observed. MIND - Confusion and dullness. Memory weak, lost. Repugnance to all occupation. Ill-humor with burning in hands. Sadness. Nervous, easily frightened. Uneasiness. Apprehensive, thinks she will die. Illusions and hallucinations of sight with sharp pains in eyes.

Head - Migraines. Congestive, throbbing headache with griping in abdomen, flushes of heat. Pain in temples on bending forward, especially left temple. Pain in occiput and upper dorsal region. Pain Magnolia grandiflora in occiput as from a blow. Weight in occiput.

Eyes - Sharp pain in eyes, from sunlight, with nervousness and visions. Vision weak, blurred. Lids heavy, sensation in lids as after weeping.

Ears - Lancinations in left ear, traveling to shoulder. Sharp pain in ears, in morning, traveling to throat.

Face - Lancinations in jaw joints. Pain in right side in joints, worse pressure, also impeding opening of mouth. Sharp pain going to ear.

Mouth - Pain in mouth, better by tepid water.

Throat - Red fauces. Burning and dryness with pain in pit of stomach and often extending to abdomen, preventing sleep. Difficult swallowing saliva. Sensation of mucus with fruitless attempts to remove it. Constriction, worse right side, worse bending forward. Pain in throat on turning head, waking him frequently at night. Vertigo - Vertigo in evening, better going to bed with an emptiness at stomach with flushing of face. Vertigo with dislike for physical labor. Vertigo beginning with blurring of slight. Vertigo as from seasickness, causing loss of appetite. COMMENTS - Allen gave indications including rheumatic pain in clavicles. Crampy pain in heart, alternating with lancinations. Pain in heart with suffocative constriction of throat. Aortic aneurysm. Nausea with vertigo and angina pectoris. Dry cough. Rheumatic pains in back, especially when alternating with similar pains in different parts. Muscular rheumatism of left arm. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Rhus-t., Dulc., Aur. (2) Magn-gl., Anis. (3) In rheumatism, Kali-bi., Kalm. (4) Inter- menstrual hemorrhage, Ham., Bov., Bell., Cham., Elaps. REFERENCES - Allen. Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Sensation as from hunger with acidity. Emptiness with general lassitude, vertigo and nausea. Nausea in morning on rising, better by breakfast. Nausea as from tobacco. Feeling of a large bolus of food which distressed the stomach.

Abdomen - Rapid, pulsating pain with griping in intestines, extending to hypochondria, as from a blow. Burning in left side of abdomen, extending to chest. Contusive pain in liver and spleen, extending to the stomach. Flatulence. Lancinations in liver and spleen.

Rectum - Constipation.

Female - Before menses, pain in small of back, hypogastrium and thighs with headache, flushes of heat to face, nausea and chill. Menses delayed, pale and scanty of coagulated blood for two days, then normal, painful. Bloody flow in interval between menses. Thick white or yellow leucorrhea, with constipation, straining when urinating. Congestion of left ovary with pain extending to left thigh. Food - Appetite lost after vertigo, with lassitude.

Chest - Oppression of chest with inability to expand the lungs. Constriction as from a band just beneath axilla. Tired feeling. Stiffness of sides of chest, as from exposure to a draft when over heated. Stitches in sides of chest, in right side.

Heart - Endocarditis and pericarditis. Tendency to faint. Pulse weak and frequent. Sensation as if heart had stopped beating. Alternating pains between spleen and heart. Crampy pain in heart. Angina pectoris. Stitches, which waking him frequently. Pain around heart accompanied by itching of the feet. Soreness after disappearance of pain.

Back - Weight in neck with tiredness of spine. Stiffness, tiredness of neck and back. Contusive pain. Stitches in right side of back.

Limbs - Stiffness and sharp erratic pains, worse in joints. Sprained pains in joints. Shooting in all limbs. Limbs tired, stiff. Stiffness of lower limbs. Sharp, erratic or rheumatic pains. Rheumatic pain in clavicles. Rheumatic pains in wrists. Numbness in left arm. Arms weak. Feet itch. Lungs - Dyspnea. Suffocation, with desire for stretching and uneasiness in paroxysms, when walking fast, when lying on left side after a meal. Hoarseness. Dry cough during the day, better at night.

Sleep - Yawning during the day with sleepiness. Sleepless early in morning. Extravagant dreams.

Skin - Itching feet, sometimes with uneasiness of legs.

Modalities - Better dry weather, motion. Better inter-menstrual flow (Ham., Bov., Bell., Elaps.). Worse damp air, in morning, lying on left side.

Teeth - Shooting in teeth. Soreness of teeth, impeding mastication.

Kidneys - Straining on passing water.

Temperature - Erratic chill. Chill in afternoon, then fever lasting into night. Heat with burning in throat and headache, flushing with sweat of hands, hands and feet, upper limbs.

name: Malandrinum
author: Murphy
constitution: Acne. Boils. Eczema. Fistula. Impetigo. Knock-knee. Measles. Skin, unhealthy. Smallpox. Typhoid fever. Vaccination, effects.
keynote:
PHARMACY - maland. Malandrinum. Grease of horses. Nosode of the disease in horses called “Grease.” Trituration of Sugar of Milk saturated with the virus. Solution of the virus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Boils. Eczema. Fistula. Impetigo. Knock-knee.…
full:
PHARMACY - maland. Malandrinum. Grease of horses. Nosode of the disease in horses called “Grease.” Trituration of Sugar of Milk saturated with the virus. Solution of the virus. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Boils. Eczema. Fistula. Impetigo. Knock-knee. Measles. Skin, unhealthy. Smallpox. Typhoid fever. Vaccination, effects.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to Jenner, the origin of cow-pox is infection of the udders of cows by contact with grass on which a ’horse infected with “Grease” has trodden. This assertion is to some extent confirmed by the experience of homeopaths, who have found in Maland, a very effectual protection against infection with smallpox and against vaccination. Straube made provings of the 30c potency. Clarke cured with it cases of unhealthy, dry, rough skin remaining for years after vaccination in smallpox, measles and impetigo. Burnett cured with it a case of knock-knee in a child who was constantly handling his penis. Maland, has been used on inferential grounds with great success in ill effects of vaccination. Efficacious in clearing of the remnants of cancerous deposits. Bone-like protuberances. Toes feel scalded and itch terribly. MIND - Dullness of mind. Dizziness. Confusion and lassitude of the mental faculties with a dread of any mental exertion. A lack of concentration.

Head - Aching in forehead. Frontal and occipital headache. Impetigo covering head from crown to neck and extending behind ears. Thick, greenish crusts with pale, reddish scabs, itching worse in evening.

Eyes - Red stripes under eyes.

Ears - Profuse, purulent, greenish-yellow discharge, mixed with blood.

Face - Scab on upper lip, with stinging pain when torn off.

Stomach - Vomiting of bilious matter, nausea.

Abdomen - Pains around umbilicus.

Stool - Dark, cadaverous-smelling stool. Yellowish, foul-smelling diarrhea. COMMENTS - Burnett's indications are “Lower half of body, greasy skin and greasy eruption. Slow suppuration, never ending, as one heals another appears.” Impetigo, ecthyma, fat, greasy-looking pustular eruptions are particularly acted on by this remedy. A. L. Marcey related a striking experience with Maland. 30c. In the presence of a smallpox epidemic, he vaccinated himself, taking at the same time Maland. 30c night and morning. The vaccination did not take. It was twice repeated and still did not take, nor was smallpox contracted. Called to vaccinate four children in a family whose parents were recovering from smallpox, he vaccinated all and gave Maland. 30c to three of them at the same time, the remaining child was the only one whose vaccination “took.” This was so severe that Maland, had to be given to modify its intensity, which it did effectively. The other three were re-vac- cinated but none “took.” Of five children from six to seventeen years of age, only the eldest had been vaccinated and he had a good scar. All except the eldest were given Maland, and were vaccinated and none of the four “took.” The eldest took smallpox. Maland, was then given and in a few days he was convalescent. In another case of smallpox, Maland, was given and the disease only lasted a few days, the eruption drying up. In Straube's proving, the symptoms were worse in evening. Burnett considers Maland, a very deeply acting remedy and one not to be repeated oftener than once a fortnight. Clears the remnants of cancerous deposits. Heath cured with Maland. 30c fistula in a pony's neck, following strangles. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) For the bad effects of vaccination, Vario., Vac., Thuj., Sabin., Ant- t., Apis, Sil. (2) In general, children handling genitals, Med. (butMaland. has deeper action). (3) In pustular eruptions, Hep., Merc. (4) Casteq., Hippoz., Hipp. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Male - Child constantly handles his penis. Mouth - Tongue is coated yellow with red streak down middle (typhoid). Tongue cracked and ulcerating down middle, swollen.

Female - Vagina closed with crusts, yellowish-greenish-brown in color.

Back - Pain along back, as if beaten. Causations - Ill effects of vaccinations (Thuj., Sil.).

Limbs - Sore pains in limbs andjoints. Pains, especially in left tibia with petechia-like patches on anterior aspect of left leg from knee to ankle. Petechia on both thighs, worse left. Knock-kneed. Impetiginous crusts on extensor sides of forearms. Runaround on nails of hands and feet.

Sleep - Dreams of troubles. Dreams of quarrels.

Skin - Smallpox. Measles, also as a preventive. Small, dusky red spots on legs, not disappearing on pressure. Petechial typhus. Impetigo covering back of head, extending over back to buttock and even into vagina, covering labia. Impetigo on extensors of forearms. Eczema. Dry, scaly, itching, cracks of hands and feet in cold weather andfrom washing. Boils. Malignant pustule. Bad effects of vaccination (dry, harsh skin).

name: Malaria Co. Nosode
author: Murphy
constitution: Ague. Bilious, fever. Cachexia. Chills. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Fatigue. Fever. Headaches. Intermittent fever. Liver, disorders. Malaria. Nausea. Spleen, disorders. Sweats. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - malar-co. Malaria co. nosode. Combination of the nosodes from all four types of malaria. (Plasmodium falciparum, Plasmodium malariae, Plasmodium vivax, and Plasmodium ovale). Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Ague. Bilious, fever. Cachexia. Chills. Diarrhea.…
full:
PHARMACY - malar-co. Malaria co. nosode. Combination of the nosodes from all four types of malaria. (Plasmodium falciparum, Plasmodium malariae, Plasmodium vivax, and Plasmodium ovale). Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Ague. Bilious, fever. Cachexia. Chills. Diarrhea. Emaciation. Fatigue. Fever. Headaches. Intermittent fever. Liver, disorders. Malaria. Nausea. Spleen, disorders. Sweats. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The first episode of symptoms usually occurs about 8 to 30 days after the mosquito bite. Headache, fatigue, and nausea. Hard, shaking chills with fever for 12 to 24 hours. Rapid breathing. Heavy sweating, accompanied by a drop in temperature. Episodes may recur every 2 or 3 days until the disease is treated. Without treatment, the disease can continue for years. Generally worse in crowded or unsanitary living conditions. Hot, humid climates. Malaria is endemic in Latin America, Asia and Africa. COMMENTS - Malaria is an infection caused by a single-cell parasite, which is transmitted by the bite of an anopheles mosquito. Malaria affects the blood cells, blood vessels, liver, central nervous system. There are four types of malarial parasites, they are transferred from person to person by a mosquito bite. The mosquito becomes infected with malaria after biting a person with the disease. The organism multiply in the mosquito, then enter the bloodstream of the next person the mosquito bites. Once in a person's bloodstream, the parasites travel to the liver, where they thrive and multiply rapidly. After several days, thousands re-enter the bloodstream and destroy red-blood cells. Some parasites remain in the liver, continue to multiply and are released again at intervals into the bloodstream. REFERENCES Murphy.

Right arm gets numb and has to be rubbed. Cold limbs, poor appetite but food does not distress her. Fearful headache, nausea, aversion to food, distress through hypochondriac region, first in the spleen, then liver and stomach and chills. Bilious colic, nausea, cramps, diarrhea and headache. HOMEOPATHIC - Malathion is an organophosphate parasympathomimetic which binds irreversibly to cholinesterase. Malathion is an insecticide of relatively high human toxicity. It weakens the immune system. Causes autoimmune disorders. Rheumatoid arthritis. Asthma and allergies. Leukemia. Aplastic anemia. Kidney failure. Drowsiness. Unusual weakness. Slow heartbeat. Dizziness. Convulsions, seizures. Trembling. Clumsiness or unsteadiness. Difficult or labored breathing. Increased sweating. Increased watering of mouth or eyes. Abdominal or stomach cramps. Diarrhea. Loss of bowel or bladder control. Intestinal disorders in children. Birth defects. Infertility or miscarriages. Lower sperm count. Slower sperm movement. Muscle twitching of eyelids, face, and neck. Pinpoint pupils. Redness, pain, swelling of eye, eyelid, inner lining of eyelid. Burning, dry or itching eyes. Conjunctivitis. Eye discharges, excessive tearing. Skin rash. Stinging or irritation of scalp. MIND- Anxiety and restlessness. Hyperactivity. Attention deficit disorder. Learning disabilities in math, reading, etc. Language or speech delays. Mental retardation. Memory weakness, confusion. Depression. Irritability. Aggressive behavior. COMMENTS - Malathion breaks down into malaoxon, which is 60 times more toxic than malathion. For this reason, if malathion is used or somehow enters an indoor environment, as it breaks down into malaoxon, it can seriously and chronically poison the occupants living or working in this environment. Malathion present in untreated water is converted to malaoxon during the chlorination phase of water treatment, so malathion should not be used in waters that may be used as a source for drinking water, or any upstream waters. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HERBAL - The Treasury of Botany noted that “Mancinella is a species of the Euphorbiacae and has all the virulent properties of the family in a high degree. It is one of the trees around which the upas legends have clustered. It is certain that the juice, which resembles pure white milk, does possess a considerable amount of acridity and that some persons suffer great pain from incautiously handing it. “Perhaps its most dangerous property is that of causing blindness, if by chance the least drop of the milk or smoke of the burning wood, comes in contact with the eyes. “Dr. Seeman states that at Veraguas some of the ship's carpenters were blinded for several days by the juice getting into their eyes while cutting down Manchineel trees, while he himself suffered from temporary loss of sight from merely gathering specimens. The same accident happened to a boat's crew from making a fire. Salt water is said to be an efficacious remedy.”

HOMEOPATHIC - Marked skin symptoms. Dermatitis with excessive blistering, oozing of sticky serum, and formation of crusts. Acridity. Burning, smarting in various parts. Favors rapid healing of wounds. Loss of vision. Pain in the thumb. Hering suggested it in mental depressed states at puberty and at menopause with an exalted sexuality. MIND - Bashful and taciturn. Timid. Sympathetic. Weeps a great deal, especially when alone. Melancholy. Homesickness. Silent mood, sadness. Depression with sexual weakness. Wandering thoughts. Sudden vanishing of thoughts. Forgets what she wishes to do next. Forgets her errands. Anger aggravates. Impatience during headache. Averse to work and answering questions. Anxiety from becoming cold, during or after scarlatina, before menses. Fear of becoming insane. Fear of evil spirits. Sometimes feels as light as if she could float or hover in the air. Delusions that he will be taken by the devil.

Head - Pain in vertex, worse lying. Heat in head, better from rest. Congestion of head before menses. Scalp itches. Hair falls out after acute sickness.

Eyes - Lids, heavy and sore. Eyes smart or burn on closing them. Dull ache behind the eyes. Intense inflammation with loss of vision (for some days). Photophobia.

Ears - Ears feel as if closed. Redness and heat of ears.

Nose - Illusions of smell of gunpowder, dung, etc. Pressure at root of nose.

Face - Swollen, spotted. Herpes on lips. Food - Craves cold water. Aversion to meat, bread, wine.

Mouth - Feels peppery. Burning and pricking in the mouth, not better by cold water. Burning of fauces. Dysphagia from constriction of throat and esophagus. Copious, offensive saliva. Profuse foul yellow saliva. Taste of blood.

Throat - Cutting pains, worse cold drinks. Diphtheria. Tonsils swollen. Choking sensation rises in the throat when speaking, preventing drinking though thirsty. Vertigo - Vertigo, head feels light, empty, while walking about. COMMENTS - Mane, was introduced into homeopathy by Bute, who proved it. It was also proved by Mure and Ackermann. Marked affects on the head, eyes, throat, abdomen and rectum. The symptoms induced included burning in all parts, vesication and ulceration of the skin and mucus membranes. Symptoms worse from drinking cold water, especially cough. Better from heat when lying down, but headache is worse from the warmth of a stove and there is an inclination to uncover. Cough is worse at night. Med. Cent, quoted the case of a woman who for several years was possessed with the fixed idea that she would become insane. She had become a wife and mother, but still the ideas possessed her. Happening to see in Puhlmann's Therapeutics that Mane, has “fear of going crazy,” she took Mane. 12c and was permanently cured. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Crot., Jatr., Canth., Anae. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Swollen epigastrium. Continual choking sensation rising from stomach. Vomiting of food, followed by severe colic and profuse diarrhea. Vomiting of ingesta, followed by griping and copious stools. Repeated green vomit. Burning pains and black vomit. As of flame rising from stomach.

Abdomen - Rumbling in abdomen renewed by every motion and when taking a deep inspiration. Colic, worse cold drinks. Bowels sore and burn.

Rectum - Sensation of fullness in rectum with hollow feeling in stomach. Sudden desire to go to stool in morning. Profuse diarrhea with colic, vertigo, much discharge of flatus. Greenish stools. Burning pain during diarrhea. Pulsation in anus. Discharge of fetid blood from hemorrhoids. Sensations - Head feels as if bruised or as if it had been exposed to the sun. Head as if hollow, as if lying on something hard. Ears as if closed. Electric thrusts in upper part of throat. As if flames rising from stomach. As if stomach drew together in a lump and then suddenly opened. As if something alive in stomach.

Chest - Oppression of chest, better expectoration. Aching pain behind sternum. Severe pain in middle of sternum, worse pressure and breathing.

Heart - Pressure in region of heart. Needle like stitches at heart. Palpitations in evening, on turning in bed, as from eating. Palpitations with weakness. Pulse weak, very large and soft.

Back - Backache with nausea and tenesmus. Sharp pain in left scapula and left chest at intervals. Painful stiffness of small of back, neck, after sleep, could scarcely move neck.

Limbs - Pain in thumb. Icy coldness of hands and feet. Biting vesicles on soles, desquamation and dryness of soles. Lungs - Rattling in left lung during breathing. Violent cough and painful stitches in trachea from slightest exertion. Cough, worse cold drinks, at night.

Skin - Intense erythema. Dermatitis with extensive blisters, oozing of sticky serum and formation of crusts. Heavy, brown crusts and scabs. Large blisters, as from scalds. Fungoid growths. Vesicles. Erysipelas. Pemphigus.

Modalities - Worse from cold. Worse cold drinks. Worse cold feet. Worse dampness. Worse touch. Worse puberty, menopause. Worse anger. Worse after eating.

Perspiration - Cold sweats. Acrid, sticky foot sweat.

Temperature - Chills with icy cold hands and feet. Burning heat, with inclination to cover himself in bed. Flushesof heat. Fever with tingling in skin, with thirst.

HERBAL - The mandrake does not derive its name from the shape of the human body which the root of the plant sometimes takes, but from the name by which it was known to the Greeks, Mandragora, and which signifies injurious to cattle. It was used by the ancient Egyptian physicians for many conditions. The mandrake figures largely in legend and poetry. It is said to be the “insane root” spoken of by Macbeth and it is mentioned by name in Antony and Cleopatra and in Romeo and Juliet. Mandrake must not be confounded with Podophyllum or Bryonia dioica, which are also sometimes called “Mandrake” in this country.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dufresne experimented with Mand. on himself and another by repeatedly smelling, at short intervals, the expressed juice of the plant, “which has a nauseating odor like adder's flesh.” W. B. Richardson also experimented with it. There are two varieties of Mand., the vernal and the autumnal; Dufresne used the vernal. The symptoms were very similar to those of Belladonna, to which it is botani- cally closely related. Mand. is like a cooled or attenuated Bell. Restless excitability and bodily weariness. Great desire for sleep. Striking tiredness, exhaustion, collapse. Depressive condition. Nervous, hypersensitive to noise and odors, ameliorated by urination. Exaggeration of sounds and enlarged vision. Joint and muscular pains. The unpleasant symptoms go off at night in bed and are succeeded by a gentle perspiration. Lingering uneasiness and coldness after removal of other symptoms. Congestive headache. Ocular complaints with mydriasis and dimming of the field of vision. Herpetic eruption on the face. Constipation. Inactive bowels with white, hard stools. Liver, gallbladder and stomach complaints. Gout. Uric diathesis. MIND - Alternating between good moods, euphoria, and depression, discontented. Depressive psychosis. Restless excitability, hysterical. Very nervous and irritable, hypersensitive to noise, ameliorated by urination. Poor powers of concentration.

Head - Head feels numb. Heaviness and confusion of head. Sense of fullness in vessels of brain. Headache resulting form an empty stomach, ameliorated by eating. Morning headache following bad digestion, accompanied by bad mood. Pulsating headache, as if in a fog and the skull seems enlarged.

Eyes - Red inflamed, tired, heavy. Pupils dilated. Conjunctivitis. Blepharitis. Keratitis. Iritis. Retinal infections. Painful, irritated with photophobia. Enlarged and confused vision. Eye movements painful, worse when reading. Eye neuralgia with spots before the eyes, dazzled and troubled vision. Stinging, smarting pains in the eyelids, which are red, swollen and itching, worse on the left side. Styes.

Ears - Exaggeration of sounds. Persistent buzzing. Early otosclerosis.

Nose - Coryza. Irritation of the nasal mucus membranes with discharge and sneezing. Nasal crusts in the morning. Spasmodic rhinitis.

Face - Sudden pallor of the face, feeling that the fingers are dead. Herpetic blisters, boils on the face. Face dirty, seborrhea of the face and nape of the neck, clothes become dirty.

Mouth - Singular taste and sensation of acidity and dryness. Bad breath, which he notices himself. Lips, mouth, palate, dry and painful. Tonguedry, irritated, as if raw, as if scalded by hot water, benumbed. Tongue covered with a white coating. Aphthae on the tongue and inside of the cheeks. Ulceration of the gums and lips. Hemorrhaging of the gums. Inflammation of the roots of the teeth, painful to the touch.

Throat - Hoarseness. Husky voice. Throat insensitive, as if anesthetized. Swallowing painful. Cryptic tonsillitis, purulent with sore throat. Intense dryness of the larynx with irritating cough. Glairy secretion from the larynx and throat. Chronic laryngitis. Vertigo - Frontal congestive headache with vertigo, dizziness of the head and extreme tiredness. COMMENTS - The effects of the provings were removed by free indulgence in wine, coffee, and cigars. With regular dieting, the symptoms lasted much longer and were removed by Nux-v., Camph. and Bell. RELATIONS -Antidotes: Nux-v.,Camph. and Bell. Compare: (1) Bell. - Hypersensitivity and hyper excitability of all the senses, pupils dilated and fixed, photophobia. Dryness of the pharynx, pulse full and bounding, menses too early, blood hot, abdomen distended. (2) Dios. - Violent abdominal colic, ameliorated by leaning backwards, genital excitability, pains in the back and the right sciatic region, dryness of the mouth and flatulence. (3) Sulph. - Irritation of skin and mucus membranes, hepatic and portal intoxication, plethora in arthritis, sclerosis, fat or thin types. REFERENCES - Clarke. Julian.

Stomach - Cramping pains in the stomach, ameliorated by eating, drinking and lying down. Stomach painful like a wound, sensitive to pressure and movement, stinging pain, better by bending double and by resting. Hiccough with salivation, eructation and nausea. Travel sickness. Vomiting during pregnancy.

Abdomen - Repletion and heaviness in the upper abdomen with dyspnea and palpitations, ameliorated by moving and getting up, and by belching and expelling gas. Gastric, duodenal, pyloric ulcers. Diaphragmatic hernia.

Rectum - Hemorrhaging recto-colitis. Spasmodic constipation. Bleeding hemorrhoids.

Stool - Inaction of bowels with white, hard feces when bowels are induced to act.

Male - Diminution of libido, aggravated after the proving. Sexual impotence. Prostatic adenoma.

Female - Menses either a few days too early or late. Blood thick, sticky, dark. Brown leucorrhea with lumbar ache and pains in the low abdomen, ameliorated in bed and by resting. Sterility. Post-menopausal osteoporosis. Food - Feeling of hunger quickly disappears after eating a little. Desire for spicy, piquant dishes, meat, cheese and sweets. Desire for sweets, which are not tolerated. Aggravated by coffee and fats. Aversion to and intolerance of alcoholic drinks.

Chest - Angina pectoris. Constriction of the heart, as if the chest were clamped in a vice, ameliorated by heat in bed and by rest. Anginal pain, lasting for an hour with cold sweat on the forehead. Constitutions - Allergic and psoric constitutions. Arthritic tendencies. Uric diathesis.

Heart - Heaviness on the heart with paresis in the left shoulder and arm. Cardiac pains aggravated in the morning, before a storm, by exertion or movement, ameliorated in bed, by resting and in the fresh air. Arterial hypertension.

Back - Backache. Severe pain in the right shoulder and left wrist, worse with movement. Pain in the scapula and right hand.

Limbs - Cramping pains in all the joints with feeling of heaviness and numbing. Sciatic pain, worse in the morning on rising and letting the leg hang loose, better with heat. Muscular pains in the hips, thighs, legs. Legs heavy, cold, walking is painful. Numbness, heaviness and coldness in the arms. Needle-like pain in the upper part of the right arm, spreading to the hand with feeling of numbness. Cramps in the hands, causing great difficulty in writing. Lungs - Slight cough with expectoration. Difficult breathing.

Sleep - Desire for sleep. Insomnia between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. Sleep disturbed by unpleasant or horrible dreams, by muscular pains. Despite good sleep, feels tired, as if he had taken a sleeping pill.

Skin - Skin itching. Allergic dermatitis. Erysipelas. Shingles. Lupus erythematous. Burning pain on the skin, resulting from exanthemata and boils. Sticky sweating on the palms, forehead, and at the hairline. Nocturnal sweating with strong odor. Exhausting, cold sweating from the trunk, around midnight, followed by feeling of improvement.

Modalities - Better from discharges. Better menses, urine. Better after urination. Better from amelioration of anger. Better from heat. Better continuous movement, stretching backwards. Better resting in bed. Worse from the first movement. Worse dangling the legs, contact. Worse greasy food. Worse between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m. Worse changes in the weather, storms. Worse from the cold, except for head congestion which is better by the cold.

Kidneys - Kidney stones. Extreme atony of the bladder despite urgent pressing feeling. Urination difficult, must force the last drops. Thick urinary stream. Urine copious, pale, milky from phosphate deposits, brown. Urine with a strong odor, accompanied by conjunctiva jaundice. Nightly bedwetting. Amelioration of anger after urination.

Blood - Arteriosclerosis. Hypoglycemia. High level of urea in the blood.

Temperature - Shivering in afternoon. Coldness remains after other symptoms. Febrile flush and pain in the bladder. Sensation of fever, with shivering in the back and persistent, sub-febrile condition.

HOMEOPATHIC - Manganese was isolated in 1774 and was introduced into the Materia Medica by Hahnemann, who made provings of the acetate and carbonate. The symptoms of the two have not been kept separate. Manganese is a metal having a remarkable affinity for and in some respects a close resemblance to iron, of which it is an extremely frequent associate. Its medicinal as well as its physical relationship with iron is very close. Symptoms of chronic manganese poisoning, according to Professor von Jaksch, were involuntary laughter, weeping and walking backwards. Exaggerated reflexes and physical disturbances, evidenced by men making fun of each other's gait. Paraplegia progressive, wasting, feeble and staggering gait. Anemia with destruction of red blood corpuscles. Affinity for the inner ear, larynx, trachea, periosteum of shinbone, joints, ankles and lower limbs. Pain extends to ear from other parts. Everything affects the ear. Yellowgreen lumpy or bloody discharges. Great accumulation of mucus. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow. Bones are very sensitive, Painful, deep soreness of the whole body, every part of the body feels sore when touched, ears, joints, skin. Weak joints. Chronic arthritis with infiltrated, glistening joints. Growing pains. Diagonal pains. Wants to lie down in bed which improves all the troubles. Cellulitis, sub-acute stage, promotes suppuration and hastens regeneration. Suppuration of skin around joints. Necrosis and decay of bones. Malignant ulcers with blue border, following slight injury. Inflammation of bones or joints with nightly digging pains. Progressive muscular atrophy. Motor paralysis, ascending paralysis. Parkinson's disease, paraplegia. Festinating, walks backwards. Jaundice, nephritis with albuminuria. Fatty degeneration of liver. Gout. Typhoid fever, cases that are badly treated with prolonged convalescence. Syphilitic and chlorotic patients with general anemia and paralytic symptoms. For speakers and singers. Valuable for boys and girls whose voices are changing. MIND-Anxiety andfear. Anxiety as if something bad is going to happen, when moving in the room, better lying down. Fretful. Weak and nervous. Peevish. Irritability in morning, during music, while talking. Hatred of persons who had offended him. Silent, reserved. Sad, weeping, silent. Depression, better sad music. Constant moaning or groaning. Confusion while sitting. Involuntary laughing and weeping, better open air. Mental conditions are better when lying down.

Head - Congestion to head, with throbbing, feels large and heavy, better open air. Frequent rush of blood to head, with thirst. Headache with stupefaction and confusion of senses while walking. Headaches worse, breathing, talking or laughing. Pains from above downwards, worse straining at stools, jarring, stepping. Sharp pains like needles, worse jarring or stepping. Cold feeling at a small spot on vertex.

Eyes - Burning in eyes during day. Pupils much dilated or contracted. Field of vision contracted. Dim vision during day. Eyestrain, with aching and pressure. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Eyelids swollen and painful to touch.

Ears - Everything affects the ears. Pain extends to ear from other parts. Swelling of the parotid glands in fevers. Sharp pains in the ears from talking, laughing, swallowing. Feel stopped, cracking on blowing nose. Whistling tinnitus. Deafness in damp weather. Blowing the nose helps deafness.

Nose - Crampy pain at the root of the nose. Dry, obstructed. Obstruction of nose and fluent coryza alternately. Chronic catarrh with bleeding, worse in cold damp weather. Blowing is painful.

Face - Pale, sickly. Stolidly mask-like. Ulcerated at corners of mouth. Twitching, jerking pain from lower jaw to temples worse laughing. Cramp pain in upper and lowerjaw aftereating. Swelling of parotid glands, in fevers.

Mouth - Dry, parched lips, with shriveling of skin, without thirst. Clear vesicles on upper lip. Nodes on palate and tongue. Tongue sore and irritable with ulcers or warts. Flow of saliva, while speaking with colic, paralysis etc. Oily taste. Toothache, worse anything cold, worse sucking, pain going up in the ears.

Throat - Chronic sore throat, with cutting pain, as from excoriation, when not swallowing. Throat as if excoriated. Throat dry, scratching. Laryngitis. Larynx dry, rough, constricted. Tuberculosis of the larynx. Sharp pain in larynx when swallowing. Chronic disease of larynx, with Eustachian deafness. Chronic hoarseness. Hemming and hawking all the time and annoying everybody. Low, monotonous voice. Rough voice better smoking. Vertigo - Vertigo when sitting or standing, nearly falling forward. COMMENTS - F. H. Pritchard, in an article on Mang., cited the action of the metal, noting that the mucus membranes are congested and secretions are increased or decreased. A powerful cholagogue, it induces inflammation and fatty degeneration of the liver. Destroys red corpuscles and causes anemia. Sensitive bones and periosteum, with periostitis. Paralysis and progressive muscular atrophy of the cerebrospinal system. Fissures, excoriation, and suppuration of the skin. Lippe noted the indication “Suppuration of skin round joints.” Pritchard quoted observations of Grille that workmen in manganese mines do not get itch and those who come to the work with itch get cured of it. The manganese waters of Cransac cause “Ill-humor, weeping, despondency, sudden palpitation.” Guernsey noted that “The bones are very sensitive, red spots on the skin, which are elevated, owing to bone disorders. Ankles are particularly affected, children may have this trouble and be unable to walk. - “Typhus fever when the parotid gland is swollen and the bones are very sensitive to touch, disorders of the internal ear, upper part of chest. Hoarse voice, drawing sensation of the muscles.” Laryngeal tuberculosis, tuberculosis. Cough better by lying down. Deep cough, worse in damp weather. Single nodes on the palate. Chlorosis, if gastric symptoms and loss of appetite predominate. Skin will not heal, slight scratches ulcerate. Anemia. Menses too frequent and too scanty in anemic girls. Boring, pressing headaches, proceed from above downwards. Headache like a concussion at every step or movement. Inflammation of bones and joints with insupportable nightly digging pains. Every part of the body feels extremely sore when touched. Rheumatic patients cannot beat any weight on their heels. Rheumatic symptoms with dark, almost blue spots on skin. Paralysis with inclination to run forward if he tried to walk. Paralysis which begins below, extending upward. Paraplegia. Paralysis from degeneration of anterior portion of cord. Clarke has frequently verified the “cough better from lying down,” and also this sensitiveness of the bones. Where these occur in connection with any other condition indicating Mang, it is sure to do good. Clarke cured in an elderly woman a flat growth on the center of her palate with Mang. 30c. Bluish nodes on the skin, malignant ulcers with blue borders following slight injury. Hansen cured with Mang. 6c a case of neuralgia of the tongue following the healing of a little ulcer on surface near left border after an application with lunar caustic. Shortly after the healing, the patient (a man, 60) had severe stinging burning at the left edge of his tongue and the inner side of his left cheek when touching the tongue. In this state he came to Hansen after allopathic treatment. Several medicines were given without result, then Mang, was chosen and made a rapid and permanent cure. A. W. Palmer reported a case of catarrhal deafness cured with Mang. 6c. Miss H., 38, had dull hearing, dry throat with hoarseness, itching in ears, loud rumbling, worse night, right ear, crackling on blowing nose, and deafness in damp weather. The last was the guiding symptom. Cooper gave several ear-cases in which Mang, proved curative. The first concerned a nodule appearance of malleus handle, thickened irregularly, with history of bilious headaches and of previous discharges from the ears. The ear drum membrane had a granular appearance. Purple glazed appearance of the malleus handles, which were thickened and very prominent, upper segment of membrane also purple and glazed. The second concerned a case of chronic periostitis of the meatus and middle ear with otorrhea, left ear. Cooper also noted a case of otorrhea with earache, pain shot up from teeth to ear, the earache was worse after early dinner, up until 8 or 9 p.m. Pains extended to and concentrated in the ears from other parts. The fourth case concerned sensitive ears, took cold and got a headache, history of gallstones and jaundice, sleepy and headache in afternoon, bitter taste in morning, lips glued together, whistling tinnitus worse in a cold, (explosions, Mag-carb., rasping, shrill tinnitus as well as cardiac tinnitus, pumping, Kali-i.). The final case Cooper recorded was deafness in a woman, 36, which dated from when she was 14 from over- strain in singing, when she lost her voice and hearing for six months. Her left hearing returned, right remained deaf, worse after a cold or if over-excited or worried. Subject all life to bilious attacks which lasted twenty-four hours and left suddenly. Head throbbed, couldn't put it down on a pillow. Headache came on in morning on awaking and reached a height at 3 or 4 p.m. and kept on until next morning. Bilious headaches went away and the hearing of right ear improved under Mang. 200c. RELATIONS - Antidotes: Coff., Merc. Compare: (1) Mang-coll. - Boils and other staphylococcal infections. (2) Mang-m. - painful ankles, bone-pains. (3) Mang-s. - liver disorders, excess of bile, a powerful intestinal stimulant. (4) Arg-n., Rhus-t., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak

Abdomen - Pressing in stomach and abdomen while eating, worse cold food. Rumbling in abdomen, from cold food. Abdominal colic, better eating. As if intestines were loose and shaking when walking about. Pain and constriction at the navel. Cutting in umbilical region worse on taking deep breath. Flatulence.

Rectum - Cramps in the anus while sitting, better lying down. Pain in rectum after dinner. Bowels are irregular, with constipation or diarrhea. Constipation with difficult, dry, knotty evacuations. Stool yellow, granular, with tenesmus and constriction of anus. Passes much flatus with stools. Sensations - Head as if larger. Ears as if stopped. Throat as if excoriated. Trachea as if closed with a film. As if pit of stomach enlarged. As if bowels drawn together. As if tendons shortened.

Female - Amenorrhea. First menses delayed. Menses, early, scanty, pale in anemic patients. Discharge of blood between periods with pressing in genitals. Flushes of heat at menopause. Food - Aversion to food from a feeling of satiety. Loss of appetite, in chlorosis. No thirst.

Chest - Heat, beating in chest. Sharp pains in chest and sternum running up and down. Bruised pain in upper chest when stooping, better raising head.

Heart - Sudden shocks at heart and in left side of chest, from above downward. Palpitations of heart, strong, irregular, trembling. Pulse irregular, sometimes rapid, sometimes slow, but constantly weak and soft.

Back - Tearing pain in whole spinal column, from above downward. Pain in small of back on bending backward. Stiffness of nape. Red, swollen streak on left side of neck.

Limbs - Muscular twitching. Parkinson's disease. Inflammation of bones and joints with nightly digging pains. Bones very sensitive. Every part of body feels sore when touched. Shiny red swelling of joints. Periosteal inflammation. Burning spots about joints. Suppuration of skin around joints. Knee pain and itching. Intolerable pain in skin of lower limbs. Legs feel numb. Stiffness in muscles of legs. Cramps in calves. Rheumatism of feet. Ankles painful. Children are unable to walk because of ankles are weak. Peculiar slapping gait,-walks on metacarpo-pha- langeal joint, walks backwards. Tending to fall forward, walks stooping forward. Cannot walk backwards without falling.

Sleep - Languor and sleepiness. Much yawning. Sleepy very early in evening. Many vivid dreams which are well remembered.

Skin - Red, elevated spots. Itching, better scratching. Itching of diabetes. Chronic eczema with amenorrhea, worse during menses or menopause. Psoriasis and pityriasis. Dry hard ulcers. Burning around ulcers. Suppuration of skin around joints. Rough, cracked (flexures), bluish. Deep cracks in bends of elbows, knees.

Modalities - Better from open air, sad music, eating, swallowing, lying down. Better or worse by change of weather. Worse cold, wet weather, damp, touching with cold things, touch. Worse at night, speaking, laughing, motion, bending backwards. Lying on the feather bed aggravates asthma.

Liver - Chronic enlargement of liver. Jaundice. Lungs - Every cold becomes bronchitis (Dulc.). Mucus difficult to loosen after long hawking. Difficult expectoration of lumps of tough mucus in evening. Scanty mucus. Lumpy, yellow, adhesive mucus. Greenish masses. Expectoration of yellowish greenish lumps, even with- Manganum aceticum out coughing in morning. Bloody, reddish phlegm. Hemoptysis with stitching pains through right lung and dry cough. Asthmatic persons who cannot lie on a feather pillow.

Kidneys - Darting in urethra on passing flatus. Cutting pain in middle of urethra between urination. Frequent desire to urinate during day. Urine profuse, sediment violet, earthy. Addison's disease.

Cough - Dry cough, incessant, from irritation about middle of sternum. Cough with aphonia. Cough better lying down, worse evening, damp weather, loud reading, laughing, walking, or deep inspiration. Inclination to cough in morning.

Temperature - Shaking chills in evening, with shooting pains in head, without thirst. Chills with icy cold hands and feet. Sudden flushes of heat in face in chest and over the back. Burning over whole body, in evening when rising from bed.

Mang-o. has some symptoms similar to Parkinson's disease, progressive lenticular degenerations and pseudo- sclerosis. Peculiar slapping gait. Muscular twitching, cramps in calves, stiff leg muscles. Pain in tibia. Dysmenorrhea. Colic and diarrhea. Easily fatigued and heated, sleepy. Stolid, mask-like face. Low monotonous voice, “economical speech.” Occasional uncontrollable laughter. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Head - Boring in right cranial bones, tearing in right occipital bone.

Face - Pressive pain in right jaw joint.

Stomach - Sour belchings of air. Pressure in stomach, worse by external pressure. Vertigo - Vertigo and reeling when walking in open air, worse looking down, on descending or stooping. REFERENCES Clarke. ***MANGANUM OXYDATUM NATIVUM (Manganese Oxydatum) PHARMACY - mang-o. Manganum oxydatum nativum. Manganese oxydatum. Pyrolusite. Native Black Oxide of Manganese. Historical dose: All potencies.

Abdomen - Frequent rumbling.

Rectum - Stool harder and scantier.

Limbs - Pain in articulation of left thumb. Drawing pain with weary feeling in right thigh while sitting. Pressure in right knee extending into leg, a bruised sensation remains in ankles, afterwards same pain in left ankle. Pressure and drawing in ankle and ankle bones. Pressure in left foot.

Modalities - Stomach pains were worse by external pressure.

full:
PHARMACY - mang-s. Manganum sulphuri- cum. Manganese sulphate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bile, excess. Gastritis. Liver, disorders. Toothaches.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper said, “This Salt of Manganese deserves more attention than seems to be at present given to it. It has been proved to cause vomiting, paralysis without convulsions and inflammation of the stomach and small intestines. As well as of the liver, spleen and heart.” C. G. Gmelin, who experimented with it, recorded its property of causing such an extraordinary secretion of bile that nearly all the intestines were colored yellow by it and the large intestines had a wax-yellow color communicated to them. According to Rutherford, Mang-s. is a powerful intestinal, but a feeble hepatic stimulant. Toothache in a bad tooth, on right side, upperjaw. Shooting, darting extending up the whole side of face and head. Painful parts tender to touch. Ure found Mang-s. to act on man as a purgative and cholagogue in doses of one to two drachms in half a pint of water. It has, however, caused vomiting and sweating as well as purgation and is uncertain in its action from an allopathic point of view. Mang-s. lx cured in one case of hepatic derangement where the stools were composed of large quantities of bile. REFERENCES - Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - One of the best general remedies for passive hemorrhages, uterine, kidney, gastric, pulmonary and intestinal. Mangi. has atonic conditions, poor circulation and relaxed muscles. Rhinitis, sneez- ing, pharyngitis, and other acute throat troubles, suffocative sensation as if throat would close. Hemorrhages ofall kinds. Varicose veins. Drowsiness. Relaxation of mucus membrane of digestive tract. Chronic intestinal irritation. Catarrhal and serous discharges. Aching of left side of body. Chilly. Sticky mucus discharges. Tendency to suppurations. Pains in spots. Pains shifting suddenly, or coming and going suddenly. Hay fever with whitish, sticky and stringy discharge. Dyspnea, starting with coryza. Skin as if sunburnt, swollen. MIND - Ailments from anger. Easily offended. Feels like striking the person irritating her. Involuntary, sighing. Weeps easily. Melancholy. Feels bored. Worse being alone. Wants to remain busy.

Nose - Colds. Rhinitis with sneezing.

Face - Swelling of lips.

Throat - Pharyngitis and other acute throat troubles. Suffocative sensation as if throat would close. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Erig., Epil. REFERENCES - Boericke.

Stomach - Hyperacidity. Worse eructations. Better drinking cold water. Burning behind sternum at 2 a.m. to 3 a.m. Nausea and vomiting in morning.

Abdomen - Heaviness of abdomen after eating.

Female - Metrorrhagia, dark blood, painless, profuse. Food - Better cold drinks. Desires mango. Desires sour. Desire for sweets. Worse sour, spicy foods.

Limbs - Itching of palms of hands.

Skin - Skin as if sunburned and swollen. White spots intense itching. Itching of palms. Lobes of ears and lips swollen.

Modalities - Better vomiting. Better open air. Better sitting bent forward or erect. Better cold drinks. Better continued motion. Worse sour food. Worse morning. Worse beginning of motion. Worse exertion, climbing. Worse 1 a.m. to 2 a.m. Worse change of weather. Worse air-conditioned room. Worse closed room. Worse stooping. Worse bending forward.

Blood - Hemorrhage, venous blood with dark clots.

HOMEOPATHIC - Activity increased. Weariness with sleepiness. Lack of vital heat or heat sensation. MIND - Hurry, haste. Anxiety alternating with cheerfulness. Anxiety about future. Fear bad something will happen. Fear with heart complaints. Delusions, that he is pursued. Ailments from domination by others. Contented. Cheerfulness, gaiety, happiness. Elated. Euphoria. Egotistic. Cheerfulness alternating with sadness. Mood changeable, variable. Morose, sulky, cross, fretful, ill-humor, peevish. Indifference, apathy. Unfeeling, hard-hearted. Sadness, despondency, depression, melancholy. Concentration difficult while studying, reading, talking, when thinking. Memory weakness. Forgetful for what he was about to do. Loss of memory. Makes mistakes in localities, talking, writing. Stupefaction, as if intoxicated.

Head - Headache in the forehead. Headache, worse from changes of weather, draft of air. Headache during fever. Pain in spots. Dull, pressing, stitching pain.

Eyes - Pain as from a foreign body. Burning, smarting, biting, pressing pain. Agglutinated inner canthi. Itching in inner canthi.

Ears - Noises in ears.

Nose - Coryza with fluent discharge. Watery discharge. Sneezing.

Face - Dryness, especially of the lips. Eruptions, pustules.

Mouth - Dryness with thirstlessness, especially tongue. Sore, bruised gums on touch. Bleeding gums when brushing teeth. Scorbutic gums.

Throat - Rawness, roughness, scratching in throat. Sore, bruised pain. Throat pain during fever. REFERENCES Gluck.

Stomach - Heartburn. Acrid, sour belching.Pressing pain.

Abdomen - Bloating. Flatulence.

Rectum - Constipation.

Female - Menses too late. Herpetic eruptions. Sexual desire diminished or increased. Food - Desires juicy things. Aversion to alcoholic drinks, worse from coffee.

Heart - Palpitations. Stitching pain in heart.

Back - Backache in dorsal, lumbar region. Lumbago. Stiffness, tension. Breast - Itching in breast, nipples. Breast, nipple pain, stitching. Dreams - Dreams lewd, lascivious, voluptuous, perverse. Dreams of anger, brutality, violence, mutilation, rape, war, escape. Dreams about children.

Neck - Pain in neck region. Stiffness, tension.

Limbs - Weariness with heaviness of limbs. Numbness, insensibility. Trembling. Weakness in the lower limbs, especially in the right knee.

Sleep - Falling asleep difficult or late. Bad sleep. Deep sleep. Position on right side, impossible to sleep on left side.

Skin - Itching.

Modalities - Better open air. Worse draft of air, or change of weather. Weariness better from lying.

Teeth - Toothaches, pressing pain.

HERBAL - A valuable herbal remedy in coughs, colds and lung infections. Sold as “Horehound ale,” a pleasant tasting beverage. An infusion of one ounce to one pint of boiling water, taken in hot wineglass doses as needed induces sweating. Horehoundcandies and cough drops are popular. Marrubium is a bitter digestive tonic, expectorant and diuretic herb. It has a bitter, aromatic taste and odor. Culpepper used it to repel the afterbirth, as an antidote to poisons, snakebites and to help indurated livers. It calms the nervous heart. Irregular heartbeats. Reduces fevers. Malaria. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Black Horehound - Stimulant, anti-spasmodic and vermifuge. Dioscorides said, “The leaves beaten with salt and applied the wound, cure the bite of mad dogs.” REFERENCES Potter.
