full:
PHARMACY - nat-c. Natrum carbonicum. Sodium carbonate. The common “Soda” of the shops, purified, not the Bicarbonate of Soda. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Albuminuria. Anemia. Anidrosis. Ankles, weak. Backache. Belching. Bums. Candida. Chills. Colic. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Coms. Coryza. Coughs. Deafness. Debility. Diarrhea. Dysmenor- rhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Elephantiasis. Emaciation. Fever. Flatulence. Food, allergies. Glands, disorders. Goiter. Hands, chapped. Headaches. Heartburn. Heat, flushes. Heatstroke. Heels, blisters. Herpes. Hiccough. Hoarseness. Hypochondriasis. Hysteria. Ichthyosis. Indigestion. Infertility. Keratitis. Leucorrhea. Lisping. Malassimilation. Malnutrition. Milk, allergies. Moles. Nausea. Nose, eruptions. Nose, swollen. Nose- bleed. Ozaena. Palpitations. Photophobia. Post-nasal, catarrh. Presbyopia. Priapism. Rheumatism. Ringworm. School, headaches. Scrofula. Stammering. Sterility. Sunstroke. Throat, mucus. Toothache. Ulcers. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts. Waterbrash.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-c. was proved by Hahnemann and is one of the anti-psoric remedies. All the natmms stimulate cellular activity and increase oxidation and metabolism. It had been used in old-school practice as an external application in solution to bums and eczema, and as a douche in nasal or vaginal catarrh. The common practice of taking sodium bicarbonate for indigestion and heartbum is founded on a true relationship (though Nat-c. is the carbonate and not the bicarbonate), but the indiscriminate and excessive use of it only intensifies the trouble. Nat-c. forms the alkaline basis in most soaps, excess alkali almost bums off the superficial layers of the epidermis and leaves the skin dry and cracked. The provings confirm this irritating action. Nat-c. is particularly useful for chapped hands and faces, rough, dry skin, eczema, herpes, warts and scrofulous conditions of the skin. Swelling and induration of glands. Exhaustion. Emaciation, anemia. Milky, watery skin. Very weak ankles. Puffiness. Relaxation, easy dislocation. Twitching in the muscles and limbs. Contraction of muscles, tendons. Pains cause tremors, cold sweat, anxiety etc. Irritation of the mucus membranes. Irritation, vesicles, ulcers and catarrh in the digestive tract from the mouth to anus. Keratitis and ulceration of the cornea. The nose is swollen and ulcerated with a thick yellow or green offensive discharge. Thick, yellow, putrid leucorrhea (Sep.). Oversensitive to open air, music, noise and dietetic errors. Worse from any physical or mental exertion, strain, from the least effort, from sun and gaslight. Debility from heat of summer, every spell of warm weather causes headache. Chronic effects of sunstroke. Headache from sun or working under lights. Children when asleep, jump, cry, grasp the mother. Startled, nervous children. Children cannot tolerate milk but thrive better on cereals. MIND - Mental weakness. Weak memory. Difficulty thinking or concentrating. Slow comprehension. Mental work is impossible. Transposes words. Spacey. Stupefaction in morning on waking. Impatience while reading. Restlessness better mental labor. Conscientious about trifles. Sympathetic. Mild and kind. Pathologically cheerful. Tendency to sacrifice for others. Refined sensibility. Dislikes intruding on people, bothering people (Staph., Sil.). Selective friendships, air of detachment. Elusive nature. Strong sense of integrity. Humane, empathetic. Very self-conscious. Closed, controlled emotions. Avoidance of stress. Meditative. Difficulty dealing with suffering and pain in the world. Profound sadness, depression and melancholy. Constantly occupied with sad thoughts, though there is also the opposite, great gaiety and talkative. Philosophical about grief, resigned. Internal sorrow, mel ancholy. Suffers grief with dignity. Unassimilated emotions. Sadness from errors of diet. Thoughts of suicide, overwhelmed with suffering. Cross, irritable. Irritability during fever. Aversion to society, even that of their own family or spouse. Sensitive to the presence of certain persons. Indifferent. Anxious and fearful. Anxiety, trembling and sweat during pains. Delusions of being deserted, forsaken. Very sensitive to noise, cold, change of weather. Worse thunderstorms, electric changes in the atmosphere. Very nervous during thunderstorm, hides in cellar. Anxious and restless during thunderstorms. Desires to be magnetized. Starting from noise. Sensitive to music (Ambr.). Music causes tendency to suicide, sadness, religious insanity. Playing on piano causes anxiety and trembling. Sensitive to sensual impressions.

Head - Head pains out through eyes, head bent backwards. Stupefying pain in forehead, with nausea, eructations and dimness of sight. Headache alternating with digestive troubles. Headaches from slightest mental exertion. Headachesfrom exposure to sunlight (Glon.), gaslight. Dullness of head when at rest or when in sun. Headaches in hot weather. Head feels too large. Pulsating, in vertex every morning. Almost painless boil on occiput. Falling out of hair.

Eyes - Burning pain in eyes, worse reading and writing, with dryness. Shooting pain from within outward. Needle-like stitches in both eyes, after dinner. Ulcers on cornea, with shooting pains. Dim eyes, has to wipe them constantly. Photophobia. Lachrymation during forenoon. Agglutination of eyes in morning. Eyes close involuntary. Heaviness of upper lids. Lids swollen. Inflammation of eyelids with photophobia.

Ears - Dryness and heat. Sharp stitching pain in ears. As if something moved in ear on swallowing. As if a bubble bursting in ears. Oversensitive hearing. Sensitive to noise, music. Stopped sensation. Deafness with recurring earache, with amenorrhea. Loss of hearing of right ear, sounds seem to come from left side when they really come from right. Hardness of hearing and roaring in left ear, worse before menses.

Nose - Swollen or peeling. Pimples and puffiness. Red nose with white pimples on it. Many troubles of external nose (Caust.). Humid herpetic eruptions and ulcers on nose, around mouth and on lips. Ulceration high up in nostrils. Nosebleed. Stoppage at night. Catarrh, post-nasal catarrh. Catarrh, foul, thick, yellow or green discharge. Hawking mucus from throat, worse slight draft. Constant coryza, obstruction of nose. Coryza, worse least draft, alternate days. Coryza, with burning in eyes. Bad odor of nasal secretions. Musty smelling discharge. Violent sneezing. Squeaking sensation at root of nose.

Face - Pale, withered, bloated face. Pale face, with dark streaks under eyes. Blue rings around eyes, swollen lids. Freckles, yellow spots, pimples. Yellow blotches on forehead and upper lip. Burning crack in lower lip. Lips swollen, particularly upper lip. Swelling of both cheeks, with glowing redness. Swelling of submaxillary glands. Pains in bones of face, with chronic nasopharyngeal catarrh.

Mouth - Constant dryness of mouth end lips, which she was constantly obliged to lick. Saliva increased. Bitter taste in the mouth, food tastes bitter. Taste perverted, too sensitive. Taste sour, metallic. Redness and soreness of mouth, with flat, painful blisters. Vesicles and smooth ulcers in mouth with burning, mouth open. Sensitiveness of lower teeth. Toothache, in lower jaw. worse eating fruits, sweets, better smoking. Nightly pressing toothache with swelling of lower lip and of gums.

Throat - Hoarseness with coryza, chilliness and scraping, painful cough. Throat painful when yawning and swallowing. Must drink to swallow solids from roughness, dryness of esophagus and throat. Hawks much mucus from the throat. Taste of blood, pus in throat. Glandular swellings in throat. Resistant swelling of middle lobe of thyroid gland. Hard goiter, with pressing pain.

Stomach - Stomach feels swollen and sensitive. Heaviness and pressure in stomach. Weak digestion, worse from slightest errors in diet. Dyspepsia relieved by soda biscuits. Old dyspeptics, always belching, have sour stomach and rheumatism. Gastric pains, better eating. Indigestion. Cramp in stomach, pressing, drawing, cutting pain. Depressed after eating. Bitter taste. Acidity. Waterbrash. Heartburn after fats. Sour eructations. Frequent hiccough. Nausea and retching, with pain and soreness in stomach. Violent retching in morning, without actual vomiting. Vomiting of bile, bitter. Food allergies. Ill effects of drinking cold water when overheated.

Abdomen - Griping colic just after a meal. Abdominal colic somewhat better eating. Indigestion, gas and bloating. Accumulation, incarceration, and painful movements of flatus in abdomen. Flatus changes places, abdomen bloated here and there. Hard, bloated, swollen abdomen. Epigastrium painful to touch and talking. Colic with retraction of naval and hardness of skin. Colic somewhat better eating and warmth. Pressure in lower abdomen, as if everything in abdomen would fall out. Violent sharp pain in right hypochondriac region, followed by griping in lower abdomen. Swelling of glands of groin and axilla. Itch-like eruption on lower part of abdomen.

Rectum - Sudden call to stool without result. Emission of much sour-smelling or fetid flatus. Stools escape with haste and noise. Constipation, insufficient stool, with tenesmus. Constipation alternating with soft and liquid stools. Gushing diarrhea, preceded by cutting pain in upper abdomen. Discharge of tinea during evacuation. Diarrhea with cutting pain . Diarrheafrom starches, milk, taking cold. Burning and cutting pain in anus and rectum during stool. Burning pain in rectum after stool. Lancinations in perineum. Itching and tingling in anus. Sensations - As if head too large, as if forehead would burst, as if head would be drawn back. As if ears were closed up, as of a bubble bursting in ear. As if tip of tongue were cracked. Dryness of mouth as if caused by heat of breath. As if veins of right leg were bruised. Blisters on points of toes as if scalded. Motion as from a fetus in uterus.

Stool - Stools, black, hard, smooth, crumbly. Watery stool. Yellow substance like pulp of orange in stool in menopausal women. Discharge of ball of mucus like peas. Stool spotted with blood, discharge of blood during stool.

Male - Straining and tenesmus, with voluptuous sensation in genitals. Glans penis becomes sore easily. Inflammation, swelling and easy excoriation of prepuce and glans penis. Prostatic affections, discharge of prostatic fluid at stool and when urinating. Bruised pain in testicles. Heaviness and drawing in testicles. Soreness between scrotum and thighs. Increased sexual desire with priapism and painful pollutions. Incomplete sex, erection weak, emissions speedy. Nightly emissions. Sweats after sex.

Female - Soreness. Deficient menses in adult females. Menses too early, late, scanty, like meat-washings (Nit-ac.). Menses with pain in lumbar region and abdomen. Dysmenorrhea. Leucorrheal discharge, offensive, irritating. Leucor- rhea thick, yellow, ropy. Leucorrhea better after urination. Profuse leucorrhea, after frequent attacks of colic. Induration of cervix. Bearing down sensation (Sep., Murx). Motion, as if fetus in uterus. Sterility. Infertility from non- retention of semen. Promotes conception. Labor pains weak, or with anguish, sweat and desire to be rubbed. Prevents false conception. Expels moles. Food - Hungry at 5 a.m. Greedy, always nibbling. Very weak digestion. Food tastes bitter. Food allergies. Oversensitive to errors in diet. Craving for sweets. Must drink in order to swallow solids. Aversion to milk. Worse from milk, causes flatulence, diarrhea. Children who can’t tolerate milk but thrive better on cereals. Drowsiness after meals. Heartburn after fats. Diarrhea from starch. Indigestion is worse from vegetables and starchy foods. Ill effects of drinking cold water when overheated.

Chest - Chilliness in one side of chest. Pressing, sharp pains in chest. Burning soreness in right mid chest. Constitutions - Suited to light-haired people and persons of leuco-phlegmatic constitution with aversion to open air and mental or physical exercise.

Heart - Painful cracking in region of heart. Palpitations from noise, on going upstairs, when attention is directed to something, when lying on left side. Palpitations, a general accompaniment of indigestion. Pulse excited at night, with ebullitions.

Back - Backache, violent pain in lumbar region after walking. Burning pain and distress along spine. Tingling in back. Cervical glands swollen. Cracking in cervical vertebrae, when moving the neck. Boring pain at tip of left scapula. Coldness between scapulae. Stiffness and drawing between scapulae. Pustules on lumbar region. Causations - Sun, gaslight, heat, changes in temperature. Ill effects of sunstroke (chronic). Suppression of sweat. Cold drink when over-heated. Extreme sensitivity to electrical changes, like thunderstorms. Over-study, strains, grief. Errors in diet, milk.

Limbs - Great weakness of limbs, especially in morning. Locomotor ataxia, fulgurating pains better eating. Heaviness of legs and feet with tension in them. Unsteady walk, small obstruction on pavement causes him to fall, or falls without apparent cause. Hollow of the knee is painful on motion. Popliteal, painful on motion. Legs are icy cold up to knees. Weak ankles. Cramps from ankles to toes. Easy dislocation and spraining of ankles. Foot bends under (Caust.). Old sprains. Heel and Achilles tendon affected. Tender soles, needlelike pain, burning while walking. Soles of feet raw and sore. Burning wrists and ankles. Jerking of hand on going to sleep. Contractions of fingers. Folds of fingers and toes sore. Chapped hands. Vesicles on tips of all fingers and toes. Lungs - Dyspnea and shortness of breathing, from tension of chest. Short cough with rattling in chest. Cough with rawness in chest, worse morning. Cough, dry, tickling, worse at 9 to 11 a.m. Cough with coldness of left side of breast. Violent and dry cough on passing from cold to hot temperature. Cough with rumbling, incarcerated flatus. Loose, hollow cough, with salty, purulent, greenish sputum. Bloody expectoration.

Sleep - Drowsy during day after meals. Falls asleep late at night. Sleeps with mouth open. Jerking and shocks during sleep. Restless sleep with ebullitions, palpitations and nightmares. Pleasant, amorous dreams. Anxious, frightful dreams. Dreams of traveling, floods, quarrels, robbers, devils, thieves, death. Wakes too early in the morning. Sleepiness in morning.

Skin - Dry, rough, milky, watery. Inclination to perspire easily or dry, rough, cracked skin. Full veins. Formication. Itching as from fleas over whole body. Pustular eruptions. Blisters on small joints, tips of toes or fingers. Red vesicles filled with fluid. Vesicles with shooting pains and itching. Vesicular eruption in patches and circles. Yellow rings like remains of herpes. Herpetic eruptions, sometimes suppurating. Ulcers, burning, pricking and pulsating. Ulcers, pus corroding, acrid, putrid and yellow. Ulcers, with swelling and inflamed redness. Warts, ulcerate, sensitive to touch. Elephantiasis.

Modalities - Better from eating, sweating. Better wiping with hand. Better boring into nose or ears with fingers. Better rubbing, motion, pressure. Aversion to cold air. Worse from heat of sun. Worse drafts, damp weather. Worse getting wet, change of weather. Worse extremes of temperature. Worse before a storm or during a storm. Worse drinking cold water, cold drinks when over heated. Worse from vegetable diet, starchy food. Worse milk, dietetic errors. Worse from music, noise. Worse mental or bodily exertion. Worse at 5 a.m. Worse alternate days. Worse the full moon. Worse sun exposure.

Tongue - Tongue coated, dry. Burning about tip of tongue, as if it was cracked. Pimples on tip of tongue, which burns as if full of cracks. Affections of under-surface of tongue. Tongue heavy, immovable, with difficult speech. Stammering on account of heaviness of tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo from wine, mental exertion, exposure to sun, better from exercise in open air. Vision - Dim vision, has to wipe eyes constantly. Can’t read small print. Sensation as if feathers before eyes. Flashes and streaks of light before closed eyes at night. Dazzling flashes or stars before eyes, on waking. Black spots before eyes when writing. COMMENTS - Sensitive digestion (Nat-s.). Chronic dyspepsia, stomachaches. Very weak digestion, burning, gas and bloating. Belching, ulcers, and indigestion. Heartburn with acid regurgitations and esophageal problems. Malassimilation, food allergies. Difficulty swallowing foods. Emaciation, anemia, and bloating. May get bloated from starchy foods. Ill effects of drinking cold water. Worse from milk, especially in children (Aeth.), causing diarrhea. Worse from wine. Stomach problems will often alternate with headaches. Depression and irritability is worse after a meal, the aggravation diminishing as digestion advances, “as the food passes through the duodenum.” Characteristic blue ring around the eyes of children with allergies. Ptosis of the eyelids. Photophobia. Chronic nasal congestion. Women can have a “discharge of mucus after an embrace” causing infertility. Candida. Bearing down pain, dragging feeling in the stomach (Sep.). Worse after sex, exhaustion. Emotional detachment. Symptoms of hysteria. Contractions of muscles and tendons, relaxation of tissues. Twitching in muscles and limbs. Paralysis of the left leg. Conditions resulting from malabsorption. Swelling and induration of glands. Bone problems, curved spine. Stooping forward. Ankle joints are weak and burn. Stitches go from within out. Right upper and left lower are particularly effected. Great debility from any exertion, unsteady walk, any little obstruction on pavement causes falling, or he falls without any apparent cause. Aversion to exercise. Symptoms are worse from mental or bodily exertion. Generally chilly. Worse extremes of temperature. Sensitivity to changes in atmosphere. Worse before a storm or during a storm. Restless before a storm or with a storm. May get migraine headaches or stomach problems before a storm. Conditions resulting from exposure in the sun. Heat exhaustion. Headache from mental exertion, sun exposure. Sensitivity to music, worse from loud music. Sensitive to particular things, not a general sensitivity (as is Phos.), certain foods, people, sounds, light conditions. Pet peeves. Aggravations cause headaches, stomachaches, heartburn, indigestion, depression. Aware of limitations and sensitivities. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Ars., Camph.. It antidotes: Chin. Compare: (1) Sodium bicarbonate - in vomiting of pregnancy with acetonuria. (2) Nat-s. is preferable for yeastlike vomiting, with pallid, dirty, livid tongue. (3) Nat-m. - hypochondriasis. That of Nat-c. keeps pace with indigestion, that of Nat-m. with degree of constipation, head and face better uncovering, leucorrhea. (4) Caust., Nat-cac. (5) Sep. - Indifferent to family, melancholy, apprehensive, worse by music, backache worse by sitting, bearing down, boring through from tip of left scapula. (6) Pic-ac. - priapism, towards morning, emission and no desire. (7) Nux-v. - hypochondriasis, morning retching, Nux-v., of pregnancy, or after debauch. (8) Phos., Rhod., Sil., Petr., worse from thunder storm. (9) Lyc. - better uncovering, ulcer on heel. Lyc. on instep, right upper, left lower. ( 10) Debility from heat of summer, Ant-c. (11) Headache from sun or gaslight, Glon., Lach. (12) Bearing down as if everything would come out. Sep., Agar., Lil-t., Murx. (13) Easily sprained ankles, Stront., Led. Complementary: Sep., Kali salts. Compatible: Calc., Nux-v., Puls., Sep., Sul. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Pressure in region of bladder. Burning in urethra during and after urination. Frequent need to urinate, with copious or scanty discharge. Bright or dark yellow urine. Urine smells like horse’s urine, from vegetable or milk diet. Involuntary urination at night.

Perspiration - Profuse sweat from the least physical exertion. Perspiration while eating, in morning. Patient breaks into a cold sweat. Burning sweat on forehead where hat presses. Anxious sweat during pain, with dreams. Perspiration all over, during fever. Night sweat alternating with dryness of skin. Perspiration in morning.

Temperature - Sudden chilliness. Chill, without thirst. Shivering fits induced by over fatigue and anxiety. Chill with cold hands and hot cheeks, or the reverse. Cold hands and feet, with hot forehead. Coldness of lower limbs. Heat with great debility and sleep. Heat with perspiration over whole body. Febrile shuddering, with cold hands and hot cheeks. Heat flushes, with aversion to uncovering.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from pressure, distraction. Worse from resting..

PHARMACY - nat-f. Natrum fluoratum. Sodium flouride. Triturations from the salts. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Constipation. Cramps. Diarrhea. Muscle, pains. Mydriasis. Proteinuria. Stomachache. Tetany. Writer’s cramp.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-f., molecular weight 42,…
full:
PHARMACY - nat-f. Natrum fluoratum. Sodium flouride. Triturations from the salts. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Constipation. Cramps. Diarrhea. Muscle, pains. Mydriasis. Proteinuria. Stomachache. Tetany. Writer’s cramp.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-f., molecular weight 42, appears in the form of colorless crystals, cubic or tetragonal in shape. The triturations were prepared from the salt. The work was completed in 1956 by Gutman New York, on twenty-one provers. The proving lasted fifty days using a 6c in tablet form. Due to the fluorine, the action of the remedy is myoneurotrophic. Sudden muscular contracture. Sudden muscular pains, coming and going in the muscles and joints. Pains while resting or from lack of distraction, reduced by pressure. Pains in the region of the left scapula. MIND - Agitation and depression. State of stupor. Loss of ability to speak.

Eyes - Mydriasis. Cramping pains in the eyelids. Food - Lack of appetite.

Mouth - Pain in the mouth with salty or soapy-tasting saliva.

Stomach - Cramping pain in the stomach. Digestive heaviness and discomfort, nausea. Stomachache, painful hungry feeling, not eased by nourishment. Blood- streaked vomit. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Cupr. - Violent intermittent, cramping pains of the eyelids, stomach, calves and feet, aggravated by the cold. REFERENCES-Julian.

Abdomen - Gastric and intestinal cramps.

Rectum - Constipation or diarrhea with expulsion of wind.

Heart - Weak heart. Irregular pulse, rapid, weak, jumping.

Back - Muscular, cramping, sudden pains. Pain in the shoulders.

Limbs - Sudden pains, coming and going in the muscles and joints. Hardening of the bones. Cramps in the calves and cyanosed, bluish coloring of the legs.

Skin - Itching of the skin without eruption. Itching eruption in the left axilla. Passing eruption on the legs. Copious, cold perspiration.

Modalities - Better from pressure, distraction. Worse from resting.

Kidneys - Oliguria. Urine retention. Proteinuria.

name: Natrum Hypochlorosum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better after stool, from cold applications. Worse from eating or drinking, drinking least drop of cold water, warm drinks. Worse by washing, damp, warmth, lying on either side. Worse before each menstrual period, before stool..
constitution: Albuminuria. Allergies. Anaphylaxis. Ankles, weak. Aphonia. Backache. Breast pain. Bronchitis. Chlorosis. Cough. Natrum hypochlorosum Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Eczema. Edema. Emaciation. Fainting. Flatus. Globus. Gravel. Headache. Hematuria. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Kidney stones. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Metrorrhagia. Nephritis. Nosebleed. Ovaries disorders. Priapism. Proctitis. Scurvy.
keynote: PHARMACY - nat-hchls. Natrum hypochlo- rosum. Labarraque’s solution. Natrum chlo- ratum. Liquor soda chlorate. It comes from hypochlorite of soda or potassium-chloride water. Potencies of the solution. Historical dose: All potencies. Fifteen to twenty drops of Labarraque’s…
full:
PHARMACY - nat-hchls. Natrum hypochlo- rosum. Labarraque’s solution. Natrum chlo- ratum. Liquor soda chlorate. It comes from hypochlorite of soda or potassium-chloride water. Potencies of the solution. Historical dose: All potencies. Fifteen to twenty drops of Labarraque’s solution in water.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Allergies. Anaphylaxis. Ankles, weak. Aphonia. Backache. Breast pain. Bronchitis. Chlorosis. Cough. Natrum hypochlorosum Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Eczema. Edema. Emaciation. Fainting. Flatus. Globus. Gravel. Headache. Hematuria. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Kidney stones. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Liver, disorders. Metrorrhagia. Nephritis. Nosebleed. Ovaries disorders. Priapism. Proctitis. Scurvy. Smarting eruptions. Sub- involution. Tongue, shriveled, swollen. Toothache. Uterus, water-logged. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-hchls., the well-known disinfecting fluid, is one of Cooper’s additions to the Materia Medica. His proving brought out some very characteristic features, although there is a close general resemblance to Nat-m. The chlorine radical determines irritation of the skin and mucus membranes, the sodium induces extreme sensitivity to humidity. The indications are not the result of a Homeopathic proving, but the result of the information given by the toxicology and the clinical usage of the remedy. Nat-hchls. affects profoundly the entire organism and causes rapid emaciation, fainting, weakness with a flabbiness most pronounced along the mucus tracts with a diffused hydrogenoid condition and a tendency to leucocytosis. Eczema and itching, more particularly localized on the upper limbs and the face. Anaphylaxis caused by cutaneous intolerance of aproduct. Chronic catarrhal diseases of the middle ear. Phlegmatic. Congested and atonic states of the uterus and its ligaments with hepatic disorders. Both hands swollen in morning. Depressed, faint.

Head - Headaches. Swimming feeling, as if top of head would float off.

Eyes - Eyes red, weeping, eyelids puffy, red and itching. Amelioration by cold compresses.

Ears - Pain under right ear when swallowing with much tenderness and swelling up side of head.

Nose - Nosebleed, clots of blood.

Face - Edema of the face.

Mouth - Putrid taste. Furred tongue, large, flabby indented. Flat ulcer on tongue far back towards root. Sore, irritable spots along sides of tongue and throat. Gums sore, tongue swollen, aphthous ulceration. Stomatitis, aphthosis.

Throat - Throat red and sore, with difficult swallowing. Burning in the pharynx with redness, choking cough. Vertigo - Vertigo with aching across forehead. Swimming feeling, as if top of head would float off. COMMENTS - Drowsiness, cannot sit down without falling asleep. A weight seems to fall from pit of chest to pit of abdomen with aching, dull sensation on vertex. Vertigo causing falling. Paralyzed feeling in brain. Sensation as if top of skull were about to float off, as though cranial bones were being crossed over each other. Swelling, neuralgic pains and suppuration about jaws. Tongue swollen or shriveled at sides. Swelling low down in abdomen, going up to chest and causing dyspnea. Swelling of both hands in morning on waking. Gatherings on fingers. Swelling on both hands in morning on waking. Pain in hip joint reflected from ovary. Dr. Robert Cooper’s grand characteristic indication for Nat-hchls. is a water-logged uterus. The womb is sodden, heavy, low down in pel vis, bearing down in pel vis with tendency to prolapse. The state of subinvolution after confinement corresponds very closely to this and Clarke frequently saw Nat- hchls. do good work in such cases. RELATIONS -Antidotedby: Puls. - rheumatic and myalgic symptoms, Guai., also, probably. the antidotes to Nat-m. Compare: (1) Aur-m. Nat-m., Calc., Sep., (2) Helio. - has uterine displacement with active bearing- down sensation and loss of voice, membranous dysmenorrhea. (3) Nat-c., Nat-m., Kali-chl., Chlor. (4) In uterine bearing down. Helio., Sep. (5) Womb feels as if it opened and shut Sep. has clutching and relaxing. (6) Feels as if uterus were pushed up when ever she sits down. Ferr-i. (7) Uterine engorgement and induration, Aur-m-n. (8) Bloated feeling after meals, worse by warm drinks, Lyc. (9) Easily overpowered with heat, Sep., Nat-m., Nat-c. Complementary: Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Drowsy after meals. Burning in epigastrium, with acrid vomiting, hematemesis.

Abdomen - Swelling low in abdomen going up to chest and causing dyspnea, worse after eating with much flatus. Bloated, tight feeling across upper abdomen.

Rectum - Anal and rectal burning, burning diarrhea. Proctitis. Hemorrhoids, anal fissure.

Female - Violent metrorrhagia. Leucorrhea and backache. Womb is feels heavy, sodden with tendency to prolapse. Feeling as if the uterus were pushed up on sitting down (Ferr-i.). Feels as if it opened and shut. Passive, bearing-down pains from heavy condition of uterus. Subinvolution. Itching of the vulva, perineum, and anus.

Back - Much pain across small of back, worse morning on rising. Constitutions - Phlegmatic, flabby, debilitated constitutions. Coughs - Cough with aphonia.

Limbs - Extreme weakness in ankles and knees. Hands swollen every morning. Lungs - Pulmonary edema, capillary bronchitis. Dyspnea, aggravated by the coughing. Dry, irritating, painful cough in fits and then frothy, pink sputum. Cough with aphonia.

Sleep - Drowsiness after meals. Drowsy by day, wakeful by night. Cannot sit down without falling asleep. Disinclined to rise in morning. Child looks ghastly, as if dead, when asleep, his sleep is quiet.

Skin - Generalized or localized itching, better by scratching. Recurring erythema with appearance of vesicles filled with a whitish, oozing liquid. Weeping eczema. Dry eczema in nursing children.

Modalities - Better after stool, from cold applications. Worse from eating or drinking, drinking least drop of cold water, warm drinks. Worse by washing, damp, warmth, lying on either side. Worse before each menstrual period, before stool.

Kidneys - Much pain across small of back. Diffuse nephritis. Dark urine with albumen and casts.

full:
PHARMACY - nat-i. Natrum iodatum. Sodium iodide. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Arteriosclerosis. Catarrh. Dyspnea. Endocarditis. Heart, disorders. Rheumatism. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-i. has various symptoms, such as angina pectoris and vertigo. Dyspnea become less marked after continued use. Chronic catarrhal affections, arteriosclerosis and rheumatism. Incipient rheumatic endocarditis. Chronic bronchitis and tertiary syphilis. Nat-i. will be found to give most excellent results where there is organic disease of the heart, associated with the angina pectoris. There is an oppression in the region of the heart that is attended with a fear of death and a feeling as if something dreadful was about to happen. Angina pectoris and dyspnea. REFERENCES - Blackwood. Boericke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Allen collected a few observation on the effects of large doses. Skinner removed with it in potencies gouty or rheumatic concretions, “chalk stones” in fingers. Gout, rheumatism. Rheumatic pains. Abnormal sense of fatigue, yawning and sleepiness. Food - Unusual hunger and thirst.

Stomach - Vomiting from very large doses. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) I he lacs, Lac-ac. (2) In “chalk stones,” Lyc., Calc. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Limbs - Great weakness of lower limbs after great physical exertion.

Sleep - Yawning and sleepiness. Sleep more prolonged and sounder.

name: Natrum Muriaticum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from open air, deep breathing. Better cool bathing, sweating. Better talking long. Better from tight clothing, rubbing, rest. Better lying on right side, sitting up. Better before breakfast, going without regular meals. Worse from sunlight, heat of sun. Worse summer, seashore. Worse dampness. Worse talking, reading, writing. Worse exertion of the eyes, mental exertion. Worse from strong emotions, consolation, sympathy. Worse puberty, sex. Worse alternated days after menses. Worse the moon. Worse from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m. Worse noise, music. Worse touch, pressure. Worse chronic sprains. Worse quinine, bread, fat, sour foods..
constitution: Acne. Addison’s disease. Allergies. Alopecia. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Anorexia nervosa. Aphthae. Asthenopia. Asthma. Atrophy. Autism. Backache. Bee, stings. Blepharitis. Brain-fag. Canker, sores. Cataract. Catarrh. Chlorosis. Chorea. Cold, sores. Colds. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coryza. Coughs. Cracks, skin. Deafness. Debility. Depression. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Disparunia. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea.
