full:
PHARMACY nat-m. Natrum muriaticum. Sodiumchloride. Common Rock Salt. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Addison’s disease. Allergies. Alopecia. Amenorrhea. Anemia. Anorexia nervosa. Aphthae. Asthenopia. Asthma. Atrophy. Autism. Backache. Bee, stings. Blepharitis. Brain-fag. Canker, sores. Cataract. Catarrh. Chlorosis. Chorea. Cold, sores. Colds. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Coryza. Coughs. Cracks, skin. Deafness. Debility. Depression. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Disparunia. Dropsy. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Edema. Emaciation. Epilepsy. Erysipelas. Eye, disorders. Eyestrain. Fever, blisters. Gleet. Glossopharyngeal, paralysis. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Gout. Grief. Hair, loss. Hay fever. Headaches. Heart, disorders. Hemiopia. Hemorrhages. Hernia. Herpes. Hiccough. Hodgkin’s disease. Housemaid’s knee. Hydremia. Hydroa. Hydrocele. Hypertension. Hyperthyroidism. Impetigo. Impotency. Infertility. Intermittent fevers. Jaundice. Lachrymation. Leucocythemia. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Lice. Lips, sores. Lungs, edema. Malaria. Menstruation, disorders. Migraines. Mouth, sores. Multiple sclerosis. Mumps. Nettlerash. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Orchitis. Otitis. Otorrhea. Palpitations. Paralysis. Phimosis. Photophobia. Psoriasis. Ptosis. Ranula. Ringworm. Self-abuse. Sinusitis. Skin, unhealthy. Sleepwalking. Sneezing. Sore throat. Speech, embarrassed. Spermatorrhea. Spinal, irritation. Spleen, enlarged. Sterility. Stomatitis. Strabismus. Styes. Sunstroke. Taste, disordered. Tongue, blistered. Toothache. Tri-facial-nerve, paralysis. Ulcers. Uterine, cramps. Varicose veins. Vaginismus. Vertigo. Vesicles. Warts. Whooping cough. Worms. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-m. is one of the remedies Schussler adopted from homeopathy. His indications are, for the most part, identical with Hahnemann’s. In old-school practice, Nat-m. was used chiefly in solution as a douche or spray in nasal and other catarrhs, and in the mixture of “Brandy and Salt,” in which large quantities of salt are given for pulmonary hemorrhages. Affects the emotions, heart, kidney, and spleen. Suited to thin patients who are thirsty, poorly nourished on account of digestive disturbances. Craves salt. The skin, may be corrosive (salt-rheum). Clear vesicles on skin or conjunctiva. Lachrymation. Salty taste in the mouth. Salivation, toothache with salivation. Constipation. Lack of mucus. Catarrh of stomach with vomiting of mucus. Water brash. Watery, mucus diarrhea. Tendency to catch colds, coryzas or hay fever. Dry mucus membranes. Mucus membranes and skin may be dry or may produce thick, white or clear, watery, acrid discharges. Dryness of mouth, throat, rectum, vagina etc. Disturbances of the digestive tract and skin. Emaciation, most notable in the neck. Emaciation from malaria. Anemia. Hyperthyroidism. Goiter. Addison’s disease. Diabetes. Gouty or rheumatic gout. Chlorosis. Bloating. Hydremia. Leucocytosis. Intermittent fever Contraction of muscles and tendons. Twitching in muscles. Frequent starts in upper part of body. Chorea, jumping after fright. Neuralgic pains with tears. Numbness of one side, parts lain on with paralysis. Fingers, parts seem too short. Constrictive sensation throughout the body. Trembling of the whole body from smoking tobacco. Greatweaknessand weariness.'Weakness felt in the morning in bed. Easy exhaustion. Tired, sleepy. Inclination to weep. Oversensitive to all sorts of influences. Coldness. Cold limbs, cold sensation along the spine. Likes to be covered but does not relieve. Children talk late, are cross, irritable, cry from slightest cause. MIND - Reserved and introverted. Depression, with spells of irritableness and crossness. Severe depression and feelings of isolation. Depression after death of loved ones, divorce, broken relationships, broken hearts. Acute and chronic grief. Suicidal after grief. Emotionally shut down and closed off since grief. Dwells on past unpleasant memories. Holds grudges for years. Offended easily. Revengeful. Cannot cry in front of others. Company distresses. Consolation aggravates. Thinks he is pitied for his misfortunes and weeps. Laughter with tears. Ailments from grief, disappointed love, fright, anger. Mental behavior and physical symptoms are hopeless or awkward in nature. Chronic affects of grief, disappointed love, fright, anger. Depressed and introverted. Dwells on past unpleasant memories. Cannot cry or express grief. Averse to consolation. Depression or paralysis from hurt emotions. Young girls fall in love with married men. Very sensitive, romantic, sentimental, intellectual. Sympathetic. Fear of hurting others emotionally. Need for unconditional love. Inability to receive and give affection. Sulking, sighing (Ign.). Despair about future. Afraid of close relationships, feels too vulnerable and shy. Poor confidence in relationships. Difficulty trusting, believing in people. Difficulty communicating emotions. Tendency to fall in love with unattainable people, particularly marriedpeople .Lovesick with one of her own sex. Appears to bid for sympathy, yet angry when consoled. Cannot cry or urinate in public. Aversion to presence of strangers during urination. Aversion to men in women. Aversion to sex. Low sex drive. Lack of enjoyment during sex. Sadness before menses. Sadness in pregnancy. Inclination to weep and be excited. Cries from music. Weeps bitterly, involuntary, whenever alone. Tears with laughter. Hysterical laughter, laughs at serious things. Child irritable and cross when spoken to, crying from slightest cause. Excitement followed by melancholy. Hypochondriasis and hysteria with constipation. Hurriedness with anxiety and fluttering at heart. Anxiety and fear. Fear of intimacy, rejection, betrayal, of losing control, of relationships. Fear of being ridiculed, embarrassed, being late. Claustrophobia. Fear of robbers, the dark, heights. Fear of insects, especially bumblebees, spiders. Fear of insanity. Alternating mental conditions. Irritable, gets into a passion about trifles. Abrupt. Absent minded. Extremely forgetful. Scattered thoughts. Mistakes in speaking, what he doesn’t intend to. Awkward speech. Awkward, hasty, drops things from nervous weakness. Shy and timid. Mental retardation. Children late learning to talk and walk. Autism.

Head - Migraine headaches, bursting, maddening, heavy. Blinding headache. Aches as if a thousand little hammers were knocking on the brain, throbs. Headaches over eyes, on vertex, with partial numbness or disturbed vision. Headaches from eyestrain. Headaches from sunrise to sunset. Headaches during, before or after menses. Burning on vertex during menses. Headaches on coughing. Headaches from sunlight. Sunstroke. Headaches with photophobia. Pains, aggravated by motion, even of eyes, worse frowning, reading. Anemic headaches of schoolgirls, nervous, discouraged, broken down. Headaches are better sleep, pressure on eyes, lying with head high, and sitting still. Headaches worse on waking. Headaches with constipation. Headaches from grief. Nodding motions of the head. Rush of blood to head. Throbbing and heat in head, with red face, nausea and vomiting. Hemicrania with sour vomiting and eructations. Falling out of hair. Chronic effects after injury to head. White scurf on scalp, dandruff, alternating with catarrh and loss of smell.

Eyes - Sensation as if eyes were filled with salt. Burning pain in eyes. Eyes itch and burn, must wipe them and pull at lashes. Photophobia, worse bright light, sunlight. Lachrymation with redness, burning, acrid from affected side from sneezing, coughing, laughing etc. Eyes appear wet with tears. Tears stream down face on coughing (Euphr.). Stricture of lachrymal duct with suppuration. Cataract incipient. Ptosis on lying down. Blepharitis with marked photophobia and spasmodic closure of lids. Divergent strabismus, coming on from fatigue, more marked in hot weather and worse in winter. Asthenopia due to the insufficiency of internal recti muscles. Muscles weak and stiff. Eyestrain. Eyes give out in reading and writing. Cannot read by artificial light. Pain in eyes when looking down. Feel bruised with headache in school children. Eyes feel drawn together. Protruding eyes, due to goiter. Styes. Lids swollen. Eyelids heavy.

Ears - Chronic catarrhal otitis with acrid discharges. Purulent discharge from ears. Catarrh of tympanitic cavity and eustachian tube, non-suppurating. Throbbing and beating in ears, ears red from congestion, otorrhea. Swelling and heat of outer ear. Itching behind ears. Painful cracking in the ear when che wing. Noises, buzzing, humming, ringing, and roaring. Roaring and buzzing in ears and head, with inability to work, read or think. Difficult hearing. Deafness from swelling of tympanitic cavity. Deafness with watery conditions of tongue.

Nose - Allergies and colds. Colds begin with sneezing. Hay fever, watery discharge from eyes and nose. Alternate fluent and dry coryza. Fluent coryza, lasting from one to three days, then changing into stoppage of nose, making breathing difficult. Discharge thin and watery like raw egg white. Violent sneezing. Sneezing early in the morning. Sinusitis. Frontal sinus inflammation. Internal soreness of nose. Dryness. Exfoliation of skin on dorsum of nose. Little ulcers in nose. Fever blisters on wings of nose and on lips. One side numb. Burning pain in nasal bones. Nosebleeds, on stooping or when coughing, at night. Loss of smell and taste.

Face - Dry skin. Oily, shiny skin, as if greased. Earthy complexion. Acne. Pimples on face. Eruptions and ulcers on chin. Fever blisters and cold sores. Herpes about the lips. Lips and corners of mouth dry, ulcerated, and cracked. Lips tingle, feel numb. Crack in the middle of the lower lip. Swollen upper lip. Throb- bing in lower jaw, worse biting, heat and cold. Down on the face in hysteria, passes away as the patient improves. Falling out of whiskers and beard. Prosopalgia. Neuralgia. Cheekbones as if bruised, when chewing. Mumps with profuse flow of saliva. Submaxillary glands swollen.

Mouth - Breath, hot offensive. Bitter taste. Loss of taste and smell. Salivation with thrush, obstinate. Saliva, profuse, watery, salty, bloody. Constant spitting. Salivation in morning. Sense of dryness of mouth. Vesicles and ulcers in mouth and on tongue, smart and burn when touched by food. Blood-blisters on inside of upper lip. Scorbutic gums. Dental fistula. Epulis or small tumor on the gums. Numbness, tingling of lips and mouth. Aphthae in mouth, on gums and cheeks, with great burning and impeded speech. Canker sores, herpes, fever blisters. Eruptions around mouth and vesicles like pearls on lips. Dry and chapped lips. Lips and corners of mouth dry, ulcerated and cracked. Deep crack in middle of lower lip.

Throat - Dry, sore spot in the throat, tickles and causes cough etc. Soreness and feeling of dryness in larynx and trachea. Sore throat with sensation as if she has to swallow over a lump. As if a plug in throat. Sensation of a splinter sticking in throat. Tobacco smoker’s sore throat. Uvula hangs to one side. Sore throat, with transparent mucus covering tonsils. Throat glistens. Hawks much mucus, bitter, salty. Only fluids can be swallowed. Solids reach a certain point and then are violently ejected. Food goes down the wrong way in post diphtheria paralysis. Swelling of cervical glands. Hypertrophy of tonsils. Exophthalmic goiter. Goiter with chronic sore throat. Hoarseness in morning. Weakness of organs of speech. Voice weak, faint, exhausting from talking. Bad effects of long speaking.

Stomach - Anxiety in stomach rises into head. Feels better on an empty stomach. Great weakness in stomach, comes in spells. Faint, weak, gone sensation in stomach during pregnancy. Heartburn during pregnancy. Heartburn with palpitations. Violent hiccough. Burning pain and belchings after eating. Sweetish eructations in morning, before or during menses. Throbbing in pit. Sticking sensation in cardiac orifice. Pressure as from a stone in stomach, with nausea. Vomiting of white, slimy mucus. Vomiting first of food, then bile. Continuous nausea with thirst and profuse water brash. Morning sickness with vomiting of frothy, watery phlegm. Stools - Hard, difficult and painful stool, followed by liquid stool. Involuntary stools. Irregular stools, sometimes two or three a day, then constipation. Stools, dry, hard, crumbling (Am-m., Mag-m.), or coated with glassy mucus. Stools, black, watery, corrosive. Green, bloody, watery or brownish stools, mostly during day. Stools transparent, glassy, slimy. Stools like white of an egg. Stools without feces.

Abdomen - Anxiety in abdomen. Cutting pain in abdomen. Much pain and soreness in left hypochondrium. Pressure in upper abdomen. Pain in abdominal ring on coughing. Epigastric pulsation. Epigastrium swollen and painful. Tightness of skin across abdomen from hip to hip, must loosen clothes. Tension groins. Rigidity of the left side. Sudden distention. Abdomen swollen, rumbling and incarceration of flatus. Great fermentation, loud gurgling. Colic with nausea, better flatus. Bilious colic. Burning in intestines. Abdominal viscera loose and dragging as if when walking. Jaundice with drowsiness. Yellowish discharge from navel.

Rectum - Ineffectual urging. Constipation from inactivity, grief. Constipation on alternate days, alternating with diarrhea. Chronic, painless, watery diarrhea, in the morning. Diarrhea preceded by pinching pain in abdomen. Diarrhea on moving about. Diarrhea after menses. Diarrhea from abuse of opium. Constriction of rectum. Stools tear the anus or cause burning. Burning, tearing, itching about anus after stool. Stinging pain in hemorrhoids and soreness at anus after stool. Anus contracted torn, bleeding. Ripping up sensation in anus after stool. Anal fissures with bleeding and smarting. Soreness at and around anus when walking. Herpes about anus. Disposition to get worms. Seat worms. Sensations - As if head too heavy and would fall forward. As if some displacement in head had taken place, as if cold wind blowing though head. As though forehead would burst on coughing, as if head in a vice, pain like a rope around head drawing tighter and tighter, as if nail driven in left side of head. As if foreign body in eyes, as if eye being torn open. As if eyeballs too large. As if a small worm squirming in nose. As if hair on tongue.

Male - Genital organs smell strongly and badly. Violent itching on and under scrotum. Itching and crawling sensation at corona glandis. Scrotum relaxed, flabby. Edema of scrotum. Hydrocele. Phimosis. Loss of hair from pubes. Genital herpes, eruptions worse from stress, emotional upsets. Gonorrhea, when chronic, discharge usually clear, sometimes yellowish, cutting in urethra after urinating. Suppressed gonorrhea. Aching in testes, orchitis, after suppression of gonorrhea or mumps. Discharge of thin fluid from urethra, causes itching and burning. Loss of prostatic fluid during stool. Emission of prostatic fluid without erection when thinking of sexual things. Erections in morning, without sexual excitement. Emission, even after sex. Impotency, with retarded emission. Sexual desire with physical weakness. Backache, weak legs and depression after sex. Weakness, even paralysis after sexual excess. Aversion to sex, since grief.

Female - Delayed first menses. Amenorrhea. Suppressed menses from grief, from putting feet in cold water. Menses irregular, usually profuse. Hot during menses. Menses painful from getting feet wet. Dysmenorrhea with convulsions. Menses preceded and followed by headache. Sore burning in vagina before menses. White leucorrhea turns green gradually. Leucorrhea acrid, watery. Debilitating, white, thick leucorrhea, instead of menses. Genital herpes, eruptions worse from stress, emotional upsets. Uterine cramps with burning and cutting in groins. Ineffectual labor-pains. Prolapse of uterus with aching in lumbar region. Bearing down pains, worse in morning (Sep.), with aching in lumbar region. Burning and soreness of vagina after urinating. Dryness and soreness of vagina, with itching. Burning, smarting in vagina during sex. Aversion to sex, which is painful from dryness of vagina. Low sex drive since grief. Sterility, with too early and too profuse menses. Infertility. Labor progresses slowly, pains feeble, seemingly from sad feelings and forebodings. Loss of hair in childbed or during period of lactation. Food-Hungry, yet loses weight (lod.),with depression. Anorexia nervosa. Hunger without relish. Hunger without appetite during pregnancy. Unquenchable thirst. Thirsty, drinks large quantity of water. Craving for salt and salty foods, especially during pregnancy. Eats more salt since a grief. Desires sour things, lemons. Desires bitter things, beer. Desires chocolate, farinaceous food, oysters, fish, milk. Averse to anything slimy like oysters, fats. Averse to meat, coffee, tobacco. Averse to bread, acidic foods. Aversion to rich food, chicken, salt, milk. Worse from bread, fat. Worse salt, acid food. Bad effects from eating salt and salty foods.

Chest - Sore pain or bruised feeling in chest. Oppression of chest. Sensation as if constricted or if lungs were too tight, with burning hands, while at work. Sensation and pain in chest as from tension. Sharp pains all over chest, on deep inspiration and when coughing. Tearing, sharp pain, from left upper region of chest to shoulder joint, after suppressed facial neuralgia. Single stitches along sternum. Pain like a cutting cramp through left chest to scapula. Severe pain in right side. Constitutions - Suited to sensitive, anemic, chlorotic people with catarrhal troubles. Cachectic persons, old people, teething children. Tuberculous, scrofulous, dropsical, emaciated persons.

Heart - Tachycardia. Fluttering of the heart with a weak, faint feeling, worse lying down. Chronic forms of valvular disease, with weak, faint feeling, must lie down. Hypertrophy of heart. Palpitations, shaking the body or alternating with beating in head. Palpitations, anxious, worse exertion, emotions, lying on left side. Palpitations before menses. Palpitations on falling asleep and on awaking. Palpitations with sensation of weakness, exhaustion and heaviness. Heart feels weak and vulnerable, worse after grief. Sensation of coldness or emptiness about heart. Heart and chest feel constricted. Painful stitches in region of heart, after reading aloud. High blood pressurefrom excess salt eating. Fluttering, palpitating, intermittent every third beat, worse lying down. Pulse, full and slow, weak and rapid.

Back - Backache with desire for firm support (Rhus-t., Sep.). Backache is better lying on back, on something hard or from pressure. Can stoop readily, but hurts to straighten. Bruised pain, early in morning, worse coughing and after sex. Spine oversensitive to touch or pressure. Sensitiveness between vertebrae. Spinal irritation from grief, anger, sexual excesses, etc. Paralytic feeling in lumbar region. Violent pulsations in lumbar region. Sacral region as if beaten. Painful stiffness of neck. Cervical glands enlarged, sore when coughing. Impetigo or itching tetter on margin of hair at nape. Breasts - Breasts emaciate. Stitches beneath nipples. Lossofhairduring breast-feeding. Child refuses breast, from sore mouth. Causations - Ill effects of grief, guilt, betrayal, disappointment. Fright, fit of passion. Loss of fluids, masturbation. Injury to head. Silver salts, eating salt. Sunlight.

Limbs - Multiple sclerosis. Paralysis after grief, intermittent fevers. Convulsive jerking of the limbs on falling asleep. Every motion accelerates the circulation. Cracking in joints on motion. Urticaria about joints. Coldness of legs with congestion to head, chest and stomach. Hamstrings seem short, painful, drawing in (Caust.). Arms and legs, but especially knees, feel weak. Housemaid’s knee. Ankles weak and turn easily. Soreness of toes or between toes. Numbness and tingling in fingers and lower limbs. Buttocks emaciated in infants. Children do not learn to walk or late learning to walk. Icy coldness of hands and feet. Palms hot and perspir- ing. Hangnails. Dryness and cracking about fingernails. Hands tremble when writing. Lungs - Acute edema of lungs. Attacks of suffocation. Difficult breathing after menses. Sighing from emotional states. Shortness of breath, especially on going upstairs (Calc.). Breathing better from exertion of arms, and better in open air. Lungs feel raw and sore from continual coughing. Spasmodic cough, face blue. Pneumonia, with much rattling, mucus clear, serous and frothy, coughed up with difficulty. Pleuritis when serous exudation has taken place. Respiratory catarrh after suppressed sweats. Yellow or blood- streaked mucus, in morning. White, salty mucus. Bloody expectoration, with cough. Profuse, frothy or watery expectoration, with asthma. Expectoration in clots, most in morning.

Sleep - Sleepy in forenoon. Sleepiness during day, with frequent yawning. Sleepy, but can't sleep at night, and in morning feels unrefreshed. Sleeplessness after gnawing grief, from depressing events, dwelling on past events. An idea clings to mind, preventing sleep. Prostration from loss of sleep. Twitching and electric shocks through whole body on falling asleep. Nervous jerking during sleep. Starts and talks in sleep. Sobs during sleep. Sleepwalking, rises and sits about room. Dreams during siesta. Vivid dreams like a living reality. Dreams about grief, past events. Dreams about work, which she is busy with a long time after waking. Dreams of burning thirst. Dreams of robbers, waking from fright, thought there were robbers in house. Very anxious dreams with weeping in sleep. Awakes feeling weak and unrefreshed.

Skin - Dry and chapped skin. Greasy, oily skin, especially on hairy parts. Herpetic eruptions, worse flexures. Fever blisters, coldsores. Vesicles, with watery contents, burst and leave a thin scurf. Pemphigus, blisters starting up on burning spots, with clear, watery contents. Small boils, blood boils. Eruption like ringworm, with itching, worse warmth. Hives, itching and burning after exertion. Nettle-rash over whole body, large red blotches, with violent itching. Itching, better from sweating. Eczema, dry, raw, red, and inflamed, worse eating salt, at seashore. Herpes zoster. Crusty, dry eruptions in bends of limbs, margin of scalp. Dry eruptions behind ears (Caust., Graph.). Urticaria. Corns. Comedones. Fungus hematodes. Insect bites, stings of bees, mosquitoes. Painful scars, redness of old scars. Sunburns easily. Affects hair follicles. Alopecia. Warts on palms of hands.

Modalities - Better from open air, deep breathing. Better cool bathing, sweating. Better talking long. Better from tight clothing, rubbing, rest. Better lying on right side, sitting up. Better before breakfast, going without regular meals. Worse from sunlight, heat of sun. Worse summer, seashore. Worse dampness. Worse talking, reading, writing. Worse exertion of the eyes, mental exertion. Worse from strong emotions, consolation, sympathy. Worse puberty, sex. Worse alternated days after menses. Worse the moon. Worse from 9 a.m. to 11 a.m. Worse noise, music. Worse touch, pressure. Worse chronic sprains. Worse quinine, bread, fat, sour foods.

Teeth - Dentition with dribbling of saliva. Teeth sensitive to air or touch, pain worse on chewing. Toothache with lachrymation or salivation. Drawing, tearing pains, extending to ears and throat. Toothache after eating and at night. Toothache worse drawing in air, touch, pressure, after chewing. Toothache before menses, beginning of menses. Scorbutic gums. Spongy and bleeding easily. Epulis or small tumor on gums. Dental fistula. Cheek swollen.

Tongue - Sense of dryness on tongue. Tongue mapped (Ars., Rhus-t., Tarax.). Numbness, tingling of tongue. Tongue broad, pale, puffy, with pasty coat. Frothy coating on tongue with bubbles on side. Tongue, beaded or striped along edges. Burning at tip of tongue. Aphthae on tongue. Herpes on tongue from seabathing. Tongue, heavy, difficult speech. Sensation of a hair on the tongue. Vertigo - Vertigo, as if falling, worse standing near a window. Vertigo on closing eyes, better lying with head high. Vertigo during pregnancy. Veñigo from straining eyes or close study. Vertigo with jerking in head, with tendency to fall forward or to left. Vertigo in morning on rising. Vertigo after stool. Vision - Eyes give out on reading or writing. Frequent obscuration of vision, when stooping, walking, reading, writing. Amaurosis, from debilitating weakness. Weakness of vision after debilitating illness. Diplopia or vertical hemiopia. Hemiopia, followed by headache. Retinal images are retained too long. Vision blurred, wavering. Letters run together. Sees sparks, fiery, zigzag appearance around all objects. Sparks, black spots. Dim vision, as if looking through gauze or feathers. Objects seem covered with a thin veil. Dark veil passes before eyes. COMMENTS - Can antidote the effects of the crude salt, allows patients to cut down intake. Antidotes the effects of Arg-n. Scrofulous ophthalmia which has been treated locally in vain with Arg-n., sore throats that have been cauterized, the effects local and remote of uterine injections of Arg-n. or cauterizing of the os uterus. Symptoms are worse at the seaside or cannot stay by the sea. Constipation at seaside. Can also be better at seaside. Great desire for open air and washing in cold water. Sensitivity to the sun. Fluttering palpitations with faint feeling, worse lying down. Characteristic sense of coldness at the heart of précordia, with trembling of the heart. In one case of hypertrophy with degeneration of most of the valves, the patient told Clarke that nothing gave her so much relief as Nat-m. Periodic, intermittent fevers. Chilliness predominates. Chill from 10 to 11 a.m. with thirst, drinks after a meal, fever blisters around mouth. Fever with violent headache, great thirst, nausea, vomiting, blueness, faint, averse to uncover. Fever may come on without chill 10 to 11 a.m. Fevers and chills from malaria (Ars.). Antidotes quinine. Headaches from over study. Headache with partial blindness. Throbbing, beating as with little hammers, pain as if the head would burst. The throbbing headache has its analog in palpitation of the heart. Headache much worse by coughing. Migraines, worse during the day and better at night. Worse from the sun or light. Lambert recorded several cases of headache associated with errors of refraction and consequent eyestrain cured with Nat-m. 30c. The headache was noticed on walking. In one case it was like a cloud over the brain with intense depression and lasted ten years. It disappeared before the vision was corrected. Indicated in some cases of multiple sclerosis and lupus. Psoriasis. Hydroa. Eczema on hair margins, especially at back of head. Warts on palms of hands. Corns. Painful scars. Greasy skin, an excess of sebaceous secretion. Disorders due to loss of fluids. Copious lachrymation. Burnett noted the characteristic “flow of tears with cough” in whooping cough. Schussler noted the specific relation to catarrh. Excessively fluent coryza with much sneezing, sore nose, especially the left wing. Tendency to loss of smell and taste. Allergies. Dry skin and lips. The lower lip has a crack down the middle. Cold sores on lips and nose. Herpes infection. Cold sores, canker sores, fever blisters and genital herpes that are worse from emotional stress or fatigue. Mapped tongue with red islands, or a clean, shining tongue with froth along each side. Sensation as if there is a hair on the tongue. Numbness and stiffness of one side, heavy, embarrassing speech. The tongue is blistered, sticks to roof of mouth. Dryness of mouth and throat. Sinking sensation. Hypoglycemia. Great hunger with no appetite. Eats heartily, ravenous appetite, but emaciates, especially about the neck. Feels better when stomach is empty. Strong aversion to fats and slimy foods. Craves chocolate, sweets, fish. Craves salt. One patient, who said she could “eat the brine out of a mackerel kit,” was cured with a single dose of Nat-m. Unquenchable thirst. After eating there are empty belchings, nausea, acidity, sleepiness, heartburn, palpitation, epigastric pressure and heat radiating up to chest. Indigestion. Violent hiccough. Nausea. Vomiting. Constipation and diarrhea. Constipation often associated with anemia, chilliness, cold feet and chills down the back. Women can have an aversion to sex, an aversion to men. Delayed first menses. Menses may be early and profuse or scanty and delayed. Bearing down pain (Sep.). Leucorrhea, with backache that is better pressure of from lying down on something hard. Characteristic dryness of the vagina with painful sex. Morning sickness during pregnancy. Infertility or amenorrhea from grief. Useful for children who are late in talking. Autism. Learning or speech disabilities. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Smelling Nit- s-d., Phos. - especially abuse of salt in food. Ars. - bad effects of sea-bathing. Nux-v. will relieve headache after Nat-m. Antidote to: Arg-n. - abuse of, as cautery. Quinine - in diseases continue intermittent and patients suffer from headache, constipation, disturbed sleep. Apis - bee stings. Compare: (1) Bry., Apis, Ign.. Sep..Thuj., Graph., Alum. (2) Bor., Nat-c., Nat-h., Kali-chl. (3) In mapped tongue, Ars., Rhus-t., Kali-bi.,Tarax„ Ran-s. (acidity). (4) Hypochondriasis with indigestion, Nat-s. (5) Lachrymose. Puls. - better consolation. (6) schoolgirls’ headache. Calc., Calc-p. (7) Headache coming and going with sun, Spig., Gels.. Glon.. Sang. (8) Headache with partial blindness, Kali-bi., Iris-v. (9) Half sight, Aur., Lith., Lyc., Titan. (9) Headache with cough. Caps.. Bry., (Sulph. occiput, Nat-m. forehead). ( 10) Ravenous yet wastes, lod. (11) Ringworm, Sep., Bar-c. Tell. (12) Paralyzed by emotion, Gels., Staph. (13) Intermittents, chill beginning in small of back, Eup-per.. Rhus-t. - chill begins in one leg, or thigh, or between shoulders. Gels. - runs up spine. (14) Sadness during menses, Lyc., Nit-ac., Sep. (15) Laughs at serious things, Anae., Phos., Lyc., Plat. (16) Aq-mar. Complementary: Apis, Sep., Caps. Nat-m. is the chronic of Ign., Bry., Apis and Caps. Compatible: Before - Sep., Thuj., after - Ign., Kali-m., Kah- p., Con., Nat-s., Calc-p., Ferr-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Kidneys - Difficulty urinating in the presence of others. Has to wait a long time for it to pass if others are present (Hep., Mur-ac.). Must wait before the urine will start. Polyuria, thirst for large quantities of water. Frequent or sudden desire to urinate, can’t retain urine, copious flow. Urination every hour at night. Tension and heat in renal region. Clear urine with red sediment. Hematuria. Urine dark, like coffee. Milky urine after menses. Involuntary urination on coughing, laughing, sneezing, walking, sitting. Pain just after urinating (Sars.).

Cough - Spasmodic, suffocative cough at night in bed. Whooping cough with flows of tears with cough. Dry cough with rattling in chest. Cough with hawking of mucus. Cough from tickling in the pit of stomach, with asthma, or with stitches in liver and spurting of urine (Caust., Squil.). Cough with palpitations. Cough with bursting pain in head. Sticking in liver while coughing. Cough in the morning, evening after lying down in bed. Cough worse in winter. Chronic cough of tuberculous subjects.

Perspiration - Sweats on every exertion. Sweats while eating, on face. Sweats at edge of hair. Sweats on nose, face while eating. Sweats in axilla and on soles of feet. Sweats with aversion to uncover. Scanty sweats. Much better during sweat. Sweats relieving headache and other pains, though it weakens. Sour sweat, weakening. Profuse, and offensive sweats, at night.

Temperature - Coldness of the body. Morning chill with thirst, between 9 a.m. and 11 a.m. Chilly, but worse in sun. Chills beginning in feet or lumbar region. Chills predominates, mostly internal, hands and feet cold. Chills with yawning, chattering of teeth. Chill alternating with fever, at various times of day, without sweat. Heat, violent thirst increases with fever. Intermittent fever. Malaria. Hydremia in chronic malarial states with weakness, constipation, loss of appetite. Fever blisters. Sunstroke.

name: Natrum Nitricum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse by deep inspiration. Worse exertion, ascending stairs. Worse sitting bent over..
constitution: Anemia. Asthma. Belching. Constipation. Croup. Distention. Exhaustion. Exophthalmic goiter. Flatulence. Headaches. Hematuria. Hemoglobinuria. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Hydremia. Influenza. Lar- yngitis. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia. Purpura hemorrhagica. Otalgia. Otitis. Rheumatism. Tracheitis. Variola. Weakness.
keynote:
PHARMACY - nat-n. Natrum nitricum. Sodium nitrate. Cubic nitre. Chili saltpetre. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Asthma. Belching. Constipation. Croup. Distention. Exhaustion. Exophthalmic goiter. Flatulence. Headaches. Hematuria.…
full:
PHARMACY - nat-n. Natrum nitricum. Sodium nitrate. Cubic nitre. Chili saltpetre. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Anemia. Asthma. Belching. Constipation. Croup. Distention. Exhaustion. Exophthalmic goiter. Flatulence. Headaches. Hematuria. Hemoglobinuria. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhages. Hydremia. Influenza. Lar- yngitis. Nosebleeds. Pneumonia. Purpura hemorrhagica. Otalgia. Otitis. Rheumatism. Tracheitis. Variola. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to Hansen, Nat-n. was called Rademacher’s Aconite; he used it in inflammations of all kinds, especially laryngitis, tracheitis, croup, and acute pneumonia. Acute rheumatism and heart affections. Exophthalmic goiter. Purpura, hemorrhages inflammations of the eye. Inflammations and hemorrhages. Hemorrhages from the mucus membranes, particularly the nasal tissues. Influenza. Pressing-inward pains in temple and forehead, in malar bones. Anemia and hydremia. Exhaustion, must rest frequently when walking. Drowsiness. Pains of tabes. Heat spreading left to right. Heat in left ear, coldness in right. Coldness streaming through upperpart of body. Cold- ness of left foot. Asthma with urine supersaturated with solids. Flatulent troubles with weight in lower abdomen. Painful retraction of abdominal muscles. Painful constipation. MIND - Great ill-humor. Mental indolence. Indisposed to mental and bodily exertion.

Head - Dull pain. Pressing inward pain. Inward pressing in malar bones. Nosebleeds. Headaches.

Ears - Otalgia.

Stomach - Sour risings. Aversions to coffee. Flatulence with pressure in pit of stomach and pain in chest, worse motion, better eructation. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Kali-n. (2) Abdomen mostly contracted, constipation, Plb. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Rademacher.

Abdomen - Abdominal muscles painfully contracted towards the spine. Distended. Constitutions - Uric acid diathesis.

Rectum - Difficult stool, feels as if more remained to pass.

Heart - Pain in region of heart. Pulse slower and softer.

Modalities - Worse by deep inspiration. Worse exertion, ascending stairs. Worse sitting bent over.

name: Natrum Nitrosum
author: Murphy
constitution: Angina pectoris. Collapse. Cyanosis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Gastro-enteritis. Roseola. Strokes.
keynote:
PHARMACY - nat-ns. Natrum nitrosum. Sodium nitrite. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Collapse. Cyanosis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Gastro-enteritis. Roseola. Strokes.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ringer and Murrell gave ten grains of Nat-ns.,…
full:
PHARMACY - nat-ns. Natrum nitrosum. Sodium nitrite. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina pectoris. Collapse. Cyanosis. Diarrhea. Fainting. Gastro-enteritis. Roseola. Strokes.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ringer and Murrell gave ten grains of Nat-ns., dissolved in one ounce of water to fourteen men and four women. It was given in five grain doses to twelve men and four women. In almost all it produced alarming symptoms of the apoplectic attack. The concomitance of fainting with other disorders may prove a keynote. Copious liquid stools at night with faintness. Better lying down, worse motion. COMMENTS - Collischorm related two cases of accidental poisoning with Nat-ns. The first patient was affected with diarrhea and fainting, heavily coated tongue, bitter belchings, and an eruption like syphilitic roseola on the chest. Traces of albumen in urine. During the night, copious alvine discharges with faintness. The following day, there was intense cyanosis. Urine dark yellow, containing copious urates. The next day, he took 2.5 grain, cyanosis diminished and the measly eruption spread all over the body except the face. The second patient had the cyanosis, diarrhea and faintings in an aggravated form so that collapse threatened. Strong coffee and omission of the drug removed the symptoms. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Coffee. Compare: (1) Amyl-n., Glon. (2) worse by motion, Bry. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Natrum Phosphoricum
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cold. Worse from sugar, milk. Worse bitter or fatty foods. Worse acids, citrusfruits. Worse from sex. Worse walking upstairs. Worse mental exertion, gaslight. Worse thunderstorms..
constitution: Acidity. Allergies. Arthritis. Belching. Blisters. Boils. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Cystitis. Diabetes.Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Dysphagia. Enteralgia. Erysipelas. Flatulence. Glands, swelling. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Gout. Heartburn. Hives. Indigestion. Infertility. Intertrigo. Jaundice. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Marasmus. Morning, sickness. Morphine addiction. Oxaluria. Peptic ulcer. Post-nasal catarrh. Rheu
keynote:
PHARMACY - nat-p. Natrum phosphoricum. Sodium phosphate. Hydric disodic phosphate. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Allergies. Arthritis. Belching. Blisters. Boils. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Cystitis. Diabetes.Diarrhea. Dyspepsia.…
full:
PHARMACY - nat-p. Natrum phosphoricum. Sodium phosphate. Hydric disodic phosphate. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acidity. Allergies. Arthritis. Belching. Blisters. Boils. Colic. Conjunctivitis. Cystitis. Diabetes.Diarrhea. Dyspepsia. Dysphagia. Enteralgia. Erysipelas. Flatulence. Glands, swelling. Goiter. Gonorrhea. Gout. Heartburn. Hives. Indigestion. Infertility. Intertrigo. Jaundice. Leucocytosis. Leucorrhea. Marasmus. Morning, sickness. Morphine addiction. Oxaluria. Peptic ulcer. Post-nasal catarrh. Rheumatism. Scrofula. Sighing. Stomach pain. Thread, worms. Tuberculosis. Urticaria. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Vomiting. Worms.

HOMEOPATHIC - Schussler, who introduced it, noted that Nat-p. is contained in the blood-corpuscles, in the cells of the muscles, of the nerves, and of the brain, as well as in the intercellular fluids. Nat-p. breaks down lactic acid into carbonic acid and water. It then binds to the carbonic acid, allowing it to be exhaled and exchanged for oxygen. Affinity for diseases caused by an excess of lactic acid. In oxaluria, Nat-p. 1 x four times daily prevents formation of stones, keeps the oxalate of lime in solution. Ailments with excess of acidity. Affects duodenum, bile ducts, mesenteric glands and genitals. Leucocytosis. Bladder infections, vaginitis and gout. Oxaluria. Diabetes. Jaundice. Swelling of lymphatic glands. Sourness, belchings, vomiting, stomach, stools, leucorrhea, expectoration, sweats. Flatulence with sour risings. Yellow, creamy coating at the back of the roof of mouth and tongue. Inflammation of the throat with sensation of a lump. Debility. Nervousness, tired feeling. Cracking in joints. Pricking sensation. Tightness of muscles and tendons. Trembling and palpitation from thunderstorms. Ill effects of mental exertion or sexual vices, or both. Marasmus of bottle-fed babies. Infants who have been fed to excess with milk and sugar. Worms. Colic with symptoms of worms. MIND - Mental weakness. Confusion from mental exertion. Nervous, forgetful, after sexual excesses. Easily frightened. Fear that something would happen, especially at night. Startingfrom noise. Imagines that he hears footsteps in the next room. Imagines that pieces of furniture are people. Sensitive and offended easily. Irritability before breakfast. Vexed at trifles. Sighing (Ign.). Grief with a craving for cold drinks. Sadness from music, from masturbation. Indifferent to everything. Indifference to loved ones. Sits still for a long time.

Head - Feels dull in the morning, full feeling and throbbing. Cutting pain in temples (right) while studying. Pressure and heat on top of head as if it would open.

Eyes - One pupil dilated. Whites of eyes are dirty yellow. Discharge of golden-yellow, creamy matter from the eyes. Eyes weak, worse gaslight. Squinting with worms.

Ears - One ear red, hot, itching, scratches until it bleeds, with gastric disorders Natrum phosphoricum and acidity. As if water falling in from a height.

Nose - Offensive odor. Naso-pharyngeal catarrh. Thick, yellow offensive mucus. Itching of nose. Prickling with lachrymation. Child picks nose.

Face - Paleness of bluish, florid appearance of face. Pale or red on alternate sides. Face burns. Itching about mouth.

Mouth - Canker sores of lip and cheeks, worse acid foods. Pricking, numbness of whole mouth. Blisters on tip of tongue with stinging in evening. Thin, moist coating on the tongue. Yellow creamy coating at the base of tongue, on tonsils or roof of mouth. Sensation as of a hair on tongue. Teeth grinding in children.

Throat - Hoarseness. Dysphagia. Thick, yellow, creamy membrane over tonsils and soft palate. As of a lump, preventing speech. Swallowing difficult. Goiter with feeling of pressure. Vertigo - Vertigo from stomach problems. Dizzy, as if he would fall, objects turn around on rising or moving. COMMENTS - Nat-p. was proved under Farrington’s direction. Charles Mohr, who was one of the provers, related the effect it had on him and the use he made of it. After being under the influence of the drug for some time, without knowing what it was, he had much itching at the ankle joints with an eczematous eruption. Headache, some nausea, vision problems, one pupil dilated. Fear, especially at night, that something would happen. The symptoms had to be antidoted with Sep. Two years after, Mohr had a patient with visual disturbance and headache. When symptoms were at their worst, the patient had a sense of fear, worse at night, and an eruption about the ankles that began with itching, Nat-p. 6x cured promptly. Acid diathesis. Gout. Spasms with acidity. Sour belchings, vomiting of sour, cheesy masses, yellowish-green. Heartburn and indigestion. Stomachaches with burning and acidic indigestion, particularly in children. Colic. Candida symptoms, diarrhea, sores in the mouth after eating acidic foods. Low blood sugar causes frequent urination or diarrhea. Atony of bladder. Kidney infections or achiness in the kidneys. Hacked diarrheas. Diarrhea since antibiotics (Nit-ac.). Allergies to sugar and milk. Recurring cases of worms in children with nasal irritation and itching of the anus. The back of the tongue is coated creamy yellow. Sensation of a hair on the tongue. Tightness of muscles and tendons. Seminal emissions. Vaginitis, cystitis. Creamy, yellow discharge. Itching of the vulva and labia after sweets and acids. Herpes outbreaks from eating sugar, acids or alcohol. Symptoms are worse walking, especially up stairs, worse from sex. during thunderstorms. The warmth of bed causes itching at anus from worms. Worse pains, causes trembling and palpitations. When big toe pains, heart pains are better. Periodic action. Sighing (Ign.). Grief with a craving for cold drinks. M. J. Luys successfully overcame the morphine habit by subcutaneous injections of Nat-p. with glycerine and water. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Acidity and scrofula, Calc., Rheum. Gout, Benz-ac., Guai., Lyc., Urt-u., Sulph. (2) Gastric catarrh. Calc., Carb-v., Kali-c., Nux-v„ Rob., Carb-ac. (3) Speech impeded, Nat-m. (4) Hair sensation. Nat-m., Kali-bi., Sil. (5) Worse from sex. Kali-c., Caust. (6) Worms, Abrot.Cina, Teucr. (7) Drinking water causes cough, Sil., Caust. bettercough. (8) Emissions causing weak back and knees, Nat-m. (9) Nat- lac. - rheumatism and gout, gouty concretions, rheumatism with diabetes. (10) Nat-ns. - angina pectoris. Cya- nosis, fainting, copious liquid stools at night, throbbing and fullness, faintness, nervous pain in head, nausea, belchihgs, blue lips. (11) Nat-sil-f. - a cancerremedy, tumors, bone affection, decay, lupus, ethmoiditis. Must be used carefully. (12) Nat-sel. - chronic laryngitis and laryngeal tuberculosis, hoarseness of singers, expectorate small lumps of mucus with frequent clearing of throat. (13) Nat-sulo. - diarrhea with yeasty stools. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Emptiness in stomach and abdomen, even in chest, worse after eating. Heaviness and pressure in epigastrium. Peptic ulcer. Heartburn, acidity, water brash. Acid dyspepsia. Sour belchings. Belchings after eating. Spits mouthfuls of food. Vomiting of sour, cheesy masses. Attacks of gastralgia and enteralgia, with Natrum phosphoricum vomiting of fluid sour as vinegar. Morning sickness, with sour vomiting.

Abdomen - Fullness in abdomen, worse standing or eating a little. Gastro-duodenal catarrh. Noisy flatulence. While at stool, sensation as if a marble dropped down descending colon.

Rectum - Urging to stool and urination after sex (men). Afraid to pass flatus lest the stool escape. Greenish diarrhea. Stools hacked. Itching at anus. Round or thread worms.

Male - Emissions without dreams, with weakness in back and trembling in limbs. Desire without erection. Thin, watery semen, smells like stale urine. Itching of scrotum, prepuce. Gonorrhea.

Female - Menses too early, pale, thin, watery. During menses, feet icy cold during day, bum at night in bed. Leucorrhea, sour, creamy, honey-colored, or acid and watery. Sour-smelling discharges from uterus. Infertility with acid secretions from vagina. Morning sickness with sour vomiting. Food - Canine hunger with gone feeling in stomach. Desires strong tasting things, eggs, fried fish, beer, which ameliorate. Aversion to bread and butter. Worse acids, citrus fruits. Worse alcohol, milk, sugar. Worse fat or bitter foods.

Chest - Chest feels empty after eating, or pain through chest after dinner. Pain in chest, worse deep breathing and pressure. Burning deep in chest, worse right side. Sudden feeling of fullness. Weight above ensiform cartilage with empty feeling. Constitutions - Acid diathesis.

Heart - Heart pains alternating with rheumatic pains. Heart pains are better when big toe pains. Anxious palpitations after a thunderstorm. Trembling about heart, worse going upstairs, after menses. Feeling as if a bubble started from heart was forced through arteries.

Back - Heavy dragging in the back. Rheumatic arthritis. Synovial crepitation. Swelling of glands of neck extending to chest. Weakness after sex. Causations - Acids, citrus fruits, alcohol, milk, sugar. Fat or bitter foods. Thunderstorms.

Limbs - Aching in wrists and finger joints. Cramps in hands while writing. Rheumatism, particularly of the knee joint. Legs give way while walking. Feet icy cold during day, bum at night. Synovial crepitation. Trembling of limbs after sex.

Sleep - Cannot get to sleep feels so hot, thoughts crowd in mind. Very drowsy, falls asleep while sitting. Sleepy in the forenoon, but sleepless before midnight. Anxious, amorous dreams, of dead people.

Skin - Yellow. Smooth, red, shining. Erysipelas. Hives. Itching in various parts, especially of ankles. Feet icy cold in daytime, burn at night. Swelling of lymphatic glands.

Modalities - Better from cold. Worse from sugar, milk. Worse bitter or fatty foods. Worse acids, citrusfruits. Worse from sex. Worse walking upstairs. Worse mental exertion, gaslight. Worse thunderstorms.

Liver - Jaundice. Sclerosis of liver and hepatic form of diabetes especially when there is a succession of boils. Lungs - Difficult respiration. Constant cough and hawking, pain in chest in mammary region. Cough, worse sitting. Cough from drinking water, from tickling in throat.

Kidneys - Frequent urination. Must wait for urine to start. Bladder semi-paralyzed, flow soon stops and requires straining. Increased urine, pale, scanty, dark. Urine too acid. Burning during urination. Diabetes, hepatic form. Urging to urinate, burning and itching at meatus after sex.

Temperature - Feet icy cold in day, burn at night. Chilly during menses, mostly on chest, followed by hot flushes around body. Flashes of heat and sweat. Exceedingly sour-smelling sweats. Intermittent fever with vomiting of sour masses.

name: Natrum Salicylicum
author: Murphy
constitution: Abscess. Amblyopia. Arthritis. Boils. Debility. Depression. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Ears, noises. Edema. Fever. Fibrositis. Head, noises. Headaches. Influenza. Iritis. Joint, pain. full:
PHARMACY - nat-sal. Natrum salicylicum. Sodium salicylate. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Amblyopia. Arthritis. Boils. Debility. Depression. Diarrhea. Dyspnea. Ears, noises. Edema. Fever. Fibrositis. Head, noises. Headaches. Influenza. Iritis. Joint, pain. Meniere’s disease. Nosebleed. Periostitis. Prostration. Rheumatism. Stammering. Strabismus divergens. Tinnitus. Tonsillitis. Unconsciousness. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - The introduction of Sali- cylic acid and Nat-sal. into general practice as remedies in rheumatism which led to much overdosing. Affinity for the joints. Affects the head, ear, throat, kidneys, liver and metabolism. Increases the quantity of bile. Vertigo when objects seem to move to the right, worse on rising from lying. Giddiness, worse on rising from lying. Marked effect upon the internal ear with vertigo, deafness, noises in the ears with loss of bone conduc- tion. Meniere’s disease. Intense tinnitus aurium with deafness. Hemorrhages, especially nosebleed. Follicular tonsillitis. Prostration after influenza. Temperature subnormal with slow pulse. Lassitude, drowsiness, listlessness, tremor. Periosteal rheumatism. Pains of gout and rheumatism in the joints. MIND - Severe mental prostration, worse since influenza. Weariness and depression. Listlessness. Apathetic. Highly nervous dread. Perfectly rational periods, alternate with manifestations of insanity of a somber character. Incipient dementia.

Head - Severe headache as though head would burst. Dull headaches and confusion. Fibrositis of the scalp.

Eyes - Pupils dilated, very slightly sensitive to light marked divergent strabismus. Eyes have a peculiar sparkle. Retinal hemorrhage. Iritis due to trauma. Amblyopia. Does not see distant objects, mydriasis.

Ears - Auditory vertigo. Giddiness, deafness, noises in ears. Tinnitus of a low tone. Deafness.

Face - Anxious expression, red face. Left face red, both eyelids, upper lip edematous. Burning pains on skin of forehead. Food - Great thirst. Appetite lost.

Mouth - Speech hoarse, indistinct, stammering, some words she cannot pronounce. Dryness in mouth and throat with great thirst.

Stomach - Vomiting, unconsciousness.

Abdomen - Inguinal glands swollen, sensitive.

Rectum - Diarrhea, great thirst.

Chest - Dyspnea, breathing noisy, shallow, panting, irregular pulse. Complete loss of voice.

Limbs - Axillary abscess. Strong itching on back of right hand. Feet swollen, soles tender, veins of dorsa much congested. Lungs - Dyspnea with great heat. Breathing so noisy it was heard in street, gasps for air. Breathing is shallow. Panting respiration, like that of a hunting-dog.

Skin - Tingling and itching. Edema and urticaria, red in circumscribed patches. Pemphigoid eruption.

Pulse - Pulse stronger, arterial pressure increased. Pulse irregular, small, weak, compressible.

Temperature - Wild delirium, with great heat, dyspnea. High fever with intense thirst. Fever and rash come only with disappearance of rheumatic pains. Vertigo - Vertigo, giddiness, worse raising head or sitting up, better lying down. All objects seem to move to the right. COMMENTS - Nat-sal. has been used freely in the manufacture of beer to prevent fermentation and this has caused poisoning symptoms, notably sweating and tenderness of the feet with dark colored and enlarged veins. In some of the overdoses, high fever with delirium was produced. Divergent strabismus and stammering were marked pathogenic effects in one case. Irritation of inguinal glands, abscess in axilla. Clarke gave Nat-sal. 3c to a patient recovering from influenza who had symptoms of vertigo with noises in the head, the patient was so much relieved by the medicine of her weakness and depression that she named the remedy her “tonic.” W. R. Rice published a case in which he gave a woman 10 grain doses of Nat-sal. every four hours. After the third dose “most alarming prostration, mental and bodily” set in. Pulse became weak and compressible and the temperature became subnormal. On stopping Nat-sal., the symptoms rapidly passed off. Ebstein claimed for Nat-sal. in ordinary dosage a controlling power over glycosuria and R. T. Williamson confirmed this in some cases. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Gaul., Chin. (2) Lob-p. - drowsiness, dizzy headache between eyebrows, cannot keep eyes open tongue whitefeels paralyzed as also do the heart and lungs intense prostration of all vital forces, deadly chill without shivering, useful for the low, nervous prostration of influenza. (3) Pyrus-m., Crab apple tree - Labyr., vertigo (Cooper). (4) Salx-m., Salx-n., Sal-ac., Salol. (5) In Meniere’s disease, Chin., Kali- i., Carb-s. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

PHARMACY - nat-sel. Natrum selenicum. Sodium selenate. Trituration. Historicaldose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Laryngitis. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - This is an unproved remedy, but it has a decided affinity for the larynx. According to Hansen, its use in homeopathy was first suggested by Meyhoffer, who gave the indication in laryngeal tuberculosis. Expectoration of small lumps of bloody mucus with slight hoarseness. It is best suited to the early stage of the disease. Laryngeal tuberculosis. Chronic laryngitis. REFERENCES - Clarke. Hansen.

PHARMACY - nat-sil. Natrum silicicum. Sodium silicate. Natrium silicatum. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Ankles, weak. Bone, diseases. Chilly. Diarrhea. Gout. Headaches. Hemophilia. Nasal, discharge. Osteomalacia. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-sil. is useful in hemophilia, pulmonary tubercle, chronic gout, osteomalacia and scrofulous diseases of bone. Marked lack of vital heat. Chilly. Marked lassitude and desire to lie down. Headache from mental exertion. Headache worse evening, noise and uncovering the head, better pressure and warm application. Pain in occiput. Nasal discharge offensive, thick and purulent. Swelling of submaxillary glands. Breathing deep, difficult and short. Dryness of mouth and throat. Sputum offensive and purulent, often with a salty taste. Cold feet. Weakness of ankles. Abscess, relieves the pain and hastens the flow of pus. Restrains progress of cancer of cervix. Diarrhea from milk. Sweats on the least exertion. Aversion to open air. Worse from exertion. Worse motion, forenoon, evening and night. Better lying down, pressure, warm applications. MIND - Weakness of mind and nerves. Can’t stand mental exertion. Headache from mental exertion. Sadness and weeping during menses. Easily frightened and starting from noise. Anxious and vivid dreams. REFERENCES - Clarke. Pulmann.

PHARMACY - nat-sil-f. Natrum silicofluoricum. Salufer. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Bone disorders. Bone caries. Ethmoiditis. Lupus. Tumors.

HOMEOPATHIC - Cooper is the chief authority for this remedy. Nat-sil-f. must be used carefully, as it has an extraordinary penetrating power. Particularly useful for bone disorders. Cooper called it the medicinal “bone scraper” in cases of caries. With a lotion of three grains to a tumbler of water he healed a case of lupus. Cooper saw ethmoiditis set up by it. Burnett cured tumors with Nat-sil-f. given internally. REFERENCES - Clarke. Cooper.

full:
PHARMACY - nat-s. Natrum sulphuricum. Sodium sulphate. Glauber’s salt. Sal Mirabile. Soda vitriolata. Trituration. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Alcoholism. Asthma. Bedwetting. Biliousness. Blindness. Brain, injuries. Chills. Colic. Coma. Concussions. Condylomata. Conjunctivitis. Convulsions. Cough. Debility. Depression. Diabetes. Dropsy. Dyspepsia. Epilepsy. Fever. Fistula. Flatulence. Gallbladder, disorders. Gonorrhea. Gout. Head, injuries. Headaches. Heartbum. Heatstroke. Hepatitis. Hydremia. Influenza. Jaundice. Leucorrhea. Leukemia. Liver, disorders. Malaria. Meningitis. Migraines. Morning sickness. Nausea. Nephritis. Nosebleeds. Ophthalmia. Opisthotonos. Panaritium. Phlegmasia alba. Photophobia. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Scrofulous, glands. Sinusitis. Spinal, injuries. Spinal, meningitis. Spleen, disorders. Suicidal. Sunstroke. Sycosis. Tuberculosis. Typhlitis. Vertigo. Vomiting. Warts.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nat-s., named Sal Mirabile, was discovered by the alchemist Glauber in 1658. It has since been named after him, Sal Glauberi. Nat-s. was proved by Schreter, Hartlaub, Trinks and others. Nat-s. was studied by Grauvogl, who found in it the typical remedy for his “hydrogenoid constitution,” and it forms one of the tissue remedies of Schussler. It corresponds to Hahnemann’s sycosis miasm. The indications from these studies are generally agreed upon by all, although homeopaths have the widest field. Grauvogl described the hydrogenoid constitution as the state in which there is extreme sensitiveness to damp wetting, bathing, watery foods and residence near fresh water, especially standing water. Periodicity is also another feature of this state. He considered this constitution as providing the soil for gonorrheal infection. Schussler wrote, “The action of the Sodium sulphate is contrary to that of the Sodium chloride. Both indeed, have the faculty of attracting water, but the end is a contrary one, Nat-m. attracts the water destined to be put to use in the organism, but Nat-sulph. attracts the water formed during the retrogressive metamorphosis of the cells and secures its elimination from the organism.” Especially affects the occiput, liver, and pancreas. Head symptoms from injuries to head. Mental troubles arising from a fall or other injuries to head. Epilepsy or depression after head injuries. Spinal meningitis. Sudden violent effects in ailing patients. Pains worse from thinking of them. Sycosis. Tendency to warts. Suppressed gonorrhea. Yellow, watery, secretions, stools, skin, vesicles etc. Thick yellow-green pus. Sour, bilious and lithemic. Fistulous abscesses. Dropsy. Chronic gout (Lyc.). Trembling. Fingers and toes affected. Skin disorders return every spring. Worse in rainy weather, water in any form, cannot eat plants growing near water, or fish. Feels every change from dry to wet. Always feels best in warm, dry air. MIND - Inability to think. Mental exertion aggravates. Industrious. Periodical attacks of mania. Sensitive and suspicious. Fear of crowds, evil. Fear from noise, from noise at night. Mental troubles arising from injury to head. Mental effects of falls, blows. Cheerful after stools. Confusion better after stools. Depression, worse music or mellow light. Sadness sitting near a stained glass window. Moved to tears by music and soft light. Sadness in morning. Very irritable, ill-humored, worse morning. Dislikes to speak or to be spoken to. Weeping, better in open air. Aversion to life, with photophobia. Estranged from her family, from his wife. Suicidal impulses, has to use self-control to prevent shooting himself (Aur.). Wants to commit suicide by shooting, or by hanging.

Head - III effects of falls and injuries to the head. Mental or physical troubles after injury. Headaches since head injury. Gnawing pain in occiput. Base of brain as if crushed in a vise. Boring in right temple, Natrum sulphuricum preceded by burning in stomach. Headaches, worse by noise, stooping, during menses, light, eating, better in dark room, vomiting. Salivation with headache. Head jerks to side (right). Brain feels loose when stooping. Bursting feeling on coughing' Pressure and heat in vertex during menses. Pulsating, from congestion of blood to head. Spinal meningitis. Head jerks to right side. Creeping in scalp of vertex. Scalp sensitive, combing hair painful.

Eyes - Yellow conjunctiva. Conjunctivitis with granular lids, green pus, terrible photophobia. Photophobia, on waking in morning. Sensitive to sunlight. Crawling or burning in eyes. As if eyeballs were hot. Granular lids. Itching on edges of lids mornings. Heaviness of eyelids. Aching in eyes in evening, when reading by candlelight. Blindness from head injury. Dimness of sight from weakness of eyes. Confused sight. Sparks before eyes after blowing nose.

Ears - Heat in right ear, evening. Piercing, stitches, sticking pains in ears, worse in damp weather. Piercing pain in right ear inward. Lancinations in ears. Irritable mucus membrane of ears and nose. Pressing in ears as if tympanum was pressed out. Earache as if something was forcing its way out. Ringing, tinkling in ears, as of bells.

Nose - Nose stopped up, great dryness and burning. Root of nose feels stopped up. Nasal catarrh with thick, yellow discharge and salty mucus. Coryza with obstruction of nose. Sneezing with fluent coryza. Yellowish- green nasal discharge becomes green on exposure to light. Watery discharge at night. Ethmoiditis. Nosebleed, before and during menses, stops and returns often.

Face - Yellow complexion, pale, sickly. Itching of face. Tearing in face and in cheekbones. Vesicles and pimples on face. Pimples on chin that burn when touched. Vesicles on lower lip. Lips burn like pepper. Dryness on upper lip.

Mouth - Offensive breath with malarial symptoms. Bitter taste. Taste unpleasant, slimy. Slimy, thick, tenacious, white mucus. Salivation during headache. Mouth as if rough and numb. Blisters on palate. Burning in mouth as from pepper. Burning of palate as if sore and raw during menses. Gums burn like fire.

Throat - Dry throat. Sore throat. Tearing pain down throat. Burning in pharynx during menses. Impeded swallowing. Feeling of a lump on swallowing. Frequent constriction of throat. Inflammation, with profuse, tenacious mucus. Thick, yellow mucus drops from posterior sinuses. Hawking of salt mucus, worse morning. Tonsils and uvula inflamed and swollen. Ulcers on tonsils. Goiter.

Stomach - Stomach feels distended and heavy. Squeamishness in stomach before meals. Slow digestion. Acid dyspepsia with heartburn and flatulence. Water brash in evening. Frequent hiccough after eating bread and butter. Hiccough in evening. Nausea with pain in eyes. Sour vomit or regurgitation. Green bilious vomiting. Green, bilious vomit. Morning sickness, vomiting with bitter taste in mouth.

Abdomen - Burning pain in abdomen and anus. Duodenal catarrh. Cramps at umbilicus. Cramps with flatulence, before breakfast, better eating. Incarcerated flatulence, painful, pushes here and there, right abdomen. Flatulency, wind colic in ascending colon, worse before breakfast. Colic better rubbing or kneading abdomen, lying on sides. Lead colic. Bruised pain with urging to stool. Abdominal flatulence after confinement. Tension in right hypochondrium as if it would burst. Inflammation of right groin, typhlitis. Tympanites in bilious fevers. Tuberculosis abdominalis.

Rectum - Bruised pain and urging to stool. Involuntary stools, when passing flatus. Rumbling, gurgling in bowels, then sudden noisy spluttering stools in the morning, can drive from bed. Loose morning stools, worse after spell of wet weather. Great size of the fecal mass. Diarrhea, yellow, watery stools. Foamy or yellow diarrhea, mixed with green slime. Burning pain in anus after stool. Itching of perineum and mons veneris. Itching of anus, as from worms. Knotty, wart-like eruption on anus and between thighs. Sensations - As if forehead would burst, as if a screw being driven in, as if top of head would split. As if brain was loose and fell to left temple, as if brain crushed in a vice or something gnawing there. Creeping in scalp to vertex. Crawling in eyes. As if bells ringing in ears. As if tympanum was pressed out, as if something forcing its way out of ears. Lump or ball in throat. Weight on chest. Burning on top of head, right eye, edges of lids, gums, palate, anus, abdomen, soles to knees.

Male - Edema of prepuce and scrotum. Sweat on scrotum in evening. Itching of glans, of scrotum with burning after scratching. Violent itching of glans of penis or scrotum. Enlarged prostate, with pus and mucus in urine. Condylomata, soft, fleshy excrescences, greenish discharges. Warts. Chronic gonorrhea, thick, greenish discharge, little pain. Increased sexual desire. Voluptuous feeling during stool.

Female - Scanty menses, too late, with knotty stools. Acrid and profuse menses, with nosebleed. Burning in pharynx during menstruation. Leucorrhea acrid, corrosive, parts inflamed. Yellow-green leucorrhea following gonorrhea, with hoarseness. Leucorrhea with hoarseness. Herpetic vulvitis. Food - Want of appetite and repugnance to food. Desire for ice and ice-cold water. Thirst at the start of fever only. Desire for salty fish, beer and cold drinks. Desire for or aversion to yogurt. Aversion to meat and bread. Starchy food, milk and potatoes disagree. Beer is distasteful. Vegetables, fruit, pastry, cold food or drink and farinaceous food causes diarrhea.

Chest - Chest feels all gone, empty. Oppression in chest. Pressure on chest, as of a heavy load. Soreness of chest when coughing, better pressure. Pain through lower left chest. Stitches in left side of chest. Swelling of ribs, near sternum. Spasmodic motions of muscles, worse left side. Swelling and induration of axillary glands. Furuncles near axilla. Foul axillary sweat. Constitutions - Hydrogenoid constitutions where complaints are such as due to living in damp houses, basements, and cellars. Patients cannot eat even plants growing near water, or fish.

Back - Violent pain in back of neck and at base of brain. Soreness up and down spine and neck. Piercing pain between scapulae. Sharp cutting pain in back spreading upwards like a fan. Bruised pain in lumbar region. Lumbar region pains if one attempts to retain the urine. Contusive pains in sacrum. Chronic swelling of cervical glands. Spinal meningitis. Opisthotonos. Itching when undressing. Breasts - Nipples retracted (Sars.).

Neck - Violent pains in back of neck and at base of brain. Stitches in nape of neck at night. Jerking, tearings and tension in muscles, on left side of neck.

Limbs - Rheumatism, worse in damp, cold weather. Rheumatic pains with gastric symptoms. Gout. Pain in limbs, compels frequent change in position. Sciatica on rising from sitting or turning in bed, no relief in any position. Pain in hip joint worse rising or sitting down. Stiffness of knees, cracking of joints. Edema of feet. Throbbing, piercing in heels. Burning in soles. Vesicles on soles. Itching between toes. Trembling of hands on waking and also when writing. Twitching of hands and feet during sleep, more after midnight. Inflammation around root of nails. Hangnail. Swelling of axillary glands.

Sleep - Great sleepiness during day. Drowsiness in forenoon when reading or writing. Sleeplessness caused by great agitation. Jerking of limbs during sleep. Awakes from the pain of flatulence. Uneasy sleep with anxious and disagreeable dreams. Dreams of running water, of flying. Dreams of being insulted or fighting. Frequent waking from unpleasant, fantastic dreams.

Skin - Jaundiced skin, after anger. Chronic skin eruptions. Eczema, moist and oozing profusely. Erysipelas, smooth, red, shiny, tingling or painful swelling of skin. Wheals containing a yellow, watery, not glutinous secretion. Watery, yellow blisters. Yellow scales after breaking of vesicles. Sycotic excrescences, wart-like red lumps all over body. Itching pimples. Itching while undressing. Chafing of skin in children with bilious symptoms.

Modalities - Better from open air, warm, dry air. Better change of position, lying on back, pressure. Better after dinner, breakfast. Worse from damp weather, dampness of cellars, night air, late evenings, wind. Worse subdued light, music, lifting, lying long in one position, touch, pressure. Worse cold food and drinks, vegetables, fruits. Worse from head injuries.

Teeth - Drawing pains in teeth. Throbbing toothache with restlessness, worse warm, but intolerable to hot drink. Tearing in carious teeth, on getting out of bed, at night. Toothache better by holding cold water in mouth. Gums burn like fire.

Tongue - Brown, bitter coating on tongue. Dirty brown or greenish yellow, thick, pasty tongue, especially at base. Tongue covered with mucus, slimy taste in mouth. Burning blisters, vesicles on tongue. Tip of tongue feels burnt. Root of tongue coated a dirty greenish gray or greenish brown. Vertigo - Vertigo, relieved by sweat on head. Vertigo after dinner, from gastric derangements. Vertigo at 6 p.m., followed by vomiting of sour mucus. COMMENTS - Grauvogl and Schussler used Nat-s. in the lower trituration. It was Schtlssler’s specific for epidemic influenza, but homeopaths need not confine themselves. When the correspondence is exact, the highest potencies will act better than the lower; when the likeness is more general, the lower will give the best results. Headache, with drowsiness. Basal head ache, as if the bones at the base of the brain were crushed, pressure on both sides or on right side of occiput. Sun headaches. Severe migraine, especially after a head injury or after grief. Nausea, vomiting, bursting and splitting migraines. Worse mental effort. Spinal meningitis with violent, crushing pain in the occiput. Traumatic epilepsy from injury to the head. Blindness after head injury, cortical blindness. Personality change after head injury. Injuries to the spine, although more specifically for the head. Mental troubles arising from injury to the head. Nervous exhaustion brought on by debilitating diseases. Chronic fatigue. Overly concerned with the future. Tend to project and plan a lot. Irritability, worse morning. The mind clears as the day goes on. Mental symptoms worse from music. Sentimental. Worse from nursing loved ones, never been well since nursing a loved one. Overwhelming sense of being overburdened. Very independent. Angry, verbally violent. Resentment about life, regretful. Holds grudges. Difficulty expressing emotions after a grief. Low spirits, even to suicidal impulse. Suicidal depression typified by a great conflict about whether to do it or not (Aurum has conflict over when they will do it). May act impulsively. Tendency to hanging or shooting themselves. Postpartum depression, especially if the birth was traumatic (Sep. first). Feeling overwhelmed and overworked with new baby. Depression worse in the morning. Despair over recovery. Hydremia, worse in humid weather, near the water and in moist, damp, underground dwellings. Ailments arise or are worse from dwelling in damp houses, from damp weather, damp soil, weather changing to damp, getting wet. Chest eruptions every spring. Warm-blooded, worse heat. Better from warm, dry weather, and being in the open air. Asthma, particularly found in malarial districts. Humid asthma. Asthma after a cold. Attacks frequently occur in the early morning hours. Skin symptoms during or after asthma. Asthma in children, with restless legs. Catarrhs with yellowish green or green secretions. Discharges are thick, green, yellow and painless (Med., pain and inflammation with the discharge). Bronchitis and coughs with a lot of mucus. Gonorrhea, sinusitis, and chronic urethritis. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Granular lids. Photophobia (Nat-c., Nat-m.). Sensitivity in the eyes. Nosebleed before and during menses (not vicarious like Bry). Toothache is worse by warm things, intolerable by hot things, and better by holding cold water in the mouth. Edema, edematous erysipelas. Vesicles on the skin containing yellowish water, moist herpes, ringworm, sycotic excrescences. Burning of the feet (Sulph.) and stiffness of the joints (Rhus-t.). Limbs feel bruised and weary, especially with migraines. Drowsy, weak, weary and heavy feeling. Functional disturbances in the secretion of bile. Chills and fever, bilious fever, influenza, diabetes, bilious vomiting, bilious diarrhea. History of hepatitis. Gallstones with severe right-sided pain and cramps. Bad taste in the mouth in morning. Tongue is coated yellow or white. Diarrhea in the morning (Sulph.), especially after eating fruits, pastries or ice cream. Diarrhea driving one out of bed. “Cheerfulness after loose stools.” Craves yogurt. Likes dairy and cheese, but not as strong. Desires sweets, but aggravate. Worse from fruits or pastries. Generally right-sided (Thuj., left sided). Hydrogenoid and sycotic miasm (Thuj.). Pain in the right colon, the right shoulder. Headaches over the right eye. Warts on the right foot and right hand (Thuj.). H. C. Allen said that with the possible exception of Graph., no remedy has “such terrible sensitiveness to light.” Hermann of Paris cured a young woman, a patient whose sleep was disturbed by dreams of fighting. Leonard cured a case of violent asthma induced by unusual exertion with Nat-s. 200x. W. J. Guernsey recorded a similar case. Natrum sulphuricum Mrs. S., 36. had violent attacks of asthma, with greenish, purulent sputa, and a loose evacuation immediately after rising the last two days. Nat-s. 500c was given in water, every two hours. She was able to lie down the same night and all her symptoms rapidly cleared up. Guernsey also had the case of Mrs. C., 42. who had been subject to attacks for years. Copious expectoration of greenish mucus. She was given Nat-s. in water every three hours. Improvement began after a few doses, expectoration became paler and less abundant. She felt better than she had for years previously. Mahlon Preston cured many cases of threatened tuberculosis having “pains flying from the chest beginning with a dry cough.” Gregg gave the symptoms “all-gone, empty feeling in chest, a sense of weakness in chest, must hold chest with both hands when coughing for support to relieve the weakness.” “Must hold chest because of pain and soreness, feels as if it would fly to pieces” (Bry., Phos.). RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Nat-suc. - catarrhal jaundice. (2) Malar. (3) Nat-ch., Fei. (4) Mom-b. - colic, dysmenorrhea with gushes of blood. (5) Pulm-v. (6) Peumus boldus. (7) Nat-i., Nat. hydrosulph. - liver-spots, locally and internally. (8) Sulph., Thuj., Merc., Still. Complementary: Ars., Thuj. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Sore and tender liver, worse deep breathing, stepping, jar. Liver sore to touch. Region of liver sensitive when walking in open air, stitching pain. As of a lump below liver. Irritable liver sometimes after excessive study or mental work. Jaundice after anger. Hepatitis, icterus and vomiting of bile. Gallbladder disorders. Clawing pain in gallbladder. Lungs - Dyspnea during damp weather. Constant desire to take deep, long breath. Humid asthma, rattling in chest, at 4 a.m. and 5 a.m. Asthma worse damp weather. Asthma, with early morning diarrhea. Asthma, sycotic in children. Every fresh cold or any unusual exertion, brings on an attack of asthma. Attacks of hay asthma. Bronchial catarrh, with glairy sputum, worse damp weather. Delayed resolution in pneumonia. Hemoptysis, in hydrogenoid constitutions. Copious expectoration, thick, ropy, greenish. Chest feels all gone with cough.

Kidneys - Frequent urination. Polyuria. Diabetes. Urging to urinate, with piercing in both groins. Burning pain in urethra. Urine loaded with bile. Urine with sediment of a yellow color or like brick-dust. Scanty, dark urine, had to get up several times at night.

Cough - Cough with thick, ropy, greenish, copious expectoration. Cough with purulent sputum and pain about last ribs, left side. Must hold chest when coughing. Springs up in the bed the cough hurts so, holds painful side (Bry.). Loose cough from tickling in throat, better sitting. Dry cough with roughness in throat, worse morning after rising, worse night.

Perspiration - Sweats without thirst. Sweats at night, in morning. Sweats on face, on scrotum.

Temperature - Chills up back, with icy coldness, gooseflesh, shaking and chattering of teeth, with anguish and thirst. Cannot get warm even in bed. Internal chills with stretching and yawning. Sudden flashes of heat towards evening. Increased warmth of body, with restlessness. Fever with aversion to uncover. Foul axillary sweat, profuse at night. Perspiration in morning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Nectrianinum is a clear liquid of a yellowish-brown hue which was prepared by Bra and Chaussé. Two month old nectria cultures on grape broth were evaporated on a water bath until reduced to one-third of their original volume. They were filtered through paper, and again through porcelain. The liquid was then taken to the autoclave at a temperature of 120 degrees centigrade. This assured that all spores are killed. Observers said that Nectrin. caused “An arrest or diminution of hemorrhages. Suppression of fetid discharges. A tendency at times to epidermization of the neoplasm with a corresponding well-defined arrest in its evolution.” The patients were worse when treatment was discontinued and better when it was resumed. In very advanced cancer, reaction may not occur. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Care., Cadm-s., Scirr. REFERENCES-Clarke.
