full:
PHARMACY - nux-m. Nux moschata. Nutmeg. Myristicafragrans. Myristica officinalis. Myristica moschata. N. O. Myristicacee. Tincture of powdered seeds deprived of the Mace. A fresh nut and fresh plant tincture should be prepared and tested. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Asthma. Backache. Belch- ings. Brain, softening. Catalepsy. Chilblains. Clairaudience. Clairvoyance. Colic. Convulsion. Cough. Debility. Drowsiness. Dryness. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Eyes, disorders. Fainting. Fevers. Flatus. Freckles. Frostbite. Gastralgia. Hemorrhage. Headaches. Head, movements. Hemorrhages. Hiccoughs. Hoarseness. Hysteria. Intermittent fever. Locomotor ataxia. Lumbago. Mania. Marasmus. Menopausal disorders. Menorrhagia. Metrorrhagia. Miscarriage. Narcolepsy. Pelvis, congestion. Perspiration, bloody, hysterical. Pregnancy, complaints. Ptosis. Puerperal convulsions. Kidney colic. Rheumatism. Sleep, overpowering. Speech, defective. Stammering. Strangury. Strokes. Toothache. Turpentine, effects. Typhoid, hemorrhage. Uterus, prolapse. Vertigo. Worms.

HERBAL - Nux-m. is one of the many examples of poisonous and medicinal substances commonly used as food. The use of nutmeg as a condiment doubtless originated because Nux- Nux moschata m. is specifically related to weak digestion. Ground nutmeg is popularly used in conditions of excessive flatulence and when the smallest excess in eating or drinking sets up indigestion. Used for diarrhea and boils. Nutmeg has a reputation for putting off the menstrual period or else for bringing it on. Using nutmeg for these purposes has led to many cases of poisoning, supplying a large number of the homeopathic symptoms.

HOMEOPATHIC - There is a characteristic “irregularity” in the remedy. It produces states of exaltation resembling hysteria, as well as the mesmeric state with exalted senses and consciousness of double person- ality. Profoundly disturbs the sensorium, mind and nerves. Characteristic drowsiness, conditions accompanied by drowsiness, especially if there is also chilliness, coldness or thirstlessness. General inclination to become unconscious during acute attacks. Marked tendency to fainting fits with heart failure, worse at stools, at menses, with slight pain, from sight of blood, while standing (when dressing). Epilepsy with consciousness. Paralysis with spasms and trembling of tongue, eyelids, esophagus. Catalepsy. Automatism. Mania. Hysteria. Mental depression from grief. Feels as if drunk, staggers on trying to walk. Cold limbs. Humming, buzzing, funny feeling in body. Hard parts feel soft. Fleeting pains. Parts lain on feel sore. Heaviness of eyes tongue etc. Sensation as of a hard lump in stomach, liver, throat. Puffiness. Extreme dryness of the mucus membranes and skin. Female organs are affected. Bearing-down pain, dark blood. Dark hemorrhages. Uterine prolapse and displacements. Useful for threatened miscarriage. Affinity for pregnancy, labor, and the puerperal state. Disturbed digestion. Indicanuria. Spasms of children with diarrhea. Marasmus of children. Useful to scrawny, delicate, hysterical women who have small breasts and who laugh or cry by turns. Clairvoyant. MIND - Confused mind and impaired memory. Memory weakness, loss associated with dryness in the brain (Alum., Anae., doesn’t have dry skin). Senile dementia (Alum.), Alzheimer’s disease. Entire loss of memory of his past life. Thoughts suddenly vanish while talking, reading or writing. Weak memory with headache. Uses wrong words during headaches. Slow ideation. Slow learning to talk. Ailments from overtaxing mental powers. Changeable moods, laughing and crying. Fickle and wavering in his undertakings. Listless, indifferent. Dreamy andbewildered, as in a dream. Does things automatically, does not recollect what she has done. Staggering state, helpless as if drunk. Unconsciousness, after mental excitement, worse just before menses. Stupefaction during menses. Confusion during pregnancy. Ailments from disappointed love. Depression with grief. Strange feelings with irresistible drowsiness. Fears to go to sleep. Starting, as if electric shocks though body during sleep; wakening her. Starting on recovering consciousness. Fright causes trembling of heart, fear and sadness. Aware of danger, but no apprehension. Mental disturbances. Hysteria and mania. Hysterical fainting. Loss of emotional control. Mania with odd speeches and ridiculous gestures. Incoherence. Talks loudly to herself. Answers irrelevantly. Mockery. Everything seems ludicrous. Laughing, in open air, before menses. Loud talking and bewildered manner, with pelvic congestion. Jesting. Clairvoyant states. Sense of duality, thinks she has two heads, seems to be two persons (Plat.). Senseofimpending dissolution. Surrounding seems changed, does not know the well-known streets. Short time seems very long. Objects seem changed or grow larger. Sense of levitation.

Head - Head feels full. As if head expanding with sleepiness. Cerebral congestion. Brain feels loose, striking the sides, on motion. Painless pulsating in head, in small spot. Cracking sensation in head. Convulsive movements of the head, could not talk or swallow. Head drops forward while sitting. Raising head from pillow causes deathly sickness. Headaches, bursting in temples. Headaches better hard pressure. Headaches from eating a little too much. Headache from wine. Headache of alcoholics.

Eyes - Eyes seems dry, which impedes the movement of the eyelids. Pterygium over cornea. Mydriasis. Blindness, then fainting. Motes before eyes. Objects look larger or too small, very distant, oblique, too close together, vanish, or are red.

Ears - Pain in Eustachian tube as from a foreign body. Tearing or sharp pains in ears. Sharp pain in left ear, worse moving jaw. Oversensitive hearing, distant sounds increased. Buzzing and ringing in ears, as if stopped up.

Nose - Dry nose, stopped up, must breathe through mouth. Catarrh worse cold, damp weather. Nosebleed of dark blood. Oversensitive sense of smell, followed by loss of smell.

Face - Deathly pale, worse in damp air. Sleepy, stupid, debauched look. Foolish, childish expression, diabolic grin. Distorted face during headache. Blue rings around eyes. Cheeks sometimes red and hot. Eruptions spreading from face to neck. Pustules with broad red borders on Nux moschata chin. Chapped lips. Lips, swollen, stick together, retracted. Jaws as if paralyzed, cannot close them.

Mouth - Chalky taste in morning, when fasting. Thick saliva like cotton (Berb.). Dry mouth without thirst, worse sleep. Tongue numb, paralyzed, speech difficult. Tongue adheres to the roof of the mouth. Teeth seem pulled, loose. Teeth painful while eating. Toothache of pregnant women, better warmth.

Throat - Great dryness of throat, without thirst. Difficult swallowing from paralysis of muscles. Scraping in throat. Contraction on throat like strangulation. Globus hystericus. Hoarse voice when walking against the wind (Hep.) Vertigo - Vertigo as if drunk, staggering. Vertigo when walking in open air. Vertigo with headache and nausea, with lightness and emptiness of head. Vertigo feels as if floating in air. COMMENTS - Stonham reported a case in which a dark-haired young man ate two nutmegs one morning. In the afternoon, he was exhilarated, able to do more than usual, to argue on any subject. At dinner, his mouth was dry, he had great thirst, felt he could not drink enough to quench it. After dinner, his head felt strange, as if in a dream, but he jointed a small musical party as he had intended. He seemed to be two people. His real, conscious self seemed to be watching his other self playing. He could not play well and had to stop. He seemed lost and when spoken to would come to himself with a start. He could hear distant sounds much more acutely than usual. A woman who ate several nutmegs in an attempt to bring on a miscarriage hallucinated that she had two heads. A. P. Williamson recorded one case of a woman who took grated nutmeg for diarrhea. After the second dose of half a nutmeg, her head felt queer and dizzy, then her head felt large. She could not reply to questions, although her eyes were open and she seemed to understand. Her pupils dilated, eyes starting, face pale, respiration was labored. She was semi-conscious and had to be shouted at, but relapsed into semi-consciousness. Pulse was at first small or rapid, but during the unconscious period it was irregular, fuller and weak. When consciousness first returned, she kept her hands to her head “to prevent it falling off, was obliged to move her head with her hands, it being too large and heavy for her body.” Her chest felt as if in a vice. For some days she was unable to use words properly, frequently obliged to stop in the middle of a sentence and change it entirely from not being able to use the appropriate words. General exaltation of the senses. One hypersensitive patient given a single dose of Nux-m. 30c, said it seemed to put a coat of cotton wool over her. Clairvoyant state, answers questions accurately quite out of her sphere and on returning to consciousness knows nothing about it. Pains as if bruised, sprained, wrenched. As if the bones smashed. As if electrified. Pressure, throbbing, drawing, burning. Parts lain on are sore. Puffiness, swellings, dropsy of outer parts. Buzzing sensation with numbness of hands and feet. Spasms and convulsions. Jactitation of muscles, chorea. Locomotor ataxia excited by cold and wet. Jerks in inner parts, in muscles, recovers with a start. Paralysis with spasms and trembling of tongue, eyelids, and esophagus. Catalepsy. Characteristic drowsiness (Op.), particularly if accompanied by chilliness and thirstlessness. Irresistible tendency to fall asleep, narcolepsy. For any disease with the concomitant overpowering sleep. Tendency to faint. Persons who easily faint from the sight of blood or from standing. Dark hemorrhages. Dryness, either actual dryness or the sensation of it. Dry skin, lack of perspiration. Dryness of the mouth and tongue (Nat-m., Alum., Bry.), usually without thirst. The tongue is so dry it adheres to the roof of the mouth. Eyes dry, too dry to close the lids. Neurotic patients who always awaken with a very dry mouth and tongue. Dryness during pregnancy. Severe constipation, inactive bowels with dry skin. Constipation with drowsiness (Op.). Faintness during or after stool. Hemorrhage of typhus, fetid flatus. Protruding hemorrhoids. Incontinence of urine. Diarrhea from milk. Eating a little too much causes a headache. Worse from alcohol. Drinking causes dry cough, colic. Drinking beer causes strangury. Brandy causes an electrifying effect. Generally worse by cold and damp, better by warmth. Aggravated by wet weather. Cough when warm in bed, or worse in bed. Clarke cured with Nux-m. 30c a very bad cause of indigestion with acne in a youth who had the symptom “the saliva seems thick like cotton.” P. P. Wells said that “in brain disorders of infants in the stupor with insensibility and unconquerable desire to sleep. Whether in idiopathic disorders of the brain or in those occurring during cholera infantum. Nux-m. is one of the most precious remedies in the Materia Medica.” J. White gave a striking instance of a Nux- m. headache, better by hard pressure, in a man convalescing from a severe gunshot wound to the head. He wanted the nurse to “bear her whole weight on it.” With the headache was rapid, anxious breathing, as if he could not get air enough and the “wind would be shut off.” Nux-m. always relieved. The 3x was first given, then a higher potency. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Laur., Gels., Nux-v., Op., Zinc, Valer. It antidotes: Ars., Laur.. Rhod., lead colic, turpentine, alcohol, bad yeasty beer. Compare: (1) 01- myr., oil of Nutmeg - as a remedy for boils, felons, poisonous ulcers, it has been used in the 2x potency. (2) Omi. (3) Myris. - Ulcerative tendency in all tissues. Inflammation, hastens suppuration, powerful anti-septic. Said to act more powerfully than Hep. and Sil. (4) Nux-v., Puls., Rhus-t„ Ign., Asaf. Compatible: Lyc., Nux-v., Puls., Rhus-t., Stram., Ant-t. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy.Phatak

Stomach - Excessively bloated. Retrocession of gout to stomach. Eating a little too much causes headache. Digestion weak, all food turns to gas. Flatulent dyspepsia. Hiccoughs and craving for highly-seasoned food. Deathly sickness on raising head from pillow. Nausea when riding in a carriage. Nausea and vomiting, with sleepiness. Nausea and vomiting, from irritation of uterine pessary, during pregnancy.

Abdomen - Enormously distended. As of a board across the hypogastrium. Paralytic weakness of the intestines. Abdominal colic from cold drinks. Colic immediately after eating. Flatulent colic. Navel is sore, even ulcerated, festering.

Rectum - Inactive rectum. Constipation in women who are disposed to faint or who bolt their food. Difficult stool during pregnancy. Hard alternating with soft stools. Stool is soft and yet is unable to expelit, even with long straining (Alum.). Summer diarrhea from cold drinks. Epidemic diarrhea in autumn, with want of appetite, but frequent thirst. Diarrhea during dentition, pregnancy, from boiled milk. Stool, soft, putrid, bright yellow and lienteric, worse at night. Slimy stools with slimy taste in mouth. Sharp pain in anus during stool. Faintness during or after stool. Acrid feeling in rectum and anus during and after stool. Passing fetid flatus. Protruding hemorrhoids. Worm affections in children. Sensations - Forehead as if pushed out, as if brain struck against side of head or loose. Objects appear much too large. As if drunk. Pain as of a rough body in Eustachian tube. Pricking as of electric sparks on cheek. As if wind incarcerated in stomach, as if a piece of bacon were in throat. Limbs as if floating in the air. As if left shoulder contained lead. As if a string were tied around arms. As of a grasping hand in upper arm.

Female - Suppressed menses with persistent fainting attacks and sleepiness (Kali-c.). Menses scanty or suppressed from fright, debility, getting cold, overexertion. Variableness of menses, irregularity in time and quantity. Menses too long, dark, thick. During menses great pressure in back from within outward. Leucorrhea, muddy, bloody. Leucorrheareplaces menses. Continuous and obstinate flooding. Flatus from vagina. Pain of uterus from pessary. Prolapse of uterus and vagina. Uterine hemorrhage. Sterility. Puerperal convulsions. Threatened abortion, in hysterical females disposed to fainting. Deficient labor pains. Labor pains weak, irregular. Uterus remains uncontracted after delivery. Food - Hunger or loss of appetite after a few mouthfuls. Thirstlessness. Loathing when eating or thinking of food. Food tastes like sawdust. Craving for highly seasoned food. Worse cold food, milk, alcohol, wine. Brandy has a kind of electrifying effect from roof of mouth downward in a straight line to feet.

Chest - Oppression of chest, generally coming from epigastrium. Fullness and distressing sensation of a load on chest. Burning in chest, peculiar dead feeling and swelling. Stitches in chest, tightness, spitting of blood. Constitutions - Suited to children, women and pregnant women. Persons with cool, dry skin, who do not easily perspire. Weakness of old age. Dyspepsia of old people. Constitutions with stiff, straight hair rather than crisp and curly. Delicate constitutions. Hydrogenoid constitution.

Heart - Trembling, fluttering, as from fright, fear, or sadness. Palpitations, better walking about, drinking warm water. Sensation as if something grasped the heart. As if beating in a vacuum. Pulse intermits at long interval, exciting fear of death. Pulse, weak, irregular. Pulse frequent, trembling, accelerated after wine.

Back - Neck so weak, head drops forward on chest. Pain in back, moves to sacrum or lumbar region. Pain along spine. Lumbago. Backache and neuralgia of sacrum and coccyx worse riding in a carriage. As if a piece of wood stretched across sacrum, worse before menses. Breasts - Nipples retracted. Breasts too small. Causations - Ill effects of fright, mental exertion, suppressed eruptions, suppressed menses. Bathing. Over- eating, milk, bad beer, alcohol.

Limbs - Fatigue on slight exertion. Hysterical paralysis. Limbs as if floating in the air. Rheumatism, drawing, wandering pains, worse cold, damp air, wet clothes, better from warmth, dry clothes. Rheumatism from getting feet wet, from exposure to drafts. Pain in right hip to knee, worse motion, especially going up stairs. Feels as if treading on hard peas when walking. Feet cold with appearance of menses. Soles always moist. Dry palms. Lungs - Paroxysms of suffocation. Dyspnea with feeling of weight in chest. Dyspnea, with upward pressure, during pregnancy. Oppressed breathing. Difficult breathing from fullness in stomach. Loss of breath when standing in water. Hysterical asthma, difficult inhalation. Wheezing, snoring, rattling in chest. Hysterical cough, worse when getting warm in bed. Cough when getting warm in bed.

Sleep - Narcolepsy. Attacks of sleepiness, with vertigo. Great drowsiness (Indol.). Complaints cause sleepiness. Great sleepiness with great inclination to laughter. Starting in sleep, but doesn’t always awake. Starts with shocks as if electricity were passing through body. Dreams of falling from high place, of being pursued. Coma.

Skin - Cold, dry skin. Dryness of inner parts. Bluish spots on the skin. Skin sensitive to cold, damp air. Anasarca, dropsy of external parts. Freckles. Acne. Chilblains. Irregular red scaling patches on face and neck during congestions, at time of menses. Ulcerations of skin. Complaints after suppressed eruptions.

Modalities - Better from moist heat, warm room, dry weather. Worse from exertion, motion, shaking head, jarring, lying on painful side, bruises. Worse from mental exertion, shock, emotions, excitement. Worse menstruation, pregnancy. Worse from alcohol. Worse damp, wind, drafts, fog, cold bath, cold feet. Worse changes of season, summer, hot weather, overheating.

Kidneys - Renal colic. Pain from stone in bladder or gravel. Dysuria from exertion of body. Dysuria with dysmenorrhea or from uterine complaints. Dysuria after eating, from beer or wine. Tenesmus of bladder. Urging at night, with scanty emission. Frequent urination, sometimes involuntary. Burning, cutting in urethra, during urination. Urine smells like violets.

Cough - Dry cough, with sudden loss of breath. Cough with great soreness in larynx or chest. Cough excited by scratching in throat, crawling in upper part of trachea. Cough from getting overheated, getting warm in bed. Cough during pregnancy.

Perspiration - Sweat is red, bloody or absent. Lack of perspiration. Sweats with aversion to be uncovered.

Temperature - Chill with stupor, pale face. Chill begins in left hand (Carb-v.). Desire to sleep between chills, if left alone. Chill alternating with heat, without thirst.

name: Nux Vomica
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from a nap, if allowed to finish it in evening. Better moist air, damp, wet weather (Caust.). Better from free discharges. Better strong pressure, wrapping head, lying on sides, resting, frequent stretching. Better hot drinks, milk, fats. Worsefrom overeating, coffee, condiments, liquor, stimulants. Worse from high living, debauched, sedentary habits. Worse narcotics, drugs tobacco, purgatives. Worse anger, mental exertion, vexation, mental shock, wounded honor, disappointment of ambitions. Worse cold, open air, dry air, drafts, wind. Worse disturbed sleep, early morning. Worse noise, music, odors, after eating, yawning. Worse pressure of clothes at waist, touch, uncovering..

PHARMACY - nux-v. Nux vomica. Poison nut. Strychnos nux vomica. N. O. Loganiacae. Tincture and trituration of imported seeds. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Addictions. Alcoholism. Amaurosis. Amblyopia. Anger, effects. Asthma. Belching. Biliousness. Bladder, disorders. Bone, nodes. Brain, disorders. Breath, sour. Catarrh. Clavus. Insomnia. Intussusception. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Locomotor ataxia. Lumbago. Masturbation. Migraines. Morning, sickness. Motion, sickness. Musca volitantes. Myelitis. Nausea. Night-blindness. Nightmares. Nymphomania. Paralysis. Paraphimosis. Photophobia. Pregnancy, affections. Pylorus, disease. Kidney, stones. Seasickness. Sexual, mania. Sexual, weakness. Sleep, disorders. Spermatorrhea. Stomach, disorders. Strabismus. Strokes. Taste, disordered. Tea, effects. Tenesmus. Tobacco, habit. Tongue, disorders. Trachea disorders. Umbilical, hernia. Urethra, spasm. Urination, frequent. Uterus, prolapse. Vagina, prolapse. Vertigo. Vomiting. Water brash. Worms. Yawning.

HOMEOPATHIC - Strychnos nux vomica is a moderate-sized tree, native to the Coromandel Coast and Cochin China. The fruit is like an orange in appearance and contains numerous seeds of flattened circular outline, about the size of a half penny, ash-gray in color, covered with fine silky hairs. The seeds are intensely bitter owing to the presence of strychnia and brucea that exist together with certain peculiar acids, but the pulp is innocuous and is said to be eaten by birds. If nitric acid is added to the seeds a deep orange-yellow color is produced. The wood of the tree is very bitter. Nux-v. is used in India in cases of intermittent fever and snakebites. The Treasury of Botany noted that a decoction of the leaves is used externally in rheumatism. The difference in the character of Ign. and Nux-v. proves the wisdom of Hahnemann’s simple methods of studying medicines. If there was nothing more than the chemistry of the drugs to go by Ign. and Nux-v might be used indifferently, but with the knowledge of their characteristic features, they are seldom even thought of in connection with the same case. Nux-v. is useful to those who lead a sedentary life doing much mental work, or to those who remain under stress and strain of prolonged office work, business cares and worries. Generally thin, spare, quick, active, nervous and irritable. Pre-eminently for men. Firm-tissued brunettes. Debauchees, much drugged patients. Useful for the ill effects of wine, women, rich food, tobacco and sedative drugs. Indulgences result in a thick head, dyspepsia and irritable temper. Irritable nervous system, hypersensitive and over-impressionable. Digestive disturbances, portal congestion and hypochondriacal states. Dyspepsia. Zealous fiery temperament. Easily chilled, avoids open air. Lightning-like pains. Neuralgia, prodromal. Internal scrapy sensation or rawness in throat, larynx. Bruised soreness of abdomen, brain etc. Reflexes increased. Twisting and jerks. Convulsions. Spasms, tetanic with consciousness, worse by slightest touch, but better by grasping tightly or when elbow was stretched. Tense, contracted feeling. Fainting. Trembling. Paralysis from a stroke in high livers, partial with vertigo and nausea, with sticking pains. Hemorrhages. Varicose veins without tortuosity, black hard cords from standing or from sedentary habits. Reversed peristalsis. Biliousness. Fainting after stools. Epilepsy during stool. Vomiting after labor pains. MIND - Overactive mind. Very irritable, sensitive to all impressions. Cannot bear noises, odors, light, touch, music. Sensitive to singing. Every harmless word offends, every little noise frightens, anxious and beside himself. Cannot stand pain, so mad, he cries. Loses connection of ideas, thinks she will lose her reason. Concentration difficult while calculating. Easily makes mistakes. Confusion of mind after vexation. Stupefaction worse in sun. Wants to be quiet, desires repose and tranquility. Despondency alternating with buoyancy. Averse to work. Time passes too slowly. Headstrong, self-willed. Zealous, fiery temperament. Angry andimpatient. Offended easily. Obstinately resists wishes of others. Can’t bear conversation or reading. Quarrelsome if disturbed. Quarrels, reproaches, scolds, insults, from jealousy. Angry when consoled. Faultfinding. Reproaches others. Can’t endure slightest contradiction. Impatient when spoken to, gets angry and violent without any provocation. Spiteful. Cursing. Ugly, malicious. Violent and abusive. Disposition to slander. Nervous and excitable. Workaholics. Anxiety about business affairs. Ambitious and competitive. Obsessive and compulsive behavior. Fastidious. Anxiety in morning on waking. Melancholy. Pessimistic. Sullen. Nagging. Alcoholism. Delirium tremens. Drug addictions. Frightened easily, wakes in fright from least noise. Frightfully apprehensive about getting married. Fears poverty. Hypochondriasis. Even the least ailment affects them. Talks about one’s condition. Fear of knives, lest she should kill herself or others. Suicidal, homicidal impulses.

Head - Migraines. Headache in occiput or over eyes. Frontal headache with desire to press the head against something. Bruised sensation of the brain. Pressing pain on vertex, as if a nail driven in. Pressive and throbbing, at vertex from fixed attention of mind. Headache in the sunshine (Glon., Nat-c.). Toxic headaches from drugs, alcohol. Headache after drugging. Hangover headaches with irritability. Headache from constipation. Congestive headache, associated with hemorrhoids. Head feels distended and sore after a debauch. Supraorbital neuralgia with great restlessness. Scalp sensitive to slight touch.

Eyes - Bloodshot eyes. Lower eyeballs yellow. Eye affections with liver disease. Burning and smarting pain as from salt, with lachrymation. Sensation of hot water in eye. Burning pain when looking at a light. Photophobia, much worse in morning. Loss of vision due to alcohol and tobacco. Twitching and blinking. Orbital twitching radiating towards the occiput. Paresis of ocular muscles. Optic neuritis. Optic nerve atrophy from habitual use of tobacco or intoxicants. Strabismus. Trachoma and follicular conjunctivitis. Conjunctivitis in spring. Smarting, dry sensation in inner canthi. Lachrymation from affected side. Exudation of blood from eyes.

Ears - Auditory canal dry and sensitive. External meatus dry and sensitive. Itching in ear through the Eustachian tube. Sharp pain, when swallowing. Otalgia, worse in bed. Hyperesthesia of auditory nerves,loudsounds arepainfulandanger him. Ringing, roaring and hissing in ears. Strong reverberation of sounds in ear.

Nose - Stuffy colds, snuffles after exposure to dry, cold atmosphere, worse in warm room. Snuffles in a newborn. Stuffed up at night and outdoors or alternates between nostrils. Sudden fluent coryza after rising. Coryza, fluent in daytime, worse warm room, better open air. Coryza with lachrymation. Acrid discharge, but with stuffed-upfeeling. Violent sneezing, abortive, from intense crawling in nostrils (left). Bloody mucus in nose. Nosebleeds in morning (Bry.). Nosebleeds during sleep, from suppressed flow of hemorrhoids, from coughing. Oversensitive to strong odors, even fainting. Smell before nose like old cheese, burning sulphur. Nose looks sharp and pointed. Picking at nose, worms.

Face - Red, turgid or yellowish. Face yellow with a red flush. Yellow around mouth and nose. Twitching and spasmodic distortion. Distortion of face. Trigeminal neuralgia with numbness of face. Submaxillary glands swollen. Erysipelas. Itching pimples on chin. Acne from eating cheese, from excessive use of liquors. Infra- orbital neuralgia with swelling of cheek intermittent, better when lying in bed. Drawing and stiffness in masseter muscles. Drawing tearing, in jaws. Jaws snap shut, stiff. Lower jaw hangs down. Left angle of the mouth drops. Child passes hand constantly over face (brain disease).

Mouth - Dry mouth. Foul, sour breath. Offensive breath in morning. Sour, bitter, bad taste in morning. Internal mouth, tongue and palate slimy, and feel raw and sore. Small aphthous ulcers in mouth and throat. Bloody saliva runs out at night. Itching of palate, Eustachian tube. Gums, swollen, white and bleeding. Teeth chatter. Toothache, worse cold, better warm drinks. Jaws contracted. Articulation and speech difficult.

Throat - Sensation of roughness, tightness and tension. Stitches into ear. Pharynx constricted. Acute catarrhal laryngitis. Spasmodic constriction of larynx with suffocating spells. Tickling in throat after waking in morning. Sore rawness in throat. Catarrhal hoarseness with scraping in throat. Tenacious mucus in upper part of trachea. Putrid taste in throat on coughing. Dark gray patches on right tonsil. Small ulcers in the throat, pain worse during empty swallowing. Diphtheria. Elongation and swelling of uvula.

Stomach - Weight and pain in stomach, worse eating. Severe pain in stomach from injury, worse least food. Ravenous hunger, especially about a day before an attack of dyspepsia. Region of stomach very sensitive to pressure (Bry., Ars.). Indigestion from alcohol. Disordered stomach from debauchery, from high living, from drugs, from sedentary habits. Indigestion, after business anxiety, from sedentary habits, night watching. Dyspepsia from drinking strong coffee. Cramps in stomach in morning and after eating. Sour taste and nausea in the morning. Food lies like a heavy knot in stomach. Epigastrium bloated with pressure as of a stone several hours after eating. Hiccough from overeating, from cold or hot drinks. Flatulence and heartburn. Sour, bitter belchings. Difficult belching of gas. Nausea and vomiting every morning, with depression of spirits. Nausea and vomiting with much retching. Nausea, better if he can vomit. Wants to vomit, but cannot. Vomiting of sour mucus, oily, greasy or black substances. Vomiting of greenish matter, undigested food, blood. Vomiting of bile with thirst, after anger. Motion sickness from riding in cars or seasickness.

Abdomen - Contraction of abdominal muscles. Bruised soreness of abdominal walls (Apis., Sulph.). Weakness of abdominal ring region. Bowels gripe here and there. Sore bowels, worse coughing and stepping. As of a hand about waist, clothes oppress it. Forcing in lower abdomen towards genitals. Intussusception, crampy, remittent pain in bowels. Gastroduodenal catarrh. Sense of goneness in the groins. Loud rumbling and gurgling in abdomen, in morning. Incarcerated flatus. Flatulent distention with spasmodic colic. Colic with upward pressure, causing short breath and desire for stool. Colic with cold hands and feet. Colic of brandy and coffee drinkers. Colic in nursing infants from stimulating food eaten by the mother (Cham.). Colic from suppressed hemorrhoidal flow, from uncovering. Strangulated hernia (Op.). Umbilical hernia of infants from constipation or crying.

Rectum - Constriction of rectum. Constant uneasiness in rectum. Irregular, peristaltic action. Constipation with frequent ineffectual urging or passing but small quantities at each attempt. Urging to stool felt throughout abdomen. Constipation, the harder he strains the harder it is to pass stool. Feeling as if part of stool remained. Sharp pain in rectum after stool. Frequent small evacuations. Dysentery, stools relieve pains for a time. Alternate constipation and diarrhea after abuse of purgatives. Diarrhea after a debauch, worse morning. Diarrhea after night watching, after overexertion of mind, after anger, after ginger or brandy. Diarrhea with jaundice (Dig.). Itching, blind hemorrhoids with ineffectual urging to stool. Burning pain in hemorrhoids, intolerable to least touch. Hemorrhoids very painful after drastic drugs. Hemorrhoids during pregnancy or after childbirth. Dragging pain at anus when not at stool. Prolapsed rectum. Sensations - As if something heavy fell into head. As if his head were immensely larger than his body. As if pressing a nail into brain into vertex, as if skull pressed asunder. Chest as if drawn together, as if something torn loose in chest. As if blood would be jerked out of veins. Navel as if drawn in. As if hernia would occur, as if everything in region of umbilicus were being shattered and torn. As of a band above knees, around body.

Stool - Stool is incomplete and unsatisfactory. First part of stool soft, last part hard. Scanty stool with much urging. Black, dark or brown stool. Hard and knotty stool, consisting of little balls. Stool often mixed with mucus and blood. Black, hard stool, often streaked with blood.

Male - Drawing pain in testicles and spermatic cords. Testes hard and retracted. Constricting pain in testes. Orchitis (Ham., Puls.). Sharp pain in testes. Heat in testicles. Hydrocele. Chronic prostatitis. Increase of smegma. Gonorrhea, thin discharge, with burning on urinating and frequent urging to stool. Spermatorrhea with dreams, backache, burning in spine, weakness and irritability. High sex drive. Cannot be in female society without having emission. Premature ejaculation. Bad effects of onanism, sexual excess. Emissions from high living. Impotency. Penis becomes relaxed during sex.

Female - Menses interrupted and beginning again. Menses irregular. Menses too early, too long, prolonged. Menses with black blood with fainting spells. Dysmenorrhea with pain in sacrum and constant urging to stool. Prolapse of uterus from straining or lifting. Cramping, in uterine region, causing her to double up and cry, must stay in bed. Contractive uterine spasms with discharge of clots. Metrorrhagia with sensation as if bowels wanted to move. Metrorrhagia at menopause. Metrorrhagia from high living. Irritation and inflammation of ovaries, caused by rich living, highly seasoned food, stimulating drinks. Uterine fibroid. Leucorrhea, fetid, staining yellow. Itching and tingling of vulva, causes masturbation. Sexual desire too strong with burning in vulva. Soreness across pubes. Threatened miscarriage. Profuse bleeding after miscarriage. Inefficient, weak labor pains. Retained placenta. Scanty, offensive lochia. Food - Hunger, yet aversion to food. Ravenous appetite after drinking beer. Craving stimulants, coffee, tobacco, drugs. Craves alcohol, beer, brandy. Craves pungent, bitter things and tonics. Craves meat, milk, gravy and spicy food. Loves fats and tolerates them well (Puls., opposite.). Aversion to bread, coffee, tobacco, meat. Bread has a bitter taste. Worse cold food, cold water. Worse from coffee. Worse alcohol, liquor, beer, wine. Worse over eating, condiments, stimulants, narcotics, drugs. Worse coffee, tobacco, purgatives. Intoxicated feeling, worse tobacco, alcohol, coffee. Artificial food disagrees and causes vomiting and purging. Coffee, milk, beer, water, don’t taste right. Thirst during chill, thirstless during heat.

Chest - Spasmodic constriction. Chest as if drawn together, at night in bed. Tightness across chest during coryza or chill. Intercostal neuralgia, worse lying on painful side. Spasms of chest from vapors of copper or arsenic. Itching and scraping under middle of sternum, causes cough. Sensation as if something were torn loose in chest during cough. Constitutions - Very particular, zealous persons inclined to get angry and excited or of a spiteful, malicious disposition. Ardent persons or disposed to anger, spite or deception, always irritable or impatient. Nervous, melancholic people, with indigestion, venous constitution with tendency to hemorrhoids. Thin, irritable, choleric persons with dark hair, who make great mental exertion or lead a sedentary life. Bilious temperament. Vigorous persons of tense tissue, ardent and irascible temperament disposition. Persons addicted to wine, coffee or pepper and condiments, who lead a sedentary life with much mental exertion. Debauches, thin, irritable, venous.

Heart - Angina pectoris, patient lies on knee with body leaning backwards, worse at night. Angina pectoris with loss of appetite and accumulation of gas in bowels. Angina pectoris from using coffee, tobacco or alcohol to excess. Heart feels tired. Distension, aching pains and anguish in region of heart and hypochondria. Dilatation of heart with nervous palpitations. Palpitations after stimulants, after eating, after wine, from mental emotions. Palpitations on lying down. Pulse rapid and irregular, at times intermitting.

Back - Sudden sharp pains in back when turning, with dull pain while sitting. Spinal irritation with sudden loss of power in legs. Lateral spinal sclerosis. Spinal anemia. Myelitis and early stages of locomotor ataxia. Crawling sensation along spine. Burning in spine, worse 3 a.m. to 4 a.m. Acute lumbago. Lumbar region feels bruised and lame. Lumbar ache, as if breaking, must sit up in order to turn in bed. Sacral region as if lame after childbirth. Bruised pain below scapulae. Sharp pains between scapulae. Cervical-brachial neuralgia, painfully stiff neck, pains down shoulder (right), worse touch. Drawing pain in muscles of neck. Torticollis from cold or nervous shock, fright.

Limbs - Chorea. Convulsions from abuse of alcohol. Progressive locomotor ataxia from alcoholism. Cramps and spasms of limbs. Cramps in calves and soles. Paresis of arms with shocks. Automatic motions of hand towards mouth. Partial paralysis from overexertion of getting soaked (Rhus-t.). Crawling and formica- tion in paralyzed parts. Legs numb, feel paralyzed. Sudden loss ofpower of arms and legs in the morning. Aching, drawing or bruised pains in limbs, worse motion and at night. Limbs heavy as lead. Rheumatism attacking mostly muscles of trunk and large joints. Legs stiff. Knee joints as if dry, cracking during motion. Drags his feet while walking, legs tremble, unsteady gait. Shooting from toes to thighs, worse after stool. Heat of hands, feet, yet they must be covered. Arms go to sleep, numb, stiff feeling. Varicose veins attributable to high living.

Sleep - Better after a nap, unless aroused. Y awning. Drowsy after meals and in early evening. Sleeplessness from abuse of coffee, wine, liquor, opium or tobacco. Sleepless from rush of ideas. Sleeplessnessfrom mental strain. Awakens in fright from least noise, as if someone were in room. Awakens at 3 a.m., lies awake for hours, with a rush of thoughts. Cannot sleep after 3 a.m. until towards morning. Weeping and talking during sleep. Amorous dreams. Dreams about exerting the mind. Anxious dreams. Dreams full of bustle and hurry, anxious. Dreams of being pursued by animals, dogs and cats. Dreams of quarrelling, of mutilations, of fatal accidents. Nightmare after a heavy supper or alcoholic beverages. Wakes feeling wretchedly.

Skin - Pale or yellowish color of skin. Jaundice. Blue mottled skin. Skin red and blotchy. Skin as if numb. Ecchymosis, blue spots. Goose bumps. Eruptions with burning, pricking, itching. Burning, pricking like fleabites. Miliary and pimpled eruptions. White miliary eruption. Acne. Furunculi. Urticaria with gastric derange- ment. Ulcers with elevated margins of a pale red color. Chilblains, burning itching. Tendency to boils. Abscesses.

Modalities - Better from a nap, if allowed to finish it in evening. Better moist air, damp, wet weather (Caust.). Better from free discharges. Better strong pressure, wrapping head, lying on sides, resting, frequent stretching. Better hot drinks, milk, fats. Worsefrom overeating, coffee, condiments, liquor, stimulants. Worse from high living, debauched, sedentary habits. Worse narcotics, drugs tobacco, purgatives. Worse anger, mental exertion, vexation, mental shock, wounded honor, disappointment of ambitions. Worse cold, open air, dry air, drafts, wind. Worse disturbed sleep, early morning. Worse noise, music, odors, after eating, yawning. Worse pressure of clothes at waist, touch, uncovering.

Teeth - Teeth seem too long. Sensation as if tooth were wrenched out. Tearing pain in teeth and jaws, worse cold drinks, better warmth. Stinging pain in decayed teeth. Pain in hollow tooth. Sharp pain in teeth on drawing in air or just after eating. Toothache, worse mental exertion, when reading or thinking. Toothache worse from exercise, better external warmth. Toothache with swollen face. Chattering of teeth. Gums swollen, white, and bleeding. Gumboils, which seem about to burst.

Tongue - First half of tongue clean, posterior covered with deep fur, white, yellow, cracked edges. Tongue black and dark red, cracked on edges. Tongue red, sore and yellow at base. Needle-like stitches at edges of tongue. Painful vesicles on tongue. Tongue seems heavy when talking. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning, on empty stomach, after dinner. Intoxicated feeling, worse morning, mental exertion, tobacco, alcohol, coffee, open air. Vertigo, brain and other objects turn in circle. Vertigo with black spell. Vertigo with momentary loss of consciousness. Dizzy and faint in a crowd or where many lights are burning. Vertigo from night watching and mental overexertion. Vertigo from opium, smell of flowers, gas, etheric oils, etc. Vision - Weakened power of accommodation from overexerting eyes. Diplopia from muscular asthenopia. Diplopia from paralytic strabismus. Blurred vision from overeating. Dim vision, can see better on cloudy day. Obscuration of vision in morning. Printed matter is seen with difficulty. Sees flashes from external canthi towards pupils, like a circle of fire, before headache. Sees streaks like lightning. Glittering appearance just outside of distinct field of vision. Floating black and grey points. COMMENTS - Clarke stated, under Brucea antidysenterica, how the bark of the tree was imported into Europe in mistake for Angustura. The tree from which the ignatia “beans” are obtained is unknown, but it is not doubted to be a strychnos, the seeds actually contain a larger proportion of strychnia than those of Nux-v. In poisoning cases, the most marked feature is the spasms and convulsions which cause death by arresting the respiratory movements. The general effect of the spasms was to cause opisthotonos and throwing the head back. In some, the body was spasmodically drawn sideways. Tetanus, differing from traumatic or idiopathic tetanus in that the spasms of the former are less continuous, do not invariably begin with the muscles of the jaws, but preferably in the lower limbs and are not accompanied by rise of temperature. Characteristic spasms. Spasms affect all the muscles, including the esophagus, stomach, intestines, uterus, bladder, rectum. Intestinal spasms after eating unripe fruit. Tetanic seizures with a drawn facial expression. Respiratory spasms. Asthmatic states. Asthma, coryza from drafts or air conditioning. A dry, persistent fatiguing cough that causes headache as if the skull would split. Cough, worse at night, after midnight. Clarke cured with Nux-v. many cases of bronchitis with copious moist rales and expectoration. Acute flus. Flu with muscle aches, toxic feeling. Gastric flus with cramps, spasms, irritability and nausea. High blood pressures, heart attacks, often from severe exhaustion. Hepatitis, cirrhosis of the liver with irritability. Kidney conditions, liver weakness. Crave fats (Nit-ac.), sweets, salt, spicy foods, coffee, tobacco, stimulants. Desires alcoholic drinks, but they aggravate. Pressure two or three hours after eating (Nux-m. and Kali-bi., have it immediately after). Severe cramps and spasms in the stomach and colon. Severe peristalsis. Colitis, ulcers, gas and bloating with irritability, depression, and frustration. Colic with alternating diarrhea with mucus in the stool and constipation with severe cramps and spasms. Irritability of the bladder and rectum. Constant urging and desire, very little passed. Tenesmus. Incontinence of urine or feces. Constipation with ineffectual urge. Alternate constipation and diarrhea. Sudden diarrhea, drives the patient out of bed. Involuntary diarrhea, can come on after a meal. Straining ceases as soon as the stool passes. Improvement for a short time after a stool. Portal stasis. Prolapse of rectum with constipation. Lack of bowel tone. Itching and burning hemorrhoids (Sulph.), worse from alcohol. Hernias in infants, or from lifting things. Incipient hernia. Inguinal and umbilical hernias. Clarke saw a case of strangulated hernia resolved by Nux-v. while preparations for an operation were in progress. Tendency to faint after diarrhea stools or after vomiting. Fainting from odors in a warm room after eating, after every labor pain. Epilepsy attacks during stool. Headaches with nondescript achiness, irritability, often associated with dietary errors. Hemorrhage. Metrorrhagia, menorrhagia. Uterine bearing down and prolapse, cramps at menstrual periods and pressure on bladder and rectum. Menses too early and profuse, dark flow, faints easily, irregular, cease flowing at nighttime. Cramping pains, cause nausea and fainting, twisting, moving about in abdomen, soreness across pubes, cramps in bladder. Nash gave a characteristic of the menses of Nux-v., “Menses a few days before the time and rather too copious or keeping on several days longer with complaints at the onset which remain until it is over.” Menses return at full moon. Pregnancy with irritability, hiccough, morning sickness, varicose veins, hemorrhoids. False labor pains. Irritability with labor pains (Cham.), with nausea or indigestion or vomiting (Sep.). Labor pains are violent and causes fainting. Lochia scanty offensive. Nipples sore, with a white spot in center. Tensive pains when nursing. Strong sexual desire in both sexes, even the slightest provocation excites sexual passion. May be impotent from overuse of drugs or excessive sexual activity. Keynote over sensitiveness. Morbid sensitiveness. Severe irritability. Languor, great nervous debility (as from sexual or other excesses). Over stimulation, particularly in sedentary people. Trembling, excitement with trembling. Locomotor ataxia. Hemiplegia. Paralysis, after a stroke, parts cold, numb, emaciated. Sleeplessness, from excitement, anger or resentment. Wakes at 3 a.m. and lies awake for hours. Falls asleep when it is time to rise and feels heavy and unrefreshed. Sleep is unattainable except from a stimulant. Symptoms are better after undisturbed sleep, worse when sleep is disturbed. Chilliness. Cannot get warm in bed at night. Coldness of the whole body with blue hands and skin. Cold, moist hands with cold tip of nose. Repugnance to cold or cold air. Chilly on least movement, from being uncovered, must be covered in every stage of fever, chill, heat or sweat. H. C. Allen noted that in the fever there is great heat, whole body burning hot, face red and hot, yet patient cannot move or uncover without being chilly. Boenninghausen’s keynote is “Feels worse in morning, soon after walking, also after mental exertion after eating and in cold air.” Worse cold, dry weather. Worse from music. General toxicity, usually from addictions to drugs, stimulants, and strong foods. Bilious affects, ailments due to high living. Alcoholism. Rage when drunk. Drug withdrawal (with Aven.). Hangovers (Ran-b., Coff.). Toxic drugged feeling, particularly in the morning. Ambitious personality, impatient, irritable. Craves stimulants. Very competitive from a young age, aggressive. Hyper or over active children, but purposeful (unlike Med.). Robust, energetic, passion behind a quick intellect. Often from an early sibling comparison (Lyc.). Career and work oriented, can be workaholics. Not sentimental. Stress and tension lead to over sensitivity, weakness. Anxious, overreact, never satisfied. Fear of failure, of not being successful. Worry. Suicidal depression. Homicidal, suicidal impulse, insanity. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Wine, coffee, Aeon., Bell., Camph., Cham., Cocc., Op., Pal., Plat., Stram., Thuj. (ineffectual desire to pass water). It antidotes: Narcotic, drastic and vegetable remedies. Bad effects of anomalies on foods, e.g., ginger, nutmeg, pepper and so-called “hot ” medicines, alcohol, Merc, (tremors), Mez. (neuralgia), ether, Thuj. (urination). Compare: (1) In tetanus, Piero., Verin., Thebin., Cic., Hy-ac., Bell., Aeon., Phys., Phyt., Cur., Camph. (2) Cerebrospinal affections, Pic-ac. (3) Fainting in nervous women, Ign., Nux-m., Mosch. (4) Gastric troubles, Bism., Ars., Kreos., Lyc., Puls., Carb-v. (Carb., v. often follows Nux- v. in ill effects of debauchery). (5) Asthma, Zing., Carb-v., Lyc., Nat-s. (6) Paralysis of sphincters, Sep., Bell., Sulph. (6) Bad temper before and during menses, Cham., Mag-m., Sep. (Lyc., before menses). (7) Wakes 3 a.m. and cannot get to sleep, Kali-c., Ars., Calc., Sep. (8) Night watching effects, sensitiveness, effects of noise, traveling by land or sea, umbilical hernia, Cocc. (9) Fear of losing senses, Calc., Lyc., Sulph. (10) Desire to kill love ones, Hep., Ars. (11) Fainting or faints after every evacuation, Dig., Nux-m. (12) Hemorrhoids, Aesc., Ham. (13) Leucorrhea staining yellow, Agn., Carb-an., Chel. (14) Impotence from abuse, Agn.. Calc., Sulph. (15) Stricture of rectum, Nat-m., Op. Compatible after: Carb-v., Ars., Ip., Mag-m., Phos., Sep., Sulph. Compatible before: Bry., Puls., Sulph. Incompatible: Zinc. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Great soreness and tenderness in region of liver, with pain in right shoulder. Liver sore, enlarged, sticking pain. Sharp pain in region of liver, worse from contact or motion. Pressure and stinging pains. Weak liver from bad diet, meat, fats, spices, alcohol, etc. Gallstone colic. Throbbing pain as from hepatic abscess. Hepatitis from bad food or water. Jaundice from anger. Jaundice from habitual use of alcohol. Cirrhosis from alcohol abuse. Enlarged liver of alcoholics. Toxic liver from drugs, chemicals and alcohol. Lungs - Shallow and oppressed breathing. Awakened every night by intolerable sense of suffocation. Dyspnea in morning and evening. Loud, snoring, during sleep. Difficult breathing, from accumulation of gas. Dyspnea during pregnancy. Asthma from disordered stomach. Asthma with fullness in stomach, worse in mornings or after eating. Asthma with feeling as if clothing were too tight, better belching. Asthma from spasmodic constriction. Yellow, grey, cold mucus. Sour or sweetish expectoration. Bright red blood. Hemop- tysis from anger, suppressed hemorrhoidal flow. Pneumonia with catarrhal irritation. Pneumonia, after suppression of hemorrhoidal flow, when hepatization occurs, from becoming chilled. Pneumonia of the elderly, also of children. Pneumonia in sick people compelled to lie upon back.

Kidneys - Pressure, burning and heat in region of kidneys, in nephritis. Nephritis from abuse of liquors. Severe sharp pains in region of left kidney, worse rising from seat and motion. Kidney colic (right), extending to genitals and legs with dribbling urine. Spasmodic strangury, after beer. Painful ineffectual urging to urinate. Frequent calls, urinates little and often. Tenacious mucus passes with the urine, without pain. Urine pale, later thick, whitish, purulent, reddish, with brick-dust sediment. Hematuria from suppressed hemorrhoidal flow or menses (Ip., Ter.). Urine dribbles in old men with enlarged prostate or gonorrhea.

Bladder - Catarrhal cystitis. Cystitis after suppression of menses or hemorrhoidal flow. Pressure on bladder before urinating. Itching burning in region of neck of bladder in morning in bed. Irritable bladder from spasmodic sphincter. Ineffectual urging, spasmodic and strangury. Paralysis of bladder. Spasms of bladder from undue use of stimulants. Spasms of bladder, especially if caused by sexual excesses. Burning and tearing pain in neck of bladder, itching in urethra, during urination. Frequent scanty urination when becoming warm from working, can’t empty bladder. Involuntary urination when laughing, coughing, sneezing. Nocturnal and diurnal bedwetting. Vesical calculi. Breasts - Nipples, sore, white spot in center. Tensive pain when nursing. Nipples painful during suckling with little or no soreness or rawness. Painless gathering of milk in breast from not nursing the child. Causations - Ill effects of alcohol, drugs, spices, stimulants, sexual excess.

Cough - Cough of nervous or gastric origin. Cough at night, preventing sleep. Dry cough, after midnight, violent in morning before rising. Dry cough with rattling of mucus. Cough after motion or mental effort. Cough with sensation as if something torn loose in the chest. Tight, dry, hacking cough, at times with bloody expectoration. Cough brings on bursting headache and bruised pain in epigastric region. Cough with sensation as if something were torn loose in chest. Cough with vomiting or bleeding from nose or mouth. Cough after yawning. Desire to eat during cough.

Perspiration - Sour perspiration, on one side of body. Rather light sweat. Cold, clammy sweat on face. Odor of sweat, musty straw. Sweats during sleep, disappears on waking. Sweats after midnight and in morning.

Temperature - Chilliness alternating with heat. Cold stage predominates. Chills with backache on slightest motion. Chills on being uncovered, must be covered in every stage of fever. Chill with thirst, and heat without thirst. Fever with internal chilliness. Fever with anxiety and restlessness. Body burning hot, especially the face.yet cannot move or uncover without feeling chilly. Warm on uppermost side, on lying down. Dry heat of the body. Paroxysms in morning. Excessive rigor with blueness of fingernails. Aching in limbs and back, and gastric symptoms.

name: Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis
author: Murphy
constitution: Chills. Constipation. Fevers, bilious. Fevers, remittent. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Vomiting.
keynote: PHARMACY - nyct. Nyctanthes arbor tristis. Sad tree. Arbortristis. Paghala tree. Sephalika. Harsinghar. Night- Jasmine of India. N. O. Jasminacee. Verbenaceae. Forests of Central India. Tincture of fresh leaves, collected March to April. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - nyct. Nyctanthes arbor tristis. Sad tree. Arbortristis. Paghala tree. Sephalika. Harsinghar. Night- Jasmine of India. N. O. Jasminacee. Verbenaceae. Forests of Central India. Tincture of fresh leaves, collected March to April. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Chills. Constipation. Fevers, bilious. Fevers, remittent. Rheumatism. Sciatica. Vomiting.

HERBAL - Nyctanthes is a small tree of the Jasmine family, having brilliant, highly fragrant flowers, white and yellow, whichdonotexpand until evening and which fall off about sunrise. During the day the tree lose all its brightness and hence is called “The Sad Tree.” “Nyctanthes” means “Night-flowering.” S. C. Ghose gave an account of the medicinal properties of this plant. He used it extensively in cases of bilious and remittent fevers, rheumatism and sciatica and the constipation of children. Nyctanthes is “a bitter tonic and expectorant and a mild purgative.” In the fever there is thirst before and during chills, and bitter vomiting at close of chill. Not much sweat.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ghose, who made a short proving of it, compared Nyct. with Eup-per. Bilious and obstinate remittent fevers, sciatica, rheumatism. Constipation of children. MIND - Anxious and restless. Depression. Food - Insatiable thirst, before and during chill and fever.

Head - Dull headache.

Mouth - Tongue coated.

Stomach - Burning sensation, better cold application. Constant nausea may or may not be present. Bilious vomiting occurs every time he takes a drink.

Rectum - Constipation. Profuse, bilious stool with nausea.

Liver - Tenderness of liver. Stitches in liver region, which is very sensitive to touch.

Kidneys - High-colored urine.

Temperature - Thirst, before and during chill and heat. Bitter vomiting at close of chill. Sweat not generally marked. COMMENTS - Dr. Sarat Chandra Ghose of Calcutta, India recorded his observations of clinical experiences and provings made about the years 1898-1903. The first case noted a woman at the house of Babu I. C. Chakrabarti, B. A., Head Master. Town School, Midnapore, was suffering from a complicated attack of intermittent fever. No medicine could give her any relief. In another case, a boy, aged 7, was suffering from intermittent fever for some time. The fever came on every evening at 7 p.m. Violent thirst during chill and fever. Bilious vomiting. Constipated bowels. Ghose prescribed Nyct. tincture in five drop doses thrice daily. The boy was cured within three days. The third case, a woman, aged 68, was suffering from remittent fever for ten days. Ghose took her under treatment on the eleventh day. The son of Babu Sarada Kanta Chatterjee was suffering from a malignant type of ague with great constipation. He was treated by some allopaths and native Kabirajes for nearly five months, but no perceptible improvement was wrought by the administration of their remedies. He was eventually placed under Ghose’s treatment. The son of Mr. M. M. Ray. Deputy Magistrate and Collector of Midnapore, was suffering from remittent fever, associated with bilious symptoms for five days. On the sixth day the boy was placed under Ghose’s treatment. The son of Mr. G. C. Dutt, Deputy Magistrate of Midnapore, was suffering from an attack of intermittent fever for some time. The fever came on every morning at about 7 a.m. Violent thirst was present during all the stages. Bilious vomiting came on in the hot stage. Constipated bowels. Ghose prescribed Nyct. tincture in three-drops doses. The boy was all right within three days. Nyct. proved an excellent remedy for the symptoms and Ghose treated nearly 120 Nyctanthes arbor tristis cases with this medicine alone and an overwhelming majority of them were cured. REFERENCES - Anshutz. Boericke. Clarke.

PHARMACY - oak-b. Oak. Quercus robur. Red female flowers are gathered and put in a bowl of sunlit water for several hours. The water is strained and prepared as medicine. Historical dose: Take two drops from the stock bottle into a one ounce dropper bottle (add brandy or alcohol, if this bottle will be used for days or weeks). This is the dosage bottle, take a few drops straight into the mouth or as needed in a little water or juice.

HOMEOPATHIC - The remedy Oak-b. belongs to Bach's group of Despondency and Despair, along with Crb-a-b„ Will-b, Star- b-b., Sw-ch-b., Elm-b„ Pine-b. and Lar-b. States of stoic perseverance and willpower in the face of hardship. Mental/emotional and physical weariness. Over-work and strength of will may lead to physical strain and undue stress. Older people may become bent from over-exertion and one-sided activity. Great determination to not succumb to invalidity. Avoids necessary rest and restful recreation, even though both may be of vital need. Psychosomatic diseases from the continued rule of willpower over the need for healthfill diversion and renewal (Cent-b.). MIND - Self-discipline, seriousness of intention. Tendency to over-work. Loyalty. Focused on completing tasks. Perseverance in duties, even though strength and vitality may be failing. Unceasing disappointments or lack of rewards despite efforts made will increase resolve to struggle on with great strength of will and ever rene wed hope. Inner weariness and lack of motivation. REFERENCES - Bach.

HERBAL - All the members of the Ocimum genus are aromatic. The Sweet or Common Basil, Ocimum basilicum, is one of the best known. Mure reported that it is used in Brazil as a specific for diseases of the kidneys, bladder and urethra. P. C. Majumdar added that Ocimum sanctum is the sacred tulsi of India and that the Kabirajes use it in diseases of the liver and bilious remittent fevers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Oci. is useful in diseases of kidneys, uterus, bladder and urethra. Kidney pain with violent vomiting every fifteen minutes. Wrings one's hands and moans and cries all the time. Kidney colic, especrally on the right side. Pronounced symptoms of kidney stones. Uric acid diathesis. Red sand in the urine. Red urine with brick-dust sediment after the attack. The urine may be saffron color or thick, purulent with an intolerable smell of musk. Febrile condition, shivering, sweating and with congestive headache. Vomiting, cries tossing about and wringing hands. Arthritis. Allergies. Pain in the left testicle. Prolapsed vagina. Vulvarcongestion. Breast congestion. Swelling of inguinal glands and breasts. Excessive sensitiveness of the breasts and pain on nursing. MIND - Difficulty concentrating. Confused state. Anxiety.

Head - Stinging pain in the head. Pain in the head, as if a nail were being driven in, ameliorated by pressure. Pulsating, throbbing headache. Headaches followed by shivering.

Eyes - Blurred vision.

Ears - Boil on the meatus of the right ear. Noise heard painfully in the ears.

Mouth - Lips dry, face red. Tongue furred, yellow, yellowish-white with a brown spot in the center. Toothache on the right, ame liorated by pressing the teeth together. Nose - Nasal congestion.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended, painful on the right side during menses. Glands in the groin swollen. Edema on the right side of the testes or labia. Breasts - Constrictive tension in the breasts. Breasts feel full and tense, itching. Neuralgic pains in the breast. Nipples painful and sensitive to the touch. Congestive pains in the breasts as after nursing. Puerperal mastitis.

Rectum - Constipation with dry, hard, evil-smelling, yellow or greenish stools. Diarrhea several times a day.

Urine - High acidity, formation of spike crystals of uric acid. Brick-dust red or yellow sediment. Red sand in saffron colored urine. \Jrinefoul-smelling with odor of musk. Turbid, thick, purulent, bloody urine. Urinary complaints with proteinuria. Scanty urine, which aggravates. Vertigo - Vertigo on rising and on sitting down. COMMENTS - Majumdar related the case of a medical man, 45. Majumdar was sent for at 4 a.m. one morning and found the patient in great agony, pain in upper part of region of right kidney, extending downwards and forwards to pubes. Constant vomiting, bilious, acid tossing about without any relief. After Calc., Lyc., Sep., Sars. and Berb. had been given in vain, Oci. 3x gave immediate relief and no other remedy was required. Majumdar also noted the case of a man, 50, with excruciating pain in his left kidney, for which he had received opium under allopathic treatment without relief. Majumdar saw the patient on the sixth day of the attack. The suffering was extreme, vomiting of bile, constant nausea, bowels constipated. Oci. 3x, one drop every three hours, speedily gave relief, and two days later two small uric acid stones were passed. There was no recurrence. Clarke published two cases. The first concerned a man, 27, who was seized with violent pains of a leaden character in the right side of the abdomen, every three or four weeks. The pains commenced in morning, lasted twelve to fifteen hours. For four hours from commencement of attack the pain steadily increased, culminating in vomiting, first of sour fluid, then slime, then a fluid like coffee. After the vomiting there was some relief of pain. Urine contained no sediment. The attacks had lasted seven years. At first they began in the evening. There was a history of epilepsy in the family, and as a child the patient had three fits. Oci. 200c, one dose, was given and there were no more attacks for about two years. On their recurrence Oci. failed to control them, but Dios, tincture succeeded. In the second case, a woman, 24, had severe pain in her right flank shooting around to her back. Frequent urination, sometimes depositing clots. Terebe. 3c gave some relief, but it was not permanent. Oci. 200c, a few globules in water, a teaspoonful every two days, rapidly relieved the symptoms and cleared up the case. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In kidney colic, Berb., Dios., Coloc., Calc., Lyc. (2) Berb.. Hedeo., Lyc., Urt-u. (3) Pareir., Coloc., Tab. (4) In painful breasts, Lac-c., Bor. (5) Crot-h., Phel. (6) Prolapsed vagina, Staph. Followed well by: Dios. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian. Phatak.

Male - Pain in the testes. Tenderness, heat and swelling of the left testicle. Increase, then diminution of sexual desire. Absence of erection.

Female - Menses late, short or abundant. Whitish-yellow leucorrhea. Vulvitis. Vulva swollen, darting pain in labia majora. Vaginal prolapse. Salpingitis. Food - Lack of appetite. Desire for cold drinks during fever.

Chest - Chest painful on right side. Dry cough in the evening and early morning. Copious sputum. Constitutions - Allergic constitutions. Psoric constitutions. Neuro-arthritic temperament.

Skin - Herpes. Eczematous eruptions. Stomach - Belching, hiccoughs. Nausea.

Modalities - Better in a room, in rainy, humid weather. Worse in the morning, from cold, right side.

Kidneys - Pyelonephritis. Cramps in kidneys. Kidney colic on the right side with vomiting ever quarter of an hour with calling out. Restlessness and groaning. Pronounced symptoms of kidney stones, especially of right side. Stones in the bladder. Tenesmus of the bladder. Sore pain in ureters. Burning pain in the urethra during urination. Urine abundant, burning.

Temperature - Shivers, fever and lack of thirst. Profuse sweating with strong odor. Fever of the tertian or quartan type.

full:
PHARMACY - oci-s. Ocimum sanctum. Holy Basil. Tulsi. N. O. Labiate. Brazil. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Asthma. Bites. Bronchitis. Broncho-pneumonia. Catarrh. Colds. Constipation. Cough. Delirium. Diarrhea. Headache. Hiccoughs. Influenza. Intermittent fevers. Leucorrhea. Memory, weak. Ophthalmia. Ozaena. Pneumonia. Ringworm. Ulcers. Urethritis.

HERBAL - Ayurvedic physicians like Cha- raka, Harita, Chakradatta, Bangasena, and others have found Ocimum sanctum very efficacious in cough, cold, catarrh, nose affections, ozaena, scorpion bites, remittent and intermittent fevers and constipation. The medicated oil is used as drops, in the ears in earache and purulent discharges, and into the nose in ozaena. The leaves, with lime juice, are rubbed over ringworm. The seeds are mucilaginous and used as a diuretic in scanty urine and cough. The leaves are expectorant, and given, sweetened with honey, in chronic cough, especially in children. The expressed juice of the herb has traditionally been administered to children who are attacked with catarrh, cough with fever and constipation, with very gratifying and beneficial results.

HOMEOPATHIC - Ocimum canum is a species of this shrub which grows abundantly in Brazil. Dr. Mure, who proved and introduced it, noted that it is largely used in Brazil “as a specific for diseases of the kidneys, bladder, and urethra.” He gave a short list of nineteen symptoms which are partly clinical and partly pathogenetic. Dr. Mure's experience was several times verified by several noted homeopaths. Drs. Pramada Prasanna Biswas of Pabna, Bengal, N. Sinha and N. C. Ghosh have made provings of this drug. MIND - Memory weak. Forgetfulness. Mistakes in talking. Difficulty concentrating. Prostration and drowsiness. Patient falls asleep while answering questions. Child is peevish and cries, does not like to lie in bed. Irregular delirium, disturbed.

Head - Headache as from a nail. Heavy, throbbing pain as if thousand nails were being driven into it, relieved by pressure. Giddiness of head, worse while walking, likes to keep quiet, relieved by wrapping up the head. Heat on the vertex, relieved by pouring cold water on the head or by fanning.

Eyes - Eyes red. Pain in the eyes, lachrymation, eye complaints due to nasal catarrh. Ophthalmia. Foggy vision. Mist before eyes, especially when fixing them on something.

Ears - Watery secretion from the ear. Offensive pus from the ears. Ears painful due to nasal catarrh. Hot flushes come out from the ears. Noises in the ears, loud sound appears to be very painful. Shortness of hearing.

Nose - Nasal obstruction. Nasal catarrh associated with frequent sneezing, white or yellow secretions. Coryza. Watery discharge from the nose. Nostrils ulcer ated. Nosebleeds.

Face - Face red or pale with reddish hue. Flushed and hot.

Mouth - Lips bright red. Lips dry and black as if burnt. Watery salivation or spitting from the mouth. Putrid and bitter taste in mouth. Ulcer, aphthae in mouth. Ulcer in mouth and tongue of children. The tongue is bright red or its edges and sides are red and the middle portion is deeply coated. Toothache, better pressing the gums together, warmth, pressure.

Throat - Pain in the throat while walking or during cough. Pain and difficulty in swallowing. Redness, ulceration of throat. Glairy phlegm. Enlargement of tonsils. Hoarseness. Voice gets changed. Vertigo - Vertigo on rising. COMMENTS - Oci-s. has an assured place in the treatment of influenza and in common nasal catarrh. Remittent fever associated with cough, cold or diarrhea, pneumonia, broncho-pneumonia, bronchitis and asthma. Typhoid fever or fever associated with delirium, comatose condition, prostration, and falls into slumber or drowsiness while answering questions (Bapt.). Fever in influenza, associated with cough, acute pains in the body, bone pains, soreness of the muscles, and terrible headache (Eup-per.). Fevers associated with cough, cold and diarrhea, especially in children. Fevers prevalent in rainy season, winter or spring. Intermittent fever. Fever with thirst or absence of thirst. Fever comes on in the afternoon with extreme chilliness, with shivering. Chilliness, even when exposed to the sun. Hands and the feet become cold and do not become warm easily. Numbness and tingling in hands and feet. Extreme heat and flushes of heat felt over the face and eyes during hot stage. Burning sensation in the palms of hands and soles of feet, relieved by cold breeze or placing cold water on the head. Sweat with heat. Heat, sweat, and chilliness may appear alternately. Sweat, delirium, drowsiness or comatose condition. Remittent fevers of children, fever during dentition period, diarrhea and worm affections (Cina.). Wormcomplaints of children, fretful and peevish, start from sleep, and do not allow the physician to examine them. The children become awfully peevish, always cry, become quiet while they are being carried (Cham.). Aching pains, in the feet and legs. Pains are felt all over the body. Offensive and filthy odor. Putrefaction. Contagious and infectious diseases caused by bacteria or bacilli. Terrible headache. Headache due to congestion, common cold, influenza or fever. Headache relieved by application of cold water on the head or by fanning the head. Better from keeping quiet or wrapping the head with a cloth, worse while walking or by motion. Face is flushed and hot. lips are red and parched, eyes are drowsy. Pain in the throat, felt while swallowing, coughing or sneezing. Redness inside the throat, both tonsils are enlarged. Offensive smell comes out of the mouth, offensive salivation. Tongue is red or reddish and shining at the edges with yellow or brown coating in the middle (Bapt.). Aphthae. Putrid ulcer in the mouth and teeth. Toothache, with terrible pains, worse at night, from touch or cold. Eyes congested, red, with lachrymation, especially in cases of the common cold. Watery discharges and sticky discharges. Ophthalmia, ophthalmia neonatorum. Earache and purulent discharges from the ear. Shortness of hearing. Difficult respiration. Asthma, the patient cannot lie on the back. Bends forward and supports the head with the hands, the elbows resting on the knees or leans forward and puts the head on the hands lain flat on such support (Aral., Lob., Blatta.). Asthma of children. Gastric and intestinal catarrh, with inflammation of the intestinal mucous membrane, fever and diarrhea. Pain in the region of liver and spleen. Abdomen distended, distension does not abate in spite of stools passed. After gurgling in the stomach, copious watery and offensive stools appear. Diarrhea with fever and cold, cough, pneumonia, broncho-pneumonia and bronchitis. Involuntary stools. Irregular, long lasting menses. Leucorrhea. Uterine complications after delivery. Terribly offensive lochia, of unnatural color, long lasting. Discharge mixed with mucus, is pus-like and like washing of fish. Ocimum sanctum is supposed to drive away mosquitoes; it may prevent malarial fevers if cultivated near a house. REFERENCES Ghose.

Stomach - Want of appetite. Thirstlessness during chill. Eructations, Hiccough.

Abdomen - Abdomen distended. Heaviness in abdomen. Griping pain in the abdomen. Pain is felt over the region of liver and spleen. Pain in the right iliac region. Hepatic pain. Gurgling sound can be felt on pressure.

Rectum - Constipation. Incomplete stools. Diarrhea with high fever. Diarrhea during rainy season and autumn. Stools liquid, copious, watery, very offensive. Yellowish or greenish liquid stools. Mucus or bloody or streaked with blood. Involuntary stools during high fever.

Male - Troublesome erections. Sexual desire increased or decreased. Impotency.

Female - Menses too late. Metrorrhagia. Leucorrhea alternating with bloody discharge. Leucorrhea offensive, profuse, white, yellow. Metritis after childbirth. Profuse bloody discharges after delivery. Lochia offensive, profuse, fetid, lasts for a long period. Sexual desire diminished or increased.

Chest - Pains are felt on both sides of the chest, worse while coughing or sneezing. Pleuritic pains in the chest. Pain is felt in the middle of sternum. Patient cannot lie quiet in bed.

Limbs - Aching pains, better from pressure. Lungs - Asthmatic attack, wheezing and rattling sound felt in the chest. Asthma better from bending head forward, rocking. Asthma of infants and children. Croupy cough. Hacking cough, profuse expectoration.

Skin - Skin disease.

Kidneys - Kidney colic. Urethritis. Desire to urinate off and on. Burning in the urethra while urinating. Yellow like saffron, urine. Discharge of mucus with urine. Involuntary urination of the children.

Perspiration - Offensive sweats.

Temperature - Chills and fever. Influenza. Remittent and intermittent fevers. Bilious, continued fever. Quartan fever, tertian fevers. Typhus, typhoid fever.

Insanity. Leprosy. Menstrual, convulsions. Nausea. Priapism. Puerperal, convulsions. Sciatica. Speech, lost. Status, epilepticus. Stomatitis. Strokes. Tetanus. Tongue, swollen. Tongue, ulcerated. Tympanites. Vertigo.
