HOMEOPATHIC - Hale said Pen. is reputed to be curative in catarrh and in diarrhea. A scalded sensation in the tongue is one of the symptoms. A sense of levitation was also produced. The symptoms proceed from above downward. Chronic disorders of mucus membranes with irritability. Chronic post-nasal catarrh, chronic pharyngitis, mucus membrane purple and relaxed. Coryza with rawness and wet feeling in nose. Hypersecretion of mucus membranes. Posterior sinuses feel moist and raw, nose and ears feel full. Throat feels raw. Aphonia, hoarseness, relaxed vocal cords. Trouble in pharyngeal vault and Eustachian tube. Itching of anus and burning in rectum. General malaise, headache, weakness of limbs inability to attend to business. MIND - Dull, discouraged and despondent. Mind is dull, study impossible. Inability to attend to business.

Head - Dull, heavy headache with heat and soreness in sacrum. Catarrhal aching in forehead. Weight in sinciput. Itching of hairy scalp.

Eyes - Inner, upper tarsal borders itch and burn. Full sensation in supra-orbital region. On closing eyes, felt like floating, vertigo. Food - Appetite increased.

Ears - Ringing and singing in both ears.

Nose - Constant wet feeling in nose, which no amount of blowing will relieve. Discharge thick, pus-like, streaked with blood. Posterior sinuses feel raw as if denuded of epithelium. Post-nasal catarrh of puberty.

Mouth - Prickling, burning sensation on tongue as though scalded. Increased flow of saliva (bloody).

Stomach - Disgust and nausea. Forcible eructation and ejection of small quantities of odorless flatus. COMMENTS - Pen. was proved by Dr. D. B. Morrow (twice), Dr. Scudder and a young man, who all took substantial doses. The majority of the symptoms are Morrow's, including the catarrhal symptoms, which have been verified in practice. “A peculiar wet feeling in sinuses as though a violent coryza would set in,” but it did not, the secretion became thickened and pus-like but not increased. The same “wet feeling” was experienced at the same time in trachea and bronchi, which passed from above down as if coryza would set in, followed by a slight feeling of constriction in the chest, which also passed from above down. The next day the nose felt stuffed. The third day the first symptoms were repeated and the discharge became thick, pus-like and streaked with blood and there was an odor in the nose as if from an open sore. Scudder had “fullness in nose and ears.” Morrow experienced itching at anus, hemorrhoids and pains and sensations in rectum, sacrum and sacroiliac joints, his first proving cured “heat and soreness in sacrum with a dull, heavy headache.” Morrow reported two cures, the first, Miss P.. 17, blonde, had severe cough of several weeks' duration. Worse by talking or singing. Frothy, greenish sputa. Puls, and Phos. failed, Pen. soon cured. The second concerned a decrepit old woman, 75, suffered from eczema for twelve years. Previous winter cured of asthma (probably from suppressed eczema) with Sulph. 100,000c. Now paretic right side, for which Phos. was given. But Phos. did not relieve a loose, continual, rattling cough, caused by tickling at bifurcation of bronchi with raising much thick, frothy, greenish sputa. Pen. pellets quickly cured. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Pen. often follows Puls., Sang., Hydr. (2) Sedum acre.. Hydrang. (3) In scalded sensation on tongue and in catarrh, Sang. (4) Catarrh, Puls. (5) Levitation. Cann-i., Cocc., Ph- ac., Stict., Sulph., Thuj. (6) Jerking of limbs, Meny., Psor. (4)

Itching of anus, hemorrhoids with aching in sacrum and sacroiliac joint. Crawling in lower rectum as though a worm tried to escape.

Kidneys - Dull aching in kidneys. Bladder sore to pressure. Urine increased, alkaline, burning along urethra when urinating.

HERBAL - Throughout the Aztec empire, avocado was used as both a food and medicine. All parts of the tree was used for medicinal purposes. Native Guatemalans have long used the avocado to stimulate hair growth, repel worms, and treat diarrhea. The fruit is highly nutritious, containing calcium, phosphorus, iron, and vitamins. Avocado is rich in potassium and vitamins B6 and E, which can help in relieving stress and sexual problems, such as infertility and impotence. Although many believe that avocados are fattening, they contain a high amount of mono-unsaturated fats, particularly oleic acid, making it a powerful antioxidant foot. The oleic acid offers protection against heart disease, strokes, and cancer. There is some evidence to suggest the fruit can help lower cholesterol. The fats are also easily digestible and contain anti-fungal and antibacterial actions that, when pureed, make an excellent food forinvalids, convalescents and sick children. In some parts of Africa, the fruit pulp is used as a baby food. Externally, the fruit soothes the skin, helps heal wounds, and stimulates hair growth. Avocado oil nourishes and softens rough, dry, or flaking skin. Stimulates the production of collagen, helping reduce the appearance of wrinkles. Avocado leaves have anti-tussive properties and increase biliary secretions. The leaves and bark are used to treat diarrhea, gas. and bloating, as well as to relieve coughs, liver obstructions, and clearing out uric acid. They can also stimulate menstruation and induce abortion. The rind can expel worms. The seed is rich in tannins, and used as a cloth dye or to treat diarrhea. The oil has been used to help reduce gout pain. A decoction reduces arthritis pains. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Per. is taken from the glairy and stringy mucus containing the virus of whooping cough. Introduced by Clarke for the treatment of whooping cough and other spasmodic coughs. In Clarke's experience, it agrees well with all other whooping cough remedies and when their specific indications appear he gave them in alternation or alone. Per. is an unproved remedy, except in the sense that every case of the disease is a proving. Can be used a preventive in whooping cough or to treat the disease. Spasmodic coughing attacks. Dry cough, spasmodic of different intensity, comes suddenly. Repeated coughing fits which end in vomiting. Increasing jerking cough with cyanosis, with a phase of apnea followed by the taking of respiration. Predisposition to tuberculosis. Asthenia. Convulsions. Muscularjerkings. Neuro-motor deficit. Polyneuritis. Paresis. Paralysis. Myelitis. Hemorrhage from the meninges. Anorexia. Sleepy and in a state of confusion. Troubles of conscience. MIND - Psycho-motor or sensorial troubles. State of confusion. Restlessness. Troubles of conscience. Cries, tears.

Eyes - Chemosis. Tears. Coryza with hacking cough.

Throat - Laryngo-spasms. Spasm of the glottis. Intense tickling in throat causing cough. COMMENTS - Clarke gave the 30c every four hours in all cases of whooping cough, suspected or defined, as a matter of routine, and as a rule it quickly assumed control of the case and did all that was necessary. Dr. Sheppard wrote about giving Per. for whooping cough prophylaxis. “Pertussin 30c acts well as a protective against whooping cough. 364 cases were given daily doses of pertussin for two weeks after contact. “Many of these cases were seen in the day nurseries under my care and not one of these children developed the disease. As twoof the nurseries took in children from two weeks old, it was most essential that they should not be exposed to the infection, and it was gratifying to find that Pertussin was a means of preventing the spread of the disease. “In another private school, a child came back after the holidays with a fully developed whooping cough, in spite of carrying a doctor's certificate as being free from any infectious disease. All the twelve children in her class were infected. “The headmistress, on my advice, gave Pertussin 30 four doses hourly, and the children had the mildest attack of whooping cough she had ever seen. She was grateful to Homoeopathy, and to the nosode Pertussin for turning so serious a disease into a mild one.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Dros., Bell., Cor-r., Cupr., Napht., Meph., Passi., Coc-c., Mang-p. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Julian.

HOMEOPATHIC - Petrolatum (vaseline) consists of hydrocarbons of the paraffin series, obtained from residues after distillation of lighter oils from cmde petroleum, or deposited from crude petroleum on standing. Petroleum is made by agitating the liquid commercial petroleum with sulphuric acid and then rectifying the portion which this acid does not act upon. It is “a light oily fluid, colorless or of a pale straw color and strong characteristic naphthalic smell. Dropped on white paper it evaporates completely, leaving no greasy stain.” Petr, was proved by Hahnemann and is one of his leading anti-psorics, closely related to Graph. It is suited to long lasting, deep- seated, wasting diseases, lingering gastric and intestinal troubles with or without ulceration. In Clarke's experience, no remedy corresponds to more cases of chlorosis in young girls, with or without ulceration of the stomach. The disorders met with in petroleum extractors and refiners are diseases of the skin and subcutaneous tissue, depressed nutrition, anemia, dyspepsia, nerve troubles, irritability insomnia, respiratory disorders. In addition to these is a kind of intoxication. Petr, chiefly acts on the skin, especially folds, scalp, face and genitals, sweat and oil glands. Cracked skin. Unhealthy granulations after severe bums. Discharges are thick, pumlent, yellowish green. Car, train or seasickness. Ailments from riding in cars, carriages or ships. Long- lasting complaints follow mental states- fright, vexation, etc. Ailments are worse during the winter. Dread of open air with shivering when exposed to it. Great weakness, fainting, tremor, twitching of limbs, catalepsy tonic spasms, left-sided paralysis. Tremulous weakness. Wooden feeling. Bmised soreness, worse in joints. Internal itching. Coldness in spots, in abdomen, in heart, after scratching. Dryness in ear, nose, etc. Catarrhal condition of the mucus membranes, of stomach and bowels. Lingering gastric and lung troubles, chronic diarrhea. Strumous diathesis, especially the dark type, who suffer from catarrhal conditions of the mucus membranes, gastric acidity and cutaneous eruptions. Enlarged glands. Emaciation, especially of chest. Feels sick internally. Hemorrhages, blood light red, worse lifting or riding. Dropsy. Burnings. MIND - Mental weakness and forgetfulness, with deep-seated disease. Very forgetful, disinclined to think. Loss of memory. Irresolution. Confusion while walking in open air. Presence of strangers aggravates. Anxiety in a crowd. Worries but does not know why. Anxiety and apprehension about his family. Anxiety with fear. Fear, long lasting. Anxiety increases until he becomes inconsolable. Feeling of helplessness. Low-spirited with dimness of sight. Sadness during menses, with weeping. Melancholy. Feels that death is near and must hurry to settle affairs. Irritable, easily offended, vexed at everything. Excited, irritable after sex with inclination to be angry and to scold. Cursing. Intolerant of contradiction. Anger with fright. Quarrelsome in morning. Sense of duality, thinks he is double of someone else lying alongside or one limb is double. Delusion there are two babies in the bed. Delusion that she has a third leg which would not remain quiet.

Head - Headache, worse shaking, while coughing, must hold temples for relief. Occiput, aching, heavy (Op.). Head feels numb as if made of wood. Scalp, sore to touch, followed by numbness. Sensitive scalp, as if a cold breeze blowing on it. Moist eruption on scalp, worse back and ears. Falling of the hair.

Eyes - Inflamed tarsi. Fistula lachrymalis (of recent origin). Blenorrhea of lachrymal sac. Marginal blepharitis. Canthi fissured. Skin around eyes dry and scurfy. Loss of eyelashes. Dim sight, far-sighted, cannot read fine print without glasses.

Ears - Ears sore to touch. Dryness in ears. Eczema in and behind ears with intense itching. Moist spots behind the ears. Fissures in meatus. Discharge of pus and blood from the ears. Itching deep in ears in Eustachian tubes. Chronic Eustachian catarrh. Dry catarrh with deafness and noises. Ringing and cracking in ears. Diminished hearing. Deafness with noises in ears in the elderly. Noise from several people talking is unbearable.

Nose - Dry. Tip of nose itches. Nostrils ulcerated, cracked, burn. Ozaena with scabs and muco-purulent discharge. Nosebleed.

Face - Dry, as if covered with albumin. Pale or yellow, hot after eating. Easy dislocation of jaw.

Mouth - Dry. Offensive smell like garlic. Ulcers on the inner cheek, painful when closing the teeth. Soreness, while chewing. Tongue, white in center, dark streak along edges.

Throat - Dry. Hoarseness (Carb-v, Caust., Phos.). Foul mucus in throat, hawks out in the morning. Croup and laryngeal diphtheria. Vertigo - Vertigo on rising, felt in occiput. Vertigo, as if intoxicated or as if seasick. Vertigo like that produced by swinging motion. COMMENTS - Kent suggested Petr, for low conditions in which there is an inability to throw out eruptions on the skin or conditions in which an eruption has disappeared without improvement in health. Mucus membranes have catarrh. Ozaena, intestinal catarrh. Soreness and cracks about mucocutaneous orifices. Severe irritability of the skin. Affinity for the scalp, behind the ears, skin folds, scrotum, and genitals. Eczema (Sil., Graph.), especially of the hands and toes. Psoriasis (Nat-m., Graph.). Severely chapped skin. Chapped, rough hands. Induration with cracks. Deep cracks that bleed. Painful cracks of the heels of palms of the hands. Fissures that ooze clear or yellow fluid. Skin feels tight, like wrapped leather. Thickened skin, hard, splitting. Fingertips crack and bleed. Nails split and turn dark. Cracked nostrils. A slight wound or injury can suppurate easily. History of suppressed eruptions with unhealthy looking skin that doesn't heal well. Marked burning sensations. Feet and palms burn (Sulph.). Severe itching, will scratch until the skin is raw and bleeding (Sulph.). Itching without eruptions. Feet feel frozen, tingling, numbness. Diabetic neuropathies (Agar.). Stinging and red. Very sensitive to clothing. Scalp eruptions, moist and sensitive to touch. Athletes foot (Thuj., Sil., Graph., Psor., Sanie.), with offensive foot sweats, deep cracks between the toes, burning and itching of the skin. Offensive, smelly feet (Sil.). Genital heipes (Nat-m., Rhus-t., Apis.). Vesicles with yellow fluid. Crusty appearance. Vesicles with yellow thick crusts that become moist, ulcerating, rawness. Sores pop, leaving a painful ulcer. Groin is itching and red. Groin eczema, fungal infections. Chilblains. Frostbite (Agar., Zinc.). Intermittent claudication, painful cramps and spasms, burning in hands and feet from poor circulation. Pain on touching something cold. Skin symptoms are worse in winter. This modality gave Nash the key to several cases of eczema, chapped hands, chilblains and one case of chronic diarrhea, as soon as he discovered that the patient had eczema of the hands in winter. Petr. 200c was given. A man, a patient of Clarke's who suffered from inveterate eczema and who had formerly been employed in a factory where much petroleum was used, noticed that his eczema was much better while working with petroleum. He told Clarke that the vapor had the singular effect of making some of the workmen insane, causing desire to kill, hallucinations, they will see things not actually visible, for instance, “they will see the rails in a station when a train is on them.” “Falling out of the hair.” Cooper clarified that Petr, “probably acts on the sebaceous rather than the sudoriferous secretions of the skin and its local action is on parts where the sebum is abundant.” Vertigo and heaviness, often associated with nausea and bilious vomiting. Useful for motion sickness or seasickness (Tab.,Cocc.). Carsickness, feels as if intoxicated. Faint and weak. Pale, cold, cold sweat, sinking nausea. Worse motion, better fresh air and cold water on face, closing eyes. Headache in the occiput region with sickness. Heaviness like lead, pressure, sticking, pulsating, worse on shaking head or any jar. Pain travels from occiput to eyes and is associated with temporary loss of sight and fainting. Blocked Eustachian tubes and itching in the ears (Kali-m., Cham.). Dizziness, ringing in the ears. “Oppression of the chest, worse in cold air.” Cough coming from deep down in the chest and frequently waking the patient up at night, usually in children. Thick, purulent and yellowish green discharges. Kent remarked on the awful ravenous hunger. Empty feeling, gnawing hunger, must eat small amounts. Hunger immediately after a stool in diarrhea, nervous affections, spinal disease, etc. Irritability of the mind. Excitable, angry at trifles. Characteristic illusion that there is another person or another baby in bed has led to cures in cases of typhoid and puerperal fever with Petr. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Cocc., Nux-v., Phos. Antidote to: Nit-ac., Lead poisoning - one of the best remedies. Compare: ( 1 ) Carb-v, Graph., Sulph., Phos. Complementary: before Sep. Compatible: Bry., Calc.. Lyc., Nit-ac., Nux-v., Puls., Sep., Sil., Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Kent. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Feeling of emptiness. Stomach pain when stomach is empty, relieved by constant eating (Anae., Sep.). Ravenous hunger. Must rise at night and eat (Psor.). Smells of garlic. Distention. Heartburn, hot, sharp, sour eructation. Pungent, acrid belchings. Nausea with accumulation of water in mouth. Vomits bitter green substance. Seasickness and motion sickness. Nausea during pregnancy, must stoop.

Abdomen - Inflated abdomen. Sensation of coldness inside. Pinching colic, better bending double. Navel ulcerated in infants.

Rectum - Diarrhea, watery, gushing. Diarrhea or dysentery during the day, worse cabbage, then empty feeling. Itching of anus after stools. Hemorrhoids and fissures of anus with great itching. Herpes on perineum. Sensations - Brain as if wrapped in a fog. As if everything in head were alive. As if head made of wood or as if bruised. As if a cold breeze were blowing on head. As if head would burst. Veil before eyes, sand in eyes. Jaw as if distended. As if something were tearing off from pit of stomach. As if a cold stone at heart. Upper and lower limbs as if stiff without joints. Splinter in heel.

Male - Sweaty genitals. Herpetic eruption on perineum. Itching in urethra. Prostate inflamed and swollen.

Female - Dry, obstinate eruptions. Genitals sore and moist. Aversion to sex. Before menses, throbbing in head (Kreos.). Menstrual flow causes itching. Leucorrhea, profuse, albuminous (Alum., Calc-p.), with lascivious dreams. Prolapsed uterus from constant diarrhea. Food - Hunger, causing nausea, wakes at night. Hunger immediately after stool. Desire for dainties, aversion to meat, fats, cooked or hot foods. Worse eating cabbage. Thirst for beer.

Chest - Oppression of chest, worse cold air. Constitutions - Suited to persons with light hair and skin. For lean, slender persons.

Heart - Cold feeling about heart (Carb-an., Nat-m.). Fainting with ebullitions, heat and palpitations.

Back - Neck, stiff and painful, cracks when moved. Weakness in small of back. Pain in spine and all over the body with sciatica. Coccyx painful on sitting. Pain in sacrum, worse standing erect. Sharp pains shooting up dorsal spine into occiput, in confinement. Breasts - Itching and mealy coating of nipple. Causations - Ailments from riding in cars, carriages or ships (Nit-ac has deafness). Vexation. Ill effects of sprains or suppressed eruptions. Cabbage.

Limbs - Limbs go to sleep. Chronic sprains. Cracking in joints. Joints stiff, particularly knees. Scalding sensation in knee. Stitches, blisters, cracks in heels. Fingertips rough, cracked, fissured every winter. Ragged, chapped hands and fingers, bleeding in housemaids. Psoriasis of the palms. Offensive sweat in axilla. Lungs - Dry cough at night, coming deep from chest, waking the patient (in young girls and boys). Cough at night or worse at night. Shatters the head, better pressing. Cough produces headache.

Sleep - Restless with frightful dreams.

Skin - Eczema with cracks in skin, worse in winter. Psoriasis, especially of hands. Deep cracks in skin folds, nipples, fingertips. Cracks bleed easily, worse in winter. Dirty, hard, rough, thickened like parchment. Skin gets raw, festers or won't heal, worse in folds. Slight injuries suppurate (Hep.). Thick, greenish crusts, burning and itching, redness, bleeding. Itching at night. Itching orifices with burning. Herpes. Chilblains, moist, itch, burn and turn purple. Brown spots. Bedsores. Skin is extremely sensitive, all clothing is painful.

Modalities - Better warm air, dry weather, lying with head high. Worse from motion of cars, trains, carriage, boat. Worsefrom dampness, cold weather, winter, changing weather, before and during a thunderstorm. Worse from mental states, vexation, sex, touch. Worse eating, cabbage.

Kidneys - Cystitis, urethritis. Stricture from chronic urethritis. Acute sudden urging, if not attended to immediately, will cause severe pain. Involuntary urine on rising. Bedwetting at night. Dribbling of urine after urination.

Temperature - Chilly with dry mouth. Chilliness, followed by sweat. Flushes of heat, particularly of the face and head, worse at night. Flushes of heat all over in frequent attacks during day. Palms and soles hot. Perspiration, foul on feet and axilla. Sweat in spots.

name: Petroselinum Sativum
author: Murphy
constitution: Blindness. Catheter, fever. Chills. Cystitis. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Fevers. Flatulence. Gleet. Gonorrhea. GraveL Hemorrhoids . Intermittent fever. Night-blindness. Polyuria. Priapism. Prostate, enlargement. Urethritis. Urinary, difficulties. Urticaria.
keynote:
PHARMACY - petros. Petroselinum sativum. Parsley. Carum petroselinum. Apium petroselinum. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of whole fresh plant when coming into bloom. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blindness. Catheter, fever. Chills. Cystitis. Dyspepsia.…
full:
PHARMACY - petros. Petroselinum sativum. Parsley. Carum petroselinum. Apium petroselinum. N. O. Umbelliferae. Tincture of whole fresh plant when coming into bloom. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blindness. Catheter, fever. Chills. Cystitis. Dyspepsia. Dysuria. Fevers. Flatulence. Gleet. Gonorrhea. GraveL Hemorrhoids . Intermittent fever. Night-blindness. Polyuria. Priapism. Prostate, enlargement. Urethritis. Urinary, difficulties. Urticaria.

HERBAL - Parsley tea is a recognized domestic remedy for gonorrhea. Parsley eaten after meals, with or without salad oil, is reputed to act as a solvent on uric acid if there is a tendency to its formation in the urine. Fresh butter and parsley applied warm is an old remedy for bruises. Cooper noted that an infusion is given to all children recovering from scarlatina by the matron of a suburban infectious hospital. An old gleet has been known to disappear from parsley infusion, and an Edinburgh surgeon used to given it in all nephritic and bladder diseases that were chronic. Parsley is said to be poisonous to ferrets.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann noted the usefulness of Petros, as agonorrheal remedy when there is a frequent desire to urinate. Affinity for the genito-urinary sphere. The leading indication is sudden urging to urinate and drawing, tingling, crawling or itching in navicular fossa. During urination, burning and tingling from perineum through whole urethra. After urination, cutting and biting in fossa navicularis. Very painful urination causing him to shiver, dance around the room in agony. Gonorrhea with a milky or yellow discharge. Dysuria with prostatic enlargement. Urinary difficulties of babies. Hemorrhoids with much itching.

Eyes - Blindness at night with swelling of eyes. Food - Thirsty and hungry, yet as soon as they begin to eat or drink they lose all desire.

Ears - Shrill singing in ears like a bell ringing out of tune, which affects the whole organism.

Stomach - Twitching, jerking pains in epigastrium. Flatulent belchings, colic, nausea and vomiting.

Rectum - Whitish evacuations like clay, chronic diarrhea. Hemorrhoids with much itching. Burning at anus.

Male - Priapism, without curvature of penis. Urethritis. Pollutions, profuse emission toward morning.

Back - Jerking or bubbling sensation in muscles of back and arms.

Sleep - Sleep late, with many anxious dreams.

Skin - Urticaria.

Kidneys - Tingling, lancinating, pressure and drawing in urethra. Burning, tingling from perineum throughout whole urethra. Dysuria and polyuria. Frequent and almost fruitless desire to urinate, every half-hour. Sudden urging to urinate, voluptuous tickling in fossa navicularis. Child suddenly seized with desire to urinate, if not gratified immediately, jumps up and down with pain. Urethritis. Gonorrhea with intense biting, itching, deep in urethra. Milky fluid, albuminous yellow discharge from urethra. Orifice of urethra agglutinated with mucus.

Temperature - Ague, especially quotidian, marked periodicity, regular stages. Acute fevers from defective assimilation or perverted innervation, accompanied by flatulent dyspepsia. Intermittent fevers with abdominal disorders. Fevers with traumatic or chronic inflammation of urethra or even stricture. COMMENTS - Petros, was proved by Beth- mann. He obtained only thirty-six symptoms, all in the genito- urinary sphere, but these were very characteristic and have given the remedy a definite place in homeopathic medicine, especially in gonorrhea and gleet. Farrington said Petros, is a great “baby medicine” for urinary difficulties. Hering collected symptoms from other observers. It has cured many cases of intermittent fever and^raumatic or other urethral fevers. Acute cystitis, urethritis. Burning and tingling in the urethra. Irresistible desire to urinate, frequent urination. Children will scream and yell with the urge to urinate, anticipating the pain. Bladder infections in children. Gonorrhea. Trauma to the urethra from catheters. Clarke confirmed its efficiency in gonorrhea and gleet, giving ten-drop doses of the tincture. In a case of dysuria from prostatic enlargement there was frequent urging to urinate every half to three-quarters of an hour with burning pains in bladder and urethra. Petros. 4x, three drops every hour took away all the pains and relieved the tenesmus in a few days. The prostate gland itself was not influenced. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) In gonorrhea with sudden and frequent urging, Cann-s., Canth., Merc. (2) Screams before urinating from irritation of mucus membrane, Aeon., Caust., Bor. (3) Sars., Lyc. and Benz-ac. have screaming before urinating when due to gravel. (4) Gonorrhea, strangury, frequent urging to urinate, white stools, Dig. (5) Dig. has slow pulse often puffed prepuce, Sulph. indurated prepuce. (6) Cystitis, Con. - has intermittent urination, Petros, has inflammation that has traveled back, sudden, irresistible desire. (7) Bubbling in back, urinary disorders, Berb. (8) Uric acid tendency intermittent fevers, Urt-u. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kalieniczensko took five or six teaspoonfuls of…
full:
PHARMACY - phal. Phallus impudicus. Stinkhorn fungus. N. O. Fungi. Tincture or infusion of whole fungus. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Gastro-enteralgia. Sweat, viscid. Vertigo. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Kalieniczensko took five or six teaspoonfuls of an infusion of Phal. in twenty-four hours and observed the effects, which included vertigo, dullness, vision disordered, gastro-enteric disturbance and viscid sweat. There is a general resemblance to the effect of Agar. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Phaseolus Nanus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Headache was worse by movement of the head or any mental exertion, reading or writing. Pressure aggravates..
constitution: Albuminuria. Breast, tumors. Diabetes. Dropsy. Hematuria. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hernia. Hydrothorax. Impotency. Palpitations. Pericarditis. Pleurisy. Prostate, diseases. Wounds, punctured.
keynote:
PHARMACY - phase. Phaseolus nanus. Dwarfbean. Phaseolus vulgaris. Kidney-bean. N. O. Leguminosae. Papilionoideae. Trituration of the dried bean. Decoction of dried beans and pods. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Breast, tumors. Diabetes.…
full:
PHARMACY - phase. Phaseolus nanus. Dwarfbean. Phaseolus vulgaris. Kidney-bean. N. O. Leguminosae. Papilionoideae. Trituration of the dried bean. Decoction of dried beans and pods. Historical dose: Trituration and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Albuminuria. Breast, tumors. Diabetes. Dropsy. Hematuria. Headache. Heart, disorders. Hernia. Hydrothorax. Impotency. Palpitations. Pericarditis. Pleurisy. Prostate, diseases. Wounds, punctured.

HERBAL - Clarke included under Phaseolus both Phaseolus nanus and Phaseolus vulgaris. The New Eng. Med. Gaz. published a translation of a pamphlet by Dr. Heinrich Ramm on the uses of “Bean tea.” A woman whom Ramm had treated in vain for mitral valve disease with liver and kidney complications and dropsy, presented herself one day apparently cured by drinking “Bean tea.” This led Ramm to try it in other cases and he found that kidney and cardiac dropsies were speedily relieved, urine largely increased in quantity and in cases of albuminuria, where the albumen quickly disappeared.

HOMEOPATHIC - Some effects of eating mildewed beans in a child were recorded by W. Dale. A. M. Cushing and Demeures both proved Phaseolus nanus, but Cushing only published the symptoms observed on the heart. Demeures, in his proving, experience severe headache from fullness in the brain. Breathing slow, pulse slow or extinct. “Irregular, weak pulse and heart failure.” Soreness to touch in eyeballs, right rib, epigastrium, and right humerus. Diabetes. Cooper noted that the inside of the pod rubbed on warts is said to cure them. A decoction of the shells has been used as a drink for diabetes, but can cause severe headaches. Ramm noted it for dropsical effusion into pleural cavity, pericardium and peritoneum. Chronic disorders of the urinary tract from kidneys to urethra, pyelitis, bladder catarrh, gravel, stones, uric acid. Ramm considered Phase, an important remedy in gout and diabetes. He used a decoction of the whole dried ripe pod “of the taller variety,” Phaseolus vulgaris. MIND - Could only be roused by speaking loudly. Frightened by irregular action of heart. Feeling that she would die with palpitations. Abdomen - Pressure on abdomen gave pain, child shrank from it and drew up legs. Dropsy. Pain like hernia in right inguinal ring, lasting all day.

Head - Aches chiefly in forehead or orbits from fullness of brain, worse any movement or mental exertion.

Eyes - Pupils dilated, insensible to light. Eyeballs (especially right) painful to touch as from a blow. Scalding pain in right orbit. Very smart itching in inner canthi. Pain over right orbit worse from mental exertion.

Face - Features expressed suffering.

Stomach - Pain in epigastrium when touched, especially in region of pylorus. Severe, dull pain in epigastrium, vomiting.

Male - Complete impotence. Prostate enlargement.

Chest - Breathing slow and sighing. Sick feeling about heart with weak pulse. Pulse rapid. Palpitations. Right ribs sore. Dropsical effusion into pleura or pericardium.

Heart - Fearful palpitations and feeling that death is approaching.

Limbs - Pain to touch in extremity of head, of right humerus. Lungs - Breathing slow and sighing.

Modalities - Headache was worse by movement of the head or any mental exertion, reading or writing. Pressure aggravates.

Kidneys - Diabetic urine. Bloody urine. Uric acid gravel.

Temperature - Cold perspiration. COMMENTS - Cushing's proving recorded disturbance of the nervous system, genital organs, impotence, stomach, bowels and kidneys and this symptom, which brought the proving to an abrupt close: “I suddenly felt a curious sensation in the region of the heart. It was so sudden and strange I immediately felt my pulse and found it very irregular and feeble, so much so I think I was frightened, at least, I did not take any more of the medicine.” Cushing used this in his case of a female doctor, 30, married, no children, never ill except with children's diseases, had much mental trouble two years before and had done much cycling. Since then her heart had given trouble. About five times in a minute the heart would give one hard, unpleasant throb, then omit one beat. During the night it was much worse and prevented sleep. Phase. 10c was given. Thirty-six hours later the heart would beat a hundred beats without varying and improvement continued, but the patient had to give up the remedy on account of the headache it caused, “as if something were pressing hard against each temple”, much worse after each dose of the medicine. The patient was never subject to headaches. He had another case, in which a man, 45, had dropsy, heart and other complications. Bean pod decoction enabled him to lie down on a couch and markedly diminished the dropsy. A clergyman, 69, many years invalid on account of heart disease after unusual exertion was greatly exhausted and became entirely pulseless and so remained four days in spite of treatment until Phase. 9x was given. In a few hours pulse returned. In thirty-six hours it was regular and strong and so remained until his death, which oc- curred two weeks later. In another case, Cushing observed a woman, 50, weak, tired, badly acting heart for some years. Phase. 9x was given and in forty-eight hours “her heart wheeled into line all right and remains so.” Another woman, 87, heart acted badly, every third beat omitted. After taking Phase, two days pulse quite right. A nurse, 50, “had fearful time with her heart palpitating and feeling as if she should die,” Phase. 15x cured. The patient “never took anything in her life that did her so much good.” In a confinement case, with primipara, urine loaded with albumen, frightful convulsions, forceps delivery. Two hours later the heart failed and no stimulants would start it. Phase. 9x was given and in ten minutes the heart was all right. Twice in the night the dose had to be repeated, but that was all. The albumen rapidly disappeared and a quick recovery was made. S. R. Stone reported the case of Mr. T., 69, whom he found semi-conscious, yet suffering severely, having been seized with distress in heart region, respiration labored, pulse 51. He had attacks previously, but lighter and the pulse in them had always been slow. Phase. 6x was given, at first every halfhour, then every hour. The next day the patient was nearly well and said he “could feel every dose working.” RELATIONS - Compare: (1) The Legumi- nosae. (2) In heart, Dig., Crat., Spig., Lach., Thyr., (3) Punctured wounds, Hyper., Led. (4) Diabetes, Syzyg., Nat-s., Uran-n. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Emphysema. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phel. acts on lungs and…
full:
PHARMACY - phel. Phellandrium aquaticum. Water dropwort. Oenanthe phellandrium. Fine-leaved water- hemlock. Horse-bane. N. O. Umbelliferae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Bronchitis. Emphysema. Tuberculosis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phel. acts on lungs and nerves. The respiratory symptoms are most important and have been frequently verified clinically. Catarrhal conditions of the respiratory tract. Bronchitis andemphysema. Offensive expectoration and cough in tuberculosis. Hemoptysis. Tuberculosis, affecting gener- Phellandrium aquaticum ally the middle lobes. Everything tastes sweet. Hectic and colliquative diarrhea. As if all the blood vessels were in vibratory motion. Feeling of tiredness while walking. MIND - Peevish arrogance. Breasts - Pain in nipples. Pain in milk ducts, intolerable between nursing.

Head - Headache involving nerves going to eye. Clang like striking on metal in brain, waking him. Weight on vertex, aching and burning in temples and above eyes. Crushing feeling in vertex. Lungs - Expectoration, horribly offensive (like bedbugs), loose, profuse, smeary, causing dyspnea. Cough compels him to sit up. Sticking pain through from left border of right breasts to between shoulders. Pains going backwards through chest.

Eyes - Only half open and look as if one has been crying for a week. Burning in eyes. Lachrymation. Ciliary neuralgia, worse any attempt to use eyes. Intolerance of light.

Face - Livid red in the evening.

Stomach - Everything tastes sweet. Desires sour things, milk or beer. Aversion to water. Belchings smelling of bed bugs. Vertigo - Vertigo, dizzy when lying down. COMMENTS - This remedy, proved by Nen- ning, has a few striking symptoms, although it is rarely used and very little known. Generally right-sided. Continuous cough for hours in the morning accompanied by dyspnea and prostration. Coarse rales, compelling the patient to remain in a sitting posture. Bronchitis and tuberculosis. Last stage of tuberculosis when a cavity has formed in the lungs and there is edema of the limbs. Diarrhea, difficult respiration and profuse sweat. Affinity for the female breasts, specially the right one. The nipples pain each time the child is put to the breast. The pain shoots inward and backward to the shoulder and to the sacrum. Intolerable pain in the right breast along the course of the lactiferous tubes immediately after nursing, causing physical and mental distress, loss of strength, and hysterical weeping. Removes abnormal sleepiness in women after childbirth. Usher reported a cure with Phel. in a woman, who would go off to sleep standing over her wash-tub. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Sleep - So sleepy, would fall asleep while standing at work.

Modalities - Better while nursing. Worse air, cold, open. Worse from using eyes.

CLINICAL - Cyanosis. Face, eruptions. Fevers. Headache. Perspiration, excessive. Typhoid fever. Uremia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phenac, belongs to the Aniline group and was…
full:
PHARMACY - phenac. Phenacetinum. Para- acetphenatidine. Derívate of anilinum. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Cyanosis. Face, eruptions. Fevers. Headache. Perspiration, excessive. Typhoid fever. Uremia.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phenac, belongs to the Aniline group and was introduced into old- school practice as a remedy in febrile states and neuralgias. Clarke added a symptom observed on a young woman who had taken Phenac, for headaches. She had a circumscribed rash on both cheeks which came out red, lasted four days and then peeled and as soon as it was clear the process was repeated. Clarke tried many remedies with varying success, but it finally disappeared under Alum. 30c, one powder at bedtime. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

name: Phenobarbitalum

HOMEOPATHIC - Phenobarbital is derived from phenylethylmalonylurea or gardenal. Chronic poisoning from phenobarbital and the other barbiturates, especially in cases of digestive or skin intolerance. Eczema, especially weeping eczema. Food, allergies. Digestive complaints from intolerance to foods (fish, Crustacea, cream). Physical and psychological depression, tiredness and sleepiness. Liver deficiency. Alternation of classical allergic phenomena including asthma, eczema, and spasmodic coryza. Nasal and pharyngeal itching. In the child, prurigo coexists or alternates with acetonemia. Urticaria, either in patches, confluent or isolated. Vesicles dry or weeping when scratched with a syrupy liquid, which is usually cloudy. Itching edema. Itching and often vesicular erythema. MIND - Mental depression alternating with hyper-excitability. Hypersensitive. Acrimonious. Memory weak.

Head - Headaches with heaviness in the head, at any time.

Eyes - Eyes tearful, eyelids heavy, puffy, itching. Sight tires easily, especially after prolonged reading.

Nose - Nasal and pharyngeal itching.

Face - Edema of the face. Impression of peripheral congestion of the face and hands.

Mouth - Bitter taste in mouth.

Stomach - Nausea in the morning. Epigastric discomfort. COMMENTS - The proving was carried out by Vannier on four people, using potencies from 30c to lc, two doses a day, for one week, decreasing the doses from potency to potency, over a period of ninety weeks. All the symptoms appeared with 4c, also with 3c, 2c and lc. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Urt-u. - Urticaria appears, especially after too much shell-fish and often is more marked on knees and elbows. (2) Apis - Rosy edema, burning and red of the eyelids. Always improved by the cold. With phenobarbital, it is somewhat whiter and unaffected by the cold. (3) Kali-c. - Swelling of the inner comer of the upper eyelids. He wants to be alone. (4) Bell. - Erythema without edema, general symptoms more violent with intense redness, but no real itching. (5) Rhus- t. - Edema with herpetic vesicular eruptions, burning discharge from the eyelids. Need for movement and cold very marked. (6) Ran- b. - Blisters and itching, but no edema. (7) Sulph. - Pruriginous redness with or without blisters with or without edema and frequent alternation with other allergic complaints or complaints caused by self-intoxication. REFERENCES-Julian.

Abdomen - Abdominal heaviness. Intestinal sluggishness. Chronic or occasional hepatic deficiency.

Female - Menses ameliorate the complaints. Food - Food, allergies. Worse from eating fish, Crustacea or cream.

Sleep - Easily tired, sleepy during the day, needs sleep.

Skin - Hot feeling in the fine areas of skin. Itching with stinging and burning, changed little by heat or cold, attended by excessive scratching to the point of smarting and discharge. Urticaria. Erythema, more or less intense, locality varies. Scarlet fever type erythema. Vesicular eczema, usually oozing with syrupy or oily liquid.

Modalities - Better from diet, rest, calm and menses. Worse from rest, heat, heat of the bed, at night, from air. Worse from eating fish, Crustacea or cream. Worse from being contradicted.

Blood - Acetonemia in the child. Constitutions - Phospho-fluoric or flouric, normal or with hypo-laxity with irregular teeth and marked clinical manifestations.

HOMEOPATHIC - Phlor. exists in fine, silky, four-sided, colorless needles, soluble in water. It has a bitter and slightly astringent taste and has been used in old-school practice as a remedy for intermittent fever. While being administered for this it has produced glycosuria. This observation led to its successful use by homeopaths in cases of diabetes. Successes with the 3x and 6c have been reported. A patient to whom it was given by Burnett accused him of having given him a preparation of apples. The man discovered it because it produced herpes along the dorsum of the penis, an effect which invariably occurred whenever he ventured to eat apples. V. Mering produced glycosuria in dogs with Phlor., but if Syzyg. was given simultaneously with Phlor., no glycosuria appeared. REFERENCES Clarke.

Proved by Hahnemann, there is a marked action on the emotional and sensorial faculties, a drowsy, depressed, apathetic state is produced, such as is met with in typhoid fevers.Ph-ac. affects the mind, especially its emotional side. It influences sensory nerves, the sexual system and bones. The debility commonly found in acids is very marked in this remedy, producing a nervous exhaustion. Conditions from a weakened immune system caused by acute disease, sexual excesses, grief, loss of vital fluids. Weakness and debility with free secretion, profuse urination, loss of fluids, sweatings etc. except with diarrhea. Heartburn, flatulence. Diarrhea, diabetes, rickets and periosteal inflammation. Sense of pressure, as of causing weight in forehead in sternum in vertex in eyes, navel, breasts etc. Formication, at root of hair, along the spine, limbs. Coldness of parts. Sensitive to light, sound and odors, which takes away her breath. Particularly suitable for young people who grow rapidly and who are mentally or physically overtaxed. MIND - Mental debility,followed by physical. Difficult comprehension. Slowness of mind and special senses. Impaired memory (Anae.). Prostrated and stupefied with grief, effects of disappointed love. Homesickness. Brain fag. Cannot collecthisthoughtsor find the right word. Forgetfulness of old people. Vanishing of thoughts on reading. Reflects long, then answers correctly, but slowly. Wants nothing and Phosphoricum acidum caresfor nothing. Indifferent to those things that used to interest her the most. Mental ailments with drowsiness, nightsweats toward morning, emaciation. Silent ill-humor. Sadness only while walking, the longer he walks the worse he gets. Sadness from masturbation. Effects of grief and mental shock. Ailments from disappointed love, with silent grief. Hysteria at menopause. Hysterical affections of young women, with excessive sensibility and irritability. Wildness from vexation. Mild delirium, easily aroused. Delirium with great stupefaction. Unconscious after strong emotions.

Head - Crushing weight on vertex, pain as if temples were crushed, worse shaking or noise. Pressure on top. Dull headache after sex, from eyestrain (Na.t-m.). School girl's headache from over use of eyes (Ruta). Hair thins, turns gray early, falls out. Hair loss after grief or loss of fluids.

Eyes - Blue rings around eyes. Lusterless, glassy, staring, sunken, dull appearance. Yellow spots on conjunctiva. Pupils dilated. Eyeballs feel large. Pain as if eyeballs were forcibly pressed together and into head. Optic nerves seem torpid. Photophobia, averse to sunlight. Sees colors as if a rainbow. Loss of vision from masturbation. Lids inflamed and cold.

Ears - Earache after blowing the nose. Shrill sound in ears on blowing the nose. Intolerance of noise, especially music, which causes stitches, even while singing himself. Illusions of hearing, hears bell pealing. Every sound re-echoes loudly in the ear. Roaring with difficult hearing. Nervous deafness after typhoid-like fevers.

Nose - Bleeding. Nose swollen with red patches or pimples on tip of nose. Itching. Bores fingers into nose.

Face - Pale, earthy, sickly. Tense as if egg white had dried on it. Sensation of coldness of one side of face. Acne from onanism. Hairs of beard fall out.

Mouth - Lips dry, cracked. Mouth dry .Taste of rotten eggs. Tongue swollen, dry with viscid, frothy mucus, slimy. Red streak in middle of tongue. Bleeding, swollen gums, retract from teeth. Painful nodosities on the gums. Teeth become yellow and feel dull. Teeth feel cold. At night, bites tongue involuntarily.

Throat - Dry palate. Hoarseness. Hawks up tough mucus. Vertigo - Vertigo toward evening, when standing or walking. Vertigo, as if floating in the air, while lying in bed with ringing in the ears and glassy eyes. COMMENTS - Convalescent remedy. Chronic fatigue since a debilitating acute. Heavy limbs, droopy eyelids, drained feeling, chills and fever (Gels.). Mononucleosis and flu with extreme weakness. Draining, debilitating chronic illness. Emaciation with dark circles around their eyes, sunken faces and apathy. Spacey and empty eyes. Chronic fatigue with weight loss, especially after grief, emotional loss, loss of fluids, or fevers. Debilitated and tired since grief (Gels., Sil.). Grief, leading to falling of hair, premature senility and depression. The hair may turn gray or fall out in patches. Homesickness (Caps.), with weight loss, insomnia, and pining. Chronic mental exertion or worry. Lack of emotions (Aur., Sep.). Apathetic (Gels.). Aversion to loved ones (Sep.), with weakness. Feels indifferent about future. Listless. Decreased mental function. Lack of direction, empty (Ign.). Blank mind, spacey, cannot concentrate. May have a history of excessive sexual activity and loss of sexual fluids. Chronic seminal discharge, prostatorrhea. Weakness and apathy from masturbation or excessive sexual activity (Sei., Agn.). Effects of chronic masturbation. Severe impotence with a history of masturbation or too much sex. Lack of sexual desire or function. Used in some countries as a tonic for sexual debility. May have a history of drug use. Vertigo with the sensation as if the feet were rising until he stood on his head. This symptom occurred in a patient of Skinner's suffering from smallpox. The disease had been cut short by Vario., when the patient, a woman, complained that her feet were rising to the ceiling and begged her nurses to keep them down. Ph-ac. speedily put her straight. Illusions of the senses as well as of the sensorium, bells are heard, ciphers, sparks, etc., are seen. Exalted sensitiveness to light, sound and odors, “odors take away his breath.” Becher, one of Hahnemann's provers, noted that his right pupil became widely dilated while the left remained normal. The more he strained the eye, the wider the pupil became until the iris had almost disappeared. Great weakness, better by short sleep (Phos.). Legs tremble when walking, limbs are difficult to control. “Weak feeling in chest from talking, coughing or sitting too long, better by walking.” Hoarseness and nasal voice. Dyspnea, capillary bronchitis. Cough, as if a feather tickling from middle of chest to larynx, low down in chest. The cough is worse in evening, after lying down. Muco-purulent, salty, bloody, offensive expectoration. Cough causes headache, nausea and vomiting of food, spurting of urine. Every draft of air causes fresh cold. Dry mouth and throat. Involuntary biting of tongue in sleep. Thirsty for ice cold drinks, bubbly drinks and mineral waters, fresh fruit juice with ice, sparkling fruit juices. Diabetes, when there is a history of sexual excess or of severe mental or emotional over-strain. Emaciation with diabetes. Copious discharges appear in the sweat and urine. Polyuria. White, milky urine and also white stools. The urine may be clear as it is passed, but turns milky at once and is very offensive. Bedwetting, the child passes a great quantity of urine. Excessive flatulence. Distention and passing of flatus in large quantities, sometimes with the odor of garlic. Weakened sphincters, involuntary escape of feces and urine, especially on coughing or movement. Keynote “persistent, painless, watery diarrhea often containing undigested particles of food and which does not debilitate.” Diarrhea in children who are emaciated and dehydrated. Weight loss from severe diarrhea. Children feel better when they're having diarrhea (Calc., better constipated). Bloating of the uterus with gas. Menses are excessive and premature. Debility from breast-feeding. Dark, profuse, passive hemorrhages. H. Maandblad offered the case of a married woman, 36, mother of eight children, who had for some time been so melancholy and depressed as to be unable to fulfill her household duties. There was no discoverable mental cause, though her condition had been made worse by a sudden death in the family. The beginning of the illness was apparently a weakness of the stomach, small appetite, always pain and distention after eating, the food seemed to lie long in the stomach undigested. (2) Oeno., Evening primrose - effortless diarrhea with nervous exhaustion. Incipient hydrocephaloid. Whooping cough and spasmodic asthma. Infants vomit milk constantly. Causations - Ill effects of bad news, disappointed love, grief, chagrin, shock. Separation from home. Loss of fluids, sexual excesses. Over-lifting, over-study. Formication in limbs. Burning below the waist. Cramps in upper arms and wrists. Heavy forearms. Wens on hands between metacarpal bones. Itching, between fingers or in folds of joints.
