HOMEOPATHIC - The homeopathic indications are based upon 5 years of clinical observations by Dr. David Flores Toledo of Mexico, who named the remedy Hypo- physinum anterioris. He wrote, in The Journal of the American Institute of Homeopathy, September, 1987, “Hypophysinum anterioris may well become one of the great polychrests. but it needs a careful proving. Numerous cases of acne, obesity, one of sterility, headaches related to menses, asthma, hemorrhoids, breast nodules, fungal infections of the nails, recurrent tonsillitis, vitiligo, and warts have been resolved with this medicine.” Hormonal, disorders. Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.). Premenstrual syndrome. Hushes of heat in young girls. Weakness and cold perspiration on rising. Obesity. Allergy, metal dermatitis (Morg-g.). Worse before menses, headache, coryza, pallor of face, nausea, vomiting, distended abdomen, yellow leucorrhea, pain in ovaries, pain in uterus, difficult respiration, painful swollen breasts, low backache, sleeplessness. Better after menses (Zinc-p.). MIND - Aversion to everything, to friends, husband. Dislike of oneself. Easily depressed and avoids her friends. Fear to be alone. Anticipatory diarrhea before a date or engagement (Arg-n.). Emotionally, worse before menses, fearfulness, irritability, sadness. Discouraged during menses. Causeless weeping. Weeping at trifles. Desire to weep, but finds it difficult. Ailments from disappointed love. Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.). Irritability before and during menses. Irritability at trifles. Anger during ovulation. Anger in morning on waking. Anger from Pituitaria glándula anterior contradiction. Desire to strike. Screaming and crying from anger.

Head - Headache before or at beginning of menses. Headache in temples at beginning of menses. Headache worse light, noise, sun, warm room. Headache due to contact lenses. Perspiration on scalp at night.

Eyes - Redness of eyes. Photophobia. Nausea preceded or attended by visual disturbances.

Nose - Susceptible to sinusitis and obstruction to nose. Obstruction in evening, alternates with pain in root of nose. Discharge watery with sneezing (Cob-n.). Pain as if nose were extremely dry. Nosebleed during sleep.

Face - Brown spots on face. Pale discoloration about eyes (Ptel.). Sensation as if face were burnt. Acne before menses. Acne on forehead during menses. Cold perspiration on face before or at beginning of menses.

Mouth - Mapped tongue (Tarax.). Bad taste in mouth before menses.

Throat - Susceptible to tonsillitis. Sore throat. Voice, hoarseness in hot weather. Hoarseness from talking. Vertigo - Vertigo with tendency to fall, worse before and during menses. Vertigo with trembling. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Vertigo worse entering dark room from a lighter place, lying on back, moving head, rising from stooping, better when sitting. Perception of colors (pink, red, yellow, green). RELATIONS - Compare: Sep., Puls., Calc., Nat-m. REFERENCES - Toledo.

Stomach - Empty feeling in stomach without hunger. Nausea preceded or attended by visual disturbances. Nausea on looking at or smell of fatty food. Nausea better after eating. Pains better after eating a little, eructations, worse rich food (Puls.).

Abdomen - Distension, causing to bend double. Rumbling after eating, after milk. Flatulence, all food seems to turn to gas. Flatulence from fruit, vegetables. Pain after eating, after milk. Pain before and during menses.

Rectum - Hemorrhoids. Constipation. Bowel movement every two or three days. Stool large, dry and hard. Stool like sheep dung. Anticipatory diarrhea before a date or engagement. Diarrhea from seafood, milk and milk products.

Female - Hormonal disorders. Premenstrual syndrome. Worse before menses, headache, coryza, pallor of face, nausea, vomiting, distended abdomen, yellow leucorrhea, pain in ovaries, pain in uterus, difficult respiration, painful swollen breasts, low backache, sleeplessness. Pain in ovaries before menses, worse stepping. Menses brown at onset, clotted. Menses coagulated during first day and last days. Menses irregular, protracted with clots. Lack of vital heat during menses. Offensive leucorrhea like fish brine. Metrorrhagia between menses. Sexual desire diminished, enjoyment absent (Sep.). Sterility. Food - Diminished appetite during menses (Mag-c.). Thirst for large quantities. Craving for cakes, sweets and chocolate. Desires fried potatoes, fruit, solid food. Indigestion from eggs. Worse from milk, seafood, fruit, vegetables. Worse from fats and rich food (Puls.).

Chest - Palpitations while lying on back. Eruptions, confluent acne. Perspiration in axilla during menses.

Back - Acne, on back and cervical region. Low backache before menses. Pain in sacral region, coccyx, during menses.

Limbs - Discoloration, white, depigmen- tated burning spots on upper limbs, worse sun. Itching eruptions on upper limbs, worse summer. Nails do not grow ( Ant-c.). Swelling of thighs before menses. Lungs - Asthmatic respiration in morning on waking. Asthma after anger. Asthma better copious expectoration. Asthma sudden attacks, from change of weather. Difficult respiration and headache. Difficult respiration before menses (Zinc.).

Skin - Eruptions, confluent acne. Moist eruptions. Brown spots. Discoloration, itching white spots worse menses. Vitiligo. Warts pedunculated, soft and small.

Bladder - Involuntary urination when rising from a seat. Breasts - Painful, swollen breasts before menses. Painful nodules in breasts.

Perspiration - Perspiration of hands and feet during menses. Weakness and cold perspiration on rising.

name: Pituitaria Gland Posterior
author: Murphy
constitution: Angina, pectoris. Arterial, spasms. Diabetes, insipidus. Diarrhea. Eclampsia. Edema. Heart, attacks. Hemorrhage. Hypertension. Lactation. Moles. Salivation. Urticaria. Uterine, atony.
keynote:
PHARMACY - pitu-p. Pituitaria glándula posterior. Posterior lobe of pituitary gland. Hypophysis posterium. Pituitarum poste- rium. Neurohypophysis. Sarcode. From the pituitary glands of sheep. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina, pectoris. Arterial, spasms.…
full:
PHARMACY - pitu-p. Pituitaria glándula posterior. Posterior lobe of pituitary gland. Hypophysis posterium. Pituitarum poste- rium. Neurohypophysis. Sarcode. From the pituitary glands of sheep. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Angina, pectoris. Arterial, spasms. Diabetes, insipidus. Diarrhea. Eclampsia. Edema. Heart, attacks. Hemorrhage. Hypertension. Lactation. Moles. Salivation. Urticaria. Uterine, atony.

HOMEOPATHIC - The posterior lobe of pituitary gland releases the oxytocin and antidiuretic hormones. Removal or injury to the posterior lobe will lead to the symptoms of diabetes insipidus. It acts upon the parasympathetc center in the hypothalamus. Rate of secretion is controlled from the hypothalamic nucleri. Antidiuretic hormone, or vasopressin, promotes the reabsorption of water in the kidneys. It raises the blood pressure and plays a role in the water balance. Also affects the production of breast milk. It constricts the arteries of the abdominal organs, therefore it use to stop hemorrhage involving abdominal blood vessels. It may produce cerebral or coronary arterial spasms in large doses. Oxytocin causes uterine contractions at term. Allopaths used it for the induction or stimulation of the labor. It has been given to relieve painful breast engorgement. Promotes breast milk release during lactation. Also for postpartum hemorrhage and uterine atony. Its action is controlled in pregnancy by progesterone, which diminishes its action, and estrogen, which increases it. An enzyme in the blood plasma of pregnant women appears to mediate this control. Mind, anxiety, Head, pain. Dropsy. Basal metabolism rate increased. Blood pressure elevated. Blood sugar increased, Bloodvessels constricted. Pulse, slow. Weakness. Abdomen - Distention.

Head - Headache in occiput, extending downwards. Hair falling out. Kidney - Suppression of urine. Lungs - Respiration difficult.

Eyes - Dilated pupils. Lachrymation. Vision loss.

Ears - Noises in ears.

Face - Dark discoloration, during pregnancy.

Mouth - Salivation.

Stomach - Nausea.

Rectum - Diarrhea.

Urine - Copious urine, with albumin, sugar, increased levels of chloride, potassium and sodium. COMMENTS - On the basis of these observations, Ghose made use of this sarcode in its 30th potency in anginal attacks with coronary spasms. Ghose's first case was that of a middle aged man of 45, suffering from diabetes for two years. He developed mild anginal attacks after slight exertion and an occasional sense of heaviness in the precordium. His cardiograph showed coronary disorder and was advised perfect rest. Blood pressure was more or less normal, pulse was 72 bpm. He was apparently a well-built man and was on a restricted diet for a long time due to diabetes. Pitu-p. 30, three times a week, brought great relief of the precordial pain and heaviness; within a fortnight he could walk about in plain ground without any discomfort. Ghose also used it in a case of old man, 70, with dyspepsia who used to get severe attacks of pain in the heart when walking, and particularly when getting up at night to attend calls for urination. He was relieved with the very first dose of Pitu-p. 30 and could move about freely without any discomfort and could also attend to his nature's calls at night without feeling any pain. In a third case. Ghose treated an old man, 65, suffering from coronary thrombosis for about a year and a half. He had W. R. 10/10 which was treated homeopathically. He was living without any heart symptom for any other trouble for about a year, when suddenly he felt agonizing pain in the heart at 11 o'clock at night, with severe dyspnea and moist sounds all over the chest. All these symptoms pointed to edema of lungs. Pulse was soft and slow. Blood pressure was rather low. Pitu-p. 30, repeated every half an hour, relieved the pain completely and made the dyspnea tolerable. A sanguinous expectoration followed for which he was given one dose of Merc-s. 200 and later on a few doses of Thyr. 200 which stopped the dyspnea completely. RELATIONS - Compare: Pitu-a., Bell., Nat-m., Phos., Sec., Thyr. REFERENCES - Ghose.

Female - Contracted uterus. Eclampsia. Weak labor pains.

Chest - Bronchi constriction.

Skin - Dry and red. Dark discoloration. Coldness of skin. Moles. Urticaria. Angioneurotic edema.

Bladder - Frequent or diminished urination. Breast - Milk increased.

Perspiration - Profuse perspiration.

name: Pix Liquida
author: Murphy
constitution: Acne. Alopecia. Ardor urine. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chest, pain. Desquamation. Diarrhea. Eczema. Eruptions. Hair, loss. Hands, eruptions. Itching. Psoriasis. Stomach, pain. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.
keynote:
PHARMACY - pix. Pix liquida. Pine tar. Liquid tar. N. O. Confierae. Pinaceae. A product of dry distillation of various coniferous woods. Tincture. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Alopecia. Ardor urine. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chest, pain. Desquamation.…
full:
PHARMACY - pix. Pix liquida. Pine tar. Liquid tar. N. O. Confierae. Pinaceae. A product of dry distillation of various coniferous woods. Tincture. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Alopecia. Ardor urine. Bedwetting. Bronchitis. Chest, pain. Desquamation. Diarrhea. Eczema. Eruptions. Hair, loss. Hands, eruptions. Itching. Psoriasis. Stomach, pain. Tuberculosis. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - In old-school practice, taris known as a “stimulant expectorant” in chronic bronchitis and tuberculosis, and a stimulant to the skin in psoriasis and scaly eczema. Tar and its constituents act on various mucus membranes. Cough. Bronchial irritation after influenza (Kreos., Kali-bi.). Tuberculosis and chronic bronchitis. Pain at the third left costal cartilage, where it joins the rib, pain of the left bronchus, with an offensive muco-purulent expectoration the indications for Pix are complete. Scaly eruptions. Much itching. Alopecia (Fl-ac.). Constant vomiting of black fluid with pain in stomach.

Abdomen - Excessive pain in bowels and loins.

Rectum - Dark-colored stools.

Chest - Suppuration of left lung with pain at third rib. Pain at a spot about the third left costal cartilage, where it joins the rib. Rales through the lungs and chest.

Skin - Acute eczema. Acne. Desquamation. Skin cracked, itches intolerably, bleeds on scratching, with sleeplessness. Eruptions on back of hands. COMMENTS - Buckley recorded severe constitutional effects following the local application of preparations of tar in skin disorders, including a high fever, black vomit, black stools, dark-colored urine, acute eczema, and acne. In the Hom. News., Raynaud noted a case of chronic bronchitis in a merchant, 55. The cough was worse nights, breath short, copious expectoration, some fever and nightsweats. He had been ill three years and was growing worse. Raynaud prescribed wood tar, a teaspoonful four times a day after meals and at bedtime, which cleared up most of the symptoms. Pix. often cures the bedwetting of children. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Terebe., Pin-s., Kreos., Eupi., Petr. (2) In chest pains, Anis, has pain at third right costal cartilage, occasionally also left, Myric., Ther. (3) Desquamation, Chin-s. (4) Ter., Carb-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Kidneys - Ardor urine. Dark-colored urine. Lungs - Chronic bronchitis. Cough chronic, worse night, expectoration purulent, fever at night. Muco-purulent sputum, offensive odor and taste.

name: Placenta Humana
author: Murphy
constitution: Abdominal, pain. Backache. Belching. Constipation. Depression. Diarrhea. Earache. Eyestrain. Flatulence. Headaches. Night-sweats. Nightmares. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Photophobia. Sciatica. Styes. Toothache. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - plac. Placenta humana. Human placenta. Sarcode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdominal, pain. Backache. Belching. Constipation. Depression. Diarrhea. Earache. Eyestrain. Flatulence. Headaches. Night-sweats. Nightmares. Nosebleeds. Palpitations.…
full:
PHARMACY - plac. Placenta humana. Human placenta. Sarcode. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdominal, pain. Backache. Belching. Constipation. Depression. Diarrhea. Earache. Eyestrain. Flatulence. Headaches. Night-sweats. Nightmares. Nosebleeds. Palpitations. Photophobia. Sciatica. Styes. Toothache. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Loss of energy. Weariness. Weakness and trembling. Restlessness, worse on waking. Poor co-ordination with extreme tiredness. Lack of vital heat, sensation of coolness. Averse to warm stuffy rooms. Worse on right side. MIND - Apathetic and emotionless. No emotions, very little reaction to things going on. Calmness, almost to the point of no reaction. Completely passive. Confused, dazed and distant. Confusion of identity. Feel isolated, lonely, vulnerable and weepy. Weak memory, forgetful. Concentration difficult with an inability for mental work. Sadness, depressed and despondent. Nostalgia with flashbacks to past events. Feeling unappreciated, cross and sorry for self. Irritability and anxiety. Anxiety, as if forgotten something important. Nervous anxiety about being on time. Anxiety about family, finances, work, the future. Anxiety about health and heart disease. Ailments from bad news. Fear, as if something would go wrong. Fear of failure. Fear of closed places, sensation of claustrophobia, fear of crowds. Fear of rats. Sexual thoughts increased.

Head - Headache, worse in the forehead, as if the head were in a vise. Headaches, worse noise, and on right side. Dull, pressing head pain. Tightness. Pain in right temple. Bursting, stabbing pains. Sensation of coldness on vertex. Head cold, body hot, better if head is wrapped. Hair greasy. Hearing - Ears with pulsating blood flow. Noise, as if under water, with distortion of hearing. Sounds distinct, more able to hear high pitched sounds. Sensitive hearing, particularly to the noise of children. Averse to loud noises. Competing, conflicting noises irritates.

Eyes - Heavy and aching. Soreness. Stabbing pain, better sleep. As if eyes strained. Must keep blinking. Hard to open eyes. Puffy on waking. Dark eyelids as if punched, worse right. Swelling of the eyelids. Styes. Photophobia during the day.

Ears - Earache, hot, painful, itchy. Aching, throbbing ear pain. Popping of ears with crusty discharge. Ears feel hot inside with a low pitched hum and bloody discharge. Fleeting, sharp pains in right ear. As if ears had been in the wind. Sensitive to vibrations.

Nose - Sneezing. Clear, watery discharge from right nostril. Clear catarrh. Copious discharge. Right nostril runny, with clear discharge, while left nostril is blocked. Discharge that drips down the back of the throat. Thick and green discharge. Lots of green, yellow, sticky mucus, worse at 3 p.m. Nosebleed on washing face. Pain on bridge of nose, left nostril sore inside, as if scratched. Sensitive smell, worse perfume, people, body odor, car fumes and dogs.

Face - Anxiety felt in face with a mild ache in cheekbones. Pain in right cheekbone. Aching. Dry, sore patch right side of nose, dry and flaky. Worse left side, after exposure to wind and rain. Left temple, dry skin erupted, lumpy. Numb patch. Tingly, numb sensation, below left eye. Right side of face numb. Red spots on the face. Feet - Cold feet. Numbness, loss of sensation in feet. Pins and needles in feet.

Mouth - Tingling of the lips. Lips, redness and swelling, peeling and dry. Ulcerated lips with yellow crusts and scabs, burning, cracking, sensitive to hot food and bleeding. Worse from eating, talking. Lips sensations, tingling, pins and needles. Crack in top lip. Vesicles on the lips and aphthae in the mouth, on the tongue. Sore lumps on roof of mouth with numbness. Gum ulceration, gums as though hardened after a burn. Gums sore, not bleeding.

Throat - Hoarseness. Throat dry and tickly. Sore throat, dryness and rawness, worse on swallowing. Sore throat with numbness, particularly on left side, worse morning, 3 p.m. Sore throat, on waking, better hot and cold drinks. Sore, swollen and hot, better cold food. Sensitive to pressure. Stinging throat pain extending down to the esophagus. Stinging from smoking. Pressing, choking sensation in throat, worse right side with a need to clear it. Need to clear mucus from the throat. Mucus in back of throat. Loose phlegm at back of throat, coughs to clear it, worse 10 p.m.

Stomach - Nervous trapped energy in stomach. Stomach cramps, worse eating, at night. Cramping pain. Pain top of stomach, connected to back. Burning stomach pain extending upward into the esophagus. Gas and acidity in stomach, worse wine. Heartburn associated with nausea. Belching. Deep, long, loud belch- ing. A lot of wind. Hiccoughs on and off throughout day. Nausea on eating. Nausea, pill tasted bitter. Nausea with sudden vomiting around midnight.

Abdomen - Bloated and uncomfortable after eating. Bloated and tender. Lower abdomen sore and bloated, better from sitting with legs wide apart. Abdominal pain associated with distension. Rumbling. Painfulflatulence, with abdominal tension. Flatulence with short, cramping, twisting pains making one double up. Shooting pain right to left, as if in labor when the head is low, better for lying on abdomen. As if needed to pass stool. Stabbing pain to right of groin. Arms - Heavy weight sensation in arms with numbness. Lancinating pain in right elbow.

Rectum - Sharp shooting pains, worse sitting, as if sword up inside. Sudden urging for stool. Constipated, better from standing to pass stool. Constipation alternating with diarrhea. Soft and watery stools, alternating with hard and dry stools. Diarrhea is gushing, watery, urgent, loud and explosive with abdominal pain. Bowel movements increased to three a day. Burning and sensation of heat during and after stools. Shoulder - Lancinating pain in right shoulder. Pain at base of left shoulder blade, worse breathing deeply. Right shoulder blade aches.

Stool - Large painful, dry stool. Loose and windy. Loose, fast stool, smelling of onions or garlic, 8 a.m. and 9 a.m. Taste - Mouth dry, with a bad taste, and breath smells. Dry, metallic taste on front of tongue. Foul taste. As if soaking up chemicals, smells and pollution. As if been licking metal.

Female - Menses delayed. Period heavy. Menstrual pain in back and abdomen. Cramps in uterus. Uterus aching and uncomfortable. Dragging period pains, better warmth and pressure. Painless period. Blood bright red. Shooting pain in ovaries and fallopian tubesfleft side morning, right side evening) during ovulation, with increased mucus. Right ovarian pain during ovulation. Streaks of blood at ovulation. Herpetic eruptions and cysts on the labia. Itching. Less vaginal discharge than normal. Small amount of dark purple, sticky mucus. Libido, strong. High sexual energy. Urge to have sex and reproduce. Strong feeling of pregnancy, as if baby moving around in belly and sensation of breasts filling up with milk. Sexual when premenstrual. Food - Lack of thirst. Appetite changeable. Appetite lost but better for eating. Appetite decreased. Reduced appetite, increased after 6 p.m. When eats, feels sick. Easy satiety with difficulty eating. Snacks rather than a meal. Snacking with weight loss. Obsession for the amount of food eaten. Increased appetite. Appetite increased for breakfast and then reduced with weight loss. Desires spicy food, curry, delicate hot foods. Desires sweets and chocolate. Intolerant to milk. Thirst increased for cold drinks, beer, carbonated drinks and tea. Strong aversion to nuts. Strong disinterest in vegetables. Hands - Itchy, flaky, dry, cracking and sore. Heels of palms of both hands hot, itchy, burning. Fingers as ifnumb with cold. Pins and needles sensations. Right hand stiff and slightly painful, especially fingers.

Chest - Constriction. Tight, suffocative feeling in chest, worse from emotions. Sensation of tight band around chest, worse at night, extending into throat. Chest feels tight and wheezy. Sensation of a lump in chest, extending to throat and back, worse swallowing, and pressure, better movement. Chest raw with a feeling of warmth. Eruptions on the chest.

Heart - Sensation of heart on right side. Heart rushing. Accelerated heartbeat. Heart racing and palpitations on going to sleep. Palpitations and breathlessness, feeling unable to breathe. Panic and palpitations with a sensation as if heart would be crushed on sitting. Hips - Muscular stiffness in left hip. Aching pain in bed. Knees - Stiff knees, worse in one position too long, worse rising. Legs - Shaking, weak legs. Legs heavy and uncoordinated. Pain in back of left thigh. Achy legs with pins and needles in right leg. Muscle spasm in right leg muscles with twitching and jerking. Numbness in right calf.

Back - Lower backache. Back pain, worse from sitting and relieved when lying down, worse during menses. Cervical and lumbar spine stiff. Right sided pains. Dull ache behind and between shoulder blades with twitching muscles. Sensation of inflammation in back.

Neck - Neck feels knotted. Stiffness. Achy and sore, neck aches in waves.

Limbs - Sciatica. Trembling of limbs, worse sitting. Coldness and itching of the extremities. Burning pain in the legs. Lungs - Tightness of lungs in waves. Cough, worse deep breathing. Tickly cough, high pitched with a sensation of hollowness in right lung. Slightly throaty, croupy cough when chest feels tight. Expectoration thick, stringy and green.

Sleep - Disturbed and difficult to get to sleep. Deep sleep. Offensive perspiration during sleep. Vivid dreams, nightmares, frightful and anxious dreams. Dreams of falling, of being pursued, of being raped, of dead people. Waking after midnight. Restlessness, worse on waking. Speech - Voice croaky, hoarse. Loss of speech.

Skin - Dry skin. Itching with and without eruptions. Painful warts. Wounds slow to heal.

Teeth - Teeth sensitive. Feel loose, difficult to bite. Bottom right side molar section loose, fell out. Toothaches. Gums receding.

Tongue - Tongue is slightly red, but not sore, with ulcer under the right side. Tongue yellow and furry, big and rough sensation. Vertigo - Light headed. Vertigo on motion of head, worse sitting, worse on closing eyes and lying down. Vertigo with fear of brain tumor. Vision - Blurred vision. Lack of focus, has to keep blinking. Fuzzy, as if drunk. Heightened vision, more sensitive. RELATIONS - Compare: Care., Lyc., Puls., Sep. REFERENCES - Biggs. Gwillim.

Bladder - Pain during urination. Offensive, strong smelling urine. Breasts - Breasts swollen and tender, before period. Nipples sensitive and tingling, as if milk coming in. Left nipple itchy with hard cheesy discharge. Shooting pains in right breast going through to back. Stitching pain, left breast. Breathing - Difficulty breathing, like old asthma. Accelerated breathing. Breathless on talking. Difficult breathing on walking up the hill. Hyperventilation.

Cough - Dry cough with nasal discharge.

Perspiration - Night sweats.

name: Plantago Major
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from sleep. Colic is better by eating. Worse at night, heat of room, heat and cold, cold air, sharp wind. Worse contact, motion, mental exertion..
constitution: Ague. Bedwetting. Bites. Breast inflammation. Burns. Ciliary neuralgia. Chilblains. Depression. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Earache. Ears inflammation. Emissions. Erysipelas. Erythema. Frostbite. Gumboils. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Injuries. Impotency. Insomnia. Mastitis. Neuralgias. Otorrhea. Polyuria. Pyorrhea. Rhus poisoning. Snakebites. Spleen, pain. Tetanus. Tobacco, habit. Toothaches. Urinatio
keynote: PHARMACY - plan. Plantago major. Plantain. Ribwort. N. O. Plantaginaceae. Plan, must not to be confounded with Musa, sometimes called “Plantain,” which belongs to a different class. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all…
full:
PHARMACY - plan. Plantago major. Plantain. Ribwort. N. O. Plantaginaceae. Plan, must not to be confounded with Musa, sometimes called “Plantain,” which belongs to a different class. Tincture of whole fresh plant. Tincture of the root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Ague. Bedwetting. Bites. Breast inflammation. Burns. Ciliary neuralgia. Chilblains. Depression. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Earache. Ears inflammation. Emissions. Erysipelas. Erythema. Frostbite. Gumboils. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Injuries. Impotency. Insomnia. Mastitis. Neuralgias. Otorrhea. Polyuria. Pyorrhea. Rhus poisoning. Snakebites. Spleen, pain. Tetanus. Tobacco, habit. Toothaches. Urination, delayed. Urticaria. Vaccinations. Worms. Wounds.

HERBAL - Plantago has a reputation in herbal medicine from remote antiquity, including for use in intermittent fevers. In 1558 the Herbal of Dodoens commended the juice of leaves or roots for “toothache and bleeding of gums.” External use in toothache in hollow teeth, otorrhea, itching and poison oak. Incised wounds. John Parkinson, in his Theater of Plants (1640), said that “the root taken fresh out of the ground, washed and gently scraped with a knife, then put into the ear, cures the toothache like a charm.” Reutlinger noted that in Switzerland the leaf tissues were frayed out and put into the ear for the same purpose. If they relieve the pain they “turn black” and have to be removed, if there is no relief the leaves remain green. Hale summed up the ancient and modern history of Plantago Maj., the weed that furnishes food for cage-birds. In herbal practice, it is constantly resorted to as an application in all disorders of the skin with irritation, pain and heat, the bruised leaves being applied to the part.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hale noted that erysipelas, rhus poisoning, erythema, burns, inflammation of the glands, bruises, incised wounds, animal bites, chilblains, and frostbite had all been relieved by its use. Plan, has a considerable clinical reputation in the treatment of earache, toothache and bedwetting. Pyorrhea al veolaris. Gums bleed easily. Sharp pain in the eyes, reflex from decayed teeth or inflammation of middle ear. Eyeball is very tender to touch. Affects the nerves, causing neuralgia of ears, teeth, face, of shingles. Pains are sharp, shifting, play between ear and teeth. Can be applied locally for neuralgia. Inflammation of the breasts. Soreness. Sensation as of a foreign body between ears in the groins, etc. Inflamed and painful hemorrhoids. MIND - Great mental prostration, worse by mental exertion, which causes rapid breathing and anxiety. Mind inactive with dullness. Confusion of thought. Irritable, morose, impatient. Restless mood with dull, stupid feeling in brain. Despondency. Depression and insomnia of chronic nicotinism. Disgust for tobacco in chewers and smokers.

Head - Dull headache. Headache with toothache. Sense of something lying in the head, through one ear to the other. As if brain turned over. Itching of scalp.

Eyes - Sharp pains in the eyes, reflex from decayed teeth. Dull, heavy ache in left eye. Eyes red, dim, inflamed, sore. Aching deep in orbit. Lids sore, swollen. As of a hair before eye.

Ears - Sticking pain in ears. Otalgia with toothache. Neuralgic earache, pain goes from one ear to the other. Pain in right ear with pains in teeth and face. Pains sharp, twinging. As of a foreign body between ears. Hearing acute, noise painful. Loud noises go through body. Ringing in ears.

Nose - Red papules around nose. Sensation at bridge as if nasal bones being pressed together. Frequent sneezing, with sudden attacks of profuse, watery, bland coryza. Sudden discharge of yellow colored water from the nose.

Face - Neuralgia of left side of face, pains shooting and tearing, extending from jaw to ear. Violent bruised, aching pain, right face. Pain radiating to temples and lower jaw. Drawing in right malar bone. Lips livid, dark, sickly, rough. Dry, scaly eruption on lower lip. Eruption on forehead. Food - Appetite poor. Thirst. Causes disgust for tobacco in chewers.

Mouth - Profuse flow of saliva. Saliva flows with pains. Dirty taste. Breath putrid. Tongue coated white, with dirty, putrid, clammy taste. Food tasteless. Gumboils. Gums bleed easily. Aphthae in children. Swelling of cheeks.

Throat - Dry, parched throat. Scraping in throat. Profuse secretion of thick sticky, mucus with much hawking. Soreness and swelling of submaxillary glands on both sides. COMMENTS - The tincture has been extensively proved by F. Humphreys (who wrote a monograph upon it), Heath and others. Neuralgic pains of teeth, ears and face were especially pronounced. Shingles, neuralgia. Great surface sensitiveness. Tearing, boring, bruised pains. Pains come suddenly and are apt to be erratic. Unendurable pains. The left side is most affected. Snake bites, bee stings, animal bites. Burns. Frostbite. Loud noises go through body. Sudden discharge of yellowish or saffron-colored water from the nose. Toothaches, especially in cavities (Hyp. tincture, Hecla.). “Toothache with earache,” particularly if with salivation. Toothache with boring and digging pains. A deep aching in hollow or rotten teeth. Neuralgic pains shooting up the face, from the tooth area. Gumboils. Grinds teeth at night (Cina., Tub.). Produces disgust for tobacco in chewers and cures neuralgia resulting from tobacco. Foul breath. Sinking and weight in stomach. Offensive flatulence. Darting up and down the urethra. Bedwetting in children. Lax sphincters. Very copious urine, with thirst. Diabetes. Diarrhea, dysentery. Worms. Painful hemorrhoids. Clarke used it with success in numberless cases of toothache and earache. It has given relief in the painful neuralgia of shingles and in pleurodynia. F. P. Stiles related three cases of its use. Mrs. S., 39, had terrible neuralgic pain in the right side of her face, shooting into temporal, superior, maxillary and orbital regions for 10 days. Plan, was applied locally to the gums, temple and cheek removed the pain in a few minutes. Some days later a slight return was promptly relieved in the same way. Mr. R. had neuralgia in left superior maxillary and lower orbital region of long standing. Promptly relieved in the same way. Mrs. N. had neuralgia of the right upper jaw, unbearable pain, radiating to ear, temple and cheek. A tooth had been extracted without relief. Plan, removed all the pain. There is a case of one man who allowed himself to be bitten by arattlesnake. He cured himself by frequently drinking the juice. RELATIONS -Antidótelo: Apis, Rhus-t., Tab. Antidotedby: Merc, (toothache). Comparent) Punctured wounds. Led., Hyper. (2) Wounds and bruises, fetid breath and flatus, Arn. (3) Earache with toothache intolerance of warm room, Puls. (4) In neuralgias, Cham., Merc., Spig., Kalm., Coloc. (5) Wounds, Calen. (6) Kalm., Cham., Puls. (7) Hemorrhoids, external and internal, Ham. (8) Equis., Bell., Caust. - bedwetting. (9) Unendurable pains, Aeon., Cham., Hep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Belchings, frequent, empty, tasting like sulphur, of carbonic acid gas. Nausea with drowsiness or faint, tremulous feeling. Sinking sensation. Heaviness of stomach as from a stone, even after a light meal.

Abdomen - Gone sensation. Severe pains in the hypochondrium. Violent griping in upper abdomen. Bowels seem cold. Distention with passage of fetid flatus. Colic, flatulent, better by eating.

Rectum - Wants to defecate, goes often, but cannot. Chronic diarrhea. Stools are brown, frothy, watery, fermented, pa- pescent, excoriating. Cholera infantum. Dysentery. Worms. Painful hemorrhoids, bloody, can hardly stand (used locally).

Male - Sexual debility. Unconscious emission in sleep.

Chest - Oppression, worse reading or talking. Sharp stitches. Orgasms of blood. Muscular drawing.

Heart - Heat in précordia when walking in open air. Violentpalpitations on ascending stairs. Pulse strong, full, intermittent.

Back - Cold sweat on sacrum. Pain in sacrum. Throbbing, pulsative pain between scapulae. Neck stiff and sore. Stiffness of sternocleidomastoid mastoid. Breasts - Inflammation the breasts. Erysipelas of breasts. Mastitis. Neuralgia of nipples. Causations - Ill effects of bites, bruises, burns, cuts, punctured wounds, snakebites, stings.

Limbs - Disposition to stretch. Stinging, dull pains here and there. Numbness and trembling legs. Great pain and stiffness in left leg and knee, worse stooping. Hard, white, flattened, papules on inside of thighs. Lungs - Hoarseness. Cough in cold air. Panting breathing, inclined to sigh.

Sleep - Excessive and continued yawning. Insomnia from abdominal trouble. Grinding teeth during sleep. Sleep restless, disturbed by dreams. Gloomy dreams exciting tears.

Skin - Sensitive skin. Burns. Violent itching, worse night. Burning, pricking, stinging pains. Burning after rubbing where scratched. Redness, swelling, and vesicles on hands and face. Papules which exude yellowish humor and form a crust. Erythema. Urticaria, chilblains (Agar., Tam.). Rhus poisoning (external use).

Modalities - Better from sleep. Colic is better by eating. Worse at night, heat of room, heat and cold, cold air, sharp wind. Worse contact, motion, mental exertion.

Teeth - Teeth feel too long. Teeth are sensitive and sore to touch. Rapid tooth decay. Toothache in decayed teeth or shooting up left side of face. Toothache, better while eating. Toothache with reflex neuralgia of eyelids. Sharp stabbing pains. Grinds teeth at night

Kidneys - Tenderness over region of kidneys on pressure. Irritable bladder with frequent urination. Urethra tingling with unpleasant itching in meatus. Delayed, dribbling urine. Frequent passage of large quantity of pale urine, worse night, with thirst. Diabetes. Profuse flow of urine. Nocturnal bedwetting from laxity of sphincter (Rhus-a., Caust., Bell.).

Temperature - Chilliness with erratic pains. Chilliness on moving about, cold hands in a warm room. Chill without thirst, with goose bumps. Coldness of body with shivering. Heat with thirst, and great excitability, mental agony, restlessness. Sweat is cold over lumbar and the sacral region, heat of room unbearable, producing perspiration.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - platan. Platanus occidentalis. Sycamore buttonwood. Platanus acerifolia. Platanus vulgaris. London plane tree. N. O. Platanaceae of the Urtica alliance. Tincture of young shoots. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Cataract. Ichthyosis. Tarsal tumors.

HERBAL - Burnett named the remedy Plat, occidentalis, but his tincture was made from Platanus acerifolia. It sheds its bark annually, which was the signature of its skin action.

HOMEOPATHIC - The tincture, applied topically, has been used for tarsal tumors, both acute and old, neglected cases. It restored to practically normal conditions areas where destruction of tissue occurred and scar tissue caused marked deformity. Ichthyosis. Must be used for some time; acts best in children. COMMENTS - Burnett recorded a case of ichthyosis in an elderly woman in which Platan, caused considerable improvement in the condition of the skin. Another case of Burnett's was that of a girl, 5 1/2, “of the coal-black variety of the strumous, her forehead low and projecting,” who was blind from double cataract due to the shock of a fall in the first instance, the lenses having gradually silted up. In this case Platan, was given, five drops night and morning, for a number of months, “with very evident improvement in the nutrition of the child's lenses.” REFERENCES - Boericke. Burnett. Clarke.

author: Murphy

full:
PHARMACY - plat. Platinum metallicum. Platina metal. The element (Pt. At. Wt. 195.08) Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amenorrhea. Chlorosis. Colic. Constipation. Convulsions. Delusions. Dentition. Depression. Dysmenorrhea. Fears. Gout. Hemorrhage. Hemorrhoids. Hysteria. Insanity. Lead, poisoning. Masturbation. Melancholia. Menorrhagia. Menses, suppressed. Multiple personalities. Neuralgias. Neurasthenia. Numbness. Nymphomania. Ovarian, disorders. Painter's colic. Pruritus, vulvae. Rape. Rheumatism. Sexual, abuse. Sexual, mania. Spasms. Tapeworms. Uterus, disorders. Vaginismus. Vaginitis. Vertigo. Yawning, spasmodic.

HOMEOPATHIC - The original name of platinum was “Platina,” a Spanish word meaning “like silver.” The metal was introduced into Europe from South America in the middle of the eighteenth century. It is always found in association with other metals, chiefly rhodium, osmium, iridium, and palladium. Hahnemann was the first to think of it as a medicine and his proving in the Chronic Diseases is the basis of the knowledge of its action. Strong tendency to paralysis, anesthesia, localized numbness and coldness are shown. Hysterical spasms, pains increase and decrease gradually (Stann.). Tremulousness. Alternation of mental and physical symptoms, as physical symptoms disappear mental symptoms appear and vice versa. Oversensitive mind, emotions and nerves. Plat, is pre-eminently a woman's remedy. Many and various symptoms reflex from ovaries and uterus or sexual organs. Sticky discharges, tears, stools, menses, etc. Catalepsy during menses. Hemorrhages with black clots with fluid. Irregular spasms, congestion of blood. Violent cramping, squeezing, thrusting or numbing pains, then spasms. Hysterical spasms. Spasms alternate with dyspnea. Tonic and clonic spasms with laughter. Violent shocks, as from pain. Contortions of limbs. Epilepsy, catalepsy. Painful tremors. Pains increase and decrease gradually. Bandaged feeling. Sensation of pricking. Localized, coldness of single parts, eyes, ears etc. or numbness of scalp, face, coccyx, calves etc. MIND - Alternate mental and physical symptoms. Physical symptoms disappear as mental symptoms develop. Mental troubles better at twilight. Mental troubles with suppressed menses. Changing moods. Cheerfulness alternating with depression. Weeps and laughs alternately. Whistles, sings, dances. Laughs at wrong time. Irritability alternating with tenderness. Irritable about trifling things. Morose and discontented mood, worse being spoken to. Sadness better open air. Sits in a corner, broods and says nothing. Bad humor, yet weeps. Inconsolable weeping, worse when spoken to. Weeps with pains. Unkind, abrupt and quarrelsome. Contempt for others. Faultfinding. Proud and erotic. Self-exaltation. Feels tall and stately. Haughty, looks with disdain upon everyone and everything. Arrogant. Wounded pride. Absent-minded and forgetful. Any serious thought is terrifying. Weary of everything. Alone, deserted feeling. Indifference while in company. Past events trouble her. Everything seems changed or different. Feels she does not belong to her own family. Thinks she has no place in the world. Forsaken, deserted feeling. Feels everything seems changed. Disordered sense of proportion, objects seem smaller, strange, frightful. Anxiety when speaking in company. Sensation of dread and horrors. Fears of death. Fear of imaginary forms, ghosts. Thinks her husband will never return, something will happen to him. Screams for help. Impulse to kill her own child, her husband. Aversion to children. Delusion of superiority. Delusions she is alone in the world. Delusions she is not appreciated. Delusions she is disgraced. Delusions everyone is an enemy. Delusion that all persons are devils. Mental symptoms alternating with sexual symptoms. Sexual excitement brings on mental symptoms. Religious affections alternating with sexual excitement. Inclination to embrace everybody. Perverted sexual desire. Unchaste talk. Hysteria before menses. Nymphomania, worse during menses. Sexual mania.

Head - Constriction about forehead and right temples. Cramp-like, squeezing pain. Tensive confusion in forehead, as if head were compressed in a vice. Tense, pressing pain, confined to a small spot. Pain in sides of head, as if caused by a plug. Tense scalp. Constrictive headache, as if a tape were tightly drawn around it with sensation of numbness in brain. Numbness with headache. Attack of headache with nausea and vomiting. Headache with leucorrhea. Headache commences on waking. As of water in forehead.

Eyes - Eyes feel cold. Cramp-like pain in orbits. Aching in eyes with sleep. Pain in eyes after fatiguing the sight by looking attentively at an object. Objects look smaller than they are. Quivering and sparkling before sight. Confused sight, as if directed through a veil, often with painless twitchings around the eye. Twitching of the eyelids (Agar.).

Ears - Cramp-like twinges. Shocks in ears. Sensation of numbness and of coldness in ears, extending to cheeks and lips. Gnawing tingling in ears. Roaring, whizzing and ringing in ears. Dull thundering, rumbling in ears.

Nose - Cramp-like pain with sensation of numbness in nose and at root of nose. Ineffectual want to sneeze and tingling in nose. Dry coryza often semi-lateral. Corrosive sensation on nose, as of something acrid.

Face - Distortion of muscles of face. Grimaces. Coldness, creeping and numbness in whole right side of face. Facial pain with numb feeling in malar bones, as if the parts were between screws. Pain at root of nose, as if squeezed in a vise. Pains increase and decrease gradually (Stann.). Boring, cramps in the jaws. Lockjaw. Smarting and sharp vesicles on lips. Numbness of lips, dry and cracked.

Mouth - Mouth feels cold. Sensation as if palate or uvula were elongated. As if tongue were scalded. Sweet taste on tip of the tongue. Numb pain in left lower teeth. Cramp-like drawing in teeth. Toothache with pulsative and digging pain. Fissures in gums.

Throat - Cramp-like drawing in throat like a constriction. Scraping and accumulation of phlegm in throat. Hawking up of phlegm. Aphonia. Vertigo - Transient attacks of vertigo in evening with loss of consciousness. Vertigo on sitting down or ascending stairs. Vertigo as if torn and pulled with threads. COMMENTS - Plat, has a lost sense of proportion in both ocular and mental vision. Objects look small or the patient thinks they are small. Distortions of distance and size (Cann.). Pride and hauteur, the patient (generally a woman) looks down on everything and everybody. Delusion of grandeur. Megalomania (Cann., Hyos.), but seen as arrogance, not insanity. Arrogant, proud, particularly after grief, fright, rape or sexual abuse. Deep hatred for men. Alternating between one mental state and another. Changing moods, sad and gay, laughs and cries by turns. Laughs immoderately, but in the wrong place, laughs at serious things. Homicidal. Manic depression. Multiple personality disorders (Anae.). Identity crisis, they forget who they are. Jahr cured with Plat, a woman who had an inspiration to kill her child. Jule Gaudy recorded the case of a woman who was tormented with an almost irresistible impulse to kill her husband, whom she loved passionately and with whom she was perfectly happy. The sight of a knife had an irresistible fascination for her and she was often obliged to leave the table to free herself from the impulse. A few months before, she had lost achild a short time after confinement, which had been followed by profuse and persistent hemorrhage. Recovering from this she became restless, irritable and her whole existence was ruled by this terrible impulse. Plat. 6x and 30x relieved and finally cured her. Kent recorded the case of a middle-aged woman, the mother of several grown-up daughters, who complained of a fear in the absence of her husband, that he would never return, that he would die or be run over. She wept all the time he was away. Kent discovered that she had been treated for uterine displacement and was then wearing a pessary. This was removed. Menstrual flow was copious, black, clotted. The external genitals were so sensitive that the usual napkin was intolerable. Plat, cured the whole case including the displacement. Nash cured a case of insanity of some duration with Plat., being led to the remedy by an alternation of the mental symptoms with a pain the whole length of the spine. Keynote occurrence of cramps, cramping pains and spasms, developing into convulsions. Cramping pains causes numbness and tingling in the parts affected. Pains as if nipped, squeezed in a vice and these pains increase gradually to a climax and then, as gradually, decline. Cramping tendency, antidotal to lead poisoning. Tenesmus. Constipation, stools are tenacious and sticky, adhere to the rectum and anus like putty or they may be hard as if burnt. Constipation comes on while traveling, in emigrants, during pregnancy. Spasms alternate between convulsions and opisthotonos, full consciousness. Spasms alternate with dyspnea. Spasmodic yawning. Pains go from right to left. The right side is somewhat more affected than the left. The symptoms are periodic and paroxysmal, as well as alternating. Severe, painful menstrual cramps. Catalepsy during menstruation. With the menses, uterine spasms, convulsions. Convulsions of puerperal state. Excessive itching in uterus, pruritus vulvae. Vaginismus. Severe stitches in right ovary. Ovarian tumors. Generally centers in and radiates from the sexual organs, male and female. The sensitiveness of the external genitals is often so great as to make sex impossible (Staph., Cact.). Digital examining of such a patient causes great pain. Prostate problems (Pall.). Masturbation before puberty and also to the effects of masturbation. Premature and excessive development of sexual instinct and organs, before puberty. Severe vaginal irritation that leads to vaginal discharge and masturbation in young girls (Med.). Excessive desire, especially in virgins. Nymphomania, worse in puerperal state. Characteristic tendency to uncover completely in sleep. It was one of Gallavardin's remedies for the impulse to pederasty and sodomy. RELATIONS - Antidote: Puls. Plat, antidotes the bad effects of lead. Antidoted by: Puls., Teste, who classes Plat. withThuj., Brom, and Cast., says Colch. is the best antidote to all four. Compare: (1) Rhodi., Stann., Valer., Sep. (2) Plat-m. (3) Sed-ac - sexual irritability, relieves irritation of nerve centers and gives rest. (4) Self-pride, Pall., Plat, egotistical, despises others, Pall, easily wounded, attaches importance toothers, Lyc. - imperious. (5)Spasms, emacia- tion from pre-puberty masturbation, Staph. (6) Uterine affections, nymphomania, Aur., Sep. (the nymphomania of Plat, is more intense. Plat, is intermediate between Aur. and Sep. in weariness of life, the uterine cramps of Plat, are followed by numbness, those of Sep. are a clutching as if suddenly seized then suddenly relaxed. (7) Hysteria indurated ulcers, Tarent. (8) Sees ghosts spirits and demons, Hyos., Kali-br. (9) Shamelessness, uncovers, Phos., Hyos. - sees things larger. Plat, smaller. (10) Thinks death near and fears it, Aeon., Ars. (11) Dark, stringy hemorrhage, Cham., Croc, has sensation of something alive. Complementary: Plat, and Pall, both affect right ovary, but Pall, has better from pressure. Compatible: Bell., Ign., Lyc., Puls., Rhus-t., Sep., Verat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Aching, pressure in stomach, especially after a meal. Sensation of constriction in pit of stomach, extending into abdomen. Fermentations in epigastric region. Ineffectual effort to belch. Empty, noisy belchings. Continued nausea with lassitude, trembling and anxiety.

Abdomen - Pressing and bearing down in abdomen, extending into pelvis. Constriction. Pinchings in umbilical region. Pain in umbilical region extending through into the back, turns and twists in all possible positions. Fermentation, much flatulence. Flatulent soreness towards hypogastrium. Colic from lead poisoning.

Rectum - Constipation after lead poisoning, sometimes very obstinate. Constipation of pregnancy. Constipation of travelers, who are constantly changing food and water. Frequent want of stool, retarded, feces scanty, evacuated with difficulty in pieces. Stool seems to stick to anus and rectum like putty. Crawling, itching anus in evening. Voluptuous crawling in rectum. Violent and dull lancinations in rectum. Sensations - As if her senses would vanish. As if everything about her were very small. As if she were constantly growing longer and longer. As if she did not belong to her own family. As if head were enlarged. As if parts of malar bones were between screws. As if throat constricted, palate elongated tongue scalded. As if abdomen, chest, nape, limbs, thing, great toe, tightly wrapped or constricted. Back and small of back as if broken. Crawling, tingling, numb sensations.

Stool - Stool as if burnt. Stools hard, black passed in small portions with great straining, Stools adhere to rectum like soft clay. Sticky stool. Tinea and ascarides are discharged from rectum. Worms.

Male - Ill effects of masturbation before puberty. Perverted sexual desires. Unnatural increase ofsexual desire with frequent erections, especially at night (with amorous dream). Sex, short duration with little enjoyment. Flow of prostatic fluid. Burning pain and gnawing in scrotum. Voluptuous tickling, itching with excessive sexual desire. V oluptuous crawling in genital organs and abdomen with anxious oppression and palpitations, then painless pressure downwards in genitals with sticking in sinciput and exhaustion.

Female - Painfully sensitive genitals with itching, tickling or crawling. Tingling internally and externally (Kali- br.). Pruritus vulvae with voluptuous angling. Excessive sexual desire that leads to masturbation. Nymphomania, worse in puerperal state. Sexual mania. Frequent sensation as if menses would appear. Menses with chilliness, sensitive genitals. Menses too early, too profuse. Menses dark, clotted, with spasms and painful bearing-down. Dysmenorrhea with shrieks and jerks. Amenorrhea in emigrants. Leucorrhea like white of an egg. Vaginismus from excessive sensitiveness of sexual organs, sex is impossible (Staph.). Prolapse of uterus. Induration, uterine cancer. Fibroids. Ovaries sensitive and burn. Infertility from ovaritis or excessive sexual excitement. Food - Ravenous hunger, persistent nausea with anxiety and weakness. Hasty eating, eats everything around her or detests it. Loss of appetite after first mouthful. Repugnance to food from sadness. Worse from fasting.

Chest - Sensation of weakness. Anxious oppression of chest with sensation of heat, which ascends from epigastrium. Pain in chest, as if a weight were pressing upon it with desire to take a full inspiration. Tension, pressure and shootings in sides of chest, which do not permit lying down on either side. Aching and dull blows in the chest. Increasing to a certain intensity and gradually diminishing in same way. Dull lancinations in sides of chest during an inspiration. Constitutions - Suited to women with dark hair, thin, sanguine, bilious with too frequent and too profuse menses, sexual organs exceedingly sensitive. Hysterical and hemorrhoidal patients.

Heart - Burning and sticking low down by heart. A dull pressure in region of apex of heart. Anxious palpitation of heart.

Back - Pains in back and small of back as if broken, after a walk. Bruised backache, worse pressure, worse on bending backwards. Contusive pain in loins and in back. Sensation of numbness in coccyx, as after a blow. Weakness and sensation of tensive numbness in nape of neck. Rigidity of nape of neck. Causations - Ill effects of fright, vexation, bereavement, fit of passion. Ill effects of sexual excess, prolonged hemorrhages and masturbation.

Limbs - Limbs feel weary, numb, paralyzed. Tingling restlessness, sensation of weakness and trembling in limbs. Paralytic weakness. Attack of spasmodic rigidity in limbs. Cramp-like jerking and drawing pains in limbs and joints. Cramp in calves. Tightness of thighs, as if too tightly wrapped. Distorted fingers. Numbness of little finger or fingers. Lungs - Inclination to draw a long breath, prevented by a sensation of weakness in chest. Shortness of breath with a constrictive oppression of chest. Short, difficult and anxious respiration. Short, nervous, dry cough with palpitations and dyspnea. Walking against wind causes sudden arrest of breathing.

Sleep - Convulsive and spasmodic yawning, especially in afternoon. Great disposition to sleep in evening. Sleeps with legs far apart. Sleeps on back with knees drawn up and spread apart, wants to uncover entirely. Waking at night with frightful dreams, want of consciousness or with anxious, sad and distressing thoughts. Anxious dreams of wars and bloodshed. Lascivious dreams. Prolonged sleep in morning.

Skin - Tingling, gnawing with pain as of excoriation and itching or burning, pricking and shooting pain on various parts of skin, which provokes scratching. Ulcers, on fingers and toes.

Modalities - Better from walking in open air, sunshine, stretching and motion. Obliged to stretch, which ameliorates. Worse from emotions, chagrin, nerve exhaustion. Worse sex, during menses. Worse touch, pressure, sitting, standing and bending backwards. Worse evening and night, in a warm room.

Kidneys - Slow but frequent emission of urine. Red urine with a white cloud, or turbid and deposits a red sediment.

Temperature - Pulse small, feeble, frequently tremulous. Constant shivering and shuddering over whole body, especially in open air. Chilliness predominates with low spirits, which ceases during heat. Heat with sensation of burning in face without any visible change in color of face. Flushes of heat interrupted by chilliness. Gradually increasing and decreasing heat. Perspiration only during sleep, ceasing as soon as one wakens.

author: Murphy
constitution: Acne. Bone, disorders. Cancer. Caries. Condylomata. Gonorrhea. Fever. Headaches. Laryngismus. Syphilis.
keynote:
PHARMACY - plat-m. Platinum muriaticum. Platina chloride. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Bone, disorders. Cancer. Caries. Condylomata. Gonorrhea. Fever. Headaches. Laryngismus. Syphilis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Plat-m. was experimented with by Hofer of Pau, who applied…
full:
PHARMACY - plat-m. Platinum muriaticum. Platina chloride. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne. Bone, disorders. Cancer. Caries. Condylomata. Gonorrhea. Fever. Headaches. Laryngismus. Syphilis.

HOMEOPATHIC - Plat-m. was experimented with by Hofer of Pau, who applied a saturated solution locally and administered solutions internally. There is only a fragmentary proving, the mental symptom “thinks she has been poisoned” might be helpful as a guide in certain cases. The local application produced acute irritation of the skin and glans penis with an eruption on the latter like commencing chancre. Decay and caries of the nasal and tarsus bones. Syphilitic caries and syphilitic rheumatism. Laryngismus. Stricture of esophagus and cancer of the stomach. Canker, condylomata. Acne. Mercury abuse. Chronic gonorrhea. Involuntary movement of tissues of muscles of nape, back and limbs for several hours. Fever, headaches, constricting sensations and fibrillary twitchings were induced by internal doses. Plat-m. has achieved beneficial results after Kali-i. failed to cure in syphilitic affection, violent occipital headaches, dysphagia and syphilitic throat and bone affections, decay of bones of feet. MIND - Thinks she has been poisoned (Ars., Lach.).

Head - Some headache with slight acidity of stomach. Severe headache, especially in occiput with fever.

Mouth - Metallic taste.

Throat - Violent constriction of larynx, so that speech and swallowing were impeded. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Acidity of stomach with headache. Warmth and heaviness in epigastrium. Nausea and vomiting.

Male - Violent itching on glans and prepuce with sensation of warmth. Eruption about glans penis, somewhat livid, raised, size of pin head, looks like commencing syphilitic sore, but disappears in twelve hours.

Skin - Discolored yellow. Skin becoming covered with rosy red eruption that disappears after a few minutes from local application.

Kidneys - Acute inflammation of urethra, pain on urinating, slight dysuria.

Temperature - Slight shuddering, pulse accelerated, warmth in epigastrium.

full:
PHARMACY - plat-m-n. Platinum muriaticum natronatum. Sodium chloroplatinate. Solution. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Eructation. Flatus. Nausea. Polyuria. Salivation. Vomiting.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hofer experimented with Plat-m-n. on the same man who took Plat-mur. The chief additional symptom was decided increased secretion of urine and saliva. Slight headache. Feeling of warmth and heaviness in stomach. Rumbling in abdomen. Transient colic. Emission of flatus. Eructation of gas. Nausea and inclination to vomit. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Plectranthus Fruticosus
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better by application of ice, belchings. Burning in mouth worse from all food and drink. Chewing causes pain in temples. Worse by motion, moving head, turning body, swallowing. Worse while urinating, better after urinating. Worse by warmth of stove. Pressure in stomach, pain in umbilical region, worse after eating. Sensations - Cool sensation followed by burning at root of tongue and palate. As if a morsel stuck in the throat after swallowing. Pressure as from a heavy weight in stomach. As through air were piercing Plectranthus fruticosus the marrow of the bones. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Urinary symptoms, Oci. (2) Black stools, Lept. (3) Stitches in chest, Kali-c. (4) Pains come and go suddenly, Lyc., Bell. (5) Crumb in throat, Hep., Nit-ac., Arg-n. REFERENCES - Clarke..

PHARMACY - plect. Plectranthus fruticosus. N. O. Labiatae. Tincture of fresh plant. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Abdomen, coldness. Cholera. Cramps. Dentition. Diarrhea. Dysphagia. Fever. Intermittent, fever. Lumbrici. Neuralgia. Rheumatism. Shoulder, pains. Spastic, paralysis. Stiff neck. Sweat, local. Throat, sore. Toothache. Wrists, pains.

HOMEOPATHIC - Plect. was proved by the Austrian Provers' Association. Severe symptoms were induced in the head, throat, intestinesandrectum, limbs and joints. Hansen mentioned spastic paralysis as having been remedied by it. Toothaches with swelling of face and difficulty of opening mouth. “Pain near right jaw joint as if a tooth were coming through” suggests a use for the remedy in difficult cutting of wisdom teeth. Burning sensation throughout the digestive tract. Coldness of abdomen, better in open air. Pressure on rectum and bladder. Discharge of white mucus from anus, causing scratching. Whites of eyes yellow, worse left. Sweat of right foot, left foot dry of right foot and both hands and no other part of scalp. Pains and other symptoms come and go suddenly. Exhaustion, bruised sensation, genera] discomfort. Cramps and paralytic pains in joints. Pains of many kinds in right shoulder. Pains about the navel. Affects the right side more than the left.

Modalities - Better by application of ice, belchings. Burning in mouth worse from all food and drink. Chewing causes pain in temples. Worse by motion, moving head, turning body, swallowing. Worse while urinating, better after urinating. Worse by warmth of stove. Pressure in stomach, pain in umbilical region, worse after eating. Sensations - Cool sensation followed by burning at root of tongue and palate. As if a morsel stuck in the throat after swallowing. Pressure as from a heavy weight in stomach. As through air were piercing Plectranthus fruticosus the marrow of the bones. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Urinary symptoms, Oci. (2) Black stools, Lept. (3) Stitches in chest, Kali-c. (4) Pains come and go suddenly, Lyc., Bell. (5) Crumb in throat, Hep., Nit-ac., Arg-n. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Plumbago Littoralis
author: Murphy
constitution: Blisters. Eyes, inflammation. Fever. Kidneys, pain. Saliva, milky. Ulcerations. Vertigo.

PHARMACY - plumbg. Plumbago littoralis. Plumbago scandens. Bay of Rio Janeiro. N. O. Plumbaginaceae. Tincture of leaves. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Blisters. Eyes, inflammation. Fever. Kidneys, pain. Saliva, milky. Ulcerations. Vertigo.

HERBAL - Mure says Plumbg. is a creeper inhabiting the shores in the bay of Rio de Janeiro. Many of the plants of this genus are acrid and caustic in the highest degree. The Treasury of Botany noted that the root of Plumbago scandens, the Herbe du Diable of San Domingo, is a blistering agent when fresh, so also is that of Plumbago rosea. The beggars employ Plumbago europea to raise ulcers on their body to excite pity, and used internally it is said to be as good an emetic as ipecac.

HOMEOPATHIC - Mure proved Plumbg. The most peculiar symptoms were profuse, milky saliva. Ulceration of commissures of lips, which is an evidence of its acridity. Costiveness with red urine. Pain in humerus on lifting anything. Hot arms with cold hands. Vertigo after eating. Aversion to everything. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Costiveness wifi red urine, Lyc. (2) The Plumbaginaneae an allied to the Primulaceae. (3) Plantaginacea< - the root of Plumbg-eu. is used dried as ; remedy for toothache. REFERENCES Clarke.

HOMEOPATHIC - Several cases of poisoning by Plb-chr. have been observed. The symptoms present the cardinal features of lead poisoning. Cramps. Convulsions with terrible pains. Pupils enormously dilated. The face was red and hot and there was heat of the body generally. Erythematous redness of chest and abdomen. Retracted abdomen. Violent diarrhea of yellow color. Yellow stools with constipation. The symptoms were worse towards evening. Better by drinking warm milk. REFERENCES - Clarke.

Indurations of great hardness. Indurations of breasts, especially when a tendency to become inflamed appears, sore and painful. Sharp pains of tabes. REFERENCES Clarke.
