full:
PHARMACY - psil. Psilocybe caerulescens. Psilocybe mushroom. N. O. Strophari- aceae. (Agaricaceae). Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Aphthae. Coryza. Delusions. Fatigue. Headache. Heat, flushes. Nausea. Palpitations. Salivation. Sneezing. Tonsillitis. Vertigo. Weakness.

HOMEOPATHIC - Extreme weakness and tiredness. Weakness and nausea. Great weakness after eating, desire to take a nap, better motion. Flushes of heat at night. Increased sexual desire at night. Voracious appetite, gets up at midnight to eat. Sour eructations after spicy and fatty food. Sensation of heaviness in stomach and indigestion, better drinking water. “Slow digestion with sensation of suffocation at night, better cold drinks.” Thirst, not better drinking. Dryness. Watery, mucus nasal discharge with sneezing. Throbbing headache, especially on the right side. Great pain in right shoulder, as if covered with ice.Sexual desire increased, especially in females. Pains appear and disappear suddenly. Pains pricking and stinging. Fleeting and erratic pains. Pain worse by small movements rather than by big movements. Painlessness of complaints usually painful. Sensation of strength. MIND - Mental weakness. Absent-minded when conversing. Abstraction of mind and fixed eyes. Distraction. Loses the thread of his conversation. Listens with interest but only some minutes later it occurs to him what was said. Forgets everything, from lack of involvement, yet without feeling worried about it. Sadness. “Great depression, recalling the past as if something was left undone, recalling occurrences with great detail, making one melancholic.” Vindictiveness, “without knowing why or against whom.” “Want of ethical and religious principles.” Indifference to everything around him. Idea that one can be in several places at the same time and think differently in each place. Sensation of being two or three personalities at the same time that cannot fuse, as if looking into several mirrors. Telepathic speaking with superior spirits. Sensation of being in visual touch with God. Alternatively attracted to God and the devil. Sensation of being possessed by a divine force. Involuntary laughing. Feels that someone is spying on him from behind and to the right, which makes him turn over in an summersault. Sensation of being in the moon. Sensation of being able to resolve whatever problem of mathematics or being able to understand any language. Thinks he is well. An old and badly dressed woman looks young and beautiful. Vivid hallucinations of luminous colors. Time appears shorter, passes too quickly. Suddenly changing delusions (Cann- i.). Delusion of having creative power. Delusion of being in communication with God. Delusion of being under a powerful, superhuman influence, alternately by God Psilocybe caerulescens and the devil. Delusion that he is hovering in the air like a spirit.

Head - Heaviness in forehead when stooping. Pain, headache, on head getting cold. Headache increasing gradually. Headache simultaneous with other pains. Pain in forehead from sunlight (Ign.). Pain in temples while chewing. Pressing pain as if by a band.

Eyes - Sensation of enlargement of left eye (Arg-n.). Burning pain in eyelids on winking. Food - Thirst, vanishing at sight of water. Worse cold food.

Nose - Violent attacks of coryza. Coryza in warm room. Obstruction and watery discharge. Sneezing in morning, after rising. Sensations - Sensation of flying. Sensation of obstruction of nose and watery discharge. Sensation of dryness of mouth and salivation. Sensation of dryness of throat, not better drinking. Sensation of sweating around the mouth, but the skin is dry.

Mouth - Aphthae, bleeding easily. Salivation and dryness of tongue. Metallic taste, at tip of tongue, seemingly originating from the teeth, with sensation as if esophagus were knotted up.

Throat - Sensation of mucus. Mucus in morning on waking. Pain when touched. Dryness of throat, worse emotions, not better drinking. Inflammation of tonsils from smoking or from tobacco smoke. Constant disposition to swallow from lump in throat. Weakness of voice after talking. Vertigo - Vertigo and trembling, better sitting. Vertigo and momentary loss of consciousness. Sensation as if the earth were slipping away under one's feet. Vertigo with weakness and trembling of legs, tendency to fall to the right side. Vision - Colors, black spots during headache (Meli.). RELATIONS - Compare: Anh., Cann-i., Sulph., Lach., Agar. REFERENCES - Murphy. Toledo.

Stomach - Emptiness, weak feeling, better pressure. Nausea, in morning on waking, from odors, while smoking.

Abdomen - Pain in liver after cold food (Mang.).

Chest - Sudden, paroxysmal palpitations.

Back - Coldness as from ice.

Limbs - Desquamating eruption of palms of hands, soles of feet. Itching of soles of feet. Wrinkling of fingertips, as if dehydrated.

Sleep - Falling asleep from weakness. Short sleep refreshes. Sleepiness during pain. Unrefreshing sleep. Difficult waking in morning. Waking from hunger. Dreams of being robbed and attacked in his own house and being incapable of defending oneself. Dreams of being chased by a vampire in a big house. Dreams of eating frogs with thorns and waking up with epigastric pain.

Modalities - Better from cold. Worse cold, wet weather. Worse in the morning on waking, right side.

Worse evening, before midnight, night, morning on waking. Worse from heat of bed, wool clothes. Worse exertion in hot sunshine, walking, moving, washing. Worse pressure, rubbing, scratching, touch, contact of own limbs, bandage. Worse from suppressions. Liver is worse lying on right side. Over-lifting causes thoughts to vanish. Winter causes cough. Summer causes diarrhea, itching eruptions. Bedwetting is worse periodically, yearly, at the full moon..

full:
PHARMACY - psor. Psorinum. Scabies nosode. The product of “Psora sicca ” epidermoid efflorescence of pityriasis by Gross. The salt from a product of psora by Hering. Nosodes. Triturations. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Acne rosacea. Adenoids. Allergies. Anus, itching. Anxiety. Asthma. Backaches. Bedwetting. Blepharitis. Boils. Cancer. Cholera infantum. Colds. Cough. Constipation. Cornea, ulcers. Crusta lactea. Crusta serpiginosa. Debility. Depression. Despair. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Emaciation. Eruptions, itching. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gouty. Hay fever. Headaches. Hemorrhages. Hemorrhoid. Hernia. Hydrocele. Hypoglycemia. Impotency. Influenza. Injuries. Itching. Leucorrhea. Lice. Lienteria. Liver, disorders. Malnutrition. Melancholy. Nose, redness. Odor, fetid. Ophthalmia. Otorrhea, fetid. Ozaena. Pericarditis. Peritonitis. Plica polonica. Polyps. Psoriasis. Quinsy. Scabies. Sciatica. Scurvy. Sian, disorders. Spina bifida. Spleen, disorders. Sprains. Syphilis. Throat, mucus. Tinea, capitis. Tonsils, concretions. Ulcers.

HOMEOPATHIC - Dr. Hering prepared this nosode from the sero-purulent matter of scabies vesicles. The therapeutic field of action is found in the psoric manifestations, when there is a lack of reaction in chronic diseases, and when well related remedies fail to relieve or to permanently improve. Psor. chiefly affects the folds of the skin, sebaceous glands, ears, bowels, respiration system and the right side. Allergies and hay fever. Syphilis, inherited and tertiary. Cardiac weakness. Looseness of joints, teeth. Prominent skin symptoms. Unhealthy skin. Severe itching, worse at night, heat of bed, worse from wool clothing. Itching leads to despair. Eczema and psoriasis. Eruptions and rashes disappear in summer, appear in winter. Offensive discharges. Thick secretions. Secretions have a filthy smell. Foul discharges, odor of the body, stools, eruptions, sweat, stubborn foot sweat. Profuse sweating. Easy perspiration when walking. Night- sweats. Otorrhea is horribly offensive. Emaciation. Cholera infantum. Diarrhea is profuse, watery, dark brown and even black and is putrid smelling like carrion. Debility independent of any organic disease. Prostration after acute disease or after loss of fluids. Feels good and bad by turns. Feels sick all over. Recurrences of diseases. Hopelessness, despair of recovery. Lack of reaction, when well-chosen remedies fail to act (Op.). A cold medicine, wants the head kept warm, wants warm clothing even in summer. Extreme sensitiveness to cold. Dread of least cold air or draft. Weak, tender and thin. Clothing seems large or he feels pushed down when walking in the sun. Hungry or unusually well before an attack. Wants to wash parts constantly, especially hands and feet. Scrofulous patients. Nervous, restless persons who are easily startled. Adapted to dirty people with a filthy smelling body, even after bathing. Pale, sickly, delicate, unhealthy looking children, who have a disagreeable smell around them. Sick babies will not sleep day and night but worry, fret and cry or good and play all day, troublesome screaming all night. Difficulty in breathing when standing in open air, wants to go home and lie down. Enlarged glands. Often gives immunity from catching colds. MIND - Dull, beclouded mind. Confusion, better open air. Difficult thinking. Stupefaction. Aversion to work. Inability for calculating, due to confusion of senses. Vanishing of thoughts after over-lifting. Memory weak, can't remember, doesn't even know his room. Anxiety and restlessness. Gestures, wringing hands. Anxiety while riding downhill. Anxiety about salvation. Foreboding. Fears the business will fail. Fearoffire. Fear of being alone, of becoming insane. Restless during a thunderstorm. Thought pains would drive him crazy. Pessimism, thinks he is very ill when he is not. Despair of recovery. Despair from itching of skin. Constant thoughts of dying. Religious melancholy. Horrid thoughts, suicidal tendency. Weeping at night. Great depression during menopause. Hopelessness. Great despondency, makes one's own life and those about him intolerable. Forsaken feeling. Sentimental. Melancholy and gloomy. Seeks solitude. Desires to remain in bed. Severe ailments from even slight emotions. Thoughts which he can't get rid of constantly reappear in his dreams. Feels himself poor. Feels his business is going to be a failure, though it is prosperous. Children very fretful, day and night. Children intolerably self-willed, annoying those about them. Peevish, irritable, noisy. Easily startled. Irritability on waking at night. Irritability while talking.

Head - Migraines. Headache as from aheavy blow, follows visual disturbances, better nosebleed. Headaches from suppressed eruptions, suppressed menses. Chronic headaches, hungry during attacks of vertigo. Hammering pain. Awakens at night with pain as from blow on head. Dull, pressive pain in occiput. Pain alternates with other complaints. Brain feels too large, worse change of weather. Head feels separated from the body. Sensitive to drafts about head, wants it covered in hot weather. Twitching in temples. Whole head burns. Viscid sweat about head. Humid eruption on scalp, hair matted. Pustules, boils on head. Spots of white skin with white lock of hair. Dry, lusterless, rough hair. Tangled hair. Head lice. Scurfy eruption of children.

Eyes - Recurring chronic ophthalmia. Acrid secretion. Profuse flow of hot tears. Sharp pains in eyes. Soreness of eyes and burning, must close them frequently. Lachrymation. Agglutinated. Gummy. Edges of eyelids red. Pterygium. Everted eyelids. Blepharitis. Tendency to styes. Objects tremble, then get dark. Darkness before eyes. Sensation as if something were moving or one were playing with his fingers before eyes. Aversion to light. Photophobia when walking in open air, walks with eyes bent upon ground.

Ears - Putrid otorrhea, with headache, with offensive watery diarrhea. Moistfetid pus from ears, brownish, offensive. Ulceration of tympanum. Reddish wax. Raw, red, oozing scabs around ears. Eczema, humid sores, behind the ears. Offensive discharge from eczema around ears. Intolerable itching. Itching in ears, child can hardly be kept from picking or boring at meatus. Herpes from temples over ears to cheeks. Severe pains. Sore pain behind ears. Illusory noises, as if he heard with ears not his own. Impaired hearing with singing, cracking, humming, buzzing and ringing in ears.

Nose - Recurring colds. Allergies. Hay fever, regularly returning every year. Hay fever coming on in August. Watery acrid discharges. Dry, coryza with stoppage of nose. Coryza with loss of smell. Chronic catarrh, dropping from posterior sinuses. Tough mucus in nose. Burning pain followed by thin nasal discharge, which relieves. Nose sensitive when inhaling air. Bloody, purulent discharge. Smell of blood. Septum inflamed, white, suppurating pustules. Small, red pimples. Acne rosacea.

Face - Pale, delicate, sickly, dirty, fuzzy or puffy. Broad blue rings around eyes. Down on the face. Burning heat and redness of face. Acne rosacea, red, small pimples, on nose, chin and middle of cheeks. Pimples on forehead. Coppery eruption on face. Humid eruptions on face. Lips dry, brown, black. Swelling of the upper lip. Cheekbones pain as if ulcerated. Soreness of jaw, right side, could not open mouth. Painful tension and pressure in right zygoma. Submaxillary and sublingual glands swollen, sore to touch.

Mouth - Mouth inflamed, sore, worse warm food, not annoyed by cold food. Mouth dry, burning. Bad taste in mouth, better open air. Bitter taste, better eating or drinking. Filthy taste. Tough mucus of foul taste adheres to soft palate. Gums, bleed, spongy, settled away from the teeth. Pyorrhea. Cyanotic lips. Burning, painful vesicles inside lower lip. Obstinate cracks in corners of mouth.

Throat - Throat burns, feels scalded. Tension and swollen feeling in throat. Dryness of throat in morning. Recurring quinsy. Eradicates tendency to quinsy. Tonsils greatly swollen, painful swallowing with pain in ears. Tonsillitis with swelling of submaxillary glands and fetid otorrhea. Profuse, offensive saliva, tough mucus in throat. Hawking up of cheesy, pea-like balls of disgusting smell and taste (Agar.). Sensation as if a plug in throat impeding hawking. Sensations of suffocation, with paroxysmal, dry, hacking cough. Tickling, throat as if narrowing, must cough to better it. Hoarseness when talking, phlegm sticks in larynx. Voice weak, trembling, talking very fatiguing. Herpetic eruption on side of neck extending from cheek.

Stomach - Hypoglycemia. Very hungry always, must have something to eat in the middle of the night. Weakness of stomach. Cramps in stomach. Sharp stinging pain in pit. Water brash when lying down, better getting up. Sour, rancid belchings, tasting and smelling like rotten eggs. Eructations, sour, rancid, room is filled with an offensive odor. Nausea after suppressed itch. Nausea all day, in morning, with pain in lumbar region. Vomiting first of blood, then of sour, slimy fluid. Vomiting of sweet mucus every morning at 10 a.m. and in evening. Nausea, vomiting of pregnancy.

Abdomen - Constant feeling of emptiness and looseness in abdomen. Pain in abdomen after eating. Abdominal affections during menopause, with high degree of ill-humor. Chronic indurations of spleen. Stitches in spleen better standing, worse moving, and continuing when again at rest. Stinging, sharp, in inguinal glands. Inguinal hernia. Lumps in right groin. preventing stooping. Pain through right groin when walking. Griping in abdomen and desire for stool while riding. Painful bearing down with painful, burning micturition. Sensations as if intestines were hanging down. Colic better eating and passing fetid flatus. Flatus like bad eggs. Flatulent symptoms with distension.

Rectum - Constipation with pain in lumbar region. Obstinate constipation with coryza and obstruction of nose. Constipation of infants in pale, sickly scrofulous children. Cholera infantum. Chronic diarrhea, early morning, urgent. Involuntary stools with sleep. Soft, difficult stools, has to go several times to pass normal stools. Hard, difficult stool with blood from rectum. Desire for stool when riding. Soreness in rectum and anus when riding. Burning in rectum. Burning hemorrhoids. Hemorrhages from rectum in old women. Sensations - As if frightened. As if he would lose his senses. As if stupid in left half of head. As if brain had not room enough in forehead. As from heavy blow on forehead. As if brain would protrude. As if sand in eyes. Eyes as if pressed outward. As if he heard with ears not his own. Cheekbones as if ulcerated. Condyle of jaw as if lame. Tongue as if burnt. Teeth as if glued together. Plug in throat. Throat as if narrowing. As if intestines hanging down.

Stool - Hot flatus, smelling like rotten eggs. Stools like rotten eggs or carrion, worse at night. Mucus stools. Stools bloody, excessively fetid, dark fluid, brown, horribly putrid, gushing. Stools have a penetrating odor, going through the whole house. Involuntary stools during sleep. Diarrhea after severe acute disease. Fetid diarrhea during dentition.

Male - Offensive genitals. Hydrocele. Inflamed ulcer on glans. Discharge of prostatic fluid before urination. Chronic, painless discharge from urethra, staining yellow. Griping pain in testes. Drawing pain, in testes and spermatic cords. Chronic gonorrhea, painless discharge from urethra staining yellow. Aversion to sex. Impotency. Absence of erections, parts flabby, torpid. Want of enjoyment of emission during sex. Excessive, uncontrollable sexual desire.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses, early and profuse. Menses delayed and scanty. Dysmenorrhea, near menopause. Menstrual disorders during menopause. Leucorrhea and debility. Fetid leucorrhea, gushing, lumpy, with violent pain in sacrum, with backache and debility. Pimples oozing an acrid fluid that burns and excoriates the glands. Ulcers on labia. Pinching pain in pubic region. Obstinate vomiting during pregnancy. Fetus moves too violently. Flow starts anew when the woman gets on her feet after a miscarriage. Food - Canine hunger preceding attacks. Very hungry always, must have something to eat in middle of night. Ravenous appetite, but grows thin. Hypoglycemia. Hungry during attacks of headache. Loss of appetite after illness with great thirst. Anemia with aversion to food. Generally worse fasting. Desires beer, acids. Aversion to pork. Dinner tastes oily. Thirst during dinner. Drinking causes cough.

Chest - Hot sensation in chest. Pain in chest, better lying down. Feeling of ulceration under sternum. Knife- like cutting pain in chest. Burning, pressing pain in chest. Dull pressure in right side of chest. Chest expands with great difficulty. Soreness as if everything were torn in chest. Chest pain extends to shoulder, worse cold drinks. Anxious oppression in chest every morning. Paroxysmal, in chest, with great anxiety. Eruption in axilla. Constitutions - Suited to scrofulous, nervous, restless persons who are easily startled. Psoric constitutions, lack of reaction after severe diseases. Complaints of psoric origin, patients emit a disagreeable odor. Pale, sickly, delicate children. Peevish, unhealthy-looking children, who have a disagreeable odor about them. Dirty people in whom the body has a filthy smell which no amount of washing can remove. Those subject to diseases of the glands and skin and who have had eruptions suppressed.

Heart - Heart murmurs and mitral regurgitation. Gurgling in the heart, worse lying down. Purring in region of apex, cyanotic lips. Pericarditis. Heart pains, better lying down. Thinks the sharp pains will kill him if they continue. Stitches in cardiac region, for a moment breathing is impossible. Palpitations with anxiety. Palpitations in those suffering from hepatic disorders. Pulse weak, feeble, irritable. Weak, irregular pulse.

Back - Backache and debility. Severe backache, as if bruised, can’t straighten out. Backaches after suppressed eruption. Spina bifida. Boring in vertebrae in morning with colic, as from rheumatism. Bruised feeling in evening, cannot straighten it. Lumbar ache worse standing or walking. Pain in lumbar region, like weakness, worse motion. Pressing pain in lumbar region, worse motion. Sticking in back. Drawing pain extending to shoulder. Tearing and sharp pains between scapulae. Painful stiffness of neck, soreness and tearing pain on bending backward. Swelling of glands of nape, with bruised pain. Breasts - Breasts swollen and painful, nipples red. Burning and itching pimples around nipples. Eruptions on breasts causing excoriation. Breast cancer. Causations - Poor hygiene and diet. Ill effects of infectious diseases lasting for years. Over-lifting injuries, blows, sprains, dislocations. Slight emotions cause severe ailments.

Neck - Glands of neck swollen, bruised pain extending to head on touch. Sticking in neck with pustules. Herpetic eruption on side of neck extending from cheek. Nape excoriated by discharge from eczema capitis.

Limbs - Caries, rachitis. Chronic forms of rheumatism. Tearing pains. Joints feel loose, weak, as if they would not hold together. Eruptions around joints, makes walking difficult. Eruptions around fingernails. Hot itching soles. Fetid foot sweat (Sil.). Hands and feet feel as if broken early in morning and after a little work. Heat in hands and feet.

Sleep - Easily started. Sleepy by day. Sleepless from anxiety and despair./rozn intolerable itching, from congestion to head. Sleepless after 12 p.m. In morning lies in same position as when he fell asleep. On waking, can't get rid of the one persistent thoughts from dreams. Vivid dreams, continue after waking. Dreams of robbers, danger, traveling.

Skin - Unhealthy skin. Abnormal tendency to skin diseases. Sebaceous glands secrete excessively, oily skin. Urticaria, worse exertion. Crusty eruptions all over. Herpetic eruptions, especially on scalp and bends of joints, with itching. Eruptions bleed easily and constantly tend to suppurate. Dirty, rough, scabby, greasy, breaks out in folds. Eczema behind ears. Pemphigus. Psoriasis. Intolerable itching, worse heat of bed. Scratches raw or until it bleeds. Rubbing skin causes small vesicles to arise. Condylomata on edges of skin. Pustules near fingernails. Indolent ulcers, slow to heal. Suppressed eruptions. Enlarged glands. Scabies. Recurring body lice. Burning itching pustule after vaccination. Skin troubles disappear in summer, only to occur again in winter.

Modalities - Better heat, warm clothing, even in summer. Better washing, hard pressure, rest, being inaroom. Betterfrom coffee, profuse sweating, nosebleed. Better from lying with head low or quietly. Better when eating, but rush of blood to head is worse immediately after. Worse from cold, open air. Worse changing weather, storms, before thunderstorms. Worse evening, before midnight, night, morning on waking. Worse from heat of bed, wool clothes. Worse exertion in hot sunshine, walking, moving, washing. Worse pressure, rubbing, scratching, touch, contact of own limbs, bandage. Worse from suppressions. Liver is worse lying on right side. Over-lifting causes thoughts to vanish. Winter causes cough. Summer causes diarrhea, itching eruptions. Bedwetting is worse periodically, yearly, at the full moon.

Teeth - Teeth stick together as if glued, from tough mucus in mouth. Looseness of teeth, fears they may fall out, worse touch. Sensations of soreness of teeth. Stitching pain in teeth from one side to other. Toothache worse at night and from cold, better warmth. Gums bleed, spongy, settled away from teeth. Pyorrhea.

Tongue - Tip of tongue feels scalded. Tongue thickly covered with whitish- yellow slime. Tongue, gums ulcerated. Tough mucus of foul taste adheres to soft palate. Vertigo - Vertigo in morning. Vertigo, objects seem to go around with him. Vertigo with headache, eyes feel pressed outwards. Vertigo with confusion and drawing in forehead, and roaring in ears. Vision - Sensation as if something were moving or one were playing with his fingers before eyes. Objects seem to tremble for a few moments, then get dark. Obscuration, with ringing in ears. Fiery sparks. Misty, after anxiety. Black spots or rings, flickering, dancing about of objects, before headache. Blurs and blue stars, during headache. COMMENTS-Psoric manifestations. Similar symptoms to Sulph., particularly for psora conditions, itch and itch-like eruptions. Exceedingly chilly, likes to have a fur cap on in summer (Sulph. is hot). H. C. Allen noted that Psor. is indicated in chronic cases when well-selected remedies fail to relieve or to permanently improve (in acute diseases, Sulph.), and when Sulph. seems indicated but fails to relieve. Clears up confused cases. Useful as an intercurrent, when indicated remedies palliate or fail to act. Feeble reactions, lack of reaction. Weakness from loss of fluids, after acute disease, with or without organic lesion. Debilitated, worse exertion. Weak since loss of fluid. Emaciation. Feels unusually well before attacks, sense of well being. Lies with arms out, as if crucified (Puls.). Whole body painful, easily sprained and inured. Unhealthy skin. Skin is dirty looking, scurfy. Sores refuse to heal. Severe eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis. Scabies. Lice, worms, parasites. Bruises and scars easily (Sulph.). Rough skin, cracks and sores (Petr.). Scaly skin. Skin will ooze and crust. Sallow and greasy face, several pustules on chin and neck that itch intensely and bleed when scratched. Constant irritation. Formication. Itch and scratch until they bleed (Alum.). Wandering itching. Tormenting, despairing itching, drives a person crazy, especially at night and in bed. Can pick at skin. Can't stand clothes or the covers. Skin problems along the hairline with inflammation and itching. Dry, lusterless hair, plica polonica. Scabs, pus, seborrheic dermatitis (Graph., Mez.). Extreme dullness. Fears inflammation of brain, better by nosebleed. Dull, heavy pain in the base of brain, in the afternoon. Headache better by eating, nosebleed, suppressed menses. Very hungry during headaches. Headache following darkness before eyes. Black spots before eyes. Chronic colds from little drafts and getting chilled easily. Chronic bronchitis with severe shortness of breath. Quinsy, throat burns, feels scalded. Tendency to quinsy. Cutting, tearing, intense pain on swallowing. Profuse, offensive saliva, tough mucus in throat, must hawk continually. Hay fever. Allergies. Allergic to wool (Sulph.). Sudden gnawing hunger. Wakes up in the middle of the night hungry. Large appetite, but loses weight. Malnutrition. Starvation (Sil., Calc-p., Calc.). Low blood sugar. Aversion to pork (Puls.). Desires acids. Thirst for beer. Chronic headaches with hunger (Anae.). Worms that irritate the colon (Cina.). Sensation as though skin of abdomen was greatly relaxed and drawn down. Decomposition. Belching like rotten eggs (Arn., Chin., Carb-v.). Flatus with pungent, carrion-like odor. Smell penetrates the room. Horribly offensive, nearly painless, almost involuntary, dark and watery stool, only in night and most towards morning. Cracking and bleeding anal fissures. Vertigo with poor circulation. Dizzy after exertion. Great sensitiveness to cold air, change, storms, sun. Lack of vital heat. Steaming perspiration. Restless for days before a thunderstorm. Symptoms are worse during menses from fats, sugar, coffee, meat. Dislikes bathing. Depression, mental anguish. Very insecure. Possessive. Sense of depletion. Anxious about health. Despair about survival. Fear of poverty, of the future, of being forsaken. Ailments from illness, malnourishment, nutritional weakness, lack of hygiene. Sick babies will not sleep day or night, but worry, fret, cry or good and play all day, restless, troublesome, screaming all night. Clarke frequently saw Psor. develop its own symptoms in patients whom it has benefited in other ways. A man who complained of “cloudiness of mind and difficult thinking,” and who had, among other symptoms, his “left foot colder than right,” received Psor. 30c. It removed these symptoms, but while under its influence new symptoms appeared, including a heavy headache across the eyebrows, and greasiness of face and forehead. Hahnemann noted the symptom “spasmodically contracting headache.” A woman to whom Clarke gave Psor. 30c complained that after each dose she had a feeling “as if something in the head were being screwed up and drawn.” A patient who took Psor. 500c complained that it had a “filthy taste.” Psor. 20,000c. has produced an eruption of boil-like indurations in both axillae, first in the left then in right. The general symptoms were relieved at the same time. Clarke noted that Psor. cured more cases of hay fever than any other single remedy in his practice. Many cases have a psoric basis and when the basic taint is corrected, the irritating agents have no effect. Nasal polyps have also been cured with Psor. when the general symptoms indicate the remedy. Hawley reported a case of cholera infantum that seemed to defy every remedy. Stools were very thin and watery, dirty greenish, smelled like carrion. Child was very fretful and had no sleep for two days and nights. Hawley gave Psor. 42,000c (Fincke), one dose in water. In two hours the child went to sleep, in four days it was well without repetition of the dose. Hawley also had the case of Miss N., 20, who had an eruption in the bends of elbows and knees. It was dry, scaly, with little pointed vesicles around the reddened edges. It disappeared entirely in summer and reappeared when cold weather set in. Violent itching, worse by warmth of bed or by scratching. Psor. 42,000c, two doses at six weeks interval, cured, it did not return the following winter. Wesselhoeft observed that headaches and eruptions were worse during changeable weather. Miss C., when convalescing from typhoid fever, reported that she was “stationary, no appetite.” Psor. 400c produced immediate change and ravenous appetite. Mr. P., age 50, complained of nothing but weakness, no appetite, least exertion put him into a perspiration. Psor. 40c cured rapidly. Mr. X., age 21, was obliged one day to run until nearly exhausted. Though strong and well before, he now became weak, perspiring easily, severe pains on right side, worse by coughing, laughing and motion. Psor. 40c cured rapidly. Mr. C., age 43, was spare, dark. Hypochondriacal. “Nervous” nine months, had to give up business, took quinine and other drugs. Complained of a very disagreeable feeling about the head and manifested mental depression, thought he would neverrecover, lost all hope. Could not apply his mind to business. Seemed confused, could not reckon. Numbness of legs and arms, worse left side, worse going to bed, formication and crawling with prickling and smarting on scalp and on limbs. Tongue coated white. After three months, treatment was stationary. It was then ascertained that he sweated very easily on least exertion and somewhat at night, and had loss of memory. Psor. 400c soon caused improvement and enabled “the patient to return to business.” G. A. Whippy cured with Psor. 200c, a dose every third night, the case of acarpenter, 40, with a long- standing discharge of reddish cerumen from left ear, worse at night. There was a sensation of a valve opening and shutting in left ear, worse afternoon. Buzzing in ear, which stopped suddenly and was followed by violent itching. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Ped. - psoric manifestations in chi Idren. Eruption on dorsum of hands, feet, neck. Prurigo, pellagra. Unusual aptitude for study and work. (2) Ped. - transmit typhus and trench fever. (3) In lack of reaction compare Op., Calc, and Nat-ar. (4) Gaert. Complementary: Sulph. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Deep, heavy pain in region of liver, worse pressure or lying onright side, worse sneezing. Stinging, sharp pain in region of liver and spleen. Flatulence with disorders of liver. Chronic hepatitis. Lungs - Difficult breathing, when standing in open air. Dyspnea wants to go home and lie down. Shortness of breath on walking in open air. Anxious dyspnea with palpitations and pain in cardiac region. Asthma with dyspnea, worse sitting up, better lying down and keeping arms spread wide apart. Asthma, feels as if he would die. Asthmatic attacks with hydrothorax. Hydrothorax. Tedious recovery in pneumonia. Allergies. Hayfever returning irregularly every year. Bloody expectoration with hot sensation in chest. Green mucus sputa, worse mornings when awaking and evenings on lying down. Tenacious mucus, difficult to expel. Green and yellow, salty taste. Small lumps of mucus.

Kidneys - Has to pass urine several times from weakness of bladder. Burning and cutting pain in urethra. Frequent, scanty urine. Urine thick, whitish, turbid, red deposit, cuticle forms on surface. Escape of urine when coughing. Obstinate bedwetting, worse full moon.

Cough - Dry, hard cough with great weakness in chest. Severe, dry cough with pain as if everything in chest were raw and scratched. Cough from tickling in larynx, with soreness under sternum and heaviness on chest. Coughs a long time before expectorating. Cough from suppressed eruption, talking. Cough worse mornings, evenings, lying down, drinking. Cough returns every winter.

Perspiration - Profuse sweats, improves all complaints. Colliquative sweats. Sour, clammy sweats. Easy, profuse sweat, worse night. Profuse, offensive at night. Sudden outbreaks of sweat on slight exertion, which is offensive, followed by debility and easily taking cold. Sweats easily on limbs. Sweats if he turns in bed. Heat with steaming sweat. Sweats on face, palms of hands and perineum when moving about. Cold sweat, on palms. Lack of perspiration and dry skin.

Temperature - Internal shivering, creeping chills and icy cold feet. Chilliness in evening, on upper arms and thighs, with thirst. Sudden heat over whole body, with trickling sweat all over face. Fever with steaming sweat. Fever at night, with dryness of mouth. Fever when riding in a carriage. Thirst during chill and heat.

author: Murphy

Worse in hot room, walking, speaking, mental exertion, moving eyes, raising eyebrows. Worse after eating, cheese, butter, meat, puddings. Worse before, during, and after stool..

PHARMACY - ptel. Ptelea tnfoliata. Hop tree. Shrubby trefoil. Water ash. Wafer ash. N. O. Xanthoxylaceae of the Rutaceae. Tincture of bark of root. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma-AscarWes. Bilious,headaches. Constipation. Dysentery. Dyspepsia. Erysipelas. Gallstones. Gastric, headaches. Headaches. Intermittent, fever. Jaundice. Liver, disorders. Nightmares. Phosphaturia. Rheumatism. Spleen, disorders. Stomach, Ptelea tnfoliata pain. Urticaria. Worms.

HERBAL - Ptelea is the Greek name for the Elm and was applied by Linnaeus to a genus of shrubs and small trees, natives of North America and Asia and included in Xanthoxylaceae. The Treasury of Botany noted that the fronds are bitter and aromatic, and have been used as a substitute for hops. In Canada, the young green shoots of Ptelea are used as an anthelmintic in the form of an infusion. One of the provers of Ptelea confirmed its anthelmintic powers by “a very copious expulsion of ascarides.”

HOMEOPATHIC - The proving was very thorough and extensive, and T. Nichol, Burt and Cowperthwaite were among the provers. Marked action on the liver and in those erysipelatous and urticaria eruptions that are so often concomitant with disorders of the liver. Ptel. is a remarkable remedy in stomach and liver disorders. Atonic states of stomach. The aching and heaviness in the region of the liver is greatly aggravated by lying down on the left side. Stomach and liver symptoms associated with pain in limbs. Worms. Ravenous hunger, empty sensation in esophagus and stomach. Taste bitter and belchings either bitter or like rotten eggs. Aching and heaviness in the region of liver worse lying on left side. Headache with hunger, especially on awaking, may prove a keynote. Right (liver) side most affected. Asthma. Difficult breathing coming on as gastric symptoms improve. Alternating symptoms. Nervous pains alternated from left arm to left eye and temple. Liveliness alternates with sadness. Sensitive to light, sound, open air. Enlarged feelings, head feels large, fingers feel numb and large and clumsy.

Head - Feels dull and stupid. Pain from forehead to root of nose, pressing-outward pain. Frontal headache, worse noise, motion, night, rubbing eyes with acidity. Temples as if pressed together. Headache better after stool.

Eyes - Eyes heavy. Pressure over eyes, worse lifting eyebrows. Pains over eyes. Sensitiveness to light.

Ears - Swelling of gland under right ear, sharp pain behind ear. Shooting pains from left ear down spine. Intolerance of loud talking. Roaring and singing in ears.

Nose - Sneezing. Nose stopped, sore, breath burns and irritates nostrils. Influenza.

Face - Face pale, especially around eyes, sickly, yellow. Burning in face. Food - Appetite voracious. Tired before finishing eating. Desire for acid food. Aversion to meat, butter and rich food. Thirsty, drank much water. Absence of thirst with bitter taste.

Mouth - Excess of saliva with dry, bitter taste. Tongue coated white or yellow, feels rough, swollen. Papillae red and prominent (Arg-n.). Coating may be brownish-yellow. Breath, hot, burns the nostrils.

Throat - Dryness, roughness, heat, constriction in throat. Throat sore, ulcerated, worse right side. Burning and pricking pains, especially in tonsils. COMMENTS - Hale said Ptel. has not the violent action of Podo, or Iris-v., but “a slow, pervading” action and causes chronic ailments. He found it useful in “bilious headache, dyspepsia, gastralgia, congestion of the liver, chronic hepatitis and chronic erysipelas.” Others used it in chronic rheumatism, dysentery and constipation. Hale said the oily constituent of Ptel. resembles turpentine and one of the most marked symptoms of the proving is: “Pressure as from a stone in pit of stomach,” recalling Abies-n. and the conifers. In the proving, the liver was swollen and tender, but it was better lying on right side and worse lying on left H. K. Leonard cured a seemingly hopeless case with Ptel. lx on the symptom weight, aching distress, dull pain in hepatic region, better lying on right side, turning on left causes a dragging as if liver pulling on its ligaments. The dull, muddled headed feeling is another liver symptom. J. Preston cured with Ptel. a case of jaundice following gallstones with great emaciation. Aching distress, general aching and soreness, malaise. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Merc., Mag-m., Nux-v., Chef REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Stomach feels empty after eating. Weight and fullness. Heat, dryness and distressing feeling of emptiness in esophagus. Constant sensation of corrosion, heat and burning in stomach. Belching, nausea and vomiting.

Abdomen - Much weight and pain in right side, heavy, aching feeling, relieved by lying on right side. Retraction of abdomen.

Rectum - Pressure in rectum, urging to stool. Stool followed by tenesmus and succeeded by itching and smarting at anus. Smarting in anus after hard stool, with diarrhea stool.

Limbs - Edema of feet and legs with liver disorders. Stomach and liver symptoms associated with pain in limbs.

Sleep - Restlessness with frightful dreams, nightmares. Awakes languid and unrefreshed.

Modalities - Better eating sour, acid things. Better in cold air, morning and evening. Worse lying down, lying on left side, after sleep, on waking, early morning, afternoon. Worse in hot room, walking, speaking, mental exertion, moving eyes, raising eyebrows. Worse after eating, cheese, butter, meat, puddings. Worse before, during, and after stool.

Liver - Liver congestion. Liver sore, swollen, sensitive to pressure. Weakness of liver. Lungs - Feeling of pressure on lungs and of suffocation, when lying on back. Asthma, dyspnea, cramp-like pain in cardiac region.

PHARMACY - puer. Pueraria lobata. Kudzu Vine. Kuzu. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Anemia. Asthma. Bronchitis. Constipation. Diabetes. Diarrhea. Dysentery. Edema. Enteritis. Fevers. Hangovers. Headaches. Hypoglycemia. Impotence. Infertility. Influenza. Insect, bites. Measles. Migraines. Pneumonia. Sinus, problems. Snake, bites. Tonsillitis.

HERBAL - Traditional Asian herbalists have long valued kudzu's root and flowers for treating colds, flu, high blood pressure, chest pain, allergies, and a host of other ailments. Research indicates that a compound in the root (an isoflavone called puerarin) may also increase blood flow to the heart and brain which may explain certain traditional uses. In traditional Chinese medicine, kudzu has been used to relieve muscle pain. Animal studies and some human case reports suggest that kudzu may have some antiinflammatory effects. Chemicals in kudzu may also lower the heart rate and regulate its rhythm, as well as widen the blood vessels near the heart and the brain. This may support its uses in heart conditions and for the treatment of migraine headaches.

HOMEOPATHIC - Other medicinal uses for kudzu include influenza, cough, colds, tonsillitis, measles, and fevers. Bronchitis, pneumonia. Asthma. Sinus problems. Lack of energy. Sexual apathy, impotence, infertility. Muscle shrinking. Dizziness. Headaches, migraines. Hangovers. Diaphoretic. Removal of excess fluids from the body. Anemia, internal bleeding. Snake and insect bites. Thirst, hunger. Bad breath. Diarrhea, dysentery, intestinal ailments, enteritis, constipation, and digestive disorders. Diabetes. Can reduce blood sugar levels and result in hypoglycemia when taken in large amounts. Strengthens the spleen, stomach and intestines, as well as the entire immune system. RELATIONS - Compare: Nux-v., Sul-ac., Lach. REFERENCES - Murphy. Yui.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pulx. has marked urinary and female symptoms. Cannot retain urine, must attend the call immediately. Stains of menses and leucorrhea are very hard to wash out. As if cotton ball inside the vagina. MIND - Very impatient. Restlessness. Cross and irritable, does not want to be looked at or spoken to. Memory confused. Cannot think. When walking has a sensation of lightness. Glad feeling, as though she had heard good news. Felt a dread of going to bed.

Head - Frontal headache with enlarged feeling of eyes. Very impatient, cross and irritable.

Eyes - Eyes feel as if enlarged.

Face - Face wrinkled and old-looking.

Mouth - Metallic taste. Sensation of a thread in throat. Thirsty, especially during headache.

Throat - As if a thread hanging in throat. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Phatak.

Stomach - Breath and taste foul. Intense nausea with vomiting, purging and faintness. Stool very offensive.

Female - Menses delayed. Increased flow of saliva during menses. Leucorrhea, profuse, foul, staining a greenish yellow, stains of menses and leucorrhea very hard to wash out. Intense burning in vagina. Food - Thirst, especially during headache.

Back - Backache (Ox-ac.). Back weakness. Drawing of muscles below scapula.

Skin - Sore spots all over. Prickly itching. Skin emits foul odor.

Modalities - Better sitting or lying down. Worse left side, moving about.

Kidneys - Urine scanty with frequent urging with pressure in bladder and tenesmus in urethra. Cannot retain urine, must attend to the call without delay. Irritable bladder before menses. Urine foul. Flow of urine stops suddenly, followed by pain.

Temperature - Feels a glow all over, like being over steam. Chilly, sitting near by fire.

full:
PHARMACY - pulm-v. Pulmo vulpis. Fox's lung. Sarcode. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Dyspnea. Catarrh. Heart, disease. Lungs, catarrh. Lungs, edema. Shortness of breath.

HOMEOPATHIC - The uses of tissues and organs as remedies have thrown light on many curiosities of ancient medicine. As the fox is probably the longest-winded of all animals, the doctrine of signatures pointed to his lungs as a likely remedy for short breath. Pulm-v. has persistent shortness of breath, causing a attack of asthma on the slightest motion. Strong, sonorous bubbling rales. COMMENTS - Grauvogl put on record his case of a women, 65, much reduced in flesh by a persistent condition of humid asthma. It commenced with chronic catarrh and symptoms of edema of the lungs. Strong, sonorous bubbling, rattling, whistling sounds over whole chest and at some distance away, perceptible also to hand laid on chest. Accelerated short breath amounting to suffocation, even without corresponding heaving of the chest, frequently with cough and inability to expectorate. Sometimes in light cases, there is no catarrh present and only persistent shortness of breath, becoming a paroxysm of asthma on the least bodily exertion. The patient could only live sitting up, bent forward, constant lividity of face, lips and limbs and dropsy of legs. Heart's pulsations irregular and death seemed imminent. Pulm-v. lx grains right was given and repeated in an hour. Visible improvement set in but without increased expectoration. After a third powder the patient was able to lie down and fell into a refreshing sleep lasting several hours. In eight days she engaged in her domestic duties. REFERENCES - Clarke.

name: Pulmonaria Officinalis
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma. Bronchitis. Coughs. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. Lung, disorders. Urinary, incontinence. Tuberculosis.

full:
PHARMACY - pul-o. Pulmonaria officinalis. Lungwort. Pulmonaria maculosa. Jerusalem sage. N. O. Boraginaceae. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Bronchitis. Coughs. Hemoptysis. Hemorrhoids. Lung, disorders. Urinary, incontinence. Tuberculosis.

HERBAL - Pulmonaria officinalis is an evergreen perennial species of lungwort, native to locations throughout Europe. A rhizome, P. officinalis produces small bunches of pink flowers which turn to blue-purple in spring. The plant has been cultivated for centuries as a medicinal herb, the ovate spotted leaves were thought to be symbolic of diseased lungs. The appearance of the plant makes it easy to see why the lungwort was used for diseases of the lung (putrid bronchitis, hemoptysis), and also for hematuria, and urinary incontinence (see also under Myos.). The medicines are prepared from the fresh, flowering herb. It is an astringent, demulcent, diaphoretic, diuretic, emollient, expectorant, ophthalmic, and resolvent. The leaves and flowering shoots are often used for their healing effect in pulmonary complaints. The leaves can also be used externally to stop bleeding. They are harvested in the spring and dried for later use. A distilled water made from the plant is an effective eyewash for tired eyes. The tannins in lungwort have a slight astringent effect when applied to the skin, thereby reducing secretions, relieving irritation, and improving tissue firmness. It has been used as a wash, poultice, or soak for hemorrhoids and minor skin injuries such as scrapes and sunburn. Lungwort has a high mucilage content and this makes it useful in the treatment of chest conditions, being of particular benefit in cases of chronic bronchitis. The herb is very mucilaginous and contains silica, tannins and saponins. It combines well with other herbs such as coltsfoot (Tus-fa.) in the treatment of chronic coughs including whooping cough and can also be taken to treat asthma. Lungwort is good for coughs, hoarseness, and mild lung problems. It acts as a good expectorant, which breaks up chest congestion. Soothes throat irritation. It can also be used for diarrhea, which makes it useful for a stomach virus accompanied by a cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - Pul-o. is used in the treatment of bronchitis, coughs and diarrhea. Bronchial catarrhs, colds. In the past, lungwort was given for the coughing up of blood arising from tubercular infection. REFERENCES - Murphy.

name: Pulsatilla Nigricans
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better from cool, fresh, open air. Better uncovering, cold applications, cold food and drinks, though not thirsty. Better from erect posture, lying with head high. Better continued, gentle motion, pressure, rubbing, massage. Worse from warmth of air, stuffy rooms, clothes, bed, sun. Worse getting feet wet, before and during thunderstorms. Worse at twilight, sunset, evening and night. Worse rest, beginning motion. Worse lying on one side, hanging down limbs. Worse puberty, before menses, pregnancy. Worse from eating, long after. Worse from rich foods, pastry, fats, ice cream, pork, eggs, tea. Worse hot food, is vomited immediately, aggravates toothache. Worse from iron, quinine. Never been well since puberty (anemia, bronchitis, phthisis)..
