full:
PHARMACY - sabad. Sabadilla officinalis. Cevadilla seed. Cebadilla. Asagraea officinalis. Scoenocaulon officinale. Veratrum officinale. N. O. Melanthaceae of the Lili- aceae. Tincture of seeds. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Allergies. Ascarides. Chilliness. Colds. Coryza. Coughs. Debility. Diarrhea. Diphtheria. Dyspepsia, pregnancy. Earache. Esophagus, stricture. Hay fever. Headaches. Imaginary diseases. Influenza. Intermittents. Lice. Mania. Melancholia. Neuralgia. Nosebleeds. Pinworms. Rheumatism. Tapeworm. Throat, sore. Toothache. Uvula, elongated. Vertigo. Worms.

HERBAL - Asagraea is a Mexican genus belonging to the Colchicum family, Melanthaceae. It has only one species, Asagraea officinalis, furnishing the cebadilla seeds from which Veratrine is prepared. According to the Treasury of Botany, the seeds were formerly used to destroy vermin.

HOMEOPATHIC - Sabadilla first appears in homeopathic literature as one of Stapf s additions; Hahnemann was one of the provers. Stapf s additions form a kind of appendix to the Materia Medica Pura. Stapf said that the plant was first described by Monades around the year 1572. At first, it was almost exclusively used for destroying lice and worms in putrid ulcers and the intestines. Sabadilla has affinities for the mucus membranes of the nose, lachrymal glands, anus, digestive tract, and the nerves. Coryza and symptoms like hay fever. Allergies. Chilliness, sensitive to cold. Nerves are affected, producing weakness. Alternate nervous and bodily symptoms. Cutting pains in bones. Formication. Worms. Reflex nervous symptoms with twitching, convulsive trembling or catalepsy. Children’s diarrhea with constant cutting pains. MIND - Nervous, timid and easily startled. Mental exertion aggravates. Thinking produces headaches and sleeplessness. Feels miserable. Fright causes hysterical paroxysms. Unresponsive to questions. Loss of consciousness, then he jumps up and runs recklessly through the room. Rage. Mania better washing head in cold water. Delirium during intermittents. Erroneous, fixed ideas about himself. Imagines he is very sick. Imagines that she is pregnant or that she has cancer. Imaginary diseases. Imagines that parts are sunken, limbs are crooked, chin is elongated. That one side is longer than the other.

Head - Dullness and oppression. Unilateral head pains or alternating sides, worse thinking, better eating. Burning, itching, crawling on hair and scalp, better scratching. Headache in schoolgirls.

Eyes - Red, burning eyelids. Redness of margins of eyelids. Lachrymation, worse during pain, sneezing, coughing, yawning. Pressure on eyeballs, especially when looking up. Weakness of sight.

Ears - Otalgia with troublesome pressure, with snapping as of electric sparks before ears. Tickling in ears. Itching in ear, alternately with itching at anus. Burning, itching and shootings in tips of ears. Humming, gurgling, and detonation in ears. Deafness as if there were a band over ears. Boring in parotids.

Nose - Influenza. Hay fever. Spasmodic sneezing with running nose. Copious, watery, nasal discharge. Coryza with severe frontal pains and redness of eyes and lachrymation. Fluent coryza, worse from the odor offlowers, even thinking of flowers increases the discharge. Oversensitive to odors, cannot tolerate the smell of garlic. Dry, itching, tickling in nose, rubs or picks at it. Tickling in nose spreads over the whole body, then dyspnea. One or the other nostril stuffed up. Hawks bright red blood from naso-ph^rynx.

Face - Lips hot, burn as if scalded. Heat of face with fiery redness, especially after drinking wine. Blue circles around the eyes. Boring in lower jaw and submaxillary glands. Cracking of the articulation of the jaw on opening mouth wide.

Mouth - Itching of the soft palate. Dryness of the mouth without thirst. Sweetish taste. Copious saliva, jelly- like saliva. Cannot bear anything hot or cold in mouth. Lips as if scalded. Tongue as if burnt, as if full of blisters. Pricking, soreness in tip of tongue. Cannot protrude tongue with sore throat.

Throat - Chronic sore throat, worse from cold air. Sore throat, left to right, worse empty swallowing, better hot drinks. Tonsillitis after coryza. Much tough phlegm. Sensation of a skin hanging loosely, must swallow it. Warm food and drink relieve. Painful empty swallowing. Dry fauces and throat. Sensation of a lump in throat with constant need to swallow. Vertigo - Vertigo with sensation as though all things were turning around each other. Vertigo accompanied by blackness before eyes and sensation of fainting. Vertigo, sudden on waking at night or rising from stooping, better resting head on table. COMMENTS - Stapf pointed out that the provings reveal strong febrile symptoms. Sabad. may be as clock- like as Cedr., and is a leading remedy in intermittent fevers and neuralgias. Sabad. is a chilly remedy, the symptoms, especially the coryza, are generally worse in the open air. Intolerant of mental exertion, thinking causes a headache. Tendency to be startled. Erroneous impressions as to the state of his body. Imaginary diseases, imagines parts shrunken. Imagines she is pregnant if there is distention from flatus. Giddiness, may cause staggering and even fainting. Objects seem to whirl around or to whirl around each other. Sitting aggravates vertigo. Rising from seat causes vertigo. Lying perfectly still ameliorates vertigo. Severe catarrhal symptoms. Hay asthma. Allergies. Hay fever with itching and tingling in the nose (All-c., Ars.). Tingling and numbness in the nose (Petros, in the urethra.). Itching in the roof of the mouth, rubbed raw by the tongue (Wye. ). Spasmodic sneezing. Coryza, sneezing and runny nose (All-c.). Thick, yellow discharge, worse stuff rooms, better fresh air (Puls.), alternates with watery discharge. Sore throats characterized by a sensation of a lump or foreign body in the throat and a constant need to swallow. Pressure on larynx causes sore throat. Lying down causes cough immediately, worse expectoration. Kent said it is suited to “old, chronic sore throats that are worse from cold air. The patient is sensitive to cold air. Every time he takes cold it settles in his nose and throat. Tonsillitis going from left to right.” Desires hot drink (opposite of Lach.). Overly sensitive to the smell of garlic (Thuj.). Opening mouth wide causes cracking of jaw joints.Disordered digestion and loaded tongue. Sinking at stomach and gnawing hunger. Indigestion, during pregnancy. “Violent itching of hairy scalp, compelling her to scratch until blood comes.” “Itching of the vertex as if a quantity of vermin had collected there, obliging him to scratch incessantly.” “Itching of anus and rectum as from ascarides.” “Itching of anus alternating with itching of alae nasi and meatus auditorius.” Scratching ameliorates itching of scalp, causes burning of anus. Kent gave Sabad. to a pet dog which had great irritation of anus and soon afterwards the dog passed a very large number of worms. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Camph., Lach., Lyc., Puls., Con. Compare:(l)Colch.,Nux-v., Bry., Arund. and Poll. (2) Veratrina is alkaloid of Sabad., not of Verat., locally in neuralgias and for removal of dropsy. Five grains to two drams. Lanolin, rubbed on inside of thighs, causes diuresis. (3) Phle. - Timothy-Hay - Potentized to 12c a specific to many cases and evidently acts in a desensitizing manner. Cumin. - hay fever. Follows well: Bry. (Pleurisy). FoUowedwellby: Ars. Bell., Merc., Nux-v. Complementary: Sep. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Spasmodic pain in stomach with dry cough and difficult breathing. Heartburn, copious salivation. Cold, empty feeling in stomach.

Abdomen - Bowels feel knotted. As of a lump or thread moving rapidly in abdomen.

Rectum - Constipation. Stools burning, frothy, loose, brown, floating. Broken, hard, scanty stools. Itching, crawling in rectum and anus, as from ascarides, alternating with itching in nose or ears. Pinworms, lumbrici, tapeworm. Sensations - As if things were turning around each other. As if she would fall if she did not hold on to something. As if eyes went around with the whirling sensation. As if uvula were down. As if esophagus would be closed. As of a lump in abdomen. As if a ball of thread were moving and turning rapidly through abdomen. As if knives were cutting abdomen. As if abdomen were shrunken, were empty. Croaking as of frogs in abdomen. As of something alive in abdomen. As if stomach were gnawed.

Male - Digging and pressive pain in testes. Tensive and painful erections, without desire for sex. Pollutions with flaccidity of penis. Diminished sexual desire.

Female - Menses too late, come by fits and starts, intermit, sometimes stronger, sometimes weaker (Kreos., Puls.). Nymphomania from worms. food Thirstless. Canine hunger for sweets and farinaceous food. Desires hot things, milk. Loathing for strong food. Aversion to all food, meat, sour things, coffee, garlic. During pregnancy, no relish for food until she takes first mouthful, then she makes a good meal.

Chest - Burning sensation on chest. Pressure on the chest. Breathing obstructed, as if there were a stone in the chest. Shootings in sides of chest. Inflammation of pleura. Red spots and points on chest. Constitutions - Suited to sensitive persons of light hair, fair complexion with a weakened, relaxed, muscular system. Children and old people.

Heart - Palpitations with pulsations through whole body.

Back - Contusive pain in back and loins, especially when seated. Burning, tingling, stinging sensation between scapulae. Stitches in rapid succession in right side of back. Causations - Ill effects of fright, mental exertion, thinking. Worms, causing convulsions, nymphomania.

Limbs - Upward jerking of arms. Cutting pains in bones. Red spots on arms and hands. Yellow spots on fingers. Swelling of feet with painful soles. Cracking of skin under and beneath toes. Inflammation under toenails. Thickened, deformed horny nails (Ant-c.). Lungs - Wheezing respiration. Short, difficult breathing. Breathing obstructed, as if there were a stone in the chest. Asthmatic breathing with itching of skin, nose and anus. Violent coughing attacks, muffled, worse anger with lachrymation. Hawking up of bright red blood, which comes from the nose. Cough dry with perspiration and water in the eyes. Cough immediately on lying down. Pleurisy with great paralytic debility.

Sleep - Great inclination to sleep during day. Sleep comes on when thinking, meditating or reading. Agitated and unrefreshing sleep at night, with anxious dreams. Sleep retarded by a multitude of thoughts. Starts up as from a fright in the morning.

Skin - Parchment-like dryness of skin. Hot burning, creeping and crawling sensation. Itching with asthmatic breathing. Tingling and burnings shooting under skin. Red bands, spots, and points in different parts of skin.

Modalities - Better from heat, warm food and drink, swallowing. Better being wrapped up, open air. Better quick motion of affected part. Warm stove ameliorates chilliness. Worse from cold air. Worse forenoon, new and full moon. Worse periodically, every week, two weeks, four weeks, same hour. Worse odors, wine. Worse undeveloped rash. Worse mental exertion. Worse forenoon.

Teeth - Toothache with drawing and pulsa- tive pain. Shooting pains in molars. Tooth decay. Pricking in gums. Bluish gums.

Kidneys - Urgent want to urinate, especially in evening, with tenesmus and scanty emission. Increased secretion of urine. Turbid, thick urine, like clay-water. Burning in urethra when urinating.

Temperature - Chill predominates from below upwards. Heat in head and face, hands and feet icy cold with chill. Thirstless, thirst after chill only. Lachrymation with chill. Shivering as a concomitant.

name: Sabal Serrulata
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better after sleep, from milk. Worse from cold, damp, cloudy weather. Worse in early morning, from rising, at bedtime. Worse from sympathy. Worse before menses. Worse from motion. Backache worse after sex. Catarrhal symptoms are worse in cold, damp weather. Cough worse on lying down at night. Depression worse before menses..
constitution: Appendicitis. Asthma. Atrophy. Backaches. Bedwetting. Breast, disorders. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Cystitis. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Epididymitis. Gland disorders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headache. Hoarseness. Impotency. Infertility. Iritis. Laryngitis. Lumbago. Malnutrition. Menses, delayed. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Obesity. Ovaries disorders. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Proctitis. Prostate, disorder
keynote:
PHARMACY - sabal. Sabal serrulata. Saw oalmetto. Serenoa serrulata. N. O. Palmace- ae. South Carolina to Florida. The tincture must be prepared from the fresh berries to be effective. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Asthma. Atrophy.…
full:
PHARMACY - sabal. Sabal serrulata. Saw oalmetto. Serenoa serrulata. N. O. Palmace- ae. South Carolina to Florida. The tincture must be prepared from the fresh berries to be effective. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Appendicitis. Asthma. Atrophy. Backaches. Bedwetting. Breast, disorders. Bronchitis. Catarrh. Cystitis. Debility. Dysmenorrhea. Dysuria. Epididymitis. Gland disorders. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Headache. Hoarseness. Impotency. Infertility. Iritis. Laryngitis. Lumbago. Malnutrition. Menses, delayed. Neuralgia. Neurasthenia. Obesity. Ovaries disorders. Peritonitis. Pharyngitis. Proctitis. Prostate, disorders. Prostate, enlarged. Prostatitis. Puerperal fever. Rhinitis. Sexual, debility. School, headache. Strangury. Testes, atrophy. Throat, sore. Tuberculosis. Urine incontinence. Uterus, disorders. Whooping cough.

HERBAL - Sabal serrulata was introduced into medicine by J. B. Read and A. A. Solomon, both of Savannah, Georgia. Dr. Read gave a “Saccharated oil,” of which he said, “By its peculiar soothing power over the mucus membranes it produces sleep and relieves the most troublesome coughs, promotes expectoration, improves digestion and increases fat, flesh and strength. “It has been used with benefit in cardiac asthma, tuberculosis, especially laryngeal, chronic bronchitis and dilatation of the bronchial tubes. Sabal’s action in catarrhal disorders in rapid and permanent. A cold in the head may be checked with two or three doses (of the saccharated oil) mixed with boiling water and used by inhalation it has been found beneficial in chronic ozaena.”

HOMEOPATHIC - In the provings, the tincture or fluid extract were used, from 5 to 10 drop doses, repeated two or three times a day. A similar dosage has been adopted in the clinical use of the remedy. Sabal is an organ remedy of great power, selecting the uterus and prostatic gland (which is the male analog of the uterus), ovaries and testes and bladder. For irritability of the genito-urinary organs, especially the prostate, ovaries, breasts, bladder and urethra. It is soothing to the mucus membranes and is tonic, nutritive and stimulating to the overworked brain. Prostate enlargement and weakness. Prostatitis. Epididymitis and urinary difficulties. Iritis with prostatic trouble. Homeopathic catheter for retention of urine due to enlarged prostate. General and sexual debility. Nervous irritability with loss of sexual desire in both sexes. Sexual neurotics. Valuable for undeveloped breast glands. Small and undeveloped genitals. Sharp, stinging and wandering pains. Languor, apathy and indifference. Fear of going to sleep. Promotes nutrition and tissue building. MIND - Difficult thinking, cannot grasp or re- memberwhatisread. Confused. Impatience, fretfulness. Irritability and depression, particularly before menses. Irritability from loss of sexual desire. Dislikes sympathy, makes them angry. Self-concentrated on their own sufferings, wants to be left alone. Apathy. Wants to go away and die alone. Indifference to wants of others. Fears to fall asleep lest something should happen. Starts up with fear as he is dozing.

Head - Severe headache with giddiness and dim vision. Headache of weak persons. Neuralgia in feeble patients. Sharp, darting pains here and there, coming and going suddenly. Pain runs up from nose and centers in forehead. Dull, aching pain in right temple and on vertex. Pain and irritation at base of brain and upper third of cervical spine (Gels.). Sensation as if something tightening in brain.

Eyes - Iritis when prostate gland is involved. Dim vision during headache.

Ears - Chronic inflammation of middle ear. Fullness in nose and ears. Frequent sharp, stitch-like pains inward from ears. Hearing diminished, voices seem far off.

Nose - Pain at root of nose. Pain running up from nose and centering in forehead. Fullness in nostrils, compelling him to pick them. Catarrhal symptoms, worse cold, damp weather. Sneezing and lachrymation, coughing and gagging.

Face - Papular eruption on left temple and about mouth. Slight neuralgia in right temple and right jaw. Pallor.

Mouth - Pungent, burning sensation in mouth and fauces, causing sneezing, coughing, and gagging. As if mouth coated with fat. Burning on tongue as if scalded.

Throat - Voice changed, throat feels husky. Sharp pain in left side of throat. Pungent, burning sensation in fauces, followed by smooth sensation, as if coated with oil. Vertigo - Vertigo with headache from fumes of oil. COMMENTS - In his book, Saw Palmetto, Hale put together most of the available knowledge regarding this plant. It is a dwarf palm with a creeping (or leaning), branching stem, the edges of leaf and petioles serrate, roots fibrous, large, half exposed. The fruit, so-called “berry,” is a one- seeded dupe about the size of an olive, dark purple when ripe, and ripening in October and November. The fruit is richer in sugar than sugar cane and contains two oils, one volatile and one fixed. The volatile oil is considered to possess the most characteristic properties of the medicine. Hale described it as “yellow,” but he quoted John Uri Lloyd of Cincinnati, as writing to him, “The principal constituent is a volatile oil. This oil possesses a deep green color.” And he goes on to say that the color is not due to chlorophyll nor to the copper of the form used in condensing it. This agrees with Estep’s contention that the preparation of Sabal should be darkgreen or grass-green. The preparation Estep used was a fluid extract prepared by Burrough Brothers of Baltimore from the “fresh green berries.” Hale directs that the fresh ripe berries should be used. Hale’s tincture was of fresh ripe berries and seeds, all crushed and macerated in 90 percent alcohol for fourteen days and decanted. He noted that the fluid extract was “probably four times stronger than the tincture.” C. S. Estep used a dark-green fluid extract that was made from the fresh green berries and as “almost as green as grass and has an oily surface.” He made his dilutions from this. Other preparations disappointed him. Oil can be prepared from the expressed juice of the fruit by allowing it to stand a few days. Saccharated oil is one part of the oil to seven parts of cane sugar. Malted Sabal is one part of the oil to seven of Maltine. Aqua Olei Sabal, for use as a spray, is a preparation suggested by Hale made by triturating 15 drops of the oil with Mag-c. 3j., gradually adding a pint of distilled water and decanting. The preparation used by Dr. Mullin’s prover was made by Boericke and Tafel. All are agreed that preparations of the dried fruit and of the root-bark do not possess the curative powers of the remedy. While on a trip through the wilds of Florida, Hale observed the great fattening properties of the berries on animals. During summer, food is scanty and the wild animals become very thin, but as soon as the palmetto fruit ripens they improve rapidly. In a few weeks have put on so much fat that they become easy prey. This fat, said Hale, “consists principally of olein and will not make lard.” Dr. Langton said that she gave 5 drop doses four times daily in cases of overworked brain and school- headache for the “tonic, nutritive and stimulating” effect of the remedy. She gives the lx as soon as relief has been obtained and she finds that the dilution often gives greater relief than the larger doses for the headaches. Mullins said “I now found the use of the drug in the 3c and 6c potency curative in nearly all of the diseases of the uterus and appendages. Also in headache from reflexes uterine troubles in breast abscess, mental irritations and nervous debility.” He thought that it well deserved the name of “The Homeopathic Catheter,” but he added that it must be given on its individual indications. W. E. Rely published three cases illustrating the prostatic action of Sabal. The first, Mr. J., 56, was very despondent, irritable. Sympathy seemed to anger him. Great tenesmus in neck of bladder with heavy, aching pains with sense of coldness extending into external genitals. Occasional sharp pains extending up into abdomen and down into thighs. Capricious appetite. Chronic constipation. Urination too frequent, disturbing sleep. Sabal tincture was given, five drops, night and morning. Steady improvement followed, and in eight weeks all the symptoms had gone and with them an annoying eczema of the hands. The second case was Mr. M., 45, who had increasing frequency of urination for a year. Despondent, distressed. Capricious appetite. Vertex headache and gastric catarrh. Little sexual desire. Sex followed by digging pain in back and tenesmus of bladder with difficulty in commencing to urinate. Genitals were cold, dull aching in region of prostate, extending to abdomen and thighs. Sabal tincture gradually relieved and cured in three weeks. The third case concerned Mr. E., 35. He had frequent urination for one and a half years. Heavy, dragging pains, extending into back and thighs, back pains much after sex. Considerable loss of prostatic fluid at times. Sexual desire much impeded. Severe headache on vertex and gastric catarrh. All symptoms were removed by Sabal tincture. Hale said that E. S. Evans of Columbus, Ohio, considered Sabal “almost specific in iritis when the prostate gland in involved. I have cured cases with the 3x which could not be relieved in any other way.” A. L. Davidson related acase of impotence in a man, 51, who had difficult urination, tenderness of prostatic portion of urethra, loss of power. His testicles shrunk, penis shrunk and cold. Sabal tincture, 15 drops, four times a day, was prescribed. At the end of the first week he complained of drawing pains in spermatic cords, there was freer flow of urine, he slept better and felt better. At the end of the second week the testes gradually increased in size. The urethral tenderness had nearly disappeared and erections were established. In two weeks more the cure was complete, the testes were even larger and firmer than normal. J. Martin Kershaw of St. Louis, treated a young woman, 23, who had great difficulty in controlling her urine all her life. Undue exertion, lifting, straining, or laughing caused it to dribble away. Unless she rose several times in the night, she was sure to wet the bed. Sabal tincture, one drop, four times a day, was given. In one month she was much improved and under the same remedy she gradually got quite well. Elias C. Price reported three cases. The first was a case of a very nervous, sensitive woman with chronic inflammation of the bladder, frequent, painful urination, ten to twelve times in the night and every fifteen to thirty minutes during the day. Spells of pressing pain on rectum, better by warm water enemas, which generally brought away hardened feces. Lil-t. 3x removed this temporarily. Rectal examination disclosed a hard, fleshy tumor the size of half a hen’s egg on the posterior aspect of the uterus. Sabal fluid extract 5 drops, thrice daily, diminished the tumor by half in two months and removed it entirely in three more. Prices’ next case was of Mrs. X. who, five days after confinement after her first child, had irritation of kidneys and a week later symptoms of pelvic peritonitis. Her uterus was much enlarged, very tender. She did not urinate very often, but when she did the pain was so excruciating that she fainted away and sometimes did not come to for an hour. • For three days no remedy did any good. Then she had a violent pain on the right ^ide of her head above and behind the ear, and paralysis of her left arm and leg. She became unconscious and could not be aroused, at times would talk of things that had occurred before her illness, insensible to external impressions. She remained so for ten days. Sabal fluid extract, 20 drops, every two hours, relieved the pain on being raised to urinate after the second dose. Recovery from the other condition was very gradual. The third case was of Miss X., 22, who had irregular menses for years, having once gone nine months without a period. When she came to Price she was three months past her time, one breast was much smaller than the other. Sabal fluid extract was given, 5 drops, thrice daily. In about a month the menses came on freely, lasting four days instead of the usual two. Breasts began to increase in size. In three months one was as large as the other. The following year she again missed her time and Sabal brought it right in a week. Using Sabal, Price has cured cases of pelvic cellulitis, peritonitis, puerperal fever inflammation of uterus, tubes, ovaries and even appendicitis and proctitis, especially if the prostatic gland is involved. Enlarged prostates. Acute prostatitis. Prostate conditions relating to impotence. Prostate cancer (Con.). Frequent urination. Chronic bladder inflammation. Benign prostatic hypertrophy. Characteristic stinging pains. Wandering, radiating and cramping pains were also prominent. Sabal has several groups of associated regions of pain: pains affecting head and ovary, ovaries and breasts, lower back and right temple, prostate and eye. Mainly used in tincture. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Sil. - Sabal grows on the sandy shore. Puls, delayed menses, Puls, also grows on sandy soils. Sabal. is most fruitful nearest the sea, compare Sil-mar. Compare: (1) Stinging pains in ovaries, Apis, Merc. (2) Pain in right ovary and thigh, Apis. (3) Breasts painful, Con., Calc. (4) School-headaches, worse by sympathy, Nat-m. (5) Prostatic affections, Ferr-pic., Cham., Arg-n., Dig., Solid. (6) Prostate and eye, Solid. (7) Worse from sex, Kali-c. (8) Wandering pains, Kali-bi. the roots of Sabal. are very rich in potash salts. (9) Over-worked women, Mag-c. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Hale.Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Sharp pain running through stomach. Severe pain in left side of stomach. Irritation of stomach. Belching and acidity. Acute gastritis, fearful burning as from sulphuric acid. Could not take meat, vegetable, or pudding, only bread and milk.

Abdomen - Sudden, intense, cramp-like pain through abdomen. Sharp, stinging pains running up and down front of abdomen, and also right side. Pain extending to thighs.

Rectum - Constipation and enlarged prostate. Hemorrhoids with dryness of stool and pressure from within out. Stools dark, almost black. Stools unusually easy, free from hemorrhoidal troubles.

Male - Coldness of genitals. Drawing pains in spermatic cords. Slight twisting chordee as if stretched from the root. Atrophy of testes. Testes drawn up, painfully. Epididymitis. Gonorrhea. Impotency, loss of sexual power. Hard erections. Semen thick, causes hot feeling along the cord. Sex is painful at the time of emission. Loss of sex drive. Sexual neurotics with suppressed or perverted sexual inclination.

Female - Amenorrhea. Ovaries tender and enlarged. Stinging pain in ovary, pains running down the thighs. Stinging pain in uterus. Uterine tumor. Heavy feeling over womb. Vulva feels open. Sensation of coldness in genitals. Awakened by a most distressing itching of labia majora. Furious sexual passion. Loss of sex drive. Sexual neurotics with suppressed or perverted sexual inclination. Food - Appetite poor and capricious. Malnutrition and great emaciation. Better from bread, milk. Constant desire for buttermilk, milk (Rhus-t., Tub.), which is usually disliked. Aversion to mother’s milk. Worse meat, pudding, vegetables.

Chest - Sharp pain in left side of chest, running through left breast. Constitutions - Sycotic constitutions.

Back - Aching across lower part of back. Deep pains in lower back. Fearful backache, pain in sacral region, before and at commencement of menses. Backache after sex.

Limbs - Pains into thighs, radiating in different directions, settling in ovaries. Sharp pain running down thigh. Aching in knee and calf. Annoying eczema of hands. Lungs - Chronic bronchitis (Stann., Hep.). Copious expectoration with catarrh of nose. Wheezing cough, worse lying down, until 6 a.m.

Sleep - Fears to fall asleep lest something should happen, starts up with this fear when he is dozing. Wakes from coldness. Awakened by stinging pains in ovaries, or by a distressing itching of labia majora.

Skin - Papular eruption on face. Eczema of hands.

Modalities - Better after sleep, from milk. Worse from cold, damp, cloudy weather. Worse in early morning, from rising, at bedtime. Worse from sympathy. Worse before menses. Worse from motion. Backache worse after sex. Catarrhal symptoms are worse in cold, damp weather. Cough worse on lying down at night. Depression worse before menses.

Kidneys - Pain or irritation in region of kidneys. Excruciating pain and fainting on being raised up to urinate.

Bladder - Feeling as if bladder too full. Heavy, aching pain and sense of coldness in bladder, extending to external genitals. Painful starting the flow, as if forced through very narrow meatus. Feeling as of a stricture about two inches down urethra. Urethra sensation of narrowness ( Arg-n.). Difficult urination, smarting, burning in urethra. Paresis of bladder sphincter. Cystitis from prostate enlargement. Painful urination, connected with ovarian pain. Urinary sediment. Incontinence from any exertion, lifting, laughing. Constant desire to pass urine at night. Bedwetting. Chronic gonorrhea. Breasts - One breast smaller than other. Breasts shrink in size (lod., Kali-i.), or increase rapidly. Breasts, sore, tender and full feeling, itching. Stinging in breasts, soreness worse after cold bath. Sharp pains in mammary glands. Pain in breasts, worse coldness, pressure. Defective lactation.

Prostate - Prostatitis. Emission of prostatic fluid during stool, on straining at stool, during urination. Prostatic weakness with discharge of prostatic fluid. Enlarged prostate. Dull aching in prostate extending into abdomen. Cystitis from prostate enlargement. Dribbling of urine from prostate enlargement.

HOMEOPATHIC - Stapf made the first collection of the symptoms of Sabin., and Hahnemann and his son were among the pro vers. A number of observations on women who had taken the drug to bring on menses or procure miscarriage have also been added, and some cases of fatal poisoning are recorded. A close botanical ally of Thuj., Sabin, is not too close to be complementary to that great anti-sycotic. Broad condylomata, fig-warts with much itching and exuberant granulations are characteristic. Like Thuj., it removes wart-like growths from the mucocutaneous surfaces. Cooper noted that Sabin, acts as a widespread irritant, inflaming the pyloric end of the duodenum and causing patches of inflammation in other portions of the intestines, especially the upper intestines, the omentum and the peritoneum. In addition, it affects the fibrous tissue of small joints, serous membranes and heels. Pronounced action on the generative organs of both sexes. It produces fig-warts with itching and burning of the external genitals, phimosis of the male, swelling of the dorsum of the penis, and gonorrhea. Uterine hemorrhages, abortion. Hemorrhages, where blood is fluid and clots together. Hemorrhage is partly pale red and partly clotted, worse from the least motion, but may be better by walking. The flow is in paroxysms and is accompanied by labor-like pains. Tendency to miscarriage especially at the third month. Warmth ameliorates pain of dysmenorrhea. The dysmenorrhea pains were better lying on flat of back with limbs extended out. Walking ameliorates the metrorrhagia. Pain from the sacrum to the pubis. Pain increases suddenly and decreases slowly. Cold applications ameliorates wandering pains in joints. Red, shiny, swelling of affected parts. Acutely inflamed arthritic nodes. Violent pulsations, wants windows open. Heaviness and indolence of body, wants to lie down. Sense of fullness. Lies on left side during sleep. Sleepless and restless after midnight. MIND - Dejection, discouragement and sadness. Feeling of deep-seated trouble, which makes him melancholy and sad. Sadness with great tiredness and laziness. Melancholy. Moroseness with dislike to conversation, especially when exercising in open air. Weeping aloud. Desires repose and tranquility. Reserved while walking in open air. Taciturn while waking in morning. Nervous and hysterical. Great anxiety, fear and apprehension. Irritable nerves. Much irritability of temper. Irascibility with tears and sobs. Listlessness. Weakness of memory. Hypochondriacal mood. Sensitive to slight- est noise. Starting from noise. Music goes through bone and marrow. Music is intolerable, it produces nervousness. Distraction from sound of piano.

Head - Rush of blood to head and face. Bursting headache, coming suddenly and going slowly. Splitting sensation in forehead and temples. Pulsative headache with heaviness and stupefaction. Drawing pains in masseter muscles.

Eyes - Tensive pain in eyes, as if muscles too short. Heat in eyes. Eyes dull and downcast. Clouds before eyes. Smarting tears. Jerking quivering of lids.

Ears - Pinching in ears. Hardness of hearing. Gets deaf when tired, in foggy weather, or at any change of weather.

Nose - Dry coryza.

Face - Pale with blue circles around eyes. Black pores in cheeks and around nose. Paralytic pain and pressure in zygomatic process.

Mouth - Drawing pain in the muscles of jaws. Toothache, worse only when chewing. Bitter taste to food especially milk or coffee.

Throat - Sore throat during deglutition, as from a foreign body or an internal swelling in gullet, with pressure and choking. Dull lancinations in throat. Dryness in throat with drawing pain. Vertigo - Vertigo with suppressed menses. Stupefying vertigo, leading to falling, with cloudiness of sight. Giddiness with congestions to and heat in head. COMMENTS - Characteristic pain from sacrum to pubis. Pains are paroxysmal and labor-like. Pain suddenly increases and then slowly disappears. Wandering pains (Puls.). Numbness, goes through bone and marrow. Inflamed sacrum, or severe aching pains in the sacrum. “Intermittent aching” in the heels. Tendency to bleed (Phos.). Nosebleed (Phos., Ferr-p.). Tendency to warts, genital warts, venereal warts, and anal warts. Bleeding warts (Nit-ac.). Gonorrhea, or a history of gonorrhea, with genital warts (Thuj.). History of vaginitis with genital warts. Hemorrhage of bright red blood, with clots (Bell.), comes in gushes. Heavy menstrual bleeding, with swelling, fatigue and headaches, worse motion. Menses too early, too abundant, may last too long. Painful dysmenorrhea with heavy bleeding, pains from the pubic bone back to the sacrum, better lying on the back, limbs extended. Pains can be sharp and stabbing. Bearing down pains. Drawing pains. Endometriosis (Med.). Pelvic inflammatory disease, with a throbbing uterus. Discharge of blood between the periods with sexual excitement. Bleeding fibroids. Blood streaked leucorrhea. Vaginitis with offensive, irritating, profuse discharge. Severe morning sickness, spasmodic vomiting. Miscarriages due to spasmodic vomiting. Tendency to miscarriage (Caul., Sep.), usually in the third month (Bell.), with bleeding, passing clots and membranes. Retained placenta (Sec., Caul.). Hemorrhage after an abortion. Postpartum hemorrhage. Severe after-pains. Hemorrhage during menopause. Pulsating sensation and hot flashes during menopause. Throbbing with hot flashes. Turmoil in the circulation. Hot flashes, worse clothing, wants to take off clothing and fan themselves. Desires fresh air. Irritable and ill humored during menopause. History of being worn out, overworked, with many children. Menopause brought on by a weakened uterus. Varicose veins. Obscure abdominal pains due to inflammatory states of the peritoneum. Sensation of something alive in the abdomen (Thuj.). Rumbling with indigestion and uterine problems, as if something is kicking or moving. Bleeding hemorrhoids, especially with a history of constipation and uterine problems. Bloody urine. Irritability, hysteria and hypochondriasis. Discouraged and adverse to conversation. Music is intolerable. Overheats easily. dislikes stuffy rooms. Desires juicy, sour things. Can complain that food tastes too bitter. Generally left sided. Worse at night and from physical contact. RELATIONS-Antidoted by: Puls. Compare: (1) Croc., Calc., Tril., Ip., Mill., Erig. (2) Hir. - the leech. (3) Rosm. (4) Worse by music - Ambr., Thuj., Sep. (5) Inter-menstrual flow, Ham., Ambr. (6) Condylomata, Thuj., Nit-ac. (7) Hemorrhage, worse from least motion, Sec. (8) Menses partly fluid, partly clotted, Ferr. (9) Retained placenta, Caul., Sec. Promotes expulsion of moles or foreign bodies from uterus, Canth. (10) Better in fresh air, desires lemonade, Puls. (11) Clotted hemorrhage, Mill., Plat, is dark, Sabin, bright red. Compatible: Ars., Bell., Rhus-t., Spong. Complementary to: Thuj., Nit-ac. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Stomach - Fullness and inflation of region of stomach. Pain from epigastrium to back. Stomachache. Acidity in stomach after a meal. Empty risings and heartburn. Nausea with fullness in stomach. Vomiting of bile or of food eaten the previous day.

Abdomen - Tympanitic distention. Congested. Quivering as if something were alive, resembling fetal movements. Bearing-down, constrictive pain. Colic, mostly in hypogastric region.

Rectum - Sense of fullness. Pain from back to pubis. Constipation. Hemorrhoids with bright, red blood, bleed copiously. Hemorrhoids alternate with pain in limbs. Sensations - As if she would fall. As if parts of temporal eminence were pressed asunder. As if skin had grown fast in forehead. As if eyes would be pressed out. As if tooth would burst. As if he had to swallow over a foreign body. As of a lump in throat. As if vomiting would come on. As if something alive in abdomen. Right shoulder joint as if sprained.

Male - Burning, sore pain in glans. Prepuce painful with difficulty in retracting it. Sexual desire increased with violent continuous erections. Hard swelling on dorsum of penis. Sycotic warts, growths. Gonorrhea with pus- like discharge.

Female - Menses, too profuse too early, gushing of hot, watery, bright, blood, mixed with dark clots. Dysmenorrhea, better lying flat on the back with limbs extended. Bleeding between periods with sexual excitement. Increased desire for sex. Vaginitis. Leucorrhea from suppressed menses or copious menses. Leucorrhea. foul, acrid, thick, yellow. Leucorrhea after menses, corrosive, offensive. Atony of uterus. Uterine pains extend into thighs. Pain from sacrum to pubis and from below upwards. Shooting pain up the vagina. Uterine hemorrhage, partly clotted, worsefrom least motion. Bleeding fibroids (Thalspi). Promotes expulsion of moles from uterus (Canth.).Tendency to miscarriage, especially at the third month. Menorrhagia in women who abort readily. Itching of pudenda during pregnancy. Retained placenta, intense after-pains. Inflammation of ovaries and uterus after childbirth. Food - Poor appetite. Bitter taste of food, especially milk and coffee. Desire for acids, especially lemonade.

Chest - Pressure on chest. Pressive, spasmodic tension in chest in middle of sternum. Trembling in the lungs with dull rattling and crackling. Lancinations. Constitutions - Suited to hot-blooded women with gouty or rheumatic diathesis, arthritic pains. For the chronic ailments of women, tendency to miscarriage, hemorrhagic tendency, nosebleeds and hematuria. Farrington said it is suited to “plethoric women who suffer from what they call rheumatic inflammation” of the heels.

Heart - Violent pulsation in blood vessels through whole body. Augmented and extended beating of the heart. Pulse unequal, generally quick, strong and hard.

Back - Paralytic pain in small of back. Pain between sacrum and pubis. Breasts - Crawling, voluptuous itching in nipples. Stitches in left nipple.

Limbs - Arthritic pain in joints. Red, shining swelling. Gouty nodosities (Am-p.). Gout, worse in heated room. Knots and enlargements in varicose veins. Bruised pains in anterior portion of thighs. Shooting in metatarsal bones. Shooting, intermittent aching in the heels. Swelling, redness and stitches in right big toe. Lungs - Dry, hacking cough and tickling in the trachea. Hemoptysis. Expectoration of mucus streaked with blood.

Sleep - Sleeplessness and restlessness after midnight. Disturbed sleep with frequent waking. Talking and loud snoring during sleep. Tendency to lie on left side when sleeping. Anxious, continued dreams, full of fanciful images and intellectual efforts.

Skin - Black pores in skin, especially face. Foul, itching, burning. Exuberant granulations (Thuj., Nit-ac.). Warts. Fig-warts, moist with intolerable itching and burning.

Modalities - Better from cold, cool open air. Better exhalation. Worse from foggy weather, night. Worse heat, warm air. Worse heat of bed or room. Worse exertion, stooping, least motion, taking a deep breath. Worse letting limbs hang down. Worse pregnancy, menopause. Worse music. Worse by touch, though better pressure.

Kidneys - Burning and throbbing in region of kidneys. Bladder inflamed, throbbing. Bladder irritability with gouty diathesis. Inflammation of urethra. Bloody urine with much urging.

Temperature - Intolerable burning heat of whole body, with great restlessness. Great chilliness through the day. Chill in the evening with attacks of chilliness. Fever in evening, first shivering, then heat and lastly perspiration.

HOMEOPATHIC - This substance is a derivative of benzoic acid, and is made synthetically from coal-tar. It is a white powder, readily soluble in warm water, but to only a slight extent in cold water. Saccharin is the foundation for many low- calorie and sugar-free products and is used in table top sweeteners, baked goods, jams, chewing gum, canned fruit, candy, dessert toppings and salad dressings. Saccharin is about 300 times as sweet as sucrose, but has an unpleasant bitter or metallic aftertaste, especially at high concentrations. Saccharin goes directly through the human digestive system without being digested. It does not affect blood insulin levels, and has effectively no food value. Saccharin is not recommend for children with “sulfa” allergies, and has been linked to short-term problems with infant muscle tone, “lazy” eye, irritability, and insomnia. Saccharin has been implicated in the development of photosensitive skin eruptions in humans, and as a hypoglycemic agent in animals. Increased incidences of bladder cancer and tumors have been found in toxicity studies. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Aspart., Sac-alb. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - According to Hering, a large proportion of chronic diseases of women and children are developed by using too much sugar. Like so many other articles of diet, Sugar may be a poison and a medicine as well as a food. Sugar preserves food, as salt does, and both sugar and salt have produced scurvy. Cases of scurvy, rickets in bottle-fed children have been traced to excess of sugar in their food and the exclusion of sugar from the dietary of the gouty, rheumatic and the diabetic, shows the pathogenetic power it is credited. Acidity of the stomach and itching at the anus are common effects of taking too much sugar. Sugar is an antiseptic. Combats infection and putrefaction. It has a solvent action on fibrin and stimulates secretion by the intense osmotic changes induced, thus rinsing out the wound with serum from within outward, favoring healing. Leg ulcers. Sensitive to pain or not sensitive to pain at all. Fainting from pain. Fainting on seeing blood. Fainting from a blood puncture. Fainting spells. Plethora. Weakness, lack of energy. Sudden weakness, ameliorated by eating. Weakness after sweets.. Physical tension. Waking very early in the morning. Extreme dryness, dryness of skin, hair, nails, hands, feet, inside of nose, eyes, mouth, throat, vagina, stool. Tingling in the limbs. Pains in bones from head to foot. Edema of feet. Cold expectoration. Opacity of cornea. Dim sight. Myocardial degeneration. Headache every seven days. Emaciation with great appetite. Obesity with compulsive eating, especially sweets, cakes and pastries. potato chips, anything. Acidity and anal itching. Children who are cross, peevish, whining, capricious. Very aggressive children, often emaciated. Children who want dainty things, tidbits and refuse substantial food. Scurvy, rickets in children. Fat, bloated, large limbed children. Family history of diabetes and cancer. MIND - Discontented with himself and with everything. Hard to please. Lack of joy in life, feeling that life is not worth living. Want of childish cheerfulness. Sadness, worse after sweets. Loneliness. No real feelings of relationship with other people and with life in general. Longing and melancholy, as if homesick. Lack of love. Possessive love. Jealousy, from fear of losing the loved one. Fundamental frustration in affection in the past, mostly in early childhood. Very uncertain about the love of partner or parents. Fear of failure. Sensitive to criticism. Great need of approbation. Ailments from lack of affection, lack of physical contact in early childhood. Lack of attention. Loquacity, mostly to have attention. Plays antics to have attention. Forsaken feeling. Desire to be held in the mother’s arms. Desire to be carried. Great need to be caressed and touched, or difficulty in admitting this need and refusing every contact. Often a lack of contact with the mother. Sucking the fingers or thumb. Sucking thumb almost the whole day and during the night, or never sucking the thumb at all. Sucking the thumb until an advanced age. Biting nails, up to the quick. Biting toenails. Touches everything. Alternating moods, gentleness alternating with aggression. Peevishness. Melancholic mood with chilliness. Capriciousness. Low spirited, hypochondriacal mood. Restlessness, aggravated after eating sweets. Indifference. Disinclined to talk, want of interest. Antisocial. Thinks he is neglected and placed at a disadvantage. Feels despised. Envious. Jealous. Lack of self-confidence. Timidity. Increased modesty of women. Great modesty. Stupidity. Irresolution. Dainty, cross and whining, indolent. Anxious. Worries about all sorts of things at night. Fear of fainting, of seeing blood. Fear of falling. Felt afraid to go to bed, of the dark. Fear of failure (Care.). Fear of losing beloved persons and parents. Hypochondriacal mood. Intense nervousness. Jumps from her seat at the least unusual noise. Seems as if she would fly out of her skin. Irritable, in morning, until breakfast. Irritable when hungry, better by eating. Offended easily. Cross and fault-finding. Censorious and sarcastic. Bilious sanguineous temperament. Quarrelsomeness. Violent temper. Extremely aggressive, quarrelsome, violent, malicious and defiant, especially after eating chocolate or sweets. Fits of anger, unapproachable. Kicks and hits. Ailments from anger. Bad effects from violent anger. Ailments from excitement, stress. Fainting from pain. Delusion of being persecuted. Delusion that her parents don’t love her or that she is less loved than her siblings. Imagined that her mother wanted to kill her. Imagines that some one is behind her. Feeling that everybody in the world is against him.

Head - Giddiness from indigestion. Migraine. One-sided headache. Headache every week the same day. Severe headache with the chill. Cold in the head. Hair grows rapidly. Perspiration only on the head.

Eyes - Dullness of eyes. Dryness. Eyes closed by swelling and inflammation of lids. V aricóse distention of vessels of eyes. Ophthalmia. Cataract, opacity of lens. Opacity of cornea. Dimness of the cornea. Dimness of sight. Obscuration of sight. Inflammation of the eyelids. Edematous swelling of the eyelids.

Ears - Discharge of pus from the ears.

Nose - Dryness inside nose. Coryza, dry without discharge. Sneezing.

Face - Changed expression of the countenance. Face pale, deathlike. Face bloated, edematous. Healthy fresh color of the face. Twitching of muscles of right cheek, over malar bone.

Mouth - Dryness of mouth. Salivation. Inflammation of salivary glands. Inflammation of lining membrane of mouth. White coating on tongue, so thick as to cause stiffness in it. Cracked, fissured mouth, tongue. Ranula. Thrush. Aphthae of children. Scorbutic gums. Teeth feel as if on edge. Dullness of teeth with sour vomiting. Scurvy. Sucking the fingers or thumb. Children put fingers in the mouth. Biting nails.

Throat - Dryness of throat. Dry, rawness in the larynx. Irritation of larynx, causing a slight hacking cough with yellow, salty sputa, which floats on water. Ulceration of the larynx. Ulcers in throat. Hoarse, catarrhal voice. Hoarseness from reading but a short time. Vertigo - Fainting attacks. Giddiness from indigestion. Harassing giddiness with gout. Vertigo with low blood sugar, weakness. Vertigo better after eating. Vertigo while lying down. Vertigo as if sinking down through the bed. COMMENTS - Restlessness, aggravated after eating sweets. Running, moving all the time. Restless while sitting. Difficult concentrating, particularly when eating sweets. Very uncertain. Fear of unknown situations (Lyc., Stram.). Sensitive to reprimand, or not sensitive to reprimand at all (Tub.). Impossible to correct. Alternating moods, gentleness alternating with aggression. Extremely aggressive, quarrelsome, violent, malicious, and defiant, especially after eating chocolate or sweets. Kicks and hits. Fits of anger. Insolence. Disobedience. Unapproachable. Waking early in the morning. Aphthae. Profuse salivation. To these symptoms have been added others observed by Swan from a patient who accidentally discovered after twenty-five years of suffering, that the cause of his trouble was sugar. All the symptoms disappeared when he abstained from sugar in food or drink and only reappeared when he took it again by way of experiment. Then from two to four days after taking sugar, the same train of symptoms invariably occurred. Burning at pit of stomach. A white coat on tongue, so thick as to cause stiffness of it. Sharp burning pains run up from head to foot, causing a rigidity of the muscles so that it was impossible to rise from bed until he had been rubbed. Chill commencing in small of back and spreading up and down. Severe headache and occasional vomiting with the chill. Fever followed with headache, morbid hunger and a hectic flush. Increased urine, strong odor, white sediment. Great pain in kidneys. Constipation. Sleeplessness. Edema of feet and ankles. Weakness of legs, as if paralyzed, causing staggering. Painful jactitation of feet and legs during the burning in the stomach. Oppression of chest with a cough. Profuse cream-like expectoration, that was very offensive and cold. Sac-alb. 10,000c and 5,000c cured him of some remaining symptoms and the 41,000c enabled him to eat sugar with impunity. Swan also reported the case of a woman who was continually eating candies of which she was very fond, until her digestive organs were affected. A few doses of Sac-alb. 30,000c changed her taste so that she ate no more and could not even bear the sight of them. Farrington traced a great similarity between Sac-alb. and Calc. Sac-alb. is indicated, he said in children who are large- limbed, fat and bloated with a tendency to dropsy. Sac-alb. has produced opacity of the cornea and ought to cure it. The children are dainty and capricious, care nothing for substantial food, but want little “knick- knacks,” always cross and whining and, if old enough, are insolent and do not care to occupy themselves in any way. Everything is too much trouble. H. C. Allen related a case of opacity of cornea cured with Sac-alb. and with the same remedy in 2,000c potency he cured swelling around the ankles following rheumatism. According to Lippe, black-and-tan terrier dogs that eat sugar go blind. The cataract and amblyopiaof diabetics are well known. Here, again, salt and sugar meet as Burnett has shown in his super salinity of the blood that excess of salt in food has been an important factor in the production of cataract. Sugar must be considered a sustainer and developer of the musculature of the heart and hence useful in failure of compensation and a variety of cardio-vascular troubles. It acts as a nutrient and tonic in wasting disorders, anemia, neurasthenia, etc. increasing weight and power. One ounce of lump sugar morning and evening valuable adjunct in the treatment of obstinate cases of heart failure due to deficient heart muscle without valvular lesion. Epilepsy, blood with reduced sugar content irritates the nervous system with tending to convulsions. Sugar as an oxytocic has its most suitable application toward the end of labor when there is no mechanical obstruction and delay is due to uterine inertia. 25 grams dissolved in water, several times every half hour. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Sac-1., (2) Sacchin - hinders both the salivary and peptic ferment actions with consequent dyspepsia. Prof. Lewin believes its action to be on the secretory cells themselves and it has caused pain, (right hypogastrium). loss of appetite, diarrhea and wasting. (3) Arg-n., Lyc., Sulph. - craving for sweets. (4) Sil. - rickets. (5) Arg-n. - diabetes, swollen ankles, (6) Santa. - Kidney ache. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Lippe. Smits. Swan.

Stomach - Acidity of the stomach. Disordered stomach. Slow digestion. Indigestion, weak with acidity. Burning at pit of stomach. Stomach bloated, overloaded with sour mucus. Empty, weak, hungry feeling in stomach. Painful constriction of stomach. Painful sensitiveness of the pit of the stomach. Coldness or heat in the stomach. Gurgling and rumbling noises in stomach. Pressure in the stomach in the morning when fasting. Stomach pain with hypochondriacal persons. Nausea early in morning. Violent retching and gagging. Vomiting of white, viscid tough mucus. Vomiting of blood. Vomiting acid, making teeth dull. Vomiting, occasional with the chill. Periodical vomiting. Vomiting of alcoholics. Malnutrition.

Abdomen - Abdomen swollen and enlarged. Abdomen as hard as a stone. Painful hardness of the abdomen. Hard swollen abdomen after scarlet fever. Swelling and induration of the mesenteric glands. Tabes mesenterica. Abdomen shows the presence of water on percussion. Dropsy. Flatulency. Pain in the spleen (from a blow received a long time ago) and liver. Swelling of the spleen. Breasts - Atrophy of breasts. Fullness and swelling of breasts before menses. Pain in breasts before menses. Causations - Sugar. Anger.

Rectum - Lump sensation. Dragging and heaviness sensation in rectum. Constipation alternating with mucus diarrhea. Constipation, stools difficult, dry. Diarrhea, stools watery and debilitating. Stools of mucus and blood, bilious. Itching at the anus. Congested and painful hemorrhoids. Hemorrhoids bleed. Painful hemorrhoidal tumors. Worm affections of children.

Male - Enormous swelling of scrotum, right genitals. Swelling of the penis. Increased sexual desire. Frequent involuntary emissions.

Female - Amenorrhea. Menses diminished, scanty. Menses painful, dysmenorrhea. Menstrual pale blood, watery. Painful ovulation and menses. Brown leucorrhea. Suppressed leucorrhea. Complaints before menses including sadness, irritability, swelling and painful breasts (Sep., Care.). Brown bloody discharge preceding menses. Leucorrhea, bloody before menses. Dryness of vagina. Increased sexual desire. Swelling of the genitals. Food - Compulsive eating. Bulimia with obesity. Ravenous appetite soon after eating with feeling of emptiness in stomach and general weakness. Insatiable appetite not ameliorated by eating. Morbid hunger with the fever. Anorexia, no feeling of hunger at all at any time, no desire to eat. Little or no appetite in the morning, but insatiable appetite in the evening, especially for sweets. Hypoglycemia. Has to eat at the normal times, otherwise weak, dizzy, trembling, headache. Tendency to eat frequently between meals. Better after eating, after breakfast, from sweets. Desires sugar, sweets, chocolate, pastries and cakes. Desires sweets after dinner and before menses. Desires bread, butter, fat, salt, sour, lemons, mustard. Desires raw vegetables. Worsefrom chocolate, sweets. Aversion to sweets, butter, fat, warm milk, warm food, cooked vegetables. Aversion to anything except sweets. Thirst for large quantities. Thirstlessness. Desires licorice. Desires cold drinks, especially water, tea, warm milk. Desires alcohol. Bad effects from spirituous liquors.

Chest - Sharp pains in the left side of the chest. Rheumatic pain in the region of the heart. Fullness in the chest, in the morning and relieved by expectoration of mucus. Swelling of the lower part of the sternum. Emaciation of the chest, the muscles dwindle away. Constitutions - Bilious, sanguine temperament. Plethoric constitution.

Heart - Myocardial degeneration. Endocarditis. Rheumatic pain in heart region. Weakness of heart. Pulse weak and irregular.

Limbs - Stiffness. Legs swollen and as hard as a stone. Emaciation, especially of lower limbs. Heat of lower limbs, must uncover feet. Gouty pains, wandering. Sharp pains. Weakness of the legs. Tingling in limbs. Restlessness of legs. Cramps in the calves of the legs. Caries on the feet. Ulcers on legs. Edematous swelling of the legs, water oozes out from them. Sensation as if water, oozing from legs. Swelling around the ankles. Panaritium. Felon. Nail disorders. Edematous swelling of the right arm with stinging, less painful when uncovering the arm, more painful in the evening and during damp weather. Fistulous ulceration of the rightforearm with tingling and stitches, discharge of yellowish thin pus (Bute-j.).

Sleep - Sleeplessness. Starts in sleep. Dreams of dead persons, of falling. Slow to wake up and revive after rising in the morning.

Skin - Dryness of skin. Chlorosis, after anger, with dropsy. Eruptions, red blotches. Pale red blotches over the body. Anasarca after scarlet fever. Scurvy. Panaritium. Ulcers. Excessive granulation in the ulcers. Proud flesh in the ulcers. Gangrenous ulcers, cold dry gangrene. Old herpes.

Modalities - Better after eating, in evening. Dyspnea better in erect position. Worse in early morning, difficulty starting the day. Worse from warm weather. Worse from anger (Staph., Coloc., Cham.). Worse sugar, sweets, chocolate. B ad effects from spirituous liquors.

Liver - Pain in liver and spleen. Liver is swollen, indurated. Increased secretion of bile. Hypoglycemia. Lungs - Breathing oppressed with cold expectoration. Suffocative attacks, must be bolstered up. Can only breathe in an erect position. Respiration difficult, oppressed in the morning, relieved by expectoration. Accumulation of mucus in the lungs. Expectoration with the cough is very offensive. Suppressed expectoration is restored. Expectoration very fetid, offensive odor. Expectoration white, yellow. Expectoration tastes salty. Expectoration thin, watery, while walking in open air. Dry, loose cough. Cough with children. Pneumonia.

Kidneys - Great pains in kidneys. Sharp burning pains run from kidneys to shoulders, passing under scapulae. Increased urination, strong odor, white sediment. Diabetes mellitus. Sugar in urine. Urine diminished. Scanty urine.

Perspiration - Perspiration day and night. Profuse sweat at night, especially on head. Sweats on head, neck and shoulders. All perspiration is suppressed.

Temperature - Instability of body temperature. Extreme chilliness alternating with heat, especially at night. Chilliness from 10 a.m. until evening with melancholic mood. Chills beginning in lower back, spreading up and down. Chilliness alternates with perspiration. Chill followed by profuse sweat. Intermittent fever every one, two or three days, irregular in its type. Evening fever. Rheumatic fevers. Malignant plague fevers. Suppressed fevers from quinine sulphate. Hot feet, sticks them out of bed, often only one foot. Sticks one or two arms out of bed or sleeps with the upper half of body uncovered.

name: Sacharum Lactis
author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Worse by a coming storm, the approach of which was felt some twelve hours previously. Pains, worse in damp room or basement, but better if there was a fire. All symptoms better after 4 p.m. Worse by blue and yellow colors, better by red..
constitution: Amblyopia. Angina pectoris. Body, odor. Diabetes. Dyspepsia. Earache. Gout. Headache. Hysteria. Labia, soreness. Nervousness. Neuralgia. Ovaries disorders. Over-exertion. Ptosis. Sciatica. Sighing. Styes. Umbilicus inflammation.
keynote:
PHARMACY - sac-1. Sacharum lactis. Milk sugar. Lactose. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Angina pectoris. Body, odor. Diabetes. Dyspepsia. Earache. Gout. Headache. Hysteria. Labia, soreness. Nervousness. Neuralgia. Ovaries disorders. Over-exertion. Ptosis.…
full:
PHARMACY - sac-1. Sacharum lactis. Milk sugar. Lactose. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Amblyopia. Angina pectoris. Body, odor. Diabetes. Dyspepsia. Earache. Gout. Headache. Hysteria. Labia, soreness. Nervousness. Neuralgia. Ovaries disorders. Over-exertion. Ptosis. Sciatica. Sighing. Styes. Umbilicus inflammation.

HOMEOPATHIC - Hahnemann chose globules of Sacharum lactis as the chief vehicle of his remedies because he considered it the most inert substance he could find. But his method of attenuating remedies had shown that no substance is inert in potencies and experience shows that no substance is absolutely inert in any form. Sac-1, in large doses develops the bacillus acidophilus to correct putrefactive intestinal conditions and also constipation. Diuresis. Amblyopia. Sensitive in every part of body. Small shooting pains all over in morning. Throbbing in parts of body. Cold pains, as if produced by fine, icy cold needle with tingling, as if frost bitten. Great physical exhaustion and weakness, caused by overwork. Prostration from mental excitement. MIND - Extremely nervous, jumps from her seat at least unusual noise. Sudden fear and trembling of whole body, as from fright. Sarcastic and fault-finding, could not speak a pleasant word to any one. Laziness. Longing and melancholy as if homesick, with oppressed breathing. Her heart aches as if it would burst, yet she cannot weep. Fear of death during pain in heart. Hysteria in evening, laughing and crying, jumping up and lying down. Sensation as if she were kept together by a great effort. Loses her way in well-known streets. Imagines that there is a large hole in her back just above sacrum, that her mother wants to kill her, that some one is behind her.

Head - Sharp pains behind right ear. Pain in left eyebrow. Left temple sore to touch. Burning like fire, extending from right frontal eminence to vertex. Sensation as of pressure on frontal bone at inner canthi of left eye, felt very sore. Sharp darting pain on left side of head from temple to occiput. Forehead feels very heavy with a tendency to fall forward. Sharp pain in forehead from one temple to the other. Head feels large and as though all the blood in the body had gone into the head. Head feels confused and as if it were tossing on a rough sea.

Eyes - Pain through right eye inwards. Sensation as if needles were sticking in eyes. Dryness of eyeball so that the lid would stick to it. Looking at bright light dazzles and makes her close eyes, no pain. Sight fails, eyes tire very easily. Styes. Swelling of right upper lid. Can only elevate upper lids half way.

Ears - Pain in right ear and underneath it. Painfulness of right external ear with burning like an ulcer, also when touched. Pain passing from right ear to shoulder. Pain from right ear to lower part of inferior maxillary bone. Pain in left ear and sensation as if there were a gathering. Shooting pains in and behind ears and all over face. Pains in external ears and behind them. Reverberation of voice when speaking. Buzzing sound in right ear. Sensation as if she could not hear, but she could.

Nose - Pain in sides, end of nose. Ridge of nose extremely sore, it feels sore to touch or from the least movement of facial muscles, the left side is the worst and somewhat swollen.

Face - Sad expression of face, eyes look as from weeping, though she has not wept. Wretched appearance. Great pallor efface with dark places under eyes. Burning in cheekbones towards temples and lower jaw. Pain passing from corner of mouth of forepart of right axilla. Pain all over face, then centering in right ear. Corners of mouth, chin smart and burn.

Mouth - Burning in whole mouth. Sensation of coolness as of ice in mouth and throat. Roof of mouth sore. Soreness like blisters in mouth and on tongue. Sore on left side of tongue. Tongue, coated white, yellow. Taste, putrid in mouth after eating or fine spicy taste like fresh nuts. Thick bitter mucus in mouth during morning. Lips feel very sore, raw and dry with great thirst.

Throat - Spasmodic stricture in esophagus. Globus hystericus after lunch at noon with dull, sick headache. Throat very sensitive to external pressure, the least pressure causes a feeling as if she were choking. Sensation when swallowing as of a fishbone in throat. COMMENTS - Swan is the authority for Sac- 1. as a homeopathic remedy. He published a full pathogenesis of Sac-1., proved in the potencies from 30c upward, together with confirmed and cured symptoms. One of Swan's pro vers had the symptom “Sight fails, eyes tire very easily." Another patient, when taking pilules of Sac-1, three times a day complained that they made his “eyes ache and feel weak.” Sensations of both coldness and heat. One of the cold sensations is “Sensation of extreme cold passing in a fine line from center of pubes to a point two or three inches above.” Swan regarded cold pains as a keynote and recorded the case of Mr. S., who had an excessively cold neuralgic pain in the cartilage of both ears, the right being the worst with tingling as if frost-bitten, rubbing with difficulty restored the warmth. Lancinating, neuralgic pains in forehead in occiput, extending from region above ears down through ears into muscles of neck in both eyes, worse by least breath of air, skin sensitive to touch as in inflammatory rheumatism. These pains were icy cold, as if produced by an extremely fine ice-cold needle. As Sac- I. has “fine cold pains” and pains passing in all directions, Sac-1. 1.000c was given and relieved all the pains within an hour. H. A. Hare said of Sac-1.. “Scientific and clinical studies have shown it to be possessed of very great diuretic powers when given in full doses.” He said further, that its direct action on the kidneys and its slight action elsewhere indicate it in kidney dropsy and kidney inactivity, that it acts best in cases where albuminuria is absent and that it causes profuse diuresis in infants fed on it. RELATIONS - Camph. aggravates the effects of Sac-1. Compare: (1) Sac-alb. in rickets, acidity, fat children. Calc., the Lacs. (2) Right cheekbone, Mag-c. (3) Roof of mouth, Mang. (4) Ball sensation in rectum pains, Kali- bi. (5) Kidney ache, Santa, Sacchin. (6) Fatigue, Pic- ac., Mag-c. (7) Heat in heart, Lachn. (8) better lying on left side, Lil-t. (9) worse from damp, Dulc. ( 10) Sensitiveness, Kali-i. Mag-c. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Stomach - Pressure in stomach as if she had eaten something indigestible. Dyspepsia after eating hot pie- crust. Heartburn with sweet taste coming from stomach without water brash. Violent sickness, going on all day. Nausea does not affect appetite. Nausea like seasickness.

Abdomen - Sore to touch, painful from the jar caused by walking. Severe pain passing through abdomen during stool. Sharp pain passing across bowels just above navel and all around body. Pain in left hypochondrium passing under left breast. Pain above left hip, which would come when leaning back, followed by severe pain in forehead.

Rectum - Stool preceded by shooting pains across abdomen, which are better by stool. Before stool, pains in breasts and upper abdomen. Urgent inclination to stool, felt as though there were a great ball in rectum, much straining and some flatulence, but no stool and not better from the flatulence. Stools smell like rotten eggs. Soreness around anus, extending up rectum. Creeping, itching and crawling around anus, extending inside rectum. Shooting pains in rectum.

Female - Menses commenced too early, no pain. Menses very dark. Profuse greenish- yellow leucorrhea. Bloody leucorrhea. Soreness and rawness of labia with profuse greenish-yellow leucorrhea. Itching of labia. Lobulated growths on each side of vagina, extremely sore and sensitive to touch. Pain in region of right ovary. Ovarian region very weak and painful when walking. Dragging-down sensation in pelvic region. Food - Hungry all the time. When first getting out of bed feels faint for something to eat. Desire for dainties. Feeling of distention after eating. Great thirst, wanted large quantities of very cold water.

Chest - Feeling as if ulcerated over right short ribs, worse from touch and when stooping. Pain in axilla.

Heart - Sensation as if a fire in heart. Feeling as if heart would burst. Awoke at midnight with severe numb pains about heart, great fear of death, when the pains passed off they left great soreness around heart. Pulse intermittent.

Back - Dull ache all over back and in right arm. Backaches the whole length of spine. Pain passing up and down along right side of neck. Hot flashes all over back of neck and shoulders. Pain with soreness at upper right scapula. Pain in sacral region, worse when taking a breath. Pain passing up back from sacrum. Pain in lumbar region, worse by leaning backward. Breasts - Sharp pain into right breast, very sore to touch. Constant pain under left breast, worse when bending forward. Severe pains under left breast at every inspiration. Causations - Mental excitement. Overfatigue.

Limbs - Pain from right shoulder passing down to waist. Pain from right shoulder to left breast. Pain in forepart of right upper arm. Pain in right wrist. Pain, itching in palm of right hand. Grasping anything with right handcauses pains to pass from all the fingers into palm. Sharp pain in all right fingers except little finger. Skin under nails looks dirty. Awful pain extending down the right sciatic nerve. Pains in thighs and hips. Hot flashes in lower limbs. Pain in right instep when bending foot. Pain like gout in right toe. Balls of feet covered with little corns, which are very painful when walking.

Sleep - Yawning all day. Sleeplessness after midnight. Cannot sleep on right side. Cannot go to sleep without putting arms over head. Impossible to lie straight in bed, finds herself continually lying diagonally across bed. Has to lie on left side. Fatiguing dreams all night. Awoke with the impression that she had dreamed of dreadful pains in chest, does not know whether it was a dream or a reality.

Skin - Very restless at night from itching all over body as soon as she is covered in bed. Itching of both shoulders.

Modalities - Worse by a coming storm, the approach of which was felt some twelve hours previously. Pains, worse in damp room or basement, but better if there was a fire. All symptoms better after 4 p.m. Worse by blue and yellow colors, better by red.

Kidneys - Constant pain in region of left kidney. Soreness of urethra during urination. Constant, urgent desire to urinate with cutting pain up urethra. Sound of running water produced urination, no power to restrain it. Involuntary urination during night. Urinates large quantities very frequently. Urine causes intense pain when coming in contact with the labia, which are very sensitive. Urination followed by a thick yellow discharge. Urine stains a dark yellow.

Temperature - Great coldness as if a chill were coming on. Fingers, feet toes, icy cold, could not keep warm in bed covered with clothes. Hot flashes inside body pressing from below upward. Feeling of heat all over, the body is covered with a light sweat, enough to feel uncomfortable. Strange restlessness at night.

Influenza. Intestine ulceration. Iritis. Melancholy. Meniere’s disease. Menopausal. Necrosis. Pharyngitis, herpetic. Puerperal fever. Purpura. Rheumatism. Rheumatoid arthritis. Scarlatina. Sciatica. Septicemia. Sto
