PHARMACY - sep. Sepia succus. Cuttlefish ink. Sepia officinalis. N. O. Cephalopoda. Trituration of dried liquid contained in the ink-bag. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abortion. Addison’s disease. Alcohol, effects. Amenorrhea. Anal, problems. Appetite, depraved. Ascarides. Baldness. Bedwetting. Bladder, weak. Birth control pills. Cancer. Childbirth. Chloasma. Chorea. Condylomata. Constipation. Cortisone, effects. Cushing’s disease. Cystitis. Depression. Dysmenorrhea. Dyspepsia. Eczema. Estrogen, effects. Eyes, disorders. Face, yellow. Freckles. Gleet. Gonorrhea. Gravel. Hair, loss. Hemorrhoids. Herpes. Hormonal, disorders. Hormonal, drugs. Hot, flushes. Hysterectomy. Hysteria. Infertility. Jaundice. Labor, pains. Leucorrhea. Libido, low. Liver, spots. Liver, torpid. Menopause. Menstruation, disorders. Mental, disorders. Miscarriages. Morning sickness. Neuralgias. Nose, inflamed. Nosebleed. Ovarian, disorders. Ozaena. Phimosis. Pityriasis, versicolor. Pleurisy. Pregnancy, disorders. Premenstrual, syndrome. Pruritus. Psoriasis. Ptosis. Puberty, disorders. Pylorus, induration. Quinsy. Rectal, disorders. Ringworm. Sacrum, pain. Sciatica. Seborrhea. Sexual, disorders. Smell, disorders. Spermatorrhea. Strokes. Styes. Toothache. Urinary, incontinence. Uterus, disorders. Uterus, prolapsed. Vaginitis. Varicose, veins. Venous stasis. Warts. Whooping cough.

HOMEOPATHIC - The inky juice of cuttlefish, known as Indian ink, is one of the remedies of the Chronic Diseases, and was proved by Goullon, Von Gersdorff, Gross, Hartlaub and Wahle. It is preeminently a woman’s remedy, although the first symptoms were found by Hahnemann accidentally proved by a male artist. It affects the generative organs of both sexes and a large number of the symptoms occurring in other organs have some relation thereto. Sep. affects the venous circulation, especially of the female pelvic organs and of the digestive tract. It acts especially on the portal system with venous congestion. Venous stasis, ptosis of viscera. Violent ebullitions of blood with pulsation throughout the body. Pulsating headache in cerebellum. Bleedings. Hormonal disorders. Affections in pregnant women. Tendency to miscarriages. Bearing down in pelvic region. Uterus prolapsed. Hot flashes at menopause with weakness and perspiration. Excess of sexual indulgence. Loss of vital fluids. Milky secretions. Upward tendency of its symptoms. Symptoms settle in back, in ileo-cecal region, ovaries. Pains extend down to back, chills easily. Shuddering from pain. Burning pains in different parts of the body. Rheumatism, chronic cases. Fits of uneasiness and hysterical spasms. Spasms, clonic, tonic, cataleptic. Jerking in muscles. Fidgety. Sudden prostration. Easy fainting. Feels cold, even in warm room. Short walk fatigues much. Weariness and misery. Weakness, yellow complexion. Weak, empty, hollow feeling in epigastrium, chest, muscles, lumbar back, hips, knees etc. or sensation of fullness. As of a lump or something rolling over internally. “Ball’’ sensation in inner parts. Females dragged down by overwork. Tubercular patient with chronic hepatic troubles and uterine reflexes. Children who take cold easily when the weather changes. Relaxed, plethoric females. Weak, potbellied mothers with yellow complexion. Diseased conditions which drag on, linger. Atrophy of children, their face like an old man. Warty growths. Big belly, dry flabby skin. MIND - Mentally and physically worn-out patients. Industrious. Indisposed to mental labor. Repugnance to customary business, disgust of life. Makes mistakes while writing or reading. Poor memory. Confused, wants to run away. Confusion of mind when spoken to. Irresolution. Anxious fear, over trifles. Anxiety during heat flushes. Constantly worries, frets and cries about her real or imaginary illness. Despair about recovery. Cries when telling her symptoms. Fear of poverty. Fear of thun- derstorms. Nervous, so that she wants to hold on to something or she should scream. Sense of helplessness. Feels unfortunate without cause. Weeping, worse from consolation. Breaks down in spells of weeping. Miserly. Dwells on past disagreeable occurrences. Self-pity. Complaints and grievances. Sad and gloomy moods. Sad over her health and domestic affairs. Tendency to burst into tears. They have too much work to do. People are not kind to them. No one realizes how much suffering they have or with what difficulties they have to contend. Depression, suicidal. Depression on awaking in morning. Depression related to pregnancy, menses or menopause. Unhappy married life. Great sadness during pregnancy or lactation. Post-partum depression. Emotional stillness. Sexually shut down, no libido. Low sex drive since childbirth, hysterectomy, menopause. Aversion to the opposite sex. Women who dislike men and men who dislike women. Loss of sex drive and sexual disorders. Nausea, disgust at the thought of sex. Anxiety after sex. Dullness of mind after sex. Aversion to those loved best, to family. Aversion to sympathy and company, yet dreads to be alone. Averse to occupation, house work. Indolent. Desires solitude, lies with closed eyes. Sits quietly and answers either with yes or no. Irritable and easily offended. Irritability, alternating with indifference or sulks. Bad- tempered. Resents criticism of any kind. Spiteful. Lack of sympathy. Angry, sensitive, easily offended and miserable. Anger about past events. Anger from contradic-. tion. Anger related to pregnancy, menses or menopause. Anger in morning. Censorious. Takes pleasure in teasing others. Never seems happy unless annoying someone. Says and does strange things. Mania before menses. Sensitive to least noise.odors. Excited during thunderstorms. Cheerful when it thunders and with lightning. Loves to dance.

Head - Headache alternating sides of occiput. Headache worse lying on painful side, indoors. Headache better after meals. Headache with terrible shocks at menstrual time, with scanty flow, or before menses. Weekly or monthly headaches. Headache worse from shopping, mental labor, better after meals. Headache with nausea and vomiting. Smell of food repulsive during headache. Jaundice with headache. Hair falls out after chronic headache. Shooting pains. Screams with pain. Stinging pain within out or upwards. Stinging pain over left eye. Heavy feeling on vertex. Cold sensation on vertex. Involuntary jerking of head backwards and forwards, with open fontanelles in children. Prodromal symptoms of a stroke. Hemicrania. Hair falls out at menopause. Root of hair sensitive to combing. Pimples on forehead along the margins of hair.

Eyes - Eyes feel tired and look injected. Conjunctivitis. Muscular asthenopia. Asthenic inflammations with uterine trouble. Burning in eyes with lachrymation. Aching at back of eyeballs. Eyes feel sore as if bruised. Falling out feeling in eyes during headache. Pressure as from sand in eyes. Arrests cataract in women. Photophobia. Cannot tolerate reflected light. Aggravation of eye troubles morning and evening. Agglutination of eyelids. Epithelioma of eyelids. Eyelids red, itching. Styes. Ptosis. Drooping eyelids. Eyelids as if too heavy to open. Venous congestion of the fundus. Tarsal tumors. Tarsi, red, itching cancer.

Ears - Chronic otalgia. Discharge, thick yellow pus offensive. Discharge of thin matter. Itching in affected ear. Pain as if from sub-cutaneous ulceration. Dragging or stitching pain in ears. Swelling of and eruptions on external ear. Herpes, behind ears, on lobe of ears, on nape of neck. Tetter on lobes of ear and behind ears. Oversensitive to noise, especially music. Loud sounds and humming in ears. Sudden deafness, as if caused by the plug in ears.

Nose - Yellowish-brown saddle across nose. Dry feeling in nose. Pressive pain in root of nose. Tip of nose inflamed and swollen. Nostrils ulcerated. Chronic nasal catarrh. Post-nasal catarrh, dripping of heavy, lumpy discharge, must be hawked through the mouth. Thick greenish discharge, foul, plugs and crusts. Ozaena. Ascending throat colds. Frequent sneezing without coryza. Fluent coryza. Nosebleed, when the nose has been struck by anything, even lightly, during menses or pregnancy, with hemorrhoids. Great sensitiveness to odors. Odors are repulsive to the smell of cooking food. Fetid smell before nose.

Face - Old, wrinkled skin with spots. Black pores. Face changes color. Chloasma. Dark circles under eyes. Yellowish -brown saddle across nose. Yellow-brownish discoloration on nose and cheeks. Yellow blotches, pale or sallow, yellow about mouth. Rosacea. Acne, worse before menses. Warts. Swollen, cracked lower lip. Cancer of the lips, epithelioma. Swelling of submaxillary glands. Numbness of malar bones. Jerking of facial muscles while talking. Facial neuralgia during pregnancy.

Mouth - Swelling and cracking of lower lip. Mouth and tongue feel as if scalded. Offensive or sour smell from mouth. Profuse flow of salty saliva. Taste of rotten eggs on coughing. Taste salty, putrid, cheesy, fishy. Taste bitter, sour, putrid, offensive. Everything tastes too salty. Hawks foul or cheesy grains in the morning.

Throat - Dryness and soreness. Roughness and soreness of larynx and throat. Roughness and burning in fauces, worse hawking. Raw pain when swallowing. Pressure in the throat, feels neck cloth tight. Sensation of dryness in larynx. Sensation of a plug. Sore throat with swelling of cervical glands. Ascending throat colds. Hawks foul or cheesy lumps in morning. Hoarseness. Aphonia.

Stomach - Gnawing in stomach, better eating. Sinking down feeling and weakness. Faint sinking feeling at epigastrium, not better by eating. Severe cramping pains. Hardness in pyloric region. Burning in pit of stomach. Heartburn. Sensation of a lump in stomach (Carb-an.). Sensation of something twisting about in stomach and rising into the throat. Disordered stomach after bread, milk, fat food or acids. Stomach pain and vomiting of mucus after simplest food. Acid dyspepsia with bloated abdomen, sourbelchings. Dyspepsia from over-lifting, from smoking. Belchings, milky, sour, bitter, rancid of tough, foamy mucus. Eructations like rotten eggs. Nausea at thought or smell of food. Nausea in morning before eating. Nausea worse lying on side. Morning sickness, motion sickness. Disposition to vomit after eating. Vomiting of milky fluid during pregnancy. Vomiting of bile and food.

Abdomen - Brown spots on abdomen. Coldness in abdomen. Lax feeling in abdomen. Falling out or heavy, bearing down feeling in hypogastrium, better by holding it or crossing legs. Burning and shooting pains. Violent pain in umbilical region. Bloated abdomen after eating. Loud rumbling in abdomen after eating. Flatulence with headache. Colic and faintness before menses. Soreness and pain as if menses would appear. Pot-belly of mothers.

Rectum - Sensation of weight or ball in anus, not better by stool. Shooting pains up rectum and vagina. Prolapsed anus (Podo.), rectum, worse from smoking. Rectum is constricted and powerless, almost constant oozing from anus. Bleeding at stool and fullness of rectum. Weak feeling in rectum. Obstinate constipation, no urging for days. Constipation, large, hard stools, cannot strain, with great tenesmus. Constipation during pregnancy. Infantile diarrhea, worse from boiled milk and rapid exhaustion. Heat, burning and swelling of anus. Itching in rectum and anus. Hemorrhoids during pregnancy. Hemorrhoids prolapsing with sticking pain. Hemorrhoids bleed while walking. Soreness between buttocks. Cancer of rectum. Anus encircled by ring of condylomata. Sensations - As if something twisting in stomach and rising to throat. As if viscera turning inside out. As if bladder full and contents would fall out over pubes. As if drops came out of bladder. As if bladder and urinary organs would be pressed out. As of everything would fall out through vulva. As if everything would fall out of uterus. Uterus as if clutched. As if vulva enlarged. As if something heavy would force itself from vagina. As if heart stood still. As of a ball in inner parts. As of hot water poured over body. As if roots of hair were sore, as if cut short near roots.

Stool - Stools passed after prolonged straining, followed by cupful of jelly like yellow-white, very offensive mucus. Insufficient stool, mixed or covered with mucus. Dark-brown, round balls gluedtogether with mucus. Large, hard stools, constipated. Soft stool, difficult. Narrow stools, sometimes triangular. Greenish loose stool. Stool has a putrid, sourish, fetid smell, expelled suddenly. Almost constant oozing from anus.

Male - Offensive perspiration on scrotum. Itching and dry eruption on genitals. Her pes. Prepuce ulcerates and itches. Cracks on foreskin. Condylomata surrounding head of penis. Swelling of scrotum. Cutting pains in testes. Weak prostate gland. Weakness of genitals. Genitals cold. Impotency. Insufficient erections. Sexual desire increased or decreased. Nightly emissions with sexual dreams. Watery semen. Complaints after sex. Gonorrhea. Gleet, discharge from urethra only during night, no pain.

Female - Hormonal disorders. Never well since puberty, childbirth, after weaning or hormone pills. Amenorrhea. Menses irregular, early and profuse. Menses too late and scanty. Menses cause faintness, chilliness and shuddering. Mania from profuse menses. Dysmenorrhea in women with scanty menses. Dryness of vagina and vulva after menses. Leucorrhea, yellow, greenish, milky in large lumps, with much itching, instead of menses. Leucorrhea, foul, gonorrheal with stitches up in vagina from uterus to navel. Leucorrhea in little girls. Pelvic organs relaxed. Weak uterus. Dragging or bearing down sensation as if everything would escape through the vagina (Bell., Lil-t., Nat-c.), must cross limbs to prevent protrusion or press against vulva. Prolapsed uterus or vagina. Sub-involution. Violent stitches upward in the vagina from uterus to umbilicus. Griping, burning or sticking in uterus. Sharp clutching pains. Labia swollen, abscessed. Severe itching in vulva causing abortion. Tendency to miscarriage from the fifth to the seventh month. Labor-like, during seventh month of pregnancy. Morning sickness. Motion of fetus is intolerable. Retained placenta after abortion. Offensive, excoriating lochia. Infertility. Sterility. Aversion to sex, worse since childbirth. Low sex drive. Nausea and irritability on thought of sex. Sexual parts tender to touch. Sex painful Sepia succus from dryness of vagina. Bleeding after sex. Exhaustion after sex. Sudden flushes of heat with weakness and sweat during menopause. Metrorrhagia at the time of menopause. Food - Voracious appetite or no appetite. Sudden cravings and sudden satiety. Everything tastes too salty (Carb-v.. Chin.). Desires chocolate, sweets, wine, vinegar, acids and pickles. Great sensitiveness to smell of cooking food. Nausea at thought or smell of food. Aversion to all food during headache, to bread and milk during pregnancy. Aversion to fat, meat, milk. Aggravated from acids and fats, loathes fats. Worse from boiled milk. Great nervous irritability from coffee. Water brash after eating or drinking. Thirst during headache.

Chest - Oppression of chest, morning and evening. Oppression when walking or from slightest exertion. Pain in sides of chest, when inspiring or coughing. Sensation of emptiness in chest. Chest symptoms better by pressure of hand. Stitches in chest when coughing. Fungus hematodes in clavicular region, bleeding profusely. Boils in axilla. Swelling and suppuration of axillary glands. Humid tetter in axilla. Brown spots on chest. Constitutions - Hering said it was suited to young persons of both sexes of nervous and delicate constitution, who are disposed to sexual excitement or worn out by sexual excess. Women during pregnancy, in childbed, and while nursing. Children who take cold readily when the weather changes. Scrofulous persons. Men who have been addicted to drinking and sexual excesses. Pot-bellied mothers, yellow saddle across nose, irritable, faint from least exertion, leuco-phlegmatic constitutions. Bahr indicated it for sanguine, excitable temperaments inclined to congestions. Coughs - Cough in morning with profuse expectoration, tasting salty (Phos., Ambr.). Rotten-egg taste with coughing. Cough excited by tickling in larynx or chest. Cough better eating. Cough with nausea and bitter vomiting. Dry, fatiguing cough with foul sputum, as if coming from stomach, worse rapid change of temperature. Spasmodic cough, evening and at night in bed, preventing sleep. Child cries each time it coughs at night. Whooping cough that drags on.

Heart - Irregular circulation, seems to stagnate. Venous stasis. Congestion of blood vessels. Dropsy in consequence of valvularinsufficiency. General pulsations. Ebullitions at night. Tremulous feeling with flushes. Beating in all arteries. Violent, intermittent palpitations. Palpitations with anxiety. Nervous palpitations, better walking fast, worse lying on left side. Visible palpitations, ascends to occiput. Palpitations before scanty menses. Wakes up with violent beating of heart. An occasional hard thump of the heart. Sensation as if heart stood still. Pulse full and quick during night and then intermitting. Pulse slow during day. Pulse accelerated by motion or being angry.

Back - Backache, causes nausea and faint feeling while standing. Sudden pain in back, as if struck by a hammer, worse stooping, kneeling. Back pain, better belching, by pressing back against something hard. Heaviness in back in morning on waking. Burning pressure in spine. Spine tender to touch or pressure. Aching and dull pain in lumbar and sacral regions. Aching in inter-scapular or lumbar region, paralytic, wants to be pressed. Weakness in small of back, when walking, from uterine disease. Weakness in lumbar region. Lumbar region as if sprained. Throbbing in lumbar region. Cramps in buttocks when stretching out legs. Coldness between scapula, as from an icy hand. Collar feels tight.

Limbs - Poor circulation. Venous stasis. Heaviness and a bruised feeling. Restlessness in all limbs, twitching and jerkings night and day. Sensation of running, as from a mouse in lower limbs. Tension in limbs as if they were too short. Lower limbs lame and stiff. Short walk fatigues. Limbs go to sleep easily. Coldness of legs, knees, feet, and heels. Coldness of limbs during fever. Hot hands with cold feet or vice versa. Cold hands in warm room. Rheumatic pains. Stiffness of joints. Weakness of joints, especially the knees. Swelling of veins of affected limbs. Sciatica, better during pregnancy, chronic, localizing in heels. Ulcers on small joints, fingers, toes. Thick crusts on elbows. Hands sweaty, purple. Skin of palms peels off. Crippled nails.

Sleep - Sleeplessness from excitement. Insomnia from rush of thoughts. Talks loudly during sleep. Wakes frequently as if he has been called. Frequent starts with fright, screaming. Waking at night from frightful dreams, with screaming out. Dreams of rape, being pursued, chased with a knife. Dreams of urinating and finds on waking an urgent desire to do so. Dreams, worse if he lies on left side. No desire to rise in morning. Very sleepy during day, falls asleep as soon as she sits down.

Skin - Chloasma. Spots on skin. Yellowish- brown spots. Blotched, raw, rough, hard or cracked, worse flexures. Wine colored skin. Delicate skin, least injury tends to ulceration. Ulcers, on small joints. Herpetic eruption on lips, about mouth and nose. Ringworm in isolated spots. Ringwormlike eruption every spring. Itching, not Sepia succus relieved by scratching, worse in bends of elbows and knees. Itching vesicles. Urticaria, worse open air better warm room. Boils in axilla. Hyperidrosis and bromidrosis. Lentigo in young women. Ichthyosis with offensive odor of skin. Ichthyosis with offensive odor of skin. Skin pinkish after scratching. Indurations from constant pressure with purple color. Large, hard, seed warts. Small, itching, flat warts on hands and face. Epithelioma, on eyelids, lips.

Modalities - Better sitting with legs crossed, crossing or drawing limbs up. Better from exercise,running, dancing, vigorous motion. Better pressure, warmth of bed, hot applications. Better after sleep. Better cold drinks, cold bathing, open air. Worse from cold, air, dampness, north wind, snowy air, snowfall. Worse before thunderstorms. Worse washing clothes, laundry-work. Worse morning and evening. Worse after first sleep, falling to sleep. Worse left side. Worse after sweat. Worse sitting, standing, kneeling, jarring, stooping. Worse ascending, lifting. Worse from touch, rubbing, scratching. Worse after sex, sexual excess. Worse before menses, after pregnancy, miscarriage.

Teeth - Bleeding of gums. Gums painful, as if burned. Grinding teeth. Teeth decay. Teeth feel dull. Hollow molar pains as if elongated and swollen. Toothache from hot or cold things. Toothache better cold water, returning as soon as water gets warm. Toothache better inhaling cold air. Toothache after sweets and from tea-drinking. Toothache when biting teeth together. Toothache during pregnancy. Toothache and throbbing in gums during menses.

Tongue - Tip of tongue as if scalded. Tongue white and feels burnt. Tongue coated with mucus, dirty yellow, brown with red edges. Tongue pale, flabby and indented. Tongue stiff. Vesicles on tongue. Tongue dirty, becomes clear during menses. Vertigo - Fits of vertigo, worse walking in open air, least movement of arms. Vertigo with a sensation as if something rolling around the head. Vertigo as if intoxicated. Vertigo as if every object were in motion. Vertigo as if suspended in air. Vision - Black spots, points, before the eyes. Amaurosis, with contracted pupils. He- miopia. Vision was dimmed from sexual excess, masturbation or uterine diseases. Vanishing of sight during menses, better lying. Flashes of light when closing eyes. Sparks, veil, streaks before the eyes. Intolerance of reflected light from bright objects. COMMENTS - Historically, physicians used the flesh, the eggs or even the only bone that constitutes the skeleton of this animal, for “leucorrhea, gonorrhea, catarrh of the bladder, gravel, spasms of the bladder, baldness, freckles and certain kinds of tetters which is sufficiently remarkable in the light of the provings.” Sep. acts on the vital forces as well as on organic tissues. The sphincters and all non-striated muscles are weakened. Sep. disturbs the circulation, causing flushes and other irregularities, throbbings all over, hot hands and cold feet or vice versa. The flushes run upward and end in sweat with a faint, weak feeling. Nosebleed may occur from a blow, from being in a warm room, or from suppressed menses. Low thyroid with hormonal components. Grimmer stated “This remedy has cured cancer of rectum and uterus, it acts strongly on the sexual organs of both sexes and a great many symptoms and conditions are manifested in this sphere. Young people of both sexes frequently have ailments calling for this medicine, women during the pregnant state after childbirth, men who have been addicted to drinking and sexual excesses are often helped by this remedy. Sex aggravates it in both sexes.” Difficulty with hormonal changes, associated with headaches, constipation, hemorrhoids and irritability. Never well since puberty (Puls.), childbirth, miscarriage, abortion, menopause. Ailments from the birth control pill, hormonal creams or patches. Premenstrual syndrome, with irritability, headache, generally fastidious before menses. Irregular menses, painful, may have a heavy flow. Low energy, bloating, irritability and sensitivity before period. May crave chocolate. Somewhat offensive, yellowish-green leucorrhea. Prolapse or induration of uterus and cervix. Engorgement of the uterus going on to induration. Prolapse or retroversion. Bearing-down pains of great intensity, in the abdomen, back, extending into thighs, and sometimes even seem to interfere with breathing. Bearing down worse standing or walking. Constant sense of pressing into vagina, compelling the patient to cross the limbs to prevent prolapse. Uterine symptoms with hysteria, weakness, palpitation, orgasm of blood, faintness. Loss of sex drive. Aversion to sex, to affection, or being touched and held since hormonal change. Aversion to the smells of their partner. Aloofness, disgust for sex. May fake orgasms, have sex out of a feeling of duty, obligation. Anorgasmie or may take a long time to orgasm. Ailments from rape, with emotional and sexual shutdown (Staph, has anger). Drainedof love and affection for all loved ones. Empty, sinking feeling. Morning sickness with aversion to sight, smell, thought of foods. Vomiting of food, bile and milky fluid, in the morning. Strains so that blood comes up. “The thought of food sickens her with sense of a great weight in anus.” Hypersensitive to odors, delusions of odors. Disgusted feeling. May want to back out of pregnancy. May have a history of many childbirths or miscarriages. Miscarriage from sex, causes contractions. Tendency to miscarriage. Hering is reported to have said “All women prone to miscarriage should take Sep. or Zinc.” Physical affects from abortions (Nat-m. for emotional trauma). Difficulty making decisions, confusion, anger during pregnancy. Sinking sensation in pregnancy. Premature delivery or false labor pains associated with low energy or depression. Traumatic, loss of blood and energy. Long and exhausting labor. Postpartum depression. Emotionally shutdown after childbirth. Loss of mothering instincts. Aversion to breastfeeding. Ill effects of breastfeeding. Weight gain since pregnancy (Calc.). Depression with meno- Sepia succus pause. Hot flashes, low sex drive, depression after a hysterectomy. Indifference to loved ones. Aloof and detached, insensitive. Critical, cold hearted, tendency to nag and complain, especially with hormonal changes. Easily upset, frustrated (Ign.), from hormonal imbalance. Ailments from grief (Nat-m.). Impulse to do violence. Fits of weeping, without knowing why. Fear of not understanding their emotions. Worse from consolation, desires to be left alone. Lack of mental thought, of emotional feeling. Mind becomes dull, struggle to thing. Weak, dragged feeling. Venous stasis, weak veins. Slowed circulation, better from vigorous exercise. Raynaud’s disease. Tendency to bruise easily. Cold hands and feet. Varicose veins (Phos.), during or since pregnancy. Weakened uterine tissues, bearing down feeling. Lack of tone and weakness leading to congestion, then to bearing down pain. Hemorrhoids, ever since childbirth. Hemorrhoids with menses. Prolapsed rectum in cases of hemorrhoids. Sensation of emptiness, sometimes connected with the pelvic bearing down. Empty sensation in the epigastrium and throughout the abdomen. Lump sensation in the throat and rectum. “Ball” sensation in inner parts, most notably in rectum, not relieved by stool. Clarke has cured both constipation and diarrhea when that symptom was present. Upward stitches in rectum and vagina. Portal stasis. Fullness, soreness and stitches in liver region, as well as stitches in left hypochondrium. Diabetes with a hormonal component. Low blood sugar. Dyspepsia, from injury, by over-lifting. Severe constipation (Alum., Calc.), or constipation during pregnancy. Craves chocolate, bitter, sour and tart foods, particularly during pregnancy. Tendency to stimulate their taste buds. Strong aversion to fat. Irritation of the urinary tract. Catarrh of bladder and urethra. Frequent strong urging to urinate. Stitches along the urethra. Relaxed sphincters. Bedwetting, “The bed is wet almost as soon as the child goes to sleep, always during the first sleep.” Discharge of urine may be difficult even with urgent desire. Gonorrhea after the acute stage has subsided. Gleet and gonorrheal warts. Delicate skin, the least injury tends to ulceration. Itching, which often changes to burning when scratched. Soreness of skin, humid places on bends of knees. Painful eruption on tip of nose. Herpetic eruption on lips and about mouth. Skin condition relating to hormonal changes. Tendency to dry skin from low estrogen. Severe dryness of the vagina (Nat-m.). Chloasma. Liver spots, brown spots. Hair falls out after childbirth or with menopause. Acne, mole growth, freckles related to hormonal change, including puberty, childbirth, or birth control pills. Brittle nails. Addison’s disease. Psoriasis, skin funguses (Thuj.), ringworm (Thuj., Bac., Tell.). Ringworm-like eruptions, pityriasis, every spring on different parts of body. Herpes circinatus. Round, yellow spots. Nettle rash, appears on going into open air, better in warm room. Desperate itching, especially when it affects the genitals and anus. Bursitis from kneeling and scrubbing the floors, overwork. Patient is worn out from domestic duties. Arthritis, worse cold, wet (Calc.), packache (Bry., Nat-m.). Stiffness of limbs worse after sleep. Stiffness of uterine region. “Involuntary jerking of head backward and forward, especially at forenoon when sitting.” Jerking in hysteria. Open fontanelles in children. Vertigo with sensation of something “rolling round” in the head. “Faints easily,” after getting wet, from extremes of heat and cold, riding in a carriage, kneeling at church. Chronic nasal catarrh. Inflamed tonsils from colds, tending to suppuration. Nash had a case in which the discharge was thick, bland and copious. Puls, relieved the catarrh but increased the menstrual flow too much. Sep. cured both. Whooping cough when it has lasted eight weeks or longer and the paroxysms, though reduced in number and virulence, do not disappear and occur especially before midnight. The patients are reduced in strength, dyspeptic, irritable, tearful, easily angered or apathetic. Symptoms are generally left-sided. Worse standing, kneeling, on the left. Very chilly, sensitive to cold. Better deep pressure but worse light touch. Irritable in the mornings from toxicity in the liver (Nux-v.). Need movement, but worse from exertion. Cheerful with thunderstorms. Kunkel reported a case of pulmonary affection in a boy, 14, who had been under treatment five weeks for cough and hoarseness. Hoarseness was worse evening, cough with purulent sputa during the day. Slept well but dreamed when he lay on left side. Emaciated. Phos. lOx produced little change. There was remarkable tightness of the chest on breathing with inclination to take a deep breath, this was better in open air, on motion, while at work, worse while in the house and at rest. Though the weather was bad he had a constant desire to be out of doors. Sep. lOx made a rapid cure. Boenninghausen recommended Sep. in cases of cough, either with or without expectoration with blood- streaked, purulent, yellow greenish or stinking sputa, and especially in tuberculosis. Nash mentioned a case of cholera infantum that he cured with Sep. on the indication “always worse after taking milk.” He compared it with Ant-c. for moisture oozing from the anus, which has the first place. Bahr said Sep. afforded considerable help in a certain condition of the system that had only been noticed in females. After the exacerbation of a chronic gastric catarrh has lasted a few days with intolerable burning pains, the kidney region becomes painful, more particularly the left side. Violent burning pain in the kidney region and a quantity of saturated, highly-colored urine is discharged. Urine deposits copious quantities of urates, or else a clear urine with copious sandy sediment, coated with uric acid. After the discharge, the pains generally abate and only return if the stomach has not been restored to its normal condition. Hering noted its usefulness for “condylomata completely surrounding head of penis.” Clarke cured a crop of small, velvety warts completely encircling the mouth of the prepuce. Thuja had failed. Clarke also cured with Sep. 3x a large horn-like wart on the abdomen of a woman. It was as large as a crown- piece but shaped like a bean and raised a quarter of an inch from the surface. Clarke confirmed the experience of Dr. Swallow, who found the fresh preparation of Sep. to possess a wider range than the ordinary preparation and to act as an “organ remedy” in a great variety of uterine disorders not definitely indicated by the pathogenesis. Clarke used it in potencies from the 5c to 30c. RELATIONS - Antidoted by: Smelling Nit-s-d., by vegetable acids, Aeon., Ant-c., Ant-t., Rhus-t. It antidotes: Calc., Chin., Merc., Nat-m., Nat-p., Phos., Sars., Sulph. Compare: (l)Nat-m., Bell-p., Lil-t., Murx., Sil., Sulph. (2) Vesicular eruptions and ulcers about joints, Bor., Mez. (3) Indifferent to his occupation, Fl-ac., Ph-ac. (4) Sensation of ball in inner parts, Lach. (5) Ringworm in isolated spots, Bac., Calc., Tell. (6) Psoriasis, Ars., Ars- i. (7) Chloasma, Lyc., Nux-v., Sulph., Cur. (8) Constipation during pregnancy, Alum. (9) Pain in rectum long after stool, Nit-ac., Sulph. (10) Empty feeling better eating, Chel., Lyc., Phos. (11) Bedwetting almost as soon as child goes to sleep, Kreos. (12) Bearing down as if everything would protrude from pelvis, Agar., Bell. Lil-t., Murx., Sanie. (13) Sight or thought of food sickens, Nux-v. Smell of cooking food nauseates, Ars., Colch. Complementary: Nat-m., Phos. Nux-v. intensifies action. Guaiacum is often beneficial after Sep. Followed well by: Nit-ac. Inimical: Lach., Puls. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke. Murphy. Phatak.

Liver - Aching, throbbing, shooting, stitching, pressing in hepatic region. Liver sore and painful, relieved by lying on right side. Pain in the region of liver or gallbladder, worse stooping. Lungs - Dyspnea, worse after sleep, better rapid motion. Dyspnea better dancing or walking rapidly. Dyspnea in dry air, fog, east and north wind. Loss of breath, with palpitation, after mental emotions. Suffocation in stormy weather. Asthma, wheezing expiration. Spasmodic asthma. Suddenly aroused from a deep sleep by asthma. Neglected pneumonia. Pleuritis. Copious, very offensive expectoration. Expectoration of blood, after lying down. Yellow, green or grey pus. Expectoration milk-white, tenacious mucus, generally of salty taste, in morning. Can raise sputum if he turns from left to right side.

Kidneys - Weak kidneys. Kidney pain and backache. Nephritis. Feeble stream, urine is thick, foul, white, milky, bloody. Gritty, red, adhesive, sandy sediment in urine.

Bladder - Chronic cystitis. Prolapsed bladder, must cross limbs to prevent protrusion or press against vulva. Bladder weak. Sensation as if bladder falls to side lain on. Cutting pain in bladder before urination. Involuntary urination, worse coughing, sneezing, laughing, hearing sudden noise, fright or inattention, especially in women. Slow urination with bearing down sensation above pubis. Bedwetting during first part of sleep. Breasts - Swollen, sensitive breasts before menses. Sensation as if breasts were enlarged. Stitches, tender, burning pains. Induration of breasts. Scirrhus breasts. Burning pain in a fixed spot under right nipple. Nipples cracked across the crown. Nipples bleeding and sore, preceded by itching. Causations - Ill effects of overwork, anger and vexation. Ill effects of blows, injury, over-lifting, falls. Ill effects of getting wet, laundry work, boiled milk, fat, pork, tobacco, alcohol. Snowy air. Puberty, hormone treatment, birth control pills, hysterectomy, pregnancy, childbirth, menopause. Sexual abuse.

Perspiration - Hot sweats, worse menopause. Easy, offensive sweat, with orgasms, on genitals, in axilla or back, between menses. Hands sweaty, purple. Sweats from least motion. Sweat on feet, worse on toes, intolerable odor. Cold sweats at night, on chest, back and thighs. Continuous, debilitating sweats. Sweet- smelling sweat.

Temperature - Poor circulation. General lack of warmth of body. Cold in spots, on vertex, between scapula. Easily chilled. Chilly in warm room, during day. Chilly with air hunger. Chilliness during stool. Feet cold and wet in bed. Very sensitive to cold air. Shivering with thirst, worse toward evening. Irregular fevers. Hot flashes. Heat ascending or as if hot water were poured over her. Frequent flushes of heat. Anxious hot flushes preceded by sudden weakness.

name: Sequoia Sempervirens
author: Murphy
constitution: Asthma. Constipation. Edema. Flatulence. Headache. Lungs, collapsed. Nausea. Pneumonia. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Salivation. Sneezing.
keynote:
PHARMACY - seq-s. Sequoia sempervirens. Redwood. N. O. Taxodiaceae. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Constipation. Edema. Flatulence. Headache. Lungs, collapsed. Nausea. Pneumonia. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Salivation. Sneezing.

HOMEOPATHIC - Birch and Rockwell,…
full:
PHARMACY - seq-s. Sequoia sempervirens. Redwood. N. O. Taxodiaceae. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Asthma. Constipation. Edema. Flatulence. Headache. Lungs, collapsed. Nausea. Pneumonia. Polyuria. Rheumatism. Salivation. Sneezing.

HOMEOPATHIC - Birch and Rockwell, wrote, in A Homoeopathic Proving of Sequoia sempervirens, 1994, “The tree grows in the fog where it is damp and wet, it also grows near the ocean. “The source of the remedy is the burl, a growth on the tree from which new life sprouts. If one were to study the logging industry, one would find that in man’s greed and desire for more, bigger and better, he shows no restraint from destroying the last few virginal growths of these incredible giants. “It seems to affect some people in one way, while in others the effects are opposite. In the lungs there is ease of breath or there is difficulty of breath. In the heart we find pressure, shooting pains and symptoms from grief, or absence of symptoms and complete happiness. Blurry vision or clarity of vision.” Seq-s. is a sycotic remedy. Hydrogenoid propensity, overproduction of mucus, voracious appetite, rheumatic complaints. Wandering pains. Pains gripping, constrictive, aching. Stiff and tight feeling in body (Guai.). Feeling of well-being. Great exhaustion. Voracious appetite. Strong desire for whatever is available. Increased salivation. Fluid retention Absence of fluid being collected. Vision extremely clear. Blurred vision, worse wind. Worse lying, sitting, continued motion. MIND - Clarity of thought, as if a fog or haze had lifted in the mind. Feeling of well-being. Feels new and rejuvenated. Relaxed, in tense situations. Difficult concentration. Confusion. Confused by simple tasks. Overwhelming feeling of being old (Gink.). Feels cut down. Desires solitude. Aversion to company, desire to go somewhere where no one will bother. Sadness, hard to raise oneself to get up and go in the day. Sympathetic, takes on other peoples sufferings, only feels good while rescuing someone. Irritability, about trifles, about noises. Desire to scream that gets suppressed. Delusion of being fragile, as if she would emotionally fall apart. Delusion of being unappreciated. Delusion as if she is falling in love, of having a broken heart, as if his wife of many years never loves him. Time appeared to be slowed down.

Head - Headache between the eyes.

Ears - Outward pressing pain.

Nose - Burning pain in nasal passages. Sneezing.

Face - Looks much older. Sensation of fullness, as if more fluid were under the skin. Obstruction of facial sinuses. Pressing pain in maxillary area.

Mouth - Salivation increased. Bitter taste. Sensation of stiffness in jaws. Hard to articulate words that require more motion of the jaw.

Throat - Nausea felt in pit of throat. Vision - Objects have a haze to them. Edges of objects seem to swim. Vision, as if on a hallucinogenic drug. RELATIONS - Compare: (1) Lyc. REFERENCES - Birch. Rockwell.

Stomach - Nausea. Thirst diminished.

Abdomen - Burning pain in abdomen. Gripping pain in abdomen, worse after eating, motion, better after sleep.

Rectum - Constipation during menses. Flatulence, frequent, like rotten eggs. Loose and putrid stool.

Male - Sexual desire diminished.

Female - Menses starts and stops; copious.

Chest - Limp feeling in chest. Short sharp pain in right side of chest. Shooting pain in heart from being heart broken. Band of tightness in diaphragm, desire to stretch, which causes soreness.

Heart - Feeling as if he would die from a broken heart. Sensation of a wall of bricks and stones fall away from the heart and a yellow and white light encompass the heart.

Back - Pain extending down to hips and knees.

Limbs - Sharp pain in elbows, shoulders and feet. Sensation of tightness in hands and feet. Lungs - History of collapsed lungs, pneumonia. Feeling as though one couldn’t get enough airinto lungs, breathing deeper and deeper yet still wanted more. Asthmatic respiration, worse night, better steam and fresh air. Sore pain in lungs. Coughing up thick mucus. Feeling as if lungs are hyper-clear, as if more air can move in and out of the lungs.

Sleep - Sleepiness in the afternoon. Deep sleep, refreshing. Dreams, of being happy and finding someone who really loves them. Dreams of responsibility, of rescuing some children by the side of the road. Wakes unrefreshed; wakes in a sweat.

Skin - Eruptions, raised circular or oval bumps of a light brown discoloration. Itching, worse night.

Teeth - Desire to clench teeth, to scratch teeth.

Bladder - Pressing pain in bladder. Polyuria. Desire to urinate even after having just done so.

name: Serotonin
author: Murphy
constitution: Alcoholism. Alzheimer’s disease. Anxiety. Autism. Bipolar disorder. Bulimia. Clumsiness. Compulsive disorders. Depression. Drowsiness. Edema. Insomnia. Learning, disorders. Migraine. Nightmares. Palpitations. Restlessness. Schizophrenia. Suicidal. Twitching. Vertigo.
keynote:
PHARMACY - serot. Serotonin. A brain neurotransmitter. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Alzheimer’s disease. Anxiety. Autism. Bipolar disorder. Bulimia. Clumsiness. Compulsive disorders. Depression. Drowsiness. Edema. Insomnia. Learning, disorders.…
full:
PHARMACY - serot. Serotonin. A brain neurotransmitter. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Alcoholism. Alzheimer’s disease. Anxiety. Autism. Bipolar disorder. Bulimia. Clumsiness. Compulsive disorders. Depression. Drowsiness. Edema. Insomnia. Learning, disorders. Migraine. Nightmares. Palpitations. Restlessness. Schizophrenia. Suicidal. Twitching. Vertigo.

HOMEOPATHIC - Serotonin is aneurotrans- mitter produced in the brain known to influence the functioning of the cardiovascular, renal, immune, and gastrointestinal systems. In the nervous system, serotonin is believed to play an important role in the regulation of mood, sleep, vomiting, sexuality and appetite. Serotonin has been thought to play a part in many disorders, notably as part of the biochemistry of depression, migraine, bipolar disorder and anxiety. Recent research suggests that serotonin also plays an important role in liver regeneration. It is well known that abnormal serotonin levels can cause various types of sexual dysfunction such as anorgasmia, erectile dysfunction, and diminished libido. Serotonin also causes problems such as insomnia, depression, obesity, eating disorders, premenstrual syndrome, panic attacks, alcoholism, anxiety disorders, and bulimia. Serotonin, at increasing levels, stimulates nervous tension, drowsiness, heart palpitations, water retention and inability to concentrate and perform. Any disruption in the synthesis, metabolism or uptake of this neurotransmitter has been found to be responsible for certain manifestations of schizophrenia, depression, compulsive disorders and learning problems. Increase in brain levels of either of neurotransmitter, serotonin, produces a craving for alcohol, anger, or anxiety, especially for those who have a history of alcoholism. Drowsiness. Tiredness. Sustained rapid eye movement. Overreaction of the reflexes. Rapid muscle contraction and relaxation in the ankle causing abnormal movements of the foot. Clumsiness. Muscle contraction and relaxation in the jaw. Twitching of the muscles. Rigidity. High body temperature. Sweating. MIND - Euphoric feelings. Feelings of intoxication. Substance abuse. Impulsive behavior, recklessness, exhibitionism. Restlessness. Hostility, argumentative behavior. Violence, violent nightmares. Insomnia. Depression, anxiety, suicidal tendency. Psychosis. Schizophrenia, mood disorders. Organic brain disease, mental retardation, autism and Alzheimer’s. RELATIONS - Compare: Melat. REFERENCES - Murphy.

HOMEOPATHIC - Jousset considered Ser- ang. a specific in disorders of the heart and kidneys without much edema. Ser-ang. affects the kidneys, which becomes acutely affected, either from cold, infection or intoxication. The attack is characterized by oliguria, anuria and albuminuria. Jousset’s experiments have demonstrated the rapid hematuria, albuminuria and oliguria caused by it. But its really specific indication seems to be for sub-acute and acute nephritis. Repressed kidney function and sexuality. Acute nephritis with threatening uremia. Diuresis. Albuminuria. Kidney failure. Cardiac uremia. Hypertension and oliguria without edema. Heart diseases in cases of failure of compensation and impending asystole. Functional heart diseases. Mitral insufficiency. Asystole with or without edema, dyspnea and difficult urinary secretion. Warm-blooded. Chilliness when tired. Desire for warm room. Lymphoedema after operation on breast tumor. Elephantiasis. Faintness and nausea. MIND - Indifference and lack of will power. Irresolution. Every effort is too much. Aversion to change. Irritability and dissatisfaction with oneself. Nervousness. Restlessness. Sensitive to noises and odors. Anger from noise. Mental dullness. Difficult concentration. Memory weakness. Brain fatigue. Mental and physical symptoms better from appearance of menses.

Head - Congestive headaches, often onesided. Pressing sensation in head. Sensation as if head enlarged. Sudden heat in face and head.

Eyes - Sudden sparks before the eyes. Food - Appetite increased or decreased. Ravenous appetite in evening. Appetite decreased, thirst increased or vice versa. Desire for salty and pungent foods. Desire for coffee.

Throat - Dry feeling in pharynx. Vertigo - Dizziness on rising. Faintness and nausea. COMMENTS - The serum of the eel has a toxic action on the blood, rapidly destroying its globules. The presence of albumin and kidney elements in the urine, the hemoglobinuria. the prolonged anuria (24 and 26 hours), together with the results of the autopsy, plainly demonstrate its elective action on the kidneys. Secondarily, the liver and the heart are affected and the alteration observed are those usually present in infectious diseases. Boericke wrote, “When during the course of heart disease, the kidney, previously working well, should suddenly become af fected and its function inhibited and when besides we observe cardia irregularities and a marked state of asystole, we may yet expect good results from this serum. But to determine here the choice of this remedy is not an easy matter.” RELATIONS - Vip. Compare: ( 1 ) Dig., Lach., Apis. REFERENCES - Boericke. Rohrer.

Stomach - Eructations better after eating. Nausea concomitant with heart or kidney diseases.

Abdomen - Pain in abdomen when retaining urine.

Heart - Consciousness of heart. Oppression. Constriction. Stitches in heart. Palpitations. Cardiac uremia. Heart diseases with failure of compensation and impending asystole. Mitral insufficiency. Hypertension and oliguria without edema.

Limbs - Wandering joints pains. Pains wander from fingers to elbows and shoulders. Pains wander from toes to knees and hips. Restless legs, impossible to remain seated, must move.

Sleep - Dreams of traveling, of black snakes. Erotic dreams of naked women.

Modalities - Aversion to warm room. Worse deep inspiration, swallowing, bending head backward. Worse from noises and odors.

Kidneys - Kidney failure. Repressed kidney function. Acute nephritis. Uremia. Hematuria, albuminuria and oliguria.

Perspiration - Sweat smells sweetish.

full:
PHARMACY - sil-mar. Silica marina. Sea sand. Silica maritima. Trituration. Historical dose: All potencies.

CLINICAL - Abscess. Constipation. Glands, enlargement. Glands, suppuration. Gonorrhea. Tartar.

HOMEOPATHIC - W. B. Clarke of India napolis told of the use of Sil-mar. as a remedy for constipation. He used it in patients of all ages with excellent results, giving it in crude doses. W. B. Clarke’ s preparation was taken from the beach, just as it was left by the tide, on a pan of the coast many miles distant from a river estuary or a drained town. He preferred the rather coarse sand taken from a river sand-bar. He thought a finer variety may be better for younger patients. This was thoroughly washed and baked in an oven. The sand is taken plain or enclosed in capsules or made into pills. In either case it is washed down with water and water is to be drunk freely during the treatment. Sil-mar. has Sil. and Nat-m. symptoms. Inflamed glands and suppuration. Constipation. W. B. Clarke mentioned this case as the hardest he had encountered: a man, 60, had suffered for thirty years with severe constipation often sitting at stool for an hour and nearly fainting. He took a teaspoonful after dinner daily for a week without particular effect. Then he took it three times a day for a week. After this he was able to return to the one dose a day and soon required it but once a week. “The peculiarity of this treatment is the ease with which evacuation is accomplished after the first impression is made, the discharges being soft, mushy and yellow and the regular habit then seems established, for the treatment can then be discontinued.” If there is any return of the trouble, a dose or two more will be sufficient to put it right. This experience is of great value and interest as Sil. in the potencies (as well as Nat-m.) is a great constipation remedy. W. B. Clarke never observed any ill effects of the treatment. In the case of a child, age 4 to whom Cooper gave Sil-mar. 6x “a thick mass of tartar which had accumulated behind the front teeth came away in flakes. COMMENTS - Clarke had a specimen triturated and run up to the 30c potency. He had not long to wait for an opportunity of testing it. A tall, fair young man of 24, a violinist, presented himself with a mass of scrofulous glands on the right side of the neck softening at one point., Clarke gave him Sil-mar. 3c, three or four times a day and warned him not to poultice. The mass of glands soon began to diminish. The abscess matured and discharged itself through a minute opening and eventually healed without leaving a perceptible scar. The rest of the glands, in the meantime, disappeared. Sil-mar. 3c, three times a day, rapidly cured a case of gonorrhea in a patient who had many previous attacks, as well as stricture which had been treated with cauterizations and strong silver nitrate. It was this history which partly led Clarke to give the remedy on account of the Nairn. element contained in it. The discharge was creamy and there was tenderness in the middle of the urethra. For three days after commencing the Sil-mar. there was a sharp aggravation, the discharge became very profuse, was worse at night and accompanied by painful erections. Burnett told an interesting experience of his in which he was consulted about a boy who persisted in spite of punishment in eating sand when playing on the beach. Burnett Silica marina advised the parents to let the boy eat as much as he liked. He kept it up for a fortnight, at the end of which time he was vastly improved in health and he neither wanted nor ate any more sand from that day. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

author: Murphy
modalities: Modalities: Better warmth, warm room, warm wraps, especially around head. Better summer, wet or humid weather. Better from profuse urination. Better magnetism and electricity. Worse from moon changes, new moon, increasing moon and full moon. Worse night, in morning. Worse from vaccinations..

Fistula. Foot sweat, suppressed. Foreign bodies. Fractures. Ganglion. Gastric, catarrh. Glandular, swellings. Headaches. Hernia. Hip joint, disease. Homesickness. Housemaid’s, knee. Hydrocele. Hypopion. Iritis. Jaw, bone, decay. Keloids. Keratitis. Kyphosis. Lachrymal, fistula. Locomotor ataxia. Malnutrition. Mania. Ménière’s disease. Meningitis. Metritis. Metrorrhagia. Migraines. Miner’s, disease. Miscarriage. Molluscum, contagiosum. Morphinism. Morvan’s disease. Nails, problems. Nails, splitting. Necrosis. Neuralgias. Nodes. Panaritium. Perspiration, offensive. Phimosis. Pleurisy. Potts’ disease. Psoas, abscess. Pyorrhea. Rheumatism, chronic. Rickets. Scars. Sinuses. Sleepwalking. Spermatorrhea. Spina bifida. Spinal, curvature. Spinal, irritation. Strains. Strangury. Styes. Suppurations. Synovitis. Teeth, decay. Tenesmus. Tumors. Ulcers. Urethra, stricture. Urethritis. Urine, incontinence. Vaccination, effects. Vagina, spasms. Vertigo. Walking, late. Whitlow. Worms. Writer’s cramp. Wounds.

HOMEOPATHIC - Outside homeopathy, flint is practically unknown as an internal remedy. Hahnemann introduced it into medicine and it was his method of attenuating insoluble substances that enabled him to discover its powers. Sil. forms one of the most important remedies for chronic diseases. Want of grit, moral or physical. Proud flesh. Prostration of mind and body. Tendency to easy exhaustion and abnormal sweats. Defective nutrition due to imperfect assimilation, especially inchildren. Emacia- tion. Arrested development. Enlarged glands. Slow, incomplete inflammation of glands, cellular tissue and skin, then induration. Edema in morning. Cancer. Contracted sphincters. Cerebral softening. Diseases of bones and cartilages, decay and necrosis, softening of bones. Exostosis. Skin is unhealthy, every injury festers. Suppurative processes, stubborn, fistulous openings, abscesses. Pustulous burrowings. Ripens abscesses, promotes suppuration. Ailments attended withpusformation. Dis- charges offensive, pus, sweat, stools etc. Sil. can stimulate the organism to reabsorb fibrotic conditions and scar-tissue. Scars indurated, hard, nodular, shiny, glassy, tender with shooting pain. Keloid growth. J. Weir noted that it must be used with care in cases of tuberculosis as it may cause the absorption of scar tissue and liberate the disease. Removes foreign bodies. Neurasthenic states with increased susceptibility to nervous stimuli and exaggerated reflexes. Epilepsy, aura in the solar plexus creeping into the chest and stomach. Convulsions begin in the solar plexus, after vaccination. Feeling of coldness before spasms or epileptic attacks. Spinal curvature. Nervous disorders after spinal injury, especially when pressure on spine causes pain in remote parts. Hysteria, paralysis and obstinate neuralgias caused by dissipation, hard work with close confine- ment. Progressive locomotor ataxia. Organic changes, it is deep and slow in action. Periodical states. Ascending effects. Pains are violent and sticking, localized in ears, throat, ulcers etc. Parts lain on to go to sleep. Sensation as if she were divided into halves and left side does not belong to her. Sensation of a hair on tongue, in trachea. Generally cold, chilly, hugs the fire, wants plenty warm clothing, hates drafts, hands and feet cold, worse in winter. Want of vital heat even when exercising. Intolerance of alcoholic stimulants. Sensitive to pain, noise, starts at least noise. Restless, fidgety. Ill effects of vaccination. Scrofulous, rickety children with large heads, open fontanelles and sutures, distended hot and hard abdomen, slow in walking and wasted in body, especially legs. Children crawl nervously or are dragged in on their mother’s arms, on running they become pale. Cachectic and senile patients, persons of fair, clear complexion. MIND - Complaints from anticipation. Faint hearted, anxious. Nervous and excitable. Loss of self- confidence. Anticipates failure. Performance anxiety. Fear of speaking in front of a group (Arg-n., Gel., Lyc., Nairn.). Timidity about appearing in public. Irresolution. Bashful. Worries about their mind and its ability to perform. Undertakes nothing lest he fail. Mental acuteness with physical weakness and torpidity. Cannot express himself correctly. Mental confusion. Abstracted. Conscience about trifles. Fastidious for details. Inconstancy. Forgetfulness better after eating. Restlessness while sitting, on waking. Procrastinates, dread at any mental effort. Intellect lacks stability and clarity. Poor concentration, inability to focus, poor memory. Brain-fag of businessmen, lawyers, preachers and students. Brain exhaustion (Sulph., Cann., Arg-n., Lyc., Pic-ac.). Fear of literary work. Prostration of mind after writing. Can overexert their minds. Avoid things that take away their energy. Tendency to monitor energy function. Afraid of draining activities. Anxiety about health, worse during menopause. Fear of injury. Fear of becoming weak. Fear of being incapable. Sensitive to all impressions. Starts from slight noise. Timidity. Fidgety. Sensitive weeping mood. Cries when spoken to kindly. Yielding disposition. Lackscourage. Homesickness. Longing for his relations and home. Obstinate, stubborn, headstrong, in children. Mental dullness in children. Hopeless. Sad. Sullen. Disgust for life, wishes to drown herself. Melancholy and weariness of life during menses. Worse from mental exertion, talking, nervous excitement. Mild and yielding when calm but irritable and irascible when aroused. Intolerant of contradiction. Indisposed to talk loud. Screaming violently, groaning, in epilepsy. Fixed ideas. Fear ofneedles, pins and sharp objects. Thinks only of pins, searches for them, and counts them. Somnambulism during increase of moon.

Head - Chronic, periodical headaches since some severe disease. Migraines. Headaches located over one eye. Headache as if vertex will burst. Vertex throbs. Sick headaches as if coming from spine or occiput. Headache, then blindness. Headache while fasting or when not eating at proper time. Headache worse by exertion, study noise, motion, jar, light, cold air, talking and straining at stools. Headache better by wrapping warmly, binding and pressure. Profuse urination, relieves the headache. Swelling filled with grumous fluid between scalp and bone. Must keep head covered or catches a cold. Lumps on scalp. Profuse sweats on head. Moist crusty eruptions on the scalp. Premature falling of hair, baldness. Swelling of glabella. Cephalohematoma. Fontanelles open with distended abdomen.

Eyes - Eyestrain and headaches. Keratitis, pustular, perforating. Iritis and irido- choroiditis with pus in anterior chamber. Perforating or sloughing ulcer of cornea. Abscess in cornea after traumatic injury. Opacities of the cornea after smallpox. Cataracts and weak vision, from over use. Cataract in office workers after sup- pressed foot sweat. Inflammation of eyes. Sharp pain through eyes. Eyes tender to touch, worse when closed. Swelling of lachrymal duct. Stricture of lachrymal duct. Hypopyon. Angles of eyes affected. Affections of canthi, tear-ducts. Styes. Encysted tumors of lids. Aversion to light, especially daylight, it produces dazzling. Amblyopia from abuse of stimulants.

Ears - Earaches. Abscess. Boils. Otorrhea, fetid discharge. Crusty formations in ears. Perforated eardrum. Itching in ears when swallowing. Itching of outer ears. Shooting pain in left ear. Feeling of stoppage in the ear, better when yawning or swallowing. Decay of mastoid process. Child bores into its ears with fingers when asleep, causing a discharge of pus and blood. Sensitive to noise. Ménière’s disease. Hissing, roaring in ears. Hissing in perforated ear. Ringing in the ears or loss of hearing. Loud pistol-like report. Deafness, hears again with a loud report or on blowing the nose and coughing, worse full moon.

Nose - Obstinate colds, with ear affections. Sinusitis. Chronic catarrh and coryza. Coryza with nosebleed. Frothy nasal discharge. Acrid, excoriating discharge. Sneezing in morning. Obstructed and loss of smell. Burning, shooting pain. Drawing pain in root of nose and right malar bone. Nose, dry, cold. Sore, sensitive nasal bones. Itching at tip of nose. Herpetic eruption around nostrils and lips. Ulcers high up in nose. Cracks in nostrils. Perforation of septum. Dry, hard crusts form, bleeding when loosened. Nosebleed in infants. Dryness and stoppage after suppressed foot sweat.

Face - Pale, cachectic, waxy. Red spots on cheeks with burning heat. Lupus. Burning about mouth. Skin of face cracks. Cracks in lips, on skin of face. Indurated fissures at the corners of lips. Cancer of lower lip. Comedones. Eruptions on chin. Herpes on chin. Rheumatic pain in jaw and decayed teeth. Swelling of jaw. Swelling of maxillary glands. Parotid glands swollen (Bell., Rhus-t., Calc.), enlarged. Facial neuralgia, throbbing, tearing, face red, worse cold damp. Boring, tearing pains.

Mouth - Saliva runs out of mouth. Inflammation and suppuration of salivary glands. Offensive odor from mouth in morning. Water tastes badly, vomits after drinking. Dryness of mouth. Sores in mouth. Sore mouth, gangrenous with perforating ulcer of palate. Abscess at the root of the teeth. Pyorrhea. Boils on gums (Merc- c.). Gums sensitive to cold air. Sensitive to cold water.

Throat - Sore throat. Burning in throat. Chronic pharyngitis. Periodical quinsy. Colds settle in throat. Tonsillitis. Tonsils swollen, suppurating. Pricking as ofapin in tonsil. Enlarged thyroid gland. Right lobe of thyroid gland swollen, having the appearance of an elastic cyst. Swallowing is painful, stinging, difficult, hysterical. Sticking pain on swallowing or on touch. Food is ejected through nose, when swallowing. Swelling of larynx. Roughness and soreness in larynx. Tickling in larynx causes slight cough and hoarseness. Foreign bodies in larynx. Hawks foul lumps. Bittertaste. Husky voice, worse mornings with chronic coryza. Hoarseness.

Stomach - Anguish in pit of stomach, with attacks of melancholy. Pit of stomach painful to pressure. Gnawing, twisting pain in epigastrium, worse by pressure. Sensation as if a cold stone were in stomach. Sensation of emptiness in stomach, with nausea. Induration of pylorus. Slow and painful digestion. Griping in stomach after eating. Screwing, pressing, twisting pain in stomach after drinking. Swallowing food easily gets into posterior sinuses. Burning or throbbing in pit. Intense heartburn. Sour belchings after eating (Sep., Calc.). Nausea, with good appetite. Nausea during sex in females. Nausea and vomiting during pregnancy. Vomiting after drinking (Ars., Bism., Verat.). Sour vomiting. Vomiting of food at night. Water brash with chilliness.

Abdomen - Hard, bloated. Distended, hard and hot, with thin legs, especially in children. Abdomen feels thick and heavy like a weight. Clothing across abdomen feels too tight, after eating. Tightness transversely across abdomen. Pain or painful cold feeling in abdomen, better external heat. Soreness of abdominal walls. Cracks on abdominal wall. Much rumbling in bowels. Flatulence with much rumbling. Ascites with great effusion, with frequent attacks of watery diarrhea. Flatulence incarcerated with constipation. Colic, cutting pain with constipation. Colic from worms. Inguinal glands swollen and painful. Inguinal hernia.

Rectum - Feels as if rectum is paralyzed. Constant but ineffectual desire for stool. Straining with soft stools, with exhaustion. Great straining, rectum stings, closes upon stool. Feces remain a long time in rectum. Itching in rectum and anus during stool. Moist anus, foul flatus. Chronic diarrhea. Diarrhea after milk. Diarrhea of cadaverous odor. Constipation always before and during menses. Burning, smarting and pressing in anus, after stool. Pain in anus as if constricted during stool. Painful spasms of sphincter. Cutting, cramping pain in rectum extending to testes, worse sex. Fistula in anus (Berb., Lach.), alternating with chest symptoms. Painful hemorrhoids, protrude during stool. Sensation as of a heavy lump in anus during menses. Tapeworm. Sensations - As if she would die. As if beaten all over. As if he had lain in an uncomfortable position. As if gradually losing senses. As if feeling for pins. Sensation as if she were divided into halves and that the left side does not belong to her. As if head would burst with throbbing in it internal and external at same time. As if forehead would be torn asunder, as from a heavy weight over eyes. As if head were forced asunder. As of a splinter in finger. As if a panaritium would form in index finger. As if fingertips were suppurating. As if finger were thick and bone enlarged. As if joints of fingers were being pulled out of sockets. Nails as if decayed.

Stool - Stools comes out with difficulty when partly expelled, recedes again. Stools retained for fear of pain. Stools offensive, painless, lienteric, of cadaverous odor. Stool composed of hard lumps, light-colored and very hard.

Male - Burning and soreness of genitals. Squeezing pain in testes. Sharp pricking pain in penis. Itching moist spots on scrotum. Elephantiasis of scrotum. Hydrocele. Painful eruptions in pubic region. Chronic urethritis with twisting pain. Prostate gland enlarged. Discharge of prostatic fluid when straining at stool. Burning in prepuce after stool. Sexual desire increases or decreases. Sexual weakness, nocturnal emissions Extreme exhaustion after sex, takes 8 to 10 days to recover. Worse after sex, sensation on right side of head as if paralyzed. Chronic gonorrhea with thick, foul, urethral discharge.

Female - Amenorrhea. Watery discharge instead of menses. Early, scanty menses. Increased menses with paroxysms of icy coldness over whole body. Menses strong-smelling, acrid. Discharge of blood between menstrual periods. Discharge of blood from vagina every time child is nursed. Leucorrhea milky (Calc., Puls., Sep.). Leucorrhea acrid gushing, worse during urination. Burning and soreness about vulva. Cutting pain around the navel with leucorrhea. Cutting upward in vagina, worse urinating. Vaginal cysts (Lyc., Puls., Rhod.). Abscess of labia. Itching of vulva and vagina, very sensitive. Pressing-down feeling in vagina. Prolapsus uteri in consequence of myelitis. Salpingitis with accumulation of pus or serum that escapes from uterus from time to time. Nausea during sex. Nymphomania. Sterility. Miscarriage or no conception due to weakness. Too violent motion of fetus. After-pains felt in hips. Promotes expulsion of moles. Food - Want of appetite, thirst excessive. Loss of appetite and of taste. Voracious appetite, but disappears on attempting to eat or loathing of food. Desires only cold things, ice cream, ice water, feels comfortable when it is in stomach. Aversion to cooked or warm food and meat. Disgust for meat and warm food, milk. Pain in head better while eating. Worse after eating. Aversion to mother’s milk, child vomits as soon as it nurses. Milk, aggravates, causes diarrhea and vomiting. Drinking cold water causes dry cough. Warm drinks improves cough, causes sweat about head and face. Water tastes badly. Intolerance of alcoholic stimulants.

Chest - General sensation of weakness in chest, can hardly speak (Stann.). Can’t breathe deeply without chest pain. Sticking pain in chest on inspiration. Bruised pain in chest on coughing. Stitches in chest, through the back. Painless throbbing in sternum. Tight feeling around chest, as if tied in with tape. Pressure at lower sternum as from a stone. Eruption like varicella, covering chest and itching violently. Axillary glands swollen, enlarged. Offensive axillary sweat. Constitutions - Demineralized constitution. Constitutions that suffer from deficient nutrition due to lack of assimilating power, oversensitive physically and mentally. Children with large heads, open fontanelles and sutures, much sweating about the head, which must be kept warm. Distended abdomen, weak ankles, slow in learning to walk. Nervous, irritable persons with dry skin, profuse saliva, diarrhea, and night sweats. Weakly persons, fine skin, pale face, light complexion, lax muscles. Scrofulous children who have worm diseases during dentition. Stonecutters’ ailments, chest disorders and total loss of strength.

Heart - Circulation easily agitated. Heart troubles from nervous exhaustion. Throbbing all over the body, when sitting or while in motion. Palpitations while sitting, with trembling of hand. Violent hammering palpitation, after every quick or violent motion. Orgasm of blood at night, throbbing in all vessels. Pulse small, hard, rapid. Pulse irregular and thenslow. Pulse imperceptible.

Back - Constant aching in center of spine. Spinal irritation after injuries to spine. Spine, weak, very sensitive to drafts on back. Spina bifida. Spinal curvature. Painful kyphosis. Pott’s disease. Decay of vertebrae. Diseases of bones of spine. Backache as from riding in carriages for a long time. Burning in back, when body is being heated, after walking in open air. Rheumatism. Aching, beating, throbbing, in lumbosacral region. Coccyx hurts after riding. Painful coccyx. Lameness in region of sacrum. Stiff neck with headache. Haid, cold swelling of cervical glands. Boils or carbuncles.

Limbs - Pott’s disease. Psoas abscess. Felons, deep-seated pain. Axillary glands swollen, enlarged. Ulcers around the joints. Sciatica, pains through the hips, legs and feet. The parts lain on go to sleep. Limbs distorted during convulsion. Slovenly gait. Legs feel paralyzed, trembling while walking. Loss of power in legs. Pain in knee, as if tightly bound. Calves tense and contacted. Cramp in calves and soles. Weak ankles and feet. Icy cold and sweaty feet. Voluptuous tingling in soles. Soreness in feet from instep through to the sole (Ruta.). Pain beneath toes. Bunions. Soft corns in between toes. Distorted ingrown, yellow nails. Affections °f fingernails, especially if white spots on nails. Nails, splitting. Nails, rough, yellow, crippled, brittle, white spots, blue in fever. Fingertips, as if suppurating, painful, dry, at night. Tremulous hands when using them. Paralytic weakness of forearm. Panaritium. Arms (left) shake before epilepsy.

Lightning-like flashes during headache. Dim vision and flickering, worse after headache. Dim vision after suppressed foot sweat. COMMENTS - Sea sand (Sil-mar.) is mainly composed of silica. The spicules of many sponges are made up of silica. Silicates are taken up by plants and silica is often deposited on the surface or in the interior of their stems. The strength of straw is due to silica. Equisetum generally contains as much as 18 percent silica. Flint supplies the “grit” of the earth’s crust, of plant life and to a large extent of animal life also. Schussler, who was a homeopath before he was a biochemist, noted that silicic acid, from the tissue remedy point of view, is a constituent of the cells of the connective tissue or the epidermis, the hair and the nails. It may be used if a suppurative center is formed either in the connective tissue or in a portion of the skin. These cells are thereby enabled to throw off inimical substances (the pus). In consequences, the pus is either absorbed by the lymphatics or it is cast out. In the latter case there is a breaking open of the suppurative center. Sil. may also cause an effusion of blood in any tissue to be absorbed through the lymphatics. Teste put Sil. in his Puls, group of remedies, the other members of it being Calc., Hep., Graph., and Phos. According to Teste, Sil. is the “chronic” of Puls. HOMEOPATHIC - The leaves of this plant, when they first come up, present their faces uniformly north and south, later on, when the leaves become heavy, the winds cany them in different directions and the polarity is not to be observed. The stem of the plant exudes an abundance of resin, as some of its names indicate. Cooper used Silphu. in single doses of tincture with notable effect in cases of cancer of the throat and mouth. The great “sensation of emptiness” of the proving shows a relation to the cancer cachexia. Hale mentioned that Silphu. has been used in all forms of asthma and in chronic bronchitis with large quantities of stringy, Silphium laciniatum frothy, light-colored mucus and in catarrh of the bladder. Catarrhal influenza. Dysentery, attack preceded by constipated stools covered with white mucus.

Nose - Irritation extends from throat up posterior sinuses to nose causing sneezing, followed by discharge of limpid, acrid mucus. Constriction and pressure in supra-orbital region.

Mouth - Tongue, whitish slimy coat, with dry sensation as if burned with hot soup.

Throat - Scraping, tickling and irritation of fauces and throat. Desire to hawk and scrape throat and throw off a thin viscid mucus. Engorgement and thickening of mucus membrane of throat extending down. COMMENTS - Hale gave the case of Mr. H., 55, who had tuberculosis for twenty years. On the slightest exposure or cold he would have congestion of mucus surfaces, followed by copious expectoration of stringy, frothy, light-colored mucus (from one to three pints in twenty-four hours). Rapid exhaustion, at times keeping him in bed for weeks. Silphu. 2x trituration was used, 2 grains every two hours. During the next night, less than a tea cupful of mucus was raised and its sudden decrease alarmed the patient so much that he left off the remedy until his doctor assured him that he was very much better and thatM the remedy had been more successful than he himself had expected. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Aral., Cop., Just., Tereb., Cub., Samb. (2) Silpho. - tuberculosis pulmonum with incessant cough, profuse night-sweats, emaciation. (3) Polyg-a. has been found useful in tuberculosis, when given in material doses of the mother tincture, salvia tickling cough. (4) Arum-d. - loose cough at night on lying down. (5) Just. - bronchial catarrh, hoarseness, oversensitive. REFERENCES - Boericke. Clarke.

Rectum - Stool natural, but covered with slimy mucus.

Chest - Constriction and tightness of chest. Hacking, spasmodic cough.

Kidneys - Frequent urination with sense of heat or burning at meatus during urination. Urine, high-colored, scanty. Lungs - Constriction of lungs. Catarrh with copious, stringy, mucus discharges. Irritation of posterior sinuses involving mucus membranes of nasal passages with constriction of supra-orbital region. Cough with expectoration, profuse, stringy, frothy, light-colored. PHARMACY - sima. Simaruba amara. Mountain damson. Simaruba officinalis. Simaruba glauca. N. O. Simarubacae. West Indies and tropical America. Tincture of the dried root-bark. Historical dose: Tincture and all potencies.

CLINICAL - Diarrhea. Dysentery. Snakebite. Worms.

HERBAL - Simaruba bark is used as a bitter tonic and as a local remedy for dysentery and diarrhea. The part used is the bark, which is really the rind of the root of which, domestically, a decoction is made. “In large doses,” said the Treasury of Botany, “it is said to actas an emetic, purgative and diaphoretic.” Simaruba versicolor, a Brazilian species, has similar properties. The fruits and bark are used as anthelmintics, an infusion of the latter is employed in cases of snakebite. The plant is so bitter that insects will not attack it, on which account the powdered root has been used to kill vermin. Simaruba glauca, a native of Cuba, furnishes a glutinous juice which is employed in certain cases of skin- disease. And it is well to remember that Cedrón, which is “Simaba Cedrón,” belongs to the same order. COMMENTS - Clarke’s first practical acquaintance with Sima, as a homeopathic remedy was in the case of a traveling patient who suffered from a chronic tendency to looseness of the bowels. He had stools like yellow ochre, for which Gamb. had been very helpful. When in the south of France, he consulted Simaruba amara a homeopath who prescribed Sima, with excellent effect. Since then, Clarke used it in similar cases. H. H. Beamish said that for dysentery the simaruba bark is boiled and, by way of strengthening the astringent effect. Alum is added to the decoction. But Simaruba is the specific agent. RELATIONS - Compare: ( 1 ) Cedr., Ail., Chap., Quas. (2) Vac., Chin., Rheum. Gamb. REFERENCES-Clarke.
